1.en: AI Trends & Their Effects on Education and Society
1.zh: 人工智慧趨勢及其對教育與社會的影響

items.def: to make a machine or computer do a job without people
items.s: Many banks now ________ simple customer questions with smart software, so staff can spend more time on difficult problems.
items.zh: 許多銀行現在用智慧軟體將簡單的顧客問題自動化,因此員工能花更多時間處理困難的問題。
items.sec: AI & Technology Basics 人工智慧與科技基礎

items.def: the use of machines and computers to do work
items.s: Thanks to ________ in the factory, the cars are built much faster, but some workers worry about losing their jobs.
items.zh: 多虧了工廠裡的自動化,汽車的製造速度快了許多,但有些工人擔心會失去工作。
items.sec: AI & Technology Basics 人工智慧與科技基礎

items.def: the science of designing and building robots
items.s: My cousin joined the school ________ club last year, and now he can build a small robot that follows a black line.
items.zh: 我表弟去年加入了學校的機器人社團,現在他能做出一台會沿著黑線前進的小機器人。
items.sec: AI & Technology Basics 人工智慧與科技基礎

items.def: a mistake in a computer program
items.s: The new game kept crashing because of a small ________ in the code, so the company quickly released an update.
items.zh: 這款新遊戲因為程式碼中的一個小程式錯誤而一直當機,所以公司很快就發布了更新。
items.sec: AI & Technology Basics 人工智慧與科技基礎

items.def: programs that tell a computer what to do
items.s: Our school bought new learning ________ for every classroom, but the teachers needed a week of training before using it.
items.zh: 我們學校為每間教室購買了新的學習軟體,但老師們在使用前需要一週的培訓。
items.sec: AI & Technology Basics 人工智慧與科技基礎

items.def: the physical parts of a computer, like the screen and keyboard
items.s: The ________ in the computer lab is very old, so the new AI programs run slowly and often freeze.
items.zh: 電腦教室裡的硬體非常老舊,所以新的人工智慧程式跑得很慢,而且常常當機。
items.sec: AI & Technology Basics 人工智慧與科技基礎

items.def: a person who writes computer programs
items.s: My uncle works as a ________ at a tech company, and he spends most of his day writing and testing code.
items.zh: 我叔叔在一家科技公司擔任程式設計師,他一天大部分的時間都在寫程式和測試程式碼。
items.sec: AI & Technology Basics 人工智慧與科技基礎

items.def: writing instructions for a computer
items.s: Some primary schools now teach ________ to young children because they believe it helps them think step by step.
items.zh: 有些小學現在教小孩子寫程式,因為他們認為這能幫助孩子一步一步地思考。
items.sec: AI & Technology Basics 人工智慧與科技基礎

items.def: a large collection of information used by a computer
items.s: The company trained its AI on a huge ________ of photos, but the system still made mistakes with darker images.
items.zh: 這家公司用一個龐大的照片資料集訓練它的人工智慧,但系統在較暗的圖片上仍然會出錯。
items.sec: AI & Technology Basics 人工智慧與科技基礎

items.def: an organised collection of information stored on a computer
items.s: The library keeps all its book records in an online ________, so students can check if a book is available from home.
items.zh: 圖書館把所有的書籍紀錄存放在線上資料庫裡,所以學生在家就能查詢某本書是否可借。
items.sec: AI & Technology Basics 人工智慧與科技基礎

items.def: the use or study of computers
items.s: Modern AI needs a great deal of ________ power, so tech companies are building huge data centres around the world.
items.zh: 現代人工智慧需要大量的運算能力,所以科技公司正在世界各地興建巨大的資料中心。
items.sec: AI & Technology Basics 人工智慧與科技基礎

items.def: the main part of a computer that does calculations
items.s: My old laptop has a slow ________, so it takes almost a minute to open a video editing program.
items.zh: 我的舊筆電有一顆很慢的處理器,所以打開影片剪輯程式幾乎要花一分鐘。
items.sec: AI & Technology Basics 人工智慧與科技基礎

items.def: a very small piece of material inside electronic devices
items.s: Taiwan makes many of the world's most advanced computer ________s, and these are used in phones and AI servers.
items.zh: 台灣製造許多世界上最先進的電腦晶片,而這些晶片被用在手機和人工智慧伺服器中。
items.sec: AI & Technology Basics 人工智慧與科技基礎

items.def: a powerful computer that stores data and runs services for others
items.s: The online exam stopped for twenty minutes because the ________ crashed, so the teacher gave everyone extra time.
items.zh: 線上考試停擺了二十分鐘,因為伺服器當機了,所以老師給大家延長了時間。
items.sec: AI & Technology Basics 人工智慧與科技基礎

items.def: online storage and services on distant computers
items.s: I save all my school projects in the ________, so I can open them on my phone even if my laptop breaks.
items.zh: 我把所有學校作業都存在雲端,所以即使筆電壞了,我也能用手機打開它們。
items.sec: AI & Technology Basics 人工智慧與科技基礎

items.def: to make a machine or program newer and better
items.s: We decided to ________ our home computer last month, because the old one could not run the new translation app.
items.zh: 我們上個月決定把家裡的電腦升級,因為舊電腦跑不動新的翻譯應用程式。
items.sec: AI & Technology Basics 人工智慧與科技基礎

items.def: to put a program onto a computer or phone
items.s: Before the class started, the teacher asked us to ________ the learning app, but my phone did not have enough space.
items.zh: 上課開始前,老師要我們安裝學習應用程式,但我的手機空間不夠。
items.sec: AI & Technology Basics 人工智慧與科技基礎

items.def: the part of a program that a user sees and uses
items.s: The new app has a simple ________ with large buttons, so even my grandparents can use it without help.
items.zh: 這個新應用程式有一個簡單的介面,按鈕很大,所以連我的祖父母都能自己使用。
items.sec: AI & Technology Basics 人工智慧與科技基礎

items.def: a device that notices light, heat, movement or sound
items.s: The smart light in our hallway has a ________ that notices movement, so it turns on when someone walks past at night.
items.zh: 我們走廊的智慧燈有一個能偵測動作的感測器,所以晚上有人經過時燈就會亮起。
items.sec: AI & Technology Basics 人工智慧與科技基礎

items.def: existing on a computer, not in the real world
items.s: Our class took a ________ tour of a museum in Paris, and we could look around every room without leaving Taipei.
items.zh: 我們班參加了巴黎一間博物館的虛擬導覽,我們不用離開台北就能逛遍每個展間。
items.sec: AI & Technology Basics 人工智慧與科技基礎

items.def: using computer technology
items.s: More and more students read ________ textbooks on tablets, but some say paper books are easier on their eyes.
items.zh: 越來越多學生在平板上閱讀數位課本,但有些人說紙本書對眼睛比較好。
items.sec: AI & Technology Basics 人工智慧與科技基礎

items.def: to change paper documents or pictures into computer files
items.s: The city library plans to ________ its old newspapers, so researchers can search them online instead of visiting in person.
items.zh: 市立圖書館計畫將舊報紙數位化,這樣研究人員就能上網搜尋,而不必親自到館。
items.sec: AI & Technology Basics 人工智慧與科技基礎

items.def: made by people, not natural
items.s: The robot dog looks friendly, but its ________ fur feels strange when you touch it, so my little sister was scared.
items.zh: 這隻機器狗看起來很友善,但牠的人造毛摸起來很奇怪,所以我妹妹嚇到了。
items.sec: AI & Technology Basics 人工智慧與科技基礎

items.def: related to or like a robot
items.s: The hospital uses a ________ arm during some operations, because it can make very small and steady movements.
items.zh: 這家醫院在某些手術中使用機器手臂,因為它能做出非常細微又穩定的動作。
items.sec: AI & Technology Basics 人工智慧與科技基礎

items.def: to copy how something happens in real life using a computer
items.s: Pilots practise in machines that ________ bad weather, so they know what to do before they face a real storm.
items.zh: 飛行員在能模擬惡劣天氣的機器裡練習,這樣他們在遇到真正的暴風雨之前就知道該怎麼做。
items.sec: AI & Technology Basics 人工智慧與科技基礎

items.def: a computer copy of a real situation used for practice or study
items.s: The science teacher showed us a ________ of an earthquake, and we could see how different buildings shake and fall.
items.zh: 自然老師給我們看了一段地震的模擬,我們可以看到不同的建築物如何搖晃和倒塌。
items.sec: AI & Technology Basics 人工智慧與科技基礎

items.def: the amount of data an internet connection can carry
items.s: Our home internet does not have enough ________, so the video keeps stopping when my brother and I are online together.
items.zh: 我們家的網路頻寬不夠,所以當我和哥哥同時上網時,影片一直卡住。
items.sec: AI & Technology Basics 人工智慧與科技基礎

items.def: a small problem that stops something working properly
items.s: A ________ in the school's website showed the wrong exam dates, but the office fixed it before anyone got confused.
items.zh: 學校網站上的一個小故障顯示了錯誤的考試日期,但辦公室在任何人搞混之前就修好了。
items.sec: AI & Technology Basics 人工智慧與科技基礎

items.def: to fail to work in the correct way
items.s: The self-checkout machine began to ________ during the busy lunch hour, so a staff member had to help every customer.
items.zh: 自助結帳機在忙碌的午餐時間開始故障,所以一位店員必須幫每位顧客結帳。
items.sec: AI & Technology Basics 人工智慧與科技基礎

items.def: the first model of a new product, made for testing
items.s: The students built a ________ of a smart trash can, and although it was rough, the judges liked their idea.
items.zh: 學生們做了一個智慧垃圾桶的原型,雖然還很粗糙,但評審很喜歡他們的點子。
items.sec: AI & Technology Basics 人工智慧與科技基礎

items.def: the right to keep your personal life secret
items.s: Many parents worry about their children's ________, because some apps collect photos and locations without asking clearly.
items.zh: 許多家長擔心孩子的隱私,因為有些應用程式在沒有清楚詢問的情況下收集照片和位置。
items.sec: Data, Privacy & Security 數據、隱私與安全

items.def: the careful watching of people, often by cameras
items.s: The city added more ________ cameras near the station, and although crime dropped, some people felt they were always being watched.
items.zh: 市政府在車站附近增設了更多監視攝影機,雖然犯罪減少了,但有些人覺得自己一直被盯著。
items.sec: Data, Privacy & Security 數據、隱私與安全

items.def: a person who breaks into computer systems
items.s: A ________ broke into the shop's website last week, so the owner told all customers to change their passwords.
items.zh: 上週一名駭客入侵了這家店的網站,所以店主告訴所有顧客要更改密碼。
items.sec: Data, Privacy & Security 數據、隱私與安全

items.def: to secretly get into someone's computer or account
items.s: Someone tried to ________ my email account, but the system sent me a warning, so I changed my password at once.
items.zh: 有人試圖駭入我的電子郵件帳號,但系統傳了警告給我,所以我立刻更改了密碼。
items.sec: Data, Privacy & Security 數據、隱私與安全

items.def: an attack on computer systems through the internet
items.s: The hospital's computers stopped working after a ________, so doctors had to write patient notes by hand for two days.
items.zh: 醫院的電腦在一次網路攻擊後停止運作,所以醫生們有兩天必須手寫病人的紀錄。
items.sec: Data, Privacy & Security 數據、隱私與安全

items.def: changing data into a secret code so others cannot read it
items.s: This messaging app uses strong ________, so even the company itself cannot read the messages that users send.
items.zh: 這個通訊應用程式使用強大的加密技術,所以連公司本身都無法讀取使用者傳送的訊息。
items.sec: Data, Privacy & Security 數據、隱私與安全

items.def: to put information into a secret code
items.s: You should ________ important files before you send them online, because anyone could read them if they are stolen.
items.zh: 你在網路上傳送重要檔案之前應該先將它們加密,因為萬一被偷,任何人都能讀取。
items.sec: Data, Privacy & Security 數據、隱私與安全

items.def: a secret word or set of letters used to enter an account
items.s: My brother uses the same ________ for every website, but I told him that this makes it easy for hackers.
items.zh: 我哥哥在每個網站都用同一組密碼,但我告訴他這樣會讓駭客很容易得手。
items.sec: Data, Privacy & Security 數據、隱私與安全

items.def: an event where private information is stolen or shown
items.s: After a data ________ at the online store, thousands of customers' phone numbers appeared on the internet, so many people were angry.
items.zh: 那家網路商店發生資料外洩後,數千名顧客的電話號碼出現在網路上,因此許多人非常生氣。
items.sec: Data, Privacy & Security 數據、隱私與安全

items.def: to let secret information become known
items.s: An employee ________ed the details of the new phone before its launch, and the company lost its big surprise.
items.zh: 一名員工在新手機發表前洩漏了它的細節,公司因此失去了大驚喜。
items.sec: Data, Privacy & Security 數據、隱私與安全

items.def: permission to do something
items.s: The school must get parents' ________ before it posts students' photos online, because some families want to protect their privacy.
items.zh: 學校在網路上張貼學生照片之前必須取得家長的同意,因為有些家庭想保護他們的隱私。
items.sec: Data, Privacy & Security 數據、隱私與安全

items.def: to follow where someone goes or what they do
items.s: Many free apps ________ what you click and buy, and then they sell this information to advertising companies.
items.zh: 許多免費應用程式會追蹤你點擊和購買的東西,然後把這些資訊賣給廣告公司。
items.sec: Data, Privacy & Security 數據、隱私與安全

items.def: to watch or check something over a period of time
items.s: Some companies use software to ________ how long workers spend on each task, but many employees say it feels unfair.
items.zh: 有些公司使用軟體來監控員工在每項任務上花了多少時間,但許多員工說這感覺不公平。
items.sec: Data, Privacy & Security 數據、隱私與安全

items.def: with a name that is not known or not shown
items.s: The class survey was ________, so students felt free to say what they really thought about using AI for homework.
items.zh: 這份班級問卷是匿名的,所以學生們能自在地說出他們對用人工智慧寫作業的真實想法。
items.sec: Data, Privacy & Security 數據、隱私與安全

items.def: who a person is; their name and personal details
items.s: Criminals stole her ________ by using her ID number online, and she spent months fixing her bank records.
items.zh: 罪犯在網路上盜用她的身分證號碼竊取了她的身分,她花了好幾個月才處理好銀行紀錄。
items.sec: Data, Privacy & Security 數據、隱私與安全

items.def: to check that something is true or correct
items.s: The bank sends a code to your phone to ________ that it is really you, so strangers cannot easily use your account.
items.zh: 銀行會傳一組代碼到你的手機來驗證真的是你本人,所以陌生人無法輕易使用你的帳戶。
items.sec: Data, Privacy & Security 數據、隱私與安全

items.def: the process of proving who you are to a system
items.s: Two-step ________ takes a few more seconds, but it makes your social media account much safer from hackers.
items.zh: 雙重身分驗證多花幾秒鐘,但它能讓你的社群帳號更不容易被駭客入侵。
items.sec: Data, Privacy & Security 數據、隱私與安全

items.def: a system that blocks dangerous traffic from the internet
items.s: The company set up a stronger ________ after the attack, and since then no strangers have entered its network.
items.zh: 公司在遭受攻擊後架設了更強的防火牆,從那之後就沒有外人再闖入它的網路。
items.sec: Data, Privacy & Security 數據、隱私與安全

items.def: harmful software that damages computers or steals data
items.s: I clicked a strange link in a message, and ________ quickly spread through my computer and deleted many files.
items.zh: 我點了訊息裡一個奇怪的連結,結果惡意軟體迅速擴散到我的電腦並刪除了許多檔案。
items.sec: Data, Privacy & Security 數據、隱私與安全

items.def: a program that copies itself and harms computers
items.s: My dad's laptop got a ________ from a free game website, so now it opens strange pop-up windows all the time.
items.zh: 我爸爸的筆電從一個免費遊戲網站中了病毒,所以現在它一直跳出奇怪的視窗。
items.sec: Data, Privacy & Security 數據、隱私與安全

items.def: unwanted messages sent to many people
items.s: I get dozens of ________ emails every day, but luckily my email app moves most of them into a separate folder.
items.zh: 我每天收到幾十封垃圾郵件,但幸好我的郵件程式會把大部分移到另一個資料夾。
items.sec: Data, Privacy & Security 數據、隱私與安全

items.def: a dishonest plan to get money from people
items.s: My grandmother almost fell for a phone ________ that used an AI copy of my voice, but she called me to check first.
items.zh: 我奶奶差點落入一通用人工智慧模仿我聲音的電話詐騙,但她先打電話給我確認。
items.sec: Data, Privacy & Security 數據、隱私與安全

items.def: fake messages that try to steal passwords or bank details
items.s: The email looked like it came from our bank, but it was a ________ attack, so I deleted it without clicking anything.
items.zh: 那封電子郵件看起來像是銀行寄來的,但它其實是網路釣魚攻擊,所以我什麼都沒點就把它刪了。
items.sec: Data, Privacy & Security 數據、隱私與安全

items.def: a small file a website saves to remember your activity
items.s: Every time I open a news website, it asks me to accept ________s, but I usually say no because I do not want to be tracked.
items.zh: 每次我打開新聞網站,它都會要求我接受Cookie,但我通常會拒絕,因為我不想被追蹤。
items.sec: Data, Privacy & Security 數據、隱私與安全

items.def: using body features like fingerprints or faces to identify people
items.s: The airport now uses ________ gates that scan your face, so passengers can pass through security much more quickly.
items.zh: 機場現在使用會掃描臉部的生物辨識閘門,所以旅客能更快地通過安檢。
items.sec: Data, Privacy & Security 數據、隱私與安全

items.def: the pattern of lines on the tip of your finger
items.s: I unlock my phone with my ________, but it does not work when my hands are wet after swimming.
items.zh: 我用指紋解鎖手機,但游泳後手濕濕的時候就沒辦法用。
items.sec: Data, Privacy & Security 數據、隱私與安全

items.def: related to the face
items.s: Some schools use ________ scanning to take attendance, but many parents think this collects too much personal data.
items.zh: 有些學校用臉部掃描來點名,但許多家長認為這蒐集了太多個人資料。
items.sec: Data, Privacy & Security 數據、隱私與安全

items.def: meant to be kept secret
items.s: The doctor said patient records are ________, so they should never be typed into a public chatbot.
items.zh: 醫生說病歷是機密的,所以絕不應該輸入到公開的聊天機器人裡。
items.sec: Data, Privacy & Security 數據、隱私與安全

items.def: to protect something from harm or loss
items.s: New laws aim to ________ children's personal information, because young users often share too much online.
items.zh: 新法律旨在保護兒童的個人資訊,因為年輕使用者經常在網路上分享太多。
items.sec: Data, Privacy & Security 數據、隱私與安全

items.def: an extra copy of data kept in case the original is lost
items.s: Luckily I had a ________ of my science report, because my laptop broke the night before it was due.
items.zh: 幸好我有科學報告的備份,因為我的筆電在截止前一晚壞掉了。
items.sec: Data, Privacy & Security 數據、隱私與安全

items.def: a computer program that talks with people using text or voice
items.s: When I had a question about my order late at night, a ________ answered me at once, but it could not solve the problem.
items.zh: 我深夜對訂單有疑問時,一個聊天機器人立刻回覆了我,但它沒辦法解決問題。
items.sec: Generative AI & Digital Tools 生成式AI與數位工具

items.def: the instruction or question you type into an AI tool
items.s: If you write a clear ________ with details, the AI gives better answers, but a short vague question often gets a poor reply.
items.zh: 如果你寫出清楚又有細節的提示詞,人工智慧會給出更好的答案,但簡短模糊的問題常常得到很差的回覆。
items.sec: Generative AI & Digital Tools 生成式AI與數位工具

items.def: able to create new text, pictures or sound
items.s: ________ AI can write a poem in seconds, but many teachers say students still need to learn how to write their own.
items.zh: 生成式人工智慧能在幾秒內寫出一首詩,但許多老師說學生仍需要學會自己寫作。
items.sec: Generative AI & Digital Tools 生成式AI與數位工具

items.def: a fake video or voice made by AI that looks real

items.s: She is a ________ designer, so she worries that AI image tools may take away some of her clients.
items.zh: 她是一位自由接案的設計師,所以她擔心人工智慧繪圖工具可能會搶走她的一些客戶。
items.sec: Work, Jobs & the Economy 工作、就業與經濟

items.def: a short job or piece of paid work
items.s: Many students do ________ work like food delivery, because the hours are flexible, but the pay is not stable.
items.zh: 許多學生做外送之類的零工,因為時間有彈性,但收入並不穩定。
items.sec: Work, Jobs & the Economy 工作、就業與經濟

items.def: to learn or teach new skills for a different job
items.s: The government pays factory workers to ________ as technicians, so they can find jobs that machines cannot do.
items.zh: 政府出錢讓工廠工人重新受訓成為技術人員,這樣他們就能找到機器做不來的工作。
items.sec: Work, Jobs & the Economy 工作、就業與經濟

items.def: to learn new skills to do your job better
items.s: Our company asked all staff to ________ in data analysis, because managers now expect reports with clear charts.
items.zh: 我們公司要求全體員工在資料分析方面提升技能,因為主管現在期望報告附有清楚的圖表。
items.sec: Work, Jobs & the Economy 工作、就業與經濟

items.def: money paid to a worker, usually by the hour or week
items.s: Some workers fear that their ________s will fall if robots can do the same job for less money.
items.zh: 有些工人擔心,如果機器人能用更少的錢做同樣的工作,他們的工資會下降。
items.sec: Work, Jobs & the Economy 工作、就業與經濟

items.def: fixed money paid to a worker every month
items.s: AI engineers earn a very high ________, so many university students now want to study computer science.
items.zh: 人工智慧工程師的薪水非常高,所以現在許多大學生都想念資訊工程。
items.sec: Work, Jobs & the Economy 工作、就業與經濟

items.def: money a business makes after paying its costs
items.s: The online shop's ________s grew quickly after it used AI to suggest products, but some customers found the ads annoying.
items.zh: 這家網路商店用人工智慧推薦商品後獲利快速成長,但有些顧客覺得廣告很煩人。
items.sec: Work, Jobs & the Economy 工作、就業與經濟

items.def: a new small company, often in technology
items.s: My friend works at an AI ________ in Taipei, and although the hours are long, she is learning a lot.
items.zh: 我朋友在台北一家人工智慧新創公司工作,雖然工時很長,但她學到很多。
items.sec: Work, Jobs & the Economy 工作、就業與經濟

items.def: a person who starts their own business
items.s: The young ________ used AI to design her logo and website, so she opened her online shop with very little money.
items.zh: 這位年輕的創業家用人工智慧設計標誌和網站,所以她只花很少的錢就開了網路商店。
items.sec: Work, Jobs & the Economy 工作、就業與經濟

items.def: a person who puts money into a business to make more money
items.s: Many ________s are putting money into AI companies, but some warn that the market may be growing too fast.
items.zh: 許多投資人正把錢投入人工智慧公司,但有些人警告市場可能成長得太快了。
items.sec: Work, Jobs & the Economy 工作、就業與經濟

items.def: making goods in large numbers in factories
items.s: Robots now do many dangerous jobs in ________, so fewer workers are hurt, but the factories need fewer people.
items.zh: 機器人現在在製造業中做許多危險的工作,所以受傷的工人變少了,但工廠需要的人力也減少了。
items.sec: Work, Jobs & the Economy 工作、就業與經濟

items.def: a large building where goods are stored
items.s: In the online shop's ________, robots carry the shelves to the workers, so packing an order takes only a few minutes.
items.zh: 在這家網路商店的倉庫裡,機器人把貨架搬到員工面前,所以包裝一張訂單只需要幾分鐘。
items.sec: Work, Jobs & the Economy 工作、就業與經濟

items.def: work, especially physical work; workers as a group
items.s: Farms are using drones and robots because there is not enough ________ in the countryside, and young people prefer city jobs.
items.zh: 農場正在使用無人機和機器人,因為鄉下的勞力不足,而且年輕人比較喜歡城市的工作。
items.sec: Work, Jobs & the Economy 工作、就業與經濟

items.def: the jobs a person does during their working life
items.s: My sister changed her ________ from accounting to data science, because she believed AI would change her old job.
items.zh: 我姐姐把她的職涯從會計轉向資料科學,因為她相信人工智慧會改變她原本的工作。
items.sec: Work, Jobs & the Economy 工作、就業與經濟

items.def: no longer used because something newer exists
items.s: Some skills, like typing fast, may become ________, but skills like teamwork will still be needed in the future.
items.zh: 有些技能,例如快速打字,可能會變得過時,但團隊合作之類的技能未來仍然會被需要。
items.sec: Work, Jobs & the Economy 工作、就業與經濟

items.def: a person who applies for a job or place
items.s: Each job ________ must complete an online test, and an AI system reads the answers before a manager sees them.
items.zh: 每位應徵者都必須完成線上測驗,而人工智慧系統會在經理看到之前先讀過答案。
items.sec: Work, Jobs & the Economy 工作、就業與經濟

items.def: a person who finds new workers for companies
items.s: The ________ said she now uses AI to sort hundreds of CVs, but she still meets the final candidates in person.
items.zh: 這位招募人員說她現在用人工智慧整理數百份履歷,但她仍會親自面試最後的人選。
items.sec: Work, Jobs & the Economy 工作、就業與經濟

items.def: a situation where there is not enough of something
items.s: There is a ________ of nurses in many hospitals, so robots now deliver medicine, but patients still need human care.
items.zh: 許多醫院護理師短缺,所以現在由機器人遞送藥物,但病人仍然需要人的照顧。
items.sec: Work, Jobs & the Economy 工作、就業與經濟

items.def: a person or company that pays people to work
items.s: Many ________s now ask whether job seekers can use AI tools, so students should learn these skills before graduating.
items.zh: 許多雇主現在會詢問求職者是否會使用人工智慧工具,所以學生應該在畢業前學會這些技能。
items.sec: Work, Jobs & the Economy 工作、就業與經濟

items.def: moral rules about what is right and wrong
items.s: Our class discussed the ________ of using AI in hospitals, because a wrong decision by a machine could hurt a patient.
items.zh: 我們班討論了在醫院使用人工智慧的倫理問題,因為機器做出錯誤決定可能會傷害病人。
items.sec: Ethics, Bias & Regulation 倫理、偏見與規範

items.def: morally right or acceptable
items.s: Is it ________ to use AI to write a love letter, or should those words always come from your own heart?
items.zh: 用人工智慧寫情書是合乎道德的嗎?還是那些話應該永遠出自你自己的內心?
items.sec: Ethics, Bias & Regulation 倫理、偏見與規範

items.def: unfair support for or against a group
items.s: The hiring program showed ________ against women, because it had learned from old records in which most staff were men.
items.zh: 這個招聘程式顯示出對女性的偏見,因為它是從大多數員工都是男性的舊紀錄中學習的。
items.sec: Ethics, Bias & Regulation 倫理、偏見與規範

items.def: unfairly favouring one side or group
items.s: The AI gave ________ answers about some countries, so the teacher reminded us to compare several sources.
items.zh: 人工智慧對某些國家給出了偏頗的答案,所以老師提醒我們要比較多個資料來源。
items.sec: Ethics, Bias & Regulation 倫理、偏見與規範

items.def: to treat a person or group unfairly
items.s: Banks must make sure their AI does not ________ against older people, because everyone deserves a fair chance at a loan.
items.zh: 銀行必須確保它們的人工智慧不會歧視年長者,因為每個人都應該有公平申請貸款的機會。
items.sec: Ethics, Bias & Regulation 倫理、偏見與規範

items.def: unfair treatment of people because of who they are
items.s: Some job seekers faced ________ because of their accent, so the company stopped using the voice-checking software.
items.zh: 有些求職者因為口音而受到歧視,所以公司停止使用那個語音檢測軟體。
items.sec: Ethics, Bias & Regulation 倫理、偏見與規範

items.def: treating people equally and in the right way
items.s: Parents questioned the ________ of AI grading, because their children received low scores for creative but unusual answers.
items.zh: 家長質疑人工智慧評分的公平性,因為他們的孩子因富有創意但不尋常的答案而拿到低分。
items.sec: Ethics, Bias & Regulation 倫理、偏見與規範

items.def: open and easy to understand, with nothing hidden
items.s: Companies should be ________ about how their AI makes decisions, so users can understand why they were refused.
items.zh: 公司應該對人工智慧如何做決定保持透明,這樣使用者才能理解自己為何被拒絕。
items.sec: Ethics, Bias & Regulation 倫理、偏見與規範

items.def: openness about how decisions are made
items.s: The public is asking for more ________ from tech companies, because nobody knows exactly what data their AI was trained on.
items.zh: 大眾要求科技公司提高透明度,因為沒有人確切知道它們的人工智慧是用什麼資料訓練的。
items.sec: Ethics, Bias & Regulation 倫理、偏見與規範

items.def: responsible for your actions and able to explain them
items.s: If a self-driving car causes an accident, who should be held ________, the driver or the company that made it?
items.zh: 如果自駕車造成事故,誰該負責,是駕駛還是製造它的公司?
items.sec: Ethics, Bias & Regulation 倫理、偏見與規範

items.def: being responsible for decisions and their results
items.s: There is little ________ when an algorithm makes a mistake, so lawmakers want clear rules about who must pay.
items.zh: 當演算法出錯時幾乎沒有責任歸屬,所以立法者希望明確規定誰必須賠償。
items.sec: Ethics, Bias & Regulation 倫理、偏見與規範

items.def: to control something with official rules
items.s: Many countries are trying to ________ AI, but technology changes so quickly that new laws are soon out of date.
items.zh: 許多國家正試圖規範人工智慧,但科技變化太快,新法律很快就過時了。
items.sec: Ethics, Bias & Regulation 倫理、偏見與規範

items.def: an official group that makes sure rules are followed
items.s: The ________ fined the app company because it had collected children's voices without asking their parents.
items.zh: 監管機構對這家應用程式公司開罰,因為它沒有詢問家長就蒐集了兒童的聲音。
items.sec: Ethics, Bias & Regulation 倫理、偏見與規範

items.def: a law or group of laws
items.s: New ________ requires AI-made videos to carry a label, so viewers know that what they are watching is not real.
items.zh: 新的法規要求人工智慧製作的影片必須加上標示,讓觀眾知道他們看的不是真的。
items.sec: Ethics, Bias & Regulation 倫理、偏見與規範

items.def: to officially say something is not allowed
items.s: Some schools ________ phones during lessons, while others allow them because students use them for learning apps.
items.zh: 有些學校在上課時禁止使用手機,而其他學校則允許,因為學生會用它們來使用學習應用程式。
items.sec: Ethics, Bias & Regulation 倫理、偏見與規範

items.def: the legal right to own and control creative work
items.s: Artists say AI companies broke ________ laws by using their paintings to train machines, and some have gone to court.
items.zh: 藝術家們說人工智慧公司用他們的畫作訓練機器違反了著作權法,有些人已經告上法院。
items.sec: Ethics, Bias & Regulation 倫理、偏見與規範

items.def: to use something in a wrong or harmful way
items.s: If people ________ AI to make fake news, it becomes harder for everyone to trust what they read online.
items.zh: 如果人們濫用人工智慧製造假新聞,每個人就更難相信他們在網路上讀到的內容。
items.sec: Ethics, Bias & Regulation 倫理、偏見與規範

items.def: to control people or facts in a dishonest way
items.s: Some apps ________ users into spending more time online, because the companies earn more money from longer visits.
items.zh: 有些應用程式操弄使用者花更多時間上網,因為公司能從更長的瀏覽時間中賺更多錢。
items.sec: Ethics, Bias & Regulation 倫理、偏見與規範

items.def: dishonest control of people, facts or images
items.s: Photo ________ is now so easy with AI that a single image can no longer prove that something really happened.
items.zh: 有了人工智慧,照片竄改變得非常容易,以至於單一張圖片已無法證明某件事真的發生過。
items.sec: Ethics, Bias & Regulation 倫理、偏見與規範

items.def: careful and sensible in how you behave
items.s: A ________ AI user checks facts before sharing them, because chatbots sometimes give answers that sound right but are wrong.
items.zh: 一位負責任的人工智慧使用者在分享前會先查核事實,因為聊天機器人有時會給出聽起來正確但其實錯誤的答案。
items.sec: Ethics, Bias & Regulation 倫理、偏見與規範

items.def: the job of watching and checking that something is done properly
items.s: Doctors say AI must work under human ________, because a computer cannot take responsibility for a patient's life.
items.zh: 醫生們說人工智慧必須在人類的監督下運作,因為電腦無法為病人的生命負責。
items.sec: Ethics, Bias & Regulation 倫理、偏見與規範

items.def: advice or a rule about how to do something
items.s: The school published clear ________s on AI use, so students know when it is allowed and when it counts as cheating.
items.zh: 學校公布了清楚的人工智慧使用準則,讓學生知道什麼時候可以用、什麼時候算作弊。
items.sec: Ethics, Bias & Regulation 倫理、偏見與規範

items.def: a gap in a rule that lets people avoid it
items.s: The company found a ________ in the law, so it could keep users' data for years without breaking any rules.
items.zh: 這家公司找到法律的漏洞,所以它能保存使用者的資料好幾年而不違反任何規定。
items.sec: Ethics, Bias & Regulation 倫理、偏見與規範

items.def: a case brought to a court of law
items.s: A group of writers started a ________ against the AI firm, because it had used their books without paying them.
items.zh: 一群作家對這家人工智慧公司提起訴訟,因為它未付費就使用了他們的書。
items.sec: Ethics, Bias & Regulation 倫理、偏見與規範

items.def: an unfair opinion formed without enough knowledge
items.s: AI systems can repeat human ________ if they learn from unfair data, so developers must test them very carefully.
items.zh: 如果人工智慧系統從不公平的資料中學習,就可能複製人類的偏見,所以開發者必須非常仔細地測試它們。
items.sec: Ethics, Bias & Regulation 倫理、偏見與規範

items.def: a fixed, too-simple idea about a group of people
items.s: When we asked the AI to draw a nurse, it always drew a woman, which shows a common gender ________.
items.zh: 當我們請人工智慧畫一位護理師時,它總是畫出女性,這顯示了一種常見的性別刻板印象。
items.sec: Ethics, Bias & Regulation 倫理、偏見與規範

items.def: to use someone or something unfairly for your own gain
items.s: Some companies ________ low-paid workers to label training data, and these workers often see upsetting images all day.
items.zh: 有些公司剝削低薪工人來標記訓練資料,而這些工人經常整天看到令人不安的圖片。
items.sec: Ethics, Bias & Regulation 倫理、偏見與規範

items.def: wrong information that is spread, often by mistake
items.s: During the election, ________ spread quickly on social media, so many voters were confused about the real facts.
items.zh: 選舉期間,錯誤訊息在社群媒體上迅速散播,所以許多選民對真實情況感到困惑。
items.sec: Ethics, Bias & Regulation 倫理、偏見與規範

items.def: a mobile phone that can use the internet and apps
items.s: Almost every teenager in Taiwan owns a ________, so schools must teach them how to use AI apps wisely.
items.zh: 台灣幾乎每個青少年都有一支智慧型手機,所以學校必須教他們如何明智地使用人工智慧應用程式。
items.sec: Society, Daily Life & the Future 社會、日常生活與未來

items.def: a small useful machine or tool
items.s: My dad loves new ________s, so he bought a smart speaker, but he mostly uses it to play old songs.
items.zh: 我爸爸很喜歡新奇的小裝置,所以他買了一台智慧音箱,但他大多只用它來播老歌。
items.sec: Society, Daily Life & the Future 社會、日常生活與未來

items.def: designed to be worn on the body
items.s: My grandmother wears a ________ device on her wrist, and it calls my mum automatically if she falls down.
items.zh: 我奶奶手腕上戴著一個穿戴式裝置,如果她跌倒,它會自動打電話給我媽媽。
items.sec: Society, Daily Life & the Future 社會、日常生活與未來

items.def: being easy and useful, saving time
items.s: Online shopping offers great ________, but some people miss the fun of visiting real shops with friends.
items.zh: 網路購物提供了極大的便利,但有些人懷念和朋友一起逛實體店的樂趣。
items.sec: Society, Daily Life & the Future 社會、日常生活與未來

items.def: easy and saving you time or trouble
items.s: It is ________ to ask a smart speaker for the weather, but it is a little worrying that it is always listening.
items.zh: 問智慧音箱天氣很方便,但它總是在聆聽這件事有點令人擔憂。
items.sec: Society, Daily Life & the Future 社會、日常生活與未來

items.def: an unfair difference between groups of people
items.s: AI could increase ________ if only rich schools can afford the best tools, so the government wants to help poorer areas.
items.zh: 如果只有富裕的學校負擔得起最好的工具,人工智慧可能會加劇不平等,所以政府想幫助較貧困的地區。
items.sec: Society, Daily Life & the Future 社會、日常生活與未來

items.def: a large difference between two groups
items.s: There is a growing ________ between students who have fast internet at home and those who do not.
items.zh: 家裡有高速網路的學生和沒有的學生之間差距越來越大。
items.sec: Society, Daily Life & the Future 社會、日常生活與未來

items.def: easy to reach, use or understand
items.s: AI reading tools make books more ________ to blind students, because the computer can read every page aloud.
items.zh: 人工智慧閱讀工具讓盲人學生更容易取得書籍,因為電腦能把每一頁都朗讀出來。
items.sec: Society, Daily Life & the Future 社會、日常生活與未來

items.def: the pleasure of having friendly company
items.s: Some lonely older people find ________ in talking robots, but experts say real friends are still much more important.
items.zh: 一些孤單的長者從會說話的機器人身上得到陪伴,但專家說真正的朋友仍然重要得多。
items.sec: Society, Daily Life & the Future 社會、日常生活與未來

items.def: needing something so much that you cannot do without it
items.s: Too much ________ on GPS has made some drivers forget how to read a map, and AI may have the same effect on writing.
items.zh: 過度依賴衛星導航已讓一些駕駛忘了怎麼看地圖,而人工智慧對寫作可能也有同樣的影響。
items.sec: Society, Daily Life & the Future 社會、日常生活與未來

items.def: needing someone or something to survive or work
items.s: Many students have become ________ on AI for their homework, so they struggle when they must write without it in exams.
items.zh: 許多學生寫作業已變得依賴人工智慧,所以在考試中必須自己寫時就很吃力。
items.sec: Society, Daily Life & the Future 社會、日常生活與未來

items.def: a new idea, method or invention
items.s: AI is a major ________ in medicine, and it can now spot some diseases in X-rays earlier than many doctors.
items.zh: 人工智慧是醫學上的一大創新,它現在能比許多醫生更早在X光片中發現某些疾病。
items.sec: Society, Daily Life & the Future 社會、日常生活與未來

items.def: using new ideas or methods
items.s: The teacher had an ________ idea: students had to find and correct the mistakes in an AI-written essay.
items.zh: 這位老師有個創新的點子:學生必須找出並改正一篇人工智慧寫的作文中的錯誤。
items.sec: Society, Daily Life & the Future 社會、日常生活與未來

items.def: very modern and seeming to come from the future
items.s: The new train station looks very ________, with robots giving directions and screens that speak many languages.
items.zh: 新的火車站看起來非常有未來感,有機器人指路,還有會說多種語言的螢幕。
items.sec: Society, Daily Life & the Future 社會、日常生活與未來

items.def: to change something completely and in a big way
items.s: Experts believe AI will ________ medicine, because it can study millions of patient records in just a few hours.
items.zh: 專家相信人工智慧將徹底改變醫學,因為它能在短短幾小時內研究數百萬份病歷。
items.sec: Society, Daily Life & the Future 社會、日常生活與未來

items.def: to change something completely, usually to improve it
items.s: Smartphones ________ed the way we communicate, and now AI is changing the way we search, learn and work.
items.zh: 智慧型手機改變了我們溝通的方式,而現在人工智慧正在改變我們搜尋、學習和工作的方式。
items.sec: Society, Daily Life & the Future 社會、日常生活與未來

items.def: a complete change in something
items.s: The bank went through a digital ________, so customers now do almost everything online instead of visiting a branch.
items.zh: 這家銀行經歷了數位轉型,所以顧客現在幾乎所有事都在網路上辦理,而不必去分行。
items.sec: Society, Daily Life & the Future 社會、日常生活與未來

items.def: working without a human driver
items.s: ________ buses are being tested in some Taiwanese cities, but a safety officer still sits on board in case of problems.
items.zh: 台灣一些城市正在測試無人駕駛公車,但仍有一位安全人員坐在車上以防出問題。
items.sec: Society, Daily Life & the Future 社會、日常生活與未來

items.def: able to work or decide without human control
items.s: The ________ vacuum cleaner maps our apartment by itself, so it cleans every room while we are at school.
items.zh: 這台自動掃地機會自己繪製我們家的地圖,所以它在我們上學時就把每個房間打掃乾淨。
items.sec: Society, Daily Life & the Future 社會、日常生活與未來

items.def: a small aircraft without a pilot, controlled from the ground
items.s: Farmers use ________s to spray crops, and this saves time, although some neighbours complain about the noise.
items.zh: 農夫用無人機噴灑農作物,這節省了時間,雖然有些鄰居抱怨噪音。
items.sec: Society, Daily Life & the Future 社會、日常生活與未來

items.def: services for looking after people's health
items.s: AI could make ________ cheaper and faster, but patients still want to speak to a real doctor about serious problems.
items.zh: 人工智慧可能讓醫療照護更便宜、更快速,但病人遇到嚴重問題時仍想和真正的醫生談。
items.sec: Society, Daily Life & the Future 社會、日常生活與未來

items.def: seeing a doctor through video or phone instead of in person
items.s: ________ helps people on small islands, because they can talk to city doctors without taking a long boat trip.
items.zh: 遠距醫療幫助住在小島上的人,因為他們不用搭很久的船就能和城市裡的醫生交談。
items.sec: Society, Daily Life & the Future 社會、日常生活與未來

items.def: buying and selling goods on the internet
items.s: ________ has grown quickly in Taiwan, and AI now helps online shops guess what customers will want to buy next.
items.zh: 電子商務在台灣快速成長,而人工智慧現在幫助網路商店猜測顧客接下來會想買什麼。
items.sec: Society, Daily Life & the Future 社會、日常生活與未來

items.def: describing a frightening imagined future where life is bad
items.s: The film shows a ________ world where machines control people, but the director says it is a warning, not a prediction.
items.zh: 這部電影描繪了一個由機器控制人類的反烏托邦世界,但導演說這是警告,而不是預言。
items.sec: Society, Daily Life & the Future 社會、日常生活與未來

items.def: doubting whether something is true or useful
items.s: My grandfather is ________ about AI doctors, because he believes a machine cannot understand how a patient really feels.
items.zh: 我爺爺對人工智慧醫生抱持懷疑態度,因為他認為機器無法理解病人真正的感受。
items.sec: Society, Daily Life & the Future 社會、日常生活與未來

items.def: all the people who live together in one home
items.s: Nearly every ________ in our building now has a smart lock, so residents open their doors with their phones.
items.zh: 我們大樓裡幾乎每一戶現在都有智慧門鎖,所以住戶用手機開門。
items.sec: Society, Daily Life & the Future 社會、日常生活與未來

items.def: to study something carefully to understand it
items.s: AI can ________ thousands of test results in seconds, so teachers can quickly see which topics the class finds difficult.
items.zh: 人工智慧能在幾秒內分析數千筆測驗結果,所以老師能很快看出全班覺得哪些主題困難。

items.def: large in amount or importance
items.s: The school spent a ________ amount of money on new tablets, but many teachers still prefer paper and pens.
items.zh: 學校花了可觀的金額購買新平板,但許多老師仍偏好紙筆。

items.def: to slowly make something weaker
items.s: Fake AI videos can ________ public trust in the news, because people start to doubt even true reports.
items.zh: 人工智慧假影片會削弱大眾對新聞的信任,因為人們開始連真實的報導都懷疑。

items.def: to give money, time or resources for a purpose
items.s: The city will ________ more money to teacher training, because new tools are useless if nobody knows how to use them.
items.zh: 市政府將撥更多經費給教師培訓,因為如果沒有人會用,新工具就毫無用處。

items.def: causing a lot of disagreement
items.s: Using AI cameras in classrooms is ________, because some parents feel safer while others think it invades privacy.
items.zh: 在教室使用人工智慧攝影機是有爭議的,因為有些家長覺得比較安心,而其他人認為這侵犯隱私。

items.def: a way of dealing with something
items.s: Our teacher's ________ is simple: we can use AI to find ideas, but we must write every sentence ourselves.
items.zh: 我們老師的方法很簡單:我們可以用人工智慧找點子,但每個句子都必須自己寫。

items.def: to judge how good or useful something is
items.s: Students should ________ every website they use, because not all online information is accurate or up to date.
items.zh: 學生應該評估他們使用的每個網站,因為並非所有網路資訊都正確或最新。

items.def: large or important enough to notice
items.s: There was a ________ rise in online shopping after the pandemic, and many shops never went back to their old ways.
items.zh: 疫情過後網路購物出現顯著的成長,許多商店再也沒有回到原本的經營方式。

items.def: extremely important
items.s: It is ________ to check AI answers carefully, because one wrong fact in a report can make readers doubt the whole thing.
items.zh: 仔細檢查人工智慧的答案是極為重要的,因為報告中一個錯誤的事實就可能讓讀者懷疑整份報告。

items.def: to improve the quality of something
items.s: Good pictures and videos can ________ a lesson, but too many screens may make students less active in class.
items.zh: 好的圖片和影片能提升一堂課的品質,但太多螢幕可能讓學生在課堂上變得不積極。

items.def: to make an action or process easier
items.s: Online forums ________ discussion between students from different schools, so they can share ideas without meeting in person.
items.zh: 線上論壇促進了不同學校學生之間的討論,讓他們不必見面就能分享想法。

items.def: to start using a plan or system
items.s: The school will ________ the new AI rules next term, but teachers first want to hear what students think.
items.zh: 學校將在下學期實施新的人工智慧規定,但老師們想先聽聽學生的想法。

items.def: to include something as part of a larger thing
items.s: Our teacher tries to ________ games into every lesson, because she believes students remember more when they have fun.
items.zh: 我們老師試著把遊戲融入每一堂課,因為她相信學生在玩得開心時會記得更多。

items.def: to start using a new idea or method
items.s: Many companies ________ed AI tools very quickly, but they did not always train their staff to use them safely.
items.zh: 許多公司很快就採用了人工智慧工具,但它們並不總是訓練員工安全地使用。

items.def: to appear or become known
items.s: New AI tools ________ almost every week, so it is hard for schools to keep their rules up to date.
items.zh: 新的人工智慧工具幾乎每週都會出現,所以學校很難讓規定跟上時代。

items.def: a general direction in which things are changing
items.s: One clear ________ is that young people search for information on video apps rather than on traditional websites.
items.zh: 一個明顯的趨勢是,年輕人在影音應用程式上搜尋資訊,而不是在傳統網站上。

items.def: something that happens and can be observed
items.s: The fast spread of AI chatbots is a global ________, and it is changing how people study, work and shop.
items.zh: 人工智慧聊天機器人的快速普及是一個全球現象,它正在改變人們學習、工作和購物的方式。

items.def: happening in many places or among many people
items.s: The use of AI for homework is now ________, so teachers are designing tasks that require personal experience.
items.zh: 用人工智慧寫作業現在已經很普遍,所以老師們正在設計需要個人經驗的作業。

items.def: certain to happen and impossible to avoid
items.s: Some changes to jobs are ________ as AI improves, so young people should keep learning new skills.
items.zh: 隨著人工智慧進步,工作上的某些改變是不可避免的,所以年輕人應該持續學習新技能。

items.def: the possibility of developing or being useful in the future
items.s: AI has great ________ to help children in poor areas, but only if they have computers and internet at home.
items.zh: 人工智慧有很大的潛力幫助貧困地區的孩子,但前提是他們家裡要有電腦和網路。

items.def: very large
items.s: AI data centres use an ________ amount of electricity, so some people worry about the effect on the environment.
items.zh: 人工智慧資料中心使用龐大的電量,所以有些人擔心它對環境的影響。

items.def: fairly large in size or amount
items.s: Learning to use the new system took ________ time, but after a month the office staff were working much faster.
items.zh: 學習使用新系統花了相當多的時間,但一個月後辦公室員工的工作速度快了許多。

items.def: in a sudden and very noticeable way
items.s: The number of online students rose ________ during the pandemic, and many universities still offer online courses today.
items.zh: 疫情期間線上學生的人數大幅增加,許多大學至今仍提供線上課程。

items.def: happening very quickly
items.s: The ________ growth of AI surprised many experts, and governments are now hurrying to write new laws.
items.zh: 人工智慧的快速成長讓許多專家感到驚訝,各國政府現在正急著制定新法律。

items.def: happening slowly over a long time
items.s: There has been a ________ change in how people read news, because most now use their phones instead of newspapers.
items.zh: 人們閱讀新聞的方式出現了逐漸的改變,因為現在大多數人用手機而不是看報紙。

items.def: a change in position or direction
items.s: There has been a big ________ from paper tests to online tests, but some students find reading on screens tiring.
items.zh: 考試已從紙本大幅轉變為線上測驗,但有些學生覺得在螢幕上閱讀很累。

items.def: the process of changing from one state to another
items.s: The ________ to online banking was hard for my grandparents, so my cousin taught them how to use the app.
items.zh: 轉換到網路銀行的過渡期對我的祖父母來說很辛苦,所以我表哥教他們如何使用應用程式。

items.def: to develop and change slowly over time
items.s: Chatbots have ________d from simple question-answer tools into assistants that can plan trips and write code.
items.zh: 聊天機器人已從簡單的問答工具演變成能規劃旅行和寫程式的助理。

items.def: advanced and complicated
items.s: Modern scams are very ________, because criminals use AI to write perfect messages that look like real bank emails.
items.zh: 現代的詐騙非常精密,因為罪犯用人工智慧寫出看起來像真正銀行郵件的完美訊息。

items.def: made of many parts and difficult to understand
items.s: The AI's decision process is so ________ that even its designers cannot fully explain why it chose one answer.
items.zh: 人工智慧的決策過程非常複雜,連它的設計者都無法完全解釋它為什麼選擇某個答案。

items.def: the ability to do something
items.s: The new phone has the ________ to translate conversations in real time, so travellers can chat easily with local people.
items.zh: 這支新手機具備即時翻譯對話的能力,所以旅客能輕鬆地和當地人聊天。

items.def: something that limits what you can do
items.s: Time is the biggest ________ for many teachers, so they welcome tools that help them prepare lessons more quickly.
items.zh: 時間是許多老師最大的限制,所以他們歡迎能幫助他們更快備課的工具。

items.def: a weakness or a point beyond which something cannot go
items.s: One ________ of chatbots is that they sometimes make up facts, so users must always check important information.
items.zh: 聊天機器人的一個局限是它們有時會捏造事實,所以使用者必須隨時查核重要資訊。

items.def: a disadvantage or problem
items.s: The main ________ of online classes is that students have fewer chances to make friends, although they save travel time.
items.zh: 線上課程的主要缺點是學生交朋友的機會較少,雖然它們節省了通勤時間。

items.def: to get help or an advantage from something
items.s: Students with reading difficulties can ________ from AI tools that read texts aloud, and they often feel more confident.
items.zh: 有閱讀困難的學生可以從朗讀文本的人工智慧工具中受益,而且他們通常會變得更有自信。

items.def: to make it possible for someone to do something
items.s: Video calls ________ grandparents to see their grandchildren every day, even when they live in different countries.
items.zh: 視訊通話使祖父母能夠每天看到孫子孫女,即使他們住在不同的國家。

items.def: to make certain that something happens
items.s: Teachers must ________ that every student understands the AI rules, because some may cheat without knowing it.
items.zh: 老師必須確保每位學生都了解人工智慧的使用規定,因為有些人可能在不知情的情況下作弊。

items.def: to start or create something that will last
items.s: The university ________ed an AI research centre last year, and it has already attracted students from many countries.
items.zh: 這所大學去年設立了一個人工智慧研究中心,而它已經吸引了來自許多國家的學生。

items.def: a set of ideas or rules used to make decisions
items.s: The government created a ________ for safe AI use in schools, but each school can add its own rules.
items.zh: 政府為學校安全使用人工智慧建立了一套框架,但每所學校可以加入自己的規定。

items.def: basic systems like roads, power and internet that a society needs
items.s: Rural areas need better internet ________, because students there cannot join online classes when the connection is weak.
items.zh: 鄉村地區需要更好的網路基礎建設,因為那裡的學生在連線不穩時無法參加線上課程。

items.def: something useful such as money, materials or information
items.s: The library offers many free online ________s, so students do not have to buy expensive books.
items.zh: 圖書館提供許多免費的線上資源,所以學生不必購買昂貴的書籍。

items.def: to provide money for something
items.s: The company agreed to ________ a coding club at our school, so students can learn programming for free after class.
items.zh: 這家公司同意資助我們學校的程式社團,所以學生放學後可以免費學寫程式。

items.def: the amount of money available to spend
items.s: Our school has a small ________, so it cannot buy the newest computers, but it uses free AI tools instead.
items.zh: 我們學校的預算很少,所以買不起最新的電腦,但改用免費的人工智慧工具。

items.def: one part of a country's economy or society
items.s: The banking ________ was one of the first to use AI, because computers can spot strange payments very quickly.
items.zh: 銀行業是最早使用人工智慧的產業之一,因為電腦能非常快速地發現異常的付款。

items.def: an area of knowledge or activity
items.s: AI is now used in almost every ________, from farming to music, but each area faces different problems.
items.zh: 人工智慧現在幾乎被用於每個領域,從農業到音樂,但每個領域面臨不同的問題。

items.def: the situation or information around something that helps explain it
items.s: A chatbot may translate a word wrongly if it misses the ________, so you should always read the whole sentence.
items.zh: 聊天機器人如果忽略了上下文,就可能把字翻錯,所以你應該永遠讀完整個句子。

items.def: one part or feature of something
items.s: Speed is only one ________ of good writing, and AI cannot replace your own ideas, feelings and experiences.
items.zh: 速度只是好寫作的一個層面,而人工智慧無法取代你自己的想法、感受和經驗。

items.def: a part or feature of a situation
items.s: AI adds a new ________ to the problem of cheating, because teachers can no longer easily tell who wrote an essay.
items.zh: 人工智慧為作弊問題增添了一個新的面向,因為老師再也無法輕易分辨作文是誰寫的。

items.def: a basic part of something
items.s: Trust is an important ________ of any online service, so companies must protect users' data carefully.
items.zh: 信任是任何線上服務的重要要素,所以公司必須小心保護使用者的資料。

items.def: one of the parts that make up a machine or system
items.s: Each ________ of the robot was made in a different country, and then they were put together in Taiwan.
items.zh: 這個機器人的每個零件都是在不同國家製造的,然後在台灣組裝起來。

items.def: the job that something is designed to do
items.s: The most useful ________ of the app is the voice reader, because I can listen to articles while I walk to school.
items.zh: 這個應用程式最有用的功能是語音朗讀,因為我走路上學時可以聽文章。

items.def: a system or process that does a particular job
items.s: The website has a ________ for reporting fake news, but few users know where to find the button.
items.zh: 這個網站有一套檢舉假新聞的機制,但很少使用者知道去哪裡找那個按鈕。

items.def: the official way of doing something
items.s: The school has a clear ________ for reporting online bullying, so students know exactly whom to talk to.
items.zh: 學校有一套清楚的網路霸凌通報程序,所以學生確切知道該找誰談。

items.def: a way of doing something
items.s: The flashcard ________ works well for memorising words, but you also need to read a lot to use them naturally.
items.zh: 字卡方法很適合背單字,但你也需要大量閱讀才能自然地運用它們。

items.def: a plan for reaching a goal
items.s: A good study ________ is to test yourself often, because simply reading notes again does not help you remember much.
items.zh: 一個好的讀書策略是常常自我測驗,因為只是重讀筆記並不太能幫助你記憶。

items.def: a special way of doing something that needs skill
items.s: Our teacher showed us a ________ for checking facts online, and now I always compare three sources before I believe something.
items.zh: 老師教我們一個網路查證的技巧,現在我在相信某件事之前總會比對三個資料來源。

items.def: a basic rule or belief
items.s: The company follows one simple ________: a human must check every decision before the AI's answer is sent to a customer.
items.zh: 這家公司遵守一個簡單的原則:在人工智慧的答案送給顧客之前,必須由人檢查每一個決定。

items.def: an idea or general understanding of something
items.s: The ________ of a robot teacher sounded strange ten years ago, but now some schools are already testing it.
items.zh: 機器人老師的概念十年前聽起來很奇怪,但現在有些學校已經在測試了。

items.def: an idea that tries to explain something
items.s: One ________ says that people trust machines more than humans, but recent studies show the opposite is often true.
items.zh: 有一種理論說人們比較相信機器而不是人類,但最近的研究顯示事實往往相反。

items.def: something you believe is true without proof
items.s: Many people make the ________ that computers are never wrong, so they do not check the answers they receive.
items.zh: 許多人假定電腦永遠不會出錯,所以他們不檢查收到的答案。

items.def: to think something is true without checking
items.s: Don't ________ that a website is reliable just because it looks professional, because many fake sites look very real.
items.zh: 不要只因為網站看起來很專業就認定它可靠,因為許多假網站看起來非常逼真。

items.def: an idea that an argument or plan is based on
items.s: The film's ________ is that robots have taken all human jobs, and the story follows one family trying to survive.
items.zh: 這部電影的前提是機器人已經取代了人類所有的工作,而故事描述一家人努力求生。

items.def: a way of thinking about something
items.s: Talking to older workers gave me a new ________ on AI, because they remember how computers changed offices before.
items.zh: 和年長的員工聊天讓我對人工智慧有了新的觀點,因為他們記得電腦以前如何改變辦公室。

items.def: a public opinion on an issue
items.s: The school has taken a clear ________ on AI: students may use it for practice, but not for graded work.
items.zh: 學校對人工智慧採取了明確的立場:學生可以用它來練習,但不能用在要打分數的作業上。

items.def: to give reasons to support an opinion
items.s: Some experts ________ that AI will create more jobs than it destroys, while others think many workers will be left behind.
items.zh: 有些專家主張人工智慧創造的工作會比它消滅的還多,而其他人則認為許多工人會被淘汰。

items.def: to say something is true without proof
items.s: The company ________s that its app can teach you English in one month, but most users say real progress takes much longer.
items.zh: 這家公司聲稱它的應用程式能在一個月內教會你英文,但大多數使用者說真正的進步要花更久。

items.def: to say something firmly and confidently
items.s: The inventor ________ed that his robot was completely safe, but reporters found several cases where it had hurt workers.
items.zh: 發明者堅稱他的機器人完全安全,但記者發現了幾起它傷害工人的案例。

items.def: to say that something is true in an argument
items.s: Critics ________ that AI art is not real art, because the machine does not feel anything when it makes a picture.
items.zh: 批評者主張人工智慧藝術不是真正的藝術,因為機器在創作時沒有任何感受。

items.def: to accept or admit that something is true
items.s: The company ________d that its chatbot gave wrong medical advice, and it promised to add more safety checks.
items.zh: 這家公司承認它的聊天機器人給了錯誤的醫療建議,並承諾增加更多安全檢查。

items.def: to admit, often unwillingly, that something is true
items.s: The teacher ________d that the AI's essay was well written, but she said it lacked any personal voice.
items.zh: 老師承認人工智慧寫的作文寫得很好,但她說它缺乏個人的聲音。

items.def: to show that something is very important
items.s: Our principal ________d that AI is a tool, not a replacement for thinking, and every student should use it carefully.
items.zh: 我們校長強調人工智慧是一種工具,而不是思考的替代品,每位學生都應該謹慎使用。

items.def: to draw attention to something important
items.s: The report ________s the danger of fake videos, and it asks social media companies to label AI content clearly.
items.zh: 這份報告突顯了假影片的危險,並要求社群媒體公司清楚標示人工智慧內容。

items.def: to explain something with examples or pictures
items.s: The teacher used a funny AI mistake to ________ why we should check facts, and the whole class laughed.
items.zh: 老師用一個好笑的人工智慧錯誤來說明為什麼我們應該查核事實,全班都笑了。

items.def: to show clearly that something is true or how it works
items.s: The engineer ________d how the robot could sort rubbish, and the audience was impressed by its speed.
items.zh: 工程師示範了機器人如何分類垃圾,觀眾對它的速度印象深刻。

items.def: to show or suggest that something is true
items.s: Recent surveys ________ that most teenagers use AI for homework, but only a few tell their teachers about it.
items.zh: 最近的調查顯示大多數青少年用人工智慧寫作業,但只有少數人會告訴老師。

items.def: to suggest something without saying it directly
items.s: The teacher's smile ________d that she knew I had used AI, but she simply asked me to explain my answer.
items.zh: 老師的微笑暗示她知道我用了人工智慧,但她只是請我解釋我的答案。

items.def: to guess a fact from the information you have
items.s: From his perfect grammar, the teacher ________red that he had used an AI tool, so she asked him to rewrite it in class.
items.zh: 老師從他完美的文法推斷他用了人工智慧工具,所以要他在課堂上重寫。

items.def: to decide something after thinking about the facts
items.s: After a year of testing, the researchers ________d that AI tutors help weaker students most, but strong students gain less.
items.zh: 經過一年的測試,研究人員得出結論:人工智慧家教對程度較弱的學生幫助最大,而程度好的學生獲益較少。

items.def: to explain or understand the meaning of something
items.s: Machines can recognise words quickly, but they cannot always ________ jokes, so their translations sometimes sound strange.
items.zh: 機器能很快辨認文字,但它們不一定能解讀笑話,所以翻譯有時聽起來很奇怪。

items.def: to make something easier to understand
items.s: The school sent parents a letter to ________ the new phone rules, because many families had been confused.
items.zh: 學校寄信給家長以澄清新的手機規定,因為許多家庭感到困惑。

items.def: to give good reasons for something
items.s: The company could not ________ the high price of its AI course, so many customers asked for their money back.
items.zh: 這家公司無法合理解釋其人工智慧課程的高價,所以許多顧客要求退款。

items.def: to prove that something is true or correct
items.s: Scientists must ________ the results of the AI study with real patients, because computer tests are not enough.
items.zh: 科學家必須用真實的病人來驗證這項人工智慧研究的結果,因為電腦測試是不夠的。

items.def: to show or say that something is definitely true
items.s: The museum ________ed that the famous photo was made by AI, and it removed the picture from its website.
items.zh: 博物館證實那張知名照片是由人工智慧製作的,並將它從網站上撤下。

items.def: to say the opposite of what someone else has said
items.s: The chatbot's answer ________ed what our textbook said, so we asked the teacher which source was correct.
items.zh: 聊天機器人的答案和課本的說法矛盾,所以我們問老師哪個來源才正確。

items.def: to question whether something is true or right
items.s: Good students ________ information they read online, and they do not believe everything just because a computer says it.
items.zh: 好學生會質疑他們在網路上讀到的資訊,而不會只因為電腦這麼說就相信一切。

items.def: to say that something is not true or correct
items.s: The artist ________d the company's claim that its AI images were original, and she showed copies of her own paintings.
items.zh: 這位藝術家質疑公司聲稱其人工智慧圖片是原創的說法,並出示了她自己畫作的副本。

items.def: to say what is wrong with someone or something
items.s: Parents ________d the game company because its app showed too many adverts to young children.
items.zh: 家長們批評這家遊戲公司,因為它的應用程式對幼童播放太多廣告。

items.def: comments saying what is wrong with something
items.s: The new exam system received a lot of ________, so the education department agreed to review it next year.
items.zh: 新的考試制度受到許多批評,所以教育部門同意明年重新檢討。

items.def: careful and detailed examination
items.s: AI companies are under close ________ from governments, because people want to know how their data is being used.
items.zh: 人工智慧公司正受到各國政府的嚴格審查,因為人們想知道自己的資料如何被使用。

items.def: to try to find out the facts about something
items.s: The police are ________ing a fake video of the mayor, and they believe it was made with free AI software.
items.zh: 警方正在調查一段市長的假影片,他們認為它是用免費的人工智慧軟體製作的。

items.def: a set of questions asked to many people to learn their opinions
items.s: A recent ________ of university students found that most use AI weekly, but many feel unsure about the rules.
items.zh: 最近一項針對大學生的調查發現,大多數人每週使用人工智慧,但許多人對規定感到不確定。

items.def: facts and numbers collected for study
items.s: Companies collect huge amounts of ________ from our phones, and they use it to decide which adverts we see.
items.zh: 公司從我們的手機蒐集大量資料,並用它來決定我們會看到哪些廣告。

items.def: numbers that give information about something
items.s: Government ________ show that more older people are shopping online, so banks are offering classes to help them stay safe.
items.zh: 政府統計數據顯示越來越多長者在網路上購物,所以銀行正在開課幫助他們維護安全。

items.def: facts that show something is true
items.s: There is little ________ that AI apps alone improve exam results, but they seem to help when teachers guide their use.
items.zh: 幾乎沒有證據顯示單靠人工智慧應用程式就能提升考試成績,但在老師引導使用時似乎有幫助。

items.def: based on real experiments or observation, not theory
items.cn: 實證的;以經驗為依據的
items.s: We need more ________ research on AI in classrooms, because most claims so far come from companies selling the tools.
items.zh: 我們需要更多關於課堂人工智慧的實證研究,因為目前大多數說法都來自販售這些工具的公司。

items.def: based on facts, not personal feelings
items.s: Some people think computers are more ________ than humans, but AI can also be unfair if it learns from biased data.
items.zh: 有些人認為電腦比人類更客觀,但人工智慧若從有偏見的資料中學習,也可能不公平。

items.def: based on personal feelings or opinions
items.s: Judging a poem is very ________, so many teachers do not trust AI to give fair scores for creative writing.
items.zh: 評斷一首詩是非常主觀的,所以許多老師不相信人工智慧能為創意寫作公平打分。

items.def: able to be trusted
items.s: Wikipedia can be a useful starting point, but it is not always ________, so check the sources at the bottom of the page.
items.zh: 維基百科可以是有用的起點,但它不一定可靠,所以要查看頁面底部的資料來源。

items.def: based on good reasons or facts; acceptable
items.s: Your argument is ________, but you need more examples to support it, so try adding a real case from the news.
items.zh: 你的論點站得住腳,但你需要更多例子來支持它,所以試著加入一個新聞中的真實案例。

items.def: correct and true in every detail
items.s: The weather app is usually ________, but yesterday it said sunny and we got caught in heavy rain on the way home.
items.zh: 天氣應用程式通常很準確,但昨天它說是晴天,結果我們回家路上被大雨淋到。

items.def: exact and clear in every detail
items.s: The map gave ________ directions to the café, so we found it easily even though it was hidden in a small lane.
items.zh: 地圖給了到咖啡館的精確路線,所以即使它藏在一條小巷裡,我們還是很容易就找到了。

items.def: always behaving or happening in the same way
items.s: If you practise English for ten minutes every day, your progress will be more ________ than if you study once a week for hours.
items.zh: 如果你每天練習英文十分鐘,你的進步會比一週讀一次好幾小時更穩定一致。

items.def: not staying the same; changing in a confusing way
items.s: The chatbot gave ________ answers to the same question, so I stopped trusting it for my science homework.
items.zh: 聊天機器人對同一個問題給出前後不一致的答案,所以我寫自然作業時不再相信它。

items.def: happening without any plan or pattern
items.s: The app shows ________ words each day, but I prefer lists that are organised by topic because they are easier to remember.
items.zh: 這個應用程式每天顯示隨機的單字,但我比較喜歡按主題分類的清單,因為比較好記。

items.def: a small group chosen to represent a larger group
items.s: The researchers asked a ________ of 500 students about AI, but critics said all of them came from city schools.
items.zh: 研究人員針對五百名學生的樣本詢問有關人工智慧的問題,但批評者說他們全都來自城市學校。

items.def: a person who takes part in an activity or study
items.s: Each ________ in the study used an AI tutor for a month, and then they took the same English test again.
items.zh: 研究中的每位參與者都使用人工智慧家教一個月,然後再考一次相同的英文測驗。

items.def: a part of a whole, compared with the total
items.s: A large ________ of online shoppers are now over sixty, so websites are making their text bigger and clearer.
items.zh: 網路購物者中有很大比例現在超過六十歲,所以網站正在把文字放大、變得更清楚。

items.def: an amount shown as part of 100
items.s: The ________ of homes with fast internet is high in Taipei, but it is much lower in the mountains.
items.zh: 在台北,擁有高速網路的家庭百分比很高,但在山區則低得多。

items.def: more than half of a group
items.s: The ________ of my classmates use AI to check grammar, but only a few use it to write whole paragraphs.
items.zh: 我的同學中大多數都用人工智慧檢查文法,但只有少數人用它寫整段文章。

items.def: less than half of a group
items.s: Only a ________ of teachers have received AI training, so many are still unsure how to use it in lessons.
items.zh: 只有少數老師接受過人工智慧培訓,所以許多人仍不確定如何在課堂上使用它。

items.def: close to an exact number, but not exactly
items.s: ________ half of all office tasks could be done by AI, but most jobs include skills that machines still cannot copy.
items.zh: 大約一半的辦公室工作可以由人工智慧完成,但大多數工作都包含機器仍無法複製的技能。

items.def: to guess a number or amount by thinking carefully
items.s: Experts ________ that the market for AI tools will double in five years, so many companies are hiring quickly.
items.zh: 專家估計人工智慧工具的市場將在五年內翻倍,所以許多公司正在快速招募人才。

items.def: to say what will happen in the future
items.s: AI can ________ which students might fail a course, so teachers can offer extra help before it is too late.
items.zh: 人工智慧能預測哪些學生可能會被當,所以老師可以在為時已晚之前提供額外幫助。

items.def: to say what will probably happen, often with weather or money
items.s: The bank ________ that online payments would keep growing, so it closed several branches and opened a new app.
items.zh: 這家銀行預測線上付款會持續成長,所以關閉了幾家分行並推出新的應用程式。

items.def: to expect something and prepare for it
items.s: We did not ________ that the new app would be so popular, so the servers crashed on the first day.
items.zh: 我們沒有預料到這個新應用程式會這麼受歡迎,所以伺服器在第一天就當機了。

items.def: to guess about something without enough facts
items.s: Many people ________ about what jobs will look like in 2050, but nobody can know for sure because technology changes so fast.
items.zh: 許多人推測2050年的工作會是什麼樣子,但沒有人能確定,因為科技變化太快了。

items.def: how probable something is
items.s: The ________ of being tricked by a scam is higher for people who do not know about AI voice copies, so education is important.
items.zh: 不了解人工智慧聲音模仿的人被詐騙的可能性較高,所以教育很重要。

items.def: how likely something is to happen, often as a number
items.s: The app says there is a 70% ________ of rain, so I decided to bring an umbrella even though the sky looked clear.
items.zh: 應用程式說有百分之七十的降雨機率,所以雖然天空看起來很晴朗,我還是決定帶傘。

items.def: a feeling of not being sure about something
items.s: There is a lot of ________ about which jobs will survive, so many parents do not know what to tell their children to study.
items.zh: 哪些工作能留存下來有很大的不確定性,所以許多家長不知道該建議孩子讀什麼。

items.def: having more than one possible meaning
items.s: My prompt was ________, so the AI wrote a story about a bat the animal when I wanted one about a baseball bat.
items.zh: 我的提示詞模稜兩可,所以當我想要一個關於棒球棒的故事時,人工智慧寫了一個關於蝙蝠的故事。

items.def: easy to see or understand
items.s: It soon became ________ that the essay was written by AI, because it used words that the student had never learned.
items.zh: 很快就明顯看出那篇作文是人工智慧寫的,因為它用了那位學生從沒學過的字。

items.def: clear and easy to notice
items.s: The benefits of online banking are ________, but older users still need help to protect themselves from scams.
items.zh: 網路銀行的好處顯而易見,但年長的使用者仍需要協助來保護自己免於詐騙。

items.def: being a natural part of something that cannot be removed
items.s: There are ________ risks in sharing personal photos online, because once they are posted, you can never fully delete them.
items.zh: 在網路上分享個人照片有其固有的風險,因為一旦貼出,你就永遠無法完全刪除。

items.def: basic and very important
items.s: Reading and thinking are ________ skills, so students should not let AI do all their reading for them.
items.zh: 閱讀和思考是基本技能,所以學生不應該讓人工智慧替他們完成所有的閱讀。

items.def: completely necessary
items.s: A stable internet connection is ________ for online classes, so the school lends Wi-Fi devices to families who need them.
items.zh: 穩定的網路連線對線上課程是不可或缺的,所以學校會借無線網路設備給有需要的家庭。

items.def: extremely important and necessary
items.s: It is ________ to teach children about online safety early, because many of them have phones before they are ten.
items.zh: 及早教孩子網路安全是極為重要的,因為他們很多人不到十歲就有手機了。

items.def: main; most important
items.s: The ________ goal of the new law is to protect children, but it also gives adults more control over their data.
items.zh: 這項新法律的主要目標是保護兒童,但它也讓成人對自己的資料有更多掌控。

items.def: less important than something else
items.s: For our teacher, the final grade is ________, and what matters most is that we learn to think for ourselves.
items.zh: 對我們的老師來說,最終成績是次要的,最重要的是我們學會獨立思考。

items.def: happening after something else
items.s: The first version of the app had many problems, but ________ updates fixed most of them, so users came back.
items.zh: 這個應用程式的第一版有很多問題,但後續的更新修好了大部分,所以使用者又回來了。

items.def: happening before something
items.s: No ________ experience is needed for the coding course, so anyone who is curious about AI can join.
items.zh: 這門程式課不需要事先的經驗,所以任何對人工智慧好奇的人都可以參加。

items.def: before now or before a particular time
items.s: The job was ________ done by three people, but now one worker and an AI program handle it together.
items.zh: 這份工作以前是由三個人做的,但現在由一名員工和一套人工智慧程式一起處理。

items.def: at the beginning
items.s: ________, I thought the AI tutor was boring, but after a few weeks I found that my speaking had improved a lot.
items.zh: 起初,我覺得人工智慧家教很無聊,但幾週後我發現我的口說進步了很多。

items.def: in the end; finally
items.s: AI can give advice, but ________ it is the doctor who must decide on the treatment and explain it to the patient.
items.zh: 人工智慧能給建議,但最終還是由醫生決定治療方式並向病人說明。

items.def: after a long time or many problems
items.s: The robot made many mistakes at first, but it ________ learned to fold clothes as well as a person.
items.zh: 這個機器人一開始犯了很多錯,但它最後學會了像人一樣好地摺衣服。

items.def: in addition; also
items.s: The app is free, and ________, it works without the internet, so it is perfect for students in the countryside.
items.zh: 這個應用程式是免費的,而且它不需要網路就能使用,所以非常適合鄉下的學生。

items.def: used to add more information
items.s: Online classes save travel time; ________, students can watch the recordings again if they miss something.
items.zh: 線上課程節省通勤時間;此外,學生如果漏掉什麼還可以再看錄影。

items.def: despite what has just been said
items.s: The AI essay had perfect grammar; ________, the teacher gave it a low mark because it had no personal ideas.
items.zh: 那篇人工智慧作文文法完美;儘管如此,老師還是給了低分,因為它沒有個人的想法。

items.def: used to compare two different facts
items.s: My brother learns best from videos, ________ I prefer reading because I can stop and think about each sentence.
items.zh: 我哥哥看影片學得最好,而我比較喜歡閱讀,因為我可以停下來思考每個句子。

items.def: as a result of this action
items.s: The school blocked some websites during tests, ________ making it harder for students to search for answers online.
items.zh: 學校在考試期間封鎖了某些網站,從而讓學生更難上網搜尋答案。

items.def: for this reason
items.s: The robot cannot climb stairs, ________ it is only used on the ground floor, but the company is building a better model.
items.zh: 這個機器人不能爬樓梯,因此它只用在一樓,但公司正在打造更好的機型。

items.def: although
items.s: The new translation app is useful, ________ a little slow, so I still carry a small dictionary when I travel.
items.zh: 這個新的翻譯應用程式很有用,雖然有點慢,所以我旅行時還是會帶一本小字典。

items.def: used to suggest another choice
items.s: You can hand in your project on paper; ________, you can upload it online, but please do not do both.
items.zh: 你可以交紙本專題;或者,你也可以上傳到網路,但請不要兩種都交。

items.def: another choice or possibility
items.s: If the school bans phones, it should offer an ________, such as tablets, so students can still use learning apps.
items.zh: 如果學校禁止手機,就應該提供替代方案,例如平板,讓學生仍能使用學習應用程式。

items.def: something that has the same value or meaning
items.s: An hour of online tutoring costs the ________ of two cups of coffee, so many families can afford it.
items.zh: 一小時的線上家教費用相當於兩杯咖啡,所以許多家庭都負擔得起。

items.def: similar enough to be compared
items.s: The cheaper laptop has ________ speed to the expensive one, so I bought it and spent the extra money on books.
items.zh: 這台較便宜的筆電和貴的那台速度相當,所以我買了它,並把省下的錢拿去買書。

items.def: connected to what is being discussed
items.s: The AI gave me lots of information, but much of it was not ________ to my topic, so I had to delete half of it.
items.zh: 人工智慧給了我很多資訊,但很多都和我的主題不相關,所以我必須刪掉一半。

items.def: suitable for a situation
items.s: It is not ________ to use a chatbot during a test, but it can be a helpful study partner at home.
items.zh: 考試時使用聊天機器人是不適當的,但在家裡它可以是有幫助的讀書夥伴。

items.def: enough or good enough for a purpose
items.s: Many rural schools do not have ________ computers, so students must share one device between three people.
items.zh: 許多鄉村學校沒有足夠的電腦,所以學生必須三個人共用一台設備。

items.def: enough for a particular purpose
items.s: One week was not ________ time to learn the new software, so the manager gave the team another training session.
items.zh: 一週的時間不足以學會新軟體,所以經理又為團隊安排了一次培訓課程。

items.def: not enough
items.s: The study used ________ data from older people, so its results may not apply to everyone.
items.zh: 這項研究使用的長者資料不足,所以它的結果可能不適用於每個人。

items.def: existing in large amounts
items.s: Information is ________ online, but good judgement is rare, so students must learn to choose the best sources.
items.zh: 網路上的資訊豐富,但良好的判斷力卻很少見,所以學生必須學會選擇最好的資料來源。

items.def: not easy to find; not enough
items.s: Skilled AI engineers are ________ in many countries, so companies offer very high salaries to attract them.
items.zh: 許多國家都缺乏熟練的人工智慧工程師,所以公司提供非常高的薪水來吸引他們。

items.def: including many different types of people or things
items.s: The company hired a ________ team to test its AI, because people from different backgrounds notice different problems.
items.zh: 這家公司聘請了一支多元的團隊來測試它的人工智慧,因為來自不同背景的人會注意到不同的問題。

items.def: a range of many different people or things
items.s: There is little ________ in the photos used to train some AI systems, so they make more mistakes with certain faces.
items.zh: 用來訓練某些人工智慧系統的照片缺乏多樣性,所以它們在某些臉孔上犯更多錯。

items.def: clearly different or separate
items.s: Human writing and AI writing used to be quite ________, but now even teachers sometimes cannot tell them apart.
items.zh: 人類的寫作和人工智慧的寫作過去相當不同,但現在連老師有時都分辨不出來。

items.def: to see the difference between things
items.s: Young children often cannot ________ between real videos and AI videos, so parents should watch with them.
items.zh: 幼童常常無法區分真實影片和人工智慧影片,所以家長應該陪他們一起看。

items.def: to show or find the difference between things
items.s: Good teachers ________ their lessons for different learners, and AI tools can help them prepare tasks at several levels.
items.zh: 好老師會針對不同的學習者區分教學內容,而人工智慧工具能幫助他們準備不同程度的任務。

items.def: to put things into groups
items.s: The email app ________s messages into work, shopping and social, so I can find important emails more quickly.
items.zh: 這個郵件應用程式把訊息分類成工作、購物和社交,所以我能更快找到重要的郵件。

items.def: to recognise and name someone or something
items.s: The app can ________ a plant from a single photo, so our class used it during the school field trip.
items.zh: 這個應用程式能從一張照片辨識出植物,所以我們班在校外教學時用了它。

items.def: to explain the exact meaning of a word or idea
items.s: It is hard to ________ creativity, but most people agree that it involves new ideas, not just copying old ones.
items.zh: 定義創造力很難,但大多數人同意它涉及新的想法,而不只是模仿舊的。

items.def: to state something clearly and in detail
items.s: The teacher asked us to ________ which parts of our project used AI, so she could fairly judge our own work.
items.zh: 老師要我們具體說明專題中哪些部分用了人工智慧,這樣她才能公平地評斷我們自己的作品。

items.def: to limit what someone can do
items.s: Some parents ________ their children's screen use to one hour a day, but the children often find ways around the rules.
items.zh: 有些家長把孩子使用螢幕的時間限制在一天一小時,但孩子們常常找到規避規定的方法。

items.def: a rule that limits what you can do
items.s: The new ________s on AI in exams are strict, so students who break them may have to take the test again.
items.zh: 考試中使用人工智慧的新規定很嚴格,所以違反的學生可能必須重考。

items.def: to officially forbid something
items.s: The rules ________ students from recording teachers without permission, because it could break their privacy.
items.zh: 規定禁止學生未經允許錄下老師的影音,因為這可能侵犯他們的隱私。

items.def: to allow something officially
items.s: Our school ________s AI for brainstorming, but it does not allow students to copy AI answers into their essays.
items.zh: 我們學校允許用人工智慧腦力激盪,但不准學生把人工智慧的答案抄進作文裡。

items.def: to obey a rule or request
items.s: All apps sold in Europe must ________ with strict data laws, so some companies changed their products for those markets.
items.zh: 所有在歐洲販售的應用程式都必須遵守嚴格的資料法規,所以有些公司為那些市場修改了產品。

items.def: to make sure that people obey a rule or law
items.s: It is difficult to ________ the no-AI rule at home, so teachers now give more writing tasks in class.
items.zh: 在家裡很難執行禁用人工智慧的規定,所以老師們現在在課堂上給更多寫作任務。

items.def: to force people to accept a rule or cost
items.s: The government plans to ________ heavy fines on companies that make deepfakes without clear labels.
items.zh: 政府計畫對製作深偽影片卻未清楚標示的公司處以高額罰款。

items.def: the power to make decisions, or an official group with this power
items.s: The education ________ will decide next month whether students can use AI in the national exams.
items.zh: 教育當局將在下個月決定學生是否能在全國考試中使用人工智慧。

items.def: a large important organisation, like a university or bank
items.s: Every ________ needs its own AI policy, because a hospital and a school face very different risks.
items.zh: 每個機構都需要自己的人工智慧政策,因為醫院和學校面臨的風險非常不同。

items.def: able to continue without harming the environment
items.s: AI uses a lot of energy, so companies are looking for more ________ ways to power their data centres.
items.zh: 人工智慧使用大量能源,所以公司正在尋找更永續的方式為它們的資料中心供電。

items.def: to take part in an activity
items.s: Shy students often ________ more in online discussions, because they have time to think before they type.
items.zh: 害羞的學生在線上討論中通常參與得更多,因為他們在打字之前有時間思考。

items.def: to work together with others
items.s: Students from Taiwan and Japan ________d on a project using online tools, and they presented it together on video.
items.zh: 台灣和日本的學生用線上工具合作完成一項專題,並一起用視訊發表。

items.def: working together to reach a shared goal
items.s: International ________ is needed to control AI, because the internet does not stop at any country's border.
items.zh: 管控人工智慧需要國際合作,因為網路不會在任何國家的邊界停下來。

items.def: to discuss something to reach an agreement
items.s: The workers' union ________d with the company, so staff who lost jobs to AI will get training and extra pay.
items.zh: 工會與公司協商,所以因人工智慧而失業的員工將獲得培訓和額外補償。

items.def: to find a solution to a problem
items.s: The customer service bot could not ________ my problem, so I finally asked to speak to a real person.
items.zh: 客服機器人無法解決我的問題,所以我最後要求和真人通話。

items.def: to start dealing with a problem
items.s: Schools must ________ the problem of AI cheating, but simply banning the tools is not likely to work.
items.zh: 學校必須處理人工智慧作弊的問題,但單純禁止這些工具不太可能有效。

items.def: to face and deal with a difficult problem
items.s: Society must ________ the fact that some jobs will disappear, so it should prepare workers for new kinds of work.
items.zh: 社會必須正視某些工作將會消失的事實,所以應該讓勞工為新型態的工作做好準備。

items.def: to succeed in dealing with a problem
items.s: My grandmother ________ her fear of computers, and now she video-calls her friends and shops online every week.
items.zh: 我奶奶克服了對電腦的恐懼,現在她每週都和朋友視訊並上網購物。

items.def: something that blocks you from doing something
items.s: Cost is the biggest ________ for poor families, because they cannot afford laptops or fast internet for their children.
items.zh: 費用是貧困家庭最大的障礙,因為他們負擔不起孩子的筆電或高速網路。

items.def: something that stops people from doing or getting something
items.s: Translation apps help break down language ________s, so tourists can talk to taxi drivers and shop owners easily.
items.zh: 翻譯應用程式幫助打破語言隔閡,所以遊客能輕鬆地和計程車司機及店主交談。

items.def: a hard situation where you must choose between two options
items.s: Teachers face a ________: if they ban AI, students may fall behind, but if they allow it, students may stop thinking.
items.zh: 老師們面臨一個兩難:如果禁止人工智慧,學生可能會落後,但如果允許,學生可能會停止思考。

items.def: a situation that seems strange because it has two opposite facts
items.s: It is a ________ that we have more ways to connect online than ever, but many young people say they feel lonelier.
items.zh: 這是一個矛盾:我們在網路上聯繫的方式比以往任何時候都多,但許多年輕人說他們感覺更孤單。

items.def: agreement among most people in a group
items.s: There is no ________ yet on how to use AI in schools, so each country is trying a different approach.
items.zh: 對於如何在學校使用人工智慧尚未有共識,所以每個國家都在嘗試不同的方法。

items.def: a serious disagreement
items.s: There is a ________ between parents who want more technology in class and parents who want children to read real books.
items.zh: 希望課堂上有更多科技的家長和希望孩子讀實體書的家長之間存在衝突。

items.def: a feeling of worry or bad feeling between people
items.s: There is growing ________ between artists and AI companies, because many artists feel their work was used without permission.
items.zh: 藝術家與人工智慧公司之間的緊張關係日益加劇,因為許多藝術家覺得他們的作品未經允許就被使用。

items.def: a possible result of an action, often unexpected
items.s: Few people thought about the ________s of sharing family photos online, but now these photos can be used to make deepfakes.
items.zh: 很少有人想過在網路上分享家庭照片的後果,但現在這些照片可能被用來製作深偽影片。

items.def: a strong effect on something
items.s: AI will have a huge ________ on jobs, but its effect on our daily lives may be even bigger.
items.zh: 人工智慧將對工作造成巨大的衝擊,但它對我們日常生活的影響可能更大。

items.def: to have an effect on how someone thinks or acts
items.s: Social media apps ________ what young people buy, because they show the same products again and again.
items.zh: 社群媒體應用程式影響年輕人購買的東西,因為它們一再展示相同的商品。

items.def: to cause a change in someone or something
items.s: Using phones late at night can ________ your sleep, so many students feel tired during morning classes.
items.zh: 深夜使用手機會影響你的睡眠,所以許多學生在早上的課堂上感到疲倦。

items.def: to change something, usually slightly
items.s: It is very easy to ________ a photo with AI, so you should not believe every picture you see online.
items.zh: 用人工智慧修改照片非常容易,所以你不應該相信網路上看到的每張圖片。

items.def: to change something a little to improve it
items.s: The teacher ________d the test after she found that the AI could answer every question, and now it asks for personal opinions.
items.zh: 老師發現人工智慧能回答每個問題後修改了考卷,現在它要求寫出個人意見。

items.def: to change to suit a new situation
items.s: Older workers can ________ to new technology, but they need patient training and enough time to practise.
items.zh: 年長員工能夠適應新科技,但他們需要有耐心的培訓和足夠的練習時間。

items.def: to change something slightly to make it work better
items.s: You can ________ the speed of the reading app, so beginners can listen slowly while advanced learners go faster.
items.zh: 你可以調整閱讀應用程式的速度,所以初學者可以慢慢聽,而進階學習者可以加快。

items.def: to make something work as well as possible
items.s: The delivery company uses AI to ________ its routes, so drivers save time and the company spends less on fuel.
items.zh: 這家物流公司用人工智慧優化路線,所以司機節省時間,公司也花更少的燃料費。

items.def: to make something as large as possible
items.s: Online shops use AI to ________ sales, but sometimes they push customers to buy things they do not need.
items.zh: 網路商店用人工智慧將銷售額最大化,但有時它們會促使顧客購買不需要的東西。

items.def: to make something as small as possible
