items.s: To ________ the risk of scams, never share your password, and always call your bank if a message seems strange.
items.zh: 為了把詐騙風險降到最低,絕不要分享你的密碼,如果訊息看起來奇怪,一定要打電話給銀行。

items.def: to remove something completely
items.s: AI may ________ some boring office tasks, so workers can spend more time on creative and social work.
items.zh: 人工智慧可能會消除一些無聊的辦公室工作,讓員工能花更多時間在創意和社交工作上。

items.def: to become or make smaller or less important
items.s: If students let AI think for them, their writing skills may ________, so teachers encourage them to write first drafts alone.
items.zh: 如果學生讓人工智慧替他們思考,他們的寫作能力可能會減弱,所以老師鼓勵他們獨自寫初稿。

items.def: to become or make bigger
items.s: The online learning company plans to ________ into Southeast Asia, because many families there want cheap English lessons.
items.zh: 這家線上學習公司計畫擴展到東南亞,因為那裡許多家庭想要便宜的英文課。

items.def: computer systems that can think and learn like people
items.s: ______ ______ is changing the way we study, because students can now get instant explanations for difficult problems at any time.
items.zh: 人工智慧正在改變我們學習的方式,因為學生現在隨時都能針對困難的問題得到即時的解說。

items.def: a way for computers to learn from data without step-by-step instructions
items.s: The music app uses ______ ______ to study the songs you skip, so its suggestions get better every week.
items.zh: 這個音樂應用程式使用機器學習來研究你跳過的歌曲,所以它的推薦每週都變得更好。

items.def: extremely large amounts of information studied by computers
items.s: Supermarkets use ______ ______ to see what customers buy together, and then they place those products side by side.
items.zh: 超市使用大數據來了解顧客會一起購買哪些商品,然後把那些商品並排擺放。

items.def: the gap between people who have technology and those who do not
items.s: The ______ ______ became clear during online classes, because some children had no computer while others had two.
items.zh: 線上課程期間數位落差變得很明顯,因為有些孩子沒有電腦,而其他人卻有兩台。

items.def: the record of everything you do online
items.s: Everything you post leaves a ______ ______, so think carefully before sharing photos that might embarrass you later.
items.zh: 你貼出的每樣東西都會留下數位足跡,所以在分享日後可能讓你難堪的照片前要仔細想想。

items.def: using the newest and most advanced ideas
items.s: Taiwan's chip makers are ______ ______ ______ ______ of technology, so AI companies around the world depend on them.
items.zh: 台灣的晶片製造商處於科技的最尖端,所以全世界的人工智慧公司都依賴它們。

items.def: the feeling that you will not lose your job
items.s: Many office workers worry about their ______ ______, because AI can already write emails and reports in seconds.
items.zh: 許多上班族擔心他們的工作保障,因為人工智慧已經能在幾秒內寫好電子郵件和報告。

items.def: being honest in schoolwork and not cheating
items.s: The university held a talk on ______ ______, because more students were handing in essays written by chatbots.
items.zh: 這所大學舉辦了一場關於學術誠信的講座,因為越來越多學生交出聊天機器人寫的作文。

items.def: something that has both good and bad effects
items.s: AI is ______ ______ ______ for students, because it can explain hard ideas but also makes cheating very easy.
items.zh: 人工智慧對學生來說是一把雙面刃,因為它能解釋困難的概念,但也讓作弊變得非常容易。

items.def: to change or move as fast as something else
items.s: Schools find it hard to ______ ______ ______ new technology, so their rules are often out of date by the time they are published.
items.zh: 學校發現很難跟上新科技,所以它們的規定在公布時往往已經過時了。

items.def: a mistake made by a person, not a machine
items.s: Most car accidents are caused by ______ ______, so supporters of driverless cars believe they will make roads safer.
items.zh: 大多數車禍是由人為疏失造成的,所以無人駕駛車的支持者認為它們會讓道路更安全。

items.def: to begin to do something that someone else did before
items.s: Robots have ______ ______ many dangerous factory jobs, but humans are still needed to repair and check them.
items.zh: 機器人已經接手了許多危險的工廠工作,但仍需要人類來維修和檢查它們。

items.def: careful thinking to judge whether information is true or good
items.s: ______ ______ is more important than ever, because AI can produce answers that sound confident but are completely wrong.
items.zh: 批判性思考比以往任何時候都更重要,因為人工智慧可能產生聽起來很有把握卻完全錯誤的答案。

items.def: the kindness and understanding that only a person can give
items.s: The robot nurse is efficient, but patients say it lacks ______ ______ ______, so they still prefer a real nurse's smile.
items.zh: 機器人護理師很有效率,但病人說它缺少人情味,所以他們仍偏好真人護理師的笑容。

items.def: to make people worried about something
items.s: Facial scanning in schools has ______ ______ among parents, because nobody is sure how long the photos are kept.
items.zh: 學校的臉部掃描已在家長之間引發擔憂,因為沒有人確定這些照片會保存多久。

items.def: the advantages and disadvantages of something
items.s: Our class debated the ______ ______ ______ of AI tutors, and most students agreed they are useful but cannot replace teachers.
items.zh: 我們班辯論了人工智慧家教的利弊,大多數學生同意它們很有用,但無法取代老師。

items.def: over a long period of time in the future
items.s: Learning to write well yourself takes effort, but ______ ______ ______ ______ it will help you much more than copying AI answers.
items.zh: 自己學會寫好文章需要努力,但長遠來看,它對你的幫助會比抄人工智慧的答案大得多。

items.def: to fail to keep up with others
items.s: Workers who refuse to learn new digital skills may ______ ______, so many companies offer free training courses.
items.zh: 拒絕學習新數位技能的員工可能會落後,所以許多公司提供免費的培訓課程。

items.def: to join something popular just because others are doing it
items.s: Many companies ______ ______ ______ ______ and added AI to their products, but some of these features are not useful at all.
items.zh: 許多公司跟風,在產品中加入人工智慧,但其中有些功能根本沒有用。

items.def: something that completely changes how things are done
items.cn: 改變局勢的事物;顛覆性創新
items.s: Translation apps have been a ______ ______ for travellers, because they can now read signs and menus in any language.
items.zh: 翻譯應用程式對旅客來說是顛覆性的創新,因為他們現在能讀懂任何語言的標誌和菜單。

2.zh: 野生動物保育與瀕危物種

items.def: a group of animals or plants of the same kind
items.s: Scientists discovered a new ________ of frog in the mountains of Taiwan, and they are now studying how it survives the cold winters.
items.zh: 科學家在台灣山區發現了一種新的青蛙物種，他們現在正在研究牠如何度過寒冷的冬天。
items.sec: Species & Biodiversity 物種與生物多樣性

items.def: in danger of disappearing forever
items.s: The Formosan clouded leopard was once an ________ animal in Taiwan, but sadly no one has seen one in the wild for many years.
items.zh: 台灣雲豹曾經是台灣瀕臨絕種的動物，但遺憾的是，已經很多年沒有人在野外見過牠了。
items.sec: Species & Biodiversity 物種與生物多樣性

items.def: no longer existing anywhere in the world
items.s: Dinosaurs have been ________ for about 66 million years, so we can only learn about them from fossils and bones.
items.zh: 恐龍已經絕種大約六千六百萬年了，所以我們只能從化石和骨頭來認識牠們。
items.sec: Species & Biodiversity 物種與生物多樣性

items.def: the situation when a species no longer exists
items.s: Many frogs around the world face ________ because a deadly disease is spreading quickly, and scientists are racing to find a cure.
items.zh: 世界各地許多青蛙正面臨滅絕，因為一種致命的疾病正在迅速擴散，而科學家們正爭分奪秒地尋找解藥。
items.sec: Species & Biodiversity 物種與生物多樣性

items.def: the variety of plants and animals in one place
items.s: Coral reefs have amazing ________ because thousands of fish and sea creatures live there, so protecting them is very important.
items.zh: 珊瑚礁擁有驚人的生物多樣性，因為有成千上萬種魚類和海洋生物住在那裡，所以保護它們非常重要。
items.sec: Species & Biodiversity 物種與生物多樣性

items.def: an animal that feeds its babies with milk
items.s: A whale looks like a giant fish, but it is actually a ________ because it breathes air and feeds its babies with milk.
items.zh: 鯨魚看起來像一條巨大的魚，但牠其實是一種哺乳動物，因為牠呼吸空氣並用乳汁餵養寶寶。
items.sec: Species & Biodiversity 物種與生物多樣性

items.def: a cold-blooded animal with dry skin, like a snake
items.s: A turtle is a ________ that lays its eggs on the beach, and the baby turtles must run to the sea after they hatch.
items.zh: 烏龜是一種會在海灘上產卵的爬蟲類動物，而小海龜孵化後必須奔向大海。
items.sec: Species & Biodiversity 物種與生物多樣性

items.def: an animal that lives both in water and on land
items.s: A frog is an ________ because it begins life in the water as a tadpole, but later it can also live on land.
items.zh: 青蛙是一種兩棲動物，因為牠一開始以蝌蚪的形態生活在水中，但之後也能在陸地上生活。
items.sec: Species & Biodiversity 物種與生物多樣性

items.def: a group of animals that includes monkeys, apes and humans
items.s: The Formosan rock macaque is the only wild ________ in Taiwan, and you can often see groups of them at Shoushan in Kaohsiung.
items.zh: 台灣獼猴是台灣唯一的野生靈長類動物，你常常可以在高雄的壽山看到成群的牠們。
items.sec: Species & Biodiversity 物種與生物多樣性

items.def: a small animal with sharp front teeth, like a mouse
items.s: A squirrel is a ________ with strong front teeth, so it can easily break open hard nuts and seeds in the forest.
items.zh: 松鼠是一種前齒很強壯的囓齒動物，所以牠能輕易地咬開森林裡堅硬的堅果和種子。
items.sec: Species & Biodiversity 物種與生物多樣性

items.def: an animal that carries its baby in a pouch
items.s: The kangaroo is the most famous ________ in Australia, and the mother carries her tiny baby in a pouch for several months.
items.zh: 袋鼠是澳洲最有名的有袋動物，而母袋鼠會把小小的寶寶放在育兒袋裡好幾個月。
items.sec: Species & Biodiversity 物種與生物多樣性

items.def: an animal that eats meat
items.s: A lion is a ________ that hunts zebras and other large animals, so it needs to eat a lot of meat to stay strong.
items.zh: 獅子是一種會獵捕斑馬和其他大型動物的肉食性動物，所以牠需要吃大量的肉才能保持強壯。
items.sec: Species & Biodiversity 物種與生物多樣性

items.def: an animal that eats only plants
items.s: The giant panda is mostly a ________ because it eats bamboo almost all day, although it sometimes eats small animals too.
items.zh: 大貓熊大多是草食性動物，因為牠幾乎整天都在吃竹子，雖然牠偶爾也會吃小動物。
items.sec: Species & Biodiversity 物種與生物多樣性

items.def: an animal that eats both plants and meat
items.s: A bear is an ________ that eats fruit, insects and fish, so it can find food easily in different seasons.
items.zh: 熊是一種會吃水果、昆蟲和魚的雜食性動物，所以牠在不同季節都能輕易找到食物。
items.sec: Species & Biodiversity 物種與生物多樣性

items.def: an animal that hunts and kills other animals
items.s: The eagle is a powerful ________ in the sky, and small birds hide in the bushes whenever they see its shadow.
items.zh: 老鷹是天空中強大的掠食者，每當小鳥看到牠的影子就會躲進灌木叢裡。
items.sec: Species & Biodiversity 物種與生物多樣性

items.def: an animal that is hunted and eaten by another
items.s: Rabbits are common ________ for foxes and owls, so they always stay alert and run quickly when they hear a strange noise.
items.zh: 兔子是狐狸和貓頭鷹常見的獵物，所以牠們總是保持警覺，一聽到奇怪的聲音就會快速逃跑。
items.sec: Species & Biodiversity 物種與生物多樣性

items.def: an animal that has a backbone
items.s: Fish, birds and humans are all ________ because they have a backbone, but worms and jellyfish do not have one.
items.zh: 魚、鳥和人類都是脊椎動物，因為牠們有脊椎骨，但蟲和水母則沒有。
items.sec: Species & Biodiversity 物種與生物多樣性

items.def: an animal without a backbone
items.s: An octopus is a clever ________ that has no bones at all, so it can squeeze through very small holes.
items.zh: 章魚是一種聰明的無脊椎動物，牠完全沒有骨頭，所以能擠過非常小的洞。
items.sec: Species & Biodiversity 物種與生物多樣性

items.def: a smaller group within a species
items.s: The Formosan black bear is a ________ of the Asian black bear, and it has a white V-shaped mark on its chest.
items.zh: 台灣黑熊是亞洲黑熊的一個亞種，牠的胸前有一個白色的V字形斑紋。
items.sec: Species & Biodiversity 物種與生物多樣性

items.def: animals and plants that live in nature
items.s: Kenting National Park is full of ________, so visitors often see colourful birds, butterflies and even wild deer during their trip.
items.zh: 墾丁國家公園充滿了野生動植物，所以遊客在旅途中常常能看見色彩繽紛的鳥、蝴蝶，甚至野鹿。
items.sec: Species & Biodiversity 物種與生物多樣性

items.def: all the animals living in a particular area
items.s: The ________ of Madagascar is very special because about ninety percent of its animals cannot be found anywhere else on Earth.
items.zh: 馬達加斯加的動物群非常特別，因為那裡大約百分之九十的動物在地球上其他地方都找不到。
items.sec: Species & Biodiversity 物種與生物多樣性

items.def: all the plants growing in a particular area
items.s: The guide explained the local ________ to us during the hike, and we learned that some flowers only bloom in high mountains.
items.zh: 嚮導在健行途中向我們介紹當地的植物，我們得知有些花只在高山上開花。
items.sec: Species & Biodiversity 物種與生物多樣性

items.def: a living thing, such as a plant or animal
items.s: Even the smallest ________ in a pond plays a role in nature, because bigger animals depend on it for food.
items.zh: 即使是池塘中最小的生物在大自然中也扮演一個角色，因為較大的動物依賴牠作為食物。
items.sec: Species & Biodiversity 物種與生物多樣性

items.def: an example of an animal or plant kept for study
items.s: The museum keeps a ________ of an extinct bird in a glass box, so students can see what it looked like long ago.
items.zh: 博物館把一隻已滅絕鳥類的標本保存在玻璃盒裡，讓學生們能看到牠很久以前的模樣。
items.sec: Species & Biodiversity 物種與生物多樣性

items.def: not seen or found very often
items.s: The Mikado pheasant is a ________ bird that lives only in Taiwan's high mountains, so photographers wait for hours to take its picture.
items.zh: 帝雉是一種只生活在台灣高山的稀有鳥類，所以攝影師們會等上好幾個小時只為了拍到牠。
items.sec: Species & Biodiversity 物種與生物多樣性

items.def: found naturally in only one place
items.s: The Taiwan blue magpie is ________ to Taiwan, which means you cannot see this beautiful bird in the wild in any other country.
items.zh: 台灣藍鵲是台灣特有的鳥類，這表示你在其他任何國家的野外都看不到這種美麗的鳥。
items.sec: Species & Biodiversity 物種與生物多樣性

items.def: belonging naturally to a place; original
items.s: Farmers planted ________ trees along the river instead of foreign ones, because local birds and insects depend on them.
items.zh: 農夫們沿著河岸種植原生樹木而不是外來樹種，因為當地的鳥類和昆蟲依賴它們生存。
items.sec: Species & Biodiversity 物種與生物多樣性

items.def: active at night and sleeping during the day
items.s: Owls are ________ birds that hunt mice in the dark, so you rarely see them flying around during the day.
items.zh: 貓頭鷹是在黑暗中獵捕老鼠的夜行性鳥類，所以你很少在白天看到牠們飛來飛去。
items.sec: Species & Biodiversity 物種與生物多樣性

items.def: not able to fly
items.s: The kakapo is a ________ parrot from New Zealand, so it walks and climbs trees instead of flying away from danger.
items.zh: 鴞鸚鵡是一種來自紐西蘭的不會飛的鸚鵡，所以牠遇到危險時是用走和爬樹的方式，而不是飛走。
items.sec: Species & Biodiversity 物種與生物多樣性

items.def: an insect or animal that carries pollen between flowers
items.s: The bee is an important ________ for many fruit trees, so farmers worry when the number of bees goes down.
items.zh: 蜜蜂是許多果樹重要的授粉者，所以當蜜蜂數量減少時，農夫們就會擔心。
items.sec: Species & Biodiversity 物種與生物多樣性

items.def: the natural home of an animal or plant
items.s: When a forest is cut down, many animals lose their ________, and they have to search for a new place to live.
items.zh: 當森林被砍伐時，許多動物就失去了牠們的棲息地，而且必須尋找新的地方居住。
items.sec: Habitats & Ecosystems 棲地與生態系

items.def: all the living things in an area and how they connect
items.s: If one animal disappears from an ________, other animals and plants may also be affected because they all depend on each other.
items.zh: 如果一種動物從一個生態系統中消失，其他動植物也可能受到影響，因為牠們都互相依賴。
items.sec: Habitats & Ecosystems 棲地與生態系

items.def: the study of how living things relate to their environment
items.s: My sister studies ________ at university, and she often goes to the wetlands to count birds and test the water.
items.zh: 我姊姊在大學念生態學，她常常去濕地數鳥並檢測水質。
items.sec: Habitats & Ecosystems 棲地與生態系

items.def: related to plants, animals and their environment
items.s: Building a new road through the forest could cause serious ________ damage, so many local people are against the plan.
items.zh: 在森林中蓋一條新道路可能造成嚴重的生態破壞，所以許多當地居民反對這項計畫。
items.sec: Habitats & Ecosystems 棲地與生態系

items.def: a thick tropical forest with heavy rain all year
items.s: The Amazon ________ is home to millions of insects and animals, but large areas of it are cut down every year.
items.zh: 亞馬遜雨林是數百萬種昆蟲和動物的家園，但每年都有大片面積遭到砍伐。
items.sec: Habitats & Ecosystems 棲地與生態系

items.def: land that is wet, such as a marsh or swamp
items.s: The black-faced spoonbills spend the winter in the ________ of Tainan, so many birdwatchers visit the area every year.
items.zh: 黑面琵鷺在台南的濕地過冬，所以每年都有許多賞鳥人士造訪那個地區。
items.sec: Habitats & Ecosystems 棲地與生態系

items.def: a large area of land covered with grass
items.s: Zebras and antelopes live on the African ________, and they travel long distances every year to find fresh grass and water.
items.zh: 斑馬和羚羊生活在非洲的草原上，牠們每年都要長途跋涉尋找新鮮的草和水。
items.sec: Habitats & Ecosystems 棲地與生態系

items.def: a flat grassy plain in a hot country with few trees
items.s: Lions rest under the trees of the ________ during the hot afternoon, and they usually hunt when the sun goes down.
items.zh: 獅子在炎熱的午後於熱帶大草原的樹下休息，而牠們通常在太陽下山後才狩獵。
items.sec: Habitats & Ecosystems 棲地與生態系

items.def: a cold, flat area with no trees near the Arctic
items.s: The Arctic ________ is frozen for most of the year, but in summer it becomes green and many birds fly there to lay eggs.
items.zh: 北極凍原一年中大部分時間都是冰凍的，但到了夏天就會變綠，許多鳥會飛到那裡產卵。
items.sec: Habitats & Ecosystems 棲地與生態系

items.def: a hard sea substance made by tiny sea animals
items.s: When the sea becomes too warm, ________ turns white and may die, so divers are worried about the future of the reefs.
items.zh: 當海水變得太暖時，珊瑚會變白甚至死亡，所以潛水員們很擔心珊瑚礁的未來。
items.sec: Habitats & Ecosystems 棲地與生態系

items.def: a line of rock or coral near the surface of the sea
items.s: We went snorkelling near a ________ in Green Island, and we saw colourful fish swimming between the rocks.
items.zh: 我們在綠島的一處珊瑚礁附近浮潛，看到了色彩繽紛的魚在岩石之間游來游去。
items.sec: Habitats & Ecosystems 棲地與生態系

items.def: a tree that grows in salty water along coasts
items.s: The ________ along the coast protect the land from strong waves, and they also give young fish a safe place to grow.
items.zh: 海岸邊的紅樹林保護陸地免受大浪侵襲，同時也提供小魚一個安全成長的地方。
items.sec: Habitats & Ecosystems 棲地與生態系

items.def: the wide part of a river where it meets the sea
items.s: The Danshui River ________ is full of crabs and birds, because fresh water and sea water mix there and bring plenty of food.
items.zh: 淡水河河口充滿了螃蟹和鳥類，因為淡水和海水在那裡交會，帶來了豐富的食物。
items.sec: Habitats & Ecosystems 棲地與生態系

items.def: the top layer of branches and leaves in a forest
items.s: Many monkeys spend their whole lives in the forest ________, so they rarely come down to the ground.
items.zh: 許多猴子一生都待在森林的樹冠層，所以牠們很少下到地面上。
items.sec: Habitats & Ecosystems 棲地與生態系

items.def: bushes and small plants growing under big trees
items.s: The small deer hid in the thick ________ when it heard our footsteps, so we could not take a photo of it.
items.zh: 小鹿聽到我們的腳步聲就躲進了茂密的矮樹叢裡，所以我們沒辦法拍到牠的照片。
items.sec: Habitats & Ecosystems 棲地與生態系

items.def: a hole in the ground that an animal digs to live in
items.s: The pangolin digs a deep ________ under the ground, and it sleeps there during the day to stay cool and safe.
items.zh: 穿山甲在地底下挖了一個很深的洞穴，白天牠就在那裡睡覺，以保持涼爽和安全。
items.sec: Habitats & Ecosystems 棲地與生態系

items.def: a home that birds build for their eggs
items.s: A pair of swallows built a ________ under our balcony, and we watched the parents feed their babies every morning.
items.zh: 一對燕子在我們的陽台下築了一個巢，我們每天早上都看著燕子爸媽餵食牠們的寶寶。
items.sec: Habitats & Ecosystems 棲地與生態系

items.def: the hidden home of a wild animal such as a bear
items.s: The mother bear stays in her ________ all winter, and her cubs are born there while the snow covers the forest.
items.zh: 熊媽媽整個冬天都待在她的巢穴裡，而當白雪覆蓋森林時，她的小熊就在那裡出生。
items.sec: Habitats & Ecosystems 棲地與生態系

items.def: an area that an animal treats as its own
items.s: A male tiger marks its ________ with its smell, and it will fight any other tiger that tries to enter.
items.zh: 公老虎會用氣味標示牠的地盤，而且會和任何試圖闖入的其他老虎打鬥。
items.sec: Habitats & Ecosystems 棲地與生態系

items.def: the special role of a species in its environment
items.s: Each bird on the island has its own ________, because some eat seeds while others catch insects, so they do not compete for food.
items.zh: 島上每種鳥都有自己的生態棲位，因為有些吃種子，有些捕捉昆蟲，所以牠們不會爭奪食物。
items.sec: Habitats & Ecosystems 棲地與生態系

items.def: the seasonal movement of animals to another place
items.s: The ________ of the purple crow butterflies in Taiwan is famous, so the government closes some highway lanes to protect them every spring.
items.zh: 台灣紫斑蝶的遷徙非常有名，所以政府每年春天都會封閉部分高速公路車道來保護牠們。
items.sec: Habitats & Ecosystems 棲地與生態系

items.def: to travel to another place when the season changes
items.s: Gray-faced buzzards ________ through Kenting every autumn, and thousands of birdwatchers gather there to watch them fly across the sky.
items.zh: 每年秋天灰面鵟鷹會遷徙經過墾丁，成千上萬的賞鳥人士聚集在那裡觀看牠們飛越天空。
items.sec: Habitats & Ecosystems 棲地與生態系

items.def: to sleep through the whole winter
items.s: Some bears ________ during the cold months because food is hard to find, and they live on the fat stored in their bodies.
items.zh: 有些熊會在寒冷的月份冬眠，因為食物很難找到，牠們靠著儲存在體內的脂肪維生。
items.sec: Habitats & Ecosystems 棲地與生態系

items.def: a long sleep that some animals have in winter
items.s: After a long ________, the hedgehog woke up very hungry, so it searched the garden for insects and worms.
items.zh: 經過漫長的冬眠後，刺蝟醒來時非常飢餓，所以牠在花園裡四處尋找昆蟲和蟲子。
items.sec: Habitats & Ecosystems 棲地與生態系

items.def: a scientist who studies living things and their environment
items.s: The ________ spent three months in the mountains, and she recorded every type of bird she saw in her notebook.
items.zh: 那位生態學家在山上待了三個月，她把看到的每一種鳥都記錄在筆記本上。
items.sec: Habitats & Ecosystems 棲地與生態系

items.def: an area of land and its physical features
items.s: The rangers use horses instead of cars because the ________ is rocky and steep, and there are no proper roads.
items.zh: 巡山員們騎馬而不是開車，因為那裡的地形多岩石又陡峭，而且沒有像樣的道路。
items.sec: Habitats & Ecosystems 棲地與生態系

items.def: plants in general, especially in one area
items.s: After the heavy rain, the ________ on the hills grew quickly, so the deer had plenty of fresh leaves to eat.
items.zh: 大雨過後，山坡上的植被迅速生長，所以鹿有大量新鮮的葉子可以吃。
items.sec: Habitats & Ecosystems 棲地與生態系

items.def: a pool of water where wild animals go to drink
items.s: During the dry season, elephants walk for hours to reach a ________, but lions often wait there to catch other animals.
items.zh: 在乾季時，大象要走好幾個小時才能到達水坑，但獅子常常在那裡等著捕捉其他動物。
items.sec: Habitats & Ecosystems 棲地與生態系

items.def: related to the sea and the animals in it
items.s: Plastic bags are a serious danger to ________ animals, because turtles often think the bags are jellyfish and eat them.
items.zh: 塑膠袋對海洋動物是嚴重的危害，因為海龜常常把塑膠袋誤認為水母而吃下去。
items.sec: Habitats & Ecosystems 棲地與生態系

items.def: an animal that eats dead animals it did not kill
items.s: The vulture is a ________ that eats dead animals, so it helps to keep the savannah clean and stops diseases from spreading.
items.zh: 禿鷹是一種吃動物屍體的食腐動物，所以牠幫助維持草原的乾淨，並防止疾病擴散。
items.sec: Habitats & Ecosystems 棲地與生態系

items.def: something that may cause harm or danger
items.s: Stray dogs are a serious ________ to wild birds in the park, because they often chase and attack birds that nest on the ground.
items.zh: 流浪狗對公園裡的野鳥是嚴重的威脅，因為牠們常常追逐並攻擊在地面築巢的鳥。
items.sec: Threats to Wildlife 野生動物面臨的威脅

items.def: to put something in danger
items.s: Rising sea levels ________ the nesting beaches of sea turtles, and some beaches may disappear completely in the future.
items.zh: 海平面上升威脅到海龜的築巢海灘，而有些海灘未來可能會完全消失。
items.sec: Threats to Wildlife 野生動物面臨的威脅

items.def: the cutting down of forests on a large scale
items.s: ________ in Southeast Asia has destroyed the homes of orangutans, so their numbers have fallen sharply in the past thirty years.
items.zh: 東南亞的森林砍伐摧毀了紅毛猩猩的家園，所以牠們的數量在過去三十年間急遽下降。
items.sec: Threats to Wildlife 野生動物面臨的威脅

items.def: the business of cutting down trees for wood
items.s: Illegal ________ continues in some national parks, because the wood is valuable and the forests are too large to guard.
items.zh: 非法伐木在一些國家公園仍持續發生，因為木材很值錢，而森林又大到難以看守。
items.sec: Threats to Wildlife 野生動物面臨的威脅

items.def: the act of damaging something so badly it cannot be used
items.s: The ________ of wetlands for new factories has left many birds with nowhere to rest during their long journey.
items.zh: 為了蓋新工廠而破壞濕地，讓許多鳥類在漫長的旅程中無處歇息。
items.sec: Threats to Wildlife 野生動物面臨的威脅

items.def: to damage something so badly that it cannot be used
items.s: The forest fire ________ thousands of trees last summer, and many koalas lost their homes and food.
items.zh: 去年夏天的森林大火摧毀了數千棵樹，許多無尾熊因此失去了家園和食物。
items.sec: Threats to Wildlife 野生動物面臨的威脅

items.def: the breaking of a large area into small separate parts
items.s: Habitat ________ is a big problem for leopards, because new roads divide the forest into small pieces and the cats cannot meet each other.
items.zh: 棲地破碎化對豹來說是個大問題，因為新道路把森林分割成小塊，使這些貓科動物無法彼此相遇。
items.sec: Threats to Wildlife 野生動物面臨的威脅

items.def: to slowly take over land that belongs to others
items.s: As cities grow, houses ________ on the forest, so monkeys sometimes come into people's kitchens to look for food.
items.zh: 隨著城市擴張，房屋侵占了森林，所以猴子有時候會跑進人們的廚房找食物。
items.sec: Threats to Wildlife 野生動物面臨的威脅

items.def: the growth of towns and cities
items.s: Rapid ________ has replaced many rice fields with tall buildings, so frogs and egrets have fewer places to live.
items.zh: 快速的都市化使許多稻田被高樓取代，所以青蛙和白鷺鷥能居住的地方變少了。
items.sec: Threats to Wildlife 野生動物面臨的威脅

items.def: a chemical used to kill insects that harm crops
items.s: Farmers used too much ________ on their vegetables, and as a result many bees and birds near the farm died.
items.zh: 農夫們在蔬菜上使用了太多農藥，結果農場附近許多蜜蜂和鳥都死了。
items.sec: Threats to Wildlife 野生動物面臨的威脅

items.def: to harm or kill with a dangerous substance
items.s: Some farmers ________ rats in their fields, but owls and eagles then eat the dead rats and become sick.
items.zh: 有些農夫在田裡毒殺老鼠，但貓頭鷹和老鷹接著吃了死老鼠就會生病。
items.sec: Threats to Wildlife 野生動物面臨的威脅

items.def: the process of making something dirty or harmful
items.s: Water ________ from a nearby factory killed hundreds of fish in the river, so the villagers asked the government to take action.
items.zh: 附近工廠造成的水質汙染害死了河裡數百條魚，所以村民們要求政府採取行動。
items.sec: Threats to Wildlife 野生動物面臨的威脅

items.def: to make something dirty or poisonous
items.s: Oil from the broken ship began to ________ the beach, and volunteers rushed to clean the feathers of the seabirds.
items.zh: 破損船隻漏出的油開始汙染海灘，志工們趕緊去清洗海鳥的羽毛。
items.sec: Threats to Wildlife 野生動物面臨的威脅

items.def: a light material made from chemicals, used for bags and bottles
items.s: Scientists found pieces of ________ inside the stomach of a dead whale, so they asked people to stop using so many straws and bags.
items.zh: 科學家在一隻死去的鯨魚胃裡發現了塑膠碎片，所以他們呼籲大家不要再使用那麼多吸管和塑膠袋。
items.sec: Threats to Wildlife 野生動物面臨的威脅

items.def: broken pieces of rubbish that are left behind
items.s: After the typhoon, the beach was covered with ________, and a young turtle was found trapped in an old fishing net.
items.zh: 颱風過後，海灘上布滿了垃圾碎片，還發現一隻小海龜被困在舊漁網裡。
items.sec: Threats to Wildlife 野生動物面臨的威脅

items.def: spreading quickly and harming the local plants or animals
items.s: The green iguana is an ________ species in southern Taiwan, because it eats farmers' crops and has no natural enemies here.
items.zh: 綠鬣蜥在台灣南部是一種外來入侵物種，因為牠會吃農作物，而且在這裡沒有天敵。
items.sec: Threats to Wildlife 野生動物面臨的威脅

items.def: the sudden start of a disease
items.s: An ________ of bird flu forced the zoo to close for two weeks, while the vets tested all the birds.
items.zh: 禽流感的爆發迫使動物園關閉兩週，同時獸醫們為所有鳥類進行檢測。
items.sec: Threats to Wildlife 野生動物面臨的威脅

items.def: suffering or death caused by having no food
items.s: Many polar bears face ________ because the sea ice melts earlier each year, so they cannot hunt seals for long enough.
items.zh: 許多北極熊面臨餓死的危機，因為海冰每年都更早融化，所以牠們無法有足夠長的時間獵捕海豹。
items.sec: Threats to Wildlife 野生動物面臨的威脅

items.def: to suffer or die because there is no food
items.s: If the bamboo forests keep disappearing, the pandas will ________, because bamboo makes up almost all of their food.
items.zh: 如果竹林持續消失，貓熊就會餓死，因為竹子幾乎是牠們全部的食物。
items.sec: Threats to Wildlife 野生動物面臨的威脅

items.def: a long period with little or no rain
items.s: The long ________ dried up the rivers in Kenya, and hundreds of elephants died because they could not find water.
items.zh: 漫長的乾旱使肯亞的河流乾涸，數百頭大象因為找不到水而死亡。
items.sec: Threats to Wildlife 野生動物面臨的威脅

items.def: a large fire that spreads quickly in forests
items.s: The ________ in Australia spread very fast because of the strong wind, and millions of animals could not escape in time.
items.zh: 澳洲的野火因為強風而蔓延得非常快，數百萬隻動物來不及逃生。
items.sec: Threats to Wildlife 野生動物面臨的威脅

items.def: catching too many fish so their number falls
items.s: ________ has made sharks much harder to find, because boats catch them faster than they can produce babies.
items.zh: 過度捕撈讓鯊魚越來越難找到，因為漁船捕捉牠們的速度比牠們繁殖的速度還快。
items.sec: Threats to Wildlife 野生動物面臨的威脅

items.def: sea animals caught by accident while fishing
items.s: Dolphins often become ________ in large fishing nets, so some fishermen now use special nets that let them escape.
items.zh: 海豚常常在大型漁網中成為混獲，所以有些漁民現在使用能讓牠們逃脫的特殊漁網。
items.sec: Threats to Wildlife 野生動物面臨的威脅

items.def: an accident when two things hit each other
items.s: A ________ with a fast boat badly hurt the manatee, so the rescue team took it to an animal hospital.
items.zh: 與快艇的碰撞讓那隻海牛受了重傷，所以救援團隊把牠送到動物醫院。
items.sec: Threats to Wildlife 野生動物面臨的威脅

items.def: animals killed by cars on roads
items.s: ________ is a big problem for leopard cats in Miaoli, so the government put up warning signs along the mountain roads.
items.zh: 路殺對苗栗的石虎是一大問題，所以政府在山區道路沿線設置了警告標誌。
items.sec: Threats to Wildlife 野生動物面臨的威脅

items.def: the slow wearing away of land by water or wind
items.s: Beach ________ is making the turtles' nesting areas smaller, and the eggs may be washed away by big waves.
items.zh: 海灘侵蝕正使海龜的築巢區域變小，而且蛋可能會被大浪沖走。
items.sec: Threats to Wildlife 野生動物面臨的威脅

items.def: to become gradually smaller in number
items.s: The number of wild tigers has ________ over the last century, but some countries are now working hard to protect them.
items.zh: 野生老虎的數量在過去一個世紀逐漸減少，但有些國家現在正努力保護牠們。
items.sec: Threats to Wildlife 野生動物面臨的威脅

items.def: to remove the water from an area
items.s: The company wanted to ________ the marsh to build a parking lot, but the birdwatchers protested because thousands of birds rest there.
items.zh: 那家公司想排乾沼澤的水來蓋停車場，但賞鳥人士提出抗議，因為有成千上萬隻鳥在那裡休息。
items.sec: Threats to Wildlife 野生動物面臨的威脅

items.def: a substance that makes air, water or land dirty
items.s: The factory released a dangerous ________ into the river, and soon the fish and frogs began to disappear.
items.zh: 那家工廠把一種危險的汙染物排進河裡，不久之後魚和青蛙就開始消失了。
items.sec: Threats to Wildlife 野生動物面臨的威脅

items.def: to disappear suddenly or completely
items.s: Many small birds have ________ from the island since rats arrived on ships, because the rats eat their eggs.
items.zh: 自從老鼠搭船來到島上後，許多小鳥就從島上消失了，因為老鼠會吃牠們的蛋。
items.sec: Threats to Wildlife 野生動物面臨的威脅

items.def: to hunt or catch animals illegally
items.s: Criminals ________ elephants for their tusks, and they sell the ivory for a lot of money in other countries.
items.zh: 犯罪分子為了象牙盜獵大象，並將象牙在其他國家以高價賣出。
items.sec: Poaching & Illegal Wildlife Trade 盜獵與非法野生動物交易

items.def: a person who hunts animals illegally
items.s: The rangers caught a ________ in the national park last night, and they found three dead birds in his bag.
items.zh: 巡山員昨晚在國家公園裡抓到一名盜獵者，並在他的袋子裡發現了三隻死鳥。
items.sec: Poaching & Illegal Wildlife Trade 盜獵與非法野生動物交易

items.def: the illegal hunting of animals
items.s: ________ is the main reason why rhinos are in danger, because some people still believe their horns can cure illness.
items.zh: 盜獵是犀牛陷入危險的主要原因，因為有些人仍然相信犀牛角能治病。
items.sec: Poaching & Illegal Wildlife Trade 盜獵與非法野生動物交易

items.def: the hard white material from elephant tusks
items.s: Many countries have stopped the sale of ________, but some people still buy it secretly as jewellery or art.
items.zh: 許多國家已經禁止販售象牙，但仍有一些人偷偷購買它作為珠寶或藝術品。
items.sec: Poaching & Illegal Wildlife Trade 盜獵與非法野生動物交易

items.def: a very long pointed tooth of an elephant
items.s: An elephant uses its ________ to dig for water and remove tree bark, so losing them makes its life much harder.
items.zh: 大象用牠的長牙挖水和剝樹皮，所以失去長牙會讓牠的生活困難許多。
items.sec: Poaching & Illegal Wildlife Trade 盜獵與非法野生動物交易

items.def: a hard pointed part growing on an animal's head
items.s: A rhino's ________ is made of the same material as our fingernails, but criminals still sell it at a very high price.
items.zh: 犀牛的角是由和我們指甲一樣的物質組成，但犯罪分子仍以極高的價格販售它。
items.sec: Poaching & Illegal Wildlife Trade 盜獵與非法野生動物交易

items.def: a large heavy animal with one or two horns on its nose
items.s: Only a few northern white ________ are left in the world, so scientists are trying to save them with new technology.
items.zh: 全世界只剩下幾頭北方白犀牛，所以科學家們正嘗試用新科技拯救牠們。
items.sec: Poaching & Illegal Wildlife Trade 盜獵與非法野生動物交易

items.def: a small animal covered in hard scales that eats ants
items.s: The ________ rolls into a ball when it is scared, but this does not protect it from poachers who simply pick it up.
items.zh: 穿山甲受到驚嚇時會捲成一顆球，但這無法保護牠免於盜獵者，因為他們直接就能把牠撿起來。
items.sec: Poaching & Illegal Wildlife Trade 盜獵與非法野生動物交易

items.def: to take things secretly and illegally into a country
items.s: The man tried to ________ rare turtles through the airport in his suitcase, but the security officers found them on the X-ray screen.
items.zh: 那名男子試圖把稀有的烏龜藏在行李箱裡走私通過機場，但安檢人員在X光螢幕上發現了牠們。
items.sec: Poaching & Illegal Wildlife Trade 盜獵與非法野生動物交易

items.def: a person who smuggles goods illegally
items.s: The police arrested a ________ at the harbour, because he was hiding hundreds of parrots in small plastic tubes.
items.zh: 警方在港口逮捕了一名走私者，因為他把數百隻鸚鵡藏在小塑膠管裡。
items.sec: Poaching & Illegal Wildlife Trade 盜獵與非法野生動物交易

items.def: the illegal buying and selling of goods or animals
items.s: Wildlife ________ is a huge business around the world, so governments must work together to stop it.
items.zh: 野生動物非法交易是全球性的大生意，所以各國政府必須合作阻止它。
items.sec: Poaching & Illegal Wildlife Trade 盜獵與非法野生動物交易

items.def: a person who buys and sells illegal goods
items.s: The ________ sold baby monkeys online as pets, but the police tracked him down after a buyer reported the website.
items.zh: 那名非法販運者在網路上把小猴子當寵物販售，但在一位買家檢舉該網站後，警方追查到了他。
items.sec: Poaching & Illegal Wildlife Trade 盜獵與非法野生動物交易

items.def: not allowed by law
items.s: It is ________ to keep a Formosan black bear as a pet in Taiwan, and anyone who does so may face a heavy fine.
items.zh: 在台灣把台灣黑熊當寵物飼養是違法的，任何這麼做的人都可能面臨重罰。
items.sec: Poaching & Illegal Wildlife Trade 盜獵與非法野生動物交易

items.def: to officially take something away from someone
items.s: Customs officers ________ two hundred kilograms of shark fins, and they plan to destroy them in public next month.
items.zh: 海關人員沒收了兩百公斤的魚翅，並計畫下個月公開銷毀。
items.sec: Poaching & Illegal Wildlife Trade 盜獵與非法野生動物交易

items.def: the act of taking illegal goods by force or law
items.s: The ________ of ten tonnes of pangolin scales was the largest ever in the country, and it shocked many animal lovers.
items.zh: 查獲十公噸穿山甲鱗片是該國有史以來最大規模的查獲，讓許多愛護動物的人士大為震驚。
items.sec: Poaching & Illegal Wildlife Trade 盜獵與非法野生動物交易

items.def: the place at a border where officers check goods
items.s: The traveller was stopped at ________ because his bag smelled strange, and the officers found live lizards inside.
items.zh: 那名旅客在海關被攔下，因為他的包包有股奇怪的味道，而官員在裡面發現了活的蜥蜴。
items.sec: Poaching & Illegal Wildlife Trade 盜獵與非法野生動物交易

items.def: a person whose job is to protect a park or forest
items.s: The ________ walks through the forest every day to check the camera traps, and he also looks for signs of poachers.
items.zh: 那位巡山員每天走過森林檢查自動相機，同時也尋找盜獵者的蹤跡。
items.sec: Poaching & Illegal Wildlife Trade 盜獵與非法野生動物交易

items.def: to walk or drive around an area to protect it
items.s: Soldiers and rangers ________ the park at night, because most poachers come in the dark when they think no one is watching.
items.zh: 士兵和巡山員晚上會在公園裡巡邏，因為大多數盜獵者會在他們以為沒人注意的夜裡前來。
items.sec: Poaching & Illegal Wildlife Trade 盜獵與非法野生動物交易

items.def: part of a dead animal kept to show hunting success
items.s: Some rich tourists pay to shoot lions and take their heads home as a ________, but many people think this is cruel.
items.zh: 有些有錢的觀光客付錢射殺獅子，並把獅子頭帶回家當作戰利品，但許多人認為這很殘忍。
items.sec: Poaching & Illegal Wildlife Trade 盜獵與非法野生動物交易

items.def: the thick soft hair of an animal
items.s: Many fashion brands no longer use real ________ in their coats, because customers do not want animals to suffer for clothes.
items.zh: 許多時尚品牌不再在大衣中使用真的毛皮，因為顧客不希望動物為了衣服而受苦。
items.sec: Poaching & Illegal Wildlife Trade 盜獵與非法野生動物交易

items.def: something you buy to remember a trip
items.s: Never buy a ________ made from coral or turtle shell on holiday, because it may be illegal and it harms sea life.
items.zh: 度假時千萬不要購買用珊瑚或龜殼做的紀念品，因為那可能是違法的，而且會傷害海洋生物。
items.sec: Poaching & Illegal Wildlife Trade 盜獵與非法野生動物交易

items.def: from a faraway country; unusual and interesting
items.s: Some people keep ________ pets like snakes and parrots, but many of these animals were caught illegally in the wild.
items.zh: 有些人飼養蛇和鸚鵡等奇特的寵物，但這些動物中有許多是從野外非法捕捉來的。
items.sec: Poaching & Illegal Wildlife Trade 盜獵與非法野生動物交易

items.def: strong official action to stop illegal activity
items.s: The government started a ________ on illegal pet shops, and dozens of rare birds were rescued in just one week.
items.zh: 政府展開了對非法寵物店的嚴厲取締，短短一週內就救出了數十隻稀有鳥類。
items.sec: Poaching & Illegal Wildlife Trade 盜獵與非法野生動物交易

items.def: a punishment for breaking a law
items.s: The ________ for killing a protected animal in Taiwan is very serious, and the criminal may even go to prison.
items.zh: 在台灣殺害保育類動物的刑罰非常重，犯人甚至可能入獄。
items.sec: Poaching & Illegal Wildlife Trade 盜獵與非法野生動物交易

items.def: a trap made of wire for catching animals
items.s: A young bear lost part of its paw in a ________, so the vet had to perform an operation to save its life.
items.zh: 一隻小熊的腳掌因捕獸套索失去了一部分，所以獸醫必須動手術救牠一命。
items.sec: Poaching & Illegal Wildlife Trade 盜獵與非法野生動物交易

items.def: to protect something from being damaged or lost
items.s: Local villagers work with scientists to ________ the forest, because it gives them clean water as well as a home for animals.
items.zh: 當地村民和科學家合作保護森林，因為森林不僅為動物提供家園，也為他們提供乾淨的水。
items.sec: Conservation Action & Protected Areas 保育行動與保護區

items.def: a person who works to protect nature
items.s: The ________ has spent twenty years saving sea turtles, and she teaches children how to keep the beaches clean.
items.zh: 那位保育人士花了二十年拯救海龜，她也教孩子們如何保持海灘乾淨。
items.sec: Conservation Action & Protected Areas 保育行動與保護區

items.def: the act of keeping something safe from harm
items.s: The ________ of old forests is important, because many animals cannot survive in young forests that have just been planted.
items.zh: 老森林的保護很重要，因為許多動物無法在剛種植的年輕森林中生存。
items.sec: Conservation Action & Protected Areas 保育行動與保護區

items.def: the act of keeping someone or something safe
items.s: The black-faced spoonbill is under legal ________ in Taiwan, so no one is allowed to hunt or disturb it.
items.zh: 黑面琵鷺在台灣受到法律保護，所以任何人都不得獵捕或干擾牠。
items.sec: Conservation Action & Protected Areas 保育行動與保護區

items.def: a safe place where animals are protected
items.s: The elephants at the ________ were rescued from circuses, and now they can walk freely and swim in the river.
items.zh: 庇護所裡的大象是從馬戲團被救出來的，現在牠們可以自由行走並在河裡游泳。
items.sec: Conservation Action & Protected Areas 保育行動與保護區

items.def: a wild natural area where no people live
items.s: Alaska still has huge areas of ________, so bears and wolves can live there without being disturbed by people.
items.zh: 阿拉斯加仍有大片的荒野，所以熊和狼可以生活在那裡而不受人類干擾。
items.sec: Conservation Action & Protected Areas 保育行動與保護區

items.def: to bring an animal back to an area where it once lived
items.cn: 重新引入；野放回原棲地
items.s: Scientists plan to ________ beavers to the river, because they believe the animals can help create new wetlands.
items.zh: 科學家計畫把河狸重新引入那條河，因為他們相信這些動物能幫助創造新的濕地。
items.sec: Conservation Action & Protected Areas 保育行動與保護區

items.def: the act of bringing a species back to its old habitat
items.s: The ________ of wolves to Yellowstone was a great success, and the whole ecosystem became healthier afterwards.
items.zh: 狼群重新引入黃石公園非常成功，之後整個生態系統都變得更健康了。
items.sec: Conservation Action & Protected Areas 保育行動與保護區

items.def: the act of returning something to its earlier good condition
items.s: The ________ of the old rice fields brought back many frogs and fireflies, so families now visit the area at night.
items.zh: 舊稻田的復育讓許多青蛙和螢火蟲回來了，所以現在家庭們都會在晚上造訪那個地區。
items.sec: Conservation Action & Protected Areas 保育行動與保護區

items.def: returning land to its natural wild state
items.s: ________ projects in Europe allow farmland to turn back into forest, and wild animals like bison have started to return.
items.zh: 歐洲的再野化計畫讓農地恢復成森林，而像野牛這樣的野生動物已經開始回來了。
items.sec: Conservation Action & Protected Areas 保育行動與保護區

items.def: a strip of land that connects two habitats
items.s: The government built a wildlife ________ under the highway, so leopard cats can cross safely from one forest to another.
items.zh: 政府在高速公路下方建造了一條野生動物廊道，讓石虎能安全地從一片森林穿越到另一片森林。
items.sec: Conservation Action & Protected Areas 保育行動與保護區

items.def: a fixed limit on the number of something allowed
items.s: Each fishing boat has a ________ for tuna, so it must stop fishing when it reaches that number.
items.zh: 每艘漁船都有鮪魚的捕撈配額，所以達到該數量時就必須停止捕撈。
items.sec: Conservation Action & Protected Areas 保育行動與保護區

items.def: an official count of a population
items.s: Volunteers joined the annual bird ________ last weekend, and they counted more spoonbills than ever before.
items.zh: 志工們上週末參加了年度鳥類普查，他們數到的黑面琵鷺比以往任何時候都多。
items.sec: Conservation Action & Protected Areas 保育行動與保護區

items.def: to put a small label or device on an animal
items.s: Researchers ________ young sharks with small electronic devices, so they can follow where the sharks swim around the world.
items.zh: 研究人員為幼鯊加上小型電子標籤，這樣他們就能追蹤鯊魚在世界各地游到哪裡。
items.sec: Conservation Action & Protected Areas 保育行動與保護區

items.def: a band put around an animal's neck
items.s: The bear wears a GPS ________ around its neck, and the scientists can see its location on their computer every hour.
items.zh: 那隻熊的脖子上戴著一個GPS項圈，科學家每小時都能在電腦上看到牠的位置。
items.sec: Conservation Action & Protected Areas 保育行動與保護區

items.def: a person who works without being paid
items.s: As a ________ at the animal rescue centre, I clean the cages every Saturday, and I also help feed the injured birds.
items.zh: 身為動物救援中心的志工，我每個星期六都會清洗籠子，也會幫忙餵食受傷的鳥。
items.sec: Conservation Action & Protected Areas 保育行動與保護區

items.def: money or goods given to help a group
items.s: Thanks to a large ________ from a local company, the zoo was able to build a bigger home for its tigers.
items.zh: 多虧一家本地公司的大筆捐款，動物園得以為老虎建造一個更大的家。
items.sec: Conservation Action & Protected Areas 保育行動與保護區

items.def: an organisation that helps people or animals in need
items.s: My class raised money for a wildlife ________, and the charity used it to buy medicine for injured turtles.
items.zh: 我們班為一家野生動物慈善機構募款，而該機構用這筆錢購買受傷海龜的藥品。
items.sec: Conservation Action & Protected Areas 保育行動與保護區

items.def: a planned series of actions to achieve a goal
items.s: The students started a ________ to stop people from feeding wild monkeys, because human food makes the monkeys sick and aggressive.
items.zh: 學生們發起了一項宣傳活動，勸阻人們餵食野生猴子，因為人類的食物會讓猴子生病並變得具攻擊性。
items.sec: Conservation Action & Protected Areas 保育行動與保護區

items.def: a written request signed by many people
items.s: More than fifty thousand people signed a ________ to save the wetland, so the city council finally cancelled the building plan.
items.zh: 超過五萬人簽署了拯救濕地的連署，所以市議會最終取消了建設計畫。
items.sec: Conservation Action & Protected Areas 保育行動與保護區

items.def: travel to natural areas that helps protect them
items.s: ________ brings money to local villages, so people there now see living whales as more valuable than dead ones.
items.zh: 生態旅遊為當地村莊帶來收入，所以那裡的人們現在認為活的鯨魚比死的更有價值。
items.sec: Conservation Action & Protected Areas 保育行動與保護區

items.def: not harmful to the environment
items.s: Our hotel uses ________ soap and shampoo, because the water from the rooms flows into a river full of fish.
items.zh: 我們的飯店使用環保香皂和洗髮精，因為房間的排水會流入一條充滿魚的河流。
items.sec: Conservation Action & Protected Areas 保育行動與保護區

items.def: the process of returning to a healthy state
items.s: The humpback whale has made a strong ________ since hunting was stopped, and now tourists can see them near Taiwan again.
items.zh: 自從捕鯨被禁止後，大翅鯨的數量已大幅恢復，現在遊客又能在台灣附近看到牠們了。
items.sec: Conservation Action & Protected Areas 保育行動與保護區

items.def: to increase again after falling
items.s: The number of sea otters began to ________ after hunting was banned, and today hundreds swim along the Californian coast.
items.zh: 禁止獵捕後海獺的數量開始回升，如今已有數百隻在加州海岸游泳。
items.sec: Conservation Action & Protected Areas 保育行動與保護區

items.def: to grow strongly and successfully
items.s: Fireflies ________ in clean, dark places, so they disappear quickly when bright lights and dirty water arrive.
items.zh: 螢火蟲在乾淨又黑暗的地方茁壯繁衍，所以當明亮的燈光和髒水出現時，牠們很快就會消失。
items.sec: Conservation Action & Protected Areas 保育行動與保護區

items.def: to grow well and be healthy
items.s: After the factory closed, the river became clean again, and fish and water birds began to ________ there.
items.zh: 工廠關閉後，河水又變乾淨了，魚和水鳥開始在那裡繁盛起來。
items.sec: Conservation Action & Protected Areas 保育行動與保護區

items.def: a formal written agreement between countries
items.s: More than 180 countries have signed a ________ that controls the trade in wild animals, but some still fail to follow it.
items.zh: 超過一百八十個國家簽署了一項管制野生動物貿易的條約，但有些國家仍未遵守。
items.sec: Conservation Action & Protected Areas 保育行動與保護區

items.def: to kill some animals to reduce their number
items.s: The island decided to ________ the wild goats, because they were eating all the plants that rare birds needed.
items.zh: 那座島決定撲殺野山羊，因為牠們把稀有鳥類需要的植物都吃光了。
items.sec: Conservation Action & Protected Areas 保育行動與保護區

items.def: to move animals to a new place
items.s: The team had to ________ the turtle eggs to a safer beach, because the old beach was going to flood during the typhoon.
items.zh: 團隊必須把海龜蛋移置到較安全的海灘，因為原本的海灘在颱風期間將會淹水。
items.sec: Conservation Action & Protected Areas 保育行動與保護區

items.def: an area that protects something from harm
items.s: Farmers left a ________ of trees between their fields and the river, and it stops chemicals from flowing into the water.
items.zh: 農夫們在農田和河流之間留下一片樹木作為緩衝區，它能阻止化學物質流入水中。
items.sec: Conservation Action & Protected Areas 保育行動與保護區

items.def: to keep animals so that they produce babies
items.s: The zoo has ________ several baby pandas over the years, and some of them were later sent back to China.
items.zh: 動物園多年來已經繁殖了好幾隻貓熊寶寶，其中有些後來被送回中國。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour, Breeding & Rescue 動物行為、繁殖與救援

items.def: the process of animals producing young
items.s: The ________ season for sea turtles starts in May, so the beaches are closed to visitors at night.
items.zh: 海龜的繁殖季從五月開始，所以海灘晚上不開放遊客進入。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour, Breeding & Rescue 動物行為、繁殖與救援

items.def: kept in a cage or enclosed area; not free
items.s: The ________ kakapos are watched closely by scientists, and each egg is carefully protected until it hatches.
items.zh: 圈養的鴞鸚鵡受到科學家密切觀察，每一顆蛋都受到細心保護直到孵化。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour, Breeding & Rescue 動物行為、繁殖與救援

items.def: the state of being kept in a cage or zoo
items.s: Dolphins in ________ often show signs of boredom, because a small pool is very different from the open ocean.
items.zh: 圈養中的海豚常常出現無聊的跡象，因為小水池和廣闊的海洋非常不同。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour, Breeding & Rescue 動物行為、繁殖與救援

items.def: the baby or babies of an animal
items.s: An elephant usually has only one ________ every four or five years, so it takes a long time for their numbers to grow.
items.zh: 大象通常每四到五年才生一隻後代，所以牠們的數量需要很長時間才能增加。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour, Breeding & Rescue 動物行為、繁殖與救援

items.def: to come together to produce babies
items.s: Male peacocks show their beautiful tails to attract females, and the females choose the best male to ________ with.
items.zh: 雄孔雀展示牠們美麗的尾羽來吸引雌孔雀，而雌孔雀會選擇最好的雄孔雀來交配。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour, Breeding & Rescue 動物行為、繁殖與救援

items.def: to break out of an egg
items.s: The baby turtles ________ at night when the sand is cool, and then they follow the moonlight to the sea.
items.zh: 小海龜在沙子涼爽的夜晚孵化，然後牠們跟著月光爬向大海。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour, Breeding & Rescue 動物行為、繁殖與救援

items.def: a baby animal that has just come out of its egg
items.s: Only one ________ out of a thousand turtles grows into an adult, because birds and fish eat most of them.
items.zh: 一千隻剛孵化的小海龜中只有一隻能長大為成龜，因為大部分都被鳥和魚吃掉了。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour, Breeding & Rescue 動物行為、繁殖與救援

items.def: a young bear, lion, tiger or fox
items.s: The bear ________ stays with its mother for about two years, and it learns how to find food and climb trees.
items.zh: 小熊會和媽媽待在一起大約兩年，學習如何找食物和爬樹。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour, Breeding & Rescue 動物行為、繁殖與救援

items.def: a young cow, elephant or whale
items.s: The baby elephant is called a ________, and the whole herd protects it when lions come close.
items.zh: 小象被稱為幼象，當獅子靠近時，整個象群都會保護牠。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour, Breeding & Rescue 動物行為、繁殖與救援

items.def: a group of baby animals born at the same time
items.s: Our neighbour's cat gave birth to a ________ of five kittens, so she is looking for kind families to adopt them.
items.zh: 鄰居的貓生了一窩五隻小貓，所以她正在尋找有愛心的家庭來領養牠們。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour, Breeding & Rescue 動物行為、繁殖與救援

items.def: to produce an egg from the body
items.s: The mother turtle ________ about one hundred eggs in the sand, and then she slowly crawled back to the sea.
items.zh: 海龜媽媽在沙裡產下大約一百顆蛋，然後慢慢地爬回大海。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour, Breeding & Rescue 動物行為、繁殖與救援

items.def: to keep eggs warm until they hatch
items.s: Because the parents had left the nest, the rescue centre had to ________ the eggs in a warm machine.
items.zh: 因為鳥爸媽離開了鳥巢，救援中心只好用保溫機器來孵這些蛋。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour, Breeding & Rescue 動物行為、繁殖與救援

items.def: to search for food
items.s: Wild boars ________ in the forest at night, but sometimes they come into villages and dig up farmers' sweet potatoes.
items.zh: 山豬在夜晚於森林中覓食，但有時牠們會跑進村莊挖農夫的地瓜。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour, Breeding & Rescue 動物行為、繁殖與救援

items.def: to eat grass in a field
items.s: The deer ________ quietly in the field every evening, but they run away as soon as they smell a human.
items.zh: 鹿每天傍晚都在田野裡安靜地吃草，但一聞到人類的氣味就會立刻逃跑。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour, Breeding & Rescue 動物行為、繁殖與救援

items.def: colours or patterns that help an animal hide
items.s: The leaf insect has perfect ________, so birds fly right past it without noticing it on the branch.
items.zh: 葉䗛有完美的偽裝，所以鳥從牠旁邊飛過也不會注意到樹枝上的牠。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour, Breeding & Rescue 動物行為、繁殖與救援

items.def: a natural behaviour an animal does without learning
items.s: Baby turtles move towards the sea by ________, even though no one has ever shown them the way.
items.zh: 小海龜靠著本能朝大海前進，即使從來沒有人教過牠們怎麼走。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour, Breeding & Rescue 動物行為、繁殖與救援

items.def: a group of birds or sheep
items.s: A ________ of spoonbills landed in the wetland at sunset, and the birdwatchers quickly lifted their cameras.
items.zh: 一群黑面琵鷺在日落時降落在濕地上，賞鳥人士迅速舉起了相機。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour, Breeding & Rescue 動物行為、繁殖與救援

items.def: a large group of animals such as cows or elephants
items.s: A ________ of buffalo crossed the road slowly, so all the cars had to stop and wait for several minutes.
items.zh: 一群水牛緩緩地穿越馬路，所以所有車輛都必須停下來等好幾分鐘。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour, Breeding & Rescue 動物行為、繁殖與救援

items.def: living or spending time alone
items.s: Leopards are ________ animals that hunt alone, while lions live and hunt together in big family groups.
items.zh: 豹是單獨狩獵的獨居動物，而獅子則以大家庭群體一起生活和狩獵。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour, Breeding & Rescue 動物行為、繁殖與救援

items.def: to save someone or something from danger
items.s: Fishermen ________ a baby dolphin that was trapped in a net, and they carefully returned it to the sea.
items.zh: 漁民們救出了一隻被困在網中的小海豚，並小心地把牠送回海裡。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour, Breeding & Rescue 動物行為、繁殖與救援

items.def: to help an injured animal become healthy again
items.s: The centre ________ injured eagles for several months, and then it releases them back into the mountains.
items.zh: 中心會花好幾個月幫助受傷的老鷹康復，然後把牠們野放回山林。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour, Breeding & Rescue 動物行為、繁殖與救援

items.def: the process of helping an animal recover
items.s: After three months of ________, the sea turtle could swim well again, so the vets returned it to the ocean.
items.zh: 經過三個月的復健，那隻海龜又能好好游泳了，所以獸醫們把牠放回海洋。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour, Breeding & Rescue 動物行為、繁殖與救援

items.def: an animal doctor
items.s: The ________ removed a fishing hook from the bird's throat, and the bird was able to eat again the next day.
items.zh: 獸醫從那隻鳥的喉嚨裡取出了一個魚鉤，隔天那隻鳥就能再次進食了。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour, Breeding & Rescue 動物行為、繁殖與救援

items.def: having lost its parents
items.cn: 失去父母的；成為孤兒的
items.s: The ________ baby monkey was found alone by the road, so volunteers fed it milk every three hours.
items.zh: 那隻失去父母的小猴子被發現獨自待在路邊，所以志工們每三個小時就餵牠喝一次奶。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour, Breeding & Rescue 動物行為、繁殖與救援

items.def: hurt or harmed
items.s: We found an ________ owl in the school garden, and we called the animal rescue centre right away.
items.zh: 我們在學校的花園裡發現了一隻受傷的貓頭鷹，於是馬上打電話給動物救援中心。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour, Breeding & Rescue 動物行為、繁殖與救援

items.def: a person who looks after animals in a zoo
items.s: The ________ prepares fresh bamboo for the pandas every morning, and she also checks whether they are healthy.
items.zh: 那位保育員每天早上都為貓熊準備新鮮的竹子，也會檢查牠們是否健康。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour, Breeding & Rescue 動物行為、繁殖與救援

items.def: an area with a fence or wall where animals are kept
items.s: The new ________ for the tigers has trees, rocks and a pool, so the animals can behave more naturally.
items.zh: 老虎的新圈養區有樹木、岩石和水池，所以動物們能表現得更自然。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour, Breeding & Rescue 動物行為、繁殖與救援

items.def: a building where people can see fish and sea animals
items.s: We visited the ________ in Pingtung last summer, and the children loved watching the penguins and sharks.
items.zh: 我們去年夏天參觀了屏東的水族館，孩子們很喜歡看企鵝和鯊魚。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour, Breeding & Rescue 動物行為、繁殖與救援

items.def: a place where wild animals are kept for people to see
items.s: The Taipei ________ is very popular with families, and it also runs programmes to protect the Formosan pangolin.
items.zh: 台北市立動物園很受家庭歡迎，而且它也推行保護台灣穿山甲的計畫。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour, Breeding & Rescue 動物行為、繁殖與救援

items.def: farm animals such as cows, sheep and goats
items.s: Wolves sometimes attack farmers' ________ at night, so many farmers now use guard dogs to protect their sheep.
items.zh: 狼有時會在夜裡攻擊農夫的家畜，所以許多農夫現在用護衛犬來保護他們的羊。
items.sec: People, Farming & Wildlife Conflict 人類、畜牧與野生動物衝突

items.def: cows and bulls kept on a farm
items.s: The farmer lost three ________ to a lion last month, so he is now building a stronger fence around his farm.
items.zh: 那位農夫上個月有三頭牛被獅子咬死，所以他現在正在農場周圍建造更堅固的圍籬。
items.sec: People, Farming & Wildlife Conflict 人類、畜牧與野生動物衝突

items.def: a person who looks after a group of animals
items.s: The ________ walks with his goats through the mountains every day, and he carries a whistle to scare away wild animals.
items.zh: 那位牧民每天帶著他的山羊走過山區，並帶著一個哨子來嚇跑野生動物。
items.sec: People, Farming & Wildlife Conflict 人類、畜牧與野生動物衝突

items.def: a person who owns or runs a large cattle farm
items.s: The ________ was angry when wolves returned to the area, but later he learned to protect his cows without killing them.
items.zh: 當狼回到這個地區時，那位牧場主人很生氣，但後來他學會了在不殺狼的情況下保護他的牛。
items.sec: People, Farming & Wildlife Conflict 人類、畜牧與野生動物衝突

items.def: land used for growing crops or keeping animals
items.s: Much of the forest was turned into ________ fifty years ago, so the leopard cats now live close to people.
items.zh: 五十年前大部分的森林被改成了農地，所以石虎現在住得離人很近。
items.sec: People, Farming & Wildlife Conflict 人類、畜牧與野生動物衝突

items.def: a plant grown on a farm for food
items.s: Elephants sometimes eat a whole field of ________ in one night, so the farmers lose all the food they planned to sell.
items.zh: 大象有時一個晚上就吃掉整片田的農作物，讓農夫們失去所有打算拿去賣的作物。
items.sec: People, Farming & Wildlife Conflict 人類、畜牧與野生動物衝突

items.def: a wall made of wood or wire around a field
items.s: The villagers built an electric ________ around their fields, but the clever elephants learned to push trees onto it.
items.zh: 村民們在田地周圍建造了電圍籬，但聰明的大象學會了把樹推倒在上面。
items.sec: People, Farming & Wildlife Conflict 人類、畜牧與野生動物衝突

items.def: a person who looks after sheep
items.s: The ________ keeps his sheep inside a strong pen at night, because snow leopards often hunt in the area.
items.zh: 那位牧羊人晚上把羊關在堅固的羊圈裡，因為雪豹常在那一帶獵食。
items.sec: People, Farming & Wildlife Conflict 人類、畜牧與野生動物衝突

items.def: to attack a place suddenly to take things
items.s: Monkeys often ________ the fruit farms in the mountains, and they can eat hundreds of bananas in a single afternoon.
items.zh: 猴子常常襲擊山上的果園，牠們一個下午就能吃掉數百根香蕉。
items.sec: People, Farming & Wildlife Conflict 人類、畜牧與野生動物衝突

items.def: to hurt someone because they hurt you
items.s: When a tiger killed their cows, some villagers wanted to ________, but the rangers convinced them to wait for help.
items.zh: 當老虎咬死他們的牛時，有些村民想要報復，但巡山員說服他們等待協助。
items.sec: People, Farming & Wildlife Conflict 人類、畜牧與野生動物衝突

items.def: action taken to hurt someone who hurt you
items.s: Many lions are killed in ________ for attacks on cattle, so conservation groups pay farmers when they lose animals.
items.zh: 許多獅子因為攻擊牛隻而遭到報復殺害，所以保育團體會在農民損失牲畜時給予賠償。
items.sec: People, Farming & Wildlife Conflict 人類、畜牧與野生動物衝突

items.def: money paid to someone for a loss
items.s: The government gives ________ to farmers whose chickens are killed by leopard cats, so the farmers are less likely to hurt them.
items.zh: 政府會給雞隻被石虎咬死的農民賠償金，所以農民比較不會傷害石虎。
items.sec: People, Farming & Wildlife Conflict 人類、畜牧與野生動物衝突

items.def: to live together peacefully in the same place
items.s: People and bears can ________ in the same mountains, but campers must keep their food in locked boxes.
items.zh: 人類和熊可以在同一片山林中共存，但露營者必須把食物放在上鎖的箱子裡。
items.sec: People, Farming & Wildlife Conflict 人類、畜牧與野生動物衝突

items.def: the state of living together peacefully
items.s: Peaceful ________ between farmers and elephants is possible, but it needs good planning and support from the government.
items.zh: 農民與大象之間的和平共存是可能的，但這需要良好的規劃和政府的支持。
items.sec: People, Farming & Wildlife Conflict 人類、畜牧與野生動物衝突

items.def: to stop something from happening by making it difficult
items.s: Farmers hang bright lights around their farms to ________ lions at night, and the number of attacks has dropped a lot.
items.zh: 農民在農場周圍掛上明亮的燈來在夜間嚇阻獅子，攻擊事件的數量因此大幅減少。
items.sec: People, Farming & Wildlife Conflict 人類、畜牧與野生動物衝突

items.def: something that makes people or animals not want to do something
items.s: Beehives along the fence are a good ________ against elephants, because the large animals are afraid of bee stings.
items.zh: 沿著圍籬設置的蜂箱是防範大象的好嚇阻物，因為這些大型動物害怕被蜜蜂叮咬。
items.sec: People, Farming & Wildlife Conflict 人類、畜牧與野生動物衝突

items.def: a device for catching animals
items.s: The researchers used a safe ________ to catch the leopard cat, and they released it after putting on a GPS collar.
items.zh: 研究人員用安全的捕獸器捕捉石虎，並在為牠戴上GPS項圈後將牠野放。
items.sec: People, Farming & Wildlife Conflict 人類、畜牧與野生動物衝突

items.def: an insect or animal that damages crops or food
items.s: Some farmers see wild boars as a ________, because the boars destroy their vegetable gardens almost every night.
items.zh: 有些農民把山豬視為有害動物，因為山豬幾乎每晚都破壞他們的菜園。
items.sec: People, Farming & Wildlife Conflict 人類、畜牧與野生動物衝突

items.def: a person who owns land
items.s: The ________ agreed to keep part of his forest untouched, so the rare birds living there would not lose their home.
items.zh: 那位地主同意保留他一部分的森林不被開發，讓住在那裡的稀有鳥類不會失去家園。
items.sec: People, Farming & Wildlife Conflict 人類、畜牧與野生動物衝突

items.def: a person who lives in a village
items.s: Every ________ was invited to the meeting about the new nature park, because the plan would change their daily lives.
items.zh: 每一位村民都受邀參加有關新自然公園的會議，因為這項計畫將會改變他們的日常生活。
items.sec: People, Farming & Wildlife Conflict 人類、畜牧與野生動物衝突

items.def: the time when crops are collected
items.s: Just before the ________, a group of monkeys came down from the mountain and ate most of the farmer's peaches.
items.zh: 就在收成前，一群猴子從山上下來，吃掉了農夫大部分的桃子。
items.sec: People, Farming & Wildlife Conflict 人類、畜牧與野生動物衝突

items.def: the way someone earns money to live
items.s: Fishing is the main ________ of the islanders, so they need to protect the sea if they want to keep their jobs.
items.zh: 捕魚是島民主要的生計，所以如果他們想保住工作，就必須保護海洋。
items.sec: People, Farming & Wildlife Conflict 人類、畜牧與野生動物衝突

items.def: chickens, ducks and other farm birds
items.s: Leopard cats sometimes steal ________ from farms, but some farmers now use stronger cages to keep their chickens safe.
items.zh: 石虎有時會偷農場的家禽，但有些農民現在用更堅固的籠子來保護他們的雞。
items.sec: People, Farming & Wildlife Conflict 人類、畜牧與野生動物衝突

items.def: unfriendly and ready to fight
items.s: Local people used to be ________ towards the wolves, but their attitude changed when wolf tourism brought money to the town.
items.zh: 當地人過去對狼抱持敵對的態度，但當賞狼旅遊為小鎮帶來收入後，他們的態度就改變了。
items.sec: People, Farming & Wildlife Conflict 人類、畜牧與野生動物衝突

items.def: to accept something you do not like
items.s: Farmers are more willing to ________ wild animals on their land when they receive help to protect their crops.
items.zh: 當農民獲得保護農作物的協助時，他們更願意容忍野生動物出現在自己的土地上。
items.sec: People, Farming & Wildlife Conflict 人類、畜牧與野生動物衝突

items.def: to leave something or someone and not come back
items.s: Some owners ________ their pet turtles in city ponds when they get bored, but these turtles can harm the local wildlife.
items.zh: 有些飼主玩膩了就把寵物烏龜棄養在城市池塘裡，但這些烏龜會危害當地的野生動物。

items.def: to go somewhere with someone
items.s: A trained guide will ________ every group into the forest, because visitors might get lost or disturb the nesting birds.
items.zh: 每一團進入森林時都會有一位受過訓練的嚮導陪同，因為遊客可能會迷路或打擾築巢的鳥。

items.def: next to or near something
items.s: The new factory will be built on land ________ to the wetland, so many birdwatchers are worried about noise and dirty water.
items.zh: 新工廠將蓋在鄰近濕地的土地上，所以許多賞鳥人士擔心噪音和汙水的問題。

items.def: to publicly support an idea or plan
items.s: Many scientists ________ stronger laws against the pet trade, because they have seen how many animals die during transport.
items.zh: 許多科學家提倡更嚴格的法律來對抗寵物交易，因為他們親眼看到許多動物在運送途中死亡。

items.def: to make small changes to a law or document
items.s: The government decided to ________ the wildlife law last year, so the penalties for selling protected animals are now much heavier.
items.zh: 政府去年決定修訂野生動物保育法，所以現在販售保育類動物的刑罰重了許多。

items.def: happening once every year
items.s: The ________ bird festival in Kenting attracts thousands of visitors, and local hotels are usually fully booked that week.
items.zh: 墾丁一年一度的賞鳥節吸引了數千名遊客，當地的飯店那一週通常都會客滿。

items.def: chosen by chance, not based on reason
items.s: The borders of the national park are not ________, because scientists drew them after studying where the animals actually live.
items.zh: 國家公園的邊界並不是任意劃定的，因為科學家們是在研究動物實際棲息的地點之後才畫出來的。

items.def: to gather together in one place
items.s: Thousands of crabs ________ on the beach every summer to release their eggs, and the road is closed so cars do not crush them.
items.zh: 每年夏天成千上萬隻螃蟹會聚集在海灘上釋放卵，道路會因此封閉以免車子壓死牠們。

items.def: to judge how good, bad or serious something is
items.s: Experts came to ________ the damage after the oil spill, and they found that hundreds of seabirds had been affected.
items.zh: 專家們在漏油事件後前來評估損害，他們發現有數百隻海鳥受到影響。

items.def: to give someone a job or task
items.s: The leader will ________ each volunteer to a different beach, so the whole coastline can be checked for turtle nests.
items.zh: 領隊會把每位志工分派到不同的海灘，這樣整條海岸線都能被檢查是否有海龜巢。

items.def: to reach a goal after a lot of effort
items.s: The project hopes to ________ its goal of five hundred kakapos by 2030, but it will need more money and more islands.
items.zh: 該計畫希望在2030年前達到五百隻鴞鸚鵡的目標，但這需要更多資金和更多島嶼。

items.def: the main or largest part of something
items.s: The ________ of the money goes to paying rangers, because protecting the animals on the ground is the most important job.
items.zh: 大部分的經費都用來支付巡山員的薪水，因為在第一線保護動物是最重要的工作。

items.def: having the ability to do something
items.s: Crows are ________ of using tools to find food, so scientists believe they are one of the smartest birds in the world.
items.zh: 烏鴉能夠使用工具尋找食物，所以科學家們認為牠們是世界上最聰明的鳥類之一。

items.def: to stop doing something
items.s: The factory was ordered to ________ all work near the river, because its waste water was killing the fish.
items.zh: 那家工廠被下令停止在河邊的所有作業，因為它的廢水正在殺死魚群。

items.def: to mention something as proof or an example
items.s: In her report, the student ________ a study about bees, and she used it to show why pesticides should be controlled.
items.zh: 那位學生在報告中引用了一篇關於蜜蜂的研究，並用它來說明為何應該管制農藥。

items.def: clear, logical and easy to understand
items.s: The country needs a ________ plan to protect its forests, because different offices are currently making different rules.
items.zh: 這個國家需要一套條理清楚的計畫來保護森林，因為目前不同單位制定了不同的規則。

items.def: to happen at the same time as something else
items.s: The rainy season ________ with the birth of many baby animals, so there is plenty of fresh food for the young ones.
items.zh: 雨季和許多小動物出生的時間同時發生，所以幼小的動物有充足的新鮮食物。

items.def: a sudden failure or fall
items.s: Scientists warned that the ________ of the fish population could happen quickly, so the fishing season was shortened.
items.zh: 科學家警告魚群數量的崩潰可能來得很快，所以漁季被縮短了。

items.def: to begin
items.s: The turtle-watching tours will ________ in June, but visitors must book early because only twenty people can join each night.
items.zh: 賞海龜行程將於六月開始，但遊客必須提早預約，因為每晚只能有二十人參加。

items.def: an official group given a special task
items.s: A special ________ was set up to study the falling number of whales, and it will report its findings next year.
items.zh: 一個特別委員會已經成立，專門研究鯨魚數量下降的問題，並將在明年公布調查結果。

items.def: to promise to give time or money to something
items.s: The company has ________ one million dollars to save the coral reefs, and its staff will also help clean the beaches.
items.zh: 那家公司已承諾投入一百萬美元拯救珊瑚礁，員工們也會協助清理海灘。

items.def: a product that can be bought and sold
items.s: For some criminals, wild animals are just a ________ to sell, and they do not care if the animals suffer.
items.zh: 對某些罪犯來說，野生動物只是可以販賣的商品，他們並不在乎動物是否受苦。

items.def: able to exist together without problems
items.s: Tourism and wildlife protection can be ________, but only if the number of visitors is carefully controlled.
items.zh: 觀光和野生動物保護可以是相容的，但前提是遊客數量必須受到謹慎控管。

items.def: to collect information and put it together
items.s: The volunteers ________ a list of every bird they saw this year, and the list will help scientists study changes in the area.
items.zh: 志工們彙整了今年看到的每一種鳥的清單，這份清單將幫助科學家研究這個地區的變化。

items.def: to add something that makes another thing better
items.s: Online classes ________ the field trips well, because students first learn the facts and then see the animals in real life.
items.zh: 線上課程和戶外教學相輔相成，因為學生先學習知識，然後再親眼看到動物。

items.def: to consist of or be made up of
items.s: The national park ________ forests, rivers and high mountains, so it is home to many different kinds of animals.
items.zh: 這座國家公園包含森林、河流和高山，所以它是許多不同種類動物的家園。

items.def: to think of a new idea or plan
items.s: The idea of the wildlife bridge was ________ by a group of students, and the city later decided to build it.
items.zh: 野生動物天橋的點子是由一群學生構想出來的，市政府後來決定建造它。

items.def: to organise and carry out an activity
items.s: The university will ________ a study on the frogs in the area, because their numbers have fallen in recent years.
items.zh: 大學將針對這個地區的青蛙進行一項研究，因為牠們的數量近年來下降了。

items.def: to keep someone or something within a small area
items.s: The circus used to ________ the tigers to small cages, but now the animals live in a large sanctuary.
items.zh: 馬戲團過去把老虎關在小籠子裡，但現在這些動物住在一個大型庇護所中。

items.def: to follow rules or standards
items.s: All new buildings near the coast must ________ to the new rules, so they cannot use bright lights that confuse baby turtles.
items.zh: 海岸附近所有的新建築都必須符合新規定，所以不能使用會讓小海龜迷失方向的強光。

items.def: to form or make up something
items.s: Insects ________ more than half of all known animal species, but most people rarely think about protecting them.
items.zh: 昆蟲構成了所有已知動物物種的一半以上，但大多數人很少想到要保護牠們。

items.def: to build something
items.s: Engineers ________ a fish ladder beside the dam, so salmon can swim up the river to lay their eggs.
items.zh: 工程師們在水壩旁建造了一座魚梯，讓鮭魚能逆流而上去產卵。

items.def: to ask an expert for advice or information
items.s: The city should ________ wildlife experts before building the new road, because it will cross an important forest.
items.zh: 市政府在建造新道路之前應該諮詢野生動物專家，因為這條路將穿越一片重要的森林。

items.def: belonging to the present time; modern
items.s: ________ zoos focus more on education and protection, while old zoos were mainly places for entertainment.
items.zh: 當代的動物園更重視教育和保護，而舊式動物園主要是娛樂場所。

items.def: completely different or opposite
items.s: ________ to popular belief, sharks rarely attack humans, and many more sharks are killed by people every year.
items.zh: 和一般人的看法相反，鯊魚很少攻擊人類，而每年被人類殺死的鯊魚卻多得多。

items.def: a lot of public disagreement about something
items.s: The plan to kill wild cats on the island caused great ________, because some people believed there were kinder solutions.
items.zh: 撲殺島上野貓的計畫引起了極大的爭議，因為有些人認為還有更人道的解決方法。

items.def: to change something into a different form or use
items.s: The town ________ an old fish farm into a nature park, and now hundreds of birds stop there in winter.
items.zh: 小鎮把一座舊養殖場改建成自然公園，現在每年冬天都有數百隻鳥在那裡停留。

items.def: to make someone believe or do something
items.s: The documentary ________ many viewers to stop eating shark fin soup, because it showed how cruel the fishing was.
items.zh: 那部紀錄片說服了許多觀眾不再吃魚翅湯，因為它呈現了捕撈過程有多殘忍。

items.def: to organise people to work together well
items.s: The centre ________ the work of rangers, vets and volunteers, so every injured animal gets help as quickly as possible.
items.zh: 中心負責協調巡山員、獸醫和志工的工作，讓每隻受傷的動物都能盡快獲得協助。

items.def: the most central or important part
items.s: No visitors are allowed in the ________ of the reserve, because the rarest birds build their nests there.
items.zh: 保護區的核心區域禁止遊客進入，因為最稀有的鳥類在那裡築巢。

items.def: related to large companies
items.s: More ________ sponsors are supporting wildlife projects, because customers prefer brands that care about nature.
items.zh: 越來越多企業贊助商支持野生動物計畫，因為消費者偏好關心大自然的品牌。

items.def: to match or be similar to something
items.s: The drop in bird numbers ________ closely with the increase in pesticide use, so scientists believe the two are connected.
items.zh: 鳥類數量的下降和農藥使用量的增加密切對應，所以科學家認為兩者有關聯。

items.def: standards used to judge something
items.s: A species must meet certain ________ before it is called endangered, such as a fast drop in its population.
items.zh: 一個物種必須符合某些標準才會被列為瀕危物種，例如族群數量快速下降。

items.def: a series of events that happen again and again
items.s: The life ________ of a salmon is amazing, because it is born in a river, lives in the sea and returns to the same river.
items.zh: 鮭魚的生命週期很驚人，因為牠在河中出生，在海裡生活，然後再回到同一條河。

items.def: to reach a conclusion from the facts you have
items.s: From the footprints in the mud, the ranger ________ that a mother bear and two cubs had passed by that morning.
items.zh: 從泥巴上的腳印，巡山員推斷當天早上有一隻熊媽媽和兩隻小熊經過。

items.def: to say that something is not true
items.s: The shop owner ________ selling illegal birds, but the police found several rare parrots hidden in the back room.
items.zh: 店主否認販售非法鳥類，但警方在後面的房間裡發現了好幾隻被藏起來的稀有鸚鵡。

items.def: to use up or greatly reduce the amount of something
items.s: Overfishing has ________ the tuna in this part of the ocean, so the fishermen now have to sail much farther to catch anything.
items.zh: 過度捕撈已經耗盡了這片海域的鮪魚，所以漁民現在必須航行得更遠才能捕到魚。

items.def: to notice or discover something
items.s: Hidden cameras can ________ animals that move at night, so scientists can study shy creatures without disturbing them.
items.zh: 隱藏式相機能偵測到夜間活動的動物，所以科學家可以在不打擾牠們的情況下研究害羞的生物。

items.def: to move away from the usual way or plan
items.s: Visitors must not ________ from the marked path, because rare plants and small animals live on the forest floor.
items.zh: 遊客不可以偏離標示的步道，因為稀有植物和小動物生活在森林地面上。

items.def: a small machine or tool made for a purpose
items.s: The scientists attached a tiny ________ to the turtle's shell, and it sends its location to a satellite every day.
items.zh: 科學家在海龜的殼上裝了一個微小的裝置，它每天都會把位置傳送到衛星上。

items.def: to give your time or energy to something
items.s: Jane Goodall ________ her whole life to studying chimpanzees, and she taught the world how intelligent they are.
items.zh: 珍古德把她的一生都奉獻給黑猩猩的研究，她讓全世界知道牠們有多聰明。

items.def: to force people or animals to leave their home
items.s: The new dam ________ hundreds of families and animals, because the water covered the whole valley.
items.zh: 新水壩迫使數百個家庭和動物離開家園，因為水淹沒了整個山谷。

items.def: to get rid of something
items.s: Campers must ________ of their rubbish properly, because bears and monkeys are attracted to the smell of food.
items.zh: 露營者必須妥善處理垃圾，因為熊和猴子會被食物的氣味吸引。

items.def: to change facts so they are no longer true
items.s: Some websites ________ the facts about sharks to get more clicks, so many people are more afraid than they need to be.
items.zh: 有些網站為了獲得更多點閱而扭曲關於鯊魚的事實，使許多人產生不必要的恐懼。

items.def: to give things to many people
items.s: The volunteers ________ leaflets at the night market, and they explained why people should not buy wild animals.
items.zh: 志工們在夜市發放傳單，並解釋為什麼人們不應該購買野生動物。

items.def: to record information in writing or with photos
items.s: The photographer has ________ the life of a wild leopard family for five years, and his pictures are now in a book.
items.zh: 那位攝影師已經記錄一個野生豹家庭的生活五年了，他的照片現在已出版成書。

items.def: kept by people at home or on a farm; tame
items.s: ________ cats kill millions of wild birds every year, so experts suggest keeping pet cats indoors.
items.zh: 家貓每年殺死數百萬隻野鳥，所以專家建議把寵物貓養在室內。

items.def: to have the most power or importance
items.s: In the forest, one strong male gorilla ________ the group, and the others follow him when he moves.
items.zh: 在森林裡，一隻強壯的雄性大猩猩主宰整個群體，當牠移動時其他成員都會跟隨。

items.def: the length of time something lasts
items.s: For the ________ of the nesting season, dogs are not allowed on the beach, because they may dig up the eggs.
items.zh: 在築巢季的期間，狗不可以進入海灘，因為牠們可能會把蛋挖出來。

items.def: always changing and full of energy
items.s: A forest is a ________ system that changes every season, so scientists must visit it many times a year.
items.zh: 森林是一個每季都在改變的動態系統，所以科學家一年必須造訪許多次。

items.def: special importance given to something
items.s: The new programme puts great ________ on education, because children who love nature will protect it when they grow up.
items.zh: 新計畫非常重視教育，因為熱愛自然的孩子長大後會保護它。

items.def: a meeting that is unexpected
items.s: My ________ with a wild bear on the mountain trail was frightening, but I stayed calm and slowly walked away.
items.zh: 我在山路上和一隻野生熊的不期而遇很可怕，但我保持冷靜並慢慢地走開。

items.def: something that exists as a single unit
items.s: The river and the forest should be seen as one ________, because what happens to the water also affects the trees and animals.
items.zh: 河流與森林應該被視為一個整體，因為水發生的事也會影響樹木和動物。

items.def: to slowly damage or wear away
items.s: Strong waves continue to ________ the island's beaches, and soon there may be no sand left for turtles to nest in.
items.zh: 強浪持續侵蝕島上的海灘，不久之後可能就沒有沙子讓海龜築巢了。

items.def: to be more than a limit or amount
items.s: The number of tourists ________ the park's limit last weekend, so the rangers had to close the gate early.
items.zh: 上週末遊客人數超過了公園的上限，所以巡山員不得不提早關閉大門。

items.def: to keep out or not include
items.s: A special fence ________ foxes and cats from the area, so the small birds can raise their chicks safely.
items.zh: 一道特殊的圍籬把狐狸和貓排除在這個區域之外，讓小鳥們能安全地養育雛鳥。

items.def: an object or display shown in a museum or zoo
items.s: The new ________ at the museum shows the bones of a giant whale, and it also explains why whales need protection.
items.zh: 博物館的新展覽展示了一頭巨鯨的骨骼，同時也說明了為什麼鯨魚需要保護。

items.def: to put someone or something in danger
items.s: Cutting down the trees ________ the soil to heavy rain, so the land quickly washes away into the river.
items.zh: 砍伐樹木會使土壤暴露在大雨之下，所以土地很快就被沖進河裡。

items.def: coming from outside
items.s: ________ threats such as new roads and farms are pushing the animals into a smaller and smaller area.
items.zh: 新道路和農場等外部威脅正把動物們逼進越來越小的區域。

items.def: to take something out, often with effort
items.s: Companies want to ________ oil from under the Arctic ice, but scientists warn that a spill could kill many seals and whales.
items.zh: 企業想從北極冰層下開採石油，但科學家警告漏油可能會害死許多海豹和鯨魚。

items.def: an important part or quality of something
items.s: The long neck is the most famous ________ of the giraffe, and it helps the animal eat leaves high up in the trees.
items.zh: 長脖子是長頸鹿最有名的特徵，它幫助這種動物吃到樹上高處的葉子。

items.def: able to change easily
items.s: Conservation plans must be ________, because the weather and the animals' behaviour can change from year to year.
items.zh: 保育計畫必須有彈性，因為天氣和動物的行為每年都可能改變。

items.def: to go up and down often
items.s: The number of butterflies ________ from year to year, so scientists need data from many years to see the real trend.
items.zh: 蝴蝶的數量每年都會波動，所以科學家需要多年的資料才能看出真正的趨勢。

items.def: the way something is arranged or presented
items.s: The wildlife report is available in a simple ________ for students, so even young readers can understand the main ideas.
items.zh: 這份野生動物報告有提供給學生的簡易格式版本，所以即使是年紀小的讀者也能了解主要內容。

items.def: a special mix of ingredients
items.s: The zoo developed a special milk ________ for the baby pangolin, because its mother could not feed it.
items.zh: 動物園為小穿山甲研發了一種特殊的奶粉配方，因為牠的媽媽無法餵養牠。

items.def: an organisation that gives money to good causes
items.s: The ________ gives money to schools that teach children about wildlife, and it also supports rangers in Africa.
items.zh: 那個基金會捐款給教導孩子認識野生動物的學校，同時也支持非洲的巡山員。

items.def: to produce or create something
items.s: Whale watching ________ a lot of income for the small fishing town, so the local people now protect the whales.
items.zh: 賞鯨為這個小漁村創造了大量收入，所以當地人現在都保護鯨魚。

items.def: related to the whole world
items.s: The loss of bees is a ________ problem, so countries need to share their research and work together.
items.zh: 蜜蜂消失是一個全球性的問題，所以各國需要分享研究並共同合作。

items.def: money given by a government or group for a purpose
items.s: The team received a large ________ from the government, so they can now buy cameras to study the leopard cats.
items.zh: 團隊從政府獲得了一大筆補助金，所以他們現在能購買相機來研究石虎。

items.def: to promise that something will happen
items.s: No one can ________ that the baby rhino will survive, but the vets are doing everything they can to help it.
items.zh: 沒有人能保證那隻犀牛寶寶能活下來，但獸醫們正盡一切所能地幫助牠。

items.def: a system where some members have more power than others
items.s: Wolves live in a clear ________, and the strongest pair usually leads the pack and eats first.
items.zh: 狼生活在明確的階級制度中，而最強壯的一對通常帶領狼群並最先進食。

items.def: lack of knowledge about something
items.s: Many people harm wild animals out of ________ rather than cruelty, so education is an important part of conservation.
items.zh: 許多人傷害野生動物是出於無知而非殘忍，所以教育是保育中很重要的一環。

items.def: something that encourages people to do something
items.s: The government offers farmers an ________ to plant trees on their land, so more birds have places to live.
items.zh: 政府提供農民在自己的土地上種樹的誘因，讓更多鳥類有地方居住。

items.def: money that someone earns
items.s: Selling honey gives the villagers a steady ________, so they no longer need to cut down the forest for money.
items.zh: 販售蜂蜜為村民帶來穩定的收入，所以他們不再需要砍伐森林來賺錢。

items.def: a single person or animal
items.s: Scientists can recognise each ________ whale by the shape of its tail, so they know which whales return every year.
items.zh: 科學家能從尾巴的形狀辨認出每一隻鯨魚個體，所以他們知道哪些鯨魚每年都會回來。

items.def: to slow down or stop something
items.s: Cold water can ________ the growth of young fish, so the hatchery keeps the water at a warm temperature.
items.zh: 冷水會抑制幼魚的成長，所以孵化場會把水溫維持在溫暖的溫度。

items.def: to start something such as a plan
items.s: The school ________ a project to plant trees along the river, and every student planted one tree on Earth Day.
items.zh: 學校發起了一項沿著河岸種樹的計畫，每位學生都在世界地球日種下一棵樹。

items.def: a new plan to solve a problem
items.s: The city's new ________ turns off street lights near the beach at night, so baby turtles can find their way to the sea.
items.zh: 市政府的新措施在夜間關閉海灘附近的路燈，讓小海龜能找到通往大海的路。

items.def: a deep and clear understanding of something
items.s: The study gave scientists new ________ into how elephants talk to each other, because it recorded sounds too low for humans to hear.
items.zh: 這項研究讓科學家對大象如何彼此溝通有了新的見解，因為它錄下了低到人類聽不見的聲音。

items.def: to look at something carefully to check it
items.s: Officers ________ every pet shop in the city twice a year, and they check whether any animals are illegal.
items.zh: 官員每年兩次檢查市內的每家寵物店，確認是否有任何非法動物。

items.def: an example of something
