items.s: In one ________, a dog found forty turtle nests in a single morning, so the team now trains more dogs for this job.
items.zh: 在一個例子中，一隻狗在一個早上就找到了四十個海龜巢，所以團隊現在訓練更多的狗來做這項工作。

items.def: necessary and important as part of a whole
items.cn: 不可或缺的；構成整體所必需的
items.s: Local people are an ________ part of the project, because they know the forest better than anyone else.
items.zh: 當地居民是這項計畫不可或缺的一部分，因為他們比任何人都更了解這片森林。

items.def: the state of being whole and not damaged
items.s: The new highway would destroy the ________ of the forest, because it would cut the animals' home into two parts.
items.zh: 新高速公路會破壞森林的完整性，因為它會把動物的家園切成兩半。

items.def: very strong or extreme
items.s: The ________ heat this summer dried up many ponds, so the frogs had to find new places to lay their eggs.
items.zh: 今年夏天強烈的高溫使許多池塘乾涸，所以青蛙們必須找新的地方產卵。

items.def: to become stronger or more serious
items.s: The police have ________ their checks at the airport, because more smugglers are trying to bring in rare reptiles.
items.zh: 警方已加強機場的檢查，因為越來越多走私者試圖帶入稀有的爬蟲類。

items.def: inside something such as a body or group
items.s: The vet used an X-ray to check for ________ injuries, because the turtle had been hit by a boat but looked fine outside.
items.zh: 獸醫用X光檢查是否有內部傷害，因為那隻海龜被船撞到了，但外表看起來沒事。

items.def: to separate someone or something from others
items.s: The sick birds were ________ from the others in a separate room, so the disease would not spread through the whole zoo.
items.zh: 生病的鳥被隔離在另一個房間，這樣疾病就不會傳遍整個動物園。

items.def: an important problem that people discuss
items.s: Plastic in the ocean has become a major ________ in many countries, and some cities have stopped giving out free plastic bags.
items.zh: 海洋中的塑膠已成為許多國家的重大議題，有些城市已經停止提供免費塑膠袋。

items.def: to describe someone or something with a word
items.s: People often ________ sharks as dangerous killers, but most sharks are shy and have never attacked a human.
items.zh: 人們常常把鯊魚貼上危險殺手的標籤，但大多數鯊魚都很害羞，而且從未攻擊過人類。

items.def: a level of something that lies over or under another
items.s: Whales have a thick ________ of fat under their skin, so they can stay warm even in very cold water.
items.zh: 鯨魚的皮膚下有一層厚厚的脂肪，所以即使在非常冰冷的水中也能保暖。

items.def: a connection between two things
items.s: Scientists found a clear ________ between warmer seas and the death of corals, so they are asking for faster action on climate.
items.zh: 科學家發現海水變暖與珊瑚死亡之間有明顯的關聯，所以他們呼籲更快採取氣候行動。

items.def: to find the exact position of something
items.s: The team used a drone to ________ the missing bear, and they found it resting near a river two kilometres away.
items.zh: 團隊用無人機找到了失蹤熊的位置，發現牠在兩公里外的河邊休息。

items.def: a sensible way of thinking
items.s: There is simple ________ behind protecting bees, because without them, many of our fruits and vegetables would not grow.
items.zh: 保護蜜蜂背後有個簡單的道理，因為沒有牠們，我們的許多水果和蔬菜就無法生長。

items.def: a book that tells you how to do something
items.s: Every new volunteer receives a ________ that explains how to handle injured birds, so they do not hurt the animals by mistake.
items.zh: 每位新志工都會收到一本手冊，說明如何處理受傷的鳥，以免他們不小心傷害到動物。

items.def: the edge of an area
items.s: Many birds nest along the ________ of the lake, so boats are not allowed close to the shore in spring.
items.zh: 許多鳥類沿著湖的邊緣築巢，所以春天時船隻不得靠近岸邊。

items.def: related to the mind
items.s: Animals in small cages can suffer from ________ problems, so good zoos give them toys and puzzles to keep them busy.
items.zh: 關在小籠子裡的動物可能會出現心理問題，所以好的動物園會給牠們玩具和益智遊戲讓牠們保持忙碌。

items.def: very small in amount
items.s: The new tourist boats make ________ noise, so they do not frighten the dolphins swimming nearby.
items.zh: 新型觀光船只發出極小的噪音，所以不會嚇到附近游泳的海豚。

items.def: the reason why someone does something
items.s: Money is the main ________ for most poachers, so helping villagers find other jobs can reduce hunting.
items.zh: 金錢是大多數盜獵者的主要動機，所以幫助村民找到其他工作可以減少獵捕。

items.def: shared by two or more people or animals
items.s: The clownfish and the sea anemone have a ________ relationship, because each one helps the other to survive.
items.zh: 小丑魚和海葵之間有一種互利的關係，因為彼此都幫助對方生存。

items.def: not supporting either side in a disagreement
items.s: The meeting was led by a ________ expert, so both the farmers and the conservation group felt their voices were heard.
items.zh: 會議由一位中立的專家主持，所以農民和保育團體都覺得自己的聲音被聽見了。

items.def: however; even so
items.s: The project faced many problems in its first year; ________, the team managed to save twenty baby turtles.
items.zh: 這項計畫在第一年遇到許多問題；儘管如此，團隊還是成功救了二十隻小海龜。

items.def: what is usual or expected
items.s: Using reusable bags has become the ________ in many cities, and as a result less plastic ends up in the sea.
items.zh: 使用環保袋在許多城市已成為常態，因此流入海洋的塑膠變少了。

items.def: an idea or belief
items.s: The ________ that zoos only exist for fun is out of date, because many zoos now help save endangered animals.
items.zh: 動物園只是為了娛樂而存在的觀念已經過時了，因為現在許多動物園都在幫助拯救瀕危動物。

items.def: to get something, often with effort
items.s: Researchers must ________ a special permit before they enter the protected area, and they must follow strict rules inside.
items.zh: 研究人員必須先取得特別許可才能進入保護區，而且在裡面必須遵守嚴格的規定。

items.def: easy to see or understand
items.s: It was ________ that the bird was sick, because it could not stand up and its feathers were dirty.
items.zh: 那隻鳥顯然生病了，因為牠無法站起來，羽毛也很髒。

items.def: to live in or use a place
items.s: The owls ________ an old building on the farm, and the farmer is happy because they catch the rats in his barn.
items.zh: 貓頭鷹占據了農場上的一棟舊建築，農夫很高興，因為牠們會抓穀倉裡的老鼠。

items.def: to happen
items.s: Most attacks on livestock ________ at night, so farmers now bring their animals into safe pens before dark.
items.zh: 大部分對家畜的攻擊都發生在夜晚，所以農民現在會在天黑前把動物趕進安全的圍欄。

items.def: to balance one thing with another
items.s: The airline plants trees to ________ the pollution from its flights, but some experts say this is not enough.
items.zh: 那家航空公司種樹來抵銷航班造成的汙染，但有些專家說這樣還不夠。

items.def: still happening; continuing
items.s: The ________ study of the bears has lasted ten years, and it has taught us a lot about their eating habits.
items.zh: 對熊持續進行的研究已經持續了十年，它讓我們對牠們的飲食習慣了解很多。

items.def: a choice you can make
items.s: Moving the elephants to another park was the only ________, because there was no longer enough food for them.
items.zh: 把大象遷到另一座公園是唯一的選擇，因為那裡已經沒有足夠的食物給牠們了。

items.def: including everything; general
items.s: The ________ number of storks has increased this year, although some smaller groups are still in danger.
items.zh: 今年鸛鳥的整體數量增加了，雖然有些較小的群體仍處於危險之中。

items.def: in or from another country across the sea
items.s: ________ visitors love Taiwan's mountain birds, so guided birdwatching tours have become a popular business.
items.zh: 海外遊客很喜愛台灣的高山鳥類，所以導覽賞鳥行程已成為熱門的生意。

items.def: happening at the same time and similar
items.s: The two countries are running ________ programmes to protect the same turtles, because the turtles swim between both coasts.
items.zh: 兩國正在進行平行的計畫來保護同一種海龜，因為這些海龜在兩國海岸之間游動。

items.def: to continue to exist for a long time
items.s: Chemicals from old pesticides can ________ in the soil for many years, so they still harm insects and birds today.
items.zh: 舊農藥中的化學物質可以在土壤中持續存在很多年，所以至今仍會傷害昆蟲和鳥類。

items.def: a stage in a process
items.s: In the first ________ of the project, the team will count the animals, and in the second they will plant new trees.
items.zh: 在計畫的第一階段，團隊將清點動物數量，第二階段則將種植新的樹木。

items.def: a plan of action agreed by a government or group
items.s: The new ________ bans single-use plastic in national parks, so visitors must bring their own bottles and bags.
items.zh: 新政策禁止在國家公園使用一次性塑膠，所以遊客必須自備水瓶和袋子。

items.def: a part of something larger
items.s: A large ________ of the money from ticket sales is used to protect the forest, so visiting the park also helps nature.
items.zh: 門票收入中很大一部分被用來保護森林，所以參觀公園也是在幫助大自然。

items.def: to happen before something else
items.s: A long dry season ________ the forest fire, so the trees and grass burned very quickly.
items.zh: 森林大火之前經歷了一段漫長的乾季，所以樹木和草很快就燒起來了。

items.def: most common or strongest
items.s: Pine is the ________ tree in this forest, and it provides food for many squirrels and birds.
items.zh: 松樹是這片森林中主要的樹種，它為許多松鼠和鳥類提供食物。

items.def: coming before the main part; early
items.s: ________ results show that the number of leopard cats has increased, but the final report will come out next year.
items.zh: 初步結果顯示石虎的數量增加了，但最終報告將在明年發表。

items.def: to think something is true without proof
items.s: The rangers ________ that the tiger crossed the river at night, because they found its footprints on the other side.
items.zh: 巡山員推測老虎在夜間渡過了河，因為他們在對岸發現了牠的腳印。

items.def: something that is more important than other things
items.s: Saving the last few kakapos is a top ________ for New Zealand, so the government spends a lot on the project.
items.zh: 拯救最後幾隻鴞鸚鵡是紐西蘭的首要優先事項，所以政府在這項計畫上投入了大量經費。

items.def: to continue doing something
items.s: The building work cannot ________ until the birds leave their nests, so the company has to wait until autumn.
items.zh: 在鳥兒離巢之前，建築工程無法繼續進行，所以公司必須等到秋天。

items.def: to help something grow or become popular
items.s: The town wants to ________ ecotourism, so it is training local young people to become nature guides.
items.zh: 小鎮想要推廣生態旅遊，所以正在培訓當地年輕人成為自然導覽員。

items.def: the possibility that something will happen
items.s: The ________ of seeing wild whales attracts many tourists to Hualien, so boat companies there are very busy in summer.
items.zh: 看到野生鯨魚的可能性吸引了許多遊客前往花蓮，所以那裡的船公司夏天都非常忙碌。

items.def: a set of rules for how to do something
items.s: The rescue team follows a strict ________ when they handle sick animals, because some diseases can spread to humans.
items.zh: 救援團隊在處理生病的動物時遵循嚴格的規範程序，因為有些疾病會傳染給人類。

items.def: to print or put information online for the public
items.s: The scientists will ________ their research on dolphins next month, and they hope it will lead to better laws.
items.zh: 科學家們將在下個月發表他們對海豚的研究，並希望這能帶來更好的法律。

items.def: to try to achieve something over a long time
items.s: My cousin wants to ________ a career in marine biology, because she has loved sea animals since she was a child.
items.zh: 我表姊想要從事海洋生物學的工作，因為她從小就熱愛海洋動物。

items.def: based on numbers and amounts
items.s: The team collected ________ data on the number of eggs in each nest, so they could compare the results with last year.
items.zh: 團隊收集了每個巢中蛋數量的定量資料，這樣他們就能和去年的結果比較。

items.def: very new and different; extreme
items.s: Some experts believe we need ________ changes in how we farm, because current methods are destroying too much wildlife.
items.zh: 有些專家認為我們需要徹底改變耕作方式，因為目前的方法摧毀了太多野生動物。

items.def: the relationship between two amounts
items.s: The ________ of male to female turtles is changing, because warmer sand produces more female babies.
items.zh: 海龜的雄雌比例正在改變，因為較溫暖的沙子會孵出更多雌性小海龜。

items.def: based on clear thinking, not feelings
items.s: We need a ________ discussion about wild boars, because both the farmers and the animal lovers have strong feelings.
items.zh: 我們需要對山豬進行理性的討論，因為農民和愛護動物人士雙方的情緒都很強烈。

items.def: to return to a normal or healthy state
items.s: The forest will take fifty years to ________ from the fire, but some small plants are already growing again.
items.zh: 這片森林需要五十年才能從大火中恢復，但有些小植物已經開始重新生長了。

items.def: to improve something by making small changes
items.s: The scientists ________ their camera traps after the first test, so now the photos are much clearer at night.
items.zh: 科學家們在第一次測試後改進了他們的自動相機，所以現在夜間的照片清晰許多。

items.def: a large area of a country or the world
items.s: This ________ of Africa has the largest number of elephants, so it is a key area for the fight against poaching.
items.zh: 非洲的這個地區擁有最多的大象，所以它是對抗盜獵的關鍵區域。

items.def: to put a name on an official list
items.s: All pet owners must ________ their reptiles with the city, so the government knows which animals are kept in homes.
items.zh: 所有飼主都必須向市政府登記他們的爬蟲類寵物，這樣政府才知道哪些動物被飼養在家中。

items.def: to make something stronger
items.s: The farmers ________ their fences with metal posts, because the wild boars had broken the old wooden ones.
items.zh: 農民們用金屬柱加強了他們的圍籬，因為山豬已經撞壞了舊的木頭圍籬。

items.def: to refuse to accept something
items.s: The city council ________ the plan to build a hotel on the beach, because it would destroy the turtles' nesting area.
items.zh: 市議會否決了在海灘上蓋飯店的計畫，因為它會破壞海龜的築巢區。

items.def: to let an animal go free
items.s: After two months of care, the team ________ the eagle back into the mountains, and everyone cheered as it flew away.
items.zh: 經過兩個月的照顧，團隊把老鷹野放回山林，當牠飛走時大家都歡呼了起來。

items.def: not willing to do something
items.s: Some farmers are ________ to share their land with wild animals, because they worry about losing their crops.
items.zh: 有些農民不情願和野生動物分享他們的土地，因為他們擔心失去農作物。

items.def: to need or depend on someone or something
items.s: Many island birds ________ on one type of fruit tree for food, so they will suffer if that tree disappears.
items.zh: 許多島嶼鳥類仰賴單一種果樹作為食物，所以如果那種樹消失，牠們就會受苦。

items.def: to need something
items.s: Looking after a baby elephant ________ a lot of time and money, because it drinks milk every three hours.
items.zh: 照顧一隻小象需要大量的時間和金錢，因為牠每三個小時就要喝一次奶。

items.def: to live in a particular place
items.s: About two hundred black bears ________ in this national park, but they are rarely seen by hikers.
items.zh: 大約有兩百隻黑熊居住在這座國家公園裡，但健行者很少看到牠們。

items.def: to bring something back to a good condition
items.s: Volunteers are working to ________ the old pond, so frogs and dragonflies can live there again.
items.zh: 志工們正在努力修復那座舊池塘，讓青蛙和蜻蜓能再次在那裡生活。

items.def: to show something that was hidden
items.s: The camera traps ________ that a rare cat lives in the forest, and the scientists were very excited by the news.
items.zh: 自動相機揭露了森林裡住著一種稀有的貓科動物，科學家們對這個消息感到非常興奮。

items.def: money that a business or government receives
items.s: The park uses its ticket ________ to pay the rangers, so tourism directly supports the protection of wildlife.
items.zh: 公園用門票收入來支付巡山員的薪水，所以觀光直接支持了野生動物的保護。

items.def: to change something back to how it was
items.s: It is not too late to ________ the loss of our forests, but we must start planting trees and stop cutting them down.
items.zh: 要扭轉森林消失的趨勢還不算太晚，但我們必須開始種樹並停止砍伐。

items.def: to change something to improve or correct it
items.s: Every five years, the experts ________ the list of endangered species, and some animals are added while others are removed.
items.zh: 專家每五年修訂一次瀕危物種名單，有些動物被加進去，而有些則被移除。

items.def: very strict and difficult to change
items.s: The rules in the protected area are ________, so even scientists must ask for permission before they collect any plants.
items.zh: 保護區內的規定非常嚴格，所以即使是科學家在採集任何植物前也必須申請許可。

items.def: the way from one place to another
items.s: The new railway will cut across the elephants' ________ to the river, so engineers are planning a tunnel for them.
items.zh: 新鐵路將切斷大象前往河邊的路線，所以工程師正在為牠們規劃一條隧道。

items.def: a possible situation in the future
items.s: In the worst ________, the island's rare birds could disappear within ten years, so action must be taken now.
items.zh: 在最壞的情況下，島上的稀有鳥類可能在十年內消失，所以現在就必須採取行動。

items.def: an official plan or programme
items.s: Under the new ________, farmers get money for every leopard cat seen on their land, so they now protect the animals.
items.zh: 在新方案下，農民在自己的土地上每發現一隻石虎就能獲得獎金，所以他們現在都會保護這種動物。

items.def: the range of things that something covers
items.s: The ________ of the study is quite small, because the scientists only looked at birds in one city park.
items.zh: 這項研究的範圍相當小，因為科學家只觀察了一座城市公園裡的鳥。

items.def: to get something important after effort
items.s: The charity finally ________ enough money to buy the forest, so it will never be cut down.
items.zh: 那個慈善機構終於爭取到足夠的資金買下那片森林，所以它永遠不會被砍伐了。

items.def: to try to find or get something
items.s: During the drought, many animals ________ water in nearby villages, which led to conflicts with farmers.
items.zh: 乾旱期間，許多動物到附近村莊尋找水源，因而和農民發生衝突。

items.def: a series of events in a particular order
items.s: Scientists studied the ________ of events that led to the fish deaths, and they found that the problem began at a factory.
items.zh: 科學家研究了導致魚群死亡的一連串事件，發現問題始於一家工廠。

items.def: a number of similar things that come one after another
items.s: The BBC made a nature ________ about the ocean, and it made millions of viewers care about plastic pollution.
items.zh: 英國廣播公司製作了一部關於海洋的自然系列節目，讓數百萬觀眾開始關心塑膠汙染。

items.def: a place where something is or happens
items.s: The beach is an important nesting ________ for green turtles, so it is closed to the public from May to October.
items.zh: 這片海灘是綠蠵龜重要的築巢地點，所以從五月到十月不對外開放。

items.def: only; single
items.s: The kakapo's ________ defence is to stay still and hide, but this does not work against cats and rats.
items.zh: 鴞鸚鵡唯一的防禦方式就是靜止不動並躲藏，但這招對貓和老鼠沒有用。

items.def: a little; to some degree
items.s: The number of visitors has dropped ________ since the new rules began, but the animals seem much calmer now.
items.zh: 自從新規定實施以來，遊客人數稍微減少了，但動物們現在似乎平靜多了。

items.def: the place where something comes from
items.s: Insects are the main food ________ for many birds, so fewer insects means fewer birds in the countryside.
items.zh: 昆蟲是許多鳥類主要的食物來源，所以昆蟲變少就代表鄉間的鳥類也會變少。

items.def: exact and clear; particular
items.s: Each type of butterfly needs a ________ plant to lay its eggs on, so gardeners should grow many kinds of local plants.
items.zh: 每一種蝴蝶都需要一種特定的植物來產卵，所以園丁應該種植多種本地植物。

items.def: not changing much; steady
items.s: The number of gorillas in the park has been ________ for five years, so the rangers feel hopeful about the future.
items.zh: 公園裡大猩猩的數量五年來一直保持穩定，所以巡山員對未來感到有希望。

items.def: official position or condition
items.s: The giant panda's ________ changed from endangered to vulnerable in 2016, because its numbers had slowly increased.
items.zh: 大貓熊的保育狀態在2016年從瀕危降為易危，因為牠們的數量已經慢慢增加了。

items.def: to give a document to someone for a decision
items.s: Our class ________ a proposal to the principal, and we asked for a small garden for bees and butterflies at school.
items.zh: 我們班向校長提交了一份提案，請求在學校設置一座小型的蜜蜂和蝴蝶花園。

items.def: money a government pays to help reduce costs
items.s: Farmers who stop using pesticides can receive a ________ from the government, so their income does not drop.
items.zh: 停止使用農藥的農民可以獲得政府的補貼，讓他們的收入不會減少。

items.def: something used instead of another thing
items.s: Scientists are developing a plant-based ________ for rhino horn, because they hope it will reduce the demand for real horns.
items.zh: 科學家正在開發一種植物性的犀牛角替代品，因為他們希望這能減少對真犀牛角的需求。

items.def: to add something to make it better or complete
items.s: In winter, the zoo ________ the birds' food with extra seeds, because there are fewer insects for them to eat.
items.zh: 冬天時，動物園會用額外的種子來補充鳥的食物，因為可以吃的昆蟲變少了。

items.def: to continue to live, especially after danger
items.s: Only a few baby turtles ________ their first year, because so many animals in the sea want to eat them.
items.zh: 只有少數幾隻小海龜能存活過第一年，因為海裡有太多動物想吃牠們。

items.def: to stop something for a period of time
items.s: The city ________ the building work near the lake, because a family of rare otters was found living there.
items.zh: 市政府暫停了湖邊的建築工程，因為發現一家稀有的水獺住在那裡。

items.def: to keep something alive or continuing
items.s: The small forest cannot ________ so many deer, so the animals are eating all the young trees.
items.zh: 這片小森林無法維持那麼多鹿的生存，所以這些動物正在吃光所有的小樹。

items.def: something that represents an idea
items.s: The giant panda has become a ________ of wildlife protection, and its picture appears on the WWF logo.
items.zh: 大貓熊已經成為野生動物保護的象徵，牠的圖案出現在世界自然基金會的標誌上。

items.def: a goal you want to achieve
items.s: The country set a ________ of protecting thirty percent of its land, and it hopes to reach this goal by 2030.
items.zh: 這個國家設定了保護百分之三十國土的目標，並希望在2030年前達成。

items.def: lasting only for a short time
items.s: The injured deer was kept in a ________ shelter, and it was released once its leg had healed.
items.zh: 受傷的鹿被安置在一個臨時收容所，等腿傷痊癒後就被野放了。

items.def: to end something
items.s: The government ________ the company's fishing licence, because it had caught dolphins again and again.
items.zh: 政府終止了那家公司的捕魚執照，因為它一再捕捉到海豚。

items.def: a belief or custom passed down for many years
items.s: In some cultures, eating wild animals is an old ________, so changing people's habits takes patience and respect.
items.zh: 在某些文化中，吃野生動物是一種古老的傳統，所以改變人們的習慣需要耐心和尊重。

items.def: final and most important
items.s: The ________ goal of the breeding programme is to return the animals to the wild, not to keep them in zoos forever.
items.zh: 繁殖計畫的最終目標是讓動物回歸野外，而不是讓牠們永遠待在動物園裡。

items.def: to experience a process or change
items.s: The injured dolphin ________ surgery last week, and the vets say it is now eating and swimming normally.
items.zh: 那隻受傷的海豚上週接受了手術，獸醫說牠現在已經能正常進食和游泳了。

items.def: to be the real cause of something
items.cn: 構成……的基礎；是……的根本原因
items.s: Poverty often ________ the problem of poaching, because hunters need money to feed their families.
items.zh: 貧窮往往是盜獵問題的根本原因，因為獵人需要錢來養家。

items.def: the same in all parts or at all times
items.s: There is no ________ rule for keeping exotic pets, because each country has its own laws.
items.zh: 飼養奇特寵物並沒有統一的規定，因為每個國家都有自己的法律。

items.def: being the only one of its kind
items.s: Every zebra has a ________ pattern of stripes, so scientists can use photos to tell the animals apart.
items.zh: 每隻斑馬都有獨一無二的條紋圖案，所以科學家可以用照片來區分牠們。

items.def: to use something in an effective way
items.s: Rangers in the park now ________ smartphones to report poachers quickly, so help can arrive within minutes.
items.zh: 園區的巡山員現在利用智慧型手機迅速通報盜獵者，讓支援能在幾分鐘內抵達。

items.def: to be different in different situations
items.s: The size of a bear's territory can ________ a lot, because it depends on how much food is available.
items.zh: 熊的領域大小可能差異很大，因為這取決於有多少可取得的食物。

items.def: to break a law or rule
items.s: The tour company ________ the rules by getting too close to the whales, so it had to pay a large fine.
items.zh: 那家旅遊公司因為太靠近鯨魚而違反規定，所以必須支付一大筆罰款。

items.def: able to be seen
items.s: The damage from the oil spill was clearly ________ from the air, and black water stretched for kilometres along the coast.
items.zh: 漏油造成的損害從空中清楚可見，黑色的海水沿著海岸延伸了好幾公里。

items.def: done because you choose to, not because you must
items.s: The beach clean-up is ________, but more than two hundred students joined it last Saturday.
items.zh: 淨灘活動是自願參加的，但上週六有超過兩百名學生加入。

items.def: the health and happiness of people or animals
items.s: Good zoos care about the ________ of their animals, so they give them large spaces and a natural diet.
items.zh: 好的動物園關心動物的福祉，所以會給牠們寬敞的空間和自然的飲食。

items.def: to happen or make happen faster
items.s: Warmer weather has ________ the melting of the Arctic ice, so polar bears have less time to hunt each year.
items.zh: 較暖的天氣加速了北極冰層的融化，所以北極熊每年能狩獵的時間變少了。

items.def: a period of ten years
items.s: Over the last ________, the number of black-faced spoonbills has more than doubled, thanks to the hard work of many countries.
items.zh: 在過去十年間，黑面琵鷺的數量增加了一倍以上，這要歸功於許多國家的努力。

items.def: a close connection between people or animals
items.s: The ________ between a mother orangutan and her baby is very strong, because the baby stays with her for about eight years.
items.zh: 紅毛猩猩媽媽和寶寶之間的情感連結非常緊密，因為寶寶會和媽媽待在一起大約八年。

items.def: very close to disappearing forever
items.s: The vaquita porpoise is ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, because only about ten of them are left in the sea near Mexico.
items.zh: 小頭鼠海豚瀕臨滅絕，因為墨西哥附近的海域只剩下大約十隻。

items.def: living free in nature, not in a zoo
items.s: Pandas live for about twenty years ______ ______ ______, but they can live longer in zoos because they get medical care.
items.zh: 貓熊在野外大約能活二十年，但在動物園裡因為能得到醫療照顧，所以可以活得更久。

items.def: the order in which animals eat other plants and animals
items.s: Sharks are at the top of the ocean ______ ______, so when they disappear, the whole sea can become unbalanced.
items.zh: 鯊魚位於海洋食物鏈的頂端，所以當牠們消失時，整個海洋都可能失去平衡。

items.def: the place where an animal normally lives in nature
items.s: The zoo tries to make the gorillas' home look like their ______ ______, so it has planted tall trees and thick bushes.
items.zh: 動物園試著讓大猩猩的家看起來像牠們的自然棲地，所以種了高大的樹木和茂密的灌木。

items.def: the destruction of the places where animals live
items.s: ______ ______ is the biggest danger for orangutans, because their forests are being replaced by palm oil farms.
items.zh: 棲地喪失是紅毛猩猩面臨的最大危險，因為牠們的森林正被棕櫚油農園取代。

items.def: long-term changes in the Earth's weather and temperature
items.s: ______ ______ is making the sea warmer, so many corals are dying and fish are moving to cooler waters.
items.zh: 氣候變遷正使海水變暖，所以許多珊瑚正在死亡，魚群也正移往較涼的水域。

items.def: an animal that many other species depend on
items.s: The sea otter is a ______ ______, because it eats sea urchins that would otherwise destroy the kelp forests.
items.zh: 海獺是一種關鍵物種，因為牠會吃掉海膽，否則海膽會摧毀海藻森林。

items.def: problems that happen when people and wild animals meet
items.s: ______ ______ is growing in Kenya, because more farms are being built on land where elephants used to walk.
items.zh: 人與野生動物的衝突在肯亞日益加劇，因為越來越多農場蓋在大象過去行走的土地上。

items.def: to disappear completely
items.s: The dodo ______ ______ in the 1600s, because sailors hunted it and the animals they brought ate its eggs.
items.zh: 渡渡鳥在十七世紀絕跡了，因為水手們獵捕牠，而他們帶來的動物則吃掉了牠的蛋。

items.def: to destroy or kill something completely
items.s: A single disease could ______ ______ the whole population of Tasmanian devils, so scientists keep some healthy ones on a safe island.
items.zh: 單一種疾病就可能徹底消滅所有的袋獾，所以科學家把一些健康的袋獾養在一座安全的島上。

items.def: to be a danger to something
items.s: Stray cats ______ ______ ______ ______ the small birds on the island, because they hunt them day and night.
items.zh: 流浪貓對島上的小鳥構成威脅，因為牠們日夜都在獵捕鳥類。

items.def: to become common or successful again
items.s: The bald eagle has ______ ______ ______ in the United States, because the harmful pesticide DDT was banned in 1972.
items.zh: 白頭海鵰已經在美國重新出現，因為有害的農藥DDT在1972年被禁用了。

items.def: to find a fair middle point between two things
items.s: The town is trying to ______ ______ ______ between tourism and nature, so it limits the number of boats near the dolphins.
items.zh: 小鎮正努力在觀光與自然之間取得平衡，所以限制了靠近海豚的船隻數量。

items.def: in danger of being harmed or destroyed
items.s: Many wetlands in Asia are ______ ______ from new buildings, so migrating birds are losing their resting places.
items.zh: 亞洲許多濕地正受到新建築的威脅，所以遷徙的鳥類正逐漸失去牠們的休息地。

items.def: likely to suffer something bad
items.s: Without help, the Formosan leopard cat is ______ ______ ______ disappearing from Taiwan, so people must drive slowly on mountain roads.
items.zh: 如果沒有協助，石虎有從台灣消失的危險，所以人們在山區道路上必須慢慢開車。

items.def: to do something to solve a problem
items.s: If we do not ______ ______ now, our children may only see tigers in books, so everyone should help in small ways.
items.zh: 如果我們現在不採取行動，我們的孩子可能只能在書中看到老虎，所以每個人都應該盡一點小小的心力。

items.def: a very small amount compared with what is needed
items.s: One beach clean-up may seem like ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, but if everyone joins in, the difference can be huge.
items.zh: 一次淨灘看起來也許只是杯水車薪，但如果每個人都參與，差別就會非常大。

items.def: to pretend not to notice something wrong
items.cn: 視而不見；睜一隻眼閉一隻眼
items.s: Some officers ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ the illegal pet shops, so the animal trade continues in the city.
items.zh: 有些官員對非法寵物店視而不見，所以動物交易在城市裡持續進行。

items.def: the natural state in which plants and animals live together steadily
items.s: When wolves were removed from the park, ______ ______ ______ ______ was broken, and the deer ate too many young trees.
items.zh: 當狼被移出公園後，生態平衡就被破壞了，鹿吃掉了太多小樹。

items.def: completely gone or no longer existing
items.s: If we keep cutting down the rainforest, many amazing animals will soon be ______ ______ ______ ______, and we can never bring them back.
items.zh: 如果我們持續砍伐雨林，許多令人驚嘆的動物很快就會徹底消失，而且我們再也無法讓牠們回來。

items.def: the usual weather of a place over many years
items.s: Taiwan has a warm and wet ________, so many visitors from Europe find the summer months hard to handle at first.
items.zh: 台灣擁有溫暖潮濕的氣候,所以許多來自歐洲的遊客一開始會覺得夏季幾個月很難適應。
items.sec: Climate Science & the Atmosphere 氣候科學與大氣

items.def: the layer of gases around the Earth
items.s: Scientists explained that the ________ works like a warm blanket around the Earth, but too much carbon makes the blanket thicker.
items.zh: 科學家解釋說,大氣層就像包覆地球的一條溫暖毯子,但太多的碳會讓這條毯子變得更厚。
items.sec: Climate Science & the Atmosphere 氣候科學與大氣

items.def: connected with the air around the Earth
items.s: The research team measures ________ pressure every hour, because sudden changes often tell them that a storm is coming.
items.zh: 研究團隊每小時測量一次大氣壓力,因為突然的變化常常告訴他們暴風雨即將來臨。
items.sec: Climate Science & the Atmosphere 氣候科學與大氣

items.def: how hot or cold something is
items.s: The average ________ in Taipei has risen over the past fifty years, and many older residents say summers feel much longer now.
items.zh: 台北的平均氣溫在過去五十年間上升了,許多年長居民說現在的夏天感覺長了許多。
items.sec: Climate Science & the Atmosphere 氣候科學與大氣

items.def: the amount of water in the air
items.s: The ________ was over ninety percent this afternoon, so my clothes would not dry and the whole apartment felt sticky.
items.zh: 今天下午的濕度超過百分之九十,所以我的衣服乾不了,整間公寓都感覺黏黏的。
items.sec: Climate Science & the Atmosphere 氣候科學與大氣

items.def: hot and wet in an uncomfortable way
items.s: July in southern Taiwan is extremely hot and ________, so we always carry a towel and plenty of water when we go out.
items.zh: 南台灣的七月非常炎熱又潮濕悶熱,所以我們出門時總是帶著毛巾和充足的水。
items.sec: Climate Science & the Atmosphere 氣候科學與大氣

items.def: rain, snow or hail that falls from the sky
items.s: Climate models show that ________ will become less regular, so some months may be very dry while others bring heavy rain.
items.zh: 氣候模型顯示降水將變得較不規律,因此有些月份可能非常乾燥,而另一些月份則會帶來大雨。
items.sec: Climate Science & the Atmosphere 氣候科學與大氣

items.def: the amount of rain that falls in a place
items.s: Farmers in the area depend on spring ________ for their rice fields, but last year the rain arrived almost a month late.
items.zh: 這地區的農夫依賴春季降雨量來灌溉稻田,但去年雨水幾乎晚了一個月才來。
items.sec: Climate Science & the Atmosphere 氣候科學與大氣

items.def: to change from liquid into gas
items.s: During the heatwave, the water in the small pond began to ________ quickly, and the frogs had to look for a new home.
items.zh: 熱浪期間,小池塘裡的水開始迅速蒸發,青蛙們只好去找新的家。
items.sec: Climate Science & the Atmosphere 氣候科學與大氣

items.def: the process of water turning into gas
items.s: Higher temperatures increase ________ from lakes and soil, so reservoirs can lose water even when nobody is using it.
items.zh: 較高的氣溫會增加湖泊和土壤的蒸發,因此即使沒有人使用,水庫也可能流失水量。
items.sec: Climate Science & the Atmosphere 氣候科學與大氣

items.def: water drops that form when warm air touches something cold
items.s: There was a lot of ________ on the bathroom window this morning, because the hot shower filled the cold room with steam.
items.zh: 今天早上浴室窗戶上有很多凝結的水珠,因為熱水澡讓冰冷的房間充滿了蒸氣。
items.sec: Climate Science & the Atmosphere 氣候科學與大氣

items.def: a small amount of water in the air or in something
items.s: Warm air can hold more ________ than cold air, which is one reason why storms are becoming heavier in a warmer world.
items.zh: 暖空氣能比冷空氣容納更多水氣,這就是在更暖的世界裡暴風雨變得更猛烈的原因之一。
items.sec: Climate Science & the Atmosphere 氣候科學與大氣

items.def: a gas high in the sky that blocks harmful sunlight
items.s: The layer of ________ high above us protects our skin from strong sunlight, and countries worked together to repair the hole in it.
items.zh: 我們頭頂高空中的臭氧層保護我們的皮膚免受強烈陽光傷害,各國也曾合作修補它的破洞。
items.sec: Climate Science & the Atmosphere 氣候科學與大氣

items.def: describing invisible light from the sun that can burn skin
items.s: The weather app warned that ________ levels would be very high at noon, so the coach moved our practice to the evening.
items.zh: 天氣應用程式警告中午的紫外線指數會非常高,所以教練把我們的練習改到傍晚。
items.sec: Climate Science & the Atmosphere 氣候科學與大氣

items.def: energy that travels as heat or light
items.s: The Earth receives ________ from the sun every day, and some of this energy should escape back into space at night.
items.zh: 地球每天接收來自太陽的輻射,而其中一部分能量應該在夜間散逸回太空。
items.sec: Climate Science & the Atmosphere 氣候科學與大氣

items.def: connected with the sun
items.s: Our school installed ________ lights along the path to the gym, and they charge during the day and shine all night.
items.zh: 我們學校在通往體育館的小路旁裝了太陽能燈,它們白天充電,整晚都會發光。
items.sec: Climate Science & the Atmosphere 氣候科學與大氣

items.def: a scientist who studies and reports the weather
items.s: The TV ________ said the typhoon would turn north, but many people still bought extra food and water just in case.
items.zh: 電視上的氣象預報員說颱風會轉向北方,但許多人還是買了額外的食物和水以防萬一。
items.sec: Climate Science & the Atmosphere 氣候科學與大氣

items.def: a scientist who studies climate over long periods
items.s: A ________ visited our class and showed us old temperature records, so we could see how much the island has warmed.
items.zh: 一位氣候學家來到我們班上,給我們看舊的氣溫紀錄,讓我們看見這座島已經變暖了多少。
items.sec: Climate Science & the Atmosphere 氣候科學與大氣

items.def: a tool that measures temperature
items.s: The ________ outside our classroom showed thirty-six degrees, so the principal let everyone stay inside during the break.
items.zh: 我們教室外的溫度計顯示三十六度,所以校長讓大家下課時都待在室內。
items.sec: Climate Science & the Atmosphere 氣候科學與大氣

items.def: a scale for measuring temperature where water freezes at 0
items.s: World leaders hope to keep warming below 1.5 degrees ________, but many experts believe this goal is becoming very difficult.
items.zh: 世界領袖希望把暖化控制在攝氏1.5度以下,但許多專家認為這個目標正變得非常困難。
items.sec: Climate Science & the Atmosphere 氣候科學與大氣

items.def: something that is different from what is normal
items.s: A warm winter used to be an ________ in this region, but now it happens almost every year and nobody is surprised.
items.zh: 暖冬過去在這個地區是一種異常現象,但現在幾乎每年都會發生,也沒有人感到驚訝了。
items.sec: Climate Science & the Atmosphere 氣候科學與大氣

items.def: happening at a particular time of the year
items.s: Many farmers hire ________ workers in the summer, but the harvest now starts earlier because the spring is warmer.
items.zh: 許多農夫在夏天雇用季節性工人,但因為春天變得較暖,收成現在提早開始了。
items.sec: Climate Science & the Atmosphere 氣候科學與大氣

items.def: the season of heavy rain in South and Southeast Asia
items.s: The ________ brings most of the year's rain to India, so a weak season can hurt millions of farmers and their families.
items.zh: 季風為印度帶來一年中大部分的雨量,所以雨季偏弱時可能會傷害數百萬農民和他們的家庭。
items.sec: Climate Science & the Atmosphere 氣候科學與大氣

items.def: from the hot area near the equator
items.s: ________ diseases such as dengue fever are spreading north, because mosquitoes can now survive in places that were once too cool.
items.zh: 像登革熱這樣的熱帶疾病正向北擴散,因為蚊子現在能在曾經太涼爽的地方存活。
items.sec: Climate Science & the Atmosphere 氣候科學與大氣

items.def: very dry with little rain
items.s: The farm is in an ________ part of the country, so the family collects every drop of rain and grows plants that need little water.
items.zh: 這座農場位於國內乾旱的地區,所以這家人收集每一滴雨水,並種植需水量少的植物。
items.sec: Climate Science & the Atmosphere 氣候科學與大氣

items.def: not very hot and not very cold
items.s: Britain has a ________ climate, but recent summers have been so hot that train tracks bent and some roads began to melt.
items.zh: 英國屬於溫帶氣候,但最近幾個夏天熱到鐵軌彎曲,有些道路也開始融化。
items.sec: Climate Science & the Atmosphere 氣候科學與大氣

items.def: near the North or South Pole
items.s: ________ regions are warming faster than the rest of the planet, and this change affects weather patterns far away.
items.zh: 極地地區暖化的速度比地球其他地方更快,而這種變化會影響遠方的天氣型態。
items.sec: Climate Science & the Atmosphere 氣候科學與大氣

items.def: the distance of a place north or south of the equator
items.s: Some plants are moving to higher ________ as the climate warms, but slow-growing trees often cannot move fast enough.
items.zh: 隨著氣候變暖,有些植物正往較高緯度遷移,但生長緩慢的樹木往往移動得不夠快。
items.sec: Climate Science & the Atmosphere 氣候科學與大氣

items.def: the height of a place above sea level
items.s: Tea farmers in Taiwan are planting at higher ________ now, because the lower hills have become too warm for good leaves.
items.zh: 台灣的茶農現在都種在更高的海拔,因為較低的山丘已經變得太熱,長不出好的茶葉。
items.sec: Climate Science & the Atmosphere 氣候科學與大氣

items.def: a strong, fast wind high in the sky
items.s: When the ______ ______ gets weak and wavy, hot or cold weather can stay in one place for many days.
items.zh: 當噴射氣流變弱並呈波浪狀時,炎熱或寒冷的天氣可能會在同一個地方停留許多天。
items.sec: Climate Science & the Atmosphere 氣候科學與大氣

items.def: a gas that traps heat in the atmosphere
items.s: Carbon dioxide is the most common ______ ______, but methane from farms is also a serious problem.
items.zh: 二氧化碳是最常見的溫室氣體,但來自農場的甲烷也是一個嚴重的問題。
items.sec: Greenhouse Gases & Emissions 溫室氣體與排放

items.def: gas or smoke that is sent into the air
items.s: The city wants to cut its ________ by half before 2035, so it is adding more bus lanes and bike paths.
items.zh: 這座城市想在2035年前把排放量減半,所以正在增加更多公車專用道和自行車道。
items.sec: Greenhouse Gases & Emissions 溫室氣體與排放

items.def: to send out gas, heat, light or sound
items.s: Old motorcycles ________ much more smoke than new electric scooters, so the government gives money to people who replace them.
items.zh: 舊機車排放的廢氣比新的電動機車多得多,所以政府會補助汰換的民眾。
items.sec: Greenhouse Gases & Emissions 溫室氣體與排放

items.def: a chemical element found in coal, oil and living things
items.s: Trees store ________ in their wood and leaves, so cutting down forests releases it back into the air.
items.zh: 樹木把碳儲存在木材和葉子裡,所以砍伐森林會把它釋放回空氣中。
items.sec: Greenhouse Gases & Emissions 溫室氣體與排放

items.def: the gas CO2, produced when fuel is burned
items.s: Every time we drive a petrol car, it releases ______ ______, and this gas stays in the air for hundreds of years.
items.zh: 每次我們開汽油車,它都會釋放二氧化碳,而這種氣體會在空氣中停留數百年。
items.sec: Greenhouse Gases & Emissions 溫室氣體與排放

items.def: a strong greenhouse gas from farms, rubbish and gas fields
items.s: Cows produce a lot of ________ when they digest grass, so some farmers are testing new kinds of animal food.
items.zh: 牛在消化草時會產生大量甲烷,所以有些農夫正在測試新型的動物飼料。
items.sec: Greenhouse Gases & Emissions 溫室氣體與排放

items.def: coal, oil or gas formed from ancient plants and animals
items.s: Most power plants still burn ______ ______, but the share of clean energy is growing every year.
items.zh: 大多數發電廠仍在燃燒化石燃料,但潔淨能源的比例每年都在成長。
items.sec: Greenhouse Gases & Emissions 溫室氣體與排放

items.def: a hard black rock burned to make heat or electricity
items.s: The old power station burned ________ for forty years, but it will close next year and become a museum.
items.zh: 這座老舊發電廠燒煤燒了四十年,但它明年將關閉並改建為博物館。
items.sec: Greenhouse Gases & Emissions 溫室氣體與排放

items.def: oil from under the ground used to make fuel and plastic
items.s: Many everyday products are made from ________, so reducing plastic also helps to reduce our use of oil.
items.zh: 許多日常用品都是由石油製成的,所以減少塑膠也有助於減少我們對石油的使用。
items.sec: Greenhouse Gases & Emissions 溫室氣體與排放

items.def: waste gas that comes out of an engine
items.s: The ________ from the buses made the air near the station dirty, so the city switched to electric buses last year.
items.zh: 公車排出的廢氣讓車站附近的空氣很髒,所以市政府去年改用電動公車。
items.sec: Greenhouse Gases & Emissions 溫室氣體與排放

items.def: strong, unpleasant smoke or gas
items.s: The ________ from the factory smelled terrible, so local parents asked the company to clean its chimneys.
items.zh: 工廠排出的煙霧聞起來很可怕,所以當地家長要求公司清理煙囪。
items.sec: Greenhouse Gases & Emissions 溫室氣體與排放

items.def: dirty air that looks like fog over a city
items.s: Thick ________ covered the city for three days, so schools cancelled outdoor sports and many people wore masks.
items.zh: 濃厚的霧霾籠罩城市三天,所以學校取消了戶外運動,許多人也戴上口罩。
items.sec: Greenhouse Gases & Emissions 溫室氣體與排放

items.def: black powder made when something is burned
items.s: Black ________ from wildfires lands on snow and ice, and the dark surface then melts faster in the sun.
items.zh: 野火產生的黑色煙灰落在雪和冰上,而深色的表面在陽光下就會融化得更快。
items.sec: Greenhouse Gases & Emissions 溫室氣體與排放

items.def: the process of burning
items.s: Cars with ________ engines burn fuel to move, but electric cars use batteries and produce no smoke on the road.
items.zh: 使用燃燒式引擎的汽車靠燃燒燃料來行駛,但電動車使用電池,在路上不會產生廢氣。
items.sec: Greenhouse Gases & Emissions 溫室氣體與排放

items.def: to take in something such as liquid, heat or gas
items.s: The ocean can ________ a lot of heat, but warmer water then causes problems for fish and other sea life.
items.zh: 海洋能吸收大量的熱,但較暖的海水接著會為魚類和其他海洋生物帶來問題。
items.sec: Greenhouse Gases & Emissions 溫室氣體與排放

items.def: the process of taking something in
items.s: Dark roofs increase the ________ of heat, so painting them white can keep a building several degrees cooler.
items.zh: 深色屋頂會增加熱的吸收,所以把它們漆成白色可以讓建築物涼爽好幾度。
items.sec: Greenhouse Gases & Emissions 溫室氣體與排放

items.def: keeping heat in and not letting it escape
items.s: These ________ gases act like the glass of a car in summer, and the temperature inside keeps rising.
items.zh: 這些困住熱能的氣體就像夏天汽車的玻璃,而裡面的溫度會不斷上升。
items.sec: Greenhouse Gases & Emissions 溫室氣體與排放

items.def: a tall chimney on a factory
items.s: Grey smoke rose from the tall ________ all night, and the neighbours complained that their washing turned dirty.
items.zh: 灰色煙霧整夜從高高的煙囪冒出,鄰居抱怨他們晾的衣服都變髒了。
items.sec: Greenhouse Gases & Emissions 溫室氣體與排放

items.def: the pipe at the back of a car where exhaust comes out
items.s: Electric cars have no ________, but the electricity they use may still come from coal power stations.
items.zh: 電動車沒有排氣管,但它們使用的電力可能仍來自燃煤發電廠。
items.sec: Greenhouse Gases & Emissions 溫室氣體與排放

items.def: a place where rubbish is buried in the ground
items.s: Food waste in a ________ produces methane as it rots, so our town now collects kitchen scraps separately.
items.zh: 垃圾掩埋場裡的廚餘在腐爛時會產生甲烷,所以我們鎮上現在把廚餘分開收集。
items.sec: Greenhouse Gases & Emissions 溫室氣體與排放

items.def: a substance added to soil to help plants grow
items.s: Too much ________ washes into rivers when it rains, and it also releases a gas that warms the planet.
items.zh: 下雨時過多的肥料會被沖進河川,而且它也會釋放一種使地球變暖的氣體。
items.sec: Greenhouse Gases & Emissions 溫室氣體與排放

items.def: a factory where oil is made into fuel
items.s: The new ________ will create many jobs, but environmental groups worry about the extra pollution it will bring.
items.zh: 新的煉油廠將創造許多工作機會,但環保團體擔心它會帶來額外的污染。
items.sec: Greenhouse Gases & Emissions 溫室氣體與排放

items.def: to make air, water or land dirty
items.s: Factories that ________ the river must now pay large fines, so many of them have started to clean their waste water.
items.zh: 污染河川的工廠現在必須繳納高額罰款,所以其中許多已開始處理它們的廢水。
items.sec: Greenhouse Gases & Emissions 溫室氣體與排放

items.def: a forest, ocean or soil that takes in more carbon than it gives out
items.s: The mangrove forest is an important ______ ______, so the village protects it and plants new trees every spring.
items.zh: 紅樹林是一個重要的碳匯,所以村民保護它,並在每年春天種植新樹。
items.sec: Greenhouse Gases & Emissions 溫室氣體與排放

items.def: to reduce the carbon a country or company produces
items.s: The steel company promised to ________ its factories by 2050, but critics say the plan has no clear steps.
items.zh: 這家鋼鐵公司承諾在2050年前讓工廠去碳化,但批評者說這個計畫沒有明確的步驟。
items.sec: Greenhouse Gases & Emissions 溫室氣體與排放

items.def: tiny drops or bits floating in the air
items.s: Some ________ from volcanoes can cool the planet for a short time, but they do not solve the problem of global warming.
items.zh: 某些來自火山的懸浮微粒能讓地球短暫降溫,但它們無法解決全球暖化的問題。
items.sec: Greenhouse Gases & Emissions 溫室氣體與排放

items.def: to burn something completely, especially rubbish
items.s: Many cities ________ their rubbish to save space, but burning plastic releases carbon and other harmful gases.
items.zh: 許多城市焚化垃圾以節省空間,但燃燒塑膠會釋放碳和其他有害氣體。
items.sec: Greenhouse Gases & Emissions 溫室氣體與排放

items.def: having many factories and industries
items.s: ________ countries have produced most of the carbon in the past, so poorer nations say the rich should pay more for solutions.
items.zh: 工業化國家過去製造了大部分的碳,所以較貧窮的國家說富國應該為解決方案付出更多。
items.sec: Greenhouse Gases & Emissions 溫室氣體與排放

items.def: extremely hot and uncomfortable
items.s: It was a ________ afternoon at the bus stop, and an old man nearly fainted before the bus finally arrived.
items.zh: 公車站那天下午酷熱難耐,一位老先生在公車終於到站前差點昏倒。
items.sec: Extreme Weather & Natural Hazards 極端天氣與自然災害

items.def: a period of unusually hot weather
items.s: During the ________ last August, hospitals were full of elderly patients, so the city opened cool rooms in libraries.
items.zh: 去年八月的熱浪期間,醫院擠滿了年長的病人,所以市政府在圖書館開設了降溫室。
items.sec: Extreme Weather & Natural Hazards 極端天氣與自然災害

items.def: a violent tropical storm in the western Pacific
items.s: Schools were closed because a strong ________ was approaching, but my little brother was disappointed that it only rained a little.
items.zh: 因為一個強烈颱風正在接近,學校停課了,但我弟弟很失望因為只下了一點雨。
items.sec: Extreme Weather & Natural Hazards 極端天氣與自然災害

items.def: a violent tropical storm in the Atlantic
items.s: The ________ destroyed hundreds of homes in Florida, and many families had to live in hotels for months.
items.zh: 颶風摧毀了佛羅里達州數百棟房屋,許多家庭不得不在旅館住上好幾個月。
items.sec: Extreme Weather & Natural Hazards 極端天氣與自然災害

items.def: a violent storm with strong circular winds
items.s: A powerful ________ hit the coast of Bangladesh, but early warnings helped thousands of people reach safety in time.
items.zh: 一個強大的氣旋襲擊了孟加拉沿岸,但及早的警報幫助數千人及時抵達安全處。
items.sec: Extreme Weather & Natural Hazards 極端天氣與自然災害

items.def: a narrow, spinning column of wind that destroys things
items.s: The ________ lifted cars into the air, yet the family survived because they hid in the basement.
items.zh: 龍捲風把汽車捲到空中,但這家人因為躲在地下室而倖存。
items.sec: Extreme Weather & Natural Hazards 極端天氣與自然災害

items.def: a sudden rise of sea water pushed by a storm
items.s: The ______ ______ pushed seawater two metres into the streets, so many ground-floor shops were completely ruined.
items.zh: 風暴潮把海水推進街道達兩公尺高,所以許多一樓的店家完全被毀。
items.sec: Extreme Weather & Natural Hazards 極端天氣與自然災害

items.def: to cover an area with water
items.s: Heavy rain ________ the underground car park, and dozens of cars were stuck under the water until the next day.
items.zh: 大雨淹沒了地下停車場,數十輛汽車被困在水下直到隔天。
items.sec: Extreme Weather & Natural Hazards 極端天氣與自然災害

items.def: a sudden heavy fall of rain
items.s: We were caught in a sudden ________ on the way home, and our school bags were completely soaked.
items.zh: 我們在回家的路上遇到一場突如其來的傾盆大雨,書包全都濕透了。
items.sec: Extreme Weather & Natural Hazards 極端天氣與自然災害

items.def: used to describe very heavy rain
items.s: ________ rain fell for twelve hours, so the river rose quickly and the bridge had to be closed.
items.zh: 傾盆大雨下了十二個小時,所以河水迅速上漲,橋也不得不封閉。
items.sec: Extreme Weather & Natural Hazards 極端天氣與自然災害

items.def: a mass of earth and rocks falling down a hill
items.s: A ________ blocked the mountain road after the typhoon, and the villagers had no fresh food for a week.
items.zh: 颱風過後一場山崩堵住了山路,村民們一週都沒有新鮮的食物。
items.sec: Extreme Weather & Natural Hazards 極端天氣與自然災害

items.def: a flow of wet mud down a hill
items.s: The hillside had lost its trees, so the heavy rain caused a ________ that buried several houses.
items.zh: 山坡的樹木已經沒了,所以大雨引發了一場土石流,掩埋了好幾棟房子。
items.sec: Extreme Weather & Natural Hazards 極端天氣與自然災害

items.def: a large amount of snow falling down a mountain
items.s: Warmer winters make the snow less stable, so the risk of an ________ is higher for skiers in spring.
items.zh: 較暖的冬天讓積雪較不穩定,所以春季滑雪者遇到雪崩的風險更高。
items.sec: Extreme Weather & Natural Hazards 極端天氣與自然災害

items.def: a severe snowstorm with strong wind
items.s: The ________ closed the airport for two days, and thousands of travellers slept on the floor of the terminal.
items.zh: 暴風雪讓機場關閉了兩天,數千名旅客睡在航廈的地板上。
items.sec: Extreme Weather & Natural Hazards 極端天氣與自然災害

items.def: a storm in which balls of ice fall from the sky
items.s: A sudden ________ damaged the fruit on the trees, so the farmer lost almost half of his apples.
items.zh: 一場突如其來的冰雹打壞了樹上的果實,所以這位農夫損失了將近一半的蘋果。
items.sec: Extreme Weather & Natural Hazards 極端天氣與自然災害

items.def: a bright flash of electricity in the sky during a storm
items.s: ________ struck a tree near the playground, so the teacher told all the students to go inside at once.
items.zh: 閃電擊中了遊樂場附近的一棵樹,所以老師叫所有學生立刻進到室內。
items.sec: Extreme Weather & Natural Hazards 極端天氣與自然災害

items.def: a storm with thunder, lightning and heavy rain
items.s: Afternoon ________ are common in Taipei in summer, so I always keep an umbrella in my backpack.
items.zh: 夏天的台北常有午後雷雨,所以我總是在背包裡放一把傘。
items.sec: Extreme Weather & Natural Hazards 極端天氣與自然災害

items.def: a sudden strong rush of wind
items.s: A strong ________ of wind turned my umbrella inside out, and everyone at the bus stop started laughing.
items.zh: 一陣強風把我的傘吹得翻了過來,公車站的每個人都笑了起來。
items.sec: Extreme Weather & Natural Hazards 極端天氣與自然災害

items.def: to move people away from a dangerous place
items.s: Officials decided to ________ the coastal village before the storm arrived, but some old fishermen refused to leave.
items.zh: 官員決定在暴風雨來臨前撤離沿海村莊,但有些老漁夫拒絕離開。
items.sec: Extreme Weather & Natural Hazards 極端天氣與自然災害

items.def: the act of moving people to a safe place
items.s: The school practises an ________ plan twice a year, so every student knows which exit to use in an emergency.
items.zh: 學校每年演練兩次疏散計畫,所以每位學生都知道緊急時要走哪個出口。
items.sec: Extreme Weather & Natural Hazards 極端天氣與自然災害

items.def: a place that protects people from danger or bad weather
items.s: The town turned the sports centre into a ________, and volunteers gave out blankets and hot meals all night.
items.zh: 鎮上把運動中心改成避難所,志工們整晚發放毛毯和熱食。
items.sec: Extreme Weather & Natural Hazards 極端天氣與自然災害

items.def: a person who is hurt or killed in an accident or disaster
items.s: The storm was very strong, but there were few ________ because people had left the area in time.
items.zh: 暴風雨非常強烈,但由於人們及時離開了該地區,傷亡人數很少。
items.sec: Extreme Weather & Natural Hazards 極端天氣與自然災害

items.def: a sudden event that causes great damage
items.s: The flood was the worst ________ in the town's history, and it took three years to rebuild the main street.
items.zh: 這場洪水是鎮上有史以來最嚴重的災難,重建主要街道花了三年時間。
items.sec: Extreme Weather & Natural Hazards 極端天氣與自然災害

items.def: causing terrible damage
items.s: Scientists warn that warming of three degrees could have ________ effects, so they want governments to act now.
items.zh: 科學家警告升溫三度可能帶來災難性的影響,所以他們希望各國政府現在就採取行動。
items.sec: Extreme Weather & Natural Hazards 極端天氣與自然災害

items.def: to destroy or damage something very badly
items.s: The wildfire ________ the small mountain town, but the residents promised to rebuild it together.
items.zh: 野火摧毀了這座山中小鎮,但居民們承諾要一起重建它。
items.sec: Extreme Weather & Natural Hazards 極端天氣與自然災害

items.def: something that may be dangerous
items.s: Fallen power lines are a serious ________ after a typhoon, so children should never touch anything on the ground.
items.zh: 颱風過後倒下的電線是嚴重的危險,所以孩子們絕不應該碰觸地上的任何東西。
items.sec: Extreme Weather & Natural Hazards 極端天氣與自然災害

items.def: how often something happens
items.s: The ________ of strong typhoons has increased in recent years, and insurance companies have raised their prices.
items.zh: 近年來強烈颱風的頻率增加了,保險公司也提高了保費。
items.sec: Extreme Weather & Natural Hazards 極端天氣與自然災害

items.def: how serious or bad something is
items.s: Nobody expected the ________ of the flooding, so many families did not move their cars or furniture in time.
items.zh: 沒有人預料到淹水的嚴重程度,所以許多家庭沒有及時移走他們的車子或家具。
items.sec: Extreme Weather & Natural Hazards 極端天氣與自然災害

items.def: a dangerous illness caused by too much heat
items.s: Two runners suffered from ________ during the summer race, so the organisers moved the next event to early morning.
items.zh: 兩名跑者在夏季賽跑中中暑,所以主辦單位把下一場比賽改到清晨。
items.sec: Extreme Weather & Natural Hazards 極端天氣與自然災害

items.def: a period with no rain
items.s: After a long ______ ______, the farmers were happy to see rain, but the hard ground could not absorb it.
items.zh: 經過長時間的乾旱期,農夫們很高興看到下雨,但乾硬的土地無法吸收雨水。
items.sec: Extreme Weather & Natural Hazards 極端天氣與自然災害

items.def: a large mass of ice that moves slowly down a mountain
items.s: My grandparents visited the ________ forty years ago, and when we went there last summer it was much smaller.
items.zh: 我的祖父母四十年前造訪過那座冰河,而我們去年夏天去的時候它已經小了很多。
items.sec: Oceans, Ice & Rising Seas 海洋、冰層與海平面上升

items.def: a very large, thick layer of ice covering land
items.s: The ______ ______ in Greenland is losing billions of tonnes of ice each year, and this water raises the sea.
items.zh: 格陵蘭的冰原每年流失數十億噸的冰,而這些水會使海平面上升。
items.sec: Oceans, Ice & Rising Seas 海洋、冰層與海平面上升

items.def: a huge piece of ice floating in the sea
items.s: A giant ________ broke away from Antarctica last year, and it was bigger than the city of Taipei.
items.zh: 去年一座巨大的冰山從南極洲斷裂分離,它比台北市還要大。
items.sec: Oceans, Ice & Rising Seas 海洋、冰層與海平面上升

items.def: ground that stays frozen all year
items.s: As the ________ melts, roads and houses in northern Russia are sinking, and old gases escape into the air.
items.zh: 隨著永凍土融化,俄羅斯北部的道路和房屋正在下陷,古老的氣體也逸散到空氣中。
items.sec: Oceans, Ice & Rising Seas 海洋、冰層與海平面上升

items.def: to change from ice to water; to stop being frozen
items.s: The lake used to stay frozen until April, but now it starts to ________ in early March.
items.zh: 這座湖過去會一直結冰到四月,但現在三月初就開始解凍了。
items.sec: Oceans, Ice & Rising Seas 海洋、冰層與海平面上升

items.def: to change from solid to liquid because of heat
items.s: The snow on the mountain ________ earlier every year, so the river has less water in the dry summer months.
items.zh: 山上的雪每年都更早融化,所以河川在乾燥的夏季月份水量變少了。
items.sec: Oceans, Ice & Rising Seas 海洋、冰層與海平面上升

items.def: water from melting snow or ice
items.s: Villages in the Himalayas depend on ________ from glaciers, but this supply may disappear within a few decades.
items.zh: 喜馬拉雅山區的村莊依賴冰河的融水,但這項水源可能在幾十年內消失。
items.sec: Oceans, Ice & Rising Seas 海洋、冰層與海平面上升

items.def: the average height of the sea's surface
items.s: The ______ ______ around this island has risen by about twenty centimetres, and high tides now reach the main road.
items.zh: 這座島周圍的海平面上升了約二十公分,現在漲潮時海水已經到達主要道路。
items.sec: Oceans, Ice & Rising Seas 海洋、冰層與海平面上升

items.def: the land along the edge of the sea
items.s: Taiwan has a long and beautiful ________, but some beaches are disappearing because the sea is rising.
items.zh: 台灣擁有漫長而美麗的海岸線,但有些海灘正因海平面上升而消失。
items.sec: Oceans, Ice & Rising Seas 海洋、冰層與海平面上升

items.def: on or near the sea coast
items.s: Many ________ cities are building higher walls, because storms push seawater further inland than before.
items.zh: 許多沿海城市正在建造更高的牆,因為暴風雨把海水推得比以前更深入內陸。
items.sec: Oceans, Ice & Rising Seas 海洋、冰層與海平面上升

items.def: close to sea level
items.s: The family sold their house in a ________ area, because the street flooded every time there was a heavy storm.
items.zh: 這家人賣掉了他們位在地勢低窪地區的房子,因為每次大暴雨街道都會淹水。
items.sec: Oceans, Ice & Rising Seas 海洋、冰層與海平面上升

items.def: to go or put completely under water
items.s: Some Pacific islands may be ________ by the end of the century, so their governments are already planning for the future.
items.zh: 一些太平洋島嶼可能在本世紀末被淹沒,所以它們的政府已經在為未來做規劃。
items.sec: Oceans, Ice & Rising Seas 海洋、冰層與海平面上升

items.def: to flood an area with water
items.s: Seawater ________ the rice fields during the storm, and the salt made the soil useless for several years.
items.zh: 暴風雨期間海水淹沒了稻田,而鹽分讓土壤好幾年都無法使用。
items.sec: Oceans, Ice & Rising Seas 海洋、冰層與海平面上升

items.def: the regular rise and fall of the sea
items.s: When the ________ is high and it rains heavily, the drains cannot empty, so the streets of the old town flood.
items.zh: 當潮水很高又下大雨時,排水溝無法排空,所以老城區的街道就會淹水。
items.sec: Oceans, Ice & Rising Seas 海洋、冰層與海平面上升

items.def: connected with the rise and fall of the sea
items.s: The ________ flat near our town is full of crabs and birds, but rising water may cover it completely one day.
items.zh: 我們鎮附近的潮間灘地充滿了螃蟹和鳥類,但上升的海水有一天可能會把它完全淹沒。
items.sec: Oceans, Ice & Rising Seas 海洋、冰層與海平面上升

items.def: the process of becoming more acidic
items.s: Ocean ________ makes it harder for shellfish to build their shells, so oyster farmers are very worried.
items.zh: 海洋酸化讓貝類更難形成外殼,所以牡蠣養殖戶非常擔心。
items.sec: Oceans, Ice & Rising Seas 海洋、冰層與海平面上升

items.def: containing acid; sour
items.s: The sea is becoming more ________ because it absorbs carbon dioxide, and this change harms tiny sea creatures.
items.zh: 海洋因為吸收二氧化碳而變得更酸,這種變化傷害了微小的海洋生物。
items.sec: Oceans, Ice & Rising Seas 海洋、冰層與海平面上升

items.def: the loss of colour in coral when the water is too warm
items.s: Divers in Kenting saw serious coral ________ last summer, because the sea temperature stayed high for weeks.
items.zh: 去年夏天潛水員在墾丁看到嚴重的珊瑚白化,因為海水溫度連續好幾週居高不下。
items.sec: Oceans, Ice & Rising Seas 海洋、冰層與海平面上升

items.def: a steady flow of water in one direction
items.s: Ocean ________ carry warm water around the world, and if they slow down, the weather in Europe could change.
items.zh: 洋流把溫暖的海水帶到世界各地,如果它們減緩,歐洲的天氣可能會改變。
items.sec: Oceans, Ice & Rising Seas 海洋、冰層與海平面上升

items.def: the area around the North Pole
items.s: The ________ is warming almost four times faster than the rest of the world, so polar bears are losing their hunting grounds.
items.zh: 北極地區暖化的速度幾乎是世界其他地方的四倍,所以北極熊正在失去牠們的獵食場。
items.sec: Oceans, Ice & Rising Seas 海洋、冰層與海平面上升

items.def: connected with the area around the South Pole
items.s: Scientists live at ________ research stations for months, and they study the ice to learn about past climates.
items.zh: 科學家在南極研究站住上好幾個月,他們研究冰層以了解過去的氣候。
items.sec: Oceans, Ice & Rising Seas 海洋、冰層與海平面上升

items.def: a thick layer of ice covering a large area
items.s: The polar ______ ______ reflect sunlight back into space, but as they shrink, the dark sea absorbs more heat.
items.zh: 極地冰帽會把陽光反射回太空,但當它們縮小時,深色的海洋就會吸收更多熱。
items.sec: Oceans, Ice & Rising Seas 海洋、冰層與海平面上升

items.def: the amount of salt in water
items.s: Melting ice lowers the ________ of the ocean, and this can change the way water moves around the planet.
items.zh: 融化的冰會降低海洋的鹽度,而這可能改變海水在地球上流動的方式。
items.sec: Oceans, Ice & Rising Seas 海洋、冰層與海平面上升

items.def: frozen sea water floating on the ocean
items.s: Polar bears hunt seals on the ______ ______, but it now melts earlier in spring and forms later in autumn.
items.zh: 北極熊在海冰上獵捕海豹,但現在海冰春天融化得更早,秋天也更晚形成。
items.sec: Oceans, Ice & Rising Seas 海洋、冰層與海平面上升

items.def: the way water takes up more space when it gets warmer
items.s: Part of sea level rise comes from ______ ______, because warm water takes up more space than cold water.
items.zh: 海平面上升有一部分來自熱膨脹,因為溫暖的水比冷水占據更多空間。
items.sec: Oceans, Ice & Rising Seas 海洋、冰層與海平面上升

items.def: flat land where a river divides before entering the sea
items.s: Millions of people farm in the Mekong ________, but salty seawater is now reaching their rice fields.
items.zh: 數百萬人在湄公河三角洲務農,但鹹的海水現在已經流進他們的稻田。
items.sec: Oceans, Ice & Rising Seas 海洋、冰層與海平面上升

items.def: a serious lack of food in a large area
items.s: Years without rain led to ________ in parts of East Africa, so aid groups sent food and clean water.
items.zh: 多年不下雨導致東非部分地區發生饑荒,所以援助團體送去了食物和乾淨的水。
items.sec: Impacts on People & Nature 對人類與自然的影響

items.def: a situation in which there is not enough of something
items.s: Water ________ is a growing problem in many cities, and some families can only use tap water on certain days.
items.zh: 水資源短缺在許多城市是一個日益嚴重的問題,有些家庭只能在特定日子使用自來水。
items.sec: Impacts on People & Nature 對人類與自然的影響

items.def: when people need more water than is available
items.s: Regions under high ______ ______ must save every drop, so farmers there are switching to crops that need less water.
items.zh: 處於高度缺水壓力的地區必須節約每一滴水,所以那裡的農夫正改種需水量較少的作物。
items.sec: Impacts on People & Nature 對人類與自然的影響

items.def: when crops do not grow well enough to harvest
items.s: A ______ ______ can push food prices up quickly, and poor families then have to spend more on rice and vegetables.
items.zh: 作物歉收可能讓食物價格迅速上漲,而貧窮家庭就得花更多錢在米和蔬菜上。
items.sec: Impacts on People & Nature 對人類與自然的影響

items.def: the amount of crops a farm produces
items.s: The rice ________ fell sharply this year because of the heat, so the price of a bowl of rice went up.
items.zh: 由於高溫,今年稻米的產量大幅下降,所以一碗飯的價格上漲了。
items.sec: Impacts on People & Nature 對人類與自然的影響

items.def: caused by very hot weather
items.s: Doctors reported more ________ illnesses this summer, and most of the patients were outdoor workers or elderly people.
items.zh: 醫生回報今年夏天與高溫相關的疾病增加了,而大多數病人是戶外工作者或年長者。
items.sec: Impacts on People & Nature 對人類與自然的影響

items.def: a serious disease spread by mosquitoes
items.s: ________ used to be rare in the highlands of Kenya, but warmer weather now lets mosquitoes live there.
items.zh: 瘧疾過去在肯亞高地很少見,但較暖的天氣現在讓蚊子能在那裡生存。
items.sec: Impacts on People & Nature 對人類與自然的影響

items.def: a small flying insect that bites people
items.s: Every summer the city sprays areas where ________ breed, because they can spread dengue fever.
items.zh: 每年夏天市政府都會在蚊子繁殖的地方噴藥,因為牠們會傳播登革熱。
items.sec: Impacts on People & Nature 對人類與自然的影響

items.def: able to spread from one person to another
items.s: Floods can spread ________ diseases quickly, so health workers handed out clean water and medicine after the storm.
items.zh: 洪水可能讓傳染性疾病迅速擴散,所以暴風雨過後衛生人員發放了乾淨的水和藥品。
items.sec: Impacts on People & Nature 對人類與自然的影響

items.def: a person forced to leave their home or country
items.s: Some experts believe that climate ________ will increase in the future, because rising seas and droughts make places unsafe.
items.zh: 一些專家認為氣候難民未來會增加,因為上升的海平面和乾旱讓一些地方變得不安全。
items.sec: Impacts on People & Nature 對人類與自然的影響

items.def: the forced movement of people from their homes
items.s: The floods caused the ________ of thousands of families, and many of them still live in temporary camps.
items.zh: 這場洪水造成數千個家庭流離失所,其中許多人至今仍住在臨時營地。
items.sec: Impacts on People & Nature 對人類與自然的影響

items.def: a person who moves to another place to find work or safety
items.s: Many ________ left their dry farms and moved to the city, but finding a job there was not easy.
items.zh: 許多移民離開了他們乾旱的農地搬到城市,但在那裡找工作並不容易。
items.sec: Impacts on People & Nature 對人類與自然的影響

items.def: having no place to live
items.s: The typhoon left hundreds of people ________, so local temples opened their doors and offered free meals.
items.zh: 颱風讓數百人無家可歸,所以當地廟宇敞開大門並提供免費餐點。
items.sec: Impacts on People & Nature 對人類與自然的影響

items.def: buildings and land that someone owns
items.s: ________ near the beach used to be very valuable, but buyers are now worried about flooding and rising seas.
items.zh: 海灘附近的房地產過去非常值錢,但買家現在擔心淹水和海平面上升。
items.sec: Impacts on People & Nature 對人類與自然的影響

items.def: an agreement to pay money if something is damaged or lost
items.s: After three floods in five years, the company refused to sell ________ to homeowners in that area.
items.zh: 五年內發生三次水災之後,這家公司拒絕賣保險給那個地區的屋主。
items.sec: Impacts on People & Nature 對人類與自然的影響

items.def: the amount paid regularly for insurance
items.s: Our home insurance ________ doubled this year, because the company now sees our street as a high-risk area.
items.zh: 我們的房屋保險保費今年翻倍了,因為保險公司現在把我們這條街視為高風險地區。
items.sec: Impacts on People & Nature 對人類與自然的影響

items.def: physical harm that makes something less useful or valuable
items.s: The storm caused serious ________ to the school roof, so classes moved to the library for two weeks.
items.zh: 暴風雨對學校屋頂造成了嚴重的損害,所以上課地點移到圖書館兩週。
items.sec: Impacts on People & Nature 對人類與自然的影響

items.def: the state of being very poor
items.s: Climate change can push families into ________, because one bad harvest may take away a whole year's income.
items.zh: 氣候變遷可能把家庭推向貧窮,因為一次歉收就可能奪走一整年的收入。
items.sec: Impacts on People & Nature 對人類與自然的影響

items.def: having enough safe, healthy food to eat
items.s: Taiwan imports most of its wheat, so ______ ______ is an important topic when global harvests fail.
items.zh: 台灣大部分的小麥都靠進口,所以當全球收成不佳時,糧食安全是一個重要的議題。
items.sec: Impacts on People & Nature 對人類與自然的影響

items.def: weak or ill because of not eating enough healthy food
items.s: After two failed harvests, many children in the village were ________, so a charity started a free lunch programme.
items.zh: 連續兩次歉收後,村裡許多孩子營養不良,所以一個慈善團體開始了免費午餐計畫。
items.sec: Impacts on People & Nature 對人類與自然的影響

items.def: to become dry and weak and start to die
items.s: The vegetables in our garden began to ________ in the heat, so my mother watered them twice a day.
items.zh: 我們菜園裡的蔬菜在高溫中開始枯萎,所以我媽媽一天澆兩次水。
items.sec: Impacts on People & Nature 對人類與自然的影響

items.def: very dry because of no rain
items.s: The fields were brown and ________ after months without rain, and the cows had little grass to eat.
items.zh: 幾個月沒下雨後,田地變得又黃又乾裂,牛群幾乎沒有草可吃。
items.sec: Impacts on People & Nature 對人類與自然的影響

items.def: the process of land slowly becoming desert
items.s: ________ is spreading in northern China, so millions of trees have been planted to stop the sand.
items.zh: 沙漠化正在中國北方擴散,所以已經種了數百萬棵樹來阻擋沙子。
items.sec: Impacts on People & Nature 對人類與自然的影響

items.def: very simple plants that grow in water
items.s: Warm water caused ________ to grow quickly in the lake, and the fish died because there was not enough oxygen.
items.zh: 溫暖的水讓湖中的藻類迅速生長,魚群因為氧氣不足而死亡。
items.sec: Impacts on People & Nature 對人類與自然的影響

items.def: the area where a plant or animal lives
items.s: The ________ of this butterfly has moved two hundred kilometres north, because its old home has become too warm.
items.zh: 這種蝴蝶的分布範圍已經向北移動了兩百公里,因為牠原本的家變得太熱了。
items.sec: Impacts on People & Nature 對人類與自然的影響

items.def: a city area much warmer than the countryside around it
items.s: The city centre is a ______ ______ in summer, because concrete and cars trap heat even at night.
items.zh: 市中心在夏天是一個熱島,因為混凝土和汽車即使在夜間也會困住熱能。
items.sec: Impacts on People & Nature 對人類與自然的影響

items.def: a difficult situation, often without enough money or food
items.s: The drought brought great ________ to farming families, but neighbours shared water and food to help each other.
items.zh: 乾旱為務農家庭帶來極大的困境,但鄰居們分享水和食物互相幫助。
items.sec: Impacts on People & Nature 對人類與自然的影響

items.def: not safe or suitable for people to live in
items.s: Some scientists fear that parts of the Middle East could become ________ in summer, because the heat will be too extreme.
items.zh: 一些科學家擔心中東部分地區在夏天可能變得不適合居住,因為高溫將過於極端。
items.sec: Impacts on People & Nature 對人類與自然的影響

items.def: a change made to deal with new conditions
items.s: Climate ________ includes simple steps like planting trees for shade, so it is not only about expensive engineering.
items.zh: 氣候調適包括像種樹遮蔭這樣簡單的步驟,所以它不只是關於昂貴的工程。

items.def: able to recover quickly after something bad happens
items.cn: 有韌性的;能迅速復原的
items.s: The new hospital was designed to be ________, so it can keep running even if the power goes out during a storm.
items.zh: 新醫院被設計得很有韌性,所以即使暴風雨中停電也能持續運作。

items.def: a strong wall built to stop the sea from flooding land
items.s: The town built a taller ________ along the beach, but some people say it ruined the view of the ocean.
items.zh: 鎮上沿著海灘建了一道更高的海堤,但有些人說它破壞了海景。

items.def: a raised bank built beside a river to stop flooding
items.s: The ________ along the river held back the water, so the neighbourhood stayed dry during the heavy rain.
items.zh: 沿著河邊的河堤擋住了河水,所以這個社區在大雨期間保持乾燥。

items.def: a wall of earth or stone that holds back water
items.s: Volunteers filled sandbags to make the ________ higher, and they worked through the night before the river peaked.
items.zh: 志工們裝填沙包把堤防加高,他們在河水達到最高點前通宵工作。

items.def: a gate that controls the flow of water
items.s: Workers closed the ________ before the typhoon arrived, so the seawater could not flow into the canal.
items.zh: 工人在颱風來臨前關閉了水閘門,所以海水無法流進運河。

items.def: the system that carries away extra water
items.s: The old ________ system cannot handle today's heavy rain, so the city is digging wider pipes under the streets.
items.zh: 舊的排水系統無法應付現今的大雨,所以市政府正在街道下方挖設更寬的管線。

items.def: a large lake used to store water
items.s: The water in the ________ dropped to ten percent, so the government asked everyone to take shorter showers.
items.zh: 水庫的水位降到百分之十,所以政府要求大家縮短淋浴時間。

items.def: supplying water to land so crops can grow
items.s: Drip ________ gives water directly to plant roots, so farmers can grow food while using much less water.
items.zh: 滴水灌溉直接把水送到植物根部,所以農夫可以用少得多的水種出糧食。

items.def: to supply water to land through pipes or channels
items.s: The farmers ________ their fields at night now, because less water evaporates when the sun is down.
items.zh: 農夫們現在在夜間灌溉田地,因為太陽下山後蒸發的水較少。

items.def: able to grow well with little water
items.s: Scientists developed ________ rice, so farmers can still get a harvest when the rains come late.
items.zh: 科學家研發出耐旱稻米,所以即使雨水來得晚,農夫仍然可以有收成。

items.def: a system that tells people about danger before it arrives
items.s: The new ______ ______ ______ sends text messages before floods, so families have time to move to higher ground.
items.zh: 新的預警系統會在淹水前發送簡訊,讓家庭有時間移往地勢較高處。

items.def: to raise something to a higher position
items.s: Many families ________ their houses on concrete posts, so floodwater can pass underneath without entering the rooms.
items.zh: 許多家庭把房子架高在混凝土柱上,讓洪水可以從下方流過而不會進到房間。

items.def: tall posts that hold a building above the ground or water
items.s: The fishermen's houses stand on ________ above the water, so they stay safe when the tide is unusually high.
items.zh: 漁民的房子立在水面上的高腳柱上,所以即使潮水異常高漲也能保持安全。

items.def: water that has fallen as rain
items.s: Our school collects ________ from the roof in large tanks, and we use it to water the garden and flush toilets.
items.zh: 我們學校用大水塔收集屋頂的雨水,用來澆花和沖馬桶。

items.def: the process of removing salt from sea water
items.s: The island built a ________ plant because its wells were drying up, but the drinking water is now more expensive.
items.zh: 這座島建了一座海水淡化廠,因為島上的水井快要乾涸,但飲用水現在變得更貴了。

items.def: an area that is darker and cooler because the sun cannot reach it
items.s: The city planted trees along the bus stops, so passengers can wait in the ________ on hot afternoons.
items.zh: 市政府在公車站旁種了樹,讓乘客在炎熱的下午可以在陰涼處等車。

items.def: planting trees in an area where forests were cut down
items.s: The ________ project has planted a million trees, and the hills now hold rainwater instead of sliding down.
items.zh: 這項重新造林計畫已種下一百萬棵樹,現在山丘能留住雨水而不會崩塌。

items.def: to plant again
items.s: After the fire, students helped ________ young trees on the hill, and they return every year to check them.
items.zh: 火災之後,學生們幫忙在山坡上補種小樹,而且他們每年都會回去查看。

items.def: a roof covered with plants
items.s: Our library has a ______ ______ full of plants, so the building stays cooler and absorbs heavy rain.
items.zh: 我們的圖書館有一座長滿植物的綠屋頂,所以建築物保持較涼爽,也能吸收大雨。

items.def: the movement of fresh air through a room or building
items.s: Good ________ keeps classrooms cooler without air-conditioning, so the new school has large windows on both sides.
items.zh: 良好的通風能讓教室在不開冷氣的情況下保持涼爽,所以新學校兩側都有大窗戶。

items.def: a system that keeps the air in a building cool
items.s: Many families cannot afford ________, so heatwaves are especially dangerous for poor and elderly people.
items.zh: 許多家庭負擔不起冷氣,所以熱浪對貧窮和年長者特別危險。

items.def: a public place where people can escape extreme heat
items.s: The library became a ______ ______ during the heatwave, and older residents spent the afternoon there reading newspapers.
items.zh: 熱浪期間圖書館成了避暑中心,年長居民在那裡看報紙度過下午。

items.def: the state of being ready for an emergency
items.s: Disaster ________ starts at home, so every family should have a bag with water, a torch and medicine.
items.zh: 災害防備從家裡開始,所以每個家庭都應該準備一個裝有水、手電筒和藥品的包包。

items.def: a plan for what to do if something goes wrong
items.s: The festival organisers had a ______ ______ for bad weather, so the concert moved indoors when the storm came.
items.zh: 活動主辦單位有針對惡劣天氣的應變計畫,所以暴風雨來時音樂會就移到室內舉行。

items.def: to add new parts to an old building or machine
items.s: The city will ________ old apartment buildings with better insulation, so residents can stay cool and pay less for electricity.
items.zh: 市政府將為老舊公寓大樓加裝更好的隔熱設備,讓居民可以保持涼爽並少付電費。

items.def: likely to flood
items.s: New homes should not be built in ________ areas, but land there is cheap, so developers keep building.
items.zh: 新房子不應該蓋在易淹水的地區,但那裡的土地便宜,所以開發商一直在蓋。

items.def: rules about how land in an area may be used
items.s: The new ________ rules stop building near the river, and the land will become a park that can safely flood.
items.zh: 新的土地分區規定禁止在河邊建房,這塊地將變成一座可以安全淹水的公園。

items.def: a planned move of people away from dangerous coastal areas
items.s: The village chose ______ ______ instead of building a huge wall, so the families moved inland with government help.
items.zh: 這個村莊選擇了有計畫的撤退,而不是建造巨大的牆,所以這些家庭在政府協助下遷往內陸。

items.def: to collect and store a large supply of something
items.s: Before the typhoon season, the town ________ rice, water and medicine, so nobody went hungry when the roads closed.
items.zh: 颱風季前,鎮上儲備了米、水和藥品,所以道路封閉時沒有人挨餓。

items.def: actions that reduce how bad something is
items.s: Climate ________ means cutting emissions, while adaptation means preparing for the changes that are already coming.
items.zh: 氣候減緩指的是減少排放,而調適則是為已經到來的變化做準備。
items.sec: Mitigation, Energy & Climate Policy 減緩、能源與氣候政策

items.def: able to be replaced naturally, like sun and wind
items.s: Taiwan wants more ________ energy, so wind farms are being built off the west coast.
items.zh: 台灣希望有更多可再生能源,所以正在西部外海興建風場。
items.sec: Mitigation, Energy & Climate Policy 減緩、能源與氣候政策

items.def: a tall machine that uses wind to make electricity
items.s: Each ______ ______ off the coast can power thousands of homes, but fishermen worry about losing their fishing areas.
items.zh: 外海的每一座風力發電機都能供應數千戶家庭用電,但漁民擔心失去他們的漁場。
items.sec: Mitigation, Energy & Climate Policy 減緩、能源與氣候政策

items.def: a flat device that turns sunlight into electricity
items.s: My uncle put ______ ______ on his roof, and now his electricity bill is almost zero in summer.
items.zh: 我叔叔在他家屋頂裝了太陽能板,現在他夏天的電費幾乎是零。
items.sec: Mitigation, Energy & Climate Policy 減緩、能源與氣候政策

items.def: electricity made from moving water
items.s: ________ provides clean electricity, but dams can also flood valleys and change the life of a river.
items.zh: 水力發電提供潔淨的電力,但水壩也可能淹沒山谷並改變河流的生態。
items.sec: Mitigation, Energy & Climate Policy 減緩、能源與氣候政策

items.def: using heat from inside the Earth
items.s: Iceland uses ________ energy to heat most of its homes, because hot water lies just under the ground.
items.zh: 冰島使用地熱能源為大部分的住家供暖,因為熱水就在地底下不遠處。
items.sec: Mitigation, Energy & Climate Policy 減緩、能源與氣候政策

items.def: fuel made from plants or animal waste
items.s: Some airlines are testing ________ made from used cooking oil, but there is not enough of it for every plane.
items.zh: 一些航空公司正在測試用廢食用油製成的生質燃料,但數量還不夠供應每架飛機。
items.sec: Mitigation, Energy & Climate Policy 減緩、能源與氣候政策

items.def: a car or scooter that runs on a battery
items.s: My father bought an ______ ______ last year, and he charges it at home every night after work.
items.zh: 我爸爸去年買了一輛電動車,他每天下班後晚上都在家充電。
items.sec: Mitigation, Energy & Climate Policy 減緩、能源與氣候政策

items.def: a device that stores electricity
items.s: Large ________ can store solar power during the day, so homes can still use clean energy at night.
items.zh: 大型電池可以在白天儲存太陽能,讓家庭在夜間仍然能使用潔淨能源。
items.sec: Mitigation, Energy & Climate Policy 減緩、能源與氣候政策

items.def: the network of power lines that delivers electricity
items.s: The power ________ could not handle the demand during the heatwave, so some areas had blackouts in the evening.
items.zh: 熱浪期間電網無法負荷用電需求,所以有些地區在傍晚停電。
items.sec: Mitigation, Energy & Climate Policy 減緩、能源與氣候政策

items.def: material that stops heat from getting in or out
items.s: Good roof ________ keeps the top floor cooler in summer, so the family uses the air-conditioner much less.
items.zh: 良好的屋頂隔熱能讓頂樓在夏天保持涼爽,所以這家人使用冷氣的次數大幅減少。
items.sec: Mitigation, Energy & Climate Policy 減緩、能源與氣候政策

items.def: using less energy to do the same job
items.s: We replaced our old fridge with an ________ model, and our monthly electricity bill dropped quite a lot.
items.zh: 我們把舊冰箱換成節能型號,每月的電費也下降了不少。
items.sec: Mitigation, Energy & Climate Policy 減緩、能源與氣候政策

items.def: to treat used things so they can be used again
items.s: Our class tries to ________ every bottle and can, and we use the money from the recycling centre for a class trip.
items.zh: 我們班盡量回收每一個瓶子和罐子,並用從回收中心換來的錢去校外旅行。
items.sec: Mitigation, Energy & Climate Policy 減緩、能源與氣候政策

items.def: a charge on fuels that produce carbon
items.s: The government introduced a ______ ______ on big factories, so many companies started to look for cleaner ways to work.
items.zh: 政府對大型工廠開徵碳稅,所以許多公司開始尋找更乾淨的運作方式。
items.sec: Mitigation, Energy & Climate Policy 減緩、能源與氣候政策

items.def: a serious promise
items.s: Many countries made a ________ to reach net zero, but their actions so far are not enough to meet it.
items.zh: 許多國家做出了達到淨零的承諾,但它們到目前為止的行動還不足以實現它。
items.sec: Mitigation, Energy & Climate Policy 減緩、能源與氣候政策

items.def: an important meeting between leaders
items.s: World leaders met at the climate ________ in November, but they could not agree on how much money to give poorer nations.
items.zh: 世界領袖們在十一月的氣候高峰會上會面,但他們無法就該給較貧窮國家多少資金達成共識。
items.sec: Mitigation, Energy & Climate Policy 減緩、能源與氣候政策

items.def: a person sent to a meeting to represent others
items.s: The young ________ from a Pacific island gave an emotional speech, and many people in the room started crying.
items.zh: 來自一座太平洋島嶼的年輕代表發表了一場動人的演說,會場上許多人都哭了。
items.sec: Mitigation, Energy & Climate Policy 減緩、能源與氣候政策

items.def: an official agreement between countries
items.s: The Paris ________ was signed by almost every country, but each nation decides its own plan to cut emissions.
items.zh: 《巴黎協定》幾乎每個國家都簽署了,但每個國家自行決定減排計畫。
items.sec: Mitigation, Energy & Climate Policy 減緩、能源與氣候政策

items.def: a promise to do something
items.s: The company made a ________ to use only green electricity, so it signed a long contract with a wind farm.
items.zh: 這家公司承諾只使用綠電,所以它與一座風場簽訂了長期合約。
items.sec: Mitigation, Energy & Climate Policy 減緩、能源與氣候政策

items.def: to make an agreement official by signing or voting
items.s: Parliament voted to ________ the climate agreement, and the new law will start next January.
items.zh: 國會投票正式批准這項氣候協議,新法將於明年一月開始實施。
items.sec: Mitigation, Energy & Climate Policy 減緩、能源與氣候政策

items.def: adding no extra carbon to the atmosphere overall
items.s: Our school wants to become ________ by 2030, so we are planting trees and putting solar panels on the gym.
items.zh: 我們學校希望在2030年前達到碳中和,所以我們正在種樹並在體育館上裝設太陽能板。
items.sec: Mitigation, Energy & Climate Policy 減緩、能源與氣候政策

items.def: using energy from splitting atoms
items.s: ________ power produces very little carbon, but many people worry about accidents and how to store the waste.
items.zh: 核能發電產生的碳非常少,但許多人擔心意外事故以及如何貯存廢料。
items.sec: Mitigation, Energy & Climate Policy 減緩、能源與氣候政策

items.def: a person who works to bring political or social change
items.s: The young climate ________ spoke at the United Nations, and her speech inspired students in many countries.
items.zh: 這位年輕的氣候行動者在聯合國發表演說,她的演講激勵了許多國家的學生。
items.sec: Mitigation, Energy & Climate Policy 減緩、能源與氣候政策

items.def: a public event where people show they disagree
items.s: Thousands of students joined the climate ________ on Friday, and they carried signs asking leaders to act now.
items.zh: 數千名學生參加了星期五的氣候抗議活動,他們舉著標語要求領袖們立即行動。
items.sec: Mitigation, Energy & Climate Policy 減緩、能源與氣候政策

items.def: making a product seem better for nature than it really is
items.s: The ad showed trees and rivers, but the company still burned coal, so critics called it ________.
items.zh: 這則廣告展示了樹木和河流,但這家公司仍在燒煤,所以批評者稱之為漂綠。
items.sec: Mitigation, Energy & Climate Policy 減緩、能源與氣候政策

items.def: technology that catches carbon dioxide and stores it
items.s: The power plant is testing ______ ______ to trap its emissions, but the technology is still very expensive.
items.zh: 這座發電廠正在測試碳捕捉以收集其排放,但這項技術仍然非常昂貴。
items.sec: Mitigation, Energy & Climate Policy 減緩、能源與氣候政策

items.def: buses and trains that everyone can use
items.s: If more people took ______ ______ instead of driving, the city would have less traffic and cleaner air.
items.zh: 如果更多人搭乘大眾運輸而不開車,城市就會有更少的車流和更乾淨的空氣。
items.sec: Mitigation, Energy & Climate Policy 減緩、能源與氣候政策

items.def: to turn food and garden waste into natural fertiliser
items.s: Our family started to ________ vegetable scraps in the garden, and now we throw away much less rubbish.
items.zh: 我們家開始在花園裡把菜渣拿來堆肥,現在我們丟的垃圾少多了。
items.sec: Mitigation, Energy & Climate Policy 減緩、能源與氣候政策

items.def: never happened before
items.s: The summer of 2023 brought ________ heat to many countries, and records that had stood for decades were broken.
