items.zh: 2023年夏天為許多國家帶來前所未有的高溫,保持了數十年的紀錄紛紛被打破。

items.def: very great or serious
items.s: Rising seas will have a ________ effect on island nations, so their leaders are asking the world for urgent help.
items.zh: 海平面上升將對島國造成深遠的影響,所以它們的領袖正在向世界請求緊急協助。

items.def: very important for what happens next
items.s: The next ten years will be ________ for the climate, because decisions made now will affect the planet for centuries.
items.zh: 未來十年對氣候將是關鍵的,因為現在所做的決定將影響地球好幾個世紀。

items.def: to control or limit something bad
items.s: The new rules aim to ________ air pollution from factories, but some owners say the changes are too expensive.
items.zh: 新規定的目的是抑制工廠的空氣污染,但有些業主說這些改變太昂貴了。

items.def: to deal with a difficult problem
items.s: No single country can ________ climate change alone, so nations must share their technology, ideas and money.
items.zh: 沒有任何單一國家能獨自應對氣候變遷,所以各國必須分享它們的技術、想法和資金。

items.def: to try to stop something harmful
items.s: The city planted thousands of street trees to ________ rising temperatures, and some streets are now two degrees cooler.
items.zh: 市政府種了數千棵行道樹來對抗上升的氣溫,有些街道現在涼了兩度。

items.def: to help something develop
items.s: The teacher wants to ________ a love of nature in her students, so she takes the class to the wetlands every month.
items.zh: 這位老師想培養學生對大自然的熱愛,所以她每個月都帶全班去濕地。

items.def: to make something stronger
items.s: The government will ________ the river banks with stone, because last year's flood almost broke through.
items.zh: 政府將用石頭加強河岸,因為去年的洪水差點沖破堤防。

items.def: to make it difficult for something to happen
items.s: Heavy rain ________ the rescue work, but the teams kept searching for missing people all night.
items.zh: 大雨阻礙了救援工作,但救難隊仍整夜持續搜尋失蹤者。

items.def: to slow down or block progress
items.s: Fallen trees ________ traffic on the main road, so ambulances had to take a much longer route.
items.zh: 倒下的樹木妨礙了主要道路的交通,所以救護車不得不繞一條更遠的路。

items.def: to put something in danger
items.s: Warmer seas could ________ the fishing industry, and many coastal families would lose their main income.
items.zh: 較暖的海水可能危及漁業,許多沿海家庭將失去他們主要的收入。

items.def: an agreement where each side gives up something
items.s: The two groups reached a ________ after long talks, so the wind farm will be built further from the fishing area.
items.zh: 兩個團體在長時間協商後達成妥協,所以風場將建在離漁場更遠的地方。

items.def: to become more serious or bigger
items.s: The water dispute between the two farms began to ________, so the village leader invited them to a meeting.
items.zh: 兩座農場之間的用水糾紛開始加劇,所以村長邀請他們來開會。

items.def: a sudden large increase
items.s: There was a ________ in electricity use during the heatwave, and the power company asked people to save energy.
items.zh: 熱浪期間用電量激增,電力公司要求民眾節約能源。

items.def: to fall suddenly and by a large amount
items.s: Fish numbers ________ after the water became too warm, so the fishermen had to stay in port for weeks.
items.zh: 海水變得太暖之後魚群數量驟降,所以漁民不得不在港口停留好幾週。

items.def: to rise very quickly to a high level
items.s: Vegetable prices ________ after the typhoon damaged the farms, so my mother bought frozen vegetables instead.
items.zh: 颱風損壞農田後菜價飆升,所以我媽媽改買冷凍蔬菜。

items.def: to increase quickly in number
items.s: Electric scooters have ________ in Taipei, and charging stations now appear on almost every street.
items.zh: 電動機車在台北迅速增加,現在幾乎每條街上都有充電站。

items.def: to make something stronger or more serious
items.s: Climate change can ________ natural dangers, so a normal storm may now cause much more damage.
items.zh: 氣候變遷可能放大自然災害的危險,所以一場普通的暴風雨現在可能造成更多損害。

items.def: to make something seem or become bigger
items.s: Poor building rules ________ the damage from earthquakes and floods, so experts want stricter checks.
items.zh: 不良的建築規範擴大了地震和洪水造成的損害,所以專家希望實施更嚴格的檢查。

items.def: the path or direction of development
items.s: On the current ________, the world will warm by almost three degrees, but faster action could change this path.
items.zh: 照目前的發展趨勢,世界將升溫將近三度,但更快的行動可以改變這條路徑。

items.def: the level at which something starts to happen
items.s: Once the temperature passes a certain ________, coral begins to die, and recovery can take many years.
items.zh: 一旦溫度超過某個臨界點,珊瑚就開始死亡,而復原可能需要許多年。

items.def: a starting point used for comparison
items.s: The scientists used 1990 as the ________, so every later measurement could be compared with that year.
items.zh: 科學家們以1990年作為基準線,讓之後的每個測量值都可以與那一年比較。

items.def: an estimate of what will happen in the future
items.s: The latest ________ shows that sea levels could rise by one metre, but this depends on how fast ice melts.
items.zh: 最新的推估顯示海平面可能上升一公尺,但這取決於冰融化的速度。

items.def: a factor that can change
items.s: Rainfall is an important ________ in the study, because it affects both crop growth and river levels.
items.zh: 降雨量是這項研究中的一個重要變數,因為它同時影響作物生長和河川水位。

items.def: to have a close connection
items.s: Hospital visits ________ closely with hot days, so doctors prepare extra beds when a heatwave is forecast.
items.zh: 醫院就診人數與炎熱天數密切相關,所以每當預報熱浪,醫生就會準備額外病床。

items.def: a difference between things that should match
items.s: There was a ________ between the two temperature records, so the team checked the instruments again.
items.zh: 兩份溫度紀錄之間有出入,所以團隊再次檢查了儀器。

items.def: always in the same way
items.s: The island has ________ recorded higher temperatures since 2000, and this pattern worries local farmers.
items.zh: 這座島自2000年以來始終記錄到較高的氣溫,這個模式讓當地農民很擔心。

items.def: especially; in a way that is worth noticing
items.s: Many countries have cut emissions, ________ the UK, which has closed almost all of its coal power plants.
items.zh: 許多國家已經減少排放,尤其是英國,它已經關閉了幾乎所有的燃煤發電廠。

items.def: mainly; mostly
items.s: The region is ________ agricultural, so long dry seasons hurt almost every family's income there.
items.zh: 這個地區主要以農業為主,所以漫長的乾季幾乎影響當地每個家庭的收入。

items.def: by a large amount
items.s: The cost of solar panels has fallen ________ in ten years, so more families can now afford them.
items.zh: 太陽能板的成本在十年內大幅下降,所以現在更多家庭負擔得起。

items.def: very small and not important
items.s: Changing light bulbs makes only a ________ difference, but bigger changes like better buses can help a lot.
items.zh: 換燈泡只帶來微小的差異,但像改善公車這樣較大的改變可以幫助很多。

items.def: so small that it is not important
items.s: The extra cost of the green design was ________, and the building saves a lot of money on energy every year.
items.zh: 綠色設計的額外成本微不足道,而這棟建築每年在能源上節省很多錢。

items.def: extreme and having a strong effect
items.s: Scientists say we need ________ cuts in emissions, because small changes will not stop dangerous warming.
items.zh: 科學家說我們需要大幅削減排放,因為小小的改變無法阻止危險的暖化。

items.def: very serious or bad
items.s: The farm suffered ________ damage in the storm, but the family received help from neighbours and the government.
items.zh: 這座農場在暴風雨中受到嚴重的損害,但這家人得到鄰居和政府的幫助。

items.def: going to happen very soon
items.cn: 即將發生的;迫在眉睫的
items.s: The warning said a flood was ________, so families quickly moved their belongings to the second floor.
items.zh: 警報說洪水即將發生,所以家家戶戶趕緊把財物搬到二樓。

items.def: possible and practical to do
items.s: Building a wall around the whole island is not ________, so the government is looking for cheaper ideas.
items.zh: 在整座島周圍築牆並不可行,所以政府正在尋找較便宜的辦法。

items.def: able to work successfully
items.s: Electric buses are now a ________ choice for small towns, because batteries have become cheaper and last longer.
items.zh: 電動公車現在對小鎮來說是可行的選擇,因為電池變得更便宜也更耐用。

items.def: dealing with problems in a practical way
items.s: The mayor took a ________ approach to flooding, and she fixed the drains before planning any big projects.
items.zh: 市長以務實的方式處理淹水問題,在規劃任何大型工程之前先修好了排水溝。

items.def: needing a lot of effort to achieve
items.s: The country set an ________ goal of zero emissions by 2040, but it has not explained how it will pay for it.
items.zh: 這個國家訂下2040年零排放的遠大目標,但它還沒有說明要如何支付費用。

items.def: very strict
items.s: The European Union has ________ rules on car emissions, so companies must build cleaner engines to sell there.
items.zh: 歐盟對汽車排放有嚴格的規定,所以公司必須製造更乾淨的引擎才能在那裡銷售。

items.def: not strict enough
items.s: Critics say the punishment for illegal dumping is too ________, so some companies simply pay the fine and continue.
items.zh: 批評者說非法傾倒的處罰太寬鬆,所以有些公司只是繳罰款然後繼續做。

items.def: including everything that is needed
items.s: The city published a ________ plan for heatwaves, and it covers schools, hospitals, buses and parks.
items.zh: 市政府發布了一份全面的熱浪應對計畫,內容涵蓋學校、醫院、公車和公園。

items.def: looking at the whole situation, not just parts
items.s: Experts call for a ________ approach to water, so cities should think about rain, rivers and drinking water together.
items.zh: 專家呼籲對水資源採取整體的方法,所以城市應該把雨水、河川和飲用水放在一起考慮。

items.def: fair to everyone
items.s: The climate fund must be ________, because the poorest countries suffer the most but caused the least pollution.
items.zh: 氣候基金必須是公平的,因為最貧窮的國家受害最深,卻造成最少的污染。

items.def: too large or too small compared with something else
items.s: Heatwaves have a ________ effect on old people, so nurses visit those who live alone during hot weather.
items.zh: 熱浪對老年人造成不成比例的影響,所以天氣炎熱時護理師會去探訪獨居者。

items.def: easily broken or damaged
items.s: Mountain ecosystems are very ________, and even a small rise in temperature can change which plants survive there.
items.zh: 山區生態系非常脆弱,即使氣溫小幅上升也可能改變哪些植物能在那裡存活。

items.def: to treat something as more important than other things
items.s: The town decided to ________ flood defences, so the new sports stadium will have to wait a few years.
items.zh: 鎮上決定優先處理防洪設施,所以新的運動場得等上幾年。

items.def: to organise people or resources for action
items.s: The school managed to ________ two hundred volunteers, and they cleaned the beach in just one morning.
items.zh: 學校成功動員了兩百名志工,他們只花一個早上就清乾淨了海灘。

items.def: to try to influence politicians
items.s: Oil companies ________ the government for years, so laws to cut emissions were delayed again and again.
items.zh: 石油公司多年來一直遊說政府,所以減排法律一再被延遲。

items.def: to publicly support something
items.s: Several famous athletes ________ the tree-planting campaign, and thousands of young fans signed up to help.
items.zh: 幾位知名運動員公開支持植樹活動,數千名年輕粉絲報名參加。

items.def: to disagree with and try to stop something
items.s: Local residents ________ the new airport, because it would destroy farmland and increase air pollution.
items.zh: 當地居民反對興建新機場,因為它會破壞農地並增加空氣污染。

items.def: to find a way for two different ideas to exist together
items.s: It is hard to ________ economic growth with lower emissions, but some countries have managed to do both.
items.zh: 要調和經濟成長與降低排放很困難,但有些國家已經成功做到兩者兼顧。

items.def: something you agree to give up in a discussion
items.s: Rich countries made a ________ on climate funding, so the talks finally ended with an agreement.
items.zh: 富國在氣候資金上做出讓步,所以談判最終以達成協議收場。

items.def: an official charge or tax
items.s: The airport introduced a small ________ on every flight, and the money is used to plant forests.
items.zh: 機場對每個航班徵收一筆小額稅款,這筆錢被用來種植森林。

items.def: to put something into use or action
items.s: The government will ________ more soldiers and boats to the coast, because a strong typhoon is on its way.
items.zh: 政府將在沿海部署更多士兵和船隻,因為一個強烈颱風正在逼近。

items.def: to put money into something to get a benefit later
items.s: The city decided to ________ in bike lanes, and now many students ride to school instead of taking the bus.
items.zh: 市政府決定投資興建自行車道,現在許多學生改騎單車上學而不搭公車。

items.def: the amount of money spent
items.s: Government ________ on disaster recovery has doubled, so less money is left for schools and hospitals.
items.zh: 政府在災後復原上的支出已經翻倍,所以留給學校和醫院的錢變少了。

items.def: cheap enough for most people to buy
items.s: Electric scooters are now more ________, so many young workers have changed from petrol models.
items.zh: 電動機車現在更負擔得起,所以許多年輕上班族已經從汽油車款換過去了。

items.def: giving good results for the money spent
items.s: Planting mangroves is a ________ way to protect the coast, and it also creates homes for fish and birds.
items.zh: 種植紅樹林是保護海岸符合成本效益的方法,同時也為魚類和鳥類創造棲息地。

items.def: temporary, until something permanent is ready
items.s: The families moved into ________ housing after the flood, but they hope to return home before New Year.
items.zh: 這些家庭在水災後搬進了臨時住所,但他們希望在新年前能回家。

items.def: happening while changing from one state to another
items.s: Natural gas is often called a ________ fuel, because it is cleaner than coal but still not truly clean.
items.zh: 天然氣常被稱為過渡燃料,因為它比煤乾淨,但仍不是真正的潔淨能源。

items.def: something you must do because of a law or promise
items.s: Rich nations have an ________ to help poorer ones, because they produced most of the carbon in the past.
items.zh: 富國有義務幫助較貧窮的國家,因為它們過去製造了大部分的碳。

items.def: an official order to do something
items.s: The new ________ requires all new buildings to have solar panels, so builders are changing their designs.
items.zh: 新的規定要求所有新建築都必須裝設太陽能板,所以建商正在修改設計。

items.def: that must be obeyed by law
items.s: The agreement is not legally ________, so countries cannot be punished if they miss their targets.
items.zh: 這份協議在法律上不具約束力,所以各國即使未達目標也不會受到處罰。

items.def: to make a law
items.s: The government plans to ________ a new climate law this year, and it will set limits for every industry.
items.zh: 政府計畫今年制定一部新的氣候法,而它將為每個產業設定上限。

items.def: strong disagreement with an official opinion
items.s: There was some ________ among the scientists, but most of them agreed that the data showed clear warming.
items.zh: 科學家之間有一些異議,但他們大多數人都同意數據顯示出明顯的暖化。

items.def: refusing to accept that something is true
items.s: Climate ________ is less common today, because people can see the effects of extreme weather with their own eyes.
items.zh: 氣候否定論如今較不常見,因為人們能親眼看見極端天氣的影響。

items.def: able to be believed or trusted
items.s: Students should use ________ sources for their climate projects, so they should check who wrote each website.
items.zh: 學生的氣候專題應該使用可信的資料來源,所以他們應該查看每個網站是誰寫的。

items.def: very careful and thorough
items.s: The study used ________ methods, and other scientists were able to repeat it and get the same results.
items.zh: 這項研究使用了嚴謹的方法,其他科學家也能重複實驗並得到相同結果。

items.def: strong and unlikely to fail
items.s: The city needs a ________ water system, so it will not fail during the next long drought.
items.zh: 這座城市需要一個穩固的供水系統,這樣在下一次長期乾旱時才不會失靈。

items.def: checked by other experts before being published
items.s: The report was based on ________ research, so the government took its warnings very seriously.
items.zh: 這份報告是以經同儕審查的研究為基礎,所以政府非常認真看待其中的警告。

items.def: agreed by everyone
items.s: The vote was ________, and every member of the student council supported the plan to ban plastic bottles.
items.zh: 這次投票是全體一致同意,學生會的每位成員都支持禁用塑膠瓶的計畫。

items.def: likely to cause disagreement
items.s: Building a dam in the valley is a ________ issue, because it brings clean power but floods people's homes.
items.zh: 在山谷中興建水壩是一個有爭議的議題,因為它帶來潔淨電力卻也淹沒了人們的家園。

items.def: needing to be dealt with now
items.s: Clean water is the most ________ problem after the flood, so the army is bringing in large water tanks.
items.zh: 乾淨的水是水災過後最迫切的問題,所以軍隊正在運來大型水箱。

items.def: the need to act quickly
items.s: Young people speak about climate change with real ________, because they will live with the results for the longest time.
items.zh: 年輕人談論氣候變遷時帶著真切的急迫感,因為他們將承受後果最久。

items.def: done by a group of people together
items.s: Climate change needs ________ action, so even small efforts by millions of people can make a difference.
items.zh: 氣候變遷需要集體行動,所以即使是數百萬人的小小努力也能帶來改變。

items.def: fairness and equal treatment
items.s: ________ is an important part of climate policy, because poor families should not pay the highest price for change.
items.zh: 公平是氣候政策的重要部分,因為貧窮家庭不應該為改變付出最高的代價。

items.def: fair treatment for everyone
items.s: Activists call for climate ________, because the people least responsible for emissions often suffer the most.
items.zh: 行動者呼籲氣候正義,因為對排放責任最小的人往往受害最深。

items.def: a heavy duty or problem that someone must deal with
items.s: The cost of rebuilding after floods is a heavy ________ for small towns, so they need support from the central government.
items.zh: 水災後重建的費用對小鎮來說是沉重的負擔,所以它們需要中央政府的支援。

items.def: legal responsibility for something
items.s: The court decided the company had ________ for the oil spill, so it must pay to clean the beaches.
items.zh: 法院判決這家公司對漏油事件負有法律責任,所以它必須出錢清理海灘。

items.def: increasing by adding one thing after another
items.s: The ________ effect of small changes is large, so turning off lights every day really does save energy over time.
items.zh: 小小改變的累積效果很大,所以每天隨手關燈長期下來確實能節省能源。

items.def: happening in small steps
items.s: The company is making ________ changes to its factories, but critics say it needs to move much faster.
items.zh: 這家公司正對工廠做逐步的改變,但批評者說它需要加快速度。

items.def: increasing faster and faster
items.s: The growth of solar power has been ________, and it now produces more electricity than anyone expected.
items.zh: 太陽能的成長呈指數型,現在它產生的電力比任何人預期的都多。

items.def: changing at a steady rate
items.s: Sea level rise is not ________, so it may speed up suddenly if large ice sheets begin to break apart.
items.zh: 海平面上升並非線性的,所以如果大型冰原開始崩解,它可能會突然加速。

items.def: the quality of changing often
items.s: Rainfall ________ makes farming difficult, because farmers never know whether the season will be wet or dry.
items.zh: 降雨的變化性讓務農變得困難,因為農夫永遠不知道這一季會是濕潤還是乾燥。

items.def: the great size or importance of something
items.s: Few people understood the ________ of the problem, so the government reacted too slowly at first.
items.zh: 很少人理解這個問題的規模,所以政府一開始反應太慢。

items.def: the size or level of something
items.s: The ________ of the flood shocked everyone, and the water covered an area larger than the whole city.
items.zh: 洪水的規模讓每個人都震驚,淹水範圍比整座城市還大。

items.def: how large or serious something is
items.s: Satellites showed the ________ of the ice loss, and the photos made the news around the world.
items.zh: 衛星顯示了冰層流失的範圍,這些照片登上了全世界的新聞。

items.def: formed by adding together several amounts
items.s: The ________ cost of the storms was billions of dollars, so insurance companies have raised their prices.
items.zh: 這些暴風雨總計的損失高達數十億美元,所以保險公司已經調漲了價格。

items.def: in the middle of a set of numbers
items.s: The ________ temperature this June was the highest on record, and the hottest days were even worse.
items.zh: 今年六月的中位數氣溫是有紀錄以來最高的,而最熱的幾天更糟。

items.def: to measure something as a number
items.s: It is difficult to ________ the value of a forest, because it gives us clean air, water and beauty.
items.zh: 要量化一座森林的價值很困難,因為它給予我們乾淨的空氣、水和美景。

items.def: to find an answer using numbers
items.s: We used an app to ________ our family's carbon footprint, and we were surprised by how much came from flying.
items.zh: 我們用一個應用程式計算全家的碳足跡,很驚訝有那麼多來自搭飛機。

items.def: to judge or measure something
items.s: It is hard to ________ public opinion on the new tax, so the city will hold online surveys next month.
items.zh: 很難評估民眾對新稅的看法,所以市政府下個月將舉辦線上調查。

items.def: to describe the main points of something
items.s: The minister ________ the new energy plan on TV, but she did not explain how much it would cost.
items.zh: 部長在電視上概述了新的能源計畫,但她沒有說明它會花多少錢。

items.def: to give more details
items.s: The reporter asked the scientist to ________ on her research, so she explained how the ice samples were collected.
items.zh: 記者請這位科學家詳細說明她的研究,所以她解釋了冰芯樣本是如何採集的。

items.def: to express ideas clearly
items.s: The student was able to ________ her worries about the future, and the audience listened carefully.
items.zh: 這位學生能夠清楚表達她對未來的擔憂,觀眾都仔細聆聽。

items.def: to communicate an idea or feeling
items.s: The photo of the thin polar bear ________ the problem better than any graph, so it was shared millions of times.
items.zh: 那張瘦弱北極熊的照片比任何圖表都更能傳達問題,所以它被分享了數百萬次。

items.def: to show something in a picture or story
items.s: The film ________ a future city under water, and many viewers left the cinema feeling worried.
items.zh: 這部電影描繪了一座被水淹沒的未來城市,許多觀眾離開電影院時心情沉重。

items.def: to describe or show someone or something in a certain way
items.s: The news often ________ farmers as victims, but many of them are also finding smart ways to adapt.
items.zh: 新聞常常把農民描寫成受害者,但他們之中許多人也在找尋聰明的調適方法。

items.def: to emphasise that something is important
items.s: The recent floods ________ the need for better drains, and the city council finally agreed to spend more money.
items.zh: 最近的水災凸顯了改善排水系統的必要,市議會終於同意投入更多經費。

items.def: to say something again for emphasis
items.s: The president ________ her promise to close the coal plants, but she did not give a date.
items.zh: 總統重申了她關閉燃煤電廠的承諾,但她沒有給出日期。

items.def: to say that something is caused by a certain thing
items.s: Scientists ________ most of the recent warming to human activity, and they have strong data to support this.
items.zh: 科學家把近年大部分的暖化歸因於人類活動,而且他們有有力的數據支持。

items.def: to begin to happen or exist
items.s: New problems ________ when the river dried up, so the farmers had to share water more carefully.
items.zh: 河川乾涸時新的問題出現了,所以農夫們必須更謹慎地分配用水。

items.def: to begin or come from somewhere
items.s: Most typhoons that hit Taiwan ________ over the warm Pacific Ocean, and warmer water makes them stronger.
items.zh: 大多數侵襲台灣的颱風都源自溫暖的太平洋,而較暖的海水讓它們變得更強。

items.def: to involve something as a necessary part
items.s: Moving the whole village would ________ huge costs, so the leaders are looking at other options first.
items.zh: 遷移整個村莊將需要龐大的費用,所以領袖們先考慮其他選項。

items.def: to make something necessary
items.s: Rising sea levels will ________ new building rules, and older houses near the beach may have to be raised.
items.zh: 海平面上升將使新的建築規範成為必要,而海邊較舊的房子可能必須架高。

items.def: to make an action seem right or necessary
items.s: The danger was serious enough to ________ an evacuation, so the police went from door to door.
items.zh: 危險嚴重到有必要進行撤離,所以警察挨家挨戶通知。

items.def: to include many different things
items.s: The new course will ________ science, economics and history, so students can see climate change from many angles.
items.zh: 新課程將涵蓋科學、經濟和歷史,讓學生能從許多角度看待氣候變遷。

items.def: to be a clear example of an idea
items.s: The green school building ________ the idea of living with nature, and visitors come from all over Asia to see it.
items.zh: 這棟綠色校舍體現了與自然共存的理念,來自亞洲各地的訪客都來參觀。

items.def: to be a typical example of something
items.s: Copenhagen ________ how a city can cut emissions, because most people there cycle to work.
items.zh: 哥本哈根是城市如何減少排放的典範,因為那裡大多數人都騎單車上班。

items.def: to show something clearly
items.s: Climate change can ________ itself in many ways, such as stronger storms, longer droughts and earlier springs.
items.zh: 氣候變遷可能以許多方式顯現出來,例如更強的暴風雨、更長的乾旱和更早的春天。

items.def: to be common or most powerful at a certain time
items.s: Strong winds ________ along the west coast in winter, so it is a good place to build wind farms.
items.zh: 冬季西海岸盛行強風,所以那裡是興建風場的好地點。

items.def: spreading widely through every part
items.s: Plastic pollution is ________ in the ocean, and scientists have found tiny pieces even in deep sea fish.
items.zh: 塑膠污染在海洋中無所不在,科學家甚至在深海魚體內也發現了微小碎片。

items.def: seeming to be everywhere
items.s: Air-conditioners are ________ in Taipei apartments, but they push hot air into the streets and make the city warmer.
items.zh: 冷氣在台北的公寓裡隨處可見,但它們把熱空氣排到街上,讓城市變得更熱。

items.def: normal and traditional
items.s: ________ farming uses a lot of chemicals, but some farmers are trying natural methods to protect the soil.
items.zh: 傳統的農業使用大量化學物質,但一些農夫正嘗試自然的方法來保護土壤。

items.def: generally accepted as correct
items.s: The young engineer questioned the ________ way of building dams, and her new design used much less concrete.
items.zh: 這位年輕工程師質疑建造水壩的傳統方式,她的新設計使用了少得多的混凝土。

items.def: new and different
items.s: The students came up with a ________ idea for cooling classrooms, and they won first prize at the science fair.
items.zh: 學生們想出一個為教室降溫的新穎點子,並在科展中獲得第一名。

items.def: old and no longer useful
items.s: The city's flood maps are ________, so many new homes have been built in areas that are actually dangerous.
items.zh: 這座城市的淹水地圖已經過時,所以許多新房子蓋在其實很危險的地區。

items.def: not certain or final
items.s: The two countries reached a ________ agreement, but they still need to discuss the details next month.
items.zh: 兩國達成了暫定的協議,但它們下個月仍需要討論細節。

items.def: arranged for now but may change later
items.s: The ________ results show that this was the hottest year ever, and the final report will come out in spring.
items.zh: 暫定的結果顯示今年是史上最熱的一年,最終報告將於春天發布。

items.def: final and not able to be changed
items.s: There is no ________ answer to the question yet, so scientists will continue to collect data for several more years.
items.zh: 這個問題目前還沒有明確的答案,所以科學家會再繼續收集數年的資料。

items.def: proving something without doubt
items.s: The evidence for human-caused warming is ________, and almost every climate scientist agrees with it.
items.zh: 人為造成暖化的證據是確鑿的,幾乎每位氣候科學家都同意。

items.def: seeming reasonable or likely to be true
items.s: Her explanation for the fish deaths was ________, but the team still tested the water to make sure.
items.zh: 她對魚群死亡的解釋合理,但團隊仍然檢驗了水質以確認。

items.def: having mistakes or weaknesses
items.s: The report was ________ because it used only one year of data, so other experts did not trust its conclusions.
items.zh: 這份報告有缺陷,因為它只用了一年的數據,所以其他專家不信任它的結論。

items.def: not supporting one side more than another
items.s: The committee must stay ________, so none of its members can work for oil or gas companies.
items.zh: 委員會必須保持公正,所以其成員都不能為石油或天然氣公司工作。

items.def: the quality of being clear and easy to understand
items.s: Businesses want ________ about future energy rules, because they need to plan their investments for many years.
items.zh: 企業希望未來的能源規定能更明確,因為他們需要為多年的投資做規劃。

items.def: a small but important difference in meaning
items.s: The debate on nuclear power needs more ________, because it is not simply good or bad.
items.zh: 關於核能的辯論需要更多細微的區辨,因為它並不是單純的好或壞。

items.def: treating a problem as simpler than it really is
items.s: Saying that planting trees will solve everything is ________, because we also need to cut emissions.
items.zh: 說種樹就能解決一切是過度簡化的想法,因為我們也需要減少排放。

items.def: to describe something in a way that is too simple
items.s: Headlines often ________ scientific reports, so readers may not understand how uncertain some results are.
items.zh: 新聞標題常常過度簡化科學報告,所以讀者可能不了解某些結果有多不確定。

items.def: to say something is true for all cases
items.s: We should not ________ from one cold winter, because climate is about long-term patterns, not a single season.
items.zh: 我們不應該從一個寒冷的冬天就一概而論,因為氣候講的是長期模式,而不是單一季節。

items.def: the reasons for a decision
items.s: The mayor explained the ________ for the new parking fees, and she said the money would pay for more buses.
items.zh: 市長解釋了新停車費的理由,她說這筆錢將用來增加公車。

items.def: a way of measuring something
items.s: Carbon per person is a useful ________, but it does not show which countries polluted the most in the past.
items.zh: 人均碳排放是一個有用的指標,但它無法顯示哪些國家過去污染最多。

items.def: a standard used for comparison
items.s: The new office became a ________ for green buildings, and other companies copied many of its ideas.
items.zh: 這棟新辦公室成為綠建築的標竿,其他公司仿效了它的許多設計。

items.def: a limit or rule that controls how something is done
items.s: The model uses several ________ such as wind speed and temperature, so its forecasts are quite accurate.
items.zh: 這個模型使用了幾個參數,例如風速和溫度,所以它的預報相當準確。

items.def: a typical model or way of thinking
items.s: Renewable energy has changed the old ________ of power, so homes can now produce electricity as well as use it.
items.zh: 可再生能源改變了舊有的電力模式,所以家庭現在既能用電也能發電。

items.def: clearly separate
items.s: The study divided the coast into ________ sections, and each part was tested for erosion separately.
items.zh: 這項研究把海岸劃分為個別的區段,每個部分都分別進行侵蝕檢測。

items.def: very strongly; by a very large amount
items.s: The public ________ supported the new park, so the city cancelled its plan to build a shopping mall there.
items.zh: 民眾壓倒性地支持新公園,所以市政府取消了在那裡蓋購物中心的計畫。

items.def: by which; through which
items.s: The town created a system ________ people can borrow electric bikes for free, and it has reduced traffic a lot.
items.zh: 鎮上建立了一個制度,藉此民眾可以免費借用電動自行車,而它大幅減少了車流。

items.def: in the same way
items.s: Our school turned off the lights at lunchtime, and the school next door did ________, so both saved energy.
items.zh: 我們學校在午餐時間關燈,隔壁學校也同樣這麼做,所以兩校都節省了能源。

items.def: used to show that a name may not be accurate
items.s: The ________ green bags were made of thick plastic, so they were actually worse for the environment.
items.zh: 那些所謂的環保袋是用厚塑膠做的,所以它們其實對環境更糟。

items.def: not expected or predicted
items.s: The project faced ________ problems, but the engineers solved them and finished the seawall on time.
items.zh: 這項工程遇到意料之外的問題,但工程師們解決了它們並準時完成海堤。

items.def: to start doing a job or task
items.s: The university ________ a five-year study of the river, and the results helped the city plan new flood walls.
items.zh: 這所大學進行了一項為期五年的河川研究,其結果幫助市政府規劃新的防洪牆。

items.def: going to happen soon
items.s: The ________ climate summit will be held in Asia, so many local groups are preparing to attend.
items.zh: 即將到來的氣候高峰會將在亞洲舉行,所以許多在地團體正準備參加。

items.def: having a limit
items.s: Oil and coal are ________ resources, so the world will have to replace them sooner or later.
items.zh: 石油和煤是有限的資源,所以世界遲早必須取代它們。

items.def: happening all the time
items.s: The village faces ________ danger from rising water, but many families do not want to leave their land.
items.zh: 這個村莊面臨上升海水持續不斷的威脅,但許多家庭不想離開他們的土地。

items.def: a fact or condition that affects a situation
items.s: Under normal ________ the river is calm, but after heavy rain it can rise by three metres in a few hours.
items.zh: 在正常情況下河水很平靜,但大雨過後它可能在幾小時內上漲三公尺。

items.def: a clear difference between two things
items.s: There is a sharp ________ between the cool forest and the hot city, so many families go to the mountains on weekends.
items.zh: 涼爽的森林和炎熱的城市之間有明顯的對比,所以許多家庭週末都會上山。

items.def: a formal agreement between countries
items.s: The United Nations climate ________ was signed in 1992, and countries have met every year since then.
items.zh: 聯合國氣候公約於1992年簽署,此後各國每年都會開會。

items.def: a set of political ideas or beliefs
items.s: Climate policy should be based on science rather than ________, but in some countries it has become very political.
items.zh: 氣候政策應該以科學為基礎而非意識形態,但在某些國家它已變得非常政治化。

items.def: between two levels or stages
items.s: The plan has an ________ target for 2030, so the country can check its progress before the final goal.
items.zh: 這項計畫訂有2030年的中期目標,讓國家能在最終目標之前檢視進度。

items.def: to use a law or rule to support an action
items.s: The president ________ emergency powers after the flood, so the army could help with rescue work at once.
items.zh: 水災後總統行使緊急權力,讓軍隊能立刻協助救援工作。

items.def: to help two sides reach an agreement
items.s: A local professor agreed to ________ between the fishermen and the energy company, and both sides finally signed a deal.
items.zh: 一位當地教授同意在漁民和能源公司之間調解,雙方最終簽署了協議。

items.def: a system of rules or government
items.s: The new tax ________ rewards companies that pollute less, so many factories are buying cleaner machines.
items.zh: 新的稅收制度獎勵污染較少的公司,所以許多工廠正在購買更乾淨的機器。

items.def: a person or thing that comes after another
items.s: The old agreement ended in 2020, and its ________ sets stronger goals for every country.
items.zh: 舊協議在2020年結束,而它的後繼協議為每個國家訂定了更強的目標。

items.def: to bring people or things together
items.s: The flood helped to ________ the community, because neighbours who had never spoken started to help each other.
items.zh: 這場水災幫助團結了社區,因為從未交談過的鄰居開始互相幫忙。

items.def: an area of activity or interest
items.s: Climate change affects every ________ of life, so it is discussed in science, business and even art classes.
items.zh: 氣候變遷影響生活的每個領域,所以它在科學、商業,甚至藝術課中都會被討論。

items.def: about quality rather than numbers
items.s: The team collected ________ data by talking to farmers, because numbers alone could not show how they felt.
items.zh: 團隊透過與農夫交談收集了質性資料,因為光靠數字無法呈現他們的感受。

items.def: a long piece of writing for a university degree
items.s: My cousin wrote her ________ on heat in Taipei, and the city government used some of her ideas.
items.zh: 我表姐寫了一篇關於台北高溫的論文,市政府採用了她的一些想法。

items.def: to think that two things are the same
items.s: Many people ________ a warm winter with good weather, but it can actually harm crops and insects.
items.zh: 許多人把暖冬等同於好天氣,但它其實可能傷害作物和昆蟲。

items.def: the way you think or feel about something
items.s: Public ________ towards electric cars has changed, and now many young people say they will never buy a petrol car.
items.zh: 大眾對電動車的態度已經改變,現在許多年輕人說他們永遠不會買汽油車。

items.def: how easy something is to get or use
items.s: The ________ of clean water is falling in some regions, so people walk further every day to find it.
items.zh: 某些地區乾淨水源的供應正在減少,所以人們每天要走更遠才能取得。

items.def: to understand something fully
items.s: It is hard to ________ how fast the ice is melting, so the scientist showed us photos taken ten years apart.
items.zh: 很難理解冰融化的速度有多快,所以這位科學家給我們看了相隔十年拍攝的照片。

items.def: to consider or judge something in a certain way
items.s: The bridge was ________ unsafe after the earthquake, so cars had to use a road ten kilometres away.
items.zh: 地震後這座橋被認為不安全,所以汽車必須改走十公里外的道路。

items.def: to notice or understand something that is not obvious
items.s: It is difficult to ________ a clear trend from one year of data, so researchers look at records over many decades.
items.zh: 很難從一年的數據中察覺出明確的趨勢,所以研究人員會檢視數十年的紀錄。

items.def: to succeed in doing something
items.s: The village ________ its goal of using only solar power, and other towns are now asking how they did it.
items.zh: 這個村莊達成了只使用太陽能的目標,其他城鎮現在都在詢問他們是怎麼做到的。

items.def: to become less strong
items.s: The rescue boats waited until the storm began to ________, and then they went out to find the missing fishermen.
items.zh: 救援船等到暴風雨開始減弱,接著才出海搜尋失蹤的漁民。

items.def: to make something happen sooner
items.s: The heat ________ the melting of the glacier, so the river flooded villages downstream in July.
items.zh: 高溫加速了冰河的融化,所以河水在七月淹沒了下游的村莊。

items.def: to increase the size or value of something
items.s: The city will ________ its water supply with rainwater tanks, because the reservoir alone is no longer enough.
items.zh: 市政府將以雨水儲水槽來擴大供水量,因為光靠水庫已經不夠了。

items.def: changing often in a way that cannot be predicted
items.s: The weather has become very ________ in recent years, so farmers are not sure when to plant their seeds.
items.zh: 近年來天氣變得非常不穩定,所以農夫不確定何時該播種。

items.def: likely to change suddenly
items.s: Oil prices are very ________, so countries that use more renewable energy are better protected from sudden changes.
items.zh: 油價非常多變,所以使用較多可再生能源的國家較不受突然變化的影響。

items.def: stopping and starting again
items.s: Wind and solar power are ________, so we need batteries to store energy for times without sun or wind.
items.zh: 風力和太陽能是間歇性的,所以我們需要電池在沒有陽光或風的時候儲存能源。

items.def: happening only sometimes
items.s: There was only ________ rain during the spring, so the reservoirs were nearly empty by June.
items.zh: 春天只下了零星的雨,所以到六月時水庫幾乎見底。

items.def: lasting for a long time
items.s: A ________ drought dried up the rivers, and many farmers had to sell their animals.
items.zh: 一場長期乾旱讓河川乾涸,許多農夫不得不賣掉他們的牲畜。

items.def: happening again and again
items.s: ________ flooding has damaged the old market many times, so the shop owners finally agreed to move.
items.zh: 反覆發生的淹水多次損壞了老市場,所以店家們最終同意搬遷。

items.def: always; every time
items.s: Heavy rain ________ causes traffic jams in the city, so many people now work from home on stormy days.
items.zh: 大雨總是造成市區交通堵塞,所以許多人現在在暴風雨的日子都在家工作。

items.def: used to say something may be true, though some may disagree
items.s: Climate change is ________ the biggest challenge of our time, but many people still do not think about it every day.
items.zh: 氣候變遷可以說是我們這個時代最大的挑戰,但許多人仍然不會每天想到它。

items.def: in the opposite way
items.s: Some regions will get more rain; ________, others will become much drier, so farming must change in both places.
items.zh: 有些地區會有更多降雨;相反地,其他地區會變得更加乾燥,所以兩地的農業都必須改變。

items.def: after that time
items.s: The factory closed in 2015, and ________ the river slowly became clean enough for fish to return.
items.zh: 工廠在2015年關閉,此後河川慢慢變得乾淨到足以讓魚群回來。

items.def: in a way that is clear and easy to notice
items.s: Air quality improved ________ during the holiday, because fewer cars were on the road and factories were closed.
items.zh: 假期期間空氣品質明顯改善,因為路上的車少了,工廠也關閉了。

items.def: gradually and in a regular way
items.s: The number of electric buses has grown ________, and the city hopes all buses will be electric by 2030.
items.zh: 電動公車的數量穩定地成長,市政府希望在2030年前所有公車都改為電動。

items.def: at the same time
items.s: The city is building a new seawall and ________ planting mangroves, so the coast will have two kinds of protection.
items.zh: 市政府正在興建新海堤,並同時種植紅樹林,讓海岸擁有兩種保護。

items.def: in the same order as the things just mentioned
items.s: Wind and solar produced twenty and fifteen percent of the power ________, so clean energy is growing fast.
items.zh: 風力和太陽能分別提供了百分之二十和百分之十五的電力,所以潔淨能源成長迅速。

items.def: in a way that fits the situation
items.s: The forecast said the storm would be strong, so the school planned ________ and moved all classes online.
items.zh: 預報說暴風雨會很強烈,所以學校相應地做了安排,把所有課程改為線上。

items.def: used when you agree that something is true
items.s: ________, solar panels are expensive at first, but they save money on electricity for many years.
items.zh: 誠然,太陽能板一開始很貴,但它們能在許多年間節省電費。

items.def: appearing to be true, but perhaps not
items.s: The river looked ________ clean, but tests showed that it contained dangerous chemicals from the farms.
items.zh: 這條河看似很乾淨,但檢驗顯示它含有來自農場的危險化學物質。

items.def: said to be true, but not proved
items.s: The company ________ dumped waste into the sea, and the police are now checking its records.
items.zh: 這家公司據稱把廢棄物倒入海中,警方目前正在調查它的紀錄。

items.def: compared with other things
items.s: The changes needed are ________ simple, but they require people to give up some old habits.
items.zh: 所需的改變相對簡單,但它們需要人們放棄一些舊習慣。

items.def: almost completely
items.s: The lake had ________ disappeared by the end of summer, so the boat owners had nothing to do.
items.zh: 到夏末時湖泊幾乎消失了,所以船主們無事可做。

items.def: careful and complete
items.s: The engineers made a ________ check of the dam after the earthquake, and they found two small cracks.
items.zh: 地震後工程師們對水壩做了徹底的檢查,並發現了兩道小裂縫。

items.def: very careful about details
items.s: She kept ________ records of the birds in her garden for thirty years, so scientists used them to study climate change.
items.zh: 她三十年來一絲不苟地記錄自家花園裡的鳥類,所以科學家用這些紀錄來研究氣候變遷。

items.def: done according to a careful plan
items.s: The team used a ________ method to count the trees, and they checked every square of the forest map.
items.zh: 團隊使用有系統的方法計算樹木數量,並檢查了森林地圖上的每一格。

items.def: united and working well together
items.s: A ________ community recovers faster after a disaster, because neighbours share tools, food and information.
items.zh: 有凝聚力的社區在災後復原得更快,因為鄰居們會分享工具、食物和資訊。

items.def: too important to be without
items.s: Weather satellites are ________ for typhoon forecasts, so countries share their data with each other.
items.zh: 氣象衛星對颱風預報是不可或缺的,所以各國彼此分享資料。

items.def: more important than anything else
items.s: Safety is ________ during a typhoon, so people should stay indoors even if the wind seems weak.
items.zh: 颱風期間安全是最重要的,所以即使風看起來很弱,人們也應該待在室內。

items.def: most important or noticeable
items.s: The report listed the ________ points on the first page, so busy leaders could understand it quickly.
items.zh: 報告在第一頁列出了最重要的重點,讓忙碌的領袖們能快速理解。

items.def: important and well known
items.s: A ________ scientist spoke at the conference, and her warning about sea level rise made the evening news.
items.zh: 一位著名的科學家在會議上發表演說,她對海平面上升的警告登上了晚間新聞。

items.def: very easy to see or notice
items.s: The damage to the forest was ________ from the plane, and large brown areas stretched across the hills.
items.zh: 從飛機上看森林的損害非常明顯,大片褐色區域橫跨整個山丘。

items.def: real and able to be seen or measured
items.s: Students want ________ results from the climate club, so they track how much rubbish they collect each month.
items.zh: 學生們希望氣候社團有具體的成果,所以他們記錄每個月收集了多少垃圾。

items.def: to prove that something is wrong
items.s: The scientist used clear data to ________ the false claim, and the video was watched by millions of people.
items.zh: 這位科學家用明確的數據駁斥了錯誤的說法,這段影片被數百萬人觀看。

items.def: to support an idea with new evidence
items.s: Satellite images ________ what the villagers said, because the glacier had clearly become much smaller.
items.zh: 衛星影像證實了村民所說的話,因為冰河明顯變小了很多。

items.def: the rise in the Earth's average temperature
items.s: ______ ______ is making summers longer in Taiwan, so schools are thinking about starting classes earlier in the morning.
items.zh: 全球暖化正讓台灣的夏天變得更長,所以學校正在考慮早上提早開始上課。

items.def: the amount of carbon a person or activity produces
items.s: Flying to Europe adds a lot to your ______ ______, so my family took a train trip around Taiwan this year.
items.zh: 飛往歐洲會大幅增加你的碳足跡,所以我們家今年改搭火車環島旅行。

items.def: very unusual and dangerous weather
items.s: ______ ______ such as floods and heatwaves is becoming more common, and cities must prepare for it.
items.zh: 像水災和熱浪這樣的極端天氣變得越來越常見,城市必須為此做好準備。

items.def: the moment when a small change causes a big, sudden effect
items.s: Scientists fear the rainforest may reach a ______ ______, and then it could slowly turn into dry grassland.
items.zh: 科學家擔心雨林可能達到臨界點,接著它可能慢慢變成乾燥的草原。

items.def: a problem that will become very serious soon
items.cn: 定時炸彈;隨時會爆發的問題
items.s: Experts call the melting permafrost ______ ______ ______ ______, because it holds huge amounts of gas that could escape.
items.zh: 專家把融化中的永凍土稱為一顆定時炸彈,因為它蘊含大量可能逸散的氣體。

items.def: for people who will live after us
items.s: We must protect the forests ______ ______ ______, because our children and grandchildren will need clean air and water too.
items.zh: 我們必須為了後代子孫保護森林,因為我們的孩子和孫子也會需要乾淨的空氣和水。

items.def: to use or do less of something
items.s: Our family decided to ______ ______ ______ meat, because farming animals produces a lot of greenhouse gases.
items.zh: 我們家決定減少吃肉,因為飼養動物會產生大量溫室氣體。

items.def: to stop using something gradually
items.s: The government plans to ______ ______ petrol scooters by 2035, so new buyers are already choosing electric ones.
items.zh: 政府計畫在2035年前逐步淘汰汽油機車,所以新買家已經在選擇電動機車了。

items.def: to start living or working in a way that is better for the environment
items.s: The café decided to ______ ______ last year, so it stopped using plastic straws and started selling local food.
items.zh: 這家咖啡廳去年決定走向環保,所以它停止使用塑膠吸管並開始販售在地食材。

items.def: to have no more of something left
items.s: If the rain does not come soon, the town will ______ ______ ______ drinking water, so people are saving every drop.
items.zh: 如果雨再不來,鎮上就會用完飲用水,所以人們正在節約每一滴水。

items.def: a small, visible part of a much bigger problem
items.s: The flooded streets were only ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, because the storm had also damaged farms and power lines.
items.zh: 淹水的街道只是冰山一角,因為暴風雨也損壞了農場和電線。

items.def: to get through a difficult time successfully
items.s: The small farm lost half its crops, but the family managed to ______ ______ ______ with help from the community.
items.zh: 這座小農場損失了一半的作物,但這家人在社區的幫助下設法度過難關。

items.def: to suffer the worst part of something
items.cn: 首當其衝;承受最大衝擊
items.s: Poor coastal villages ______ ______ ______ ______ rising seas, but they produced almost none of the pollution.
items.zh: 貧窮的沿海村莊首當其衝承受海平面上升的衝擊,但它們幾乎沒有製造任何污染。

items.def: a situation where you must work very fast to finish before it is too late
items.s: Saving the coral reef is ______ ______ ______ ______, because the water is getting warmer every summer.
items.zh: 拯救珊瑚礁是一場與時間賽跑,因為海水每年夏天都在變暖。

items.def: to warn people about a danger
items.s: Scientists ______ ______ ______ about melting ice many years ago, but governments were slow to listen.
items.zh: 科學家多年前就對融冰敲響了警鐘,但政府遲遲不願傾聽。

items.def: to do things in order to achieve something
items.s: Our school has ______ ______ ______ save energy, and we now turn off all fans when we leave the classroom.
items.zh: 我們學校已經採取措施節約能源,現在我們離開教室時都會關掉所有電扇。

items.def: increasing
items.s: Heat-related illnesses are ______ ______ ______, so doctors advise people to drink water and stay out of the midday sun.
items.zh: 與高溫相關的疾病正在增加,所以醫生建議民眾多喝水並避開正午的陽光。

items.def: when dealing with a difficult situation
items.s: ______ ______ ______ ______ rising seas, the islanders have kept their culture alive, but many young people have moved away.
items.zh: 面對上升的海平面,島民們讓自己的文化延續下去,但許多年輕人已經搬走了。

items.def: to show others how to behave by doing it yourself
items.s: Our principal wanted to ______ ______ ______, so she started riding a bicycle to school every day.
items.zh: 我們校長想要以身作則,所以她開始每天騎腳踏車上學。

items.def: causing harm or loss to something else
items.s: The factory grew quickly ______ ______ ______ ______ the river, and now the water is too dirty for fish.
items.zh: 這家工廠的快速成長是以河川為代價,現在河水髒到魚都無法生存。

items.def: the ground at the bottom of the sea
items.s: The divers found an old anchor lying on the sandy ________, and they carefully brought it up to the boat.
items.zh: 潛水員在沙質的海床上發現一個老舊的錨,他們小心地把它帶上船。
items.sec: Ocean Zones & Geography 海洋分區與地理

items.def: a very deep, narrow valley in the ocean floor
items.s: The Mariana ________ is deeper than Mount Everest is tall, so very few people have ever reached its bottom.
items.zh: 馬里亞納海溝比聖母峰還要深,所以極少有人曾到達它的底部。
items.sec: Ocean Zones & Geography 海洋分區與地理

items.def: a very deep place that seems to have no bottom
items.s: The documentary showed strange fish living in the dark ________, where sunlight never reaches and the water is freezing cold.
items.zh: 這部紀錄片介紹了住在黑暗深淵裡的奇特魚類,那裡陽光永遠照不到,而且海水冰冷刺骨。
items.sec: Ocean Zones & Geography 海洋分區與地理

items.def: found in the deepest parts of the ocean
items.s: Scientists know very little about ________ animals because they live thousands of metres down, and their habitat is hard to reach.
items.zh: 科學家對深海底層的動物所知甚少,因為牠們住在數千公尺深的地方,而且牠們的棲地很難抵達。
items.sec: Ocean Zones & Geography 海洋分區與地理

items.def: the shallow sea floor near the edge of a continent
items.s: Most fish are caught on the ______ ______ because the water there is shallow, and sunlight helps plants and plankton grow.
items.zh: 大部分的魚是在大陸棚捕獲的,因為那裡的海水較淺,而且陽光能幫助植物和浮游生物生長。
items.sec: Ocean Zones & Geography 海洋分區與地理

items.def: a long, narrow line of high land or mountains
items.s: A huge underwater ________ runs through the middle of the Atlantic, and new sea floor slowly forms along it.
items.zh: 一條巨大的海底海脊貫穿大西洋中部,新的海床沿著它慢慢形成。
items.sec: Ocean Zones & Geography 海洋分區與地理

items.def: a large, low area of land or sea floor shaped like a bowl
items.s: The Pacific Ocean ________ is the largest on Earth, and it covers almost one third of the planet's surface.
items.zh: 太平洋海盆是地球上最大的,它幾乎覆蓋了地球表面的三分之一。
items.sec: Ocean Zones & Geography 海洋分區與地理

items.def: an underwater mountain that does not reach the surface
items.s: Sharks often gather around a ________ because food is plentiful there, so fishermen like to visit these underwater mountains.
items.zh: 鯊魚常常聚集在海底山附近,因為那裡食物豐富,所以漁民喜歡造訪這些海底山。
items.sec: Ocean Zones & Geography 海洋分區與地理

items.def: a narrow area of sea that joins two larger seas
items.s: Ferries cross the Taiwan ________ every day, but the trip can be rough when strong winds blow in winter.
items.zh: 渡輪每天橫越台灣海峽,但冬天颳強風時航程可能會很顛簸。
items.sec: Ocean Zones & Geography 海洋分區與地理

items.def: a large area of sea mostly surrounded by land
items.s: Many oil platforms stand in the ________ of Mexico, and they have caused serious pollution after accidents in the past.
items.zh: 墨西哥灣有許多石油平台,而且它們過去在意外發生後造成了嚴重的污染。
items.sec: Ocean Zones & Geography 海洋分區與地理

items.def: a part of the sea that curves into the land
items.s: We rented kayaks and paddled around the quiet ________, while our parents relaxed on the beach and read their books.
items.zh: 我們租了獨木舟在寧靜的海灣划船,而我們的父母則在海灘上放鬆看書。
items.sec: Ocean Zones & Geography 海洋分區與地理

items.def: an area of calm sea water separated from the ocean by sand or reef
items.s: The water in the ________ is calm and warm, so it is a safe place for children to swim and snorkel.
items.zh: 潟湖裡的海水平靜又溫暖,所以對孩子來說是游泳和浮潛的安全地方。
items.sec: Ocean Zones & Geography 海洋分區與地理

items.def: a narrow area of water that goes into the land from the sea
items.s: Small fishing boats hide in the ________ during typhoons, because the hills around it block the strongest winds.
items.zh: 颱風期間小漁船會躲在小海灣裡,因為周圍的山丘能擋住最強的風。
items.sec: Ocean Zones & Geography 海洋分區與地理

items.def: land almost surrounded by water but joined to a larger area
items.s: Hengchun is on a ________ in southern Taiwan, so visitors can see the sea on three sides of the town.
items.zh: 恆春位在台灣南部的一個半島上,所以遊客可以在小鎮的三面看見大海。
items.sec: Ocean Zones & Geography 海洋分區與地理

items.def: a group of many islands
items.s: The Philippines is a large ________ of over 7,000 islands, and many people travel between them by boat.
items.zh: 菲律賓是一個由超過七千座島嶼組成的大群島,許多人搭船往返於島嶼之間。
items.sec: Ocean Zones & Geography 海洋分區與地理

items.def: a ring-shaped coral island around a lagoon
items.s: The tiny ________ is only two metres above the sea, so rising water is a serious danger for the people living there.
items.zh: 這個小環礁只高出海面兩公尺,所以上升的海水對住在那裡的人是嚴重的危險。
items.sec: Ocean Zones & Geography 海洋分區與地理

items.def: the edge of the sea where it meets the land
items.s: Volunteers walked along the ________ for three hours, and they collected more than fifty bags of rubbish.
items.zh: 志工們沿著海岸線走了三個小時,他們收集了超過五十袋垃圾。
items.sec: Ocean Zones & Geography 海洋分區與地理

items.def: an area of shallow water
items.s: Young fish stay in the ________ near the beach because big predators cannot easily follow them there.
items.zh: 幼魚待在海灘附近的淺水區,因為大型掠食者不容易跟著牠們到那裡。
items.sec: Ocean Zones & Geography 海洋分區與地理

items.def: how deep something is
items.s: The submarine reached a ________ of 3,000 metres, but the crew had to return because the battery was getting low.
items.zh: 潛水艇到達了三千公尺的深度,但組員必須返航,因為電池電量越來越低。
items.sec: Ocean Zones & Geography 海洋分區與地理

items.def: the top layer of water or land
items.s: The whale came up to the ________ to breathe, and everyone on the boat cheered when they saw its huge tail.
items.zh: 那頭鯨魚浮上水面呼吸,船上的每個人看到牠巨大的尾巴時都歡呼了起來。
items.sec: Ocean Zones & Geography 海洋分區與地理

items.def: receiving light from the sun
items.s: Most ocean life lives in the ________ top layer of the sea, because plants there can use light to make food.
items.zh: 大部分的海洋生物生活在海洋陽光照射的最上層,因為那裡的植物能利用光來製造食物。
items.sec: Ocean Zones & Geography 海洋分區與地理

items.def: the dim ocean layer between about 200 and 1,000 metres deep
items.s: Very little light reaches the ______ ______, so many fish there have huge eyes to help them see.
items.zh: 極少光線能到達暮光帶,所以那裡的許多魚有巨大的眼睛幫助牠們看見東西。
items.sec: Ocean Zones & Geography 海洋分區與地理

items.def: a crack in the sea floor that lets out very hot water
items.s: Scientists were surprised to find crabs and worms living near a ______ ______, although the water there was extremely hot.
items.zh: 科學家驚訝地發現螃蟹和蠕蟲生活在熱泉噴口附近,儘管那裡的水極度炙熱。
items.sec: Ocean Zones & Geography 海洋分區與地理

items.def: the rising of cold, deep water to the surface
items.s: ________ brings cold, nutrient-rich water to the surface, so the area becomes an excellent place for fishing.
items.zh: 湧升流把寒冷、富含養分的海水帶到表面,所以這個區域成為絕佳的漁場。
items.sec: Ocean Zones & Geography 海洋分區與地理

items.def: a large system of circular ocean currents
items.s: Floating rubbish gets trapped in the North Pacific ________, and it slowly forms a huge area of plastic waste.
items.zh: 漂浮的垃圾被困在北太平洋環流中,而且慢慢形成一大片塑膠垃圾區。
items.sec: Ocean Zones & Geography 海洋分區與地理

items.def: long, smooth waves caused by distant winds
items.s: Surfers were excited about the big ________ that arrived after the storm, but the lifeguards warned beginners to stay out.
items.zh: 衝浪者對暴風雨過後來的大湧浪感到興奮,但救生員警告初學者不要下水。
items.sec: Ocean Zones & Geography 海洋分區與地理

items.def: a strong current under the surface that pulls water away from the shore
items.s: The beach looked calm, but a dangerous ________ pulled the swimmer away from the shore, so a lifeguard had to rescue him.
items.zh: 海灘看起來很平靜,但危險的底流把泳客拉離岸邊,所以救生員必須救他。
items.sec: Ocean Zones & Geography 海洋分區與地理

items.def: a very large wave caused by an earthquake under the sea
items.s: After the earthquake, a ________ warning was sent to everyone's phones, and families quickly moved to higher ground.
items.zh: 地震之後,海嘯警報發送到每個人的手機,家家戶戶迅速移往高處。
items.sec: Ocean Zones & Geography 海洋分區與地理

items.def: located in the sea, away from the coast
items.s: The government plans to build more ________ wind farms, because the wind at sea is stronger and more reliable.
items.zh: 政府計畫興建更多離岸風場,因為海上的風更強、更穩定。
items.sec: Ocean Zones & Geography 海洋分區與地理

items.def: in the sea but close to the land
items.s: ________ fishing boats are small, so they usually stay close to the coast and return to the harbour every evening.
items.zh: 近岸漁船很小,所以通常待在海岸附近,而且每天傍晚返回港口。
items.sec: Ocean Zones & Geography 海洋分區與地理

items.def: connected with the sea or ships
items.s: Taiwan has a long ________ history, and the museum in Keelung shows how people traded by sea centuries ago.
items.zh: 台灣有悠久的海洋歷史,而基隆的博物館展示了幾百年前人們如何透過海路貿易。
items.sec: Ocean Zones & Geography 海洋分區與地理

items.def: relating to the ocean
items.s: ________ islands like Hawaii were formed by volcanoes, so their plants and animals arrived from far away.
items.zh: 像夏威夷這樣的海洋島嶼是由火山形成的,所以島上的動植物是從遠方來的。
items.sec: Ocean Zones & Geography 海洋分區與地理

items.def: a small, sheltered bay
items.s: We found a hidden ________ with clear blue water, and we spent the whole afternoon swimming there without other tourists.
items.zh: 我們發現了一個海水清澈湛藍的隱密小海灣,整個下午都在那裡游泳,沒有其他遊客。
items.sec: Ocean Zones & Geography 海洋分區與地理

items.def: the open ocean that no country controls
items.s: Fishing on the ______ ______ is hard to control because no single country owns those waters.
items.zh: 在公海捕魚很難管控,因為沒有任何單一國家擁有那片水域。
items.sec: Ocean Zones & Geography 海洋分區與地理

items.def: tiny plants and animals that float in the sea
items.s: Many large whales eat ________, although these tiny living things are almost too small to see.
items.zh: 許多大型鯨魚以浮游生物為食,儘管這些微小的生物小到幾乎看不見。

items.def: tiny plants that float in the sea and use sunlight
items.s: ________ produces a large part of the oxygen we breathe, so the health of the ocean matters to everyone.
items.zh: 浮游植物製造了我們呼吸的大部分氧氣,所以海洋的健康對每個人都很重要。

items.def: tiny animals that float in the sea
items.s: Small fish feed on ________ at night, and then bigger fish come to hunt those small fish.
items.zh: 小魚在夜間以浮游動物為食,然後更大的魚會來獵捕那些小魚。

items.def: small shrimp-like animals eaten by whales and penguins
items.s: Blue whales can eat four tonnes of ________ a day, so they need huge areas of rich, cold water.
items.zh: 藍鯨一天可以吃掉四噸的磷蝦,所以牠們需要廣大、豐富又寒冷的水域。

items.def: a soft sea animal with long parts that can sting
items.s: My sister was stung by a ________ while she was swimming, so we put vinegar on her arm right away.
items.zh: 我妹妹游泳時被水母螫到,所以我們立刻在她手臂上塗醋。

items.def: a sea animal with a soft body and eight arms
items.s: The ________ can change its colour in seconds, and it often hides between rocks to avoid hungry predators.
items.zh: 章魚能在幾秒內改變顏色,而且牠常常躲在岩石之間躲避飢餓的掠食者。

items.def: a sea animal with ten arms and a long body
items.s: Fishermen use bright lights at night to attract ________, and the boats look like floating stars from the shore.
items.zh: 漁民在夜間使用明亮的燈光吸引魷魚,從岸邊看,那些船就像漂浮的星星。

items.def: an animal with a hard shell, such as a crab or shrimp
items.s: A crab is a ________, so it has a hard shell, and it must grow a new one as its body gets bigger.
items.zh: 螃蟹是甲殼類動物,所以牠有堅硬的殼,而且當身體長大時必須長出新殼。

items.def: a sea animal with a shell, eight legs and two claws
items.s: The little ________ walked sideways across the sand, and it quickly disappeared into a hole when we came closer.
items.zh: 那隻小螃蟹橫著走過沙灘,我們靠近時牠迅速消失在一個洞裡。

items.def: a large shellfish with big claws that people eat
items.s: ________ is an expensive dish in many restaurants, but some people refuse to eat it because they worry about overfishing.
items.zh: 龍蝦在許多餐廳是昂貴的菜餚,但有些人拒絕吃,因為他們擔心過度捕撈。

items.def: sea animals with shells that people eat, like clams and shrimp
items.s: My uncle cannot eat ________ because it makes his skin itchy, so he always orders fish instead.
items.zh: 我叔叔不能吃有殼海鮮,因為那會讓他皮膚發癢,所以他總是改點魚。

items.def: a soft animal often with a shell, like a snail or octopus
items.s: An octopus is a ________ without a shell, while a snail is one that carries its shell on its back.
items.zh: 章魚是沒有殼的軟體動物,而蝸牛則是背著殼的軟體動物。

items.def: a shellfish with two shells that close tightly
items.s: We dug ________ out of the wet sand at low tide, and my grandmother cooked them in a delicious soup.
items.zh: 我們在退潮時從濕沙裡挖出蛤蜊,而奶奶把牠們煮成美味的湯。

items.def: a shellfish that can make pearls and is often eaten raw
items.s: Changhua is famous for its ________ farms, and visitors love to try the local oyster omelettes.
items.zh: 彰化以牡蠣養殖場聞名,而遊客喜歡品嚐當地的蚵仔煎。

items.def: a small round sea animal covered in sharp spines
items.s: Wear shoes when you walk on the rocks, because a ______ ______ can hurt your feet badly with its sharp spines.
items.zh: 在岩石上走路時要穿鞋,因為海膽會用牠尖銳的刺嚴重刺傷你的腳。

items.def: a flat sea animal shaped like a star
items.s: The children found a bright orange ________ in a rock pool, but their teacher asked them to put it back gently.
items.zh: 孩子們在潮池裡發現一隻鮮橘色的海星,但老師請他們輕輕地把牠放回去。

items.def: a simple sea animal with a body full of holes
items.s: A ________ looks like a plant, but it is actually an animal that filters food from the water.
items.zh: 海綿看起來像植物,但牠其實是從水中過濾食物的動物。

items.def: a small fish with a head shaped like a horse
items.s: The male ________ carries the babies in a pouch, and this makes it very unusual in the animal world.
items.zh: 雄海馬把寶寶放在育兒袋中,這讓牠在動物界中非常特別。

items.def: a large fish with sharp teeth
items.s: Many people fear the ________, but it rarely attacks humans, and millions are killed every year for their fins.
items.zh: 許多人害怕鯊魚,但牠很少攻擊人類,而且每年有數百萬隻因為魚鰭而被殺。

items.def: a very large sea mammal
items.s: We took a boat trip from Hualien to see a ________, and we were lucky enough to watch one jump out of the water.
items.zh: 我們從花蓮搭船出海去看鯨魚,而且很幸運地看到一隻躍出水面。

items.def: an intelligent sea mammal with a long nose
items.s: A group of ________ swam next to our boat, and they seemed to enjoy playing in the waves.
items.zh: 一群海豚在我們的船旁邊游泳,牠們似乎很享受在浪中嬉戲。

items.def: a sea mammal with flippers that lives in cold places
items.s: A ________ was lying on the rocks in the sun, and it did not seem worried by the tourists taking photos.
items.zh: 一隻海豹躺在岩石上曬太陽,而且牠似乎一點也不在意拍照的遊客。

items.def: a large turtle that lives in the ocean
items.s: A ______ ______ swam slowly past us while we were snorkelling off Xiaoliuqiu, and we kept a respectful distance.
items.zh: 我們在小琉球外海浮潛時,一隻海龜慢慢游過我們身邊,我們保持了尊重的距離。

items.def: a bird that lives near the sea and eats fish
items.s: The ________ dived into the water to catch a fish, but it accidentally swallowed a piece of plastic too.
items.zh: 那隻海鳥衝進水裡抓魚,但牠也不小心吞下了一片塑膠。

items.def: a black and white sea bird that cannot fly but swims well
items.s: A ________ cannot fly, but it is an excellent swimmer, so it can catch fish easily under the ice.
items.zh: 企鵝不會飛,但牠是很棒的游泳者,所以能輕鬆地在冰下捕魚。

items.def: the part of a fish used for breathing in water
items.s: Fish breathe through their ________, so they can take oxygen from the water but cannot live in the air.
items.zh: 魚透過鰓呼吸,所以牠們能從水中取得氧氣,但無法在空氣中存活。

items.def: a thin flat part of a fish that helps it swim
items.s: We saw a dark ________ above the water and thought it was a shark, but it turned out to be a friendly dolphin.
items.zh: 我們看到水面上有一個深色的鰭,以為是鯊魚,但結果是一隻友善的海豚。

items.def: a long, thin arm of an animal like an octopus or jellyfish
items.s: The jellyfish's ________ can be several metres long, so swimmers may be stung without even seeing it.
items.zh: 水母的觸手可能長達好幾公尺,所以泳客甚至沒看到牠就可能被螫。

items.def: the hard outer cover of some animals
items.s: My little brother collected a beautiful ________ from the beach, but I reminded him that some crabs need them as homes.
items.zh: 我弟弟從海灘撿了一個美麗的貝殼,但我提醒他有些螃蟹需要它們當家。

items.def: the thick layer of fat under the skin of whales and seals
items.s: Seals have a thick layer of ________ under their skin, so they can stay warm in icy water.
items.zh: 海豹皮膚下有一層厚厚的脂肪層,所以牠們能在冰冷的水中保暖。

items.def: a large group of fish swimming together
items.s: A huge ________ of silver fish moved together like one animal, and it quickly changed direction when a shark appeared.
items.zh: 一大群銀色的魚群像一隻動物般一起移動,而且當鯊魚出現時迅速改變方向。

items.def: an animal that eats by straining tiny food from water
items.s: The whale shark is a ______ ______, so although it is huge, it only eats tiny plankton and small fish.
items.zh: 鯨鯊是濾食動物,所以雖然牠很巨大,但只吃微小的浮游生物和小魚。

items.def: able to produce its own light
items.s: The waves glowed blue at night because of ________ plankton, and tourists came from far away to see it.
items.zh: 因為會發光的浮游生物,海浪在夜裡發出藍光,遊客從遠方前來觀賞。

items.def: living or growing in water
items.s: Frogs begin life as ________ animals, but adult frogs can live on land as well as in water.
items.zh: 青蛙一開始是水生動物,但成蛙既能在水中也能在陸地上生活。

items.def: a tiny soft animal that builds coral
items.s: Each coral ________ is smaller than a grain of rice, but millions of them together can build a huge reef.
items.zh: 每一隻珊瑚蟲都比一粒米還小,但數百萬隻聚在一起就能建造巨大的珊瑚礁。
items.sec: Coral Reefs & Coastal Habitats 珊瑚礁與海岸棲地

items.def: a close relationship between two living things that helps both
items.s: Coral and tiny algae live in ________, because the algae make food for the coral while the coral gives them a safe home.
items.zh: 珊瑚和微小的藻類處於共生關係,因為藻類為珊瑚製造食物,而珊瑚給它們一個安全的家。
items.sec: Coral Reefs & Coastal Habitats 珊瑚礁與海岸棲地

items.def: helping each other by living closely together
items.s: The clownfish and the anemone have a ________ relationship, so the fish gets protection while the anemone gets cleaned.
items.zh: 小丑魚和海葵有共生關係,所以魚得到保護,而海葵得到清潔。
items.sec: Coral Reefs & Coastal Habitats 珊瑚礁與海岸棲地

items.def: a very large, brown seaweed
items.s: Sea otters live among tall ________ in California, and they often wrap themselves in it so they do not float away while sleeping.
items.zh: 海獺生活在加州高大的巨藻間,而且牠們常把自己纏在裡面,這樣睡覺時才不會漂走。
items.sec: Coral Reefs & Coastal Habitats 珊瑚礁與海岸棲地

items.def: a plant that grows in the sea
items.s: Many Asian dishes use dried ________, and it is also becoming popular as a healthy snack in Western countries.
items.zh: 許多亞洲料理使用乾海苔,而它在西方國家也逐漸成為受歡迎的健康零食。
items.sec: Coral Reefs & Coastal Habitats 珊瑚礁與海岸棲地

items.def: grass-like plants that grow in shallow sea water
items.s: Green turtles feed on ________ in shallow bays, so protecting these underwater meadows also protects the turtles.
items.zh: 綠蠵龜在淺海灣以海草為食,所以保護這些水下草原也就保護了海龜。
items.sec: Coral Reefs & Coastal Habitats 珊瑚礁與海岸棲地

items.def: a small pool of sea water left among rocks at low tide
items.s: The children spent the morning looking into a ______ ______, and they found tiny fish, crabs and sea snails.
items.zh: 孩子們整個早上都在觀察一個潮池,他們發現了小魚、螃蟹和海螺。
items.sec: Coral Reefs & Coastal Habitats 珊瑚礁與海岸棲地

items.def: a long pile of sand in the sea near the coast
items.s: Our boat got stuck on a ________ at low tide, so we had to wait two hours for the water to rise again.
items.zh: 我們的船在退潮時卡在沙洲上,所以我們必須等兩個小時讓海水再次上漲。
items.sec: Coral Reefs & Coastal Habitats 珊瑚礁與海岸棲地

items.def: a hill of sand formed by the wind
items.s: Grass helps hold each ________ in place, so visitors are asked not to walk on the plants near the beach.
items.zh: 草有助於讓每座沙丘保持在原位,所以遊客被要求不要踩踏海灘附近的植物。
items.sec: Coral Reefs & Coastal Habitats 珊瑚礁與海岸棲地

items.def: between the high and low tide lines
items.s: Animals in the ________ zone must survive both dry air and sea water, because the tide covers them only part of the day.
items.zh: 潮間帶的動物必須在乾燥的空氣和海水中都能存活,因為潮水一天只淹沒牠們一段時間。
items.sec: Coral Reefs & Coastal Habitats 珊瑚礁與海岸棲地

items.def: wet coastal land covered with grass and flooded by the tide
items.s: The ______ ______ protects the village from storms, and it also provides food for thousands of birds every winter.
items.zh: 鹽沼保護村莊免受暴風侵襲,而且每年冬天也為數千隻鳥提供食物。
items.sec: Coral Reefs & Coastal Habitats 珊瑚礁與海岸棲地

items.def: a high, steep rock face, often by the sea
items.s: Seabirds build their nests on the ________ above the sea, so foxes and other animals cannot reach their eggs.
items.zh: 海鳥在海面上的懸崖築巢,所以狐狸和其他動物碰不到牠們的蛋。
items.sec: Coral Reefs & Coastal Habitats 珊瑚礁與海岸棲地

items.def: the land along the edge of the sea
items.s: We walked along the ________ at sunset, and we watched the fishing boats coming back into the harbour.
items.zh: 我們在日落時沿著海岸散步,看著漁船駛回港口。
items.sec: Coral Reefs & Coastal Habitats 珊瑚礁與海岸棲地

items.def: a small, smooth, round stone
items.s: The beach at Qixingtan is covered with ________ instead of sand, so it makes a lovely sound when the waves pull back.
items.zh: 七星潭的海灘上覆蓋著鵝卵石而不是沙子,所以當海浪退去時會發出美妙的聲音。
items.sec: Coral Reefs & Coastal Habitats 珊瑚礁與海岸棲地

items.def: a small sea animal that sticks to rocks and ships
items.s: Thousands of ________ grew on the bottom of the boat, so it moved more slowly and used more fuel.
items.zh: 數千隻藤壺長在船底,所以船移動得更慢,而且耗費更多燃料。
items.sec: Coral Reefs & Coastal Habitats 珊瑚礁與海岸棲地

items.def: a sea animal with many soft arms that looks like a flower
items.s: The ________ looks like a colourful flower, but its soft arms can sting small fish that swim too close.
items.zh: 海葵看起來像一朵色彩繽紛的花,但它柔軟的觸手會螫傷游得太近的小魚。
items.sec: Coral Reefs & Coastal Habitats 珊瑚礁與海岸棲地

items.def: a small orange and white fish that lives in anemones
items.s: After the famous cartoon came out, many children wanted a ________ as a pet, and wild numbers dropped in some places.
items.zh: 那部知名卡通上映後,許多孩子想要養小丑魚當寵物,而某些地方的野生數量因此下降。
items.sec: Coral Reefs & Coastal Habitats 珊瑚礁與海岸棲地

items.def: a soft sea animal shaped like a cucumber that lives on the sea floor
items.s: A ______ ______ cleans the sea floor by eating sand and waste, but it is overharvested because some people consider it a luxury food.
items.zh: 海參藉由吃沙子和廢物來清潔海床,但牠被過度採集,因為有些人把牠當作高級食材。
items.sec: Coral Reefs & Coastal Habitats 珊瑚礁與海岸棲地

items.def: to produce eggs in large numbers (of fish and other water animals)
items.s: Corals ________ on just a few nights each year, and divers travel far to see the water fill with tiny eggs.
items.zh: 珊瑚每年只在少數幾個夜晚產卵,而潛水員遠道而來觀看海水充滿微小的卵。
items.sec: Coral Reefs & Coastal Habitats 珊瑚礁與海岸棲地

items.def: a very young form of an animal before it changes into an adult
items.s: Each coral ________ drifts in the ocean for days, and then it settles on a rock to start a new colony.
items.zh: 每一隻珊瑚幼體在海洋中漂流好幾天,然後它會附著在岩石上開始一個新的群體。
items.sec: Coral Reefs & Coastal Habitats 珊瑚礁與海岸棲地

items.def: a place where young animals grow up safely
items.s: Mangrove roots are a ________ for young fish, because larger fish cannot swim between the thick roots.
items.zh: 紅樹林的根部是幼魚的育幼場,因為較大的魚無法在茂密的根之間游動。
items.sec: Coral Reefs & Coastal Habitats 珊瑚礁與海岸棲地

items.def: a type of white or grey rock formed from shells and coral
items.s: Kenting's coastline is made of ________ that was once an ancient coral reef, and you can still see fossils in the rocks.
items.zh: 墾丁的海岸線是由曾經是古老珊瑚礁的石灰岩構成的,而你仍能在岩石中看到化石。
items.sec: Coral Reefs & Coastal Habitats 珊瑚礁與海岸棲地

items.def: the hard structure that supports a body
items.s: When coral dies, its white ________ remains on the reef, but seaweed soon grows over it.
items.zh: 珊瑚死亡時,它白色的骨骼會留在礁上,但海藻很快就會長滿在上面。
items.sec: Coral Reefs & Coastal Habitats 珊瑚礁與海岸棲地

items.def: a chemical element found in bones, shells and coral
items.s: Coral uses ________ from sea water to build its hard skeleton, but warmer, more acidic water makes this harder.
items.zh: 珊瑚利用海水中的鈣建造堅硬的骨骼,但更溫暖、更酸的海水讓這件事變得更困難。
items.sec: Coral Reefs & Coastal Habitats 珊瑚礁與海岸棲地

items.def: to swim near the surface with a tube to breathe through
items.s: We went to ________ near Green Island, and we saw colourful fish only a few metres from the beach.
items.zh: 我們到綠島附近浮潛,而且在離海灘只有幾公尺的地方就看到色彩繽紛的魚。
items.sec: Coral Reefs & Coastal Habitats 珊瑚礁與海岸棲地

items.def: swimming deep underwater with an air tank
items.s: My cousin took a ______ ______ course last summer, and now she can explore reefs twenty metres underwater.
items.zh: 我表姊去年夏天上了水肺潛水課程,現在她可以探索水下二十公尺的珊瑚礁。
items.sec: Coral Reefs & Coastal Habitats 珊瑚礁與海岸棲地

items.def: a sea area where all fishing and collecting are banned
items.s: Fishing is completely banned in the ______ ______, so fish numbers there have grown quickly over the past ten years.
items.zh: 在禁漁區內完全禁止捕魚,所以那裡的魚群數量在過去十年快速成長。
items.sec: Coral Reefs & Coastal Habitats 珊瑚礁與海岸棲地

items.def: a person whose job is to watch and rescue swimmers
items.s: The ________ blew his whistle loudly, because a group of teenagers were swimming outside the safe area.
items.zh: 救生員大聲吹哨,因為一群青少年在安全區域外游泳。
items.sec: Coral Reefs & Coastal Habitats 珊瑚礁與海岸棲地

items.def: a strong current that flows quickly away from the beach
items.s: If a ______ ______ pulls you out to sea, swim parallel to the beach instead of fighting against the water.
items.zh: 如果離岸流把你拉向外海,要與海灘平行地游,而不是逆著水流掙扎。
items.sec: Coral Reefs & Coastal Habitats 珊瑚礁與海岸棲地

items.def: a wall built into the sea to protect a harbour from waves
items.s: The new ________ protects the harbour from big waves, but some people worry that it has changed the beach nearby.
items.zh: 新的防波堤保護港口不受大浪侵襲,但有些人擔心它改變了附近的海灘。
items.sec: Coral Reefs & Coastal Habitats 珊瑚礁與海岸棲地

items.def: a long structure built from the land out over the sea
items.s: We walked to the end of the ________ to watch the sunset, and an old man there was fishing quietly.
items.zh: 我們走到碼頭盡頭看夕陽,那裡有一位老人正安靜地釣魚。
items.sec: Coral Reefs & Coastal Habitats 珊瑚礁與海岸棲地

items.def: a tower with a bright light that warns ships of danger
items.s: The old ________ at Eluanbi has guided ships for over a hundred years, and it is now a popular tourist spot.
items.zh: 鵝鑾鼻的老燈塔已經為船隻導航超過一百年,而它現在是熱門的觀光景點。
items.sec: Coral Reefs & Coastal Habitats 珊瑚礁與海岸棲地

items.def: a large group of fish swimming together
items.s: A ________ of sardines turned silver in the sunlight, and the divers watched as it twisted and turned around them.
items.zh: 一群沙丁魚魚群在陽光下閃著銀光,潛水員看著牠們在身邊扭轉迴旋。
items.sec: Coral Reefs & Coastal Habitats 珊瑚礁與海岸棲地

items.def: the scientific study of the ocean
items.s: My cousin is studying ________ at university, and she spends a month at sea every year collecting water samples.
items.zh: 我表姊在大學讀海洋學,而且她每年都會在海上待一個月採集海水樣本。
items.sec: Ocean Science & Exploration 海洋科學與探索

items.def: a scientist who studies the ocean
items.s: An ________ explained on TV that the ocean is getting warmer, and she warned that fish are moving to cooler waters.
items.zh: 一位海洋學家在電視上解釋海洋正在變暖,而且她警告魚類正遷往較涼的水域。
items.sec: Ocean Science & Exploration 海洋科學與探索

items.def: a scientist who studies living things in the sea
items.s: I want to become a ______ ______ because I love sea animals, and I hope to help protect coral reefs one day.
items.zh: 我想成為海洋生物學家,因為我熱愛海洋動物,而且我希望有一天能幫忙保護珊瑚礁。
items.sec: Ocean Science & Exploration 海洋科學與探索

items.def: a ship that can travel underwater
items.s: The tourist ________ took us forty metres under the sea, and we watched sharks through the large windows.
items.zh: 觀光潛水艇帶我們到海面下四十公尺,我們透過大窗戶觀看鯊魚。
items.sec: Ocean Science & Exploration 海洋科學與探索

items.def: a small underwater vehicle used for research
items.s: The scientists used a ________ to reach the deep sea floor, because divers cannot survive the pressure there.
items.zh: 科學家使用深潛器抵達深海海床,因為潛水員無法承受那裡的壓力。
items.sec: Ocean Science & Exploration 海洋科學與探索

items.def: a system that uses sound to find objects underwater
items.s: The ship used ________ to map the sea floor, but scientists worry that the loud sounds may confuse whales.
items.zh: 這艘船使用聲納繪製海床地圖,但科學家擔心巨大的聲響可能讓鯨魚感到混亂。
items.sec: Ocean Science & Exploration 海洋科學與探索

items.def: a floating object in the sea used as a marker or to measure things
items.s: A yellow ________ floats above the reef to show boats where they can tie up, so they do not drop anchors on the coral.
items.zh: 一個黃色浮標漂浮在珊瑚礁上方,告訴船隻可以在哪裡繫泊,這樣它們就不會把錨丟在珊瑚上。
items.sec: Ocean Science & Exploration 海洋科學與探索

items.def: a tool sent to collect information from a place that is hard to reach
items.s: Researchers lowered a ________ into the deep water, and it sent back data about temperature and oxygen levels.
items.zh: 研究人員把探測器放入深水中,它傳回有關溫度和氧氣含量的數據。
items.sec: Ocean Science & Exploration 海洋科學與探索

items.def: an organised journey to explore or study something
items.s: The team went on a three-month ________ to Antarctica, and they discovered several new kinds of sea creatures.
items.zh: 團隊前往南極進行為期三個月的考察,而且他們發現了好幾種新的海洋生物。
items.sec: Ocean Science & Exploration 海洋科學與探索

items.def: a person who travels to unknown places to learn about them
items.s: The famous ocean ________ spent his life studying the sea, and his films made millions of people love marine life.
items.zh: 這位著名的海洋探險家一生都在研究海洋,而他的影片讓數百萬人愛上海洋生物。
items.sec: Ocean Science & Exploration 海洋科學與探索

items.def: to find the way when travelling, especially by sea
items.s: Ancient sailors used the stars to ________ across the Pacific, although they had no maps or modern instruments.
items.zh: 古代水手利用星星航行橫越太平洋,儘管他們沒有地圖或現代儀器。
items.sec: Ocean Science & Exploration 海洋科學與探索

items.def: the skill of planning and following a route
items.s: Modern ________ depends on satellites, but sailors still learn to use maps in case the electronic system fails.
items.zh: 現代導航仰賴衛星,但水手仍然學習使用地圖,以防電子系統故障。
items.sec: Ocean Science & Exploration 海洋科學與探索

items.def: a long journey by sea
items.s: The ________ from Taiwan to Japan took three days, and many passengers felt seasick during the stormy weather.
items.zh: 從台灣到日本的航程花了三天,而且許多乘客在暴風雨天氣中感到暈船。
items.sec: Ocean Science & Exploration 海洋科學與探索

items.def: a ship or large boat
items.s: The research ________ carries a small lab, so scientists can study samples while they are still at sea.
items.zh: 這艘研究船上載有一間小實驗室,所以科學家仍在海上時就能研究樣本。
items.sec: Ocean Science & Exploration 海洋科學與探索

items.def: the people who work on a ship
items.s: The ________ worked through the night to repair the engine, because the ship was drifting toward dangerous rocks.
items.zh: 船員們徹夜工作修理引擎,因為船正漂向危險的岩石。
items.sec: Ocean Science & Exploration 海洋科學與探索

items.def: found or happening in the deepest parts of the ocean
items.s: ________ fish often look strange, and some have glowing lights that help them catch food in the dark.
items.zh: 深海魚常常長得很奇特,而且有些有發光器幫助牠們在黑暗中捕捉食物。
items.sec: Ocean Science & Exploration 海洋科學與探索

items.def: the force of water pushing on something
items.s: ______ ______ increases as you go deeper, so divers must come up slowly to stay safe.
items.zh: 水壓會隨著你潛得越深而增加,所以潛水員必須慢慢上升才能保持安全。
items.sec: Ocean Science & Exploration 海洋科學與探索

items.def: sand, mud and stones that settle at the bottom of water
items.s: Scientists study ________ from the sea floor, because it holds clues about the climate thousands of years ago.
items.zh: 科學家研究海床的沉積物,因為它保存了數千年前氣候的線索。
items.sec: Ocean Science & Exploration 海洋科學與探索

items.def: to make a map of an area, especially of the sea
items.s: Early sailors had to ________ the coastline carefully, because hidden rocks could easily sink their ships.
items.zh: 早期水手必須仔細繪製海岸線的地圖,因為隱藏的礁石很容易讓船沉沒。
items.sec: Ocean Science & Exploration 海洋科學與探索

items.def: to go under water, often with special equipment
items.s: We plan to ________ near the shipwreck tomorrow, but the trip will be cancelled if the sea is too rough.
items.zh: 我們計畫明天在沉船附近潛水,但如果海象太差,行程就會取消。
items.sec: Ocean Science & Exploration 海洋科學與探索

items.def: a person who swims underwater, often for work or sport
items.s: The ________ checked his air tank twice before jumping in, because a small mistake can be very dangerous underwater.
items.zh: 那位潛水員跳下水前檢查了他的氣瓶兩次,因為在水下一個小錯誤就可能非常危險。
items.sec: Ocean Science & Exploration 海洋科學與探索

items.def: a tight rubber suit that keeps you warm in water
items.s: The water was only eighteen degrees, so I wore a thick ________ and stayed warm for the whole dive.
items.zh: 海水只有十八度,所以我穿了一件厚防寒衣,整趟潛水都保持溫暖。
items.sec: Ocean Science & Exploration 海洋科學與探索

items.def: below the surface of water
items.s: She bought an ________ camera before her holiday, and she took amazing photos of turtles and coral.
items.zh: 她在假期前買了一台水下相機,而且拍了很棒的海龜和珊瑚照片。
items.sec: Ocean Science & Exploration 海洋科學與探索

items.def: a machine in space that sends information back to Earth
items.s: Data from a ________ shows that sea temperatures are rising, so scientists can warn reef managers in advance.
items.zh: 來自衛星的數據顯示海水溫度正在上升,所以科學家能事先警告珊瑚礁管理人員。
items.sec: Ocean Science & Exploration 海洋科學與探索

items.def: not yet mapped or explored
items.cn: 未知的;海圖上未標明的
items.s: Large parts of the sea floor are still ________, so explorers may discover new mountains and canyons in the future.
items.zh: 海床的大部分地區仍然未被繪製,所以探險家未來可能會發現新的山脈和峽谷。
items.sec: Ocean Science & Exploration 海洋科學與探索

items.def: not yet visited or studied
items.s: More than eighty percent of the ocean is ________, and scientists believe millions of species are still unknown.
items.zh: 超過百分之八十的海洋尚未被探索,而且科學家相信仍有數百萬個物種不為人知。
items.sec: Ocean Science & Exploration 海洋科學與探索

items.def: a tool with a needle that always points north
items.s: The sailor checked his ________ because the clouds were hiding the stars, and he did not want to lose his way.
items.zh: 那名水手查看他的指南針,因為雲層遮住了星星,而他不想迷失方向。
items.sec: Ocean Science & Exploration 海洋科學與探索

items.def: a heavy metal object dropped to stop a boat from moving
items.s: Boats should never drop an ________ on coral, because it can break plants and animals that took years to grow.
items.zh: 船隻絕不應該把錨丟在珊瑚上,因為它會破壞花了好幾年才長成的動植物。
items.sec: Ocean Science & Exploration 海洋科學與探索

items.def: the main body of a ship
items.s: The ________ of the ship was damaged by rocks, so water began to come in and the crew called for help.
items.zh: 船的船體被岩石撞壞,所以海水開始流入,船員發出求救訊號。
items.sec: Ocean Science & Exploration 海洋科學與探索

items.def: a sheltered area of water where ships can stay safely
items.s: All the fishing boats returned to the ________ before the typhoon arrived, and the fishermen tied them together tightly.
items.zh: 所有漁船在颱風來臨前回到港口,漁民們把船緊緊地綁在一起。
items.sec: Ocean Science & Exploration 海洋科學與探索

items.def: to go down below the surface of water
items.s: The old ship hit an iceberg and ________ in less than three hours, so many passengers did not have time to escape.
items.zh: 那艘老船撞上冰山,不到三小時就沉沒了,所以許多乘客來不及逃生。
items.sec: Ocean Science & Exploration 海洋科學與探索

items.def: the remains of a ship that has sunk
items.s: The ________ has become an artificial reef, and divers love to see the fish living inside it.
items.zh: 這艘沉船已經成為人工魚礁,而潛水員喜歡觀看住在裡面的魚。
items.sec: Ocean Science & Exploration 海洋科學與探索

items.def: to save goods or a ship from damage or the sea
items.s: The company tried to ________ the cargo from the sunken ship, but strong currents made the work very slow.
items.zh: 公司試著從沉船中打撈貨物,但強勁的海流讓工作進行得非常緩慢。
items.sec: Ocean Science & Exploration 海洋科學與探索

items.def: a very small piece of plastic less than 5 mm long
items.s: Scientists found ________ in the stomachs of many fish, and some of these tiny pieces may end up in our food.
items.zh: 科學家在許多魚的胃裡發現塑膠微粒,而這些微小碎片有些可能最後進入我們的食物。
items.sec: Threats to the Ocean 海洋威脅

items.def: an accident in which oil escapes into the sea
items.s: The ______ ______ covered the beach in black oil, and volunteers spent weeks cleaning birds and rocks.
items.zh: 漏油讓海灘覆蓋上黑色的油,志工們花了好幾週清洗鳥類和岩石。
items.sec: Threats to the Ocean 海洋威脅

items.def: rain water that flows from land into rivers and the sea, carrying dirt and chemicals
items.s: Farm ________ carries fertiliser into the sea after heavy rain, so harmful algae can grow very quickly.
items.zh: 大雨過後,農田逕流把肥料帶入海中,所以有害的藻類會迅速生長。
items.sec: Threats to the Ocean 海洋威脅

items.def: dirty water and waste from toilets and drains
items.s: Some coastal towns still release ________ straight into the sea, so swimmers may get sick after a day at the beach.
items.zh: 一些沿海城鎮仍然把污水直接排入海中,所以泳客在海灘待一天後可能會生病。
items.sec: Threats to the Ocean 海洋威脅

items.def: to throw away waste in a careless or illegal way
items.s: Some factories secretly ________ chemicals into rivers at night, but the waste still flows into the ocean.
items.zh: 有些工廠在夜間偷偷把化學物質傾倒到河裡,但這些廢物仍會流入海洋。
