items.sec: Threats to the Ocean 海洋威脅

items.def: an event where people collect rubbish from a beach
items.s: Our class joined a ______ ______ last Saturday, and we were shocked by how many bottle caps we found in the sand.
items.zh: 我們班上週六參加了淨灘活動,而我們對在沙子裡找到那麼多瓶蓋感到震驚。
items.sec: Threats to the Ocean 海洋威脅

items.def: a large area of the ocean where floating rubbish collects
items.s: The Great Pacific ______ ______ is not a solid island, but it contains millions of small pieces of floating plastic.
items.zh: 太平洋垃圾帶不是一座實心的島,但它含有數百萬片漂浮的小塑膠碎片。
items.sec: Threats to the Ocean 海洋威脅

items.def: a fishing net that has been lost or left in the sea
items.s: A ______ ______ can keep catching fish for years after it is lost, so divers work hard to remove them from reefs.
items.zh: 幽靈漁網遺失後仍能持續捕到魚好幾年,所以潛水員努力把它們從珊瑚礁上移除。
items.sec: Threats to the Ocean 海洋威脅

items.def: to catch something so that it cannot get free
items.s: Old fishing lines can ________ turtles and seals, and many of these animals die because they cannot swim or eat.
items.zh: 舊的釣魚線可能纏住海龜和海豹,而許多這些動物因為無法游泳或進食而死亡。
items.sec: Threats to the Ocean 海洋威脅

items.def: an area of sea with too little oxygen for most life
items.s: Fertiliser has created a ______ ______ near the river mouth, and almost no fish can survive there in summer.
items.zh: 肥料在河口附近造成了一個死區,而夏天幾乎沒有魚能在那裡存活。
items.sec: Threats to the Ocean 海洋威脅

items.def: a condition of having too little oxygen
items.s: ________ in coastal waters is becoming more common, because warm water holds less oxygen than cold water.
items.zh: 沿岸水域的缺氧現象越來越常見,因為溫水所含的氧氣比冷水少。
items.sec: Threats to the Ocean 海洋威脅

items.def: too many nutrients in water, which causes plants to grow too much
items.s: ________ happens when too many nutrients enter the water, so the lake turns green and fish begin to die.
items.zh: 當太多養分進入水中時就會發生優養化,所以湖水變綠,魚也開始死亡。
items.sec: Threats to the Ocean 海洋威脅

items.def: a fast increase of algae in water
items.s: An ______ ______ turned the water bright green, and the government closed the beach because the water was unsafe.
items.zh: 藻華讓海水變成鮮綠色,而政府關閉了海灘,因為海水不安全。
items.sec: Threats to the Ocean 海洋威脅

items.def: a harmful algae bloom that makes the sea look red
items.s: Shellfish from the area were banned during the ______ ______, because eating them could make people seriously ill.
items.zh: 紅潮期間禁止販售該地區的有殼海鮮,因為吃了可能讓人嚴重生病。
items.sec: Threats to the Ocean 海洋威脅

items.def: a poisonous substance made by a living thing
items.s: Some algae produce a ________ that builds up in shellfish, so people can get sick even when the seafood looks fresh.
items.zh: 有些藻類會產生在貝類體內累積的毒素,所以即使海鮮看起來很新鮮,人們還是可能生病。
items.sec: Threats to the Ocean 海洋威脅

items.def: a poisonous silver metal that can build up in fish
items.s: Large fish like tuna may contain ________, so doctors advise pregnant women to eat them only once in a while.
items.zh: 像鮪魚這樣的大型魚可能含有汞,所以醫生建議孕婦只偶爾吃。
items.sec: Threats to the Ocean 海洋威脅

items.def: a dangerous metal such as lead or mercury
items.s: A ______ ______ like lead can stay in the sea for a long time, and it slowly builds up in the bodies of marine animals.
items.zh: 像鉛這樣的重金屬能在海中停留很久,而且它會慢慢在海洋動物體內累積。
items.sec: Threats to the Ocean 海洋威脅

items.def: harmful or annoying levels of noise
items.s: Ships create a lot of ______ ______ underwater, so whales find it harder to hear each other over long distances.
items.zh: 船隻在水下製造大量噪音污染,所以鯨魚更難在遠距離聽到彼此。
items.sec: Threats to the Ocean 海洋威脅

items.def: to let a liquid or gas flow out
items.s: Factories are not allowed to ________ hot water into the bay, because sudden warming can kill coral and fish.
items.zh: 工廠不准把熱水排放到海灣中,因為突然升溫會殺死珊瑚和魚類。
items.sec: Threats to the Ocean 海洋威脅

items.def: to dig mud and sand from the bottom of a river, harbour or sea
items.s: The port plans to ________ the harbour to let bigger ships in, but environmental groups say it will destroy seagrass.
items.zh: 港務單位計畫疏浚港口讓更大的船隻進入,但環保團體說這會破壞海草。
items.sec: Threats to the Ocean 海洋威脅

items.def: sea water carried in a ship to keep it steady
items.s: Ships carry ______ ______ from one country to another, so tiny foreign animals can be released into new seas.
items.zh: 船隻把壓艙水從一個國家帶到另一個國家,所以微小的外來生物可能被釋放到新的海域。
items.sec: Threats to the Ocean 海洋威脅

items.def: a very small living thing that causes disease
items.s: A new ________ has killed many starfish along the coast, and scientists think warmer water helped it spread.
items.zh: 一種新的病原體已經殺死沿岸許多海星,而科學家認為較溫暖的海水幫助它擴散。
items.sec: Threats to the Ocean 海洋威脅

items.def: made to be used once and then thrown away
items.s: Our school stopped selling drinks in ________ bottles, and students now bring their own water bottles every day.
items.zh: 我們學校停止販售一次性瓶裝飲料,而學生們現在每天自己帶水瓶。
items.sec: Threats to the Ocean 海洋威脅

items.def: a thin tube used for drinking
items.s: Many cafés in Taipei have stopped giving out a plastic ________ with each drink, so customers use paper or metal ones instead.
items.zh: 台北許多咖啡店已經不再每杯飲料附上塑膠吸管,所以顧客改用紙製或金屬吸管。
items.sec: Threats to the Ocean 海洋威脅

items.def: the materials used to wrap or protect goods
items.s: Online shopping creates a lot of ________, and much of this plastic ends up in rivers and then the sea.
items.zh: 網路購物產生大量包裝,而這些塑膠很多最後流入河川,然後進入海洋。
items.sec: Threats to the Ocean 海洋威脅

items.def: able to break down naturally without harming nature
items.s: The shop uses ________ bags made from corn, so they break down naturally instead of polluting the ocean.
items.zh: 這家店使用玉米製成的可生物分解袋子,所以它們會自然分解,而不會污染海洋。
items.sec: Threats to the Ocean 海洋威脅

items.def: to break down slowly into smaller parts
items.s: Plastic bottles take hundreds of years to ________, so the ones we throw away today will still be in the sea in 2400.
items.zh: 塑膠瓶需要數百年才能分解,所以我們今天丟掉的瓶子到了2400年仍會在海中。
items.sec: Threats to the Ocean 海洋威脅

items.def: to take food or other things into the body
items.s: Turtles often ________ plastic bags by mistake, because the bags look like jellyfish floating in the water.
items.zh: 海龜常常誤吞塑膠袋,因為袋子看起來就像漂浮在水中的水母。
items.sec: Threats to the Ocean 海洋威脅

items.def: to die because there is no air or oxygen
items.s: Fish ________ when there is too little oxygen in the water, and thousands may wash up on the beach at once.
items.zh: 當水中氧氣太少時,魚會窒息,而且可能一次有數千條被沖上海灘。
items.sec: Threats to the Ocean 海洋威脅

items.def: to be unable to breathe because something blocks the throat
items.s: Seabirds can ________ on bottle caps, because they mistake the bright plastic for small fish.
items.zh: 海鳥可能被瓶蓋噎住,因為牠們把鮮豔的塑膠誤認為小魚。
items.sec: Threats to the Ocean 海洋威脅

items.def: the dead body of an animal
items.s: A whale ________ washed up on the beach last week, and scientists found more than twenty kilograms of plastic in its stomach.
items.zh: 上週一具鯨魚屍體被沖上海灘,而科學家在牠的胃裡發現超過二十公斤的塑膠。
items.sec: Threats to the Ocean 海洋威脅

items.def: to leave a sea animal stuck on land and unable to return
items.s: Low tides sometimes ________ dolphins on the beach, so local volunteers keep them wet until the water returns.
items.zh: 退潮有時會使海豚擱淺在海灘上,所以當地志工會讓牠們保持濕潤,直到海水回來。
items.sec: Threats to the Ocean 海洋威脅

items.def: made to be thrown away after use
items.s: ________ chopsticks and cups are convenient, but they create mountains of waste that often end up in the sea.
items.zh: 免洗筷子和杯子很方便,但它們製造了堆積如山的垃圾,而這些垃圾常常最後流入大海。
items.sec: Threats to the Ocean 海洋威脅

items.def: an area or business where fish are caught
items.s: The local ________ closed for three months, so fish numbers could recover after years of heavy fishing.
items.zh: 當地漁場關閉三個月,好讓魚群數量在多年的大量捕撈後得以恢復。
items.sec: Fishing, Shipping & Ocean Resources 漁業、航運與海洋資源

items.def: a person who catches fish as a job
items.s: My grandfather was a ________ for forty years, and he says there were far more fish in the sea when he was young.
items.zh: 我爺爺當了四十年的漁夫,而他說他年輕時海裡的魚多得多。
items.sec: Fishing, Shipping & Ocean Resources 漁業、航運與海洋資源

items.def: a large fishing boat that pulls a big net
items.s: A huge ________ can catch tons of fish in one day, but it also catches many animals that nobody wants to eat.
items.zh: 一艘巨大的拖網漁船一天就能捕到好幾噸的魚,但它也捕到許多沒人想吃的動物。
items.sec: Fishing, Shipping & Ocean Resources 漁業、航運與海洋資源

items.def: to catch fish by pulling a large net through the water
items.s: Boats that ________ along the sea floor damage coral and sponges, so some countries have banned this method.
items.zh: 沿著海床拖網捕魚的船隻會破壞珊瑚和海綿,所以一些國家已經禁止這種方法。
items.sec: Fishing, Shipping & Ocean Resources 漁業、航運與海洋資源

items.def: a very long fishing line with thousands of hooks
items.s: A single ________ can stretch for many kilometres, and sea turtles and birds are sometimes caught on its hooks.
items.zh: 一條延繩釣可以延伸好幾公里,而且海龜和海鳥有時會被它的鉤子鉤住。
items.sec: Fishing, Shipping & Ocean Resources 漁業、航運與海洋資源

items.def: to get hold of a fish or animal
items.s: My father ________ three large fish yesterday, but he let the smallest one go because it was too young.
items.zh: 我爸爸昨天捕到三條大魚,但他把最小的那條放走了,因為牠太小了。
items.sec: Fishing, Shipping & Ocean Resources 漁業、航運與海洋資源

items.def: the amount of fish of one kind in an area
items.s: The ______ ______ of tuna has fallen sharply, so the government has limited how many fish each boat can catch.
items.zh: 鮪魚的魚群存量已經大幅下降,所以政府限制了每艘船能捕撈的魚量。
items.sec: Fishing, Shipping & Ocean Resources 漁業、航運與海洋資源

items.def: the farming of fish and other sea creatures
items.s: ________ provides about half of the seafood we eat today, but badly run farms can pollute the water nearby.
items.zh: 水產養殖提供了我們今天所吃海鮮的大約一半,但管理不善的養殖場會污染附近的水域。
items.sec: Fishing, Shipping & Ocean Resources 漁業、航運與海洋資源

items.def: a place where fish are raised for food
items.s: The ______ ______ near our village raises milkfish, and it sells them to restaurants all over southern Taiwan.
items.zh: 我們村子附近的養魚場養殖虱目魚,而且把牠們賣給台灣南部各地的餐廳。
items.sec: Fishing, Shipping & Ocean Resources 漁業、航運與海洋資源

items.def: fish and shellfish eaten as food
items.s: We had fresh ________ at the night market, and my brother tried grilled squid for the first time.
items.zh: 我們在夜市吃了新鮮的海鮮,而我弟弟第一次嚐試了烤魷魚。
items.sec: Fishing, Shipping & Ocean Resources 漁業、航運與海洋資源

items.def: a large sea fish often eaten in sushi or from cans
items.s: Bluefin ________ is very popular in sushi restaurants, but its numbers dropped sharply because of overfishing.
items.zh: 黑鮪魚在壽司店非常受歡迎,但牠的數量因為過度捕撈而大幅減少。
items.sec: Fishing, Shipping & Ocean Resources 漁業、航運與海洋資源

items.def: a fish with pink flesh that swims from the sea up rivers to lay eggs
items.s: Every autumn, ________ swim up rivers to lay their eggs, and bears wait by the water to catch them.
items.zh: 每年秋天,鮭魚會逆流而上產卵,而熊會在水邊等著抓牠們。
items.sec: Fishing, Shipping & Ocean Resources 漁業、航運與海洋資源

items.def: a small sea animal with a shell that people eat
items.s: Mangroves are often cut down to build ________ farms, so coastlines lose their natural protection from storms.
items.zh: 紅樹林常被砍伐來興建蝦場,所以海岸線失去了抵擋暴風的天然屏障。
items.sec: Fishing, Shipping & Ocean Resources 漁業、航運與海洋資源

items.def: a town or city with a harbour where ships load and unload
items.s: Kaohsiung is a busy ________, and huge ships arrive there every day from all over the world.
items.zh: 高雄是個繁忙的港口,而巨大的船隻每天從世界各地抵達那裡。
items.sec: Fishing, Shipping & Ocean Resources 漁業、航運與海洋資源

items.def: goods carried by a ship, plane or truck
items.s: The ship was carrying ________ from China to Europe, but a storm forced it to stop in Singapore.
items.zh: 這艘船正把貨物從中國運往歐洲,但一場暴風雨迫使它停靠新加坡。
items.sec: Fishing, Shipping & Ocean Resources 漁業、航運與海洋資源

items.def: a large ship that carries goods in big metal boxes
items.s: A ______ ______ got stuck in the Suez Canal in 2021, and hundreds of other ships had to wait for days.
items.zh: 2021年一艘貨櫃船卡在蘇伊士運河,而數百艘其他船隻必須等好幾天。
items.sec: Fishing, Shipping & Ocean Resources 漁業、航運與海洋資源

items.def: a ship that carries oil or other liquids
items.s: The oil ________ ran into rocks near the coast, so thousands of tonnes of oil leaked into the sea.
items.zh: 那艘油輪在海岸附近撞上岩石,所以數千噸的石油漏入海中。
items.sec: Fishing, Shipping & Ocean Resources 漁業、航運與海洋資源

items.def: goods carried by ship, train or plane
items.s: Most international ________ travels by sea because it is cheaper, although air transport is much faster.
items.zh: 大部分國際貨運走海運,因為比較便宜,雖然空運快得多。
items.sec: Fishing, Shipping & Ocean Resources 漁業、航運與海洋資源

items.def: a regular route used by ships at sea
items.s: The ______ ______ passes close to a whale feeding area, so ships are asked to slow down during certain months.
items.zh: 這條航道靠近鯨魚的覓食區,所以船隻在某些月份被要求減速。
items.sec: Fishing, Shipping & Ocean Resources 漁業、航運與海洋資源

items.def: a large structure used to get oil from under the sea
items.s: Workers on the ______ ______ live at sea for weeks at a time, and they fly home by helicopter.
items.zh: 鑽油平台上的工人一次在海上住好幾週,而且他們搭直升機回家。
items.sec: Fishing, Shipping & Ocean Resources 漁業、航運與海洋資源

items.def: making deep holes in the ground to find oil or gas
items.s: Offshore ________ brings money to the region, but many residents worry about another oil spill.
items.zh: 離岸鑽探為地區帶來收入,但許多居民擔心再次發生漏油。
items.sec: Fishing, Shipping & Ocean Resources 漁業、航運與海洋資源

items.def: a natural substance such as metal found in rock
items.s: The sea floor contains many valuable ________, but mining them could destroy habitats that we barely understand.
items.zh: 海床含有許多珍貴的礦物,但開採它們可能會破壞我們幾乎不了解的棲地。
items.sec: Fishing, Shipping & Ocean Resources 漁業、航運與海洋資源

items.def: a small round lump of mineral found on the sea floor
items.s: Each metal ________ on the sea floor took millions of years to form, so mining companies cannot simply wait for more.
items.zh: 海床上的每一顆金屬結核都花了數百萬年才形成,所以採礦公司無法單純等它再長出來。
items.sec: Fishing, Shipping & Ocean Resources 漁業、航運與海洋資源

items.def: electricity made from the movement of sea waves
items.s: Taiwan is surrounded by the sea, so ______ ______ could become an important source of clean energy in the future.
items.zh: 台灣四面環海,所以波浪發電未來可能成為重要的乾淨能源來源。
items.sec: Fishing, Shipping & Ocean Resources 漁業、航運與海洋資源

items.def: an area of sea where many fish are caught
items.s: The waters near Penghu are a rich ______ ______, and fishermen there have caught squid for generations.
items.zh: 澎湖附近的海域是豐富的漁場,那裡的漁民世世代代都在捕魷魚。
items.sec: Fishing, Shipping & Ocean Resources 漁業、航運與海洋資源

items.def: the hunting of whales
items.s: Most countries have banned ________, but a few still hunt whales and say it is part of their culture.
items.zh: 大多數國家已經禁止捕鯨,但少數國家仍然獵捕鯨魚,並說這是他們文化的一部分。
items.sec: Fishing, Shipping & Ocean Resources 漁業、航運與海洋資源

items.def: a long spear used to hunt whales and large fish
items.s: In the past, hunters threw a ________ by hand, but modern whaling ships use guns that fire them.
items.zh: 過去,獵人用手投擲魚叉,但現代捕鯨船使用發射魚叉的槍。
items.sec: Fishing, Shipping & Ocean Resources 漁業、航運與海洋資源

items.def: food put on a hook or in a trap to catch fish or animals
items.s: We used small pieces of squid as ________, and within ten minutes my sister caught her first fish.
items.zh: 我們用小塊魷魚當魚餌,不到十分鐘我妹妹就釣到她的第一條魚。
items.sec: Fishing, Shipping & Ocean Resources 漁業、航運與海洋資源

items.def: to use too much of a natural resource so it cannot recover
items.s: If we continue to ________ the sea, there may be almost no large fish left by the end of this century.
items.zh: 如果我們繼續過度利用海洋,到本世紀末可能幾乎不剩任何大型魚類。
items.sec: Fishing, Shipping & Ocean Resources 漁業、航運與海洋資源

items.def: a small, shiny white ball that grows inside an oyster
items.s: Each ________ takes years to grow inside an oyster, so natural ones are rare and very expensive.
items.zh: 每一顆珍珠都要在牡蠣裡花好幾年才能長成,所以天然珍珠很稀少且非常昂貴。
items.sec: Fishing, Shipping & Ocean Resources 漁業、航運與海洋資源

items.def: the organisation that protects people and controls activity along the coast
items.s: The ________ rescued five fishermen after their boat sank, and they also arrested a ship that was fishing illegally.
items.zh: 海巡在漁船沉沒後救起五名漁民,而且他們也逮捕了一艘非法捕魚的船。
items.sec: Fishing, Shipping & Ocean Resources 漁業、航運與海洋資源

items.def: a group of ships that work together
items.s: The country's fishing ________ has grown to over 2,000 boats, so experts worry that fish cannot reproduce fast enough.
items.zh: 該國的捕魚船隊已經成長到超過兩千艘船,所以專家擔心魚類繁殖的速度跟不上。
items.sec: Fishing, Shipping & Ocean Resources 漁業、航運與海洋資源

items.def: a net used for catching fish
items.s: An old ______ ______ was stuck on the reef, and the divers spent an hour cutting it free.
items.zh: 一張舊漁網卡在珊瑚礁上,潛水員們花了一個小時把它割下來。
items.sec: Fishing, Shipping & Ocean Resources 漁業、航運與海洋資源

items.def: a very large amount of something
items.s: There is an ________ of fish around the protected reef, so local divers earn more money from tourists than before.
items.zh: 受保護的珊瑚礁周圍有大量的魚,所以當地潛水員從遊客身上賺的錢比以前多。

items.def: to follow a rule or agreement closely
items.s: All boats must ________ to the new speed limits in the bay, or they will have to pay a heavy fine.
items.zh: 所有船隻都必須遵守海灣新的速限,否則將被處以重罰。

items.def: the arrival or beginning of something important
items.s: Since the ________ of cheap plastic in the 1950s, the amount of rubbish in the ocean has grown every year.
items.zh: 自從1950年代廉價塑膠出現以來,海洋中的垃圾量每年都在增加。

items.def: more than enough
items.s: The research ship carries ________ food and fuel for two months, so the scientists do not need to return to port often.
items.zh: 研究船載有足夠兩個月的充足食物和燃料,所以科學家不需要常常返港。

items.def: similar in some way
items.s: A coral reef is ________ to a busy city, because thousands of different creatures live and work closely together.
items.zh: 珊瑚礁類似一座繁忙的城市,因為成千上萬種不同的生物緊密地一起生活和運作。

items.def: equipment used for a particular purpose
items.s: Divers must check their breathing ________ carefully, because one broken part could put their lives in danger.
items.zh: 潛水員必須仔細檢查他們的呼吸設備,因為一個損壞的零件就可能危及生命。

items.def: large enough to be noticed
items.s: The ban on plastic bags led to an ________ drop in beach litter, and volunteers noticed the change within a year.
items.zh: 塑膠袋禁令讓海灘垃圾明顯減少,而志工在一年內就注意到這個改變。

items.def: an official check of records or activities
items.s: The government carried out an ________ of all fishing boats, and it found that some were catching more than allowed.
items.zh: 政府對所有漁船進行稽核,並發現有些船的捕撈量超過規定。

items.def: the freedom to make your own decisions
items.s: Local fishing villages want more ________ over their waters, because they understand the sea better than officials in the city.
items.zh: 當地漁村希望對自己的水域有更多自主權,因為他們比城市裡的官員更了解大海。

items.def: to provide what people need or want
items.s: The aquarium has special tours that ________ to young children, so families with toddlers can enjoy the visit too.
items.zh: 水族館有專門迎合幼童的導覽,所以有幼兒的家庭也能享受參觀。

items.def: to force someone to do something
items.s: Rising fuel prices ________ many fishermen to stay in port, so fresh seafood became more expensive at the market.
items.zh: 上漲的油價迫使許多漁民留在港內,所以市場上的新鮮海鮮變得更貴。

items.def: helping something to happen
items.s: Warm, clear water is ________ to coral growth, but water that is too hot can kill the reef.
items.zh: 溫暖清澈的海水有助於珊瑚生長,但太熱的海水會殺死珊瑚礁。

items.def: to discuss something with others before deciding
items.s: The ship's captain had to ________ with the coastguard before he changed course, because the weather was getting worse.
items.zh: 船長在改變航向前必須與海巡商議,因為天氣越來越糟。

items.def: the way parts are arranged
items.s: The ________ of the new offshore wind farm was changed, so the turbines would not block the whales' route.
items.zh: 新離岸風場的配置被修改了,這樣風機就不會擋住鯨魚的路線。

items.def: following one after another without a break
items.s: The reef has suffered from very hot water for three ________ summers, so scientists fear it may not recover.
items.zh: 這片珊瑚礁已經連續三個夏天受到極熱海水的影響,所以科學家擔心它可能無法恢復。

items.def: one of the parts that form something
items.s: Salt is the main ________ that makes sea water different from river water, but it also contains many other minerals.
items.zh: 鹽是讓海水與河水不同的主要成分,但海水也含有許多其他礦物質。

items.def: to think carefully about something
items.s: The town is ________ a ban on jet skis near the beach, because the noise disturbs both swimmers and dolphins.
items.zh: 鎮上正在考慮禁止在海灘附近使用水上摩托車,因為噪音會干擾泳客和海豚。

items.def: depending on something else
items.s: Our boat trip is ________ on the weather, so we will check the forecast tomorrow morning before we decide.
items.zh: 我們的乘船行程取決於天氣,所以我們明天早上決定前會先看天氣預報。

items.def: to come together for a formal meeting
items.s: World leaders will ________ in New York next month, and they hope to sign a treaty to protect the high seas.
items.zh: 世界領袖下個月將在紐約召開會議,而他們希望簽署一項保護公海的條約。

items.def: to reduce or limit something
items.s: The government decided to ________ fishing during the spawning season, so the fish could lay their eggs safely.
items.zh: 政府決定在產卵季節限制捕魚,讓魚能安全地產卵。

items.def: to give your time and energy to something
items.s: She has ________ her life to protecting sea turtles, and she spends every summer guarding their nests at night.
items.zh: 她把一生奉獻給保護海龜,而且她每年夏天晚上都在守護牠們的巢。

items.def: done on purpose
items.s: The oil spill was not an accident but a ________ act, so the ship's owner was taken to court.
items.zh: 這起漏油不是意外而是蓄意的行為,所以船主被告上法院。

items.def: to describe or mark the exact edges of something
items.s: The new map clearly ________ the borders of the marine park, so fishermen know exactly where they cannot fish.
items.zh: 新地圖清楚劃定了海洋公園的邊界,所以漁民確切知道哪裡不能捕魚。

items.def: to be a sign of something
items.s: Red flags on the beach ________ dangerous currents, so swimmers should stay out of the water when they see them.
items.zh: 海灘上的紅旗表示有危險的海流,所以泳客看到時應該遠離水域。

items.def: to officially choose something for a purpose
items.s: The government plans to ________ the bay as a protected area, and fishing there will be banned from next year.
items.zh: 政府計畫把這個海灣劃定為保護區,而且明年起將禁止在那裡捕魚。

items.def: to plan or invent a new way of doing something
items.s: Students ________ a simple machine that collects floating plastic, and they tested it in the river near their school.
items.zh: 學生們設計了一台收集漂浮塑膠的簡單機器,而且在學校附近的河裡進行測試。

items.def: to spread over a wide area
items.s: Strong winds helped ________ the oil across a large area, so the clean-up became much more difficult.
items.zh: 強風讓油污擴散到大片區域,所以清理工作變得困難許多。

items.def: to stop something from continuing normally
items.s: Loud ship noise can ________ the way whales communicate, so they may lose contact with their family groups.
items.zh: 巨大的船隻噪音會擾亂鯨魚的溝通方式,所以牠們可能和家族群體失去聯繫。

items.def: to slowly disappear or become weaker
items.s: The typhoon began to ________ after it reached land, but heavy rain continued for two more days.
items.zh: 颱風登陸後開始減弱消散,但大雨又持續了兩天。

items.def: to go in different directions
items.s: Scientists' opinions ________ on deep-sea mining, because some focus on the metals while others focus on the damage.
items.zh: 科學家們對深海採礦的看法分歧,因為有些人著重在金屬,而有些人著重在破壞。

items.def: to change the direction of something
items.s: The ship was ________ to a different port because of the storm, so the passengers arrived a day late.
items.zh: 這艘船因為暴風雨被改道到另一個港口,所以乘客晚了一天抵達。

items.def: able to last a long time without breaking
items.s: Fishing nets are made of ________ plastic, so they can stay in the ocean for hundreds of years after they are lost.
items.zh: 漁網是用耐用的塑膠製成的,所以遺失後它們能在海洋中留存數百年。

items.def: to get a reaction or information from someone
items.s: The photo of a turtle with a straw in its nose ________ a strong reaction online, and many people stopped using straws.
items.zh: 一張海龜鼻子插著吸管的照片在網路上引起強烈反應,而許多人因此不再使用吸管。

items.def: difficult to find or catch
items.s: The giant squid is so ________ that nobody filmed one alive until 2012, although sailors told stories about it for centuries.
items.zh: 大王魷魚非常難以找到,直到2012年才有人拍到活體,儘管水手們講述牠的故事已經好幾個世紀。

items.def: to start something new and important
items.s: The team will ________ on a two-year study of the reef, and they will dive there every month to collect data.
items.zh: 團隊將著手一項為期兩年的珊瑚礁研究,而且他們每個月都會潛到那裡收集數據。

items.def: a serious attempt to do something difficult
items.s: Cleaning the whole ocean is a huge ________, but every small action by individuals still makes a difference.
items.zh: 清理整個海洋是一項巨大的努力,但每個人的小行動仍然能帶來改變。

items.def: to imagine something as a future possibility
items.s: The mayor ________ a clean harbour where children can swim safely, so she has started a ten-year plan.
items.zh: 市長設想一個孩子們能安全游泳的乾淨港口,所以她已經啟動了一項十年計畫。

items.def: very complete and including everything
items.s: The report gives an ________ list of all the fish species in the bay, and it took researchers five years to finish.
items.zh: 這份報告列出了海灣內所有魚種的詳盡清單,而研究人員花了五年才完成。

items.def: to develop a plan carefully
items.s: The council is trying to ________ a plan to reduce plastic waste, and it wants ideas from local students.
items.zh: 議會正在試著制定減少塑膠垃圾的計畫,而且它希望聽取當地學生的想法。

items.def: exactly the same
items.s: The two fish look almost ________, but one lives only in fresh water while the other lives in the sea.
items.zh: 這兩種魚看起來幾乎一模一樣,但一種只生活在淡水中,而另一種生活在海裡。

items.def: extremely large
items.s: The ocean holds an ________ amount of heat, so it has slowed down global warming on land.
items.zh: 海洋儲存了巨大的熱量,所以它減緩了陸地上的全球暖化。

items.def: extremely important and needing urgent action
items.s: It is ________ that we protect the remaining mangroves, because they defend the coast and store large amounts of carbon.
items.zh: 保護剩下的紅樹林是刻不容緩的,因為它們保護海岸並儲存大量的碳。

items.def: a feeling that makes you want to do something
items.s: Many young people have little ________ to become fishermen, so the average age of fishermen keeps rising.
items.zh: 許多年輕人沒什麼意願成為漁民,所以漁民的平均年齡持續上升。

items.def: having many small parts or details
items.s: The ________ shapes of coral provide hiding places for small fish, so a healthy reef supports many kinds of life.
items.zh: 珊瑚錯綜複雜的形狀為小魚提供藏身處,所以健康的珊瑚礁能支持許多種生命。

items.def: extremely useful
items.s: Local fishermen gave ________ help to the scientists, because they knew exactly where the rare fish could be found.
items.zh: 當地漁民給了科學家非常寶貴的幫助,因為他們確切知道哪裡能找到稀有的魚。

items.def: a complete list of things in a place
items.s: Divers made an ________ of every coral species on the reef, so they could see changes in the following years.
items.zh: 潛水員為珊瑚礁上的每一種珊瑚做了清單,這樣他們就能看到接下來幾年的變化。

items.def: fair, reasonable or legal
items.s: Fishermen have ________ concerns about the new rules, because their families depend on fishing for income.
items.zh: 漁民對新規定有合理的擔憂,因為他們的家庭依靠捕魚維生。

items.def: many
items.s: The beach clean-up found ________ bottle caps and lighters, and many of them had come from other countries.
items.zh: 淨灘活動發現了許多瓶蓋和打火機,而它們有很多來自其他國家。

items.def: to leave out something
items.s: The company ________ important facts about the oil leak in its report, so the public did not trust its explanation.
items.zh: 公司在報告中遺漏了漏油的重要事實,所以大眾不相信它的解釋。

items.def: best or most suitable
items.s: Early morning is the ________ time for diving here, because the water is calm and the light is soft.
items.zh: 清晨是這裡潛水的最佳時間,因為海水平靜而且光線柔和。

items.def: to find your position or direction
items.s: Sea turtles use the Earth's magnetic field to ________ themselves, so they can return to the beach where they were born.
items.zh: 海龜利用地球的磁場來定向,所以牠們能回到出生的海灘。

items.def: directly connected to the subject
items.s: The student asked a ________ question about plastic in seafood, and the expert was happy to explain the latest research.
items.zh: 那位學生問了一個關於海鮮中塑膠的切題問題,而專家很樂意解釋最新的研究。

items.def: a person who works in a skilled job
items.s: Every diving ________ must complete safety training, because guiding tourists underwater is a serious responsibility.
items.zh: 每位潛水從業人員都必須完成安全訓練,因為在水下帶領遊客是一項重大的責任。

items.def: likely to suffer from something
items.s: This part of the coast is ________ to strong currents, so swimming is not allowed without a lifeguard.
items.zh: 這段海岸容易出現強勁的海流,所以沒有救生員時禁止游泳。

items.def: to cause a strong reaction
items.s: The plan to build a factory near the reef ________ angry protests, and thousands of people signed a petition against it.
items.zh: 在珊瑚礁附近興建工廠的計畫引起憤怒的抗議,而且數千人連署反對。

items.def: the state of being near
items.s: Because of its ________ to the sea, the town has fresh seafood, but it also faces greater danger from typhoons.
items.zh: 由於鄰近大海,這個小鎮有新鮮的海鮮,但它也面臨更大的颱風威脅。

items.def: quickly and easily
items.s: Plastic bags are ________ available in many shops, so people use them without thinking about where they end up.
items.zh: 塑膠袋在許多商店都很容易取得,所以人們使用時不會去想它們最後的去處。

items.def: to move back from a higher point
items.s: After the storm, the water began to ________, and people returned to clean the mud from their homes.
items.zh: 暴風雨過後,海水開始退去,人們回去清理家中的泥巴。

items.def: given or done in return by both sides
items.s: The two countries signed a ________ agreement, so each one can fish in the other's waters under strict rules.
items.zh: 兩國簽訂了一項互惠協議,所以雙方都能在嚴格規定下在對方水域捕魚。

items.def: to grow again after damage
items.s: A starfish can ________ a lost arm, but it takes several months for the new arm to grow fully.
items.zh: 海星能再生失去的觸腕,但新的觸腕要好幾個月才能完全長好。

items.def: to cause something to be in a certain condition
items.s: The oil spill ________ the beach unsafe for months, so many hotels lost most of their summer guests.
items.zh: 漏油使海灘好幾個月都不安全,所以許多飯店失去了大部分夏季客人。

items.def: to fill something up again
items.s: Fish need time to ________ their numbers, so the fishing season is closed for three months every year.
items.zh: 魚類需要時間來恢復數量,所以每年漁季會關閉三個月。

items.def: to produce young animals or plants
items.s: Many sharks ________ slowly and have only a few babies, so their numbers fall quickly when too many are caught.
items.zh: 許多鯊魚繁殖緩慢,而且只生幾隻寶寶,所以捕撈太多時牠們的數量會快速下降。

items.def: to stop someone from doing something
items.s: Parents should ________ their children from touching coral, because even a gentle touch can damage the living animals.
items.zh: 父母應該制止孩子觸摸珊瑚,因為即使輕輕一碰也可能傷害這些活的生物。

items.def: one part of something
items.s: Only one ________ of the coast is open to tourists, while the rest is protected for nesting birds.
items.zh: 海岸只有一個區段開放給遊客,而其餘部分是為了築巢的鳥類而受到保護。

items.def: small in number and spread out
items.s: Fish are ________ in the open ocean far from land, but they gather in large numbers near reefs and coasts.
items.zh: 遠離陸地的大洋中魚類稀少,但牠們會大量聚集在珊瑚礁和海岸附近。

items.def: small and not easy to notice
items.s: The changes in the reef were ________ at first, but after five years most of the colourful coral had disappeared.
items.zh: 珊瑚礁的變化起初很細微,但五年後大部分色彩繽紛的珊瑚都消失了。

items.def: an amount that is more than needed
items.s: The fish farm produced a ________ this year, so the owner gave extra fish to a local food bank.
items.zh: 今年養魚場的產量過剩,所以老闆把多出來的魚送給當地的食物銀行。

items.def: sudden and unexpected
items.s: There was an ________ drop in water temperature, and many tropical fish died because they could not adjust in time.
items.zh: 水溫突然下降,許多熱帶魚因為無法及時適應而死亡。

items.def: connected with beauty
items.s: The coastline has great ________ value, so people are against building a large factory that would spoil the view.
items.zh: 這條海岸線有極高的美學價值,所以人們反對興建會破壞景觀的大型工廠。

items.def: to arrange things so they agree or match
items.s: The new fishing rules ________ with international law, so Taiwanese boats can continue to sell fish to Europe.
items.zh: 新的漁業規定與國際法一致,所以台灣的船隻能繼續把魚賣到歐洲。

items.def: to have a strong wish to achieve something
items.s: Many students ________ to work in marine science, but they need strong maths and biology skills first.
items.zh: 許多學生立志從事海洋科學工作,但他們首先需要很好的數學和生物能力。

items.def: to tell someone confidently that something is true
items.s: The captain ________ the passengers that the storm would pass soon, and he asked them to stay inside.
items.zh: 船長向乘客保證暴風雨很快就會過去,並請他們待在室內。

items.def: real and not a copy
items.s: The restaurant serves ________ fishermen's dishes, and the owner buys fresh fish from the harbour every morning.
items.zh: 這家餐廳供應道地的漁家料理,而老闆每天早上都從港口買新鮮的魚。

items.def: to find a way around a rule or problem
items.s: Some fishing boats ________ the rules by changing their flags, so it is hard for officials to track them.
items.zh: 有些漁船藉由更換船旗來規避規定,所以官員很難追蹤它們。

items.def: to end with an important event
items.s: Years of protests ________ in a new law that banned plastic bags, and many people saw it as a great victory.
items.zh: 多年的抗議最終促成一項禁用塑膠袋的新法律,而許多人把它視為一大勝利。

items.def: having a very important effect on the result
items.s: Quick action by the coastguard played a ________ role, because the oil was stopped before it reached the beach.
items.zh: 海巡的迅速行動發揮了決定性的作用,因為油污在抵達海灘前就被攔住了。

items.def: to make information known to the public
items.s: The company refused to ________ how much waste it had dumped into the sea, so journalists began their own investigation.
items.zh: 公司拒絕公開它把多少廢棄物傾倒入海,所以記者們開始自行調查。

items.def: to give someone the power or confidence to do something
items.s: The project ________ local villagers to manage their own fishing areas, and fish numbers have since increased.
items.zh: 這個計畫賦予當地村民管理自己漁區的權力,而魚群數量從那時起就增加了。

items.def: to provide the tools needed for a job
items.s: The new research boat is ________ with modern sonar, so scientists can map the sea floor in great detail.
items.zh: 新的研究船配備有現代聲納,所以科學家能非常詳細地繪製海床地圖。

items.def: special skill or knowledge
items.s: The team needed someone with ________ in underwater filming, so they hired a famous wildlife cameraman.
items.zh: 團隊需要一位具備水下攝影專業的人,所以他們聘請了一位知名的野生動物攝影師。

items.def: an event, especially an unusual or unpleasant one
items.s: The shark ________ frightened many tourists, but experts reminded everyone that attacks are extremely rare.
items.zh: 這起鯊魚事件嚇壞了許多遊客,但專家提醒大家攻擊事件極為罕見。

items.def: to put something inside something else
items.s: Scientists ________ a tiny tracker under the turtle's shell, and now they can follow its journey across the ocean.
items.zh: 科學家在海龜的殼下放入一個微小的追蹤器,現在他們能追蹤牠橫越海洋的旅程。

items.def: to tell someone officially what to do
items.s: The guide ________ us not to touch anything underwater, because some sea creatures can sting or bite.
items.zh: 導遊指示我們不要碰水下的任何東西,因為有些海洋生物會螫人或咬人。

items.def: a way of communicating or expressing something
items.s: Film is a powerful ________ for teaching people about the ocean, because many viewers have never seen a coral reef.
items.zh: 影片是教導人們認識海洋的強大媒介,因為許多觀眾從未見過珊瑚礁。

items.def: a particular way of doing something
items.s: Shipping is the cheapest ________ of transport for heavy goods, but it also produces a lot of pollution.
items.zh: 海運是運送重物最便宜的運輸方式,但它也產生大量污染。

items.def: a group of experts who discuss or decide something
items.s: A ________ of scientists will review the mining plan, and their report will be shared with the public next month.
items.zh: 一個科學家小組將審查採礦計畫,而他們的報告下個月會公開。

items.def: main or most important
items.s: Overfishing is a ________ cause of the decline in shark numbers, but climate change also plays a part.
items.zh: 過度捕撈是鯊魚數量下降的主要原因,但氣候變遷也有影響。

items.def: most important
items.s: Tourism is the island's ________ source of income, so a healthy reef is important for every family there.
items.zh: 觀光業是這座島的主要收入來源,所以健康的珊瑚礁對那裡的每個家庭都很重要。

items.def: the act of moving people or goods from one place to another
items.s: Some fish die during ________ to the market, so fishermen keep them in cold water on the boat.
items.zh: 有些魚在運送到市場的途中死亡,所以漁民在船上把牠們養在冷水中。

items.def: an idea or hope about the future
items.s: The organisation has a ________ of plastic-free oceans by 2050, but it knows the goal will be very hard to reach.
items.zh: 這個組織有一個在2050年前實現無塑海洋的願景,但它知道這個目標非常難達成。

items.def: to include someone or something as a necessary part
items.s: The clean-up project will ________ students from ten schools, and each class will look after one part of the beach.
items.zh: 淨灘計畫將讓十所學校的學生參與,而每個班級將負責海灘的一部分。
items.t: 讓十所學校的學生參與

items.def: to react to something
items.s: Corals ________ to heat stress by losing their colour, and they may die if the water does not cool down.
items.zh: 珊瑚會以失去顏色來回應熱壓力,而且如果海水不降溫,它們可能會死亡。

items.def: to take something away
items.s: Divers worked for three days to ________ a huge fishing net, and they freed several trapped turtles.
items.zh: 潛水員花了三天移除一張巨大的漁網,並解救了幾隻受困的海龜。

items.def: something built from many parts
items.s: An old oil platform can become a ________ for marine life, because coral and fish quickly settle on its legs.
items.zh: 一座舊的鑽油平台可以成為海洋生物的構造物,因為珊瑚和魚很快就會在它的支柱上定居。

items.def: to sell goods to another country
items.s: Taiwan ________ large amounts of frozen fish every year, and much of it goes to Japan and the United States.
items.zh: 台灣每年出口大量冷凍魚,而其中很多銷往日本和美國。

items.def: a number used to measure changes
items.s: The ocean health ________ gives each country a score, so we can compare how well they protect their seas.
items.zh: 海洋健康指數給每個國家一個分數,所以我們能比較它們保護海洋的成效。

items.def: an official document that allows you to do something
items.s: You need a fishing ________ to fish in this lake, and the money helps pay for protecting the fish.
items.zh: 在這座湖釣魚需要釣魚許可證,而這筆錢有助於支付保護魚類的費用。

items.def: a mistake
items.s: A small ________ in the ship's map led it onto the rocks, so the company now checks all its maps twice.
items.zh: 船上地圖的一個小錯誤導致它撞上礁石,所以公司現在會把所有地圖檢查兩次。

items.def: rich and having a comfortable life
items.s: ________ countries eat far more seafood per person, but poorer coastal communities often depend on fish to survive.
items.zh: 富裕國家每人吃的海鮮多得多,但較貧窮的沿海社區常常依賴魚類維生。

items.def: something that makes a place comfortable or easy to use
items.s: The new beach park has every ________ visitors need, such as showers and toilets, but it also has strict rules about rubbish.
items.zh: 新的海灘公園有遊客需要的各種便利設施,例如淋浴間和廁所,但它對垃圾也有嚴格的規定。

items.def: based on personal stories, not careful research
items.s: Fishermen have ________ evidence that fish are getting smaller, but scientists want more data before they agree.
items.zh: 漁民有魚越來越小的傳聞證據,但科學家在同意之前想要更多數據。

items.def: a lack of interest or concern
items.s: Public ________ about ocean pollution is a big problem, because people rarely see what happens under the waves.
items.zh: 大眾對海洋污染的冷漠是個大問題,因為人們很少看到海浪下發生的事。

items.def: very difficult and tiring
items.s: Rowing across the Atlantic is an ________ journey, and the young woman spent ninety days alone on the ocean.
items.zh: 划船橫越大西洋是一段艱辛的旅程,而那位年輕女子獨自在海上度過了九十天。

items.def: to show or prove that something is true
items.s: Local divers can ________ to the reef's recovery, because they have seen the fish return over the past few years.
items.zh: 當地潛水員能證明珊瑚礁的恢復,因為他們這幾年親眼看到魚群回來。

items.def: to give official permission for something
items.s: Only the government can ________ fishing in the marine park, and boats without permits will be stopped.
items.zh: 只有政府能批准在海洋公園內捕魚,而沒有許可證的船隻將被攔下。

items.def: to prevent something bad from happening
items.s: Quick action by the crew helped ________ a disaster, because they fixed the leak before the ship began to sink.
items.zh: 船員的迅速行動幫助避免了一場災難,因為他們在船開始下沉前修好了漏洞。

items.def: without hope or encouragement
items.s: The future of the reef looks ________ if sea temperatures keep rising, but scientists say it is not too late to act.
items.zh: 如果海水溫度持續上升,珊瑚礁的前景看起來很黯淡,但科學家說現在採取行動還不算太遲。

items.def: an important new discovery
items.s: Scientists made a ________ in growing coral in labs, so damaged reefs may be repaired faster in the future.
items.zh: 科學家在實驗室培育珊瑚方面取得了突破,所以受損的珊瑚礁未來可能會更快被修復。

items.def: growing quickly
items.s: The island's ________ diving industry has created many jobs, but it also puts more pressure on the reefs.
items.zh: 這座島迅速發展的潛水產業創造了許多工作機會,但它也對珊瑚礁造成更大的壓力。

items.def: to use a situation to gain an advantage
items.s: The town decided to ________ on its whale-watching tours, and tourism has now replaced fishing as its main business.
items.zh: 這個小鎮決定利用賞鯨行程,而觀光業現在已經取代捕魚成為它的主要產業。

items.def: something that causes an important change
items.s: The oil spill was a ________ for change, because it made the public demand stricter safety laws for ships.
items.zh: 這起漏油事件是改變的催化劑,因為它讓大眾要求更嚴格的船舶安全法規。

items.def: careful to avoid danger
items.s: New divers should be ________ near strong currents, so they should always stay close to their guide.
items.zh: 新手潛水員在強勁海流附近應該謹慎,所以他們應該總是待在導遊身邊。

items.def: too satisfied and not worried about possible danger
items.s: We cannot become ________ after one good year, because fish numbers can fall again very quickly.
items.zh: 我們不能在一個好年之後就掉以輕心,因為魚群數量可能會很快再次下降。

items.def: short and clear
items.s: The guide gave a ________ safety talk before the dive, and everyone understood the rules in just five minutes.
items.zh: 導遊在潛水前做了一段簡潔的安全說明,而每個人只花五分鐘就了解規則。

items.def: to say strongly that something is wrong
items.s: Environmental groups ________ the plan to dump waste at sea, and they asked the government to stop it immediately.
items.zh: 環保團體譴責在海上傾倒廢棄物的計畫,並要求政府立即停止。

items.def: careful to do things well and correctly
items.s: She is a ________ diver who always picks up rubbish underwater, so her friends call her the reef's guardian.
items.zh: 她是一位盡責的潛水員,總是在水下撿垃圾,所以朋友們稱她為珊瑚礁守護者。

items.def: a person or thing with the same role in a different place
items.s: Taiwan's coastguard met its Japanese ________ to discuss illegal fishing, and they agreed to share information.
items.zh: 台灣海巡與日本的對口單位會面討論非法捕魚,而且雙方同意分享資訊。

items.def: believing people only act for their own benefit
items.s: Some people are ________ about the company's green promises, because it still sells huge amounts of plastic.
items.zh: 有些人對這家公司的環保承諾抱持懷疑的態度,因為它仍然販售大量塑膠。

items.def: making you feel worried about whether you can succeed
items.s: Cleaning the whole coastline seemed ________ at first, but hundreds of volunteers finished the job in one weekend.
items.zh: 清理整條海岸線起初看起來令人卻步,但數百名志工在一個週末就完成了工作。

items.def: a lack of something
items.s: There is a ________ of data about the deep sea, so scientists cannot predict how mining will affect it.
items.zh: 關於深海的數據缺乏,所以科學家無法預測採礦會對它造成什麼影響。

items.def: to destroy or kill a large part of something
items.s: Disease has ________ the starfish population along the coast, and the number of sea urchins has grown quickly as a result.
items.zh: 疾病大幅減少了沿岸的海星數量,而海膽的數量因此迅速增加。

items.def: relating to the age, size and structure of a population
items.s: ________ changes in fishing villages are worrying, because most young people have moved to the cities for work.
items.zh: 漁村的人口結構變化令人擔憂,因為大部分年輕人都已經搬到城市工作。

items.def: working hard and carefully
items.s: The ________ students recorded the water temperature every day for a year, and their data helped a university project.
items.zh: 那些勤奮的學生一整年每天記錄水溫,而他們的數據幫助了一項大學研究計畫。

items.def: serious discussion about a subject
items.s: Public ________ about the ocean has changed, because more people now see plastic as a serious problem.
items.zh: 關於海洋的公眾討論已經改變,因為現在更多人把塑膠視為嚴重的問題。

items.def: a large difference between things
items.s: There is a large ________ between rich and poor fishermen, because big companies own most of the modern boats.
items.zh: 富有和貧窮的漁民之間存在很大的差距,因為大公司擁有大部分現代化的船隻。

items.def: to make a belief or feeling disappear
items.s: The documentary helped ________ the myth that sharks hunt humans, and many viewers began to support shark protection.
items.zh: 這部紀錄片幫助破除鯊魚會獵捕人類的迷思,而許多觀眾開始支持保護鯊魚。

items.def: the ability to produce the result you want
items.s: Scientists are testing the ________ of new nets that let turtles escape, and early results look very promising.
items.zh: 科學家正在測試能讓海龜逃脫的新漁網的效果,而初步結果看起來很有希望。

items.def: to try to copy someone because you admire them
items.s: Other countries hope to ________ Palau's success, because its strict ocean laws have helped fish numbers recover.
items.zh: 其他國家希望效法帛琉的成功,因為它嚴格的海洋法律幫助魚群數量恢復。

items.def: lasting for a long time
items.s: The old lighthouse is an ________ symbol of the town, and people still love to take photos there.
items.zh: 這座老燈塔是小鎮長久的象徵,而人們至今仍喜歡在那裡拍照。

items.def: firmly established and difficult to change
items.s: Eating shark fin soup is an ________ tradition at some weddings, so changing people's habits takes time.
items.zh: 在某些婚宴上吃魚翅湯是根深蒂固的傳統,所以改變人們的習慣需要時間。

items.def: lasting only a short time
items.s: The glowing blue waves are ________, so tourists must visit on the right nights to see them.
items.zh: 發光的藍色海浪很短暫,所以遊客必須在對的夜晚造訪才能看到。

items.def: to get rid of something completely
items.s: It is almost impossible to ________ an invasive fish once it spreads, so prevention is the best approach.
items.zh: 外來魚種一旦擴散就幾乎不可能根除,所以預防是最好的方法。

items.def: to escape or avoid something
items.s: The illegal fishing boat tried to ________ the coastguard, but it was caught after a two-hour chase.
items.zh: 那艘非法漁船試圖躲避海巡,但在兩小時的追逐後被逮到。

items.def: to use power or influence
items.s: Big seafood companies ________ strong influence on fishing laws, so smaller fishermen often feel ignored.
items.zh: 大型海鮮公司對漁業法規施加強大影響,所以小規模漁民常常覺得被忽略。

items.def: covering a large area or including a lot
items.s: The typhoon caused ________ damage to the harbour, and many boats will need months of repairs.
items.zh: 颱風對港口造成大範圍的損害,而許多船隻需要好幾個月的修理。

items.def: to use known facts to guess about the future
items.s: Scientists ________ from current data that the reef could disappear by 2050, although they hope action will change this.
items.zh: 科學家根據目前的數據推斷珊瑚礁可能在2050年前消失,雖然他們希望採取行動能改變這一點。

items.def: to invent false information to deceive people
items.s: The company ________ its fishing records to hide the illegal catch, but inspectors discovered the truth.
items.zh: 這家公司捏造捕撈紀錄來隱瞞非法漁獲,但檢查人員發現了真相。

items.def: one part or side of something
items.s: Pollution is only one ________ of the problem, because overfishing and warming are also harming the ocean.
items.zh: 污染只是問題的一個面向,因為過度捕撈和暖化也在傷害海洋。

items.def: a false idea that many people believe
items.s: It is a ________ that the ocean is too big to be harmed, because human activities have already changed it greatly.
items.zh: 認為海洋大到不會受到傷害是一種謬誤,因為人類活動已經大大改變了它。

items.def: to build a strong relationship or agreement
items.s: The two countries hope to ________ a strong partnership to protect the shared sea, and they will meet again next year.
items.zh: 兩國希望建立強大的夥伴關係來保護共有的海域,而他們明年會再次會面。

items.def: very powerful or difficult
items.s: The great white shark is a ________ hunter, but it is now threatened by humans in many parts of the world.
items.zh: 大白鯊是令人敬畏的獵手,但牠現在在世界許多地方受到人類威脅。

items.def: careful not to waste money or resources
items.s: Island families have long lived ________ lives, so they rarely waste food, water or fuel.
items.zh: 島上的家庭長久以來過著節儉的生活,所以他們很少浪費食物、水或燃料。

items.def: producing good results
items.s: The meeting between fishermen and scientists was ________, because both sides agreed on a new plan for the bay.
items.zh: 漁民和科學家之間的會議成果豐碩,因為雙方對海灣的新計畫達成共識。

items.def: having no chance of success
items.s: Cleaning the beach may seem ________ when new rubbish arrives every day, but it still saves many animals.
items.zh: 當每天都有新垃圾漂來時,清理海灘可能看起來是徒勞的,但它仍然拯救了許多動物。

items.def: to make it difficult for something to happen
items.s: Bad weather ________ the search for the missing fishermen, so the rescue teams had to wait until the wind dropped.
items.zh: 惡劣天氣阻礙了搜尋失蹤漁民的行動,所以救援隊必須等到風勢減弱。

items.def: to control and use natural energy
items.s: Engineers are trying to ________ the power of ocean waves, so coastal towns can produce clean electricity.
items.zh: 工程師正在試著利用海浪的力量,讓沿海城鎮能產生乾淨的電力。

items.def: to make a feeling or effect stronger
items.s: News about plastic in seafood has ________ public concern, and many shoppers now ask where their fish comes from.
items.zh: 海鮮中含塑膠的新聞提高了大眾的擔憂,而許多購物者現在會詢問他們的魚來自哪裡。

items.def: made of parts that are all the same
items.s: A fish farm is a ________ environment with only one species, while a wild reef contains hundreds of different ones.
items.zh: 養魚場是只有一個物種的同質環境,而野生珊瑚礁則有數百種不同的物種。

items.def: to make something clearer or easier to understand
items.s: The new study helps ________ how whales communicate, because it recorded their songs over many years.
items.zh: 這項新研究有助於闡明鯨魚如何溝通,因為它記錄了牠們多年來的歌聲。

items.def: about to happen, usually something bad
items.s: Fishermen rushed back to the harbour because of the ________ storm, and the coastguard closed the sea to all boats.
items.zh: 漁民們因為即將來臨的暴風雨趕回港口,而海巡對所有船隻封閉了海域。

items.def: something that encourages an activity to develop
items.s: The photos of dying coral gave new ________ to the campaign, and thousands of people joined in the following month.
items.zh: 垂死珊瑚的照片給了這項運動新的動力,而接下來一個月有數千人加入。

items.def: to experience something unpleasant, such as a cost, as a result of an action
items.s: Boats that fish in protected areas will ________ heavy fines, and their owners may lose their licences.
items.zh: 在保護區捕魚的船隻將遭受重罰,而且船主可能失去執照。

items.def: done without careful choice
items.s: ________ fishing with huge nets kills dolphins and turtles, so many people now choose seafood with eco-labels.
items.zh: 用巨網不加選擇地捕魚會殺死海豚和海龜,所以現在許多人選擇有環保標章的海鮮。

items.def: the arrival of many people or things
items.s: The ________ of tourists every summer brings money to the island, but it also creates huge amounts of rubbish.
items.zh: 每年夏天遊客的湧入為島嶼帶來收入,但也製造了大量垃圾。

items.def: to live in a place
items.s: Strange creatures ________ the deepest parts of the ocean, and many of them have never been seen by humans.
items.zh: 奇特的生物棲息在海洋最深的地方,而其中許多從未被人類見過。

items.def: too great to be dealt with
items.s: The problem of ocean plastic is not ________, but it needs cooperation between governments, companies and ordinary people.
items.zh: 海洋塑膠的問題並非無法克服,但它需要政府、企業和一般民眾之間的合作。

items.def: complete and not damaged
items.s: The ship had been underwater for a hundred years, but its wooden hull was still almost ________ because of the cold water.
items.zh: 這艘船已經在水下一百年了,但因為海水冰冷,它的木製船身仍幾乎完好無缺。

items.def: depending on each other
items.s: All the creatures on a reef are ________, so the loss of one species can affect many others.
items.zh: 珊瑚礁上的所有生物都是相互依存的,所以失去一個物種可能會影響許多其他物種。

items.def: disturbing in an unwelcome way
items.s: Some whale-watching boats get too close, which is ________ for the whales, so new rules set a minimum distance.
items.zh: 有些賞鯨船靠得太近,這對鯨魚來說是一種打擾,所以新規定設定了最小距離。

items.def: producing a lot of money
items.s: Shark fin is a ________ business for some traders, but it has caused shark numbers to fall all over the world.
items.zh: 魚翅對某些商人來說是利潤豐厚的生意,但它導致全世界的鯊魚數量下降。

items.def: very small in amount
items.s: The fishermen's catch was ________ this year, so many families had to find other work to pay their bills.
items.zh: 今年漁民的漁獲很微薄,所以許多家庭必須找其他工作來支付帳單。

items.def: the force that keeps something moving or developing
items.s: The campaign against plastic straws gained ________ quickly, and soon many restaurants stopped using them.
items.zh: 反塑膠吸管運動迅速獲得動力,很快許多餐廳就不再使用吸管。

items.def: very many
items.s: The reef is home to ________ colourful creatures, and every dive shows you something new and surprising.
items.zh: 珊瑚礁是無數色彩繽紛生物的家,而每一次潛水都讓你看見新奇又令人驚喜的東西。

items.def: not well known
items.s: The tiny fish was so ________ that it had no common name, but scientists discovered it could clean sick coral.
items.zh: 這種小魚非常鮮為人知,連個俗名都沒有,但科學家發現牠能清潔生病的珊瑚。

items.def: to choose one thing instead of another
items.s: More shoppers now ________ for fish with eco-labels, so supermarkets have started to sell more of them.
items.zh: 現在更多購物者選擇有環保標章的魚,所以超市已經開始販售更多這類產品。

items.def: to be greater or more important than something else
items.s: The long-term benefits of a marine park ________ the short-term losses for fishermen, because fish numbers grow outside the park too.
items.zh: 海洋公園的長期效益超過漁民的短期損失,因為公園外的魚群數量也會增加。

items.def: to fail to notice or consider something
items.s: People often ________ the role of tiny plankton, but these creatures produce much of the oxygen on Earth.
items.zh: 人們常常忽略微小浮游生物的角色,但這些生物製造了地球上大部分的氧氣。

items.def: to make something continue, especially something bad
items.s: Films that show sharks as monsters ________ people's fear, so fewer people support protecting them.
items.zh: 把鯊魚描繪成怪物的電影延續了人們的恐懼,所以支持保護牠們的人變少了。

items.def: to find or describe something exactly
items.s: Scientists used satellites to ________ the source of the oil, and they found a ship that had cleaned its tanks at sea.
items.zh: 科學家利用衛星精確找出油污的來源,並發現了一艘在海上清洗油槽的船。

items.def: very strong or powerful
items.s: Some sea snails produce a ________ poison, so divers should never pick up shells that still have animals inside.
items.zh: 有些海螺會產生強效的毒素,所以潛水員絕不應該撿起裡面還有生物的貝殼。

items.def: not safe or secure; likely to get worse
items.s: Many small fishermen are in a ________ situation, because one bad season can leave them without money.
items.zh: 許多小規模漁民處於岌岌可危的處境,因為一個糟糕的漁季就可能讓他們身無分文。

items.def: a difficult situation
items.s: The village faced a ________, because the new port would bring jobs but would also destroy the beach.
items.zh: 村莊面臨一個困境,因為新港口會帶來工作,但也會摧毀海灘。

items.def: to prevent something from happening
items.s: The strong currents ________ swimming at this beach, so visitors can only walk along the sand.
items.zh: 強勁的海流使這片海灘無法游泳,所以遊客只能在沙灘上散步。

items.def: something that must exist before something else can happen
items.s: Clean water is a ________ for healthy coral, so the town must stop sewage from entering the bay.
items.zh: 乾淨的水是健康珊瑚的先決條件,所以小鎮必須阻止污水流入海灣。

items.def: completely clean and untouched
items.s: The island's beaches are still ________, because only a small number of visitors are allowed each day.
items.zh: 這座島的海灘仍然潔淨原始,因為每天只允許少數遊客進入。

items.def: producing a lot of something
items.s: Cod are ________ breeders that lay millions of eggs, but overfishing still caused their numbers to crash.
items.zh: 鱈魚是多產的繁殖者,一次產下數百萬顆卵,但過度捕撈仍然導致牠們的數量崩跌。

items.def: to be successful, especially by earning money
items.s: The village began to ________ after the reef recovered, because divers from around the world came to visit.
items.zh: 珊瑚礁恢復後村莊開始繁榮起來,因為世界各地的潛水客都來造訪。

items.def: careful and sensible
items.s: It would be ________ to wait before mining the deep sea, because we still know very little about life there.
items.zh: 在開採深海之前先等一等是明智的,因為我們對那裡的生物仍所知甚少。

items.def: growing or spreading in an uncontrolled way
items.s: Illegal fishing is ________ in some areas, so honest fishermen find it hard to earn a fair living.
items.zh: 非法捕魚在某些地區很猖獗,所以誠實的漁民很難賺取合理的生活費。

items.def: to correct something that is wrong
items.s: The company promised to ________ the damage it caused, and it paid to replant the mangroves along the river.
items.zh: 公司承諾彌補它造成的損害,並出資沿著河岸重新種植紅樹林。

items.def: continuing strongly without stopping
items.s: The ________ waves slowly wore away the cliff, so the old house on top is now in danger of falling.
items.zh: 持續不斷的海浪慢慢侵蝕懸崖,所以上面的老房子現在有倒塌的危險。

items.def: a way to solve a problem
items.s: There is no quick ________ for ocean pollution, but reducing plastic use is an important first step.
items.zh: 海洋污染沒有快速的解決辦法,但減少塑膠使用是重要的第一步。

items.def: a return of something after a period of decline
items.s: There has been a ________ of humpback whales in the area, and whale-watching tours are now fully booked every summer.
items.zh: 這個地區的座頭鯨數量已經回升,而賞鯨行程現在每年夏天都被訂滿。

items.def: to give new life and energy to something
items.s: The government plans to ________ the old fishing port, so it will attract tourists with cafés and a seafood market.
items.zh: 政府計畫振興舊漁港,讓它以咖啡館和海鮮市場吸引遊客。

items.def: an amount that is less than needed
items.s: There is a ________ of funding for ocean research, so many important studies have been delayed.
items.zh: 海洋研究的經費不足,所以許多重要的研究被延後了。

items.def: to change information so it is not accurate
items.s: A few very large catches can ________ the average, so scientists look at many years of data instead.
items.zh: 幾次非常大量的漁獲可能會扭曲平均值,所以科學家改為觀察多年的數據。

items.def: to control the direction of a vehicle or situation
items.s: The captain had to ________ the boat carefully between the rocks, because the water was very shallow there.
items.zh: 船長必須小心地在岩石之間駕駛船隻,因為那裡的水非常淺。

items.def: to try very hard to achieve something
items.s: The aquarium ________ to teach visitors about ocean protection, and every tour ends with tips for reducing plastic.
items.zh: 這間水族館努力教導遊客保護海洋的知識,而每次導覽都以減少塑膠的小訣竅作結。

items.def: to be unable to resist something
items.s: Many corals ________ to disease after the heatwave, because they were already weak from the hot water.
items.zh: 熱浪過後許多珊瑚不敵疾病而死,因為它們已經被高溫海水削弱了。

items.def: to be better or greater than something
items.s: Plastic in the ocean may ________ the weight of all fish by 2050, unless we change our habits soon.
items.zh: 海洋中的塑膠重量可能在2050年超過所有魚類的重量,除非我們儘快改變習慣。

items.def: extremely large
items.s: The Pacific is so ________ that a ship can sail for weeks without seeing land, and few people have crossed it alone.
items.zh: 太平洋如此遼闊,一艘船可以航行好幾週都看不到陸地,而很少人曾獨自橫越它。

items.def: watching carefully for danger
items.s: Lifeguards must stay ________ all day, because a swimmer can get into trouble in just a few seconds.
items.zh: 救生員必須整天保持警覺,因為泳客可能在短短幾秒內就陷入危險。

items.def: staying only for a short time
items.s: Many of the whales seen near Taiwan are ________ visitors, so they only stay for a few weeks each year.
items.zh: 在台灣附近看到的許多鯨魚是短暫停留的訪客,所以牠們每年只停留幾週。

items.def: to understand or solve something complicated
items.s: Scientists are trying to ________ the mystery of how eels find their way back to the same sea to lay eggs.
items.zh: 科學家正在試著解開鰻魚如何找到路回到同一片海域產卵的謎團。

items.def: to support or defend a law or decision
items.s: The court ________ the ban on fishing in the marine park, so the companies that opposed it lost their case.
items.zh: 法院維持了海洋公園內禁止捕魚的禁令,所以反對的公司輸了官司。

items.def: able to be used in many different ways
items.s: Seaweed is a ________ plant, because it can be used in food, medicine and even plastic-free packaging.
items.zh: 海藻是一種用途多樣的植物,因為它可以用在食物、藥品,甚至無塑包裝上。

items.def: moving in a strong and uneven way
items.s: The sea was ________ after the storm, so the ferry to the island was cancelled for two days.
items.zh: 暴風雨過後海面波濤洶湧,所以前往島上的渡輪停駛了兩天。

items.def: to become weaker or smaller
items.s: Public interest in the oil spill began to ________ after a few weeks, but the beach was still polluted.
items.zh: 幾週後大眾對漏油事件的關注開始減弱,但海灘仍然受到污染。

items.def: strong, active and full of energy
items.s: The mangroves showed ________ growth after they were replanted, and birds soon returned to nest in them.
items.zh: 紅樹林重新種植後展現了旺盛的生長,而鳥類很快就回來在其中築巢。

items.def: a part of the sea where human activities are limited to protect nature
items.s: Fishing is strictly limited inside the ______ ______ ______, so the number of large fish there has doubled in ten years.
items.zh: 海洋保護區內的捕魚受到嚴格限制,所以那裡的大型魚數量在十年內增加了一倍。

items.def: catching fish in a way that leaves enough to breed
items.s: ______ ______ means leaving enough fish in the sea to breed, so future generations can still enjoy seafood.
items.zh: 永續漁業意味著在海中留下足夠的魚來繁殖,這樣後代子孫仍能享用海鮮。

items.def: harm to nature caused by plastic waste
items.s: ______ ______ is now found even in the deepest trench, so scientists say no part of the ocean is truly untouched.
items.zh: 現在即使在最深的海溝也發現了塑膠污染,所以科學家說海洋沒有任何地方是真正未受影響的。

items.def: the network of who eats whom in an ecosystem
items.s: If sharks disappear, the whole ______ ______ changes, because the animals they used to eat grow out of control.
items.zh: 如果鯊魚消失,整個食物網都會改變,因為牠們原本捕食的動物會失控地增加。

items.def: to be carried onto the shore by the sea
items.s: Every morning, plastic bottles ______ ______ on the beach, and volunteers collect them before the tourists arrive.
items.zh: 每天早上都有塑膠瓶被沖上海灘,志工們會在遊客到達前把它們撿起來。

items.def: in serious trouble
items.s: The fishing company is ______ ______ ______ after it was caught catching sharks illegally, and it may have to close.
items.zh: 這家漁業公司被抓到非法捕撈鯊魚後陷入大麻煩,而且可能必須關門。

items.def: in a situation that is too difficult for your skills
items.cn: 力不從心;超出能力範圍
items.s: I felt completely ______ ______ ______ ______ during the advanced diving course, so I asked the instructor for extra practice.
items.zh: 在進階潛水課程中我覺得完全力不從心,所以我請教練讓我多練習。

items.def: to cause trouble or attract attention by doing something new
items.s: The young activist began to ______ ______ when her video about ocean plastic went viral, and politicians started to listen.
items.zh: 當這位年輕行動者關於海洋塑膠的影片爆紅時,她開始引起轟動,而政治人物也開始傾聽。

items.def: to try something carefully to see how people react
items.s: The company decided to ______ ______ ______ by selling paper straws in one city, and then it planned to expand.
items.zh: 這家公司決定先在一個城市販售紙吸管來試水溫,然後計畫再擴大。

items.def: to cause problems by challenging the way things are
items.s: Some fishermen did not want to ______ ______ ______ by reporting illegal boats, but one brave captain finally spoke up.
items.zh: 有些漁民不想透過舉報非法船隻來惹麻煩,但一位勇敢的船長終於站了出來。

items.def: to lose a chance by being too slow
items.s: Countries that do not invest in clean ocean energy now may ______ ______ ______, while others lead the new industry.
items.zh: 現在不投資乾淨海洋能源的國家可能會錯失良機,而其他國家則領導這個新產業。

items.def: in the same difficult situation as others
items.s: All the fishermen in the village are ______ ______ ______ ______, because the typhoon damaged every boat in the harbour.
items.zh: 村裡所有的漁民都處境相同,因為颱風損壞了港內的每一艘船。

items.def: to succeed or fail without help from others
items.s: New guides at the diving centre are not left to ______ ______ ______, because experienced divers train them for a month.
items.zh: 潛水中心的新導遊不會被放著自生自滅,因為有經驗的潛水員會訓練他們一個月。

items.def: a person who feels uncomfortable in an unfamiliar situation
items.s: I felt like ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ at my first diving club meeting, but the other members were very friendly.
items.zh: 我在第一次參加潛水社聚會時覺得渾身不自在,但其他社員都非常友善。

items.w: plenty more fish in the sea
items.def: there are many other people or chances available
items.cn: 天涯何處無芳草;機會多的是
items.s: My friend was sad after her break-up, so I told her there were ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______.
items.zh: 我朋友分手後很難過,所以我告訴她天涯何處無芳草。

items.def: to attract a lot of attention
items.s: The student's invention for catching microplastics ______ ______ ______ at the science fair, and a company offered to help develop it.
items.zh: 那位學生捕捉塑膠微粒的發明在科展上引起轟動,而一家公司提議協助開發它。

items.def: confused and not knowing what to do
items.s: I was ______ ______ ______ during my first ocean science lecture, but the professor's simple examples helped me understand.
items.zh: 我在第一堂海洋科學課上感到茫然不知所措,但教授簡單的例子幫助我理解了。

items.def: left in a difficult situation without help
items.s: When the factory closed, hundreds of workers were left ______ ______ ______, and many moved away from the fishing town.
items.zh: 工廠關閉時,數百名工人被棄之不顧,而許多人搬離了這個漁港小鎮。

items.def: to learn how to do a job or activity
items.s: It took me a whole summer to ______ ______ ______ on my uncle's fishing boat, but now I can help him with almost everything.
items.zh: 我花了一整個夏天才在叔叔的漁船上熟悉門道,但現在幾乎所有事我都能幫他。

items.def: a complete and important change
items.s: There has been ______ ______ ______ in how people see sharks, and many now want to protect them instead of fearing them.
items.zh: 人們看待鯊魚的方式已經有了徹底的轉變,而許多人現在想保護牠們而不是害怕牠們。

5.zh: 心理學：壓力、動機與決策

items.def: a feeling of worry caused by too much to do
items.s: Many senior high students feel a lot of ________ before the entrance exam, so teachers try to keep the classroom calm and friendly.
items.zh: 許多高三學生在升學考試前感受到很大的壓力,所以老師們試著讓教室保持平靜和友善。
items.sec: Stress & the Body 壓力與身體反應

items.def: a difficult situation that makes you tired or worried
items.s: Looking after her sick father and working full-time put a huge ________ on Amy, and she started to lose sleep.
items.zh: 照顧生病的父親又要全職工作,給艾咪帶來了巨大的負擔,她開始失眠。
items.sec: Stress & the Body 壓力與身體反應

items.def: a body chemical that gives energy when you are scared or excited
items.s: When the fire alarm suddenly rang, a rush of ________ made my heart race, and I ran down the stairs very quickly.
items.zh: 火災警報突然響起時,一股腎上腺素讓我心跳加速,我很快地跑下樓梯。
items.sec: Stress & the Body 壓力與身體反應

items.def: the sound or movement of your heart
items.s: I could hear my own ________ in my ears as I walked onto the stage, but I took a slow breath and began my speech.
items.zh: 走上舞台時,我在耳朵裡能聽見自己的心跳,但我慢慢吸了一口氣,然後開始演講。
items.sec: Stress & the Body 壓力與身體反應

items.def: how fast your heart is beating, felt at the wrist
items.s: The nurse checked my ________ after the long run, and she said it was still high because my body was under stress.
items.zh: 長跑之後護士檢查了我的脈搏,她說脈搏還是很快,因為我的身體正處於壓力之下。
items.sec: Stress & the Body 壓力與身體反應

items.def: to have water come out of your skin
items.s: Ben always starts to ________ when he has to speak English in front of the class, so he keeps a small towel in his bag.
items.zh: 班每次要在全班面前說英文時就開始流汗,所以他在書包裡放了一條小毛巾。
items.sec: Stress & the Body 壓力與身體反應

items.def: to shake slightly because you are afraid or nervous
items.s: My hands began to ________ when I opened the envelope with my test results, but I was relieved to see a good score.
items.zh: 我打開裝著考試成績的信封時,雙手開始顫抖,但看到好成績我就鬆了一口氣。
items.sec: Stress & the Body 壓力與身體反應

items.def: to suddenly feel so afraid that you cannot think clearly
items.s: Don't ________ if you cannot answer the first question, because you can skip it and come back to it later.
items.zh: 如果第一題答不出來,不要驚慌,因為你可以先跳過,之後再回來作答。
items.sec: Stress & the Body 壓力與身體反應

items.def: worried and a little afraid about something
items.s: Lisa felt very ________ before her job interview, so she practised her answers with her sister the night before.
items.zh: 麗莎在工作面試前感到非常緊張,所以她前一天晚上和姊姊一起練習回答問題。
items.sec: Stress & the Body 壓力與身體反應

items.def: unable to relax because you are worried
items.s: The atmosphere in the office was ________ before the big meeting, and nobody wanted to tell jokes or chat.
items.zh: 大會議開始前,辦公室裡的氣氛很緊繃,沒有人想說笑或閒聊。
items.sec: Stress & the Body 壓力與身體反應

items.def: a pain in your head
items.s: I often get a bad ________ when I stay up late studying, so I now try to go to bed before midnight.
items.zh: 我熬夜讀書時常常會頭痛,所以現在我試著在午夜前上床睡覺。
items.sec: Stress & the Body 壓力與身體反應

items.def: the state of being extremely tired
items.s: After three nights of little sleep, Tom was suffering from ________, and his doctor told him to rest for a few days.
items.zh: 連續三晚睡得很少之後,湯姆陷入筋疲力盡的狀態,醫生要他休息幾天。
items.sec: Stress & the Body 壓力與身體反應

items.def: to work too hard or too long
items.s: If you ________ every day without a break, your body will eventually get sick, and your work will not improve either.
items.zh: 如果你每天都過度工作而不休息,身體最後會生病,你的工作表現也不會變好。
items.sec: Stress & the Body 壓力與身體反應

items.def: the latest time by which something must be finished
items.s: The ________ for the science report is next Monday, but Kevin has not even started his research yet.
items.zh: 科學報告的截止期限是下週一,但凱文連研究都還沒開始。
items.sec: Stress & the Body 壓力與身體反應

items.def: the amount of work a person has to do
items.s: Our teacher reduced the homework ________ during exam week, because she knew we were already very stressed.
items.zh: 考試週期間老師減少了作業的工作量,因為她知道我們已經壓力很大了。
items.sec: Stress & the Body 壓力與身體反應

items.def: something that causes stress
items.s: Moving to a new school is a common ________ for teenagers, but making one good friend can make the change much easier.
items.zh: 轉學到新學校是青少年常見的壓力源,但交到一個好朋友就能讓這個改變輕鬆許多。
items.sec: Stress & the Body 壓力與身體反應

items.def: describing the body's quick reaction to danger
items.s: When a dog suddenly barked at me, my ________ response kicked in, and I jumped back before I could even think.
items.zh: 一隻狗突然對我吠叫時,我的戰或逃反應啟動了,我還來不及思考就往後跳開。
items.sec: Stress & the Body 壓力與身體反應

items.def: the parts of the body that fight illness
items.s: Long periods of stress can weaken your ______ ______, so you may catch colds more easily during busy exam seasons.
items.zh: 長期的壓力會削弱你的免疫系統,所以在忙碌的考試季節你可能更容易感冒。
items.sec: Stress & the Body 壓力與身體反應

items.def: unable to stay still or relax
items.s: The children grew ________ after sitting in the car for four hours, so their parents stopped at a park to let them run.
items.zh: 孩子們在車上坐了四個小時後變得焦躁不安,所以父母在一座公園停車讓他們跑一跑。
items.sec: Stress & the Body 壓力與身體反應

items.def: nervous and shaky
items.s: I drank too much coffee before the test, and I felt ________ for the whole morning, so now I only drink water.
items.zh: 考試前我喝了太多咖啡,整個早上都覺得緊張不安,所以現在我只喝水。
items.sec: Stress & the Body 壓力與身體反應

items.def: without sleep
items.s: Emma spent a ________ night worrying about her presentation, but in the end the audience loved her ideas.
items.zh: 艾瑪為了她的簡報擔心了一整個無眠的夜晚,但最後聽眾很喜歡她的想法。
items.sec: Stress & the Body 壓力與身體反應

items.def: a very bad headache that can make you feel sick
items.s: My mother gets a ________ when she is under a lot of pressure at work, and she has to lie down in a dark room.
items.zh: 我媽媽工作壓力很大時會偏頭痛,她必須躺在黑暗的房間裡休息。
items.sec: Stress & the Body 壓力與身體反應

items.def: the force of blood moving through your body
items.s: The doctor said my grandfather's ______ ______ was too high, so he should reduce stress and eat less salt.
items.zh: 醫生說我爺爺的血壓太高,所以他應該減少壓力並少吃鹽。
items.sec: Stress & the Body 壓力與身體反應

items.def: a pain in your stomach
items.s: Some students get a ________ on the morning of a big test, although they are not really sick.
items.zh: 有些學生在大考當天早上會肚子痛,雖然他們並沒有真的生病。
items.sec: Stress & the Body 壓力與身體反應

items.def: the feeling that you want to eat
items.s: Jason lost his ________ during the stressful week of finals, and his mother worried because he barely ate dinner.
items.zh: 傑森在期末考那個壓力很大的一週失去了食慾,他媽媽很擔心,因為他幾乎不吃晚餐。
items.sec: Stress & the Body 壓力與身體反應

items.def: to take air into your body and let it out
items.s: The coach told the players to ________ slowly before the penalty kick, and it helped them stay calm and focused.
items.zh: 教練告訴球員們在罰球前要慢慢呼吸,這幫助他們保持冷靜和專注。
items.sec: Stress & the Body 壓力與身體反應

items.def: very tired and upset because of too much to do
items.s: By Friday afternoon, the new teacher felt completely ________, but a quiet weekend helped her recover.
items.zh: 到了星期五下午,這位新老師覺得完全疲憊不堪,但一個安靜的週末幫助她恢復了精神。
items.sec: Stress & the Body 壓力與身體反應

items.def: very busy and full of activity
items.s: December is always a ________ month for shop workers, so many of them feel tired and stressed before the holidays.
items.zh: 十二月對店員來說總是忙亂的月份,所以許多人在假期前感到疲累和有壓力。
items.sec: Stress & the Body 壓力與身體反應

items.def: needing a lot of time, effort or skill
items.s: Nursing is a very ________ job, but many nurses say that helping patients makes all the hard work worthwhile.
items.zh: 護理是一份非常費力的工作,但許多護理師說幫助病人讓所有的辛苦都很值得。
items.sec: Stress & the Body 壓力與身體反應

items.def: thinking about something too much, in a way that is not helpful
items.s: Too much ________ kept Mia awake at night, so her counsellor suggested writing her worries on paper before bed.
items.zh: 過度思考讓米亞晚上睡不著,所以她的輔導老師建議她睡前把煩惱寫在紙上。
items.sec: Stress & the Body 壓力與身體反應

items.def: a strong feeling such as love, fear or anger
items.s: It is normal to feel a mix of ________ before graduation, because you are excited about the future but sad to leave your friends.
items.zh: 畢業前感受到複雜的情緒是正常的,因為你對未來感到興奮,卻又捨不得離開朋友。
items.sec: Emotions & Mental Health 情緒與心理健康

items.def: the feeling of being upset because you cannot do something
items.s: Leo shouted in ________ when his computer crashed again, and he lost the essay he had been writing all evening.
items.zh: 里歐的電腦又當機時,他挫折地大叫,而且他弄丟了整個晚上都在寫的文章。
items.sec: Emotions & Mental Health 情緒與心理健康

items.def: a strong feeling when something is wrong or unfair
items.s: Instead of showing her ________ in front of the class, the teacher waited until she was calm and then spoke to the student.
items.zh: 老師沒有在全班面前表現她的憤怒,而是等到自己冷靜下來才和那位學生談話。
items.sec: Emotions & Mental Health 情緒與心理健康

items.def: the feeling you have when you think something bad will happen
items.s: Many people have a ________ of speaking in public, but regular practice can make it much less frightening.
items.zh: 許多人對公開演講有恐懼,但經常練習可以讓它變得不那麼可怕。
items.sec: Emotions & Mental Health 情緒與心理健康

items.def: to keep thinking about problems or bad things
items.s: Parents often ________ about their children's grades, but too much pressure from home can make students even more stressed.
items.zh: 父母常常擔心孩子的成績,但來自家裡的太多壓力會讓學生壓力更大。
items.sec: Emotions & Mental Health 情緒與心理健康

items.def: a bad feeling because you did something wrong
items.s: Sam felt a strong sense of ________ after he forgot his best friend's birthday, so he bought her a gift the next day.
items.zh: 山姆忘了最好朋友的生日之後感到強烈的罪惡感,所以他隔天買了一份禮物給她。
items.sec: Emotions & Mental Health 情緒與心理健康

items.def: a painful feeling that you have done something wrong or silly
items.s: He felt deep ________ after cheating on the quiz, and he finally told his teacher the truth.
items.zh: 他在小考作弊後感到深深的羞愧,最後他向老師說出了實話。
items.sec: Emotions & Mental Health 情緒與心理健康

items.def: the feeling of being shy or uncomfortable in front of others
items.s: Her face turned red with ________ when she called her teacher "Mum" by mistake, but everyone laughed kindly.
items.zh: 她不小心把老師叫成「媽媽」時,臉因為尷尬而漲紅,但大家都善意地笑了。
items.sec: Emotions & Mental Health 情緒與心理健康

items.def: an unhappy feeling when someone has what you want
items.s: A little ________ is natural when your friend wins a prize, but it should not stop you from congratulating her.
items.zh: 朋友得獎時有一點嫉妒是很自然的,但這不應該阻止你恭喜她。
items.sec: Emotions & Mental Health 情緒與心理健康

items.def: to want something that another person has
items.s: I sometimes ________ students who never seem nervous before exams, but I know they probably work hard too.
items.zh: 我有時會羨慕那些考試前似乎從不緊張的同學,但我知道他們可能也很努力。
items.sec: Emotions & Mental Health 情緒與心理健康

items.def: great sadness, especially when someone dies
items.s: After his grandmother died, Ken was full of ________, so his friends visited him often and listened to his stories about her.
items.zh: 奶奶過世後,肯滿懷悲痛,所以他的朋友們常去探望他,並聽他講關於奶奶的故事。
items.sec: Emotions & Mental Health 情緒與心理健康

items.def: a happy feeling when something worrying ends
items.s: It was a great ________ to hear that the flight was safe, because we had been waiting at the airport for hours.
items.zh: 聽到班機平安讓我們鬆了一口氣,因為我們已經在機場等了好幾個小時。
items.sec: Emotions & Mental Health 情緒與心理健康

items.def: a quiet feeling of being happy and satisfied
items.s: My grandfather finds ________ in simple things, such as gardening and drinking tea with his old friends.
items.zh: 我爺爺在簡單的事情中找到滿足,像是種花種菜和跟老朋友喝茶。
items.sec: Emotions & Mental Health 情緒與心理健康

items.def: a pleased feeling after you do or get what you wanted
items.s: Finishing a difficult puzzle gives me a sense of ________, and it also helps me forget about my worries.
items.zh: 完成一個困難的拼圖帶給我一種滿足感,也能幫助我忘掉煩惱。
items.sec: Emotions & Mental Health 情緒與心理健康

items.def: the feeling that good things will happen
items.s: Her ________ helped the whole team, because she always believed they could win even when they were behind.
items.zh: 她的樂觀幫助了整個團隊,因為即使落後,她也總是相信他們能贏。
items.sec: Emotions & Mental Health 情緒與心理健康

items.def: the feeling that bad things will happen
items.s: There was a lot of ________ among the players after three losses, but the coach reminded them of their past successes.
items.zh: 輸了三場之後,球員之間瀰漫著悲觀的氣氛,但教練提醒他們過去的成功。
items.sec: Emotions & Mental Health 情緒與心理健康

items.def: hopeful that things will turn out well
items.s: Although the test was hard, Jenny felt ________ about her score, because she had studied every chapter carefully.
items.zh: 雖然考試很難,珍妮對她的分數感到樂觀,因為她仔細讀過了每一章。
items.sec: Emotions & Mental Health 情緒與心理健康

items.def: expecting things to go badly
items.s: My brother is always ________ about job interviews, so I tell him to focus on his strengths instead.
items.zh: 我哥哥對工作面試總是很悲觀,所以我叫他改為專注於自己的優點。
items.sec: Emotions & Mental Health 情緒與心理健康

items.def: sad and without hope
items.s: The rainy weather made everyone feel ________, so our teacher played some cheerful music during the break.
items.zh: 下雨的天氣讓大家都覺得陰沉憂鬱,所以老師在下課時播放了一些輕快的音樂。
items.sec: Emotions & Mental Health 情緒與心理健康

items.def: happy and friendly
items.s: The nurse was always ________ with her patients, and her smile made the hospital feel less frightening.
items.zh: 那位護理師對病人總是很開朗,她的微笑讓醫院顯得不那麼可怕。
items.sec: Emotions & Mental Health 情緒與心理健康

items.def: relaxed and not worried or excited
items.s: Try to stay ________ during the exam, because panicking will only make you forget what you have learned.
items.zh: 考試時要盡量保持冷靜,因為驚慌只會讓你忘記學過的東西。
items.sec: Emotions & Mental Health 情緒與心理健康

items.def: unhappy or worried because something bad happened
items.s: Lily was ________ when her best friend moved to another city, but they still video-chat every weekend.
items.zh: 莉莉最好的朋友搬到另一個城市時,她很難過,但她們每個週末仍然視訊聊天。
items.sec: Emotions & Mental Health 情緒與心理健康

items.def: a little angry
items.s: I was ________ when my little brother kept talking during my online class, so I asked him to play in another room.
items.zh: 我上線上課時弟弟一直講話,讓我很惱怒,所以我請他去別的房間玩。
items.sec: Emotions & Mental Health 情緒與心理健康

items.def: a very strong fear of something
items.s: Mark has a ________ of heights, so he never goes on the glass bridge, even when his friends try to persuade him.
items.zh: 馬克有懼高恐懼症,所以即使朋友試著說服他,他也從不走玻璃橋。
items.sec: Emotions & Mental Health 情緒與心理健康

items.def: a person trained to listen and give advice about problems
items.s: If you feel stressed about school, you can talk to the school ________, and everything you say will be kept private.
items.zh: 如果你對學業感到有壓力,可以找學校的輔導老師談談,你說的一切都會被保密。
items.sec: Emotions & Mental Health 情緒與心理健康

items.def: a person who helps people with mental or physical problems
items.s: After the car accident, Anna saw a ________ every week, and slowly she felt brave enough to drive again.
items.zh: 車禍之後,安娜每週去看治療師,慢慢地她覺得有勇氣再開車了。
items.sec: Emotions & Mental Health 情緒與心理健康

items.def: treatment that helps someone feel better
items.s: Talking ________ helped my cousin understand his feelings, and now he handles stress much better than before.
items.zh: 談話治療幫助我表哥了解自己的感受,現在他處理壓力的能力比以前好多了。
items.sec: Emotions & Mental Health 情緒與心理健康

items.def: a person who studies the mind and behaviour
items.s: The ________ explained that short breaks help the brain rest, so students should not study for hours without stopping.
items.zh: 那位心理學家解釋說,短暫的休息能讓大腦休息,所以學生不應該連續讀好幾個小時都不停下來。
items.sec: Emotions & Mental Health 情緒與心理健康

items.def: a doctor who treats mental illness
items.s: Her family doctor sent her to a ________, because her sleeping problems had lasted for many months.
items.zh: 她的家庭醫師把她轉介給精神科醫師,因為她的睡眠問題已經持續好幾個月了。
items.sec: Emotions & Mental Health 情緒與心理健康

items.def: belief in your own abilities
items.s: Joining the drama club gave Tina more ________, and now she is not afraid to share her ideas in class.
items.zh: 加入戲劇社讓蒂娜更有自信心,現在她不再害怕在課堂上分享想法。
items.sec: Emotions & Mental Health 情緒與心理健康

items.def: the act of resting and becoming calm
items.s: Listening to soft music is my favourite form of ________, and it helps me fall asleep after a long day at school.
items.zh: 聽輕音樂是我最喜歡的放鬆方式,它幫助我在學校忙碌一整天後入睡。
items.sec: Coping & Self-Care 調適與自我照顧

items.def: sitting quietly and focusing your mind to feel calm
items.s: Our class tried ten minutes of ________ before the test, and many students said they felt less nervous afterwards.
items.zh: 我們班在考試前嘗試了十分鐘的冥想,許多同學說之後覺得比較不緊張了。
items.sec: Coping & Self-Care 調適與自我照顧

items.def: exercises for the body and breathing that help you relax
items.s: My aunt started doing ________ twice a week, and she says her back pain and stress have both improved.
items.zh: 我阿姨開始每週做兩次瑜伽,她說她的背痛和壓力都改善了。
items.sec: Coping & Self-Care 調適與自我照顧

items.def: writing about your thoughts and feelings regularly
items.s: Daily ________ helps Amy understand her feelings, because writing them down makes her problems seem smaller.
items.zh: 每天寫心情日記幫助艾咪了解自己的感受,因為把感受寫下來讓她的問題顯得比較小。
items.sec: Coping & Self-Care 調適與自我照顧

items.def: an activity you enjoy in your free time
items.s: Painting is a relaxing ________ for my father, and he often paints on Sunday mornings to forget about work.
items.zh: 畫畫是我爸爸很放鬆的嗜好,他常在星期天早上畫畫來忘掉工作。
items.sec: Coping & Self-Care 調適與自我照顧

items.def: a session of physical exercise
items.s: A short ________ after school gives me more energy, so I can concentrate better when I do my homework.
items.zh: 放學後短暫的運動給我更多精力,所以我寫作業時能更專心。
items.sec: Coping & Self-Care 調適與自我照顧

items.def: a short sleep during the day
items.s: A twenty-minute ________ after lunch can refresh your brain, but sleeping too long may make you feel more tired.
items.zh: 午餐後二十分鐘的小睡可以讓大腦恢復精神,但睡太久可能會讓你更累。
items.sec: Coping & Self-Care 調適與自我照顧

items.def: taking slow, full breaths to calm down
