items.s: The nurse taught the children ______ ______ before their injections, and most of them stayed calm and did not cry.
items.zh: 護理師在打針前教孩子們深呼吸,大部分的孩子都保持冷靜沒有哭。
items.sec: Coping & Self-Care 調適與自我照顧

items.def: things you do to protect your own health and happiness
items.s: Getting enough sleep is an important part of ________, but many busy students ignore it during exam week.
items.zh: 睡眠充足是自我照顧的重要部分,但許多忙碌的學生在考試週會忽略它。
items.sec: Coping & Self-Care 調適與自我照顧

items.def: the feeling of being thankful
items.s: Writing down three things you feel ________ for each night can make you happier, and it only takes two minutes.
items.zh: 每天晚上寫下三件讓你心懷感恩的事可以讓你更快樂,而且只需要兩分鐘。
items.sec: Coping & Self-Care 調適與自我照顧

items.def: a hopeful and cheerful attitude
items.s: Our coach is full of ________, so even after a loss, the team leaves practice feeling hopeful.
items.zh: 我們的教練充滿正能量,所以即使輸了比賽,球隊練習結束時仍然充滿希望。
items.sec: Coping & Self-Care 調適與自我照顧

items.def: to relax after work or stress
items.s: After a busy week, my parents like to ________ by watching a movie at home, and they turn off their phones.
items.zh: 忙碌一週之後,我爸媽喜歡在家看電影來放鬆,而且他們會把手機關掉。
items.sec: Coping & Self-Care 調適與自我照顧

items.def: to get your energy back by resting
items.s: Weekend trips to the countryside help me ________, so I feel fresh and ready when Monday comes.
items.zh: 週末到鄉下旅行幫助我恢復精力,所以星期一來臨時我感到神清氣爽、準備就緒。
items.sec: Coping & Self-Care 調適與自我照顧

items.def: to express strong feelings, especially anger
items.s: It is healthy to ________ your feelings to a trusted friend, but shouting at strangers online is not a good idea.
items.zh: 向信任的朋友發洩情緒是健康的,但在網路上對陌生人大吼並不是好主意。
items.sec: Coping & Self-Care 調適與自我照顧

items.def: to tell someone a secret or private feeling
items.s: Many teenagers ________ in their friends rather than their parents, because they worry that adults will not understand.
items.zh: 許多青少年會向朋友而不是父母傾訴,因為他們擔心大人不會理解。
items.sec: Coping & Self-Care 調適與自我照顧

items.def: to make someone feel less worried
items.s: The doctor ________ my mother that the operation was simple, and she finally stopped worrying.
items.zh: 醫生向我媽媽保證手術很簡單,讓她安心,她終於不再擔心了。
items.sec: Coping & Self-Care 調適與自我照顧

items.def: to make someone feel better when they are sad
items.s: When Sarah failed her driving test, her friends ________ her with ice cream and funny stories.
items.zh: 莎拉駕照考試沒過時,她的朋友們用冰淇淋和好笑的故事安慰她。
items.sec: Coping & Self-Care 調適與自我照顧

items.def: to make someone calm or less upset
items.s: The sound of the rain ________ me, and I soon forgot about the argument I had with my brother.
items.zh: 雨聲撫慰了我,我很快就忘了和哥哥的爭吵。
items.sec: Coping & Self-Care 調適與自我照顧

items.def: time when you rest and do not work
items.s: Students need some ________ every day, because studying all the time can lead to stress and poor sleep.
items.zh: 學生每天都需要一些休息時間,因為一直讀書會導致壓力和睡不好。
items.sec: Coping & Self-Care 調適與自我照顧

items.def: a short holiday away from home
items.s: After the busy exam period, our family took a weekend ________ to the beach, and we all came back relaxed.
items.zh: 忙碌的考試期過後,我們家去海邊短暫度假了一個週末,大家回來時都很放鬆。
items.sec: Coping & Self-Care 調適與自我照顧

items.def: the sound or act of laughing
items.s: They say ________ is the best medicine, and watching a funny show with friends really does lower my stress.
items.zh: 人家說歡笑是最好的良藥,而和朋友一起看搞笑節目真的能降低我的壓力。
items.sec: Coping & Self-Care 調適與自我照顧

items.def: to spend time with other people for fun
items.s: Busy students should still ________ with friends sometimes, because spending time with people they like reduces stress.
items.zh: 忙碌的學生偶爾還是應該和朋友交際往來,因為和喜歡的人相處能減輕壓力。
items.sec: Coping & Self-Care 調適與自我照顧

items.def: a way to express feelings or use energy
items.s: Playing the drums is a great ________ for my anger, and my neighbours are kind enough not to complain.
items.zh: 打鼓是我宣洩怒氣很好的出口,而且我的鄰居們很好心沒有抱怨。
items.sec: Coping & Self-Care 調適與自我照顧

items.def: rubbing the body to relieve pain or stress
items.s: My shoulders were stiff after hours at the computer, so my sister gave me a short ________, and I felt much better.
items.zh: 在電腦前好幾個小時之後我的肩膀很僵硬,所以姊姊幫我做了簡短的按摩,我感覺好多了。
items.sec: Coping & Self-Care 調適與自我照顧

items.def: a phone service that gives advice or support
items.s: If you feel very upset late at night, you can call a ________, and a trained person will listen to you.
items.zh: 如果你深夜感到非常難過,可以打求助專線,會有受過訓練的人聽你說話。
items.sec: Coping & Self-Care 調適與自我照顧

items.def: something you want to achieve
items.s: My ________ this year is to read twenty English books, so I read for half an hour every night before bed.
items.zh: 我今年的目標是讀二十本英文書,所以我每晚睡前閱讀半小時。

items.def: a strong wish to be successful
items.s: Her ________ is to become a doctor, but she knows she must study very hard to reach that dream.
items.zh: 她的抱負是成為醫生,但她知道必須非常努力讀書才能實現那個夢想。

items.def: strong energy and wish to achieve something
items.s: Jack has the ________ to succeed, so he practises the piano every day even when his friends go out to play.
items.zh: 傑克有成功的幹勁,所以即使朋友們出去玩,他還是每天練琴。

items.def: not giving up even when something is difficult
items.s: With great ________, the runner finished the marathon, although she had hurt her ankle halfway through the race.
items.zh: 這位跑者憑著極大的決心跑完了馬拉松,雖然她在比賽途中扭傷了腳踝。

items.def: continuing to try even when progress is slow
items.s: Learning a language takes ________, because you will make many mistakes before you speak it well.
items.zh: 學習語言需要毅力,因為在說得流利之前你會犯很多錯。

items.def: the ability to control what you do and resist temptation
items.s: It takes ________ to put your phone away while studying, but your grades will thank you later.
items.zh: 讀書時把手機收起來需要意志力,但你的成績之後會感謝你。

items.def: the ability to make yourself do things you should do
items.s: Online learning requires a lot of ________, because nobody checks whether you are really watching the lessons.
items.zh: 線上學習需要很強的自律,因為沒有人會檢查你是否真的在看課程。

items.def: a very strong interest or love for something
items.s: Daniel has a ________ for cooking, and he dreams of opening his own small restaurant one day.
items.zh: 丹尼爾對烹飪充滿熱情,他夢想有一天開一家屬於自己的小餐廳。

items.def: a feeling of being very excited and interested
items.s: The students showed great ________ for the science fair, so they stayed after school to build their projects.
items.zh: 學生們對科展展現極大的熱忱,所以他們放學後留下來製作作品。

items.def: the hard work you use to do something
items.s: Our teacher praises ________ more than results, because she believes hard work matters more than talent.
items.zh: 我們老師稱讚努力多過稱讚結果,因為她相信努力比天分更重要。

items.def: something good you have done through hard work
items.s: Passing the advanced English test was a big ________ for Kelly, and her parents took her out to celebrate.
items.zh: 通過高級英語檢定對凱莉來說是很大的成就,她爸媽帶她出去慶祝。

items.def: a reason that gives your life or work meaning
items.s: Volunteering at the animal shelter gave Tom a sense of ________, and he stopped feeling bored on weekends.
items.zh: 在動物收容所當志工讓湯姆有了意義感,他週末不再覺得無聊。

items.def: a strong wish to know or learn something
items.s: Young children are full of ________, and they ask "why" so many times that parents sometimes run out of answers.
items.zh: 小孩子充滿好奇心,他們問好多次「為什麼」,讓父母有時都答不出來了。

items.def: something that gives you new ideas or makes you want to do something
items.s: The athlete's story was a great ________ to the students, and many of them joined the school running team.
items.zh: 那位運動員的故事對學生們是很大的鼓舞,許多人加入了學校的跑步隊。

items.def: words that show you think someone did well
items.s: A little ________ from a teacher can make a big difference, because students work harder when they feel noticed.
items.zh: 老師的一點稱讚就能帶來很大的不同,因為學生覺得被注意到時會更努力。

items.def: words or actions that give someone confidence
items.s: With her parents' ________, Grace entered the singing contest, and she was surprised to reach the final round.
items.zh: 在父母的鼓勵下,葛蕾絲參加了歌唱比賽,而她很驚訝自己進入了決賽。

items.def: courage and the will to keep going
items.s: Research suggests that ________ matters as much as talent, because people who keep trying often achieve more.
items.zh: 研究顯示堅韌的毅力和天分一樣重要,因為持續嘗試的人往往成就更多。

items.def: a problem that delays your progress
items.s: Failing the first driving test was a ________, but Eric practised more and passed easily the second time.
items.zh: 第一次駕照考試沒過是個挫折,但艾瑞克多加練習,第二次就輕鬆通過了。

items.def: a lack of success
items.s: Don't see ________ as the end, because every mistake teaches you something useful for next time.
items.zh: 不要把失敗看作終點,因為每個錯誤都會教你一些下次有用的東西。

items.def: movement towards a goal or improvement
items.s: Keep a list of new words you learn each week, and you will see how much ________ you have made by the end of the term.
items.zh: 把每週學到的新單字列成清單,到學期末你就會看到自己有多大的進步。

items.def: a person's usual way of thinking
items.s: Students with a positive ________ see hard problems as chances to learn, while others may give up too quickly.
items.zh: 擁有正向心態的學生把難題看作學習的機會,而其他人可能太快放棄。

items.def: confidence in your own abilities
items.s: Winning the speech contest gave Ivy more ________, and she began to answer questions in class without fear.
items.zh: 贏得演講比賽讓艾薇更相信自己,她開始毫不畏懼地在課堂上回答問題。

items.def: wanting very much to win or be better than others
items.s: My brother is very ________, so he gets upset when he loses even a simple card game with the family.
items.zh: 我弟弟非常好勝,所以連跟家人玩簡單的紙牌遊戲輸了他都會不高興。

items.def: wanting to do something very much
items.s: The new students were ________ to make friends, so they joined several clubs during the first week of school.
items.zh: 新生們渴望交朋友,所以他們在開學第一週就加入了好幾個社團。

items.def: very interested and enthusiastic
items.s: Tom is ________ on basketball, and he practises shooting every evening, even when it is cold outside.
items.zh: 湯姆熱衷於籃球,他每天傍晚都練習投籃,即使外面很冷也一樣。

items.def: putting a lot of effort into work
items.s: My classmate is so ________ that she reviews her notes on the bus, so she rarely needs to study late at night.
items.zh: 我的同學非常勤奮,她在公車上複習筆記,所以她很少需要熬夜讀書。

items.def: not wanting to work or make an effort
items.s: I felt ________ on Sunday morning and stayed in bed, but then I had to rush to finish my homework at night.
items.zh: 星期天早上我覺得很懶,一直賴在床上,結果晚上必須趕著完成作業。

items.def: the feeling of being tired because nothing is interesting
items.s: Some students check their phones out of ________, but this habit can make it hard to concentrate in class.
items.zh: 有些學生出於無聊而查看手機,但這個習慣會讓上課難以專心。

items.def: able to work hard without others pushing you
items.s: Ken is very ________, so he studies English online every day even though nobody tells him to.
items.zh: 肯非常自動自發,所以即使沒有人要求,他每天都在線上學英文。

items.def: to give all your attention to one thing
items.s: It is hard to ________ on your homework when the TV is on, so find a quiet place and turn off your phone.
items.zh: 電視開著的時候很難專注在作業上,所以找個安靜的地方並把手機關掉。

items.def: to delay doing something you should do
items.s: I often ________ when I have a big essay to write, so I now break it into small parts and do one each day.
items.zh: 我有一篇大論文要寫時常常會拖延,所以現在我把它分成小部分,每天完成一部分。

items.def: the habit of delaying things you should do
items.s: ________ is a common problem among students, and it often leads to stress the night before a deadline.
items.zh: 拖延是學生常見的問題,它常常導致截止日前一晚壓力很大。

items.def: to move an event to a later time
items.s: The school decided to ________ the sports day because of the typhoon, and students were happy to have an extra week to practise.
items.zh: 學校因為颱風決定延後運動會,學生們很高興多了一週可以練習。

items.def: to make something happen later than planned
items.s: If you ________ starting your project, you will have less time to fix mistakes, and the result may disappoint you.
items.zh: 如果你延遲開始你的專題,你修正錯誤的時間就會變少,結果可能讓你失望。

items.def: something you do regularly, often without thinking
items.s: Checking her phone first thing in the morning became a bad ________, so Lucy now keeps it outside her bedroom.
items.zh: 一早醒來就查看手機成了一個壞習慣,所以露西現在把手機放在臥室外面。

items.def: done often or regularly as a habit
items.s: He is a ________ late-comer, and his teacher finally called his parents because he missed the first class every Monday.
items.zh: 他是個習慣性遲到的人,老師最後打電話給他的父母,因為他每週一都錯過第一節課。

items.def: a strong wish to do something you should not do
items.s: The ________ to play games was strong, but Kevin finished his maths homework first and then relaxed.
items.zh: 打電動的誘惑很強,但凱文先完成數學作業,然後才放鬆。

items.def: to make someone want to do something, often something wrong
items.s: The smell of fried chicken ________ me to stop at the night market, although I had promised to eat healthily this week.
items.zh: 炸雞的香味引誘我在夜市停下來,雖然我答應過這週要吃得健康。

items.def: a plan that lists times for activities
items.s: Making a weekly study ________ helped me balance homework and basketball, and I felt much less stressed.
items.zh: 擬定每週讀書時間表幫助我平衡作業和籃球,我覺得壓力小了很多。

items.def: a list of times when classes or events happen
items.s: Our class ________ changed this term, so now we have English first thing on Monday, which everyone finds hard.
items.zh: 我們班這學期的課表改了,所以現在星期一第一節就是英文,大家都覺得很辛苦。

items.def: a small book for writing plans and dates
items.s: I write all my tests and deadlines in a ________, and checking it every morning keeps me from forgetting anything.
items.zh: 我把所有的考試和截止日期寫在計畫本裡,每天早上查看它讓我不會忘記任何事。

items.def: a list of tasks you need to do
items.s: I make a ______ ______ every Sunday night, and crossing off each finished task gives me a nice feeling.
items.zh: 我每個星期天晚上都會列一張待辦清單,每劃掉一項完成的事就讓我感覺很好。

items.def: something that helps you remember
items.s: I set a phone ________ for my dentist appointment, because I had forgotten it twice before.
items.zh: 我在手機上設定了看牙醫的提醒,因為我之前已經忘記過兩次了。

items.def: a list of things to check or do
items.s: Before every trip, my mother uses a ________ to pack, so we never forget passports or phone chargers.
items.zh: 每次出遊前,我媽媽都用檢查清單打包,所以我們從不會忘記護照或手機充電器。

items.def: staying away from something you do not want to face
items.s: Playing games all night was just ________, because Tim did not want to think about his poor test result.
items.zh: 整晚打電動只是一種逃避,因為提姆不想去想他很差的考試成績。

items.def: a reason you give to explain a mistake or avoid something
items.s: Andy always has an ________ for not doing his homework, but this time his teacher did not believe him.
items.zh: 安迪總是有不寫作業的藉口,但這次老師不相信他了。

items.def: done at the latest possible time
items.s: ________ studying rarely works well, because your brain needs time and sleep to remember new information.
items.zh: 臨時抱佛腳的讀書很少有好效果,因為大腦需要時間和睡眠來記住新資訊。

items.def: to study a lot in a short time before an exam
items.s: Many students ________ the night before a test, but they often forget most of the information a week later.
items.zh: 許多學生在考試前一晚死記硬背,但一週後他們往往忘了大部分的內容。

items.def: the ability to control your feelings and actions
items.s: It takes ________ to stop watching videos after one episode, so I ask my sister to hide the remote control.
items.zh: 看完一集影片就停下來需要自制力,所以我請姊姊把遙控器藏起來。

items.def: a series of successes or days in a row
items.s: I have a sixty-day ________ on my language app, and I don't want to lose it, so I practise even on holidays.
items.zh: 我在語言學習應用程式上有六十天的連續紀錄,我不想中斷,所以連假日也練習。

items.def: a very strong wish for something, often food
items.s: Stress can give people a ________ for sweet snacks, so I keep fruit on my desk during exam week.
items.zh: 壓力會讓人渴望甜食,所以考試週時我在書桌上放水果。

items.def: not working or doing anything useful
items.s: Rather than sitting ________ during the long summer holiday, Mia took a part-time job at a bookshop.
items.zh: 米亞沒有在漫長的暑假裡無所事事,而是在一家書店找了份兼職工作。

items.def: to move or act very slowly
items.s: If you ________ on the way to school, you will miss the bus, and then you will be late for the test.
items.zh: 如果你上學途中拖拖拉拉,你會錯過公車,然後考試就會遲到。

items.def: the need to make everything perfect
items.s: Her ________ made her rewrite the first page ten times, so she never finished the rest of the story.
items.zh: 她的完美主義讓她把第一頁重寫了十次,所以她一直沒寫完故事的其他部分。

items.def: a person who wants everything to be perfect
items.s: As a ________, Leo spends hours on small details, but he sometimes misses deadlines because of this.
items.zh: 身為完美主義者,里歐花好幾個小時在小細節上,但他有時因此錯過截止期限。

items.def: a choice you make after thinking
items.s: Choosing a university is a big ________, so you should talk to teachers and visit the campus before you decide.
items.zh: 選擇大學是個重大的決定,所以你在決定之前應該和老師談談並參觀校園。

items.def: the act of picking one thing from several
items.s: There were too many ________ on the menu, and it took my friend twenty minutes to order a simple drink.
items.zh: 菜單上有太多選擇,我的朋友花了二十分鐘才點了一杯簡單的飲料。

items.def: the ability to make good decisions
items.s: Lack of sleep can affect your ________, so you should never drive when you feel very tired.
items.zh: 睡眠不足會影響你的判斷力,所以覺得很累時千萬不要開車。

items.def: a simple rule that helps you decide quickly
items.s: People often use a simple ________ when shopping, such as choosing the brand they know, but it does not always give the best result.
items.zh: 人們購物時常用一種簡單的經驗法則,例如選擇熟悉的品牌,但這不一定能得到最好的結果。

items.def: knowing something from feeling, not from thinking it through
items.s: My ________ told me something was wrong with the online offer, so I did not give my credit card number.
items.zh: 我的直覺告訴我那個網路優惠有問題,所以我沒有提供信用卡號碼。

items.def: based on feelings rather than facts; easy to understand
items.s: The new app is very ________, so even my grandmother learned to use it in a few minutes without any help.
items.zh: 這個新的應用程式非常直觀,所以連我奶奶都在幾分鐘內不靠任何幫忙就學會使用了。

items.def: not based on clear thinking
items.s: Her fear of the dark is ________, but it still makes her feel nervous when she walks home at night.
items.zh: 她對黑暗的恐懼是不理性的,但這仍然讓她晚上走路回家時感到緊張。

items.def: the process of thinking about something in a logical way
items.s: The teacher liked Jason's ________ in his essay, because each point was supported by clear examples.
items.zh: 老師喜歡傑森文章中的論證,因為每個論點都有清楚的例子支持。

items.def: following clear and sensible thinking
items.s: It is ________ to compare prices before buying a new phone, but many people buy on impulse instead.
items.zh: 買新手機前比較價格是合乎邏輯的,但許多人反而一時衝動就買了。

items.def: done too quickly without enough thought
items.s: Don't make a ________ decision about quitting the team, because you might feel differently after a good night's sleep.
items.zh: 不要草率決定退出球隊,因為好好睡一晚之後你可能會有不同的感覺。

items.def: a risky action that may succeed or fail
items.s: Leaving his stable job to start a café was a ________, but Mr Lin was willing to take the risk.
items.zh: 辭掉穩定的工作去開咖啡店是一場賭注,但林先生願意冒這個險。

items.def: a balance between two things you cannot have together
items.s: There is always a ________ between time and money, because a faster train usually costs more than a slow bus.
items.zh: 時間和金錢之間總是有取捨,因為較快的火車通常比慢速巴士貴。

items.def: to feel sorry about something you did or did not do
items.s: I ________ not studying harder in junior high, but I am working much harder now that I am in senior high.
items.zh: 我後悔國中時沒有更努力讀書,但現在上了高中我努力多了。

items.def: understanding a situation only after it has happened
items.s: With ________, I should have started revising earlier, but at the time I thought I had plenty of time.
items.zh: 事後看來,我應該早點開始複習,但當時我以為時間很充裕。

items.def: doing dangerous things without thinking about the results
items.s: Riding a scooter fast in the rain is ________, and many accidents happen because drivers ignore the danger.
items.zh: 在雨中騎機車騎很快是很魯莽的,許多事故都是因為駕駛人忽視危險而發生。

items.def: too much belief in your own ability
items.s: His ________ cost him the match, because he did not prepare and thought he would win easily.
items.zh: 他的過度自信讓他輸掉了比賽,因為他沒有準備,還以為可以輕鬆獲勝。

items.def: the habit of only noticing facts that agree with what you already believe
items.s: Because of ______ ______, people often read news that supports their own opinions, and they ignore other views.
items.zh: 由於確認偏誤,人們常常閱讀支持自己意見的新聞,而忽略其他觀點。

items.def: relying too much on the first number or fact you hear
items.s: Shops use ________ when they show a high "original price" first, so the sale price looks like a great deal.
items.zh: 商店先標出高的「原價」來運用錨定效應,讓特價看起來非常划算。

items.def: the way information is presented, which can change choices
items.s: The ________ of the message mattered, because more people bought the yogurt labelled "90% fat-free" than "10% fat".
items.zh: 訊息的表述方式很重要,因為標示「90%無脂」的優格比標示「10%脂肪」的賣得更多。

items.def: the tendency to fear losing more than you enjoy winning
items.s: ______ ______ explains why many people keep a bad investment, because selling it would mean accepting a loss.
items.zh: 損失規避解釋了為什麼許多人會留著不好的投資,因為賣掉就代表要接受虧損。

items.def: money or time already spent that cannot be recovered
items.s: I kept watching the boring movie because of the ______ ______ of the ticket, but I just wasted two more hours.
items.zh: 因為電影票的沉沒成本,我繼續看那部無聊的電影,但我只是又浪費了兩個小時。

items.def: liking one thing more than another
items.s: Many students have a ________ for studying at night, while others focus better early in the morning.
items.zh: 許多學生偏好在晚上讀書,而其他人則在一大早比較專心。

items.def: what you give up when you choose something else
items.s: The ______ ______ of playing games all weekend is the study time you lose, so think carefully before you start.
items.zh: 整個週末打電動的機會成本就是你失去的讀書時間,所以開始前要仔細想想。

items.def: influence from friends to act like them
items.s: Because of ______ ______, some teenagers try things they don't really want to do, so it is important to learn to say no.
items.zh: 由於同儕壓力,有些青少年會嘗試他們其實不想做的事,所以學會說不是很重要的。

items.def: behaving the same way as most people in a group
items.s: Wearing a uniform shows ________ to school rules, but some students wish they could express their own style.
items.zh: 穿制服表示遵從校規,但有些學生希望能表現自己的風格。

items.def: when a group agrees too quickly and ignores other ideas
items.s: The team fell into ________, because nobody wanted to argue with the leader, so they missed an obvious problem.
items.zh: 團隊陷入了團體迷思,因為沒有人想和隊長爭論,所以他們漏掉了一個明顯的問題。

items.def: an opinion about what someone should do
items.s: My older cousin gave me useful ________ about choosing a major, and I felt much clearer about my future.
items.zh: 我的表哥給了我關於選擇科系很有用的建議,我對未來感到清楚多了。

items.def: unable to make decisions quickly
items.s: My sister is so ________ that she spent an hour choosing a T-shirt, and in the end she bought nothing.
items.zh: 我姊姊非常優柔寡斷,她花了一個小時挑一件T恤,最後什麼都沒買。

items.def: to be unable to decide what to do
items.s: If you ________ too long about joining the trip, the tickets may sell out, so please decide by Friday.
items.zh: 如果你對參加旅行猶豫不決太久,票可能會賣完,所以請在星期五前決定。

items.def: to pause before doing something because you are unsure
items.s: Please don't ________ to ask questions in class, because other students probably have the same questions too.
items.zh: 上課時請不要猶豫提問,因為其他同學可能也有同樣的問題。

items.def: to think carefully about something before deciding
items.s: You should ________ the costs and benefits of a part-time job, because it may take time away from your studies.
items.zh: 你應該權衡打工的成本與好處,因為它可能會佔用你的讀書時間。

items.def: the ability to plan for what will happen in the future
items.s: Thanks to her mother's ________, they had packed umbrellas, so they stayed dry when the storm suddenly arrived.
items.zh: 多虧媽媽的先見之明,她們帶了雨傘,所以暴風雨突然來時她們沒有淋濕。

items.def: done too quickly without thinking
items.s: Selling his bike on the spot was a ________ decision, and he regretted it the next morning when he had to walk to school.
items.zh: 當場賣掉腳踏車是個輕率的決定,隔天早上他必須走路上學時就後悔了。

items.def: to think again about a decision
items.s: The manager asked Nina to ________ her plan to quit, because the company did not want to lose such a good worker.
items.zh: 經理請妮娜重新考慮她辭職的計畫,因為公司不想失去這麼好的員工。

items.def: to doubt a decision after you have made it
items.s: Don't ________ every answer on the test, because your first choice is often correct if you studied well.
items.zh: 不要對考卷上的每個答案反覆懷疑,因為如果你有好好讀書,第一個選擇往往是對的。

items.def: the type of person you are, shown by how you behave
items.s: Jenny has a warm ________, so new students always feel welcome when they sit next to her.
items.zh: 珍妮有溫暖的個性,所以新同學坐在她旁邊總是覺得很受歡迎。
items.sec: Personality & Social Behaviour 人格與社會行為

items.def: a quality that is part of someone's character
items.s: Patience is an important ________ for teachers, because students in the same class often learn at very different speeds.
items.zh: 耐心是老師重要的特質,因為同一班的學生學習速度常常差很多。
items.sec: Personality & Social Behaviour 人格與社會行為

items.def: a quiet person who gets energy from being alone
items.s: As an ________, Ryan enjoys reading alone after school, but he still likes spending time with a few close friends.
items.zh: 身為內向的人,萊恩喜歡放學後獨自閱讀,但他還是喜歡和幾個好朋友相處。
items.sec: Personality & Social Behaviour 人格與社會行為

items.def: a lively person who gets energy from being with others
items.s: My best friend is a true ________, and she feels tired if she has to stay home alone all weekend.
items.zh: 我最好的朋友是個真正的外向的人,如果整個週末都得獨自待在家,她會覺得很累。
items.sec: Personality & Social Behaviour 人格與社會行為

items.def: friendly and liking to meet people
items.s: Linda is ________ and talks to everyone at parties, while her twin brother prefers to listen quietly.
items.zh: 琳達很外向,在派對上和每個人聊天,而她的雙胞胎哥哥則比較喜歡安靜地聽。
items.sec: Personality & Social Behaviour 人格與社會行為

items.def: nervous about talking to people you don't know
items.s: Tom was too ________ to ask the teacher for help, so he stayed confused about the maths problem for days.
items.zh: 湯姆太害羞了,不敢向老師求助,所以好幾天都對那道數學題感到困惑。
items.sec: Personality & Social Behaviour 人格與社會行為

items.def: enjoying spending time with other people
items.s: Dogs are very ________ animals, and they often feel lonely if their owners leave them alone all day.
items.zh: 狗是非常喜歡與人相處的動物,如果主人整天把牠們單獨留下,牠們常會感到寂寞。
items.sec: Personality & Social Behaviour 人格與社會行為

items.def: the ability to understand how others feel
items.s: Good doctors show ________ to their patients, because sick people need kindness as well as medicine.
items.zh: 好醫生會對病人展現同理心,因為生病的人除了藥物也需要關懷。
items.sec: Personality & Social Behaviour 人格與社會行為

items.def: feeling sorry for someone who is in trouble
items.s: We sent a card to show our ________ when our teacher's father passed away, and she thanked the whole class.
items.zh: 老師的父親過世時,我們寄了一張卡片表達同情與慰問,她向全班道謝。
items.sec: Personality & Social Behaviour 人格與社會行為

items.def: a strong wish to help people who are suffering
items.s: The volunteers treated the homeless with ________, and they listened to their stories as well as giving them food.
items.zh: 志工們以慈悲心對待無家可歸的人,除了提供食物也聆聽他們的故事。
items.sec: Personality & Social Behaviour 人格與社會行為

items.def: caring about others more than yourself
items.s: Donating blood is a simple act of ________, because you help a stranger and expect nothing in return.
items.zh: 捐血是一種簡單的無私行為,因為你幫助陌生人而不期待任何回報。
items.sec: Personality & Social Behaviour 人格與社會行為

items.def: caring only about yourself
items.s: It was ________ of him to eat all the snacks, and his roommates were angry because they had paid for them too.
items.zh: 他把所有零食都吃光很自私,他的室友們很生氣,因為他們也有出錢。
items.sec: Personality & Social Behaviour 人格與社會行為

items.def: happy to give time, money or help to others
items.s: Our neighbour is very ________, and she often shares the vegetables from her garden with the whole street.
items.zh: 我們的鄰居非常慷慨,她常把自家菜園的蔬菜分享給整條街的人。
items.sec: Personality & Social Behaviour 人格與社會行為

items.def: not willing to change your mind
items.s: My grandfather is ________ about using his old phone, although we have bought him a new one twice.
items.zh: 我爺爺很固執地要用他的舊手機,雖然我們已經買了兩次新手機給他。
items.sec: Personality & Social Behaviour 人格與社會行為

items.def: unable to wait calmly
items.s: People become ________ when the internet is slow, and some of them close the website after only a few seconds.
items.zh: 網路很慢時人們會變得不耐煩,有些人只等幾秒鐘就關掉網站。
items.sec: Personality & Social Behaviour 人格與社會行為

items.def: your sense of your own importance
items.s: Losing the final hurt his ________, but he learned to accept defeat and train harder for next year.
items.zh: 輸掉決賽傷了他的自尊心,但他學會接受失敗並為明年更努力訓練。
items.sec: Personality & Social Behaviour 人格與社會行為

items.def: the feeling that you are a valuable person
items.s: Your ________ should not depend on your test scores, because you have many other strengths as a person.
items.zh: 你的自我價值不應該取決於考試分數,因為身為一個人你還有許多其他優點。
items.sec: Personality & Social Behaviour 人格與社會行為

items.def: not confident about yourself
items.cn: 沒有安全感的;不自信的
items.s: Social media can make teenagers feel ________ about their looks, so it is wise to limit screen time.
items.zh: 社群媒體會讓青少年對自己的外表感到不自信,所以限制使用螢幕的時間是明智的。
items.sec: Personality & Social Behaviour 人格與社會行為

items.def: a person who sees something happen but is not involved
items.s: One ________ called an ambulance after the accident, while others just stood and took photos with their phones.
items.zh: 事故發生後有一位旁觀者叫了救護車,而其他人只是站著用手機拍照。
items.sec: Personality & Social Behaviour 人格與社會行為

items.def: doing what you are told to do
items.s: The dog trainer taught basic ________ to the puppies, and soon they could sit and wait on command.
items.zh: 訓犬師教小狗們基本的服從訓練,很快牠們就能聽口令坐下和等待。
items.sec: Personality & Social Behaviour 人格與社會行為

items.def: to make someone agree to do something by giving reasons
items.s: I tried to ________ my parents to let me join the school trip, and I promised to finish my homework first.
items.zh: 我試著說服爸媽讓我參加校外旅行,並答應會先完成作業。
items.sec: Personality & Social Behaviour 人格與社會行為

items.def: expressing your opinions clearly and confidently
items.s: Being ________ in group work is useful, but you should also listen carefully to your classmates' ideas.
items.zh: 在小組作業中有主見很有用,但你也應該仔細聆聽同學的想法。
items.sec: Personality & Social Behaviour 人格與社會行為

items.def: behaving in an angry or violent way
items.cn: 有攻擊性的;具侵略性的
items.s: Some players become ________ when they are losing, so the referee has to stop the game and calm them down.
items.zh: 有些球員輸球時會變得具攻擊性,所以裁判必須暫停比賽讓他們冷靜下來。
items.sec: Personality & Social Behaviour 人格與社會行為

items.def: not showing your feelings or opinions easily
items.s: My new classmate seemed ________ at first, but after a few weeks she became one of the funniest people in our class.
items.zh: 我的新同學一開始看起來很拘謹,但幾週後她成了我們班最有趣的人之一。
items.sec: Personality & Social Behaviour 人格與社會行為

items.def: relaxed and not easily worried or annoyed
items.s: Our homeroom teacher is very ________, so students feel comfortable telling her about their problems.
items.zh: 我們的導師非常隨和,所以學生們很自在地跟她說自己的問題。
items.sec: Personality & Social Behaviour 人格與社會行為

items.def: a comparison that explains one thing by showing how it is like another
items.s: The teacher used an ________ to explain stress, saying the mind is like a cup that overflows if you keep pouring water into it.
items.zh: 老師用一個類比來解釋壓力,說心靈就像一個杯子,一直倒水就會滿出來。

items.def: to cancel the effect of something
items.s: Staying up all night can ________ the benefits of studying, because a tired brain cannot remember new information well.
items.zh: 整夜不睡會抵消讀書的效果,因為疲累的大腦無法好好記住新資訊。

items.def: despite this
items.s: The exam was very difficult; Sarah passed it easily ________, because she had practised with past papers for months.
items.zh: 那次考試非常難;儘管如此,莎拉還是輕鬆通過了,因為她用考古題練習了好幾個月。

items.def: to create a problem or question
items.s: Too much screen time can ________ a risk to teenagers' sleep, so many parents set phone rules at night.
items.zh: 過多的螢幕時間會對青少年的睡眠造成風險,所以許多父母在晚上訂下手機規則。

items.def: having mixed feelings about something
items.s: Kevin felt ________ about moving abroad, because he was excited about the new school but sad to leave his friends.
items.zh: 凱文對出國感到心情矛盾,因為他對新學校很興奮,卻也捨不得離開朋友。

items.def: worried that something bad may happen
items.s: Many students feel ________ about the first day of university, but most of them settle in within a few weeks.
items.zh: 許多學生對大學第一天感到憂慮,但大多數人在幾週內就適應了。

items.def: clever at understanding situations quickly
items.s: An ________ teacher can notice when a student is stressed, even if the student smiles and says everything is fine.
items.zh: 一位敏銳的老師能察覺學生何時有壓力,即使學生微笑著說一切都很好。

items.def: listening or watching carefully
items.s: The students were very ________ during the talk on sleep, because the speaker gave many useful and funny examples.
items.zh: 學生們在關於睡眠的講座中非常專心,因為講者舉了許多實用又有趣的例子。

items.def: a strong dislike of something
items.s: Some people have an ________ to risk, so they choose a safe job even when a riskier one pays more.
items.zh: 有些人對風險有反感,所以即使有風險的工作薪水更高,他們仍選擇安穩的工作。

items.def: not harmful
items.s: A little stress before a test is usually ________, and it can even help you stay alert and focused.
items.zh: 考試前有一點壓力通常是無害的,甚至能幫助你保持警覺和專注。

items.def: when two things happen together by chance
items.s: It was a ________ that we both chose the same university, but we were very happy to have a familiar friend there.
items.zh: 我們都選了同一所大學是個巧合,但能在那裡有個熟悉的朋友讓我們很開心。

items.def: happening often; not unusual
items.s: Online counselling has become ________ in recent years, and many students find it easier than talking face to face.
items.zh: 近年來線上諮商已變得普遍,許多學生覺得這比面對面談話容易。

items.def: very interesting or convincing
items.cn: 令人信服的;引人入勝的
items.s: The scientist gave ________ evidence that exercise reduces stress, so many listeners decided to start walking every day.
items.zh: 那位科學家提出了運動能減輕壓力的有力證據,所以許多聽眾決定開始每天散步。

items.def: the ability to understand something
items.s: Stress can reduce your reading ________, so you may need to read a passage twice when you are very anxious.
items.zh: 壓力會降低你的閱讀理解力,所以在很焦慮時你可能需要把文章讀兩遍。

items.def: possible to imagine or believe
items.s: It is ________ that the test will be harder this year, so we should prepare more carefully than last year's students did.
items.zh: 今年的考試可能會更難,所以我們應該比去年的學生準備得更仔細。

items.def: to agree
items.s: Most experts ________ that regular sleep is important for learning, but many teenagers still go to bed after midnight.
items.zh: 大多數專家都同意規律的睡眠對學習很重要,但許多青少年仍然在午夜後才上床。

items.def: to accept bad behaviour as acceptable
items.s: The school does not ________ bullying, and any student who hurts others will have to meet the principal.
items.zh: 學校不縱容霸凌,任何傷害他人的學生都必須去見校長。

items.def: aware of something
items.s: Ella was ________ of her shaking voice during the speech, but she kept going and finished with a big smile.
items.zh: 艾拉在演講中意識到自己的聲音在發抖,但她繼續講下去,並帶著燦爛的笑容結束。

items.def: helpful and useful, meant to improve something
items.s: The coach gave the players ________ comments after the game, so they knew exactly what to practise next week.
items.zh: 教練在比賽後給球員們有建設性的意見,所以他們確切知道下週要練習什麼。

items.def: a strong belief
items.s: She spoke with ________ about the value of hard work, and her words motivated many students in the hall.
items.zh: 她以堅定的信念談論努力的價值,她的話激勵了禮堂裡許多學生。

items.def: having the opposite effect of what you want
items.s: Studying for ten hours without a break is ________, because your brain gets tired and you remember less.
items.zh: 連續讀十個小時不休息是適得其反的,因為大腦會疲勞,你記得的反而更少。

items.def: to develop a skill, quality or habit
items.s: Parents can help children ________ good study habits, and these habits will be useful for the rest of their lives.
items.zh: 父母可以幫助孩子培養良好的讀書習慣,而這些習慣會讓他們受用一生。

items.def: a division between two opposite things
items.s: There is a false ________ between work and rest, because good rest actually makes your work better.
items.zh: 工作與休息之間是一種錯誤的二分對立,因為好好休息其實能讓你的工作更好。

items.def: a person's natural character
items.s: My grandmother has a cheerful ________, and she rarely worries even when life becomes difficult.
items.zh: 我奶奶有開朗的性情,即使生活變得艱難她也很少憂慮。

items.def: to ignore something
items.s: Many busy workers ________ the warning signs of stress, and they only see a doctor when they become ill.
items.zh: 許多忙碌的上班族忽視壓力的警訊,直到生病才去看醫生。

items.def: not sure; probably not true or honest
items.s: I was ________ about the advert that promised to cure stress in one day, so I did not buy the expensive pills.
items.zh: 我對那個保證一天就能消除壓力的廣告感到半信半疑,所以我沒有買那昂貴的藥丸。

items.def: wrong; not correct
items.s: It is an ________ belief that stress is always bad, because a small amount can help people perform better.
items.zh: 認為壓力總是不好的是一種錯誤的觀念,因為少量的壓力能幫助人表現得更好。

items.def: to bring a feeling or memory into your mind
items.s: The smell of my grandmother's soup ________ happy memories, and it always makes me feel calm and safe.
items.zh: 奶奶煮的湯的味道喚起美好的回憶,它總是讓我感到平靜和安心。

items.def: to describe something as bigger or worse than it is
items.s: People under stress often ________ their problems, so talking to a friend can help them see things more clearly.
items.zh: 處於壓力下的人常常誇大自己的問題,所以和朋友聊聊可以幫助他們看得更清楚。

items.def: to be very good at something
items.s: Some students ________ in exams, while others perform better in projects, so teachers should use different kinds of tests.
items.zh: 有些學生在考試中表現優異,而有些人在專題中表現更好,所以老師應該使用不同類型的評量。

items.def: to do what you hoped or promised
items.s: He worked hard for three years, and he finally ________ his dream of studying music in Vienna.
items.zh: 他努力了三年,終於實現了到維也納學音樂的夢想。

items.def: not interested or caring
items.s: Some students seem ________ to their grades, but they may simply be hiding their worries from others.
items.zh: 有些學生對成績似乎漠不關心,但他們可能只是向別人隱藏自己的擔憂。

items.def: so fixed that it is hard to change
items.s: Her habit of checking messages at night was so ________ that it took months to break, but she now sleeps much better.
items.zh: 她晚上查看訊息的習慣是如此根深蒂固,花了好幾個月才戒掉,但現在她睡得好多了。

items.def: to slowly make someone have a feeling or idea
items.s: Good coaches ________ confidence in young players, and this belief helps them stay calm in difficult games.
items.zh: 好教練會在年輕球員心中逐漸培養自信,而這份信念幫助他們在艱難的比賽中保持冷靜。

items.def: to get involved to stop or change a situation
items.s: When two students started arguing loudly, the teacher had to ________, and she helped them talk about the problem calmly.
items.zh: 兩個學生開始大聲爭吵時,老師必須介入,她幫助他們冷靜地討論問題。

items.def: to make someone feel frightened or less confident
items.s: Large crowds ________ some speakers, so they practise in front of small groups first and slowly build their confidence.
items.zh: 大批群眾會讓一些講者感到畏懼,所以他們先在小團體面前練習,慢慢建立自信。

items.def: a short time when you fail to do something well
items.s: A brief ________ in concentration caused the driver to miss the red light, but luckily nobody was hurt.
items.zh: 一時注意力疏失讓駕駛人沒注意到紅燈,但幸好沒有人受傷。

items.def: thinking about something all the time
items.s: His ________ with perfect grades made him unhappy, so his parents told him that effort mattered more than scores.
items.zh: 他對完美成績的執念讓他不快樂,所以他的父母告訴他努力比分數更重要。

items.def: to think something is bigger or better than it is
items.s: Students often ________ how much they can study in one night, and then they feel disappointed when they cannot finish.
items.zh: 學生常常高估自己一個晚上能讀多少,結果讀不完時就感到失望。

items.def: to think carefully about something for a long time
items.s: She ________ the job offer for a whole week, because it meant moving to a city where she knew nobody.
items.zh: 她仔細考慮那份工作邀約整整一週,因為那代表她要搬到一個一個人都不認識的城市。

items.def: to make something bad happen suddenly or sooner
items.s: Losing his job ________ a difficult period in his life, but the support of his family helped him recover.
items.zh: 失業促成了他人生中一段艱難的時期,但家人的支持幫助他重新振作。

items.def: thinking so much about something that you ignore other things
items.cn: 心事重重的;全神貫注於
items.s: Dad was ________ with work problems during dinner, so he did not hear my news about the school prize.
items.zh: 爸爸晚餐時滿腦子都是工作上的問題,所以沒聽到我得到學校獎項的消息。

items.def: something you believe is true without proof
items.s: The ________ that boys are better at maths is wrong, and it can discourage many talented girls.
items.zh: 認為男生數學比較好的假設是錯的,而且會使許多有天分的女生灰心。

items.def: a natural tendency to behave in a certain way
items.s: Some people have a ________ to worry, so they need to practise calming techniques more than others do.
items.zh: 有些人天生有愛擔心的傾向,所以他們比別人更需要練習放鬆的技巧。

items.def: a person who supports an idea
items.s: Dr Chen is a strong ________ of short daily exercise, and she says it can improve both mood and memory.
items.zh: 陳醫師是每天短時間運動的堅定支持者,她說這可以改善情緒和記憶力。

items.def: to think about something again and maybe change your opinion
items.s: After failing the first test, Leo ________ his study methods, and he started using flashcards and practice questions.
items.zh: 第一次考試不及格之後,里歐重新評估他的讀書方法,並開始使用單字卡和練習題。

items.def: thinking about a past event
items.s: In ________, the stressful exam year taught me how to manage my time, so I am grateful for it now.
items.zh: 回想起來,那壓力很大的考試年教會我如何管理時間,所以現在我很感謝那段日子。

items.def: done suddenly without planning
items.s: We made a ________ decision to go hiking on Saturday, and the fresh air helped us forget about our exams.
items.zh: 我們臨時起意決定星期六去爬山,新鮮的空氣幫助我們忘掉考試。

items.def: not moving, changing or developing
items.s: His English felt ________ after months of using the same textbook, so he started watching English videos every day.
items.zh: 用同一本課本好幾個月後,他覺得自己的英文停滯不前,所以他開始每天看英文影片。

items.def: happening in your mind without you knowing
items.s: Our ________ worries can appear in our dreams, so stressful weeks often bring strange dreams at night.
items.zh: 我們潛意識裡的擔憂會出現在夢中,所以壓力大的那幾週晚上常會做奇怪的夢。

items.def: a habit of behaving in a certain way
items.s: Tom has a ________ to leave everything until the last minute, so his teacher helped him make a weekly plan.
items.zh: 湯姆有把每件事都拖到最後一刻的傾向,所以老師幫他擬定每週計畫。

items.def: small and not important
items.s: When you are tired, ________ problems can feel huge, but a good night's sleep often makes them seem small again.
items.zh: 當你很累時,微不足道的問題也會感覺很嚴重,但好好睡一晚常常會讓它們又顯得很小。

items.def: more than is reasonable or necessary
items.s: Parents should not put ________ pressure on their children, because too much stress can make learning harder.
items.zh: 父母不應該給孩子過度的壓力,因為太多壓力會讓學習變得更困難。

items.def: the greatest possible
items.s: Mental health is of the ________ importance, and schools should give students time to rest as well as study.
items.zh: 心理健康是極為重要的,學校應該讓學生有讀書也有休息的時間。

items.def: to deal with something difficult without being harmed
items.s: Regular exercise helps the body ________ stress, so even a short walk each day can make a difference.
items.zh: 規律運動幫助身體承受壓力,所以即使每天短暫散步也能帶來改變。

items.def: a very difficult situation
items.s: She showed great courage in the face of ________, and she continued her studies even after her family lost their home.
items.zh: 她在逆境中展現極大的勇氣,即使家裡失去了房子她仍繼續學業。

items.def: to make someone feel unfriendly or not part of a group
items.s: Constant criticism can ________ teenagers from their parents, so families should also talk about good news.
items.zh: 不斷的批評會讓青少年和父母疏遠,所以家人之間也應該聊聊好消息。

items.def: difficult to deal with; heavy
items.s: The extra homework felt ________ during exam season, so the students asked their teacher for a little more time.
items.zh: 考試季節額外的作業讓人覺得很繁重,所以學生們請老師多給一點時間。

items.def: honest and direct
items.s: The singer was ________ about her stage fright in the interview, and many fans said her story helped them.
items.zh: 那位歌手在訪談中坦白談到自己的怯場,許多歌迷說她的故事幫助了他們。

items.def: care to avoid danger or mistakes
items.s: You should use ________ when taking advice from social media, because not everyone online is an expert.
items.zh: 從社群媒體獲取建議時你應該謹慎,因為網路上並不是每個人都是專家。

items.def: the state of a group being united
items.s: Team-building games improved the class's ________, and students started helping each other with difficult homework.
items.zh: 團隊建立遊戲提升了全班的凝聚力,學生們開始互相幫忙解決困難的作業。

items.def: to praise someone formally
items.s: The principal ________ the students for their hard work, and she gave each of them a certificate at the ceremony.
items.zh: 校長表揚了學生們的努力,並在典禮上頒給每個人一張證書。

items.def: a strong feeling that you must do something
items.s: Many people feel a ________ to check their phones every few minutes, even when they are not expecting any messages.
items.zh: 許多人覺得有一股衝動每隔幾分鐘就要查看手機,即使他們並沒有在等任何訊息。

items.def: an opinion that someone argues for
items.s: The writer's main ________ is that rest improves performance, and she supports it with several interesting studies.
items.zh: 作者的主要論點是休息能提升表現,她用幾項有趣的研究來支持它。

items.def: able to be trusted
items.s: A ________ friend is someone who listens when you are stressed, and they don't share your secrets with others.
items.zh: 可靠的朋友是在你有壓力時會傾聽的人,而且他們不會把你的祕密告訴別人。

items.def: to take something important away from someone
items.s: Late-night gaming ________ many teenagers of sleep, and they then find it hard to concentrate at school.
items.zh: 深夜打電動剝奪了許多青少年的睡眠,導致他們在學校難以專心。

items.def: to make something seem less good
items.s: One small mistake did not ________ from her excellent performance, and the judges still gave her first prize.
items.zh: 一個小失誤並沒有減損她出色的表現,評審仍然給了她第一名。

items.def: the right to decide something; care in what you say
items.s: Teachers have the ________ to give students extra time, and they often do so when a student is ill.
items.zh: 老師有斟酌決定是否給學生額外時間的權力,當學生生病時他們常會這麼做。

items.def: disappointed because something is not as good as you believed
items.s: Many young workers become ________ with long hours, so they look for jobs with a better work-life balance.
items.zh: 許多年輕上班族對長工時感到幻滅,所以他們尋找工作與生活更平衡的工作。

items.def: to decide something is not important
items.s: Don't ________ your feelings as silly, because talking about them is the first step to feeling better.
items.zh: 不要把你的感受當作很傻而不予理會,因為說出來是讓自己好過一點的第一步。

items.def: extremely upset and worried
items.cn: 心煩意亂的;極度不安的
items.s: The boy was ________ when he lost his dog in the park, but a kind stranger helped him find it an hour later.
items.zh: 那個男孩在公園弄丟了狗時心煩意亂,但一位好心的陌生人一小時後幫他找到了。

items.def: able to speak or write clearly and powerfully
items.s: The student gave an ________ speech about mental health, and many classmates cried because it was so honest.
items.zh: 那位學生發表了一場關於心理健康、很有感染力的演講,許多同學哭了,因為它是如此真誠。

items.def: to accept something new with enthusiasm
items.s: Successful students ________ challenges instead of avoiding them, because they see mistakes as a normal part of learning.
items.zh: 成功的學生會欣然接受挑戰而不是逃避,因為他們把錯誤視為學習中正常的一部分。

items.def: to suffer something difficult for a long time
items.s: Athletes must ________ hours of hard training, but the joy of winning makes the pain worthwhile for many of them.
items.zh: 運動員必須忍受好幾個小時的艱苦訓練,但對許多人來說,勝利的喜悅讓這些痛苦都值得。

items.def: to give someone more knowledge or understanding
items.s: The talk on sleep science really ________ us, and many students decided to put their phones away at night.
items.zh: 那場關於睡眠科學的演講真的啟發了我們,許多學生決定晚上把手機收起來。

items.def: to give someone the right to do or have something
items.s: Every worker is ________ to rest breaks during the day, but some busy employees skip them to finish their tasks.
items.zh: 每位員工都有權在白天享有休息時間,但有些忙碌的員工為了完成工作而跳過休息。

items.def: to imagine something that may happen in the future
items.s: Before the race, the runner likes to ________ herself crossing the finish line, and this helps her feel calm and ready.
items.zh: 比賽前,那位跑者喜歡想像自己衝過終點線,這幫助她感到冷靜並做好準備。

items.def: avoiding giving a clear answer
items.s: When I asked my brother about his test, he was ________, so I guessed that he had not done very well.
items.zh: 我問弟弟考試考得如何時,他含糊其詞,所以我猜他考得不太好。

items.def: unusually good
items.s: She showed ________ calm during the emergency, and her quick thinking helped everyone leave the building safely.
items.zh: 她在緊急狀況中展現了非凡的冷靜,她的機智幫助大家安全離開大樓。

items.def: so good that others should copy it
items.s: The student's behaviour was ________ during the school trip, so the teacher asked him to help lead the next one.
items.zh: 那位學生在校外教學期間的表現堪為模範,所以老師請他幫忙帶領下一次的活動。

items.def: very exciting and making you feel happy
items.s: Riding the roller coaster was ________, and for a few minutes I completely forgot about my homework.
items.zh: 坐雲霄飛車令人非常興奮,有好幾分鐘我完全忘了作業的事。

items.def: to think about one thing too much
items.s: If you ________ on one bad grade, you may lose confidence, so try to look at your overall progress instead.
items.zh: 如果你執著於一次不好的成績,可能會失去自信,所以試著改看你整體的進步。

items.def: to make something stronger
items.s: A good breakfast can ________ your body for a long day of tests, so don't skip it even when you are in a hurry.
items.zh: 一頓好的早餐能強化你的身體以應付一整天的考試,所以即使匆忙也不要跳過。

items.def: likely to do something or behave in a certain way
items.s: Tired people are more ________ to make poor choices, so it is wise not to make big decisions late at night.
items.zh: 疲倦的人比較傾向做出不好的選擇,所以深夜不做重大決定是明智的。

items.def: late; should have happened before now
items.s: My library book was two weeks ________, and I had to pay a small fine because I forgot to return it.
items.zh: 我的圖書館書已經逾期兩週了,因為我忘記歸還,只好付了一小筆罰款。

items.def: the bad effect that something has over time
items.s: Months of night shifts took a heavy ________ on the nurse's health, so she finally asked for a day job.
items.zh: 好幾個月的夜班對那位護理師的健康造成了嚴重的損害,所以她終於申請了白班工作。

items.def: the start of something
items.s: At the ________ of the course, the teacher explained all the rules, so nobody was surprised by the strict deadlines.
items.zh: 課程一開始,老師就解釋了所有規則,所以沒有人對嚴格的截止期限感到意外。

items.def: the way two or more things affect each other
items.s: There is a complex ________ between sleep and mood, because poor sleep makes us sad and sadness makes sleep harder.
items.zh: 睡眠和情緒之間有複雜的相互影響,因為睡不好讓我們難過,而難過又讓人更難入睡。

items.def: a small detail that makes something complicated
items.s: The ________ of the human mind fascinates scientists, but there are still many things about it that we do not understand.
items.zh: 人類心智的錯綜複雜讓科學家著迷,但關於它仍有許多我們不了解的事。

items.def: without considering something
items.s: Everyone needs rest ________ of their age, so both children and adults should sleep for enough hours every night.
items.zh: 不論年齡,每個人都需要休息,所以孩子和大人每晚都應該睡足夠的時間。

items.def: having a good reason
items.s: Her anger was ________ because her partner did none of the group work, but she still spoke to him politely.
items.zh: 她的憤怒是情有可原的,因為她的組員完全沒做小組作業,但她仍然禮貌地跟他說話。

items.def: tired and without energy
items.s: I always feel ________ after eating a huge lunch, so I now eat a smaller meal and take a short walk.
items.zh: 吃完一頓豐盛的午餐後我總覺得無精打采,所以我現在吃少一點,並短暫散個步。

items.def: not very good; only average
items.s: His first essay was ________, but he read his teacher's comments carefully and the next one was much better.
items.zh: 他的第一篇文章很普通,但他仔細看了老師的評語,下一篇就好多了。

items.def: a good quality that deserves praise
items.s: Each plan has its ________, so the team discussed both of them carefully before they made a final decision.
items.zh: 每個計畫都有它的優點,所以團隊在做最後決定前仔細討論了兩個計畫。

items.def: a wrong idea or belief
items.s: It is a common ________ that asking for help is a sign of weakness, but it actually shows strength and good sense.
items.zh: 認為求助是軟弱的表現是常見的誤解,但其實這展現了堅強和明智。

items.def: to make someone believe something false
items.s: The advert ________ customers into thinking the drink could reduce stress, so the company had to change it.
items.zh: 那則廣告誤導顧客以為那種飲料可以減輕壓力,所以公司必須修改它。

items.def: boring because it never changes
items.s: Copying words again and again is ________, so our teacher uses games to help us remember new vocabulary.
items.zh: 一遍又一遍地抄寫單字很單調乏味,所以老師用遊戲幫助我們記住新單字。

items.def: having many different parts or sides
items.s: Stress is a ________ problem, so the solution may involve sleep, exercise, diet and support from friends.
items.zh: 壓力是一個多面向的問題,所以解決方法可能包括睡眠、運動、飲食以及朋友的支持。

items.def: required by a rule
items.s: Attendance at the safety talk was ________, so every student had to sign their name at the door.
items.zh: 參加安全講座是必須的,所以每位學生都得在門口簽名。

items.def: best; most suitable
items.s: Scientists say the ________ amount of sleep for teenagers is about nine hours, but most of them get much less.
items.zh: 科學家說青少年最佳的睡眠時數大約是九小時,但大多數人睡得少得多。

items.def: a person's general attitude to life
items.s: Volunteering changed her ________ on life, and she now feels thankful for the small things she has.
items.zh: 當志工改變了她的人生觀,她現在對自己擁有的小事物心懷感激。

items.def: to think something is better than it really is
items.s: Many people ________ the value of expensive gadgets, but simple habits like walking often improve mood more.
items.zh: 許多人高估了昂貴電子產品的價值,但像散步這樣簡單的習慣往往更能改善心情。

items.def: seeming impossible because it combines opposite ideas
items.s: It seems ________, but taking more breaks can help you finish your work faster, because your brain stays fresh.
items.zh: 這看起來很矛盾,但多休息反而能幫助你更快完成工作,因為你的大腦能保持清醒。

items.def: not as important as the main part
items.s: Don't waste time on ________ details in the reading test, because most questions focus on the main ideas.
items.zh: 閱讀測驗中不要在次要細節上浪費時間,因為大多數題目都聚焦在主旨上。

items.def: likely to behave or suffer in a certain way
items.s: Some people are ________ to anxiety because of their family history, but healthy habits can still help a lot.
items.zh: 有些人因為家族病史而容易焦慮,但健康的習慣仍然能有很大的幫助。

items.def: very noticeable
items.s: There was a ________ improvement in her mood after she started jogging, and her friends noticed it within a week.
items.zh: 她開始慢跑之後心情有了明顯的改善,她的朋友們一週內就注意到了。

items.def: able to be measured with numbers
items.s: Happiness is not easily ________, but researchers use surveys to compare how people feel in different countries.
items.zh: 快樂不容易量化,但研究人員使用問卷調查來比較不同國家人們的感受。

items.def: willing to listen to new ideas
items.s: Students are more ________ to advice when they feel respected, so teachers should speak to them kindly.
items.zh: 學生覺得受到尊重時更樂於接受建議,所以老師應該親切地跟他們說話。

items.def: to think or believe
items.s: I ________ that a short walk would help you relax, so why don't we go to the park after dinner?
items.zh: 我認為短暫散個步能幫助你放鬆,所以我們晚餐後何不去公園走走?

items.def: to think carefully about something you did
items.s: At the end of each week, I ________ on what went well and what I can do better, and I write my ideas in a notebook.
items.zh: 每週結束時,我會反思哪些事做得好、哪些可以做得更好,並把想法寫在筆記本裡。

items.def: to stop yourself from doing something
items.s: Please ________ from using your phone during the exam, or the teacher will take your paper away.
items.zh: 考試期間請避免使用手機,否則老師會把你的考卷收走。

items.def: aimed at improving skills that are weak
items.s: The school offers ________ classes after school, and students who fell behind can catch up there.
items.zh: 學校在放學後提供補救課程,落後的學生可以在那裡趕上進度。

items.def: calm control over your feelings or actions
items.s: The referee showed great ________ when the angry fans shouted at him, and he calmly continued the game.
items.zh: 生氣的球迷對裁判大吼時,他表現出極大的克制,並冷靜地繼續比賽。

items.def: being unwilling to change or adapt
items.s: The ________ of the old timetable caused stress, so the school made it more flexible for students with long journeys.
items.zh: 舊課表的僵化造成了壓力,所以學校讓它對通勤時間長的學生更有彈性。

items.def: to examine something very carefully
items.s: Before signing the contract, my father ________ every line, because he did not want any unpleasant surprises later.
items.zh: 簽約前,我爸爸仔細檢查了每一行字,因為他不想之後有任何不愉快的意外。

items.def: reasonable and practical
items.s: It is ________ to plan your revision early, because you will feel calmer and more prepared on the day of the exam.
items.zh: 提早規劃複習是明智的,因為考試當天你會覺得更冷靜、更有準備。

items.def: a weakness or fault
items.s: Everyone has ________, but accepting them is the first step to improving yourself and feeling less stressed.
items.zh: 每個人都有缺點,但接受它們是改善自己並減輕壓力的第一步。

items.def: to be a sign of something
items.s: A sudden loss of interest in hobbies may ________ that a friend is stressed, so it is kind to ask how they are.
items.zh: 突然對嗜好失去興趣可能意味著朋友有壓力,所以關心問候他們近況是很貼心的。

items.def: to bring a strong feeling under control
items.s: She took a few deep breaths to ________ her anger, and then she explained calmly why she was upset.
items.zh: 她做了幾次深呼吸來抑制怒氣,然後冷靜地解釋她為什麼不高興。

items.def: to prove something with evidence
items.s: You must ________ your claims with examples in your essay, or the examiner will give you a lower score.
items.zh: 你必須在文章中用例子證實你的主張,否則閱卷老師會給你較低的分數。

items.def: long and boring
items.s: Filling in the forms was ________, but my sister finished them quickly because she wanted to start her new job.
items.zh: 填寫那些表格很冗長乏味,但我姊姊很快就填完了,因為她想趕快開始新工作。

items.def: the quality of not giving up easily
items.s: The young scientist's ________ paid off, because after many failed experiments she finally found the answer.
items.zh: 那位年輕科學家的堅持不懈得到了回報,因為在許多次失敗的實驗後她終於找到了答案。

items.def: completely clear, with no doubt
items.s: The doctor's advice was ________, so my uncle stopped smoking and started exercising the very next day.
items.zh: 醫生的建議毫不含糊,所以我叔叔隔天就戒菸並開始運動了。

items.def: the amount by which things differ
items.s: There is a large ________ in how much sleep students get, and those who sleep more usually get better grades.
items.zh: 學生的睡眠時數有很大的差異,而睡得多的人通常成績比較好。

items.def: the power to choose for yourself
items.s: She joined the extra classes of her own ________, and nobody had to tell her to study harder.
items.zh: 她是出於自己的意願參加額外課程的,沒有人需要叫她更用功。

items.def: very tired
items.s: The ________ travellers finally reached the hotel after a long delay, and they went straight to bed without eating.
items.zh: 那些疲憊的旅客在長時間延誤後終於抵達飯店,他們沒吃東西就直接上床睡覺了。

items.def: to choose not to do something you enjoy
items.s: My father decided to ________ from coffee for a month, and he found that he slept much better at night.
items.zh: 我爸爸決定戒一個月的咖啡,他發現自己晚上睡得好多了。

items.def: to make something more noticeable
items.s: Lack of sleep can ________ negative feelings, so small problems seem much bigger when you are tired.
items.zh: 睡眠不足會加劇負面情緒,所以你疲倦時小問題看起來會嚴重得多。

items.def: very skilled at something
items.s: My mother is ________ at calming people down, so neighbours often come to her when they have family problems.
items.zh: 我媽媽很擅長安撫別人,所以鄰居們有家庭問題時常來找她。

items.def: to state that something is true; to support
items.s: Kind words from parents ________ a child's value, and this helps the child feel safe enough to try new things.
items.zh: 父母親切的話語能肯定孩子的價值,這幫助孩子感到足夠安心去嘗試新事物。

items.def: to mention something in an indirect way
items.s: In his speech, the principal ________ to the stress of the coming exams, but he did not talk about them directly.
items.zh: 校長在演講中間接提到即將到來的考試壓力,但他沒有直接談論。

items.def: to find out the truth about something
items.s: The teacher tried to ________ why the student was always late, and she learned that he looked after his little sister.
items.zh: 老師試著查明那位學生為什麼總是遲到,她得知他要照顧妹妹。

items.def: to confuse someone completely
items.s: The last maths question ________ everyone in the class, so the teacher explained it again step by step.
items.zh: 最後一道數學題讓全班都困惑不已,所以老師一步一步重新講解。

items.def: to make someone very confused
items.s: The busy train station ________ my grandmother, so I held her hand and guided her to the right platform.
items.zh: 繁忙的火車站讓我奶奶不知所措,所以我牽著她的手帶她到正確的月台。

items.def: aware of something
items.s: Teachers should be ________ of the pressure students face, and they should not give too much homework before exams.
items.zh: 老師應該意識到學生面臨的壓力,考試前不應該出太多作業。

items.def: an opinion based on incomplete information
items.s: The reason for his sudden absence is only ________, so we should not spread rumours about him.
items.zh: 他突然缺席的原因只是推測,所以我們不應該散播關於他的謠言。

items.def: staying firm and loyal
items.s: Her parents were ________ in their support, and they never criticised her when she failed her first audition.
items.zh: 她的父母堅定不移地支持她,她第一次試鏡失敗時他們從未責備她。

items.def: to come together at one point
items.s: Many different studies ________ on one idea, which is that regular exercise improves both mood and memory.
items.zh: 許多不同的研究都趨向同一個觀點,那就是規律運動能改善情緒和記憶力。

items.def: to delay something until later
items.s: Some students ________ their university studies for a year, so they can work, travel and decide what they really want.
items.zh: 有些學生把大學學業延後一年,這樣他們可以工作、旅行並決定自己真正想要什麼。

items.def: completely without something
items.s: The waiting room was cold and ________ of colour, so the hospital painted it bright yellow to help patients feel calmer.
items.zh: 候診室冰冷又毫無色彩,所以醫院把它漆成亮黃色,幫助病人感到更平靜。

items.def: disagreement between people
items.s: There was some ________ in the group about the project topic, but they finally agreed after a friendly vote.
items.zh: 小組對專題題目有些不和,但他們在一次友善的投票後終於達成共識。

items.def: very different from each other
items.s: The club brings together students from ________ backgrounds, and they quickly become friends through music.
items.zh: 這個社團聚集了來自迥然不同背景的學生,他們透過音樂很快就成為朋友。

items.def: not active now but able to become active later
items.s: Her love of painting had been ________ for years, but it came back when she joined an art class after retirement.
items.zh: 她對繪畫的熱愛已經沉寂多年,但退休後參加美術課時又重新燃起。

items.def: to make a process happen faster
items.s: The new online system will ________ the application process, so students will receive their results in days, not weeks.
items.zh: 新的線上系統將加快申請流程,所以學生會在幾天內而不是幾週內收到結果。

items.def: to choose not to have something you would like
items.s: Many students ________ weekend outings before the big exam, but short breaks are still important for their health.
items.zh: 許多學生在大考前放棄週末出遊,但短暫的休息對健康仍然很重要。

items.def: to pay attention to advice or a warning
items.s: If you ________ your body's warning signs, such as headaches and poor sleep, you can deal with stress before it gets worse.
items.zh: 如果你留意身體的警訊,例如頭痛和睡不好,就能在壓力惡化之前處理它。

items.def: acting quickly without thinking carefully
items.s: He made an ________ decision to quit his job after one bad day, and he regretted it when he could not pay his rent.
items.zh: 他在糟糕的一天之後做了辭職的衝動決定,當他付不出房租時就後悔了。

items.def: done without meaning to
items.s: Her ________ comment hurt her friend's feelings, so she apologised as soon as she realised what she had said.
items.zh: 她無心的一句話傷了朋友的感情,所以她一意識到自己說了什麼就立刻道歉。

items.def: never stopping
items.s: The ________ noise from the building site made it hard to study, so I went to the library for some peace.
items.zh: 工地不停的噪音讓人很難讀書,所以我去圖書館找個清靜。

items.def: having no skill
items.s: I felt ________ at cooking when I first lived alone, but after many YouTube videos I can now make simple meals.
items.zh: 我剛開始獨自生活時覺得自己做菜很笨拙,但看了許多影片之後,現在我能做簡單的餐點了。

items.def: always wanting more
items.s: Some children have an ________ curiosity about science, and they ask questions that even their teachers cannot answer.
items.zh: 有些孩子對科學有永不滿足的好奇心,他們問的問題連老師都答不出來。

items.def: careful thinking about your own thoughts and feelings
items.s: A little ________ can help you understand your stress, but too much thinking about yourself may make you more anxious.
items.zh: 一點自我反省能幫助你了解自己的壓力,但過度思考自己可能讓你更焦慮。

items.def: impossible to change or undo
items.cn: 不可撤銷的;無法挽回的
items.s: Choosing a university major is important, but it is not ________, because many students change their major later.
items.zh: 選擇大學科系很重要,但並非無法挽回,因為許多學生後來會轉系。

items.def: present but hidden or not yet developed
items.s: The drama teacher discovered his ________ talent for acting, and he soon became the star of the school play.
items.zh: 戲劇老師發掘了他潛在的表演天分,他很快就成了學校話劇的主角。

items.def: ordinary and not interesting
items.s: Even ________ tasks like washing dishes can be relaxing, because they give your mind a break from difficult problems.
items.zh: 即使像洗碗這樣平凡的家務也能讓人放鬆,因為它們讓你的頭腦暫時擺脫困難的問題。

items.def: a person who is new to an activity
items.s: As a ________ at public speaking, Amy felt nervous, but her teacher gave her simple tips that helped a lot.
items.zh: 身為公開演講的新手,艾咪感到很緊張,但老師給了她一些簡單又很有幫助的訣竅。

items.def: not aware of something
items.s: He was ________ to the time while playing his game, so he missed dinner and his mother was not happy.
items.zh: 他打電動時渾然不覺時間的流逝,所以錯過了晚餐,他媽媽很不高興。

items.def: done openly, not secretly
items.s: There were no ________ signs of stress, but her friends noticed that she had stopped eating lunch with them.
items.zh: 她沒有明顯的壓力跡象,但她的朋友們注意到她不再和他們一起吃午餐了。

items.def: so strong that it can almost be felt
items.s: The tension in the exam hall was ________, and nobody spoke while the teacher handed out the papers.
items.zh: 考場裡的緊張氣氛清晰可感,老師發考卷時沒有人說話。

items.def: never ending; happening again and again
items.s: Living in a state of ________ worry is bad for your health, so learning to relax is an important life skill.
items.zh: 處於無止盡的擔憂狀態對健康有害,所以學會放鬆是一項重要的生活技能。

items.def: to make someone feel young or energetic again
items.s: A week by the sea ________ my parents, and they came home smiling and full of new plans.
items.zh: 在海邊待一週讓我爸媽恢復了活力,他們帶著笑容回家,還充滿新計畫。

items.def: to give up control or a position
items.s: The captain decided to ________ his role because of stress, and another player took over the team leadership.
items.zh: 隊長因為壓力決定放棄他的職位,另一名球員接手了球隊的領導工作。

items.def: a strong feeling of being sorry for doing something wrong
items.s: He felt deep ________ after shouting at his little sister, so he bought her favourite cake to say sorry.
items.zh: 對妹妹大吼之後他深感懊悔,所以他買了她最愛的蛋糕來道歉。

items.def: to stop yourself from showing a feeling
items.s: If you always ________ your feelings, they may come out later in unhealthy ways, so it is better to talk about them.
items.zh: 如果你總是壓抑自己的感受,它們之後可能會以不健康的方式爆發,所以最好說出來。

items.def: to feel angry about something unfair
items.s: Some students ________ group projects because they end up doing most of the work, while others do very little.
items.zh: 有些學生怨恨小組專題,因為最後大部分工作都是他們在做,而其他人做得很少。

items.def: a short rest from something difficult
items.s: The long weekend gave the students a welcome ________ from exams, and many of them spent it with their families.
items.zh: 連假讓學生們從考試中得到難得的喘息,許多人和家人一起度過。

items.def: to go back to a previous state or habit
items.s: After the holidays, it is easy to ________ to bad sleeping habits, so try to wake up at the same time every day.
items.zh: 假期過後很容易回到不好的睡眠習慣,所以試著每天在同一時間起床。

items.def: very basic
items.s: I only have a ________ knowledge of Japanese, but I can order food and ask for directions when I travel.
items.zh: 我只有基礎的日文知識,但旅行時我能點餐和問路。

items.def: very careful to be honest and correct
items.s: The scientist was ________ about recording every result, so other researchers trusted her findings completely.
items.zh: 那位科學家對記錄每個結果都一絲不苟,所以其他研究人員完全信任她的發現。

items.def: to stop something from developing
items.s: Too many rules can ________ creativity, so the art teacher lets students choose their own topics and materials.
items.zh: 太多規則會扼殺創造力,所以美術老師讓學生自己選擇主題和材料。

items.def: clear and short
items.s: Please keep your answers ________ in the interview, because the panel has many candidates to see today.
items.zh: 面試時請讓你的回答保持簡潔,因為評審團今天要面試很多候選人。

items.def: more than is needed
items.s: Remove any ________ words from your essay, because clear and simple writing is easier for examiners to read.
items.zh: 把文章中任何多餘的字刪掉,因為清楚簡單的寫作讓閱卷老師更容易閱讀。

items.def: to deal with a difficulty successfully
items.s: With the help of her tutor, she managed to ________ her fear of maths, and she even chose it as her favourite subject later.
items.zh: 在家教的幫助下,她成功克服了對數學的恐懼,後來甚至把它選為最喜歡的科目。

items.def: to influence someone's opinion or decision
items.s: Advertisements can easily ________ young shoppers, so it is wise to wait a day before buying something expensive.
items.zh: 廣告很容易左右年輕購物者,所以在買昂貴的東西前先等一天是明智的。

items.def: to combine ideas or information into one
items.s: Good students ________ information from different sources, and they use it to write clear and balanced essays.
items.zh: 好學生會整合來自不同來源的資訊,並用它寫出清楚而平衡的文章。

items.def: very weak or uncertain
items.s: The link between the two events was ________, so the teacher asked us to find stronger evidence for our argument.
items.zh: 這兩件事之間的關聯很薄弱,所以老師要我們為論點找更有力的證據。

items.def: not based on facts
items.s: Her fears about the new school were ________, because the students were friendly and the teachers were very helpful.
items.zh: 她對新學校的恐懼是毫無根據的,因為同學們很友善,老師們也很樂於幫忙。

items.def: not changing or becoming weaker
items.s: The team's ________ belief in their coach helped them through a difficult season, and they finally won the cup.
items.zh: 球隊對教練堅定不移的信任幫助他們度過艱難的球季,最後他們贏得了冠軍。

items.def: used to something
items.s: It took me a month to get ________ to waking up early, but now I enjoy the quiet time before school.
items.zh: 我花了一個月才習慣早起,但現在我很享受上學前的安靜時光。

items.def: to make someone lose confidence or not want to do something
items.s: Don't let one bad score ________ you, because every learner has difficult days and you can still improve.
items.zh: 不要讓一次糟糕的分數使你灰心,因為每個學習者都有不順的日子,而你仍然可以進步。

items.def: a feeling of shock and disappointment
items.s: To her ________, the bus left just as she arrived, so she had to wait thirty minutes in the rain.
items.zh: 令她沮喪的是,她一到公車就開走了,所以她只好在雨中等了三十分鐘。

items.def: having very strong feelings about something
items.s: My cousin is a ________ supporter of the local team, and he goes to every home game even when it rains.
items.zh: 我表哥是當地球隊的狂熱支持者,即使下雨他也去看每一場主場比賽。

items.def: most important
items.s: Your health should be your ________ concern, and no exam result is worth losing sleep for weeks.
items.zh: 你的健康應該是你最重要的考量,沒有任何考試成績值得讓你連續好幾週失眠。

items.def: courage in pain or difficulty
items.s: The patient faced her long treatment with great ________, and she always smiled at the nurses.
items.zh: 那位病人以極大的堅毅面對漫長的治療,她總是對護理師們微笑。

items.def: wanting to learn and ask questions
items.s: ________ students often learn faster, because they ask questions until they really understand the topic.
items.zh: 好問的學生通常學得比較快,因為他們會一直提問直到真正理解主題。

items.def: famous for something bad
items.cn: 惡名昭彰的;出了名(不好)的
items.s: This road is ________ for traffic jams, so my father leaves home very early to avoid being late for work.
items.zh: 這條路以塞車出了名,所以我爸爸很早出門以免上班遲到。

items.def: a difficult or sad situation
items.s: The news story about the ________ of overworked delivery drivers made many people tip them more generously.
items.zh: 關於過勞外送員困境的新聞報導,讓許多人更慷慨地給他們小費。

items.def: to enjoy something very much
items.s: Some people ________ a challenge, and they feel more excited than nervous before an important game.
items.zh: 有些人享受挑戰,在重要比賽前他們感到的是興奮多於緊張。

items.def: determined and not willing to change
items.s: She was ________ in her plan to run a marathon, so she trained every morning, even in the cold winter.
items.zh: 她對跑馬拉松的計畫非常堅決,所以即使在寒冷的冬天她每天早上都訓練。

items.def: a method used to achieve something
items.s: One useful ________ for exams is to answer the easy questions first, so you build confidence before the hard ones.
items.zh: 考試的一個實用策略是先回答簡單的題目,這樣在面對難題前你就能建立信心。

items.def: changing in a way that is hard to guess
items.s: The weather in the mountains is ________, so you should always bring a raincoat, even on a sunny morning.
items.zh: 山上的天氣難以預測,所以即使是晴朗的早晨,你也應該隨身帶雨衣。

items.def: not clear or detailed
items.s: My goals were too ________ last year, so this year I wrote specific plans with dates and small steps.
items.zh: 我去年的目標太模糊了,所以今年我寫下了有日期和小步驟的具體計畫。

items.def: worth the time, money or effort
items.s: Learning to manage stress is ________, because it will help you in school, at work and in your relationships.
items.zh: 學習管理壓力是值得的,因為它會在學業、工作和人際關係中幫助你。

items.def: the energy to keep doing something for a long time
items.s: Long exams require mental ________, so students should practise with full-length tests before the real exam.
items.zh: 長時間的考試需要心理上的耐力,所以學生在正式考試前應該用完整長度的測驗練習。

items.def: energy and liveliness
items.s: Regular exercise gives older people more ________, and many of them say they feel ten years younger.
items.zh: 規律運動讓年長者更有活力,許多人說他們覺得自己年輕了十歲。

items.def: a typical way of thinking
items.s: A winning ________ helps athletes stay calm under pressure, but they also need good training and rest.
items.zh: 贏家心態幫助運動員在壓力下保持冷靜,但他們也需要良好的訓練和休息。

items.def: making you think of something in the past
items.s: The smell of the new classroom was ________ of my first day at primary school, and it made me feel a little nervous.
items.zh: 新教室的氣味讓我聯想起小學第一天上學,這讓我感到有點緊張。

items.def: to criticise someone, often gently
items.s: Don't ________ yourself for every small mistake, because being kind to yourself makes it easier to improve.
items.zh: 不要為每個小錯誤責備自己,因為善待自己會讓進步變得更容易。

items.def: required by law or rules
items.s: Physical education is ________ in most schools, and it gives students a healthy break from sitting in class.
items.zh: 體育課在大多數學校是必修的,它讓學生從久坐的課堂中得到健康的休息。

items.def: clear and easy to understand
items.s: The teacher gave a ________ explanation of the grammar rule, so even the weakest students could follow it.
items.zh: 老師對這個文法規則做了清晰易懂的解釋,所以連程度最弱的學生都能理解。

items.def: feeling stressed because of demands
items.s: Many students perform badly ______ ______, so teachers give them practice tests to make the real exam feel familiar.
items.zh: 許多學生在壓力下表現不佳,所以老師讓他們做模擬考,使正式考試感覺比較熟悉。

items.def: very worried and tense
items.s: I was so ______ ______ before my final exams that I could not sleep, so my mum made me a cup of warm milk.
items.zh: 期末考前我壓力大到睡不著,所以媽媽幫我泡了一杯熱牛奶。

items.def: to work or study late at night
items.s: Jason had to ______ ______ ______ ______ to finish his project, and he looked very tired in class the next morning.
items.zh: 傑森必須熬夜苦讀才能完成他的專題,隔天早上他在課堂上看起來非常疲倦。

items.def: to stay calm in a difficult situation
items.s: The pilot ______ ______ ______ when the engine failed, and she landed the plane safely in a nearby field.
items.zh: 引擎故障時那位機長保持冷靜,並把飛機安全降落在附近的田野上。

items.def: to suddenly become very angry
items.s: My father rarely ______ ______ ______, but he shouted when my brother broke the window for the second time.
items.zh: 我爸爸很少發脾氣,但我弟弟第二次打破窗戶時他大吼了。

items.def: to delay doing something
items.s: I always ______ ______ cleaning my room until the weekend, and by then it is so messy that it takes hours.
items.zh: 我總是把打掃房間拖延到週末,到那時房間亂到要花好幾個小時才能整理好。

items.def: to release strong feelings or energy
items.s: After a long day of exams, the students played basketball to ______ ______ ______, and they all felt better afterwards.
items.zh: 經過一整天的考試,學生們打籃球來發洩情緒,之後大家都覺得好多了。

items.w: bite off more than one can chew
items.def: to try to do more than you are able to
items.s: Lucy joined four clubs this term, but she ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, so she quit two of them.
items.zh: 露西這學期參加了四個社團,但她貪多嚼不爛,所以退出了其中兩個。

items.def: to avoid choosing between two sides
items.s: You can't ______ ______ ______ ______ forever, because the team needs your vote before we can start the project.
items.zh: 你不能永遠騎牆觀望,因為我們開始專題之前,團隊需要你投下一票。

items.def: to decide
items.s: I couldn't ______ ______ ______ ______ about which dress to buy, so I asked my sister to choose for me.
items.zh: 我無法決定要買哪件洋裝,所以我請姊姊幫我選。

items.def: to wait until the next day before deciding
items.s: The job offer sounded exciting, but my mother told me to ______ ______ ______ before I gave the company an answer.
items.zh: 那份工作邀約聽起來很令人興奮,但媽媽叫我先考慮一晚再給公司答覆。

items.def: to make a decision based on feelings
items.s: When you are not sure of an answer, it is often best to ______ ______ ______ ______, because your first idea is usually right.
items.zh: 當你不確定答案時,憑直覺通常是最好的,因為你的第一個想法往往是對的。

items.def: to start to doubt a decision
items.s: Mark agreed to sing at the concert, but he began to ______ ______ ______ when he saw how big the audience was.
items.zh: 馬克答應在音樂會上唱歌,但當他看到觀眾有多少時,他開始猶豫要不要改變主意。

items.def: to decide something is true too quickly
items.s: Don't ______ ______ ______ when a friend does not reply quickly, because they may simply be busy with homework.
items.zh: 朋友沒有很快回覆時不要妄下結論,因為他們可能只是在忙作業。

items.def: to make more effort than is expected
items.s: Our English teacher always ______ ______ ______ ______ for her students, and she even stays after school to answer questions.
items.zh: 我們的英文老師總是為學生加倍付出,她甚至放學後留下來回答問題。

items.w: light at the end of the tunnel
items.def: a sign that a difficult time will end soon
items.cn: 黑暗盡頭的曙光;苦盡甘來的希望
items.s: Exams finish next Friday, so we can finally see the ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, and we are planning a party.
items.zh: 考試下週五結束,所以我們終於看到了隧道盡頭的曙光,我們正在計畫辦派對。

items.def: to relax and not work too hard
items.s: The doctor told my mother to ______ ______ ______ for a week, so we all helped with the cooking and cleaning.
items.zh: 醫生叫我媽媽好好休息一週,所以我們大家都幫忙煮飯和打掃。

items.def: relief from a worry or responsibility
items.s: Handing in my final report was ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, and I slept for ten hours that night.
items.zh: 交出期末報告讓我如釋重負,那天晚上我睡了十個小時。

items.def: to suddenly feel too nervous to do something you planned
items.s: Tina planned to try out for the school play, but she ______ ______ ______ at the last moment and stayed home.
items.zh: 蒂娜原本打算參加學校話劇的試鏡,但她在最後一刻臨陣退縮,待在家裡。

items.w: at the end of one's tether
items.def: so tired or upset that you cannot cope any more
items.s: After a week of noisy neighbours and little sleep, I was ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, so I asked them politely to be quiet.
items.zh: 經過一週吵鬧的鄰居和很少的睡眠,我已經忍無可忍,所以我禮貌地請他們安靜一點。

items.def: a school for children aged about three to six
items.s: My little brother started ________ last September, and now he sings English songs at home every evening.
items.zh: 我弟弟去年九月開始上幼兒園，現在他每天晚上都在家唱英文歌。
items.sec: Schools & School Life 學校與校園生活

items.def: a school for young children before primary school
items.s: Many parents in Taipei send their children to a bilingual ________ because they want them to learn English early.
items.zh: 台北許多家長把孩子送到雙語幼稚園，因為他們希望孩子及早學英文。
items.sec: Schools & School Life 學校與校園生活

items.def: about the first, simplest stage of school or learning
items.s: My cousin teaches at an ________ school in Tainan, and she says the children are full of energy every morning.
items.zh: 我表姊在台南一所小學教書，她說孩子們每天早上都精力充沛。
items.sec: Schools & School Life 學校與校園生活

items.def: a school where students live and sleep during the term
items.s: Jason was nervous about moving to a ______ ______ in the mountains, but he soon made friends in his dormitory.
items.zh: 傑森對於搬到山上的寄宿學校感到緊張，但他很快就在宿舍交到了朋友。
items.sec: Schools & School Life 學校與校園生活

items.def: the teacher who is in charge of a school
items.s: The ________ gave a short speech at the start of the year, and she asked every student to try something new.
items.zh: 校長在學年開始時做了簡短的演講，她要求每位學生嘗試一件新事物。
items.sec: Schools & School Life 學校與校園生活

items.def: a person in the same class as you at school
items.s: I forgot my calculator before the maths test, so my ________ kindly lent me hers for the whole lesson.
items.zh: 我在數學考試前忘了帶計算機，所以我的同學好心地把她的借我用了一整節課。
items.sec: Schools & School Life 學校與校園生活

items.def: an outdoor area at school where children play
items.s: The younger pupils rushed to the ________ as soon as the bell rang, and they played until lunch was ready.
items.zh: 鐘聲一響，低年級學生就衝到操場，一直玩到午餐準備好。
items.sec: Schools & School Life 學校與校園生活

items.def: a place in a school where students buy and eat food
items.s: The school ________ now offers more vegetables and fruit, but some students still prefer fried chicken and bubble tea.
items.zh: 學校餐廳現在提供更多蔬菜和水果，但有些學生還是比較喜歡炸雞和珍珠奶茶。
items.sec: Schools & School Life 學校與校園生活

items.def: a small metal cupboard where students keep their things
items.s: I left my heavy dictionary in my ________ after class, so my backpack felt much lighter on the way home.
items.zh: 我下課後把厚重的字典留在置物櫃裡，所以回家路上背包輕多了。
items.sec: Schools & School Life 學校與校園生活

items.def: a large building where students live and sleep
items.s: The ________ lights go off at eleven o'clock, so students who want to keep studying have to use small desk lamps.
items.zh: 宿舍的燈十一點就熄了，所以想繼續讀書的學生只能用小檯燈。
items.sec: Schools & School Life 學校與校園生活

items.def: one of the two main periods in a school year
items.s: This ________ I am taking an extra Japanese class, but I still have time to play basketball on Fridays.
items.zh: 這學期我多修了一堂日文課，但我星期五仍然有時間打籃球。
items.sec: Schools & School Life 學校與校園生活

items.def: a short break between lessons at school
items.s: During morning ________ the students bought snacks at the school shop, and some of them finished their reading homework.
items.zh: 在早上的下課時間，學生們到福利社買零食，其中有些人寫完了閱讀作業。
items.sec: Schools & School Life 學校與校園生活

items.def: how often someone is present at school or class
items.s: Her ________ was almost perfect this year, because she only missed one day when she had a bad cold.
items.zh: 她今年的出席率幾乎是完美的，因為她只有在重感冒時缺席了一天。
items.sec: Schools & School Life 學校與校園生活

items.def: not at school or work when you should be
items.s: Three students were ________ on Monday because of the flu, so the teacher decided to postpone the speaking test.
items.zh: 星期一有三位學生因為流感而缺席，所以老師決定延後口說測驗。
items.sec: Schools & School Life 學校與校園生活
