items.def: staying away from school without permission
items.s: The school called his parents about his ________, and they were shocked because he had left home every morning in uniform.
items.zh: 學校打電話給他的父母談他逃學的事，他們很震驚，因為他每天早上都穿著制服出門。
items.sec: Schools & School Life 學校與校園生活

items.def: to officially make a student leave a school
items.s: The school may ________ any student who brings a weapon to class, so the rules are explained clearly on the first day.
items.zh: 學校可能會開除任何帶武器到班上的學生，所以第一天就會清楚說明規定。
items.sec: Schools & School Life 學校與校園生活

items.def: a punishment where a student must stay after school
items.s: Ken talked loudly during the test, so he got an hour of ________ and missed his football practice.
items.zh: 肯在考試時大聲講話，所以被罰課後留校一小時，錯過了足球練習。
items.sec: Schools & School Life 學校與校園生活

items.def: arriving or doing something at the right time
items.s: Our English teacher is always ________, and she expects us to be in our seats before the bell rings.
items.zh: 我們的英文老師總是很準時，她也要求我們在鐘響前坐到座位上。
items.sec: Schools & School Life 學校與校園生活

items.def: done at school but not part of normal lessons
items.s: Universities like applicants who join ________ activities, because these activities show teamwork and leadership skills.
items.zh: 大學喜歡參加課外活動的申請者，因為這些活動能展現團隊合作和領導能力。
items.sec: Schools & School Life 學校與校園生活

items.def: a visit made by students to learn outside school
items.s: Our class went on a ______ ______ to the science museum, and we watched a show about volcanoes and earthquakes.
items.zh: 我們班去科學博物館校外教學，還觀看了一場關於火山和地震的表演。
items.sec: Schools & School Life 學校與校園生活

items.def: a meeting of all the students and teachers in a school
items.s: Every Monday morning the whole school gathers for ________, and the student council shares important news.
items.zh: 每個星期一早上全校都會集合參加朝會，學生會在會中分享重要消息。
items.sec: Schools & School Life 學校與校園生活

items.def: a time of introduction for new students
items.s: New students attended a two-day ________ before classes began, so they knew where the library and labs were.
items.zh: 新生在開學前參加了兩天的新生訓練，所以他們知道圖書館和實驗室在哪裡。
items.sec: Schools & School Life 學校與校園生活

items.def: former students of a school or university
items.s: Several famous ________ came back to give talks on career day, and the students asked them many questions.
items.zh: 幾位知名校友在職涯日回校演講，學生們問了他們很多問題。
items.sec: Schools & School Life 學校與校園生活

items.def: the class where students meet their main teacher each day
items.s: Our ________ teacher checks attendance every morning, and she also helps us when we have problems with friends.
items.zh: 我們的導師每天早上點名，而且在我們和朋友有問題時也會幫助我們。
items.sec: Schools & School Life 學校與校園生活

items.def: to hurt or frighten someone weaker again and again
items.s: Some older boys used to ________ him online, but he told a teacher and the school stopped it quickly.
items.zh: 有些年紀較大的男孩過去常在網路上霸凌他，但他告訴了老師，學校很快就制止了。
items.sec: Schools & School Life 學校與校園生活

items.def: a room where lessons take place
items.s: Our ________ has new air conditioners this year, so it is much easier to concentrate on hot afternoons.
items.zh: 我們的教室今年裝了新冷氣，所以在炎熱的下午專心上課容易多了。
items.sec: Schools & School Life 學校與校園生活

items.def: pens, paper, rulers and other things for writing
items.s: Before the new semester, students crowd into ________ shops, and they buy colourful pens, notebooks and sticky notes.
items.zh: 新學期開始前，學生們擠進文具店，買彩色筆、筆記本和便利貼。
items.sec: Schools & School Life 學校與校園生活

items.def: a room in a school where teachers work and rest
items.s: I took my test paper to the ________ after lunch, because I wanted to ask my teacher about one question.
items.zh: 午餐後我把考卷拿到教師辦公室，因為我想問老師其中一題。
items.sec: Schools & School Life 學校與校園生活

items.def: for both boys and girls together
items.s: Most high schools in Taiwan are now ________, but some traditional schools still accept only boys or only girls.
items.zh: 台灣大多數高中現在都是男女合校，但有些傳統學校仍然只收男生或只收女生。
items.sec: Schools & School Life 學校與校園生活

items.def: only for boys or only for girls
items.s: My mother studied at a ________ school for girls, and she says it helped her feel confident in science classes.
items.zh: 我媽媽以前就讀一所單一性別的女校，她說那幫助她在科學課上更有自信。
items.sec: Schools & School Life 學校與校園生活

items.def: a school paid for by the government
items.s: In Britain most children go to a ______ ______, while a small number of families pay for private education.
items.zh: 在英國大部分孩子就讀公立學校，而少數家庭則花錢讓孩子接受私立教育。
items.sec: Schools & School Life 學校與校園生活

items.def: a person who cleans and looks after a school building
items.s: The ________ fixed the broken window before school started, so our lesson was not interrupted by the cold wind.
items.zh: 工友在上課前修好了破掉的窗戶，所以我們上課沒有被冷風打擾。
items.sec: Schools & School Life 學校與校園生活

items.def: rules about what clothes people may wear
items.s: The school relaxed its ______ ______ last year, so students can now wear sports clothes on hot days.
items.zh: 學校去年放寬了服裝規定，所以學生現在天氣熱時可以穿運動服。
items.sec: Schools & School Life 學校與校園生活

items.def: a meeting of people who have not seen each other for a long time
items.s: My father went to his high school ________ last weekend, and he was surprised that many classmates had become teachers.
items.zh: 我爸爸上週末去參加高中同學會，他很驚訝許多同學都成了老師。
items.sec: Schools & School Life 學校與校園生活

items.def: the methods and practice of teaching
items.s: The new teacher studied modern ________ at university, so she uses games and discussions instead of just talking for an hour.
items.zh: 這位新老師在大學研讀過現代教學法，所以她用遊戲和討論，而不是只講課一個小時。
items.sec: Teaching & Classroom Practice 教學與課堂實務

items.def: a person whose job is teaching or education
items.s: Many ________ in Taiwan are trying new methods, but they still need time and support from their schools.
items.zh: 台灣許多教育工作者正在嘗試新方法，但他們仍然需要學校給予時間和支持。
items.sec: Teaching & Classroom Practice 教學與課堂實務

items.def: a person who teaches a practical skill
items.s: My swimming ________ is very patient, and she never shouts when I make the same mistake again.
items.zh: 我的游泳教練非常有耐心，即使我再犯同樣的錯誤，她也從不大吼。
items.sec: Teaching & Classroom Practice 教學與課堂實務

items.def: a teacher's written plan for one class
items.s: Ms Lin writes a detailed ______ ______ for every class, but she changes it when the students need more practice.
items.zh: 林老師每堂課都會寫詳細的教案，但當學生需要更多練習時她會調整。
items.sec: Teaching & Classroom Practice 教學與課堂實務

items.def: a paper with exercises for students to complete
items.s: The teacher handed out a ________ about the reading passage, and we had ten minutes to answer the questions in pairs.
items.zh: 老師發下一張關於閱讀文章的學習單，我們有十分鐘兩人一組回答問題。
items.sec: Teaching & Classroom Practice 教學與課堂實務

items.def: a sheet of information given to students in class
items.s: Please keep this ________ in your folder, because it has all the grammar rules that will be on the test.
items.zh: 請把這份講義收在你的資料夾裡，因為上面有所有會考的文法規則。
items.sec: Teaching & Classroom Practice 教學與課堂實務

items.def: a white board that teachers write on with markers
items.s: The teacher drew a timeline on the ________, and the students copied it carefully into their notebooks.
items.zh: 老師在白板上畫了一條時間軸，學生們仔細地把它抄進筆記本。
items.sec: Teaching & Classroom Practice 教學與課堂實務

items.def: a machine that shows pictures or slides on a screen
items.s: The ________ stopped working in the middle of my presentation, so I had to explain my ideas without any slides.
items.zh: 投影機在我報告到一半時壞了，所以我只好在沒有投影片的情況下解釋我的想法。
items.sec: Teaching & Classroom Practice 教學與課堂實務

items.def: tasks that students do together in small teams
items.s: Some students enjoy ______ ______, but others feel that one or two members always do most of the job.
items.zh: 有些學生喜歡分組活動，但也有人覺得總是一兩位組員做了大部分的工作。
items.sec: Teaching & Classroom Practice 教學與課堂實務

items.def: a small class where students discuss a subject with a teacher
items.s: In the weekly ________ each student shares an article, and the others ask questions about it.
items.zh: 在每週的專題討論課中，每位學生分享一篇文章，其他人則針對它提問。
items.sec: Teaching & Classroom Practice 教學與課堂實務

items.def: a short lesson for one student or a small group
items.s: I watched an online ________ about using spreadsheets, and then I finally finished my science report.
items.zh: 我看了一段關於使用試算表的線上教學影片，然後終於完成了我的科學報告。
items.sec: Teaching & Classroom Practice 教學與課堂實務

items.def: an activity where students act as other people
items.s: We did a ________ about ordering food in a restaurant, and it helped shy students speak more English.
items.zh: 我們做了一個在餐廳點餐的角色扮演，它幫助害羞的學生說更多英文。
items.sec: Teaching & Classroom Practice 教學與課堂實務

items.def: a talk in which someone shows and explains information
items.s: I practised my ________ in front of a mirror many times, so I felt much calmer when I spoke to the class.
items.zh: 我對著鏡子練習口頭報告很多次，所以向全班說話時我覺得冷靜多了。
items.sec: Teaching & Classroom Practice 教學與課堂實務

items.def: to share many ideas quickly in a group
items.s: Before writing, the students ________ ideas about their dream school, and the teacher wrote every idea on the board.
items.zh: 寫作前，學生們針對理想中的學校腦力激盪，老師把每個想法都寫在黑板上。
items.sec: Teaching & Classroom Practice 教學與課堂實務

items.def: learning by doing things yourself
items.s: The science class is very ________, because we build simple machines instead of only reading about them.
items.zh: 這堂科學課非常注重實作，因為我們親手製作簡單機械，而不只是讀有關它們的內容。
items.sec: Teaching & Classroom Practice 教學與課堂實務

items.def: focusing on what students need and do
items.s: In a ________ classroom students ask more questions, while the teacher guides them rather than gives long talks.
items.zh: 在以學習者為中心的教室裡，學生提出更多問題，而老師是引導他們，而不是長篇講課。
items.sec: Teaching & Classroom Practice 教學與課堂實務

items.def: focusing mainly on the teacher talking and controlling
items.s: Old-fashioned lessons were often ________, and students simply listened and copied notes for most of the class.
items.zh: 傳統的課堂常常是以教師為中心的，學生大部分時間只是聽講和抄筆記。
items.sec: Teaching & Classroom Practice 教學與課堂實務

items.def: the ways a teacher keeps a class organised and calm
items.s: Good ______ ______ makes lessons run smoothly, and new teachers often learn it from experienced colleagues.
items.zh: 良好的班級經營讓課程進行順利，新老師常從資深同事那裡學習。
items.sec: Teaching & Classroom Practice 教學與課堂實務

items.def: training people to obey rules and control behaviour
items.s: The coach believes in strict ________, so players who arrive late have to run extra laps.
items.zh: 教練相信嚴格的紀律，所以遲到的球員必須多跑幾圈。
items.sec: Teaching & Classroom Practice 教學與課堂實務

items.def: students watch lessons at home and practise in class
items.s: In a ______ ______ we watch short videos at home, and then we use class time for projects and questions.
items.zh: 在翻轉教室裡，我們在家看短片，然後把上課時間用來做專題和提問。
items.sec: Teaching & Classroom Practice 教學與課堂實務

items.def: learning by asking questions and finding answers
items.s: Our school uses ________ learning in science, so students design their own experiments to test ideas.
items.zh: 我們學校在科學課採用探究式學習，所以學生自己設計實驗來驗證想法。
items.sec: Teaching & Classroom Practice 教學與課堂實務

items.def: learning through long practical projects
items.s: The ________ course asked us to plan a school garden, and we learned maths, science and teamwork at the same time.
items.zh: 這門專題式課程要我們規劃一座校園花園，而我們同時學到了數學、科學和團隊合作。
items.sec: Teaching & Classroom Practice 教學與課堂實務

items.def: a chart that explains how work will be scored
items.s: The teacher gave us the ________ before we started writing, so we knew exactly how our stories would be marked.
items.zh: 老師在我們開始寫作前就給了評分規準，所以我們清楚知道故事會如何被評分。
items.sec: Teaching & Classroom Practice 教學與課堂實務

items.def: the speed at which something happens
items.s: The teacher explained the new grammar at a slow ________, because many students had never seen it before.
items.zh: 老師用緩慢的速度解釋新文法，因為許多學生以前從未見過。
items.sec: Teaching & Classroom Practice 教學與課堂實務

items.def: to repeat the main points briefly
items.s: At the end of each lesson the teacher asks one student to ________ the key ideas, and the others add anything missing.
items.zh: 每堂課結束時，老師會請一位學生扼要重述重點，其他人再補充遺漏的部分。
items.sec: Teaching & Classroom Practice 教學與課堂實務

items.def: a friendly relationship of trust and understanding
items.s: Mr Wang has a great ________ with his students, so they feel comfortable asking him about anything.
items.zh: 王老師和學生之間關係非常融洽，所以他們什麼事都敢問他。
items.sec: Teaching & Classroom Practice 教學與課堂實務

items.def: a picture, chart or object that helps people understand
items.s: Maps and photos are useful ______ ______, because they help students remember new words more easily.
items.zh: 地圖和照片是很有用的視覺輔助教具，因為它們幫助學生更容易記住新單字。
items.sec: Teaching & Classroom Practice 教學與課堂實務

items.def: a mix of online learning and classroom teaching
items.s: Since the pandemic many schools use ______ ______, and students do some lessons online and some in class.
items.zh: 自從疫情以來，許多學校採用混成學習，學生有些課在線上上，有些在教室上。
items.sec: Teaching & Classroom Practice 教學與課堂實務

items.def: a person who is training to become a teacher
items.s: A ______ ______ joined our class for six weeks, and she taught us some fun songs about grammar.
items.zh: 一位實習老師來我們班六週，她教了我們一些有趣的文法歌。
items.sec: Teaching & Classroom Practice 教學與課堂實務

items.def: a person who helps a teacher in class
items.s: The ______ ______ helps students who fall behind, while the main teacher works with the rest of the class.
items.zh: 助教協助進度落後的學生，而主要老師則帶領班上其他同學。
items.sec: Teaching & Classroom Practice 教學與課堂實務

items.def: practice by repeating the same exercise many times
items.s: We did a pronunciation ________ for ten minutes, and by the end everyone could say "th" correctly.
items.zh: 我們做了十分鐘的發音反覆練習，到最後每個人都能正確發出 th 的音。
items.sec: Teaching & Classroom Practice 教學與課堂實務

items.def: writing down words that someone reads aloud
items.s: Every Friday we have a spelling ________, so I review the new words on the bus every Thursday night.
items.zh: 每個星期五我們有拼字聽寫，所以我每週四晚上都在公車上複習新單字。
items.sec: Teaching & Classroom Practice 教學與課堂實務

items.def: to give students answers so they do not think for themselves
items.cn: 填鴨式餵答案；過度灌輸
items.s: Some tutors ________ students with model answers, but this does not teach them how to solve new problems.
items.zh: 有些補習老師用範本答案填鴨學生，但這並不能教會他們如何解決新問題。
items.sec: Teaching & Classroom Practice 教學與課堂實務

items.def: a person whose behaviour others want to copy
items.s: My aunt is my ______ ______, because she became a doctor while helping her family run a small shop.
items.zh: 我阿姨是我的榜樣，因為她一邊幫家裡經營小店一邊成為了醫生。
items.sec: Teaching & Classroom Practice 教學與課堂實務

items.def: writing down the key points while listening or reading
items.s: Good ________ helps you remember a lecture, but you should also read your notes again within a day.
items.zh: 良好的做筆記技巧能幫你記住一堂課，但你也應該在一天內重讀筆記。
items.sec: Learning Skills & Study Habits 學習技巧與讀書習慣

items.def: to draw a line under words to show they are important
items.s: When I read a hard article, I ________ the main ideas, and then I write a short summary in the margin.
items.zh: 讀困難的文章時，我會在主要概念底下畫線，然後在頁邊寫一段簡短摘要。
items.sec: Learning Skills & Study Habits 學習技巧與讀書習慣

items.def: to read something quickly to get the main idea
items.s: First ________ the passage to understand the topic, and then read the questions before you look for details.
items.zh: 先略讀文章以了解主題，然後在找細節之前先讀題目。
items.sec: Learning Skills & Study Habits 學習技巧與讀書習慣

items.def: to look quickly through a text for a particular piece of information
items.s: I ________ the timetable for the date of the exam, but I could not find it anywhere on the page.
items.zh: 我快速瀏覽時刻表尋找考試日期，但在整頁上都找不到。
items.sec: Learning Skills & Study Habits 學習技巧與讀書習慣

items.def: to learn something so well that you can remember it exactly
items.s: She tried to ________ fifty words in one night, but she forgot most of them by the next morning.
items.zh: 她試著在一個晚上背五十個單字，但到隔天早上就忘了大部分。
items.sec: Learning Skills & Study Habits 學習技巧與讀書習慣

items.def: to study something again in order to remember it
items.s: I ________ my notes for ten minutes every evening, so I do not have to stay up late before tests.
items.zh: 我每天晚上複習筆記十分鐘，所以考試前不必熬夜。
items.sec: Learning Skills & Study Habits 學習技巧與讀書習慣

items.def: a small card with a word on one side and its meaning on the other
items.s: My sister makes a ________ for every new word, and she tests herself while she waits for the bus.
items.zh: 我妹妹為每個新單字做一張單字卡，並在等公車時自我測驗。
items.sec: Learning Skills & Study Habits 學習技巧與讀書習慣

items.def: a diagram that connects ideas around a central topic
items.s: Before writing my essay I drew a ______ ______, and it helped me organise my ideas into three clear paragraphs.
items.zh: 寫作文前我畫了一張心智圖，它幫助我把想法整理成三個清楚的段落。
items.sec: Learning Skills & Study Habits 學習技巧與讀書習慣

items.def: a small group of students who learn together
items.s: We formed a ______ ______ before the final exams, and we met in the library every Saturday afternoon.
items.zh: 我們在期末考前組了一個讀書會，每個星期六下午在圖書館見面。
items.sec: Learning Skills & Study Habits 學習技巧與讀書習慣

items.def: learning by yourself without a teacher
items.s: The school gives seniors two hours of ________ every afternoon, but some students just chat with friends.
items.zh: 學校每天下午給高三學生兩小時自修時間，但有些學生只是和朋友聊天。
items.sec: Learning Skills & Study Habits 學習技巧與讀書習慣

items.def: controlled and planned by the learner themselves
items.s: Taiwan's new curriculum encourages ________ learning, so students choose a topic and plan their own research.
items.zh: 台灣的新課綱鼓勵自主學習，所以學生自己選擇主題並規劃研究。
items.sec: Learning Skills & Study Habits 學習技巧與讀書習慣

items.def: the way a person learns best
items.s: Some people say each child has one ______ ______, but many researchers believe we all learn in mixed ways.
items.zh: 有些人說每個孩子都有一種學習風格，但許多研究者認為我們都以混合的方式學習。
items.sec: Learning Skills & Study Habits 學習技巧與讀書習慣

items.def: learning by moving and touching things
items.s: My brother is a ________ learner, so he remembers science better when he builds models with his hands.
items.zh: 我弟弟是動覺型學習者，所以他親手做模型時對科學記得更牢。
items.sec: Learning Skills & Study Habits 學習技巧與讀書習慣

items.def: the skill of planning and using your time well
items.s: Good ______ ______ is important in senior high school, because students have many tests and club activities.
items.zh: 良好的時間管理在高中很重要，因為學生有許多考試和社團活動。
items.sec: Learning Skills & Study Habits 學習技巧與讀書習慣

items.def: to read writing carefully to find and correct mistakes
items.s: Always ________ your report before you hand it in, because small spelling mistakes can make a bad impression.
items.zh: 交報告前務必要校對，因為小小的拼字錯誤可能會給人不好的印象。
items.sec: Learning Skills & Study Habits 學習技巧與讀書習慣

items.def: a book or app that explains the meanings of words
items.s: I checked the word in an online ________, and I also listened to its pronunciation several times.
items.zh: 我在線上字典查了這個字，還聽了好幾次它的發音。
items.sec: Learning Skills & Study Habits 學習技巧與讀書習慣

items.def: a list of difficult words with their meanings, often at the end of a book
items.s: The biology book has a ________ at the back, so students can quickly look up difficult terms.
items.zh: 這本生物書後面附有詞彙表，所以學生能快速查找困難的術語。
items.sec: Learning Skills & Study Habits 學習技巧與讀書習慣

items.def: a list of books and articles used in a piece of writing
items.s: Our teacher reminded us to include a ________, because we must show where all our information came from.
items.zh: 老師提醒我們要附上參考書目，因為我們必須說明所有資訊的來源。
items.sec: Learning Skills & Study Habits 學習技巧與讀書習慣

items.def: a person who works in a library
items.s: The ________ helped me find three useful books on Taiwanese history, and she showed me how to use the online catalogue.
items.zh: 圖書館員幫我找到三本有關台灣歷史的實用書籍，還教我如何使用線上目錄。
items.sec: Learning Skills & Study Habits 學習技巧與讀書習慣

items.def: a list of books students are told to read
items.s: The summer ______ ______ includes five English novels, but students only need to write a report on one of them.
items.zh: 暑假書單包含五本英文小說，但學生只需要針對其中一本寫報告。
items.sec: Learning Skills & Study Habits 學習技巧與讀書習慣

items.def: to understand something, especially something difficult
items.s: At first I could not ________ how the past perfect works, but my teacher's timeline made it clear.
items.zh: 一開始我無法理解過去完成式怎麼用，但老師畫的時間軸讓它變清楚了。
items.sec: Learning Skills & Study Habits 學習技巧與讀書習慣

items.def: to learn something completely and become very good at it
items.s: It takes years to ________ a musical instrument, so you should not give up after only a few lessons.
items.zh: 要精通一種樂器需要好幾年，所以不應該只上幾堂課就放棄。
items.sec: Learning Skills & Study Habits 學習技巧與讀書習慣

items.def: to learn about something so that you know it well
items.s: New students should ________ themselves with the school rules, because teachers will not accept excuses later.
items.zh: 新生應該熟悉校規，因為之後老師不會接受任何藉口。
items.sec: Learning Skills & Study Habits 學習技巧與讀書習慣

items.def: to do something again and again to improve
items.s: I ________ speaking English with a language partner online, and my confidence has grown a lot this year.
items.zh: 我在線上和語言夥伴練習說英文，今年我的自信心增加了很多。
items.sec: Learning Skills & Study Habits 學習技巧與讀書習慣

items.def: thinking about how you think and learn
items.s: Teachers want to develop students' ________, so they ask them to explain how they solved each problem.
items.zh: 老師們想培養學生的後設認知，所以會請他們說明自己如何解出每個問題。
items.sec: Learning Skills & Study Habits 學習技巧與讀書習慣

items.def: spending a lot of time studying and reading
items.s: Ben is very ________ and often reads in the library, but he also enjoys playing basketball with friends.
items.zh: 班非常用功，常在圖書館讀書，但他也喜歡和朋友打籃球。
items.sec: Learning Skills & Study Habits 學習技巧與讀書習慣

items.def: a person who loves reading books
items.s: My best friend is a real ________, and she finished the whole Harry Potter series in two weeks.
items.zh: 我最好的朋友是個十足的書蟲，她兩週就讀完了整套哈利波特。
items.sec: Learning Skills & Study Habits 學習技巧與讀書習慣

items.def: how quickly someone learns something new
items.s: Coding has a steep ______ ______ at first, but it becomes much easier after a few weeks of practice.
items.zh: 寫程式一開始的學習曲線很陡峭，但練習幾週之後就容易多了。
items.sec: Learning Skills & Study Habits 學習技巧與讀書習慣

items.def: a period when progress stops for a while
items.s: Many language learners reach a ________ after a year, so they need new challenges to keep improving.
items.zh: 許多語言學習者在一年後會進入停滯期，所以他們需要新挑戰才能持續進步。
items.sec: Learning Skills & Study Habits 學習技巧與讀書習慣

items.def: to add short notes to a text to explain or comment
items.s: We ________ the poem with our own comments, and then we compared our ideas in small groups.
items.zh: 我們在詩上加了自己的註解，然後在小組中比較彼此的想法。
items.sec: Learning Skills & Study Habits 學習技巧與讀書習慣

items.def: a bright pen used to mark important words
items.s: He used a yellow ________ on almost every line, so the colour no longer showed what was really important.
items.zh: 他幾乎每一行都用黃色螢光筆畫，所以顏色已經無法顯示真正重要的內容。
items.sec: Learning Skills & Study Habits 學習技巧與讀書習慣

items.def: a recording of someone reading a book aloud
items.s: I listen to an English ________ on my way to school, and it has improved my listening skills.
items.zh: 我上學途中聽英文有聲書，它提升了我的聽力。
items.sec: Learning Skills & Study Habits 學習技巧與讀書習慣

items.def: having learned a skill by yourself, without lessons
items.s: The ________ guitarist never took a single lesson, but he learned hundreds of songs from online videos.
items.zh: 這位自學的吉他手從沒上過一堂課，但他從網路影片學會了好幾百首歌。
items.sec: Learning Skills & Study Habits 學習技巧與讀書習慣

items.def: a formal test of knowledge or skill
items.s: The final ________ is next Tuesday, so the library will stay open until ten o'clock every night this week.
items.zh: 期末考試在下週二，所以這週圖書館每晚都會開到十點。

items.def: a person who sets or marks an exam, or tests speaking
items.s: The IELTS ________ asked me about my hometown, and I tried to give long answers with examples.
items.zh: 雅思主考官問我關於家鄉的問題，我試著用例子給出較長的回答。

items.def: a person who watches students during an exam
items.s: The ________ walked slowly around the hall, and she collected all the phones before the test began.
items.zh: 監考人員在考場裡慢慢走動，並在考試開始前收走所有手機。

items.def: a person who is taking an exam
items.s: Each ________ must bring an ID card to the test centre, or they will not be allowed to enter the room.
items.zh: 每位考生都必須攜帶身分證到考場，否則將不被允許進入考場。

items.def: a practice exam taken before the real one
items.s: My score on the ______ ______ was disappointing, but it showed me exactly which topics I needed to review.
items.zh: 我模擬考的成績令人失望，但它讓我清楚知道需要複習哪些主題。

items.def: an exam from a previous year used for practice
items.s: Our teacher gave us a ______ ______ from 2023, and we did it under real time limits in class.
items.zh: 老師給了我們一份2023年的考古題，我們在課堂上依照真實的時間限制作答。

items.def: giving several possible answers to choose from
items.s: The first part of the test has forty ________ questions, while the second part asks students to write short answers.
items.zh: 測驗第一部分有四十題選擇題，而第二部分要學生寫簡答。

items.def: allowing students to use books during the exam
items.s: The history test was ________, but it was still difficult because the questions asked for our own opinions.
items.zh: 這次歷史考試是開書考，但仍然很難，因為題目要求我們提出自己的看法。

items.def: spoken rather than written
items.s: I was nervous before the ________ exam, but the teacher smiled and asked easy questions at first.
items.zh: 口試前我很緊張，但老師面帶微笑，一開始問的是簡單的問題。

items.def: an official record of a student's courses and results
items.s: Universities abroad asked for my high school ________, so I requested an English copy from the school office.
items.zh: 國外大學要求我提供高中成績單，所以我向學校辦公室申請了英文版。

items.def: a school report showing a student's results
items.s: When I brought my ______ ______ home, my parents were happy because my science result had improved a lot.
items.zh: 我把成績單帶回家時，爸媽很開心，因為我的自然成績進步了很多。

items.def: to check and give a score to students' work
items.s: The teacher stayed up late to ________ our tests, so we got them back the very next morning.
items.zh: 老師熬夜批改我們的考卷，所以我們隔天早上就拿回來了。

items.def: to take an exam again after failing or to get a better score
items.s: He decided to ________ the driving test next month, because he had made a small mistake when parking.
items.zh: 他決定下個月重考駕照，因為他在停車時犯了一個小錯。

items.def: the same for everyone, so results can be compared
items.s: The GSAT is a ________ test, so students across Taiwan answer the same questions on the same day.
items.zh: 學測是標準化測驗，所以全台學生在同一天回答同樣的題目。

items.def: an exam you must pass to join a school or university
items.s: She studied for months for the ______ ______, and she was accepted by the medical school she wanted.
items.zh: 她為入學考試準備了好幾個月，最後被她想要的醫學系錄取。

items.def: money given to a student to help pay for education
items.s: He won a full ________ to study in Canada, so his parents did not have to worry about the fees.
items.zh: 他獲得了全額獎學金到加拿大念書，所以他父母不必擔心學費。

items.def: the highest level of result in an exam
items.s: She passed her piano exam with ________, and her teacher invited her to play at the school concert.
items.zh: 她以優異成績通過鋼琴檢定，老師邀請她在學校音樂會上演奏。

items.def: a unit that shows a student has completed part of a course
items.s: Each elective course is worth two ________, and students need a certain number of them to graduate.
items.zh: 每門選修課值兩個學分，學生需要修滿一定數量才能畢業。

items.def: a position in a list showing who is better or worse
items.s: The school no longer posts each student's ________ on the wall, because it made many teenagers feel stressed.
items.zh: 學校不再把每位學生的排名貼在牆上，因為那讓許多青少年感到壓力。

items.def: a position showing what percentage of people scored lower
items.s: His score put him in the 90th ________, which means he did better than ninety percent of test takers.
items.zh: 他的分數落在第90百分位數，這表示他考得比百分之九十的考生好。

items.def: having very important results or effects
items.s: University entrance tests are ________ exams, so many students feel huge pressure in their final year.
items.zh: 大學入學考試是攸關重大的考試，所以許多學生在最後一年感到巨大壓力。

items.def: used during learning to help students improve
items.s: Short ________ tests help teachers see what students do not understand, and they do not count towards the final score.
items.zh: 簡短的形成性測驗幫助老師看出學生不懂的地方，而且不計入總成績。

items.def: used at the end to judge what students have learned
items.s: The final exam is a ________ test, so it shows how much students have learned during the whole semester.
items.zh: 期末考是總結性測驗，所以它顯示學生整學期學到了多少。

items.def: the paper on which students write or mark their answers
items.s: Use a 2B pencil on the ______ ______, and make sure you fill in each circle completely.
items.zh: 在答案卡上要用2B鉛筆，並確保每個圓圈都完整塗滿。

items.def: extra time given to finish a piece of work
items.s: I was ill for a week, so the teacher gave me an ________ and I handed in my project on Friday.
items.zh: 我病了一週，所以老師讓我延期，我在星期五交了專題。

items.def: a small hidden paper with answers used to cheat
items.s: The student hid a ______ ______ in his pencil case, but the invigilator found it within five minutes.
items.zh: 那位學生把小抄藏在鉛筆盒裡，但監考人員五分鐘內就發現了。

items.def: the percentage of people who pass an exam
items.s: The ______ ______ for the driving test is quite low, so most people take extra lessons before trying it.
items.zh: 駕照考試的通過率相當低，所以大部分人在應考前會多上幾堂課。

items.def: the official guide for scoring an exam
items.s: Teachers follow the same ______ ______, so students at different schools are scored in a fair way.
items.zh: 老師們遵循同一套評分標準，所以不同學校的學生都能被公平評分。

items.def: a document showing you have completed a course
items.s: She proudly held her ________ on stage, and her grandparents took dozens of photos from the audience.
items.zh: 她在台上驕傲地拿著畢業證書，她的祖父母在觀眾席拍了好幾十張照片。

items.def: an official record that you have passed exams or training
items.s: You need a teaching ________ to work in a public school, but private cram schools are not always so strict.
items.zh: 在公立學校任教需要教師資格，但私人補習班不一定那麼嚴格。

items.def: a level from 1 to 9 given in the IELTS test
items.s: She needs a ______ ______ of 6.5 for her university application, so she is practising writing every day.
items.zh: 她的大學申請需要6.5的級分，所以她每天都在練習寫作。

items.def: to do less well than your ability suggests
items.s: Bright students sometimes ________ when they feel bored, so teachers try to give them more challenging tasks.
items.zh: 聰明的學生有時在感到無聊時會表現不如預期，所以老師會試著給他們更有挑戰性的任務。

items.def: a person who is very successful, especially at school
items.s: Lucy is a ______ ______ in every subject, but she still asks for help when she does not understand something.
items.zh: 露西每一科都是成績頂尖的學生，但遇到不懂的地方她仍然會請求協助。

items.def: a university student studying for a first degree
items.s: As an ________ she lived in a shared flat, and she worked part-time in a café to pay her rent.
items.zh: 身為大學部學生，她住在合租公寓，並在咖啡店打工支付房租。
items.sec: Higher Education & University Life 高等教育與大學生活

items.def: relating to study after a first degree
items.s: He started a ________ course in engineering, because he wanted to design safer bridges in the future.
items.zh: 他開始攻讀工程研究所課程，因為他未來想設計更安全的橋梁。
items.sec: Higher Education & University Life 高等教育與大學生活

items.def: a student in the first year of high school or university
items.s: As a ________ I got lost on campus several times, but older students always helped me find my classroom.
items.zh: 身為新生，我在校園裡迷路了好幾次，但學長姊總會幫我找到教室。
items.sec: Higher Education & University Life 高等教育與大學生活

items.def: a first university degree, usually after four years
items.s: My sister earned her ______ ______ in nursing, and now she works at a hospital in Kaohsiung.
items.zh: 我姊姊取得了護理學士學位，現在在高雄的一家醫院工作。
items.sec: Higher Education & University Life 高等教育與大學生活

items.def: a university degree after a bachelor's degree
items.s: Many engineers in Taiwan study for a ______ ______, because it often leads to a higher salary.
items.zh: 台灣許多工程師攻讀碩士學位，因為這往往能帶來較高的薪水。
items.sec: Higher Education & University Life 高等教育與大學生活

items.def: the highest university degree, also called a PhD
items.s: Dr Chen completed her ________ in marine biology, and she now teaches at a university in Keelung.
items.zh: 陳博士完成了海洋生物學的博士學位，現在在基隆的一所大學任教。
items.sec: Higher Education & University Life 高等教育與大學生活

items.def: a long piece of writing done for a university degree
items.s: He spent his final year writing a ________ on online learning, and his professor praised his careful research.
items.zh: 他大四整年都在寫一篇關於線上學習的學位論文，教授稱讚他研究嚴謹。
items.sec: Higher Education & University Life 高等教育與大學生活

items.def: the main subject a university student studies
items.s: My ________ is economics, but I am also taking classes in Japanese because I want to work in Tokyo.
items.zh: 我的主修是經濟學，但我也在修日文課，因為我想在東京工作。
items.sec: Higher Education & University Life 高等教育與大學生活

items.def: a second subject studied at university, with fewer courses
items.s: She chose psychology as her ________, and the extra classes helped her understand her future customers.
items.zh: 她選擇心理學作為輔修，這些額外課程幫助她了解未來的顧客。
items.sec: Higher Education & University Life 高等教育與大學生活

items.def: a group of university departments, or all the teaching staff
items.s: The ________ of medicine has a new building, and students can now practise in modern training rooms.
items.zh: 醫學院有一棟新大樓，學生現在可以在現代化的訓練教室練習。
items.sec: Higher Education & University Life 高等教育與大學生活

items.def: the land and buildings of a university or school
items.s: The ________ is so large that many students ride bicycles between classes, and some even use electric scooters.
items.zh: 校園大到許多學生在上課之間騎腳踏車往返，有些人甚至騎電動滑板車。
items.sec: Higher Education & University Life 高等教育與大學生活

items.def: a senior teacher at a university
items.s: Our ________ explained the theory with real examples, so even students without a science background understood.
items.zh: 我們的教授用真實例子解釋理論，所以即使沒有理科背景的學生也聽得懂。
items.sec: Higher Education & University Life 高等教育與大學生活

items.def: a person in charge of a faculty or of students at a university
items.s: The ________ of students met the club leaders, and she agreed to give them more money for events.
items.zh: 學務長和社團幹部會面，並同意撥給他們更多活動經費。
items.sec: Higher Education & University Life 高等教育與大學生活

items.def: permission to join a school or university
items.s: Her ________ to National Taiwan University surprised no one, because she had worked hard for years.
items.zh: 她被台大錄取一點也不令人意外，因為她多年來一直很努力。
items.sec: Higher Education & University Life 高等教育與大學生活

items.def: money borrowed to pay for university, paid back later
items.s: He took out a ______ ______ to pay his fees, so he plans to work for a few years before travelling.
items.zh: 他申請了學生貸款來支付學費，所以他打算先工作幾年再去旅行。
items.sec: Higher Education & University Life 高等教育與大學生活

items.def: a year off between school and university
items.s: After high school she took a ______ ______ to volunteer in Thailand, and it helped her decide what to study.
items.zh: 高中畢業後她休了一個空檔年去泰國當志工，這幫助她決定要念什麼。
items.sec: Higher Education & University Life 高等教育與大學生活

items.def: a student who studies in another country for a short time
items.s: An ______ ______ from Germany joined our class, and we taught her how to use chopsticks.
items.zh: 一位來自德國的交換學生加入我們班，而我們教她怎麼用筷子。
items.sec: Higher Education & University Life 高等教育與大學生活

items.def: to go to another country to study
items.s: Many young Taiwanese hope to ______ ______, but the costs of living overseas can be very high.
items.zh: 許多台灣年輕人希望出國留學，但在國外生活的費用可能非常高。
items.sec: Higher Education & University Life 高等教育與大學生活

items.def: a short period of work to gain experience
items.s: She did a summer ________ at a design company, and they offered her a job after she graduated.
items.zh: 她暑假在一家設計公司實習，而公司在她畢業後提供了她一份工作。
items.sec: Higher Education & University Life 高等教育與大學生活

items.def: teaching skills for a particular job
items.s: He chose a ________ high school to learn car repair, and he opened his own garage at twenty-five.
items.zh: 他選擇讀技職高中學汽車維修，並在二十五歲時開了自己的修車廠。
items.sec: Higher Education & University Life 高等教育與大學生活

items.def: a period of training for a skilled job with an expert
items.s: He spent three years in an ________ with a famous baker, and now he runs a popular bakery in Taichung.
items.zh: 他跟著一位知名麵包師傅當了三年學徒，現在在台中經營一家受歡迎的麵包店。
items.sec: Higher Education & University Life 高等教育與大學生活

items.def: officially approved as meeting standards
items.s: Make sure the online college is ________, or employers may not accept the degree you earn there.
items.zh: 務必確認那所線上學院是經過認證的，否則雇主可能不承認你在那裡取得的學位。
items.sec: Higher Education & University Life 高等教育與大學生活

items.def: a course that students can choose to take
items.s: I took photography as an ________ this year, and now I take pictures of the school garden every week.
items.zh: 我今年選了攝影作為選修課，現在我每週都拍校園花園。
items.sec: Higher Education & University Life 高等教育與大學生活

items.def: a person who shares a room with you
items.s: My ________ stays up late playing games, so I wear earplugs when I need to sleep before an exam.
items.zh: 我的室友熬夜打電動，所以考試前需要睡覺時我會戴耳塞。
items.sec: Higher Education & University Life 高等教育與大學生活

items.def: an organisation run by students to support them
items.s: The ______ ______ organised a free concert, and hundreds of students came to relax after their exams.
items.zh: 學生會舉辦了一場免費音樂會，好幾百位學生考完試後來放鬆。
items.sec: Higher Education & University Life 高等教育與大學生活

items.def: careful study to discover new facts
items.s: Her ________ on sleep and memory was published last year, and many teachers have shared it online.
items.zh: 她關於睡眠與記憶的研究去年發表了，許多老師都在網路上分享。
items.sec: Higher Education & University Life 高等教育與大學生活

items.def: a room where scientific experiments are done
items.s: We wear safety glasses in the chemistry ________, because some liquids can hurt our eyes.
items.zh: 我們在化學實驗室裡戴護目鏡，因為有些液體可能傷害眼睛。
items.sec: Higher Education & University Life 高等教育與大學生活

items.def: research done outside, in the real world
items.s: The geography students did ________ by the river, and they measured how fast the water was flowing.
items.zh: 地理系學生在河邊做實地考察，並測量了水流的速度。
items.sec: Higher Education & University Life 高等教育與大學生活

items.def: a teacher who guides a student's research
items.s: My ________ reads every chapter of my thesis, and she gives detailed comments within a week.
items.zh: 我的指導教授會讀我論文的每一章，並在一週內給我詳細的意見。
items.sec: Higher Education & University Life 高等教育與大學生活

items.def: a person who leaves school before finishing
items.s: He was a high school ________, but he went back to study at night and later became a nurse.
items.zh: 他曾是高中輟學生，但後來回去念夜校，之後成為了護理師。
items.sec: Higher Education & University Life 高等教育與大學生活

items.def: relating to education at college or university
items.s: Taiwan has many ________ institutions, so almost every high school graduate can find a place at college.
items.zh: 台灣有許多大專院校，所以幾乎每位高中畢業生都能找到大學可念。
items.sec: Higher Education & University Life 高等教育與大學生活

items.def: education at university or college
items.s: The government spends a lot on ______ ______, but some people think vocational training needs more money.
items.zh: 政府在高等教育上花了很多錢，但有些人認為職業訓練需要更多經費。
items.sec: Higher Education & University Life 高等教育與大學生活

items.def: subjects such as history, literature and philosophy
items.s: Fewer students now choose the ________, because many parents believe science leads to better jobs.
items.zh: 現在選讀人文學科的學生變少了，因為許多家長認為理工科能找到較好的工作。
items.sec: Higher Education & University Life 高等教育與大學生活

items.def: having much greater natural ability than most people
items.s: The school runs a special class for ________ children, but it also tries to keep them with friends their own age.
items.zh: 學校為資優兒童開設特別班，但也盡量讓他們和同齡朋友待在一起。
items.sec: Gifted, Mixed-Ability & Inclusive Education 資優、混合能力與融合教育

items.def: having a natural ability to do something well
items.s: Many ________ young musicians practise for hours every day, so they have little free time for other hobbies.
items.zh: 許多有才華的年輕音樂家每天練習好幾個小時，所以很少有空從事其他嗜好。
items.sec: Gifted, Mixed-Ability & Inclusive Education 資優、混合能力與融合教育

items.def: a young person with extraordinary ability
items.s: The chess ________ beat several adult players at the age of eight, and newspapers wrote stories about him.
items.zh: 這位西洋棋神童八歲就打敗了好幾位成人棋手，報紙紛紛報導他。
items.sec: Gifted, Mixed-Ability & Inclusive Education 資優、混合能力與融合教育

items.def: developing skills much earlier than usual
items.s: She was a ________ reader who read adult novels at seven, but she sometimes felt lonely with classmates.
items.zh: 她是個閱讀能力早熟的孩子，七歲就讀成人小說，但和同學相處時有時會感到孤單。
items.sec: Gifted, Mixed-Ability & Inclusive Education 資優、混合能力與融合教育

items.def: a person with extremely high intelligence or skill
items.s: People called him a ________ after he won the science prize, but he said hard work mattered more than talent.
items.zh: 他贏得科學獎後大家稱他為天才，但他說努力比天分更重要。
items.sec: Gifted, Mixed-Ability & Inclusive Education 資優、混合能力與融合教育

items.def: a number that measures a person's thinking ability
items.s: A high ________ does not guarantee success, because skills like patience and teamwork also matter a lot.
items.zh: 高智商並不保證成功，因為耐心和團隊合作等能力也非常重要。
items.sec: Gifted, Mixed-Ability & Inclusive Education 資優、混合能力與融合教育

items.def: including students of different levels together
items.s: Teaching a ________ class is challenging, so teachers often prepare easy and difficult versions of each task.
items.zh: 教導混合能力班級很有挑戰性，所以老師常為每項任務準備簡單和困難兩種版本。
items.sec: Gifted, Mixed-Ability & Inclusive Education 資優、混合能力與融合教育

items.def: putting students into classes by their ability level
items.s: Some schools have stopped ________, because weaker students in the lowest class often lose confidence.
items.zh: 有些學校已停止能力分班，因為在最低程度班的弱勢學生常會失去自信。
items.sec: Gifted, Mixed-Ability & Inclusive Education 資優、混合能力與融合教育

items.def: forming small groups of students at similar levels
items.s: Our maths teacher uses ______ ______ for some activities, but she mixes the groups again for projects.
items.zh: 我們數學老師在某些活動中採用能力分組，但做專題時她會再把各組打散混合。
items.sec: Gifted, Mixed-Ability & Inclusive Education 資優、混合能力與融合教育

items.def: welcoming and including all kinds of people
items.s: An ________ school welcomes students with disabilities, and teachers adapt lessons so everyone can take part.
items.zh: 融合學校歡迎身心障礙學生，老師也調整課程讓每個人都能參與。
items.sec: Gifted, Mixed-Ability & Inclusive Education 資優、混合能力與融合教育

items.def: extra help that some students need to learn
items.s: Children with ______ ______ may get extra time in exams, so they have a fair chance to show what they know.
items.zh: 有特殊需求的孩子考試時可能獲得額外時間，讓他們有公平的機會展現所學。
items.sec: Gifted, Mixed-Ability & Inclusive Education 資優、混合能力與融合教育

items.def: a condition that makes some kinds of learning difficult
items.s: Having a ______ ______ does not mean a child is not clever, and many such students go on to university.
items.zh: 有學習障礙並不代表孩子不聰明，許多這樣的學生後來都上了大學。
items.sec: Gifted, Mixed-Ability & Inclusive Education 資優、混合能力與融合教育

items.def: a language that uses hand movements instead of sounds
items.s: Our class learned some basic ______ ______, so we could chat with a new classmate who cannot hear.
items.zh: 我們班學了一些基本手語，這樣就能和一位聽不見的新同學聊天。
items.sec: Gifted, Mixed-Ability & Inclusive Education 資優、混合能力與融合教育

items.def: a system of raised dots that blind people read by touch
items.s: The library now has textbooks in ________, so blind students can read the same lessons as everyone else.
items.zh: 圖書館現在有點字版課本，所以視障學生能和大家讀一樣的課程。
items.sec: Gifted, Mixed-Ability & Inclusive Education 資優、混合能力與融合教育

items.def: unable to hear, or not able to hear well
items.s: The ________ student follows lessons through a sign language interpreter, and she is one of the top students.
items.zh: 這位聽障學生透過手語翻譯員上課，而且她是成績頂尖的學生之一。
items.sec: Gifted, Mixed-Ability & Inclusive Education 資優、混合能力與融合教育

items.def: planned for one particular person
items.s: Each student with special needs has an ________ learning plan, and teachers review it with parents twice a year.
items.zh: 每位特殊需求學生都有一份個別化學習計畫，老師每年和家長檢討兩次。
items.sec: Gifted, Mixed-Ability & Inclusive Education 資優、混合能力與融合教育

items.def: between one teacher and one student
items.s: He improved quickly after a few ________ lessons, because the teacher could focus only on his mistakes.
items.zh: 他上了幾堂一對一課後進步很快，因為老師能只專注在他的錯誤上。
items.sec: Gifted, Mixed-Ability & Inclusive Education 資優、混合能力與融合教育

items.def: a student who needs more time to learn
items.s: My father says he was a ______ ______ at school, but he later became an excellent engineer.
items.zh: 我爸爸說他在學校時是個學得比較慢的學生，但後來成為了優秀的工程師。
items.sec: Gifted, Mixed-Ability & Inclusive Education 資優、混合能力與融合教育

items.def: having difficulty doing something
items.s: Volunteers tutor ________ readers after school, and many of the children now enjoy reading picture books.
items.zh: 志工在放學後輔導閱讀有困難的學生，許多孩子現在都喜歡讀繪本了。
items.sec: Gifted, Mixed-Ability & Inclusive Education 資優、混合能力與融合教育

items.def: having less money and fewer chances than most people
items.s: The charity gives free laptops to ________ students, so they can join online classes at home.
items.zh: 這個慈善團體免費提供筆電給弱勢學生，讓他們能在家參加線上課程。
items.sec: Gifted, Mixed-Ability & Inclusive Education 資優、混合能力與融合教育

items.def: facing problems such as poverty that make success harder
items.s: Students from ________ families often lack quiet places to study, so the school keeps its library open late.
items.zh: 來自弱勢家庭的學生常缺乏安靜的讀書空間，所以學校讓圖書館開到很晚。
items.sec: Gifted, Mixed-Ability & Inclusive Education 資優、混合能力與融合教育

items.def: to separate one group of people from others
items.s: In the past many countries would ________ disabled children in separate schools, but today most try to include them.
items.zh: 過去許多國家會把身心障礙兒童隔離在不同學校，但現在大多數國家努力讓他們融入。
items.sec: Gifted, Mixed-Ability & Inclusive Education 資優、混合能力與融合教育

items.def: ordinary and used by most people
items.s: Most students with mild disabilities now attend ________ schools, and they get extra support in certain classes.
items.zh: 大多數輕度障礙學生現在就讀一般學校，並在某些課程中獲得額外支援。
items.sec: Gifted, Mixed-Ability & Inclusive Education 資優、混合能力與融合教育

items.def: involving a lot of work in a short time
items.s: She took an ________ English course in the summer, and she studied six hours a day for four weeks.
items.zh: 她暑假上了密集英文課，連續四週每天學習六小時。
items.sec: Gifted, Mixed-Ability & Inclusive Education 資優、混合能力與融合教育

items.def: a belief about what someone should achieve
items.s: Her parents had high ________ for her, but they never stopped her from choosing art as her major.
items.zh: 她父母對她有很高的期望，但他們從未阻止她選擇藝術當主修。
items.sec: Gifted, Mixed-Ability & Inclusive Education 資優、混合能力與融合教育

items.def: a person of the same age or level as you
items.s: Teenagers often care more about the opinions of their ________ than about what adults think.
items.zh: 青少年往往更在意同儕的看法，而不是大人的想法。
items.sec: Gifted, Mixed-Ability & Inclusive Education 資優、混合能力與融合教育

items.def: extremely good
items.s: He gave an ________ performance in the speech contest, and the judges gave him first prize.
items.zh: 他在演講比賽中表現傑出，評審頒給他第一名。
items.sec: Gifted, Mixed-Ability & Inclusive Education 資優、混合能力與融合教育

items.def: belonging to the best or most powerful group
items.s: Only a few students get into the ________ science class, so competition for places is very strong.
items.zh: 只有少數學生能進入菁英科學班，所以名額競爭非常激烈。
items.sec: Gifted, Mixed-Ability & Inclusive Education 資優、混合能力與融合教育

items.def: a system where people succeed because of ability and hard work
items.s: Supporters say exams create a ________, but critics argue that rich families can still buy extra lessons.
items.zh: 支持者說考試創造了功績主義的社會，但批評者認為有錢人家仍然可以花錢多補習。
items.sec: Gifted, Mixed-Ability & Inclusive Education 資優、混合能力與融合教育

items.def: a special advantage that only some people have
items.s: Studying abroad is a ________ that many families cannot afford, so scholarships are very important.
items.zh: 出國念書是許多家庭負擔不起的特權，所以獎學金非常重要。
items.sec: Gifted, Mixed-Ability & Inclusive Education 資優、混合能力與融合教育

items.def: to teach your children at home instead of sending them to school
items.s: Some parents ________ their children because they want more freedom, but the children still need chances to make friends.
items.zh: 有些家長讓孩子在家自學，因為他們想要更多自由，但孩子仍需要交朋友的機會。
items.sec: Gifted, Mixed-Ability & Inclusive Education 資優、混合能力與融合教育

items.def: the ability to understand and work with numbers
items.s: Good ________ is needed in daily life, because we use numbers when we shop, cook and plan our time.
items.zh: 良好的數理能力在日常生活中是必要的，因為我們購物、煮飯和規劃時間時都會用到數字。
items.sec: Gifted, Mixed-Ability & Inclusive Education 資優、混合能力與融合教育

items.def: relating to social class and money
items.s: Researchers found that ________ background affects test scores, so the government gives extra money to poorer schools.
items.zh: 研究者發現社會經濟背景會影響考試成績，所以政府給較貧困的學校額外經費。
items.sec: Gifted, Mixed-Ability & Inclusive Education 資優、混合能力與融合教育

items.def: relating to the ability to think and understand ideas
items.s: Reading widely gives children ________ challenges, and it also helps them understand other people's feelings.
items.zh: 廣泛閱讀給孩子帶來智力上的挑戰，也幫助他們理解別人的感受。

items.def: having enough skill to do something well
items.s: After two years of practice she became a ________ writer, but she still asks her teacher to check her work.
items.zh: 經過兩年練習，她成為一位稱職的寫作者，但她仍會請老師檢查她的作品。

items.def: relating to a job that needs special training
items.s: Teachers attend ________ training every summer, so they can learn new ways to support their students.
items.zh: 老師們每年暑假參加專業培訓，以便學習支持學生的新方法。

items.def: to repeat the exact words that someone else said or wrote
items.s: In your report you may ________ a famous scientist, but you must put the words in quotation marks.
items.zh: 在報告中你可以引用一位知名科學家的話，但必須把那段文字加上引號。

items.def: using more words than are needed
items.s: His essay was too ________, so the teacher asked him to cut it from 800 words to 400.
items.zh: 他的文章太冗長了，所以老師要他從800字刪到400字。

items.def: a slightly different form of something
items.s: The teacher prepared an easier ________ of the article, so weaker readers could follow the class discussion.
items.zh: 老師準備了這篇文章較簡單的版本，讓閱讀較弱的學生也能跟上課堂討論。

items.def: help and advice about what to do
items.s: Students need ________ when they choose a university major, because the decision affects their future career.
items.zh: 學生選擇大學主修時需要指導，因為這個決定會影響未來的職涯。

items.def: to understand the value of something
items.s: I did not ________ my history teacher at first, but now I understand how much she taught me.
items.zh: 一開始我並不欣賞我的歷史老師，但現在我明白她教了我多少東西。

items.def: short, using few words or lasting a short time
items.s: Please give a ________ answer to each question, because you only have twenty minutes for the whole section.
items.zh: 請每題給出簡短的回答，因為整個部分你只有二十分鐘。

items.def: a set of comments explaining or judging something
items.s: The teacher wrote a short ________ on each poem, and it helped us understand the writer's hidden meaning.
items.zh: 老師為每首詩寫了一段簡短的評論，這幫助我們理解作者隱含的意思。

items.def: a large formal meeting where people discuss ideas
items.s: Our principal attended an education ________ in Singapore, and she came back with many new ideas for our school.
items.zh: 我們校長參加了在新加坡舉辦的教育研討會，帶回許多給學校的新點子。

items.def: a qualification that shows you are able to do a job
items.s: Online courses can give useful ________, but employers still want to see real skills in interviews.
items.zh: 線上課程能提供有用的資格證明，但雇主在面試時仍想看到真正的能力。

items.def: the ability to make good, quick judgements
items.s: She showed great business ________ when she ran the school café, so the club made a big profit.
items.zh: 她經營學校咖啡店時展現了極佳的商業敏銳度，所以社團賺了一大筆錢。

items.def: having a great deal of knowledge from reading
items.s: Our ________ professor can talk about almost any topic, yet he explains things in very simple language.
items.zh: 我們那位博學的教授幾乎能談論任何話題，但他用非常簡單的語言解釋事情。

items.def: caring too much about small details and rules
items.cn: 迂腐的；過分拘泥細節的
items.s: Some students think the teacher is ________ about commas, but good punctuation makes writing much clearer.
items.zh: 有些學生覺得老師對逗號過分講究，但良好的標點讓文章清楚得多。

items.def: intended to teach, often in a way that feels like a lecture
items.s: The film was too ________, so the audience felt they were being lectured instead of entertained.
items.zh: 這部電影太說教了，所以觀眾覺得自己在被訓話而不是在娛樂。

items.def: following a fixed pattern, with no originality
items.s: Many exam essays are ________, because students memorise the same opening sentences and use them every time.
items.zh: 許多考試作文都很公式化，因為學生背誦同樣的開頭句並每次都使用。

items.def: to accept and follow a rule or decision
items.s: All candidates must ________ by the exam rules, or their results may be cancelled without any warning.
items.zh: 所有考生都必須遵守考試規則，否則成績可能會在沒有任何警告的情況下被取消。

items.def: made shorter by removing some parts
items.s: We read an ________ version of the novel, because the original was too long for a one-month course.
items.zh: 我們讀的是這本小說的簡寫版，因為原著對一個月的課程來說太長了。

items.def: completely silly or unreasonable
items.s: It seems ________ to give young children three hours of homework a night, and many parents have complained.
items.zh: 讓幼童每晚寫三小時作業似乎很荒謬，許多家長已經提出抱怨。

items.def: praise or an award for an achievement
items.s: The teacher received the highest ________ in the city, but she said the real winners were her students.
items.zh: 這位老師獲得全市最高的榮譽，但她說真正的贏家是她的學生。

items.def: to provide what someone needs
items.s: The new library can ________ three hundred students, so it is never too crowded even during exams.
items.zh: 新圖書館能容納三百名學生，所以即使考試期間也不會太擁擠。

items.def: to make yourself or someone familiar with something
items.s: Before the trip, the teacher wanted to ________ us with local customs, so she showed a short video about Japan.
items.zh: 出發前老師想讓我們熟悉當地習俗，所以她播放了一段關於日本的短片。

items.def: able to change to suit new situations
items.s: Children are very ________, so most of them settle into a new school within a few weeks.
items.zh: 孩子的適應力很強，所以大多數在幾週內就能適應新學校。

items.def: to organise and give something such as a test
items.s: The teachers will ________ the reading test in the morning, and the results will be ready by Friday.
items.zh: 老師們將在早上實施閱讀測驗，結果會在星期五前出爐。

items.def: deserving respect and approval
items.s: Her effort to learn three languages is ________, especially because she also works part-time after school.
items.zh: 她努力學習三種語言的精神令人欽佩，尤其是她放學後還要打工。

items.def: able to move or think quickly and easily
items.s: Chess keeps the mind ________, and many retired people play it in the park every afternoon.
items.zh: 下西洋棋能讓頭腦保持靈活，許多退休人士每天下午都在公園下棋。

items.def: to give a share of time or money for a purpose
items.s: The teacher will ________ five minutes to each group, so please plan your presentation carefully.
items.zh: 老師會分配給每組五分鐘，所以請仔細規劃你們的報告。

items.def: to collect a large amount of something over time
items.s: Over four years she ________ a huge collection of English novels, and she now lends them to classmates.
items.zh: 四年來她累積了大量的英文小說，現在她把書借給同學。

items.def: doing something for enjoyment, not as a job
items.s: He is only an ________ photographer, but his pictures of the school festival were printed in the newspaper.
items.zh: 他只是個業餘攝影師，但他拍的校慶照片登上了報紙。

items.def: to make a bad situation better
items.s: The city built new libraries to ________ the lack of study space, and they are now full every weekend.
items.zh: 市政府蓋了新圖書館來改善讀書空間不足的問題，現在每個週末都座無虛席。

items.def: willing to accept or be influenced by ideas
items.s: The principal was ________ to the students' suggestion, so the school changed the lunch break to one hour.
items.zh: 校長願意接受學生的建議，所以學校把午休改成一小時。

items.def: old-fashioned and no longer suitable
items.s: The school's computers are ________, so students often bring their own laptops to finish projects.
items.zh: 學校的電腦老舊過時，所以學生常自己帶筆電來完成專題。

items.def: suitable or right for a situation
items.s: "Practice makes perfect" was an ________ title for her speech, because she talked about learning the violin.
items.zh: 「熟能生巧」是她演講恰當的標題，因為她談的是學小提琴。

items.def: very old and no longer used
items.s: Shakespeare uses many ________ words, so students often need notes to understand his famous plays today.
items.zh: 莎士比亞使用許多古老的字詞，所以現今學生常需要註解才能理解他的名劇。

items.def: very enthusiastic and passionate
items.s: My uncle is an ________ supporter of free education, and he volunteers at a reading centre every Sunday.
items.zh: 我叔叔是免費教育的熱烈支持者，他每個星期天都在閱讀中心當志工。

items.def: working very carefully and with great effort
items.s: She was an ________ student who checked every answer twice, so she rarely made careless mistakes.
items.zh: 她是個勤勉的學生，每個答案都檢查兩次，所以很少粗心犯錯。

items.def: very plain and simple, without comfort
items.s: The old boarding school had ________ rooms with only a bed and a desk, but the students did not complain.
items.zh: 那所舊寄宿學校的房間很簡樸，只有一張床和一張書桌，但學生們沒有抱怨。

items.def: very keen and enthusiastic about something
items.s: He is an ________ reader of science fiction, and he borrows at least three books from the library each week.
items.zh: 他是科幻小說的熱衷讀者，每週至少從圖書館借三本書。

items.def: a statement accepted as true without needing proof
items.s: It is an ________ in education that children learn best when they feel safe, so schools must stop bullying.
items.zh: 孩子在感到安全時學得最好，這是教育界的公理，所以學校必須杜絕霸凌。

items.def: to make someone or something seem unimportant
items.s: Good teachers never ________ students' questions, because even simple questions can lead to deep learning.
items.zh: 好老師從不輕視學生的問題，因為即使是簡單的問題也可能帶來深入的學習。

items.def: the quality of using few words
items.s: The judges praised the speech for its ________, because she made three strong points in only two minutes.
items.zh: 評審稱讚這篇演講簡潔，因為她只用兩分鐘就提出三個有力的論點。

items.def: a system with many complicated official rules
items.s: Teachers complain about too much ________, because they spend hours filling in forms instead of preparing lessons.
items.zh: 老師們抱怨太多繁文縟節，因為他們花好幾個小時填表格而不是備課。

items.def: the level of quality or ability
items.s: The school attracts teachers of high ________, so its students often win national science prizes.
items.zh: 這所學校吸引了高水準的教師，所以學生常贏得全國科學獎項。

items.def: very clear and certain, with no doubt
items.s: The principal gave a ________ answer that phones would not be allowed in class, so nobody argued.
items.zh: 校長明確表示上課時不准使用手機，所以沒有人爭論。

items.def: to criticise someone strongly and officially
items.s: The education board ________ the school for hiding its exam problems, and the principal later resigned.
items.zh: 教育局譴責這所學校隱瞞考試問題，校長後來辭職了。

items.def: needing careful thought rather than feelings
items.s: Chess is a very ________ game, but young children can still enjoy it with simple rules.
items.zh: 西洋棋是非常需要動腦的遊戲，但幼童仍能用簡單的規則樂在其中。

items.def: arranged in the order in which events happened
items.s: Put the events in ________ order, and then write a short paragraph about the most important one.
items.zh: 把事件按時間順序排列，然後針對最重要的事件寫一小段。

items.def: to force someone to do something they do not want to do
items.s: Parents should not ________ children into studying medicine, because forced choices often lead to unhappy careers.
items.zh: 父母不應強迫孩子讀醫科，因為被迫的選擇常導致不快樂的職涯。

items.def: clear, logical and able to persuade people
items.s: Her argument was ________ and well organised, so the debate judges gave her team the highest score.
items.zh: 她的論點有說服力且條理分明，所以辯論評審給她的隊伍最高分。

items.def: to collect and arrange information in order
items.s: The class leader will ________ everyone's answers to the survey, and then she will share the results on Monday.
items.zh: 班長會彙整大家的問卷答案，然後在星期一分享結果。

items.def: used in informal conversation, not formal writing
items.s: "Gonna" is a ________ word, so you should not use it in an academic essay or a formal email.
items.zh: gonna 是口語用字，所以不應用在學術文章或正式電子郵件中。

items.def: matching in size, amount or level
items.s: Teachers want salaries ________ with their long working hours, but the budget has not increased for years.
items.zh: 老師們希望薪水與長工時相稱，但預算已經好幾年沒有增加。

items.def: to divide things into separate parts
items.s: Schools often ________ knowledge into separate subjects, but real problems need science, maths and language together.
items.zh: 學校常把知識分隔成各別科目，但真實的問題需要同時運用科學、數學和語言。

items.def: done by people working together with determination
items.s: Parents and teachers made a ________ effort to reduce phone use, and students now talk more during breaks.
items.zh: 家長和老師齊心協力減少手機使用，現在學生下課時聊天變多了。

items.def: to make a text shorter but keep the main ideas
items.s: Try to ________ your notes onto one page, because it is easier to review a short summary before the test.
items.zh: 試著把筆記濃縮成一頁，因為考前複習簡短的摘要比較容易。

items.def: having knowledge of something
items.s: Most students are ________ with social media, but many still do not know how to check facts online.
items.zh: 大多數學生熟悉社群媒體，但許多人仍不知道如何在網路上查證事實。

items.def: in large amounts
items.s: She took ________ notes during the lecture, so she could explain every detail to her sick friend later.
items.zh: 她上課時做了大量筆記，所以之後能向生病的朋友解釋每個細節。

items.def: belief that something is true
items.s: The new study gives ________ to the idea that sleep helps memory, so schools may start classes later.
items.zh: 這項新研究為「睡眠有助記憶」的說法增添了可信度，所以學校可能會延後上課時間。

items.def: to judge something carefully, showing good and bad points
items.s: In art class we ________ each other's paintings, but we must always begin with something positive.
items.zh: 美術課上我們互相評析彼此的畫作，但一定要先從優點說起。

items.def: done quickly without paying attention to details
items.s: He gave the article only a ________ glance, so he missed the most important point in the last paragraph.
items.zh: 他只是粗略看了一眼那篇文章，所以錯過了最後一段最重要的重點。

items.def: to make someone or something very weak
items.s: Lack of sleep can ________ students during exam season, so doctors advise at least seven hours a night.
items.zh: 睡眠不足會在考試期間使學生虛弱，所以醫生建議每晚至少睡七小時。

items.def: to work out the meaning of something difficult to read
items.s: The teacher could not ________ his messy handwriting, so she asked him to type his essay next time.
items.zh: 老師無法辨認他潦草的字跡，所以要他下次把作文打字。

items.def: polite respect for someone's opinion or position
items.s: In many Asian classrooms students show ________ to teachers, but this can make them afraid to ask questions.
items.zh: 在許多亞洲教室裡學生對老師表現敬意，但這可能使他們不敢發問。

items.def: to search deeply for information
items.s: For her project she ________ into old newspapers, and she discovered how her school was founded in 1920.
items.zh: 為了專題她深入研究舊報紙，發現了她的學校在1920年是如何創立的。

items.def: the way a person behaves or looks
items.s: The examiner had a calm ________, so the nervous students relaxed as soon as the interview started.
items.zh: 主考官舉止沉穩，所以緊張的學生在面試一開始就放鬆了。

items.def: to make something easier to understand
items.s: The workshop aims to ________ university applications, so parents can help their children without paying agents.
items.zh: 這個工作坊旨在讓大學申請流程變得易懂，讓家長不用花錢請代辦也能協助孩子。

items.def: to criticise something strongly in public
items.s: Many teachers ________ the plan to cut art classes, and they started a campaign to protect them.
items.zh: 許多老師公開譴責刪減美術課的計畫，並發起運動來保護這些課程。

items.def: to laugh at someone in an unkind way
items.s: Other students used to ________ his accent, but now he speaks three languages and works as an interpreter.
items.zh: 以前其他學生常嘲笑他的口音，但現在他會說三種語言並擔任口譯員。

items.def: worth having or wanting
items.s: Good communication skills are highly ________ in any job, so schools should give students chances to speak.
items.zh: 良好的溝通能力在任何工作中都非常理想，所以學校應該給學生說話的機會。

items.def: skill in using your hands or mind
items.s: Playing the piano improves finger ________, and it also trains children to read music quickly.
items.zh: 彈鋼琴能提升手指的靈巧度，也訓練孩子快速讀譜。

items.def: to talk about something not connected to the main topic
items.s: Our history teacher often ________ to tell funny stories, but we always learn something from them.
items.zh: 我們的歷史老師常常離題講有趣的故事，但我們總能從中學到東西。

items.def: to spread information widely
items.s: The school uses an app to ________ news to parents, so nobody misses important dates any more.
items.zh: 學校用一款應用程式向家長傳播消息，所以再也沒有人錯過重要日期。

items.def: to take the most important ideas from something
items.s: The teacher helped us ________ the long article into five key points, and we wrote them on a poster.
items.zh: 老師幫我們把那篇長文章提煉成五個重點，並寫在海報上。

items.def: a set of beliefs taught by a group
items.s: The old ________ that children should be seen and not heard is disappearing, and students now share opinions freely.
items.zh: 「小孩有耳無嘴」的舊觀念正在消失，現在學生可以自由分享意見。

items.def: sure that your beliefs are right and refusing other ideas
items.s: A ________ teacher may stop students from thinking critically, because they learn that only one answer is accepted.
items.zh: 教條式的老師可能會阻礙學生批判思考，因為他們學到只有一個答案被接受。

items.def: including ideas or styles from many different sources
items.s: She has an ________ taste in books, so her shelves hold poetry, comics, history and science fiction.
items.zh: 她閱讀品味多元，所以書架上有詩集、漫畫、歷史和科幻小說。

items.def: believing everyone should have equal rights and chances
items.s: Finland has a very ________ school system, and almost every child attends a free local school.
items.zh: 芬蘭的學校制度非常平等，幾乎每個孩子都就讀免費的社區學校。

items.def: to explain something clearly
items.s: The professor used a simple diagram to ________ the theory, and suddenly the whole class understood it.
items.zh: 教授用一張簡單的圖表來闡明這個理論，全班突然都懂了。

items.def: famous and respected in a particular field
items.s: An ________ scientist visited our school, and she encouraged girls to study physics and engineering.
items.zh: 一位著名的科學家來訪我們學校，並鼓勵女生攻讀物理和工程。

items.def: said with force to show something is important
items.s: Her answer was ________: she would not let her son quit school, even though he wanted to become a gamer.
items.zh: 她的回答很斷然：即使兒子想當電玩選手，她也不會讓他休學。

items.def: to express the main idea in a short way
items.s: Your title should ________ the main idea of your essay, so the reader knows what to expect.
items.zh: 你的標題應該概括文章的主旨，讓讀者知道會讀到什麼。

items.def: to give a large amount of money to a school or other organisation
items.s: A former student ________ the library with a million dollars, and it now has a new reading room.
items.zh: 一位校友捐贈了一百萬元給圖書館，現在圖書館有了一間新的閱覽室。

items.def: to cause a feeling or situation to exist
items.s: Constant comparison with classmates can ________ jealousy, so parents should focus on their child's own progress.
items.zh: 不斷和同學比較可能會引起嫉妒，所以家長應關注孩子自身的進步。

items.def: to name things one by one in a list
items.s: The teacher asked us to ________ the causes of the war, and then we discussed which one was most important.
items.zh: 老師要我們列舉戰爭的起因，然後我們討論哪一個最重要。

items.def: understood only by a small group of experts
items.s: The lecture was too ________ for first-year students, so many of them stopped taking notes after ten minutes.
items.zh: 這堂課對大一學生來說太深奧了，所以很多人十分鐘後就不再做筆記。

items.def: to support an idea or belief
items.s: Many modern teachers ________ learning through play, and they believe children remember more when they have fun.
items.zh: 許多現代老師擁護從遊戲中學習，他們相信孩子在快樂時記得更多。

items.def: needing a lot of care, effort and skill
items.s: The music academy has ________ standards, so students practise for many hours before each audition.
items.zh: 這所音樂學院標準嚴格，所以學生在每次試鏡前都要練習好幾個小時。

items.def: to make someone very annoyed
items.s: Students who chat during tests ________ the teacher, so she now moves them to the front row.
items.zh: 考試時聊天的學生惹惱了老師，所以她現在把他們移到第一排。

items.def: not required to do something that others must do
items.s: Students with a high listening score are ________ from the extra class, so they can use the time for self-study.
items.zh: 聽力分數高的學生免上加強課，所以他們能用這段時間自修。

items.def: to explain an idea in detail
items.s: The guest speaker ________ on the history of Taiwanese education, and he answered questions for an hour afterwards.
items.zh: 客座講者詳細闡述台灣教育的歷史，之後還回答了一個小時的問題。

items.def: too simple and not showing careful thought
items.s: Saying that students are lazy is a ________ explanation, because many of them are simply tired from long school days.
items.zh: 說學生懶惰是膚淺的解釋，因為他們很多人只是被漫長的上學日累壞了。

items.def: able to make mistakes
items.s: Teachers are ________ like everyone else, so they should admit their mistakes in front of students.
items.zh: 老師和其他人一樣會犯錯，所以應該在學生面前承認錯誤。

items.def: not serious or important
items.s: Some parents see drama club as ________, but it builds confidence and teamwork that are useful in any job.
items.zh: 有些家長認為戲劇社無關緊要，但它培養的自信和團隊合作在任何工作中都很有用。

items.def: to shock or excite someone into taking action
items.s: The flood in the village ________ students to raise money, and they collected enough to rebuild the school library.
items.zh: 村莊的水災激勵學生募款，他們募到足夠的錢重建學校圖書館。

items.def: to collect or gain something such as support
items.s: Her speech about mental health ________ a lot of support, and the school agreed to hire another counsellor.
items.zh: 她關於心理健康的演講贏得大量支持，學校同意再聘一位輔導老師。

items.def: to collect information slowly, in small amounts
items.s: I ________ useful tips from older students, and they helped me prepare for my university interview.
items.zh: 我從學長姊那裡蒐集到許多有用的建議，它們幫助我準備大學面試。

items.def: to try hard to deal with a difficult problem
items.s: Many schools ________ with how to use AI tools fairly, but there are still no clear national rules.
items.zh: 許多學校正努力解決如何公平使用人工智慧工具的問題，但至今仍沒有明確的全國規範。

items.def: not planned or organised
items.s: His ________ way of studying wasted a lot of time, so his tutor helped him make a weekly plan.
items.zh: 他雜亂無章的讀書方式浪費了很多時間，所以家教幫他制定了每週計畫。

items.def: to improve a skill through practice
items.s: She joined the debate club to ________ her speaking skills, and now she is confident in every presentation.
items.zh: 她加入辯論社來磨練口語能力，現在她在每次報告中都充滿自信。

items.def: unusual and typical of one particular person
items.s: The professor has an ________ teaching style, but students love his classes because they are never boring.
items.zh: 這位教授的教學風格很獨特，但學生喜歡他的課，因為從不無聊。

items.def: famous and admired because of great achievements
items.s: The university has an ________ history, and several of its former students have won Nobel Prizes.
items.zh: 這所大學有輝煌的歷史，好幾位校友都得過諾貝爾獎。

items.def: to pass knowledge or skills to someone
items.s: Good teachers do more than ________ facts, because they also show students how to think for themselves.
items.zh: 好老師不只是傳授事實，他們也教學生如何獨立思考。

items.def: very poor
items.s: Children in ________ villages often walk for hours to school, but many of them still dream of going to university.
items.zh: 貧困村莊的孩子常要走好幾個小時去上學，但他們許多人仍夢想上大學。

items.def: strange because it does not fit the situation
items.s: His bright red suit looked ________ at the serious graduation ceremony, and many people turned to stare at him.
items.zh: 他那套鮮紅色西裝在莊重的畢業典禮上顯得格格不入，許多人轉頭盯著他看。

items.def: not important
items.s: Don't waste time on ________ details in the exam, because the main argument is worth most of the marks.
items.zh: 考試時別把時間浪費在無關緊要的細節上，因為主要論點佔了大部分的分數。

items.def: to teach people to accept beliefs without questioning them
items.s: Schools should not ________ students with one political view, but should help them compare different opinions.
items.zh: 學校不應向學生灌輸單一政治觀點，而應幫助他們比較不同意見。

items.def: impossible to stop
items.s: The ________ rise of online learning has changed schools, and even grandparents now take courses on their phones.
items.zh: 線上學習勢不可擋的興起改變了學校，連祖父母現在都用手機上課。

items.def: to start an action or event
items.s: The students ________ a campaign to save the old school tree, and the city finally agreed to protect it.
items.zh: 學生們發起了一場拯救校園老樹的運動，市政府最後同意保護它。

items.def: skill in thinking of clever new ideas
items.s: The robot team showed great ________, because they built their machine from old bicycles and plastic bottles.
items.zh: 機器人隊展現了極大的巧思，因為他們用舊腳踏車和塑膠瓶打造機器。

items.def: very important in making something happen
items.s: My English teacher was ________ in helping me win the scholarship, so I sent her a thank-you card.
items.zh: 我的英文老師在幫助我贏得獎學金這件事上功不可沒，所以我寄了一張感謝卡給她。

items.def: clear enough to be understood
items.s: Your accent does not matter much, as long as your speech is ________ and your ideas are clear.
items.zh: 你的口音不太重要，只要你的話語清楚易懂、想法清晰就好。

items.def: involving two or more subjects
items.s: Our ________ project combined history and art, so we painted a mural about our town's past.
items.zh: 我們的跨學科專題結合了歷史與藝術，所以我們畫了一幅關於小鎮過去的壁畫。

items.def: special words used by a group that others find hard to understand
items.s: The report was full of education ________, so many parents could not understand the new policy.
items.zh: 這份報告充滿教育術語，所以許多家長看不懂新政策。

items.def: to put two things side by side to compare them
items.s: The writer ________ a rich school and a poor school, and the contrast made readers think about fairness.
items.zh: 作者把一所富裕學校和一所貧窮學校並列比較，這種對比讓讀者思考公平問題。

items.def: needing a lot of time and effort
items.s: Copying notes by hand is ________, but some studies show it helps students remember more.
items.zh: 用手抄筆記很費力，但有些研究顯示它能幫助學生記住更多。

items.def: deserving praise
items.s: The plan to give every child a free breakfast is ________, but the city still needs to find the money.
items.zh: 讓每個孩子都有免費早餐的計畫值得稱讚，但市政府仍需籌措經費。

items.def: not strict enough
items.s: Security at the exam centre was ________, so some students brought their phones into the room.
items.zh: 考場的安全管理很鬆散，所以有些學生把手機帶進了考場。

items.def: clear enough to read
items.s: Please make your handwriting ________, because the examiners cannot give marks for words they cannot read.
items.zh: 請把字寫得清楚易讀，因為閱卷人無法為看不懂的字給分。

items.def: using the basic meaning of a word
items.s: A ________ translation of an idiom often sounds strange, so translators look for a phrase with the same feeling.
items.zh: 成語的字面翻譯常常聽起來很奇怪，所以譯者會找有相同感覺的說法。

items.def: very high, noble or ambitious
items.s: The school has ________ goals for every student, but some teachers worry that the targets are unrealistic.
items.zh: 學校為每位學生設定了遠大的目標，但有些老師擔心這些目標不切實際。

items.def: studying the same people over a long time
items.s: A ________ study followed 1,000 children for twenty years, and it found that reading at home predicted later success.
items.zh: 一項長期追蹤研究追蹤了一千名兒童二十年，發現在家閱讀能預測日後的成功。

items.def: easily changed or influenced
items.s: Young minds are ________, so the habits children form at school can last for their whole lives.
items.zh: 年輕的心智是可塑的，所以孩子在學校養成的習慣可能維持一輩子。

items.def: required by law or rules
items.s: Swimming lessons are ________ in many schools in Taiwan, because the island is surrounded by sea.
items.zh: 游泳課在台灣許多學校是必修的，因為這座島四面環海。

items.def: a short saying that gives a rule for behaviour
items.s: My grandfather's favourite ________ was "Never stop learning", and he took a computer class at eighty.
items.zh: 我祖父最喜歡的格言是「學無止境」，他八十歲時還去上電腦課。

items.def: doing things carefully in a planned order
items.s: Lisa is very ________ when she studies, so she always finishes her review a week before the test.
items.zh: 麗莎讀書時非常有條不紊，所以她總在考試前一週就完成複習。

items.def: not very large; or not talking much about your success
items.s: The new rule brought only a ________ improvement in reading scores, but teachers hope it will grow over time.
items.zh: 新規定只帶來些微的閱讀成績進步，但老師們希望它會隨時間擴大。

items.def: not thinking about the future
items.s: Cutting the library budget is a ________ decision, because reading skills affect every other subject.
items.zh: 刪減圖書館預算是短視的決定，因為閱讀能力會影響其他每一科。

items.def: lacking experience and too ready to believe things
items.s: It is ________ to believe everything you read online, so students must learn to check sources.
items.zh: 相信網路上讀到的每件事是很天真的，所以學生必須學會查證來源。

items.def: not taking enough care
items.s: The school was found ________ after a student was hurt in the lab, because no teacher was watching.
items.zh: 一名學生在實驗室受傷後，學校被認定疏失，因為當時沒有老師在場看管。

items.def: very small, much less than the real value
items.s: The museum charges students only a ________ fee, so whole classes can visit on school trips.
items.zh: 博物館只向學生收取象徵性的費用，所以整班都能在校外教學時參觀。

items.def: difficult and heavy to deal with
items.s: The ________ paperwork for studying abroad took her weeks, but her visa finally arrived in July.
items.zh: 出國留學的繁重文件花了她好幾週，但她的簽證終於在七月寄到了。

items.def: difficult to understand; not clear
items.s: The scoring system was ________, so parents asked the school to explain how the results were calculated.
items.zh: 評分制度不透明，所以家長要求學校說明成績是如何計算的。

items.def: seeming to be true, but perhaps not really
items.s: The new test is ________ about creativity, but many students say it still rewards memorising answers.
items.zh: 新測驗表面上是考創造力，但許多學生說它仍然獎勵背答案。

items.def: no longer fashionable or useful
items.s: Some teaching methods are ________, so the government is training teachers to use more discussion in class.
items.zh: 有些教學方法已經過時，所以政府正在訓練老師在課堂上多採用討論。

items.def: to change a system completely to improve it
items.s: The ministry plans to ________ the exam system, but teachers want more time to prepare for the changes.
items.zh: 教育部計畫全面改革考試制度，但老師們希望有更多時間準備這些改變。

items.def: to watch and organise work to check it is done well
items.s: A senior teacher will ________ the science fair, so every project is checked for safety first.
items.zh: 一位資深老師將督導科展，所以每件作品都會先接受安全檢查。

items.def: strange or unusual
items.s: The new student had a ________ habit of reading while walking, and he once walked into a door.
items.zh: 那位新同學有邊走路邊看書的奇怪習慣，有一次還撞上了門。

items.def: to make someone confused
items.s: The last question ________ most students, because it used a word that nobody had seen before.
items.zh: 最後一題讓大部分學生很困惑，因為它用了一個沒人見過的字。

items.def: a very large amount, often too much
items.s: There is a ________ of learning apps online, so it is hard for parents to choose the best one.
items.zh: 網路上有大量學習應用程式，所以家長很難選出最好的一個。

items.def: to divide people into two opposing groups
items.s: The debate about school uniforms tends to ________ parents, because some see them as fair and others as old-fashioned.
items.zh: 關於校服的爭論往往使家長意見兩極化，因為有些人認為它公平，有些人認為它過時。

items.def: to suggest an idea as a basis for a theory
items.s: Some researchers ________ that bilingual children solve problems faster, but more evidence is needed before schools change.
items.zh: 有些研究者假定雙語兒童解決問題更快，但在學校做出改變之前，仍需要更多證據。

items.def: an earlier event used as an example for later decisions
items.s: Letting one student retake the test would set a ________, so the teacher refused all similar requests.
items.zh: 讓一位學生重考會開先例，所以老師拒絕了所有類似的要求。

items.def: an idea formed before you have enough information
items.s: Many people have a ________ that vocational schools are for weak students, but this is often untrue.
items.zh: 許多人有個成見，認為技職學校是給程度差的學生念的，但這常常不是事實。

items.def: the person who had a job before someone else
items.s: The new principal kept many of her ________ ideas, but she also added a reading hour every morning.
items.zh: 新校長保留了許多前任校長的想法，但她也增加了每天早上的閱讀時間。

items.def: happening too early
items.s: It is ________ to judge the new curriculum after one year, so researchers want to wait for more data.
items.zh: 一年後就評斷新課綱還太早，所以研究者想等更多資料。

items.def: to assume something is true before you begin
items.s: The question ________ that all students have a computer at home, but many families do not own one.
items.zh: 這個題目預設所有學生家裡都有電腦，但許多家庭並沒有。

items.def: respected and admired as very good
items.s: She was accepted by a ________ university in London, and her whole family celebrated at a restaurant.
items.zh: 她被倫敦一所名校錄取，全家人在餐廳慶祝。

items.def: to spread ideas or beliefs to many people
items.s: Social media can ________ false ideas about learning, so teachers explain what the research really says.
items.zh: 社群媒體可能散播關於學習的錯誤觀念，所以老師會解釋研究真正的結論。

items.def: to push or drive someone forward
items.s: Winning the science contest ________ her into the national team, and she later studied physics abroad.
items.zh: 贏得科學競賽推動她進入國家隊，她後來出國攻讀物理。

items.def: expected to become something in the future
items.s: The university held an open day for ________ students, and they toured the labs and dormitories.
items.zh: 大學為未來的學生舉辦了開放日，他們參觀了實驗室和宿舍。

items.def: intended as punishment
items.s: Many experts say ________ rules do not stop bullying, so schools should also teach empathy and kindness.
items.zh: 許多專家說懲罰性的規定無法阻止霸凌，所以學校也應該教導同理心和善良。

items.def: being the most typical example of something
items.s: Night markets are a ________ part of Taiwanese life, so exchange students always ask to visit one.
items.zh: 夜市是台灣生活最典型的一部分，所以交換學生總是要求去逛。

items.def: a change made to improve a system
items.s: The education ________ gave students more elective courses, but some parents worry about university entrance.
items.zh: 這次教育改革給了學生更多選修課，但有些家長擔心升大學的問題。

items.def: to move someone or something to a less important position
items.s: Many schools ________ art and music to one hour a week, because they focus on exam subjects.
items.zh: 許多學校把美術和音樂降為每週一小時，因為他們專注在考試科目上。

items.def: official permission or approval
items.s: The club cannot hold the overnight event without the school's ________, so the leaders wrote a formal request.
items.zh: 沒有學校的批准，社團不能舉辦過夜活動，所以幹部寫了正式申請。
