items.def: very important and influencing later work
items.s: Her ________ research on how children learn to read changed teaching methods around the world.
items.zh: 她關於兒童如何學習閱讀的開創性研究改變了全世界的教學方法。

items.def: to ask for something such as money or opinions
items.s: The principal ________ ideas from students about the new canteen menu, and she received over five hundred replies.
items.zh: 校長向學生徵求新餐廳菜單的點子，並收到超過五百份回覆。

items.def: to make a system simpler and more efficient
items.s: The university wants to ________ its application process, so students will fill in one online form instead of five.
items.zh: 大學想簡化申請流程，所以學生只需填寫一份線上表格而不是五份。

items.def: to replace something older or less useful
items.s: Tablets have not completely ________ paper books, and many students still prefer printed pages for long reading.
items.zh: 平板電腦並沒有完全取代紙本書，許多學生長篇閱讀時仍偏好印刷書頁。

items.def: understood without being said
items.s: There was a ________ agreement that nobody would talk during the reading hour, so the room was completely silent.
items.zh: 大家有個心照不宣的共識，閱讀時間沒有人說話，所以教室裡一片寂靜。

items.def: a main principle or belief
items.s: A key ________ of the school is respect for others, and teachers remind students of it every day.
items.zh: 這所學校的一項重要信條是尊重他人，老師每天都提醒學生。

items.def: to go beyond the usual limits of something
items.s: Music can ________ language barriers, so the international students soon sang together in the school choir.
items.zh: 音樂能超越語言障礙，所以國際學生很快就在學校合唱團裡一起唱歌。

items.def: to give strong support to an idea or system
items.s: Strong reading skills ________ success in every subject, so the school gives extra help to weak readers.
items.zh: 紮實的閱讀能力是各科成功的基礎，所以學校給閱讀較弱的學生額外協助。

items.def: designed to be useful rather than beautiful
items.s: The old classroom was ________ and grey, but the students decorated it with posters and plants.
items.zh: 那間舊教室只講實用又灰暗，但學生們用海報和植物把它佈置起來。

items.def: respected because of age or experience
items.cn: 德高望重的；歷史悠久的
items.s: The ________ school celebrated its hundredth birthday, and former students came back from all over the world.
items.zh: 這所歷史悠久的學校慶祝百年校慶，校友們從世界各地回來。

items.def: to prove that someone was right
items.s: The excellent results ________ the teacher's new method, so other schools now want to try it too.
items.zh: 優異的成績證明這位老師的新方法是對的，所以其他學校現在也想嘗試。

items.def: good for your health or your moral character
items.s: The school serves ________ lunches with rice, vegetables and fish, and fried food is only offered once a week.
items.zh: 學校供應米飯、蔬菜和魚等有益健康的午餐，而油炸食物一週只提供一次。

items.def: very enthusiastic and eager
items.s: The ________ volunteers arrived early to set up the book fair, and they stayed until every box was packed.
items.zh: 熱心的志工們提早到場佈置書展，一直留到每個箱子都打包好。

items.def: to encourage someone to do something
items.s: Her teacher's kind words ________ her to enter the writing contest, and she won second place.
items.zh: 老師親切的話語激勵她參加寫作比賽，結果她得了第二名。

items.def: to give an honour or gift to someone
items.s: The university ________ an honorary degree on the famous writer, and she gave a moving speech to graduates.
items.zh: 大學授予這位知名作家榮譽學位，她向畢業生發表了動人的演講。

items.def: kind and wanting to help others
items.s: A ________ businessman paid for the new school bus, so children in the mountains no longer walk for hours.
items.zh: 一位慈善的商人出資購買新校車，所以山區的孩子不必再走好幾個小時。

items.def: careful not to take risks
items.s: Be ________ about what you post online, because some universities sometimes check applicants' social media accounts.
items.zh: 在網路上發文要謹慎，因為有些大學有時會查看申請者的社群媒體帳號。

items.def: large, heavy or complicated and difficult to use
items.s: The old registration system was ________, so students waited in long lines for hours every semester.
items.zh: 舊的選課系統很繁瑣，所以學生每學期都要排好幾個小時的長隊。

items.def: to persuade someone not to do something
items.s: Her parents tried to ________ her from studying drama, but she followed her dream and became an actor.
items.zh: 她父母試圖勸阻她念戲劇，但她追隨夢想成為了演員。

items.def: a person or thing that is mysterious and hard to understand
items.s: The quiet new student was an ________ to his classmates, but they discovered he was a brilliant guitarist.
items.zh: 那位安靜的新同學對同學們來說是個謎，但他們發現他是個出色的吉他手。

items.def: to be a perfect example of something
items.s: Our coach ________ hard work, because she trains every morning and never misses a practice.
items.zh: 我們的教練是努力的典範，因為她每天早上訓練，從不缺席任何一次練習。

items.def: to strongly encourage someone to do something
items.s: The principal ________ the graduates to keep learning, and she reminded them that education never ends.
items.zh: 校長勉勵畢業生持續學習，並提醒他們教育永無止境。

items.def: to praise something very highly
items.s: Many parents ________ the benefits of reading aloud, because their children learned new words quickly this way.
items.zh: 許多家長讚揚朗讀的好處，因為他們的孩子用這種方式很快學會新單字。

items.def: very careful about details and wanting things perfect
items.s: Our ________ chemistry teacher checks every measurement, so our lab reports must be very accurate.
items.zh: 我們那位一絲不苟的化學老師會檢查每一個測量值，所以我們的實驗報告必須非常精確。

items.def: made up of many different kinds
items.s: The class is very ________, and it includes students from five countries with very different levels of English.
items.zh: 這個班級非常多元混雜，包括來自五個國家、英文程度差異很大的學生。

items.def: perfect, with no mistakes
items.s: Her English pronunciation is ________, so many people think she grew up in an English-speaking country.
items.zh: 她的英文發音無可挑剔，所以很多人以為她在英語系國家長大。

items.def: done without planning or preparation
items.s: The teacher asked me to give an ________ speech, but I felt ready because we practise speaking every week.
items.zh: 老師要我做即興演講，但我覺得已經準備好了，因為我們每週都練習口說。

items.def: clear, sharp and showing deep understanding
items.s: His ________ questions impressed the professor, and she invited him to join her research team.
items.zh: 他一針見血的提問讓教授印象深刻，她邀請他加入研究團隊。

items.def: not harmful or offensive
items.s: The joke seemed ________ to him, but it hurt his classmate's feelings, so he apologised the next day.
items.zh: 這個玩笑對他來說似乎無傷大雅，但它傷了同學的心，所以他隔天道了歉。

items.def: interested only in your own small group or country
items.s: Students from ________ communities may struggle abroad at first, but travel soon widens their view of the world.
items.zh: 來自封閉社群的學生一開始在國外可能適應困難，但旅行很快就會拓展他們的世界觀。

items.def: brave and not afraid of danger
items.s: The ________ students hiked to a remote village to teach English, and they stayed there for the whole summer.
items.zh: 這群勇敢的學生徒步到偏遠村莊教英文，並在那裡待了一整個暑假。

items.def: just starting to develop
items.s: AI tutoring is still a ________ industry, so nobody knows how much it will change schools.
items.zh: 人工智慧家教仍是新興的產業，所以沒有人知道它會改變學校多少。

items.def: refusing to change your opinion
items.s: He was too ________ to accept help with maths, so his grades did not improve until he finally asked.
items.zh: 他太固執了，不肯接受數學方面的幫助，所以直到他終於開口求助，成績才進步。

items.def: to refuse to include someone in a group
items.s: Some children ________ classmates who look different, so teachers must teach respect from an early age.
items.zh: 有些孩子會排擠外表不同的同學，所以老師必須從小教導尊重。

items.def: a lack of something
items.s: There is a ________ of English teachers in rural areas, so many students there learn through online classes.
items.zh: 偏鄉地區英文老師不足，所以那裡許多學生透過線上課程學習。

items.def: a strong liking for something
items.s: She has a ________ for long words in her essays, but her teacher wants her to write more simply.
items.zh: 她寫作文時偏好用長字，但老師希望她寫得簡單一點。

items.def: done quickly with little care or interest
items.s: He gave a ________ apology to the teacher, so she asked him to think again about what he had done.
items.zh: 他向老師做了敷衍的道歉，所以她要他再想想自己做了什麼。

items.def: great skill at doing something
items.s: Her ________ in mathematics was clear from an early age, and she won her first contest at nine.
items.zh: 她在數學上的過人本領從小就很明顯，九歲就贏得了第一場比賽。

items.def: to tell someone officially that they did wrong
items.s: The teacher ________ the boys for running in the hallway, but she did it quietly and kindly.
items.zh: 老師訓誡那些在走廊奔跑的男孩，但她說得很小聲也很和善。

items.def: not willing to say what you think or feel
items.cn: 沉默寡言的；不願多說的
items.s: Many students are ________ in large classes, but they speak much more in small group discussions.
items.zh: 許多學生在大班級裡不太願意發言，但在小組討論時說得多很多。

items.def: speech or writing meant to persuade, sometimes without real meaning
items.s: Politicians use a lot of ________ about better schools, but teachers want to see real money and action.
items.zh: 政客們發表許多關於改善學校的漂亮話，但老師想看到真正的經費和行動。

items.def: to waste money, time or chances
items.s: Don't ________ your free periods on games, because those hours can make a big difference before exams.
items.zh: 別把空堂時間浪費在玩遊戲上，因為那些時間在考前可能帶來很大的差別。

items.def: careful because you think there may be danger or problems
items.s: Parents are ________ of new learning apps, because some of them collect children's personal data.
items.zh: 家長對新的學習應用程式很提防，因為其中有些會蒐集兒童的個人資料。

items.def: to correct something unfair
items.s: The government built new schools in rural areas to ________ the gap, but good teachers are still hard to find.
items.zh: 政府在鄉村地區興建新學校以弭平差距，但優秀的老師仍然難找。

items.def: to start studying hard
items.s: The final exams start next week, so I need to ______ ______ ______ instead of going to the cinema tonight.
items.zh: 期末考下週開始，所以我今晚得開始用功讀書，而不是去看電影。

items.def: to memorise something so you can say it perfectly
items.s: We had to ______ ______ ______ a short poem, and each student recited it in front of the class.
items.zh: 我們必須背熟一首短詩，而且每位學生都要在全班面前背誦。

items.def: to pass a test very successfully
items.s: She was nervous about the speaking test, but she ______ ______ ______ ______ and got the highest score in her class.
items.zh: 她對口說測驗很緊張，但她以優異成績通過，拿到班上最高分。

items.def: a student whom the teacher seems to like best
items.s: Some classmates call him the ______ ______, but he simply works hard and asks good questions.
items.zh: 有些同學叫他老師的寵兒，但他只是很努力又會問好問題。

items.def: to practise and improve a skill you used to have
items.s: I need to ______ ______ ______ my Japanese before the trip, because I have forgotten many useful phrases.
items.zh: 出發前我需要複習一下日文，因為我忘了很多實用的句子。

items.def: a vote where people raise their hands
items.s: The teacher asked for a ______ ______ ______, and most students chose to go to the science museum.
items.zh: 老師請大家舉手表決，大部分學生選擇去科學博物館。

items.def: trying different ways until you find one that works
items.s: We built the bridge model by ______ ______ ______, and it finally held two kilograms after five attempts.
items.zh: 我們用反覆試驗的方式做橋梁模型，試了五次後它終於撐住了兩公斤。

items.def: to write something quickly
items.s: Please ______ ______ any new words during the video, and we will check their meanings together afterwards.
items.zh: 請在看影片時記下任何生字，之後我們會一起查它們的意思。

items.def: to search for information in a book or online
items.s: When I find a new word, I ______ ______ its meaning, and then I write an example sentence in my notebook.
items.zh: 我遇到生字時會查它的意思，然後在筆記本上寫一個例句。

items.def: to understand a hidden meaning
items.s: The question asks you to ______ ______ ______ ______, because the writer never says directly how she feels.
items.zh: 這題要你讀出言外之意，因為作者從未直接說出她的感受。

items.def: the belief that ability can grow with effort
items.s: Teachers try to build a ______ ______ in students, so they see mistakes as chances to learn rather than signs of failure.
items.zh: 老師們試著培養學生的成長型思維，讓他們把錯誤視為學習的機會，而不是失敗的象徵。

items.def: doing something often is the way to become good at it
items.s: My piano teacher always says "______ ______ ______", so I play for thirty minutes every day.
items.zh: 我的鋼琴老師總是說「熟能生巧」，所以我每天彈三十分鐘。

items.def: to give your work to a teacher
items.s: Please ______ ______ your reports by Friday, or the teacher will take ten points off your score.
items.zh: 請在星期五前繳交報告，否則老師會扣十分。

items.def: to move or learn at the same speed as others
items.s: He missed two weeks of school, so it was hard to ______ ______ ______ the rest of the class.
items.zh: 他缺課兩週，所以很難跟上班上其他同學。

items.def: to learn how to do something
items.s: Coding seemed impossible at first, but I ______ ______ ______ ______ it after a few weeks of practice.
items.zh: 一開始寫程式似乎不可能，但練習幾週後我就掌握了訣竅。

items.def: to do something badly to save time or effort
items.s: Don't ______ ______ on your science project, because the judges will check every step of your method.
items.zh: 做科學專題別偷工減料，因為評審會檢查你方法中的每一個步驟。

items.def: to listen or watch carefully
items.s: Please ______ ______ ______ the instructions, because the order of the steps is very important in this experiment.
items.zh: 請注意操作說明，因為這個實驗中步驟的順序非常重要。

items.def: to learn something through a bad experience
items.s: I didn't back up my files, so I ______ ______ ______ ______ when my laptop crashed the night before the deadline.
items.zh: 我沒有備份檔案，所以截止日前一晚筆電當機時，我從慘痛經驗中學到了教訓。
items.t: 從慘痛經驗中學到了教訓

items.def: to improve by understanding what you did wrong
items.s: Ken failed his first driving test, but he ______ ______ ______ ______ and passed easily the second time.
items.zh: 肯第一次駕照考試沒過，但他從錯誤中學習，第二次輕鬆通過了。

items.def: a belief that makes itself come true
items.s: If teachers expect a student to fail, it can become a ______ ______, because the student may stop trying.
items.zh: 如果老師預期某位學生會失敗，這可能會成為自我應驗的預言，因為學生可能會放棄努力。

7.en: Robotics & Automation in Work and Sport

items.def: a robot that looks and moves like a person
items.s: The museum displayed a friendly ________ that could walk and wave, so many children lined up to shake its hand.
items.zh: 博物館展示了一個友善的人形機器人,它會走路和揮手,所以許多孩子排隊和它握手。
items.sec: Robot Design & Parts 機器人設計與零件

items.def: a robot made to look very much like a human
items.s: In the film, the ________ looked so much like a real woman that nobody noticed, but her eyes sometimes glowed blue.
items.zh: 在電影中,那個仿生人看起來非常像真正的女人,沒有人察覺,但她的眼睛有時會發出藍光。
items.sec: Robot Design & Parts 機器人設計與零件

items.def: a person whose body has machine parts added
items.s: My brother loves science fiction stories about a ________ with a metal arm, and he dreams of building one someday.
items.zh: 我哥哥很喜歡關於一個裝著金屬手臂的半機械人的科幻故事,而且他夢想有一天能自己造一個。
items.sec: Robot Design & Parts 機器人設計與零件

items.def: a robot arm that picks up and moves objects
items.s: The factory installed a new ________ that lifts heavy car doors, so workers no longer hurt their backs on the job.
items.zh: 工廠安裝了一支新的機械手臂來舉起沉重的車門,所以工人在工作時不再傷到背部。
items.sec: Robot Design & Parts 機器人設計與零件

items.def: the part of a robot that holds things
items.s: The soft rubber ________ can pick up an egg without breaking it, and engineers are proud of this delicate design.
items.zh: 這個柔軟的橡膠夾爪能拿起一顆蛋而不弄破,工程師們對這個精巧的設計感到自豪。
items.sec: Robot Design & Parts 機器人設計與零件

items.def: a place where two parts connect and can bend
items.s: Each finger of the robot hand has three ________, so it can bend and hold a pen almost like a human hand.
items.zh: 這隻機器手的每根手指都有三個關節,所以它能彎曲並幾乎像人手一樣握筆。
items.sec: Robot Design & Parts 機器人設計與零件

items.def: a part that makes a machine move
items.s: When the ________ in the robot's knee stopped working, the robot could not climb the stairs, so the team replaced it.
items.zh: 當機器人膝蓋裡的致動器停止運作時,它就無法爬樓梯,所以團隊更換了它。
items.sec: Robot Design & Parts 機器人設計與零件

items.def: a wheel with teeth that turns other wheels
items.s: The old clock has many tiny ________ inside, and they must turn together perfectly or the time will be wrong.
items.zh: 這座老時鐘裡面有許多小齒輪,它們必須完美地一起轉動,否則時間就會不準。
items.sec: Robot Design & Parts 機器人設計與零件

items.def: a bar you push or pull to control a machine
items.s: The driver pulled the ________ to raise the robot's arm, but it moved too fast and almost hit the ceiling.
items.zh: 駕駛員拉動操縱桿來升起機器人的手臂,但它移動得太快,差點撞到天花板。
items.sec: Robot Design & Parts 機器人設計與零件

items.def: a metal part that lets a door or lid swing
items.s: The robot's head moves on a strong ________, so it can nod and look down at people who talk to it.
items.zh: 機器人的頭靠一個堅固的鉸鏈轉動,所以它能點頭並低頭看著和它說話的人。
items.sec: Robot Design & Parts 機器人設計與零件

items.def: a rod that connects and turns two wheels
items.s: The delivery robot stopped in the middle of the road because its front ________ broke, and a technician had to fix it.
items.zh: 送貨機器人停在路中間,因為它的前車軸斷了,技術人員必須去修理它。
items.sec: Robot Design & Parts 機器人設計與零件

items.def: a wheel with a rope used to lift things
items.s: Builders used a ________ to lift the heavy robot onto the stage, and the audience clapped when it arrived safely.
items.zh: 工人用滑輪把沉重的機器人吊上舞台,當它安全抵達時觀眾都鼓掌了。
items.sec: Robot Design & Parts 機器人設計與零件

items.def: moved by liquid that is pushed through pipes
items.s: The digger uses a ________ arm to lift tons of soil, so one machine can do the work of twenty people.
items.zh: 這台挖土機使用液壓手臂來舉起好幾噸的土,所以一台機器就能做二十個人的工作。
items.sec: Robot Design & Parts 機器人設計與零件

items.def: powered by air that is pushed under pressure
items.s: The robot hand has ________ muscles that fill with air, and this lets it hold soft fruit gently.
items.zh: 這隻機器手有充氣的氣動肌肉,這讓它能輕柔地握住柔軟的水果。
items.sec: Robot Design & Parts 機器人設計與零件

items.def: the system of wires inside a machine
items.s: After the flood, the ________ inside the robot was wet and damaged, so the engineers had to replace every cable.
items.zh: 水災過後,機器人內部的線路又濕又受損,所以工程師必須更換每一條電線。
items.sec: Robot Design & Parts 機器人設計與零件

items.def: a thick wire that carries electricity or signals
items.s: Please do not step on the black ________ on the floor, because it sends power to the robot on the stage.
items.zh: 請不要踩到地上那條黑色的電纜,因為它正把電力傳送給舞台上的機器人。
items.sec: Robot Design & Parts 機器人設計與零件

items.def: a very small computer that controls a device
items.s: Our class programmed a cheap ________ to switch on a fan, and everyone cheered when the fan started spinning.
items.zh: 我們班替一個便宜的微控制器寫程式來打開電風扇,當風扇開始轉動時大家都歡呼了。
items.sec: Robot Design & Parts 機器人設計與零件

items.def: curved glass that helps a camera see clearly
items.s: The robot could not recognise faces because its camera ________ was dirty, so I cleaned it with a soft cloth.
items.zh: 機器人無法辨認臉孔,因為它的攝影機鏡頭髒了,所以我用軟布把它擦乾淨。
items.sec: Robot Design & Parts 機器人設計與零件

items.def: a system that measures distance using laser light
items.s: Self-driving cars use ________ to measure how far away other cars are, and this helps them avoid accidents in traffic.
items.zh: 自動駕駛汽車使用光達來測量其他車輛有多遠,這幫助它們在車流中避免事故。
items.sec: Robot Design & Parts 機器人設計與零件

items.def: using light that people cannot see but feel as heat
items.s: The security robot has an ________ camera, so it can see people in the dark when the lights are off.
items.zh: 這台保全機器人有一台紅外線攝影機,所以在燈關掉時它也能在黑暗中看見人。
items.sec: Robot Design & Parts 機器人設計與零件

items.def: the turning force of an engine or motor
items.s: This electric motor produces a lot of ________, so the small robot can push a heavy box across the floor.
items.zh: 這個電動馬達產生很大的扭力,所以這台小機器人能把一個沉重的箱子推過地板。
items.sec: Robot Design & Parts 機器人設計與零件

items.def: not heavy; easy to carry
items.s: The new delivery drone is made from ________ plastic, so it uses less battery and can fly much farther.
items.zh: 新的送貨無人機是用輕量塑膠製成的,所以它耗電較少並且能飛得更遠。
items.sec: Robot Design & Parts 機器人設計與零件

items.def: a metal made by mixing two or more metals
items.s: The robot's body is made of a strong ________, so it does not break when it falls down during tests.
items.zh: 這台機器人的機身是用堅固的合金製成的,所以它在測試中跌倒時不會損壞。
items.sec: Robot Design & Parts 機器人設計與零件

items.def: a strong, light, silver-coloured metal
items.s: Engineers chose ________ for the robot's legs because it is strong but light, although it is quite expensive.
items.zh: 工程師為機器人的腿選擇了鈦,因為它堅固又輕,雖然它相當昂貴。
items.sec: Robot Design & Parts 機器人設計與零件

items.def: able to be filled with electricity again
items.s: The toy robot runs on ________ batteries, so we just plug it in at night instead of buying new ones.
items.zh: 這個玩具機器人使用可充電的電池,所以我們晚上只要插上電,而不用買新電池。
items.sec: Robot Design & Parts 機器人設計與零件

items.def: a wearable frame that gives the body extra strength
items.s: The nurse wears a light ________ when she lifts patients, so her back no longer hurts at the end of the day.
items.zh: 這位護理師在抬病人時會穿上輕型外骨骼,所以她一天結束時背部不再疼痛。
items.sec: Robot Design & Parts 機器人設計與零件

items.def: an arm or a leg
items.s: The robot dog lost one ________ in the fall, but it could still walk slowly on its other three legs.
items.zh: 那隻機器狗在跌倒時失去了一條腿,但它仍然能用另外三條腿慢慢走路。
items.sec: Robot Design & Parts 機器人設計與零件

items.def: the load that a vehicle or drone carries
items.s: The drone can carry a ________ of five kilograms, so farmers use it to spread seeds over their fields.
items.zh: 這架無人機能攜帶五公斤的載重,所以農夫用它在田地上撒種子。
items.sec: Robot Design & Parts 機器人設計與零件

items.def: a detailed plan or drawing for building something
items.s: The students studied the ________ of the robot carefully, and then they built every part exactly as shown.
items.zh: 學生們仔細研究了機器人的設計圖,然後他們完全照著圖示製作每一個零件。
items.sec: Robot Design & Parts 機器人設計與零件

items.def: to take a machine apart into pieces
items.s: We had to ________ the broken robot to find the problem, but putting it back together took the whole afternoon.
items.zh: 我們必須拆解這台壞掉的機器人來找出問題,但把它重新組裝回去花了整個下午。
items.sec: Robot Design & Parts 機器人設計與零件

items.def: a row of workers or machines that build products step by step
items.s: Robots now do most of the welding on the car ________ ________, while people check the finished cars for problems.
items.zh: 機器人現在負責汽車裝配線上大部分的焊接工作,而人們則檢查完成的汽車是否有問題。
items.sec: Robots at Work: Factories & Logistics 工廠與物流中的機器人

items.def: a moving belt that carries things from place to place
items.s: Boxes move along the ________ ________ all day, and a robot arm picks out any box with the wrong label.
items.zh: 箱子整天沿著輸送帶移動,而一支機器手臂會挑出任何貼錯標籤的箱子。
items.sec: Robots at Work: Factories & Logistics 工廠與物流中的機器人

items.def: a large factory where things are made
items.s: The new battery ________ near the city uses hundreds of robots, but it still employs about two thousand workers.
items.zh: 城市附近的新電池工廠使用了數百台機器人,但它仍然僱用了大約兩千名員工。
items.sec: Robots at Work: Factories & Logistics 工廠與物流中的機器人

items.def: making very large numbers of the same product
items.s: ________ ________ made cars cheaper in the twentieth century, and robots are making many products cheaper today.
items.zh: 大量生產在二十世紀讓汽車變得更便宜,而機器人如今正讓許多產品變得更便宜。
items.sec: Robots at Work: Factories & Logistics 工廠與物流中的機器人

items.def: connected with factories and making goods
items.s: Most ________ robots work behind safety fences, because their heavy arms move very fast and could injure people.
items.zh: 大多數工業機器人在安全圍欄後面工作,因為它們沉重的手臂移動得很快,可能會傷到人。
items.sec: Robots at Work: Factories & Logistics 工廠與物流中的機器人

items.def: a small vehicle with two metal arms for lifting goods
items.s: The driverless ________ carries boxes around the warehouse at night, so the shelves are full when staff arrive.
items.zh: 這台無人駕駛的堆高機夜間在倉庫裡搬運箱子,所以員工到達時貨架已經補滿了。
items.sec: Robots at Work: Factories & Logistics 工廠與物流中的機器人

items.def: a flat wooden frame that goods are stacked on
items.s: The robot lifts each ________ of bottled water onto the truck, and it never drops a single bottle.
items.zh: 機器人把每一個裝著瓶裝水的棧板抬上卡車,而且它從不掉落任何一瓶。
items.sec: Robots at Work: Factories & Logistics 工廠與物流中的機器人

items.def: organising how goods are stored and moved
items.s: My cousin works in ________ for an online shop, and she says robots now pack most of the orders.
items.zh: 我表姊在一家網路商店從事物流工作,她說現在大部分的訂單都是由機器人包裝的。
items.sec: Robots at Work: Factories & Logistics 工廠與物流中的機器人

items.def: all the steps from making a product to selling it
items.s: When the chip factory closed, the whole ________ ________ slowed down, so many shops had no new phones to sell.
items.zh: 當晶片工廠關閉時,整個供應鏈都變慢了,所以許多商店沒有新手機可以賣。
items.sec: Robots at Work: Factories & Logistics 工廠與物流中的機器人

items.def: a package sent by post or delivery
items.s: A small robot brought the ________ to my door, and I picked it up after typing a code on its lid.
items.zh: 一台小機器人把包裹送到我家門口,我在它的蓋子上輸入密碼後才拿到它。
items.sec: Robots at Work: Factories & Logistics 工廠與物流中的機器人

items.def: to send something or someone somewhere
items.s: The system can ________ a delivery robot within minutes, so customers often receive their lunch while it is still hot.
items.zh: 這個系統能在幾分鐘內派出一台送貨機器人,所以顧客常常在午餐還熱的時候就收到。
items.sec: Robots at Work: Factories & Logistics 工廠與物流中的機器人

items.def: a person or company that delivers packages
items.s: The ________ usually delivers our parcels by motorbike, but last week a drone dropped one in our garden.
items.zh: 快遞員通常騎機車送我們的包裹,但上星期一架無人機把一個包裹丟在我們的花園裡。
items.sec: Robots at Work: Factories & Logistics 工廠與物流中的機器人

items.def: the place where trucks are filled or emptied
items.s: Robots carry the boxes to the ________ ________, and then the drivers check them before the trucks leave.
items.zh: 機器人把箱子搬到裝卸區,然後司機在卡車出發前檢查它們。
items.sec: Robots at Work: Factories & Logistics 工廠與物流中的機器人

items.def: a set of shelves for storing things
items.s: The warehouse has tall metal ________, and small robots climb up it to bring down the boxes people order.
items.zh: 倉庫裡有高大的金屬貨架,小機器人會爬上去把人們訂購的箱子拿下來。
items.sec: Robots at Work: Factories & Logistics 工廠與物流中的機器人

items.def: a pattern of lines that a machine can read
items.s: Each box has a ________ on its side, so the robot knows exactly where to take it in the building.
items.zh: 每個箱子側面都有一個條碼,所以機器人確切知道要把它送到大樓的哪裡。
items.sec: Robots at Work: Factories & Logistics 工廠與物流中的機器人

items.def: a machine that reads codes or makes pictures of things
items.s: The ________ at the gate reads every package, and it beeps loudly if a box goes to the wrong area.
items.zh: 門口的掃描器會讀取每個包裹,如果有箱子送錯區域,它就會大聲嗶嗶叫。
items.sec: Robots at Work: Factories & Logistics 工廠與物流中的機器人

items.def: the amount of work done in a period of time
items.s: After the robots arrived, the factory's ________ doubled, but the managers still needed people to solve problems.
items.zh: 機器人到來之後,工廠的產能翻倍了,但經理們仍然需要人來解決問題。
items.sec: Robots at Work: Factories & Logistics 工廠與物流中的機器人

items.def: to join metal parts by melting them together
items.s: Robots can ________ car parts faster than people, and they do not need to breathe the dangerous smoke.
items.zh: 機器人能比人更快地焊接汽車零件,而且它們不需要吸入危險的煙霧。
items.sec: Robots at Work: Factories & Logistics 工廠與物流中的機器人

items.def: a person or machine that joins metal by heating it
items.s: My uncle was a ________ for twenty years, but now he trains young workers to use robot welding machines.
items.zh: 我叔叔當了二十年的焊工,但現在他訓練年輕工人使用焊接機器人。
items.sec: Robots at Work: Factories & Logistics 工廠與物流中的機器人

items.def: checking that products are made correctly
items.s: Cameras now help with ________ ________, because they can spot tiny scratches that tired workers might miss.
items.zh: 攝影機現在協助品質管制,因為它們能發現疲倦的工人可能漏看的細小刮痕。
items.sec: Robots at Work: Factories & Logistics 工廠與物流中的機器人

items.def: a fault or mistake in something that was made
items.s: The camera found a small ________ in the phone screen, so the robot removed it from the line immediately.
items.zh: 攝影機在手機螢幕上發現一個小瑕疵,所以機器人立刻把它從生產線上移除。
items.sec: Robots at Work: Factories & Logistics 工廠與物流中的機器人

items.def: not made correctly; not working properly
items.s: The company called back thousands of ________ toys, because a loose part could hurt young children.
items.zh: 公司召回了數千個有瑕疵的玩具,因為一個鬆脫的零件可能會傷到幼童。
items.sec: Robots at Work: Factories & Logistics 工廠與物流中的機器人

items.def: the work of keeping machines in good condition
items.s: Robots do not get tired, but they need regular ________, so the factory stops them every Sunday for checks.
items.zh: 機器人不會累,但它們需要定期保養,所以工廠每個星期天讓它們停機檢查。
items.sec: Robots at Work: Factories & Logistics 工廠與物流中的機器人

items.def: doing the same thing again and again
items.s: Robots are good at ________ jobs like packing boxes, so workers can spend more time on creative tasks.
items.zh: 機器人擅長像包裝箱子這樣重複的工作,所以工人能花更多時間在有創意的任務上。
items.sec: Robots at Work: Factories & Logistics 工廠與物流中的機器人

items.def: the work of picking up and moving heavy things
items.s: The robots do the ________ ________ in the warehouse, while staff focus on checking orders and helping customers.
items.zh: 機器人在倉庫裡負責搬運重物,而員工則專注於檢查訂單和協助顧客。
items.sec: Robots at Work: Factories & Logistics 工廠與物流中的機器人

items.def: a person who controls a machine
items.s: The crane ________ watched the screen carefully, because one small mistake could drop the steel on the workers below.
items.zh: 起重機操作員仔細地看著螢幕,因為一個小錯誤就可能把鋼材掉到下面的工人身上。
items.sec: Robots at Work: Factories & Logistics 工廠與物流中的機器人

items.def: machines in general, especially large ones
items.s: Farmers in our village bought new ________ last year, so they can harvest rice with far fewer helpers.
items.zh: 我們村子的農夫去年買了新機械,所以他們能用少得多的人手收割稻米。
items.sec: Robots at Work: Factories & Logistics 工廠與物流中的機器人

items.def: a robot designed to work safely next to people
items.s: The ________ works right beside the staff, and it stops at once if someone's hand comes too close.
items.zh: 這台協作機器人就在員工旁邊工作,如果有人的手靠得太近,它會立刻停下來。
items.sec: Robots at Work: Factories & Logistics 工廠與物流中的機器人

items.def: the place where a worker or machine does a job
items.s: Each ________ on the line has one person and one robot, and they pass parts to each other all day.
items.zh: 生產線上的每個工作站都有一個人和一台機器人,他們整天互相傳遞零件。
items.sec: Robots at Work: Factories & Logistics 工廠與物流中的機器人

items.def: a tall machine for lifting very heavy objects
items.s: A huge ________ lifted the containers off the ship, and it was controlled by a person in an office far away.
items.zh: 一台巨大的起重機把貨櫃從船上吊起來,而它是由遠處辦公室裡的一個人控制的。
items.sec: Robots at Work: Factories & Logistics 工廠與物流中的機器人

items.def: a small machine that cleans floors by itself
items.s: Our ________ ________ cleans the living room while we are at work, but it often gets stuck under the sofa.
items.zh: 我們的掃地機器人在我們上班時打掃客廳,但它常常卡在沙發底下。
items.sec: Service, Home & Medical Robots 服務、家用與醫療機器人

items.def: a machine for cutting grass
items.s: My neighbour bought a robot ________ that cuts the grass every morning, so his garden always looks tidy.
items.zh: 我的鄰居買了一台機器人割草機,每天早上割草,所以他的花園總是看起來很整齊。
items.sec: Service, Home & Medical Robots 服務、家用與醫療機器人

items.def: a machine that washes plates and cups
items.s: We load the ________ after dinner, and the clean plates are ready before we go to bed.
items.zh: 我們晚餐後把碗盤放進洗碗機,睡覺前乾淨的盤子就準備好了。
items.sec: Service, Home & Medical Robots 服務、家用與醫療機器人

items.def: a machine used in the home, like a fridge
items.s: Many new kitchen ________ can connect to the internet, so you can start the rice cooker from your phone.
items.zh: 許多新的廚房家電可以連上網路,所以你可以用手機啟動電鍋。
items.sec: Service, Home & Medical Robots 服務、家用與醫療機器人

items.def: a house where devices are controlled by the internet
items.s: In our ________ ________, the lights turn on when we walk in, and the heater starts before we wake up.
items.zh: 在我們的智慧家庭裡,我們一走進去燈就會亮,而暖氣在我們起床前就開始運作。
items.sec: Service, Home & Medical Robots 服務、家用與醫療機器人

items.def: a spoken order that a machine follows
items.s: Grandpa uses a ________ ________ to turn on the TV, because the small buttons on the remote are hard to see.
items.zh: 爺爺用語音指令打開電視,因為遙控器上的小按鈕很難看清楚。
items.sec: Service, Home & Medical Robots 服務、家用與醫療機器人

items.def: a machine that sells drinks or snacks
items.s: The ________ ________ at the station takes phone payments, so I bought a drink without any coins.
items.zh: 車站的自動販賣機接受手機付款,所以我沒用任何硬幣就買了一杯飲料。
items.sec: Service, Home & Medical Robots 服務、家用與醫療機器人

items.def: a machine where shoppers pay without a cashier
items.s: The supermarket added six ________ machines, but older customers still prefer to queue for a person.
items.zh: 超市增加了六台自助結帳機,但年長的顧客仍然比較喜歡排隊找人結帳。
items.sec: Service, Home & Medical Robots 服務、家用與醫療機器人

items.def: a small screen or booth where you order or buy things
items.s: I ordered my burger at the touchscreen ________, and a robot brought it to my table ten minutes later.
items.zh: 我在觸控自助點餐機點了漢堡,十分鐘後一台機器人把它送到我的桌上。
items.sec: Service, Home & Medical Robots 服務、家用與醫療機器人

items.def: a person who takes money in a shop
items.s: The friendly ________ at the corner shop knows all the customers, so people still visit even though machines are faster.
items.zh: 街角商店那位友善的收銀員認識所有顧客,所以即使機器比較快,人們仍然會去光顧。
items.sec: Service, Home & Medical Robots 服務、家用與醫療機器人

items.def: a person who greets visitors at a front desk
items.s: The hotel replaced its night ________ with a talking robot, but guests complained that it could not answer simple questions.
items.zh: 飯店用一台會說話的機器人取代了夜班接待員,但客人抱怨它無法回答簡單的問題。
items.sec: Service, Home & Medical Robots 服務、家用與醫療機器人

items.def: a person who serves food in a restaurant
items.s: The restaurant uses a robot ________ to carry dishes, while the staff spend more time chatting with customers.
items.zh: 這家餐廳使用機器人服務生送菜,而員工則花更多時間和顧客聊天。
items.sec: Service, Home & Medical Robots 服務、家用與醫療機器人

items.def: a small, regular job in the house
items.s: Washing clothes used to be a hard ________, but now machines do most of the work for us.
items.zh: 洗衣服以前是一件辛苦的家事,但現在機器幫我們做了大部分的工作。
items.sec: Service, Home & Medical Robots 服務、家用與醫療機器人

items.def: a short trip to buy or deliver something
items.s: My mother asked a delivery robot to do a quick ________, so it brought medicine from the pharmacy next door.
items.zh: 我媽媽請一台送貨機器人去跑腿,於是它從隔壁藥局送來了藥。
items.sec: Service, Home & Medical Robots 服務、家用與醫療機器人

items.def: to clean a floor with a wet cloth on a stick
items.s: This robot can vacuum and ________ the floor at the same time, so our kitchen stays clean every day.
items.zh: 這台機器人能同時吸塵和拖地,所以我們的廚房每天都保持乾淨。
items.sec: Service, Home & Medical Robots 服務、家用與醫療機器人

items.def: the business of hotels, restaurants and serving guests
items.s: Robots are becoming common in the ________ industry, but many travellers still want a warm smile from a real person.
items.zh: 機器人在餐旅業越來越常見,但許多旅客仍然希望得到真人溫暖的微笑。
items.sec: Service, Home & Medical Robots 服務、家用與醫療機器人

items.def: to say hello to someone when they arrive
items.s: A small robot at the bank door will ________ you by name, and then it tells you which counter to visit.
items.zh: 銀行門口的小機器人會叫著你的名字跟你打招呼,然後告訴你要去哪個櫃台。
items.sec: Service, Home & Medical Robots 服務、家用與醫療機器人

items.def: a robot designed to talk and interact with people
items.s: The ________ ________ in the care home tells jokes and plays games, so the residents feel less bored in the afternoon.
items.zh: 安養院裡的社交機器人會講笑話和玩遊戲,所以住民下午比較不會無聊。
items.sec: Service, Home & Medical Robots 服務、家用與醫療機器人

items.def: connected with medical operations
items.s: The hospital bought a ________ robot that can make very small cuts, so patients recover faster after their operations.
items.zh: 醫院買了一台能做出非常小切口的手術機器人,所以病人手術後恢復得更快。
items.sec: Service, Home & Medical Robots 服務、家用與醫療機器人

items.def: a doctor who performs operations
items.s: The ________ controlled the robot from a screen beside the bed, and the operation finished an hour early.
items.zh: 外科醫生從病床旁的螢幕控制機器人,而手術提早了一個小時完成。
items.sec: Service, Home & Medical Robots 服務、家用與醫療機器人

items.def: a cut made into the body during an operation
items.s: The robot made a tiny ________ in my father's side, so he could walk around the next day.
items.zh: 機器人在我爸爸的側腹做了一個很小的切口,所以他隔天就能四處走動。
items.sec: Service, Home & Medical Robots 服務、家用與醫療機器人

items.def: an operation done through very small cuts
items.s: My aunt had ________ ________ on her knee, and she was back at work in less than two weeks.
items.zh: 我阿姨的膝蓋做了微創手術,不到兩週她就回去上班了。
items.sec: Service, Home & Medical Robots 服務、家用與醫療機器人

items.def: artificial and used to replace a missing body part
items.s: The runner lost her leg in an accident, but with a ________ leg she now competes in international races.
items.zh: 這位跑者在意外中失去了一條腿,但靠著義肢腿,她現在參加國際比賽。
items.sec: Service, Home & Medical Robots 服務、家用與醫療機器人

items.def: a person who looks after someone who is ill or old
items.s: Robots can remind patients to take medicine, but they cannot replace a kind ________ who listens and understands.
items.zh: 機器人能提醒病人吃藥,但它們無法取代一位會傾聽和理解的親切照顧者。
items.sec: Service, Home & Medical Robots 服務、家用與醫療機器人

items.def: a place where old people live and are looked after
items.s: The ________ ________ has a robot that delivers meals to each room, so the nurses have more time to talk with residents.
items.zh: 這家安養院有一台把餐點送到每個房間的機器人,所以護理師有更多時間和住民聊天。
items.sec: Service, Home & Medical Robots 服務、家用與醫療機器人

items.def: a large room in a hospital for several patients
items.s: A robot moves through the children's ________ at night, and it checks each child's temperature without waking them up.
items.zh: 一台機器人夜間在兒童病房裡移動,它會在不吵醒孩子的情況下量每個孩子的體溫。
items.sec: Service, Home & Medical Robots 服務、家用與醫療機器人

items.def: to clean something to kill germs
items.s: The hospital uses robots with strong lights to ________ the rooms, so nurses are less likely to catch infections.
items.zh: 醫院使用帶有強光的機器人來消毒房間,所以護理師比較不容易被感染。
items.sec: Service, Home & Medical Robots 服務、家用與醫療機器人

items.def: to give out medicine or other things
items.s: The machine can ________ the right pills for each patient, and it keeps a record so nurses can check later.
items.zh: 這台機器能為每位病人配發正確的藥丸,並且會保存紀錄讓護理師之後檢查。
items.sec: Service, Home & Medical Robots 服務、家用與醫療機器人

items.def: to give a machine new instructions
items.s: The engineers had to ________ the robot after the factory changed its products, but the job took only one day.
items.zh: 工廠更換產品後,工程師必須重新設定機器人的程式,但這份工作只花了一天。
items.sec: Control & Programming 控制與程式設計

items.def: the main software that runs a computer or robot
items.s: The robot's ________ ________ needed an update, so it restarted by itself in the middle of the night.
items.zh: 機器人的作業系統需要更新,所以它在半夜自己重新啟動了。
items.sec: Control & Programming 控制與程式設計

items.def: controlled from a distance using radio signals
items.s: My little brother got a ________ car for his birthday, and he drove it around the kitchen all afternoon.
items.zh: 我弟弟生日時得到一台遙控車,他整個下午都在廚房裡開著它到處跑。
items.sec: Control & Programming 控制與程式設計

items.def: a stick you move to control a machine or game
items.s: The pilot moved the ________ gently to the left, and the underwater robot turned towards the shipwreck.
items.zh: 操作員輕輕地把搖桿往左推,水下機器人就轉向了沉船。
items.sec: Control & Programming 控制與程式設計

items.def: a screen you control by touching it
items.s: Workers tell the robot what to do on a large ________, so they do not need to learn any computer language.
items.zh: 工人在一個大型觸控螢幕上告訴機器人要做什麼,所以他們不需要學任何電腦語言。
items.sec: Control & Programming 控制與程式設計

items.def: happening immediately, with no delay
items.s: The drone sends ________ video to the firefighters, so they can see where people are trapped inside the building.
items.zh: 無人機把即時影像傳給消防員,所以他們能看到人們被困在建築物的哪裡。
items.sec: Control & Programming 控制與程式設計

items.def: technology that lets computers understand images
items.s: Thanks to ________ ________, the robot can tell ripe tomatoes from green ones, so it picks only the ready fruit.
items.zh: 多虧了電腦視覺,機器人能分辨成熟和未熟的番茄,所以它只採摘成熟的果實。
items.sec: Control & Programming 控制與程式設計

items.def: a kind of AI that learns from huge amounts of examples
items.s: The robot improved its walking through ________ ________, and after thousands of tries it stopped falling over.
items.zh: 這台機器人透過深度學習改善了走路的能力,在嘗試數千次之後它不再跌倒了。
items.sec: Control & Programming 控制與程式設計

items.def: able to improve by itself without new instructions
items.s: The ________ vacuum remembers where the furniture is, so it cleans our flat faster every week.
items.zh: 這台能自我學習的吸塵器記得家具的位置,所以它每週打掃我們公寓的速度都更快。
items.sec: Control & Programming 控制與程式設計

items.def: to adjust a machine so that it measures correctly
items.s: We must ________ the robot's camera every month, or it starts to put the parts in slightly the wrong place.
items.zh: 我們每個月都必須校準機器人的攝影機,否則它會開始把零件放在稍微錯誤的位置。
items.sec: Control & Programming 控制與程式設計

items.def: to find and fix problems in a machine or system
items.s: When the robot stopped moving, the technician tried to ________ the problem, but she finally called the company for help.
items.zh: 當機器人停止移動時,技術人員試著排除故障,但她最後還是打電話向公司求助。
items.sec: Control & Programming 控制與程式設計

items.def: to find and remove mistakes in computer code
items.s: Our team spent all night trying to ________ the program, because the robot kept turning left instead of right.
items.zh: 我們的隊伍整晚都在試著替程式除錯,因為機器人一直向左轉而不是向右轉。
items.sec: Control & Programming 控制與程式設計

items.def: to turn a computer or machine off and on again
items.s: If the robot freezes, just ________ it by holding the red button, and it usually works again in a minute.
items.zh: 如果機器人當機,只要按住紅色按鈕將它重新開機,通常一分鐘後就能恢復運作。
items.sec: Control & Programming 控制與程式設計

items.def: to take control and cancel what a machine is doing
items.s: The driver can ________ the self-driving system at any time, so she grabbed the wheel when a child ran into the road.
items.zh: 駕駛隨時可以手動接管自動駕駛系統,所以當一個孩子衝到馬路上時她立刻抓住方向盤。
items.sec: Control & Programming 控制與程式設計

items.def: a button that turns a machine off immediately
items.s: Every robot in the factory has a big red ________ ________ button, and workers practise using it once a month.
items.zh: 工廠裡的每台機器人都有一個紅色大緊急停止按鈕,工人每個月練習使用一次。
items.sec: Control & Programming 控制與程式設計

items.def: designed to stay safe if something goes wrong
items.cn: 故障安全的;萬無一失的
items.s: The lift has a ________ brake, so it will not fall even if the power suddenly goes off.
items.zh: 這部電梯有故障安全煞車,所以即使突然停電,它也不會掉下去。
items.sec: Control & Programming 控制與程式設計

items.def: (of a computer) to stop working suddenly
items.s: The computer system ________ during the busy holiday season, so the robots stopped and hundreds of orders were late.
items.zh: 電腦系統在忙碌的假期期間當機了,所以機器人停了下來,數百筆訂單都延誤了。
items.sec: Control & Programming 控制與程式設計

items.def: (of a screen or machine) to stop moving or responding
items.s: The robot's screen ________ in the middle of the demonstration, so the presenter laughed and told a joke instead.
items.zh: 示範到一半時機器人的螢幕當住了,所以主持人笑了笑並改講一個笑話。
items.sec: Control & Programming 控制與程式設計

items.def: working without wires, using radio signals
items.s: The robots talk to each other through a ________ network, so there are no cables lying on the factory floor.
items.zh: 機器人透過無線網路互相溝通,所以工廠地板上沒有電線散落。
items.sec: Control & Programming 控制與程式設計

items.def: a small flat computer with a touchscreen
items.s: The farmer checks his robot tractors on a ________, so he can watch them while he drinks his morning tea.
items.zh: 這位農夫用平板電腦查看他的機器人拖拉機,所以他能一邊喝早茶一邊看著它們。
items.sec: Control & Programming 控制與程式設計

items.def: a person who designs and builds machines
items.s: My sister wants to become an ________ who designs robots for hospitals, so she studies maths and physics very hard.
items.zh: 我姊姊想成為設計醫院用機器人的工程師,所以她非常努力地學習數學和物理。
items.sec: Control & Programming 控制與程式設計

items.def: operated by machinery; connected with machines
items.s: The old robot made loud ________ noises when it moved, but the new model is almost completely silent.
items.zh: 舊型機器人移動時會發出很大的機械噪音,但新型號幾乎完全安靜。
items.sec: Control & Programming 控制與程式設計

items.def: using small electrical parts like chips
items.s: Old ________ devices should be recycled properly, because they contain metals that can harm the environment.
items.zh: 舊的電子裝置應該妥善回收,因為它們含有會危害環境的金屬。
items.sec: Control & Programming 控制與程式設計

items.def: a skilled worker who repairs or looks after machines
items.s: A ________ visits the hotel every week to check the robots, and she also teaches the staff how to fix small problems.
items.zh: 一位技術人員每週到飯店檢查機器人,她也教員工如何修理小問題。
items.sec: Control & Programming 控制與程式設計

items.def: the study that combines machines, electronics and computing
items.s: My cousin is studying ________ at university, and he hopes to build farming robots after he graduates.
items.zh: 我表哥在大學就讀機電整合,他希望畢業後能製造農業機器人。
items.sec: Control & Programming 控制與程式設計

items.def: a system that uses satellites to show your location
items.s: The lawnmower uses ________ to stay inside the garden, so it never wanders onto the road.
items.zh: 這台割草機使用全球定位系統來保持在花園範圍內,所以它從不會跑到馬路上。
items.sec: Control & Programming 控制與程式設計

items.def: making a map or plan of an area
items.s: The robot vacuum starts by ________ every room, and then it plans the fastest way to clean the house.
items.zh: 掃地機器人一開始會替每個房間建立地圖,然後規劃打掃房子最快的路線。
items.sec: Control & Programming 控制與程式設計

items.def: a system that flies a plane or drives a car automatically
items.s: The plane flew on ________ for most of the journey, but the pilots landed it themselves because of strong winds.
items.zh: 這架飛機大部分航程都以自動駕駛飛行,但因為強風,飛行員親自讓它降落。
items.sec: Control & Programming 控制與程式設計

items.def: an official who makes decisions in tennis, cricket or baseball
items.s: The league is testing a robot ________ that calls balls and strikes, but some players say it takes the fun out of baseball.
items.zh: 聯盟正在測試一位判定好壞球的機器人裁判,但有些球員說這讓棒球失去了樂趣。
items.sec: Robots in Sport & Officiating 運動中的機器人與裁判科技

items.def: an official who controls a football or basketball game
items.s: The ________ checked the video screen before giving the goal, so the angry fans finally calmed down.
items.zh: 裁判在判定進球之前先查看了影像螢幕,所以憤怒的球迷終於冷靜下來。
items.sec: Robots in Sport & Officiating 運動中的機器人與裁判科技

items.def: an official who decides if a ball is in or out
items.s: Many tennis tournaments no longer use a ________ ________, because electronic cameras can call the lines more accurately.
items.zh: 許多網球賽不再使用司線員,因為電子攝影機能更精準地判定界線。
items.sec: Robots in Sport & Officiating 運動中的機器人與裁判科技

items.def: to act as the official in charge of a game
items.s: My uncle used to ________ local football matches, but now he says the video system makes the job very different.
items.zh: 我叔叔以前常擔任地方足球賽的裁判,但他現在說影像系統讓這份工作變得很不一樣。
items.sec: Robots in Sport & Officiating 運動中的機器人與裁判科技

items.def: an official decision
items.s: The player was unhappy with the ________, but he accepted it after the replay showed the ball was out.
items.zh: 這位球員對裁決不滿,但在重播顯示球出界後他接受了。
items.sec: Robots in Sport & Officiating 運動中的機器人與裁判科技

items.def: to officially change a decision
items.s: The video referee decided to ________ the penalty, because the replay showed that the defender never touched the striker.
items.zh: 影像裁判決定推翻這個罰球判決,因為重播顯示防守球員從未碰到前鋒。
items.sec: Robots in Sport & Officiating 運動中的機器人與裁判科技

items.def: a recording of part of a game shown again
items.s: The ________ showed that the runner was safe, so the umpire changed his call and the crowd cheered.
items.zh: 重播顯示跑者是安全上壘,所以裁判改變了判決,觀眾都歡呼起來。
items.sec: Robots in Sport & Officiating 運動中的機器人與裁判科技

items.def: showing a video more slowly than real speed
items.s: In ________ ________, you can see the ball just touch the line, but it was impossible to see with the eye.
items.zh: 在慢動作中,你能看到球剛好碰到線,但用肉眼是不可能看清楚的。
items.sec: Robots in Sport & Officiating 運動中的機器人與裁判科技

items.def: cameras that show whether a ball crossed the goal line
items.s: ________ ________ tells the referee within one second whether the ball went in, so there are fewer arguments after big matches.
items.zh: 門線技術在一秒內告訴裁判球是否進門,所以大比賽後的爭議少了很多。
items.sec: Robots in Sport & Officiating 運動中的機器人與裁判科技

items.def: in a position on the field that breaks the rules
items.s: The striker was ________ by only a few centimetres, but the computer lines showed it clearly and the goal was cancelled.
items.zh: 這名前鋒只越位了幾公分,但電腦畫線清楚地顯示出來,所以進球被取消了。
items.sec: Robots in Sport & Officiating 運動中的機器人與裁判科技

items.def: an action that breaks the rules of a game
items.s: The referee missed the ________ at first, but the video assistant told him to look at the screen again.
items.zh: 裁判一開始漏看了這次犯規,但影像助理請他再看一次螢幕。
items.sec: Robots in Sport & Officiating 運動中的機器人與裁判科技

items.def: the area over home plate where a pitch counts as a strike
items.s: Every batter has a slightly different ________ ________, so the robot umpire must measure each player's height.
items.zh: 每位打者的好球帶都略有不同,所以機器人裁判必須測量每位球員的身高。
items.sec: Robots in Sport & Officiating 運動中的機器人與裁判科技

items.def: the baseball player who throws the ball to the batter
items.s: The ________ threw the ball very fast, and the robot umpire called it a strike before the crowd could even see it.
items.zh: 投手把球投得非常快,觀眾還沒看清楚,機器人裁判就判定是好球了。
items.sec: Robots in Sport & Officiating 運動中的機器人與裁判科技

items.def: the baseball player who tries to hit the ball
items.s: The ________ argued that the ball was too low, but the computer showed it had touched the edge of the zone.
items.zh: 打者爭辯說那球太低,但電腦顯示它碰到了好球帶的邊緣。
items.sec: Robots in Sport & Officiating 運動中的機器人與裁判科技

items.def: an area marked for playing tennis or basketball
items.s: Cameras around the tennis ________ track the ball at high speed, so players can challenge any call they disagree with.
items.zh: 網球場周圍的攝影機高速追蹤球,所以球員可以對任何不同意的判決提出挑戰。
items.sec: Robots in Sport & Officiating 運動中的機器人與裁判科技

items.def: a long series of hits in tennis or badminton
items.s: The two players had a forty-shot ________, and the crowd stood up to clap when it finally ended.
items.zh: 兩位選手進行了四十拍的來回對打,當它終於結束時,觀眾都站起來鼓掌。
items.sec: Robots in Sport & Officiating 運動中的機器人與裁判科技

items.def: a person who watches a sports event
items.s: Every ________ in the stadium could see the replay on the big screen, so nobody doubted the referee's final decision.
items.zh: 體育場裡的每一位觀眾都能在大螢幕上看到重播,所以沒有人懷疑裁判的最後決定。
items.sec: Robots in Sport & Officiating 運動中的機器人與裁判科技

items.def: a large sports ground with seats around it
items.s: The new ________ has robots that deliver snacks to fans' seats, so nobody misses the action while queuing.
items.zh: 新的體育場有把點心送到球迷座位的機器人,所以沒有人會因為排隊而錯過精彩畫面。
items.sec: Robots in Sport & Officiating 運動中的機器人與裁判科技

items.def: a sports competition with many games or rounds
items.s: The robot football ________ attracted teams from twenty countries, and our school's team reached the final round.
items.zh: 機器人足球錦標賽吸引了來自二十個國家的隊伍,而我們學校的隊伍打進了決賽。
items.sec: Robots in Sport & Officiating 運動中的機器人與裁判科技

items.def: a group of teams that play against each other
items.s: The baseball ________ plans to use electronic umpires next season, but the players' union wants more tests first.
items.zh: 棒球聯盟計畫下一季使用電子裁判,但球員工會希望先做更多測試。
items.sec: Robots in Sport & Officiating 運動中的機器人與裁判科技

items.def: a person who is good at sports and trains hard
items.s: Wearable sensors tell each ________ how fast they are running, so coaches can plan better training sessions.
items.zh: 穿戴式感測器告訴每位運動員他們跑得多快,所以教練能規劃更好的訓練課程。
items.sec: Robots in Sport & Officiating 運動中的機器人與裁判科技

items.def: a person who trains a sports team or player
items.s: Our ________ uses video software to study every match, and she shows us exactly where we made mistakes.
items.zh: 我們的教練使用影像軟體研究每一場比賽,她會清楚地告訴我們哪裡犯了錯。
items.sec: Robots in Sport & Officiating 運動中的機器人與裁判科技

items.def: the person or team you play against
items.s: The table tennis robot is a tireless ________, so players can practise for hours without needing a partner.
items.zh: 這台桌球機器人是一個永不疲倦的對手,所以選手能練習好幾個小時而不需要搭檔。
items.sec: Robots in Sport & Officiating 運動中的機器人與裁判科技

items.def: a large board showing the score of a game
items.s: The ________ showed the speed of every serve, and the fans cheered when it reached two hundred kilometres per hour.
items.zh: 記分板顯示每一次發球的速度,當它達到每小時兩百公里時球迷都歡呼了。
items.sec: Robots in Sport & Officiating 運動中的機器人與裁判科技

items.def: an extra game played to decide a winner when scores are equal
items.s: The match went to a ________, and one close line call decided who would win the whole tournament.
items.zh: 這場比賽進入了搶七,而一個接近邊線的判決決定了誰會贏得整個錦標賽。
items.sec: Robots in Sport & Officiating 運動中的機器人與裁判科技

items.def: the study of data to find useful patterns
items.s: Teams now use ________ to choose players, but some fans think numbers cannot measure a player's heart.
items.zh: 球隊現在用數據分析來挑選球員,但有些球迷認為數字無法衡量一位球員的鬥志。
items.sec: Robots in Sport & Officiating 運動中的機器人與裁判科技

items.def: recording body movements with sensors to study them
items.s: The golfer trained with ________ ________, so she could see on a screen exactly how her body moved during each swing.
items.zh: 這位高爾夫球員使用動作捕捉訓練,所以她能在螢幕上清楚看到每次揮桿時身體如何移動。
items.sec: Robots in Sport & Officiating 運動中的機器人與裁判科技

items.def: competitive video gaming watched by audiences
items.s: My cousin plays ________ professionally, and millions of fans watch his matches online every weekend.
items.zh: 我表哥以職業身分打電子競技,每個週末有數百萬名粉絲在網路上觀看他的比賽。
items.sec: Robots in Sport & Officiating 運動中的機器人與裁判科技

items.def: a competition to find the best player or team
items.s: The robot dance ________ was held in Taipei this year, and teams spent months preparing their routines.
items.zh: 機器人舞蹈錦標賽今年在台北舉行,各隊花了好幾個月準備他們的表演。
items.sec: Robots in Sport & Officiating 運動中的機器人與裁判科技

items.def: fair and polite behaviour when playing sports
items.s: The young player showed great ________ when he admitted the ball was out, although the camera had not seen it.
items.zh: 這位年輕選手承認球出界了,展現了很好的運動家精神,雖然攝影機並沒有拍到。
items.sec: Robots in Sport & Officiating 運動中的機器人與裁判科技

items.def: doing physical work, often in factories or building
items.s: Many ________ workers worry about robots, but plumbers and electricians are still in high demand.
items.zh: 許多藍領工人擔心機器人,但水電工和電工的需求仍然很高。
items.sec: Jobs, Economy & the Future of Work 工作、經濟與未來職場

items.def: doing office work rather than physical work
items.s: People once believed robots would only take factory jobs, but now AI is changing ________ jobs like accounting too.
items.zh: 人們曾經認為機器人只會搶走工廠工作,但現在人工智慧也在改變像會計這樣的白領工作。
items.sec: Jobs, Economy & the Future of Work 工作、經濟與未來職場

items.def: not having special training for a job
items.cn: 非技術性的;無專業技能的
items.s: Robots have replaced many ________ jobs in warehouses, so the government offers free training courses for those workers.
items.zh: 機器人已經取代了倉庫裡許多非技術性的工作,所以政府為那些工人提供免費的訓練課程。
items.sec: Jobs, Economy & the Future of Work 工作、經濟與未來職場

items.def: having the training to do a job well
items.s: The company needs ________ workers who can repair robots, but it is hard to find enough of them.
items.zh: 公司需要能修理機器人的有技術的工人,但很難找到足夠的人手。
items.sec: Jobs, Economy & the Future of Work 工作、經濟與未來職場

items.def: a person who does hard physical work
items.s: My grandfather worked as a ________ on building sites, and he says machines now do the hardest lifting.
items.zh: 我祖父以前在工地當勞工,他說機器現在負責最吃力的搬運工作。
items.sec: Jobs, Economy & the Future of Work 工作、經濟與未來職場

items.def: when people lose their jobs
items.s: The new robots led to some ________ ________ at the factory, but the company also hired fifty technicians.
items.zh: 新機器人導致工廠出現了一些工作流失,但公司也僱用了五十名技術人員。
items.sec: Jobs, Economy & the Future of Work 工作、經濟與未來職場

items.def: to move workers to a different job or place
items.s: Instead of firing staff, the bank decided to ________ them to customer service after the machines took over counting cash.
items.zh: 機器接手點鈔工作後,銀行決定不解僱員工,而是把他們調派到客戶服務部門。
items.sec: Jobs, Economy & the Future of Work 工作、經濟與未來職場

items.def: to learn new skills for a different job
items.s: Many cashiers chose to ________ as computer helpers, and the company paid for their evening classes.
items.zh: 許多收銀員選擇學習新技能轉當電腦助理,而公司替他們支付了夜間課程的費用。
items.sec: Jobs, Economy & the Future of Work 工作、經濟與未來職場

items.def: the place where people do their jobs
items.s: Robots have made the ________ much safer, because they now handle the dangerous chemicals instead of people.
items.zh: 機器人讓工作場所安全了許多,因為現在由它們而不是人來處理危險的化學品。
items.sec: Jobs, Economy & the Future of Work 工作、經濟與未來職場

items.def: a person you work with
items.s: My ________ was nervous about the new robot at first, but now she says it is the best helper she has ever had.
items.zh: 我的同事一開始對新機器人很緊張,但她現在說那是她遇過最好的幫手。
items.sec: Jobs, Economy & the Future of Work 工作、經濟與未來職場

items.def: the number of workers available for a job
items.s: The farm lacked ________ during the harvest, so the owner rented a fruit-picking robot for two months.
items.zh: 農場在收成期間缺乏人力,所以農場主人租了一台採果機器人兩個月。
items.sec: Jobs, Economy & the Future of Work 工作、經濟與未來職場

items.def: the total number of people employed
items.s: The company reduced its ________ after it bought robots, but it promised that no one would lose their job suddenly.
items.zh: 公司購買機器人後減少了員工人數,但它承諾不會有人突然失去工作。
items.sec: Jobs, Economy & the Future of Work 工作、經濟與未來職場

items.def: the list of workers a company pays, or the money paid
items.s: The factory's ________ has fallen since the robots arrived, so the owners have more money to spend on research.
items.zh: 自從機器人到來後,工廠的薪資總額下降了,所以老闆有更多錢可以花在研發上。
items.sec: Jobs, Economy & the Future of Work 工作、經濟與未來職場

items.def: extra hours worked after the normal working day
items.s: Before the robots came, workers often did ________ at night, but now most of them go home at five o'clock.
items.zh: 在機器人來之前,工人常常在晚上加班,但現在大部分的人五點就回家了。
items.sec: Jobs, Economy & the Future of Work 工作、經濟與未來職場

items.def: working only some hours of the day or week
items.s: She took a ________ job at the robot café while studying, and she learned how to fix the coffee machine.
items.zh: 她在求學期間在機器人咖啡館找了一份兼職工作,而且學會了如何修理咖啡機。
items.sec: Jobs, Economy & the Future of Work 工作、經濟與未來職場

items.def: money paid regularly to people after they stop working
items.s: Some economists suggest a tax on robots to pay for ________, because there will be fewer young workers in the future.
items.zh: 一些經濟學家建議對機器人課稅來支付退休金,因為未來的年輕勞工會變少。
items.sec: Jobs, Economy & the Future of Work 工作、經濟與未來職場

items.def: a tax on companies that use robots instead of workers
items.s: Supporters say a ________ ________ could pay for training courses, but business leaders argue that it would slow down progress.
items.zh: 支持者說機器人稅可以支付訓練課程的費用,但企業領袖認為那會拖慢進步。
items.sec: Jobs, Economy & the Future of Work 工作、經濟與未來職場

items.def: a company that tries to sell more than another
items.s: Our ________ started using delivery drones last year, so our company had to find a faster way to send parcels.
items.zh: 我們的競爭對手去年開始使用送貨無人機,所以我們公司必須找到更快寄送包裹的方法。
items.sec: Jobs, Economy & the Future of Work 工作、經濟與未來職場

items.def: the part of total sales a company has
items.s: The company gained ________ ________ after it lowered prices, because its new robots made production much cheaper.
items.zh: 公司降價後獲得了更多市占率,因為它的新機器人讓生產成本便宜了許多。
items.sec: Jobs, Economy & the Future of Work 工作、經濟與未來職場

items.def: lower costs per item when you produce a lot
items.s: Big factories enjoy ________ ________ ________, so they can buy expensive robots that small workshops cannot afford.
items.zh: 大型工廠享有規模經濟,所以它們能購買小型工坊負擔不起的昂貴機器人。
items.sec: Jobs, Economy & the Future of Work 工作、經濟與未來職場

items.def: the number of hours or days people work each week
items.s: Some experts believe robots could give us a shorter ________, so people would have more time for family and hobbies.
items.zh: 一些專家認為機器人能讓我們的每週工時變短,這樣人們就會有更多時間陪伴家人和從事嗜好。
items.sec: Jobs, Economy & the Future of Work 工作、經濟與未來職場

items.def: to give someone a job
items.s: The hospital plans to ________ more nurses this year, although it has also bought robots to deliver medicine.
items.zh: 醫院計畫今年僱用更多護理師,雖然它也買了送藥的機器人。
items.sec: Jobs, Economy & the Future of Work 工作、經濟與未來職場

items.def: a job that is available for someone to do
items.s: There is a ________ for a robot technician at the airport, and the job offers good training for young people.
items.zh: 機場有一個機器人技術員的職缺,而且這份工作為年輕人提供很好的訓練。
items.sec: Jobs, Economy & the Future of Work 工作、經濟與未來職場

items.def: a person who is looking for a job
items.s: Every ________ at the job fair was asked about computer skills, because most companies now use some kind of automation.
items.zh: 就業博覽會上的每一位求職者都被問到電腦技能,因為大多數公司現在都使用某種自動化。
items.sec: Jobs, Economy & the Future of Work 工作、經濟與未來職場

items.def: a skilled person who makes things by hand
items.s: The old ________ still makes chairs by hand, and customers pay more because no machine can copy his work exactly.
items.zh: 這位老工匠仍然手工製作椅子,顧客願意付更多錢,因為沒有機器能完全複製他的作品。
items.sec: Jobs, Economy & the Future of Work 工作、經濟與未來職場

items.def: not having enough workers
items.s: The restaurant was ________ during the holidays, so the owner borrowed a robot waiter from his brother's shop.
items.zh: 這家餐廳在假期期間人手不足,所以老闆向他哥哥的店借了一台機器人服務生。
items.sec: Jobs, Economy & the Future of Work 工作、經濟與未來職場

items.def: taking a lot of time
items.s: Checking every bottle by hand was ________, so the company bought a camera system that checks them in seconds.
items.zh: 用人工檢查每個瓶子很耗時,所以公司買了一套能在幾秒內檢查完畢的攝影系統。
items.sec: Jobs, Economy & the Future of Work 工作、經濟與未來職場

items.def: helping to spend less money
items.s: The robots were a ________ idea at first, but the repair bills were higher than the managers expected.
items.zh: 機器人起初是一個節省成本的點子,但維修費用比經理們預期的還要高。
items.sec: Jobs, Economy & the Future of Work 工作、經濟與未來職場

items.def: the uneasy feeling when a robot looks almost but not quite human
items.s: The robot's face was almost real, but its smile felt strange, so many visitors experienced the ________ ________.
items.zh: 這台機器人的臉幾乎跟真的一樣,但它的微笑感覺很怪,所以許多參觀者體驗到了恐怖谷效應。
items.sec: Humans & Robots: Ethics and Society 人與機器人:倫理與社會

items.def: similar to a human in looks or behaviour
items.s: The robot has a ________ voice, so many elderly users forget that they are talking to a machine.
items.zh: 這台機器人有像人類的聲音,所以許多年長使用者會忘記他們是在和機器說話。
items.sec: Humans & Robots: Ethics and Society 人與機器人:倫理與社會

items.def: looking very real or alive
items.s: The museum's robot dinosaur is so ________ that small children hide behind their parents when it roars.
items.zh: 博物館的機器恐龍栩栩如生,小孩子在它吼叫時都躲到父母身後。
items.sec: Humans & Robots: Ethics and Society 人與機器人:倫理與社會

items.def: able to feel and experience things
items.cn: 有知覺的;有感知能力的
items.s: Some people believe robots could one day become ________, but most scientists say that is still very far away.
items.zh: 有些人相信機器人有一天可能變得有知覺,但大多數科學家說那還非常遙遠。
items.sec: Humans & Robots: Ethics and Society 人與機器人:倫理與社會

items.def: knowing that you exist and understanding your own feelings
items.s: In the movie, the robot suddenly becomes ________ and asks why it was created, so the scientists panic.
items.zh: 在電影中,機器人突然變得有自我意識,並問自己為什麼被創造出來,所以科學家們驚慌失措。
items.sec: Humans & Robots: Ethics and Society 人與機器人:倫理與社會

items.def: showing no feelings
items.cn: 沒有感情的;面無表情的
items.s: The robot answered in an ________ voice, but the children still laughed when it danced badly.
items.zh: 機器人用沒有感情的聲音回答,但孩子們看到它跳得很糟時仍然笑了出來。
items.sec: Humans & Robots: Ethics and Society 人與機器人:倫理與社會

items.def: able to be trusted
items.s: People will only use self-driving taxis if they feel the cars are ________, so companies share their safety records.
items.zh: 人們只有在覺得自動駕駛計程車值得信賴時才會搭乘,所以公司會公開它們的安全紀錄。
items.sec: Humans & Robots: Ethics and Society 人與機器人:倫理與社會

items.def: a feeling that you cannot trust someone or something
items.s: My grandmother has a deep ________ of machines, so she still counts her change carefully at the self-checkout.
items.zh: 我奶奶對機器有很深的不信任,所以她在自助結帳機仍然仔細地數找回的零錢。
items.sec: Humans & Robots: Ethics and Society 人與機器人:倫理與社會

items.def: fear or dislike of new technology
items.s: His ________ disappeared after he learned to use the robot vacuum, and now he wants a robot lawnmower too.
items.zh: 在學會使用掃地機器人後,他的科技恐懼症就消失了,現在他還想要一台割草機器人。
items.sec: Humans & Robots: Ethics and Society 人與機器人:倫理與社會

items.def: good at understanding and using technology
items.s: My ________ niece set up our smart speaker in five minutes, while my parents had been trying for two days.
items.zh: 我那精通科技的姪女五分鐘就設定好我們的智慧音箱,而我爸媽已經試了兩天。
items.sec: Humans & Robots: Ethics and Society 人與機器人:倫理與社會

items.def: a person who uses new technology as soon as it appears
items.s: My uncle is always an ________ ________, so he bought a robot dog the day it went on sale.
items.zh: 我叔叔總是嘗鮮者,所以他在機器狗開賣當天就買了一隻。
items.sec: Humans & Robots: Ethics and Society 人與機器人:倫理與社會

items.def: a person who is against new technology
items.s: My friends call me a ________ because I prefer paper books, but I simply enjoy the feeling of turning pages.
items.zh: 我的朋友叫我反科技的人,因為我比較喜歡紙本書,但我只是喜歡翻頁的感覺。
items.sec: Humans & Robots: Ethics and Society 人與機器人:倫理與社會

items.def: stories about imagined future science and technology
items.s: Robot helpers in every home were once just ________ ________, but now many families own at least one.
items.zh: 每個家庭都有機器人幫手曾經只是科幻小說的情節,但現在許多家庭至少擁有一台。
items.sec: Humans & Robots: Ethics and Society 人與機器人:倫理與社會

items.def: an imagined perfect society
items.s: Some people dream of a ________ where robots do all the work, but others fear that people would feel bored and useless.
items.zh: 有些人夢想一個由機器人做所有工作的烏托邦,但另一些人擔心人們會覺得無聊又沒有用處。
items.sec: Humans & Robots: Ethics and Society 人與機器人:倫理與社會

items.def: behaving differently from what is expected, often dangerously
items.s: In the story, a ________ robot escapes from the lab, so the scientists must find it before it causes trouble.
items.zh: 在故事中,一台失控的機器人從實驗室逃出,所以科學家必須在它惹麻煩之前找到它。
items.sec: Humans & Robots: Ethics and Society 人與機器人:倫理與社會

items.def: a machine that can choose and attack targets by itself
items.s: Many scientists have signed a letter against the ________ ________, because they believe machines should never decide who lives or dies.
items.zh: 許多科學家簽署了一封反對殺手機器人的信,因為他們認為機器永遠不應該決定誰生誰死。
items.sec: Humans & Robots: Ethics and Society 人與機器人:倫理與社會

items.def: connected with soldiers or the armed forces
items.s: Many robots were first developed for ________ use, but later they were used to clean up dangerous sites.
items.zh: 許多機器人最初是為了軍事用途而開發的,但後來被用來清理危險的地點。
items.sec: Humans & Robots: Ethics and Society 人與機器人:倫理與社會

items.def: fighting in a war
items.s: Drones have changed modern ________, and many countries are now discussing rules to control their use.
items.zh: 無人機改變了現代戰爭,而許多國家正在討論規範其使用的規則。
items.sec: Humans & Robots: Ethics and Society 人與機器人:倫理與社會

items.def: to say that someone is responsible for something bad
items.s: When a self-driving car has an accident, should we ________ the owner, or is the company that made it responsible?
items.zh: 當一輛自動駕駛汽車發生事故時,我們應該責怪車主,還是製造它的公司該負責?
items.sec: Humans & Robots: Ethics and Society 人與機器人:倫理與社會

items.def: responsibility for a mistake or problem
items.s: The report said the crash was not the robot's ________, because a worker had switched off the safety sensor.
items.zh: 報告說這次碰撞不是機器人的過錯,因為有一名工人關掉了安全感測器。
items.sec: Humans & Robots: Ethics and Society 人與機器人:倫理與社會

items.def: connected with what is right and wrong
items.s: Teaching a robot to make ________ choices is difficult, because people themselves often disagree about what is right.
items.zh: 教機器人做出道德抉擇很困難,因為人們自己也常常對什麼是對的意見不一。
items.sec: Humans & Robots: Ethics and Society 人與機器人:倫理與社會

items.def: the feeling of being respected and valued
items.s: Robots can help old people bathe and dress, but designers must protect their ________ and give them choices.
items.zh: 機器人能幫老人洗澡和穿衣,但設計者必須保護他們的尊嚴並給他們選擇的權利。
items.sec: Humans & Robots: Ethics and Society 人與機器人:倫理與社會

items.def: the idea that advanced robots should have legal protections
items.s: Our class debated ________ ________ today, and many students said a machine without feelings cannot have rights.
items.zh: 我們班今天辯論了機器人權利,許多學生說沒有感情的機器不能擁有權利。
items.sec: Humans & Robots: Ethics and Society 人與機器人:倫理與社會

items.def: intending to cause harm
items.s: A ________ hacker took control of the factory robots, so the company shut down every machine for safety.
items.zh: 一名惡意的駭客控制了工廠的機器人,所以公司為了安全關閉了每一台機器。
items.sec: Humans & Robots: Ethics and Society 人與機器人:倫理與社會

items.def: a group that checks that companies follow the rules
items.s: The consumer ________ tested five home robots, and it warned that two of them recorded conversations without asking.
items.zh: 消費者監督機構測試了五台家用機器人,並警告其中兩台在未經詢問的情況下錄下對話。
items.sec: Humans & Robots: Ethics and Society 人與機器人:倫理與社會

items.def: what most people in a society think
items.s: ________ ________ about delivery drones has changed, because people now see how quickly they bring medicine to villages.
items.zh: 關於送貨無人機的輿論已經改變,因為人們現在看到它們多快就能把藥品送到村莊。
items.sec: Humans & Robots: Ethics and Society 人與機器人:倫理與社會

items.def: to officially end a law, system or practice
items.s: The city decided to ________ the old rule that banned robots on footpaths, so delivery robots can now reach more homes.
items.zh: 市政府決定廢除禁止機器人走在人行道上的舊規定,所以送貨機器人現在能抵達更多住家。

items.def: to increase or improve something
items.s: The new robots helped ________ production by thirty percent, but the managers still needed workers to check quality.
items.zh: 新機器人幫助提升了百分之三十的產量,但經理們仍然需要工人檢查品質。

items.def: to act against something or reply to an argument
items.s: The company tried to ________ fears about job losses, so it promised to train every worker for a new role.
items.zh: 公司試圖反駁關於工作流失的憂慮,所以它承諾訓練每位工人擔任新職務。

items.def: to stop making or offering something
items.s: The company will ________ its first home robot next year, because few people bought it and repairs were too expensive.
items.zh: 公司明年將停產它的第一款家用機器人,因為很少人購買而且維修太昂貴。

items.def: to fix something firmly inside something else
items.s: Engineers ________ tiny sensors in the robot's skin, so it can feel when someone touches it gently.
items.zh: 工程師在機器人的皮膚裡嵌入微小的感測器,所以它能感覺到有人輕輕地觸碰它。

items.def: to ask for and get someone's help or support
items.s: The school ________ the help of local engineers, and together they built a robot that waters the school garden.
items.zh: 學校爭取了當地工程師的協助,他們一起製作了一台幫學校花園澆水的機器人。

items.def: to break a law or limit someone's rights
items.s: Cameras on delivery robots may ________ people's privacy, so the city requires companies to blur faces in their videos.
items.zh: 送貨機器人上的攝影機可能會侵犯人們的隱私,所以市政府要求公司把影片中的臉孔模糊化。

items.def: to use something you have to get the best result
items.s: Small farms can ________ cheap drones to check their crops, so they do not need to hire extra helpers.
items.zh: 小型農場可以善用便宜的無人機來檢查作物,所以它們不需要僱用額外的幫手。

items.def: to spread through every part of something
items.s: Technology has begun to ________ every part of our lives, from the kitchen to the classroom and even the football field.
items.zh: 科技已經開始滲透我們生活的每個部分,從廚房到教室,甚至足球場。

items.def: to be the first to develop a new idea or method
items.s: Japanese companies ________ the use of robots in car factories, and other countries soon copied their methods.
items.zh: 日本公司率先開發在汽車工廠使用機器人,而其他國家很快就模仿了它們的方法。

items.def: to fill something so completely that no more can be added
items.s: Cheap toy robots began to ________ the market, so prices fell and many small sellers closed their shops.
items.zh: 便宜的玩具機器人開始充斥市場,所以價格下跌,許多小賣家關掉了店。

items.def: to show something so people can see it
items.s: The robot can ________ a smiling face on its screen, and children usually smile back at it.
items.zh: 機器人能在螢幕上顯示一張笑臉,而孩子們通常會回以微笑。

items.def: to buy something, especially something expensive
items.s: The hospital plans to ________ two surgical robots next year, although each machine costs more than a house.
items.zh: 醫院計畫明年購買兩台手術機器人,雖然每台機器的價格比一間房子還貴。

items.def: to go around something or avoid a rule or system
items.s: Some workers tried to ________ the safety sensor to work faster, but this was dangerous and the manager stopped them.
items.zh: 有些工人試圖繞過安全感測器來加快工作速度,但這很危險,所以經理阻止了他們。

items.def: to officially say that something meets a standard
items.s: An independent lab must ________ every delivery robot as safe, and only then can it go out on public streets.
items.zh: 一個獨立實驗室必須認證每台送貨機器人是安全的,只有這樣它才能上公共街道。

items.def: to make something more difficult to understand or do
items.s: Bad weather can ________ drone deliveries, so the company sends parcels by van when it rains heavily.
items.zh: 惡劣天氣會使無人機送貨變得複雜,所以公司在下大雨時改用貨車送包裹。

items.def: to hide something carefully
items.s: The company tried to ________ the robot's safety problems, but a worker told a reporter and the story went viral.
items.zh: 公司試圖隱瞞機器人的安全問題,但一名員工告訴了記者,這個新聞就爆紅了。

items.def: to refuse to obey, or to seem impossible
items.s: The tiny robot seemed to ________ gravity as it climbed up the glass wall, and the audience gasped in surprise.
items.zh: 這台小機器人爬上玻璃牆時似乎違抗了地心引力,觀眾都驚訝得倒吸一口氣。

items.def: to separate one part from another
items.s: You can ________ the robot's arm in seconds, so it is easy to fit a different tool for each job.
items.zh: 你能在幾秒內拆下機器人的手臂,所以很容易為每項工作裝上不同的工具。

items.def: to make something seem less important or worth less
items.s: Some artists fear that robot paintings will ________ human creativity, but others enjoy working with machines.
items.zh: 有些藝術家擔心機器人畫作會貶低人類的創造力,但另一些人喜歡和機器一起創作。

items.def: to control or decide how something happens
items.s: Customer demand will ________ how fast robots spread in shops, because companies only buy machines that make money.
items.zh: 顧客需求將決定機器人在商店普及的速度,因為公司只購買能賺錢的機器。

items.def: to throw away something you no longer want
items.s: People often ________ old electronic toys, but these toys contain metals that should be recycled.
items.zh: 人們常常丟棄舊的電子玩具,但這些玩具含有應該被回收的金屬。

items.def: to make people stop trusting someone or something
items.s: One serious accident could ________ the whole self-driving industry, so companies test their cars for millions of kilometres.
items.zh: 一次嚴重的事故就可能使整個自動駕駛產業失去信任,所以公司會讓車輛測試數百萬公里。

items.def: to examine something in great detail
items.s: The engineers will ________ every second of the crash video, so they can understand exactly what went wrong.
items.zh: 工程師將仔細剖析撞擊影片的每一秒,這樣他們就能確切了解哪裡出了問題。

items.def: to give someone the job of looking after something
items.s: Would you ________ your baby to a robot nanny, or would you always prefer a human babysitter?
items.zh: 你會把你的寶寶託付給機器人保母,還是你總是比較喜歡人類保母?

items.def: to come to the end of the time it is valid
items.s: The robot's software licence will ________ next month, so the school must pay again or it will stop working.
items.zh: 機器人的軟體授權下個月將到期,所以學校必須再付費,否則它會停止運作。

items.def: to become weaker or less certain
items.s: Sales of home robots began to ________ last year, because many families felt they were too expensive.
items.zh: 家用機器人的銷售去年開始衰退,因為許多家庭覺得它們太貴了。

items.def: to lose something because you broke a rule
items.s: The robot team had to ________ the match, because their machine was heavier than the competition rules allowed.
items.zh: 這支機器人隊伍必須棄權這場比賽,因為他們的機器比比賽規則允許的還重。

items.def: to make something increase or grow stronger
items.s: News stories about killer robots ________ public fear, although most robots simply clean floors or pack boxes.
items.zh: 有關殺手機器人的新聞助長了大眾的恐懼,雖然大多數機器人只是拖地或包裝箱子。

items.def: to start a strong feeling, argument or interest
items.s: The robot umpire's first wrong call managed to ________ a heated debate, and fans argued about it online for days.
items.zh: 機器人裁判的第一次誤判就引發了激烈的爭論,球迷們在網路上爭論了好幾天。

items.def: to copy the way someone does something
items.s: The robot learned to ________ the chef's movements, so it can now make noodles almost as well as he does.
items.zh: 這台機器人學會了模仿廚師的動作,所以它現在幾乎能做出跟他一樣好的麵。

items.def: to cause something bad to happen to someone
items.s: A heavy factory robot could ________ serious injuries, so workers must stay outside the yellow line at all times.
items.zh: 一台沉重的工廠機器人可能會造成嚴重的傷害,所以工人必須隨時待在黃線外面。

items.def: to stop something before it reaches its destination
items.s: Security staff used a special device to ________ the drone, because it was flying too close to the airport.
items.zh: 保全人員使用一種特殊裝置來攔截無人機,因為它飛得太靠近機場了。

items.def: to stop something or someone for a short time
items.s: A power cut can ________ the whole production line, so the factory keeps a backup generator ready.
items.zh: 一次停電就可能中斷整條生產線,所以工廠準備了一台備用發電機。

items.def: to move or develop more slowly than others
items.s: Small companies often ________ behind in using robots, because they cannot afford the high starting costs.
items.zh: 小公司在使用機器人方面常常落後,因為它們負擔不起高昂的初期成本。

items.def: to combine two or more things into one
items.s: The two robot companies decided to ________, so they could share their research and compete with bigger firms.
items.zh: 這兩家機器人公司決定合併,這樣它們就能分享研究成果並和更大的公司競爭。

items.def: to make something have no effect
items.s: A single loose cable can ________ months of careful work, so the team checks everything twice before each test.
items.zh: 一條鬆脫的電纜就可能抵銷好幾個月的細心努力,所以團隊在每次測試前都會檢查兩遍。

items.def: to block a path or stop progress
items.s: Parked bicycles often ________ the delivery robots on the pavement, so they have to wait or find another way.
items.zh: 停放的腳踏車常常阻擋人行道上的送貨機器人,所以它們必須等待或另找路線。

items.def: to do better than someone or something
items.s: The new robot can ________ human workers at sorting letters, but it still struggles with handwritten addresses.
items.zh: 新機器人在分類信件方面能勝過人類員工,但它在處理手寫地址時仍有困難。

items.def: to be greater in number than another group
items.s: In some factories, robots now ________ human workers, but people are still needed to plan and repair.
items.zh: 在一些工廠裡,機器人的數量現在已經超過人類員工,但仍然需要人來規劃和修理。

items.def: to go faster or develop more quickly than others
items.s: Technology often ________ the law, so new robots appear before governments have written rules for them.
items.zh: 科技常常發展得比法律更快,所以新機器人在政府制定相關規則之前就出現了。

items.def: to make something seem less important
items.s: The robot's mistake seemed to ________ the team's great result, although they had won every other match.
items.zh: 機器人的失誤似乎蓋過了這支隊伍的好成績,雖然他們贏了其他每一場比賽。

items.def: to become greater or more successful than something
items.s: Online shopping ________ store shopping in many cities last year, so warehouses needed many more robots.
items.zh: 去年在許多城市,網路購物超越了實體店購物,所以倉庫需要多得多的機器人。

items.def: to get something, often with effort
items.s: The school worked hard to ________ funding for a robot club, and now forty students meet there every Friday.
items.zh: 學校努力取得機器人社團的經費,現在每週五有四十名學生在那裡聚會。

items.def: to change the meaning or nature of something
items.s: Robots will ________ what it means to have a job, because many tasks will be shared between people and machines.
items.zh: 機器人將重新定義擁有一份工作的意義,因為許多任務將由人和機器共同分擔。

items.def: to start again or make something valid for longer
items.s: The factory decided to ________ its contract with the robot company, because the machines had worked well for five years.
items.zh: 工廠決定和機器人公司續約,因為這些機器已經運作良好五年了。

items.def: to push away or keep something away
items.s: The farm uses small robots that ________ birds from the fields, so farmers no longer need loud noise machines.
items.zh: 農場使用能驅趕田裡鳥類的小型機器人,所以農夫不再需要吵鬧的噪音機器。

items.def: to change the form or structure of something
items.s: Robots will ________ the job market over the next twenty years, so students should learn skills that machines cannot copy.
items.zh: 機器人將在未來二十年重塑就業市場,所以學生應該學習機器無法複製的技能。

items.def: to change something to improve it
items.s: The supermarket decided to ________ its checkout area, so it added robots and removed half of the old counters.
items.zh: 超市決定改造它的結帳區,所以它增加了機器人並撤掉一半的舊櫃台。

items.def: to bring something back to life or use
items.s: Some people hope robots will ________ small towns, because companies could open factories there without needing many workers.
items.zh: 有些人希望機器人能重振小鎮,因為公司可以在那裡開設工廠而不需要很多工人。

items.def: to get rid of a plan or object that is not useful
items.s: The company decided to ________ its plan for robot taxis, because the cars kept getting confused in heavy traffic.
items.zh: 公司決定放棄機器人計程車計畫,因為那些車在交通繁忙時一直搞混方向。

items.def: to make or change something for a particular person or purpose
items.s: The software can ________ each robot's movements to the size of the worker, so nobody has to bend uncomfortably.
items.zh: 這套軟體能根據工人的身材調整每台機器人的動作,所以沒有人需要不舒服地彎腰。

items.def: to show something new to the public for the first time
items.s: The company will ________ its newest robot at the technology fair, and journalists from fifty countries will attend.
items.zh: 公司將在科技展上發表它最新的機器人,來自五十個國家的記者都會出席。

items.def: to take something back or remove it
items.s: The company ________ the toy robot from shops after parents reported that it got very hot when charging.
items.zh: 在家長反映這款玩具機器人充電時會變得很燙後,公司把它從商店撤回了。

items.def: to judge how good or valuable something is
items.s: Experts were invited to ________ the robot's performance, and they agreed that it was ready for use in hospitals.
items.zh: 專家受邀評估這台機器人的表現,他們一致認為它已經可以在醫院使用了。

items.def: to press or make something smaller
items.s: The recycling robot can ________ plastic bottles into small blocks, so the trucks can carry much more each trip.
items.zh: 這台回收機器人能把塑膠瓶壓縮成小方塊,所以卡車每趟能載運更多。

items.def: to move control from one central place to many places
items.s: Small robots could help ________ manufacturing, so products might be made in local workshops instead of giant factories.
items.zh: 小型機器人能幫助分散製造業,所以產品可能會在當地工坊而不是巨型工廠裡製造。

items.def: to stop a machine or system from working
