items.s: Workers must ________ the robot before they enter its area, or it could start moving without warning.
items.zh: 工人進入機器人的區域前必須先將它停用,否則它可能會毫無預警地開始移動。

items.def: to make something bigger
items.s: The factory plans to ________ its robot testing area, because the new machines are much bigger than the old ones.
items.zh: 工廠計畫擴大機器人測試區,因為新機器比舊機器大得多。

items.def: to carry out a plan, order or task
items.s: The robot can ________ hundreds of tiny movements every minute, and it never loses concentration like tired workers do.
items.zh: 這台機器人每分鐘能執行數百個細微動作,而且它從不像疲倦的工人那樣分心。

items.def: to say that someone must not do something
items.s: The park rules ________ flying drones near the children's playground, so we took ours to an open field instead.
items.zh: 公園的規定禁止在兒童遊樂場附近放無人機,所以我們把我們的帶到一片空地去。

items.def: to stop something completely
items.s: The factory had to ________ production for a week, because a computer virus had attacked the robots' software.
items.zh: 工廠必須停止生產一星期,因為電腦病毒攻擊了機器人的軟體。

items.def: to stay in the air in one place
items.s: The drone can ________ above the building for twenty minutes, and it sends pictures of the roof to the repair team.
items.zh: 這架無人機能在大樓上方懸停二十分鐘,並把屋頂的照片傳給維修團隊。

items.def: to move something carefully through a difficult space
items.s: The delivery robot must ________ around people and dogs on busy pavements, so it moves slowly in crowded areas.
items.zh: 送貨機器人必須在繁忙的人行道上繞過行人和狗靈活移動,所以它在擁擠區域行進得很慢。

items.def: to fix something onto a wall, stand or vehicle
items.s: The workers will ________ a camera on top of the robot, so it can see over the boxes in front of it.
items.zh: 工人將在機器人頂部安裝一台攝影機,這樣它就能看到前方箱子的另一邊。

items.def: to say officially what must be done
items.s: Safety laws ________ how far workers must stand from moving robots, and inspectors check this every year.
items.zh: 安全法規規定工人必須和移動中的機器人保持多遠的距離,而檢查員每年都會查核。

items.def: to get something back after losing it
items.s: After the stroke, my grandmother used a robot glove to ________ the use of her hand, and now she can write again.
items.zh: 中風後,我奶奶使用機器人手套來恢復手部功能,現在她又能寫字了。

items.def: to change something so much that it seems completely new
items.s: The camera company had to ________ itself when phones replaced cameras, so it started making parts for robots.
items.zh: 當手機取代相機時,這家相機公司必須徹底改造自己,於是它開始製造機器人零件。

items.def: to start again after a pause
items.s: The match will ________ after the referee checks the video, so the players are waiting in the middle of the field.
items.zh: 比賽將在裁判檢查影片後恢復進行,所以球員們正在球場中央等待。

items.def: to turn around a central point
items.s: The robot's wrist can ________ in a full circle, so it can screw lids onto jars faster than any worker.
items.zh: 機器人的手腕能旋轉一整圈,所以它把蓋子轉緊在罐子上的速度比任何工人都快。

items.def: to give up something valuable for something more important
items.s: Some companies ________ quality for speed, but customers soon notice the problems and stop buying their products.
items.zh: 有些公司為了速度而犧牲品質,但顧客很快就會注意到問題並停止購買他們的產品。

items.def: to protect someone or something from harm
items.s: The robot's metal cover ________ its electronic parts from dust, so it can work in dirty factories for years.
items.zh: 機器人的金屬外殼保護它的電子零件不受灰塵影響,所以它能在骯髒的工廠裡工作好幾年。

items.def: to make something stronger
items.s: The government wants to ________ safety rules for drones, because several have crashed into homes this year.
items.zh: 政府想要加強無人機的安全規範,因為今年已有好幾架撞進民宅。

items.def: to discover something that was hidden
items.s: Reporters managed to ________ the truth about the robot accident, and the company was forced to apologise.
items.zh: 記者成功揭露了機器人事故的真相,公司被迫道歉。

items.def: to make something less strong
items.s: Cheap robots from abroad could ________ local factories, so the government is offering them money to modernise.
items.zh: 來自國外的便宜機器人可能會削弱本地工廠,所以政府提供資金幫助它們現代化。

items.def: to continue working or living longer than something else
items.s: These robot batteries ________ the old ones by several hours, so the machines can work through a whole night shift.
items.zh: 這些機器人電池比舊電池更持久好幾個小時,所以機器能撐過整個夜班。

items.def: progress or development in something
items.s: Recent ________ in battery technology have made robots lighter, and they can now work longer without charging.
items.zh: 近來電池技術的進步讓機器人變得更輕,而且它們現在不必充電就能工作更久。

items.def: a large group or range of things
items.s: The robot carries an ________ of sensors on its head, so it can measure heat, light and sound at the same time.
items.zh: 這台機器人頭上搭載了一系列感測器,所以它能同時測量熱度、光線和聲音。

items.def: something or someone that is useful and valuable
items.s: The robot became a real ________ to the small bakery, because it could knead dough while the baker served customers.
items.zh: 這台機器人成為小麵包店真正的資產,因為它能在麵包師傅招呼顧客時揉麵團。

items.def: a point where things slow down and cause delays
items.s: Packing was the main ________ in the warehouse, so the manager bought two robots to speed it up.
items.zh: 包裝是倉庫裡主要的瓶頸,所以經理買了兩台機器人來加快速度。

items.def: the end or failure of something
items.s: Many people predicted the ________ of the bank teller, but most banks still keep some staff to help customers.
items.zh: 許多人預測銀行櫃員會消失,但大多數銀行仍然保留一些員工來協助顧客。

items.def: the spreading of something over a wide area or among many people
items.s: The ________ of robots into small businesses has been slow, because the machines are still quite expensive.
items.zh: 機器人在小型企業中的普及一直很緩慢,因為這些機器仍然相當昂貴。

items.def: the act of supplying something people need
items.s: The ________ of free robot training for workers is important, because it helps them find new jobs quickly.
items.zh: 為工人提供免費的機器人訓練很重要,因為這能幫助他們很快找到新工作。

items.def: a way of sending information or goods
items.s: The company uses social media as its main ________ for robot news, so fans can watch new videos every week.
items.zh: 公司把社群媒體當作機器人新聞的主要管道,所以粉絲每週都能看到新影片。

items.def: a part of a contract or legal document
items.s: The contract includes a ________ about robot accidents, so both companies know who must pay if something goes wrong.
items.zh: 合約中包含一條關於機器人事故的條款,所以兩家公司都知道出事時由誰負責賠償。

items.def: a written legal agreement between people or companies
items.s: The robot company signed a ________ with the airport, and its robots will clean the floors for the next three years.
items.zh: 這家機器人公司和機場簽了一份合約,它的機器人將在未來三年清潔地板。

items.def: the money used in a country
items.s: The robot at the airport can exchange ________ for travellers, and it shows the rate clearly on its screen.
items.zh: 機場的機器人能為旅客兌換貨幣,並在螢幕上清楚地顯示匯率。

items.def: the way something is planned and made
items.s: The robot's simple ________ makes it easy to repair, so even school students can replace its broken parts.
items.zh: 這台機器人簡單的設計讓它很容易修理,所以連學生都能更換它壞掉的零件。

items.def: the conditions and surroundings where something works
items.s: Robots work well in a controlled ________ like a factory, but they still struggle on rocky ground or in heavy rain.
items.zh: 機器人在像工廠這樣受控的環境中運作良好,但它們在崎嶇地面或大雨中仍有困難。

items.def: money, or the management of money
items.s: The start-up needed more ________ to build its farming robots, so it asked several investors for help.
items.zh: 這家新創公司需要更多資金來製造農業機器人,所以它向幾位投資人尋求協助。

items.def: a stage in the development of a product
items.s: The latest ________ of robot vacuums can climb small steps, so they can clean several rooms without help.
items.zh: 最新一代的掃地機器人能爬上小台階,所以它們不需協助就能打掃好幾個房間。

items.def: a machine that carries people or goods, like a car
items.s: The robot ________ carries food around the university campus, and students order it from an app on their phones.
items.zh: 這輛機器人車輛在大學校園裡運送食物,學生用手機上的應用程式點餐。

items.def: public praise for something
items.s: The young inventors won international ________ for their cheap robot hand, and hospitals in many countries now use it.
items.zh: 這些年輕發明家以他們便宜的機器手贏得了國際讚譽,現在許多國家的醫院都在使用它。

items.def: an enemy or opponent
items.s: The chess robot was a tough ________, but the young player studied its moves and finally beat it.
items.zh: 這台下棋機器人是一個難纏的對手,但這位年輕棋手研究了它的棋路,最後打敗了它。

items.def: a large place for sports or shows; an area of activity
items.s: The robot fighting competition was held in a huge ________, and thousands of fans shouted for their favourite machines.
items.zh: 機器人格鬥比賽在一座巨大的競技場舉行,數千名粉絲為他們最喜愛的機器吶喊。

items.def: a strong negative reaction from many people
items.s: There was a public ________ when the supermarket replaced all its cashiers, so it brought some of them back.
items.zh: 當超市取代所有收銀員時引發了大眾的強烈反彈,所以它讓其中一些人回來工作。

items.def: a group of similar things close together
items.s: A ________ of robot companies has grown up around the university, because they want to hire its graduates.
items.zh: 一群機器人公司在大學周圍發展起來,因為它們想僱用該校的畢業生。

items.def: a group of companies working together on a project
items.s: A ________ of car makers is developing a shared system for self-driving cars, so they can all save money.
items.zh: 一個汽車製造商聯盟正在開發共用的自動駕駛系統,這樣它們全都能省錢。

items.def: a confusing and difficult problem
items.s: Self-driving cars face a moral ________: should they protect the passenger or the person crossing the road?
items.zh: 自動駕駛汽車面臨一個道德難題:它們應該保護乘客還是過馬路的人?

items.def: a situation where no progress can be made because people disagree
items.s: The talks about robot rules reached a ________, because neither the companies nor the workers would change their position.
items.zh: 關於機器人規範的談判陷入了僵局,因為公司和工人雙方都不願改變立場。

items.def: a meeting or website where people discuss ideas
items.s: The city held a public ________ about delivery robots, and many residents shared their worries about safety.
items.zh: 市政府舉辦了一場關於送貨機器人的公開論壇,許多居民分享了他們對安全的擔憂。

items.def: disagreement between people; or rubbing between surfaces
items.s: The new robots caused some ________ between managers and workers, so the company held meetings to listen to everyone.
items.zh: 新機器人在經理和工人之間造成了一些摩擦,所以公司舉行會議聆聽每個人的意見。

items.def: a typical feature that shows what something is like
items.s: Smooth, quiet movement is the ________ of a well-designed robot, and engineers spend years trying to achieve it.
items.zh: 流暢安靜的動作是設計精良的機器人的特點,而工程師花了好幾年試圖做到這一點。

items.def: a problem you must solve before you can make progress
items.s: Cost is still the biggest ________ for home robots, but prices are falling a little every year.
items.zh: 價格仍然是家用機器人最大的障礙,但價格每年都在稍微下降。

items.def: the start of an organisation or activity
items.s: Since its ________ in 2015, the robot club has grown from five members to more than a hundred.
items.zh: 自從2015年創立以來,這個機器人社團已經從五名成員成長到一百多人。

items.def: one of the things needed to make something successful
items.s: Teamwork was the key ________ in our robot project, because nobody could build every part alone.
items.zh: 團隊合作是我們機器人專題中的關鍵要素,因為沒有人能獨自製作每個零件。

items.def: the official power to make legal decisions in an area
items.s: Drone rules differ in each ________, so pilots must check the local laws before they fly in a new city.
items.zh: 每個管轄區的無人機規定都不同,所以操作者在新城市飛行前必須查看當地法規。

items.def: an important event or step in development
items.s: The first robot surgery was a ________ in medical history, and it encouraged hospitals around the world to try the technology.
items.zh: 第一次機器人手術是醫學史上的一個里程碑,它鼓勵了世界各地的醫院嘗試這項技術。

items.def: something left behind from the past that still has effects
items.s: The old factory's ________ is still visible in the town, but now the building is used as a robot museum.
items.zh: 老工廠的遺留影響在鎮上仍然可見,但現在這棟建築被用作機器人博物館。

items.def: complete control of a market by one company
items.s: One company had a ________ on surgical robots for years, so hospitals had to pay whatever price it asked.
items.zh: 一家公司多年來壟斷了手術機器人市場,所以醫院必須支付它開出的任何價格。

items.def: the money spent on something, especially at the start
items.s: The initial ________ for the robots was high, but the farm saved money on labour within three years.
items.zh: 購買機器人的初期支出很高,但農場在三年內就在人力成本上省回了錢。

items.def: the state of being equal
items.s: Robots have nearly reached ________ with humans at sorting fruit, but they are still slower at picking delicate berries.
items.zh: 機器人在水果分類方面幾乎已經和人類達到同等水準,但在採摘嬌嫩的莓果時仍然比較慢。

items.def: an official right to be the only one to make an invention
items.s: The student applied for a ________ on her robot design, because she did not want big companies to copy it.
items.zh: 這位學生為她的機器人設計申請了專利,因為她不想讓大公司抄襲。

items.def: a hidden problem or danger
items.s: One ________ of home robots is that they collect a lot of data, so users should check the privacy settings carefully.
items.zh: 家用機器人的一個隱患是它們會收集大量資料,所以使用者應該仔細檢查隱私設定。

items.def: something done to prevent harm in the future
items.s: As a safety ________, all workers wear bright vests, so the robots can see them clearly in the warehouse.
items.zh: 作為安全預防措施,所有工人都穿著鮮豔的背心,這樣機器人在倉庫裡就能清楚地看到他們。

items.def: an area of activity or interest
items.s: Robots that cook full meals are no longer in the ________ of fantasy, because several restaurants already use them.
items.zh: 能烹煮整頓飯的機器人不再屬於幻想的範疇,因為已經有幾家餐廳在使用它們。

items.def: a person or group affected by a decision
items.s: Every ________, including workers, customers and neighbours, was invited to give opinions before the robot factory was built.
items.zh: 每一位利害關係人,包括工人、顧客和鄰居,都在機器人工廠興建前受邀提供意見。

items.def: a way of looking at or judging a situation
items.s: From a safety ________, robots are a great help, but from a social one, they raise difficult questions.
items.zh: 從安全的觀點來看,機器人是很大的幫助,但從社會的觀點來看,它們引發了困難的問題。

items.def: the extra power produced when people or things work together
items.s: There is real ________ between the nurses and the robots, because each does what it is best at.
items.zh: 護理師和機器人之間有真正的協同作用,因為各自做自己最擅長的事。

items.def: a big change that causes confusion or difficulty
items.s: The arrival of robots caused great ________ in the town, so many families moved away to find new jobs.
items.zh: 機器人的到來在小鎮引起了巨大的動盪,所以許多家庭搬走去找新工作。

items.def: the quality of being useful
items.s: The ________ of a robot depends on the job it does, so a cheap cleaning robot may be more valuable than a fancy one.
items.zh: 一台機器人的實用性取決於它所做的工作,所以一台便宜的清潔機器人可能比一台花俏的更有價值。

items.def: a new business activity that involves risk
items.s: Their robot delivery ________ failed in the first year, but they learned a lot and started a better company later.
items.zh: 他們的機器人送貨事業在第一年就失敗了,但他們學到很多,後來創立了一家更好的公司。

items.def: an opinion or decision after testing or judging something
items.s: The teachers' ________ on the classroom robot was positive, although they said it needed a quieter voice.
items.zh: 老師們對教室機器人的評價是正面的,雖然他們說它需要更小聲一點的聲音。

items.def: a particular way of thinking about something
items.s: From the customer's ________, robot waiters are fun, but many restaurant workers see them as a threat to their jobs.
items.zh: 從顧客的觀點來看,機器人服務生很有趣,但許多餐廳員工把它們視為對工作的威脅。

items.def: the area near a particular place
items.s: Drones are not allowed in the ________ of the airport, so the police stopped a man who was flying one there.
items.zh: 機場附近不允許無人機飛行,所以警察攔下了一名在那裡放無人機的男子。

items.def: a list of things to discuss or plans to carry out
items.s: Robot safety was at the top of the meeting's ________, because a worker had been hurt the week before.
items.zh: 機器人安全排在會議議程的首位,因為前一週有一名工人受傷了。

items.def: the period after a bad event
items.s: In the ________ of the earthquake, rescue robots searched the broken buildings, so firefighters could stay out of danger.
items.zh: 在地震的餘波中,救援機器人搜尋倒塌的建築物,所以消防員可以遠離危險。

items.def: a failure of a machine to work
items.s: A ________ in the main robot stopped the whole line, so the company now keeps a spare machine ready.
items.zh: 主要機器人的故障讓整條生產線停擺,所以公司現在會準備一台備用機器。

items.def: the reporting of news about something
items.s: The robot football match got a lot of media ________, and our school's team appeared on the evening news.
items.zh: 這場機器人足球賽得到很多媒體報導,而我們學校的隊伍出現在晚間新聞上。

items.def: an impressive achievement that needs skill or strength
items.s: Running a full marathon was an amazing ________ for a robot, although it needed three battery changes along the way.
items.zh: 跑完一場全程馬拉松對機器人來說是驚人的壯舉,雖然它途中需要換三次電池。

items.def: film or video of an event
items.s: Video ________ showed that the robot had stopped in time, so the company was not blamed for the accident.
items.zh: 錄影畫面顯示機器人及時停下,所以公司沒有因這次事故而被責怪。

items.def: a short description of the main points
items.s: The teacher gave us a quick ________ of robot history, and then we watched a video of the first factory robots.
items.zh: 老師給我們一個簡短的機器人歷史概述,然後我們觀看了第一批工廠機器人的影片。

items.def: the highest point of achievement
items.s: Winning the world robot championship was the ________ of her career, but she still enjoys teaching beginners.
items.zh: 贏得世界機器人錦標賽是她職涯的巔峰,但她仍然喜歡教初學者。

items.def: a range of products, or a collection of someone's work
items.s: The company's ________ includes robots for farms, hospitals and homes, so it does not depend on a single market.
items.zh: 這家公司的產品組合包括農場、醫院和家庭用的機器人,所以它不依賴單一市場。

items.def: an idea, offer or plan to consider
items.s: A robot that costs less than a phone is an attractive ________, but customers want to know how long it will last.
items.zh: 一台比手機還便宜的機器人是很有吸引力的提議,但顧客想知道它能用多久。

items.def: a person or company competing with another
items.s: Our school's main ________ won the robot contest last year, so we practised every weekend to beat them this time.
items.zh: 我們學校的主要競爭對手去年贏得了機器人比賽,所以我們每個週末都練習,這次要打敗他們。

items.def: an event that shows the best qualities of something
items.s: The technology fair is a ________ for young inventors, and many of them get job offers after the event.
items.zh: 這個科技展是年輕發明家的展示舞台,許多人在活動後得到工作機會。

items.def: an act of buying or selling something
items.s: Each ________ at the robot shop is recorded on the computer, so the owner knows exactly what sold each day.
items.zh: 機器人商店的每一筆交易都記錄在電腦上,所以老闆確切知道每天賣出了什麼。

items.def: the rate at which workers leave and are replaced
items.s: The warehouse had high staff ________ because the work was boring, so the managers brought in robots for the dullest jobs.
items.zh: 這間倉庫因為工作枯燥而人員流動率很高,所以經理們引進機器人來做最乏味的工作。

items.def: the cost or work of keeping something in good condition
items.s: The ________ of the robots costs the hotel a lot each year, so it is not sure the machines really save money.
items.zh: 機器人的維護費用每年讓飯店花不少錢,所以飯店不確定這些機器是否真的省錢。

items.def: a standard used to judge or compare things
items.s: Speed is not the only ________ for a good robot, because safety and reliability are just as important.
items.zh: 速度不是衡量好機器人的唯一標準,因為安全性和可靠度同樣重要。

items.def: a secure position from which to make progress
items.s: The young company gained a ________ in the Asian market, and now it sells cleaning robots in ten countries.
items.zh: 這家年輕的公司在亞洲市場取得了立足點,現在它在十個國家銷售清潔機器人。

items.def: affecting or relevant to a person or situation
items.s: The new safety rules are ________ to all robots in public places, so delivery robots must now carry warning lights.
items.zh: 新的安全規定適用於公共場所的所有機器人,所以送貨機器人現在必須配備警示燈。

items.def: connected with buying, selling and making money
items.s: The robot was first built for research, but now the company sells it for ________ use in shops and hotels.
items.zh: 這台機器人最初是為了研究而製造的,但現在公司把它賣給商店和飯店作商業用途。

items.def: usual or traditional in a situation
items.s: It is ________ to thank the shopkeeper in our town, so some people even say thank you to the robot at the till.
items.zh: 在我們鎮上感謝店主是慣例,所以有些人甚至會對收銀台的機器人說謝謝。

items.def: made of separate parts that can be joined or replaced
items.s: The robot has a ________ design, so if one part breaks, you can change that piece instead of buying a new robot.
items.zh: 這台機器人採用模組化設計,所以如果一個零件壞了,你可以更換那一塊而不用買新機器人。

items.def: connected with trade, industry and money
items.s: Robots bring clear ________ benefits to factories, but governments must also think about the workers who lose their jobs.
items.zh: 機器人為工廠帶來明顯的經濟效益,但政府也必須考慮失去工作的工人。

items.def: connected with the body or real objects
items.s: Robots can take over the most tiring ________ work, so older employees can stay in their jobs for longer.
items.zh: 機器人能接手最累人的體力工作,所以年長員工能在職位上待得更久。

items.def: connected with practical skills or machines
items.s: The robot stopped because of a ________ problem, but the engineer fixed it quickly and the show continued.
items.zh: 機器人因為一個技術問題而停下,但工程師很快就修好了,表演繼續進行。

items.def: able to be changed to suit different needs
items.s: The robot desk has an ________ height, so both short and tall students can use it comfortably.
items.zh: 這張機器人桌子的高度是可調整的,所以矮個子和高個子的學生都能舒服地使用。

items.def: causing worry or fear
items.s: The report showed an ________ number of drone accidents near schools, so the city introduced stricter rules.
items.zh: 報告顯示學校附近的無人機事故數量令人擔憂,所以市政府實施了更嚴格的規定。

items.def: large and difficult to carry or move
items.s: Early robots were ________ and slow, but modern ones are small enough to fit under a kitchen table.
items.zh: 早期的機器人既笨重又緩慢,但現代的機器人小到可以放在廚房桌子底下。

items.def: small and using little space
items.s: The new robot is very ________, so it can clean under beds and between chair legs easily.
items.zh: 新的機器人非常小巧,所以它能輕鬆地打掃床底和椅腳之間。

items.def: expensive; causing loss or damage
items.s: Mistakes on the production line can be ________, so the company uses cameras to catch problems early.
items.zh: 生產線上的錯誤可能代價很高,所以公司使用攝影機及早發現問題。

items.def: much too expensive
items.s: The price of the first robot dog was ________, but now similar models cost less than a new phone.
items.zh: 第一隻機器狗的價格高得離譜,但現在類似的型號比一支新手機還便宜。

items.def: new and still being tested
items.s: The airport is using an ________ robot to guide travellers, so staff are watching closely to see how passengers react.
items.zh: 機場正在使用一台實驗性的機器人引導旅客,所以員工密切觀察乘客的反應。

items.def: very unusual or surprising
items.s: The robot showed ________ balance on the icy path, and the engineers were surprised that it never slipped.
items.zh: 這台機器人在結冰的路上展現了驚人的平衡力,工程師們很驚訝它從未滑倒。

items.def: new and very important; never done before
items.s: The team's ________ research helped robots feel heat and pain, and other universities soon started similar projects.
items.zh: 這個團隊的開創性研究幫助機器人感受熱與痛,其他大學很快也開始了類似的計畫。

items.def: using the most modern technology
items.s: The new library is very ________, because robots bring books to readers and return them to the shelves.
items.zh: 新的圖書館非常高科技,因為機器人會把書送給讀者並把它們放回書架。

items.def: continuing for a long time
items.s: After a ________ test period, the robot taxi was finally allowed to carry passengers in the city centre.
items.zh: 經過漫長的測試期,機器人計程車終於獲准在市中心載客。

items.def: possible to deal with or control
items.s: With robots doing the heavy lifting, the nurses' workload became more ________, and they felt less tired at night.
items.zh: 有了機器人負責搬運重物,護理師的工作量變得比較應付得來,她們晚上也覺得沒那麼累了。

items.def: very large and heavy
items.s: The company made a ________ investment in robots, so it expects to produce twice as many cars next year.
items.zh: 公司在機器人上進行了大規模的投資,所以它預計明年的汽車產量將翻倍。

items.def: extremely small
items.s: The robot can find ________ cracks in aeroplane engines, so it helps keep passengers safe on every flight.
items.zh: 這台機器人能找出飛機引擎中微小的裂縫,所以它幫助保障每趟航班的乘客安全。

items.def: very large or important
items.s: Building a robot that truly understands people is a ________ task, and it may take scientists many more decades.
items.zh: 打造一台真正理解人類的機器人是一項極其艱鉅的任務,科學家可能還需要好幾十年。

items.def: able to be used for many different jobs
items.s: The farm bought a ________ robot that can plant seeds, pull weeds and check the soil, so it saves a lot of time.
items.zh: 農場買了一台能播種、拔草和檢查土壤的多用途機器人,所以它節省了許多時間。

items.def: light and easy to carry
items.s: The doctor carries a ________ scanner to the villages, so patients do not need to travel to the city hospital.
items.zh: 醫生帶著一台可攜式掃描儀到村莊,所以病人不需要遠赴城市的醫院。

items.def: useful and suitable for real situations
items.s: A robot that folds clothes sounds fun, but a robot that washes dishes is more ________ for busy families.
items.zh: 一台會摺衣服的機器人聽起來很有趣,但對忙碌的家庭來說,一台會洗碗的機器人更實用。

items.def: not certain, or possibly wrong
items.s: The robot umpire made a ________ call in the final inning, so the coach asked to see the replay.
items.zh: 機器人裁判在最後一局做出了一個值得懷疑的判決,所以教練要求查看重播。

items.def: smooth and without problems or breaks
items.s: The robot and the nurse worked together in a ________ way, so the patient hardly noticed the machine.
items.zh: 機器人和護理師以流暢無縫的方式合作,所以病人幾乎沒注意到那台機器。

items.def: fairly large
items.s: A ________ number of shoppers prefer human cashiers, so the supermarket still keeps several staffed counters open.
items.zh: 相當大比例的顧客比較喜歡人工收銀員,所以超市仍然保留好幾個有人的櫃台。

items.def: designed for one particular purpose
items.s: The hospital uses ________ robots to carry blood samples, so doctors get test results much faster.
items.zh: 醫院使用專門的機器人運送血液樣本,所以醫生能更快拿到檢驗結果。

items.def: better than others in quality
items.s: The new camera gives the robot ________ eyesight, so it can read small labels from across the room.
items.zh: 新攝影機讓機器人擁有更優越的視力,所以它能從房間另一頭讀出小標籤。

items.def: lower in quality than others
items.s: Some customers think robot-made food is ________, but blind taste tests show most people cannot tell the difference.
items.zh: 有些顧客認為機器人做的食物比較差,但盲測顯示大多數人吃不出差別。

items.def: not watched or looked after by anyone
items.s: Never leave a charging robot ________ for hours, because faulty batteries can sometimes overheat and start fires.
items.zh: 絕對不要讓充電中的機器人無人看管好幾個小時,因為有問題的電池有時會過熱並引發火災。

items.def: operating without a person on board
items.cn: 無人駕駛的;無人操作的
items.s: An ________ boat collected rubbish from the lake, so volunteers no longer had to paddle out in the cold.
items.zh: 一艘無人駕駛的船收集了湖上的垃圾,所以志工們不再需要在寒冷中划船出去。

items.def: better than any other
items.s: The factory's robots have ________ speed, so they can produce ten thousand phones every single day.
items.zh: 這間工廠的機器人有無與倫比的速度,所以它們每天能生產一萬支手機。

items.def: happening on a very large scale, affecting many things
items.s: Experts warn that ________ automation could leave many people without work, so they want governments to prepare now.
items.zh: 專家警告大規模的自動化可能讓許多人失業,所以他們希望政府現在就做好準備。

items.def: simple and not carefully made
items.s: Our first robot was quite ________, but it could move forward and turn, and we were very proud of it.
items.zh: 我們的第一台機器人相當粗糙,但它能前進和轉彎,我們為它感到非常自豪。

items.def: easily broken or damaged; needing care
items.s: Picking strawberries is a ________ job, so the robot uses soft fingers that will not crush the fruit.
items.zh: 採草莓是一項精細的工作,所以機器人使用不會把果實壓爛的柔軟手指。

items.def: very serious or terrible
items.s: Some writers make ________ predictions about robots taking every job, but history shows new jobs usually appear.
items.zh: 一些作家對機器人奪走所有工作做出可怕的預測,但歷史顯示通常會出現新的工作。

items.def: allowed to do or receive something
items.s: Workers who lost jobs to robots are ________ for free training, so many of them are learning computer skills.
items.zh: 因機器人而失去工作的工人有資格接受免費訓練,所以他們之中許多人正在學習電腦技能。

items.def: very strong or intense
items.s: Competition between robot companies is ________, so prices have dropped and quality has improved quickly.
items.zh: 機器人公司之間的競爭很激烈,所以價格下降了,品質也很快地提升了。

items.def: able to move easily from place to place
items.s: The hospital has a ________ robot that travels between floors, and it can even take the lift by itself.
items.zh: 醫院有一台在樓層間移動的可移動式機器人,它甚至能自己搭電梯。

items.def: smooth, shiny and attractive in shape
items.s: The new robot has a ________ white body, so it looks more like a piece of furniture than a machine.
items.zh: 新機器人有線條流暢的白色機身,所以它看起來更像一件家具而不是一台機器。

items.def: very large or sudden; or rising sharply
items.s: There has been a ________ rise in robot sales since last year, because prices have dropped and quality has improved.
items.zh: 自去年以來機器人的銷售量急劇上升,因為價格下降而品質提升了。

items.def: strong and not easily broken
items.s: The farm robot needs ________ wheels, because it has to drive over rocks and through mud every day.
items.zh: 農場機器人需要堅固的輪子,因為它每天都必須開過石頭和穿過泥巴。

items.def: working hard without getting tired
items.s: Robots are ________ workers, but they cannot comfort a crying child or understand a joke.
items.zh: 機器人是不知疲倦的工作者,但它們無法安慰哭泣的孩子或聽懂笑話。

items.def: only; not including anything else
items.s: The robot is used ________ for cleaning the hospital floors, so it never enters the patients' rooms.
items.zh: 這台機器人專門用來清潔醫院的地板,所以它從不進入病房。

items.def: for a period with no fixed end
items.s: The robot taxi service was stopped ________ after the accident, and nobody knows when it will start again.
items.zh: 事故發生後,機器人計程車服務被無限期暫停,沒有人知道它何時會再開始。

items.def: more and more
items.s: Robots are ________ common in restaurants, and some young children have never ordered food from a person.
items.zh: 機器人在餐廳裡越來越常見,有些小孩甚至從來沒有向真人點過餐。

items.def: mostly; to a great degree
items.s: The factory is now ________ run by robots, but a small team of engineers works there day and night.
items.zh: 這間工廠現在主要由機器人運作,但有一小組工程師日夜在那裡工作。

items.def: only; nothing more than
items.s: The robot is ________ a tool, so the people who use it must take responsibility for what it does.
items.zh: 機器人只不過是一個工具,所以使用它的人必須為它所做的事負責。

items.def: not completely; partly
items.s: The new system is only ________ automated, so workers still need to check every order before it leaves.
items.zh: 新系統只有部分自動化,所以工人仍然需要在每筆訂單出貨前檢查。

items.def: not often; rarely
items.s: The robot ________ makes mistakes, but when it does, they can be expensive, so humans still check its work.
items.zh: 這台機器人很少犯錯,但一旦犯錯就可能代價高昂,所以人類仍然會檢查它的工作。

items.def: certainly; without any doubt
items.s: Robots will ________ change the way we work, but nobody knows exactly which jobs will disappear first.
items.zh: 機器人無疑會改變我們的工作方式,但沒有人確切知道哪些工作會最先消失。

items.def: until now; until a particular time
items.s: The robot reached places that had ________ been impossible to explore, and it sent back amazing pictures from the cave.
items.zh: 這台機器人抵達了迄今無法探索的地方,並從洞穴傳回了驚人的照片。

items.def: as a result; therefore
items.s: The robot works all night without breaks, and ________ the factory can produce far more goods each day.
items.zh: 機器人整夜工作不休息,因此工廠每天能生產多得多的商品。

items.def: from this time on
items.s: The company announced that ________ all deliveries in the city centre would be made by robots, so drivers were moved to other areas.
items.zh: 公司宣布從今以後市中心的所有配送都將由機器人完成,所以司機被調到其他地區。

items.def: about; approximately
items.s: ________ half of the jobs in the warehouse are now done by robots, but the company still employs about three hundred people.
items.zh: 倉庫裡大約一半的工作現在由機器人完成,但公司仍然僱用約三百人。

items.def: quickly
items.s: The rescue robot moved ________ through the smoke, and it found the trapped family within minutes.
items.zh: 救援機器人在煙霧中迅速地移動,並在幾分鐘內找到了受困的一家人。

items.def: damage that happens through normal use over time
items.s: After five years of daily use, the robot showed signs of ______ ______ ______, so the company replaced its wheels and joints.
items.zh: 經過五年的每日使用,這台機器人出現了磨損的跡象,所以公司更換了它的輪子和關節。

items.def: all day and all night without stopping
items.s: Robots in the warehouse work ______ ______ ______, so customers can receive their orders even on public holidays.
items.zh: 倉庫裡的機器人全天候工作,所以顧客即使在國定假日也能收到訂單。

items.def: to check how good something is by using it in a hard situation
items.s: The rescue robot was ______ ______ ______ ______ after the earthquake, and it found three people under the broken building.
items.zh: 救援機器人在地震後接受了考驗,它在倒塌的建築下找到了三個人。

items.def: to start to have an effect
items.s: Human judgement must ______ ______ ______ when the robot faces a new situation, because it only knows what it has learned.
items.zh: 當機器人面臨新情況時,人類的判斷力就必須開始發揮作用,因為它只知道它學過的東西。

items.w: at the push of a button
items.def: very easily, by just pressing a button
items.cn: 一按按鈕就;輕而易舉地
items.s: You can start the robot vacuum ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, and it will clean the whole flat by itself.
items.zh: 你一按按鈕就能啟動掃地機器人,它會自己打掃整間公寓。

items.def: to introduce something gradually
items.s: The city plans to ______ ______ robot buses over five years, so drivers will have time to train for new jobs.
items.zh: 市政府計畫在五年內逐步引進機器人公車,這樣司機就有時間接受新工作的訓練。

items.def: to become involved to help or stop a problem
items.s: If the robot cannot answer a customer's question, a staff member will ______ ______ and help them right away.
items.zh: 如果機器人無法回答顧客的問題,員工會介入並立即協助他們。

items.def: to watch something carefully
items.s: A supervisor must ______ ______ ______ ______ the robots during the night shift, because a small problem can quickly become serious.
items.zh: 夜班期間必須有一位主管留意機器人,因為小問題很快就可能變得嚴重。

items.def: to make a situation fair for everyone
items.s: Video technology helps ______ ______ ______ ______ in sport, because every team gets the same fair decisions.
items.zh: 影像科技有助於在運動中創造公平的競爭環境,因為每支隊伍都得到同樣公正的判決。

items.def: believing someone when you are not completely sure
items.s: Human umpires sometimes gave popular players ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, but the robot treats everyone exactly the same.
items.zh: 人類裁判有時會對受歡迎的球員姑且相信,但機器人對每個人都一視同仁。

items.def: to be the person who makes the important decisions
items.s: Robots may do the work, but humans still ______ ______ ______, so we decide what the machines should and should not do.
items.zh: 機器人也許負責做事,但人類仍然發號施令,所以由我們決定機器該做和不該做什麼。

items.def: not moving or making any progress
items.s: The whole warehouse was ______ ______ ______ after the computer crashed, so hundreds of parcels were delivered late.
items.zh: 電腦當機後整個倉庫陷入停頓,所以數百個包裹延遲送達。

items.def: working properly after being set up or repaired
items.s: The technicians got the robots ______ ______ ______ again within an hour, so the factory lost very little time.
items.zh: 技術人員在一小時內就讓機器人重新正常運轉,所以工廠幾乎沒有損失時間。

items.def: something you do easily without thinking
items.s: Using voice commands has become ______ ______ for my children, so they talk to the smart speaker like a friend.
items.zh: 使用語音指令對我的孩子們來說已經成為第二天性,所以他們像跟朋友一樣和智慧音箱說話。

items.def: to change your ideas or methods as the world changes
items.s: Older shop owners must ______ ______ ______ ______, or they may lose customers to stores that use modern technology.
items.zh: 年長的店主必須與時俱進,否則他們可能會把顧客輸給使用現代科技的商店。

items.def: to make it possible for something to happen later
items.s: Early factory robots helped ______ ______ ______ ______ today's home robots, because they proved that machines could work safely.
items.zh: 早期的工廠機器人幫忙為今日的家用機器人鋪路,因為它們證明了機器可以安全地工作。

items.def: accepted and likely to continue for a long time
items.s: Some people still dislike robot waiters, but most experts agree that this technology is ______ ______ ______.
items.zh: 有些人仍然不喜歡機器人服務生,但大多數專家都同意這項技術會一直存在。

items.def: using your hands, not a machine
items.s: My grandmother still washes her clothes ______ ______, although we bought her a washing machine last year.
items.zh: 我奶奶仍然用手洗衣服,雖然我們去年買了一台洗衣機給她。

items.def: a situation where something bad almost happened
items.s: It was ______ ______ ______ when the robot arm nearly hit a worker, so the factory moved the safety line further back.
items.zh: 當機器手臂差點撞到一名工人時真是千鈞一髮,所以工廠把安全線往後移。

items.def: at risk of being lost or damaged
items.s: Thousands of jobs are ______ ______ ______ because of the new robots, so the union is meeting the company next week.
items.zh: 因為新機器人,數千個工作岌岌可危,所以工會下週將和公司會面。

items.def: the study of the past by digging up old objects and places
items.s: My cousin chose to study ________ at university, because she loves finding out how people lived thousands of years ago.
items.zh: 我表姊選擇在大學念考古學,因為她很喜歡探究幾千年前的人們如何生活。

items.def: a person who studies the past by digging up old things
items.s: The ________ carefully lifted the old pot out of the ground, and she smiled because it was still in one piece.
items.zh: 那位考古學家小心地把古老的陶罐從地下取出,她笑了,因為它仍然完整無缺。

items.def: connected with the study of ancient remains
items.s: Builders found an ________ site under the new car park, so the work stopped while experts studied the area.
items.zh: 工人在新停車場底下發現了一個考古遺址,所以工程在專家研究這個區域時暫停了。

items.def: to dig carefully to find buried objects
items.s: The team plans to ________ the hill next summer, because local farmers have found old coins there for years.
items.zh: 團隊計畫明年夏天發掘這座山丘,因為當地農夫多年來一直在那裡發現古錢幣。

items.def: the careful digging up of an old site
items.s: The ________ lasted three months, and students from five countries helped the experts remove the soil by hand.
items.zh: 這次發掘工作持續了三個月,來自五個國家的學生協助專家們用手清除泥土。

items.def: an organised archaeological excavation
items.s: I joined a summer ________ in Greece last year, and I spent every morning brushing dirt off broken pottery.
items.zh: 我去年參加了希臘的一個夏季考古挖掘,每天早上都在刷掉碎陶片上的泥土。

items.def: a small hand tool with a flat blade for digging
items.s: Each volunteer was given a ________ and a bucket, and they started scraping the soil away very slowly.
items.zh: 每位志工都拿到一把小鏟子和一個水桶,然後他們開始非常緩慢地刮去泥土。

items.def: a tool with a net that separates small things from soil
items.s: We poured the soil through a ________, so even tiny beads and fish bones would not be thrown away.
items.zh: 我們把泥土倒進篩子裡,這樣連小珠子和魚骨頭都不會被丟掉。

items.def: a hole dug in the ground
items.s: The workers found an ancient rubbish ________ full of broken bowls, and it told them a lot about what people ate.
items.zh: 工人們發現了一個裝滿破碗的古代垃圾坑,它透露了許多關於人們吃些什麼的資訊。

items.def: a small hill made of earth or stones
items.s: The grassy ________ near the village looked natural, but scientists discovered that it was actually an ancient grave.
items.zh: 村莊附近那座長滿草的土丘看起來像是天然的,但科學家發現它其實是一座古墓。

items.def: one layer of soil or rock (plural: strata)
items.s: Each ________ of soil represents a different period, so the deepest objects are usually the oldest.
items.zh: 每一地層的土壤代表一個不同的時期,所以最深處的物品通常是最古老的。

items.def: to find something by digging it out of the ground
items.s: Farmers often ________ old tools while ploughing their fields, and some of them are more than two thousand years old.
items.zh: 農夫在犁田時常常挖出古老的工具,其中一些已有兩千多年的歷史。

items.def: the broken parts left of an old building
items.s: We walked around the ________ of an old castle, and our guide explained how the walls had once looked.
items.zh: 我們在一座古城堡的廢墟周圍散步,導遊解釋了那些城牆以前的樣子。

items.def: parts of something that are left after a long time
items.s: The ________ of a Roman house were found under the shopping centre, so the builders had to change their plans.
items.zh: 在購物中心底下發現了羅馬房屋的遺跡,所以建商必須改變他們的計畫。

items.def: broken stones and bricks from a fallen building
items.s: After the earthquake, the old temple was just a pile of ________, but archaeologists still found statues inside it.
items.zh: 地震過後,那座古老的寺廟只剩一堆瓦礫,但考古學家仍然在裡面找到雕像。

items.def: hidden under the ground
items.s: The children dreamed of finding ________ treasure on the beach, but they only found an old bottle cap.
items.zh: 孩子們夢想在海灘上找到被埋藏的寶藏,但他們只找到一個舊瓶蓋。

items.def: to clean something gently with a brush
items.s: The students had to ________ the dirt away very gently, because the old bones could break easily.
items.zh: 學生們必須非常輕柔地刷掉泥土,因為那些古老的骨頭很容易斷裂。

items.def: a small broken piece of something
items.s: They found a ________ of a painted wall, and experts used it to imagine the colours of the whole room.
items.zh: 他們找到了一塊彩繪牆壁的碎片,專家用它來想像整個房間的顏色。

items.def: a sharp broken piece of pottery or glass
items.s: Thousands of pottery ________ were collected from the site, and volunteers spent months trying to fit them together.
items.zh: 從遺址收集了數千片陶器碎片,志工們花了好幾個月試著把它們拼湊起來。

items.def: a hidden collection of valuable things
items.s: A man with a shovel discovered a ________ of silver coins in his garden, and the local museum bought it for a large sum.
items.zh: 一名拿著鏟子的男子在他的花園裡發現了一批銀幣窖藏,當地博物館以一大筆錢買下了它。

items.def: a collection of gold, jewels or valuable objects
items.s: The pirates in the story hid their ________ on an island, but nobody has ever found it.
items.zh: 故事中的海盜把他們的寶藏藏在一座島上,但從來沒有人找到過。

items.def: an object that survives from the distant past
items.s: This old sword is a ________ from a battle that happened eight hundred years ago, so the museum keeps it behind glass.
items.zh: 這把古劍是八百年前一場戰役的遺物,所以博物館把它放在玻璃後面保存。

items.def: the ancient past, especially before the Middle Ages
items.s: The city has been an important trading centre since ________, and you can still see Greek columns in the old town.
items.zh: 這座城市自古代以來就是重要的貿易中心,在舊城區裡仍然可以看到希臘式柱子。

items.def: to steal things, especially from ancient sites
items.s: Thieves came at night to ________ the tombs, so the government sent guards to protect the site.
items.zh: 小偷在夜裡來盜掘墳墓,所以政府派了警衛來保護遺址。

items.def: a person in charge of a museum collection
items.s: The ________ explained the history of each object, and the students took notes for their school project.
items.zh: 策展人解說了每件物品的歷史,學生們為他們的學校專題做筆記。

items.def: to make a detailed list of objects
items.s: After each dig, the team must ________ every object, so other researchers can find the information later.
items.zh: 每次挖掘之後,團隊都必須把每件物品編目,這樣其他研究人員之後才能找到資料。

items.def: taken from or happening in the air
items.s: ________ photos taken by a drone showed the outline of an old village, although nothing was visible from the ground.
items.zh: 無人機拍攝的空中照片顯示出一座古老村莊的輪廓,雖然從地面上什麼也看不到。

items.def: a machine that uses radio waves to see under the ground
items.s: The team used ________ ________ to look under the field, so they knew where to dig before touching the soil.
items.zh: 團隊使用透地雷達探查田地底下,所以他們在動土之前就知道該在哪裡挖。

items.def: the top layer of soil
items.s: The workers removed the ________ with a small machine, and then they continued digging slowly by hand.
items.zh: 工人們用小型機器移除了表土,然後繼續用手慢慢挖掘。

items.def: completely full of water
items.s: Wood usually rots quickly, but in ________ ground it can survive for thousands of years because there is no air.
items.zh: 木頭通常很快就會腐爛,但在浸水的土地中它能保存數千年,因為那裡沒有空氣。

items.def: an object made by people long ago
items.s: Every ________ in the museum has a label, so visitors can learn where it was found and how old it is.
items.zh: 博物館裡的每件文物都有標籤,所以參觀者能知道它是在哪裡被發現以及有多古老。

items.def: pots and dishes made from baked clay
items.s: Ancient ________ can tell us what people cooked, because scientists can test the food left inside the pots.
items.zh: 古代陶器能告訴我們人們煮了什麼,因為科學家可以檢驗殘留在罐子裡的食物。

items.def: made of clay that has been baked hard
items.s: My grandmother collects old ________ bowls, and she keeps the most valuable one in a glass cabinet.
items.zh: 我奶奶收藏古老的陶瓷碗,她把最珍貴的那一個放在玻璃櫃裡。

items.def: soft, wet earth used to make pots
items.s: The children shaped little animals out of ________, and their teacher baked them in the school oven.
items.zh: 孩子們用黏土捏出小動物,老師用學校的烤爐把它們烤硬。

items.def: a very hot oven for baking pottery or bricks
items.s: Archaeologists found an ancient ________ near the river, so they believe the village made its own pots and bricks.
items.zh: 考古學家在河邊發現了一座古窯,所以他們相信這個村莊自己製作陶罐和磚塊。

items.def: a large decorated pot, often used to hold ashes
items.s: The beautiful ________ was found in a grave, and it still contained the ashes of a person who died long ago.
items.zh: 這個美麗的甕是在墳墓裡發現的,裡面仍然裝著一位很久以前去世之人的骨灰。

items.def: a small ball with a hole, used to make jewellery
items.s: The necklace was made from hundreds of glass ________, and each one was coloured by hand.
items.zh: 這條項鍊由數百顆玻璃珠子製成,每一顆都是手工上色的。

items.def: an object used for decoration
items.s: The rich family decorated their home with gold ________, but poor families used simple wooden ones.
items.zh: 富有的家庭用金色的裝飾品裝飾家裡,而貧窮的家庭則使用簡單的木製裝飾。

items.def: a small statue of a person or animal
items.s: The tiny ________ of a horse is only five centimetres tall, but it is more than three thousand years old.
items.zh: 這尊馬的小雕像只有五公分高,但它已有三千多年的歷史。

items.def: a large figure of a person or animal made of stone or metal
items.s: The ________ of the king stood in the city square for centuries, until an earthquake knocked it over.
items.zh: 國王的雕像在城市廣場上矗立了好幾個世紀,直到一場地震把它震倒了。

items.def: a shape or pattern cut into wood or stone
items.s: The walls of the cave are covered with ________ of animals, and nobody knows exactly who made them.
items.zh: 洞穴的牆上布滿了動物的雕刻,沒有人確切知道是誰刻的。

items.def: to cut words or pictures into a hard surface
items.s: The workers used to ________ the king's name on every stone, so his power would be remembered forever.
items.zh: 工人們過去會在每塊石頭上刻上國王的名字,這樣他的權力就會永遠被記住。

items.def: words cut into stone or metal
items.s: The ________ on the gravestone was hard to read, but the expert slowly worked out the name of the woman.
items.zh: 墓碑上的銘文很難辨讀,但專家慢慢地解讀出了那名女子的名字。

items.def: paper made from a water plant by ancient Egyptians
items.s: Ancient Egyptians wrote on ________ made from river plants, and some of these documents still survive today.
items.zh: 古埃及人在用河邊植物製成的莎草紙上書寫,其中一些文件至今仍然留存。

items.def: writing material made from animal skin
items.s: Monks copied books by hand on ________, so a single book could take a whole year to finish.
items.zh: 修道士用手在羊皮紙上抄寫書籍,所以一本書可能要花整整一年才能完成。

items.def: a book or document written by hand
items.s: The old ________ is kept in a dark room, because strong light could damage the ink on its pages.
items.zh: 這份古老的手抄本被保存在一間暗室裡,因為強光可能會損壞書頁上的墨水。

items.def: a hard brown metal made from copper and tin
items.s: The soldiers carried weapons made of ________, and these were much stronger than the stone tools used before.
items.zh: 士兵們攜帶青銅製的武器,這些武器比之前使用的石器堅固得多。

items.def: a soft reddish-brown metal
items.s: People first learned to melt ________ about seven thousand years ago, and this changed how they made tools.
items.zh: 人類大約在七千年前首次學會熔化銅,這改變了他們製作工具的方式。

items.def: a hard grey stone that breaks into sharp pieces
items.s: Early humans made knives from ________, because the stone could be shaped into a very sharp edge.
items.zh: 早期人類用燧石製作刀子,因為這種石頭能被打製出非常鋒利的邊緣。

items.def: black glass formed from volcanic rock
items.s: Tools made of ________ were traded over long distances, so scientists can trace ancient trade routes by studying them.
items.zh: 黑曜石製的工具被交易到很遠的地方,所以科學家能透過研究它們來追溯古代的貿易路線。

items.def: a branch-like horn on the head of a deer
items.s: Prehistoric people made needles and combs from deer ________, and some of them were beautifully decorated.
items.zh: 史前人類用鹿角製作針和梳子,其中一些裝飾得很精美。

items.def: cloth or woven material
items.s: Ancient ________ rarely survive because cloth rots easily, but dry deserts have kept some pieces in good condition.
items.zh: 古代紡織品很少能保存下來,因為布料容易腐爛,但乾燥的沙漠讓一些布片保持在良好狀態。

items.def: a machine or frame for weaving cloth
items.s: The women in the village worked at a wooden ________ every evening, and they made beautiful cloth for the market.
items.zh: 村裡的婦女每天晚上都在木製織布機前工作,她們為市集織出美麗的布料。

items.def: to make cloth by crossing threads over and under
items.s: Thousands of years ago, people ________ baskets from grass, and some of these baskets were found in a dry cave.
items.zh: 幾千年前,人們用草編織籃子,其中一些籃子在一個乾燥的洞穴裡被發現。

items.def: a substance used to change the colour of cloth
items.s: Purple ________ was very expensive in ancient times, so only kings and rich people could wear purple clothes.
items.zh: 紫色染料在古代非常昂貴,所以只有國王和富人才能穿紫色的衣服。

items.def: a picture made from many small coloured stones
items.s: The floor of the Roman villa had a ________ of dolphins, and it still looked bright after two thousand years.
items.zh: 這座羅馬別墅的地板上有一幅海豚的鑲嵌畫,兩千年後它看起來仍然很鮮豔。

items.def: a painting made on wet plaster on a wall
items.s: The ________ on the church wall shows a famous story, but parts of it have faded because of damp air.
items.zh: 教堂牆上的濕壁畫描繪了一個著名的故事,但其中一些部分因為潮濕的空氣而褪色了。

items.def: a natural powder used to make colour
items.s: Cave artists mixed red ________ from crushed rocks with animal fat, and they painted with their fingers.
items.zh: 洞穴藝術家把壓碎的岩石製成的紅色顏料和動物油脂混合,然後用手指作畫。

items.def: a small object worn to protect against bad luck
items.s: The child was buried with a small ________ around her neck, because her parents believed it would keep her safe.
items.zh: 那個孩子下葬時脖子上戴著一個小護身符,因為她的父母相信它能保佑她平安。

items.def: to heat rock to get metal out of it
items.s: Ancient workers learned to ________ iron in hot fires, and this allowed them to make stronger tools and weapons.
items.zh: 古代工人學會在高溫的火中冶煉鐵,這讓他們能製造更堅固的工具和武器。

items.def: a method of finding the age of old organic material
items.s: ________ ________ showed that the wooden boat was four thousand years old, so it is one of the oldest in Europe.
items.zh: 放射性碳定年法顯示這艘木船已有四千年歷史,所以它是歐洲最古老的船之一。
items.sec: Dating & Scientific Methods 年代測定與科學方法

items.def: a form of a chemical element with a different weight
items.s: By testing the ________ in a person's teeth, scientists can tell where that person grew up, even thousands of years later.
items.zh: 透過檢測一個人牙齒中的同位素,科學家即使在數千年後也能知道那個人在哪裡長大。
items.sec: Dating & Scientific Methods 年代測定與科學方法

items.def: the time it takes for half of a substance to disappear
items.s: Carbon-14 has a ________ of about 5,730 years, so it is useful for dating objects that are not too old.
items.zh: 碳十四的半衰期大約是五千七百三十年,所以它適合用來測定不太古老的物品年代。
items.sec: Dating & Scientific Methods 年代測定與科學方法

items.def: dating wood by counting and comparing tree rings
items.s: Using ________, the team counted the rings in the old beams, and they found that the house was built in 1450.
items.zh: 團隊運用樹輪年代學計算舊樑木的年輪,發現這棟房子建於1450年。
items.sec: Dating & Scientific Methods 年代測定與科學方法

items.def: the material in cells that carries genetic information
items.s: Scientists took ________ from the ancient bones, and they discovered that the man was related to people living nearby today.
items.zh: 科學家從古代骨骸中提取了DNA,發現這名男子與今天住在附近的人有親屬關係。
items.sec: Dating & Scientific Methods 年代測定與科學方法

items.def: all the genetic information of a living thing
items.s: Researchers studied the ________ of an ancient wolf, so they could learn when dogs first became pets.
items.zh: 研究人員研究了一隻古代狼的基因組,以便了解狗最初是何時成為寵物的。
items.sec: Dating & Scientific Methods 年代測定與科學方法

items.def: the people your family came from in the past
items.s: Many people now test their ________ with a simple kit, and some are surprised to find relatives in other countries.
items.zh: 現在許多人用簡單的套組檢測自己的血統,有些人驚訝地發現自己在其他國家有親戚。
items.sec: Dating & Scientific Methods 年代測定與科學方法

items.def: a line of family descent from an ancestor
items.s: The noble family could trace its ________ back to a famous king, so they were proud of their history.
items.zh: 這個貴族家庭能把他們的世系追溯到一位著名的國王,所以他們以自己的歷史為傲。
items.sec: Dating & Scientific Methods 年代測定與科學方法

items.def: an instrument that makes tiny things look bigger
items.s: Under the ________, the scientist saw tiny pieces of wheat on the stone tool, so she knew it was used for grinding grain.
items.zh: 在顯微鏡下,科學家在石器上看到微小的小麥碎屑,所以她知道它是用來磨穀物的。
items.sec: Dating & Scientific Methods 年代測定與科學方法

items.def: a small amount of something that remains after a process
items.s: Scientists tested the ________ inside the old jar, and they found that it once held wine and honey.
items.zh: 科學家檢驗了古罐內的殘留物,發現它曾經裝過葡萄酒和蜂蜜。
items.sec: Dating & Scientific Methods 年代測定與科學方法

items.def: fine powder from flowers
items.s: Ancient ________ found in the mud showed which plants grew nearby, so experts could describe the landscape at that time.
items.zh: 在泥土中發現的古代花粉顯示附近生長過哪些植物,所以專家能描述當時的地景。
items.sec: Dating & Scientific Methods 年代測定與科學方法

items.def: a list of events in the order they happened
items.s: Our teacher drew a ________ on the board, and we added the dates of each ancient empire in different colours.
items.zh: 老師在黑板上畫了一條時間軸,我們用不同顏色加上每個古代帝國的年代。
items.sec: Dating & Scientific Methods 年代測定與科學方法

items.def: a long period of history
items.s: The Roman ________ brought new roads to Britain, and many of those roads are still used today.
items.zh: 羅馬時代為英國帶來了新的道路,其中許多道路至今仍在使用。
items.sec: Dating & Scientific Methods 年代測定與科學方法

items.def: a period of time marked by special events
items.s: The invention of writing began a new ________ in human history, because knowledge could finally be recorded.
items.zh: 文字的發明開啟了人類歷史的新紀元,因為知識終於可以被記錄下來。
items.sec: Dating & Scientific Methods 年代測定與科學方法

items.def: a period of one thousand years
items.s: The village has existed for more than a ________, and some of its families have lived there for forty generations.
items.zh: 這個村莊已經存在超過一千年,其中一些家族已經在那裡住了四十代。
items.sec: Dating & Scientific Methods 年代測定與科學方法

items.def: an exact copy of an object
items.s: The museum shows a ________ of the golden mask, because the real one is too valuable to put on display.
items.zh: 博物館展示的是黃金面具的複製品,因為真品太珍貴而無法公開展示。
items.sec: Dating & Scientific Methods 年代測定與科學方法

items.def: to build or create something again from pieces of evidence
items.s: Artists used the skull to ________ the woman's face, and visitors could finally see what she might have looked like.
items.zh: 藝術家利用頭骨重建了那名女子的臉孔,參觀者終於能看見她可能的樣貌。
items.sec: Dating & Scientific Methods 年代測定與科學方法

items.def: a copy made to trick people into thinking it is real
items.s: The famous statue turned out to be a ________, because tests showed that the paint was only fifty years old.
items.zh: 那座著名的雕像原來是贗品,因為檢測顯示顏料只有五十年的歷史。
items.sec: Dating & Scientific Methods 年代測定與科學方法

items.def: coming from living things such as plants or animals
items.s: ________ materials like wood and leather usually rot away, but they can survive in very dry or very cold places.
items.zh: 像木頭和皮革這樣的有機材料通常會腐爛,但它們能在非常乾燥或非常寒冷的地方保存下來。
items.sec: Dating & Scientific Methods 年代測定與科學方法

items.def: to break down slowly after death
items.s: Bodies usually ________ quickly in warm soil, but the man found in the ice was almost perfectly preserved.
items.zh: 屍體在溫暖的土壤中通常很快就會腐爛,但在冰中發現的那名男子幾乎被完整保存下來。
items.sec: Dating & Scientific Methods 年代測定與科學方法

items.def: the remains of an ancient plant or animal in rock
items.s: My brother found a ________ of a small sea creature on the beach, although the beach is now far from the sea.
items.zh: 我弟弟在海灘上發現了一塊小型海洋生物的化石,雖然那片海灘現在離海很遠。
items.sec: Dating & Scientific Methods 年代測定與科學方法

items.def: to be slowly damaged by water or chemicals
items.s: Iron objects ________ quickly in wet soil, so ancient swords are often found as lumps of rust.
items.zh: 鐵器在潮濕的土壤中很快就會腐蝕,所以古劍常常以一團鏽塊的樣子被發現。
items.sec: Dating & Scientific Methods 年代測定與科學方法

items.def: a scientist who studies rocks and the earth
items.s: A ________ helped the team understand the rock layers, so they could estimate when the river had flooded.
items.zh: 一位地質學家幫助團隊了解岩層,所以他們能估計河流氾濫的時間。
items.sec: Dating & Scientific Methods 年代測定與科學方法

items.def: a picture that shows the inside of an object
items.s: An ________ of the mummy showed a broken leg, so experts think the man may have died after an accident.
items.zh: 木乃伊的X光顯示一條斷腿,所以專家認為這名男子可能是在一場意外後去世的。
items.sec: Dating & Scientific Methods 年代測定與科學方法

items.def: having existed for hundreds of years
items.s: The ________ bridge is still used by cars today, although it was built for horses and carts.
items.zh: 這座有數百年歷史的橋至今仍有汽車通行,雖然它當初是為馬和馬車而建的。
items.sec: Dating & Scientific Methods 年代測定與科學方法

items.def: very small living things that can cause decay
items.s: In cold, dry places, ________ cannot grow easily, so ancient bodies and clothes are often well preserved.
items.zh: 在寒冷乾燥的地方細菌不容易生長,所以古代的遺體和衣物常常保存得很好。
items.sec: Dating & Scientific Methods 年代測定與科學方法

items.def: a developed society with cities, laws and writing
items.s: The Maya built a great ________ in the rainforest, but many of their cities were empty by the year 900.
items.zh: 馬雅人在雨林中建立了一個偉大的文明,但到了西元900年,他們的許多城市都已空無一人。
items.sec: Ancient Civilisations & Societies 古文明與社會

items.def: very old; from a long time ago
items.s: We visited an ________ temple in Cambodia, and our guide said it was built almost a thousand years ago.
items.zh: 我們參觀了柬埔寨的一座古老寺廟,導遊說它幾乎是一千年前建造的。
items.sec: Ancient Civilisations & Societies 古文明與社會

items.def: a group of countries ruled by one powerful ruler
items.s: The Roman ________ once stretched from Britain to Egypt, so people in many lands used the same coins.
items.zh: 羅馬帝國曾經從不列顛延伸到埃及,所以許多地方的人使用相同的錢幣。
items.sec: Ancient Civilisations & Societies 古文明與社會

items.def: the male ruler of an empire
items.s: The first ________ of China connected many walls to protect his land, but thousands of workers died building them.
items.zh: 中國的第一位皇帝把許多城牆連接起來保護他的領土,但數千名工人在建造時喪生。
items.sec: Ancient Civilisations & Societies 古文明與社會

items.def: a series of rulers from the same family
items.s: The Tang ________ was famous for poetry and trade, and many foreigners lived in its capital city.
items.zh: 唐朝以詩歌和貿易聞名,許多外國人居住在它的首都。
items.sec: Ancient Civilisations & Societies 古文明與社會

items.def: a king of ancient Egypt
items.s: The young ________ died when he was only nineteen, but his tomb was filled with golden treasures.
items.zh: 那位年輕的法老年僅十九歲就去世了,但他的墳墓裡裝滿了黃金寶藏。
items.sec: Ancient Civilisations & Societies 古文明與社會

items.def: a king or queen
items.s: The ________ lived in a huge palace, while most ordinary people lived in small houses made of mud.
items.zh: 君主住在一座巨大的宮殿裡,而大多數平民住在泥土做的小房子裡。
items.sec: Ancient Civilisations & Societies 古文明與社會

items.def: a country ruled by a king or queen
items.s: The small ________ grew rich from trade, so neighbouring rulers often tried to take control of it.
items.zh: 這個小王國因貿易而富裕,所以鄰近的統治者常常試圖控制它。
items.sec: Ancient Civilisations & Societies 古文明與社會

items.def: the period when a king or queen rules
items.s: During the queen's long ________, the country built many roads, and trade with other lands grew quickly.
items.zh: 在女王漫長的統治期間,國家修建了許多道路,與其他地區的貿易也迅速成長。
items.sec: Ancient Civilisations & Societies 古文明與社會

items.def: a city that governs itself like an independent country
items.s: Athens was a powerful ________ in ancient Greece, and it had its own army, laws and coins.
items.zh: 雅典是古希臘一個強大的城邦,它擁有自己的軍隊、法律和錢幣。
items.sec: Ancient Civilisations & Societies 古文明與社會

items.def: a person who belongs to a city or country and has rights
items.s: In ancient Athens, every male ________ could vote, but women and foreigners were not allowed to take part.
items.zh: 在古雅典,每位男性公民都可以投票,但女性和外國人不被允許參與。
items.sec: Ancient Civilisations & Societies 古文明與社會

items.def: a system where people choose their leaders by voting
items.s: The idea of ________ began in ancient Greece, although only a small group of people could actually vote.
items.zh: 民主的概念起源於古希臘,雖然實際上只有一小群人能投票。
items.sec: Ancient Civilisations & Societies 古文明與社會

items.def: a country with elected leaders and no king
items.s: Rome was a ________ for nearly five hundred years, but later it was ruled by emperors.
items.zh: 羅馬作為共和國將近五百年,但後來由皇帝統治。
items.sec: Ancient Civilisations & Societies 古文明與社會

items.def: a group of important people who make laws
items.s: The Roman ________ met in a large building in the city centre, and its members argued about wars and taxes.
items.zh: 羅馬元老院在市中心的一棟大建築裡開會,議員們爭論戰爭和稅收的問題。
items.sec: Ancient Civilisations & Societies 古文明與社會

items.def: a person from a rich, noble family
items.s: The ________ wore silk robes and gold rings, so everyone in the street knew he was an important man.
items.zh: 那位貴族穿著絲綢長袍和金戒指,所以街上的每個人都知道他是個重要人物。
items.sec: Ancient Civilisations & Societies 古文明與社會

items.def: a poor farmer in the past
items.s: A ________ worked in the fields from morning to night, but he had to give much of his harvest to the landowner.
items.zh: 一位農民從早到晚在田裡工作,但他必須把大部分收成交給地主。
items.sec: Ancient Civilisations & Societies 古文明與社會

items.def: a person who performs religious ceremonies
items.s: The ________ climbed to the top of the temple each morning, and he watched the sky to predict the weather.
items.zh: 祭司每天早上爬到神廟頂端,觀察天空來預測天氣。
items.sec: Ancient Civilisations & Societies 古文明與社會

items.def: a god or goddess
items.s: Each city in ancient Egypt had its own ________, and people built temples to ask for good harvests.
items.zh: 古埃及的每個城市都有自己的神祇,人們建造神廟來祈求豐收。
items.sec: Ancient Civilisations & Societies 古文明與社會

items.def: to show respect and love to a god
items.s: Ancient farmers used to ________ the sun, because they knew that their crops could not grow without it.
items.zh: 古代農民過去會崇拜太陽,因為他們知道沒有它作物就無法生長。
items.sec: Ancient Civilisations & Societies 古文明與社會

items.def: a ceremony that is always done in the same way
items.s: The ________ took place every spring, and the whole village danced and shared food to welcome the new season.
items.zh: 這個儀式每年春天舉行,全村的人一起跳舞並分享食物來迎接新的季節。
items.sec: Ancient Civilisations & Societies 古文明與社會

items.def: a gift given to a god
items.s: People left food and flowers as an ________ at the temple, because they hoped the gods would protect their families.
items.zh: 人們把食物和花留在神廟作為供品,因為他們希望神明保佑他們的家人。
items.sec: Ancient Civilisations & Societies 古文明與社會

items.def: an ancient story about gods and heroes
items.s: The Greek ________ about a hero who fights a monster is still popular, and many films have retold it.
items.zh: 那則關於英雄與怪物戰鬥的希臘神話至今仍很受歡迎,許多電影都重新講述過它。
items.sec: Ancient Civilisations & Societies 古文明與社會

items.def: an old story that may be partly true
items.s: According to ________, a golden city lies hidden in the jungle, but explorers have never found it.
items.zh: 根據傳說,有一座黃金城市隱藏在叢林裡,但探險家們從未找到它。
items.sec: Ancient Civilisations & Societies 古文明與社會

items.def: a person whose job was to write documents in the past
items.s: Only a ________ could read and write in ancient Egypt, so these men were highly respected.
items.zh: 在古埃及只有書記會讀寫,所以這些人非常受尊敬。
items.sec: Ancient Civilisations & Societies 古文明與社會

items.def: picture symbols used in ancient Egyptian writing
items.s: The walls of the tomb were covered with ________, and experts spent years learning what they meant.
items.zh: 墳墓的牆上布滿了象形文字,專家們花了好幾年才弄懂它們的意思。
items.sec: Ancient Civilisations & Societies 古文明與社會

items.def: a set of letters used to write a language
items.s: The Phoenicians created an ________ with only twenty-two letters, so writing became much easier to learn.
items.zh: 腓尼基人創造了一套只有二十二個字母的字母表,所以書寫變得容易學習多了。
items.sec: Ancient Civilisations & Societies 古文明與社會

items.def: a system for dividing the year into days and months
items.s: The Maya had a very accurate ________, because their priests studied the movements of the sun and the stars.
items.zh: 馬雅人有非常精確的曆法,因為他們的祭司研究太陽和星星的運行。
items.sec: Ancient Civilisations & Societies 古文明與社會

items.def: the scientific study of stars and planets
items.s: Ancient Babylonians were skilled in ________, and they could predict when the moon would turn dark.
items.zh: 古巴比倫人精通天文學,他們能預測月亮何時會變暗。
items.sec: Ancient Civilisations & Societies 古文明與社會

items.def: a person who thinks deeply about life and truth
items.s: The Greek ________ taught his students by asking questions, and his method is still used in classrooms today.
items.zh: 那位希臘哲學家以提問的方式教導學生,而他的方法至今仍在教室中使用。
items.sec: Ancient Civilisations & Societies 古文明與社會

items.def: payment given by a weaker ruler to a stronger one
items.s: Small kingdoms had to send ________ to the emperor every year, so his palace was full of gold and silk.
items.zh: 小王國每年都必須向皇帝送上貢品,所以他的宮殿裡堆滿了黃金和絲綢。
items.sec: Ancient Civilisations & Societies 古文明與社會

items.def: a building or statue built to remember a person or event
items.s: Stonehenge is a famous ________ in England, and thousands of visitors come to see the sunrise there in summer.
items.zh: 巨石陣是英國一座著名的古蹟,夏天有數千名遊客來這裡看日出。
items.sec: Monuments, Architecture & Burial 古蹟、建築與墓葬

items.def: a very large stone used in ancient monuments
items.s: Each ________ weighs about twenty-five tons, so nobody is sure how ancient people moved them so far.
items.zh: 每塊巨石重約二十五噸,所以沒有人確定古人是如何把它們搬運得那麼遠的。
items.sec: Monuments, Architecture & Burial 古蹟、建築與墓葬

items.def: a huge stone building with four sloping sides
items.s: The Great ________ took about twenty years to build, and it was the tallest building in the world for centuries.
items.zh: 大金字塔花了大約二十年建造,並在好幾個世紀裡都是世界上最高的建築。
items.sec: Monuments, Architecture & Burial 古蹟、建築與墓葬

items.def: a building used for religious worship
items.s: The ________ stood on top of a hill, so the priests could see the whole valley from its steps.
items.zh: 那座神廟矗立在山頂上,所以祭司們能從它的台階上看到整個山谷。
items.sec: Monuments, Architecture & Burial 古蹟、建築與墓葬

items.def: a large, grand house of a king or queen
items.s: The king's ________ had more than a thousand rooms, and some of them had beautiful paintings on the walls.
items.zh: 國王的宮殿有一千多個房間,其中一些房間的牆上有美麗的壁畫。
items.sec: Monuments, Architecture & Burial 古蹟、建築與墓葬

items.def: a strong fortress on high ground in or near a city
items.s: The people ran to the ________ when the enemy arrived, because its thick walls could protect them.
items.zh: 敵人來襲時,人們跑進要塞,因為它厚厚的城牆能保護他們。
items.sec: Monuments, Architecture & Burial 古蹟、建築與墓葬

items.def: a wide wall of earth or stone built for defence
items.s: The old town is surrounded by a stone ________, and today tourists can walk along the top of it.
items.zh: 舊城區被一道石砌城牆環繞,今天遊客可以沿著城牆頂端散步。
items.sec: Monuments, Architecture & Burial 古蹟、建築與墓葬

items.def: a round open building with rows of seats
items.s: The Roman ________ could hold fifty thousand people, and they came to watch shows and contests.
items.zh: 羅馬圓形劇場能容納五萬人,他們來這裡觀看表演和比賽。
items.sec: Monuments, Architecture & Burial 古蹟、建築與墓葬

items.def: a bridge-like structure that carries water
items.s: The Romans built a long ________ to bring fresh water into the city, and part of it still stands today.
items.zh: 羅馬人建造了一條很長的導水渠把淡水引進城市,其中一部分至今仍然屹立。
items.sec: Monuments, Architecture & Burial 古蹟、建築與墓葬

items.def: a tall column that supports a roof
items.s: Each ________ in the temple is carved with flowers, and together they hold up the heavy stone roof.
items.zh: 神廟裡的每根柱子都刻有花朵,它們一起支撐著沉重的石製屋頂。
items.sec: Monuments, Architecture & Burial 古蹟、建築與墓葬

items.def: a curved structure over an opening
items.s: The Romans used the ________ to build strong bridges, because the curved shape spreads the weight evenly.
items.zh: 羅馬人使用拱形結構建造堅固的橋樑,因為弧形能平均分散重量。
items.sec: Monuments, Architecture & Burial 古蹟、建築與墓葬

items.def: a round roof shaped like half a ball
items.s: The huge ________ of the building was the largest in the world for many years, and it still has no cracks.
items.zh: 這棟建築巨大的圓頂多年來是世界上最大的,而且至今仍沒有裂縫。
items.sec: Monuments, Architecture & Burial 古蹟、建築與墓葬

items.def: the stones or bricks that make up a building
items.s: The ________ of the old castle was so well made that the stones fit together without any cement.
items.zh: 這座古城堡的石造結構做得非常好,石塊之間不用任何水泥就能緊密接合。
items.sec: Monuments, Architecture & Burial 古蹟、建築與墓葬

items.def: a place where stone is dug out of the ground
items.s: The stones for the temple came from a ________ twenty kilometres away, so workers had to drag them across the hills.
items.zh: 建造神廟的石頭來自二十公里外的採石場,所以工人必須把它們拖過山丘。
items.sec: Monuments, Architecture & Burial 古蹟、建築與墓葬

items.def: a very large rock
items.s: A huge ________ blocked the entrance to the cave, and it took ten men to roll it away.
items.zh: 一塊巨大的大圓石擋住了洞穴的入口,需要十個人才能把它滾開。
items.sec: Monuments, Architecture & Burial 古蹟、建築與墓葬

items.def: a thick, flat piece of stone
items.s: The tomb was covered by a heavy stone ________, so robbers could not open it easily.
items.zh: 墳墓被一塊沉重的石板蓋住,所以盜墓者無法輕易打開它。
items.sec: Monuments, Architecture & Burial 古蹟、建築與墓葬

items.def: a block of baked clay used for building
items.s: The ancient city was built with mud ________, and the workers dried them in the hot sun before using them.
items.zh: 這座古城是用泥磚建造的,工人們在使用前先把磚塊放在烈日下曬乾。
items.sec: Monuments, Architecture & Burial 古蹟、建築與墓葬

items.def: a mixture used to hold bricks or stones together
items.s: Roman ________ was so strong that some of their walls are still standing after two thousand years.
items.zh: 羅馬的灰漿非常堅固,所以他們的一些城牆在兩千年後仍然屹立。
items.sec: Monuments, Architecture & Burial 古蹟、建築與墓葬

items.def: a large grave, often with a building over it
items.s: The ________ of the king was hidden deep under the mountain, so it stayed safe from robbers for centuries.
items.zh: 國王的陵墓深藏在山底下,所以好幾個世紀都沒有被盜墓者破壞。
items.sec: Monuments, Architecture & Burial 古蹟、建築與墓葬

items.def: the act of putting a dead body in the ground
items.s: The way a society handled ________ tells us a lot, because it shows what people believed about death.
items.zh: 一個社會處理埋葬的方式告訴我們很多事,因為它顯示了人們對死亡的看法。
items.sec: Monuments, Architecture & Burial 古蹟、建築與墓葬

items.def: a place in the ground where a dead person is buried
items.s: Archaeologists found a ________ containing a warrior and his horse, and both were buried with gold jewellery.
items.zh: 考古學家發現了一座墳墓,裡面埋著一名戰士和他的馬,兩者都戴著金飾下葬。
items.sec: Monuments, Architecture & Burial 古蹟、建築與墓葬

items.def: a box in which a dead body is buried
items.s: The wooden ________ was painted with bright colours, and it still looked new when the team opened the tomb.
items.zh: 那具木棺材漆著鮮豔的顏色,團隊打開墳墓時它看起來仍然像新的。
items.sec: Monuments, Architecture & Burial 古蹟、建築與墓葬

items.def: a stone coffin, often decorated
items.s: The heavy ________ was carved with pictures of the dead man's life, and it took eight workers to lift its lid.
items.zh: 那具沉重的石棺刻有死者生平的圖案,需要八名工人才能抬起它的蓋子。
items.sec: Monuments, Architecture & Burial 古蹟、建築與墓葬

items.def: to preserve a dead body by drying and wrapping it
items.s: Ancient Egyptians used salt to ________ their dead, because they believed the body was needed in the afterlife.
items.zh: 古埃及人用鹽把死者製成木乃伊,因為他們相信來世需要這具身體。
items.sec: Monuments, Architecture & Burial 古蹟、建築與墓葬

items.def: to treat a dead body with chemicals to stop it decaying
items.s: Priests would ________ the body with oils and spices, and then they wrapped it in long strips of cloth.
items.zh: 祭司們會用油和香料為屍體防腐,然後用長條布把它包裹起來。
items.sec: Monuments, Architecture & Burial 古蹟、建築與墓葬

items.def: a large area of land where people are buried
items.s: The old ________ outside the town has graves from five hundred years ago, so historians often visit it.
items.zh: 鎮外那座古老的墓地有五百年前的墳墓,所以歷史學家常常去那裡參訪。
items.sec: Monuments, Architecture & Burial 古蹟、建築與墓葬

items.def: a room, especially one inside a tomb or palace
items.s: The secret ________ inside the pyramid was discovered using special cameras, but nobody has entered it yet.
items.zh: 金字塔內的秘密墓室是用特殊攝影機發現的,但還沒有人進去過。
items.sec: Monuments, Architecture & Burial 古蹟、建築與墓葬

items.def: a life that some people believe begins after death
items.s: People were buried with food and tools, because they believed they would need them in the ________.
items.zh: 人們下葬時會帶著食物和工具,因為他們相信在來世會需要這些東西。
items.sec: Monuments, Architecture & Burial 古蹟、建築與墓葬

items.def: objects buried with a dead person
items.s: The ________ ________ in the tomb included gold cups and weapons, so experts believe the woman was a powerful leader.
items.zh: 墳墓中的陪葬品包括金杯和武器,所以專家相信這名女子是一位有權勢的領袖。
items.sec: Monuments, Architecture & Burial 古蹟、建築與墓葬

items.def: the longest or shortest day of the year
items.s: On the summer ________, the sun rises exactly between the two largest stones, and crowds gather to watch it.
items.zh: 在夏至那天,太陽正好從兩塊最大的石頭之間升起,人群聚集觀看。
items.sec: Monuments, Architecture & Burial 古蹟、建築與墓葬

items.def: from the time before writing was invented
items.s: ________ people painted animals on cave walls, and some of these paintings are more than thirty thousand years old.
items.zh: 史前人類在洞穴牆上畫了動物,其中一些畫已有三萬多年的歷史。
items.sec: Prehistoric Life & Early Humans 史前生活與早期人類

items.def: the early period when people used stone tools
items.s: People in the ________ ________ made tools from rocks, but they also used wood and bone for many jobs.
items.zh: 石器時代的人用石頭製作工具,但他們也用木頭和骨頭來做許多工作。
items.sec: Prehistoric Life & Early Humans 史前生活與早期人類

items.def: a long period when ice covered much of the Earth
items.s: During the last ________ ________, sea levels were much lower, so people could walk from Asia to America.
items.zh: 在最後一次冰河時期,海平面低得多,所以人們能從亞洲走到美洲。
items.sec: Prehistoric Life & Early Humans 史前生活與早期人類

items.def: from the later Stone Age when farming began
items.s: ________ farmers built the first villages in Europe, and they kept sheep, goats and cattle.
items.zh: 新石器時代的農民在歐洲建立了第一批村莊,他們飼養綿羊、山羊和牛。
items.sec: Prehistoric Life & Early Humans 史前生活與早期人類

items.def: a person who lives by hunting animals and collecting plants
items.s: A ________ had to move often to find food, so he could not carry many things with him.
items.zh: 狩獵採集者必須經常遷移來尋找食物,所以他無法隨身攜帶很多東西。
items.sec: Prehistoric Life & Early Humans 史前生活與早期人類

items.def: moving from place to place without a fixed home
items.s: The ________ people followed their animals across the grasslands, and they lived in tents that were easy to carry.
items.zh: 那些遊牧民族跟隨他們的牲畜穿越草原,住在容易攜帶的帳篷裡。
items.sec: Prehistoric Life & Early Humans 史前生活與早期人類

items.def: a group of families with the same customs and leader
items.s: Each ________ had its own leader, but they sometimes met together to trade and celebrate.
items.zh: 每個部落都有自己的首領,但他們有時會聚在一起交易和慶祝。
items.sec: Prehistoric Life & Early Humans 史前生活與早期人類

items.def: a large group of related families
items.s: Members of the same ________ shared the same family name, and they helped each other during hard winters.
items.zh: 同一氏族的成員擁有相同的姓氏,他們在艱困的冬天互相幫助。
items.sec: Prehistoric Life & Early Humans 史前生活與早期人類

items.def: a family relationship between people
items.s: ________ was very important in early societies, because your family decided where you lived and whom you married.
items.zh: 親屬關係在早期社會中非常重要,因為你的家族決定了你住在哪裡以及和誰結婚。
items.sec: Prehistoric Life & Early Humans 史前生活與早期人類

items.def: a person who moves to a new place to live
items.s: The first ________ on the island built their homes near the beach, because the land inland was rocky.
items.zh: 島上的第一批移居者把家建在海灘附近,因為內陸的土地多岩石。
items.sec: Prehistoric Life & Early Humans 史前生活與早期人類

items.def: a place where people have come to live
items.s: The remains of a small ________ were found by the lake, and it included ten round houses and a well.
items.zh: 在湖邊發現了一個小聚落的遺跡,包括十座圓形房屋和一口井。
items.sec: Prehistoric Life & Early Humans 史前生活與早期人類

items.def: a small simple house
items.s: Each family lived in a small ________ made of wood and mud, and they cooked over a fire in the middle.
items.zh: 每個家庭住在用木頭和泥土搭成的小茅屋裡,他們在屋子中央生火煮飯。
items.sec: Prehistoric Life & Early Humans 史前生活與早期人類

items.def: a house or place where someone lives
items.s: The cave was used as a ________ for thousands of years, and the floor was full of animal bones and ash.
items.zh: 這個洞穴被當作住所使用了數千年,地上滿是動物骨頭和灰燼。
items.sec: Prehistoric Life & Early Humans 史前生活與早期人類

items.def: a large hole in a hill or under the ground
items.s: Some children chased their dog into a ________, and they discovered amazing paintings on the walls.
items.zh: 幾個孩子追著他們的狗跑進一個洞穴,結果在牆上發現了驚人的壁畫。
items.sec: Prehistoric Life & Early Humans 史前生活與早期人類

items.def: an ancient picture painted on the wall of a cave
items.s: The ________ ________ shows people hunting deer, so it gives us a clear idea of how they found food.
items.zh: 這幅洞穴壁畫描繪人們獵鹿的場景,所以它讓我們清楚了解他們如何取得食物。
items.sec: Prehistoric Life & Early Humans 史前生活與早期人類

items.def: a long stick with a sharp point used for hunting
items.s: The hunter threw his ________ at the deer, but it ran into the forest before he could catch it.
items.zh: 獵人把長矛擲向那隻鹿,但牠在他抓到之前就跑進了森林。
items.sec: Prehistoric Life & Early Humans 史前生活與早期人類

items.def: the sharp stone or metal point of an arrow
items.s: My uncle found a small stone ________ in his garden, and the museum said it was about five thousand years old.
items.zh: 我叔叔在他的花園裡發現了一個小石箭頭,博物館說它大約有五千年的歷史。
items.sec: Prehistoric Life & Early Humans 史前生活與早期人類

items.def: a tool with a heavy blade for cutting wood
items.s: Early farmers used a stone ________ to cut down trees, so they could clear the land for their crops.
items.zh: 早期農民用石斧砍伐樹木,這樣他們就能清出土地來種植作物。
items.sec: Prehistoric Life & Early Humans 史前生活與早期人類

items.def: to tame an animal or grow a plant for human use
items.s: People began to ________ wild goats about ten thousand years ago, and this gave them a steady supply of milk.
items.zh: 人類大約在一萬年前開始馴化野山羊,這讓他們有穩定的乳汁來源。
items.sec: Prehistoric Life & Early Humans 史前生活與早期人類

items.def: farming; growing crops and raising animals
items.s: The start of ________ changed human life completely, because people could stay in one place and build towns.
items.zh: 農業的開始徹底改變了人類生活,因為人們可以定居在一個地方並建立城鎮。
items.sec: Prehistoric Life & Early Humans 史前生活與早期人類

items.def: to plant seeds in the ground
items.s: Early farmers ________ wheat in the autumn, and they harvested it in the summer when it turned golden.
items.zh: 早期農民在秋天播種小麥,並在夏天麥子轉為金黃時收割。
items.sec: Prehistoric Life & Early Humans 史前生活與早期人類

items.def: the seeds of crops like wheat and rice
items.s: The village stored its ________ in large clay jars, so families would have enough food during the winter.
items.zh: 村莊把穀物儲存在大陶罐裡,這樣家家戶戶在冬天就有足夠的食物。
items.sec: Prehistoric Life & Early Humans 史前生活與早期人類

items.def: a farm tool used to turn over the soil
items.s: The invention of the ________ made farming much easier, because animals could now pull it through the fields.
items.zh: 犁的發明讓耕作容易得多,因為現在可以讓動物拉著它在田裡耕地。
items.sec: Prehistoric Life & Early Humans 史前生活與早期人類

items.def: a large hairy elephant that lived long ago
items.s: Hunters worked together to catch a ________, and one animal could feed a whole group for weeks.
items.zh: 獵人們合作捕捉一頭長毛象,一頭就能餵飽整個群體好幾個星期。
items.sec: Prehistoric Life & Early Humans 史前生活與早期人類

items.def: the area around a fire in a home
items.s: The family sat around the ________ every evening, and the older people told stories to the children.
items.zh: 一家人每天晚上圍坐在火爐邊,年長的人講故事給孩子們聽。
items.sec: Prehistoric Life & Early Humans 史前生活與早期人類

items.def: a family member who lived long before you
items.s: Many families visit the graves of their ________ every year, because they want to show respect to them.
items.zh: 許多家庭每年都會去掃祖先的墓,因為他們想表達對祖先的敬意。
items.sec: Prehistoric Life & Early Humans 史前生活與早期人類

items.def: the bones of the head
items.s: The ________ found in the cave belonged to a young woman, and scientists used it to rebuild her face.
items.zh: 在洞穴中發現的頭骨屬於一名年輕女子,科學家用它來重建她的臉孔。
items.sec: Prehistoric Life & Early Humans 史前生活與早期人類

items.def: simple and from an early stage of development
items.s: The tools looked ________, but they were actually very well designed for cutting meat and cleaning animal skins.
items.zh: 這些工具看起來很原始,但它們其實設計得非常適合切肉和清理獸皮。
items.sec: Prehistoric Life & Early Humans 史前生活與早期人類

items.def: a person who buys and sells goods, often abroad
items.s: The ________ travelled for months to sell his cloth, and he came home with spices, gold and stories.
items.zh: 那位商人旅行了好幾個月去賣他的布料,回家時帶著香料、黃金和許多故事。
items.sec: Trade, Seafaring & Conflict 貿易、航海與衝突

items.def: to exchange goods without using money
items.s: Before coins existed, people would ________ grain for tools, so a farmer could get an axe for a bag of wheat.
items.zh: 在錢幣出現之前,人們會用穀物交換工具,所以農夫可以用一袋小麥換一把斧頭。
items.sec: Trade, Seafaring & Conflict 貿易、航海與衝突

items.def: a small round piece of metal used as money
items.s: The ________ shows the face of an emperor, so experts know exactly when it was made.
items.zh: 這枚錢幣上有一位皇帝的頭像,所以專家確切知道它是何時鑄造的。
items.sec: Trade, Seafaring & Conflict 貿易、航海與衝突

items.def: a group of traders travelling together, often with camels
items.s: A long ________ of camels crossed the desert, and it carried silk, spices and glass to distant markets.
items.zh: 一支長長的駱駝商隊穿越沙漠,運送絲綢、香料和玻璃到遙遠的市場。
items.sec: Trade, Seafaring & Conflict 貿易、航海與衝突

items.def: ancient trade routes linking China and Europe
items.s: The ________ ________ connected China with Europe, so ideas and inventions spread along with goods.
items.zh: 絲路連接了中國和歐洲,所以思想和發明隨著商品一起傳播。
items.sec: Trade, Seafaring & Conflict 貿易、航海與衝突

items.def: a dried plant part used to add flavour to food
items.s: Pepper was once a very expensive ________, and sailors risked their lives to bring it from Asia.
items.zh: 胡椒曾經是一種非常昂貴的香料,水手們冒著生命危險從亞洲把它運回來。
items.sec: Trade, Seafaring & Conflict 貿易、航海與衝突

items.def: hard yellow stone made from old tree resin
items.s: Beads made of ________ were traded across Europe, and some pieces even contain tiny insects from millions of years ago.
items.zh: 琥珀製的珠子在歐洲各地交易,有些甚至含有數百萬年前的小昆蟲。
items.sec: Trade, Seafaring & Conflict 貿易、航海與衝突

items.def: a person who attacks and robs ships at sea
items.s: Mediterranean ________ often attacked trading ships near the islands, so merchants usually travelled in groups for safety.
items.zh: 地中海海盜常在島嶼附近攻擊貿易船隻,所以商人們通常結伴航行以策安全。
items.sec: Trade, Seafaring & Conflict 貿易、航海與衝突

items.def: an ancient ship moved by oars and sails
items.s: The ________ had more than a hundred rowers, and it could move fast even when there was no wind.
items.zh: 這艘槳帆船有一百多名划槳手,即使沒有風也能快速前進。
items.sec: Trade, Seafaring & Conflict 貿易、航海與衝突
