items.def: a long pole with a flat end used to row a boat
items.s: Each rower held a heavy ________, and they moved together to the beat of a drum.
items.zh: 每位划槳手握著一支沉重的槳,他們隨著鼓聲一起划動。
items.sec: Trade, Seafaring & Conflict 貿易、航海與衝突

items.def: a large cloth that catches the wind to move a ship
items.s: The ship raised its ________ when the wind became strong, so the tired rowers could finally rest.
items.zh: 風變強時船升起了帆,所以疲憊的划槳手終於可以休息了。
items.sec: Trade, Seafaring & Conflict 貿易、航海與衝突

items.def: travelling regularly by sea
items.s: The Phoenicians were a ________ people, and they set up trading ports all around the Mediterranean Sea.
items.zh: 腓尼基人是一個航海民族,他們在地中海沿岸各地建立了貿易港口。
items.sec: Trade, Seafaring & Conflict 貿易、航海與衝突

items.def: the work of building ships
items.s: The town was famous for ________, so wood was brought from distant forests to make strong boats.
items.zh: 這個城鎮以造船業聞名,所以人們從遙遠的森林運來木材製造堅固的船隻。
items.sec: Trade, Seafaring & Conflict 貿易、航海與衝突

items.def: to take control of a place and send people to live there
items.s: The Greeks began to ________ islands across the sea, because there was not enough farmland at home.
items.zh: 希臘人開始在海上各島殖民,因為本土沒有足夠的農地。
items.sec: Trade, Seafaring & Conflict 貿易、航海與衝突

items.def: to enter a country with an army to take control
items.s: The enemy decided to ________ in winter, because they knew the river would be frozen and easy to cross.
items.zh: 敵人決定在冬天入侵,因為他們知道河流會結冰而容易渡過。
items.sec: Trade, Seafaring & Conflict 貿易、航海與衝突

items.def: to take control of a place by force
items.s: Alexander the Great managed to ________ a huge area, but his empire broke apart soon after he died.
items.zh: 亞歷山大大帝成功征服了廣大的地區,但他死後不久帝國就分裂了。
items.sec: Trade, Seafaring & Conflict 貿易、航海與衝突

items.def: surrounding a city to force it to give up
items.s: The ________ lasted for ten months, and the people inside the walls had to eat rats to survive.
items.zh: 這場圍城持續了十個月,城牆內的人們必須吃老鼠才能活下去。
items.sec: Trade, Seafaring & Conflict 貿易、航海與衝突

items.def: a strong building used for military defence
items.s: The ________ was built on a cliff above the sea, so attackers could not reach it easily.
items.zh: 這座堡壘建在海上的懸崖上,所以攻擊者無法輕易接近它。
items.sec: Trade, Seafaring & Conflict 貿易、航海與衝突

items.def: metal clothing worn to protect the body in battle
items.s: The knight's ________ was so heavy that he needed help to climb onto his horse.
items.zh: 那位騎士的盔甲非常沉重,所以他需要別人幫忙才能爬上馬。
items.sec: Trade, Seafaring & Conflict 貿易、航海與衝突

items.def: a weapon with a long metal blade
items.s: The ________ was found in a river, and experts believe it was thrown there as a gift to the gods.
items.zh: 這把劍是在河裡發現的,專家相信它是被當作獻給神明的禮物丟進去的。
items.sec: Trade, Seafaring & Conflict 貿易、航海與衝突

items.def: a brave fighter, especially in ancient times
items.s: The ________ was buried with his sword and shield, so archaeologists knew he was an important fighter.
items.zh: 這名戰士與他的劍和盾牌一起下葬,所以考古學家知道他是一位重要的戰士。
items.sec: Trade, Seafaring & Conflict 貿易、航海與衝突

items.def: the place where a battle is fought
items.s: Metal arrowheads were found all over the ________, and they helped historians understand how the battle took place.
items.zh: 在整個戰場上都發現了金屬箭頭,它們幫助歷史學家了解這場戰役是如何進行的。
items.sec: Trade, Seafaring & Conflict 貿易、航海與衝突

items.def: to steal goods by force, especially in war
items.s: The invaders tried to ________ the temple's gold, but the priests had hidden it in a secret room.
items.zh: 入侵者試圖掠奪神廟的黃金,但祭司們已經把它藏在一間密室裡。
items.sec: Trade, Seafaring & Conflict 貿易、航海與衝突

items.def: an attempt by people to fight against their rulers
items.s: The peasants started a ________ because taxes were too high, but the army stopped it within a month.
items.zh: 農民們因為稅太重而發動起義,但軍隊在一個月內就鎮壓了。
items.sec: Trade, Seafaring & Conflict 貿易、航海與衝突

items.def: an agreement between groups to support each other
items.s: The two cities formed an ________ against their common enemy, and together they won the war.
items.zh: 這兩座城市結成聯盟對抗共同的敵人,並一起贏得了戰爭。
items.sec: Trade, Seafaring & Conflict 貿易、航海與衝突

items.def: the loss of power or success
items.s: Bad harvests and endless wars led to the ________ of the empire, so its great cities slowly became empty.
items.zh: 歉收和無休止的戰爭導致帝國的衰敗,所以它的偉大城市漸漸變得空蕩。
items.sec: Trade, Seafaring & Conflict 貿易、航海與衝突

items.def: to increase or build up gradually over time
items.s: Layers of mud began to ________ over the old city, so after many centuries it was completely hidden underground.
items.zh: 一層層的泥土開始在古城上累積,所以經過許多世紀後它完全被埋在地下。

items.def: to decorate something to make it beautiful
items.s: Ancient Egyptians liked to ________ their tombs with bright paintings, and many of the colours are still clear today.
items.zh: 古埃及人喜歡用鮮豔的圖畫裝飾他們的墳墓,其中許多顏色至今仍然清晰。

items.def: to go up or climb
items.s: Visitors must ________ more than two hundred steps to reach the top of the temple, but the view is worth the effort.
items.zh: 遊客必須登上兩百多級台階才能到達神廟頂端,但那景色值得這番努力。

items.def: to leave something to someone after you die
items.s: The rich collector decided to ________ his ancient coins to the museum, so everyone could enjoy them.
items.zh: 這位富有的收藏家決定把他的古錢幣遺贈給博物館,讓每個人都能欣賞。

items.def: to record events in the order they happened
items.s: Monks used to ________ every important event in the kingdom, and their books are now valuable to historians.
items.zh: 修道士過去會記錄王國中每一件重要的事,他們的書現在對歷史學家非常珍貴。

items.def: to do something special to remember a person or event
items.s: The city built a statue to ________ the famous queen, and people place flowers there every year.
items.zh: 市政府建造了一座雕像來紀念那位著名的女王,人們每年都會在那裡獻花。

items.def: to argue that something is wrong or not true
items.s: Some historians ________ the idea that the city was destroyed by war, because they found no weapons there.
items.zh: 一些歷史學家質疑這座城市是被戰爭摧毀的說法,因為他們在那裡沒有找到武器。

items.def: to damage the surface of something, especially by writing on it
items.s: Some tourists ________ the ancient walls with their names, so the government now fines anyone who does this.
items.zh: 一些遊客在古老的牆上寫名字而毀損了它們,所以政府現在對任何這樣做的人處以罰款。

items.def: to go down
items.s: We had to ________ a narrow staircase into the tomb, and the air became cooler with every step.
items.zh: 我們必須走下一道狹窄的樓梯進入墳墓,每走一步空氣就變得更涼。

items.def: to live in a place
items.s: People used to ________ in these caves during the winter, but they moved to the river valley in summer.
items.zh: 人們過去冬天居住在這些洞穴裡,但夏天會搬到河谷。

items.def: to become more important or successful than something else
items.s: The new port began to ________ the old trading town, so many merchants packed up and moved away.
items.zh: 新港口開始使舊的貿易城鎮黯然失色,所以許多商人收拾行李搬走了。

items.def: to happen after or as a result of something
items.s: When the king died without a son, a long fight for power began to ________, and the kingdom was divided.
items.zh: 當國王死時沒有兒子,一場漫長的權力爭奪隨之而來,王國也因此分裂。

items.def: to build or put up something tall
items.s: Ancient people managed to ________ huge stones in a circle, although they had no machines or metal tools.
items.zh: 古人成功地把巨石豎立成一圈,雖然他們沒有機器或金屬工具。

items.def: to put out a fire or end something
items.s: The villagers tried to ________ the fire with river water, but the wooden temple burned to the ground.
items.zh: 村民們試著用河水撲滅火勢,但那座木造神廟還是被燒成平地。

items.def: to praise someone and make them seem better than they are
items.s: Old paintings often ________ the king as a great hero, although historians know he lost many battles.
items.zh: 古老的畫作常常把國王美化成偉大的英雄,雖然歷史學家知道他輸了許多戰役。

items.def: to make someone famous for a very long time
items.s: The poet wanted to ________ the brave soldiers in his poem, and people still read it two thousand years later.
items.zh: 詩人想在他的詩中使那些勇敢的士兵永垂不朽,兩千年後人們仍然在讀這首詩。

items.def: to receive money or property from someone who has died
items.s: The young prince would ________ the throne when his father died, so he was trained to rule from childhood.
items.zh: 年輕的王子將在父親去世後繼承王位,所以他從小就接受統治的訓練。

items.def: to feel or say that you are very sad about something
items.s: Many local people ________ the loss of the old market, because it was replaced by a modern shopping centre.
items.zh: 許多當地人哀嘆老市集的消失,因為它被一座現代購物中心取代了。

items.def: to stay for a long time
items.s: Visitors often ________ in front of the golden mask, because it is the most beautiful object in the museum.
items.zh: 參觀者常常在黃金面具前逗留,因為它是博物館裡最美的物品。

items.def: to spoil or damage something
items.s: Ugly modern buildings ________ the view of the ancient castle, so many tourists feel disappointed when they arrive.
items.zh: 醜陋的現代建築破壞了古堡的景觀,所以許多遊客抵達時都感到失望。

items.def: to tell a story or describe events
items.s: An actor will ________ the history of the city during the light show, and the story will be shown on the old walls.
items.zh: 一位演員將在燈光秀期間講述這座城市的歷史,故事會投影在古老的城牆上。

items.def: to destroy something completely
items.s: The volcano managed to ________ the town in a single day, but the ash also preserved many buildings perfectly.
items.zh: 火山在一天之內就徹底摧毀了這座城鎮,但火山灰也完整地保存了許多建築。

items.def: to spread over a place in large numbers
items.s: After the people left, wild plants ________ the city, and the temples were hidden by trees for centuries.
items.zh: 人們離開後,野生植物蔓延整座城市,神廟被樹木遮蓋了好幾個世紀。

items.def: to die, especially in a terrible way
items.s: Thousands of people ________ when the volcano erupted, because they did not have enough time to escape.
items.zh: 火山爆發時數千人喪生,因為他們沒有足夠的時間逃離。

items.def: to announce something officially and publicly
items.s: After the battle, the general decided to ________ himself emperor, but many soldiers refused to follow him.
items.zh: 戰役結束後,那位將軍決定宣布自己為皇帝,但許多士兵拒絕追隨他。

items.def: to search a place roughly and steal things
items.s: Robbers ________ the tomb long ago, so archaeologists found only broken pots and a few small beads.
items.zh: 盜墓者很久以前就洗劫了這座墳墓,所以考古學家只找到破碎的陶罐和幾顆小珠子。

items.def: to completely destroy a building or town
items.s: The invaders tried to ________ the city to the ground, but some of its strong stone walls survived.
items.zh: 入侵者試圖把這座城市夷為平地,但它一些堅固的石牆倖存了下來。

items.def: to tell someone about something that happened
items.s: The old sailor liked to ________ stories about his voyages, and the children listened with wide eyes.
items.zh: 老水手喜歡講述他航行的故事,孩子們睜大眼睛聽著。

items.def: to find something again after it was lost or forgotten
items.s: Explorers managed to ________ the lost city in 1911, although local farmers had known about it for years.
items.zh: 探險家在1911年重新發現了這座失落之城,雖然當地農民多年來早已知道它的存在。

items.def: to use something for a new purpose
items.s: The town decided to ________ the old prison as a history museum, so visitors can now explore its dark cells.
items.zh: 小鎮決定把舊監獄改作歷史博物館,所以遊客現在可以探索它陰暗的牢房。

items.def: to bring something back into use or existence
items.s: Historians tried to ________ ancient recipes, and they cooked bread exactly as the Romans did.
items.zh: 歷史學家試圖復原古代食譜,他們完全按照羅馬人的方式烤麵包。

items.def: to respect and admire someone or something deeply
items.s: The local people ________ the old tree as a sacred symbol, so nobody is allowed to cut its branches.
items.zh: 當地人把那棵老樹尊崇為神聖的象徵,所以沒有人被允許砍它的樹枝。

items.def: to build or place something in a particular position
items.s: The ancient people chose to ________ their village on a hill, because it was safer from floods and enemies.
items.zh: 古人選擇把他們的村莊建在山丘上,因為那裡比較不會受洪水和敵人侵擾。

items.def: to take the place of something older
items.s: Iron tools began to ________ bronze ones, because iron was easier to find and much stronger.
items.zh: 鐵器開始取代青銅器,因為鐵比較容易取得而且堅固得多。

items.def: to guess something without much evidence
items.s: From the size of the house, we can ________ that a rich family lived there, but we do not know their names.
items.zh: 從房子的大小,我們可以推測那裡住過一個富有的家庭,但我們不知道他們的名字。

items.def: to show that something is true
items.s: The beautiful gold jewellery seems to ________ to the wealth of the city, so it must have been a busy trading centre.
items.zh: 這些美麗的金飾似乎證明了這座城市的富裕,所以它一定曾是繁忙的貿易中心。

items.def: to make something or someone fall
items.s: Angry citizens tried to ________ the cruel ruler, and they pulled down his statue in the main square.
items.zh: 憤怒的市民試圖推翻殘暴的統治者,他們在主廣場上拉倒了他的雕像。

items.def: to make people leave their home and move far away
items.s: The war managed to ________ thousands of families, so whole villages were empty for many years.
items.zh: 戰爭讓數千個家庭被迫離開家園,所以整個村莊空了好多年。

items.def: to have and use power or a weapon
items.s: Priests used to ________ great power in ancient Egypt, and even kings asked them for advice.
items.zh: 在古埃及,祭司過去握有很大的權力,連國王都會向他們請教。

items.def: to exist in large numbers
items.s: Stories about hidden treasure ________ in this region, so treasure hunters often visit with metal tools.
items.zh: 這個地區充滿有關隱藏寶藏的故事,所以尋寶者常帶著金屬工具來訪。

items.def: to join two or more things together into one
items.s: The two kingdoms decided to ________ through marriage, and the new country became the strongest in the region.
items.zh: 這兩個王國決定透過聯姻合併,而新的國家成為該地區最強大的國家。

items.def: to take control of a country or area and add it to your own
items.s: The emperor tried to ________ the small island, because it was an important stop for trading ships.
items.zh: 皇帝試圖併吞那座小島,因為它是貿易船隻的重要中繼站。

items.def: to store documents or records in an organised way
items.s: The library will ________ the old letters in a safe room, and students can read digital copies online.
items.zh: 圖書館會把這些舊信件歸檔保存在安全的房間裡,學生可以在網路上閱讀數位副本。

items.def: to be disloyal to someone who trusts you
items.s: The general decided to ________ his king, and he opened the city gates to the enemy at night.
items.zh: 那位將軍決定背叛他的國王,他在夜裡為敵人打開了城門。

items.def: to break into small pieces slowly
items.s: The old walls began to ________ after centuries of rain, so workers are now repairing them stone by stone.
items.zh: 經過幾個世紀的雨水沖刷,古老的城牆開始崩塌,所以工人們正在一塊一塊地修補。

items.def: to give an official order
items.s: The emperor ________ that everyone must use the same weights and measures, so trade became easier across the land.
items.zh: 皇帝下令每個人都必須使用相同的度量衡,所以全國的貿易變得更加容易。

items.def: to break into many small parts
items.s: The old paper can ________ if you touch it, so the experts wear gloves and use special tools.
items.zh: 那些古老的紙張一碰就可能碎裂,所以專家們戴著手套並使用特殊工具。

items.def: to add details to a story to make it more interesting
items.s: Storytellers often ________ old legends with magic and monsters, so it is hard to know what really happened.
items.zh: 說書人常常在古老的傳說中添加魔法和怪物,所以很難知道真正發生了什麼事。

items.def: to protect an idea or right, often in law
items.s: The new law will ________ the protection of ancient sites, so nobody can build on them without permission.
items.zh: 新法律將把古蹟保護明文載入,所以未經許可任何人都不能在上面建造。

items.def: to force someone to leave their country
items.s: The new king decided to ________ his brother to a distant island, because he was afraid of losing his throne.
items.zh: 新國王決定把他的弟弟流放到遙遠的島上,因為他害怕失去王位。

items.def: to change records to trick people
items.s: Some officials used to ________ the tax records, so the emperor received much less gold than he expected.
items.zh: 一些官員過去會竄改稅收紀錄,所以皇帝收到的黃金比他預期的少得多。

items.def: to officially control a country or area
items.s: The emperor sent his sons to ________ the far provinces, but they often fought with each other.
items.zh: 皇帝派他的兒子們去治理遙遠的省份,但他們常常互相爭鬥。

items.def: to be a sign that something is going to happen
items.s: The invention of writing seemed to ________ a new age, because laws and stories could now be kept forever.
items.zh: 文字的發明似乎預示了一個新時代,因為法律和故事現在可以永久保存。

items.def: to think that something is better than it really is
items.s: People often ________ life in ancient times, but most people worked very hard and died young.
items.zh: 人們常常把古代生活理想化,但大多數人工作非常辛苦而且很年輕就去世。

items.def: to open a new building or start something officially
items.s: The mayor will ________ the new museum next month, and entry will be free for the first week.
items.zh: 市長將在下個月為新博物館舉行開幕典禮,第一週入場免費。

items.def: to encourage people to be violent or angry
items.s: The rebel leader tried to ________ the peasants against the king, so soldiers were sent to arrest him.
items.zh: 叛軍首領試圖煽動農民反抗國王,所以士兵被派去逮捕他。

items.def: to mix together
items.s: In busy ports, many cultures began to ________, so the food, music and languages became very rich.
items.zh: 在繁忙的港口,許多文化開始交融,所以食物、音樂和語言都變得非常豐富。

items.def: to treat a group of people cruelly and unfairly
items.s: The cruel ruler continued to ________ the farmers with high taxes, so many of them ran away to the mountains.
items.zh: 那位殘暴的統治者持續用重稅壓迫農民,所以許多人逃到了山裡。

items.def: to live longer than someone or something
items.s: Good stone buildings can ________ the people who built them by thousands of years, and the pyramids are a great example.
items.zh: 好的石造建築能比建造它們的人存在更久好幾千年,而金字塔就是一個絕佳的例子。

items.def: to remove a ruler from power by force
items.s: The soldiers ________ the emperor in a single night, and they chose a new leader from their own army.
items.zh: 士兵們在一夜之間推翻了皇帝,並從自己的軍隊中選出了新的領袖。

items.def: to exist earlier than something else
items.s: The stone circle seems to ________ the pyramids by several hundred years, so it is even older than people thought.
items.zh: 這個石圈似乎早於金字塔好幾百年,所以它比人們以為的還要古老。

items.def: to get back something that was taken from you
items.s: Several countries want to ________ ancient objects from foreign museums, because they believe these treasures belong at home.
items.zh: 好幾個國家想從外國博物館收回古代文物,因為他們認為這些寶物屬於自己的國家。

items.def: to put someone or something back in its old position
items.s: After the war, the people chose to ________ the old king, because the new ruler had been cruel.
items.zh: 戰後,人民選擇恢復舊國王的王位,因為新統治者很殘暴。

items.def: to officially give up a right or position
items.s: The prince chose to ________ his right to the throne, so he could marry the woman he loved.
items.zh: 王子選擇放棄他的王位繼承權,這樣他就能和他心愛的女子結婚。

items.def: to look like or be similar to something
items.s: The ancient tools ________ modern kitchen knives, so it is easy to guess what they were used for.
items.zh: 這些古代工具很像現代的菜刀,所以很容易猜到它們的用途。

items.def: to fight against something or refuse to accept it
items.s: The small town managed to ________ the invaders for months, but finally it ran out of food and water.
items.zh: 這個小鎮成功抵抗入侵者好幾個月,但最終耗盡了食物和水。

items.def: to move back, especially in a battle
items.s: The army had to ________ when winter came, because the soldiers did not have warm clothes or enough food.
items.zh: 冬天來臨時軍隊必須撤退,因為士兵們沒有保暖的衣服或足夠的食物。

items.def: to have something as the main subject or centre
items.s: Life in the village used to ________ around the harvest, so everyone helped in the fields during autumn.
items.zh: 過去村莊的生活圍繞著收成,所以秋天每個人都會到田裡幫忙。

items.def: to spread things over a wide area
items.s: The storm seemed to ________ the ship's cargo across the seabed, so divers found jars over a large area.
items.zh: 暴風雨似乎把船上的貨物散落在整片海床上,所以潛水員在大範圍內發現了陶罐。

items.def: to become less strong or return to normal
items.s: When the floods began to ________, the villagers returned and found that their houses were covered in mud.
items.zh: 洪水開始消退時,村民們回到家,發現房子都被泥巴覆蓋了。

items.def: to stop fighting and accept defeat
items.s: The city decided to ________ after a long siege, because the people inside were starving.
items.zh: 經過長時間的圍城,這座城市決定投降,因為城內的人們正在挨餓。

items.def: to make something less bright or damage a reputation
items.s: Silver coins ________ quickly in damp air, so the museum keeps them in special dry cases.
items.zh: 銀幣在潮濕的空氣中很快就會失去光澤,所以博物館把它們存放在特殊的乾燥櫃中。

items.def: to stop someone from doing what they planned
items.s: Guards managed to ________ the robbers' plan, so the golden statues stayed safely inside the temple.
items.zh: 警衛成功挫敗了盜賊的計畫,所以黃金雕像安全地留在神廟裡。

items.def: a natural liking for or connection with something
items.s: The two ancient languages show a strong ________ with each other, so experts believe they came from the same source.
items.zh: 這兩種古代語言彼此顯示出很強的相似性,所以專家相信它們來自同一個源頭。

items.def: loyalty to a leader, country or group
items.s: The soldiers swore ________ to the new king, but some of them secretly supported his brother.
items.zh: 士兵們宣誓效忠新國王,但其中一些人暗中支持他的弟弟。

items.def: a situation with no government or order
items.s: After the emperor was killed, the country fell into ________, and robbers controlled many of the roads.
items.zh: 皇帝被殺後,國家陷入了無政府狀態,盜匪控制了許多道路。

items.def: something that existed before and influenced something later
items.s: The ancient Greek theatre is an ________ of modern drama, so many plays today still follow its rules.
items.zh: 古希臘劇場是現代戲劇的前身,所以今天許多戲劇仍然遵循它的規則。

items.def: the highest point of something
items.s: The empire reached its ________ around the year 100, but it slowly grew weaker after that.
items.zh: 這個帝國大約在西元100年達到巔峰,但之後逐漸衰弱。

items.def: great skill in creating something beautiful
items.s: The ________ of the golden mask amazed the visitors, because every tiny detail was perfectly made by hand.
items.zh: 黃金面具的藝術技巧讓參觀者驚嘆,因為每一個細節都是手工完美製作的。

items.def: a position of power or control
items.s: The city gained ________ over its neighbours through trade, and soon it controlled the whole coast.
items.zh: 這座城市透過貿易取得了對鄰近城市的支配地位,很快就控制了整個海岸。

items.def: a sudden event that causes great damage
items.s: The flood was a terrible ________ for the farming town, and many families lost their homes and animals.
items.zh: 這場洪水對這個農業小鎮是一場可怕的災難,許多家庭失去了家園和牲畜。

items.def: a shared feature or interest
items.s: There is a clear ________ between the two cultures, because both built pyramids and worshipped the sun.
items.zh: 這兩種文化之間有明顯的共同點,因為兩者都建造金字塔並崇拜太陽。

items.def: an extra feeling or idea that a word suggests
items.s: The word "barbarian" has a negative ________, but in ancient Greek it simply meant someone who spoke another language.
items.zh: 「野蠻人」這個字帶有負面的含義,但在古希臘語中它只是指說另一種語言的人。

items.def: the state of continuing without stopping or changing
items.s: There is great ________ in the village's traditions, because people still celebrate festivals that began a thousand years ago.
items.zh: 這個村莊的傳統有很強的延續性,因為人們仍然慶祝始於一千年前的節慶。

items.def: the most important part on which something is based
items.s: Farming was the ________ of the ancient economy, so a bad harvest could make the whole kingdom poor.
items.zh: 農業是古代經濟的基石,所以一次歉收就可能讓整個王國陷入貧困。

items.def: a person or group responsible for protecting something
items.s: The museum sees itself as the ________ of the nation's history, so it takes great care of every object.
items.zh: 博物館把自己視為國家歷史的守護者,所以它非常細心地照顧每一件物品。

items.def: the beginning of something
items.s: The ________ of farming happened about ten thousand years ago, and it slowly changed the way humans lived.
items.zh: 農業的開端大約在一萬年前,它逐漸改變了人類的生活方式。

items.def: behaviour showing too much love of pleasure and luxury
items.s: Some writers blamed the ________ of the rich for the fall of Rome, although historians now point to many other causes.
items.zh: 一些作家把羅馬的衰亡歸咎於富人的頹廢,雖然歷史學家現在指出了許多其他原因。

items.def: a person related to someone who lived long ago
items.s: DNA tests showed that the farmer was a ________ of the ancient king, and the news surprised his whole village.
items.zh: DNA檢測顯示這位農夫是那位古代國王的後裔,這個消息讓全村都感到驚訝。

items.def: the power to rule, or the land that someone rules
items.s: The king had ________ over a vast area, but he rarely visited the distant parts of his land.
items.zh: 國王擁有廣大地區的統治權,但他很少造訪領土的偏遠地區。

items.def: a large, impressive building
items.s: The palace was a magnificent ________ of marble and gold, so visitors from other lands were amazed by it.
items.zh: 這座宮殿是一座用大理石和黃金建成的宏偉建築,所以來自其他地方的訪客都被它震撼。

items.def: the whole of something
items.s: The museum will show the collection in its ________ for the first time, so visitors can see all five hundred objects.
items.zh: 博物館將首次展出收藏品的全部,所以參觀者可以看到全部五百件物品。

items.def: a short part taken from a longer text
items.s: Our teacher read an ________ from an ancient diary, and we learned how a Roman soldier felt about his job.
items.zh: 老師朗讀了一段古代日記的節選,我們了解了一名羅馬士兵對他的工作有什麼感受。

items.def: a situation where many people leave a place at the same time
items.s: There was a mass ________ from the city after the river dried up, so the streets were soon empty.
items.zh: 河流乾涸後,城市出現了大規模的人口外移,所以街道很快就空了。

items.def: a wide, open area of land, sea or sky
items.s: A huge ________ of desert separated the two cities, so traders needed camels to carry water.
items.zh: 一大片廣闊的沙漠隔開了這兩座城市,所以商人需要駱駝來運水。

items.def: the basic structure of a society
items.s: Long years of war and disease destroyed the ________ of society, and many villages were never rebuilt.
items.zh: 多年的戰爭和疾病摧毀了社會的結構,許多村莊再也沒有重建。

items.def: a small group within a larger group, often in conflict
items.s: One ________ in the senate wanted peace, but the other group pushed the city into a long war.
items.zh: 元老院中的一個派系希望和平,但另一派把城市推向了一場漫長的戰爭。

items.def: a long, bitter argument between families or groups
items.s: The ________ between the two families lasted for generations, and nobody could remember how it started.
items.zh: 這兩個家族之間的世仇持續了好幾代,沒有人記得它是怎麼開始的。

items.def: traditional stories and beliefs of a community
items.s: According to local ________, a dragon once lived in the hills, so the villagers built a temple to keep it calm.
items.zh: 根據當地的民間傳說,山丘上曾經住著一條龍,所以村民們建了一座廟來安撫牠。

items.def: something that came before and led to something newer
items.s: The ancient Chinese compass was a ________ of modern navigation tools, and it helped sailors travel much farther.
items.zh: 古代中國的指南針是現代導航工具的前身,它幫助水手航行得更遠。

items.def: a mixture of different things joined together
items.s: The city's art shows a ________ of Greek and Indian styles, because the two cultures met there through trade.
items.zh: 這座城市的藝術呈現了希臘和印度風格的融合,因為這兩種文化透過貿易在那裡相遇。

items.def: the beginning or origin of something
items.s: The ________ of the Olympic Games goes back to ancient Greece, where athletes competed to honour the gods.
items.zh: 奧林匹克運動會的起源可以追溯到古希臘,當時運動員比賽是為了榮耀神明。

items.def: the quality of being very large and impressive
items.s: The ________ of the ancient temple took our breath away, and we spent the whole afternoon exploring it.
items.zh: 那座古老神廟的宏偉讓我們嘆為觀止,我們花了整個下午探索它。

items.def: the act of living in a place
items.s: There are signs of human ________ in the cave, so people probably lived there for thousands of years.
items.zh: 洞穴裡有人類居住的跡象,所以人們可能在那裡生活了數千年。

items.def: a person who will receive someone's property or position
items.s: The king had no ________, so after his death his cousins fought over the throne for many years.
items.zh: 國王沒有繼承人,所以他死後他的堂兄弟們為了王位爭鬥了好多年。

items.def: the time when something was most successful
items.s: In its ________, the port had hundreds of ships every day, but now it is a quiet fishing village.
items.zh: 在它的全盛時期,這個港口每天有數百艘船,但現在它是一個安靜的漁村。

items.def: something done to show great respect
items.s: Every year, thousands of people pay ________ to the ancient king by visiting his tomb on his birthday.
items.zh: 每年都有數千人在古代國王生日那天造訪他的陵墓,向他致敬。

items.def: a famous person or thing that represents an idea
items.cn: 象徵;代表性人物或事物
items.s: The Great Wall has become an ________ of China, and millions of tourists walk along it every year.
items.zh: 長城已經成為中國的象徵,每年有數百萬遊客沿著它行走。

items.def: a mark or lasting effect left by something
items.s: The Romans left a deep ________ on European culture, and many modern languages come from Latin.
items.zh: 羅馬人在歐洲文化上留下了深刻的印記,許多現代語言源自拉丁語。

items.def: a sudden attack into another country's land
items.s: The wall was built to stop ________ from the north, but enemy soldiers still found ways to get through.
items.zh: 這道城牆是為了阻止來自北方的侵襲而建造的,但敵軍仍然找到了穿越的方法。

items.def: a person who helps two sides communicate or trade
items.s: Desert tribes acted as an ________ between East and West, so they became rich by moving goods across the sand.
items.zh: 沙漠部落充當東西方之間的中間人,所以他們靠著穿越沙漠運送貨物而致富。

items.def: a particular point in time, especially an important one
items.s: At this ________ in history, the small kingdom had to choose between war and peace, and its choice changed everything.
items.zh: 在歷史的這個關頭,這個小王國必須在戰爭與和平之間做出選擇,而它的選擇改變了一切。

items.def: knowledge and stories passed down within a group
items.s: Old sailors shared ________ about the stars, so young crew members learned to find their way at night.
items.zh: 老水手們分享關於星星的傳統知識,所以年輕船員學會在夜裡辨別方向。

items.def: impressive beauty and greatness
items.s: The ________ of the mountain temple impressed every visitor, especially when the morning sun lit up its golden roof.
items.zh: 山中神廟的莊嚴讓每位訪客印象深刻,尤其是早晨陽光照亮它金色屋頂的時候。

items.def: a pattern or idea that is repeated in art
items.s: The lotus flower is a common ________ in Egyptian art, and you can see it on walls, jewellery and pottery.
items.zh: 蓮花是埃及藝術中常見的圖案,你可以在牆壁、珠寶和陶器上看到它。

items.def: a quality of mystery that makes something attractive
items.s: The lost city has a special ________, so many films and novels have been written about it.
items.zh: 這座失落之城有一種特殊的神秘感,所以許多電影和小說都以它為題材。

items.def: a person who gives money to support artists or projects
items.s: A rich ________ paid for the temple's paintings, and his face was painted among the gods as a reward.
items.zh: 一位富有的贊助人出資繪製神廟的壁畫,作為回報,他的臉被畫在眾神之中。

items.def: great danger
items.s: Sailors faced great ________ on long voyages, because storms and pirates could appear at any time.
items.zh: 水手們在長途航行中面臨極大的危險,因為暴風雨和海盜隨時可能出現。

items.def: all the people who will live in the future
items.s: The king built huge monuments for ________, because he wanted people to remember him forever.
items.zh: 國王為後世建造了巨大的紀念碑,因為他希望人們永遠記住他。

items.def: something that comes before and leads to something else
items.s: The abacus was a ________ of the calculator, and traders used it for thousands of years.
items.zh: 算盤是計算機的先驅,商人們使用它長達數千年。

items.def: the place where something comes from and its history
items.s: The museum checks the ________ of every object, so it does not buy anything that was stolen from a site.
items.zh: 博物館會查核每件物品的來源,所以它不會購買任何從遺址被盜出的東西。

items.def: a long search for something
items.s: The explorer's ________ for the lost city lasted twenty years, but he never found what he was looking for.
items.zh: 這位探險家對失落之城的追尋持續了二十年,但他始終沒有找到他要找的東西。

items.def: a place that gives protection from danger
items.s: The cave offered ________ during the war, and families hid there until the soldiers left the valley.
items.zh: 戰爭期間洞穴提供了庇護,家家戶戶躲在那裡直到士兵離開山谷。

items.def: a small part that remains of something larger
items.s: Only a ________ of the old city wall survives today, but it shows how strong the defences once were.
items.zh: 今天只剩下舊城牆的一小段殘餘,但它顯示了當年的防禦有多堅固。

items.def: a new period of interest and activity in something
items.s: The town is enjoying a cultural ________, because young artists have opened studios in its old buildings.
items.zh: 這個城鎮正經歷一場文化復興,因為年輕藝術家在它的老建築裡開設了工作室。

items.def: a place where things are stored
items.s: The ancient library was a ________ of knowledge, but a terrible fire destroyed most of its scrolls.
items.zh: 那座古代圖書館是知識的寶庫,但一場可怕的大火燒毀了它大部分的卷軸。

items.def: a traditional ceremony
items.s: The ________ of passage marked the day a boy became a man, and the whole village came to watch.
items.zh: 這個成年儀式標誌著男孩成為男人的那一天,全村的人都來觀禮。

items.def: the quality of being holy or very important
items.s: Visitors must respect the ________ of the temple, so they are asked to remove their shoes and speak quietly.
items.zh: 參觀者必須尊重神廟的神聖性,所以他們被要求脫鞋並輕聲說話。

items.def: complete power to govern a country
items.s: The small island fought for its ________ for many years, and finally it became an independent nation.
items.zh: 這座小島為了它的主權奮鬥了許多年,最後成為一個獨立的國家。

items.def: great beauty and impressive appearance
items.s: The ________ of the royal palace showed the power of the king, and foreign visitors were often speechless.
items.zh: 皇宮的輝煌展現了國王的權勢,外國訪客常常說不出話來。

items.def: the importance or reputation of someone
items.s: The city grew in ________ as more traders arrived, and soon it was the richest place in the region.
items.zh: 隨著越來越多商人到來,這座城市的地位日漸提高,很快就成為該地區最富裕的地方。

items.def: the ability to survive with just enough food
items.s: Most families lived at a ________ level, so they grew only enough food to feed themselves.
items.zh: 大多數家庭過著勉強維生的生活,所以他們只種植足夠養活自己的食物。

items.def: the position of being the most powerful
items.s: The two cities fought for ________ at sea, because the winner would control the rich trade routes.
items.zh: 這兩座城市為了海上霸權而戰,因為勝利者將控制富饒的貿易路線。

items.def: the period when someone holds an important position
items.s: During his ________ as governor, he built schools and roads, so people remembered him as a fair leader.
items.zh: 在他擔任總督的任期內,他興建了學校和道路,所以人們記得他是一位公正的領袖。

items.def: something that clearly shows that something is true
items.s: The pyramids are a ________ to the skill of ancient engineers, because they are still standing after 4,500 years.
items.zh: 金字塔是古代工程師技術的證明,因為它們在四千五百年後仍然屹立。

items.def: a state of great confusion or disorder
items.s: The kingdom was in ________ after the king's death, so many people fled to safer lands.
items.zh: 國王死後王國陷入動盪,所以許多人逃往較安全的地方。

items.def: a situation where people fight against those in power
items.s: The ________ began in the countryside, but it soon spread to the capital and frightened the emperor.
items.zh: 這場起義從鄉間開始,但很快就蔓延到首都,讓皇帝感到恐慌。

items.def: a small part or sign of something that once existed
items.s: The last ________ of the old road can still be seen in the forest, so hikers sometimes walk along it.
items.zh: 舊道路的最後遺跡仍然可以在森林中看到,所以登山客有時會沿著它行走。

items.def: the time when something is most powerful or successful
items.s: At its ________, the empire controlled most of the known world, and its capital had a million people.
items.zh: 在它的鼎盛時期,這個帝國控制了大部分已知世界,首都有一百萬人口。

items.def: connected with farming and farmland
items.s: Most ancient societies were ________, so the success of the harvest decided whether people lived or starved.
items.zh: 大多數古代社會都是農業社會,所以收成好壞決定了人們是溫飽還是挨餓。

items.def: secret and understood by only a few people
items.s: The priests used ________ symbols that ordinary people could not read, so their power seemed almost magical.
items.zh: 祭司們使用一般人看不懂的神秘符號,所以他們的力量看起來幾乎像魔法。

items.def: too dry or poor for plants to grow
items.s: The land around the ruins is now ________, but pollen studies show that it was once covered in forests.
items.zh: 遺址周圍的土地現在很貧瘠,但花粉研究顯示那裡曾經被森林覆蓋。

items.def: belonging to a time in the past
items.s: The old photographs remind us of a ________ age, when people travelled by horse and wrote letters by hand.
items.zh: 這些老照片讓我們想起往昔的時代,那時人們騎馬旅行並用手寫信。

items.def: used in or connected with a formal ceremony
items.s: The golden knife was probably ________, because it was too soft to cut anything and it showed no signs of use.
items.zh: 這把黃金刀可能是儀式用的,因為它太軟無法切任何東西,而且沒有使用過的痕跡。

items.def: connected with ancient Greece and Rome
items.s: Many government buildings copy ________ designs, so they have tall white columns like Greek temples.
items.zh: 許多政府建築模仿古典設計,所以它們有像希臘神廟一樣高大的白色柱子。

items.def: extremely large
items.s: A ________ statue of the king once stood at the harbour entrance, and ships sailed between its legs.
items.zh: 一座國王的巨大雕像曾經矗立在港口入口,船隻從它的雙腿之間駛過。

items.def: shared by everyone in a group
items.s: The village had a ________ oven, so families took turns baking their bread there every morning.
items.zh: 村莊有一座共用的烤爐,所以各家每天早上輪流在那裡烤麵包。

items.def: having a hidden meaning that is hard to understand
items.s: The message carved on the stone was ________, and scholars still argue about what it means.
items.zh: 刻在石頭上的訊息很隱晦,學者們至今仍在爭論它的意思。

items.def: no longer existing or working
items.s: The old railway is now ________, but the station has been turned into a small history museum.
items.zh: 那條舊鐵路現在已經廢棄,但車站已被改建成一座小型歷史博物館。

items.def: old and in very bad condition
items.s: The ________ castle was almost falling down, so the town raised money to repair its towers.
items.zh: 那座年久失修的城堡幾乎要倒塌了,所以小鎮募款修復它的塔樓。

items.def: extremely beautiful and delicate
items.s: The museum displays an ________ gold necklace, and its tiny flowers are smaller than a grain of rice.
items.zh: 博物館展示了一條精緻的金項鍊,上面的小花比一粒米還小。

items.def: still existing, especially from long ago
items.s: Only three copies of the ancient book are ________, so each one is extremely valuable.
items.zh: 這本古書只有三本現存,所以每一本都極為珍貴。

items.def: famous and talked about in old stories
items.s: Explorers searched for the ________ city of gold, but most of them returned with nothing.
items.zh: 探險家們尋找傳說中的黃金之城,但大多數人空手而歸。

items.def: able to produce good crops
items.s: The river flooded every year and left ________ soil behind, so farmers could grow plenty of wheat.
items.zh: 河流每年氾濫並留下肥沃的土壤,所以農民能種出大量的小麥。

items.def: connected with a system where peasants worked land for lords
items.s: In the ________ system, peasants worked on the lord's land, and in return he protected them from enemies.
items.zh: 在封建制度下,農民在領主的土地上工作,作為回報,領主保護他們免受敵人侵擾。

items.def: connected with the natural features of an area
items.s: The city's ________ position between two seas made it rich, because every trader had to pass through it.
items.zh: 這座城市位於兩海之間的地理位置讓它變得富裕,因為每個商人都必須經過那裡。

items.def: passed from parents to children
items.s: The title of king was ________, so the oldest son usually became the next ruler.
items.zh: 國王的頭銜是世襲的,所以通常由長子成為下一任統治者。

items.def: important in history
items.s: The ________ agreement ended a war that had lasted fifty years, and both sides celebrated for a week.
items.zh: 這份具有歷史意義的協議結束了一場持續了五十年的戰爭,雙方慶祝了一個星期。

items.def: connected with an empire or an emperor
items.s: The ________ palace had walls painted red, and ordinary people were not allowed to enter it.
items.zh: 皇宮的牆漆成紅色,一般百姓不被允許進入。

items.def: difficult to live in because of harsh conditions
items.s: The desert is an ________ place, but ancient traders crossed it regularly with camels and water bags.
items.zh: 沙漠是一個不適合居住的地方,但古代商人經常帶著駱駝和水袋穿越它。

items.def: very generous, rich or expensive
items.s: The king held ________ parties in his palace, while many of his people did not have enough to eat.
items.zh: 國王在宮殿裡舉辦奢華的宴會,而他的許多人民卻吃不飽。

items.def: made quickly to be used for a short time
items.s: After the flood, families lived in ________ shelters made of branches, so the winter was very hard for them.
items.zh: 洪水過後,家家戶戶住在用樹枝搭成的臨時棚屋裡,所以那個冬天對他們來說非常艱難。

items.def: from the Middle Ages, about 500 to 1500 AD
items.s: The ________ town still has narrow streets and stone walls, so walking there feels like travelling back in time.
items.zh: 這座中世紀小鎮仍然保有狹窄的街道和石牆,所以走在那裡感覺就像回到過去。

items.def: showing great wealth; very luxurious
items.s: The ________ rooms of the palace were full of gold and silk, and each one was decorated differently.
items.zh: 宮殿中富麗堂皇的房間裡堆滿了黃金和絲綢,每一間的裝飾都不一樣。

items.def: decorated with many complicated details
items.s: The church has an ________ ceiling covered with paintings, so visitors often lie on the benches to look up at it.
items.zh: 這座教堂有一片繪滿壁畫的華麗天花板,所以參觀者常常躺在長椅上仰望它。

items.def: connected with country life and keeping animals
items.s: The ________ people moved their sheep between the mountains and valleys, following the grass each season.
items.zh: 這些畜牧民族在山區和山谷之間遷移他們的羊群,每個季節跟著青草走。

items.def: rough, rocky and difficult to travel across
items.s: The ________ mountains protected the kingdom from invaders, because armies could not march through them easily.
items.zh: 崎嶇的山脈保護王國免受入侵,因為軍隊無法輕易地穿越。

items.def: holy and connected with a god
items.s: The mountain was ________ to the local people, so nobody was allowed to climb to the top.
items.zh: 那座山對當地人來說是神聖的,所以沒有人被允許爬到山頂。

items.def: not connected with religion
items.s: Most ancient buildings were temples, but this ________ building was used for markets and meetings.
items.zh: 大多數古代建築是神廟,但這棟世俗的建築被用作市集和集會場所。

items.def: spreading out over a large area
items.cn: 延伸廣闊的;雜亂擴展的
items.s: The ________ ancient city covered more than twenty square kilometres, and only a small part has been excavated.
items.zh: 這座廣闊延伸的古城占地超過二十平方公里,只有一小部分被發掘過。

items.def: existing under the ground
items.s: The city had a ________ network of tunnels, so people could hide underground when enemies attacked.
items.zh: 這座城市有一個地下隧道網絡,所以敵人來襲時人們可以躲到地下。

items.def: changed in colour or shape by wind and rain
items.s: The ________ statues have lost their noses and fingers, but you can still see the shape of their faces.
items.zh: 那些風化的雕像已經失去了鼻子和手指,但你仍然可以看出它們臉部的輪廓。

items.def: impossible to remove or forget
items.s: The Roman Empire left an ________ mark on Europe, and we can still see it in roads, laws and languages.
items.zh: 羅馬帝國在歐洲留下了不可磨滅的印記,我們至今仍能在道路、法律和語言中看到它。

items.def: lasting for a very long time or happening again and again
items.s: Water shortage was a ________ problem in the desert city, so engineers built huge underground tanks.
items.zh: 缺水是這座沙漠城市長期存在的問題,所以工程師建造了巨大的地下水槽。

items.def: famous and respected
items.s: The city was ________ for its glassmaking, and its beautiful cups were sold as far away as China.
items.zh: 這座城市以玻璃製造聞名,它美麗的杯子遠銷到中國。

items.def: able to provide everything you need without help
items.s: The monastery was ________, because the monks grew their own food and made their own clothes.
items.zh: 這座修道院是自給自足的,因為修士們自己種植食物並製作衣服。

items.def: most important or most commonly used
items.s: Rice was the ________ food in the region, so a poor harvest meant hunger for almost everyone.
items.zh: 米是這個地區的主要食物,所以歉收意味著幾乎每個人都會挨餓。

items.def: important for achieving a military or political aim
items.s: The fortress was built in a ________ position above the river, so soldiers could watch every boat that passed.
items.zh: 這座堡壘建在河流上方一個戰略位置,所以士兵能監視每一艘經過的船。

items.def: very expensive and impressive
items.s: The king served a ________ meal to his guests, and it included roast peacock and rare fruits.
items.zh: 國王為客人準備了一頓豐盛的大餐,包括烤孔雀和珍稀水果。

items.def: full of energy and life
items.s: The ancient market was a ________ place, where traders from many lands shouted prices in different languages.
items.zh: 古代市集是一個充滿活力的地方,來自各地的商人用不同的語言喊價。

items.def: empty and without people, often sad
items.s: The once busy city is now ________, and only the wind moves through its empty streets.
items.zh: 這座曾經熱鬧的城市現在一片荒涼,只有風吹過它空蕩的街道。

items.def: simple and not rich or important
items.s: The great emperor came from a ________ family of farmers, but he rose to power through his skill in battle.
items.zh: 這位偉大的皇帝出身於一個卑微的農民家庭,但他靠著戰鬥才能崛起掌權。

items.def: impressive and grand in appearance
items.s: The ________ old house stands in a large park, and its rooms are filled with paintings and old furniture.
items.zh: 那棟宏偉的老宅矗立在一座大公園裡,房間裡擺滿了畫作和古老的家具。

items.def: not affected by changes in time or fashion
items.cn: 永恆的;不受時間影響的
items.s: The ________ beauty of Greek statues still inspires artists, although they were made over two thousand years ago.
items.zh: 希臘雕像永恆的美至今仍啟發著藝術家,雖然它們是兩千多年前製作的。

items.def: continuing for a long time
items.s: The invention of paper had a ________ effect on the world, because books became cheaper and easier to make.
items.zh: 紙的發明對世界產生了持久的影響,因為書變得更便宜也更容易製作。

items.def: in the past; before now
items.s: The library was ________ a royal palace, but now anyone can walk in and read the books for free.
items.zh: 這座圖書館以前是皇宮,但現在任何人都可以走進去免費看書。

items.def: according to what people say
items.s: The castle is ________ haunted by a queen, so many visitors come at night hoping to see her ghost.
items.zh: 據說這座城堡有一位女王的鬼魂出沒,所以許多遊客晚上來希望看到她。

items.def: according to what is generally believed, although it may not be true
items.s: The sword ________ belonged to a famous king, but tests showed that it was made much later.
items.zh: 這把劍據稱屬於一位著名的國王,但檢測顯示它是很久以後才製造的。

items.def: at the same time; while something else is happening
items.s: The men went hunting in the forest, and ________ the women gathered fruit and looked after the children.
items.zh: 男人們到森林裡打獵,與此同時,女人們採集水果並照顧孩子。

items.def: mainly; mostly
items.s: The city became rich ________ through the salt trade, because salt was needed to keep food fresh.
items.zh: 這座城市主要透過鹽的貿易而致富,因為人們需要鹽來保存食物。

items.def: in a surprising way
items.s: The ancient boat was ________ well preserved, so experts could see the marks made by the builders' tools.
items.zh: 這艘古船保存得非常好,所以專家能看到造船工人工具留下的痕跡。

items.def: in a very surprising way
items.s: ________, the seeds found in the tomb started to grow when scientists planted them, although they were two thousand years old.
items.zh: 令人驚訝的是,科學家種下在墳墓中發現的種子後它們竟然開始發芽,雖然它們已有兩千年的歷史。

items.def: with many people or things close together
items.s: The ancient city was ________ populated, so houses were built right next to each other with no gardens.
items.zh: 這座古城人口稠密,所以房子緊挨著建造,沒有花園。

items.def: very carefully and with great effort
items.s: The team ________ glued thousands of pottery pieces back together, and the work took more than two years.
items.zh: 團隊煞費苦心地把數千片陶器碎片重新黏合起來,這項工作花了兩年多。

items.def: only just; almost not
items.s: The writing on the stone is ________ visible today, so experts use special lights to read it.
items.zh: 石頭上的文字如今幾乎看不見了,所以專家使用特殊燈光來閱讀。

items.def: at the present time; now
items.s: The statue is ________ in a museum in London, but many people believe it should return to Greece.
items.zh: 這座雕像目前在倫敦的一間博物館裡,但許多人認為它應該歸還給希臘。

items.def: in the correct or expected way
items.s: The ancient tax was ________ paid by every family, and scribes recorded each payment on clay tablets.
items.zh: 古代的稅如期由每個家庭繳納,書記們把每一筆款項記錄在泥板上。

items.def: completely; fully
items.s: The temple was ________ built by hand, so it took thousands of workers many years to finish it.
items.zh: 這座神廟完全是手工建造的,所以數千名工人花了許多年才完成。

items.def: in a way that cannot be separated
items.s: The history of the city is ________ linked to the river, because the river brought water, food and trade.
items.zh: 這座城市的歷史與河流密不可分,因為河流帶來了水、食物和貿易。

items.def: in a way that cannot be got back or repaired
items.s: Many ancient books were ________ lost in the fire, so we will never know what they said.
items.zh: 許多古書在大火中無法挽回地遺失了,所以我們永遠不會知道它們寫了什麼。

items.def: to have existed since a particular time in the past
items.s: The oldest part of the castle seems to ______ ______ ______ the twelfth century, but the towers were added much later.
items.zh: 這座城堡最古老的部分似乎可追溯到十二世紀,但塔樓是很久以後才加上去的。

items.def: fixed and impossible to change
items.cn: 一成不變的;不可更改的
items.s: Our plans for the museum trip are not ______ ______ ______, so we can change the date if it rains.
items.zh: 我們參觀博物館的計畫並不是一成不變的,所以如果下雨我們可以改日期。

items.def: to try every possible way to find something
items.s: The archaeologists promised to ______ ______ ______ ______ in their search for the lost tomb, so they checked every hill in the valley.
items.zh: 考古學家承諾在尋找失落墳墓時會不遺餘力,所以他們檢查了山谷中的每一座山丘。

items.def: a very short distance
items.s: Our hotel was just ______ ______ ______ from the ancient amphitheatre, so we walked there every evening.
items.zh: 我們的飯店離古代圓形劇場只有一箭之遙,所以我們每天晚上都走路過去。

items.def: to understand a situation by putting separate facts together
items.s: Historians used letters and coins to ______ ______ the story of the city, although many records were lost.
items.zh: 歷史學家利用信件和錢幣拼湊出這座城市的故事,雖然許多紀錄已經遺失。

items.def: to become known
items.s: New facts about the ancient king ______ ______ ______ last year, when workers found his letters in a library basement.
items.zh: 關於這位古代國王的新事實在去年被發現,當時工人在圖書館地下室找到了他的信件。

items.def: to stay strong or popular for a very long time
items.s: Roman roads have ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, and some of them are still used by cars today.
items.zh: 羅馬道路經得起時間的考驗,其中一些至今仍有汽車行駛。

items.def: to create the basic conditions for something to develop
items.s: Greek thinkers helped ______ ______ ______ ______ modern science, because they tried to explain nature through reason.
items.zh: 希臘思想家幫助為現代科學奠定基礎,因為他們試圖用理性解釋自然。

items.def: the growth and later decline of something
items.s: The book describes the ______ ______ ______ of the Roman Empire, and it explains why such a powerful state collapsed.
items.zh: 這本書描述了羅馬帝國的興衰,並解釋了為什麼這麼強大的國家會崩潰。

items.def: the place where an early civilisation first developed
items.s: Mesopotamia is often called ______ ______ ______ ______, because the first cities and writing appeared there.
items.zh: 美索不達米亞常被稱為文明的搖籃,因為最早的城市和文字出現在那裡。

items.def: to be remembered for a long time because of something important
items.s: The discovery of the young king's tomb will ______ ______ ______ ______ as one of the greatest finds ever.
items.zh: 這位年輕國王陵墓的發現將作為有史以來最偉大的發現之一而載入史冊。

items.def: to give knowledge or objects to younger generations
items.s: Families used to ______ ______ old stories from parents to children, because most people could not read or write.
items.zh: 家族過去會把古老的故事從父母傳給孩子,因為大多數人不會讀寫。

items.def: the truth will become clear in the future
items.s: Nobody knows if the new theory about the pyramids is correct, but ______ ______ ______ as more evidence is found.
items.zh: 沒有人知道關於金字塔的新理論是否正確,但隨著更多證據被發現,時間會證明一切。

items.def: to return to an earlier time or situation
items.s: Visiting the old village feels like a way to ______ ______ ______ ______, because people still farm without machines there.
items.zh: 參觀這個古老村莊感覺像是讓時光倒流,因為那裡的人們仍然不用機器耕種。

items.w: Rome wasn't built in a day
items.def: important things take a long time to achieve
items.s: Learning to read ancient languages is slow, but ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, so keep practising every day.
items.zh: 學習閱讀古代語言很慢,但羅馬不是一天造成的,所以每天持續練習吧。

items.def: there are many ways to reach the same goal
items.s: You can study history at university or in a museum job, because ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ if you are passionate.
items.zh: 你可以在大學或博物館工作中學習歷史,因為只要你有熱情,條條大路通羅馬。

items.def: easy to see but not noticed
items.cn: 藏在顯眼處;近在眼前卻未被注意
items.s: The ancient carving was ______ ______ ______ ______ on the church wall, but nobody noticed it until a student took a photo.
items.zh: 那幅古代雕刻就近在眼前地刻在教堂牆上,但直到一名學生拍了照片才有人注意到。

items.def: to deal with only a small part of a subject
items.s: After ten years of digging, the team has only ______ ______ ______ of the huge ancient city, so there is much more to find.
items.zh: 經過十年的挖掘,團隊對這座巨大的古城只觸及皮毛,所以還有更多東西等待發現。

items.def: to stop arguing and become friends again
items.s: The two kings finally decided to ______ ______ ______, and they signed a peace treaty after years of war.
items.zh: 兩位國王終於決定握手言和,他們在多年戰爭之後簽署了和平條約。

items.w: lost in the mists of time
items.def: forgotten because it happened very long ago
items.s: The name of the person who built the stone circle is ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, so we may never know it.
items.zh: 建造這個石圈的人的名字已經湮沒在歷史長河中,所以我們可能永遠無法知道。

9.en: The Industrial Revolution & History of Inventions

items.def: a machine that uses steam to make power
items.s: James Watt improved the ________ in the 1760s, and factories soon used his design to run their machines.
items.zh: 詹姆斯·瓦特在1760年代改良了蒸汽機,而工廠很快就用他的設計來運轉機器。
items.sec: Steam Power & Engines 蒸汽動力與引擎

items.def: a large container where water is heated into steam
items.s: The workers filled the ________ with water every morning, but they had to watch it carefully because it could explode.
items.zh: 工人們每天早上把鍋爐裝滿水,但他們必須小心看著它,因為它可能會爆炸。
items.sec: Steam Power & Engines 蒸汽動力與引擎

items.def: a part that moves up and down inside a tube in an engine
items.s: The steam pushed the ________ up and down, and this movement turned the big wheel of the machine.
items.zh: 蒸汽推動活塞上下移動,而這個動作帶動了機器的大輪子轉動。
items.sec: Steam Power & Engines 蒸汽動力與引擎

items.def: a tube-shaped part of an engine where a piston moves
items.s: Our science teacher showed us a model of an old engine, and we could see the piston moving inside the ________.
items.zh: 我們的自然老師給我們看了一台舊引擎的模型,而我們可以看到活塞在汽缸裡移動。
items.sec: Steam Power & Engines 蒸汽動力與引擎

items.def: a part that opens and closes to control gas or liquid
items.s: The engineer opened the ________ slowly, so the extra steam could escape safely from the old engine.
items.zh: 工程師慢慢打開閥門,好讓多餘的蒸汽能安全地從舊引擎中排出。
items.sec: Steam Power & Engines 蒸汽動力與引擎

items.def: a very hot enclosed fire used to heat or melt things
items.s: The men shovelled coal into the ________ all day, and their faces were always black with dust.
items.zh: 那些男人整天把煤鏟進熔爐裡,而他們的臉總是被灰塵弄得黑黑的。
items.sec: Steam Power & Engines 蒸汽動力與引擎

items.def: a heavy wheel that keeps a machine turning smoothly
items.s: The heavy ________ kept spinning after the steam stopped, so the machine did not suddenly jerk to a halt.
items.zh: 蒸汽停止後,沉重的飛輪仍持續轉動,所以機器不會突然猛地停下來。
items.sec: Steam Power & Engines 蒸汽動力與引擎

items.def: a rod in an engine that turns up-and-down movement into turning
items.s: The mechanic said the ________ in my grandfather's old car was broken, and fixing it would cost a lot of money.
items.zh: 技師說我祖父那輛舊車的曲軸壞了,而修理它要花很多錢。
items.sec: Steam Power & Engines 蒸汽動力與引擎

items.def: a unit for measuring the power of an engine
items.s: Early cars had only a few ________, but people were still amazed because they did not need horses at all.
items.zh: 早期的汽車只有幾匹馬力,但人們仍然很驚訝,因為它們完全不需要馬。
items.sec: Steam Power & Engines 蒸汽動力與引擎

items.def: using coal as the fuel to produce heat or power
items.s: The town had a large ________ power station, and on windy days the smoke drifted over our school.
items.zh: 這個鎮上有一座大型燃煤發電廠,而在颳風的日子,煙會飄到我們學校上空。
items.sec: Steam Power & Engines 蒸汽動力與引擎

items.def: driven by the power of steam
items.s: The museum still runs a ________ printing machine on weekends, and children love watching it work.
items.zh: 博物館在週末仍會運轉一台蒸汽動力的印刷機,而孩子們很喜歡看它運作。
items.sec: Steam Power & Engines 蒸汽動力與引擎

items.def: a part that cools steam and turns it back into water
items.s: Watt added a separate ________ to the engine, so it wasted much less coal than older designs.
items.zh: 瓦特在引擎上加了一個獨立的冷凝器,所以它比舊設計浪費的煤少得多。
items.sec: Steam Power & Engines 蒸汽動力與引擎

items.def: a tall pipe that carries smoke up and out of a building
items.s: Hundreds of tall ________ rose above the city, and thick black smoke poured out of them day and night.
items.zh: 數以百計高高的煙囪聳立在城市上方,而濃濃的黑煙日夜從裡面冒出來。
items.sec: Steam Power & Engines 蒸汽動力與引擎

items.def: a large wheel turned by flowing water to power machines
items.s: Before steam engines, many mills were built next to rivers because they needed a ______ ______ for power.
items.zh: 在蒸汽機出現之前,許多磨坊都建在河邊,因為它們需要水車來提供動力。
items.sec: Steam Power & Engines 蒸汽動力與引擎

items.def: a building with sails that the wind turns to make power
items.s: The old ________ on the hill once ground wheat into flour, but now it is a popular spot for photos.
items.zh: 山丘上那座古老的風車曾經把小麥磨成麵粉,但現在它是熱門的拍照景點。
items.sec: Steam Power & Engines 蒸汽動力與引擎

items.def: a machine with blades that spin to produce power
items.s: Steam flows through the ________ at high speed, and the spinning blades help produce electricity for the city.
items.zh: 蒸汽高速流過渦輪機,而旋轉的葉片幫助為城市產生電力。
items.sec: Steam Power & Engines 蒸汽動力與引擎

items.def: a machine that turns movement into electricity
items.s: My bike has a small ________ on the front wheel, so the light comes on when I pedal at night.
items.zh: 我的腳踏車前輪上有一個小發電機,所以晚上我踩踏板時燈就會亮。
items.sec: Steam Power & Engines 蒸汽動力與引擎

items.def: a machine that produces electricity
items.s: The power went off during the storm, but the hospital switched on its ________ and kept working.
items.zh: 暴風雨期間停電了,但醫院啟動了發電機並持續運作。
items.sec: Steam Power & Engines 蒸汽動力與引擎

items.def: a form of energy used for light, heat and machines
items.s: Before ________ reached their village, families used oil lamps at night, and children did homework by candlelight.
items.zh: 在電力到達他們的村莊之前,家家戶戶晚上用油燈,而孩子們在燭光下寫功課。
items.sec: Steam Power & Engines 蒸汽動力與引擎

items.def: the force of an electric current, measured in volts
items.s: You should check the ________ before you plug in your hair dryer abroad, or it may burn out.
items.zh: 在國外插上吹風機之前你應該檢查電壓,否則它可能會燒壞。
items.sec: Steam Power & Engines 蒸汽動力與引擎

items.def: tiny drops of water or other liquid in the air
items.s: When the kettle boiled, white ________ rose into the cold kitchen, and the windows quickly became cloudy.
items.zh: 水壺燒開時,白色的蒸氣升進寒冷的廚房,而窗戶很快就變得霧濛濛的。
items.sec: Steam Power & Engines 蒸汽動力與引擎

items.def: an engine that burns fuel inside it to make power
items.s: The ______ ______ ______ made cars lighter and faster, so steam cars slowly disappeared from the roads.
items.zh: 內燃機讓汽車更輕更快,所以蒸汽車慢慢從道路上消失了。
items.sec: Steam Power & Engines 蒸汽動力與引擎

items.def: a small part that makes a spark to light fuel in an engine
items.s: My motorbike would not start this morning, and the mechanic said the ______ ______ needed to be replaced.
items.zh: 我的機車今天早上發不動,而技師說火星塞需要更換。
items.sec: Steam Power & Engines 蒸汽動力與引擎

items.def: to become too hot
items.s: The old engine began to ________ on the steep hill, so we stopped and waited for it to cool down.
items.zh: 那台舊引擎在陡坡上開始過熱,所以我們停下來等它冷卻。
items.sec: Steam Power & Engines 蒸汽動力與引擎

items.def: to put oil on parts so they move smoothly
items.s: Workers had to ________ the moving parts every day, because dry metal wore out very quickly.
items.zh: 工人們每天都必須潤滑那些移動的零件,因為乾燥的金屬磨損得很快。
items.sec: Steam Power & Engines 蒸汽動力與引擎

items.def: to become covered with a reddish layer when iron gets wet
items.s: My dad left his tools outside in the rain, and after a week they began to ________ badly.
items.zh: 我爸把他的工具留在外面淋雨,而一週後它們開始嚴重生鏽。
items.sec: Steam Power & Engines 蒸汽動力與引擎

items.def: a machine that pushes liquid or air in or out
items.s: Water kept flooding the mine, so the owners bought a steam ________ to remove it day and night.
items.zh: 水不斷淹進礦坑,所以礦主買了一台蒸汽抽水機日夜把水抽出。
items.sec: Steam Power & Engines 蒸汽動力與引擎

items.def: to add fuel to a fire and keep it burning strongly
items.s: On the old steam train, one man had to ________ the fire all the time, while the driver watched the track.
items.zh: 在那列老蒸汽火車上,一個人必須一直添煤撥火,而司機則盯著鐵軌。
items.sec: Steam Power & Engines 蒸汽動力與引擎

items.def: a place where electricity is produced
items.s: The new ______ ______ supplies electricity to the whole county, but some residents worry about the noise.
items.zh: 新的發電廠供電給整個郡,但一些居民擔心噪音問題。
items.sec: Steam Power & Engines 蒸汽動力與引擎

items.def: a building where goods are made in large numbers by machines
items.s: My aunt works in a shoe ________ near the harbour, and she often has to work late before the holidays.
items.zh: 我阿姨在港口附近的一家鞋子工廠工作,而假期前她經常得加班。
items.sec: Factories, Mills & Textiles 工廠、磨坊與紡織

items.def: a building with machines for making cloth or flour
items.s: The cotton ________ employed over a thousand people, but the noise of the machines was almost unbearable.
items.zh: 那家棉紡廠雇用了一千多人,但機器的噪音幾乎令人無法忍受。
items.sec: Factories, Mills & Textiles 工廠、磨坊與紡織

items.def: a soft white plant fibre used to make cloth
items.s: Britain imported huge amounts of raw ________, and its factories turned it into cheap cloth for the world.
items.zh: 英國進口了大量的原棉,而它的工廠把棉花製成便宜的布料賣到全世界。
items.sec: Factories, Mills & Textiles 工廠、磨坊與紡織

items.def: the soft hair of sheep, used to make cloth
items.s: My grandmother knitted me a scarf from thick ________, and it keeps me warm on cold winter mornings.
items.zh: 我奶奶用厚厚的羊毛為我織了一條圍巾,而它讓我在寒冷的冬天早晨保持溫暖。
items.sec: Factories, Mills & Textiles 工廠、磨坊與紡織

items.def: a simple machine for making thread at home
items.s: Before factories, women made thread at home on a ______ ______, but it took many hours to make enough.
items.zh: 在工廠出現之前,婦女們在家用紡車紡線,但要花好幾個小時才能做出足夠的線。
items.sec: Factories, Mills & Textiles 工廠、磨坊與紡織

items.def: an early machine that spun many threads at once
items.s: The ______ ______ could spin eight threads at once, so one worker could do the job of eight people.
items.zh: 珍妮紡紗機一次可以紡八條線,所以一個工人就能做八個人的工作。
items.sec: Factories, Mills & Textiles 工廠、磨坊與紡織

items.def: a machine driven by power for weaving cloth
items.s: The ______ ______ wove cloth much faster than hand weavers, and many of them lost their jobs.
items.zh: 動力織布機織布比手工織工快得多,而他們之中許多人因此失業。
items.sec: Factories, Mills & Textiles 工廠、磨坊與紡織

items.def: long thread used for knitting or weaving
items.s: She bought some bright red ________ at the market, and she plans to knit a hat for her little brother.
items.zh: 她在市場買了一些鮮紅色的毛線,而她打算為弟弟織一頂帽子。
items.sec: Factories, Mills & Textiles 工廠、磨坊與紡織

items.def: a long thin string of cotton or other material used for sewing
items.s: The button on my coat fell off, so my mother sewed it back on with some black ________.
items.zh: 我外套上的鈕扣掉了,所以我媽媽用一些黑色的線把它縫回去。
items.sec: Factories, Mills & Textiles 工廠、磨坊與紡織

items.def: a thin rod on which thread is wound when it is spun
items.s: Each machine had hundreds of ________ turning at once, and children had to fix the broken threads quickly.
items.zh: 每台機器上有數百個錠子同時轉動,而孩子們必須迅速接好斷掉的線。
items.sec: Factories, Mills & Textiles 工廠、磨坊與紡織

items.def: material made by weaving cotton, wool or other fibres
items.s: The tailor measured me carefully, and then he cut the dark blue ________ to make my school uniform.
items.zh: 裁縫仔細幫我量尺寸,然後他剪裁深藍色的布料來做我的校服。
items.sec: Factories, Mills & Textiles 工廠、磨坊與紡織

items.def: a piece of clothing
items.s: Every ________ in this shop is made from recycled material, but the prices are still quite reasonable.
items.zh: 這家店的每一件衣服都是用回收材料做的,但價格仍相當合理。
items.sec: Factories, Mills & Textiles 工廠、磨坊與紡織

items.def: a machine for joining cloth with thread
items.s: My mum bought an old ______ ______ online, and now she makes curtains and bags for the whole family.
items.zh: 我媽媽在網路上買了一台舊縫紉機,而現在她為全家人做窗簾和袋子。
items.sec: Factories, Mills & Textiles 工廠、磨坊與紡織

items.def: a person who makes cloth by crossing threads on a loom
items.s: The village ________ worked at home for centuries, but factory machines soon took away their income.
items.zh: 村裡的織工幾世紀以來都在家工作,但工廠的機器很快就奪走了他們的收入。
items.sec: Factories, Mills & Textiles 工廠、磨坊與紡織

items.def: work done by people in their own homes
items.s: Making lace was once a ______ ______ in this area, and many families earned extra money from it.
items.zh: 製作蕾絲曾經是這個地區的家庭手工業,而許多家庭藉此賺取額外收入。
items.sec: Factories, Mills & Textiles 工廠、磨坊與紡織

items.def: a room or building where things are made or repaired
items.s: Grandpa spends every afternoon in his ________, and he has built three wooden chairs this year.
items.zh: 爺爺每天下午都待在他的工作坊裡,而他今年已經做了三張木椅。
items.sec: Factories, Mills & Textiles 工廠、磨坊與紡織

items.def: a worker who is in charge of a group of other workers
items.s: The ________ shouted at the boys to work faster, but they were too tired after twelve hours.
items.zh: 工頭對著男孩們大吼要他們做快一點,但工作十二小時後他們已經太累了。
items.sec: Factories, Mills & Textiles 工廠、磨坊與紡織

items.def: to start using machines to do work
items.s: Farmers began to ________ their work in the 1800s, so fewer people were needed in the fields.
items.zh: 農民在1800年代開始讓工作機械化,所以田裡需要的人手變少了。
items.sec: Factories, Mills & Textiles 工廠、磨坊與紡織

items.def: the use of machines to replace human or animal work
items.s: ________ made cloth much cheaper, but it also caused many skilled workers to lose their jobs.
items.zh: 機械化讓布料便宜很多,但也導致許多熟練工人失去工作。
items.sec: Factories, Mills & Textiles 工廠、磨坊與紡織

items.def: a person who owns a factory or mill
items.s: The rich ______ ______ built houses for his workers, while other owners did not care where workers lived.
items.zh: 那位富有的工廠主為他的工人蓋了房子,而其他工廠主並不在乎工人住在哪裡。
items.sec: Factories, Mills & Textiles 工廠、磨坊與紡織

items.def: a natural substance used to make products
items.s: Cotton was the main ______ ______ for the mills, so ships brought it across the ocean every week.
items.zh: 棉花是工廠的主要原料,所以船隻每週都把它運過大洋。
items.sec: Factories, Mills & Textiles 工廠、磨坊與紡織

items.def: products that are ready to be sold
items.s: The factory turned cotton into ______ ______, and trains carried them to shops all over the country.
items.zh: 工廠把棉花變成成品,而火車把它們運到全國各地的商店。
items.sec: Factories, Mills & Textiles 工廠、磨坊與紡織

items.def: a company that makes goods in large amounts
items.s: This toy ________ moved its factory to another country, because the costs there were much lower.
items.zh: 這家玩具製造商把工廠遷到另一個國家,因為那裡的成本低得多。
items.sec: Factories, Mills & Textiles 工廠、磨坊與紡織

items.def: a strong table used for making or repairing things
items.s: He laid all the clock parts on the ________, and he slowly put them back together one by one.
items.zh: 他把所有的時鐘零件攤在工作檯上,然後慢慢地一個一個把它們組裝回去。
items.sec: Factories, Mills & Textiles 工廠、磨坊與紡織

items.def: a skilled person who makes things by hand
items.s: This market sells bread from a local ________, and people queue early because it sells out fast.
items.zh: 這個市場販售當地一位手藝人做的麵包,而人們很早就排隊,因為很快就賣光了。
items.sec: Factories, Mills & Textiles 工廠、磨坊與紡織

items.def: made by hand, not by machine
items.s: Her ________ pottery is more expensive than factory cups, but every piece has its own special pattern.
items.zh: 她手工製作的陶器比工廠做的杯子貴,但每一件都有自己獨特的圖案。
items.sec: Factories, Mills & Textiles 工廠、磨坊與紡織

items.def: produced by a machine, not by hand
items.s: ________ socks were much cheaper than knitted ones, so poor families could finally afford new clothes.
items.zh: 機器製造的襪子比手織的便宜很多,所以貧窮的家庭終於買得起新衣服。
items.sec: Factories, Mills & Textiles 工廠、磨坊與紡織

items.def: a machine that separates cotton fibres from seeds
items.s: The ______ ______ cleaned cotton very quickly, but sadly it also increased the demand for slave labour.
items.zh: 軋棉機能很快地清理棉花,但可悲的是它也增加了對奴隸勞動的需求。
items.sec: Factories, Mills & Textiles 工廠、磨坊與紡織

items.def: identical parts that can replace each other easily
items.s: Guns made with ______ ______ were easy to repair, because a broken piece could simply be swapped.
items.zh: 用可互換零件製造的槍很容易修理,因為壞掉的零件只要直接換掉就好。
items.sec: Factories, Mills & Textiles 工廠、磨坊與紡織

items.def: a place underground where coal is dug out
items.s: My great-grandfather worked in a ______ ______ when he was only twelve, and he rarely saw the sun in winter.
items.zh: 我曾祖父十二歲時就在煤礦工作,而他在冬天很少見到太陽。
items.sec: Mining, Iron & Steel 採礦與鋼鐵

items.def: a coal mine and the buildings around it
items.s: The ________ closed in 1985, and many families in the valley had to move away to find work.
items.zh: 那座煤礦場在1985年關閉了,而山谷裡的許多家庭必須搬走去找工作。
items.sec: Mining, Iron & Steel 採礦與鋼鐵

items.def: a person who works under the ground digging coal or metal
items.s: The ________ went down into the dark tunnels every morning, and their families waited nervously for them.
items.zh: 礦工們每天早上下到黑暗的坑道裡,而他們的家人緊張地等著他們回來。
items.sec: Mining, Iron & Steel 採礦與鋼鐵

items.def: a deep hole going down into a mine
items.s: The workers rode a small lift down the ______ ______, and the air grew hotter as they went deeper.
items.zh: 工人們乘坐小升降機沿著礦井下去,而越往深處空氣就越熱。
items.sec: Mining, Iron & Steel 採礦與鋼鐵

items.def: a long passage under the ground
items.s: The train went into a long ________ under the mountain, and suddenly my phone lost its signal.
items.zh: 火車開進山底下一條長長的隧道,而我的手機突然沒有訊號了。
items.sec: Mining, Iron & Steel 採礦與鋼鐵

items.def: rock from which metal can be taken
items.s: The rocks in this area contain copper ________, so a mining company wants to start digging here.
items.zh: 這個地區的岩石含有銅礦石,所以一家礦業公司想在這裡開挖。
items.sec: Mining, Iron & Steel 採礦與鋼鐵

items.def: rock that contains iron
items.s: Australia exports a lot of ______ ______ to Asia, and much of it is turned into steel for buildings.
items.zh: 澳洲出口大量鐵礦石到亞洲,而其中很多被製成建築用的鋼材。
items.sec: Mining, Iron & Steel 採礦與鋼鐵

items.def: hard iron that is shaped by pouring it into a mould
items.s: My mother cooks with a heavy ______ ______ pan, and she says it lasts much longer than modern ones.
items.zh: 我媽媽用一個沉重的鑄鐵鍋煮飯,而她說它比現代的鍋子耐用得多。
items.sec: Mining, Iron & Steel 採礦與鋼鐵

items.def: iron that is heated and bent into shapes by hand
items.s: The old park has beautiful ______ ______ gates, and tourists often stop to take pictures of them.
items.zh: 那座老公園有漂亮的鍛鐵大門,而遊客經常停下來拍照。
items.sec: Mining, Iron & Steel 採礦與鋼鐵

items.def: rough iron that comes straight from a furnace
items.s: Workers poured the hot ______ ______ into sand moulds, and then it was sent away to be made into steel.
items.zh: 工人們把熾熱的生鐵倒進沙模中,然後它被送去製成鋼。
items.sec: Mining, Iron & Steel 採礦與鋼鐵

items.def: a huge furnace where hot air helps melt iron from rock
items.s: The ______ ______ burned day and night, so the sky above the town glowed orange after dark.
items.zh: 那座高爐日夜燃燒,所以天黑後鎮上的天空都閃著橘色的光。
items.sec: Mining, Iron & Steel 採礦與鋼鐵

items.def: a factory where iron is made
items.s: The town grew quickly around the ________, and its population doubled in only twenty years.
items.zh: 這個小鎮圍繞著煉鐵廠迅速發展,而它的人口在短短二十年間就翻倍了。
items.sec: Mining, Iron & Steel 採礦與鋼鐵

items.def: a factory where steel is made
items.s: My uncle got a job at the ________ after school, and he worked there for over thirty years.
items.zh: 我舅舅畢業後在鋼鐵廠找到工作,而他在那裡工作了三十多年。
items.sec: Mining, Iron & Steel 採礦與鋼鐵

items.def: a factory where metal is melted and shaped
items.s: The bells for the church were made at a local ________, and each one weighed more than a car.
items.zh: 教堂的鐘是在當地一家鑄造廠製作的,而每一個都比一輛車還重。
items.sec: Mining, Iron & Steel 採礦與鋼鐵

items.def: melted by very great heat
items.s: The workers wore thick gloves while they poured the ________ metal, because one drop could burn through skin.
items.zh: 工人們倒熔化的金屬時戴著厚手套,因為一滴就能燙穿皮膚。
items.sec: Mining, Iron & Steel 採礦與鋼鐵

items.def: a hollow shape into which hot liquid is poured
items.s: We poured melted chocolate into a heart-shaped ________, and then we put it in the fridge to set.
items.zh: 我們把融化的巧克力倒進心形的模具裡,然後把它放進冰箱定型。
items.sec: Mining, Iron & Steel 採礦與鋼鐵

items.def: a heavy iron block on which hot metal is hammered
items.s: The smith hammered the red-hot metal on the ________, and sparks flew across the dark room.
items.zh: 鐵匠在鐵砧上敲打燒紅的金屬,而火花在昏暗的房間裡四處飛濺。
items.sec: Mining, Iron & Steel 採礦與鋼鐵

items.def: a person who makes things from iron by heating and hammering
items.s: Every village once had a ________ who made horseshoes, but few people learn this skill today.
items.zh: 以前每個村莊都有一位做馬蹄鐵的鐵匠,但現在很少人學這項技藝了。
items.sec: Mining, Iron & Steel 採礦與鋼鐵

items.def: a strong metal made from iron and carbon
items.s: Modern skyscrapers have frames made of ________, so they can be much taller than old stone buildings.
items.zh: 現代摩天大樓的骨架是用鋼做的,所以它們可以比古老的石造建築高得多。
items.sec: Mining, Iron & Steel 採礦與鋼鐵

items.def: a cheap way to make steel by blowing air through iron
items.s: The ______ ______ made steel cheap for the first time, so railways and bridges could use it everywhere.
items.zh: 貝塞麥煉鋼法首次讓鋼變得便宜,所以鐵路和橋梁各處都能使用它。
items.sec: Mining, Iron & Steel 採礦與鋼鐵

items.def: an unwanted substance mixed into something
items.s: Blowing air through the hot iron burned away each ________, and the metal became much stronger.
items.zh: 讓空氣吹過熾熱的鐵會燒掉每一種雜質,而金屬變得堅固許多。
items.sec: Mining, Iron & Steel 採礦與鋼鐵

items.def: a layer of coal under the ground
items.s: The miners found a thick ______ ______ deep underground, but reaching it safely was very difficult.
items.zh: 礦工們在地底深處發現一個厚厚的煤層,但要安全地挖到它非常困難。
items.sec: Mining, Iron & Steel 採礦與鋼鐵

items.def: a heavy tool with a pointed metal head for breaking rock
items.s: Each miner carried a ________ and a lamp, and they broke the hard rock by hand for hours.
items.zh: 每位礦工都帶著一把十字鎬和一盞燈,而他們徒手敲碎堅硬的岩石好幾個小時。
items.sec: Mining, Iron & Steel 採礦與鋼鐵

items.def: a sudden violent burst with a loud noise
items.s: Gas in the mine caused a terrible ________, and the whole town gathered at the gate for news.
items.zh: 礦坑裡的瓦斯引發了一場可怕的爆炸,而全鎮的人都聚集在大門口等消息。
items.sec: Mining, Iron & Steel 採礦與鋼鐵

items.def: a special lamp that will not light gas in a mine
items.s: The new ______ ______ protected miners from deadly gas explosions, so far fewer men died underground after 1816.
items.zh: 新的安全燈保護礦工免於致命的瓦斯爆炸,所以1816年後在地下喪生的人少了很多。
items.sec: Mining, Iron & Steel 採礦與鋼鐵

items.def: the science of metals and how to use them
items.s: My cousin studies ________ at university, and she hopes to design lighter metals for planes one day.
items.zh: 我表姊在大學唸冶金學,而她希望有一天能為飛機設計更輕的金屬。
items.sec: Mining, Iron & Steel 採礦與鋼鐵

items.def: a short metal pin used to join metal sheets together
items.s: The Eiffel Tower is held together by millions of ________, and workers put each one in by hand.
items.zh: 艾菲爾鐵塔是由數百萬顆鉚釘固定起來的,而工人們是一顆一顆用手裝上去的。
items.sec: Mining, Iron & Steel 採礦與鋼鐵

items.def: a long strong metal beam that supports a building or bridge
items.s: A crane lifted the huge steel ________ into place, while workers on the bridge guided it carefully.
items.zh: 起重機把巨大的鋼樑吊到定位,而橋上的工人小心地引導它。
items.sec: Mining, Iron & Steel 採礦與鋼鐵

items.def: a system of tracks and trains for moving people and goods
items.s: The first public ________ opened in 1825, and soon people could travel between cities in hours, not days.
items.zh: 第一條公共鐵路在1825年開通,而很快人們就能在幾小時內而非幾天內往返城市。
items.sec: Transport: Railways, Canals & Cars 交通運輸:鐵路、運河與汽車

items.def: the engine that pulls a train
items.s: The old steam ________ is kept in the museum, and visitors can climb into the driver's cab.
items.zh: 那輛老蒸汽火車頭保存在博物館裡,而參觀者可以爬進司機室。
items.sec: Transport: Railways, Canals & Cars 交通運輸:鐵路、運河與汽車

items.def: a train pulled by an engine that uses steam
items.s: We rode an old ______ ______ through the mountains, and the whistle echoed loudly across the valley.
items.zh: 我們搭乘一列老蒸汽火車穿越山區,而汽笛聲在山谷間響亮地迴盪。
items.sec: Transport: Railways, Canals & Cars 交通運輸:鐵路、運河與汽車

items.def: the metal rails that trains run on
items.s: Never walk along the ______ ______, because trains move faster than you think and cannot stop quickly.
items.zh: 絕對不要沿著鐵軌走,因為火車行駛得比你想的快,而且無法很快停下來。
items.sec: Transport: Railways, Canals & Cars 交通運輸:鐵路、運河與汽車

items.def: a train system; travel by train
items.s: Travelling by ________ is better for the environment, so our school took the train to the science museum.
items.zh: 搭鐵路旅行對環境比較好,所以我們學校搭火車去科學博物館。
items.sec: Transport: Railways, Canals & Cars 交通運輸:鐵路、運河與汽車

items.def: one of the separate parts of a train where people sit
items.s: The front ________ was very crowded, so we walked to the back of the train and found empty seats.
items.zh: 前面的車廂非常擠,所以我們走到火車後段並找到了空位。
items.sec: Transport: Railways, Canals & Cars 交通運輸:鐵路、運河與汽車

items.def: a part of a train for carrying goods
items.s: Each ________ was filled with coal, and the long train moved slowly towards the port.
items.zh: 每一節貨車車廂都裝滿了煤,而那列長長的火車緩緩駛向港口。
items.sec: Transport: Railways, Canals & Cars 交通運輸:鐵路、運河與汽車

items.def: a place where trains stop for passengers
items.s: We arrived at the ________ ten minutes early, but the train was delayed because of heavy snow.
items.zh: 我們提早十分鐘到達車站,但火車因為大雪而誤點了。
items.sec: Transport: Railways, Canals & Cars 交通運輸:鐵路、運河與汽車

items.def: a place where a road crosses a railway line
items.s: The barriers came down at the ______ ______, so all the cars waited while the train rushed past.
items.zh: 平交道的柵欄放下來了,所以所有車子都在等待,而火車呼嘯而過。
items.sec: Transport: Railways, Canals & Cars 交通運輸:鐵路、運河與汽車

items.def: a person travelling in a vehicle who is not driving
items.s: Every ________ must wear a seat belt on this bus, and the driver will not leave until everyone does.
items.zh: 這輛公車上每位乘客都必須繫安全帶,而司機在所有人繫好前不會開車。
items.sec: Transport: Railways, Canals & Cars 交通運輸:鐵路、運河與汽車

items.def: a man-made river for boats
items.s: Before railways, factories sent goods along the ________, because boats could carry heavy loads cheaply.
items.zh: 在鐵路出現之前,工廠沿著運河運送貨物,因為船隻能便宜地載運重物。
items.sec: Transport: Railways, Canals & Cars 交通運輸:鐵路、運河與汽車

items.def: a section of a canal with gates to raise or lower boats
items.s: Our boat entered the ________, and the water slowly rose until we could continue up the hill.
items.zh: 我們的船駛進船閘,而水慢慢上升,直到我們能繼續往山上航行。
items.sec: Transport: Railways, Canals & Cars 交通運輸:鐵路、運河與汽車

items.def: a long flat boat for carrying goods on rivers or canals
items.s: A horse pulled the heavy ________ along the canal, and a boy walked beside it with a stick.
items.zh: 一匹馬沿著運河拉著沉重的駁船,而一個男孩拿著棍子走在牠旁邊。
items.sec: Transport: Railways, Canals & Cars 交通運輸:鐵路、運河與汽車

items.def: a path beside a canal where horses once pulled boats
items.s: Today people cycle along the old ________, but in the past it was used by horses pulling boats.
items.zh: 現在人們沿著舊縴道騎腳踏車,但在過去它是給拉船的馬使用的。
items.sec: Transport: Railways, Canals & Cars 交通運輸:鐵路、運河與汽車

items.def: a large ship driven by steam power
items.s: The ________ crossed the Atlantic in two weeks, so letters and goods arrived much sooner than before.
items.zh: 那艘蒸汽船兩週就橫越大西洋,所以信件和貨物比以前早得多送達。
items.sec: Transport: Railways, Canals & Cars 交通運輸:鐵路、運河與汽車

items.def: a steamboat moved by large turning wheels on its sides
items.s: We took a trip on an old ______ ______, and the big wheels splashed loudly as we moved down the river.
items.zh: 我們搭乘一艘老明輪汽船遊覽,而當我們順河而下時,大輪子嘩啦嘩啦地拍打著水。
items.sec: Transport: Railways, Canals & Cars 交通運輸:鐵路、運河與汽車

items.def: pulled by a horse
items.s: ________ carts were common in big cities, but they made the streets dirty, noisy and very slow.
items.zh: 馬拉的貨車在大城市很常見,但它們讓街道變得又髒、又吵、又非常緩慢。
items.sec: Transport: Railways, Canals & Cars 交通運輸:鐵路、運河與汽車

items.def: a car
items.s: Karl Benz built the first practical ________ in 1885, and within fifty years cars had changed city life.
items.zh: 卡爾·賓士在1885年製造出第一輛實用的汽車,而在五十年內汽車就改變了城市生活。
items.sec: Transport: Railways, Canals & Cars 交通運輸:鐵路、運河與汽車

items.def: an old-fashioned word for a car
items.s: My great-grandmother remembered the first ______ ______ in her village, and everyone ran outside to look at it.
items.zh: 我曾祖母記得她村裡的第一輛汽車,而大家都跑出去看它。
items.sec: Transport: Railways, Canals & Cars 交通運輸:鐵路、運河與汽車

items.def: a car that uses a steam engine
items.s: The ______ ______ was quiet and powerful, but it took too long to start on cold mornings.
items.zh: 蒸汽汽車安靜又有力,但在寒冷的早晨要花太久時間才能啟動。
items.sec: Transport: Railways, Canals & Cars 交通運輸:鐵路、運河與汽車

items.def: a vehicle with two wheels that you ride by pushing pedals
items.s: The ________ gave working people cheap freedom, so they could visit the countryside on weekends.
items.zh: 腳踏車給了勞工們便宜的自由,讓他們週末可以去鄉間遊玩。
items.sec: Transport: Railways, Canals & Cars 交通運輸:鐵路、運河與汽車

items.def: a rubber ring filled with air around a wheel
items.s: I got a flat ________ on the way to school, so I had to push my bike for the last two kilometres.
items.zh: 我在上學途中輪胎爆了,所以最後兩公里我只好牽著腳踏車走。
items.sec: Transport: Railways, Canals & Cars 交通運輸:鐵路、運河與汽車

items.def: the frame of a vehicle that holds the engine and body
items.s: The factory first builds the ________, and then workers add the engine, wheels and seats.
items.zh: 工廠先打造底盤,然後工人們加上引擎、輪子和座椅。
items.sec: Transport: Railways, Canals & Cars 交通運輸:鐵路、運河與汽車

items.def: the wheel a driver turns to control a car's direction
items.s: Early cars used a stick instead of a ______ ______, so turning corners was quite difficult.
items.zh: 早期汽車用一根桿子而不是方向盤,所以轉彎相當困難。
items.sec: Transport: Railways, Canals & Cars 交通運輸:鐵路、運河與汽車

items.def: a part that makes a vehicle slow down or stop
items.s: The driver hit the ________ when a dog ran into the road, and luckily nobody was hurt.
items.zh: 一隻狗衝到馬路上時司機踩了煞車,而幸好沒有人受傷。
items.sec: Transport: Railways, Canals & Cars 交通運輸:鐵路、運河與汽車

items.def: a person who drives a train
items.s: The ______ ______ blew the whistle twice, and the children on the platform waved goodbye.
items.zh: 火車司機鳴了兩次汽笛,而月台上的孩子們揮手道別。
items.sec: Transport: Railways, Canals & Cars 交通運輸:鐵路、運河與汽車

items.def: a person who checks tickets on a train or bus
items.s: The ________ checked our tickets carefully, but he let my little brother travel for free.
items.zh: 車掌仔細檢查我們的車票,但他讓我弟弟免費搭乘。
items.sec: Transport: Railways, Canals & Cars 交通運輸:鐵路、運河與汽車

items.def: a long high bridge that carries a road or railway across a valley
items.s: The train crossed a tall stone ________, and we could see the river far below our window.
items.zh: 火車越過一座高高的石造高架橋,而我們從窗戶可以看到遠在下方的河流。
items.sec: Transport: Railways, Canals & Cars 交通運輸:鐵路、運河與汽車

items.def: a person who travels some distance to work every day
items.s: My father is a daily ________ who takes the 7:15 train into the city, and he reads the news on his phone during the trip.
items.zh: 我爸爸是每天搭7點15分火車進城的通勤者,而他在車程中用手機看新聞。
items.sec: Transport: Railways, Canals & Cars 交通運輸:鐵路、運河與汽車

items.def: a person who creates something new for the first time
items.s: Thomas Edison was a famous ________, but he worked with a large team of skilled assistants.
items.zh: 湯瑪斯·愛迪生是一位著名的發明家,但他和一大群熟練的助手一起工作。
items.sec: Inventors, Inventions & Science 發明家、發明與科學

items.def: something new that someone has made or designed
items.s: The printing press was an important ________, because it let ideas spread quickly across Europe.
items.zh: 印刷機是一項重要的發明,因為它讓思想迅速在歐洲傳播。
