items.sec: Inventors, Inventions & Science 發明家、發明與科學

items.def: to make or design something that did not exist before
items.s: Alexander Graham Bell ________ the telephone in 1876, and soon people could talk across long distances.
items.zh: 亞歷山大·格拉漢姆·貝爾在1876年發明了電話,而很快人們就能遠距離交談。
items.sec: Inventors, Inventions & Science 發明家、發明與科學

items.def: very clever and original
items.s: My brother found an ________ way to water his plants while we were away, and none of them died.
items.zh: 我哥哥想到一個巧妙的方法在我們外出時幫植物澆水,而沒有一株枯死。
items.sec: Inventors, Inventions & Science 發明家、發明與科學

items.def: to try to repair or improve something by small changes
items.s: He loves to ________ with old radios in the garage, and sometimes he makes them work again.
items.zh: 他喜歡在車庫裡擺弄舊收音機,而有時候他能讓它們重新運作。
items.sec: Inventors, Inventions & Science 發明家、發明與科學

items.def: a test to see if something works well
items.s: The new engine failed its first ________, but the engineers fixed the problem within a week.
items.zh: 新引擎第一次試驗失敗了,但工程師們在一週內就解決了問題。
items.sec: Inventors, Inventions & Science 發明家、發明與科學

items.def: a scientific test to find out something
items.s: We did a simple ________ in class with magnets, and everyone was surprised by the results.
items.zh: 我們在課堂上用磁鐵做了一個簡單的實驗,而大家都對結果感到驚訝。
items.sec: Inventors, Inventions & Science 發明家、發明與科學

items.def: a person who repairs engines and machines
items.s: The ________ found the problem quickly, but he needed two days to order the right part.
items.zh: 技師很快就找到了問題,但他需要兩天來訂購正確的零件。
items.sec: Inventors, Inventions & Science 發明家、發明與科學

items.def: the work of designing and building machines, roads and bridges
items.s: She wants to study ________ at university, because she loves solving problems and building things.
items.zh: 她想在大學唸工程,因為她熱愛解決問題和動手做東西。
items.sec: Inventors, Inventions & Science 發明家、發明與科學

items.def: a scientist who studies energy, force and matter
items.s: The ________ explained how electricity works, and the audience finally understood why lights switch on.
items.zh: 那位物理學家解釋了電是怎麼運作的,而觀眾終於明白燈為什麼會亮。
items.sec: Inventors, Inventions & Science 發明家、發明與科學

items.def: a scientist who studies substances and how they change
items.s: A young ________ discovered the first artificial dye by accident, and it made him very rich.
items.zh: 一位年輕的化學家意外發現了第一種人工染料,而它讓他變得非常富有。
items.sec: Inventors, Inventions & Science 發明家、發明與科學

items.def: the act of finding something that was not known before
items.s: The ________ of electricity changed everyday life, but it took many years to reach ordinary homes.
items.zh: 電的發現改變了日常生活,但它花了很多年才進入一般家庭。
items.sec: Inventors, Inventions & Science 發明家、發明與科學

items.def: a person who introduces new ideas or methods
items.s: Steve Jobs is often called an ________, although many people helped him create his famous products.
items.zh: 史蒂夫·賈伯斯常被稱為創新者,雖然有很多人幫他打造出那些知名產品。
items.sec: Inventors, Inventions & Science 發明家、發明與科學

items.def: a change that makes something better
items.s: Watt's ________ to the steam engine saved coal, so factory owners were eager to buy his machines.
items.zh: 瓦特對蒸汽機的改進節省了煤,所以工廠老闆們都急著買他的機器。
items.sec: Inventors, Inventions & Science 發明家、發明與科學

items.def: a strange or complicated machine or device
items.s: My little sister built a funny ________ from boxes and string, and it actually feeds the cat.
items.zh: 我妹妹用箱子和繩子做了一個好笑的奇怪裝置,而它居然真的能餵貓。
items.sec: Inventors, Inventions & Science 發明家、發明與科學

items.def: a small clever device (informal)
items.s: Dad bought a new kitchen ________ that peels apples, but we still prefer using a knife.
items.zh: 爸爸買了一個能削蘋果皮的新廚房小玩意兒,但我們還是比較喜歡用刀子。
items.sec: Inventors, Inventions & Science 發明家、發明與科學

items.def: a copy of something
items.s: The shop sold a cheap ________ of the famous watch, but it stopped working after a month.
items.zh: 那家店賣那款名錶的便宜仿製品,但它一個月後就壞了。
items.sec: Inventors, Inventions & Science 發明家、發明與科學

items.def: money paid to an inventor or writer each time their work is used
items.s: The inventor received a ________ for every machine sold, so he earned money for many years.
items.zh: 發明家每賣出一台機器就收到一筆權利金,所以他好多年都持續有收入。
items.sec: Inventors, Inventions & Science 發明家、發明與科學

items.def: a name or sign that belongs to one company
items.s: The company protected its ________ carefully, because the name was famous all over the world.
items.zh: 那家公司小心保護它的商標,因為那個名稱聞名全世界。
items.sec: Inventors, Inventions & Science 發明家、發明與科學

items.def: a person or company that gives money to support something
items.s: The young inventor found a rich ________, so he could finally build a full-size model of his machine.
items.zh: 那位年輕發明家找到一位富有的贊助者,所以他終於能打造機器的實物大小模型。
items.sec: Inventors, Inventions & Science 發明家、發明與科學

items.def: someone who supports a project with money
items.s: The project failed when its main ________ pulled out, and the workshop had to close.
items.zh: 當主要資助者撤資時那個計畫就失敗了,而工作坊也不得不關門。
items.sec: Inventors, Inventions & Science 發明家、發明與科學

items.def: a public show of objects or works
items.s: The Great ________ of 1851 showed amazing new machines, and six million people came to see them.
items.zh: 1851年的萬國博覽會展出了驚人的新機器,而有六百萬人前來參觀。
items.sec: Inventors, Inventions & Science 發明家、發明與科學

items.def: showing how something works
items.s: The inventor gave a ________ of his new telephone, and the crowd cheered when they heard his voice.
items.zh: 發明家為他的新電話做了一場示範,而當群眾聽到他的聲音時都歡呼起來。
items.sec: Inventors, Inventions & Science 發明家、發明與科學

items.def: a large international exhibition of new products and ideas
items.s: The Eiffel Tower was built for a ______ ______ in 1889, but it later became a symbol of Paris.
items.zh: 艾菲爾鐵塔是為1889年的世界博覽會而建造的,但後來它成為了巴黎的象徵。
items.sec: Inventors, Inventions & Science 發明家、發明與科學

items.def: good at thinking of new ideas
items.s: Our science teacher is very ________, and she often turns rubbish into tools for our experiments.
items.zh: 我們的自然老師非常有創造力,而她常把垃圾變成我們做實驗的工具。
items.sec: Inventors, Inventions & Science 發明家、發明與科學

items.def: a quick simple drawing
items.s: Leonardo da Vinci made a ________ of a flying machine, but nobody could build it at that time.
items.zh: 李奧納多·達文西畫了一張飛行機器的草圖,但當時沒有人能把它造出來。
items.sec: Inventors, Inventions & Science 發明家、發明與科學

items.def: a piece of metal that pulls iron towards it
items.s: I keep my shopping list on the fridge with a ________, so I never forget it when I go out.
items.zh: 我用磁鐵把購物清單貼在冰箱上,所以我出門時從不會忘記。
items.sec: Inventors, Inventions & Science 發明家、發明與科學

items.def: the force that magnets produce
items.s: Scientists studied ________ and electricity together in the 1820s, and their work led to the first electric motors.
items.zh: 科學家們在1820年代一起研究磁力和電,而他們的成果催生了第一批電動馬達。
items.sec: Inventors, Inventions & Science 發明家、發明與科學

items.def: a long thin piece of metal used to carry electricity
items.s: The lamp stopped working because a ________ was loose, so my dad fixed it with a screwdriver.
items.zh: 這盞燈不亮了是因為一條電線鬆了,所以我爸用螺絲起子修好了它。
items.sec: Inventors, Inventions & Science 發明家、發明與科學

items.def: the growth of factories and industry in a country
items.s: ________ brought many new jobs to the cities, but it also brought pollution and crowded housing.
items.zh: 工業化為城市帶來了許多新的工作機會,但也帶來了污染和擁擠的住屋。
items.sec: Social Change: Workers, Cities & Reform 社會變遷:勞工、城市與改革

items.def: people who do physical or factory work for wages
items.s: The ______ ______ worked long hours in the mills, while the owners lived in large houses outside town.
items.zh: 勞工階級在工廠裡長時間工作,而工廠老闆則住在鎮外的大房子裡。
items.sec: Social Change: Workers, Cities & Reform 社會變遷:勞工、城市與改革

items.def: people with average income, such as teachers and shopkeepers
items.s: The ______ ______ grew quickly in the 1800s, and these families could afford pianos and books.
items.zh: 中產階級在1800年代迅速成長,而這些家庭買得起鋼琴和書籍。
items.sec: Social Change: Workers, Cities & Reform 社會變遷:勞工、城市與改革

items.def: a person who works in a factory
items.s: As a ______ ______, my grandmother sewed shirts all day, but she still found time to read at night.
items.zh: 身為工廠工人,我祖母整天縫襯衫,但她晚上仍會抽空閱讀。
items.sec: Social Change: Workers, Cities & Reform 社會變遷:勞工、城市與改革

items.def: the use of children as workers
items.s: ______ ______ was common in early factories, because children were small and their wages were low.
items.zh: 童工在早期工廠很常見,因為孩子們個子小而且工資低。
items.sec: Social Change: Workers, Cities & Reform 社會變遷:勞工、城市與改革

items.def: the hours, safety and environment of a job
items.s: The workers went on strike because their ______ ______ were dangerous, and the owners refused to listen.
items.zh: 工人們罷工是因為他們的工作環境很危險,而老闆們拒絕傾聽。
items.sec: Social Change: Workers, Cities & Reform 社會變遷:勞工、城市與改革

items.def: a very poor, crowded and dirty area of a city
items.s: Thousands of families lived in the ________ near the factories, and diseases spread quickly there.
items.zh: 數千個家庭住在工廠附近的貧民窟裡,而疾病在那裡迅速傳播。
items.sec: Social Change: Workers, Cities & Reform 社會變遷:勞工、城市與改革

items.def: a large old building divided into small flats for poor families
items.s: Eight people shared one room in the ________, and they used a single toilet with the whole building.
items.zh: 八個人擠在廉價公寓的一個房間裡,而他們和整棟樓的人共用一間廁所。
items.sec: Social Change: Workers, Cities & Reform 社會變遷:勞工、城市與改革

items.def: having too many people in a space
items.s: The trains are ________ during rush hour, so I usually leave home early to get a seat.
items.zh: 尖峰時段火車過度擁擠,所以我通常提早出門好找到座位。
items.sec: Social Change: Workers, Cities & Reform 社會變遷:勞工、城市與改革

items.def: systems for clean water and removing waste
items.s: Better ________ in the cities saved thousands of lives, because clean water stopped many deadly diseases from spreading.
items.zh: 城市裡更好的衛生設施拯救了數千條人命,因為乾淨的水阻止了許多致命疾病的傳播。
items.sec: Social Change: Workers, Cities & Reform 社會變遷:勞工、城市與改革

items.def: a serious disease caused by dirty water
items.s: John Snow traced a ________ outbreak to one water pump, and the city removed its handle to stop it.
items.zh: 約翰·斯諾把一場霍亂疫情追查到一座抽水機,而市政府拆掉它的把手來阻止疫情。
items.sec: Social Change: Workers, Cities & Reform 社會變遷:勞工、城市與改革

items.def: an organisation of workers that protects their rights
items.s: The workers formed a ______ ______, so they could ask for better pay together instead of alone.
items.zh: 工人們組成了一個工會,這樣他們就能一起而非單獨爭取更好的薪水。
items.sec: Social Change: Workers, Cities & Reform 社會變遷:勞工、城市與改革

items.def: a time when workers stop working to protest
items.s: The bus drivers went on ________ last week, so many students had to walk or cycle to school.
items.zh: 公車司機上週舉行罷工,所以許多學生只好走路或騎腳踏車上學。
items.sec: Social Change: Workers, Cities & Reform 社會變遷:勞工、城市與改革

items.def: a person who works to improve society
items.s: The ________ visited the dirty factories herself, and her reports shocked many people in the government.
items.zh: 那位改革者親自走訪骯髒的工廠,而她的報告震驚了許多政府官員。
items.sec: Social Change: Workers, Cities & Reform 社會變遷:勞工、城市與改革

items.def: the lowest pay that the law allows
items.s: The government raised the ______ ______ this year, but some shop owners say they cannot afford it.
items.zh: 政府今年調高了最低工資,但一些店家老闆說他們負擔不起。
items.sec: Social Change: Workers, Cities & Reform 社會變遷:勞工、城市與改革

items.def: a person who rents a house or room to others
items.s: Our ________ raised the rent again, so my family is looking for a cheaper flat near my school.
items.zh: 我們的房東又調漲房租了,所以我家正在我學校附近找比較便宜的公寓。
items.sec: Social Change: Workers, Cities & Reform 社會變遷:勞工、城市與改革

items.def: connected with the countryside
items.s: Many young people left ________ areas for the big cities, because factories offered steady work and pay.
items.zh: 許多年輕人離開鄉村地區前往大城市,因為工廠提供穩定的工作和薪水。
items.sec: Social Change: Workers, Cities & Reform 社會變遷:勞工、城市與改革

items.def: an increase in the number of people
items.s: Fast ______ ______ made the cities crowded, and the government struggled to build enough homes.
items.zh: 快速的人口成長讓城市變得擁擠,而政府難以蓋足夠的房子。
items.sec: Social Change: Workers, Cities & Reform 社會變遷:勞工、城市與改革

items.def: a place where very poor people lived and worked in the past
items.s: In Oliver Twist, the boy grows up in a ________, and he is punished for asking for more food.
items.zh: 在《孤雛淚》中,那個男孩在濟貧院長大,而他因為要求多一點食物而受罰。
items.sec: Social Change: Workers, Cities & Reform 社會變遷:勞工、城市與改革

items.def: a person who cleans chimneys
items.s: In the past, a small boy often worked as a ______ ______, because he could climb inside narrow chimneys.
items.zh: 過去,小男孩常常當掃煙囪工人,因為他能爬進狹窄的煙囪裡。
items.sec: Social Change: Workers, Cities & Reform 社會變遷:勞工、城市與改革

items.def: a young person learning a skill from an expert
items.s: He worked as an ________ to a carpenter for four years, and now he runs his own furniture business.
items.zh: 他當了四年木匠的學徒,而現在他經營自己的家具事業。
items.sec: Social Change: Workers, Cities & Reform 社會變遷:勞工、城市與改革

items.def: a factory where people work long hours for very low pay
items.s: Some cheap clothes are made in a ________, so we should check where our clothes come from.
items.zh: 有些便宜的衣服是在血汗工廠裡製造的,所以我們應該查查衣服的來源。
items.sec: Social Change: Workers, Cities & Reform 社會變遷:勞工、城市與改革

items.def: a violent protest by a crowd of people
items.s: Hungry workers started a ________ when bread prices rose, and soldiers were sent to the town.
items.zh: 當麵包價格上漲時,飢餓的工人們發起了暴動,而士兵被派往那個小鎮。
items.sec: Social Change: Workers, Cities & Reform 社會變遷:勞工、城市與改革

items.def: a person who uses money to own businesses and make profit
items.s: The ________ invested in new machines, and he made huge profits while his workers stayed poor.
items.zh: 那位資本家投資新機器,而他賺取了巨額利潤,他的工人卻仍然貧窮。
items.sec: Social Change: Workers, Cities & Reform 社會變遷:勞工、城市與改革

items.def: an economic system based on private business and profit
items.s: Under ________, companies compete to sell products, so prices can fall but some people are left behind.
items.zh: 在資本主義之下,公司們競爭銷售產品,所以價格可能下降,但有些人被拋在後頭。
items.sec: Social Change: Workers, Cities & Reform 社會變遷:勞工、城市與改革

items.def: products that people buy for their own use
items.s: Factories made ______ ______ like soap and shoes cheaper, so ordinary families could buy more.
items.zh: 工廠讓肥皂和鞋子這類消費品變得更便宜,所以一般家庭能買得更多。
items.sec: Social Change: Workers, Cities & Reform 社會變遷:勞工、城市與改革

items.def: how comfortable and wealthy people's lives are
items.s: Their ______ ______ ______ improved slowly, but it took decades before workers could afford good housing.
items.zh: 他們的生活水準慢慢提升,但過了幾十年工人才負擔得起好的住屋。
items.sec: Social Change: Workers, Cities & Reform 社會變遷:勞工、城市與改革

items.def: the average number of years a person is likely to live
items.s: ______ ______ in factory towns was very low, but clean water and better food slowly raised it.
items.zh: 工廠城鎮的平均壽命非常低,但乾淨的水和更好的食物慢慢地提高了它。
items.sec: Social Change: Workers, Cities & Reform 社會變遷:勞工、城市與改革

items.def: an old system for sending messages along wires using signals
items.s: News of the battle came by ________, so people in London knew about it on the same day.
items.zh: 戰役的消息透過電報傳來,所以倫敦的人們在同一天就知道了。
items.sec: Communication & Everyday Inventions 通訊與日常發明

items.def: a code of short and long signals for letters
items.s: The soldiers sent short messages in ______ ______, and only trained operators could understand them quickly.
items.zh: 士兵們用摩斯密碼傳送簡短訊息,而只有受過訓練的操作員能迅速看懂。
items.sec: Communication & Everyday Inventions 通訊與日常發明

items.def: a device for talking to someone far away
items.s: My grandparents had only one ________ in the hall, and the whole family shared it.
items.zh: 我祖父母家只有一支電話放在走廊,而全家人共用它。
items.sec: Communication & Everyday Inventions 通訊與日常發明

items.def: an early machine for recording and playing sound
items.s: Edison recorded his own voice on the ________, and people could hardly believe a machine could talk.
items.zh: 愛迪生用留聲機錄下自己的聲音,而人們幾乎不敢相信機器會說話。
items.sec: Communication & Everyday Inventions 通訊與日常發明

items.def: an old machine that plays music from flat discs
items.s: My grandfather still plays old records on his ________, and the music sounds warm and a little scratchy.
items.zh: 我祖父仍用他的唱機播放老唱片,而音樂聽起來溫暖又帶點沙沙聲。
items.sec: Communication & Everyday Inventions 通訊與日常發明

items.def: a device for taking photographs
items.s: I left my ________ at home on our trip, but luckily my phone took clear pictures.
items.zh: 旅行時我把相機留在家裡了,但幸好我的手機拍得很清楚。
items.sec: Communication & Everyday Inventions 通訊與日常發明

items.def: a picture made with a camera
items.s: We found an old ________ of our town from 1900, and the main street looked completely different.
items.zh: 我們找到一張1900年我們小鎮的老照片,而主要街道看起來完全不一樣。
items.sec: Communication & Everyday Inventions 通訊與日常發明

items.def: a glass object that gives light when electricity passes through
items.s: The ______ ______ in my room burned out, so I did my homework in the kitchen last night.
items.zh: 我房間的燈泡燒壞了,所以我昨晚在廚房寫功課。
items.sec: Communication & Everyday Inventions 通訊與日常發明

items.def: a very thin wire inside a light bulb that glows
items.s: Edison tested thousands of materials for the ________, and he finally found one that glowed for hours.
items.zh: 愛迪生為燈絲測試了上千種材料,而他終於找到一種能發光好幾個小時的。
items.sec: Communication & Everyday Inventions 通訊與日常發明

items.def: a machine for printing books and newspapers
items.s: The ______ ______ made books cheaper, so more people learned to read and share ideas.
items.zh: 印刷機讓書變得更便宜,所以更多人學會閱讀和分享想法。
items.sec: Communication & Everyday Inventions 通訊與日常發明

items.def: a machine with keys for printing letters onto paper
items.s: My mother learned to type on a ________, so she still presses the keys very hard on her laptop.
items.zh: 我媽媽是用打字機學打字的,所以她在筆電上還是很用力地按鍵。
items.sec: Communication & Everyday Inventions 通訊與日常發明

items.def: a device that receives sound broadcasts
items.s: We listen to the ________ in the car every morning, and my dad always checks the traffic news.
items.zh: 我們每天早上在車上聽廣播,而我爸總是會注意交通新聞。
items.sec: Communication & Everyday Inventions 通訊與日常發明

items.def: equipment that sends out radio or TV signals
items.s: The station built a tall ________ on the mountain, so people far away could hear the programmes.
items.zh: 電台在山上蓋了一座高高的發射器,讓遠方的人也能收聽節目。
items.sec: Communication & Everyday Inventions 通訊與日常發明

items.def: the part of a telephone you hold to your ear
items.s: She picked up the ________ and heard a strange voice, but the caller hung up before she could answer.
items.zh: 她拿起聽筒聽到一個陌生的聲音,但對方在她回答前就掛斷了。
items.sec: Communication & Everyday Inventions 通訊與日常發明

items.def: a sound, light or wave that carries information
items.s: The guard waved a green flag as a ________, and the train slowly pulled out of the station.
items.zh: 列車長揮動綠旗作為信號,而火車慢慢駛出車站。
items.sec: Communication & Everyday Inventions 通訊與日常發明

items.def: a machine that keeps food cold
items.s: Before the ________ was invented, people kept food in cool cellars, but it still went bad quickly.
items.zh: 在冰箱發明之前,人們把食物放在陰涼的地窖裡,但它還是很快就壞了。
items.sec: Communication & Everyday Inventions 通訊與日常發明

items.def: food kept in sealed metal containers
items.s: Sailors took ______ ______ on long voyages, because it stayed safe to eat for months.
items.zh: 水手們長途航行時會帶罐頭食品,因為它可以安全食用好幾個月。
items.sec: Communication & Everyday Inventions 通訊與日常發明

items.def: a metal container for keeping food
items.s: We made a simple phone from two ______ ______ and a string, and it actually worked across the garden.
items.zh: 我們用兩個鐵罐和一條繩子做了一支簡單的電話,而它真的能隔著花園通話。
items.sec: Communication & Everyday Inventions 通訊與日常發明

items.def: a bat with strings used to hit a tennis ball
items.s: My new ______ ______ is much lighter than my old wooden one, so I can swing it faster.
items.zh: 我的新網球拍比舊的木頭球拍輕多了,所以我可以揮得更快。
items.sec: Communication & Everyday Inventions 通訊與日常發明

items.def: a soft black form of carbon used in pencils and sports equipment
items.s: Pencils contain ________, not lead, and it is also used to make strong but light rackets.
items.zh: 鉛筆含有的是石墨而不是鉛,而它也被用來做堅固又輕巧的球拍。
items.sec: Communication & Everyday Inventions 通訊與日常發明

items.def: a very strong light material made from thin threads of carbon
items.s: Racing bikes are made of ______ ______, so they are light but still very strong.
items.zh: 競賽用腳踏車是用碳纖維做的,所以它們很輕卻依然非常堅固。
items.sec: Communication & Everyday Inventions 通訊與日常發明

items.def: a machine that carries people up and down in a building
items.s: The ________ made tall buildings possible, because nobody wanted to climb twenty floors every day.
items.zh: 電梯讓高樓成為可能,因為沒有人想每天爬二十層樓。
items.sec: Communication & Everyday Inventions 通訊與日常發明

items.def: moving stairs
items.s: The ________ at the station was broken, so we carried our heavy suitcases up the stairs.
items.zh: 車站的手扶梯壞了,所以我們把沉重的行李箱扛上樓梯。
items.sec: Communication & Everyday Inventions 通訊與日常發明

items.def: a tool doctors use to listen to your heart and breathing
items.s: The doctor put the cold ________ on my chest, and she asked me to breathe in deeply.
items.zh: 醫生把冰涼的聽診器放在我胸口,而她要我深呼吸。
items.sec: Communication & Everyday Inventions 通訊與日常發明

items.def: a substance that protects people from a disease
items.s: Edward Jenner made the first ________ in 1796, and it protected millions of people from deadly smallpox.
items.zh: 愛德華·詹納在1796年製成了第一支疫苗,而它保護了數百萬人免於致命的天花。
items.sec: Communication & Everyday Inventions 通訊與日常發明

items.def: a drug that stops you feeling pain during an operation
items.s: Before ________ was used, operations were terribly painful, so surgeons had to work very fast.
items.zh: 在使用麻醉劑之前,手術極度痛苦,所以外科醫生必須動作非常快。
items.sec: Communication & Everyday Inventions 通訊與日常發明

items.def: a medicine that kills bacteria
items.s: Alexander Fleming discovered ________ by accident, and it has saved millions of lives since then.
items.zh: 亞歷山大·弗萊明意外發現了盤尼西林,而它從那時起已拯救了數百萬條生命。
items.sec: Communication & Everyday Inventions 通訊與日常發明

items.def: the pipes that carry water in a building
items.s: Modern ________ brought clean water into homes, so people no longer had to carry buckets from the well.
items.zh: 現代的水管系統把乾淨的水引進家中,所以人們不再需要從井裡提水。
items.sec: Communication & Everyday Inventions 通訊與日常發明

items.def: to succeed in doing something after effort
items.s: Edison failed many times, but he finally ________ his goal of making a light bulb that lasted for hours.
items.zh: 愛迪生失敗了很多次,但他最終實現了做出能亮好幾個小時燈泡的目標。

items.def: the work of organising and running a business or government
items.s: The factory needed more office staff for ________, because it now had thousands of workers to pay.
items.zh: 工廠需要更多辦公室人員負責行政,因為它現在有數千名工人要發薪水。

items.def: help or support
items.s: The old inventor needed ________ to finish his last machine, so his daughter helped him every evening.
items.zh: 年老的發明家需要協助來完成他的最後一台機器,所以他女兒每天晚上都幫他。

items.def: a group of things that share the same features
items.s: The museum puts each invention into a ________, such as transport or communication, so visitors can find them easily.
items.zh: 博物館把每項發明歸入一個類別,例如交通或通訊,讓參觀者容易找到。

items.def: the people who live in one area
items.s: When the mine closed, the whole ________ suffered, and many shops on the main street shut down.
items.zh: 當礦坑關閉時,整個社區都受到影響,而大街上許多商店都關門了。

items.def: connected with the art, ideas and customs of a society
items.s: Railways brought big ________ changes, because people from different regions began to meet and share ideas.
items.zh: 鐵路帶來了巨大的文化變遷,因為來自不同地區的人們開始相遇並交流想法。

items.def: an organisation for research or education
items.s: She joined a research ________ after university, and now she studies how batteries can store more energy.
items.zh: 她大學畢業後加入了一個研究機構,而現在她研究電池如何儲存更多能量。

items.def: a serious magazine about a subject, often science
items.s: The scientist published his results in a famous ________, and other researchers soon tested his ideas.
items.zh: 那位科學家把研究結果發表在一份著名的期刊上,而其他研究者很快就測試了他的想法。

items.def: to choose carefully from a group
items.s: The judges will ________ the three best student inventions, and the winners will travel to the national fair.
items.zh: 評審將挑選出三件最佳學生發明,而得獎者將前往參加全國展覽會。

items.def: something you say or write to give an opinion
items.s: My teacher wrote a helpful ________ on my report, so I added more facts about the steam engine.
items.zh: 老師在我的報告上寫了一則有幫助的評語,所以我加入了更多關於蒸汽機的事實。

items.def: a set of beliefs about how to live or work
items.s: The company's ________ is to make simple products, and that is why its phones have so few buttons.
items.zh: 這家公司的理念是製造簡單的產品,而這就是為什麼它的手機按鍵這麼少。

items.def: scientific knowledge used in practical ways
items.s: New ________ changes how we work, but older people sometimes find it hard to keep up.
items.zh: 新科技改變了我們工作的方式,但年長者有時覺得很難跟上。

items.def: the chance or right to use something
items.s: Poor families had no ________ to clean water, so they often became sick from dirty wells.
items.zh: 貧窮家庭無法取得乾淨的水,所以他們常因骯髒的井水而生病。

items.def: connected with ordinary citizens or the government, not the army
items.cn: 公民的;民用的;土木(工程)的
items.s: The bridge was built by ________ engineers, and it still carries heavy traffic after a hundred years.
items.zh: 那座橋是由土木工程師建造的,而它在一百年後仍承載著繁忙的交通。

items.def: to share information with others
items.s: The telegraph helped people ________ across countries, so business decisions could be made much faster.
items.zh: 電報幫助人們跨國溝通,所以商業決策能做得快很多。

items.def: early work that makes later progress possible
items.s: Early scientists laid the ________ for modern electricity, so later inventors could build on their ideas.
items.zh: 早期的科學家為現代電力打下了基礎,所以後來的發明家能在他們的想法上繼續發展。

items.def: a short statement of the main points
items.s: Please write a ________ of the chapter in five sentences, and include the most important inventions.
items.zh: 請用五個句子寫出這一章的摘要,並且包含最重要的發明。

items.def: a school or society for special training or study
items.s: The Royal ________ of Sciences gave him a medal, and his invention became famous across Europe.
items.zh: 皇家科學院頒給他一枚獎章,而他的發明因此聞名全歐洲。

items.def: power from sources like coal, oil or electricity
items.s: Coal was the main source of ________ in the 1800s, but today we are trying to use cleaner sources.
items.zh: 煤是1800年代主要的能源來源,但今天我們正嘗試使用更乾淨的來源。

items.def: supporting freedom and gradual social change
items.s: The ________ politicians wanted to improve working conditions, but the factory owners fought against them.
items.zh: 開明派政治人物想改善勞動條件,但工廠老闆們反對他們。

items.def: a large area of land with a big house, owned by one person
items.s: The rich family owned a huge country ________, and they rarely visited the dirty factory towns.
items.zh: 那個富有的家族擁有一座巨大的鄉間莊園,而他們很少造訪髒亂的工廠城鎮。

items.def: a person with special knowledge or skill
items.s: We asked an ________ to look at the old clock, and she said it was made in London in 1820.
items.zh: 我們請一位專家看看這座老鐘,而她說它是1820年在倫敦製造的。

items.def: a government department
items.s: The ________ of Transport plans to build a new railway line, but local farmers are against it.
items.zh: 交通部計劃興建一條新鐵路線,但當地農民反對。

items.def: help, especially money or food given to people in need
items.s: The charity sent food ________ to the miners' families, because the men had been on strike for weeks.
items.zh: 慈善團體送了食物援助給礦工家庭,因為那些男人已經罷工好幾週了。

items.def: a substance made by or used in chemistry
items.s: The factory poured a dangerous ________ into the river, and many fish died within a few days.
items.zh: 工廠把一種危險的化學物質倒進河裡,而許多魚在幾天內就死了。

items.def: very good and a typical example of its kind
items.s: The Model T is a ________ car, and collectors still pay a lot of money for one in good condition.
items.zh: T型車是一款經典汽車,而收藏家仍願意花大錢買一輛車況良好的。

items.def: clear and certain
items.s: We do not have a ________ date for the museum trip yet, but it will probably be in December.
items.zh: 我們還沒有參觀博物館的確定日期,但它可能會在十二月。

items.def: the act of printing a book or article for the public
items.s: After the ________ of his book, Darwin became famous, but many people strongly disagreed with him.
items.zh: 他的書出版之後,達爾文變得很有名,但許多人強烈反對他。

items.def: to start an organisation or company
items.s: Henry Ford ________ his car company in 1903, and it grew into one of the largest in the world.
items.zh: 亨利·福特在1903年創立了他的汽車公司,而它成長為世界上最大的公司之一。

items.def: a huge change in the way people live or work
items.s: The smartphone started a ________ in communication, and now most people carry the internet in their pocket.
items.zh: 智慧型手機掀起了一場通訊革命,而現在大多數人口袋裡都帶著網路。

items.def: a person with a lower position at work
items.s: The manager blamed his ________ for the mistake, but everyone knew he had made the decision himself.
items.zh: 經理把錯誤怪到他的下屬身上,但大家都知道是他自己做的決定。

items.def: to be made of (with "of")
items.s: A steam engine mainly ________ of a boiler, a cylinder and a piston, but there are many smaller parts too.
items.zh: 蒸汽機主要由鍋爐、汽缸和活塞組成,但也有許多較小的零件。

items.def: the system of money, trade and industry in a country
items.s: Britain's ________ grew rapidly in the 1800s, and it became the richest country in the world.
items.zh: 英國的經濟在1800年代快速成長,而它成為了世界上最富有的國家。

items.def: allowed by law
items.s: It was ________ to employ young children in the early mills, but new laws later stopped this practice.
items.zh: 在早期工廠雇用幼童是合法的,但後來新的法律禁止了這種做法。

items.def: the job or purpose someone or something has
items.s: Women played an important ________ in the textile mills, although they were paid much less than men.
items.zh: 女性在紡織廠中扮演重要的角色,雖然她們的薪水比男性少很多。

items.def: almost the same
items.s: My design is ________ to my friend's, but mine uses less material and is easier to build.
items.zh: 我的設計和朋友的很相似,但我的用料較少而且比較容易製作。

items.def: a length of time in history
items.s: The Victorian ________ saw many great inventions, and the population of Britain doubled at the same time.
items.zh: 維多利亞時期出現許多偉大的發明,而英國人口同時也增加了一倍。

items.def: good or helpful
items.s: The railway had a ________ effect on farmers, because they could now sell fresh food in distant cities.
items.zh: 鐵路對農民產生了正面的影響,因為他們現在能把新鮮食物賣到遙遠的城市。

items.def: the process of starting to exist or become known
items.s: The ________ of factories changed family life, since parents now worked away from home all day.
items.zh: 工廠的興起改變了家庭生活,因為父母現在整天都離家工作。

items.def: the act of starting to use something new
items.s: The ________ of electric lights made streets safer at night, so more people went out after dark.
items.zh: 電燈的採用讓夜晚的街道更安全,所以更多人在天黑後外出。

items.def: to make money from a product or idea by selling it
items.s: Many scientists made discoveries, but they did not know how to ________ them, so others got rich instead.
items.zh: 許多科學家有了發現,但他們不知道如何將其商業化,所以反而是別人致富了。

items.def: the state of being rich and successful
items.s: The new port brought ________ to the town, and many families could finally afford better houses.
items.zh: 新港口為這個小鎮帶來了繁榮,而許多家庭終於買得起更好的房子。

items.def: producing a lot
items.s: Factories were much more ________ than home workshops, so the price of cloth dropped sharply.
items.zh: 工廠比家庭作坊更有生產力,所以布料價格大幅下降。

items.def: making a lot of money
items.s: Selling cheap cotton shirts was very ________, so more and more mills opened in northern England.
items.zh: 販賣便宜的棉襯衫非常賺錢,所以越來越多工廠在英格蘭北部開設。

items.def: connected with trade and merchants
items.s: Liverpool was a busy ________ city, and ships from all over the world unloaded goods in its docks.
items.zh: 利物浦是一座繁忙的商業城市,而來自世界各地的船隻在它的碼頭卸貨。

items.def: money used to start or grow a business
items.s: He needed ________ to build his first factory, so he borrowed money from his wealthy uncle.
items.zh: 他需要資金來蓋他的第一間工廠,所以他向富有的叔叔借錢。

items.def: buying and selling, especially on a large scale
items.s: Canals and railways helped ________ grow, because goods could reach customers faster and more cheaply.
items.zh: 運河和鐵路幫助商業成長,因為貨物能更快、更便宜地送達顧客手中。

items.def: a business or company
items.s: Her small ________ began in her kitchen, but now it sells handmade soap all over the country.
items.zh: 她的小企業從她的廚房起步,而現在它在全國各地販售手工肥皂。

items.def: working hard
items.s: The ________ young engineer worked late every night, and his boss soon gave him a bigger project.
items.zh: 那位勤奮的年輕工程師每晚都工作到很晚,而老闆很快就交給他更大的專案。

items.def: good at finding clever ways to solve problems
items.s: The ________ miners built a pump from old parts, so they could keep working after the flood.
items.zh: 足智多謀的礦工們用舊零件做了一台抽水機,所以他們在淹水後還能繼續工作。

items.def: having bold, original ideas about the future
items.s: The ________ engineer imagined trains under the city, and fifty years later London opened its first underground line.
items.zh: 那位有遠見的工程師構想了城市底下的火車,而五十年後倫敦開通了第一條地下鐵路線。

items.def: causing a great change
items.s: Electricity was a ________ invention, because it changed how people worked, travelled and spent their evenings.
items.zh: 電是一項具變革性的發明,因為它改變了人們工作、旅行和度過夜晚的方式。

items.def: having a big effect on many things
items.s: The new law had ________ effects, since it limited working hours in every factory in the country.
items.zh: 這項新法律產生了影響深遠的效果,因為它限制了全國每家工廠的工時。

items.def: very important, especially for the future
items.s: The first flight in 1903 was a ________ event, but only a few people saw it with their own eyes.
items.zh: 1903年的首次飛行是一個重大的事件,但只有少數人親眼目睹。

items.def: an event that marks a very important change
items.s: The year 1830 was a ________ for travel, because the first passenger railway between two cities opened.
items.zh: 1830年是旅行的分水嶺,因為第一條連接兩座城市的客運鐵路開通了。

items.def: the place or point where something begins
items.s: The ________ of the word "robot" is a Czech play, but now people all over the world use it.
items.zh: "robot"這個字的起源是一齣捷克劇作,但現在全世界的人都在使用它。

items.def: the state of being known by many people
items.s: The inventor won ________ and money, but he said his greatest joy was solving difficult problems.
items.zh: 這位發明家贏得了名聲和財富,但他說他最大的喜悅是解決困難的問題。

items.def: the opinion people have about someone or something
items.s: The company has a good ________ for safety, so many parents trust its car seats for their babies.
items.zh: 這家公司在安全方面有良好的聲譽,所以許多父母信任它為嬰兒做的汽車座椅。

items.def: to make something as good as possible
items.s: The Wright brothers spent years trying to ________ their flying machine, and they tested it hundreds of times.
items.zh: 萊特兄弟花了好幾年試圖完善他們的飛行器,而他們測試了好幾百次。

items.def: to increase greatly in number
items.s: The number of factories began to ________ quickly, and soon the sky over the city was full of smoke.
items.zh: 工廠的數量開始迅速成倍增加,而很快城市上空就佈滿了煙霧。

items.def: to start making a wider range of products
items.s: The company decided to ________ when cotton prices fell, so it also began making wool and silk.
items.zh: 當棉花價格下跌時,這家公司決定多角化經營,所以它也開始生產羊毛和絲綢。

items.def: to make a machine work
items.s: Only trained workers could ________ the huge machines, but small children often cleaned underneath them while they ran.
items.zh: 只有受過訓練的工人能操作這些巨大的機器,但小孩子們常在機器運轉時鑽到下方打掃。

items.def: to move or reach a larger area
items.s: News of the invention ________ quickly, and soon factories in America were copying the British machines.
items.zh: 這項發明的消息迅速傳開,而很快美國的工廠就仿造起英國的機器。

items.def: to move or pass around
items.s: Newspapers began to ________ widely in the cities, so ordinary workers learned about politics and new ideas.
items.zh: 報紙開始在城市中廣泛流通,所以一般工人得以了解政治和新思想。

items.def: an amount of something that is available to use
items.s: The city needed a steady ________ of coal, so trains brought it in from the mines every day.
items.zh: 城市需要穩定的煤供應,所以火車每天從礦場把煤運進來。

items.def: the need or wish of people to buy something
items.s: ________ for cheap clothes grew quickly, so mill owners bought more machines and hired more workers.
items.zh: 對便宜衣服的需求迅速成長,所以工廠主購買了更多機器並雇用更多工人。

items.def: to use up fuel, energy or time
items.s: Early steam engines ________ huge amounts of coal, but later designs were much more efficient.
items.zh: 早期的蒸汽機消耗大量的煤,但後來的設計效率高得多。

items.def: to use less money or resources
items.s: My family tries to ________ on electricity, so we turn off lights and unplug chargers every night.
items.zh: 我家努力節約用電,所以我們每晚關燈並拔掉充電器。

items.def: wasting time, energy or money
items.s: The old machine was slow and ________, so the company replaced it with a modern one last year.
items.zh: 那台舊機器又慢又沒效率,所以公司去年把它換成了新型的。

items.def: needing a lot of physical effort
items.s: Mining was ________ work, and most miners suffered from back pain before they turned forty.
items.zh: 採礦是費力的工作,而大多數礦工在四十歲之前就飽受背痛之苦。

items.def: able to kill
items.s: Coal dust could be ________ in large amounts, but miners had no masks to protect their lungs.
items.zh: 大量的煤塵可能是致命的,但礦工們沒有口罩來保護他們的肺。

items.def: causing death
items.s: There was a ________ accident at the factory last year, and it led to new safety rules for every machine.
items.zh: 去年工廠發生了一起致命意外,而它促使每台機器都有了新的安全規定。

items.def: causing damage or injury
items.s: Smoke from the factories was ________ to people's health, but many families could not afford to move away.
items.zh: 工廠排出的煙對人們的健康有害,但許多家庭沒有能力搬走。

items.def: very dirty and unpleasant because of poverty
items.s: Many workers lived in ________ rooms without water, and their children often became sick in winter.
items.zh: 許多工人住在沒有水的骯髒破敗的房間裡,而他們的孩子在冬天常常生病。

items.def: shockingly bad
items.s: The conditions in the mines were ________, so reporters wrote angry articles about them in the newspapers.
items.zh: 礦坑裡的環境極其惡劣,所以記者們在報紙上寫了憤怒的文章。

items.def: very bad and deserving strong criticism
items.s: Charles Dickens described the ________ life of poor children, and his novels made readers want change.
items.zh: 查爾斯·狄更斯描寫了窮苦孩子悲慘的生活,而他的小說讓讀者渴望改變。

items.def: unpleasant and depressing
items.s: Factory towns looked ________ and grey, but people still found ways to enjoy music and football.
items.zh: 工廠城鎮看起來陰沉又灰暗,但人們仍然找到方法享受音樂和足球。

items.def: cruel, severe or unkind
items.s: The rules in the mill were very ________, and workers lost a day's pay if they arrived five minutes late.
items.zh: 工廠裡的規定非常嚴苛,而工人遲到五分鐘就會被扣一天的工資。

items.def: having no money, food or home
items.s: When her husband died in the mine, the widow was left ________, so she had to beg on the streets.
items.zh: 當她丈夫死在礦坑中時,這位寡婦變得一貧如洗,所以她只好上街乞討。

items.def: treated as unimportant and kept out of power
items.s: ________ groups had no vote in the 1800s, so their problems were often ignored by the government.
items.zh: 被邊緣化的群體在1800年代沒有投票權,所以他們的問題常被政府忽視。

items.def: not fair or morally right
items.s: Workers felt the new rules were ________, because owners became richer while their pay went down.
items.zh: 工人們覺得新規定很不公正,因為老闆們越來越富有,而他們的薪水卻減少了。

items.def: a situation that is unfair
items.s: The writer was angry about the ________ she saw in the mills, and she spent her life fighting for workers.
items.zh: 那位作家對她在工廠裡看到的不公義感到憤怒,而她一生都在為工人奮鬥。

items.def: a reason to complain about unfair treatment
items.s: The workers listed every ________ in a letter, and they sent it to the factory owner and the newspaper.
items.zh: 工人們把每一項不滿列在一封信裡,並把它寄給工廠老闆和報社。

items.def: a feeling of being unhappy with a situation
items.s: ________ grew among the weavers as machines took their jobs, and some of them broke the new looms.
items.zh: 隨著機器奪走工作,織工之間的不滿日益增加,而他們之中有些人砸毀了新織布機。

items.def: to fight against people in power
items.s: The workers decided to ________ against the long hours, so they refused to enter the factory one morning.
items.zh: 工人們決定反抗過長的工時,所以某天早上他們拒絕進入工廠。

items.def: an organised fight against people in power
items.s: The army quickly stopped the ________, but the government later agreed to some of the workers' demands.
items.zh: 軍隊迅速平定了這場反抗,但政府後來同意了工人們的部分要求。

items.def: ready to use strong or violent action for a cause
items.s: Some ________ workers wanted to destroy the new machines, while others preferred a peaceful protest in the town square.
items.zh: 有些激進的工人想摧毀新機器,而其他人比較偏好在鎮上廣場和平抗議。

items.def: a written law made by a government
items.s: A new ________ banned children under nine from working in mills, and inspectors checked that owners obeyed.
items.zh: 一項新法令禁止九歲以下兒童在工廠工作,而督察員檢查老闆們是否遵守。

items.def: to make something illegal
items.s: The government decided to ________ the use of young boys as chimney sweeps, but the practice continued for years.
items.zh: 政府決定立法禁止雇用小男孩掃煙囪,但這種做法仍持續了好幾年。

items.def: the right to vote in elections
items.s: Workers fought for ________ for many years, and finally most men in Britain could vote by 1884.
items.zh: 工人們為爭取選舉權奮鬥了許多年,而到了1884年英國大多數男性終於可以投票。

items.def: to make something more up to date
items.s: The town plans to ________ its old train station, so it will have lifts and new waiting rooms next year.
items.zh: 小鎮計劃將老舊的火車站現代化,所以明年它會有電梯和新的候車室。

items.def: having a large population
items.s: Manchester became a ________ city very quickly, but its streets and houses were not ready for so many people.
items.zh: 曼徹斯特很快就成為一座人口稠密的城市,但它的街道和房屋還沒準備好容納這麼多人。

items.def: connected with a large city
items.s: The ________ railway carried thousands of workers every day, so the city could spread far into the countryside.
items.zh: 大都會鐵路每天載運數千名工人,所以城市得以向鄉間遠遠擴展。

items.def: connected with a town or city government
items.s: The ________ council built public baths, and poor families could finally wash in clean hot water.
items.zh: 市議會興建了公共澡堂,而貧窮家庭終於能用乾淨的熱水洗澡。

items.def: connected with a town and its citizens
items.s: The new town hall was a symbol of ________ pride, and local factory owners paid for most of it.
items.zh: 新市政廳是市民驕傲的象徵,而當地的工廠老闆們支付了大部分費用。

items.def: a disease that spreads to many people quickly
items.s: A typhoid ________ hit the city in 1850, and doctors realised that dirty water was the cause.
items.zh: 1850年一場傷寒疫情侵襲這座城市,而醫生們意識到骯髒的水是元兇。

items.def: spreading easily from one person to another
items.s: The disease was highly ________, so sick children had to stay at home and could not go to school.
items.zh: 這種疾病具有高度傳染性,所以生病的孩子必須待在家而不能上學。

items.def: the number of deaths in a group
items.s: Child ________ was very high in factory towns, but it fell after clean water was introduced.
items.zh: 工廠城鎮的兒童死亡率非常高,但在引進乾淨的水之後就下降了。

items.def: keeping yourself and places clean to stay healthy
items.s: Good ________ prevents many diseases, so the nurse taught the children to wash their hands before meals.
items.zh: 良好的衛生習慣能預防許多疾病,所以護理師教孩子們飯前要洗手。

items.def: too much traffic in one place
items.s: There was terrible ________ in the city centre this morning, and I was twenty minutes late for school.
items.zh: 今天早上市中心的交通嚴重壅塞,而我上學遲到了二十分鐘。

items.def: interesting or important enough to be noticed
items.s: It is ________ that many great inventors had little formal education, but they never stopped learning on their own.
items.zh: 值得注意的是,許多偉大的發明家沒受過多少正規教育,但他們從未停止自學。

items.def: very noticeable or unusual
items.s: There is a ________ difference between old and new phones, and young people cannot imagine life with a dial phone.
items.zh: 舊手機和新手機之間有顯著的差異,而年輕人無法想像使用撥盤電話的生活。

items.def: using the newest and best technology
items.s: The hospital bought ________ equipment last year, so doctors can now find problems much earlier.
items.zh: 醫院去年購置了最先進的設備,所以醫生現在能更早發現問題。

items.def: modern and highly developed
items.s: Britain had the most ________ machines in 1850, but Germany and America soon caught up.
items.zh: 英國在1850年擁有最先進的機器,但德國和美國很快就迎頭趕上。

items.def: having new and creative ideas
items.s: The students came up with ________ designs for a bridge, and one group used only paper and glue.
items.zh: 學生們想出了富有想像力的橋梁設計,而其中一組只用了紙和膠水。

items.def: based on ideas rather than practice
items.s: His plan was only ________ at first, but after ten years of work he built a machine that really worked.
items.zh: 他的計畫起初只是理論上的,但經過十年的努力他造出了一台真正能運作的機器。

items.def: used in practical ways rather than just studied
items.s: She studies ________ science, so she spends more time building devices than reading old theories.
items.zh: 她唸的是應用科學,所以她花更多時間製作裝置,而不是閱讀舊理論。

items.def: connected with science
items.s: Faraday's ________ work on electricity was brilliant, although he left school at the age of thirteen.
items.zh: 法拉第在電學方面的科學研究非常傑出,雖然他十三歲就離開了學校。

items.def: connected with technology
items.s: Every ________ change creates new jobs, but it also makes some old skills less useful.
items.zh: 每一次科技變革都創造新工作,但它也讓一些舊技能變得較不實用。

items.def: to create or improve something over time
items.s: Engineers ________ a safer lamp for miners, and it saved thousands of lives in the following years.
items.zh: 工程師們開發出一種給礦工用的更安全的燈,而它在隨後幾年拯救了數千條人命。

items.def: to make something longer or larger
items.s: The company plans to ________ the railway line to the coast, so tourists can visit the beach more easily.
items.zh: 公司計劃把鐵路線延伸到海岸,讓遊客能更方便地前往海灘。

items.def: something extra produced while making something else
items.s: Coal gas was a ________ of making coke, and soon it was used to light streets across the city.
items.zh: 煤氣是製造焦炭的副產品,而很快它就被用來點亮全城的街道。

items.def: an extra and usually bad result of something
items.s: Pollution was a serious ______ ______ of industry, but many factory owners simply ignored it.
items.zh: 污染是工業一項嚴重的副作用,但許多工廠老闆根本不予理會。

items.def: a disadvantage
items.s: The ________ of living near the station is the noise, but it is very convenient for getting to work.
items.zh: 住在車站附近的缺點是噪音,但上班非常方便。

items.def: a large amount of money or property
items.s: Industry created great ________ for factory owners, while most workers stayed poor for many years.
items.zh: 工業為工廠老闆創造了巨大的財富,而大多數工人多年來仍然貧窮。

items.def: the buying and selling of goods
items.s: ________ between Britain and India grew quickly, and ships carried cotton and tea across the oceans.
items.zh: 英國和印度之間的貿易迅速成長,而船隻載運棉花和茶葉橫越大洋。

items.def: to bring goods into a country from abroad
items.s: Britain had to ________ most of its cotton, because the plant could not grow in its cold climate.
items.zh: 英國必須進口大部分棉花,因為這種植物無法在它寒冷的氣候中生長。

items.def: a tax on goods coming into a country
items.s: The government added a ________ on foreign steel, so local steel companies could compete more easily.
items.zh: 政府對外國鋼鐵加徵關稅,好讓本地鋼鐵公司更容易競爭。

items.def: the speed or frequency of something
items.s: New railways were built at an amazing ________, and by 1850 most big towns had a station.
items.zh: 新鐵路以驚人的速度興建,而到了1850年大多數大城鎮都有車站。

items.def: a number, especially in official information
items.s: The ________ for car sales rose again this year, but more people are now choosing electric cars.
items.zh: 今年汽車銷售的數字又上升了,但現在更多人選擇電動車。

items.def: an amount or number of something
items.s: Factories could make a huge ________ of nails every day, so building houses became cheaper.
items.zh: 工廠每天能製造大量的釘子,所以蓋房子變得更便宜。

items.def: the speed of something in a particular direction
items.s: The train reached a ________ of 100 kilometres an hour, and passengers were both excited and afraid.
items.zh: 火車達到每小時100公里的速度,而乘客們既興奮又害怕。

items.def: the force that pulls things towards the earth
items.s: Newton wondered why apples always fall down, and his ideas about ________ changed science and engineering forever.
items.zh: 牛頓好奇蘋果為什麼總是往下掉,而他關於重力的想法永遠改變了科學和工程。

items.def: connected with movement
items.s: The water wheel turned the ________ energy of the river into power, so the mill could grind grain.
items.zh: 水車把河流的動能轉化為動力,所以磨坊可以磨穀物。

items.def: connected with living things
items.s: Pasteur studied ________ processes like milk going sour, and his work made food much safer.
items.zh: 巴斯德研究牛奶變酸這類生物過程,而他的研究讓食物安全許多。

items.def: a substance made of two or more elements
items.s: Water is a ________ of hydrogen and oxygen, but each of these gases behaves very differently alone.
items.zh: 水是氫和氧的化合物,但這兩種氣體單獨存在時的性質非常不同。

items.def: the parts or substances that something is made of
items.s: Scientists studied the ________ of the metal, and they found that a little carbon made it much stronger.
items.zh: 科學家研究這種金屬的成分,而他們發現少量的碳讓它堅固許多。

items.def: a small part of something
items.s: The new machine used only a ________ of the coal, so the factory saved a lot of money every year.
items.zh: 新機器只用了一小部分的煤,所以工廠每年省下很多錢。

items.def: facts that show something is true
items.s: The inventor needed ________ that he had the idea first, so he showed the court his dated notebooks.
items.zh: 發明家需要證據證明是他先有這個點子的,所以他向法庭出示了標有日期的筆記本。

items.def: an argument against another argument
items.s: Write one ________ in your essay, and then explain why you still believe your own view is stronger.
items.zh: 在你的文章中寫出一個反駁論點,然後解釋為什麼你仍然認為自己的觀點比較有力。

items.def: the quality of being easy to understand or use
items.s: The bicycle became popular because of its ________, and almost anyone could learn to ride it in a day.
items.zh: 腳踏車因為它的簡單而受歡迎,而幾乎任何人都能在一天內學會騎。

items.def: secret or hidden
items.s: Some companies used ________ methods to copy foreign machines, while others paid for the right to use them.
items.zh: 有些公司用祕密的手段仿造外國機器,而其他公司則付費取得使用權。

items.def: easy to see or notice
items.s: There was a ________ drop in pollution after the factory closed, and people could see the stars again.
items.zh: 工廠關閉後污染有了明顯的下降,而人們又能看見星星了。

items.def: large enough to be measured
items.s: Street lights led to a ________ fall in crime, so other towns quickly installed them too.
items.zh: 路燈帶來了可衡量的犯罪率下降,所以其他城鎮也很快裝設了路燈。

items.def: to organise a company or system in a new way
items.s: The car company had to ________ after losing money, and several factories were closed or sold.
items.zh: 這家汽車公司虧損後不得不重組,而好幾間工廠被關閉或出售。

items.def: to arrange something in a new way
items.s: Henry Ford decided to ________ his factory around a moving line, so each worker did only one simple task.
items.zh: 亨利·福特決定圍繞著移動生產線重新安排他的工廠,所以每位工人只做一項簡單的工作。

items.def: to bring something into use for the first time
items.s: The city ________ electric trams in 1900, and people could travel across town for a few pennies.
items.zh: 這座城市在1900年引進了電車,而人們只要幾便士就能橫越城鎮。

items.def: to start selling a new product
items.s: The company will ________ its new electric bike next month, but the price has not been announced yet.
items.zh: 這家公司下個月將推出新款電動腳踏車,但價格還沒有公布。

items.def: a period when the economy is doing badly
items.s: Many factories closed during the ________, and thousands of workers had to look for new jobs.
items.zh: 許多工廠在經濟衰退期間關閉,而數千名工人必須另找工作。

items.def: a period of fast economic growth
items.s: There was a railway ________ in the 1840s, and thousands of people invested their savings in new lines.
items.zh: 1840年代出現了一股鐵路熱潮,而成千上萬的人把積蓄投資在新路線上。

items.def: a sudden fall in prices or business
items.s: After the ________ in cotton prices, many mill owners lost everything, and their workers lost their jobs.
items.zh: 棉花價格暴跌之後,許多工廠主失去了一切,而他們的工人也丟了工作。

items.def: a fall in business or economic activity
items.s: The ________ in steel sales hit the town hard, so the council started training people for other work.
items.zh: 鋼鐵銷售的下滑重創了這個小鎮,所以議會開始培訓人們從事其他工作。

items.def: a general rise in prices
items.s: ________ has made food much more expensive this year, so my family buys fewer snacks now.
items.zh: 通貨膨脹讓今年的食物貴了很多,所以我家現在比較少買零食。

items.def: a person who gives money to help others
items.s: A rich ________ paid for the town's first public library, and workers could borrow books for free.
items.zh: 一位富有的捐助者出資興建了小鎮的第一座公共圖書館,而工人們可以免費借書。

items.def: a rich person who gives money to help people
items.s: Andrew Carnegie made a fortune from steel, but he became a ________ and gave most of it away.
items.zh: 安德魯·卡內基靠鋼鐵賺了大錢,但他成為一位慈善家並把大部分財富捐了出去。

items.def: the idea that buying lots of goods is good
items.s: Cheap factory goods led to ________, and today many people buy things they do not really need.
items.zh: 便宜的工廠商品導致了消費主義,而今天許多人購買並非真正需要的東西。

items.def: a large company made of many different businesses
items.s: The ________ owns car factories, hotels and a bank, so its decisions affect millions of people.
items.zh: 這家企業集團擁有汽車工廠、飯店和一家銀行,所以它的決策影響數百萬人。

items.def: a share of a company's profit paid to its owners
items.s: The railway company paid a large ________ every year, so many middle-class families bought its shares.
items.zh: 鐵路公司每年都發放豐厚的股利,所以許多中產階級家庭買了它的股票。

items.def: a person who owns part of a company
items.s: Every ________ can vote at the annual meeting, but the biggest owners usually make the decisions.
items.zh: 每位股東都可以在年度大會上投票,但通常是最大的股東做決定。

items.def: free time when you are not working
items.s: Workers had very little ________ in the 1800s, but later laws gave them Saturday afternoons off.
items.zh: 1800年代的工人幾乎沒有閒暇時間,但後來的法律讓他們週六下午可以休息。

items.def: activities done for fun when you are not working
items.s: Cheap train tickets made seaside trips a popular form of ________, and workers' families loved the beach.
items.zh: 便宜的火車票讓海邊旅遊成為一種受歡迎的消遣,而勞工家庭很喜歡海灘。

items.def: something expensive that you enjoy but do not need
items.s: A car was a ________ in 1910, but today most families in Taiwan own at least one scooter.
items.zh: 在1910年汽車是奢侈品,但今天台灣大多數家庭至少擁有一台機車。

items.def: the quality of being modern
items.s: Tall glass towers became a symbol of ________, while old wooden houses were slowly knocked down.
items.zh: 高聳的玻璃大樓成為現代化的象徵,而老舊的木屋則慢慢被拆除。

items.def: very different from the usual way
items.s: Her ________ design used bamboo instead of steel, but it was strong enough to carry a small car.
items.zh: 她非傳統的設計用竹子取代鋼材,但它堅固到足以承載一輛小汽車。

items.def: a person who is the first to do something new
items.s: Ada Lovelace was a ________ in computing, because she wrote programs before modern computers even existed.
items.zh: 愛達·勒芙蕾絲是電腦領域的開拓者,因為她在現代電腦存在之前就寫出了程式。

items.def: a very clever person who plans something complex
items.s: Brunel was the ________ behind the Great Western Railway, and he also designed huge iron ships.
items.zh: 布魯內爾是大西部鐵路背後的策劃者,而他也設計了巨大的鐵船。

items.def: great intelligence or skill
items.s: Everyone admired the ________ of her idea, but it took ten years before anyone would pay to build it.
items.zh: 大家都欽佩她想法中的才華,但過了十年才有人願意出錢把它造出來。

items.def: the act of watching something carefully
items.s: Careful ________ of boiling water gave him an idea, and he started to experiment with steam power.
items.zh: 對沸水的仔細觀察給了他一個點子,而他開始實驗蒸汽動力。

items.def: a size or amount found by measuring
items.s: Every part needed an exact ________, or the machine would not fit together properly at the end.
items.zh: 每個零件都需要精確的尺寸,否則機器最後就無法正確組裝。

items.def: ideas and inventions that legally belong to their creator
items.s: Companies protect their ______ ______ with patents, so others cannot copy their inventions for free.
items.zh: 公司用專利保護他們的智慧財產,讓別人無法免費抄襲他們的發明。

items.def: the process of taking a case to court
items.s: The two inventors were in ________ for years, and the lawyers earned more money than either of them.
items.zh: 這兩位發明家打了好幾年的官司,而律師賺的錢比他們任何一方都多。

items.def: legally or morally correct
items.s: The court decided she was the ________ owner of the patent, so the company had to pay her.
items.zh: 法院判定她是這項專利的合法擁有者,所以那家公司必須付錢給她。

items.def: regular business costs such as rent and electricity
items.s: The shop's ________ were too high, so the owner moved to a smaller place outside the city centre.
items.zh: 這家店的營運費用太高,所以老闆搬到市中心外一個較小的地方。

items.def: the sale of goods to the public in shops
items.s: My cousin works in ________, and she says weekends before Chinese New Year are the busiest time.
items.zh: 我表姊在零售業工作,而她說農曆新年前的週末是最忙的時候。

items.def: goods that are bought and sold
items.s: The new department store displayed its ________ in large glass windows, and crowds stopped to look.
items.zh: 新的百貨公司在大玻璃櫥窗中展示它的商品,而人群停下來觀看。

items.def: the world of buying and selling
items.s: Cheap goods from factories filled the ________, so small craftsmen found it hard to make a living.
items.zh: 工廠生產的便宜商品充斥市場,所以小手工業者很難維生。

items.def: competition between people or groups
items.s: The ________ between Edison and Tesla was famous, and both men claimed their system was safer.
items.zh: 愛迪生和特斯拉之間的競爭很有名,而兩人都宣稱自己的系統比較安全。

items.def: control by one powerful country or group over others
items.s: Britain held industrial ________ for most of the 1800s, but by 1900 America produced more steel.
items.zh: 英國在1800年代大部分時間握有工業霸權,但到了1900年美國生產的鋼鐵更多。

items.def: an extremely powerful country
items.s: After the war, the country became a ________, and its factories made goods for the whole world.
items.zh: 戰後這個國家成為超級強國,而它的工廠為全世界製造商品。

items.def: connected with how geography affects politics between countries
items.s: Coal and oil had huge ________ importance, so countries fought to control the regions where they were found.
items.zh: 煤和石油具有巨大的地緣政治重要性,所以各國爭奪控制出產它們的地區。

items.def: a country or area controlled by another country
items.s: India was a British ________ at that time, and much of its cotton was sent to factories in England.
items.zh: 印度當時是英國的殖民地,而它的大部分棉花被送到英格蘭的工廠。

items.def: a system in which a powerful country controls others
items.s: Industry and ________ grew together, because factories needed raw materials from other parts of the world.
items.zh: 工業和帝國主義一起成長,因為工廠需要來自世界其他地方的原料。

items.def: the act of giving people freedom
items.s: The ________ of enslaved people was a huge step, but freed workers still faced unfair treatment for decades.
items.zh: 被奴役者的解放是重大的一步,但獲得自由的勞工在數十年間仍遭受不公平對待。

items.def: the act of freeing someone from control
items.s: The washing machine meant a kind of ________ for women, since they no longer spent a whole day washing clothes.
items.zh: 洗衣機對女性來說意味著一種解放,因為她們不再花一整天洗衣服。

items.def: connected with helping people who are suffering
items.s: The doctor did ________ work in the slums, and he treated poor patients without asking for money.
items.zh: 那位醫生在貧民窟從事人道工作,而他免費為貧窮病人看病。

items.def: a good quality in a person's character
items.s: Victorians saw hard work as a ________, so they believed poor people should simply work harder.
items.zh: 維多利亞時代的人視勤奮為一種美德,所以他們認為窮人只要更努力工作就好。

items.def: dishonest behaviour by people in power
items.s: There was ________ in the railway company, because some managers secretly took money from builders.
items.zh: 鐵路公司裡有貪腐問題,因為一些經理私下收取營造商的錢。

items.def: the crime of tricking people to get money
items.s: The banker was arrested for ________, because he had sold shares in a railway that did not exist.
items.zh: 那名銀行家因詐欺被捕,因為他賣了一條根本不存在的鐵路的股份。

items.def: allowed by law
items.s: Workers wanted a ________ way to protest, so they asked the government to allow trade unions.
items.zh: 工人們想要一個合法的抗議方式,所以他們要求政府允許成立工會。

items.def: not allowed by law or rules
items.s: Some sailors ran an ________ trade in stolen goods, but the port police finally caught them.
items.zh: 有些水手從事贓物的非法交易,但港口警察最終抓到了他們。

items.def: physical harm to the body
items.s: A serious ________ meant a worker could lose his job, and his family might have nothing to eat.
items.zh: 嚴重的受傷意味著工人可能丟掉工作,而他的家人可能會沒東西吃。

items.def: a small accident or bad luck
items.s: There was a ________ during the demonstration, because the machine caught fire, but nobody was hurt.
items.zh: 示範過程中發生了一個小意外,因為機器起火了,但沒有人受傷。

items.def: a very sad event, often with death
items.s: The mine disaster was a terrible ________, and the town still holds a memorial every year.
items.zh: 那場礦災是一場可怕的悲劇,而小鎮至今每年仍舉行追悼會。

items.def: a sudden big change or improvement
items.s: The telephone was a great ________ forward, because people could hear each other's voices across countries.
items.zh: 電話是一大躍進,因為人們能跨國聽見彼此的聲音。

items.def: an important step forward in progress
items.s: Medicine made huge ________ in the 1800s, and many common diseases could finally be prevented or cured.
items.zh: 醫學在1800年代取得了巨大的進展,而許多常見疾病終於可以預防或治癒。

items.def: a regular way in which something happens
items.s: Historians noticed a ________ in the strikes, because they usually happened when food prices went up.
items.zh: 歷史學家注意到罷工中的一種規律,因為它們通常在糧價上漲時發生。

items.def: the rate at which people start using something
items.s: The ________ of electric cars has been slow in some areas, because there are not enough charging stations.
items.zh: 在某些地區電動車的採用率一直很慢,因為充電站不夠多。

items.def: connected with society
items.s: The car caused huge ________ changes, since people could live far from work and still arrive on time.
items.zh: 汽車引起了巨大的社會變化,因為人們可以住得離工作地點很遠又仍準時到達。

items.def: connected with government money and taxes
items.s: The government had a ________ problem after building so many railways, so it raised taxes on tobacco.
items.zh: 政府興建了這麼多鐵路後出現財政問題,所以它提高了菸草稅。

items.def: connected with money
items.s: The inventor received no ________ reward for his idea, but he was proud that it helped so many people.
items.zh: 發明家沒有因為他的點子得到任何金錢報酬,但他很自豪它幫助了那麼多人。

items.def: connected with towns and cities
items.s: ________ areas grew very quickly during the Industrial Revolution, but small villages lost many young people.
items.zh: 都市地區在工業革命期間成長得非常快,但小村莊失去了許多年輕人。

items.def: connected with the areas around a city where people live
items.s: The new railway created ________ towns, and office workers could live in quiet streets with gardens.
items.zh: 新鐵路創造了郊區城鎮,而上班族可以住在有花園的安靜街道上。

items.def: the ability to move or travel easily
items.s: Cars gave people much more ________, so they could take jobs in other towns without moving house.
items.zh: 汽車給了人們更多的移動能力,所以他們不必搬家就能在其他城鎮工作。

items.def: existing in large amounts
items.s: Coal was ________ in northern England, so many factories were built close to the mines to save money.
items.zh: 英格蘭北部的煤很豐富,所以許多工廠都蓋在礦場附近以節省成本。

items.def: able to be used successfully
items.s: His first plan was not ________, but after many changes the engine finally ran without stopping.
items.zh: 他的第一個計畫並不可行,但經過多次修改後,引擎終於能不停地運轉。

items.def: so large that it can never be used up
items.s: People once thought coal was ________, but now we know that it will run out one day.
items.zh: 人們曾經以為煤是取之不盡的,但現在我們知道它總有一天會用完。

items.def: using more than is needed
items.s: Old engines were very ________, because most of the heat escaped instead of moving the machine.
items.zh: 舊引擎非常浪費,因為大部分的熱都散失了,而不是用來推動機器。

items.def: material that is thrown away after use
items.s: Factories dumped their ________ into nearby rivers, so the water turned black and smelled terrible in summer.
items.zh: 工廠把廢棄物傾倒進附近的河裡,所以河水變黑,夏天時更是臭氣沖天。

items.def: a very rich and powerful businessperson
items.s: The oil ________ owned dozens of companies, but he started his career as a poor office clerk.
items.zh: 那位石油大亨擁有數十家公司,但他的職業生涯是從一名貧窮的辦公室職員開始的。

items.def: a rich and powerful person in a particular industry
items.s: The railway ________ built a huge mansion, while the workers who laid his tracks lived in tents.
items.zh: 那位鐵路巨頭蓋了一座巨大的豪宅,而為他鋪設鐵軌的工人卻住在帳篷裡。

items.def: moving forward with full energy and speed
items.s: Once the bank gave us the loan, it was ______ ______ ______ with the project, and we finished it in six months.
items.zh: 銀行一借給我們貸款,這個計畫就全速前進,而我們在六個月內就完成了。

items.def: to lose energy or enthusiasm
items.s: I started my essay with lots of ideas, but I ______ ______ ______ ______ after the first page and had to take a break.
items.zh: 我一開始寫文章時有很多點子,但寫完第一頁後我就失去動力,只好休息一下。

items.def: to become stronger, faster or more popular
items.s: The campaign for shorter working hours began slowly, but it ______ ______ ______ when newspapers reported on child workers.
items.zh: 爭取縮短工時的運動起初進展緩慢,但在報紙報導童工之後就聲勢漸增。

items.def: to waste time making something that already exists
items.s: We do not need to ______ ______ ______, because there is already a good app for planning group projects.
items.zh: 我們不需要重複發明輪子,因為已經有一個很好的應用程式可以規劃小組作業。

items.w: necessity is the mother of invention
items.def: people invent things when they really need them
items.s: The campers had no pot, so they cooked rice in a bamboo tube, which shows that ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______.
items.zh: 露營的人沒有鍋子,所以他們用竹筒煮飯,這說明了需要為發明之母。

items.def: time to start planning again after a failure
items.s: Our paper bridge collapsed under the first book, so it was ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ for our team.
items.zh: 我們的紙橋在放上第一本書時就垮了,所以我們這組只好從頭再來。

items.def: having ideas too new for the people of that time
items.s: Da Vinci was ______ ______ ______ ______, because he drew helicopters and tanks hundreds of years before they were built.
items.zh: 達文西是超越他那個時代的人,因為他在直升機和坦克被造出來的數百年前就畫出了它們。

items.def: a moment when a big change happens
items.s: Winning the science fair was a ______ ______ in her life, and she decided to become an engineer.
items.zh: 贏得科展是她人生的轉捩點,而她決定要成為一名工程師。

items.def: boring and tiring work that you do every day
items.s: Factory workers faced ______ ______ ______ of twelve-hour shifts, and they rarely had time to rest.
items.zh: 工廠工人面對著每天十二小時輪班的日常苦差事,而他們很少有時間休息。

items.def: to think of an idea or plan
items.s: Our team had to ______ ______ ______ a way to clean the beach, and we designed a simple floating net.
items.zh: 我們這組必須想出一個清理海灘的方法,而我們設計了一個簡單的浮動網子。

items.def: to start using an idea or plan in real life
items.s: The school ______ ______ ______ the new recycling plan last month, and the amount of rubbish has already dropped.
items.zh: 學校上個月把新的回收計畫付諸實行,而垃圾量已經減少了。

items.def: being planned or developed and coming soon
items.s: A new train line to the airport is ______ ______ ______, but it will not open until 2030.
items.zh: 一條通往機場的新鐵路線正在籌備中,但它要到2030年才會通車。

items.def: doing something in a way that will lead to success
items.s: My teacher said my project was ______ ______ ______ ______, so I just need to add more data.
items.zh: 老師說我的專題方向正確,所以我只需要再加入更多數據。

items.def: to start behaving badly or failing
items.s: The project began to ______ ______ ______ ______ when the leader left, and nobody knew what to do next.
items.zh: 領導者離開後這個計畫開始失控,而沒有人知道接下來該做什麼。

items.def: to happen exactly as planned without problems
items.s: The school sports day ______ ______ ______, because the teachers had planned every detail weeks before.
items.zh: 學校運動會進行得井然有序,因為老師們好幾週前就規劃好了每個細節。

items.w: the best thing since sliced bread
items.def: an excellent new invention or idea (humorous)
items.s: My grandma thinks video calls are ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, because she can see her grandchildren every day.
items.zh: 我奶奶覺得視訊通話是有史以來最棒的發明,因為她每天都能看到孫子們。

items.def: an idea or invention created by a particular person
items.s: The underground railway was ______ ______ ______ a lawyer named Charles Pearson, but he died before it opened.
items.zh: 地下鐵路是一位名叫查爾斯·皮爾森的律師的心血結晶,但他在通車前就去世了。

items.def: to have just enough money to live
items.s: Many families could not ______ ______ ______ on one wage, so the children also had to work in the mills.
items.zh: 許多家庭靠一份工資無法維持生計,所以孩子們也必須到工廠工作。

items.def: to think in a new and creative way
items.s: To solve the problem, we had to ______ ______ ______ ______, so we used old bottles to build a greenhouse.
items.zh: 為了解決問題,我們必須跳脫框架思考,所以我們用舊瓶子蓋了一座溫室。

items.def: to start a process
items.s: The mayor ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ for a new bike lane, and work will start next spring.
items.zh: 市長啟動了新自行車道的計畫,而工程將在明年春天開始。

items.def: a person who designs how a city grows and is used
items.s: The ________ suggested adding more parks near the old station, and the city council agreed because residents wanted more green areas.
items.zh: 那位都市規劃師建議在舊車站附近增設更多公園，而市議會同意了，因為居民想要更多綠地。
items.sec: City Planning & Land Use 城市規劃與土地利用

items.def: the work of deciding how land in a town is used
items.s: Good ______ ______ can reduce traffic and noise, but poor decisions can leave a neighbourhood without schools or shops for many years.
items.zh: 良好的城鎮規劃可以減少交通與噪音，但錯誤的決策可能讓一個社區多年沒有學校或商店。
items.sec: City Planning & Land Use 城市規劃與土地利用

items.def: the view of a city's buildings and streets
items.s: From the top of the hill we could see the whole ________ of Taipei, and the lights looked beautiful after the sun went down.
items.zh: 從山頂上我們可以看到台北的整片城市景觀，而太陽下山後燈光看起來非常美麗。
items.sec: City Planning & Land Use 城市規劃與土地利用

items.def: the shape that tall buildings make against the sky
items.s: Taipei 101 still stands out on the city's ________, although several new towers have been built around it in recent years.
items.zh: 台北101在這座城市的天際線上依然很突出，儘管近年來它周圍已經蓋了好幾棟新大樓。
items.sec: City Planning & Land Use 城市規劃與土地利用

items.def: the main business area in the centre of a city
items.s: Many offices are located in the ________ area, so the streets are crowded on weekdays but quiet on Sunday mornings.
items.zh: 許多辦公室都位於市中心地區，所以街道在平日很擁擠，但在星期天早上卻很安靜。
items.sec: City Planning & Land Use 城市規劃與土地利用

items.def: the outer areas of a town or city
items.s: My uncle lives on the ________ of the city, so the rent is cheaper, but he has to drive for an hour to get to work.
items.zh: 我叔叔住在城市的郊區，所以房租比較便宜，但他得開一小時的車去上班。
items.sec: City Planning & Land Use 城市規劃與土地利用

items.def: a living area at the edge of a large city
items.s: After their second child was born, the couple moved to a quiet ________ because they wanted a garden and a bigger home.
items.zh: 第二個孩子出生後，這對夫妻搬到一個安靜的郊區住宅區，因為他們想要有花園和更大的房子。
items.sec: City Planning & Land Use 城市規劃與土地利用

items.def: an area of a town and the people who live there
items.s: Our ________ has a small park, a bakery and a night market, so we rarely need to drive anywhere at the weekend.
items.zh: 我們的社區有一座小公園、一家麵包店和一個夜市，所以週末我們很少需要開車去任何地方。
items.sec: City Planning & Land Use 城市規劃與土地利用

items.def: an official area of a city
items.s: Xinyi ________ is famous for its shopping malls and offices, while Wanhua is known for its temples and old streets.
items.zh: 信義區以購物中心和辦公大樓聞名，而萬華則以廟宇和老街著稱。
items.sec: City Planning & Land Use 城市規劃與土地利用

items.def: the way an area of land is used, such as for homes or farms
items.s: The government studied ______ ______ in the region carefully, because farmers and builders both wanted the same flat area near the river.
items.zh: 政府仔細研究了該地區的土地利用，因為農民和建商都想要河邊同一塊平坦的土地。
items.sec: City Planning & Land Use 城市規劃與土地利用

items.def: a detailed long-term plan for developing an area
items.s: The city published a ten-year ______ ______ for the harbour area, and it includes new homes, a museum and a long cycling path.
items.zh: 市政府公布了港區的十年整體規劃，而其中包括新住宅、一座博物館和一條很長的自行車道。
items.sec: City Planning & Land Use 城市規劃與土地利用

items.def: the uncontrolled spread of a city into the countryside
items.s: ______ ______ has covered many farms with houses and car parks, so people now have to drive further to reach the countryside.
items.zh: 都市擴張已經讓許多農田被房屋和停車場覆蓋，因此人們現在得開更遠的車才能到鄉間。
items.sec: City Planning & Land Use 城市規劃與土地利用

items.def: a protected area of fields and woods around a city
items.cn: 綠帶（城市周圍的保護綠地）
items.s: Builders are not allowed to put houses on the ________ around the city, so the farmland and forests there are still protected.
items.zh: 建商不被允許在城市周圍的綠帶上蓋房子，所以那裡的農田和森林仍受到保護。
items.sec: City Planning & Land Use 城市規劃與土地利用

items.def: land that was used for industry and can be built on again
items.s: The old sugar factory became a ______ ______ after it closed, and now the city wants to turn it into an arts centre.
items.zh: 那座舊糖廠關閉後成為一塊棕地，而現在市政府想把它改造成藝術中心。
items.sec: City Planning & Land Use 城市規劃與土地利用

items.def: land that has never been built on before
items.s: Building on a ______ ______ is often cheaper, but environmental groups say it destroys farmland and wildlife habitats.
items.zh: 在未開發的綠地上興建通常比較便宜，但環保團體表示這會破壞農地和野生動物的棲地。
items.sec: City Planning & Land Use 城市規劃與土地利用

items.def: the process of rebuilding an old area with new buildings
items.s: The ________ of the old harbour brought new cafés and apartments, but some long-time residents could no longer afford to live there.
items.zh: 舊港口的重建帶來了新的咖啡店和公寓，但一些長期居民再也負擔不起住在那裡的費用。
items.sec: City Planning & Land Use 城市規劃與土地利用

items.def: improving old parts of a city by repairing or rebuilding them
items.s: Many old apartment buildings in Taipei need ______ ______, but owners often argue for years before they agree on a plan.
items.zh: 台北許多老舊公寓需要都市更新，但屋主們往往要爭論好幾年才會對計畫達成共識。
items.sec: City Planning & Land Use 城市規劃與土地利用

items.def: when richer people move into a poor area and prices rise
items.s: ________ has made the old street more stylish with new coffee shops, yet many local families have been forced to move away.
items.zh: 仕紳化讓這條老街因新咖啡店而變得更時髦，然而許多當地家庭卻被迫搬離。
items.sec: City Planning & Land Use 城市規劃與土地利用

items.def: a town planned and built all at once
items.s: Linkou was developed as a ______ ______ for people working in Taipei, and it now has its own shopping malls and hospitals.
items.zh: 林口被開發成一個為在台北工作的人規劃的新市鎮，而現在它擁有自己的購物中心和醫院。
items.sec: City Planning & Land Use 城市規劃與土地利用

items.def: official approval needed before you build something
items.s: The family wanted to add a third floor to their house, but they had to wait six months for ______ ______ from the council.
items.zh: 那家人想在房子上加蓋第三層樓，但他們必須等六個月才拿到市議會的建築許可。
items.sec: City Planning & Land Use 城市規劃與土地利用

items.def: the group of elected people who run a city
items.s: The ______ ______ voted to close the road to cars on Sundays, and most shop owners were happy because more walkers came by.
items.zh: 市議會投票決定週日禁止汽車進入這條道路，而大多數店家都很高興，因為有更多行人經過。
items.sec: City Planning & Land Use 城市規劃與土地利用

items.def: the elected leader of a city or town
items.s: The ________ promised to build three new libraries before the next election, but some citizens doubted there was enough money.
items.zh: 市長承諾在下次選舉前興建三座新圖書館，但有些市民懷疑經費是否足夠。
items.sec: City Planning & Land Use 城市規劃與土地利用

items.def: the building where a town's local government works
items.s: Residents gathered outside the ______ ______ to protest against the new highway, and the meeting lasted until late at night.
items.zh: 居民們聚集在市政廳外抗議新的高速公路，而那場會議一直持續到深夜。
items.sec: City Planning & Land Use 城市規劃與土地利用

items.def: the way the parts of a place are arranged
items.s: The ________ of the old town is confusing, because the narrow streets twist and turn, so tourists often get lost.
items.zh: 這座古城的佈局很令人困惑，因為狹窄的街道彎來彎去，所以觀光客常常迷路。
items.sec: City Planning & Land Use 城市規劃與土地利用

items.def: an open public square in a city
items.s: On summer evenings, families fill the ________ in front of the station, and children play while street musicians perform.
items.zh: 在夏天的傍晚，家庭們擠滿了車站前的廣場，孩子們在玩耍，而街頭音樂家在表演。
items.sec: City Planning & Land Use 城市規劃與土地利用

items.def: an area such as a park or square that everyone can use
items.s: Good ______ ______ helps people meet their neighbours, so planners now design more benches, parks and wide pavements.
items.zh: 良好的公共空間能幫助人們認識鄰居，因此規劃者現在設計了更多長椅、公園和寬人行道。
items.sec: City Planning & Land Use 城市規劃與土地利用

items.def: to close a street to cars so only people can walk there
items.cn: 將（街道）改為行人徒步區
items.s: The city decided to ________ the busy shopping street, and although drivers complained, the shops soon had more customers.
items.zh: 市政府決定把那條繁忙的購物街改為行人徒步區，雖然駕駛人抱怨，但商店很快就有了更多顧客。
items.sec: City Planning & Land Use 城市規劃與土地利用

items.def: a short street that is closed at one end
items.s: We live at the end of a quiet ________, so there is very little traffic and the children can ride their bikes safely.
items.zh: 我們住在一條安靜死巷的盡頭，所以車流非常少，孩子們可以安全地騎腳踏車。
items.sec: City Planning & Land Use 城市規劃與土地利用

items.def: the main shopping street in a town
items.s: Many small shops on the ______ ______ have closed because people now shop online, but the cafés are still busy.
items.zh: 主要商店街上許多小店已經關門，因為人們現在都在網路上購物，但咖啡店仍然生意興隆。
items.sec: City Planning & Land Use 城市規劃與土地利用

items.def: the part of a city next to a river, lake or sea
items.s: The ________ in Tamsui is crowded at sunset, because people love to walk by the river and eat snacks from the stalls.
items.zh: 淡水的水岸在日落時分很擁擠，因為人們喜歡沿著河邊散步並吃攤販的小吃。
items.sec: City Planning & Land Use 城市規劃與土地利用

items.def: the older, central part of a city, often with social problems
items.s: Some ______ ______ areas have old buildings and few jobs, so the government is offering money to help small businesses open there.
items.zh: 一些舊市區地區建築老舊且工作機會稀少，所以政府提供資金幫助小型企業在那裡開業。
items.sec: City Planning & Land Use 城市規劃與土地利用

items.def: used for both homes and businesses
items.cn: 混合使用的；住商混合的
items.s: The new ________ building has shops on the ground floor and flats above, so residents can buy groceries without leaving home.
items.zh: 這棟新的住商混合大樓一樓是商店、樓上是公寓，所以居民不用出門就能買到日用品。
items.sec: City Planning & Land Use 城市規劃與土地利用

items.def: a very large city with over ten million people
items.s: Tokyo is a ________ with more than thirty million people in its wider area, yet its trains are famous for being clean and on time.
items.zh: 東京是一座大都會區人口超過三千萬的超大城市，然而它的火車以乾淨準時聞名。
items.sec: City Planning & Land Use 城市規劃與土地利用

items.def: a large area where several towns have grown together
items.s: Taipei and New Taipei form one huge ________, so many people live in one city but work in the other every day.
items.zh: 台北和新北形成了一個巨大的大都會區，所以許多人住在一個城市，但每天在另一個城市工作。
items.sec: City Planning & Land Use 城市規劃與土地利用

items.def: a person whose job is to design buildings
items.s: The ________ designed the library with large windows, so readers can enjoy natural sunlight while they study.
items.zh: 那位建築師把圖書館設計成有大窗戶，所以讀者在讀書時可以享受自然陽光。
items.sec: Buildings & Architectural Design 建築物與建築設計

items.def: the style and design of buildings
items.s: Tainan is full of old temples and Japanese-era houses, so visitors who love ________ can spend days exploring the city.
items.zh: 台南到處都是古老廟宇和日治時期的房子，所以喜愛建築的遊客可以花好幾天探索這座城市。
items.sec: Buildings & Architectural Design 建築物與建築設計

items.def: a very tall modern building in a city
items.s: The new ________ has more than eighty floors, and people on the top floor can see the ocean on a clear day.
items.zh: 這棟新的摩天大樓有八十多層樓，而在頂樓的人天氣晴朗時可以看到海洋。
items.sec: Buildings & Architectural Design 建築物與建築設計

items.def: very tall, with many floors
items.s: Many families in Hong Kong live in ________ apartments, so children often take the lift instead of playing in a garden.
items.zh: 許多香港家庭住在高樓公寓裡，所以孩子們常常搭電梯，而不是在花園裡玩耍。
items.sec: Buildings & Architectural Design 建築物與建築設計

items.def: a tall building with many flats or offices
items.s: The old ______ ______ was badly built in the 1970s, so the council decided to knock it down and build safer homes.
items.zh: 那棟高層公寓大樓在1970年代蓋得很差，所以市議會決定拆掉它並興建更安全的住宅。
items.sec: Buildings & Architectural Design 建築物與建築設計

items.def: the front outside wall of a building
items.s: The museum kept the old brick ________ of the bank, but the inside was completely rebuilt with glass and steel.
items.zh: 這座博物館保留了那間銀行的舊紅磚正面外牆，但內部完全用玻璃和鋼材重建。
items.sec: Buildings & Architectural Design 建築物與建築設計

items.def: one level or floor of a building
items.s: Our school's classroom building has five ________, and the science labs are on the top floor because of the good light.
items.zh: 我們學校的教學大樓有五層樓，而自然實驗室位於頂樓，因為那裡光線良好。
items.sec: Buildings & Architectural Design 建築物與建築設計

items.def: a drawing that shows the rooms of a building from above
items.s: Before we rented the flat, we studied the ______ ______ carefully, because we wanted each child to have a separate bedroom.
items.zh: 在租這間公寓之前，我們仔細研究了平面圖，因為我們希望每個孩子都有獨立的臥室。
items.sec: Buildings & Architectural Design 建築物與建築設計

items.def: a large open space inside a building, often with a glass roof
items.s: The hotel has a huge ________ full of plants, and guests can see the sky through its glass roof while they eat breakfast.
items.zh: 這家飯店有一個種滿植物的巨大中庭，而客人吃早餐時可以透過玻璃屋頂看到天空。
items.sec: Buildings & Architectural Design 建築物與建築設計

items.def: a small platform outside an upper window of a building
items.s: My grandmother grows herbs and flowers on her ________, and she sits there every morning to drink her tea.
items.zh: 我奶奶在她的陽台上種香草和花，而且她每天早上都坐在那裡喝茶。
items.sec: Buildings & Architectural Design 建築物與建築設計

items.def: an open space surrounded by walls or buildings
items.s: The traditional house is built around a quiet ________, so the family can enjoy fresh air while staying private.
items.zh: 這棟傳統房屋圍繞著一個安靜的庭院而建，所以這家人既能享受新鮮空氣又能保有隱私。
items.sec: Buildings & Architectural Design 建築物與建築設計

items.def: a flat outdoor area next to a building or on a roof
items.s: We ate dinner on the restaurant's ________, and we could watch the boats on the river while the sun went down.
items.zh: 我們在餐廳的露台上吃晚餐，而且在太陽下山時可以看著河上的船隻。
items.sec: Buildings & Architectural Design 建築物與建築設計

items.def: the outside top surface of a building
items.s: Several schools in Taipei have turned their ________ into vegetable gardens, and students learn to grow food there.
items.zh: 台北有幾所學校已經把它們的屋頂改造成菜園，而學生們在那裡學習種植食物。
items.sec: Buildings & Architectural Design 建築物與建築設計

items.def: the part of a building below the ground
items.s: The heavy rain flooded the ________ of our building, so all the cars in the car park had to be moved.
items.zh: 豪雨淹沒了我們大樓的地下室，所以停車場裡所有的車都必須移走。
items.sec: Buildings & Architectural Design 建築物與建築設計

items.def: the first room or space you enter in a building
items.s: Visitors wait in the bright ______ ______ while the receptionist checks their names, and they can read about the company's history there.
