items.zh: 訪客在明亮的入口大廳等候，同時接待員核對他們的名字，而他們可以在那裡閱讀公司的歷史。
items.sec: Buildings & Architectural Design 建築物與建築設計

items.def: a set of stairs inside a building
items.s: The old wooden ________ makes a loud noise when people walk on it, so everyone can hear when someone comes home late.
items.zh: 那座老舊的木製樓梯在人們走上去時會發出很大的聲響，所以有人晚歸時大家都聽得到。
items.sec: Buildings & Architectural Design 建築物與建築設計

items.def: the inside surface at the top of a room
items.s: The café has a very high ________ with wooden fans, so it feels cool and spacious even in the summer.
items.zh: 那家咖啡店有很高的天花板和木製吊扇，所以即使在夏天也感覺涼爽又寬敞。
items.sec: Buildings & Architectural Design 建築物與建築設計

items.def: a long thick piece of wood or metal that supports a roof
items.s: The workers found a crack in the main wooden ________, so they closed the old temple until it could be repaired.
items.zh: 工人們發現主要的木頭橫樑上有一道裂縫，所以他們關閉了這座老廟直到可以修好為止。
items.sec: Buildings & Architectural Design 建築物與建築設計

items.def: a thin wall that divides a room into smaller spaces
items.s: The landlord added a ______ ______ to turn the big room into two bedrooms, but now we can hear everything our roommate says.
items.zh: 房東加了一道隔間牆把大房間變成兩間臥室，但現在我們聽得到室友說的每一句話。
items.sec: Buildings & Architectural Design 建築物與建築設計

items.def: a long beam fixed at only one end that sticks out
items.s: The famous balcony is supported by a steel ________, so it seems to float in the air above the valley.
items.zh: 那座著名的陽台由一根鋼製懸臂樑支撐，所以它看起來像是飄浮在山谷上方的空中。
items.sec: Buildings & Architectural Design 建築物與建築設計

items.def: a tall pointed structure on top of a church or tower
items.s: You can see the church's white ________ from far away, and travellers once used it to find their way to the village.
items.zh: 你從很遠的地方就能看到教堂的白色尖塔，而以前旅人曾用它來找到前往村莊的路。
items.sec: Buildings & Architectural Design 建築物與建築設計

items.def: an old building that is protected by law
items.s: The cinema is a ______ ______, so the owner cannot knock it down, although he is allowed to repair the inside.
items.zh: 那間電影院是一棟受法律保護的歷史建築，所以業主不能拆除它，雖然他被允許修繕內部。
items.sec: Buildings & Architectural Design 建築物與建築設計
items.t: 受法律保護的歷史建築

items.def: a window in a roof that lets in light
items.s: We put a ________ in the bathroom roof, so now we do not need to turn on the lights during the day.
items.zh: 我們在浴室屋頂裝了一扇天窗，所以現在白天不需要開燈了。
items.sec: Buildings & Architectural Design 建築物與建築設計

items.def: having few inside walls, with one large shared space
items.s: Our company moved to an ________ office, and although it is easier to talk to colleagues, it is also much noisier.
items.zh: 我們公司搬到開放式辦公室，雖然和同事交談更方便，但也吵鬧得多。
items.sec: Buildings & Architectural Design 建築物與建築設計

items.def: using very few things or simple decoration
items.s: Their ________ flat has white walls and very little furniture, so it looks clean but sometimes feels a little cold.
items.zh: 他們的極簡風格公寓有白色牆壁和很少的家具，所以看起來很乾淨，但有時感覺有點冷清。
items.sec: Buildings & Architectural Design 建築物與建築設計

items.def: in the plain 20th-century style using concrete, steel and glass
items.s: The university's ________ library was built in 1965, and its simple shapes and huge windows still look fresh today.
items.zh: 這所大學的現代主義圖書館建於1965年，而它簡單的造型和巨大的窗戶至今看起來仍很新穎。
items.sec: Buildings & Architectural Design 建築物與建築設計

items.def: the quality of having two halves that match exactly
items.s: The temple was designed with perfect ________, so the left side of the building looks exactly like the right side.
items.zh: 這座廟宇被設計成完美的對稱，所以建築物的左側看起來和右側一模一樣。
items.sec: Buildings & Architectural Design 建築物與建築設計

items.def: the inside of a building or room
items.s: The outside of the old house looks plain, but the ________ is full of beautiful wooden furniture and colourful tiles.
items.zh: 這棟老房子的外觀看起來很樸素，但它的內部卻滿是漂亮的木製家具和色彩繽紛的磁磚。
items.sec: Buildings & Architectural Design 建築物與建築設計

items.def: the outside of a building
items.s: The workers are painting the ________ of the school light blue, and they will finish before the new term begins.
items.zh: 工人們正在把學校的外觀漆成淡藍色，而他們會在新學期開始前完成。
items.sec: Buildings & Architectural Design 建築物與建築設計

items.def: to repair and improve an old building
items.s: My parents decided to ________ the old kitchen, so we ate takeaway food every night for almost a month.
items.zh: 我爸媽決定翻修舊廚房，所以我們有將近一個月每晚都吃外帶食物。
items.sec: Buildings & Architectural Design 建築物與建築設計

items.def: to knock down a building completely
items.s: The city plans to ________ the old market next year, but many shoppers have signed a petition to save it.
items.zh: 市政府計畫明年拆除舊市場，但許多購物者已經連署請願要保留它。
items.sec: Buildings & Architectural Design 建築物與建築設計

items.def: a small copy of a building with the same proportions
items.s: The architects showed a ______ ______ of the new stadium, and the children loved looking at the tiny seats and trees.
items.zh: 建築師們展示了新體育館的比例模型，而孩子們很喜歡看那些小小的座位和樹木。
items.sec: Buildings & Architectural Design 建築物與建築設計

items.def: a room or flat in the top part of a building
items.cn: 閣樓；（工廠改建的）挑高公寓
items.s: The artist turned an old warehouse ________ into a studio, because the high ceiling and big windows gave her plenty of light.
items.zh: 那位藝術家把一間舊倉庫閣樓改造成工作室，因為挑高的天花板和大窗戶給了她充足的光線。
items.sec: Buildings & Architectural Design 建築物與建築設計

items.def: an outer wall of glass that does not hold up the building
items.s: The office tower is covered with a glass ______ ______, so it looks bright, but it can become very hot in summer.
items.zh: 那棟辦公大樓覆蓋著玻璃帷幕牆，所以看起來很明亮，但在夏天可能會變得非常熱。
items.sec: Buildings & Architectural Design 建築物與建築設計

items.def: a grey powder mixed with water and sand to make concrete
items.s: Making ________ releases a lot of carbon dioxide, so engineers are testing new materials that are kinder to the planet.
items.zh: 製造水泥會釋放大量二氧化碳，所以工程師們正在測試對地球更友善的新材料。
items.sec: Construction Materials & Techniques 建材與營建技術

items.def: concrete made stronger with steel bars inside it
items.s: Most apartment buildings in Taiwan are made of ______ ______, because it can survive both typhoons and strong earthquakes.
items.zh: 台灣大多數公寓大樓是用鋼筋混凝土建造的，因為它能抵擋颱風和強烈地震。
items.sec: Construction Materials & Techniques 建材與營建技術

items.def: wood used for building
items.s: The cabin is built entirely from local ________, so it blends into the forest and smells of fresh pine.
items.zh: 這間小屋完全用當地的木材建造，所以它與森林融為一體，而且散發著新鮮松木的香氣。
items.sec: Construction Materials & Techniques 建材與營建技術

items.def: strong panels made by gluing layers of wood crosswise
items.s: The new school was built with ______ ______, which is strong enough for tall buildings but stores carbon instead of releasing it.
items.zh: 這所新學校是用交錯層壓木材建造的，它堅固到足以蓋高樓，而且會儲存碳而不是釋放碳。
items.sec: Construction Materials & Techniques 建材與營建技術

items.def: a fast-growing tall plant with hard hollow stems
items.s: Builders in many Asian countries use ________ for scaffolds and walls, because it grows quickly and is surprisingly strong.
items.zh: 許多亞洲國家的建築工人用竹子搭鷹架和建牆，因為它長得快而且出奇地堅固。
items.sec: Construction Materials & Techniques 建材與營建技術

items.def: soil pressed hard into walls as a building material
items.s: The walls of the visitor centre are made of ______ ______, so the rooms stay cool in summer and warm in winter.
items.zh: 遊客中心的牆是用夯土做成的，所以房間在夏天保持涼爽，在冬天保持溫暖。
items.sec: Construction Materials & Techniques 建材與營建技術

items.def: thin layers of wood glued together into a board
items.s: Before the typhoon arrived, shop owners covered their windows with ________, and they took the boards down two days later.
items.zh: 颱風來襲前，店家用合板蓋住窗戶，而他們兩天後才把木板拆下來。
items.sec: Construction Materials & Techniques 建材與營建技術

items.def: a hard clear material used for windows
items.s: The museum's walls are made almost entirely of ________, so visitors can look out at the mountains while they view the art.
items.zh: 這座博物館的牆幾乎完全用玻璃做成，所以遊客在欣賞藝術時可以眺望群山。
items.sec: Construction Materials & Techniques 建材與營建技術

items.def: a black sticky material used to cover roads
items.s: Dark ________ absorbs a lot of heat on sunny days, so the city is testing lighter road surfaces to keep streets cooler.
items.zh: 深色柏油在晴天會吸收大量熱能，所以市政府正在測試顏色較淺的路面以保持街道涼爽。
items.sec: Construction Materials & Techniques 建材與營建技術

items.def: small stones used to make paths and roads
items.s: The park paths are covered with ________ instead of concrete, so rainwater can soak into the ground and the trees stay healthy.
items.zh: 公園的小徑鋪的是碎石而不是混凝土，所以雨水能滲入地面，樹木也能保持健康。
items.sec: Construction Materials & Techniques 建材與營建技術

items.def: a thin flat square piece used to cover floors, walls or roofs
items.s: Many old houses in Taiwan have colourful ________ on their walls, and collectors now pay a lot of money for them.
items.zh: 台灣許多老房子的牆上有色彩繽紛的磁磚，而收藏家現在願意花大錢購買它們。
items.sec: Construction Materials & Techniques 建材與營建技術

items.def: a paste that becomes hard and smooth when it dries on walls
items.s: The ________ on the old walls was cracking, so the workers removed it and covered the bricks with a fresh layer.
items.zh: 舊牆上的灰泥正在龜裂，所以工人們把它刮掉，並在磚塊上塗了一層新的。
items.sec: Construction Materials & Techniques 建材與營建技術

items.def: a covering added to the outside walls of a building
items.s: After a terrible fire, the government banned some kinds of plastic ________, because it allowed flames to spread up the building.
items.zh: 在一場可怕的火災之後，政府禁止了某些塑膠外牆覆層，因為它會讓火焰沿著大樓往上蔓延。
items.sec: Construction Materials & Techniques 建材與營建技術

items.def: a light building material made from hemp plants and lime
items.cn: 大麻混凝土（麻纖維石灰建材）
items.s: ________ is lighter than concrete and keeps homes warm, but it is not strong enough to hold up a tall building alone.
items.zh: 大麻混凝土比混凝土輕而且能讓房屋保暖，但它的強度不足以單獨支撐高樓。
items.sec: Construction Materials & Techniques 建材與營建技術

items.def: a place where a building is being built
items.s: Children are not allowed to play near the ______ ______, because heavy machines are moving around and things may fall from above.
items.zh: 孩子們不准在建築工地附近玩耍，因為重型機具在四處移動，而且可能有東西從上方掉落。
items.sec: Construction Materials & Techniques 建材與營建技術

items.def: a person or company paid to do building work
items.s: We hired a ________ to fix our roof, but he left after two days, so the rain still comes in when there is a storm.
items.zh: 我們僱了一位承包商來修屋頂，但他兩天後就走了，所以暴風雨時雨水還是會漏進來。
items.sec: Construction Materials & Techniques 建材與營建技術

items.def: a worker who builds walls with bricks
items.s: The ________ worked carefully in the hot sun, and by evening he had finished the whole garden wall.
items.zh: 那位砌磚工人在炎熱的陽光下仔細工作，而到了傍晚他已經完成了整道花園圍牆。
items.sec: Construction Materials & Techniques 建材與營建技術

items.def: a person who makes and repairs wooden things
items.s: My grandfather was a ________ for forty years, and he built most of the tables and chairs in our house.
items.zh: 我爺爺當了四十年的木匠，而我們家大部分的桌椅都是他做的。
items.sec: Construction Materials & Techniques 建材與營建技術

items.def: a person who fixes water pipes and toilets
items.s: Water was leaking from the kitchen pipe all night, so we called a ________ early in the morning to repair it.
items.zh: 廚房的水管漏了一整晚的水，所以我們一大早就打電話請水管工人來修理。
items.sec: Construction Materials & Techniques 建材與營建技術

items.def: a person who puts in and repairs electrical wires
items.s: The lights kept turning off by themselves, so my father asked an ________ to check the wiring in the old flat.
items.zh: 燈一直自己熄滅，所以我爸爸請了一位電工來檢查這間老公寓的線路。
items.sec: Construction Materials & Techniques 建材與營建技術

items.def: a powerful machine that pushes earth and knocks down buildings
items.s: A huge ________ knocked down the old factory walls in just one morning, and trucks carried the rubble away in the afternoon.
items.zh: 一台巨大的推土機只花一個早上就推倒了舊工廠的牆，而卡車在下午把瓦礫載走。
items.sec: Construction Materials & Techniques 建材與營建技術

items.def: supporting the weight of the building above it
items.s: You cannot remove a ________ wall without adding a steel beam, because the floors above might fall down.
items.zh: 你不能在沒有加裝鋼樑的情況下拆除承重牆，因為上面的樓層可能會倒塌。
items.sec: Construction Materials & Techniques 建材與營建技術

items.def: made in parts in a factory and put together on site
items.s: The ________ homes were built in a factory in a few weeks, so families who lost their houses in the flood could move in quickly.
items.zh: 這些預製房屋在工廠裡幾週內就建好了，所以在水災中失去家園的家庭能很快搬進去。
items.sec: Construction Materials & Techniques 建材與營建技術

items.def: made layer by layer by a machine that prints materials
items.s: The company built a small ________ house in just two days, and it cost much less than a normal home.
items.zh: 那家公司只花兩天就蓋好一棟小型3D列印房屋，而且它的成本比一般住宅低得多。
items.sec: Construction Materials & Techniques 建材與營建技術

items.def: built so that it will not fall down in an earthquake
items.s: Taiwan has many ________ buildings, but older homes still need checks because they were built before the safety rules changed.
items.zh: 台灣有許多耐震建築，但較老的房屋仍需要檢查，因為它們是在安全規定修改之前建造的。
items.sec: Construction Materials & Techniques 建材與營建技術

items.def: connected with earthquakes
items.s: Engineers added special ________ dampers to Taipei 101, so the tower moves less during strong winds and earthquakes.
items.zh: 工程師在台北101加裝了特殊的地震阻尼器，所以這座大樓在強風和地震時晃動得較少。
items.sec: Construction Materials & Techniques 建材與營建技術

items.def: the official rules about how buildings must be built
items.s: The new ______ ______ requires better insulation, so new homes will use less energy, although they may cost a little more.
items.zh: 新的建築法規要求更好的隔熱，所以新房屋會更節能，雖然價格可能會稍微高一點。
items.sec: Construction Materials & Techniques 建材與營建技術

items.def: an expert who makes sure buildings are strong and safe
items.s: After the earthquake, a ______ ______ checked every school building, and two of them were closed because of serious cracks.
items.zh: 地震過後，一位結構工程師檢查了每一棟校舍，而其中兩棟因為嚴重裂縫而被關閉。
items.sec: Construction Materials & Techniques 建材與營建技術

items.def: a person who measures land or checks the condition of buildings
items.s: Before buying the old house, we paid a ________ to inspect it, and he found that the roof needed urgent repairs.
items.zh: 在買下那棟老房子之前，我們花錢請了一位鑑定師來檢查，而他發現屋頂急需修繕。
items.sec: Construction Materials & Techniques 建材與營建技術

items.def: a skeleton of steel beams that holds up a building
items.s: The tower has a strong ______ ______, so the walls can be made of light glass instead of heavy stone.
items.zh: 這座大樓有堅固的鋼構骨架，所以牆面可以用輕巧的玻璃而不是沉重的石材來做。
items.sec: Construction Materials & Techniques 建材與營建技術

items.def: not allowing water to go through
items.s: We painted the roof with a ________ coating, so the ceiling no longer leaks when heavy rain falls in summer.
items.zh: 我們在屋頂上漆了一層防水塗料，所以夏天下大雨時天花板不再漏水了。
items.sec: Construction Materials & Techniques 建材與營建技術

items.def: not easily damaged or burned by fire
items.s: The doors in the hospital are made of ________ materials, so patients have more time to escape if a fire starts.
items.zh: 醫院的門是用防火材料做的，所以如果發生火災，病人會有更多時間逃生。
items.sec: Construction Materials & Techniques 建材與營建技術

items.def: the carbon released when making and transporting building materials
items.s: Steel and cement have high ______ ______, so architects now try to reuse old materials whenever they can.
items.zh: 鋼材和水泥有很高的隱含碳，所以建築師現在只要可以就會盡量重複使用舊材料。
items.sec: Construction Materials & Techniques 建材與營建技術

items.def: the cars, buses and other vehicles on a road
items.s: The ________ is always heavy near the school at 7:30, so many parents now let their children take the MRT instead.
items.zh: 早上七點半學校附近的車流總是很多，所以許多家長現在讓孩子改搭捷運。
items.sec: Transport & Getting Around 交通與移動

items.def: a long line of vehicles that cannot move or move slowly
items.s: We were stuck in a ______ ______ for two hours on the way to Yilan, so we missed the start of the concert.
items.zh: 我們在去宜蘭的路上塞車塞了兩個小時，所以錯過了音樂會的開場。
items.sec: Transport & Getting Around 交通與移動

items.def: the busy time when most people travel to or from work
items.s: The trains are packed during ______ ______, so I leave home thirty minutes earlier to get a seat.
items.zh: 火車在尖峰時段擠滿了人，所以我提早三十分鐘出門好搶到座位。
items.sec: Transport & Getting Around 交通與移動

items.def: to travel regularly between home and work or school
items.s: My sister ________ from Taoyuan to Taipei every day, and she uses the long train ride to read novels.
items.zh: 我姊姊每天從桃園通勤到台北，而她利用漫長的火車車程閱讀小說。
items.sec: Transport & Getting Around 交通與移動

items.def: a person who is walking in a street
items.s: Drivers must stop for every ________ at a crossing, but some still drive through without slowing down.
items.zh: 駕駛人必須在斑馬線前為每位行人停車，但有些人仍然沒有減速就開過去。
items.sec: Transport & Getting Around 交通與移動

items.def: a person who rides a bicycle
items.s: The new path keeps every ________ away from the cars, so more students now ride their bikes to school.
items.zh: 新的車道讓每位騎單車的人遠離汽車，所以現在有更多學生騎腳踏車上學。
items.sec: Transport & Getting Around 交通與移動

items.def: a part of a road only for bicycles
items.s: The city painted a green ______ ______ along the main road, but delivery scooters often park on it, which is dangerous.
items.zh: 市政府沿著主要道路畫了一條綠色自行車道，但外送機車常常停在上面，這很危險。
items.sec: Transport & Getting Around 交通與移動

items.def: black and white stripes on a road where people can cross
items.s: Always cross the street at a ______ ______, because drivers expect people there and are more likely to stop.
items.zh: 一定要走斑馬線過馬路，因為駕駛人預期那裡會有行人，所以更可能停車。
items.sec: Transport & Getting Around 交通與移動

items.def: the path at the side of a road for people to walk on
items.s: In many old streets, scooters are parked on the ________, so people with prams or wheelchairs have to walk in the road.
items.zh: 在許多老街上，機車停在人行道上，所以推嬰兒車或坐輪椅的人只好走在馬路上。
items.sec: Transport & Getting Around 交通與移動

items.def: a place where two or more roads cross
items.s: There are many accidents at this busy ________, so the police want to add more traffic cameras.
items.zh: 這個繁忙的十字路口發生過許多事故，所以警方想加裝更多交通攝影機。
items.sec: Transport & Getting Around 交通與移動

items.def: a circular place where roads meet and cars drive around
items.s: Drivers must give way to cars already on the ________, but many tourists are confused because they rarely use them at home.
items.zh: 駕駛人必須禮讓已經在圓環上的車輛，但許多觀光客很困惑，因為他們在家鄉很少用到圓環。
items.sec: Transport & Getting Around 交通與移動

items.def: a set of red, yellow and green lights that control traffic
items.s: The ______ ______ near our school stays red for a long time, so students often wait in the hot sun.
items.zh: 我們學校附近的紅綠燈紅燈很久，所以學生們常常在大太陽下等待。
items.sec: Transport & Getting Around 交通與移動

items.def: a raised part across a road that makes cars slow down
items.s: The residents asked for a ______ ______ outside the kindergarten, because some drivers were going far too fast.
items.zh: 居民們要求在幼兒園外設置減速丘，因為有些駕駛人開得太快了。
items.sec: Transport & Getting Around 交通與移動

items.def: a wide fast road for travelling long distances
items.s: It takes about four hours to drive down the ________ to Kaohsiung, but the high-speed train takes only ninety minutes.
items.zh: 沿著高速公路開車到高雄大約要四小時，但搭高鐵只需要九十分鐘。
items.sec: Transport & Getting Around 交通與移動

items.def: a road that goes around a city so traffic can avoid the centre
items.s: Trucks now use the new ______ ______, so the old town centre is much quieter and the air is cleaner.
items.zh: 卡車現在改走新的環狀道路，所以舊市中心安靜多了，空氣也更乾淨。
items.sec: Transport & Getting Around 交通與移動

items.def: a bridge that carries one road over another
items.s: The city removed the ugly concrete ________ above the old market, and the street below suddenly became bright and pleasant.
items.zh: 市政府拆除了舊市場上方醜陋的水泥高架橋，而下面的街道頓時變得明亮又宜人。
items.sec: Transport & Getting Around 交通與移動

items.def: a road or path that goes under another road
items.s: Pedestrians can use the ________ to cross the busy road safely, although some people say it feels dark at night.
items.zh: 行人可以利用地下道安全地穿越繁忙的馬路，雖然有些人說它晚上感覺很陰暗。
items.sec: Transport & Getting Around 交通與移動

items.def: an underground train system in a city
items.s: Taipei's ________ is clean, cheap and fast, so many residents do not feel they need to own a car.
items.zh: 台北的捷運乾淨、便宜又快速，所以許多居民覺得自己不需要擁有汽車。
items.sec: Transport & Getting Around 交通與移動

items.def: an electric vehicle that runs on rails along city streets
items.s: The old ________ in Hong Kong is slow and noisy, but tourists love riding it because the tickets are cheap and the views are great.
items.zh: 香港的老電車又慢又吵，但觀光客喜歡搭乘，因為票價便宜而且風景很棒。
items.sec: Transport & Getting Around 交通與移動

items.def: a modern electric train system that runs mainly on city streets
items.s: The new ______ ______ connects the station to the university, so students no longer need to wait for crowded buses.
items.zh: 新的輕軌連接車站和大學，所以學生們不再需要等擁擠的公車。
items.sec: Transport & Getting Around 交通與移動

items.def: a part of the road that only buses can use
items.s: Buses are much faster since the city opened a ______ ______, but car drivers complain that the other lanes are now slower.
items.zh: 自從市政府開設公車專用道後，公車快多了，但汽車駕駛人抱怨其他車道現在變慢了。
items.sec: Transport & Getting Around 交通與移動

items.def: a system where you park outside a city and take a bus in
items.s: The ________ near the motorway is popular with commuters, because parking downtown is very expensive.
items.zh: 高速公路附近的停車轉乘很受通勤族歡迎，因為在市中心停車非常貴。
items.sec: Transport & Getting Around 交通與移動

items.def: a service where people rent cars for short periods
items.s: ________ is becoming popular among young people, because they can use a car when they need one without paying for parking.
items.zh: 汽車共享在年輕人之間越來越受歡迎，因為他們需要時就能用車，而且不必支付停車費。
items.sec: Transport & Getting Around 交通與移動

items.def: to share a car journey with other people
items.s: Four teachers ________ to school every morning, so they save money on petrol and there are fewer cars on the road.
items.zh: 四位老師每天早上共乘一輛車到學校，所以他們省下了油錢，路上的車也更少。
items.sec: Transport & Getting Around 交通與移動

items.def: booking a car and driver through a phone app
items.s: Many people use ________ apps late at night, because buses stop running and taxis can be hard to find.
items.zh: 許多人深夜時使用叫車應用程式，因為公車停駛，而且計程車可能很難叫到。
items.sec: Transport & Getting Around 交通與移動

items.def: a small electric scooter that you stand on
items.s: Riding an ________ on the pavement is now banned in some cities, because several walkers were hurt in accidents.
items.zh: 在某些城市，在人行道上騎電動滑板車現在是被禁止的，因為有幾位行人在事故中受傷。
items.sec: Transport & Getting Around 交通與移動

items.def: a place where one car can be parked
items.s: It took us thirty minutes to find a ______ ______ near the night market, so next time we will take the bus.
items.zh: 我們花了三十分鐘才在夜市附近找到停車位，所以下次我們會搭公車。
items.sec: Transport & Getting Around 交通與移動

items.def: a machine on a street that you pay to park a car
items.cn: 停車計時器；停車收費器
items.s: My dad forgot to pay the ______ ______, so he got a ticket while we were eating lunch.
items.zh: 我爸忘了繳停車計時器的費用，所以我們在吃午餐時他就被開了罰單。
items.sec: Transport & Getting Around 交通與移動

items.def: the money you pay to travel on a bus, train or taxi
items.s: The bus ________ is very cheap for students, so most of my classmates use public buses after school.
items.zh: 學生的公車票價很便宜，所以我大部分的同學放學後都搭公車。
items.sec: Transport & Getting Around 交通與移動

items.def: safe and pleasant for walking around
items.s: Kyoto is a very ________ city, because shops, temples and parks are close together and the streets are quiet.
items.zh: 京都是一座非常適合步行的城市，因為商店、寺廟和公園彼此距離很近，而且街道很安靜。
items.sec: Transport & Getting Around 交通與移動

items.def: where cars are not allowed
items.s: The city holds a ________ day every September, and families ride bicycles on roads that are usually full of cars.
items.zh: 這座城市每年九月舉辦無車日，而家庭們在平常塞滿汽車的道路上騎腳踏車。
items.sec: Transport & Getting Around 交通與移動

items.def: a situation where traffic cannot move at all
items.s: The parade caused ________ in the city centre, and some people left their cars and walked home instead.
items.zh: 遊行造成市中心交通完全癱瘓，而有些人乾脆把車丟下走路回家。
items.sec: Transport & Getting Around 交通與移動

items.def: an area where old polluting vehicles must pay or cannot enter
items.s: London's ______ ______ charges old diesel cars a daily fee, so the air in the centre has become cleaner.
items.zh: 倫敦的低排放區向老舊柴油車收取每日費用，所以市中心的空氣變得更乾淨了。
items.sec: Transport & Getting Around 交通與移動

items.def: a building designed to save energy and water and harm nature less
items.s: The new library is a ______ ______ with solar power and rain collection, so its electricity bills are very low.
items.zh: 新圖書館是一棟有太陽能發電和集雨系統的綠建築，所以它的電費非常低。
items.sec: Green & Sustainable Design 綠色永續設計

items.def: a very well-sealed home that needs almost no heating or cooling
items.s: A ______ ______ keeps a steady temperature all year, so the family hardly ever turns on the heater or the air conditioner.
items.zh: 被動式節能屋一年四季都保持穩定的溫度，所以這家人幾乎從不開暖氣或冷氣。
items.sec: Green & Sustainable Design 綠色永續設計

items.def: producing as much clean energy as it uses, or no extra carbon
items.s: The company wants all its offices to be ________ by 2040, so it is putting solar panels on every roof.
items.zh: 這家公司希望在2040年前讓所有辦公室都達到淨零，所以正在每個屋頂裝設太陽能板。
items.sec: Green & Sustainable Design 綠色永續設計

items.def: a device that controls the temperature of a room
items.s: We set the ________ to 26 degrees in summer, and our electricity bill dropped by almost twenty percent.
items.zh: 我們夏天把溫控器設定在26度，而我們的電費下降了將近百分之二十。
items.sec: Green & Sustainable Design 綠色永續設計

items.def: changing sunlight directly into electricity
items.s: The school covered its sports hall with ________ panels, and now they produce enough power for all the classroom lights.
items.zh: 學校在體育館上鋪滿了光電板，而現在它們產生的電力足以供應所有教室的照明。
items.sec: Green & Sustainable Design 綠色永續設計

items.def: a machine that moves heat from outside air or ground into a building
items.s: Our old water heater broke, so we bought a ______ ______, which uses much less electricity to make hot water.
items.zh: 我們的舊熱水器壞了，所以我們買了一台熱泵，它製造熱水所用的電少得多。
items.sec: Green & Sustainable Design 綠色永續設計

items.def: windows with two layers of glass to keep heat and noise out
items.s: Our flat is next to a busy road, but the ______ ______ keeps out most of the noise, so we can sleep well.
items.zh: 我們的公寓緊鄰一條繁忙的道路，但雙層玻璃窗擋住了大部分噪音，所以我們能睡得很好。
items.sec: Green & Sustainable Design 綠色永續設計

items.def: light from the sun rather than from lamps
items.s: The classrooms have large windows that let in plenty of ______ ______, so students feel more awake and focused.
items.zh: 教室有大窗戶讓大量自然光照進來，所以學生們感覺更清醒、更專注。
items.sec: Green & Sustainable Design 綠色永續設計

items.def: the ability of heavy materials to store heat and release it slowly
items.s: Thick stone walls have high ______ ______, so they absorb heat during the day and release it slowly at night.
items.zh: 厚實的石牆有很高的蓄熱能力，所以它們白天吸收熱量，晚上再慢慢釋放出來。
items.sec: Green & Sustainable Design 綠色永續設計

items.def: a wall covered with living plants
items.s: The hotel built a huge ______ ______ beside the entrance, and the plants help clean the air and cool the building.
items.zh: 那家飯店在入口旁建了一面巨大的植生牆，而這些植物有助於淨化空氣和替建築降溫。
items.sec: Green & Sustainable Design 綠色永續設計

items.def: plants grown up a wall or on shelves rather than on the ground
items.s: Our flat has no yard, so we made a small ______ ______ on the balcony with herbs, lettuce and strawberries.
items.zh: 我們的公寓沒有院子，所以我們在陽台上用香草、萵苣和草莓做了一座小型垂直花園。
items.sec: Green & Sustainable Design 綠色永續設計

items.def: a low garden that collects rainwater from roofs and roads
items.s: The school dug a ______ ______ near the car park, and now the playground no longer floods after heavy storms.
items.zh: 學校在停車場附近挖了一座雨水花園，而現在操場在暴雨後不再淹水了。
items.sec: Green & Sustainable Design 綠色永續設計

items.def: ground covering that lets water soak through it
items.s: The new car park has a ______ ______, so rain can soak into the soil instead of running into the drains.
items.zh: 新停車場鋪設了透水鋪面，所以雨水能滲入土壤，而不是流進排水溝。
items.sec: Green & Sustainable Design 綠色永續設計

items.def: used water from sinks and showers that can be used again
items.cn: 中水；灰水（可回收的生活廢水）
items.s: The building collects ________ from its showers, and it uses this water to flush the toilets and water the garden.
items.zh: 這棟大樓收集淋浴產生的中水，並用這些水來沖馬桶和澆花園。
items.sec: Green & Sustainable Design 綠色永續設計

items.def: a city designed to soak up and store rainwater like a sponge
items.s: Wuhan is trying to become a ______ ______, so it has built wetlands and green roofs that hold water during storms.
items.zh: 武漢正努力成為一座海綿城市，所以它建造了濕地和綠屋頂，在暴雨時把水留住。
items.sec: Green & Sustainable Design 綠色永續設計

items.def: growing food and raising animals in a city
items.s: ______ ______ is becoming popular in Taipei, because people want fresh vegetables and enjoy working with their neighbours.
items.zh: 都市農業在台北越來越受歡迎，因為人們想要新鮮的蔬菜，也喜歡和鄰居一起勞動。
items.sec: Green & Sustainable Design 綠色永續設計

items.def: a shared piece of land where local people grow plants together
items.s: Retired residents look after the ______ ______ every morning, and they share the tomatoes and beans with the whole street.
items.zh: 退休的居民每天早上照顧社區花園，而他們把番茄和豆子分享給整條街的人。
items.sec: Green & Sustainable Design 綠色永續設計

items.def: trees planted along the sides of roads
items.s: The ______ ______ on this road give shade in summer, so people prefer to walk here even though it takes longer.
items.zh: 這條路上的行道樹在夏天提供遮蔭，所以人們寧願走這裡，即使要花更多時間。
items.sec: Green & Sustainable Design 綠色永續設計

items.def: a very small public park in a gap between buildings
items.s: The empty lot between two shops became a ______ ______, and now office workers eat their lunch there under the trees.
items.zh: 兩家商店之間的空地變成了一座口袋公園，而現在上班族在那裡的樹下吃午餐。
items.sec: Green & Sustainable Design 綠色永續設計

items.def: designing buildings that bring people closer to nature
items.s: The hospital used ______ ______ with plants, water and wood, and patients said they felt calmer and recovered faster.
items.zh: 這家醫院採用了有植物、水和木材的親生物設計，而病人們說他們感覺更平靜，康復得也更快。
items.sec: Green & Sustainable Design 綠色永續設計

items.def: a device that shows how much energy you are using in real time
items.s: After we installed a ______ ______, we saw how much power the old fridge used, so we finally replaced it.
items.zh: 我們裝了智慧電表之後，看到舊冰箱有多耗電，所以我們終於把它換掉了。
items.sec: Green & Sustainable Design 綠色永續設計

items.def: a label that shows how efficiently something uses energy
items.s: Before buying an air conditioner, check its ______ ______, because a better model can save you a lot of money over the years.
items.zh: 在買冷氣之前，先看看它的能源效率等級，因為比較好的機型多年下來可以幫你省下很多錢。
items.sec: Green & Sustainable Design 綠色永續設計

items.def: producing no rubbish that goes to landfill
items.s: The ________ shop sells rice and soap without plastic packaging, so customers bring their own jars and bags.
items.zh: 那家零廢棄商店販售沒有塑膠包裝的米和肥皂，所以顧客會自己帶罐子和袋子。
items.sec: Green & Sustainable Design 綠色永續設計

items.def: to turn old things into something new and more useful
items.s: The students ________ old wooden pallets into benches for the school garden, and they won a prize for their design.
items.zh: 學生們把舊木棧板升級再造成學校花園的長椅，而他們的設計還得了獎。
items.sec: Green & Sustainable Design 綠色永續設計

items.def: old wood taken from buildings and used again
items.s: The café's tables are made from ______ ______ from an old train station, so each one has a unique colour and history.
items.zh: 這家咖啡店的桌子是用舊火車站的回收木材做的，所以每一張都有獨特的顏色和歷史。
items.sec: Green & Sustainable Design 綠色永續設計

items.def: lights that use small electronic bulbs and very little power
items.s: The city changed all its street lamps to ______ ______, and it now saves millions of dollars on electricity every year.
items.zh: 市政府把所有路燈都換成LED照明，而現在每年節省數百萬元的電費。
items.sec: Green & Sustainable Design 綠色永續設計

items.def: a system that sends hot water from one plant to heat many buildings
items.s: In Copenhagen, most homes use ______ ______, and the heat often comes from burning rubbish that cannot be recycled.
items.zh: 在哥本哈根，大多數住家使用區域供熱，而熱能常常來自焚燒無法回收的垃圾。
items.sec: Green & Sustainable Design 綠色永續設計

items.def: all the trees growing in a city
items.s: Planting more trees will grow the city's ______ ______, which provides shade and helps birds and insects survive.
items.zh: 種植更多的樹會擴大城市的都市森林，它能提供遮蔭並幫助鳥類和昆蟲生存。
items.sec: Green & Sustainable Design 綠色永續設計

items.def: a roof painted a light colour to reflect sunlight
items.s: The factory turned its dark roof into a white ______ ______, and the temperature inside dropped by several degrees during the hot summer.
items.zh: 那間工廠把深色屋頂改成白色的涼屋頂，而炎熱的夏天裡室內溫度降了好幾度。
items.sec: Green & Sustainable Design 綠色永續設計

items.def: a part of a roof that sticks out beyond the walls
items.s: The wide roof ________ keeps the summer sun off the windows, but it lets in the low winter sun, so the house stays comfortable.
items.zh: 寬大的屋頂屋簷擋住了夏天照在窗上的陽光，但讓冬天低角度的陽光照進來，所以房子保持舒適。
items.sec: Green & Sustainable Design 綠色永續設計

items.def: too much artificial light at night that hides the stars
items.s: Because of ______ ______, children in the city rarely see the Milky Way, so their teacher took them to the mountains.
items.zh: 因為光害，城市裡的孩子很少看到銀河，所以他們的老師帶他們到山上去。
items.sec: Green & Sustainable Design 綠色永續設計

items.def: a high wall beside a road that blocks traffic noise
items.s: The government built a ______ ______ along the motorway, so people in nearby homes can finally open their windows.
items.zh: 政府沿著高速公路建了一道隔音牆，所以附近住家的人終於可以打開窗戶了。
items.sec: Green & Sustainable Design 綠色永續設計

items.def: how clean or polluted the air is
items.s: The ______ ______ is poor today, so the school has cancelled outdoor sports and students will play indoors.
items.zh: 今天的空氣品質很差，所以學校取消了戶外運動，學生們會在室內活動。
items.sec: Green & Sustainable Design 綠色永續設計

items.def: buildings that people live in
items.s: ________ in big cities has become so expensive that many young workers share flats with friends or live with their parents.
items.zh: 大城市的住房變得如此昂貴，以至於許多年輕上班族和朋友合租公寓或與父母同住。
items.sec: Housing & City Life 住宅與城市生活

items.def: homes provided by the government at a low rent
items.s: The city is building more ______ ______ for young families, and the rent will be about thirty percent below market prices.
items.zh: 市政府正在為年輕家庭興建更多社會住宅，而租金將比市價低約百分之三十。
items.sec: Housing & City Life 住宅與城市生活

items.def: a large group of houses or flats built at the same time
items.s: They grew up on a big ______ ______ with a playground in the middle, so they always had friends to play with after school.
items.zh: 他們在一個中央有遊樂場的大型住宅區長大，所以放學後總有朋友可以一起玩。
items.sec: Housing & City Life 住宅與城市生活

items.def: a set of rooms for living in on one floor of a building
items.s: Their ________ is on the tenth floor, so they have a great view, but they have to wait for the lift every morning.
items.zh: 他們的公寓在十樓，所以視野很棒，但他們每天早上都得等電梯。
items.sec: Housing & City Life 住宅與城市生活

items.def: a small flat with one main room for living and sleeping
items.s: After graduating, I rented a tiny ______ ______ near my office, and although it was small, I loved having my own place.
items.zh: 畢業後，我在辦公室附近租了一間小小的套房，雖然它很小，但我很喜歡擁有自己的地方。
items.sec: Housing & City Life 住宅與城市生活

items.def: a building of flats that are owned by the people living in them
items.s: Their ________ has a swimming pool and a gym, but the monthly management fee is quite high.
items.zh: 他們的公寓大廈有游泳池和健身房，但每月的管理費相當高。
items.sec: Housing & City Life 住宅與城市生活

items.def: a person who pays rent to live in a place
items.s: The new ________ promised to keep the flat clean, so the landlord agreed to let her keep a small cat.
items.zh: 新房客承諾會保持公寓整潔，所以房東同意讓她養一隻小貓。
items.sec: Housing & City Life 住宅與城市生活

items.def: money paid regularly to live in a place you do not own
items.s: The ________ in this area went up again this year, so many students are looking for rooms further from the university.
items.zh: 這一區的房租今年又上漲了，所以許多學生正在離大學更遠的地方找房間。
items.sec: Housing & City Life 住宅與城市生活

items.def: a legal agreement to rent a home or building for a period
items.s: We signed a two-year ________ for the shop, but we had to leave early because the owner sold the building.
items.zh: 我們簽了這間店面的兩年租約，但因為屋主賣掉了大樓，我們不得不提早搬走。
items.sec: Housing & City Life 住宅與城市生活

items.def: a loan from a bank to buy a home
items.s: My parents took out a twenty-year ________ to buy our house, and they will finally pay it all back next year.
items.zh: 我爸媽申請了二十年的房貸來買我們的房子，而他們明年終於要全部還清了。
items.sec: Housing & City Life 住宅與城市生活

items.def: a person who owns the home they live in
items.s: Every ________ in the building must agree before the old lift can be replaced, so the decision has taken two years.
items.zh: 大樓裡的每一位屋主都必須同意後才能更換舊電梯，所以這個決定已經拖了兩年。
items.sec: Housing & City Life 住宅與城市生活

items.def: the buying and selling of homes and their prices
items.s: The ______ ______ slowed down after interest rates rose, so some sellers had to lower their prices.
items.zh: 利率上升後房市放緩了，所以有些賣家不得不降價。
items.sec: Housing & City Life 住宅與城市生活

items.def: a person who lives in a particular place
items.s: Every ________ received a letter about the new recycling rules, but many people did not read it carefully.
items.zh: 每一位居民都收到了一封關於新回收規定的信，但許多人並沒有仔細閱讀。
items.sec: Housing & City Life 住宅與城市生活

items.def: used for homes rather than offices or factories
items.s: Trucks are not allowed in this ________ area at night, because people complained that the noise kept them awake.
items.zh: 卡車晚上不准進入這個住宅區，因為人們抱怨噪音讓他們睡不著。
items.sec: Housing & City Life 住宅與城市生活

items.def: a person who lives next to or near you
items.s: Our ________ looked after our dog while we were on holiday, so we brought her a box of pineapple cakes.
items.zh: 我們去度假時鄰居幫忙照顧我們的狗，所以我們帶了一盒鳳梨酥送她。
items.sec: Housing & City Life 住宅與城市生活

items.def: a small shop that is open long hours and sells everyday items
items.s: There is a ______ ______ on almost every corner in Taipei, so you can buy snacks or pay bills at any time of day.
items.zh: 台北幾乎每個街角都有便利商店，所以你在一天中任何時間都能買零食或繳帳單。
items.sec: Housing & City Life 住宅與城市生活

items.def: a person who sells food or goods from a stall in the street
items.s: The ______ ______ outside our school sells hot sweet potatoes in winter, and students line up for them after class.
items.zh: 我們學校外面的街頭攤販冬天賣熱騰騰的烤地瓜，而學生們下課後排隊購買。
items.sec: Housing & City Life 住宅與城市生活

items.def: an outdoor market that opens in the evening, selling food and goods
items.s: We walked around the ______ ______ for two hours, and we tried stinky tofu, bubble tea and grilled squid.
items.zh: 我們在夜市逛了兩個小時，並且嘗了臭豆腐、珍珠奶茶和烤魷魚。
items.sec: Housing & City Life 住宅與城市生活

items.def: entertainment such as bars and clubs that is open at night
items.s: The city is famous for its lively ________, so the streets are still busy at two o'clock in the morning.
items.zh: 這座城市以熱鬧的夜生活聞名，所以凌晨兩點街上仍然熱鬧。
items.sec: Housing & City Life 住宅與城市生活

items.def: the lamps that light up roads at night
items.s: Better ______ ______ has made the park safer at night, so more women now feel comfortable jogging there after work.
items.zh: 更好的路燈照明讓公園晚上更安全了，所以現在有更多女性下班後放心在那裡慢跑。
items.sec: Housing & City Life 住宅與城市生活

items.def: paintings and pictures made on walls in public places
items.s: The old alley is now covered in colourful ______ ______, and young people come from all over the city to take photos.
items.zh: 這條老巷子現在佈滿了色彩繽紛的街頭藝術，而年輕人從城市各地前來拍照。
items.sec: Housing & City Life 住宅與城市生活

items.def: words or pictures painted on walls without permission
items.s: Someone sprayed ________ on the new bus shelter last night, so the city sent workers to clean it this morning.
items.zh: 昨晚有人在新的公車候車亭上噴了塗鴉，所以市政府今天早上派工人去清除。
items.sec: Housing & City Life 住宅與城市生活

items.def: empty; not being used or lived in
items.s: There are many ________ flats in the old town, so the government wants to rent them cheaply to young artists.
items.zh: 舊城區有許多閒置的公寓，所以政府想把它們便宜地租給年輕藝術家。
items.sec: Housing & City Life 住宅與城市生活

items.def: too small for the people or things inside
items.s: Five people live in the ________ flat, so the children have to do their homework at the kitchen table.
items.zh: 五個人住在那間狹窄的公寓裡，所以孩子們只好在廚房餐桌上寫功課。
items.sec: Housing & City Life 住宅與城市生活

items.def: having a lot of space
items.s: The new library is bright and ________, so students can always find a quiet corner even during exam week.
items.zh: 新圖書館明亮又寬敞，所以學生們即使在考試週也總能找到安靜的角落。
items.sec: Housing & City Life 住宅與城市生活

items.def: to force someone to leave their home by law
items.s: The landlord tried to ________ the family because they were late with the rent, but a lawyer helped them stay.
items.zh: 房東因為那家人遲繳房租而試圖驅逐他們，但一位律師幫助他們留了下來。
items.sec: Housing & City Life 住宅與城市生活

items.def: a person who lives in an empty building without permission
items.s: A ________ had been living in the empty factory for months, and the police only found him when the building was sold.
items.zh: 一名違法佔住者已經在那間空工廠住了好幾個月，而警方直到大樓被賣掉時才發現他。
items.sec: Housing & City Life 住宅與城市生活

items.def: an area of very poor homes made from cheap materials
items.s: Many workers moved from the countryside to the ______ ______ on the edge of the city, because they could not afford proper homes.
items.zh: 許多工人從鄉下搬到城市邊緣的棚戶區，因為他們負擔不起像樣的住處。
items.sec: Housing & City Life 住宅與城市生活

items.def: how good and comfortable a person's life is
items.s: Moving to a smaller town improved their ______ ______ ______, because they spent less time in traffic and more time with their kids.
items.zh: 搬到較小的城鎮提升了他們的生活品質，因為他們花在塞車上的時間變少，陪孩子的時間變多。
items.sec: Housing & City Life 住宅與城市生活

items.def: pleasant and suitable for living in
items.s: Vienna is often named the most ________ city in the world, because it has clean air, good transport and plenty of parks.
items.zh: 維也納常被評為世界上最宜居的城市，因為它有乾淨的空氣、良好的交通和眾多公園。
items.sec: Housing & City Life 住宅與城市生活

items.def: the money needed to pay for basic things like food and housing
items.s: The ______ ______ ______ in big cities keeps rising, so many young people are moving to smaller towns to save money.
items.zh: 大城市的生活成本不斷上升，所以許多年輕人正搬到較小的城鎮以存錢。
items.sec: Housing & City Life 住宅與城市生活

items.def: a company that buys land and builds houses or offices on it
items.s: The ________ promised to build a park next to the new flats, but five years later the land is still empty.
items.zh: 建商承諾會在新公寓旁邊蓋一座公園，但五年後那塊地仍然是空的。
items.sec: Housing & City Life 住宅與城市生活

items.def: a report to the police or building managers about loud noise
items.s: Our neighbours made a ______ ______ about the party, so we turned the music down and apologised the next day.
items.zh: 我們的鄰居對派對提出了噪音投訴，所以我們把音樂關小聲，並在隔天道歉。
items.sec: Housing & City Life 住宅與城市生活

items.def: good enough to be allowed or agreed to
items.s: Residents said the noise from the building site was ________ during the day, but they asked the workers to stop by six o'clock.
items.zh: 居民表示工地的噪音在白天是可以接受的，但他們要求工人在六點前停工。

items.def: next to and joined to something
items.s: We booked two ________ rooms in the hotel, so the children could sleep next door while we stayed close by.
items.zh: 我們在飯店訂了兩間相鄰的房間，所以孩子們可以睡在隔壁，而我們也待在附近。

items.def: a mixture of different kinds of things
items.s: The market sells an ________ of handmade goods, so tourists can find gifts for everyone in their family.
items.zh: 這個市集販售各式各樣的手工商品，所以觀光客可以為家裡每個人找到禮物。

items.def: a line that marks the edge of an area
items.s: The river forms the ________ between the two cities, so people often argue about who should clean it.
items.zh: 這條河構成兩座城市之間的邊界，所以人們常常爭論應該由誰來清理它。

items.def: the distance from one side to the other; wide range
items.s: The new bridge is impressive because of its ________, and four lanes of cars can cross it side by side.
items.zh: 這座新橋令人印象深刻是因為它的寬度，而四線車道的汽車可以並排通過。

items.def: hard but easily broken
items.s: Old plastic pipes become ________ in the sun, so they often crack when workers try to move them.
items.zh: 老舊的塑膠管在陽光下會變得易碎，所以工人試圖搬動時它們常常裂開。

items.def: joined to each other so that each affects the others
items.s: Housing, jobs and transport are closely ________, so a city cannot solve one problem while ignoring the others.
items.zh: 住房、就業和交通彼此緊密相互連結，所以一座城市不能只解決一個問題而忽略其他問題。

items.def: touching or next to each other along one side
items.s: The park and the school are ________, so students can walk straight into the green area during their lunch break.
items.zh: 公園和學校是相連的，所以學生們午休時可以直接走進綠地。

items.def: what happens or is chosen if no other choice is made
items.s: Driving has become the ________ for many families in the suburbs, because buses come only once an hour.
items.zh: 對許多郊區家庭來說，開車已經成為預設選項，因為公車一小時才來一班。

items.def: money you pay for a service or to enter a place
items.s: The museum charges a small entrance ________, but students can visit for free on Wednesday afternoons.
items.zh: 這座博物館收取少量的入場費用，但學生在星期三下午可以免費參觀。

items.def: working together with another person or group
items.s: The city formed a ________ with local companies, and together they built a new sports centre for young people.
items.zh: 市政府和當地企業建立了合作關係，而他們一起為年輕人建造了一座新運動中心。

items.def: to agree to something without arguing, often unwillingly
items.s: At first the shop owners refused the plan, but they finally ________ when the council promised them more parking spaces.
items.zh: 起初店家們拒絕這項計畫，但當議會承諾給他們更多停車位時，他們最後勉強同意了。

items.def: happening at the right time
items.s: Thanks to the ________ warning from the weather office, people moved their scooters before the street flooded.
items.zh: 多虧了氣象局及時的警告，人們在街道淹水前就把機車移走了。

items.def: a long wide area of land
items.s: The new motorway cut through a large ________ of forest, so many animals lost their homes and environmental groups protested.
items.zh: 新高速公路穿越了一大片森林，所以許多動物失去家園，而環保團體提出抗議。

items.def: to make someone calmer by giving them what they want
items.s: To ________ angry residents, the company promised to plant trees and to stop work early every evening.
items.zh: 為了安撫憤怒的居民，該公司承諾種樹，並且每天傍晚提早收工。

items.def: very bold and willing to take risks
items.s: The architect's ________ design had a building that seemed to balance on one corner, and many people doubted it could be built.
items.zh: 那位建築師大膽的設計是一棟看似用一角保持平衡的建築，而許多人懷疑它能否蓋得出來。

items.def: showing signs that something will be successful
items.s: Many families choose an ________ day to move into a new home, and they often check the calendar with their grandparents.
items.zh: 許多家庭會挑選一個吉利的日子搬進新家，而他們常常和祖父母一起翻黃曆確認。

items.def: very obvious and done without shame
items.s: Parking in a bus lane is a ________ rule-breaking act, but some drivers still do it because fines are rarely given.
items.zh: 把車停在公車專用道上是公然的違規行為，但有些駕駛人仍然這麼做，因為很少被開罰。

items.def: successful and likely to stay strong (of an economy or market)
items.s: The property market is still ________ in the city centre, but prices in the outer towns have started to fall.
items.zh: 市中心的房地產市場依然蓬勃，但外圍城鎮的房價已經開始下跌。

items.def: full of busy, noisy activity
items.s: Dihua Street is ________ before Lunar New Year, and shoppers squeeze past each other to buy dried fruit and candy.
items.zh: 迪化街在農曆新年前熙熙攘攘，購物者擠來擠去購買果乾和糖果。

items.def: a loud, unpleasant mixture of sounds
items.s: I woke up to a ________ of car horns, drills and barking dogs, so I closed the window and put on my headphones.
items.zh: 我被汽車喇叭、電鑽和狗吠的嘈雜聲吵醒，所以我關上窗戶並戴上耳機。

items.def: changing suddenly without a clear reason
items.s: The weather in the mountains is ________, so hikers should bring a raincoat even when the morning looks sunny.
items.zh: 山上的天氣反覆無常，所以即使早上看起來晴朗，登山客也應該帶件雨衣。

items.def: in a complete mess and without order
items.s: The traffic was ________ after the power cut stopped the traffic lights, so police officers had to direct cars by hand.
items.zh: 停電使紅綠燈停擺之後交通一片混亂，所以警察只好用手指揮車輛。

items.def: many things lying around in an untidy way
items.s: There was so much ________ in the small flat that we could hardly walk, so we gave away half of our old things.
items.zh: 那間小公寓裡有太多雜亂的東西，我們幾乎無法走動，所以我們把一半的舊東西送人了。

items.def: to come together to form one group or thing
items.s: Several small villages slowly ________ into one large town as new roads and houses filled the gaps between them.
items.zh: 隨著新的道路和房屋填滿彼此之間的空隙，幾個小村莊逐漸合併成一個大城鎮。

items.def: the place where two rivers join
items.s: The old town was built at the ________ of two rivers, because boats could easily bring goods there from different areas.
items.zh: 這座古城建在兩條河的匯流處，因為船隻可以輕易地從不同地區把貨物運到那裡。

items.def: to gather together in a group
items.s: Young people ________ in the square on Friday nights, and street dancers perform while their friends film them.
items.zh: 年輕人星期五晚上會聚集在廣場上，而街舞者表演時他們的朋友會幫忙錄影。

items.def: not yet used, although it could be useful
items.s: Empty rooftops are an ________ resource in many cities, but they could be used for gardens or solar power.
items.zh: 空著的屋頂在許多城市是未被利用的資源，但它們可以用來做花園或太陽能發電。

items.def: too many to be counted
items.s: I have walked past that old building ________ times, but I never noticed the beautiful carvings above the door until today.
items.zh: 我已經走過那棟老建築無數次，但直到今天才注意到門上方美麗的雕刻。

items.def: old and in very bad condition
items.s: The ________ apartment block had broken windows and no lift, so the elderly residents could hardly leave their homes.
items.zh: 那棟破舊的公寓大樓窗戶破損又沒有電梯，所以年長的住戶幾乎無法出門。

items.def: to show clearly where an area begins and ends
items.s: The city painted yellow lines to ________ the parking area, so drivers would stop blocking the fire exit.
items.zh: 市政府畫上黃線來劃定停車區，好讓駕駛人不再擋住消防通道。

items.def: empty and falling apart because nobody uses it
items.s: The ________ warehouse by the river was turned into a market, and now it is full of food stalls and live music.
items.zh: 河邊那間廢棄的倉庫被改造成市集，而現在那裡滿是小吃攤和現場音樂。

items.def: sad, dark and without hope
items.s: The station looked ________ with its grey walls and broken lights, but after the makeover it became bright and welcoming.
items.zh: 這座車站以前有灰色牆壁和故障的燈，看起來很陰鬱，但改造後變得明亮又親切。

items.def: attractive and making you want to have or do something
items.s: The smell of fried chicken from the night market was so ________ that we stopped to buy some although we had just eaten.
items.zh: 夜市傳來的炸雞香味太誘人了，所以雖然我們剛吃過飯，還是停下來買了一些。

items.def: useful for a quick result, though perhaps not the best way
items.s: Building another road seemed ________ to the mayor, but experts warned that it would only bring more cars.
items.zh: 對市長來說，再蓋一條路似乎是權宜之計，但專家警告這只會帶來更多車輛。

items.def: new and still developing
items.s: The ________ bike-sharing company had only fifty bikes at first, but now it has thousands across the city.
items.zh: 那家剛起步的共享單車公司起初只有五十輛腳踏車，但現在全市已有數千輛。

items.def: full of problems or worry
items.s: The plan to move the old market was ________ with difficulties, because the vendors did not want to lose their customers.
items.zh: 遷移舊市場的計畫充滿困難，因為攤販們不想失去他們的顧客。

items.def: not special; the same as many others
items.s: Many new shopping malls look ________, so travellers sometimes forget which city they are in.
items.zh: 許多新購物中心看起來千篇一律，所以旅客有時會忘記自己身在哪座城市。

items.def: how steep a slope is
items.s: The road to the school has a steep ________, so students on bicycles often have to get off and push.
items.zh: 通往學校的路坡度很陡，所以騎腳踏車的學生常常得下車用推的。

items.def: fitting together well in a pleasant way
items.s: The new museum has a ________ design that matches the old houses nearby, so it does not look out of place.
items.zh: 新博物館有著與附近老房子相配的和諧設計，所以它看起來並不突兀。

items.def: a safe and peaceful place
items.s: The tea garden is a quiet ________ in the busy city, and people go there to escape the noise for an hour.
items.zh: 那座茶園是繁忙城市中一個安靜的避風港，而人們會去那裡躲開噪音一個小時。

items.def: the central or most important place for an activity
items.s: Taipei Main Station is a transport ________ where the MRT, trains and buses meet, so it is crowded all day long.
items.zh: 台北車站是捷運、火車和公車交會的交通樞紐，所以它一整天都很擁擠。

items.def: extremely peaceful and beautiful
items.cn: 田園詩般的；恬靜優美的
items.s: The village looks ________ with its rice fields and mountains, but young people leave because there are few jobs.
items.zh: 這個村莊有稻田和群山，看起來恬靜優美，但年輕人紛紛離開，因為工作機會很少。

items.def: perfectly clean and tidy
items.cn: 一塵不染的；完美無瑕的
items.s: The streets in the old Japanese town were ________, although there were hardly any rubbish bins anywhere.
items.zh: 那座日本古鎮的街道一塵不染，雖然到處幾乎都沒有垃圾桶。

items.def: seeming to be everywhere at the same time
items.s: Security cameras are ________ in modern cities, so people feel safer, but some worry about their privacy.
items.zh: 監視器在現代城市中無所不在，所以人們感覺更安全，但有些人擔心自己的隱私。

items.def: well arranged or behaving in a calm, organised way
items.s: Passengers wait in an ________ line on the MRT platform, so getting on and off the train is quick and safe.
items.zh: 乘客在捷運月台上排成有秩序的隊伍，所以上下車既快速又安全。

items.def: most important and including everything else
items.s: The ________ goal of the plan is to make the city greener, and every new project must help reach that goal.
items.zh: 這項計畫的首要目標是讓城市更綠化，而每一個新專案都必須有助於達成這個目標。

items.def: the outer edge of an area
items.s: Workers put a fence around the ________ of the building site, so nobody could walk in by accident.
items.zh: 工人們在工地的周邊架起圍籬，好讓沒有人會不小心走進去。

items.def: pretty enough to be in a painting
items.s: Jiufen is a ________ mountain town with narrow lanes and red lanterns, so it attracts thousands of visitors every weekend.
items.zh: 九份是一座有狹窄巷弄和紅燈籠、風景如畫的山城，所以每個週末都吸引數千名遊客。

items.def: lasting longer than expected or than usual
items.s: After ________ talks that lasted three years, the owners finally agreed to rebuild the old apartment block.
items.zh: 經過持續三年、曠日持久的協商後，屋主們終於同意重建那棟老舊公寓大樓。

items.def: attractive in an old-fashioned way
items.s: The ________ little bookshop has wooden shelves and an old cat, so many visitors stop there to take photos.
items.zh: 那家古色古香的小書店有木製書架和一隻老貓，所以許多遊客會在那裡停下來拍照。

items.def: to stop something such as fear, anger or protest
items.s: The mayor held a public meeting to ________ fears about the new tower, and engineers explained how it would stay safe in earthquakes.
items.zh: 市長召開公聽會以平息大家對新大樓的擔憂，而工程師解釋了它在地震中如何保持安全。

items.def: the distance from the centre of a circle to its edge; an area around a point
items.s: There are three schools within a one-kilometre ________ of our home, so the children can all walk to class.
items.zh: 我家方圓一公里的範圍內就有三所學校，所以孩子們都可以走路上學。

items.def: to refuse an offer or request in an unfriendly way
items.s: The owners ________ the developer's offer to buy their land, because they wanted to keep the family farm.
items.zh: 地主們斷然拒絕了建商買下他們土地的提議，因為他們想保留家族農場。

items.def: to clean, repair and decorate a building again
items.s: The hotel was closed for six months while workers ________ every room, and now it looks modern and bright.
items.zh: 飯店關閉了六個月，讓工人重新裝修每一間客房，而現在它看起來現代又明亮。

items.def: to seem important or meaningful to someone
items.s: The idea of a car-free street ________ with young people, so the online petition quickly got ten thousand signatures.
items.zh: 無車街道的構想在年輕人之間引起共鳴，所以網路連署很快就得到一萬個簽名。

items.def: calm and peaceful
items.s: The lake in the park is ________ early in the morning, and old people practise tai chi beside the water.
items.zh: 公園裡的湖在清晨很寧靜，而老人家在水邊打太極拳。

items.def: moving or working more slowly than usual
items.s: Sales in the old shopping area have been ________ this year, because many customers now prefer the new mall.
items.zh: 舊商圈的銷售今年一直很低迷，因為許多顧客現在偏好新的購物中心。

items.def: comfort when you are sad or worried
items.s: After moving to a big city alone, she found ________ in the small temple near her flat, where she could sit quietly.
items.zh: 獨自搬到大城市後，她在公寓附近的小廟找到了慰藉，在那裡她可以安靜地坐著。

items.def: so large or surprising that it is hard to believe
items.s: The new stadium cost a ________ amount of money, so many taxpayers asked why the city did not build more homes instead.
items.zh: 新體育館花了驚人的金額，所以許多納稅人質問市政府為什麼不改蓋更多住宅。

items.def: very clear and obvious, often unpleasantly so
items.s: There is a ________ contrast between the shiny towers downtown and the old houses nearby, so the city feels like two different worlds.
items.zh: 市中心閃亮的高樓和附近的老房子之間有著鮮明的對比，所以這座城市感覺像兩個不同的世界。

items.def: to say exactly what must be done, especially in a rule
items.s: The new law ________ that every large building must have bicycle parking, so offices are now adding bike racks.
items.zh: 新法律規定每棟大型建築都必須設有自行車停車位，所以辦公大樓現在正加裝腳踏車架。

items.def: quiet and calm
items.s: We stayed in a ________ village by the sea, and the only sounds at night were the waves and the wind.
items.zh: 我們住在海邊一個寧靜的村莊，而夜晚唯一的聲音是海浪和風聲。

items.def: ugly and unpleasant to look at
items.s: The ________ electricity wires above the old street were moved underground, and now tourists can take better photos.
items.zh: 老街上方難看的電線被移到地下，而現在觀光客可以拍出更好的照片。

items.def: not able to be continued or defended
items.cn: 站不住腳的；難以維持的
items.s: Paying half his salary in rent became ________, so my cousin moved back to his parents' home in the countryside.
items.zh: 把一半薪水拿去付房租變得難以維持，所以我表哥搬回鄉下父母的家。

items.def: to make fear or worry less strong
items.s: The engineers tried to ________ the residents' worries, and they showed that the new tunnel would not damage nearby homes.
items.zh: 工程師們努力減輕居民的憂慮，並且證明新隧道不會損害附近的房屋。

items.def: to be attractive or interesting to someone
items.s: Small cafés with plants and books ________ to young people, so many of them have opened in the old streets.
items.zh: 有植物和書本的小咖啡店吸引年輕人，所以許多這樣的店在老街上開張了。

items.def: to officially agree to a plan
items.s: The council finally ________ the plan for a new park, and the work will start after the rainy season.
items.zh: 議會終於批准了新公園的計畫，而工程將在雨季過後開始。

items.def: to help two sides who disagree reach a fair decision
items.s: A lawyer was asked to ________ between the landlord and the tenants, because they could not agree on the repairs.
items.zh: 一位律師被請來在房東和房客之間仲裁，因為他們無法就修繕問題達成共識。

items.def: to make an unpleasant feeling less strong
items.s: The company offered free parking to ________ the anger of local shop owners, but many were still unhappy.
items.zh: 這家公司提供免費停車來緩和當地店家的怒氣，但許多人仍然不滿意。

items.def: to make something wider or include more
items.s: The city plans to ________ the narrow road near the hospital, so ambulances can reach it more quickly.
items.zh: 市政府計畫拓寬醫院附近的狹窄道路，好讓救護車能更快抵達。

items.def: to support or make something stronger
items.s: The mayor used new data to ________ her argument for more bike lanes, and the council finally agreed.
items.zh: 市長用新的數據來加強她增設自行車道的論點，而議會最後同意了。

items.def: to support and fight for a cause
items.s: She has ________ public parks for many years, and thanks to her efforts, the city has planted over ten thousand trees.
items.zh: 她多年來一直倡導公共公園，而多虧她的努力，這座城市已經種了一萬多棵樹。

items.def: to make something narrower or more limited
items.s: The narrow streets ________ the flow of traffic, so buses in the old town are always slow at rush hour.
items.zh: 狹窄的街道限制了車流，所以舊城區的公車在尖峰時段總是很慢。

items.def: to break a law or rule
items.s: The new hotel ________ the height rules for the old town, so the council ordered the owners to remove the top floor.
items.zh: 新飯店違反了舊城區的高度規定，所以議會命令業主拆除頂層。

items.def: to reduce the bad effect of something
items.s: Planting trees can ________ the heat from roads and buildings, so the city is adding green spaces in every district.
items.zh: 種樹可以抵消道路和建築散發的熱，所以市政府正在每個區增設綠地。

items.def: to make a feeling or sound weaker
items.s: Heavy rain did not ________ the crowd's excitement, and thousands of people still came to see the new bridge open.
items.zh: 大雨並沒有減弱群眾的興奮之情，而仍有數千人前來觀看新橋通車。

items.def: to turn attention or criticism away
items.s: The mayor tried to ________ questions about the late subway line, but reporters kept asking him for a clear answer.
items.zh: 市長試圖轉移有關捷運線延宕的問題，但記者們不斷要他給出明確的答案。

items.def: to pass power from a central government to a local one
items.s: The government decided to ________ more power to local councils, so each city can now make its own transport plans.
items.zh: 政府決定把更多權力下放給地方議會，所以每個城市現在可以制定自己的交通計畫。

items.def: to make something weaker by adding something else
items.s: Critics say that adding too many shops will ________ the character of the historic street, and it will look like any other mall.
items.zh: 批評者說加入太多商店會削弱這條歷史街道的特色，而它會看起來和其他購物中心沒兩樣。

items.def: to set money aside for a particular purpose
items.s: The city has ________ two million dollars for new playgrounds, and the first one will open next spring.
items.zh: 市政府已經撥出兩百萬元用於新遊樂場，而第一座將在明年春天啟用。

items.def: to prevent something by acting first
items.s: The council repaired the old bridge to ________ an accident, because engineers had found dangerous cracks under it.
items.zh: 議會修繕舊橋以預先防止意外發生，因為工程師在橋下發現了危險的裂縫。

items.def: to join closely together, like threads
items.s: In the old town, homes, shops and temples are closely ________, so daily life and religion are part of the same streets.
items.zh: 在舊城區裡，住家、商店和廟宇緊密交織在一起，所以日常生活和宗教存在於同樣的街道中。

items.def: to make something smaller or less
items.s: The new train line should ________ traffic on the motorway, but it will take a few years before drivers change their habits.
items.zh: 新的鐵路線應該能減輕高速公路上的車流，但駕駛人要改變習慣還需要幾年時間。

items.def: to happen or appear as expected
items.s: The promised shopping centre never ________, so the land beside the station is still empty after ten years.
items.zh: 承諾的購物中心從未實現，所以車站旁的土地十年後仍然是空的。

items.def: to become larger or faster than something else
items.s: Demand for housing has ________ supply in the city, so prices have risen and young couples struggle to buy a home.
items.zh: 這座城市的住房需求已超過供給，所以房價上漲，年輕夫婦很難買到房子。

items.def: to give new energy and strength to something
items.cn: 使重新振作；重新注入活力
items.s: The weekend market helped ________ the quiet old street, and new cafés soon opened beside the stalls.
items.zh: 週末市集幫助這條寂靜的老街重新注入活力，而新的咖啡店很快就在攤位旁開張了。

items.def: to officially cancel a law or decision
items.s: After thousands of people protested, the council ________ its decision to cut down the old trees on the avenue.
items.zh: 在數千人抗議之後，議會撤銷了砍伐林蔭大道上老樹的決定。

items.def: to avoid something or someone on purpose
items.s: Many young families ________ the city centre because flats are small and expensive, so they move to the suburbs instead.
items.zh: 許多年輕家庭避開市中心，因為公寓又小又貴，所以他們改搬到郊區。

items.def: to make something stronger or more certain
items.s: The successful bike-sharing scheme helped ________ the city's reputation as a green leader, and other cities copied it.
items.zh: 成功的共享單車計畫幫助鞏固了這座城市作為綠色先鋒的名聲，而其他城市也紛紛仿效。

items.def: to lead a campaign or activity
items.s: A group of students ________ the campaign to save the old cinema, and they collected thousands of signatures in a week.
items.zh: 一群學生帶頭發起拯救老電影院的活動，並在一週內收集了數千個簽名。

items.def: to cross or stretch across both sides of something
items.s: The new bridge ________ the river, and it connects two districts that were once separated by a long ferry ride.
items.zh: 新橋橫跨河面，而它連接了兩個過去需要搭很久渡輪才能往來的行政區。

items.def: to divide something that is already divided into smaller parts
items.s: The landlord ________ the large flat into four tiny rooms, so he could earn more rent, but the rooms have no windows.
items.zh: 房東把大公寓再分割成四個小房間，以便賺更多房租，但那些房間都沒有窗戶。

items.def: to praise something to persuade people it is good
items.s: The developer ________ the flats as luxury homes, yet buyers soon found that the walls were thin and the pipes leaked.
items.zh: 建商把這些公寓吹捧為豪宅，然而買家很快就發現牆壁很薄、水管還會漏水。

items.def: to suddenly release a strong force
items.s: The new metro line could ________ a wave of building in the area, so land prices near the stations are already rising.
items.zh: 新捷運線可能會引發該地區的一波建設潮，所以車站附近的地價已經在上漲。

items.def: to compete strongly with others for something
items.s: Several cities are ________ to host the international design fair, because it brings visitors and attention.
items.zh: 好幾個城市正在角逐國際設計展的主辦權，因為它能帶來遊客和關注。

items.def: to officially allow someone not to pay or follow a rule
items.s: The museum ________ the entrance fee for local residents on Sundays, so many families visit at the weekend.
items.zh: 博物館在星期天免除當地居民的入場費，所以許多家庭在週末前往參觀。

items.def: attractive and exciting
items.s: The idea of living by the sea is ________, but the wind and salty air can damage homes quickly.
items.zh: 住在海邊的想法很迷人，但海風和含鹽的空氣會很快損壞房屋。

items.def: without interesting features; dull
items.s: Many of the new office towers are ________ grey boxes, so architects want to add more colour and plants to the skyline.
items.zh: 許多新辦公大樓都是平淡無奇的灰色方盒，所以建築師們想為天際線增添更多色彩和植物。

items.def: deserving praise
items.s: The city's effort to plant trees on every street is ________, although some people say it should also fix the pavements.
items.zh: 市政府在每條街上種樹的努力是值得稱讚的，雖然有些人說也應該修好人行道。

items.def: pleasant and friendly
items.s: The café has a ________ atmosphere with soft music and friendly staff, so students often stay there for hours to study.
items.zh: 那家咖啡店有輕柔音樂和友善店員，氣氛宜人，所以學生們常常在那裡待上好幾個小時讀書。

items.def: not willing to accept much change or new ideas
items.s: The town's ________ planners rejected the glass tower, because they wanted all new buildings to look traditional.
items.zh: 這個城鎮保守的規劃者否決了那棟玻璃大樓，因為他們希望所有新建築看起來都很傳統。

items.def: thinking about other people's feelings and needs
items.s: Our ________ neighbours always keep their music low after ten o'clock, so the whole building can sleep peacefully.
items.zh: 我們體貼的鄰居在十點後總是把音樂調小聲，所以整棟大樓都能安穩入睡。

items.def: full of people and ideas from many different countries
items.s: Singapore is a ________ city where you can hear many languages on the street, and you can eat food from all over the world.
items.zh: 新加坡是一座國際化的城市，你在街上能聽到許多種語言，而且能吃到來自世界各地的食物。

items.def: good enough; of an acceptable standard
items.s: Everyone deserves a ________ home with clean water and safe wiring, but many old buildings still lack these basics.
items.zh: 每個人都應該擁有一個有乾淨用水和安全線路的像樣住處，但許多老建築仍然缺乏這些基本條件。

items.def: careful not to attract attention
items.s: The solar panels are ________ and hidden behind the roof edge, so the historic house still looks the same from the street.
items.zh: 太陽能板很低調，藏在屋頂邊緣後面，所以這棟歷史建築從街上看起來仍然一樣。

items.def: dull, grey and boring
items.s: The ________ concrete walls of the underpass were painted with bright murals, and now people actually enjoy walking through it.
items.zh: 地下道灰暗單調的水泥牆被畫上了明亮的壁畫，而現在人們真的很喜歡走過那裡。

items.def: graceful and attractive in style
items.s: The old bank has an ________ marble entrance, so couples often go there to take their wedding photos.
items.zh: 那間老銀行有一個優雅的大理石入口，所以新人常常到那裡拍婚紗照。

items.def: too big or ambitious to be practical
items.s: The mayor's ________ plan for a floating city was never built, because it would have cost more than the entire city budget.
items.zh: 市長那個建造漂浮城市的浮誇計畫從未實現，因為它的花費會超過整個城市的預算。

items.def: not exciting or impressive
items.cn: 平淡無奇的；缺乏活力的
items.s: The new shopping street had a ________ opening, and fewer visitors came than the organisers had hoped.
items.zh: 這條新購物街的開幕平淡無奇，而來的遊客比主辦單位期望的還少。

items.def: having existed for a long time
items.cn: 長期存在的；由來已久的
items.s: Traffic jams are a ________ problem in this district, but the new metro line may finally solve them.
items.zh: 塞車是這個區長期存在的問題，但新捷運線或許終於能解決它。

items.def: covered with healthy green plants
items.s: The rooftop garden is ________ with ferns and vines, so it feels like a small forest above the busy street.
items.zh: 那座屋頂花園長滿了茂盛的蕨類和藤蔓，所以感覺像是繁忙街道上方的一座小森林。

items.def: including people of many different cultures
items.s: Our neighbourhood is very ________, and the summer festival includes food and music from Vietnam, Indonesia and the Philippines.
items.zh: 我們的社區非常多元文化，而夏季節慶包含來自越南、印尼和菲律賓的美食和音樂。

items.def: very ordinary, with no interesting features
items.s: The restaurant is inside a ________ grey building, but it serves the best beef noodles in the city, so there is always a queue.
items.zh: 那家餐廳位在一棟毫無特色的灰色建築裡，但它賣的是全市最好吃的牛肉麵，所以總是大排長龍。

items.def: costing more than it is worth
items.s: Flats near the new station are ________, so many buyers are waiting for prices to fall before they decide.
items.zh: 新車站附近的公寓定價過高，所以許多買家在決定前正等著房價下跌。

items.def: large and beautiful like a palace
items.s: The businessman lives in a ________ house with a pool and a garden, while his workers share small rooms in the city.
items.zh: 那位商人住在一棟有游泳池和花園的宮殿般的豪宅裡，而他的員工們卻在城裡合住小房間。

items.def: showing a wide view of a whole area
items.s: The tower's top floor offers a ________ view of the city, and on clear days visitors can see the mountains and the sea.
items.zh: 大樓頂層提供城市的全景視野，而在晴朗的日子遊客可以看到群山和大海。

items.def: badly built and likely to fall down
items.s: The fishermen once lived in ________ wooden huts by the shore, but the government replaced them with safer concrete homes.
items.zh: 漁民們曾經住在海邊搖搖欲墜的木屋裡，但政府用更安全的水泥房屋取代了它們。

items.def: in bad condition because nobody has looked after it
items.s: The ________ shopping centre was almost empty, so the owners decided to turn it into flats and a library.
items.zh: 那座年久失修的購物中心幾乎空無一人，所以業主決定把它改建成公寓和圖書館。

items.def: simple and typical of the countryside
items.s: The guesthouse has a ________ style with stone walls and wooden beams, so guests feel far away from city life.
items.zh: 那間民宿有石牆和木樑的鄉村風格，所以客人感覺遠離了城市生活。

items.def: having beautiful natural views
items.s: We took the ________ route along the coast, and although it took longer, the ocean views were worth it.
items.zh: 我們走了沿著海岸、風景優美的路線，雖然花了更多時間，但海景很值得。

items.def: quiet and far from other people
items.s: The writer moved to a ________ cabin in the hills, because she needed peace and quiet to finish her book.
items.zh: 那位作家搬到山上一間僻靜的小屋，因為她需要安靜來完成她的書。

items.def: having everything needed inside, without sharing with others
items.s: Each ________ unit has its own kitchen and bathroom, so students do not have to share with strangers.
items.zh: 每個設備齊全的獨立單位都有自己的廚房和浴室，所以學生們不必和陌生人共用。

items.def: extremely impressive and exciting to see
items.s: The fireworks over Taipei 101 were ________ on New Year's Eve, and millions of people watched them on TV.
items.zh: 跨年夜台北101上空的煙火非常壯觀，而數百萬人在電視上觀看。

items.def: without life, warmth or character
items.cn: 缺乏生氣的；了無生趣的
items.s: The new business park feels ________ at night, because there are no homes, shops or people after the offices close.
items.zh: 新的商業園區晚上感覺了無生氣，因為辦公室下班後那裡沒有住家、商店或人潮。

items.def: below the normal or acceptable level
items.s: Some cheap flats were built with ________ materials, so their walls cracked after only a few years.
items.zh: 有些廉價公寓是用不合標準的材料蓋的，所以它們的牆只過幾年就裂開了。

items.def: attractive and showing good judgement about style
items.s: The hotel has a ________ lobby with simple wooden furniture, and guests say it feels calm and welcoming.
items.zh: 那家飯店有擺著簡單木製家具的雅致大廳，而客人們說那裡感覺平靜又親切。

items.def: expensive and designed for rich customers
items.s: The old fish market became an ________ shopping area, but local fishermen say they can no longer afford to eat there.
items.zh: 舊魚市場變成了高檔的購物區，但當地漁民說他們再也吃不起那裡的東西了。

items.def: having plenty of money
items.s: ________ families often live near the best schools, so children from poorer areas may have fewer chances.
items.zh: 富裕的家庭往往住在最好的學校附近，所以來自較貧窮地區的孩子可能機會較少。

items.def: the feeling or mood of a place
items.s: The tea house has a peaceful ________ with soft lights and old music, so it is a perfect place for a quiet chat.
items.zh: 那間茶館有柔和燈光和老音樂，氛圍寧靜，所以是安靜聊天的完美地點。

items.def: the scenery behind something
items.s: The mountains provide a stunning ________ to the city, and photographers often climb nearby hills at sunset.
items.zh: 群山為這座城市提供了令人驚豔的背景，而攝影師們常常在日落時爬上附近的山丘。

items.def: a large amount of work waiting to be done
items.cn: 積壓的工作；待辦的大量事項
items.s: The city office has a huge ________ of building applications, so people may wait a year for planning permission.
items.zh: 市政府辦公室有大量積壓的建築申請案，所以人們可能要等一年才能拿到建築許可。

items.def: something that spoils or damages a place
items.s: Empty shops and broken windows are a ________ on the old high street, so the council wants to attract new businesses.
items.zh: 空店面和破窗戶是這條老商店街的禍害，所以議會想吸引新的商家進駐。

items.def: all the customers of a shop or business
items.s: The café's ________ is mostly students and office workers, so it opens early and offers cheap breakfast sets.
items.zh: 這家咖啡店的客群主要是學生和上班族，所以它很早開門並提供便宜的早餐組合。

items.def: a group of people or organisations working together
items.s: A ________ of residents and environmental groups fought the new highway, and they finally persuaded the city to build a park instead.
items.zh: 一個由居民和環保團體組成的聯盟對抗新高速公路，而他們最後說服市政府改建一座公園。

items.def: a group of people of a similar age or in the same situation
items.s: This ________ of young workers is renting for longer than their parents did, because buying a flat has become so expensive.
items.zh: 這一群年輕上班族租屋的時間比他們的父母更長，因為買公寓已經變得非常昂貴。

items.def: the people who vote for a particular politician in an area
items.s: The politician promised to improve buses in her ________, because many voters there do not own cars.
items.zh: 那位政治人物承諾改善她選區的公車服務，因為那裡許多選民沒有汽車。

items.def: a group that includes many different types of people
items.cn: 橫斷面；具代表性的一群人
items.s: The survey asked a ________ of residents about the new park, so the results included young, old, rich and poor people.
items.zh: 這項調查訪問了具代表性的一群居民對新公園的看法，所以結果涵蓋了老少貧富各類人士。

items.def: an area where a particular group of people lives
items.cn: 飛地；（特定族群的）聚居地
items.s: The street became a small Indonesian ________, and you can now buy spices and newspapers from home in several shops.
items.zh: 那條街成了一個小小的印尼人聚居地，而現在你可以在幾家商店買到家鄉的香料和報紙。

items.def: the central point of an activity or event
items.s: The old district has become the ________ of the city's art scene, so galleries and studios have opened in empty warehouses.
items.zh: 老城區已成為這座城市藝術圈的中心，所以畫廊和工作室紛紛在空倉庫裡開張。

items.def: a person or thing that is always present in a place
items.cn: 固定存在的人或事物；常客
items.s: The old noodle stand has been a ________ on this corner for fifty years, so locals were sad when it finally closed.
items.zh: 那個老麵攤五十年來一直固定在這個街角，所以當它最終歇業時，當地人都很難過。

items.def: the number of people who visit a shop or area
items.s: ________ in the shopping street rose after it was pedestrianised, and many shops reported higher sales.
items.zh: 那條購物街改為行人徒步區後人流量增加，而許多商店的銷售額也提高了。

items.def: the leading position in an area of activity
items.s: Copenhagen is at the ________ of green city design, so planners from around the world visit to learn from it.
items.zh: 哥本哈根處於綠色城市設計的最前沿，所以世界各地的規劃者都去那裡取經。

items.def: a place through which you enter a larger area
items.s: Keelung is the ________ to northern Taiwan for many cruise passengers, so the harbour area has been made more attractive.
items.zh: 對許多郵輪旅客來說，基隆是進入北台灣的門戶，所以港區已經被打造得更有吸引力。

items.def: a lack of desire to change or act
items.s: Because of political ________, the plan to fix the old bridge was delayed for years, and drivers grew angry.
items.zh: 由於政治上的惰性，修繕舊橋的計畫拖延了好幾年，而駕駛人越來越憤怒。

items.def: a particular area or neighbourhood
items.s: The new hospital will serve the whole ________, so people will no longer need to travel to the city for treatment.
items.zh: 新醫院將服務整個地區，所以人們不再需要到市區就醫。

items.def: the most important part that everything depends on
items.s: Tourism is the ________ of the town's economy, so the council spends a lot of money keeping the old streets beautiful.
items.zh: 觀光業是這個城鎮經濟的支柱，所以議會花很多錢維護老街的美觀。

items.def: changes that make something look much better
items.s: The old train station got a complete ________, and now it has a café, a bookshop and a small art gallery.
items.zh: 舊火車站經過了徹底的改造，而現在那裡有一間咖啡店、一間書店和一間小藝廊。

items.def: a confusing network of paths or streets
items.s: The old town is a ________ of narrow lanes, so it is easy to get lost, but you may discover hidden temples.
items.zh: 老城區是由狹窄巷弄組成的迷宮，所以很容易迷路，但你可能會發現隱藏的廟宇。

items.def: a central connection point between several things
items.s: The station is the ________ of the city's bus, train and bike networks, so it is the busiest place in town.
items.zh: 這座車站是城市公車、火車和自行車網絡的連結核心，所以它是城裡最繁忙的地方。

items.def: a person or thing very different from the rest of the group
items.s: Most cities in the survey had rising rents, but this town was an ________, because its prices actually fell.
items.zh: 調查中大多數城市的房租都在上漲，但這個城鎮是個異數，因為它的房價反而下跌了。

items.def: something believed to solve all problems
items.s: Building more roads is not a ________ for traffic, because new roads often attract even more cars.
items.zh: 多蓋道路並不是解決交通問題的萬靈丹，因為新道路往往會吸引更多車輛。

items.def: something made of many different parts that do not match
items.s: From the plane, the farmland looked like a ________ of green and yellow fields, while the city was a grey block.
items.zh: 從飛機上看，農地像是綠色和黃色田地的拼布，而城市則是一塊灰色的區塊。

items.def: an area of a town used for a special purpose, often closed to cars
items.s: The shopping ________ is closed to traffic, so parents can let their children walk around freely.
items.zh: 這個購物徒步區禁止車輛通行，所以家長可以讓孩子自由地四處走動。

items.def: a rich mixture of different things
items.s: The city is a ________ of old temples, modern towers and busy markets, so every street has something new to see.
items.zh: 這座城市是古老廟宇、現代高樓和熱鬧市場交織而成的多彩畫面，所以每條街都有新鮮事可看。

items.def: an empty area of land that is not used or cared for
items.s: The area behind the factory was a ________ for years, but volunteers cleaned it up and turned it into a garden.
items.zh: 工廠後面那塊地多年來是一片荒地，但志工們把它清理乾淨並改造成一座花園。

items.def: in a suitable or fitting way
items.s: The street is ________ named Bamboo Lane, because tall bamboo grows along both sides of it.
items.zh: 這條街被貼切地命名為「竹巷」，因為兩旁長滿了高大的竹子。

items.def: in general, without considering details
items.s: Residents ________ support the new bike lanes, although some shop owners worry about losing parking spaces.
items.zh: 居民們大致上支持新的自行車道，雖然有些店家擔心會失去停車位。

items.def: growing all the time
items.s: The city struggles to provide homes for its ________ population, so it is building new towns along the train lines.
items.zh: 這座城市難以為其不斷增加的人口提供住所，所以它正沿著鐵路線興建新市鎮。

items.def: better or greater than anything else
items.s: The tower offers ________ views of the harbour, so tickets for the observation deck sell out every weekend.
items.zh: 這座塔提供無與倫比的港口景觀，所以觀景台的門票每個週末都賣光。

items.def: a large crowd of people
items.s: A ________ of shoppers filled the street on the first day of the sale, and the police had to control the crowd.
items.zh: 特賣第一天一大群購物者擠滿了街道，而警察不得不出面控制人潮。

items.def: the place where someone lives (formal)
items.s: Her tiny flat is a humble ________, but she has filled it with plants and books, so it feels warm and cosy.
items.zh: 她的小公寓是一個簡樸的住所，但她在裡面擺滿了植物和書，所以感覺溫暖又舒適。

items.def: something very helpful
items.s: The new metro line is a ________ for students in the suburbs, because their journey to school is now half as long.
items.zh: 新捷運線對郊區的學生來說是一大福音，因為他們的上學路程現在縮短了一半。

items.def: quick and active
items.s: Business at the night market was ________ during the holiday, so the vendors stayed open until two in the morning.
items.zh: 假期間夜市的生意很興旺，所以攤販們一直營業到凌晨兩點。

items.def: a warning that something is true only in certain conditions
items.s: The plan sounds great, but there is one ________: it only works if enough people stop driving to work.
items.zh: 這個計畫聽起來很棒，但有一個但書：只有足夠多的人不再開車上班時它才行得通。

items.def: a loud demand or complaint from many people
items.s: There has been a growing ________ for cheaper housing, so the government promised to build fifty thousand new homes.
items.zh: 要求更便宜住宅的呼聲越來越大，所以政府承諾興建五萬戶新住宅。

items.def: power and influence
items.s: Large developers have a lot of political ________, so small community groups often find it hard to stop their projects.
items.zh: 大型建商有很大的政治影響力，所以小型社區團體常常很難阻止他們的開發案。

items.def: wanted very much by many people
items.cn: 令人垂涎的；眾所渴望的
items.s: A flat with a river view is a ________ prize in this city, so prices for those homes are extremely high.
items.zh: 在這座城市裡，有河景的公寓是令人垂涎的寶物，所以那些房子的價格極高。

items.def: the most important point of a problem
items.s: The ________ of the problem is that there are not enough homes, so building more is the only real solution.
items.zh: 問題的癥結在於住房不足，所以興建更多住宅才是唯一真正的解決辦法。

items.def: the person or thing that causes a problem
items.s: Experts say that air conditioners are the main ________ behind the city's summer power cuts, so they ask people to save energy.
items.zh: 專家表示冷氣是造成城市夏季停電的主要元凶，所以他們呼籲大家節約用電。

items.def: a complete and embarrassing failure
items.s: The new bus system was a ________ on its first day, because the apps crashed and passengers waited for hours.
items.zh: 新公車系統在第一天就徹底失敗，因為應用程式當機，乘客等了好幾個小時。

items.def: a very large amount of rain or water; a huge amount of something
items.cn: 豪雨；洪水般大量湧來的事物
items.s: The council received a ________ of complaints about the new parking fees, so it agreed to review them.
items.zh: 議會收到了排山倒海般的投訴，反對新的停車費，所以同意重新檢討。

items.def: a longer route taken to avoid a problem
items.s: The main road was closed for repairs, so the bus took a ________ through the back streets and we arrived late.
items.zh: 主要道路因施工封閉，所以公車繞道走後巷，而我們遲到了。
