items.def: spending or costing far too much money
items.s: Critics called the golden bus shelters ________, and they said the money should have been spent on more buses.
items.zh: 批評者稱那些金色公車候車亭太奢侈，並說這筆錢應該用來增加公車班次。

items.def: to show something off proudly to get attention
items.s: Some rich residents ________ their sports cars on the narrow streets, but neighbours complain about the noise.
items.zh: 一些有錢的居民在狹窄的街道上炫耀他們的跑車，但鄰居們抱怨噪音很大。

items.def: lasting only a very short time
items.s: We had a ________ view of the city lights from the train window before we entered the tunnel.
items.zh: 在進入隧道之前，我們從火車窗戶短暫地瞥見了城市燈火。

items.def: weak and easily broken
items.s: The ________ roof blew away in the typhoon, so the family had to stay with relatives until it was repaired.
items.zh: 那個不牢固的屋頂在颱風中被吹走了，所以這家人只好暫住親戚家直到修好為止。

items.def: fast, busy and slightly out of control
items.s: The ________ pace of city life makes some people tired, so they escape to the countryside at the weekend.
items.zh: 城市生活忙亂的步調讓一些人疲憊，所以他們週末會逃到鄉下去。

items.def: very obvious, usually about a mistake
items.s: There was a ________ mistake in the map, because it showed a bridge that had been knocked down years ago.
items.zh: 那張地圖上有一個明顯的錯誤，因為它標示了一座多年前就已拆除的橋。

items.def: very difficult and tiring
items.s: Construction workers face ________ hours in the summer heat, so the city now requires longer rest breaks at noon.
items.zh: 建築工人在夏日酷熱中面臨艱辛的工時，所以市政府現在規定中午要有更長的休息時間。

items.def: a situation where no progress is possible
items.s: Talks between the owners and the developer reached an ________, so the old building has stood empty for five years.
items.zh: 屋主和建商之間的協商陷入僵局，所以那棟老建築已經空置了五年。

items.def: well known for something bad
items.s: The road is ________ for its traffic jams, so locals avoid it during rush hour and take the train instead.
items.zh: 這條路以塞車惡名昭彰，所以當地人在尖峰時段會避開它，改搭火車。

items.def: harmful in a slow way that is hard to notice
items.s: Noise pollution is ________, because people slowly get used to it while it damages their sleep and health.
items.zh: 噪音污染是暗中為害的，因為人們會慢慢習慣它，而它同時在損害他們的睡眠和健康。

items.def: shocking or unpleasant because it does not fit
items.s: The bright pink hotel looks ________ next to the old temple, and many residents want the colour changed.
items.zh: 那家亮粉紅色的飯店在古廟旁邊看起來很突兀，而許多居民希望它換個顏色。

items.def: freedom to decide or act as you want
items.s: The rules give architects some ________ in the design, but every building must still include a green roof.
items.zh: 這些規定在設計上給了建築師一些迴旋餘地，但每棟建築仍必須設置綠屋頂。

items.def: a general feeling that something is wrong or weak
items.cn: 萎靡不振；（社會、經濟的）低迷
items.s: The town suffered an economic ________ after the factory closed, and many young people left to find work.
items.zh: 工廠關閉後這個小鎮陷入經濟低迷，而許多年輕人離開去找工作。

items.def: boring, low-paid and needing little skill
items.s: Many new arrivals in the city start with ________ jobs, but some later open their own shops and restaurants.
items.zh: 許多剛來到城市的人從低薪粗活的工作做起，但有些人後來開了自己的商店和餐廳。

items.def: happening very fast and with great success
items.cn: 迅速的；如流星般竄起的
items.s: The town's ________ growth began when the science park opened, and its population doubled in ten years.
items.zh: 這個小鎮迅速的成長始於科學園區啟用，而它的人口在十年內翻了一倍。

items.def: something annoying that causes problems
items.s: Loud motorbikes are a real ________ late at night, so the police have started to give fines to noisy riders.
items.zh: 深夜吵鬧的重型機車真的很惱人，所以警方已經開始對製造噪音的騎士開罰。

items.def: suggesting that something bad will happen
items.s: Dark clouds gathered over the city in the afternoon, and the ________ sky warned us that a storm was coming.
items.zh: 下午烏雲聚集在城市上空，而不祥的天空警告我們暴風雨即將來臨。

items.def: a strong public protest
items.s: The plan to cut down the old trees caused a public ________, so the city decided to move the road instead.
items.zh: 砍伐老樹的計畫引起公眾的強烈抗議，所以市政府決定改移道路。

items.def: very small and not worth much
items.cn: 微不足道的；少得可憐的
items.s: The tenants were offered a ________ sum to move out, so most of them refused and hired a lawyer.
items.zh: 房客們只被提供少得可憐的搬遷費，所以大多數人拒絕並請了律師。

items.def: an extra benefit you get from a job or situation
items.s: One ________ of living downtown is that you can walk to concerts, but the downside is the high rent.
items.zh: 住在市中心的一個好處是可以走路去聽音樂會，但缺點是房租很高。

items.def: a false reason given to hide the real one
items.s: The landlord used repairs as a ________ to remove the tenants, but he really wanted to rent the flat for more money.
items.zh: 房東以修繕為藉口趕走房客，但他真正想要的是把公寓以更高價出租。

items.def: a situation where it is hard to decide what to do
items.s: The family was in a ________: they could buy a big house far away or rent a small flat near work.
items.zh: 這家人陷入兩難：他們可以在遠處買一棟大房子，或者在工作地點附近租一間小公寓。

items.def: to damage something very badly
items.s: Floods ________ the low-lying parts of the city last summer, so engineers are now building higher river walls.
items.zh: 去年夏天洪水嚴重破壞了這座城市的低窪地區，所以工程師現在正在興建更高的河堤。

items.def: a possible way to get help in a difficult situation
items.s: Tenants who are treated unfairly have little ________ in some countries, because the laws mainly protect landlords.
items.zh: 在某些國家，受到不公平對待的房客幾乎沒有求助的途徑，因為法律主要保護房東。

items.def: a delay or cancellation of something bad
items.s: The old cinema got a ________ when a rich fan offered to pay its rent, so it will stay open for another year.
items.zh: 當一位富有的影迷提議替它付租金時，這間老電影院獲得了暫緩關閉的機會，所以它將再營業一年。

items.def: very common, usually about something bad
items.s: Illegal parking is ________ in the old district, so the police are using cameras to catch drivers.
items.zh: 違規停車在舊城區很普遍，所以警方正在用攝影機抓違規駕駛。

items.def: very little; not enough
items.s: The developer paid ________ attention to the residents' concerns, and as a result, the project faced months of protests.
items.zh: 建商對居民的擔憂幾乎不重視，結果這項計畫遭遇了好幾個月的抗議。

items.def: a city with many big grey buildings and few green areas
items.s: After living in the ______ ______ for ten years, my uncle moved to a farm, because he missed trees and fresh air.
items.zh: 在水泥叢林裡住了十年後，我叔叔搬到一座農場，因為他想念樹木和新鮮空氣。

items.def: very near to where you live
items.s: We have a great night market right ______ ______ ______, so we often go there for dinner after work.
items.zh: 我們家門口就有一個很棒的夜市，所以我們下班後常去那裡吃晚餐。

items.def: close enough to walk to
items.s: Our new flat is ______ ______ ______ ______ the MRT station, so I no longer need to ride my scooter to work.
items.zh: 我們的新公寓離捷運站走路就到，所以我不再需要騎機車去上班。

items.def: the noise and busy activity of a crowded place
items.s: Some people love the ______ ______ ______ of Taipei, but my grandparents prefer the quiet life in their village.
items.zh: 有些人喜歡台北的熙來攘往，但我的祖父母比較喜歡他們村子裡的寧靜生活。

items.def: real buildings, especially shops, rather than online businesses
items.s: Many shops are closing their ______ ______ ______ stores, because more customers now buy clothes online.
items.zh: 許多商店正在關閉它們的實體店面，因為現在有更多顧客在網路上買衣服。

items.def: far away from places that many people visit
items.s: The little café is ______ ______ ______ ______, but people who find it say it serves the best coffee in town.
items.zh: 那家小咖啡店位置偏僻，但找到它的人都說那裡的咖啡是鎮上最好喝的。

items.def: in the centre of a place
items.s: The hotel is ______ ______ ______ ______ the old town, so guests can walk to the temples and markets in minutes.
items.zh: 這家飯店位於舊城區的中心，所以客人幾分鐘內就能走到廟宇和市場。

items.def: a place with many buildings and few open spaces
items.s: Drivers must slow down in a ______ ______, because children and old people may suddenly cross the road.
items.zh: 駕駛人在房屋密集區必須減速，因為小孩和老人可能會突然穿越馬路。

items.def: to destroy a building completely (tear / tore / torn)
items.s: The company wanted to ______ ______ the old theatre, but local people protested, so it was saved and repaired.
items.zh: 那家公司想拆除老劇院，但當地人提出抗議，所以它被保留並修復了。

items.def: to be removed so that something new can replace it
items.s: The old houses were knocked down to ______ ______ ______ a new park, and now children play where the buildings once stood.
items.zh: 那些老房子被拆除以騰出空間給一座新公園，而現在孩子們在原本建築物所在的地方玩耍。

items.def: something new and different that is very welcome
items.cn: 令人耳目一新的人或事物
items.s: The young architect's colourful design was ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, because most buildings in the town were plain and grey.
items.zh: 那位年輕建築師色彩繽紛的設計令人耳目一新，因為這個城鎮大部分的建築都樸素又灰暗。

items.def: with vehicles so close together that they can hardly move
items.cn: 車輛一輛接一輛的；大塞車的
items.s: The traffic was ________ on the way to the beach, so we turned around and went to a park nearer home.
items.zh: 往海邊的路上車子一輛接一輛大塞車，所以我們掉頭去了離家較近的公園。
items.t: 車子一輛接一輛大塞車

items.def: an area of grass, trees or plants in a town
items.s: Every child needs some ______ ______ to run and play in, so the city is turning car parks into small parks.
items.zh: 每個孩子都需要一些可以奔跑玩耍的綠地，所以市政府正把停車場改建成小公園。

items.def: said by people who support a project but not near their home (NIMBY)
items.cn: 別蓋在我家後院（鄰避心態）
items.s: Everyone agrees the city needs a new rubbish plant, but residents keep saying "______ ______ ______ ______ ______" whenever a site is chosen.
items.zh: 每個人都同意城市需要新的垃圾處理廠，但每當選定地點時，居民們總是說「別蓋在我家後院」。

items.def: to buy your first home (get / got / got)
items.cn: 買下第一間房子；踏入房市
items.s: Young couples find it hard to ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, because prices have risen much faster than salaries.
items.zh: 年輕夫婦發現很難買下第一間房子，因為房價上漲的速度遠比薪水快。

items.def: to let someone use your property in return for money
items.s: My aunt decided to ______ ______ her spare room to a university student, and the extra money helps pay her bills.
items.zh: 我阿姨決定把她的空房間出租給一位大學生，而這筆額外的收入幫她支付帳單。

items.def: very different from
items.s: Today's busy harbour is ______ ______ ______ ______ the small fishing village it was a hundred years ago, but some old houses remain.
items.zh: 今天繁忙的港口與一百年前那個小漁村大不相同，但仍有一些老房子保留了下來。

items.def: to live without public electricity or water supplies
items.cn: 過著不依賴公共電網的生活
items.s: The family decided to ______ ______ ______ ______ in the mountains, so they use solar panels and collect rainwater.
items.zh: 這家人決定在山上過著不依賴公共電網的生活，所以他們使用太陽能板並收集雨水。
items.t: 過著不依賴公共電網的生活

items.def: the feeling of being accepted as part of a group or place
items.s: Joining the community garden gave the new residents ______ ______ ______ ______, and they quickly made friends with their neighbours.
items.zh: 加入社區花園讓新住戶有了歸屬感，而且他們很快就和鄰居成為朋友。

items.def: unable to move because the roads are full of vehicles
items.s: I was ______ ______ ______ for an hour this morning, so I missed the first part of the meeting.
items.zh: 我今天早上塞在車陣中一個小時，所以錯過了會議的第一部分。

11.zh: 糧食生產、農業與食品科技

items.def: suitable for growing crops
items.s: Only a small part of Taiwan's land is ________ because most of the island is covered by mountains, so farmers must use every flat field carefully.
items.zh: 台灣只有一小部分土地是可耕種的，因為島上大部分被山脈覆蓋，所以農民必須小心利用每一塊平地。

items.def: a grain plant used to make flour and bread
items.s: Most of the bread we eat is made from ________, but Taiwan imports almost all of it because the climate is too wet to grow it well.
items.zh: 我們吃的大部分麵包是用小麥做的，但台灣幾乎全部仰賴進口，因為氣候太潮濕而不容易種植。

items.def: a flooded field where rice is grown
items.s: When we took the train through Yilan in spring, every ________ shone like a mirror, and my little brother kept taking photos of them.
items.zh: 春天我們搭火車經過宜蘭時，每一片稻田都像鏡子一樣閃閃發亮，我弟弟一直不停地拍照。

items.def: a tall plant with yellow seeds; corn
items.s: Much of the ________ grown in the United States is fed to animals, while only a small amount is eaten directly by people.
items.zh: 美國種植的大部分玉米被拿來餵動物，而只有一小部分是直接供人食用。

items.def: a grain used for food, animal feed and making drinks
items.s: My grandmother often makes a warm ________ tea in winter because she believes it is good for digestion, and the whole kitchen smells wonderful.
items.zh: 我奶奶冬天常煮熱熱的大麥茶，因為她相信這對消化有好處，而且整個廚房都很香。

items.def: a bean used to make tofu, soy milk and oil
items.s: Tofu and soy milk both come from the ________, so it is an important source of protein for many vegetarians in Asia.
items.zh: 豆腐和豆漿都來自黃豆，所以它是亞洲許多素食者重要的蛋白質來源。

items.def: a crop grown to sell rather than to eat at home
items.s: Coffee is a popular ________ in the mountains of Yunlin, and many young farmers have returned home because it brings a good income.
items.zh: 咖啡是雲林山區很受歡迎的經濟作物，而且許多年輕農民因為它能帶來不錯的收入而返鄉。

items.def: growing different crops in a field in different years
items.s: The farmer uses ________ every year, so he plants beans after corn because the beans put goodness back into the soil.
items.zh: 這位農夫每年都採用輪作，所以他在玉米之後種豆類，因為豆類能讓土壤恢復養分。

items.def: growing only one type of crop over a large area
items.s: Huge areas of ________ look neat from the air, but one disease can destroy the whole farm because every plant is the same.
items.zh: 大面積的單一作物栽培從空中看起來很整齊，但一種病害就能摧毀整片農場，因為每株植物都一樣。

items.def: a piece of land where fruit trees are grown
items.s: We visited a strawberry farm and an apple ________ in Taichung, and the owner let us pick and eat fruit straight from the trees.
items.zh: 我們參觀了台中的草莓園和蘋果果園，而且園主讓我們直接從樹上摘水果來吃。

items.def: a farm where grapes are grown
items.s: The family has run the ________ for three generations, and they still pick the grapes by hand because machines might damage them.
items.zh: 這個家族經營這座葡萄園已經三代了，而且他們仍然用手摘葡萄，因為機器可能會損傷葡萄。

items.def: a glass building where plants are grown in warm conditions
items.s: Tomatoes grow well in the ________ even in winter, because the glass keeps the heat in and protects the plants from heavy rain.
items.zh: 即使在冬天，番茄在溫室裡也長得很好，因為玻璃能保住熱度並保護植物不受大雨侵襲。

items.def: a very young plant grown from a seed
items.s: We planted each ________ in a small pot on the balcony, and after three weeks they were strong enough to move into the garden.
items.zh: 我們把每一株幼苗種在陽台的小盆子裡，三個星期後它們就長得夠壯，可以移植到花園了。

items.def: (of a seed) to start to grow
items.s: The beans will ________ in about five days if you keep the cotton wet, but they will fail if the room is too cold.
items.zh: 如果你讓棉花保持濕潤，豆子大約五天就會發芽，但如果房間太冷，它們就長不出來。

items.def: to become ready to eat
items.s: Bananas ________ faster in a paper bag, so my mother puts the green ones in a bag and waits a couple of days.
items.zh: 香蕉放在紙袋裡會更快成熟，所以我媽媽把綠色的香蕉放進袋子裡，再等個兩三天。

items.def: a wild plant growing where it is not wanted
items.s: Every Saturday my grandfather pulls out the ________ in his vegetable garden, because they steal water and sunlight from his cabbages.
items.zh: 每個星期六我爺爺都會拔掉菜園裡的雜草，因為它們會搶走高麗菜的水分和陽光。

items.def: a chemical used to kill insects
items.s: The farmer stopped spraying ________ on his fruit trees, and he now uses natural methods because he wants to protect the bees.
items.zh: 這位農夫不再對果樹噴灑殺蟲劑，現在改用天然的方法，因為他想保護蜜蜂。

items.def: a chemical used to kill unwanted plants
items.s: Some farmers spray ________ to kill weeds quickly, but scientists worry that the chemicals can enter rivers and harm fish.
items.zh: 有些農民噴灑除草劑來快速除草，但科學家擔心這些化學物質會流入河川並傷害魚類。

items.def: moving pollen between flowers so that fruit can grow
items.s: Bees are essential for the ________ of many fruit trees, so farmers often rent hives when their orchards are in flower.
items.zh: 蜜蜂對許多果樹的授粉至關重要，所以農民常在果園開花時租用蜂箱。

items.def: an unusually large harvest
items.s: The weather was perfect this year, and the farmers enjoyed a ________ of mangoes, but prices fell because there was so much fruit.
items.zh: 今年天氣非常好，農民的芒果迎來大豐收，但因為水果太多，價格反而下跌了。

items.def: a large farm growing one crop such as tea or rubber
items.s: We visited a tea ________ in Nantou, and the workers showed us how they pick only the youngest leaves by hand.
items.zh: 我們參觀了南投的一座茶葉種植園，而且工人示範他們如何只用手摘下最嫩的葉子。

items.def: a farmer who owns or rents a small piece of land
items.s: Most rice in Taiwan is grown by a ________ with only a few fields, so these farmers often work together to buy machines.
items.zh: 台灣大部分的稻米是由只有幾塊田的小農種植的，所以這些農民常合作購買機器。

items.def: a scientist who studies soil and crops
items.s: An ________ visited the village to test the soil, and she advised the farmers to plant beans because the land lacked nitrogen.
items.zh: 一位農藝學家來到村裡檢測土壤，她建議農民種豆類，因為土地缺乏氮。

items.def: the study and practice of growing fruit, vegetables and flowers
items.s: My cousin is studying ________ at university, and she hopes to open a flower farm because she loves working with plants.
items.zh: 我表姊在大學攻讀園藝學，她希望開一間花卉農場，因為她很喜歡和植物一起工作。

items.def: (of land) left without crops for a period to recover
items.s: The farmer leaves one field ________ every few years, because the soil needs time to rest and recover its strength.
items.zh: 這位農夫每隔幾年就讓一塊田休耕，因為土壤需要時間休息並恢復地力。

items.def: to prepare and turn over soil for growing crops
items.s: In the past, farmers used water buffalo to ________ the fields, but today most of them use small machines because they are faster.
items.zh: 過去農民用水牛來耕田，但現在大多數人使用小型機器，因為速度比較快。

items.def: a tall plant whose stems are used to make sugar
items.s: Southern Taiwan once had many fields of ________, and old sugar factories in Kaohsiung and Tainan have now become popular museums.
items.zh: 南台灣過去有許多甘蔗田，而高雄和台南的老糖廠如今已成為熱門的博物館。

items.def: a figure dressed in old clothes to frighten birds away from crops
items.s: The children made a funny ________ for the school garden, but the clever birds soon realised it was not a real person.
items.zh: 孩子們為學校菜園做了一個好笑的稻草人，但聰明的鳥兒很快就發現它不是真人。

items.def: to cut and collect a crop
items.s: The villagers work together to ________ the rice in autumn, and afterwards they share a big meal to celebrate the end of the season.
items.zh: 村民在秋天一起收割稻子，之後他們會共享一頓大餐來慶祝這一季的結束。

items.def: the top layer of earth in which plants grow
items.s: Healthy ________ is full of tiny living things, and it can hold water much better than dry dust after a long drought.
items.zh: 健康的土壤充滿微小的生物，而且在長期乾旱後，它比乾燥的塵土更能保住水分。
items.sec: Soil, Water & Farm Equipment 土壤、水與農具

items.def: a substance that helps plants, animals or people grow
items.s: Plants take in each ________ they need through their roots, so farmers test the soil to see what is missing.
items.zh: 植物透過根部吸收所需的每一種養分，所以農民會檢測土壤，看看缺少了什麼。
items.sec: Soil, Water & Farm Equipment 土壤、水與農具

items.def: a gas that plants need to grow green leaves
items.s: Beans can add ________ to the soil, so organic farmers plant them between other crops instead of buying chemical fertilisers.
items.zh: 豆類能為土壤增加氮，所以有機農民把它們種在其他作物之間，而不是購買化學肥料。
items.sec: Soil, Water & Farm Equipment 土壤、水與農具

items.def: animal waste put on land to help crops grow
items.s: The farm smelled terrible after the workers spread ________ on the fields, but the vegetables grew very well later that year.
items.zh: 工人在田裡撒了糞肥之後農場臭氣沖天，但那年稍晚蔬菜長得非常好。
items.sec: Soil, Water & Farm Equipment 土壤、水與農具

items.def: material like leaves or straw spread over soil to keep it moist
items.s: We put a thick layer of ________ around the young trees, so the soil stays damp and weeds cannot grow easily.
items.zh: 我們在小樹周圍鋪了一層厚厚的覆蓋物，所以土壤能保持濕潤，雜草也不容易生長。
items.sec: Soil, Water & Farm Equipment 土壤、水與農具

items.def: the loss of soil quality and health
items.s: Too many chemicals and heavy machines can cause ________, and farmers then need even more fertiliser to grow the same amount of food.
items.zh: 過多的化學物質和重型機具會造成土壤劣化，於是農民需要更多肥料才能種出同樣多的糧食。
items.sec: Soil, Water & Farm Equipment 土壤、水與農具

items.def: the process of soil becoming too salty
items.s: Near the coast, seawater has caused the ________ of many fields, so rice no longer grows there and some farmers have left.
items.zh: 在沿海地區，海水造成許多農田鹽化，所以那裡不再能種稻，有些農民也已經離開。
items.sec: Soil, Water & Farm Equipment 土壤、水與農具

items.def: a device that sprays water over plants or grass
items.s: The ________ turns on automatically at six every morning, so the vegetables get water before the sun becomes too hot.
items.zh: 灑水器每天早上六點會自動開啟，所以蔬菜能在太陽變得太熱之前得到水分。
items.sec: Soil, Water & Farm Equipment 土壤、水與農具

items.def: watering plants slowly through small tubes near their roots
items.s: Farmers in dry areas often use ________ because it sends water straight to the roots, and very little is lost to the sun.
items.zh: 乾燥地區的農民常使用滴灌，因為它把水直接送到根部，而且很少因日曬而流失。
items.sec: Soil, Water & Farm Equipment 土壤、水與農具

items.def: water held under the ground in soil or rocks
items.s: Some fish farmers pump too much ________, and as a result the land in parts of Pingtung has slowly sunk.
items.zh: 有些養殖業者抽取過多地下水，結果屏東部分地區的地面慢慢下陷了。
items.sec: Soil, Water & Farm Equipment 土壤、水與農具

items.def: a layer of rock under the ground that holds water
items.s: The town gets its drinking water from a deep ________, but scientists warn that it will run dry if farms keep using so much.
items.zh: 這個小鎮的飲用水來自一個很深的含水層，但科學家警告，如果農場繼續大量用水，它就會枯竭。
items.sec: Soil, Water & Farm Equipment 土壤、水與農具

items.def: the level below which the ground is full of water
items.s: The ________ has dropped by several metres in recent years, so farmers must dig deeper wells to reach water.
items.zh: 近年來地下水位已下降了好幾公尺，所以農民必須挖更深的井才能取到水。
items.sec: Soil, Water & Farm Equipment 土壤、水與農具

items.def: a strong farm vehicle used to pull machines
items.s: My uncle drives a small ________ to prepare his fields, and he lets the children ride on it when they visit the farm.
items.zh: 我叔叔開一台小型耕耘機來整地，而且孩子們到農場玩時他會讓他們坐上去。
items.sec: Soil, Water & Farm Equipment 土壤、水與農具

items.def: a large machine that cuts and cleans grain in one go
items.s: A single ________ can do the work of dozens of people, so a rice field that once took a week is now finished in an afternoon.
items.zh: 一台聯合收割機能完成好幾十個人的工作，所以以前要花一週的稻田，現在一個下午就收割完了。
items.sec: Soil, Water & Farm Equipment 土壤、水與農具

items.def: a machine that plants seeds in neat rows
items.s: The farmer bought a new ________ last spring, and now his seeds are planted at exactly the right depth in straight lines.
items.zh: 這位農夫去年春天買了一台新的播種機，現在他的種子都能以剛好的深度種成整齊的直線。
items.sec: Soil, Water & Farm Equipment 土壤、水與農具

items.def: a garden tool with a long handle used to break up soil
items.s: My grandmother still uses an old ________ in her garden, and she says it is better exercise than going to the gym.
items.zh: 我奶奶仍然在菜園裡用一把舊鋤頭，而且她說這比去健身房還要好的運動。
items.sec: Soil, Water & Farm Equipment 土壤、水與農具

items.def: a tool with a row of teeth used to gather leaves or smooth soil
items.s: After the leaves fell in autumn, we used a ________ to collect them, and then we added them to the compost pile.
items.zh: 秋天落葉之後，我們用耙子把它們集中起來，然後加進堆肥堆裡。
items.sec: Soil, Water & Farm Equipment 土壤、水與農具

items.def: a curved blade with a short handle used for cutting crops
items.s: Before machines arrived, villagers cut rice with a ________, and the work was so tiring that their backs ached for days.
items.zh: 在機器出現之前，村民用鐮刀割稻，而且工作累到他們的背痛了好幾天。
items.sec: Soil, Water & Farm Equipment 土壤、水與農具

items.def: a tall tower used for storing grain or animal food
items.s: The grain is kept in a huge ________ next to the farm, because it stays dry there and rats cannot get inside.
items.zh: 穀物存放在農場旁邊一座巨大的筒倉裡，因為那裡能保持乾燥，老鼠也進不去。
items.sec: Soil, Water & Farm Equipment 土壤、水與農具

items.def: a large farm building for animals, crops or machines
items.s: The cows sleep in the ________ during typhoons, and the farmer checks on them every few hours to make sure they are safe.
items.zh: 颱風期間乳牛睡在畜舍裡，而且農夫每隔幾小時就去查看，確保牠們安全。
items.sec: Soil, Water & Farm Equipment 土壤、水與農具

items.def: a building for storing grain
items.s: In ancient times, every village had a ________ for storing rice, so people would not starve if the next harvest failed.
items.zh: 在古代，每個村莊都有一座糧倉來儲存稻米，所以即使下一次收成失敗，人們也不會挨餓。
items.sec: Soil, Water & Farm Equipment 土壤、水與農具

items.def: a long narrow line cut into soil for planting seeds
items.s: The children dropped one seed into each ________, and then they gently covered them with soil and gave them some water.
items.zh: 孩子們在每一條田溝裡放一顆種子，然後輕輕蓋上泥土並澆一些水。
items.sec: Soil, Water & Farm Equipment 土壤、水與農具

items.def: a long narrow channel dug to carry water away
items.s: The farmer dug a ________ along the edge of the field, so the heavy summer rain could drain away instead of flooding the crops.
items.zh: 農夫沿著田邊挖了一條溝渠，所以夏天的大雨可以排掉，而不會淹沒作物。
items.sec: Soil, Water & Farm Equipment 土壤、水與農具

items.def: a long rubber tube used to carry water
items.s: I watered the vegetables with a ________ this morning, but I forgot to turn it off, so the garden turned into a small lake.
items.zh: 我今天早上用水管給蔬菜澆水，但我忘了關掉，所以菜園變成了一個小湖。
items.sec: Soil, Water & Farm Equipment 土壤、水與農具

items.def: a long plastic-covered tunnel for growing plants
items.s: Many strawberry farms in Miaoli use a ________ to protect the fruit from rain, so visitors can still pick berries on wet days.
items.zh: 苗栗許多草莓園使用塑膠布棚來保護果實不被雨淋，所以遊客即使在雨天也能採草莓。
items.sec: Soil, Water & Farm Equipment 土壤、水與農具

items.def: a tool with long metal points used to lift hay
items.s: The farmer lifted the hay with a ________ and threw it into the barn, while his dog ran around barking happily.
items.zh: 農夫用乾草叉把乾草叉起來丟進穀倉，而他的狗在旁邊開心地跑來跑去吠叫。
items.sec: Soil, Water & Farm Equipment 土壤、水與農具

items.def: a long open container for animals' food or water
items.s: Every morning the farmer fills the ________ with fresh water, and the thirsty pigs push each other to drink first.
items.zh: 每天早上農夫把水槽裝滿清水，而口渴的豬會互相推擠搶著先喝。
items.sec: Soil, Water & Farm Equipment 土壤、水與農具

items.def: the ability of land to produce good crops
items.s: Volcanic ash can increase the ________ of the land, which is why farmers still grow crops near active volcanoes despite the danger.
items.zh: 火山灰能提高土地的肥沃度，這就是為什麼儘管有危險，農民仍在活火山附近種植作物。
items.sec: Soil, Water & Farm Equipment 土壤、水與農具

items.def: made from milk, or connected with producing milk
items.s: Cheese, yoghurt and butter are all ________ products, so people who cannot drink milk often have trouble eating them too.
items.zh: 起司、優格和奶油都是乳製品，所以不能喝牛奶的人常常也很難吃這些東西。
items.sec: Livestock & Animal Farming 畜牧與動物養殖

items.def: land covered with grass where animals feed
items.s: The cows spend the day on the green ________, and in the evening the farmer leads them back to the barn for milking.
items.zh: 乳牛整天待在綠色的牧草地上，到了傍晚農夫再帶牠們回到牛舍擠奶。
items.sec: Livestock & Animal Farming 畜牧與動物養殖

items.def: a field of grass and wild flowers
items.s: We had a picnic in a ________ full of wild flowers, but we had to leave quickly because a group of curious goats came over.
items.zh: 我們在一片開滿野花的草地上野餐，但因為一群好奇的山羊跑了過來，我們只好趕快離開。
items.sec: Livestock & Animal Farming 畜牧與動物養殖

items.def: food such as hay given to farm animals
items.s: The dry winter left little grass on the hills, so farmers had to buy ________ to keep their sheep alive.
items.zh: 乾燥的冬天讓山坡上幾乎沒有草，所以農民必須購買草料來讓羊存活。
items.sec: Livestock & Animal Farming 畜牧與動物養殖

items.def: grass that has been cut and dried to feed animals
items.s: The farmers cut the grass in summer and dry it into ________, so the horses have enough food during the cold months.
items.zh: 農民在夏天割草並曬成乾草，所以馬匹在寒冷的月份有足夠的食物。
items.sec: Livestock & Animal Farming 畜牧與動物養殖

items.def: green plants stored without air and used as animal food
items.s: The farmer wraps the fresh grass in plastic to make ________, and the cows eat it happily all winter.
items.zh: 農夫把新鮮的牧草用塑膠包起來做成青貯飼料，而乳牛整個冬天都吃得很開心。
items.sec: Livestock & Animal Farming 畜牧與動物養殖

items.def: a small building or area where pigs are kept
items.s: The old ________ behind the farmhouse was cleaned every day, but the smell still reached the neighbours when the wind blew.
items.zh: 農舍後面的舊豬圈每天都會清理，但風一吹，臭味還是會飄到鄰居家。
items.sec: Livestock & Animal Farming 畜牧與動物養殖

items.def: a small house where chickens are kept
items.s: We built a ________ in the backyard last year, and now we collect fresh eggs every morning before school.
items.zh: 我們去年在後院蓋了一個雞舍，現在每天早上上學前都能撿到新鮮雞蛋。
items.sec: Livestock & Animal Farming 畜牧與動物養殖

items.def: a very small cage where egg-laying hens are kept
items.s: Hens in a ________ cannot even spread their wings, so many shoppers now choose eggs from farms that let chickens walk around.
items.zh: 關在格子籠裡的母雞連翅膀都無法張開，所以現在許多消費者選擇讓雞可以四處走動的農場所生產的雞蛋。
items.sec: Livestock & Animal Farming 畜牧與動物養殖

items.def: (of farm animals) allowed to move around outside
items.s: ________ eggs cost a little more at the supermarket, but my mother buys them because she believes the hens live happier lives.
items.zh: 放養雞蛋在超市貴一點，但我媽媽還是會買，因為她相信那些母雞過得比較快樂。
items.sec: Livestock & Animal Farming 畜牧與動物養殖

items.def: a building where animals are killed for meat
items.s: The town's old ________ closed ten years ago, and it has now been turned into a cafe and art space.
items.zh: 鎮上的舊屠宰場十年前關閉了，而它現在已經改建成咖啡廳和藝術空間。
items.sec: Livestock & Animal Farming 畜牧與動物養殖

items.def: to kill animals for food
items.s: Farmers in the village used to ________ a pig before Lunar New Year, and every family received some meat for the celebrations.
items.zh: 村裡的農民以前會在農曆新年前屠宰一頭豬，而且每戶人家都能分到一些肉來過節。
items.sec: Livestock & Animal Farming 畜牧與動物養殖

items.def: a person who cuts and sells meat
items.s: The ________ at the morning market cuts the pork exactly the way my grandmother likes it, so she never buys meat anywhere else.
items.zh: 早市的肉販會完全照我奶奶喜歡的方式切豬肉，所以她從不在別的地方買肉。
items.sec: Livestock & Animal Farming 畜牧與動物養殖

items.def: to look after animals until they are fully grown
items.s: Their family has ________ ducks in Yilan for many years, and their duck meat is famous all over the county.
items.zh: 他們家在宜蘭養鴨已經很多年了，而且他們的鴨肉在全縣都很有名。
items.sec: Livestock & Animal Farming 畜牧與動物養殖

items.def: to make an animal fat before it is killed for food
items.s: Some farmers ________ their cattle with corn for months, but grass-fed beef is becoming more popular because it is seen as healthier.
items.zh: 有些農民用玉米把牛養肥好幾個月，但草飼牛肉越來越受歡迎，因為它被認為比較健康。
items.sec: Livestock & Animal Farming 畜牧與動物養殖

items.def: a medicine that kills bacteria
items.s: If farmers give animals an ________ too often, bacteria may become stronger, and medicines may stop working for humans too.
items.zh: 如果農民太常給動物使用抗生素，細菌可能會變得更強，而藥物對人類也可能失效。
items.sec: Livestock & Animal Farming 畜牧與動物養殖

items.def: a chemical that makes animals grow bigger faster
items.s: Some countries allow farmers to give cattle ________, but others have banned it because people worry about the effects on health.
items.zh: 有些國家允許農民給牛使用生長激素，但其他國家已經禁止，因為人們擔心它對健康的影響。
items.sec: Livestock & Animal Farming 畜牧與動物養殖

items.def: the health and comfort of animals
items.s: The supermarket now sells eggs with an ________ label, so customers can see that the hens were treated kindly.
items.zh: 這間超市現在販售貼有動物福利標章的雞蛋，所以顧客可以知道母雞受到善待。
items.sec: Livestock & Animal Farming 畜牧與動物養殖

items.def: keeping large numbers of animals indoors to produce cheap food
items.s: ________ produces cheap meat for millions of people, but critics say the animals suffer because they have so little space.
items.zh: 工廠化養殖為數百萬人生產便宜的肉品，但批評者說動物因為空間太小而受苦。
items.sec: Livestock & Animal Farming 畜牧與動物養殖

items.def: to cut the wool off a sheep
items.s: The farmers ________ the sheep every spring, so the animals stay cool in summer and the wool can be sold.
items.zh: 農民每年春天替羊剪毛，所以羊在夏天能保持涼爽，羊毛也可以拿去賣。
items.sec: Livestock & Animal Farming 畜牧與動物養殖

items.def: the wool coat of a sheep
items.s: Each ________ was washed and dried in the sun, and then the women spun it into thread for warm winter sweaters.
items.zh: 每一片羊毛都經過清洗並在陽光下曬乾，然後婦女們把它紡成線，用來織保暖的冬季毛衣。
items.sec: Livestock & Animal Farming 畜牧與動物養殖

items.def: a place where eggs are kept warm until young birds or fish come out
items.s: The ________ produces thousands of baby chickens every day, and they are sent to farms all over the island by truck.
items.zh: 這座孵化場每天生產數千隻小雞，然後用卡車送到全島各地的農場。
items.sec: Livestock & Animal Farming 畜牧與動物養殖

items.def: a young chicken raised for its meat
items.s: A modern ________ grows so quickly that it is ready to sell in about six weeks, but some people think this is unnatural.
items.zh: 現代的肉雞長得非常快，大約六週就可以出售，但有些人認為這很不自然。
items.sec: Livestock & Animal Farming 畜牧與動物養殖

items.def: the work of keeping bees for honey
items.s: My uncle took up ________ after he retired, and now he gives jars of honey to all his friends at Mid-Autumn Festival.
items.zh: 我舅舅退休後開始養蜂，現在每到中秋節他都會送朋友們一罐罐蜂蜜。
items.sec: Livestock & Animal Farming 畜牧與動物養殖

items.def: a box or structure where bees live and make honey
items.s: The farmer placed a ________ at the edge of the orchard, because the bees help the fruit trees and also produce honey.
items.zh: 農夫在果園邊緣放了一個蜂箱，因為蜜蜂能幫助果樹授粉，也能生產蜂蜜。
items.sec: Livestock & Animal Farming 畜牧與動物養殖

items.def: a machine used to take milk from cows
items.s: The farm bought a ________ last year, so the workers no longer get up at four o'clock to milk the cows by hand.
items.zh: 這座農場去年買了一台擠奶機，所以工人不再需要凌晨四點起床用手擠牛奶。
items.sec: Livestock & Animal Farming 畜牧與動物養殖

items.def: a very large farm for raising cattle, horses or sheep
items.s: My cousin worked on a cattle ________ in Australia for a year, and he learned to ride a horse and fix fences.
items.zh: 我表哥在澳洲的養牛大牧場工作了一年，而且學會了騎馬和修理圍籬。
items.sec: Livestock & Animal Farming 畜牧與動物養殖

items.def: a young sheep, or its meat
items.s: The newborn ________ could stand up within an hour, and the children watched quietly as it drank milk from its mother.
items.zh: 這隻剛出生的小羊不到一小時就能站起來，孩子們靜靜地看著牠喝母羊的奶。
items.sec: Livestock & Animal Farming 畜牧與動物養殖

items.def: food changed by factory methods, often with added chemicals
items.s: Instant noodles are a common ________, and they are cheap and quick, but they often contain a lot of salt.
items.zh: 泡麵是常見的加工食品，它們既便宜又快速，但常常含有大量的鹽。
items.sec: Food Processing & Preservation 食品加工與保存

items.def: made mostly from factory ingredients rather than whole foods
items.s: Many snacks in convenience stores are ________, so doctors advise teenagers to eat fruit and nuts instead.
items.zh: 便利商店的許多零食都是超加工的，所以醫生建議青少年改吃水果和堅果。
items.sec: Food Processing & Preservation 食品加工與保存

items.def: a chemical added to food to stop it from going bad
items.s: This bread contains no ________, so it goes mouldy after three days, but my family thinks it tastes much fresher.
items.zh: 這種麵包不含防腐劑，所以三天後就會發霉，但我們家覺得它吃起來新鮮多了。
items.sec: Food Processing & Preservation 食品加工與保存

items.def: a substance added to food to improve its colour, taste or life
items.s: The label lists every ________ in the drink, but most customers do not read it because the words are very small.
items.zh: 標籤上列出了飲料中的每一種添加物，但大多數顧客都不會去看，因為字實在太小了。
items.sec: Food Processing & Preservation 食品加工與保存

items.def: a substance added to food to give it a particular taste
items.s: The strawberry milk contains no real fruit, only artificial ________, but children still love its sweet pink colour.
items.zh: 這種草莓牛奶完全不含真的水果，只有人工香料，但孩子們還是很喜歡它甜甜的粉紅色。
items.sec: Food Processing & Preservation 食品加工與保存

items.def: a substance used instead of sugar to make food sweet
items.s: Diet cola uses an artificial ________ instead of sugar, so it has almost no calories, but some people dislike the taste.
items.zh: 無糖可樂使用人工甜味劑代替糖，所以幾乎沒有熱量，但有些人不喜歡它的味道。
items.sec: Food Processing & Preservation 食品加工與保存

items.def: a substance that helps oil and water mix together
items.s: Ice cream often contains an ________, because without it the cream and water would separate and the texture would become icy.
items.zh: 冰淇淋常含有乳化劑，因為如果沒有它，奶油和水會分離，口感也會變得像冰渣。
items.sec: Food Processing & Preservation 食品加工與保存

items.def: to heat milk or juice to kill harmful bacteria
items.s: Dairy farms ________ milk before it goes to shops, because heating it kills bacteria that could make people sick.
items.zh: 酪農場會在牛奶送到商店前先進行巴氏殺菌，因為加熱能殺死可能使人生病的細菌。
items.sec: Food Processing & Preservation 食品加工與保存

items.def: to make something completely free from bacteria
items.s: My mother always ________ the glass jars in boiling water before she makes jam, so the jam will not go bad.
items.zh: 我媽媽做果醬前總會先把玻璃罐放進滾水中消毒，這樣果醬才不會壞掉。
items.sec: Food Processing & Preservation 食品加工與保存

items.def: a machine or part of a fridge that keeps food frozen
items.s: We keep dumplings in the ________ for busy evenings, and we can cook a quick dinner in ten minutes.
items.zh: 我們把水餃放在冷凍庫裡備著忙碌的晚上吃，而且十分鐘就能煮好一頓快速的晚餐。
items.sec: Food Processing & Preservation 食品加工與保存

items.def: to let frozen food become soft again
items.s: You should ________ the chicken in the fridge overnight, because leaving it on the table can allow bacteria to grow.
items.zh: 你應該把雞肉放在冷藏室裡隔夜解凍，因為把它放在桌上可能會讓細菌滋生。
items.sec: Food Processing & Preservation 食品加工與保存

items.def: kept cold but not frozen
items.s: ________ salads must stay below five degrees, so the delivery driver checks the temperature in his van every hour.
items.zh: 冷藏沙拉必須保持在五度以下，所以送貨司機每小時都會檢查貨車內的溫度。
items.sec: Food Processing & Preservation 食品加工與保存

items.def: a system that keeps food cold from farm to shop
items.s: Vaccines and fresh fish both depend on the ________, because even a short break in cooling can make them unsafe.
items.zh: 疫苗和鮮魚都仰賴冷鏈，因為即使冷藏只中斷一下，也可能讓它們變得不安全。
items.sec: Food Processing & Preservation 食品加工與保存

items.def: sealed in a pack with all the air removed
items.s: The ________ meat stays fresh for weeks because no air can get in, so campers often take it on long trips.
items.zh: 真空包裝的肉能保鮮好幾週，因為空氣進不去，所以露營者常帶著它去長途旅行。
items.sec: Food Processing & Preservation 食品加工與保存

items.def: not allowing air to get in or out
items.s: Keep the cookies in an ________ box, or they will become soft because of the wet weather in Taipei.
items.zh: 把餅乾放在密封的盒子裡，否則它們會因為台北潮濕的天氣而變軟。
items.sec: Food Processing & Preservation 食品加工與保存

items.def: to remove water from food to keep it longer
items.s: Factories ________ fruit to make healthy snacks, and the dried mango slices from Tainan are popular gifts for tourists.
items.zh: 工廠將水果脫水製成健康的點心，而台南的芒果乾片是很受觀光客歡迎的伴手禮。
items.sec: Food Processing & Preservation 食品加工與保存

items.def: to keep meat or fish by drying, salting or smoking it
items.s: Families in the countryside ________ pork with salt and spices before winter, so they have meat to eat during the holidays.
items.zh: 鄉下的家庭會在冬天前用鹽和香料醃製豬肉，這樣過節時就有肉可吃。
items.sec: Food Processing & Preservation 食品加工與保存

items.def: to keep food in vinegar or salt water
items.s: My grandmother likes to ________ cucumbers in summer, and she keeps the jars in a cool cupboard for months.
items.zh: 我奶奶喜歡在夏天醃漬小黃瓜，而且她把罐子放在陰涼的櫥櫃裡好幾個月。
items.sec: Food Processing & Preservation 食品加工與保存

items.def: to change chemically because of bacteria or yeast
items.s: Cabbage is left to ________ for several days to make kimchi, and the bacteria give it a sour taste that many people love.
items.zh: 高麗菜會放著發酵好幾天來做成泡菜，而細菌讓它產生許多人喜愛的酸味。
items.sec: Food Processing & Preservation 食品加工與保存

items.def: how long a product can be kept before it goes bad
items.s: Canned soup has a long ________, so people often buy it before a typhoon, but fresh milk must be drunk within a week.
items.zh: 罐頭湯的保存期限很長，所以人們常在颱風前購買，但鮮奶必須在一週內喝完。
items.sec: Food Processing & Preservation 食品加工與保存

items.def: the date until which food is at its best quality
items.s: The yoghurt was two days past its ________, but it still smelled fine, so we decided to eat it.
items.zh: 這罐優格已經過了最佳賞味期限兩天，但聞起來還是沒問題，所以我們決定把它吃掉。
items.sec: Food Processing & Preservation 食品加工與保存

items.def: (of food) to become bad and unsafe to eat
items.s: Fresh fish can ________ within hours in summer, so the fishermen pack it in ice as soon as it is caught.
items.zh: 新鮮的魚在夏天幾小時內就可能壞掉，所以漁夫一捕到魚就立刻用冰塊包裝。
items.sec: Food Processing & Preservation 食品加工與保存

items.def: old and bad, and no longer fit to eat
items.s: We found a ________ apple at the bottom of the bag, and it had already spoiled several others around it.
items.zh: 我們在袋子底部發現了一顆腐爛的蘋果，而它已經把周圍好幾顆都弄壞了。
items.sec: Food Processing & Preservation 食品加工與保存

items.def: (of bread or snacks) no longer fresh and becoming dry or hard
items.s: The bread had gone ________ because nobody closed the bag, so we fed it to the ducks in the park.
items.zh: 因為沒有人把袋子封好，麵包變得不新鮮了，所以我們拿去公園餵鴨子。
items.sec: Food Processing & Preservation 食品加工與保存

items.def: likely to go bad quickly
items.s: Strawberries are very ________, so farmers have to sell them within a few days, or they will lose their money.
items.zh: 草莓非常容易腐壞，所以農民必須在幾天內賣掉，否則就會虧錢。
items.sec: Food Processing & Preservation 食品加工與保存

items.def: powder made from grain and used for baking
items.s: We mixed ________, eggs and milk to make pancakes, but the kitchen was covered in white powder by the time we finished.
items.zh: 我們把麵粉、雞蛋和牛奶混在一起做鬆餅，但等我們做完時，廚房已經滿是白色粉末。
items.sec: Food Processing & Preservation 食品加工與保存

items.def: to crush something into small pieces or powder
items.s: The cafe owner ________ the coffee beans just before he makes each cup, because he says it gives a much better smell.
items.zh: 這位咖啡店老闆在沖每杯咖啡前才研磨咖啡豆，因為他說這樣香氣會好得多。
items.sec: Food Processing & Preservation 食品加工與保存

items.def: sold in bottles
items.s: Many tourists buy ________ water every day, but the city now provides free water stations to cut down on plastic waste.
items.zh: 許多觀光客每天都買瓶裝水，但這座城市現在提供免費飲水站來減少塑膠垃圾。
items.sec: Food Processing & Preservation 食品加工與保存

items.def: freezing food very fast to keep its taste and texture
items.s: ________ keeps vegetables bright and crunchy, because the ice crystals stay tiny and do not damage the cells.
items.zh: 急速冷凍能讓蔬菜保持鮮豔和爽脆，因為冰晶很小，不會破壞細胞。
items.sec: Food Processing & Preservation 食品加工與保存

items.def: the science of making, storing and improving food
items.s: Advances in ________ have made food safer and cheaper, but some people prefer traditional cooking because it feels more natural.
items.zh: 食品科技的進步讓食物更安全也更便宜，但有些人比較喜歡傳統烹調，因為感覺比較天然。
items.sec: Food Technology & Innovation 食品科技與創新

items.def: a person who studies how food is made and kept safe
items.s: A ________ tested the new sauce for months, and she changed the recipe because the colour faded too quickly.
items.zh: 一位食品科學家花了好幾個月測試這款新醬料，她更改了配方，因為顏色褪得太快。
items.sec: Food Technology & Innovation 食品科技與創新

items.def: meat made from animal cells in a laboratory
items.s: ________ could reduce the number of animals that are killed, but it is still too expensive for most families to buy.
items.zh: 實驗室培育肉可以減少被宰殺的動物數量，但對大多數家庭來說還是太貴了。
items.sec: Food Technology & Innovation 食品科技與創新

items.def: made from plants rather than animals
items.cn: 植物性的；以植物為原料的
items.s: The burger shop now offers a ________ burger, and many customers cannot tell the difference from beef.
items.zh: 這家漢堡店現在提供植物性漢堡，而且許多顧客都吃不出它和牛肉的差別。
items.sec: Food Technology & Innovation 食品科技與創新

items.def: a food that is used instead of meat
items.s: Tofu has been a popular ________ in Asia for centuries, so new plant-based products are not really a new idea here.
items.zh: 豆腐在亞洲作為肉類替代品已經流行了好幾個世紀，所以新的植物性產品在這裡其實不算新點子。
items.sec: Food Technology & Innovation 食品科技與創新

items.def: a source of protein other than traditional meat
items.s: Investors are spending billions on ________ because the world's population is growing, and farms cannot produce enough meat for everyone.
items.zh: 投資人在替代蛋白質上投入數十億元，因為世界人口持續成長，而農場無法生產足夠所有人吃的肉。
items.sec: Food Technology & Innovation 食品科技與創新

items.def: an insect that is safe for people to eat
items.s: Crickets are an ________ that is rich in protein, but many people in Taiwan still feel nervous about tasting them.
items.zh: 蟋蟀是一種富含蛋白質的可食用昆蟲，但許多台灣人對品嘗牠們仍然感到緊張。
items.sec: Food Technology & Innovation 食品科技與創新

items.def: having genes changed by scientists
items.s: Most of the soybeans that Taiwan imports are ________, so tofu makers must label clearly which products use them.
items.zh: 台灣進口的黃豆大多是基因改造的，所以豆腐業者必須清楚標示哪些產品有使用。
items.sec: Food Technology & Innovation 食品科技與創新

items.def: a living thing whose genes have been changed by science
items.s: School lunches in Taiwan cannot contain any ________, because parents asked the government to make this rule several years ago.
items.zh: 台灣的學校午餐不能含有任何基因改造生物，因為家長幾年前要求政府訂定這項規定。
items.sec: Food Technology & Innovation 食品科技與創新

items.def: changing the DNA of a living thing in a precise way
items.s: Scientists are using ________ to create rice that survives floods, and farmers in Asia hope it will protect their harvests.
items.zh: 科學家正在運用基因編輯培育能在洪水中存活的稻米，而亞洲的農民希望它能保護他們的收成。
items.sec: Food Technology & Innovation 食品科技與創新

items.def: using living cells and bacteria to make useful products
items.s: My sister wants to study ________ at university, because she believes it can help farmers grow food with fewer chemicals.
items.zh: 我姊姊想在大學攻讀生物科技，因為她相信它能幫助農民用更少的化學物質種植糧食。
items.sec: Food Technology & Innovation 食品科技與創新

items.def: growing plants in water with nutrients instead of soil
items.s: The restaurant grows its own lettuce using ________, so it needs no soil, and the leaves are picked just before serving.
items.zh: 這家餐廳用水耕栽培自己種萵苣，所以不需要土壤，而且葉子是上菜前才採下的。
items.sec: Food Technology & Innovation 食品科技與創新

items.def: a system where fish and plants are raised together in water
items.s: Our school built an ________ system in the science lab, and the students feed the fish while the plants clean the water.
items.zh: 我們學校在科學實驗室裡建造了一套魚菜共生系統，學生餵魚，而植物則負責淨化水質。
items.sec: Food Technology & Innovation 食品科技與創新

items.def: growing crops in stacked layers, often inside buildings
items.s: ________ allows cities to produce vegetables in tall buildings, but the lights use a lot of electricity, so costs remain high.
items.zh: 垂直農法讓城市能在高樓裡生產蔬菜，但照明耗電量很大，所以成本仍然很高。
items.sec: Food Technology & Innovation 食品科技與創新

items.def: a farm inside a building with controlled light and temperature
items.s: The ________ near the train station grows herbs all year round, and typhoons cannot damage the crops because they are inside.
items.zh: 火車站附近的室內農場全年都在種植香草，而且颱風也無法破壞作物，因為它們都在室內。
items.sec: Food Technology & Innovation 食品科技與創新

items.def: farming that uses data and technology to treat each part of a field correctly
items.s: With ________, farmers use drones and sensors to find dry areas, so they only water the plants that really need it.
items.zh: 透過精準農業，農民使用無人機和感測器找出乾燥的區域，所以他們只澆灌真正需要水的植物。
items.sec: Food Technology & Innovation 食品科技與創新

items.def: technology used to improve farming
items.s: Young engineers are starting ________ companies in Taiwan, and they hope their apps will help older farmers save time and water.
items.zh: 年輕工程師在台灣創立農業科技公司，而他們希望自己的應用程式能幫助年長的農民節省時間和水。
items.sec: Food Technology & Innovation 食品科技與創新

items.def: farming with connected devices that collect and share data
items.s: ________ lets my uncle check the temperature of his greenhouse on his phone, so he can relax even when he travels.
items.zh: 智慧農業讓我叔叔能用手機查看溫室的溫度，所以他即使出門旅行也能放心。
items.sec: Food Technology & Innovation 食品科技與創新

items.def: producing a large amount of crops
items.s: Scientists developed ________ rice in the 1960s, and it helped millions of people in Asia escape hunger.
items.zh: 科學家在1960年代培育出高產量的稻米，而它幫助亞洲數百萬人擺脫飢餓。
items.sec: Food Technology & Innovation 食品科技與創新

items.def: a plant or animal produced from two different types
items.s: This papaya is a ________ of two local types, so it is both sweet and strong enough to survive the windy season.
items.zh: 這種木瓜是兩個本地品種的雜交種，所以它既甜又強壯，能撐過多風的季節。
items.sec: Food Technology & Innovation 食品科技與創新

items.def: a place where seeds are stored to protect plant varieties
items.s: A ________ in Norway keeps millions of seeds deep inside a mountain, so crops can be replanted if a disaster happens.
items.zh: 挪威的一座種子庫將數百萬顆種子保存在山的深處，所以如果發生災難，作物就能重新種植。
items.sec: Food Technology & Innovation 食品科技與創新

items.def: the rapid rise in crop production in the 1960s using new seeds and chemicals
items.s: The ________ doubled rice harvests in many countries, but it also increased the use of chemicals and water.
items.zh: 綠色革命讓許多國家的稻米收成加倍，但它也增加了化學物質和水的使用量。
items.sec: Food Technology & Innovation 食品科技與創新

items.def: a chemical used in farming, such as a fertiliser or pesticide
items.s: The company sells every kind of ________ to farmers, but it is also developing natural products because customers want safer food.
items.zh: 這家公司向農民銷售各種農用化學品，但它也在研發天然產品，因為消費者想要更安全的食物。
items.sec: Food Technology & Innovation 食品科技與創新

items.def: protein made from a type of fungus, used instead of meat
items.s: The vegetarian nuggets are made from ________, and they taste surprisingly like chicken, so even my meat-loving father enjoyed them.
items.zh: 這款素雞塊是用真菌蛋白做的，而且吃起來出奇地像雞肉，所以連愛吃肉的爸爸都很喜歡。
items.sec: Food Technology & Innovation 食品科技與創新

items.def: a food said to be especially good for your health
items.s: Blueberries are often called a ________, but nutritionists say that a balanced diet matters more than any single fruit.
items.zh: 藍莓常被稱為超級食物，但營養師說均衡飲食比任何單一水果都更重要。
items.sec: Food Technology & Innovation 食品科技與創新

items.def: making food in shapes using a machine that builds it in layers
items.s: The hotel used ________ to make chocolate in the shape of Taipei 101, and the guests took photos before they ate it.
items.zh: 這家飯店運用3D食物列印做出台北101形狀的巧克力，客人在吃之前都先拍了照。
items.sec: Food Technology & Innovation 食品科技與創新

items.def: a box of ingredients and a recipe delivered to your home
items.s: My parents order a ________ every week because they are busy, and all the ingredients arrive already measured.
items.zh: 我爸媽因為很忙，每週都會訂一盒食材組，而且所有食材送來時都已經量好了。
items.sec: Food Technology & Innovation 食品科技與創新

items.def: a phone app used to order meals to your home
items.s: Students often use a ________ late at night, but the plastic boxes create a lot of rubbish.
items.zh: 學生常在深夜使用外送應用程式，但塑膠餐盒製造了大量垃圾。
items.sec: Food Technology & Innovation 食品科技與創新

items.def: a large tank where cells or bacteria are grown
items.s: The meat cells grow inside a steel ________ for several weeks, and scientists control the temperature very carefully.
items.zh: 肉類細胞在鋼製的生物反應器裡生長好幾個星期，而科學家會非常小心地控制溫度。
items.sec: Food Technology & Innovation 食品科技與創新

items.def: the food you eat and how it affects your health
items.s: Good ________ is important for teenagers because they are still growing, so schools try to serve balanced lunches.
items.zh: 良好的營養對青少年很重要，因為他們還在成長，所以學校努力提供均衡的午餐。
items.sec: Nutrition, Diet & Food Safety 營養、飲食與食品安全

items.def: full of things that are good for your body
items.s: Sweet potatoes are cheap and ________, so my grandmother says they helped many families survive during hard times.
items.zh: 地瓜既便宜又有營養，所以我奶奶說它在艱困時期幫助許多家庭活了下來。
items.sec: Nutrition, Diet & Food Safety 營養、飲食與食品安全

items.def: an expert on food and healthy eating
items.s: The school ________ plans the lunch menu every month, and she makes sure there are vegetables in every meal.
items.zh: 學校的營養師每個月規劃午餐菜單，而且她確保每一餐都有蔬菜。
items.sec: Nutrition, Diet & Food Safety 營養、飲食與食品安全

items.def: eating the right amounts of different kinds of food
items.s: A ________ includes fruit, vegetables, grains and protein, so you should not live on fried chicken and bubble tea.
items.zh: 均衡飲食包括水果、蔬菜、穀物和蛋白質，所以你不應該只靠炸雞和珍珠奶茶過活。
items.sec: Nutrition, Diet & Food Safety 營養、飲食與食品安全

items.def: a nutrient in meat, eggs and beans that builds muscles
items.s: Athletes need plenty of ________ to build muscle, so many of them eat eggs, chicken or tofu after training.
items.zh: 運動員需要大量的蛋白質來增加肌肉，所以他們許多人在訓練後吃雞蛋、雞肉或豆腐。
items.sec: Nutrition, Diet & Food Safety 營養、飲食與食品安全

items.def: a nutrient in rice, bread and noodles that gives energy
items.s: Rice is the main ________ in many Asian meals, and it gives students the energy they need for long school days.
items.zh: 米飯是許多亞洲餐點中主要的碳水化合物，而且它提供學生漫長上學日所需的能量。
items.sec: Nutrition, Diet & Food Safety 營養、飲食與食品安全

items.def: the part of plant food that helps digestion
items.s: Brown rice contains more ________ than white rice, so it keeps you full for longer and helps your stomach work well.
items.zh: 糙米比白米含有更多纖維，所以能讓你飽得更久，也能幫助腸胃正常運作。
items.sec: Nutrition, Diet & Food Safety 營養、飲食與食品安全

items.def: a natural substance in food that the body needs to stay healthy
items.s: Oranges are full of ________ C, so my mother makes us eat one every day when it is flu season.
items.zh: 柳橙富含維他命C，所以在流感季節我媽媽每天都要我們吃一顆。
items.sec: Nutrition, Diet & Food Safety 營養、飲食與食品安全

items.def: a unit for measuring the energy in food
items.s: One cup of bubble tea can contain more than five hundred ________, so it is almost like eating a whole meal.
items.zh: 一杯珍珠奶茶可能含有超過五百卡路里，所以幾乎就像吃了一整餐。
items.sec: Nutrition, Diet & Food Safety 營養、飲食與食品安全

items.def: a chemical in salt that can be unhealthy in large amounts
items.s: Instant noodles are very high in ________, so doctors warn that eating them often may raise your blood pressure.
items.zh: 泡麵的鈉含量非常高，所以醫生警告常吃可能會讓血壓升高。
items.sec: Nutrition, Diet & Food Safety 營養、飲食與食品安全

items.def: a fatty substance in the blood that can block blood vessels
items.s: My father's ________ was too high last year, so he stopped eating fried food and started jogging every morning.
items.zh: 我爸爸去年膽固醇太高，所以他不再吃油炸食物，並開始每天早上慢跑。
items.sec: Nutrition, Diet & Food Safety 營養、飲食與食品安全

items.def: the state of being very overweight
items.s: Childhood ________ is rising in many countries, and experts blame sugary drinks as well as too much time on screens.
items.zh: 兒童肥胖在許多國家持續增加，而專家將原因歸咎於含糖飲料以及花太多時間在螢幕上。
items.sec: Nutrition, Diet & Food Safety 營養、飲食與食品安全

items.def: illness caused by eating food that contains harmful bacteria
items.s: Several students got ________ after the school trip, and the health department later found that the lunch boxes had been left in the sun.
items.zh: 好幾個學生在校外教學後食物中毒，而衛生局後來發現便當被放在太陽底下曬。
items.sec: Nutrition, Diet & Food Safety 營養、飲食與食品安全

items.def: a type of bacteria that causes food poisoning
items.s: Raw eggs may carry ________, so you should cook them properly, especially when you serve them to children.
items.zh: 生雞蛋可能帶有沙門氏菌，所以你應該把蛋煮熟，尤其是給小孩吃的時候。
items.sec: Nutrition, Diet & Food Safety 營養、飲食與食品安全

items.def: keeping food free from things that can make people ill
items.s: After several scandals about cooking oil, ________ became a major concern in Taiwan, and the government made stricter rules.
items.zh: 在幾起食用油醜聞之後，食品安全成為台灣重大的關注議題，而政府也訂定了更嚴格的規定。
items.sec: Nutrition, Diet & Food Safety 營養、飲食與食品安全

items.def: an official who checks that food and restaurants are safe
items.s: A ________ visited the night market last week, and two stalls were fined because their kitchens were dirty.
items.zh: 上週一名食品稽查員到夜市檢查，而有兩個攤位因為廚房骯髒而被罰款。
items.sec: Nutrition, Diet & Food Safety 營養、飲食與食品安全

items.def: information on a food package about its nutrients
items.s: Check the ________ on the back of the box, and you will see how much sugar is hidden in this healthy-looking cereal.
items.zh: 看看盒子背面的營養標示，你就會發現這款看起來很健康的穀片裡藏了多少糖。
items.sec: Nutrition, Diet & Food Safety 營養、飲食與食品安全

items.def: a substance that causes an allergic reaction
items.s: Peanuts are a common ________, so restaurants must tell customers if any dish contains them.
items.zh: 花生是常見的過敏原，所以餐廳必須告知顧客是否有任何菜餚含有花生。
items.sec: Nutrition, Diet & Food Safety 營養、飲食與食品安全

items.def: not containing gluten, a protein found in wheat
items.s: The bakery started selling ________ bread last year, and it quickly became popular with customers who cannot eat wheat.
items.zh: 這家麵包店去年開始販售無麩質麵包，而且很快就受到不能吃小麥的顧客歡迎。
items.sec: Nutrition, Diet & Food Safety 營養、飲食與食品安全

items.def: a person who eats no animal products at all
items.s: My cousin became a ________ last year, so she no longer eats meat, eggs or milk, but she still loves cooking for her friends.
items.zh: 我表妹去年成為純素食者，所以她不再吃肉、蛋或牛奶，但她仍然很喜歡為朋友下廚。
items.sec: Nutrition, Diet & Food Safety 營養、飲食與食品安全

items.def: a person who does not eat meat or fish
items.s: Taiwan is an easy place for a ________ to travel, because there are vegetarian restaurants in almost every neighbourhood.
items.zh: 台灣對素食者來說是很容易旅行的地方，因為幾乎每個社區都有素食餐廳。
items.sec: Nutrition, Diet & Food Safety 營養、飲食與食品安全

items.def: made with the whole seed of the grain, including the outer layer
items.s: ________ bread is healthier than white bread, but my little brother refuses to eat it because he says it tastes like cardboard.
items.zh: 全穀麵包比白麵包健康，但我弟弟拒絕吃，因為他說吃起來像紙板。
items.sec: Nutrition, Diet & Food Safety 營養、飲食與食品安全

items.def: food that is tasty but unhealthy
items.s: I try not to eat ________ before exams, but chips and chocolate are hard to resist when I study late.
items.zh: 我考試前盡量不吃垃圾食物，但熬夜讀書時，洋芋片和巧克力實在很難抗拒。
items.sec: Nutrition, Diet & Food Safety 營養、飲食與食品安全

items.def: the amount of food that counts as one portion on a label
items.s: The ________ on the snack bag is only ten chips, but most people eat the whole bag in one go.
items.zh: 零食袋上標示的每份份量只有十片洋芋片，但大多數人一口氣就吃掉整包。
items.sec: Nutrition, Diet & Food Safety 營養、飲食與食品安全

items.def: not cooked long enough
items.s: The chicken was ________ in the middle, so we sent it back to the kitchen because we did not want to get sick.
items.zh: 雞肉中間沒有煮熟，所以我們把它退回廚房，因為我們不想生病。
items.sec: Nutrition, Diet & Food Safety 營養、飲食與食品安全

items.def: a person whose job involves preparing or serving food
items.s: Every ________ must wear gloves and a hat, and they need a health check before they start working in the kitchen.
items.zh: 每位食品從業人員都必須戴手套和帽子，而且他們在進廚房工作前需要接受健康檢查。
items.sec: Nutrition, Diet & Food Safety 營養、飲食與食品安全

items.def: to break down food in the stomach so the body can use it
items.s: Some adults cannot ________ milk easily, so they feel uncomfortable after drinking a latte, but they can still eat cheese.
items.zh: 有些成人不容易消化牛奶，所以喝完拿鐵後會不舒服，但他們仍然可以吃起司。
items.sec: Nutrition, Diet & Food Safety 營養、飲食與食品安全

items.def: containing a lot of sugar
items.s: The government wants to tax ________ drinks, because they are a major cause of tooth decay and weight problems among children.
items.zh: 政府想對含糖飲料課稅，因為它們是兒童蛀牙和體重問題的主要原因。
items.sec: Nutrition, Diet & Food Safety 營養、飲食與食品安全

items.def: connected with the food people eat
items.s: The hotel asks every guest about their ________ needs, so the chef can prepare meals without nuts, meat or wheat.
items.zh: 這家飯店會詢問每位客人的飲食需求，所以主廚可以準備不含堅果、肉或小麥的餐點。
items.sec: Nutrition, Diet & Food Safety 營養、飲食與食品安全

items.def: the amount of food available to a population
items.s: The war cut off the city's ________, so prices rose quickly and many families could only afford one meal a day.
items.zh: 戰爭切斷了這座城市的糧食供應，所以物價迅速上漲，許多家庭一天只吃得起一餐。
items.sec: Food Supply, Trade & Waste 糧食供應、貿易與浪費

items.def: a situation in which there is not enough food
items.s: The drought caused a serious ________ in the region, and international groups sent rice and flour to help.
items.zh: 乾旱在該地區造成嚴重的糧食短缺，而國際組織送來了稻米和麵粉協助。
items.sec: Food Supply, Trade & Waste 糧食供應、貿易與浪費

items.def: the state of not having enough food to eat
items.s: Millions of people still suffer from ________ every day, although the world produces enough food for everyone.
items.zh: 每天仍有數百萬人遭受飢餓之苦，儘管全世界生產的糧食足夠每個人吃。
items.sec: Food Supply, Trade & Waste 糧食供應、貿易與浪費

items.def: food and other goods sold in a shop
items.s: We do our ________ shopping on Sunday mornings, because the market is less crowded and the vegetables are fresh.
items.zh: 我們都在星期天早上採買食品雜貨，因為市場人比較少，而且蔬菜很新鮮。
items.sec: Food Supply, Trade & Waste 糧食供應、貿易與浪費

items.def: a large shop that sells food and household goods
items.s: The ________ near my home sells vegetables from local farms, and the farmers' names and photos are printed on the packets.
items.zh: 我家附近的超市販售本地農場的蔬菜，而且包裝上印著農民的名字和照片。
items.sec: Food Supply, Trade & Waste 糧食供應、貿易與浪費

items.def: a business that sells large amounts of goods to shops
items.s: Farmers sell their cabbages to a ________, and he then sells them to restaurants and markets around the city.
items.zh: 農民把高麗菜賣給一位批發商，然後他再把它們賣給市區各地的餐廳和市場。
items.sec: Food Supply, Trade & Waste 糧食供應、貿易與浪費

items.def: a person who buys from producers and sells to shops or customers
items.s: Farmers often earn very little because the ________ takes a large share of the profit, so some now sell directly online.
items.zh: 農民常常賺得很少，因為中間商拿走大部分利潤，所以現在有些人直接在網路上販售。
items.sec: Food Supply, Trade & Waste 糧食供應、貿易與浪費

items.def: a market where farmers sell their own produce directly
items.s: Every Saturday there is a ________ near the park, and you can talk to the people who actually grew your vegetables.
items.zh: 每週六公園附近都有農夫市集，而且你可以和親手種出你蔬菜的人聊天。
items.sec: Food Supply, Trade & Waste 糧食供應、貿易與浪費

items.def: fruit and vegetables grown for sale
items.s: Fresh ________ from the mountains arrives at the market early in the morning, so chefs go there before sunrise to choose the best.
items.zh: 來自山區的新鮮農產品一大早就送到市場，所以廚師們在日出前就去挑選最好的。
items.sec: Food Supply, Trade & Waste 糧食供應、貿易與浪費

items.def: the distance food travels from where it is grown to where it is eaten
items.s: Buying local fruit reduces ________, because it does not have to be flown across the world before it reaches your table.
items.zh: 購買本地水果能減少食物里程，因為它不必飛越半個地球才送上你的餐桌。
items.sec: Food Supply, Trade & Waste 糧食供應、貿易與浪費

items.def: a system that pays farmers in poor countries a fair price
items.s: This coffee is sold under ________, so the farmers in Africa receive a fair price and can send their children to school.
items.zh: 這款咖啡以公平貿易方式販售，所以非洲的農民能得到合理的價格，並送孩子上學。
items.sec: Food Supply, Trade & Waste 糧食供應、貿易與浪費

items.def: limiting the amount of food each person may have
items.s: During the war, food ________ meant that each family could buy only a little sugar and meat each week.
items.zh: 戰爭期間，糧食配給代表每個家庭每週只能買一點點糖和肉。
items.sec: Food Supply, Trade & Waste 糧食供應、貿易與浪費

items.def: a place that gives free food to people in need
items.s: Our class collected canned food for the local ________, and the volunteers gave it to families who could not afford groceries.
items.zh: 我們班為當地的食物銀行收集罐頭食品，而志工把它們送給買不起食物的家庭。
items.sec: Food Supply, Trade & Waste 糧食供應、貿易與浪費

items.def: food that is thrown away instead of eaten
items.s: Restaurants produce a lot of ________ every night, so some now give unsold bread to charities instead of throwing it away.
items.zh: 餐廳每晚都產生大量廚餘，所以現在有些餐廳把沒賣完的麵包捐給慈善機構，而不是丟掉。
items.sec: Food Supply, Trade & Waste 糧食供應、貿易與浪費

items.def: food that remains after a meal
items.s: We often eat the ________ from Sunday dinner for lunch on Monday, so nothing goes to waste in our house.
items.zh: 我們常把星期天晚餐的剩菜當作星期一的午餐，所以我們家沒有東西會浪費。
items.sec: Food Supply, Trade & Waste 糧食供應、貿易與浪費

items.def: (of fruit or vegetables) not perfect in shape or appearance
items.s: The supermarket sells ________ carrots at half price, and customers have discovered that they taste just as good.
items.zh: 這家超市以半價販售賣相不佳的紅蘿蔔，而顧客們發現它們吃起來一樣美味。
items.sec: Food Supply, Trade & Waste 糧食供應、貿易與浪費

items.def: food given to countries or people in need
items.s: After the earthquake, ________ arrived from many countries, but the broken roads made it hard to reach mountain villages.
items.zh: 地震後，來自許多國家的糧食援助抵達了，但損毀的道路讓物資很難送到山區村莊。
items.sec: Food Supply, Trade & Waste 糧食供應、貿易與浪費

items.def: a store of grain kept for emergencies
items.s: The government keeps a large ________ of rice, so prices stay stable even when typhoons destroy part of the harvest.
items.zh: 政府保有大量的稻米儲備糧，所以即使颱風摧毀部分收成，價格也能保持穩定。
items.sec: Food Supply, Trade & Waste 糧食供應、貿易與浪費

items.def: insurance that pays farmers if their harvest is damaged
items.s: My uncle bought ________ for his banana farm, and it paid for most of his losses when the typhoon hit.
items.zh: 我叔叔為他的香蕉園買了農作物保險，而颱風來襲時，它賠償了他大部分的損失。
items.sec: Food Supply, Trade & Waste 糧食供應、貿易與浪費

items.def: farming run as a large industry
items.cn: 農業企業；農產綜合企業
items.s: Large ________ companies control much of the world's seed market, so small farmers often worry about rising prices.
items.zh: 大型農業企業控制了全球大部分的種子市場，所以小農常擔心價格上漲。
items.sec: Food Supply, Trade & Waste 糧食供應、貿易與浪費

items.def: a company that delivers goods from producers to shops
items.s: The milk ________ delivers to over two hundred stores every morning, so his trucks leave the factory before dawn.
items.zh: 這家牛奶經銷商每天早上配送到兩百多家商店，所以他的貨車天亮前就離開工廠。
items.sec: Food Supply, Trade & Waste 糧食供應、貿易與浪費

items.def: a truck with a cooling system for carrying fresh food
items.s: The fish is carried in a ________ from the port to Taipei, and the temperature inside is checked throughout the journey.
items.zh: 魚貨用冷藏車從港口運到台北，而且一路上都會檢查車內的溫度。
items.sec: Food Supply, Trade & Waste 糧食供應、貿易與浪費

items.def: keeping food in a cold place so it stays fresh
items.s: Apples can be kept in ________ for many months, so we can buy them all year, although they are picked only in autumn.
items.zh: 蘋果可以在冷藏庫裡保存好幾個月，所以儘管只在秋天採收，我們卻能全年買到。
items.sec: Food Supply, Trade & Waste 糧食供應、貿易與浪費

items.def: a sudden large increase in price
items.s: After the typhoon there was a big ________ for vegetables, so many families ate more tofu and eggs that week.
items.zh: 颱風過後蔬菜大幅漲價，所以那週許多家庭都多吃豆腐和雞蛋。
items.sec: Food Supply, Trade & Waste 糧食供應、貿易與浪費

items.def: buying large amounts at one time, usually at a lower price
items.s: ________ can save money for big families, but food may go bad if you buy more than you can eat.
items.zh: 大量採購可以為大家庭省錢，但如果你買的比吃得完的還多，食物就可能壞掉。
items.sec: Food Supply, Trade & Waste 糧食供應、貿易與浪費

items.def: a business that sells goods directly to the public
items.s: The ________ promised to stop selling eggs from caged hens by 2030, and other shops soon made the same promise.
items.zh: 這家零售商承諾在2030年前停止販售籠飼雞蛋，而其他商店很快也做出了同樣的承諾。
items.sec: Food Supply, Trade & Waste 糧食供應、貿易與浪費

items.def: small pieces of leftover food that are thrown away
items.s: In Taipei we put ________ in a special bin, and the city turns them into pig feed or fertiliser.
items.zh: 在台北我們把廚餘放進專用的桶子，而市政府會把它們變成豬飼料或肥料。
items.sec: Food Supply, Trade & Waste 糧食供應、貿易與浪費

items.def: a bag or box for taking home food you did not finish at a restaurant
items.s: We could not finish the huge pizza, so we asked the waiter for a ________ and took the rest home for breakfast.
items.zh: 我們吃不完那個超大披薩，所以我們跟服務生要了打包袋，把剩下的帶回家當早餐。
items.sec: Food Supply, Trade & Waste 糧食供應、貿易與浪費

items.def: to get used to a new climate or situation
items.s: The new rice variety needed two seasons to ________ to the cooler mountain weather, but now it grows as well as it does on the plains.
items.zh: 這個新稻種花了兩季才適應較涼的山區天氣，但現在它長得跟在平原上一樣好。

items.def: to make food worse by adding cheaper or harmful things
items.s: Some dishonest companies ________ honey with cheap sugar syrup, so experts test samples in the lab before they reach shops.
items.zh: 有些不肖公司用便宜的糖漿摻假蜂蜜，所以專家會在樣品進入商店前先在實驗室檢驗。

items.def: how cheap enough something is for people to buy
items.s: The ________ of fresh vegetables has become a problem since the typhoon, and many families now buy frozen ones instead.
items.zh: 颱風過後，新鮮蔬菜的可負擔性成了問題，而許多家庭現在改買冷凍蔬菜。

items.def: the attractive or exciting quality of something
items.s: The ________ of city jobs draws young people away from farming villages, so many fields are now looked after by elderly farmers.
items.zh: 城市工作的吸引力讓年輕人離開農村，所以現在許多田地都由年長的農民照料。

items.def: the state of having more than one possible meaning
items.s: There is some ________ in the word 'natural' on food labels, so shoppers may think a product is healthier than it really is.
items.zh: 食品標籤上「天然」這個詞有些模稜兩可，所以消費者可能以為產品比實際更健康。

items.def: to destroy something completely
items.s: A swarm of locusts can ________ a whole field of wheat in a single day, and farmers can do almost nothing to stop it.
items.zh: 一大群蝗蟲能在一天之內徹底摧毀整片麥田，而農民幾乎束手無策。

items.def: different from what is normal or expected
items.s: The scientists found ________ levels of chemicals in the river near the farm, so they took more samples to check the results.
items.zh: 科學家在農場附近的河流中發現異常的化學物質含量，所以他們採集更多樣本來確認結果。

items.def: something that reduces the bad effects of another thing
items.s: Home cooking can be an ________ to fast-food culture, and it also gives families a chance to talk at the dinner table.
items.zh: 在家做飯可以是速食文化的解藥，而且它也讓家人有機會在餐桌上聊天。

items.def: to divide something and share it out
items.s: The village committee had to ________ the limited water between the farms, but every farmer believed he deserved more.
items.zh: 村委會必須把有限的水分配給各個農場，但每位農民都認為自己應該分到更多。

items.def: a strong hope to achieve something
items.s: Her ________ is to run an organic farm in Hualien, so she is studying soil science and saving money every month.
items.zh: 她的志向是在花蓮經營一座有機農場，所以她正在研讀土壤科學，並且每個月存錢。

items.def: to take in and fully understand information or ideas
items.s: Young farmers ________ new technology quickly, while older farmers often need more time and practical examples.
items.zh: 年輕農民很快就能吸收新科技，而年長的農民常需要更多時間和實際例子。

items.def: very surprising or shocking
items.s: The amount of food wasted every year is ________, and one third of all food never reaches anyone's mouth.
items.zh: 每年浪費的食物量驚人，而所有食物中有三分之一從來沒有被吃進任何人的嘴裡。

items.def: possible to achieve
items.s: The goal of halving food waste is ________, but only if shops, restaurants and families all change their habits.
items.zh: 將食物浪費減半的目標是可以達成的，但前提是商店、餐廳和家庭都要改變習慣。

items.def: a situation in which people have less money and must spend carefully
items.s: During the years of ________, many families grew vegetables in their gardens, and they rarely ate in restaurants.
items.zh: 在撙節的那些年，許多家庭在院子裡種菜，而且他們很少上館子吃飯。

items.def: the quality of being real or true
items.s: Customers question the ________ of 'local' honey that is sold so cheaply, and some samples turned out to be imported.
items.zh: 顧客質疑那些賣得如此便宜的「本地」蜂蜜的真實性，而有些樣本後來證實是進口的。

items.def: strongly disliking or not wanting something
items.s: Many older farmers are ________ to taking risks, so they keep growing the same crops that their parents grew.
items.zh: 許多年長的農民不願意冒險，所以他們繼續種植父母那一代所種的作物。

items.def: the most important part that supports a system
items.s: Small family farms are the ________ of the local economy, so the closing of even one farm affects the whole village.
items.zh: 小型家庭農場是當地經濟的支柱，所以即使只有一座農場關閉，也會影響整個村莊。

items.def: happening or coming later than it should
items.s: The government made a ________ attempt to help the banana farmers, but by then many of them had already lost their land.
items.zh: 政府遲來地嘗試幫助香蕉農，但那時他們許多人已經失去了土地。

items.def: a person who gets an advantage from something
items.s: The main ________ of the new irrigation system was the village school, because it could finally grow its own vegetables.
items.zh: 新灌溉系統的主要受益者是村裡的學校，因為它終於能種自己的蔬菜了。

items.def: in large amounts; plentiful
items.s: The rain came at the right time this year, so the harvest was ________ and the farmers held a big festival.
items.zh: 今年雨水來得正是時候，所以收成豐碩，而農民們舉辦了一場盛大的慶典。

items.def: a series of things that happen one after another
items.s: The drought caused a ________ of problems, because crops failed, food prices rose and many workers lost their jobs.
items.zh: 乾旱引發了一連串的問題，因為作物歉收、糧價上漲，許多工人也失去了工作。

items.def: a sudden event that causes great damage
items.s: A failed rice harvest would be a ________ for the region, so scientists are working hard on flood-resistant seeds.
items.zh: 稻米歉收對這個地區會是一場大災難，所以科學家正努力研發耐洪水的種子。

items.def: the stopping of something
items.s: The ________ of fighting allowed farmers to return to their fields, and food began to reach the markets again.
items.zh: 戰事的停止讓農民得以回到田裡，而食物也開始重新送到市場。

items.def: secret and often illegal
items.s: Police discovered a ________ factory that was making fake cooking oil, and it had been selling to night markets for years.
items.zh: 警方發現了一家祕密製造假食用油的工廠，而且它已經賣給夜市好幾年了。

items.def: rough and not fine or smooth
items.s: The flour from the old stone mill is ________, but the bread has a rich taste, so tourists queue to buy it.
items.zh: 老石磨磨出的麵粉很粗，但做出的麵包風味濃郁，所以遊客都排隊購買。

items.def: happening as an extra, unplanned result of something
items.s: The chemicals killed the insects, but there was ________ damage to the bees, and the fruit trees produced less fruit.
items.zh: 化學藥劑殺死了害蟲，但也對蜜蜂造成附帶傷害，而果樹的結果量也減少了。

items.def: the ability to exist or work together without problems
items.s: The farmer tested the ________ of the two plants, because some crops grow badly when they are planted side by side.
items.zh: 農夫測試了兩種植物的相容性，因為有些作物並排種植時會長得不好。

items.def: adding something useful so that two things work well together
items.s: Rice and beans have ________ proteins, so eating them together gives the body what it needs.
items.zh: 米和豆類的蛋白質是互補的，所以一起吃能提供身體所需的營養。

items.def: made of several different parts or materials
items.s: The report used a ________ score based on price, safety and taste, and the local brand came first.
items.zh: 這份報告採用以價格、安全和口味為基礎的綜合分數，而本地品牌拿下第一名。

items.def: to make something by mixing different things, often in a new way
items.s: The chef likes to ________ new sauces from local fruit, and his mango chilli dip has become very popular.
items.zh: 這位主廚喜歡用本地水果調製新醬料，而他的芒果辣椒沾醬已經大受歡迎。

items.def: to confuse or surprise someone because it is unexpected
items.s: The tiny farm's huge harvest ________ the experts, because it used no chemicals at all.
items.zh: 這座小農場的大豐收讓專家們大感困惑，因為它完全沒有使用任何化學藥劑。

items.def: an expert who knows a lot about food, drink or art
items.s: My uncle is a tea ________, and he can tell which mountain a tea comes from just by smelling it.
items.zh: 我叔叔是茶葉行家，而且他光聞味道就能說出茶來自哪座山。

items.def: a quantity of goods sent to someone
items.s: A ________ of mangoes was stopped at the border, because officials found insects inside some of the boxes.
items.zh: 一批芒果在邊境被攔下，因為官員在部分箱子裡發現了昆蟲。

items.def: a substance that makes something dirty or unsafe
items.s: The lab found a dangerous ________ in the river water, so farmers were told not to use it for their crops.
items.zh: 實驗室在河水中發現了一種危險的污染物，所以農民被告知不要用它灌溉作物。

items.def: to manage to do something difficult, often by being clever
items.s: The family ________ to feed six children on a very small income, and the mother grew most of their vegetables herself.
items.zh: 這家人以很微薄的收入設法養活了六個孩子，而母親自己種了大部分的蔬菜。

items.def: a natural result of something else
items.s: Cheaper food is one ________ of modern farming, but another is the loss of many small family farms.
items.zh: 更便宜的食物是現代農業的一個必然結果，但另一個結果則是許多小型家庭農場的消失。

items.def: made to look real in order to trick people
items.s: Police seized thousands of bottles of ________ wine, and the labels looked so real that shops had no idea.
items.zh: 警方查獲了數千瓶仿冒葡萄酒，而標籤看起來太逼真，連商店都毫不知情。

items.def: to reduce the quality or value of something
items.s: Adding cheap oil would ________ the quality of the olive oil, so the brand checks every batch carefully.
items.zh: 添加便宜的油會降低橄欖油的品質，所以這個品牌仔細檢查每一批產品。

items.def: to make someone lose confidence or hope
items.s: The terrible harvest ________ the young farmer, but his neighbours encouraged him to try again the next year.
items.zh: 糟糕的收成讓這位年輕農夫很洩氣，但鄰居們鼓勵他明年再試一次。

items.def: a rare or expensive food that is special to eat
items.s: Mullet roe is a ________ in Taiwan, so families often give it as a gift during Lunar New Year.
items.zh: 烏魚子在台灣是一種珍饈，所以家家戶戶常在農曆新年時把它當作禮物送人。

items.def: the reduction of something until little is left
items.s: The ________ of groundwater is a serious issue in the south, and some land has sunk below sea level.
items.zh: 地下水枯竭是南部嚴重的問題，而有些土地已經下陷到海平面以下。

items.def: a layer of something left by water or natural processes
items.s: The river leaves a rich ________ of mud after each flood, so the farmland along its banks is very fertile.
items.zh: 每次洪水過後河流都會留下一層肥沃的泥沉積物，所以沿岸的農地非常肥沃。

items.def: the removal of government rules from an industry
items.s: The ________ of rice prices helped some farmers earn more, but others struggled because big companies paid them less.
items.zh: 米價鬆綁讓部分農民賺得更多，但其他人卻過得很辛苦，因為大公司付給他們的錢更少了。

items.def: to eat something quickly and hungrily
items.s: The hungry caterpillars ________ the cabbage leaves overnight, so the farmer found only holes in the morning.
items.zh: 飢餓的毛毛蟲一夜之間吞食了高麗菜葉，所以農夫早上只看到滿是破洞。

items.def: able to judge the quality of something well
items.s: ________ shoppers check where their vegetables come from, and they are willing to pay more for local produce.
items.zh: 有眼光的消費者會查看蔬菜的產地，而且他們願意為本地農產品多付錢。

items.def: something that makes people less willing to do something
items.s: Low prices are a ________ for young farmers, so few of them want to grow rice like their grandparents did.
items.zh: 低價是年輕農民的阻礙，所以他們之中很少人想像祖父母那樣種稻。

items.def: the amount of a medicine or chemical given at one time
items.s: The vet checked the ________ carefully before treating the cows, because too much medicine could end up in the milk.
items.zh: 獸醫在治療乳牛前仔細確認劑量，因為過多的藥物可能會殘留在牛奶裡。

items.def: to slowly become less or weaker
items.s: Interest in the new diet began to ________ after a few months, and the shop stopped selling the special products.
items.zh: 對這種新飲食法的興趣在幾個月後開始減退，而商店也停止販售那些特殊產品。

items.def: how much demand changes when prices change
items.s: Rice has low price ________, so people still buy it when it becomes more expensive, but they cut back on snacks.
items.zh: 米的價格彈性很低，所以即使變貴了人們仍會購買，但他們會減少吃零食。

items.def: an official ban on trade with another country
items.s: The ________ on pork exports hurt farmers badly, so the government gave them money to survive.
items.zh: 豬肉出口禁運嚴重打擊了農民，所以政府發放補助金讓他們度過難關。

items.def: not connected to the main subject; unnecessary
items.s: The recipe contains no ________ ingredients, and it uses only rice, water and a little salt.
items.zh: 這份食譜不含任何多餘的食材，而且只用米、水和一點點鹽。

items.def: to understand something difficult
items.s: Many city children cannot ________ how much work goes into growing rice, so the school takes them to a farm every year.
items.zh: 許多城市孩子無法理解種稻需要付出多少勞力，所以學校每年都帶他們去農場。

items.def: a change up and down in amount or level
items.s: The ________ in vegetable prices is huge in Taiwan, because one typhoon can destroy crops across the whole island.
items.zh: 台灣菜價的波動很大，因為一個颱風就能摧毀全島的作物。

items.def: happening by lucky chance
items.s: The discovery of the new tea flavour was ________, because insects bit the leaves and changed their taste.
items.zh: 這種新茶風味的發現是偶然的，因為昆蟲咬了葉子而改變了它們的味道。

items.def: the point at which a plan becomes real
items.s: Her dream of opening a farm cafe finally came to ________ last year, and it is now full of visitors every weekend.
items.zh: 她開農場咖啡館的夢想終於在去年實現，而現在每個週末都擠滿了遊客。

items.def: too much of something, more than is needed
items.s: There was a ________ of cabbages this winter, so prices fell sharply and some farmers left them to rot in the field.
items.zh: 今年冬天高麗菜供過於求，所以價格暴跌，有些農民乾脆讓它們爛在田裡。

items.def: to please someone or satisfy a desire
items.s: It ________ the farmers to see children enjoying their fruit, and they invited the class to visit again next year.
items.zh: 看到孩子們享用他們的水果讓農民們很欣慰，而且他們邀請這個班級明年再來參觀。

items.def: strong and able to survive difficult conditions
items.s: Sweet potatoes are ________ plants, so they can grow in poor soil where rice would never survive.
items.zh: 地瓜是生命力強的植物，所以它們能在稻米絕對無法存活的貧瘠土壤中生長。

items.def: an amount of something that has been caught or taken
items.s: The fishermen came back with a huge ________ of squid, so the harbour market was busy all night.
items.zh: 漁夫們帶回了大量的魷魚漁獲，所以港口市場整晚都很熱鬧。

items.def: large in amount, especially money
items.s: The restaurant received a ________ fine for using expired meat, and it lost many customers after the news spread.
items.zh: 這家餐廳因使用過期肉品而被處以高額罰款，而且消息傳開後失去了許多顧客。

items.def: too small to be noticed
items.s: The change in taste was almost ________, but the company had cut the sugar by twenty percent.
items.zh: 口味的改變幾乎察覺不到，但公司已經把糖減少了百分之二十。

items.def: not affected by something, or not letting water through
items.s: The new rice seems ________ to the disease, so farmers who planted it saved their whole harvest.
items.zh: 這種新稻米似乎不受這種病害影響，所以種植它的農民保住了整季的收成。

items.def: difficult to believe
items.s: The advert's claim that the tea can cure every illness is ________, so the government ordered the company to remove it.
items.zh: 廣告宣稱這款茶能治百病的說法令人難以置信，所以政府命令公司撤下廣告。

items.def: happening as a minor part of something else
items.s: Saving money was only an ________ benefit, because the main reason she grew vegetables was to relax after work.
items.zh: 省錢只是附帶的好處，因為她種菜的主要原因是下班後放鬆。

items.def: not able to exist or work together
items.s: Cheap food and fair wages for farmers can seem ________, but fair trade shows that both are possible.
items.zh: 便宜的食物與農民的合理工資看似互相抵觸，但公平貿易證明兩者可以兼得。

items.def: not giving a clear result
items.s: The study on coffee and health was ________, so scientists plan to follow more people for a longer time.
items.zh: 這項咖啡與健康的研究沒有定論，所以科學家計畫追蹤更多人更長的時間。

items.def: to allow yourself to enjoy something special
items.s: I ________ in a big slice of cake after my exams, but I usually try to avoid sweet food.
items.zh: 考完試後我會放縱自己吃一大塊蛋糕，但平常我盡量避免吃甜食。

items.def: not fit or safe to eat
