items.s: Some wild mushrooms look delicious but are ________, so you should never pick them unless an expert is with you.
items.zh: 有些野生菇類看起來很美味，卻是不能吃的，所以除非有專家同行，否則你絕不該採摘。

items.def: not producing a chemical reaction
items.s: The gas used in the snack bags is ________, so it keeps the chips fresh and does not change their taste.
items.zh: 零食袋裡使用的氣體是惰性的，所以它能保持洋芋片新鮮，又不會改變味道。

items.def: a drink made by soaking leaves or fruit in hot water; or adding something new
items.s: The government's ________ of money into agritech has attracted young people, and several new start-ups have opened.
items.zh: 政府對農業科技的資金注入吸引了年輕人，而且已經有好幾家新創公司成立。

items.def: too many to be counted
items.s: There are ________ ways to cook tofu, so my grandmother never serves it the same way twice in a week.
items.zh: 豆腐有無數種料理方式，所以我奶奶一週內從不用同一種方式煮它。

items.def: unable to pay debts
items.s: Several pig farms became ________ after the disease outbreak, and the owners had to sell their land.
items.zh: 疫情爆發後，好幾座養豬場無力償債，而場主們只好賣掉土地。

items.def: happening immediately
items.s: The effect of the new app was almost ________, because farmers could suddenly sell directly to customers.
items.zh: 這款新應用程式的效果幾乎是立竿見影的，因為農民突然間就能直接賣給顧客。

items.def: the amount of food or drink you take into your body
items.s: Doctors advise teenagers to reduce their sugar ________, because too much can harm their teeth and health.
items.zh: 醫生建議青少年減少糖的攝取量，因為攝取過多會傷害牙齒和健康。

items.def: too bad to be repaired or put right
items.cn: 無法挽回的；不可修復的
items.s: The chemical spill caused ________ damage to the farmland, so the owners could never grow crops there again.
items.zh: 化學物質外洩對農地造成無法挽回的損害，所以地主再也無法在那裡種植作物。

items.def: showing good judgement
items.s: With ________ use of water, the farm survived the drought, while neighbouring farms lost most of their crops.
items.zh: 透過審慎的用水，這座農場撐過了乾旱，而鄰近的農場卻損失了大部分的作物。

items.def: the quality of being less strict than expected
items.s: The court showed no ________ to the company that sold fake oil, and the owner was sent to prison.
items.zh: 法院對販售假油的公司毫不寬貸，而老闆被送進了監獄。

items.def: based on wrong ideas or judgement
items.s: The idea that all fat is bad is ________, because our bodies need healthy fats from fish and nuts.
items.zh: 所有脂肪都不好的觀念是錯誤的，因為我們的身體需要從魚和堅果中攝取健康的脂肪。

items.def: bad or careless control of something
items.s: The water shortage was caused partly by ________, because old pipes leaked and nobody repaired them.
items.zh: 缺水的部分原因是管理不當，因為老舊的水管漏水卻沒有人修理。

items.def: to give a living thing the food it needs to grow
items.s: Breast milk ________ babies in their first months, and it also protects them from many diseases.
items.zh: 母乳在嬰兒出生後的頭幾個月滋養他們，而且也保護他們免於許多疾病。

items.def: food needed to live and grow
items.s: The plants get ________ from the fish waste in the water, so the farmer does not need to add fertiliser.
items.zh: 植物從水中的魚排泄物獲得養分，所以農夫不需要添加肥料。

items.def: harmful or poisonous
items.s: The factory released ________ gases near the farms, and the farmers noticed brown spots on their vegetables.
items.zh: 工廠在農場附近排放了有毒氣體，而農民注意到他們的蔬菜上出現了褐色斑點。

items.def: the state of becoming old-fashioned and no longer used
items.s: Hand tools are heading towards ________ on large farms, but many small farmers in the mountains still use them every day.
items.zh: 在大型農場上手工具正逐漸走向淘汰，但山區許多小農仍然每天使用它們。

items.def: something that develops from something larger
items.s: The farm cafe began as an ________ of the family's fruit business, but now it earns more money than the orchard.
items.zh: 這間農場咖啡館起初只是家族水果事業的分支，但現在它賺的錢比果園還多。

items.def: happening at a suitable time
items.s: The rain came at an ________ moment, because the rice plants needed water just as the dry season was starting.
items.zh: 雨來得正是時候，因為乾季剛開始時稻子正需要水。

items.def: too large an amount of something
items.s: An ________ of choice in supermarkets can confuse shoppers, so some stores now offer fewer brands.
items.zh: 超市選擇過多可能會讓消費者困惑，所以有些商店現在提供較少的品牌。

items.def: using or eating too much of something
items.s: The ________ of meat in rich countries puts pressure on land and water, so experts suggest eating more beans.
items.zh: 富裕國家對肉類的過度消費對土地和水資源造成壓力，所以專家建議多吃豆類。

items.def: producing more of something than people need
items.s: ________ of milk caused prices to fall, so some farmers poured it away because they could not sell it.
items.zh: 牛奶生產過剩導致價格下跌，所以有些農民因為賣不出去而把牛奶倒掉。

items.def: to describe something as bigger or more important than it really is
items.s: Food companies sometimes ________ the health benefits of their products, so you should read the label carefully.
items.zh: 食品公司有時會誇大產品的健康益處，所以你應該仔細閱讀標籤。

items.def: pleasant enough to eat, or acceptable
items.s: The chef added herbs to make the vegetables more ________, and the children finally finished their plates.
items.zh: 主廚加了香草讓蔬菜更可口，而孩子們終於把盤子裡的東西吃完了。

items.def: having a harmful effect, especially slowly and secretly
items.s: Sugary drinks have a ________ effect on children's teeth, so the school has stopped selling them.
items.zh: 含糖飲料對兒童牙齒有有害的影響，所以學校已經停止販售。

items.def: to be connected with a particular subject
items.s: These rules ________ to all restaurants in the city, so even small noodle stalls must follow them.
items.zh: 這些規定適用於市內所有餐廳，所以即使是小麵攤也必須遵守。

items.def: the strength of something, such as a drug or chemical
items.s: The ________ of the pesticide was so high that it killed helpful insects too, so the farmer switched to a gentler product.
items.zh: 這種農藥的效力太強，連益蟲也一起殺死了，所以農夫改用較溫和的產品。

items.def: sudden and very large (of a fall)
items.s: There was a ________ drop in banana prices last month, and many farmers lost money on every box they sold.
items.zh: 上個月香蕉價格急遽下跌，而許多農民每賣一箱都在賠錢。

items.def: trying to take advantage of weaker people
items.s: Some lenders use ________ practices with poor farmers, so the government offers low-interest loans instead.
items.zh: 有些放款人對貧窮農民採取掠奪性的手段，所以政府改為提供低利貸款。

items.def: a larger number or amount of one kind than others
items.s: There is a ________ of elderly workers on Taiwan's farms, so experts worry about who will grow food in the future.
items.zh: 台灣的農場上以年長工作者居多，所以專家擔心未來由誰來種植糧食。

items.def: common or widespread at a particular time
items.s: Eating breakfast outside is ________ in Taiwan, and there is a breakfast shop on almost every street corner.
items.zh: 在台灣外食早餐很普遍，而且幾乎每個街角都有一家早餐店。

items.def: the process of buying supplies for an organisation
items.s: The school changed its ________ rules, so it now buys rice and vegetables directly from farms in the county.
items.zh: 學校修改了採購規定，所以現在直接向縣內的農場購買米和蔬菜。

items.def: very large or impressive
items.s: The festival needs a ________ amount of rice, so the organisers order it from several farms months in advance.
items.zh: 這個節慶需要驚人的米量，所以主辦單位提前好幾個月向多座農場訂購。

items.def: a very large amount of something
items.s: In spring the orchard is a ________ of white flowers, and bees come from miles around to visit them.
items.zh: 春天時果園開滿大量白花，而蜜蜂從好幾哩外飛來拜訪它們。

items.def: so expensive that people cannot afford it
items.s: The cost of a vertical farm is ________ for most small farmers, so only large companies can build one.
items.zh: 垂直農場的成本對大多數小農來說高得令人卻步，所以只有大公司蓋得起。

items.def: the state of being important or well known
items.s: Plant-based food has gained ________ in recent years, and even fast-food chains now offer vegetarian burgers.
items.zh: 近年來植物性食品逐漸取得重要地位，而且連速食連鎖店現在都提供素食漢堡。

items.def: owned by a company and protected by law
items.s: The company keeps its sauce recipe ________, so only three people in the factory know all the ingredients.
items.zh: 這家公司把醬料配方列為專有機密，所以工廠裡只有三個人知道全部的成分。

items.def: careful and sensible judgement
items.s: Farmers show ________ by saving part of their seeds every year, so they can replant if a typhoon destroys the crop.
items.zh: 農民每年保留一部分種子，展現了他們的審慎，這樣如果颱風摧毀作物，他們就能重新播種。

items.def: to give something to a different person or purpose
items.s: The government decided to ________ water from factories to farms during the drought, but factory owners were unhappy.
items.zh: 政府決定在乾旱期間把工廠的用水重新分配給農場，但工廠老闆們很不高興。

items.def: exchanging things with others for mutual benefit
items.s: Village life was based on ________, because neighbours helped each other at harvest time and shared food.
items.zh: 鄉村生活建立在互惠的基礎上，因為鄰居們在收成時互相幫忙並分享食物。

items.def: to recover after an illness or a difficult time
items.s: The land needs a few years to ________ after the flood, so the farmers are growing grass there for now.
items.zh: 洪水過後，這塊土地需要幾年時間來恢復，所以農民目前在那裡種草。

items.def: to share something out again in a different way
items.s: The app helps shops ________ unsold food to charities, so less bread and fruit end up in the bin.
items.zh: 這款應用程式幫助商店把沒賣完的食物重新分配給慈善機構，所以較少的麵包和水果最後被丟進垃圾桶。

items.def: to go back to an earlier, worse state
items.s: Without new young farmers, the village's farming could ________, and old fields could turn back into forest.
items.zh: 如果沒有新的年輕農民，村裡的農業可能會倒退，而老田也可能重新變回森林。

items.def: the state of depending on something
items.s: Taiwan's ________ on imported wheat worries some experts, because a global crisis could suddenly cut supplies.
items.zh: 台灣對進口小麥的依賴讓一些專家擔憂，因為全球危機可能突然切斷供應。

items.def: remaining after most of something has gone
items.s: The lab found ________ pesticide on the vegetables, so the farmer was told to wait longer before harvesting.
items.zh: 實驗室在蔬菜上發現殘留的農藥，所以農夫被告知要等更久才能採收。

items.def: to satisfy hunger completely
items.s: A bowl of beef noodle soup can ________ even a very hungry student, and it costs less than a fast-food meal.
items.zh: 一碗牛肉麵就能讓即使非常餓的學生吃飽，而且比一份速食餐還便宜。

items.def: to enjoy the taste of food slowly
items.s: My grandfather likes to ________ his tea slowly, and he says that people today eat and drink far too quickly.
items.zh: 我爺爺喜歡慢慢地品味他的茶，而且他說現在的人吃喝都太快了。

items.def: something that causes great trouble or suffering
items.s: Locusts have been a ________ for farmers for thousands of years, and swarms still destroy crops in parts of Africa.
items.zh: 數千年來蝗蟲一直是農民的禍害，而在非洲部分地區，蝗群至今仍在摧毀作物。

items.def: the way something changes with the seasons
items.s: The ________ of fruit means that mangoes are cheap in summer, but you can hardly find them in winter.
items.zh: 水果的季節性意味著芒果在夏天很便宜，但冬天幾乎買不到。

items.def: the ability to produce everything you need yourself
items.s: Taiwan's food ________ rate is only about thirty percent, so the country imports most of its grain.
items.zh: 台灣的糧食自給率只有大約百分之三十，所以國家大部分的穀物都仰賴進口。

items.def: to store or capture something, such as carbon, so it is kept away
items.s: Healthy soil can ________ carbon from the air, so better farming could help fight climate change.
items.zh: 健康的土壤能封存空氣中的碳，所以更好的耕作方式有助於對抗氣候變遷。

items.def: clever at understanding situations and making good decisions
items.s: The ________ farmer sold his crop before the price fell, and his neighbours wished they had done the same.
items.zh: 這位精明的農夫在價格下跌前就賣掉了作物，而他的鄰居們都希望自己也這麼做了。

items.def: to cover something completely so it cannot breathe or grow
items.s: Thick weeds can ________ young plants, so farmers remove them before the seedlings lose their sunlight.
items.zh: 茂密的雜草會悶死幼小的植物，所以農民會在幼苗失去陽光前把它們清除。

items.def: the process of finding where to get supplies
items.s: The restaurant is proud of its local ________, and every vegetable comes from farms less than fifty kilometres away.
items.zh: 這家餐廳以在地採購為傲，而且每一種蔬菜都來自五十公里內的農場。

items.def: in small amounts; not much
items.s: Use salt ________ when you cook for elderly people, because too much can raise their blood pressure.
items.zh: 為長者烹調時要少量使用鹽，因為太多可能會讓他們的血壓升高。

items.def: a state of no growth or change
items.s: Farm incomes have been in ________ for years, so many young people choose office jobs in the city.
items.zh: 農業收入多年來一直處於停滯，所以許多年輕人選擇到城市從事辦公室工作。

items.def: to manage to stay alive with very little food or money
items.s: During the war, families had to ________ on sweet potatoes, and rice was a luxury for special days.
items.zh: 戰爭期間，家家戶戶只能靠地瓜勉強維生，而白米是特殊日子才吃得到的奢侈品。

items.def: real, important and serious
items.s: The new law brought ________ changes to food labels, so shoppers can now see clearly where ingredients come from.
items.zh: 新法為食品標示帶來了實質的改變，所以消費者現在能清楚看到成分的來源。

items.def: juicy and delicious
items.s: The pineapples from Pingtung are sweet and ________, so they are sent as gifts to friends overseas.
items.zh: 屏東的鳳梨又甜又多汁，所以人們把它們當作禮物寄給海外的朋友。

items.def: to be enough
items.s: A small fridge will ________ for one person, but a family of five needs a much larger one.
items.zh: 小冰箱對一個人來說就足夠了，但五口之家需要大得多的冰箱。

items.def: how easily something is affected or harmed
items.s: Bananas have a high ________ to disease, because almost all of them are genetically identical.
items.zh: 香蕉對病害的易感性很高，因為它們幾乎全都基因相同。

items.def: food and drink that keeps someone alive
items.s: For many poor families, rice is the main source of ________, so a rise in its price can cause real hunger.
items.zh: 對許多貧困家庭來說，米是主要的糧食來源，所以它的價格上漲可能會造成真正的飢餓。

items.def: showing that a bigger problem exists
items.s: Empty fields are ________ of a deeper problem, because young people do not see a future in farming.
items.zh: 荒廢的田地反映出更深層的問題，因為年輕人看不到務農的未來。

items.def: to change something without permission, often to cause harm
items.s: Someone tried to ________ with the labels on the milk cartons, so the shop removed them all from the shelves.
items.zh: 有人企圖竄改牛奶盒上的標籤，所以商店把它們全部從架上撤下。

items.def: equal in effect to something worse
items.s: Selling expired meat to families is ________ to poisoning customers on purpose, so the punishment is very serious.
items.zh: 把過期肉品賣給家庭等同於故意毒害顧客，所以懲罰非常嚴厲。

items.def: able to be defended or kept going
items.s: Growing rice on such dry land is no longer ________, so the farmers are switching to crops that need less water.
items.zh: 在這麼乾燥的土地上種稻已經無法維持了，所以農民正改種需水量較少的作物。

items.def: acceptable, though not very good
items.s: The food at the camp was ________, but everyone was so hungry after hiking that nobody complained.
items.zh: 營地的食物還過得去，但健行後大家都餓壞了，所以沒有人抱怨。

items.def: how poisonous something is
items.s: Scientists measured the ________ of the new pesticide, and they found it was too dangerous for fish in nearby rivers.
items.zh: 科學家測量了新農藥的毒性，而他們發現它對附近河流中的魚類太危險了。

items.def: the ability to follow where a product came from
items.s: The QR code improves ________, so customers can see which farm grew their rice and when it was harvested.
items.zh: 這個QR碼提升了可追溯性，所以顧客能看到哪座農場種了他們的米，以及何時收割。

items.def: not limited by rules
items.s: ________ use of chemicals damaged the land for decades, so stricter rules were finally introduced.
items.zh: 不受限制地使用化學藥劑破壞了土地數十年，所以終於訂定了更嚴格的規定。

items.def: not able to continue at the same level
items.s: Pumping so much groundwater is ________, because the land is sinking and the wells are drying up.
items.zh: 抽取這麼多地下水是不可持續的，因為土地正在下陷，水井也在乾涸。

items.def: a sudden increase
items.s: There has been an ________ in home gardening since the pandemic, and seed shops have sold out of many vegetables.
items.zh: 疫情以來居家園藝出現了激增，而種子店的許多蔬菜種子都已經賣光了。

items.def: the leading position in developing new ideas
items.s: The Netherlands is in the ________ of greenhouse farming, so experts from many countries go there to learn.
items.zh: 荷蘭處於溫室農業的先鋒地位，所以許多國家的專家都去那裡學習。

items.def: able to be checked and proved true
items.s: The organic label must be based on ________ tests, so inspectors visit farms and take soil samples.
items.zh: 有機標章必須以可驗證的檢測為依據，所以稽查員會造訪農場並採集土壤樣本。

items.def: the ability to work successfully
items.s: The bank questioned the ________ of the indoor farm, because electricity costs were so high.
items.zh: 銀行質疑這座室內農場的可行性，因為電費實在太高了。

items.def: eating or wanting a very large amount
items.s: Teenage boys often have ________ appetites, so their parents are surprised by how much rice they eat.
items.zh: 青春期男孩常常食量驚人，所以他們的父母對他們吃那麼多飯感到驚訝。

items.def: the state of being easily hurt or damaged
items.s: The typhoon showed the ________ of the island's food supply, because vegetable prices doubled within days.
items.zh: 颱風顯示出這座島嶼糧食供應的脆弱性，因為蔬菜價格在幾天內就翻倍了。

items.def: to make someone stop depending on something
items.s: The campaign tries to ________ students off sugary drinks, so the school offers free cold water instead.
items.zh: 這項運動試圖讓學生戒掉含糖飲料，所以學校改為提供免費的冰開水。

items.def: to refuse to give something
items.s: The supermarket ________ payment from the farm, because the vegetables arrived late and many were damaged.
items.zh: 超市扣留了對農場的付款，因為蔬菜送達得太晚，而且許多都已損壞。

items.def: great energy and enthusiasm
items.s: The young farmers worked with great ________, and they turned the empty fields into a thriving organic farm.
items.zh: 年輕農民們滿懷熱忱地工作，並把空地變成了一座欣欣向榮的有機農場。

items.def: something added to a more important thing
items.s: Vitamin pills should only be an ________ to a healthy diet, so doctors say you cannot live on pills alone.
items.zh: 維他命丸只應該作為健康飲食的輔助，所以醫生說你不能只靠藥丸過活。

items.def: providing extra help or support
items.s: The farm earns ________ income from school visits, and this money helps when the harvest is poor.
items.zh: 這座農場從學校參訪中獲得附加收入，而這筆錢在收成不佳時很有幫助。

items.def: to make something weaker or less strong
items.s: Trees planted around the fields can ________ strong winds, so the crops are less likely to be damaged.
items.zh: 在田地周圍種樹可以減弱強風，所以作物比較不容易受損。

items.def: giving extra help or support
items.s: The farm installed an ________ generator, so the fridges keep working even when a typhoon cuts the power.
items.zh: 這座農場安裝了一台備用發電機，所以即使颱風造成停電，冰箱也能繼續運作。

items.def: the basic idea or thing on which others are built
items.s: Trust is the ________ of the food business, so one safety scandal can ruin a famous brand.
items.zh: 信任是食品業的根本，所以一起食安醜聞就能毀掉一個知名品牌。

items.def: to have an equal but opposite effect on something
items.s: Higher prices for organic food ________ the smaller harvests, so organic farmers can still earn a living.
items.zh: 有機食品較高的價格抵銷了較少的收成，所以有機農民仍能維持生計。

items.def: the opposite of what you would expect
items.s: It seems ________, but leaving some weeds in the field can actually help crops, because they attract useful insects.
items.zh: 這似乎違反直覺，但在田裡留一些雜草其實對作物有幫助，因為它們能吸引益蟲。

items.def: happening in a repeated pattern
items.s: Pig prices are ________, so they rise for a few years and then fall when too many farmers start raising pigs.
items.zh: 豬價是週期性的，所以它們會上漲幾年，然後在太多農民開始養豬時下跌。

items.def: making you believe something false
items.s: The packaging is ________, because the box is large but there are only a few cookies inside.
items.zh: 這個包裝很誤導人，因為盒子很大，裡面卻只有幾片餅乾。

items.def: decided by a person's own choice
items.s: Families spend less on ________ items like snacks when food prices rise, but they still buy rice and eggs.
items.zh: 當食物價格上漲時，家庭會減少在零食等非必需品上的花費，但他們仍然會買米和蛋。

items.def: causing strong disagreement between people
items.s: The import of American pork was a ________ issue in Taiwan, and people argued about it for months.
items.zh: 進口美國豬肉在台灣是個引發分歧的議題，而人們為此爭論了好幾個月。

items.def: extremely bad and obvious
items.s: The restaurant's ________ hygiene failures, such as rats in the kitchen, shocked the inspectors, so it was closed down immediately.
items.zh: 這家餐廳極其惡劣的衛生缺失，例如廚房裡有老鼠，讓稽查員大為震驚，所以它被立即勒令停業。

items.def: the great size or seriousness of a problem
items.s: The ________ of world hunger can feel overwhelming, but small actions like donating food still make a difference.
items.zh: 全球飢餓問題的嚴重性可能令人難以承受，但像捐贈食物這樣的小行動仍然能帶來改變。

items.def: the right to have or receive something
items.s: Many people believe that food is a basic ________ for every child, so free school lunches should be offered everywhere.
items.zh: 許多人認為食物是每個孩子的基本權利，所以應該在各地提供免費的學校午餐。

items.def: a rapid increase in size or seriousness
items.s: The ________ of the trade war raised food prices, and ordinary families felt the effects at the supermarket.
items.zh: 貿易戰的升級推高了食品價格，而一般家庭在超市就能感受到影響。

items.def: the act of not allowing someone or something to take part
items.s: The ________ of small farmers from big supermarket contracts is unfair, so some shops are now changing their policy.
items.zh: 將小農排除在大型超市合約之外是不公平的，所以一些商店現在正在改變政策。

items.def: how possible or practical something is
items.s: The team studied the ________ of growing coffee in Taiwan, and they found that some mountain areas were ideal.
items.zh: 這個團隊研究了在台灣種咖啡的可行性，而他們發現某些山區非常理想。

items.def: shocking and done openly
items.s: Selling dyed vegetables as organic is a ________ breach of the law, and the shop owner was heavily fined.
items.zh: 把染色蔬菜當作有機產品販售是明目張膽的違法行為，而店主被重罰。

items.def: the habit of not wasting money or food
items.s: My grandparents' ________ taught me not to waste rice, and I still finish every grain in my bowl.
items.zh: 祖父母的節儉教會我不要浪費米飯，而我到現在仍會吃完碗裡的每一粒米。

items.def: a sign that something is going to happen
items.s: The first plum flowers are a ________ of spring, so farmers start preparing their fields when they appear.
items.zh: 第一批梅花是春天的預兆，所以梅花一開，農民就開始整地。

items.def: to make things the same or similar
items.s: Global fast-food chains may ________ eating habits, but local night markets keep traditional dishes alive.
items.zh: 全球速食連鎖店可能會讓飲食習慣同質化，但本地夜市讓傳統小吃得以延續。

items.def: too large to be measured
items.s: The value of bees to farming is ________, because without them many fruits and nuts would disappear.
items.zh: 蜜蜂對農業的價值是無法衡量的，因為沒有牠們，許多水果和堅果就會消失。

items.def: something that makes progress difficult
items.s: High land prices are a major ________ for young farmers, so the government now rents out public land cheaply.
items.zh: 高地價是年輕農民的一大障礙，所以政府現在以低價出租公有土地。

items.def: to put something in danger
items.s: Rising sea levels could ________ rice farming in coastal areas, so scientists are testing salt-tolerant varieties.
items.zh: 海平面上升可能危及沿海地區的稻作，所以科學家正在測試耐鹽品種。

items.def: not wise or sensible
items.s: It would be ________ to plant all your fields with one crop, because a single disease could destroy everything.
items.zh: 把所有田地都種同一種作物是不明智的，因為單一病害就可能摧毀一切。

items.def: impossible or very difficult to reach
items.cn: 難以到達的；無法取得的
items.s: The landslide left the mountain village ________, so helicopters had to drop food for the residents.
items.zh: 山崩讓這座山村無法進出，所以直升機必須為居民空投食物。

items.def: the state of not being the same or regular
items.s: Customers complained about the ________ of the coffee, because it tasted different every time they ordered it.
items.zh: 顧客抱怨咖啡的品質不一致，因為每次點的味道都不一樣。

items.def: showing or suggesting something
items.s: Yellow leaves are often ________ of a lack of nutrients, so the farmer tested the soil immediately.
items.zh: 黃葉常表示缺乏養分，所以農夫立刻檢測了土壤。

items.def: unfair because some people get more than others
items.s: The ________ sharing of profits means that coffee farmers earn very little, while cafes make a lot of money.
items.zh: 利潤不公平的分配意味著咖啡農賺得很少，而咖啡館卻賺了很多錢。

items.def: impossible to avoid
items.s: The conclusion is ________: we must waste less food, or there will not be enough for everyone by 2050.
items.zh: 結論是無可避免的：我們必須減少浪費食物，否則到2050年將不夠每個人吃。

items.def: causing prices to rise
items.s: The rise in oil prices had an ________ effect on food, because transport and fertiliser both became more expensive.
items.zh: 油價上漲對食品產生了通膨效應，因為運輸和肥料都變得更貴了。

items.def: far more than is reasonable
items.s: Some families spend an ________ amount of money on food delivery, but they could save a lot by cooking at home.
items.zh: 有些家庭在外送上花了過多的錢，但他們如果在家做飯就能省下很多。

items.def: careless or illegal behaviour by a professional
items.s: The inspector was accused of ________, because he had accepted gifts from the factory he was checking.
items.zh: 這名稽查員被指控瀆職，因為他收受了他正在檢查的工廠所送的禮物。

items.def: many and of different kinds
items.s: The benefits of school gardens are ________, because children learn science, exercise and eat more vegetables.
items.zh: 學校菜園的好處多不勝數，因為孩子們能學習科學、運動，並且吃更多蔬菜。

items.def: the methods used in a study or activity
items.s: The researchers explained their ________ clearly, so other scientists could repeat the food-waste study in their own cities.
items.zh: 研究人員清楚地說明了他們的研究方法，所以其他科學家能在自己的城市重複這項食物浪費研究。

items.def: extremely small
items.s: The amount of pesticide found was ________, so experts said the vegetables were still safe to eat.
items.zh: 檢測出的農藥量極少，所以專家說這些蔬菜仍然可以安全食用。

items.def: a very large number of things or people
items.s: The night market offers a ________ of snacks, so first-time visitors often do not know where to begin.
items.zh: 夜市提供眾多小吃，所以第一次來的遊客常常不知道該從哪裡開始。

items.def: unpleasant and likely to offend
items.s: Neighbours found the smell from the pig farm ________, so they complained to the city council.
items.zh: 鄰居們覺得養豬場的氣味令人反感，所以他們向市議會投訴。

items.def: something that has been left out
items.s: The ________ of peanuts from the ingredient list was dangerous, because a customer with an allergy became very ill.
items.zh: 成分表中遺漏花生是很危險的，因為一位過敏的顧客因此病得很嚴重。

items.def: depending too much on something
items.s: ________ on a single crop is risky, so the government encourages farmers to grow several different kinds.
items.zh: 過度依賴單一作物是有風險的，所以政府鼓勵農民種植好幾種不同的作物。

items.def: in a way that seems strange because it is the opposite of what you expect
items.s: ________, some of the world's hungriest people are farmers, because they sell their best food to pay their debts.
items.zh: 弔詭的是，世界上最飢餓的一些人竟是農民，因為他們賣掉最好的食物來償還債務。

items.def: to eat or drink something; to take part
items.s: Guests are invited to ________ in the harvest meal, and everyone eats together at long tables in the field.
items.zh: 賓客受邀參與豐收餐會，而且大家在田裡的長桌一起用餐。

items.def: the right to be considered more important
items.s: Food safety must take ________ over profit, so the company destroyed the whole batch when one test failed.
items.zh: 食品安全必須優先於利潤，所以當一項檢驗不合格時，公司就銷毀了整批產品。

items.def: the act of happening again
items.s: To prevent a ________ of the outbreak, the farm now disinfects every truck that enters.
items.zh: 為了防止疫情再次發生，這座農場現在會對每一輛進入的卡車消毒。

items.def: a small change that improves something
items.s: After years of ________, the farmer's tea won first prize, and buyers came from Japan to order it.
items.zh: 經過多年的改良，這位農夫的茶贏得了首獎，而買家從日本前來訂購。

items.def: great care and attention to detail
items.s: The testing is done with great ________, so every batch of baby milk is checked several times.
items.zh: 檢驗以極度嚴謹的方式進行，所以每一批嬰兒奶粉都會經過多次檢查。

items.def: based on guesses rather than facts
items.s: Claims that insects will replace meat are still ________, because most people are not ready to eat them.
items.zh: 昆蟲將取代肉類的說法仍是推測，因為大多數人還沒準備好吃牠們。

items.def: clearly true and impossible to doubt
items.s: The link between sugary drinks and weight gain is ________, but many teenagers still drink them every day.
items.zh: 含糖飲料與體重增加之間的關聯是不可否認的，但許多青少年仍然每天喝。

items.def: to think something is less important than it really is
items.s: Society tends to ________ the work of farmers, although we depend on them for every meal we eat.
items.zh: 社會往往低估農民的工作，儘管我們吃的每一餐都仰賴他們。

items.def: not planned or meant
items.s: The cheap plastic bags had an ________ result, because many of them ended up in rivers and the sea.
items.zh: 便宜的塑膠袋帶來了非預期的後果，因為許多袋子最後流入了河川和海洋。

items.def: not controlled by laws or rules
items.s: ________ street stalls may sell unsafe food, so the city now gives licences only to stalls that pass inspections.
items.zh: 未受管制的路邊攤可能販售不安全的食物，所以市政府現在只發執照給通過檢查的攤位。

items.def: not justified or necessary
items.s: Some fears about frozen food are ________, because freezing keeps most vitamins and stops bacteria from growing.
items.zh: 有些對冷凍食品的擔憂是沒有根據的，因為冷凍能保留大部分維他命並阻止細菌生長。

items.def: careful attention to notice possible danger
items.s: Farmers must show constant ________ during flu season, because one sick bird can spread disease to the whole farm.
items.zh: 禽流感季節期間農民必須時時保持警覺，因為一隻生病的鳥就能把疾病傳遍整座農場。

items.def: the quality of changing suddenly and unpredictably
items.s: Price ________ makes farming risky, so farmers who sign fixed-price contracts can sleep better at night.
items.zh: 價格波動讓務農充滿風險，所以簽訂固定價格合約的農民晚上能睡得比較安穩。

items.def: directly from where food is grown to where it is eaten
items.s: The restaurant follows the idea of ______ ______ ______ ______, so the vegetables you eat at lunch were picked that morning.
items.zh: 這家餐廳遵循從產地到餐桌的理念，所以你午餐吃到的蔬菜是當天早上才採收的。

items.def: to earn enough money to feed your family
items.s: My father works two jobs to ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, but he still finds time to help me with homework.
items.zh: 我爸爸做兩份工作來養家糊口，但他仍會抽空幫我寫功課。

items.def: to earn money to support a family
items.s: In my family, both of my parents ______ ______ ______ ______, so we all share the housework at weekends.
items.zh: 在我們家，爸媽兩個人都賺錢養家，所以週末我們全家一起分擔家事。

items.def: to be thrown away or not used
items.s: We packed the leftovers in boxes because we did not want the food to ______ ______ ______, and we ate it the next day.
items.zh: 我們把剩菜裝進盒子裡，因為不想讓食物被浪費，而且我們隔天就把它吃掉了。

items.w: make hay while the sun shines
items.def: to make the most of a good chance while it lasts
items.s: Mango prices are high this week, so the farmers are picking as fast as they can to ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______.
items.zh: 這週芒果價格很高，所以農民們盡可能快速採收，好把握良機。

items.def: to experience the results of your own actions
items.s: He never studied during the term, so he ______ ______ ______ ______ when he failed the final exam.
items.zh: 他整學期都沒讀書，所以期末考不及格時，他就自食其果了。

items.def: the best people or things in a group
items.s: Only ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ are chosen for the national cooking team, and they train for hours every day.
items.zh: 只有佼佼者才會被選入國家烹飪隊，而且他們每天都要訓練好幾個小時。

items.def: (of fruit or vegetables) available and at their best now
items.s: Lychees are only ______ ______ for a few weeks in summer, so people buy boxes of them and send them to relatives.
items.zh: 荔枝只在夏天的幾個星期是當季的，所以人們會一箱箱地買來寄給親戚。

items.def: (of fruit or vegetables) not naturally available at this time
items.s: Strawberries are expensive when they are ______ ______ ______, because they have to be flown in from other countries.
items.zh: 草莓在非當季時很貴，因為它們必須從其他國家空運進口。

items.def: one bad person who has a bad effect on others
items.s: Most food sellers at the market are honest, but ______ ______ ______ who sold fake honey has hurt everyone's reputation.
items.zh: 市場裡大部分的攤販都很誠實，但一個賣假蜂蜜的害群之馬損害了大家的名聲。

items.def: to produce good results
items.s: The farmer's years of hard work finally ______ ______, and his organic rice is now sold in top restaurants.
items.zh: 這位農夫多年的努力終於開花結果，而他的有機米現在在頂級餐廳販售。

items.def: to reduce the amount of something you use or eat
items.s: My doctor told me to ______ ______ ______ salty snacks, so I now eat fruit when I feel hungry after school.
items.zh: 醫生叫我減少吃鹹的零食，所以現在我放學後肚子餓時改吃水果。

items.def: to have a meal in a restaurant rather than at home
items.s: Many people in Taipei ______ ______ almost every day because they work long hours, but cooking at home is usually healthier.
items.zh: 許多台北人幾乎每天都外食，因為他們工時很長，但在家做飯通常比較健康。

items.def: an idea that makes you think seriously
items.s: The film about food waste gave us ______ ______ ______, and our class decided to start a leftovers campaign.
items.zh: 那部關於食物浪費的電影給了我們值得深思的事，而我們班決定發起一項剩菜再利用活動。

items.def: to like eating sweet food very much
items.s: My little sister ______ ______ ______ ______, so my mother hides the chocolate on the top shelf.
items.zh: 我妹妹很愛吃甜食，所以我媽媽把巧克力藏在最上層的架子上。

items.def: something very easy to do
items.s: Making dumplings looked difficult at first, but after my grandmother showed me, it was ______ ______ ______ ______.
items.zh: 包水餃一開始看起來很難，但奶奶示範給我看之後，就變得易如反掌了。

items.def: to be upset about something that cannot be changed
items.s: The typhoon destroyed half the crop, but there is no point in ______ ______ ______ ______, so the farmers started replanting.
items.zh: 颱風摧毀了一半的作物，但為無法挽回的事懊悔也沒有用，所以農民們開始重新種植。

items.def: to sell very quickly and in large numbers
items.s: The new pineapple cakes ______ ______ ______ ______ at the festival, and the bakery ran out before noon.
items.zh: 新推出的鳳梨酥在節慶上大賣，而這家麵包店中午不到就賣光了。

items.w: put all one's eggs in one basket
items.def: to depend on only one plan or thing
items.s: Farmers who grow only bananas ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, so one disease could ruin them.
items.zh: 只種香蕉的農民等於孤注一擲，所以一種病害就可能讓他們破產。

items.def: the main way someone earns money
items.s: Rice is the ______ ______ ______ of this village, but young farmers are also trying coffee and tea to earn more.
items.zh: 稻米是這個村莊的主要收入來源，但年輕農民也在嘗試種咖啡和茶來賺更多錢。

items.def: the hard outer layer of the Earth
items.s: The Earth's ________ is very thin compared with the rest of the planet, but it is the only layer that people can actually walk on.
items.zh: 和地球的其他部分相比，地球的地殼非常薄，但它是人們唯一能夠真正行走的一層。
items.sec: Earth's Structure & Plate Tectonics 地球結構與板塊構造

items.def: the thick hot layer between the crust and the core
items.s: Our geography teacher explained that rock in the ________ moves very slowly, and this movement pushes the plates above it.
items.zh: 我們的地理老師解釋說，地函中的岩石移動得非常緩慢，而這種移動推動了上方的板塊。
items.sec: Earth's Structure & Plate Tectonics 地球結構與板塊構造

items.def: the liquid metal layer around the Earth's centre
items.s: Scientists believe that the ______ ______ is made of liquid iron, and its movement creates the Earth's magnetic field.
items.zh: 科學家相信外核是由液態鐵構成的，而它的流動產生了地球的磁場。
items.sec: Earth's Structure & Plate Tectonics 地球結構與板塊構造

items.def: the solid metal ball at the very centre of the Earth
items.s: The ______ ______ is hotter than the surface of the sun, but it stays solid because the pressure there is extremely high.
items.zh: 內核比太陽表面還要熱，但因為那裡的壓力極高，所以它保持固態。
items.sec: Earth's Structure & Plate Tectonics 地球結構與板塊構造

items.def: the rigid outer shell made of crust and upper mantle
items.s: The ________ is broken into large pieces, so the land we live on is always moving a few centimetres every year.
items.zh: 岩石圈破裂成許多大塊，所以我們居住的陸地每年都在移動幾公分。
items.sec: Earth's Structure & Plate Tectonics 地球結構與板塊構造

items.def: the soft, partly melted layer under the lithosphere
items.s: The plates slide over the ________ because this layer is soft enough to flow, although it is still mostly solid rock.
items.zh: 板塊在軟流圈上滑動，因為這一層軟到可以流動，雖然它大部分仍是固態岩石。
items.sec: Earth's Structure & Plate Tectonics 地球結構與板塊構造

items.def: a huge moving piece of the Earth's outer shell
items.s: Taiwan sits where two ______ ______ meet, so the island has many earthquakes and its mountains are still rising.
items.zh: 臺灣位於兩個構造板塊交會的地方，所以這座島嶼地震頻繁，而且山脈仍在持續升高。
items.sec: Earth's Structure & Plate Tectonics 地球結構與板塊構造

items.def: the theory that the Earth's surface is made of moving plates
items.s: ______ ______ explains why earthquakes happen in certain places, and it also helps us understand how mountains are formed.
items.zh: 板塊構造論解釋了為什麼地震會發生在某些地方，而且它也幫助我們了解山脈是如何形成的。
items.sec: Earth's Structure & Plate Tectonics 地球結構與板塊構造

items.def: the slow movement of continents across the Earth
items.s: Alfred Wegener first suggested the idea of ______ ______, but many scientists laughed at him because he could not explain how it worked.
items.zh: 韋格納首先提出大陸漂移的概念，但許多科學家嘲笑他，因為他無法解釋其運作方式。
items.sec: Earth's Structure & Plate Tectonics 地球結構與板塊構造

items.def: one huge landmass made of many joined continents
items.s: Millions of years ago, all the land formed one ________, and dinosaurs could walk from today's Africa to South America.
items.zh: 數百萬年前，所有陸地形成一個超大陸，而恐龍可以從今天的非洲走到南美洲。
items.sec: Earth's Structure & Plate Tectonics 地球結構與板塊構造

items.def: the supercontinent that existed about 300 million years ago
items.s: The coastlines of Africa and South America fit together like puzzle pieces, so scientists think they were once joined in ________.
items.zh: 非洲和南美洲的海岸線像拼圖一樣能拼在一起，所以科學家認為它們曾經在盤古大陸中相連。
items.sec: Earth's Structure & Plate Tectonics 地球結構與板塊構造

items.def: a long crack in the Earth's crust where rocks move
items.s: The new school was built far away from the ______ ______, because the city wanted to keep students safe during earthquakes.
items.zh: 新學校蓋在離斷層線很遠的地方，因為市政府希望在地震時保護學生的安全。
items.sec: Earth's Structure & Plate Tectonics 地球結構與板塊構造

items.def: when one plate slides under another plate
items.s: ________ happens when a heavy ocean plate sinks under a lighter plate, and this process often creates deep trenches and volcanoes.
items.zh: 當沉重的海洋板塊沉入較輕的板塊之下時，就會發生隱沒作用，而這個過程常常形成深海溝和火山。
items.sec: Earth's Structure & Plate Tectonics 地球結構與板塊構造

items.def: a circular flow of heat in a liquid or soft solid
items.s: Hot rock rises and cool rock sinks in the mantle, so these ______ ______ slowly drag the plates across the planet.
items.zh: 地函中熱的岩石上升、冷的岩石下沉，所以這些對流緩慢地拖動板塊在地球上移動。
items.sec: Earth's Structure & Plate Tectonics 地球結構與板塊構造

items.def: the invisible area of magnetic force around the Earth
items.s: The Earth's ______ ______ protects us from harmful particles from the sun, and it also makes a compass needle point north.
items.zh: 地球的磁場保護我們免於來自太陽的有害粒子，而且它也讓指南針的指針指向北方。
items.sec: Earth's Structure & Plate Tectonics 地球結構與板塊構造

items.def: the thin, heavy crust under the oceans
items.s: ______ ______ is younger and heavier than the land beneath our cities, so it usually sinks when two plates collide.
items.zh: 海洋地殼比我們城市底下的陸地更年輕也更重，所以當兩個板塊相撞時它通常會下沉。
items.sec: Earth's Structure & Plate Tectonics 地球結構與板塊構造

items.def: the thick, lighter crust that forms the land
items.s: ______ ______ can be more than 50 kilometres thick under high mountains, while it is much thinner under flat plains.
items.zh: 在高山底下，大陸地殼可以超過五十公里厚，而在平坦的平原底下則薄得多。
items.sec: Earth's Structure & Plate Tectonics 地球結構與板塊構造

items.def: the edge where two tectonic plates meet
items.s: Japan lies on an active ______ ______, so children there practise earthquake safety at school several times a year.
items.zh: 日本位於活躍的板塊邊界上，所以那裡的孩子每年在學校練習好幾次地震安全演練。
items.sec: Earth's Structure & Plate Tectonics 地球結構與板塊構造

items.def: a long underwater mountain chain where new crust forms
items.s: The ________ ________ runs through the middle of the Atlantic Ocean, and new rock is created there as the plates move apart.
items.zh: 中洋脊貫穿大西洋中央，而當板塊彼此分離時，新的岩石就在那裡生成。
items.sec: Earth's Structure & Plate Tectonics 地球結構與板塊構造

items.def: a long valley formed when the land splits apart
items.s: East Africa has a huge ______ ______, and some geologists think the continent may eventually split into two parts.
items.zh: 東非有一條巨大的裂谷，有些地質學家認為這塊大陸最終可能會分裂成兩部分。
items.sec: Earth's Structure & Plate Tectonics 地球結構與板塊構造

items.def: the rising of land caused by forces inside the Earth
items.s: The Himalayas are still growing because of continuous ________, and the mountains rise a few millimetres higher every year.
items.zh: 喜馬拉雅山脈仍在增高，因為持續的抬升作用，而山脈每年都會升高幾毫米。
items.sec: Earth's Structure & Plate Tectonics 地球結構與板塊構造

items.def: a bend in rock layers caused by pressure
items.s: You can see a huge ________ in the rock beside the highway, and it shows how strong the pressure inside the Earth can be.
items.zh: 你可以在公路旁的岩石上看到一個巨大的褶皺，而它顯示出地球內部的壓力有多強。
items.sec: Earth's Structure & Plate Tectonics 地球結構與板塊構造

items.def: the study of rocks and the Earth's history
items.s: My cousin chose to study ________ at university because she loves hiking, and she wants to understand how mountains were made.
items.zh: 我表姊在大學選擇念地質學，因為她熱愛健行，而且她想了解山是怎麼形成的。
items.sec: Earth's Structure & Plate Tectonics 地球結構與板塊構造

items.def: a scientist who studies the physical processes of the Earth
items.s: The ________ used special sensors to study the ground under the city, and her report helped engineers design safer buildings.
items.zh: 那位地球物理學家使用特殊感測器研究城市底下的地層，而她的報告幫助工程師設計出更安全的建築。
items.sec: Earth's Structure & Plate Tectonics 地球結構與板塊構造

items.def: the process where new ocean floor forms and moves apart
items.s: ______ ______ slowly makes the Atlantic Ocean wider, so the distance between Europe and America grows every year.
items.zh: 海底擴張慢慢讓大西洋變得更寬，所以歐洲和美洲之間的距離每年都在增加。
items.sec: Earth's Structure & Plate Tectonics 地球結構與板塊構造

items.def: related to rocks and the history of the Earth
items.s: The park has many interesting ________ features, so geography teachers often bring their students there on field trips.
items.zh: 這座公園有許多有趣的地質特徵，所以地理老師常常帶學生去那裡校外教學。
items.sec: Earth's Structure & Plate Tectonics 地球結構與板塊構造

items.def: a mountain that can send out hot rock, gas and ash
items.s: Mount Fuji is actually a ________, but it has not erupted for over 300 years, so millions of tourists climb it safely.
items.zh: 富士山其實是一座火山，但它已經超過三百年沒有噴發，所以數百萬名遊客能安全地攀登。

items.def: produced by or related to a volcano
items.s: Yangmingshan has rich ________ soil, so farmers grow excellent vegetables there, and visitors enjoy the hot springs too.
items.zh: 陽明山有肥沃的火山土壤，所以農民在那裡種出優質蔬菜，而且遊客也很喜歡那裡的溫泉。

items.def: when a volcano suddenly throws out lava, ash and gas
items.s: The ________ sent ash high into the sky, so hundreds of flights across Europe were cancelled for almost a week.
items.zh: 那次噴發把火山灰噴到高空中，所以歐洲各地數百個航班被取消將近一週。

items.def: to suddenly throw out lava, ash or gas
items.s: Scientists cannot say exactly when the volcano will ________ again, but they watch it closely every day to warn local people.
items.zh: 科學家無法確切說出那座火山何時會再次爆發，但他們每天密切監測，以便警告當地居民。

items.def: hot liquid rock under the Earth's surface
items.s: When ________ rises toward the surface, the ground may swell slightly, and scientists use this sign to predict eruptions.
items.zh: 當岩漿朝地表上升時，地面可能會稍微隆起，而科學家利用這個跡象來預測噴發。

items.def: hot liquid rock that comes out of a volcano
items.s: The red ________ flowed slowly down the mountain, but it destroyed several houses because nobody could stop it.
items.zh: 紅色的熔岩緩緩流下山，但它摧毀了好幾棟房子，因為沒有人能阻擋它。

items.def: a huge cloud of tiny rock pieces from a volcano
items.s: The airline cancelled our flight because a large ______ ______ was moving toward the airport, and the ash could damage engines.
items.zh: 航空公司取消了我們的班機，因為一大片火山灰雲正往機場移動，而火山灰可能會損壞引擎。

items.def: a large bowl-shaped hole at the top of a volcano or made by an impact
items.s: We hiked to the edge of the ________ early in the morning, and we could see steam rising from the bottom.
items.zh: 我們一大早健行到火山口邊緣，而且我們能看到蒸氣從底部冒出來。

items.def: a huge hollow formed when a volcano collapses
items.s: After the giant eruption, the top of the mountain fell in and formed a ________, which later filled with water and became a lake.
items.zh: 那次巨大噴發後，山頂崩塌形成了一個破火山口，後來積水變成了一座湖。

items.def: a fast, deadly cloud of hot gas and rock
items.s: A ______ ______ can move faster than a car, so people living near the volcano must leave as soon as officials warn them.
items.zh: 火山碎屑流可以移動得比汽車還快，所以住在火山附近的人一接到官員警告就必須離開。

items.def: a natural pool of water heated underground
items.s: After a long day of hiking, we relaxed in a ______ ______, and the warm water made our tired legs feel much better.
items.zh: 經過一整天的健行後，我們在溫泉裡放鬆，而溫暖的泉水讓我們疲憊的雙腿舒服多了。

items.def: a hot spring that shoots water and steam into the air
items.s: Tourists waited patiently for the ________ to shoot water into the air, and everyone cheered when it finally happened.
items.zh: 遊客耐心地等待間歇泉把水噴向空中，而當它終於噴發時，每個人都歡呼起來。

items.def: a sudden shaking of the ground
items.s: The ________ woke me up at three in the morning, so I hid under my desk until the shaking stopped.
items.zh: 那場地震在凌晨三點把我搖醒，所以我躲在書桌底下直到搖晃停止。

items.def: a small shaking of the ground
items.s: We felt a slight ________ during dinner, but nobody panicked because small shakes are common in Taiwan.
items.zh: 我們在晚餐時感覺到輕微的震動，但沒有人驚慌，因為小地震在臺灣很常見。

items.def: a smaller earthquake that follows a big one
items.s: Many families slept outside that night because they were afraid of another ________, and the shaking continued for days.
items.zh: 那天晚上許多家庭睡在戶外，因為他們害怕再有餘震，而搖晃持續了好幾天。

items.def: a smaller earthquake that comes before a bigger one
items.s: Nobody realised that the small shake was a ________, so people were shocked when a much stronger quake hit an hour later.
items.zh: 沒有人意識到那次小搖晃是前震，所以一小時後更強的地震來襲時，大家都嚇壞了。

items.def: a machine that measures and records earthquakes
items.s: The ________ in the school lab recorded the earthquake clearly, and our science teacher showed us the zigzag lines the next day.
items.zh: 學校實驗室裡的地震儀清楚地記錄了那場地震，而我們的自然老師隔天給我們看那些鋸齒狀的線條。

items.def: a scientist who studies earthquakes
items.s: The ________ explained on TV that the earthquake was not dangerous, but she reminded viewers to prepare emergency kits.
items.zh: 那位地震學家在電視上解釋說這次地震並不危險，但她提醒觀眾準備緊急避難包。

items.def: a scale that measures the strength of an earthquake
items.s: The earthquake measured 6.5 on the ______ ______, so the government sent rescue teams to the area immediately.
items.zh: 那場地震在芮氏規模上達到6.5級，所以政府立即派遣救援隊前往該地區。

items.def: an area with many cracks where rocks move
items.s: The town lies inside an active ______ ______, so all new buildings there must follow strict safety rules.
items.zh: 這座城鎮位於一個活躍的斷層帶內，所以那裡所有新建築都必須遵守嚴格的安全規定。

items.def: a strong wave of energy that travels through the ground or air
items.s: The ________ from the earthquake travelled hundreds of kilometres, and people in the capital felt their buildings sway.
items.zh: 地震產生的震波傳遞了數百公里，而首都的人們感覺到他們的建築物在搖晃。

items.def: when shaken wet soil starts to behave like a liquid
items.s: ________ made several buildings sink into the ground, because the soil near the river was full of water.
items.zh: 土壤液化讓好幾棟建築物陷入地下，因為河邊的土壤充滿了水。

items.def: to break or burst suddenly
items.s: When the rocks along the fault suddenly ________, huge amounts of energy are released, and the ground begins to shake.
items.zh: 當斷層沿線的岩石突然破裂時，大量能量被釋放出來，地面就開始搖晃。

items.def: an informal word for an earthquake
items.s: The ________ was short, but it knocked books off the shelves, so the library closed early to clean up.
items.zh: 那場地震很短暫，但它把書從書架上震落，所以圖書館提早關門整理。

items.def: a scientist who studies volcanoes
items.s: The ________ wore a special suit near the lava, because the heat was strong enough to burn normal clothes.
items.zh: 那位火山學家在熔岩附近穿著特殊防護衣，因為那裡的高溫足以燒毀一般衣物。

items.def: the area around the Pacific Ocean with many volcanoes and earthquakes
items.s: Taiwan is part of the ______ ______ ______, so we experience many earthquakes, and we also enjoy many hot springs.
items.zh: 臺灣是環太平洋火山帶的一部分，所以我們經歷許多地震，而且我們也享有許多溫泉。

items.def: a hole that suddenly opens in the ground
items.s: A huge ________ opened in the middle of the road after heavy rain, so the police closed the street for several days.
items.zh: 大雨過後，道路中央突然出現一個巨大的天坑，所以警方封閉了那條街好幾天。

items.def: a practice of leaving a building quickly in an emergency
items.s: Our school holds an ______ ______ every September, and students learn to leave the building calmly in under three minutes.
items.zh: 我們學校每年九月都會舉行疏散演練，而學生學習在三分鐘內冷靜地離開大樓。

items.def: a volcano that has erupted recently or may erupt soon
items.s: Iceland has many ______ ______, but tourists still visit them because the views are amazing and the guides are well trained.
items.zh: 冰島有許多活火山，但遊客仍然去參觀，因為景色壯觀而且導遊訓練有素。

items.def: a volcano that will never erupt again
items.s: Edinburgh Castle stands on an ______ ______, so visitors can enjoy the view without worrying about an eruption.
items.zh: 愛丁堡城堡矗立在一座死火山上，所以遊客可以欣賞美景而不必擔心火山噴發。

items.def: rock formed when hot melted rock cools
items.s: Basalt is a common ______ ______, and it forms when lava cools quickly on the surface of the Earth.
items.zh: 玄武岩是一種常見的火成岩，而它是在熔岩於地表迅速冷卻時形成的。
items.sec: Rocks, Minerals & Landforms 岩石、礦物與地形

items.def: rock made from layers of sand, mud or shells pressed together
items.s: ______ ______ often contains fossils, so it is the best place to look for clues about ancient life.
items.zh: 沉積岩經常含有化石，所以它是尋找古代生物線索的最佳地方。
items.sec: Rocks, Minerals & Landforms 岩石、礦物與地形

items.def: rock changed by heat and pressure
items.s: Marble is a ______ ______ that forms deep underground, and artists have used it for statues for thousands of years.
items.zh: 大理石是一種在地底深處形成的變質岩，而藝術家數千年來一直用它來製作雕像。
items.sec: Rocks, Minerals & Landforms 岩石、礦物與地形

items.def: a very hard grey or pink rock
items.s: The kitchen counter is made of ________, so it does not scratch easily, and it stays cool even in summer.
items.zh: 廚房流理臺是花崗岩做的，所以它不容易刮傷，而且即使在夏天也保持涼爽。
items.sec: Rocks, Minerals & Landforms 岩石、礦物與地形

items.def: a dark rock formed from cooled lava
items.s: The islands of Penghu are famous for their ________ columns, and many tourists take photos of these unusual rock shapes.
items.zh: 澎湖群島以玄武岩柱聞名，而許多遊客會拍下這些奇特岩石形狀的照片。
items.sec: Rocks, Minerals & Landforms 岩石、礦物與地形

items.def: a smooth hard stone often used in buildings and statues
items.s: Taroko Gorge has walls of white ________, and the river has cut through the stone for millions of years.
items.zh: 太魯閣峽谷有白色大理石構成的峭壁，而河流已經切穿這些石頭數百萬年。
items.sec: Rocks, Minerals & Landforms 岩石、礦物與地形

items.def: rock made of sand pressed together
items.s: The cliffs along the coast are made of soft ________, so the wind and waves have carved them into strange shapes.
items.zh: 海岸沿線的懸崖是由鬆軟的砂岩構成，所以風和海浪把它們雕刻成奇特的形狀。
items.sec: Rocks, Minerals & Landforms 岩石、礦物與地形

items.def: a hard clear or white mineral
items.s: My little brother found a shiny piece of ________ on the beach, and he keeps it in a box with his other treasures.
items.zh: 我弟弟在海灘上發現一塊閃亮的石英，而他把它和其他寶物一起收在盒子裡。
items.sec: Rocks, Minerals & Landforms 岩石、礦物與地形

items.def: a solid with a regular shape and flat sides
items.s: Salt forms tiny ________ when seawater dries, and you can see their square shapes with a simple magnifying glass.
items.zh: 海水乾掉時鹽會形成微小的晶體，而你可以用簡單的放大鏡看到它們的方形結構。
items.sec: Rocks, Minerals & Landforms 岩石、礦物與地形

items.def: a valuable stone used in jewellery
items.s: A ruby is a red ________ that forms deep underground, but it becomes beautiful only after it is cut and polished.
items.zh: 紅寶石是一種在地底深處形成的紅色寶石，但它要經過切割和拋光後才會變得美麗。
items.sec: Rocks, Minerals & Landforms 岩石、礦物與地形

items.def: the slow process in which rocks change from one type to another
items.s: The ______ ______ never stops, because rocks are always being broken down, buried, heated and pushed up again.
items.zh: 岩石循環從不停止，因為岩石總是不斷被分解、掩埋、加熱，然後再次被推升上來。
items.sec: Rocks, Minerals & Landforms 岩石、礦物與地形

items.def: the breaking down of rock by weather, water or plants
items.s: Years of ________ have made the old stone steps smooth, and some of the carvings are now hard to see.
items.zh: 多年的風化作用讓那些古老的石階變得光滑，而有些雕刻現在已經很難看清楚了。
items.sec: Rocks, Minerals & Landforms 岩石、礦物與地形

items.def: a deep valley with steep sides, usually cut by a river
items.s: The Grand ________ is over a kilometre deep, and it took the Colorado River millions of years to carve it.
items.zh: 大峽谷深達一公里以上，而科羅拉多河花了數百萬年才把它切割出來。
items.sec: Rocks, Minerals & Landforms 岩石、礦物與地形

items.def: a narrow valley with steep rocky walls
items.s: We walked along the narrow ________ all morning, but we had to wear helmets because small rocks sometimes fell from above.
items.zh: 我們整個早上沿著狹窄的峽谷行走，但我們必須戴安全帽，因為有時會有小石頭從上方掉落。
items.sec: Rocks, Minerals & Landforms 岩石、礦物與地形

items.def: low land between hills or mountains
items.s: The village lies in a green ________ between two mountains, so it is cool in summer but very foggy in winter.
items.zh: 那座村莊位於兩座山之間的翠綠山谷中，所以夏天涼爽，但冬天霧很濃。
items.sec: Rocks, Minerals & Landforms 岩石、礦物與地形

items.def: a long line of mountains
items.s: The Central ______ ______ divides Taiwan into east and west, and it has more than two hundred peaks over 3,000 metres.
items.zh: 中央山脈把臺灣分成東西兩半，而且它有兩百多座超過三千公尺的山峰。
items.sec: Rocks, Minerals & Landforms 岩石、礦物與地形

items.def: the pointed top of a mountain
items.s: We reached the ________ just before sunrise, and the view of the sea of clouds made the hard climb worthwhile.
items.zh: 我們在日出前抵達山峰，而雲海的景色讓艱辛的攀登變得值得。
items.sec: Rocks, Minerals & Landforms 岩石、礦物與地形

items.def: ground that goes up or down at an angle
items.s: Heavy rain made the ________ above the road unstable, so workers built a strong wall to stop rocks from falling.
items.zh: 大雨讓道路上方的斜坡變得不穩，所以工人建造了一道堅固的牆來阻止落石。
items.sec: Rocks, Minerals & Landforms 岩石、礦物與地形

items.def: a rock shape that hangs down from the roof of a cave
items.s: A single ________ can take thousands of years to grow, so visitors are told never to touch the ones in the cave.
items.zh: 一根鐘乳石可能需要數千年才能長成，所以遊客被告知絕對不要觸摸洞穴裡的鐘乳石。
items.sec: Rocks, Minerals & Landforms 岩石、礦物與地形

items.def: a rock shape that grows up from the floor of a cave
items.s: Water dripping from the ceiling slowly formed a tall ________ on the floor, and it now looks like a stone tower.
items.zh: 從洞頂滴下的水在地面上慢慢形成一根高高的石筍，而它現在看起來像一座石塔。
items.sec: Rocks, Minerals & Landforms 岩石、礦物與地形

items.def: a large cave
items.s: The guide led us into a huge underground ________, and our voices echoed loudly when we spoke.
items.zh: 導遊帶領我們進入一個巨大的地下洞穴，而我們說話時聲音回響得很大聲。
items.sec: Rocks, Minerals & Landforms 岩石、礦物與地形

items.def: a large rock that sticks out of the ground
items.s: We stopped for lunch on a rocky ________ above the river, and from there we could see the whole valley.
items.zh: 我們在河流上方一塊突出的岩石上停下來吃午餐，而從那裡我們可以看到整個山谷。
items.sec: Rocks, Minerals & Landforms 岩石、礦物與地形

items.def: a natural shape on the Earth's surface, such as a hill
items.s: A delta is a ________ that forms where a river meets the sea, and it often has very rich soil for farming.
items.zh: 三角洲是一種在河流入海處形成的地形，而它通常擁有非常適合耕種的肥沃土壤。
items.sec: Rocks, Minerals & Landforms 岩石、礦物與地形

items.def: made or caused by glaciers
items.s: The lake was formed by ________ ice thousands of years ago, so its water is very cold and clear even in summer.
items.zh: 這座湖是在數千年前由冰河冰所形成的，所以即使在夏天湖水也非常冰冷清澈。
items.sec: Rocks, Minerals & Landforms 岩石、礦物與地形

items.def: a pile of rocks and soil left by a glacier
items.s: The hikers crossed a long ________ of loose stones, and the guide explained that a glacier had pushed them there long ago.
items.zh: 健行者穿越一長片鬆散石頭構成的冰磧，而導遊解釋說很久以前是冰河把它們推到那裡的。
items.sec: Rocks, Minerals & Landforms 岩石、礦物與地形

items.def: a plain-looking rock with crystals inside
items.s: The ________ looked like an ordinary grey stone, but when my dad cut it open, it was full of purple crystals.
items.zh: 那顆晶洞看起來像一塊普通的灰色石頭，但當我爸爸把它切開時，裡面全是紫色的晶體。
items.sec: Rocks, Minerals & Landforms 岩石、礦物與地形

items.def: a deep narrow valley with steep sides
items.s: The bridge crosses a deep ________, so some visitors feel nervous when they look down at the river below.
items.zh: 這座橋橫跨一道很深的溝壑，所以有些遊客往下看到河流時會感到緊張。
items.sec: Rocks, Minerals & Landforms 岩石、礦物與地形

items.def: a natural shape made of rock
items.s: The famous Queen's Head at Yehliu is a ______ ______, but scientists worry that it may break because of weathering.
items.zh: 野柳著名的女王頭是一個岩石地形，但科學家擔心它可能會因為風化而斷裂。
items.sec: Rocks, Minerals & Landforms 岩石、礦物與地形

items.def: a small river that flows into a bigger river
items.s: The small stream behind our school is a ________ of the Tamsui River, so rubbish thrown into it can end up in the sea.
items.zh: 我們學校後面的小溪是淡水河的一條支流，所以丟進去的垃圾最後可能會流到海裡。
items.sec: Rivers, Landscapes & Deep Time 河流、地貌與地質年代

items.def: to follow a slow, winding course
items.s: The river ________ through the flat farmland, so it takes much longer to reach the sea than a straight river would.
items.zh: 那條河蜿蜒流過平坦的農田，所以它流到海的時間比一條筆直的河長得多。
items.sec: Rivers, Landscapes & Deep Time 河流、地貌與地質年代

items.def: flat land next to a river that floods sometimes
items.s: Farmers like the ________ because the soil is very rich, but their fields are often covered with water after typhoons.
items.zh: 農民喜歡氾濫平原，因為那裡的土壤非常肥沃，但颱風過後他們的田地常常被水淹沒。
items.sec: Rivers, Landscapes & Deep Time 河流、地貌與地質年代

items.def: water falling from a high place, such as a cliff
items.s: We could hear the ________ long before we saw it, and the cold spray felt wonderful on such a hot day.
items.zh: 我們在看到瀑布之前很久就聽到了它的聲音，而在那麼熱的天氣裡，冰涼的水霧讓人覺得很舒服。
items.sec: Rivers, Landscapes & Deep Time 河流、地貌與地質年代

items.def: part of a river where water flows fast over rocks
items.s: Our raft bounced wildly through the ________, and everyone screamed and laughed at the same time.
items.zh: 我們的橡皮艇在急流中劇烈顛簸，而每個人都同時尖叫又大笑。
items.sec: Rivers, Landscapes & Deep Time 河流、地貌與地質年代

items.def: a curved lake formed when a river changes its course
items.s: Over many years, the river changed direction and left behind an ______ ______, which is now a home for many birds.
items.zh: 經過許多年，河流改變了方向，留下了一座牛軛湖，而它現在是許多鳥類的家。
items.sec: Rivers, Landscapes & Deep Time 河流、地貌與地質年代

items.def: the study of water on and under the Earth's surface
items.s: Experts in ________ studied the river for years, so they could warn the city before dangerous floods arrived.
items.zh: 水文學專家研究這條河流多年，所以他們能在危險的洪水來臨前向城市發出警告。
items.sec: Rivers, Landscapes & Deep Time 河流、地貌與地質年代

items.def: the place where a river flows into the sea
items.s: Many birds gather at the ______ ______ in winter, because the water there is full of small fish and crabs.
items.zh: 許多鳥類冬天聚集在河口，因為那裡的水域充滿小魚和螃蟹。
items.sec: Rivers, Landscapes & Deep Time 河流、地貌與地質年代

items.def: a system that divides Earth's long history into periods
items.s: The ______ ______ ______ shows that humans appeared very recently, while dinosaurs lived for more than 160 million years.
items.zh: 地質年代表顯示人類出現得非常晚，而恐龍則存活了超過一億六千萬年。
items.sec: Rivers, Landscapes & Deep Time 河流、地貌與地質年代

items.def: the number 1,000,000,000
items.s: Scientists believe the Earth is about 4.5 ________ years old, but life on land appeared much later than life in the sea.
items.zh: 科學家相信地球大約有四十五億年歷史，但陸地上的生命出現得比海洋生命晚得多。
items.sec: Rivers, Landscapes & Deep Time 河流、地貌與地質年代

items.def: all the fossils found and what they tell us about past life
items.s: The ______ ______ is incomplete, because soft animals rarely leave fossils, so scientists still have many unanswered questions.
items.zh: 化石紀錄並不完整，因為軟體動物很少留下化石，所以科學家仍有許多未解的問題。
items.sec: Rivers, Landscapes & Deep Time 河流、地貌與地質年代

items.def: when a very large number of species die out in a short time
items.s: A ______ ______ happened about 66 million years ago, and most scientists think a giant space rock caused it.
items.zh: 大約六千六百萬年前發生了一次大滅絕，而大多數科學家認為是一顆巨大的太空岩石造成的。
items.sec: Rivers, Landscapes & Deep Time 河流、地貌與地質年代

items.def: a large reptile that lived millions of years ago
items.s: My nephew loves every ________ in the museum, and he can name more kinds than most adults can.
items.zh: 我的姪子喜愛博物館裡的每一隻恐龍，而且他能說出的種類比大多數大人還多。
items.sec: Rivers, Landscapes & Deep Time 河流、地貌與地質年代

items.def: when a space rock hits a planet
items.s: The huge ______ ______ threw dust into the sky and blocked sunlight, so many plants and animals could not survive.
items.zh: 那次巨大的小行星撞擊把塵埃拋向天空並遮蔽陽光，所以許多動植物無法存活。
items.sec: Rivers, Landscapes & Deep Time 河流、地貌與地質年代

items.def: a piece of rock from space that lands on Earth
items.s: The museum lets visitors touch a real ________, and children are amazed that it travelled through space for millions of years.
items.zh: 博物館讓參觀者觸摸一顆真正的隕石，而孩子們很驚訝它在太空中旅行了數百萬年。
items.sec: Rivers, Landscapes & Deep Time 河流、地貌與地質年代

items.def: a time when large areas are covered by ice
items.s: The last ________ shaped many valleys in Europe, and the ice left behind lakes that people still visit today.
items.zh: 最近一次冰河作用塑造了歐洲的許多山谷，而冰留下的湖泊至今仍有人去造訪。
items.sec: Rivers, Landscapes & Deep Time 河流、地貌與地質年代

items.def: a large area of land, such as a continent
items.s: Australia is the smallest continental ________, but it still has deserts, rainforests and snowy mountains.
items.zh: 澳洲是最小的大陸陸塊，但它仍然擁有沙漠、雨林和積雪的山脈。
items.sec: Rivers, Landscapes & Deep Time 河流、地貌與地質年代

items.def: the shape and height of the land in an area
items.s: Taiwan's ________ is very steep, so rivers flow quickly to the sea, and heavy rain often causes landslides.
items.zh: 臺灣的地形非常陡峭，所以河流很快就流入大海，而且大雨常常造成山崩。
items.sec: Rivers, Landscapes & Deep Time 河流、地貌與地質年代

items.def: a map that shows the height and shape of the land
items.s: Before the hike, our leader studied a ______ ______ carefully, because she wanted to avoid the steepest parts of the trail.
items.zh: 健行前，我們的領隊仔細研究了一張地形圖，因為她想避開步道最陡的部分。
items.sec: Rivers, Landscapes & Deep Time 河流、地貌與地質年代

items.def: the ground at the bottom of a river
items.s: The ________ was completely dry after months without rain, so the children walked across it and collected smooth stones.
items.zh: 好幾個月沒下雨後，河床完全乾涸了，所以孩子們走過河床並撿拾光滑的石頭。
items.sec: Rivers, Landscapes & Deep Time 河流、地貌與地質年代

items.def: the movement of water between the sea, air and land
items.s: In the ______ ______, water rises from the ocean as vapour, and it later falls back to the ground as rain.
items.zh: 在水循環中，水以水蒸氣的形式從海洋上升，之後又以雨的形式落回地面。
items.sec: Rivers, Landscapes & Deep Time 河流、地貌與地質年代

items.def: a long tube of ice drilled out to study the past
items.s: Each ______ ______ holds tiny air bubbles from long ago, so scientists can learn what the air was like thousands of years ago.
items.zh: 每一根冰芯都含有很久以前的微小氣泡，所以科學家可以了解數千年前的空氣是什麼樣子。
items.sec: Rivers, Landscapes & Deep Time 河流、地貌與地質年代

items.def: the sun and all the planets and objects that go around it
items.s: Our ______ ______ has eight planets, but scientists keep discovering new moons and small icy worlds at its edge.
items.zh: 我們的太陽系有八顆行星，但科學家不斷在它的邊緣發現新的衛星和冰冷的小天體。

items.def: a large round object that moves around a star
items.s: Earth is the only ________ that we know has life, so scientists are excited whenever they find water somewhere else.
items.zh: 地球是我們所知唯一有生命的行星，所以每當科學家在其他地方發現水時都會很興奮。

items.def: related to planets
items.s: She works as a ________ scientist, and her team studies the weather on Mars to prepare for future human visits.
items.zh: 她是一名行星科學家，而她的團隊研究火星上的天氣，為未來人類登陸做準備。

items.def: to move around a planet or star in a curved path
items.s: The International Space Station ________ the Earth about sixteen times a day, so the astronauts see many sunrises.
items.zh: 國際太空站每天繞地球運行大約十六圈，所以太空人能看到許多次日出。

items.def: related to the path of an object around a planet or star
items.s: Mars has a longer ________ path than Earth, so one year on Mars lasts almost twice as long as ours.
items.zh: 火星的軌道路徑比地球長，所以火星上的一年幾乎是我們的兩倍長。

items.def: the second planet from the sun, very hot and cloudy
items.s: ________ is often called Earth's sister planet because of its size, but its surface is hot enough to melt lead.
items.zh: 金星因為大小相近常被稱為地球的姊妹星，但它的表面熱到足以熔化鉛。

items.def: the red planet, fourth from the sun
items.s: Several countries have sent robots to ________, and some companies hope to send people there within the next twenty years.
items.zh: 好幾個國家已經送機器人到火星，而有些公司希望在未來二十年內把人送到那裡。

items.def: the largest planet in our solar system
items.s: ________ is so big that all the other planets could fit inside it, and it has a giant storm that has lasted for centuries.
items.zh: 木星大到其他所有行星都能裝進去，而且它有一個已經持續了好幾個世紀的巨大風暴。

items.def: the sixth planet, famous for its rings
items.s: Through the telescope we could clearly see ________ and its beautiful rings, so everyone in the class wanted another look.
items.zh: 透過望遠鏡我們能清楚看到土星和它美麗的光環，所以班上每個人都想再看一次。

items.def: the eighth and farthest planet from the sun
items.s: ________ is so far away that sunlight takes about four hours to reach it, and its winds are the fastest in the solar system.
items.zh: 海王星遠到陽光要大約四小時才能抵達，而且它的風速是太陽系中最快的。

items.def: a small round object that orbits the sun but is not a full planet
items.s: Pluto is now called a ______ ______, but many people still think of it as the ninth planet because they learned that at school.
items.zh: 冥王星現在被稱為矮行星，但許多人仍然把它當成第九顆行星，因為他們在學校是這樣學的。

items.def: a small icy dwarf planet far from the sun
items.s: A spacecraft flew past ________ in 2015, and its photos showed a giant heart-shaped area of ice on the surface.
items.zh: 一艘太空船在2015年飛越冥王星，而它拍的照片顯示表面上有一大片心形的冰原。

items.def: a natural object that moves around a planet
items.s: Jupiter has dozens of ________, and scientists think one of them may hide a salty ocean under its icy surface.
items.zh: 木星有數十顆衛星，而科學家認為其中一顆可能在冰冷表面下藏著一片鹹水海洋。

items.def: related to the moon
items.s: Many Asian festivals follow the ________ calendar, so the date of Chinese New Year changes every year.
items.zh: 許多亞洲節慶依循陰曆，所以農曆新年的日期每年都不一樣。

items.def: the curved shape of the moon when only a thin part is lit
items.s: A thin ________ appeared in the western sky after sunset, and my grandmother said it looked like a smile.
items.zh: 日落後西方天空出現一彎細細的新月，而我奶奶說它看起來像一個微笑。

items.def: the moon when it looks completely round and bright
items.s: Families in Taiwan eat mooncakes under the ______ ______ during the Mid-Autumn Festival, and many also have barbecues outdoors.
items.zh: 臺灣的家庭在中秋節時於滿月下吃月餅，而且許多人也會在戶外烤肉。

items.def: when the moon blocks the sun's light from Earth
items.s: We watched the ______ ______ through special glasses, because looking directly at the sun can damage your eyes.
items.zh: 我們透過特殊眼鏡觀看日蝕，因為直視太陽會傷害眼睛。

items.def: when the Earth's shadow falls on the moon
items.s: During the ______ ______, the moon turned a dark red colour, so people called it a "blood moon" on social media.
items.zh: 月蝕期間，月亮變成暗紅色，所以人們在社群媒體上稱它為「血月」。

items.def: a large rock that moves around the sun
items.s: Scientists track every large ________ near Earth, so they would have years of warning if one were heading toward us.
items.zh: 科學家追蹤地球附近每一顆大型小行星，所以如果有一顆朝我們飛來，他們會提前好幾年得到警告。

items.def: the area between Mars and Jupiter with many asteroids
items.s: The ______ ______ lies between Mars and Jupiter, but the rocks are so far apart that spacecraft can pass through safely.
items.zh: 小行星帶位於火星和木星之間，但那些岩石彼此相距非常遠，所以太空船可以安全通過。

items.def: an icy object with a bright tail that travels around the sun
items.s: Halley's ________ returns about every 76 years, so most people can see it only once in their lifetime.
items.zh: 哈雷彗星大約每七十六年回來一次，所以大多數人一生中只能看到它一次。

items.def: a piece of space rock that burns up in the sky
items.s: A bright ________ flashed across the sky while we were camping, and everyone quickly made a wish.
items.zh: 我們露營時一顆明亮的流星劃過天空，而每個人都趕快許了願。

items.def: a time when many meteors can be seen in the sky
items.s: We drove up the mountain to watch the ______ ______, because the city lights make it hard to see anything at home.
items.zh: 我們開車上山去看流星雨，因為城市的燈光讓我們在家裡很難看到任何東西。

items.def: an everyday name for a meteor
items.s: My little sister saw her first ______ ______ last night, and she still will not tell anyone what she wished for.
items.zh: 我妹妹昨晚看到她人生的第一顆流星，而她到現在仍不肯告訴任何人她許了什麼願。

items.def: the act of spinning around a centre
items.s: The Earth's ________ gives us day and night, and one complete turn takes about twenty-four hours.
items.zh: 地球的自轉帶給我們白天和黑夜，而轉一整圈大約需要二十四小時。

items.def: an imaginary line that a planet spins around
items.s: The Earth's ________ is tilted, so different parts of the world receive more sunlight at different times of the year.
items.zh: 地球的地軸是傾斜的，所以世界上不同地區在一年中不同時間接收到較多的陽光。

items.def: an imaginary line around the middle of the Earth
items.s: Countries near the ________ are hot all year round, and they usually have only a wet season and a dry season.
items.zh: 靠近赤道的國家一年到頭都很熱，而且它們通常只有雨季和乾季。

items.def: a huge planet made mostly of gas
items.s: Jupiter is a ______ ______, so a spacecraft could never land on it, because it has no solid surface.
items.zh: 木星是一顆氣態巨行星，所以太空船永遠無法在上面降落，因為它沒有固體表面。

items.def: a planet with a hard surface made of rock and metal
items.s: Earth is a ______ ______ like Mars, but our thick atmosphere and liquid water make it much friendlier to life.
items.zh: 地球和火星一樣是岩質行星，但我們厚厚的大氣層和液態水讓它對生命友善得多。

items.def: a dark, cooler area on the surface of the sun
items.s: Each ________ looks small in photos, but many of them are actually larger than the whole Earth.
items.zh: 每個太陽黑子在照片中看起來很小，但其中許多其實比整個地球還大。

items.def: a sudden burst of energy from the sun
items.s: A strong ______ ______ can disturb radio signals, so airlines sometimes change their routes when one is expected.
items.zh: 強烈的太陽閃焰會干擾無線電訊號，所以預期會發生時，航空公司有時會更改航線。

items.def: a stream of particles flowing out from the sun
items.s: The ______ ______ never stops blowing, but the Earth's magnetic field protects us from most of its harmful particles.
items.zh: 太陽風從未停止吹拂，但地球的磁場保護我們免受其中大部分有害粒子的傷害。

items.def: colourful lights in the night sky near the poles
items.s: We travelled to northern Norway to see the ________, and the green lights dancing across the sky were unforgettable.
items.zh: 我們到挪威北部去看極光，而在天空中舞動的綠色光芒令人難忘。

items.def: an area of icy objects beyond Neptune
items.s: Pluto lives in the ______ ______, which is a cold region full of icy objects, so it is very hard to study.
items.zh: 冥王星位於古柏帶，那是一個充滿冰冷天體的寒冷區域，所以很難研究。

items.def: a huge ball of burning gas in space, like the sun
items.s: The sun is actually an ordinary ________, but it looks much bigger and brighter because it is so close to us.
items.zh: 太陽其實是一顆普通的恆星，但因為它離我們非常近，所以看起來大得多也亮得多。
items.sec: Stars, Galaxies & the Universe 恆星、星系與宇宙

items.def: a huge group of billions of stars
items.s: Our ________ contains hundreds of billions of stars, and astronomers think there are billions of other galaxies too.
items.zh: 我們的星系包含數千億顆恆星，而天文學家認為還有數十億個其他星系。
items.sec: Stars, Galaxies & the Universe 恆星、星系與宇宙

items.def: the galaxy that contains our solar system
items.s: On a clear night in the mountains, you can see the ______ ______ as a bright band across the sky, but it is invisible in the city.
items.zh: 在山上晴朗的夜晚，你可以看到銀河像一條明亮的光帶橫跨天空，但在城市裡卻看不見。
items.sec: Stars, Galaxies & the Universe 恆星、星系與宇宙

items.def: a group of stars that forms a pattern
items.s: Orion is an easy ________ to find in winter, because three bright stars form his belt in a straight line.
items.zh: 獵戶座是冬天很容易找到的星座，因為三顆明亮的星星排成一直線構成他的腰帶。
items.sec: Stars, Galaxies & the Universe 恆星、星系與宇宙

items.def: a huge cloud of gas and dust in space
items.s: New stars are born inside a ________, and space telescopes have taken amazing colourful photos of these clouds.
items.zh: 新的恆星在星雲中誕生，而太空望遠鏡已經拍下這些雲氣令人驚嘆的彩色照片。
items.sec: Stars, Galaxies & the Universe 恆星、星系與宇宙

items.def: the huge explosion of a dying star
items.s: When a giant star dies in a ________, it can shine brighter than a whole galaxy for several weeks.
items.zh: 當一顆巨大的恆星在超新星爆炸中死亡時，它可以在幾週內比整個星系還亮。
items.sec: Stars, Galaxies & the Universe 恆星、星系與宇宙

items.def: an area in space where gravity is so strong that light cannot escape
items.s: Nothing can escape from a ______ ______, so scientists could not photograph one directly until 2019.
items.zh: 沒有任何東西能逃離黑洞，所以科學家直到2019年才能直接拍攝到一個黑洞。
items.sec: Stars, Galaxies & the Universe 恆星、星系與宇宙

items.def: a very small, very heavy dead star
items.s: A ______ ______ is only about twenty kilometres wide, but a single spoonful of it would weigh more than a mountain.
items.zh: 中子星只有大約二十公里寬，但它的一小匙物質就比一座山還重。
items.sec: Stars, Galaxies & the Universe 恆星、星系與宇宙

items.def: a large, old star that has grown cooler and redder
items.s: In about five billion years, the sun will become a ______ ______, and it may grow big enough to swallow the Earth.
items.zh: 大約五十億年後，太陽將變成一顆紅巨星，而且它可能會膨脹到足以吞噬地球。
items.sec: Stars, Galaxies & the Universe 恆星、星系與宇宙

items.def: a small, hot, dense star near the end of its life
items.s: After it stops burning fuel, the sun will shrink into a ______ ______, and it will slowly cool down for billions of years.
items.zh: 停止燃燒燃料後，太陽會縮小成一顆白矮星，而它會在數十億年間慢慢冷卻。
items.sec: Stars, Galaxies & the Universe 恆星、星系與宇宙

items.def: the distance light travels in one year
items.s: The nearest star is over four ________ away, so even our fastest spacecraft would need thousands of years to get there.
items.zh: 最近的恆星距離我們超過四光年，所以即使是我們最快的太空船也需要數千年才能抵達。
items.sec: Stars, Galaxies & the Universe 恆星、星系與宇宙

items.def: a scientist who studies stars and planets
items.s: The ________ stayed awake all night at the observatory, and she finally spotted the faint comet just before dawn.
items.zh: 那位天文學家在天文臺整夜沒睡，而她終於在黎明前發現了那顆暗淡的彗星。
items.sec: Stars, Galaxies & the Universe 恆星、星系與宇宙

items.def: the science of how stars and galaxies work
items.s: He wants to study ________ at university, because he has loved reading about black holes since he was a child.
items.zh: 他想在大學念天體物理學，因為他從小就喜歡閱讀關於黑洞的資料。
items.sec: Stars, Galaxies & the Universe 恆星、星系與宇宙

items.def: the whole universe, seen as an ordered system
items.s: Looking at the night sky makes me feel tiny, but it also makes me curious about our place in the ________.
items.zh: 仰望夜空讓我覺得自己很渺小，但也讓我對我們在宇宙中的位置感到好奇。
items.sec: Stars, Galaxies & the Universe 恆星、星系與宇宙

items.def: related to the universe or outer space
items.s: Astronauts on long missions face ________ rays from space, so engineers design special shields for their spacecraft.
items.zh: 執行長期任務的太空人會面臨來自太空的宇宙射線，所以工程師為他們的太空船設計特殊的防護罩。
items.sec: Stars, Galaxies & the Universe 恆星、星系與宇宙

items.def: everything that exists, including all stars and space
items.s: The ________ is about 13.8 billion years old, and it is still getting bigger every second.
items.zh: 宇宙大約有一百三十八億年歷史，而且它每一秒都還在變大。
items.sec: Stars, Galaxies & the Universe 恆星、星系與宇宙

items.def: the event that most scientists think started the universe
items.s: Most scientists believe the universe began with the ______ ______, although nobody knows what existed before it.
items.zh: 大多數科學家相信宇宙起源於大霹靂，雖然沒有人知道在那之前存在著什麼。
items.sec: Stars, Galaxies & the Universe 恆星、星系與宇宙

items.def: invisible material that we know exists because of its gravity
items.s: We cannot see ______ ______, but scientists know it is there because it pulls on stars and galaxies.
items.zh: 我們看不見暗物質，但科學家知道它存在，因為它會拉扯恆星和星系。
items.sec: Stars, Galaxies & the Universe 恆星、星系與宇宙

items.def: a mysterious force that makes the universe expand faster
items.s: ______ ______ is pushing galaxies apart faster and faster, but nobody yet understands what it really is.
items.zh: 暗能量正把星系推得越來越快地分開，但至今還沒有人了解它到底是什麼。
items.sec: Stars, Galaxies & the Universe 恆星、星系與宇宙

items.def: a building with large telescopes for watching the sky
items.s: The ________ is built on the top of a high mountain, because the air there is clear and there is very little light pollution.
items.zh: 那座天文臺建在高山頂上，因為那裡空氣清澈而且光害很少。
items.sec: Stars, Galaxies & the Universe 恆星、星系與宇宙

items.def: a tool that makes faraway objects look closer
items.s: I got a small ________ for my birthday, and now I go up to the roof every clear night to look at the moon.
items.zh: 我生日時收到一架小望遠鏡，而現在每個晴朗的夜晚我都會到屋頂上看月亮。
items.sec: Stars, Galaxies & the Universe 恆星、星系與宇宙

items.def: a telescope that orbits above the Earth's atmosphere
items.s: A ______ ______ takes much clearer pictures than one on the ground, because the air does not blur its view.
items.zh: 太空望遠鏡拍的照片比地面上的清晰得多，因為空氣不會讓它的視野變模糊。
items.sec: Stars, Galaxies & the Universe 恆星、星系與宇宙

items.def: a planet that moves around a star other than the sun
items.s: Astronomers have found thousands of ________, and a few of them might have the right temperature for liquid water.
items.zh: 天文學家已經發現了數千顆系外行星，而其中少數可能有適合液態水存在的溫度。
items.sec: Stars, Galaxies & the Universe 恆星、星系與宇宙

items.def: the area around a star where water can stay liquid
items.s: Earth lies in the sun's ______ ______, so it is neither too hot nor too cold for oceans to exist.
items.zh: 地球位於太陽的適居帶內，所以對海洋的存在而言既不太熱也不太冷。
items.sec: Stars, Galaxies & the Universe 恆星、星系與宇宙

items.def: between the stars
items.s: Two spacecraft launched in the 1970s have now entered ________ space, but they still send weak signals back to Earth.
items.zh: 1970年代發射的兩艘太空船現在已經進入星際空間，但它們仍然把微弱的訊號傳回地球。
items.sec: Stars, Galaxies & the Universe 恆星、星系與宇宙

items.def: in or related to the sky or outer space
items.s: Ancient sailors used ________ objects like the stars to find their way, because they had no maps or GPS.
items.zh: 古代水手利用星星之類的天體來辨別方向，因為他們沒有地圖或衛星定位。
items.sec: Stars, Galaxies & the Universe 恆星、星系與宇宙

items.def: the activity of looking at the stars
items.s: ________ is popular in Hehuanshan, so on weekends many families drive up the mountain with blankets and hot drinks.
items.zh: 在合歡山觀星很受歡迎，所以每到週末許多家庭會帶著毯子和熱飲開車上山。
items.sec: Stars, Galaxies & the Universe 恆星、星系與宇宙

items.def: an extremely bright and distant object powered by a black hole
items.s: A ________ can be brighter than a thousand galaxies, but it looks like a faint dot because it is so far away.
items.zh: 一個類星體可能比一千個星系還亮，但因為它非常遙遠，所以看起來只是一個暗淡的小點。
items.sec: Stars, Galaxies & the Universe 恆星、星系與宇宙

items.def: a telescope that collects radio waves from space
items.s: China built a huge ______ ______ in a mountain valley, and it listens for faint signals from distant stars.
items.zh: 中國在一處山谷中建造了一座巨大的電波望遠鏡，而它聆聽來自遙遠恆星的微弱訊號。
items.sec: Stars, Galaxies & the Universe 恆星、星系與宇宙

items.def: a group of stars that are close together
items.s: The Pleiades is a beautiful ______ ______, and on a dark night you can see six or seven of its stars without a telescope.
items.zh: 昴宿星團是一個美麗的星團，而在黑暗的夜晚不用望遠鏡就能看到其中六、七顆星。
items.sec: Stars, Galaxies & the Universe 恆星、星系與宇宙

items.def: travelling into space to learn about it
items.s: ______ ______ is very expensive, but it has given us many useful inventions, such as better weather forecasts and GPS.
items.zh: 太空探索非常昂貴，但它為我們帶來許多有用的發明，例如更好的天氣預報和衛星定位。
items.sec: Space Exploration & Space Junk 太空探索與太空垃圾

items.def: a person trained to travel in space
items.s: The ________ trained for years before her mission, and she said the hardest part was being away from her family.
items.zh: 那位太空人在任務前接受了多年訓練，而她說最困難的部分是離開家人。
items.sec: Space Exploration & Space Junk 太空探索與太空垃圾

items.def: a vehicle that travels in space
items.s: The ________ took seven months to reach Mars, so engineers had to plan every detail of the journey very carefully.
items.zh: 那艘太空船花了七個月才抵達火星，所以工程師必須非常仔細地規劃旅程的每個細節。
items.sec: Space Exploration & Space Junk 太空探索與太空垃圾

items.def: a large spacecraft where people live and work in orbit
items.s: Astronauts on the ______ ______ grow vegetables in space, and they also do experiments that cannot be done on Earth.
items.zh: 太空站上的太空人在太空中種植蔬菜，而且他們也進行在地球上無法做的實驗。
items.sec: Space Exploration & Space Junk 太空探索與太空垃圾

items.def: a vehicle pushed upward by burning fuel
items.s: The ________ shook the ground as it rose into the sky, and the crowd cheered until it disappeared into the clouds.
items.zh: 火箭升空時震動了地面，而群眾一直歡呼直到它消失在雲層中。
items.sec: Space Exploration & Space Junk 太空探索與太空垃圾

items.def: the place from which a rocket takes off
items.s: The rocket stood on the ______ ______ for hours, but the launch was cancelled because of strong winds.
items.zh: 火箭在發射臺上矗立了好幾個小時，但發射因為強風而取消了。
items.sec: Space Exploration & Space Junk 太空探索與太空垃圾

items.def: counting backwards to zero before something starts
items.s: The ________ reached zero and the engines roared, so everyone in the control room held their breath.
items.zh: 倒數計時歸零、引擎轟鳴，所以控制室裡的每個人都屏住了呼吸。
items.sec: Space Exploration & Space Junk 太空探索與太空垃圾

items.def: the moment a rocket leaves the ground
items.s: Just seconds after ________, the rocket was moving faster than a plane, and soon it was only a bright dot in the sky.
items.zh: 升空後短短幾秒，火箭的速度就比飛機還快，而很快它就只是天空中的一個亮點。
items.sec: Space Exploration & Space Junk 太空探索與太空垃圾

items.def: the team on Earth that guides a space flight
items.s: The astronauts talked to ______ ______ every day, and the engineers on the ground helped them fix problems with the equipment.
items.zh: 太空人每天和任務控制中心通話，而地面上的工程師幫助他們修理設備的問題。
items.sec: Space Exploration & Space Junk 太空探索與太空垃圾

items.def: special clothing that protects astronauts in space
items.s: A ________ is very heavy on Earth, but in space it protects astronauts from extreme heat, cold and radiation.
items.zh: 太空衣在地球上非常重，但在太空中它保護太空人免受極端的高溫、低溫和輻射傷害。
items.sec: Space Exploration & Space Junk 太空探索與太空垃圾

items.def: time an astronaut spends working outside a spacecraft
items.s: During the six-hour ________, the astronauts repaired a solar panel, and millions of people watched the live video online.
items.zh: 在六小時的太空漫步期間，太空人修理了一片太陽能板，而數百萬人在網路上觀看直播影片。
items.sec: Space Exploration & Space Junk 太空探索與太空垃圾

items.def: a state where things float because they seem to have no weight
items.s: In ______ ______, water forms floating balls instead of pouring, so astronauts drink through special straws.
items.zh: 在零重力狀態下，水會形成漂浮的水球而不會倒出來，所以太空人用特殊的吸管喝水。
items.sec: Space Exploration & Space Junk 太空探索與太空垃圾

items.def: having no weight, so you float
items.s: The astronauts felt ________ as soon as they reached orbit, and their pens and notebooks floated around the cabin.
items.zh: 太空人一進入軌道就感到失重，而他們的筆和筆記本在艙內四處漂浮。
items.sec: Space Exploration & Space Junk 太空探索與太空垃圾

items.def: very weak gravity, like inside an orbiting spacecraft
