items.s: Long stays in ________ make astronauts' bones and muscles weaker, so they must exercise for two hours every day.
items.zh: 長時間待在微重力環境會讓太空人的骨骼和肌肉變弱，所以他們每天必須運動兩小時。
items.sec: Space Exploration & Space Junk 太空探索與太空垃圾

items.def: the return of a spacecraft into the Earth's atmosphere
items.s: ________ is one of the most dangerous parts of a mission, because the spacecraft becomes extremely hot as it falls through the air.
items.zh: 重返大氣層是任務中最危險的部分之一，因為太空船穿過空氣墜落時會變得極度灼熱。
items.sec: Space Exploration & Space Junk 太空探索與太空垃圾

items.def: a cover that protects a spacecraft from extreme heat
items.s: The capsule has a thick ______ ______ on the bottom, so the astronauts inside stay cool while the outside glows red.
items.zh: 太空艙底部有一層厚厚的隔熱罩，所以外部燒得通紅時，裡面的太空人仍然保持涼爽。
items.sec: Space Exploration & Space Junk 太空探索與太空垃圾

items.def: a vehicle that drives on the surface of another planet
items.s: The ________ has been driving across Mars for years, and it sends back photos that look surprisingly like deserts on Earth.
items.zh: 那輛探測車已經在火星上行駛多年，而它傳回的照片看起來出奇地像地球上的沙漠。
items.sec: Space Exploration & Space Junk 太空探索與太空垃圾

items.def: a spacecraft designed to land on a planet or moon
items.s: The ________ touched down gently on the moon, and the scientists in the control room jumped up and hugged each other.
items.zh: 登陸器輕輕地降落在月球上，而控制室裡的科學家們跳起來互相擁抱。
items.sec: Space Exploration & Space Junk 太空探索與太空垃圾

items.def: a robot spacecraft sent to explore space
items.s: The ______ ______ has travelled for over forty years, but it is still sending information back to scientists on Earth.
items.zh: 那個太空探測器已經航行了四十多年，但它仍然把資訊傳回給地球上的科學家。
items.sec: Space Exploration & Space Junk 太空探索與太空垃圾

items.def: a government organisation that runs space programmes
items.s: Taiwan's ______ ______ has launched several satellites, and it hopes to train more young engineers in the next ten years.
items.zh: 臺灣的太空機構已經發射了好幾顆人造衛星，而且它希望在未來十年培育更多年輕工程師。
items.sec: Space Exploration & Space Junk 太空探索與太空垃圾

items.def: the competition between countries to explore space first
items.s: During the ______ ______, the USA and the Soviet Union competed fiercely, and both countries spent huge amounts of money.
items.zh: 在太空競賽期間，美國和蘇聯激烈競爭，而兩國都花費了鉅額資金。
items.sec: Space Exploration & Space Junk 太空探索與太空垃圾

items.def: the event of a spacecraft or people landing on the moon
items.s: My grandparents watched the first ______ ______ on a small black-and-white TV, and they still remember that exciting night.
items.zh: 我的祖父母在一臺小小的黑白電視上看了第一次登月，而他們至今仍記得那個令人興奮的夜晚。
items.sec: Space Exploration & Space Junk 太空探索與太空垃圾

items.def: old, broken objects left floating in orbit
items.s: There are millions of pieces of ______ ______ around the Earth, and even a tiny piece can damage a working satellite.
items.zh: 地球周圍有數百萬片太空垃圾，而即使是很小的一片也能損壞運作中的人造衛星。
items.sec: Space Exploration & Space Junk 太空探索與太空垃圾

items.def: the area of space close above the Earth's atmosphere
items.s: Most satellites travel in ______ ______ ______, so this area is becoming crowded, and collisions are a growing risk.
items.zh: 大多數人造衛星在低地球軌道上運行，所以這個區域變得越來越擁擠，而碰撞的風險也日益增加。
items.sec: Space Exploration & Space Junk 太空探索與太空垃圾

items.def: travelling to space for fun as a paying passenger
items.s: ______ ______ is still extremely expensive, but some companies believe ordinary people will be able to afford it one day.
items.zh: 太空旅遊仍然極其昂貴，但有些公司相信有一天普通人也能負擔得起。
items.sec: Space Exploration & Space Junk 太空探索與太空垃圾

items.def: a rocket that can be flown more than once
items.s: A ______ ______ lands back on Earth after each flight, so it greatly reduces the cost of sending satellites into space.
items.zh: 可重複使用火箭每次飛行後都會降落回地球，所以它大幅降低了發射人造衛星的成本。
items.sec: Space Exploration & Space Junk 太空探索與太空垃圾

items.def: a small engine used to move or turn a spacecraft
items.s: One ________ stopped working during the mission, so the team on the ground had to find another way to turn the spacecraft.
items.zh: 一具推進器在任務中停止運作，所以地面團隊必須找到另一種方法來轉動太空船。
items.sec: Space Exploration & Space Junk 太空探索與太空垃圾

items.def: the force that pushes something forward
items.s: Engineers are testing new kinds of ________ for spacecraft, because chemical rockets are too slow for long journeys.
items.zh: 工程師正在測試新型的太空船推進系統，因為化學火箭對長途旅行來說太慢了。
items.sec: Space Exploration & Space Junk 太空探索與太空垃圾

items.def: coming from outside the Earth
items.s: Scientists have not found any ________ life yet, but many believe simple living things may exist on other worlds.
items.zh: 科學家還沒有發現任何外星生命，但許多人相信簡單的生物可能存在於其他星球上。
items.sec: Space Exploration & Space Junk 太空探索與太空垃圾

items.def: a small sealed room for moving between areas with different air pressure
items.s: The astronauts waited inside the ________ while the air was pumped out, and then they opened the door to space.
items.zh: 太空人在氣閘艙裡等待空氣被抽出，然後他們打開了通往太空的門。
items.sec: Space Exploration & Space Junk 太空探索與太空垃圾

items.def: close to the exact number but not exact
items.s: The guide gave us the ________ height of the volcano, but she said the exact number changes slightly after each eruption.
items.zh: 導遊告訴我們那座火山的大約高度，但她說確切數字在每次噴發後都會略有改變。

items.def: happening by chance, not planned
items.s: The two earthquakes happened on the same day, but scientists said it was ________ because they were on different faults.
items.zh: 兩場地震在同一天發生，但科學家說那是巧合，因為它們位於不同的斷層上。

items.def: to limit what someone or something can do
items.s: A small budget ________ the team's research, so they could only study one volcano instead of three.
items.zh: 微薄的預算限制了團隊的研究，所以他們只能研究一座火山，而不是三座。

items.def: the act of changing something into another form
items.s: The ________ of sunlight into electricity powers the space station, and the large solar panels are always turned toward the sun.
items.zh: 將陽光轉換成電力為太空站提供能源，而那些大型太陽能板總是朝向太陽。

items.def: a standard used to judge something
items.s: The most important ________ for a new observatory is dark skies, so most are built far from big cities.
items.zh: 新天文臺最重要的標準是天空要暗，所以大多數天文臺都建在遠離大城市的地方。

items.def: reaching a conclusion by careful reasoning
items.s: Through careful ________, the detective in the novel found the thief, but readers were still surprised by the ending.
items.zh: 透過仔細的推論，小說中的偵探找到了小偷，但讀者仍對結局感到驚訝。

items.def: able to be shown or proved clearly
items.s: The new warning system has had a ________ effect on safety, because fewer people were hurt in this year's earthquakes.
items.zh: 新的預警系統對安全產生了可證明的效果，因為今年的地震中受傷的人變少了。

items.def: a change from the usual or expected path
items.s: Even a small ________ from the planned route could send the spacecraft into the wrong orbit, so engineers check it constantly.
items.zh: 即使是與預定路線的微小偏差也可能讓太空船進入錯誤的軌道，所以工程師不斷檢查。

items.def: easy to recognise because it is special
items.s: Saturn has ________ rings that are easy to spot, so it is often the first planet that children learn to recognise.
items.zh: 土星有容易辨認的獨特光環，所以它常常是孩子們第一個學會認出的行星。

items.def: by observation or experiment rather than theory
items.s: The idea sounded strange at first, but scientists tested it ________, and the results showed that it was correct.
items.zh: 這個想法起初聽起來很奇怪，但科學家以實證方式測試了它，而結果顯示它是正確的。

items.def: the process of becoming larger
items.s: The ________ of the universe means that distant galaxies are moving away from us, and they are moving faster every year.
items.zh: 宇宙的膨脹意味著遙遠的星系正在遠離我們，而且它們每年都移動得更快。

items.def: the process by which something is made
items.s: The ________ of a new island near Japan surprised scientists, and they quickly sailed there to study the fresh lava.
items.zh: 日本附近一座新島嶼的形成讓科學家很驚訝，而他們很快就航行到那裡研究新鮮的熔岩。

items.def: to suggest an idea that can be tested
items.s: Some researchers ________ that animals can sense earthquakes early, but nobody has proved this idea yet.
items.zh: 有些研究者假設動物能提早感知地震，但還沒有人證實這個想法。

items.def: a sign that shows something is happening
items.s: There was no ________ that the volcano would erupt, so the sudden explosion shocked everyone living nearby.
items.zh: 沒有任何跡象顯示那座火山會噴發，所以突如其來的爆炸讓住在附近的每個人都很震驚。

items.def: without any limit or end
items.s: Some people believe that space is ________, but others think it must have an edge somewhere.
items.zh: 有些人相信太空是無限的，但其他人認為它一定在某處有邊界。

items.def: to combine things so they work together
items.s: The app ________ earthquake alerts with maps, so users can quickly see the nearest safe place to go.
items.zh: 這個應用程式把地震警報和地圖整合在一起，所以使用者可以很快看到最近的安全地點。

items.def: to act on or affect each other
items.s: The moon and the oceans ________ through gravity, and this is why the sea rises and falls twice a day.
items.zh: 月球和海洋透過重力相互作用，而這就是海水一天漲落兩次的原因。

items.def: a careful study to find the facts
items.s: After the bridge collapsed, an ________ found that the builders had ignored the earthquake rules, so they were fined.
items.zh: 橋梁倒塌後，一項調查發現建商忽視了防震規定，所以他們被罰款。

items.def: impossible to see
items.s: Radio waves are ________ to our eyes, but special telescopes can turn them into pictures that we can understand.
items.zh: 無線電波是我們的眼睛看不見的，但特殊的望遠鏡能把它們轉換成我們能理解的圖像。

items.def: not having a regular shape or pattern
items.s: Most asteroids have an ________ shape, so they look more like potatoes than round planets.
items.zh: 大多數小行星的形狀不規則，所以它們看起來比較像馬鈴薯而不是圓形的行星。

items.def: important or interesting enough to be noticed
items.s: The most ________ discovery of the trip was a new crystal cave, and the news soon spread around the world.
items.zh: 那次旅程最值得注意的發現是一個新的晶洞，而這則新聞很快就傳遍了全世界。

items.def: to watch something carefully
items.s: Students ________ the moon every night for a month, and they recorded how its shape slowly changed.
items.zh: 學生們連續一個月每晚觀察月亮，而且他們記錄了月亮的形狀如何慢慢改變。

items.def: something that happens
items.s: Earthquakes are a common ________ in Taiwan, so most buildings are designed to sway without falling down.
items.zh: 地震在臺灣是常見的事，所以大多數建築都設計成會搖晃但不會倒塌。

items.def: the fact of being in a place
items.s: The ________ of water on Mars long ago excites scientists, because life usually needs water to survive.
items.zh: 火星很久以前有水存在這件事讓科學家很興奮，因為生命通常需要水才能存活。

items.def: used to say what you think is probably true
items.s: The ancient lake is now completely dry, so the climate here was ________ much wetter thousands of years ago.
items.zh: 那座古湖現在完全乾涸了，所以這裡的氣候在數千年前大概潮濕得多。

items.def: the quality of being correct or acceptable
items.s: Other scientists questioned the ________ of his results, because nobody else could repeat the experiment.
items.zh: 其他科學家質疑他的結果的正確性，因為沒有其他人能重複這個實驗。

items.def: different from what is usual, often in a worrying way
items.s: The sensors detected ________ gas levels near the crater, so the park closed the hiking trail immediately.
items.zh: 感測器偵測到火山口附近的氣體濃度異常，所以公園立即封閉了健行步道。

items.def: complete and total
items.s: The cave was in ________ darkness when we turned off our torches, and we could not even see our own hands.
items.zh: 當我們關掉手電筒時，洞穴裡一片完全的黑暗，而我們甚至看不到自己的手。

items.def: a gradual increase in amount
items.s: The ________ of pressure along the fault worries scientists, because it may be released in a sudden large earthquake.
items.zh: 斷層沿線壓力的累積讓科學家很擔心，因為它可能在一場突然的大地震中釋放出來。

items.def: a small change made to improve something
items.s: The pilot made a small ________ to the spacecraft's path, and it entered the moon's orbit perfectly.
items.zh: 駕駛員對太空船的航道做了一個小小的調整，而它完美地進入了月球軌道。

items.def: a change in something
items.s: The architect made an ________ to the design after the earthquake, so the new building would be much stronger.
items.zh: 地震後建築師對設計做了修改，讓新建築會堅固得多。

items.def: using careful, logical thinking to examine things
items.s: Good scientists need strong ________ skills, because they must make sense of huge amounts of data.
items.zh: 優秀的科學家需要很強的分析能力，因為他們必須理解大量的數據。

items.def: once every year
items.s: The meteor shower appears ________ in August, so many families plan camping trips to watch it.
items.zh: 那場流星雨每年八月都會出現，所以許多家庭會計畫露營去觀賞。

items.def: to be a typical quality of something
items.s: Steep mountains and short rivers ________ the landscape of Taiwan, so floods can happen very quickly after heavy rain.
items.zh: 陡峭的山和短促的河流是臺灣地貌的特徵，所以大雨過後洪水可能很快就發生。

items.def: a typical feature or quality
items.s: One ________ of Mars is its red dust, and this colour comes from rusty iron in the soil.
items.zh: 火星的一個特徵是它的紅色塵土，而這種顏色來自土壤中生鏽的鐵。

items.def: the quality of being logical and well organised
items.s: Our teacher praised the ________ of my report, because each paragraph led clearly to the next one.
items.zh: 老師稱讚我報告的連貫性，因為每一段都清楚地銜接到下一段。

items.def: involving comparing two or more things
items.s: We did a ________ study of Mars and Earth, and we found that both planets once had rivers and lakes.
items.zh: 我們做了一項火星與地球的比較研究，而我們發現兩顆行星都曾經有河流和湖泊。

items.def: the state of having many connected parts
items.s: The ________ of the mission was huge, so thousands of engineers worked together for more than ten years.
items.zh: 這項任務的複雜性非常高，所以數千名工程師合作了十多年。

items.def: the process of calculating
items.s: Early space missions relied on ________ done by hand, but today powerful computers do the work in seconds.
items.zh: 早期的太空任務仰賴人工計算，但今天強大的電腦在幾秒鐘內就能完成這些工作。

items.def: an idea or understanding of something
items.s: Ancient people had a very different ________ of the universe, and many believed the Earth was at its centre.
items.zh: 古代人對宇宙有著非常不同的觀念，而許多人相信地球位於宇宙中心。

items.def: a statement or proof that something is true
items.s: The team waited for ________ that the lander had arrived safely, and the room exploded with joy when it came.
items.zh: 團隊等待登陸器安全抵達的證實，而當消息傳來時整個房間充滿了歡呼。

items.def: much; a lot
items.s: The new telescope is ________ more powerful than the old one, so astronomers can now see galaxies that were invisible before.
items.zh: 新的望遠鏡比舊的強大得多，所以天文學家現在可以看到以前看不見的星系。

items.def: a situation where two facts cannot both be true
items.s: There was a clear ________ between the two reports, so the scientists checked the data again to find the mistake.
items.zh: 兩份報告之間有明顯的矛盾，所以科學家再次檢查數據以找出錯誤。

items.def: something you give or do to help
items.s: Her ________ to earthquake research was huge, and many of today's safety rules are based on her work.
items.zh: 她對地震研究的貢獻非常大，而今天許多安全規定都是根據她的研究制定的。

items.def: making you believe that something is true
items.s: The photos from the rover were ________ evidence of ancient rivers, so even doubtful scientists changed their minds.
items.zh: 探測車拍的照片是古代河流存在的令人信服的證據，所以即使是抱持懷疑的科學家也改變了看法。

items.def: the quality of being trusted and believed
items.s: The website lost its ________ after it shared a fake earthquake warning, and many readers stopped visiting it.
items.zh: 那個網站分享了一則假的地震警報後失去了可信度，而許多讀者不再造訪它。

items.def: able to be noticed or found
items.s: The earthquake was so small that it was only ________ by machines, and nobody in the city felt anything.
items.zh: 那場地震小到只有機器偵測得到，而城市裡沒有人感覺到任何震動。

items.def: the act of getting rid of something
items.s: The safe ________ of old satellites is a growing problem, because broken ones can crash into working ones.
items.zh: 舊人造衛星的安全處置是一個日益嚴重的問題，因為損壞的衛星可能撞上運作中的衛星。

items.def: the way something is spread over an area
items.s: The map shows the ________ of volcanoes around the world, and most of them are found along plate boundaries.
items.zh: 這張地圖顯示世界各地火山的分布，而它們大多位於板塊邊界沿線。

items.def: the state of being the most powerful
items.s: The USA's ________ in space ended when other countries built their own rockets, so the field is now much more competitive.
items.zh: 當其他國家建造自己的火箭後，美國在太空領域的主導地位就結束了，所以這個領域現在競爭激烈得多。

items.def: sudden and very noticeable
items.s: There was a ________ change in the landscape after the eruption, and the green forest turned into a grey desert.
items.zh: 噴發後地貌發生了劇烈的變化，而翠綠的森林變成了灰色的荒漠。

items.def: the complete removal of something
items.s: The total ________ of space junk is impossible, but scientists are testing nets and magnets to collect some of it.
items.zh: 完全清除太空垃圾是不可能的，但科學家正在測試用網子和磁鐵收集其中一部分。

items.def: a mathematical statement that two things are equal
items.s: Einstein's famous ________ is very short, but it changed the way scientists understand energy and matter.
items.zh: 愛因斯坦著名的方程式非常簡短，但它改變了科學家理解能量和物質的方式。

items.def: basically; in the most important ways
items.s: A comet is ________ a dirty snowball, but it grows a long bright tail when it gets close to the sun.
items.zh: 彗星本質上是一顆髒雪球，但當它接近太陽時會長出一條長長的明亮尾巴。

items.def: a careful judgement of how good something is
items.s: After a full ________ of the old school, engineers decided to strengthen its walls before the next big earthquake.
items.zh: 經過對舊校舍的全面評估後，工程師決定在下一次大地震前加固它的牆壁。

items.def: happening at the end of a long process
items.s: Scientists expect the ________ collapse of the cliff, so they have already moved the walking path further inland.
items.zh: 科學家預期那座懸崖最終會崩塌，所以他們已經把步道移到更內陸的地方。

items.def: clearly; it is easy to see that
items.s: The rocks were ________ shaped by water, because they were smooth and round like stones in a river.
items.zh: 這些岩石顯然是被水塑造出來的，因為它們像河裡的石頭一樣光滑渾圓。

items.def: clearly and directly
items.s: The signs ________ warn visitors not to leave the path, but some tourists still climb onto the dangerous rocks.
items.zh: 告示牌明確地警告遊客不要離開步道，但有些遊客仍然爬上危險的岩石。

items.def: using something, sometimes unfairly, for profit
items.s: The ________ of minerals on the moon may become possible, but many people worry about who will own them.
items.zh: 開採月球上的礦物可能會變得可行，但許多人擔心誰將擁有它們。

items.def: increasing faster and faster
items.s: The number of satellites has grown ________ in recent years, so the sky above us is becoming very crowded.
items.zh: 近年來人造衛星的數量急遽增加，所以我們頭頂上的天空變得非常擁擠。

items.def: the process of removing something from the ground
items.s: The ________ of water from ice on the moon could support future bases, because carrying water from Earth is very expensive.
items.zh: 從月球上的冰萃取水可以支持未來的基地，因為從地球運水非常昂貴。

items.def: the act of recognising who or what something is
items.s: The ________ of the strange rock took weeks, but experts finally confirmed that it was a meteorite.
items.zh: 那塊奇怪岩石的鑑定花了好幾週，但專家最後確認它是一顆隕石。

items.def: a sign that shows the state of something
items.s: Rising ground is a key ________ of a coming eruption, so scientists measure it with GPS every day.
items.zh: 地面隆起是即將噴發的重要指標，所以科學家每天用衛星定位測量它。

items.def: a conclusion based on evidence
items.s: From the shape of the valley, the ________ was that a glacier had once filled it, and later tests proved this correct.
items.zh: 從山谷的形狀推斷，曾經有冰河填滿它，而後來的測試證明這是正確的。

items.def: the state of being likely to change or fall
items.s: The ________ of the slope made the road dangerous, so drivers had to take a much longer route.
items.zh: 斜坡的不穩定讓那條道路變得危險，所以駕駛人必須繞一條遠得多的路。

items.def: the strength of something
items.s: The ________ of the shaking was strongest near the coast, but buildings in the mountains suffered less damage.
items.zh: 靠近海岸的搖晃強度最強，但山區的建築受損較少。

items.def: an explanation of the meaning of something
items.s: Each scientist had a different ________ of the strange signal, so they agreed to collect more data before deciding.
items.zh: 每位科學家對那個奇怪訊號都有不同的解讀，所以他們同意在做決定前收集更多數據。

items.def: a good reason for doing something
items.s: The government's ________ for the expensive mission was that it would inspire young people to study science.
items.zh: 政府對這項昂貴任務的理由是它會激勵年輕人學習科學。

items.def: related to numbers and calculations
items.s: The scientist used a ________ model to predict the asteroid's path, and the result showed it would safely miss the Earth.
items.zh: 科學家使用一個數學模型來預測小行星的路徑，而結果顯示它會安全地與地球擦身而過。

items.def: a small change to improve something
items.s: After one ________ to its software, the rover could drive twice as far each day, so the scientists were delighted.
items.zh: 軟體經過一次修改後，探測車每天能行駛兩倍遠，所以科學家們非常高興。

items.def: expressed in numbers
items.s: The report gave ________ data about each earthquake, but the teacher asked us to explain what the numbers meant.
items.zh: 報告提供了每場地震的數字資料，但老師要我們解釋這些數字代表什麼意思。

items.def: happening again and again at regular times
items.s: The volcano shows ________ activity every few years, so the local people are used to small puffs of smoke.
items.zh: 那座火山每隔幾年就會出現週期性的活動，所以當地人已經習慣小小的冒煙。

items.def: continuing to try even when things are difficult
items.s: Her ________ finally paid off, because after ten years of searching, she discovered a new comet.
items.zh: 她的堅持終於有了回報，因為經過十年的搜尋，她發現了一顆新彗星。

items.def: the quality of being very exact
items.s: Landing on Mars requires great ________, because even a small mistake could send the rover into a crater.
items.zh: 登陸火星需要極高的精確度，因為即使是一個小錯誤也可能讓探測車掉進坑洞裡。

items.def: able to be known in advance
items.s: Eclipses are completely ________, but earthquakes are not, so scientists can only give general warnings about them.
items.zh: 日月蝕是完全可預測的，但地震不是，所以科學家只能對地震發出大致的警告。

items.def: mainly
items.s: The mission was ________ designed to study the moon's ice, but it also took amazing photos of the Earth.
items.zh: 這項任務主要是為了研究月球上的冰而設計的，但它也拍下了地球的驚人照片。

items.def: changing in size in the same way as something else
items.s: The damage from an earthquake is not always ________ to its strength, because building quality matters a lot.
items.zh: 地震造成的損害不一定與它的強度成比例，因為建築品質非常重要。

items.def: in a very big and important way
items.s: Space telescopes have ________ changed our view of the universe, and they keep showing us things nobody expected.
items.zh: 太空望遠鏡徹底改變了我們對宇宙的看法，而且它們不斷讓我們看到沒人預料到的事物。

items.def: building something again after damage
items.s: The ________ of the town took five years after the earthquake, but the new buildings are much safer.
items.zh: 地震後小鎮的重建花了五年，但新的建築安全得多。

items.def: the quality of being connected to what is happening
items.s: Some students doubt the ________ of geology, but it helps us understand floods, landslides and earthquakes.
items.zh: 有些學生懷疑地質學的關聯性，但它幫助我們了解洪水、山崩和地震。

items.def: the quality of being trustworthy or working well
items.s: The ________ of the old warning system was poor, so the city spent millions on a new one.
items.zh: 舊預警系統的可靠性很差，所以市政府花了數百萬元建置新的系統。

items.def: not wanting to do something
items.s: Despite her ________ to leave home, the family moved away from the volcano, because the experts said it was too dangerous.
items.zh: 儘管她不願意離開家，那一家人還是搬離了火山，因為專家說那裡太危險了。

items.def: typical of a larger group
items.s: This rock is ________ of the whole area, so studying it tells us a lot about the history of the region.
items.zh: 這塊岩石對整個地區具有代表性，所以研究它能讓我們了解許多這個區域的歷史。

items.def: something that is needed or necessary
items.s: Good eyesight is a ________ for astronauts, but people who wear glasses can still apply in many countries.
items.zh: 良好的視力是太空人的必要條件，但在許多國家戴眼鏡的人仍然可以申請。

items.def: the amount of detail an image can show
items.s: The new camera has a much higher ________, so we can now see tiny craters on the moon that were invisible before.
items.zh: 新相機的解析度高得多，所以我們現在可以看到月球上以前看不見的小坑洞。

items.def: a surprising fact that is made known
items.s: The photos of Pluto were a ________, because nobody expected to see mountains of ice on such a small world.
items.zh: 冥王星的照片是一項驚人的發現，因為沒有人預料到會在那麼小的星球上看到冰山。

items.def: the importance of something
items.s: The ________ of the discovery was not clear at first, but it later changed the way scientists think about Mars.
items.zh: 這項發現的重要性起初並不明顯，但後來它改變了科學家對火星的看法。

items.def: the way in which things are alike
items.s: There is a strong ________ between the rocks in Scotland and Canada, so scientists believe the two areas were once joined.
items.zh: 蘇格蘭和加拿大的岩石之間有很強的相似性，所以科學家相信這兩個地區曾經相連。

items.def: guesses made without enough information
items.s: There was a lot of ________ about the strange object, but it turned out to be an ordinary rock from space.
items.zh: 關於那個奇怪物體有許多臆測，但結果它只是一塊普通的太空岩石。

items.def: the state of being steady and not likely to change
items.s: Engineers tested the ________ of the bridge carefully, because it must stay standing during strong earthquakes.
items.zh: 工程師仔細測試了那座橋的穩定性，因為它必須在強烈地震時保持屹立。

items.def: related to numbers collected to show facts
items.s: The ________ analysis showed that big earthquakes are rare, but scientists warned that they can still happen at any time.
items.zh: 統計分析顯示大地震很罕見，但科學家警告它們仍然可能隨時發生。

items.def: added to something to make it complete
items.s: The teacher gave us ________ reading about black holes, because many students wanted to learn more after the lesson.
items.zh: 老師給我們關於黑洞的補充閱讀資料，因為許多學生在上完課後想學更多。

items.def: the state of continuing to live
items.s: Water and oxygen are essential for ________ in space, so astronauts carefully recycle every drop of water.
items.zh: 水和氧氣對在太空中生存至關重要，所以太空人仔細回收每一滴水。

items.def: related to time
items.s: The ________ pattern of the earthquakes was strange, because they all happened late at night within one week.
items.zh: 那些地震的時間模式很奇怪，因為它們都在一週內的深夜發生。

items.def: proof that something is correct or true
items.s: The theory still needs ________ from other teams, so the scientists shared all their data online.
items.zh: 這個理論仍需要其他團隊的驗證，所以科學家把所有數據都公開在網路上。

items.def: a change or difference in amount or level
items.s: There is a large ________ in temperature on the moon, because the days are very hot and the nights are freezing.
items.zh: 月球上的溫度變化很大，因為白天非常熱而夜晚極度寒冷。

items.def: the process of checking that something is true
items.s: The news about the comet needed ________, so the reporter called two astronomers before she wrote her story.
items.zh: 關於那顆彗星的新聞需要查證，所以記者在寫報導前打電話給兩位天文學家。

items.def: to form a picture of something in your mind
items.s: It is hard to ________ how big the universe is, so our teacher used a football field to show the distances.
items.zh: 很難想像宇宙有多大，所以我們老師用一座足球場來呈現那些距離。

items.def: something unusual that is different from what is normal
items.s: The strange reading was just an ________ caused by a broken sensor, so the scientists did not need to worry.
items.zh: 那個奇怪的讀數只是一個由故障感測器造成的異常，所以科學家不需要擔心。

items.def: the act of following rules closely
items.s: Strict ________ to safety rules saved many lives during the earthquake, and the school became a model for others.
items.zh: 嚴格遵守安全規定在地震中拯救了許多生命，而這所學校成為其他學校的典範。

items.def: the size of a wave from its middle to its top
items.s: The ________ of the waves on the seismograph grew very large, so scientists knew the earthquake was strong.
items.zh: 地震儀上波形的振幅變得非常大，所以科學家知道這場地震很強烈。

items.def: excitement about something that will happen
items.s: There was great ________ before the launch, and thousands of people gathered on the beach to watch.
items.zh: 發射前充滿了極大的期待，而數千人聚集在海灘上觀看。

items.def: possibly; it can be imagined
items.s: Life could ________ exist under the ice of Jupiter's moon, so scientists are planning a mission to search for it.
items.zh: 生命有可能存在於木星衛星的冰層之下，所以科學家正在計畫一項任務去尋找它。

items.def: in a way that ends all doubt
items.s: The photos ________ proved that the Earth is round, but a few people online still refuse to believe it.
items.zh: 那些照片確鑿地證明了地球是圓的，但網路上仍有少數人拒絕相信。

items.def: when two planets appear very close together in the sky
items.s: Jupiter and Saturn met in a rare ________ in 2020, and many people took photos of the two bright points together.
items.zh: 木星和土星在2020年發生了一次罕見的合，而許多人拍下了兩個亮點並排的照片。

items.def: a possible future event that you must plan for
items.s: The astronauts trained for every ________, so they knew exactly what to do when the alarm suddenly rang.
items.zh: 太空人針對每一種意外情況受過訓練，所以當警報突然響起時，他們清楚知道該怎麼做。

items.def: the outline or shape of something
items.s: We could see the ________ of the mountains against the sunset, and the sky behind them turned bright orange.
items.zh: 我們可以看到夕陽映襯下的山脈輪廓，而它們後面的天空變成了亮橘色。

items.def: the act of moving toward the same point
items.s: The ________ of two plates pushes the land upward, so high mountains often form where plates meet.
items.zh: 兩個板塊的聚合把陸地往上推，所以高山常常在板塊交會的地方形成。

items.def: the final result of a long process
items.s: The landing on Mars was the ________ of twenty years of hard work, so many engineers cried with happiness.
items.zh: 登陸火星是二十年辛勤工作的成果，所以許多工程師喜極而泣。

items.def: the amount that something is curved
items.s: From a high plane you can see the ________ of the Earth, but from the ground the horizon looks completely flat.
items.zh: 從高空的飛機上你可以看到地球的弧度，但從地面看地平線卻完全是平的。

items.def: able to be seen or noticed, but not easily
items.s: The comet's tail was barely ________ in the city sky, so we drove to the countryside for a better view.
items.zh: 彗星的尾巴在城市的天空中幾乎看不出來，所以我們開車到鄉下去看得更清楚。

items.def: the spreading of things over a wide area
items.s: The wind caused the wide ________ of volcanic ash, and cars in cities far away were covered in grey dust.
items.zh: 風造成火山灰大範圍擴散，而遠方城市的汽車都覆蓋著灰色的塵土。

items.def: the act of moving apart in different directions
items.s: The ________ of two plates in Iceland creates new land, so the island is slowly getting wider.
items.zh: 冰島兩個板塊的分離產生新的陸地，所以這座島正慢慢變寬。

items.def: longer than usual and thin
items.s: The strange object from space had an ________ shape like a cigar, and scientists still argue about what it was.
items.zh: 那個來自太空的奇怪物體有著像雪茄一樣細長的形狀，而科學家至今仍在爭論它是什麼。

items.def: the edge of what is known or explored
items.s: Space is often called the final ________, because it is the last great place that humans have not explored.
items.zh: 太空常被稱為最後的邊疆，因為那是人類最後一個尚未探索的偉大地方。

items.def: impossible to imagine or believe
items.s: A hundred years ago, sending people to the moon was ________, but today companies sell tickets to space.
items.zh: 一百年前，把人送上月球是難以想像的，但今天公司在販售太空之旅的票。

items.def: without a fixed end or limit
items.s: The trail is closed for an ________ period after the landslide, so hikers must choose another route for now.
items.zh: 山崩後那條步道無限期封閉，所以健行者目前必須選擇另一條路線。

items.def: impossible to explain
items.s: The flashing light in the sky seemed ________, but it was later identified as a satellite reflecting sunlight.
items.zh: 天空中閃爍的光看似無法解釋，但後來被確認是一顆反射陽光的人造衛星。

items.def: extremely small
items.s: The chance of a large asteroid hitting Earth this year is ________, so there is no need to panic.
items.zh: 今年大型小行星撞擊地球的機率極小，所以沒有必要驚慌。

items.def: too small or unimportant to matter
items.s: Looking at photos of the universe makes our daily problems seem ________, and that can actually be comforting.
items.zh: 看著宇宙的照片會讓我們日常的煩惱顯得微不足道，而這其實能讓人感到安慰。

items.def: not physical, but still real
items.s: The benefits of space research are sometimes ________, because they include inspiration and curiosity, not just new products.
items.zh: 太空研究的好處有時是無形的，因為它們包括啟發和好奇心，而不只是新產品。

items.def: to turn something upside down
items.s: Telescopes often ________ the image of the moon, so beginners are confused when everything looks upside down.
items.zh: 望遠鏡常常把月亮的影像顛倒過來，所以初學者看到一切都是倒的時會很困惑。

items.def: something that is not normal or regular
items.s: The engineer noticed an ________ in the engine data, so the launch was delayed until the problem was fixed.
items.zh: 工程師注意到引擎數據中有一個異常，所以發射被延後直到問題解決。

items.def: to feel great surprise and admiration
items.s: Visitors ________ at the huge crystals in the cave, and many of them say it is the most beautiful place they have seen.
items.zh: 遊客對洞穴裡巨大的晶體驚嘆不已，而許多人說那是他們見過最美的地方。

items.def: at an angle; not straight
items.s: The photo was taken from an ________ angle, so the crater looks much deeper than it really is.
items.zh: 這張照片是從斜角度拍攝的，所以火山口看起來比實際深得多。

items.def: to move backwards and forwards regularly
items.s: Tall buildings ________ slowly during strong earthquakes, but this movement actually helps them avoid serious damage.
items.zh: 高樓在強烈地震中會緩慢地擺動，但這種晃動其實能幫助它們避免嚴重損壞。

items.def: at an angle of 90 degrees to something
items.s: The walls of the canyon are almost ________ to the river, so climbing them requires special equipment.
items.zh: 峽谷的岩壁幾乎與河流垂直，所以攀爬它們需要特殊裝備。

items.def: to send out heat or light in all directions
items.s: The sun ________ energy in every direction, but only a tiny part of it reaches the Earth.
items.zh: 太陽向四面八方散發能量，但只有很小一部分到達地球。

items.def: the state of looking similar to something
items.s: The desert in Chile has a strong ________ to the surface of Mars, so space agencies test their rovers there.
items.zh: 智利的沙漠與火星表面非常相似，所以太空機構在那裡測試他們的探測車。

items.def: completely new and causing great change
items.s: The telescope was a ________ invention, because it allowed Galileo to see the moons of Jupiter for the first time.
items.zh: 望遠鏡是一項革命性的發明，因為它讓伽利略第一次看到木星的衛星。

items.def: at the same time
items.s: The two telescopes recorded the explosion ________, so scientists could compare the results from different places.
items.zh: 兩架望遠鏡同時記錄了那次爆炸，所以科學家可以比較來自不同地方的結果。

items.def: a large empty space
items.s: Space is not a complete ________, because it contains thin gas, dust and radiation everywhere.
items.zh: 太空並不是完全的真空，因為到處都有稀薄的氣體、塵埃和輻射。

items.def: the process of going faster
items.s: The ________ during launch pushed the astronauts back into their seats, and they felt three times heavier than usual.
items.zh: 發射時的加速把太空人壓回座位上，而他們覺得自己比平常重了三倍。

items.def: the arrangement of things in a straight line
items.s: The rare ________ of five planets made headlines, and people around the world went outside before dawn to see it.
items.zh: 五顆行星罕見地排成一直線登上了新聞頭條，而世界各地的人在黎明前走到戶外觀看。

items.def: a force that pulls things toward each other
items.s: The ________ between the Earth and the moon causes ocean tides, so fishermen pay close attention to the moon's phases.
items.zh: 地球和月球之間的吸引力造成海洋潮汐，所以漁民非常注意月亮的盈虧。

items.def: the process of using numbers to find an answer
items.s: One wrong ________ caused the spacecraft to crash, because the engineers had mixed up two different units.
items.zh: 一個錯誤的計算導致太空船墜毀，因為工程師搞混了兩種不同的單位。

items.def: shaped like a circle
items.s: Most craters on the moon are ________, but a few are long because the space rock hit the surface at a low angle.
items.zh: 月球上大多數坑洞是圓形的，但少數是長條形的，因為太空岩石以低角度撞擊表面。

items.def: to put things into groups by type
items.s: Geologists ________ rocks into three main groups, and each group forms in a completely different way.
items.zh: 地質學家把岩石分類成三大類，而每一類的形成方式都完全不同。

items.def: to hit something with force
items.s: When two plates ________, the land is pushed upward, and this is how many great mountain ranges were formed.
items.zh: 當兩個板塊相撞時，陸地會被往上推，而許多大山脈就是這樣形成的。

items.def: the act of pressing something into a smaller space
items.s: Deep underground, the ________ of rock layers creates great heat, and over time this changes one rock type into another.
items.zh: 在地底深處，岩層的壓縮產生巨大的熱，而隨著時間這會把一種岩石轉變成另一種。

items.def: happening without stopping
items.s: The volcano has been in ________ eruption for months, so the lava has slowly built a new piece of land.
items.zh: 那座火山已經持續不斷地噴發好幾個月，所以熔岩慢慢地堆積出一塊新陸地。

items.def: disagreeing with each other
items.s: The two news reports gave ________ information about the earthquake, so I checked the official website instead.
items.zh: 兩則新聞報導對那場地震提供了互相矛盾的資訊，所以我改查官方網站。

items.def: not certain and open to discussion
items.s: Whether Pluto should be a planet is still ________, and some scientists want to change the definition again.
items.zh: 冥王星是否應該算是行星仍然有爭議，而且有些科學家想再次修改定義。

items.def: on purpose
items.s: The engineers ________ crashed the old spacecraft into the sea, because they did not want it to become space junk.
items.zh: 工程師故意讓那艘舊太空船墜入海中，因為他們不希望它變成太空垃圾。

items.def: heavy for its size; tightly packed
items.s: The Earth's core is very ________, so it sank to the centre of the planet when the Earth was young.
items.zh: 地核的密度非常高，所以在地球還年輕時它就沉到了地球中心。

items.def: to mix completely into a liquid
items.s: Rainwater slowly ________ limestone over thousands of years, and this process creates beautiful caves underground.
items.zh: 雨水在數千年間慢慢溶解石灰岩，而這個過程在地下形成美麗的洞穴。

items.def: far away
items.s: Light from ________ galaxies takes billions of years to reach us, so we see them as they were long ago.
items.zh: 來自遙遠星系的光需要數十億年才能到達我們這裡，所以我們看到的是它們很久以前的樣子。

items.def: something that interrupts normal conditions
items.s: The solar storm caused a ________ to phone signals, so some people could not make calls for a few hours.
items.zh: 太陽風暴對手機訊號造成了干擾，所以有些人好幾個小時無法打電話。

items.def: to push or throw something out with force
items.s: Volcanoes can ________ rocks as big as cars, so the area near the crater is extremely dangerous during an eruption.
items.zh: 火山可以噴出像汽車那麼大的岩石，所以噴發期間火山口附近的區域極度危險。

items.def: to surround something completely
items.s: Thick walls ________ the telescope, but the roof can open at night so it can point at the sky.
items.zh: 厚厚的牆壁圍住那架望遠鏡，但屋頂在晚上可以打開，讓它能夠對準天空。

items.def: not strong or clear; hard to see or hear
items.s: The star was so ________ that we could not see it with our eyes, but the telescope showed it clearly.
items.zh: 那顆星星非常微弱，所以我們用肉眼看不到它，但望遠鏡清楚地顯示了它。

items.def: to join together, often by heat
items.s: Inside the sun, small atoms ________ together, and this process releases the huge energy that gives us light.
items.zh: 在太陽內部，小原子融合在一起，而這個過程釋放出給我們光亮的巨大能量。

items.def: flat and level, parallel to the ground
items.s: The rock layers were ________ at first, but strong pressure later bent them into curves.
items.zh: 這些岩層起初是水平的，但後來強大的壓力把它們擠彎成曲線。

items.def: extremely; very much
items.s: The documentary about black holes was ________ popular, so the channel decided to make a second series.
items.zh: 那部關於黑洞的紀錄片極其受歡迎，所以頻道決定製作第二季。

items.def: a slope
items.s: The rover slowly climbed a steep ________, but the engineers stopped it when its wheels began to slip.
items.zh: 探測車慢慢爬上一個陡峭的斜坡，但當它的輪子開始打滑時，工程師讓它停了下來。

items.def: not in a direct way
items.s: Scientists study black holes ________, because they cannot see them, so they watch how nearby stars move instead.
items.zh: 科學家間接地研究黑洞，因為他們看不到黑洞，所以他們改為觀察附近恆星的移動方式。

items.def: to cover something to keep heat in or out
items.s: Engineers ________ the rover with special material, because nights on Mars are cold enough to break its parts.
items.zh: 工程師用特殊材料為探測車隔熱，因為火星的夜晚冷到足以弄壞它的零件。

items.def: to form an idea to explain something
items.s: Some scientists ________ that the moon was formed after a planet crashed into the young Earth, and many agree with them.
items.zh: 有些科學家推論月球是在一顆行星撞上年輕的地球之後形成的，而許多人同意他們的看法。

items.def: so small that it can only be seen with a microscope
items.cn: 微小的；顯微鏡才能看見的
items.s: The space dust is ________, but it hits spacecraft at such high speed that it can still cause damage.
items.zh: 太空塵埃極其微小，但它以極高的速度撞擊太空船，所以仍能造成損害。

items.def: related to molecules
items.s: The team studied the ________ structure of the meteorite, and they found chemicals that are important for life.
items.zh: 團隊研究了那顆隕石的分子結構，而他們發現了對生命很重要的化學物質。

items.def: happening sometimes but not often
items.s: Taiwan has ________ strong earthquakes, so families are advised to keep water and torches at home.
items.zh: 臺灣偶爾會有強烈地震，所以家家戶戶被建議在家裡準備水和手電筒。

items.def: a very small piece of something
items.s: Each ________ of volcanic ash is tiny and sharp, so it can hurt your lungs if you breathe it in.
items.zh: 每一顆火山灰微粒都很小又尖銳，所以如果吸進去會傷害你的肺。

items.def: to go into or through something
items.s: Radio waves can ________ thick clouds of dust, so radio telescopes can see parts of the galaxy that are hidden from normal ones.
items.zh: 無線電波可以穿透厚厚的塵埃雲，所以電波望遠鏡能看到一般望遠鏡看不到的銀河部分。

items.def: to fall or drop suddenly
items.s: Temperatures on the moon ________ to minus 170 degrees at night, so future bases will need excellent heating.
items.zh: 月球上的溫度在夜晚會驟降到零下一百七十度，所以未來的基地需要非常好的暖氣系統。

items.def: not noticed or discovered
items.s: The small asteroid passed the Earth ________, and scientists only discovered it two days later.
items.zh: 那顆小行星在未被察覺的情況下經過地球，而科學家兩天後才發現它。

items.def: mainly
items.s: The island's economy depends ________ on tourism, so the volcano is both a danger and a valuable attraction.
items.zh: 這座島的經濟主要仰賴觀光，所以那座火山既是危險，也是珍貴的觀光景點。

items.def: not easily damaged or affected by something
items.s: The new school is ________ to earthquakes, and parents feel much safer now that their children study there.
items.zh: 新的學校能抵抗地震，而家長們現在對孩子在那裡讀書感到安心得多。

items.def: hard and firm, not liquid or gas
items.s: The moon has a ________ surface, but Jupiter does not, so no spacecraft can ever land on Jupiter.
items.zh: 月球有固態表面，但木星沒有，所以沒有任何太空船能在木星上降落。

items.def: not moving
items.s: Some satellites seem ________ in the sky, but they are actually moving at the same speed as the Earth spins.
items.zh: 有些人造衛星在天空中看似靜止，但它們其實是以和地球自轉相同的速度移動。

items.def: according to theory, but not yet proven in practice
items.s: Time travel is ________ possible according to some scientists, but nobody knows how to actually do it.
items.zh: 根據某些科學家的說法，時間旅行理論上是可能的，但沒有人知道實際上該怎麼做。

items.def: very great in size or amount
items.s: The eruption released a ________ amount of energy, and the sound was heard over a thousand kilometres away.
items.zh: 那次噴發釋放了巨大的能量，而聲音在一千多公里外都聽得到。

items.def: not flat or smooth
items.s: The ground on Mars is rocky and ________, so the rover moves very slowly to avoid getting stuck.
items.zh: 火星上的地面多岩石又不平坦，所以探測車移動得非常緩慢以免卡住。

items.def: likely to change, move or fall
items.s: The cliff became ________ after the earthquake, so the beach below was closed for the rest of the summer.
items.zh: 那座懸崖在地震後變得不穩定，所以下方的海灘在夏天剩下的時間都封閉了。

items.def: going straight up and down
items.s: The climbers faced a ________ wall of rock, but they reached the top safely because they had trained for months.
items.zh: 攀岩者面對一面垂直的岩壁，但他們安全抵達頂端，因為他們已經訓練了好幾個月。

items.def: to shake with small fast movements
items.s: The windows started to ________ during the earthquake, and our dog ran under the table before we did.
items.zh: 地震時窗戶開始震動，而我們的狗比我們先跑到桌子底下。

items.def: how far or how well you can see
items.s: ________ was very poor because of the volcanic ash, so drivers turned on their lights in the middle of the day.
items.zh: 因為火山灰，能見度非常差，所以駕駛人在大白天打開了車燈。

items.def: according to what you have heard or read
items.s: The Northern Lights were ________ visible as far south as Japan last night, but I missed them because I was asleep.
items.zh: 據說昨晚在南至日本的地方都看得到北極光，但我錯過了，因為我在睡覺。

items.def: a strong statement that something is true
items.s: His ________ that the moon landing was fake was quickly proven wrong, because the evidence for it is overwhelming.
items.zh: 他認為登月是造假的主張很快就被證明是錯的，因為支持登月的證據壓倒性地多。

items.def: when compared with something else
items.s: Mars is ________ close to Earth, so it is the most likely planet for humans to visit first.
items.zh: 火星離地球相對較近，所以它是人類最有可能首先造訪的行星。

items.def: related to ideas rather than real objects
items.s: The engineers showed a ________ design for a moon base, but they admitted that building it would take decades.
items.zh: 工程師展示了一個月球基地的概念設計，但他們承認建造它需要數十年。

items.def: the quality of always behaving or performing in the same way
items.s: The ________ of the results gave the team confidence, because every test produced almost the same numbers.
items.zh: 結果的一致性讓團隊有信心，因為每次測試都得出幾乎相同的數字。

items.def: argued about; not agreed on by everyone
items.s: The age of the rocks is still ________, so two research teams are testing new samples to settle the question.
items.zh: 那些岩石的年代仍然有爭議，所以兩個研究團隊正在檢測新的樣本以解決這個問題。

items.def: the ability to last a long time without breaking
items.s: The ________ of the rover's wheels surprised everyone, because they lasted for years on the sharp Martian rocks.
items.zh: 探測車輪子的耐用性讓所有人驚訝，因為它們在尖銳的火星岩石上撐了好幾年。

items.def: related to the slow development of living things
items.s: Fossils show the ________ history of life on Earth, and they help us understand how animals changed over time.
items.zh: 化石顯示地球上生命的演化歷史，而它們幫助我們了解動物如何隨時間改變。

items.def: extremely; very
items.s: The journey to Mars is ________ long, so astronauts will need to be mentally strong as well as physically fit.
items.zh: 前往火星的旅程極其漫長，所以太空人不但身體要健康，心理也必須很堅強。

items.def: giving an explanation
items.s: The museum added ________ videos next to each rock, so visitors can understand how it was formed.
items.zh: 博物館在每塊岩石旁加上了解說影片，讓參觀者能了解它是如何形成的。

items.def: done to find out more about something
items.s: The company sent an ________ team to the island, and they found signs of a hot spring under the ground.
items.zh: 那家公司派了一支勘查團隊到島上，而他們發現地下有溫泉的跡象。

items.def: a piece of information discovered after research
items.s: The latest ________ suggests that Mars once had a large ocean, so scientists want to look for ancient life there.
items.zh: 最新的研究發現指出火星曾經有一片大海洋，所以科學家想在那裡尋找古代生命。

items.def: in a very basic and important way
items.s: The discovery ________ changed our view of the Earth, because it showed that continents are not fixed in place.
items.zh: 這項發現根本上改變了我們對地球的看法，因為它顯示大陸並不是固定不動的。

items.def: a statement that is true in most cases but not all
items.s: It is a ________ to say that all deserts are hot, because Antarctica is also a desert and it is freezing.
items.zh: 說所有沙漠都很熱是一種以偏概全的說法，因為南極洲也是沙漠，而且它冰冷無比。

items.def: not likely to happen
items.s: A direct hit from a large asteroid is ________, but space agencies still practise ways to push one off course.
items.zh: 被大型小行星直接撞擊是不太可能的，但太空機構仍然演練將小行星推離軌道的方法。

items.def: not correct or exact
items.s: The old map was ________, so we got lost on the mountain, and we only found the trail again after an hour.
items.zh: 那張舊地圖不準確，所以我們在山上迷路了，而我們一小時後才再找到步道。

items.def: so clearly true that nobody can argue about it
items.s: The evidence that the Earth goes around the sun is ________, but people believed the opposite for thousands of years.
items.zh: 地球繞著太陽轉的證據是無可爭辯的，但人們在數千年間都相信相反的說法。

items.def: in a way that cannot be avoided
items.s: Old satellites ________ fall back toward the Earth, but most of them burn up completely in the atmosphere.
items.zh: 舊的人造衛星不可避免地會落回地球，但它們大多數會在大氣層中完全燒毀。

items.def: very interesting because it is unusual
items.cn: 引人入勝的；耐人尋味的
items.s: The rover found an ________ rock with strange patterns, so the scientists decided to study it more closely.
items.zh: 探測車發現了一塊帶有奇特圖案、耐人尋味的岩石，所以科學家決定更仔細地研究它。

items.def: without any limit
items.s: The young astronomer had ________ energy, and she often stayed at the observatory until sunrise.
items.zh: 那位年輕的天文學家有著無窮的精力，而她常常在天文臺待到日出。

items.def: strange and difficult to understand
items.s: Dark matter is one of the most ________ things in science, because we know it exists but cannot see it.
items.zh: 暗物質是科學中最神秘的東西之一，因為我們知道它存在，但卻看不到它。

items.def: able to be seen or noticed
items.s: The ________ universe is huge, but scientists believe much more exists beyond what we can see.
items.zh: 可觀測的宇宙非常巨大，但科學家相信在我們能看到的範圍之外還存在更多。

items.def: according to what people say
items.s: The company is ________ planning a hotel in space, but it has not shared any details or prices yet.
items.zh: 據報導那家公司正計畫在太空中建造一間旅館，但它還沒有公布任何細節或價格。

items.def: in a way that seems reasonable or likely
items.s: The scientist ________ explained why the lake had disappeared, and her theory was later supported by satellite photos.
items.zh: 那位科學家合理地解釋了湖泊消失的原因，而她的理論後來得到衛星照片的支持。

items.def: practical, sensible and friendly
items.s: The famous astronaut was very ______ ______ ______, and she happily answered every question the students asked her.
items.zh: 那位知名太空人非常平易近人，而且她很樂意回答學生問她的每一個問題。

items.def: extremely happy
items.s: My brother was ______ ______ ______ when he was accepted to study astronomy, so he called everyone in the family that night.
items.zh: 我哥哥被錄取念天文學時欣喜若狂，所以他當晚打電話給家裡每一個人。

items.def: very rarely
items.s: We see the Northern Lights in Taiwan only ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, so most people travel abroad to watch them.
items.zh: 我們在臺灣極少能看到北極光，所以大多數人會出國去觀賞。

items.def: to try to achieve something very difficult
items.s: Our teacher always tells us to ______ ______ ______ ______, because she believes that hard work can make big dreams come true.
items.zh: 我們老師總是告訴我們要追求遠大的目標，因為她相信努力能讓遠大的夢想成真。

items.def: there is no limit to what can be achieved
items.s: You are talented and hardworking, so ______ ______ ______ ______ for your future in science.
items.zh: 你有天分又努力，所以你在科學領域的未來前途無量。

items.def: much more advanced than
items.s: The new space telescope is ______ ______ ______ ______ older models, and it has already found hundreds of new galaxies.
items.zh: 新的太空望遠鏡比舊型號遙遙領先，而它已經發現了數百個新星系。

items.def: to do everything possible to achieve something
items.s: The rescue teams ______ ______ ______ ______ to find survivors after the earthquake, and they worked for days without rest.
items.zh: 地震後救援隊竭盡全力尋找倖存者，而他們好幾天不眠不休地工作。

items.def: not based on strong facts or not certain
items.s: His argument was ______ ______ ______, because he had no real evidence that animals can predict earthquakes.
items.zh: 他的論點站不住腳，因為他沒有真正的證據證明動物能預測地震。

items.def: it is not difficult to understand
items.s: Packing an emergency kit is easy, and ______ ______ ______ ______, so every family should prepare one this weekend.
items.zh: 準備緊急避難包很容易，而且這並不難，所以每個家庭這個週末都應該準備一個。

items.def: extremely good
items.s: The view of the stars from the mountain was ______ ______ ______ ______, and we stayed outside until midnight despite the cold.
items.zh: 從山上看星星的景色好得不得了，而儘管很冷，我們仍在戶外待到午夜。

items.def: to feel very grateful for good luck
items.s: We ______ ______ ______ ______ that nobody was hurt in the earthquake, because the old shop next door completely collapsed.
items.zh: 我們慶幸自己很走運，地震中沒有人受傷，因為隔壁的老店完全倒塌了。

items.def: to do something new that nobody has done before
items.s: The young scientists ______ ______ ______ with their study of moon dust, and their work was published in a famous journal.
items.zh: 那些年輕科學家以他們對月球塵土的研究開創了新局，而他們的成果發表在一本知名期刊上。

items.def: to return to normal life after an exciting time
items.s: After the amazing trip to the observatory, it was hard to ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, because we had a math test the next day.
items.zh: 在天文臺的精彩旅程之後，很難回到現實，因為我們隔天有數學考試。

items.def: to achieve something that seems impossible
items.cn: 移山倒海；成就不可能的事
items.s: With enough teamwork, a small group of students can ______ ______, and our robot club proved this by winning the national prize.
items.zh: 只要有足夠的團隊合作，一小群學生也能成就不可能的事，而我們的機器人社團贏得全國大獎證明了這一點。

items.def: very strong, reliable and unlikely to fail
items.s: The scientists' evidence was ______ ______, so even the most doubtful reviewers accepted their surprising conclusion.
items.zh: 科學家的證據極其可靠，所以即使是最多疑的審查者也接受了他們令人驚訝的結論。

items.def: extremely important or shocking
items.s: The discovery of water on Mars was ________ news, and it appeared on the front page of every newspaper.
items.zh: 在火星上發現水是驚天動地的新聞，而它登上了每一份報紙的頭版。

items.def: to suddenly become very angry
items.s: My dad ______ ______ ______ when he saw the broken telescope, but he calmed down after my brother said sorry.
items.zh: 我爸爸看到摔壞的望遠鏡時勃然大怒，但在我哥哥道歉後他就冷靜下來了。

items.def: a quiet period before trouble or great activity
items.s: The office was silent an hour before the launch, but everyone knew it was only ______ ______ ______ ______ ______.
items.zh: 發射前一小時辦公室一片寂靜，但每個人都知道那只是暴風雨前的寧靜。

items.def: to seriously challenge basic ideas or systems
items.s: The new theory could ______ ______ ______ ______ modern physics, so many scientists are checking it very carefully.
items.zh: 這個新理論可能會動搖現代物理學的根基，所以許多科學家正非常仔細地檢驗它。

items.def: the most important person or thing (often used critically)
items.cn: 宇宙的中心；自以為最重要
items.s: He acts as if he is ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, but his teammates are tired of his selfish attitude.
items.zh: 他表現得好像自己是宇宙的中心，但他的隊友已經厭倦了他自私的態度。

items.def: slow change in living things over many generations
items.s: Our biology teacher showed us fossils of early horses, and she explained how ________ slowly changed their size and teeth over millions of years.
items.zh: 我們的生物老師給我們看早期馬的化石，並解釋了演化如何在數百萬年間慢慢改變牠們的體型和牙齒。
items.sec: Evolution & Natural Selection 演化與天擇

items.def: process where living things best suited to their surroundings survive
items.s: Rabbits with white fur are harder for foxes to see in the snow, so ______ ______ helps them survive and pass on that colour.
items.zh: 白色毛皮的兔子在雪地裡較不容易被狐狸看見，所以天擇幫助牠們存活並把這種毛色傳下去。
items.sec: Evolution & Natural Selection 演化與天擇

items.def: choosing mates by features such as bright colours or songs
items.s: Female birds often choose males with the brightest feathers, and scientists believe ______ ______ explains why many male birds look so colourful.
items.zh: 雌鳥常常選擇羽毛最鮮豔的雄鳥，而科學家相信性擇解釋了為什麼許多雄鳥看起來如此色彩繽紛。
items.sec: Evolution & Natural Selection 演化與天擇

items.def: when humans choose which plants or animals breed
items.s: All the different dog breeds came from wolves, but they look so different because people used ______ ______ for thousands of years.
items.zh: 所有不同的狗品種都來自狼，但牠們看起來如此不同，是因為人們數千年來一直進行人擇。
items.sec: Evolution & Natural Selection 演化與天擇

items.def: how well a living thing survives and has young
items.s: In biology, ________ does not mean going to the gym, because it describes how many healthy young an animal can produce.
items.zh: 在生物學中，適存度並不是指去健身房，因為它描述的是一隻動物能產下多少健康的後代。
items.sec: Evolution & Natural Selection 演化與天擇

items.def: an earlier species that two later species both came from
items.s: Humans and chimpanzees look different today, but scientists say we shared a ______ ______ that lived about six million years ago.
items.zh: 人類和黑猩猩今天看起來不同，但科學家說我們有一個大約生活在六百萬年前的共同祖先。
items.sec: Evolution & Natural Selection 演化與天擇

items.def: the forming of a new and separate species
items.s: When a river split one group of beetles into two, the groups stopped meeting, and over time ________ produced two different kinds.
items.zh: 當一條河把一群甲蟲分成兩群後，兩群不再相遇，經過一段時間，物種形成產生了兩種不同的甲蟲。
items.sec: Evolution & Natural Selection 演化與天擇

items.def: coming from earlier family members or species
items.s: The museum guide explained that whales are of land-animal ________, and the small bones in their bodies are clues to that past.
items.zh: 博物館導覽員解釋說鯨魚是陸地動物血統，而牠們體內的小骨頭就是那段過去的線索。
items.sec: Evolution & Natural Selection 演化與天擇

items.def: still present in the body but no longer useful
items.s: Some snakes still have tiny ________ leg bones inside their bodies, although they have not used legs for millions of years.
items.zh: 有些蛇的體內仍有微小的退化的腿骨，雖然牠們已經數百萬年沒有使用腿了。
items.sec: Evolution & Natural Selection 演化與天擇

items.def: a fossil that connects two groups of living things
items.s: Newspapers called the feathered dinosaur fossil a ______ ______, because it seemed to connect reptiles and modern birds.
items.zh: 報紙把這個有羽毛的恐龍化石稱為缺失的環節，因為它似乎連接了爬行動物和現代鳥類。
items.sec: Evolution & Natural Selection 演化與天擇

items.def: a diagram showing how all living things are related
items.s: The poster in the science lab shows a huge ______ ______ ______, and students can trace how fish, birds and humans are related.
items.zh: 科學實驗室裡的海報展示了一棵巨大的生命之樹，學生可以追溯魚類、鳥類和人類之間的關係。
items.sec: Evolution & Natural Selection 演化與天擇

items.def: when two species change over time because of each other
items.s: Some flowers have long tubes and some moths have long tongues, and scientists see this as a clear example of ________.
items.zh: 有些花有長長的花管，而有些蛾有長長的口器，科學家把這視為共同演化的清楚例子。
items.sec: Evolution & Natural Selection 演化與天擇

items.def: when unrelated animals develop similar features
items.s: Sharks and dolphins are not closely related, but they both have smooth bodies and fins because of ______ ______.
items.zh: 鯊魚和海豚並不是近親，但因為趨同演化，牠們都有光滑的身體和鰭。
items.sec: Evolution & Natural Selection 演化與天擇

items.def: a contest where each side keeps improving to beat the other
items.s: Cheetahs became faster to catch gazelles, while gazelles became faster to escape, so the two animals are locked in an ______ ______.
items.zh: 獵豹變得更快以捕捉瞪羚，而瞪羚也變得更快以逃脫，所以這兩種動物陷入了一場軍備競賽。
items.sec: Evolution & Natural Selection 演化與天擇

items.def: a force in nature that affects which animals survive
items.s: When the winters became colder, there was strong ______ ______ on the deer, and only those with thick coats survived.
items.zh: 當冬天變得更冷時，鹿群受到強大的選擇壓力，只有毛皮厚的鹿才存活下來。
items.sec: Evolution & Natural Selection 演化與天擇

items.def: helpful and giving a better chance of success
items.s: Long necks were ________ for giraffes because they could reach leaves high in the trees, so more long-necked giraffes survived.
items.zh: 長脖子對長頸鹿是有利的，因為牠們能吃到樹上高處的葉子，所以有更多長脖子的長頸鹿存活下來。
items.sec: Evolution & Natural Selection 演化與天擇

items.def: to do better than others in getting food or space
items.s: Grey squirrels were brought to Britain from America, and they ________ the native red squirrels in many forests.
items.zh: 灰松鼠從美洲被帶到英國，而牠們在許多森林中競爭勝過了本地的紅松鼠。
items.sec: Evolution & Natural Selection 演化與天擇

items.def: a small bird with a short, strong beak
items.s: Darwin studied the different ________ on the Galápagos Islands, and he noticed that their beaks matched the food on each island.
items.zh: 達爾文研究了加拉巴哥群島上不同的雀鳥，並注意到牠們的喙與每個島上的食物相符。
items.sec: Evolution & Natural Selection 演化與天擇

items.def: the hard, pointed mouth of a bird
items.s: Birds that crack hard seeds usually have a thick ________, but birds that catch insects often have a thin one.
items.zh: 會咬開堅硬種子的鳥通常有厚實的鳥喙，但捕捉昆蟲的鳥通常有細長的喙。
items.sec: Evolution & Natural Selection 演化與天擇

items.def: existing at the very beginning of time
items.s: Some scientists think life began in a ________ soup of chemicals in the ocean, but others believe it started near hot vents.
items.zh: 有些科學家認為生命起源於海洋中化學物質組成的原始的湯，但其他人相信生命始於熱泉噴口附近。
items.sec: Evolution & Natural Selection 演化與天擇

items.def: made of only one cell
items.s: The first living things on Earth were tiny ________ creatures, and they existed alone for billions of years before animals appeared.
items.zh: 地球上最早的生物是微小的單細胞的生物，而牠們在動物出現之前獨自存在了數十億年。
items.sec: Evolution & Natural Selection 演化與天擇

items.def: made of many cells working together
items.s: Plants and animals are ________ living things, but bacteria are made of just one cell each.
items.zh: 植物和動物都是多細胞的生物，但細菌每個都只由一個細胞組成。
items.sec: Evolution & Natural Selection 演化與天擇

items.def: a living thing too small to see without a microscope
items.s: A spoonful of garden soil contains millions of ________, and many of them help plants grow by breaking down dead leaves.
items.zh: 一湯匙的花園土壤含有數百萬個微生物，而且其中許多會分解枯葉來幫助植物生長。
items.sec: Evolution & Natural Selection 演化與天擇

items.def: a person who studies plants and animals in nature
items.s: As a young ________, Darwin collected beetles and birds, and his notes later helped him form his famous theory.
items.zh: 年輕時身為博物學家的達爾文收集甲蟲和鳥類，而他的筆記後來幫助他形成了著名的理論。
items.sec: Evolution & Natural Selection 演化與天擇

items.def: a scientist who studies living things
items.s: My cousin works as a ________ in Taiwan, and she spends weeks in the mountains counting frogs and taking photos.
items.zh: 我的表姐在台灣擔任生物學家，她會花好幾週在山裡數青蛙和拍照。
items.sec: Evolution & Natural Selection 演化與天擇

items.def: a form of something that is slightly different
items.s: Doctors watched the new ________ of the virus closely, because it spread faster than the earlier type.
items.zh: 醫生密切觀察這種病毒的新變種，因為它比較早的類型傳播得更快。
items.sec: Evolution & Natural Selection 演化與天擇

items.def: belonging to earlier family members or species
items.s: Scientists studied the ________ home of the first dogs, and they found that wolves there lived close to early humans.
items.zh: 科學家研究了最早的狗的祖先的家園，並發現那裡的狼和早期人類生活得很近。
items.sec: Evolution & Natural Selection 演化與天擇

items.def: the science of naming and grouping living things
items.s: Students learn ________ in their first year, so they can name animals correctly and know which group each one belongs to.
items.zh: 學生在第一年學習分類學，好讓他們能正確地為動物命名並知道每種動物屬於哪一類。
items.sec: Evolution & Natural Selection 演化與天擇

items.def: a moth that changed colour when cities became sooty
items.s: During the Industrial Revolution, dark ______ ______ became more common, because they were hidden on dirty black trees.
items.zh: 在工業革命期間，深色的樺尺蛾變得更常見，因為牠們能隱藏在骯髒的黑色樹幹上。
items.sec: Evolution & Natural Selection 演化與天擇

items.def: a germ that common medicines can no longer kill
items.s: Doctors warn that taking medicine you do not need can create a ________, and then ordinary drugs will stop working.
items.zh: 醫生警告服用不需要的藥物可能會產生超級細菌，然後一般的藥物就會失效。
items.sec: Evolution & Natural Selection 演化與天擇

items.def: not affected by medicines that once worked
items.s: The hospital found a ________ infection in one patient, so the nurses moved him to a separate room.
items.zh: 醫院在一名病人身上發現了抗藥性的感染，所以護理師把他移到單獨的病房。
items.sec: Evolution & Natural Selection 演化與天擇

items.def: a tall African animal with a very long neck
items.s: Male ________ swing their long necks at each other when they fight, and the stronger one usually wins a partner.
items.zh: 雄長頸鹿打鬥時會互相揮動長脖子，而較強壯的那一隻通常會贏得伴侶。
items.sec: Evolution & Natural Selection 演化與天擇

items.def: a member of the group including humans and great apes
items.s: The team discovered the teeth of an early ________ in a cave, and they believe it lived about two million years ago.
items.zh: 研究團隊在一個洞穴中發現了一個早期人科動物的牙齒，他們相信牠生活在大約兩百萬年前。
items.sec: Human Evolution & Our Relatives 人類演化與近親

items.def: the scientific name for modern humans
items.s: ______ ______ first appeared in Africa, and over thousands of years our species spread to every continent.
items.zh: 智人最早出現在非洲，而經過數千年，我們這個物種擴散到了每一個大陸。
items.sec: Human Evolution & Our Relatives 人類演化與近親

items.def: an early human who lived in Europe and Asia
items.s: Many people today carry a little ________ DNA, because our ancestors met and had children with them long ago.
items.zh: 現今許多人身上帶有一點尼安德塔人的DNA，因為我們的祖先很久以前曾與他們相遇並生下孩子。
items.sec: Human Evolution & Our Relatives 人類演化與近親

items.def: a large primate such as a gorilla or chimpanzee
items.s: The zoo built a large forest area for every ______ ______, because these clever animals need space to climb and explore.
items.zh: 動物園為每一隻大型猿類建造了大片森林區，因為這些聰明的動物需要空間攀爬和探索。
items.sec: Human Evolution & Our Relatives 人類演化與近親

items.def: an African ape that is closely related to humans
items.s: Jane Goodall watched a ________ use a stick to catch termites, and this showed that animals can make tools too.
items.zh: 珍古德看見一隻黑猩猩用樹枝捕捉白蟻，而這顯示動物也會製作工具。
items.sec: Human Evolution & Our Relatives 人類演化與近親

items.def: the largest ape, living in African forests
items.s: The silverback ________ looked scary, but he was very gentle with the babies in his family.
items.zh: 那隻銀背大猩猩看起來很可怕，但他對家族裡的寶寶非常溫柔。
items.sec: Human Evolution & Our Relatives 人類演化與近親

items.def: a red-haired ape from Borneo and Sumatra
items.s: The young ________ stays with its mother for about eight years, and she teaches it which fruits are safe to eat.
items.zh: 年幼的紅毛猩猩會和媽媽待在一起大約八年，而媽媽會教牠哪些水果可以安全食用。
items.sec: Human Evolution & Our Relatives 人類演化與近親

items.def: a peaceful ape closely related to the chimpanzee
items.s: A ________ group usually solves fights by sharing food and hugging, so scientists call them the peaceful apes.
items.zh: 巴諾布猿群體通常以分享食物和擁抱來解決爭吵，所以科學家稱牠們為和平的猿類。
items.sec: Human Evolution & Our Relatives 人類演化與近親

items.def: walking on two legs
items.s: Our early ancestors became ________ on the open grasslands, and walking upright left their hands free to carry food.
items.zh: 我們早期的祖先在開闊的草原上變成雙足行走的，而直立行走讓他們的雙手能空出來搬運食物。
items.sec: Human Evolution & Our Relatives 人類演化與近親

items.def: standing straight up
items.s: Bears can stand ________ for a short time, but they usually walk on four legs when they look for food.
items.zh: 熊可以短時間直立站著，但牠們找食物時通常用四條腿走路。
items.sec: Human Evolution & Our Relatives 人類演化與近親

items.def: the way you hold your body
items.s: Sitting at a desk for hours is bad for your ________, and doctors say our spines evolved for walking, not sitting.
items.zh: 在書桌前坐好幾個小時對你的姿勢不好，醫生說我們的脊椎是為了走路而演化的，而不是為了坐著。
items.sec: Human Evolution & Our Relatives 人類演化與近親

items.def: a thumb that can touch the other fingers
items.s: We can hold a pencil and open a jar easily, because we have an ______ ______ that works with our other fingers.
items.zh: 我們能輕鬆握筆和打開罐子，因為我們有一根能與其他手指配合的可對握的拇指。
items.sec: Human Evolution & Our Relatives 人類演化與近親

items.def: the activity of making tools
items.s: Early ________ began with simple sharp stones, but over time people learned to make spears, needles and fishing hooks.
items.zh: 早期的工具製作從簡單的尖銳石頭開始，但隨著時間推移，人們學會了製作矛、針和魚鉤。
items.sec: Human Evolution & Our Relatives 人類演化與近親

items.def: people who lived very long ago
items.s: ______ ______ learned to control fire, and cooking their food gave them more energy for their growing brains.
items.zh: 早期人類學會了控制火，而烹煮食物讓他們有更多能量供應逐漸變大的大腦。
items.sec: Human Evolution & Our Relatives 人類演化與近親

items.def: to produce young with a different group or species
items.s: Modern humans and Neanderthals ________ in the past, so traces of their DNA still exist in many people today.
items.zh: 現代人類和尼安德塔人過去曾雜交繁殖，所以他們DNA的痕跡至今仍存在於許多人身上。
items.sec: Human Evolution & Our Relatives 人類演化與近親

items.def: relating to the bones of a body
items.s: The doctor studied the ________ remains carefully, and she found that the person had walked long distances every day.
items.zh: 這位醫生仔細研究了這些骨骼的遺骸，並發現這個人生前每天都走很長的路。
items.sec: Human Evolution & Our Relatives 人類演化與近親

items.def: the bone that holds the lower teeth
items.s: The ancient ________ was small and had worn teeth, so scientists guessed the person ate tough plants.
items.zh: 這塊古老的顎骨很小，牙齒也磨損了，所以科學家推測這個人吃的是堅韌的植物。
items.sec: Human Evolution & Our Relatives 人類演化與近親

items.def: the row of bones down the middle of your back
items.s: Our ________ has an S-shape that helps us walk on two legs, but it also explains why so many adults get back pain.
items.zh: 我們的脊椎呈S形，幫助我們用雙腿走路，但這也解釋了為什麼這麼多成年人會背痛。
items.sec: Human Evolution & Our Relatives 人類演化與近親

items.def: a scientist who studies monkeys and apes
items.s: The ________ lived in the rainforest for two years, and she learned to recognise every monkey by its face.
items.zh: 那位靈長類動物學家在雨林裡住了兩年，而她學會了從臉認出每一隻猴子。
items.sec: Human Evolution & Our Relatives 人類演化與近親

items.def: a person who studies human societies and cultures
items.s: An ________ visited the mountain village to study its traditions, and the villagers taught her their old songs.
items.zh: 一位人類學家到山村研究當地的傳統，而村民教她唱他們古老的歌謠。
items.sec: Human Evolution & Our Relatives 人類演化與近親

items.def: the study of humans, their history and culture
items.s: My sister is studying ________ at university, because she wants to understand how people lived thousands of years ago.
items.zh: 我姐姐在大學主修人類學，因為她想了解人們數千年前是如何生活的。
items.sec: Human Evolution & Our Relatives 人類演化與近親

items.def: the hair that grows on the body
items.s: Humans lost most of their ______ ______ over time, and some scientists think this helped them stay cool while running.
items.zh: 人類隨著時間失去了大部分的體毛，而有些科學家認為這幫助他們在奔跑時保持涼爽。
items.sec: Human Evolution & Our Relatives 人類演化與近親

items.def: the smallest living unit of a plant or animal
items.s: Every ________ in your body contains instructions, and these instructions tell it whether to become skin, bone or blood.
items.zh: 你身體裡的每一個細胞都含有指令，而這些指令告訴它要變成皮膚、骨頭還是血液。
items.sec: Cells, DNA & Genes 細胞、DNA與基因

items.def: the centre of a cell that holds the DNA
items.s: We looked at onion cells under the microscope, and we could see a dark ________ in the middle of each one.
items.zh: 我們在顯微鏡下觀察洋蔥細胞，並能看見每個細胞中間都有一個深色的細胞核。
items.sec: Cells, DNA & Genes 細胞、DNA與基因

items.def: a thread-like structure in a cell that carries genes
items.s: Humans normally have 46 ________ in each cell, and we receive half from our mother and half from our father.
items.zh: 人類每個細胞通常有46條染色體，我們一半來自母親，一半來自父親。
items.sec: Cells, DNA & Genes 細胞、DNA與基因

items.def: a part of DNA that controls a feature like eye colour
items.s: Scientists found a ________ that affects how tall people grow, but food and sleep also play an important role.
items.zh: 科學家發現了一個會影響人們長多高的基因，但食物和睡眠也扮演重要的角色。
items.sec: Cells, DNA & Genes 細胞、DNA與基因

items.def: the twisted ladder shape of DNA
items.s: Our class built a model of DNA with sweets and sticks, and it twisted into a ______ ______ just like the real thing.
items.zh: 我們班用糖果和小棍子做了一個DNA模型，而它扭成了一個像真的一樣的雙螺旋。
items.sec: Cells, DNA & Genes 細胞、DNA與基因

items.def: two matching chemical units that form a step in DNA
items.s: Human DNA has about three billion ______ ______, so reading the whole code took scientists many years.
items.zh: 人類DNA大約有三十億個鹼基對，所以科學家花了許多年才讀完整個密碼。
items.sec: Cells, DNA & Genes 細胞、DNA與基因

items.def: the smallest unit of a substance made of atoms
items.s: DNA is a very long ________, but it is folded so tightly that it fits inside a tiny cell.
items.zh: DNA是一個非常長的分子，但它摺疊得非常緊密，所以能放進微小的細胞裡。
items.sec: Cells, DNA & Genes 細胞、DNA與基因

items.def: a substance in the body that speeds up chemical changes
items.s: Our saliva contains an ________ that starts breaking down rice, so bread tastes sweeter if you chew it for a long time.
items.zh: 我們的唾液含有一種會開始分解米飯的酵素，所以麵包嚼久了吃起來會比較甜。
items.sec: Cells, DNA & Genes 細胞、DNA與基因

items.def: the process in which one cell splits into two
items.s: A cut on your finger heals quickly, because ______ ______ makes new skin cells to fill the gap.
items.zh: 你手指上的傷口很快就會癒合，因為細胞分裂會產生新的皮膚細胞來填補缺口。
items.sec: Cells, DNA & Genes 細胞、DNA與基因

items.def: a thin layer that covers a cell
items.s: The cell ________ works like a gate, and it decides which substances can enter or leave the cell.
items.zh: 細胞薄膜就像一扇門，而它決定哪些物質可以進出細胞。
items.sec: Cells, DNA & Genes 細胞、DNA與基因

items.def: parts of a cell that make energy
items.s: Muscle cells contain many ________, because they need a lot of energy when we run or lift things.
items.zh: 肌肉細胞含有許多粒線體，因為我們跑步或舉東西時它們需要大量能量。
items.sec: Cells, DNA & Genes 細胞、DNA與基因

items.def: a molecule that helps turn DNA instructions into proteins
items.s: Some vaccines use ________ to teach the body how to fight a virus, and this new method was developed very quickly.
items.zh: 有些疫苗利用核糖核酸教導身體如何對抗病毒，而這種新方法發展得非常快。
items.sec: Cells, DNA & Genes 細胞、DNA與基因

items.def: finding the exact order of units in DNA
items.s: DNA ________ used to cost millions of dollars, but now a person's whole genome can be read for a few hundred.
items.zh: DNA定序過去要花數百萬美元，但現在一個人的全基因組只要幾百美元就能讀取。
items.sec: Cells, DNA & Genes 細胞、DNA與基因

items.def: a small unit that joins with others to build proteins
items.s: Meat, beans and eggs give us every ______ ______ we need, so vegetarians must choose their food carefully.
items.zh: 肉類、豆類和蛋提供我們所需的每一種胺基酸，所以素食者必須小心選擇食物。
items.sec: Cells, DNA & Genes 細胞、DNA與基因

items.def: the female cell that can grow into a baby
items.s: An ______ ______ is one of the largest cells in the human body, and you can almost see it without a microscope.
items.zh: 卵細胞是人體中最大的細胞之一，而你幾乎不用顯微鏡就能看見它。
items.sec: Cells, DNA & Genes 細胞、DNA與基因

items.def: when male and female cells join to start new life
items.s: Frogs lay their eggs in the water of ponds, and ________ happens outside the mother's body there.
items.zh: 青蛙把卵產在池塘的水中，而受精就在那裡、在母體之外發生。
items.sec: Cells, DNA & Genes 細胞、DNA與基因

items.def: an animal or human in the very early stage of growth
items.s: The chicken ________ grows inside the egg for about three weeks, and then the chick breaks the shell.
items.zh: 雞的胚胎在蛋裡生長大約三週，然後小雞就會啄破蛋殼。
items.sec: Cells, DNA & Genes 細胞、DNA與基因

items.def: a basic cell that can become many types of cell
items.s: Doctors hope that ______ ______ can repair damaged hearts, but more research is needed before this treatment is safe.
items.zh: 醫生希望幹細胞能修復受損的心臟，但在這種治療安全之前還需要更多研究。
items.sec: Cells, DNA & Genes 細胞、DNA與基因

items.def: a group of similar cells that work together
items.s: The scientist took a small piece of ________ from the leaf, and she studied the cells under a microscope.
items.zh: 科學家從葉子上取下一小片組織，並在顯微鏡下研究那些細胞。
items.sec: Cells, DNA & Genes 細胞、DNA與基因

items.def: a body part such as the heart that does a special job
items.s: The skin is actually the largest ________ of the human body, and it protects us from germs and heat.
items.zh: 皮膚其實是人體最大的器官，而它保護我們免受細菌和高溫的傷害。
items.sec: Cells, DNA & Genes 細胞、DNA與基因

items.def: a tiny living thing such as a bacterium
items.s: Yoghurt contains many friendly ________, and they help our stomachs digest the food we eat more easily.
items.zh: 優格含有許多有益的微生物，而它們幫助我們的胃更容易消化我們吃下的食物。
items.sec: Cells, DNA & Genes 細胞、DNA與基因

items.def: the study of chemical processes in living things
items.s: She enjoyed both biology and chemistry at school, so she decided to study ________ at university.
items.zh: 她在學校時喜歡生物和化學兩科，所以她決定在大學主修生物化學。
items.sec: Cells, DNA & Genes 細胞、DNA與基因

items.def: a scientist who studies genes
items.s: The ________ explained the results to the family, and she said the baby's condition was not passed down from the parents.
items.zh: 遺傳學家向這家人解釋了結果，並說寶寶的狀況並不是從父母遺傳下來的。
items.sec: Cells, DNA & Genes 細胞、DNA與基因

items.def: the science of how features pass from parents to children
items.s: We studied ________ this term, and now I understand why I have curly hair like my grandfather.
items.zh: 我們這學期學了遺傳學，現在我明白為什麼我會像祖父一樣有一頭捲髮。
items.sec: Cells, DNA & Genes 細胞、DNA與基因

items.def: a small round dish used to grow germs in a lab
items.s: We put a little bread in a ______ ______, and after a week a green mould had covered it.
items.zh: 我們在培養皿裡放了一點麵包，而一週後綠色的黴菌已經把它覆蓋了。
items.sec: Cells, DNA & Genes 細胞、DNA與基因

items.def: the liquid in your mouth
items.s: The test only needs a little ________, so you just spit into a small tube and send it to the lab.
items.zh: 這項檢測只需要一點點唾液，所以你只要吐進一根小管子裡然後寄到實驗室。
items.sec: Cells, DNA & Genes 細胞、DNA與基因

items.def: a cotton stick rubbed inside the mouth to collect cells
items.s: The police took a ______ ______ from each worker, because they wanted to compare their DNA with the evidence.
items.zh: 警方從每位員工身上採集了口腔拭子，因為他們想把他們的DNA和證據作比對。
items.sec: Cells, DNA & Genes 細胞、DNA與基因

items.def: to find the meaning of a code
items.s: Scientists worked for thirteen years to ________ the human genome, and they finally finished the project in 2003.
items.zh: 科學家努力了十三年來解碼人類基因組，並終於在2003年完成這項計畫。
items.sec: Cells, DNA & Genes 細胞、DNA與基因

items.def: one of two children born at the same time to the same mother
items.s: My friend is a ________, and even our teachers cannot tell her and her sister apart.
items.zh: 我的朋友是雙胞胎之一，連我們的老師都分不出她和她的姐妹。
items.sec: Cells, DNA & Genes 細胞、DNA與基因

items.def: relating to cells
items.s: Smoking causes damage at a ________ level, so the harm starts long before a person notices any illness.
items.zh: 吸菸會在細胞的層面造成傷害，所以傷害早在一個人察覺任何疾病之前就開始了。
items.sec: Cells, DNA & Genes 細胞、DNA與基因

items.def: a tiny fly often used in genetics experiments
items.s: Scientists often study the ______ ______, because it breeds very quickly and shares many genes with humans.
items.zh: 科學家常常研究果蠅，因為牠繁殖得非常快，而且和人類有許多共同的基因。
items.sec: Cells, DNA & Genes 細胞、DNA與基因

items.def: a rat used for scientific experiments
items.s: The new medicine was first tested on a ______ ______, but it must also be tested on human volunteers before it is sold.
items.zh: 這種新藥先在實驗鼠身上做了測試，但在販售之前也必須在人類志願者身上測試。
items.sec: Cells, DNA & Genes 細胞、DNA與基因

items.def: features passed from parents to children
items.s: Curly hair in our family is a clear case of ________, because my mother, my grandmother and I all have it.
items.zh: 我們家的捲髮是遺傳的明顯例子，因為我媽媽、我外婆和我都有捲髮。
items.sec: Inheritance & Genetic Variation 遺傳與基因變異

items.def: a change in a gene
items.s: A small ________ in one gene gave the cat six toes on each paw, and her kittens had extra toes too.
items.zh: 一個基因的小突變讓這隻貓每隻腳掌都有六根趾頭，而牠的小貓也有多出來的趾頭。
items.sec: Inheritance & Genetic Variation 遺傳與基因變異

items.def: to change in form because of a gene change
items.s: Flu viruses ________ quickly every single year, so many people need a new vaccine each autumn.
items.zh: 流感病毒每一年都快速突變，所以許多人每年秋天都需要接種新疫苗。
items.sec: Inheritance & Genetic Variation 遺傳與基因變異

items.def: only shown when a child gets the same gene from both parents
items.s: Blue eyes are caused by a ________ gene, so two brown-eyed parents can still have a blue-eyed baby.
items.zh: 藍眼睛是由隱性的基因造成的，所以兩個棕眼睛的父母仍然可能生下藍眼睛的寶寶。
items.sec: Inheritance & Genetic Variation 遺傳與基因變異

items.def: the set of genes a living thing has
items.s: Two plants may look the same, but they can have a different ________, so their seeds may grow differently.
items.zh: 兩株植物可能看起來一樣，但它們可能有不同的基因型，所以它們的種子可能長得不一樣。
items.sec: Inheritance & Genetic Variation 遺傳與基因變異

items.def: the features you can see, such as size or colour
items.s: A person's ________ includes height and hair colour, and it depends on both genes and lifestyle.
items.zh: 一個人的表現型包括身高和髮色，而它取決於基因和生活方式兩者。
items.sec: Inheritance & Genetic Variation 遺傳與基因變異

items.def: a person who has a gene but does not show its effect
items.s: My uncle is a ________ of the gene, but he is healthy, so the doctor told him to tell his children.
items.zh: 我舅舅是這個基因的攜帶者，但他很健康，所以醫生要他告訴他的孩子們。
items.sec: Inheritance & Genetic Variation 遺傳與基因變異

items.def: all the genes in a group of animals or people
items.s: The small island population has a limited ______ ______, so the zoo brought in new animals from other places.
items.zh: 這個小島族群的基因庫很有限，所以動物園從其他地方引進了新的動物。
items.sec: Inheritance & Genetic Variation 遺傳與基因變異

items.def: breeding between closely related animals
items.s: Many purebred dogs suffer from health problems, because years of ________ have made their genes too similar.
items.zh: 許多純種狗受健康問題所苦，因為多年的近親繁殖讓牠們的基因太過相似。
items.sec: Inheritance & Genetic Variation 遺傳與基因變異

items.def: the colour of the coloured part of the eye
items.s: Most babies in Taiwan are born with dark eyes, but ______ ______ can change during the first year in some children.
items.zh: 台灣大多數嬰兒出生時是深色眼睛，但有些孩子的眼睛顏色在第一年內可能會改變。
items.sec: Inheritance & Genetic Variation 遺傳與基因變異

items.def: a small brown spot on the skin
items.s: She has many ________ on her nose like her father, and they get darker when she spends time in the sun.
items.zh: 她的鼻子上有很多雀斑，跟她爸爸一樣，而且她曬太陽時雀斑會變得更深。
items.sec: Inheritance & Genetic Variation 遺傳與基因變異

items.def: a small hollow in the cheek when you smile
items.s: Everyone in the family has a ________ in the left cheek, so people can easily guess that we are related.
items.zh: 家裡每個人的左臉頰都有一個酒窩，所以人們很容易猜到我們是一家人。
items.sec: Inheritance & Genetic Variation 遺傳與基因變異

items.def: using the left hand more easily than the right
items.s: Both of my parents are ________, so it was not surprising that I also write with my left hand.
items.zh: 我的父母都是左撇子的，所以我也用左手寫字並不令人意外。
items.sec: Inheritance & Genetic Variation 遺傳與基因變異

items.def: a health problem that a baby is born with
items.s: Doctors advise pregnant women to take certain vitamins, because they lower the risk of a ______ ______.
items.zh: 醫生建議孕婦服用某些維生素，因為它們能降低先天缺陷的風險。
items.sec: Inheritance & Genetic Variation 遺傳與基因變異

items.def: present from birth
items.s: The puppy had a ________ heart problem, but the vet performed an operation and it now runs around happily.
items.zh: 那隻小狗有先天的心臟問題，但獸醫為牠動了手術，現在牠開心地到處跑。
items.sec: Inheritance & Genetic Variation 遺傳與基因變異

items.def: the group your blood belongs to, such as A or O
items.s: Your ______ ______ is passed down from your parents, so a family's types can help doctors find a match.
items.zh: 你的血型是從父母遺傳下來的，所以一個家庭的血型可以幫助醫生找到配對。
items.sec: Inheritance & Genetic Variation 遺傳與基因變異

items.def: the recorded family history of an animal
items.s: The breeder showed us the puppy's ________, and it listed the dog's parents and grandparents.
items.zh: 繁殖者給我們看了小狗的血統證明，而上面列出了這隻狗的父母和祖父母。
items.sec: Inheritance & Genetic Variation 遺傳與基因變異

items.def: having parents of the same breed
items.s: A ________ cat can be very expensive, but shelter cats are often healthier and cost much less.
items.zh: 一隻純種的貓可能非常昂貴，但收容所的貓往往更健康，花費也少得多。
items.sec: Inheritance & Genetic Variation 遺傳與基因變異

items.def: to mix two breeds to make a new type
items.s: Farmers ________ two kinds of rice, and the new type grows well in dry weather.
items.zh: 農民把兩種稻米雜交育種，而新品種在乾燥的天氣中長得很好。
items.sec: Inheritance & Genetic Variation 遺傳與基因變異

items.def: the way a child is cared for and taught at home
items.s: Twins who grow up apart can be very similar, but their ________ still shapes their habits and interests.
items.zh: 分開長大的雙胞胎可能非常相似，但他們的成長環境仍會塑造他們的習慣和興趣。
items.sec: Inheritance & Genetic Variation 遺傳與基因變異

items.def: the study of how lifestyle can switch genes on or off
items.s: ________ shows that stress and diet can affect how our genes work, although the DNA itself does not change.
items.zh: 表觀遺傳學顯示壓力和飲食會影響我們的基因如何運作，雖然DNA本身並沒有改變。
items.sec: Inheritance & Genetic Variation 遺傳與基因變異

items.def: (of twins) from two different eggs
items.s: My brother and I are ________ twins, so we look quite different and we were born ten minutes apart.
