items.zh: 我哥哥和我是異卵的雙胞胎，所以我們長得很不一樣，而且出生時間相差十分鐘。
items.sec: Inheritance & Genetic Variation 遺傳與基因變異

items.def: a brother or sister
items.s: Each ________ in my family has a different hobby, although we all grew up in the same small apartment.
items.zh: 我家的每個兄弟姊妹都有不同的嗜好，雖然我們都在同一間小公寓長大。
items.sec: Inheritance & Genetic Variation 遺傳與基因變異

items.def: the parent who gave you your genes
items.s: Adopted children sometimes want to find their ______ ______, because they are curious about their family history.
items.zh: 被收養的孩子有時想找到他們的親生父母，因為他們對自己的家族史感到好奇。
items.sec: Inheritance & Genetic Variation 遺傳與基因變異

items.def: how strongly a gene is turned on in a cell
items.s: Exercise can change ______ ______ in muscle cells, so regular training helps the body build stronger muscles.
items.zh: 運動可以改變肌肉細胞中的基因表現，所以規律訓練能幫助身體練出更強壯的肌肉。
items.sec: Inheritance & Genetic Variation 遺傳與基因變異

items.def: able to be passed from parent to child
items.s: Height is highly ________, but children today are taller than their grandparents because they eat better food.
items.zh: 身高是高度可遺傳的，但今天的孩子比他們的祖父母高，因為他們吃得更好。
items.sec: Inheritance & Genetic Variation 遺傳與基因變異

items.def: a coloured mark on the skin from birth
items.s: The baby has a small red ________ on her arm, but the doctor said it will fade as she grows.
items.zh: 寶寶的手臂上有一個小小的紅色胎記，但醫生說它會隨著她長大而變淡。
items.sec: Inheritance & Genetic Variation 遺傳與基因變異

items.def: being unable to see some colours clearly
items.s: ______ ______ is much more common in boys, because the gene for it is carried on the X chromosome.
items.zh: 色盲在男孩中常見得多，因為與它相關的基因位於X染色體上。
items.sec: Inheritance & Genetic Variation 遺傳與基因變異

items.def: a tool that lets scientists cut and change DNA
items.s: Scientists used ________ to remove a disease gene from mice, and the treated mice stayed healthy.
items.zh: 科學家使用基因剪刀CRISPR從老鼠身上移除一個致病基因，而接受治療的老鼠保持健康。
items.sec: Genetic Technology & Medicine 基因科技與醫學

items.def: treating illness by changing a patient's genes
items.s: The boy could not see well since birth, but ______ ______ improved his sight, and now he can read books.
items.zh: 這個男孩從出生起視力就不好，但基因療法改善了他的視力，現在他可以讀書了。
items.sec: Genetic Technology & Medicine 基因科技與醫學

items.def: a DNA test to find out who a child's father is
items.s: The court asked for a ______ ______, because the man said he was not the child's father.
items.zh: 法院要求進行親子鑑定，因為那名男子說他不是孩子的父親。
items.sec: Genetic Technology & Medicine 基因科技與醫學

items.def: using science to help solve crimes
items.s: The ________ team found a single hair at the scene, and its DNA led them to the thief.
items.zh: 鑑識的小組在現場發現了一根頭髮，而它的DNA帶領他們找到了小偷。
items.sec: Genetic Technology & Medicine 基因科技與醫學

items.def: having genes added from another species
items.s: The lab created ________ goats that produce a useful medicine in their milk, so patients can get it more cheaply.
items.zh: 實驗室培育出基因轉殖的山羊，牠們的奶中含有一種有用的藥物，所以病人能更便宜地取得。
items.sec: Genetic Technology & Medicine 基因科技與醫學

items.def: a baby whose genes are chosen or changed by parents
items.s: Many people worry about the idea of a ______ ______, because rich parents might choose intelligence or good looks for their children.
items.zh: 許多人擔心訂製嬰兒的想法，因為有錢的父母可能會為孩子挑選聰明才智或好看的外表。
items.sec: Genetic Technology & Medicine 基因科技與醫學

items.def: the study of right and wrong in medicine and biology
items.s: Our class debated gene editing in a ________ lesson, and most students felt it should only be used to cure disease.
items.zh: 我們班在一堂生命倫理學課上辯論基因編輯，而大多數學生認為它只應該被用來治療疾病。
items.sec: Genetic Technology & Medicine 基因科技與醫學

items.def: treatment planned for a person's own genes
items.s: ______ ______ lets doctors choose the right cancer drug for each patient, so the treatment works better and causes fewer problems.
items.zh: 精準醫療讓醫生能為每位病人選擇合適的抗癌藥物，所以治療效果更好，產生的問題也更少。
items.sec: Genetic Technology & Medicine 基因科技與醫學

items.def: a hormone that controls sugar in the blood
items.s: Today, bacteria are used to make human ________, so it is much cheaper than it was fifty years ago.
items.zh: 今天人們利用細菌來製造人類胰島素，所以它比五十年前便宜得多。
items.sec: Genetic Technology & Medicine 基因科技與醫學

items.def: relating to making and selling medicines
items.s: A large ________ company paid for the research, but the scientists promised to share their results with everyone.
items.zh: 一家大型製藥的公司資助了這項研究，但科學家承諾會與所有人分享他們的研究結果。
items.sec: Genetic Technology & Medicine 基因科技與醫學

items.def: a test of a new treatment on volunteers
items.s: My aunt joined a ______ ______ for a new medicine, and the nurses checked her health every week.
items.zh: 我阿姨參加了一項新藥的臨床試驗，而護理師每週都檢查她的健康狀況。
items.sec: Genetic Technology & Medicine 基因科技與醫學

items.def: a thin glass tube used in science labs
items.s: The student carefully poured the blue liquid into a ______ ______, and then she added two drops of acid.
items.zh: 那位學生小心地把藍色液體倒進試管，然後她加了兩滴酸液。
items.sec: Genetic Technology & Medicine 基因科技與醫學

items.def: a method of joining egg and sperm outside the body
items.s: The couple tried for years to have a baby, so they finally chose ________, and their daughter was born last spring.
items.zh: 這對夫妻多年來一直想要孩子，所以他們最後選擇了試管嬰兒療程，而他們的女兒在去年春天出生。
items.sec: Genetic Technology & Medicine 基因科技與醫學

items.def: a person who gives blood or body parts to help others
items.s: My father is a blood ________, and he visits the blood centre every few months to help patients.
items.zh: 我爸爸是一位捐血者，而他每隔幾個月就會去捐血中心幫助病人。
items.sec: Genetic Technology & Medicine 基因科技與醫學

items.def: the soft tissue inside bones that makes blood
items.s: The girl needed new ______ ______, and luckily a stranger with a matching type agreed to help her.
items.zh: 那個女孩需要新的骨髓，幸運的是一位配型相符的陌生人同意幫助她。
items.sec: Genetic Technology & Medicine 基因科技與醫學

items.def: a store of blood and DNA samples for research
items.s: Thousands of volunteers gave samples to the national ________, so scientists can study which genes are linked to illness.
items.zh: 數千名志願者把樣本提供給國家生物資料庫，好讓科學家研究哪些基因和疾病有關。
items.sec: Genetic Technology & Medicine 基因科技與醫學

items.def: bringing an extinct animal back to life
items.s: Some companies are working on ________, but critics say we should protect living animals first.
items.zh: 有些公司正在研究復活滅絕物種，但批評者說我們應該先保護現存的動物。
items.sec: Genetic Technology & Medicine 基因科技與醫學

items.def: a method to spread a gene quickly through a population
items.s: Scientists hope a ______ ______ could stop mosquitoes from carrying malaria, but releasing them into the wild is risky.
items.zh: 科學家希望基因驅動能阻止蚊子傳播瘧疾，但把牠們釋放到野外是有風險的。
items.sec: Genetic Technology & Medicine 基因科技與醫學

items.def: not easily damaged by insects
items.s: The farmer planted a ________ type of corn, so he did not need to spray as many chemicals.
items.zh: 那位農夫種了一種抗蟲害的玉米，所以他不需要噴灑那麼多化學藥劑。
items.sec: Genetic Technology & Medicine 基因科技與醫學

items.def: rice changed to contain more vitamin A
items.s: ______ ______ was created to help poor children get vitamin A, but some groups still oppose it.
items.zh: 黃金米是為了幫助貧窮兒童獲得維生素A而研發的，但有些團體仍然反對它。
items.sec: Genetic Technology & Medicine 基因科技與醫學

items.def: giving off bright light under special lamps
items.s: Scientists added a jellyfish gene to the fish, and now they look ________ green under blue light.
items.zh: 科學家把一個水母基因加進魚的體內，而現在牠們在藍光下看起來是螢光的綠色。
items.sec: Genetic Technology & Medicine 基因科技與醫學

items.def: shining in darkness
items.s: My little brother loves his ________ stickers, and he puts them on his ceiling so he can see stars at night.
items.zh: 我弟弟很喜歡他的夜光的貼紙，而他把它們貼在天花板上，這樣晚上就能看到星星。
items.sec: Genetic Technology & Medicine 基因科技與醫學

items.def: medical care for an illness or injury
items.s: The new ________ is expensive, but the government will pay for it because it can save many lives.
items.zh: 這種新治療很昂貴，但政府會支付費用，因為它能拯救許多生命。
items.sec: Genetic Technology & Medicine 基因科技與醫學

items.def: to force liquid out of your mouth
items.s: For the ancestry kit, I ________ into a small tube, and a month later I got a report about my family's roots.
items.zh: 為了做祖源檢測組，我吐口水到一根小管子裡，一個月後我收到了一份關於我家族根源的報告。
items.sec: Genetic Technology & Medicine 基因科技與醫學

items.def: a set of things packed together for a task
items.s: You can buy a DNA testing ________ online, but experts say the health results are not always accurate.
items.zh: 你可以在網路上買到DNA檢測套組，但專家說健康方面的結果不一定準確。
items.sec: Genetic Technology & Medicine 基因科技與醫學

items.def: relating to biology and medicine
items.s: Taiwan has invested heavily in ________ research, and many young scientists now work on new cancer treatments.
items.zh: 台灣大量投資於生物醫學的研究，現在許多年輕科學家致力於新的癌症治療。
items.sec: Genetic Technology & Medicine 基因科技與醫學

items.def: the scientific study of animal behaviour
items.s: She became interested in ________ after watching birds in the park, and she now studies how crows solve puzzles.
items.zh: 她在公園裡觀察鳥類之後對動物行為學產生了興趣，現在她研究烏鴉如何解決難題。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour & Communication 動物行為與溝通

items.def: a scientist who studies animal behaviour
items.s: The ________ watched the wolves from a hidden hut, because she did not want her presence to change their behaviour.
items.zh: 那位動物行為學家從一間隱蔽的小屋觀察狼群，因為她不希望自己的存在改變牠們的行為。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour & Communication 動物行為與溝通

items.def: an action an animal learns rather than is born with
items.s: Opening milk bottles was a ______ ______ among some birds in Britain, and young birds copied it from older ones.
items.zh: 在英國，打開牛奶瓶是某些鳥類的學習行為，而年輕的鳥從年長的鳥那裡模仿學會了。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour & Communication 動物行為與溝通

items.def: a young animal's quick bond with the first thing it sees
items.s: Because of ________, the baby geese followed the scientist everywhere, and they treated him like their mother.
items.zh: 由於銘印，小鵝到處跟著那位科學家，而且牠們把他當作媽媽。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour & Communication 動物行為與溝通

items.def: training by linking an action with a reward or result
items.s: My dog runs to the kitchen when she hears the fridge open, and this is a simple example of ________.
items.zh: 我的狗一聽到冰箱打開就跑到廚房，而這是制約的一個簡單例子。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour & Communication 動物行為與溝通

items.def: an automatic movement you do not think about
items.s: When the ball flew towards his face, he closed his eyes as a ________, and he did not even think about it.
items.zh: 當球朝他的臉飛來時，他閉上眼睛作為反射動作，而他甚至沒有思考。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour & Communication 動物行為與溝通

items.def: the musical sounds that birds make
items.s: I wake up to ________ every morning in spring, because the birds sing loudly to attract partners.
items.zh: 春天每天早上我都在鳥鳴聲中醒來，因為鳥兒大聲歌唱來吸引伴侶。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour & Communication 動物行為與溝通

items.def: (of a bird or insect) to make a short high sound
items.s: The baby birds ________ loudly whenever their mother returns, and the loudest one usually gets fed first.
items.zh: 每當媽媽回來時，雛鳥就大聲吱吱叫，而叫得最大聲的那隻通常最先被餵食。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour & Communication 動物行為與溝通

items.def: to make a long, loud crying sound
items.s: Wolves ________ to call their pack together, and the sound can travel for many kilometres at night.
items.zh: 狼嚎叫來召集狼群，而這種聲音在夜晚可以傳到好幾公里遠。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour & Communication 動物行為與溝通

items.def: to make a low, angry sound in the throat
items.s: The dog began to ________ when the stranger came near, so the man stepped back slowly.
items.zh: 當陌生人靠近時，那隻狗開始低吼，所以那個人慢慢地往後退。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour & Communication 動物行為與溝通

items.def: (of a cat) to make a soft, low sound when happy
items.s: My cat likes to ________ on my lap in the evening, and the soft sound helps me relax after school.
items.zh: 我的貓喜歡晚上在我腿上呼嚕叫，而那柔和的聲音幫助我放學後放鬆。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour & Communication 動物行為與溝通

items.def: to make a sound like a long "sss"
items.s: The snake began to ________ when we came close, so we quickly moved away from the rocks.
items.zh: 當我們靠近時那條蛇開始發出嘶嘶聲，所以我們迅速離開那些岩石。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour & Communication 動物行為與溝通

items.def: finding objects by sending out sounds and hearing echoes
items.s: Bats use ________ to catch insects in the dark, so they can hunt even when there is no moonlight.
items.zh: 蝙蝠利用回聲定位在黑暗中捕捉昆蟲，所以即使沒有月光牠們也能狩獵。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour & Communication 動物行為與溝通

items.def: a chemical an animal releases to send a message
items.s: Ants leave a ________ trail on the ground, and other ants follow it to find the food.
items.zh: 螞蟻在地上留下費洛蒙的足跡，而其他螞蟻會跟著它找到食物。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour & Communication 動物行為與溝通

items.def: a smell, especially one left by an animal
items.s: The tiger rubs its face on trees to leave its ________, and other tigers know to stay away.
items.zh: 老虎用臉磨蹭樹木留下牠的氣味，而其他老虎就知道要遠離。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour & Communication 動物行為與溝通

items.def: messages sent by the way you move or stand
items.s: A dog's ______ ______ tells you a lot, because a low tail and flat ears often mean it is afraid.
items.zh: 一隻狗的肢體語言能告訴你很多事，因為低垂的尾巴和平貼的耳朵通常表示牠很害怕。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour & Communication 動物行為與溝通

items.def: a sound an animal makes to warn others of danger
items.s: When a monkey sees an eagle, it gives a special ______ ______, and the whole group hides in the trees.
items.zh: 當一隻猴子看見老鷹時，牠會發出特別的警戒叫聲，而整個群體就躲進樹裡。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour & Communication 動物行為與溝通

items.def: a dance bees do to show where food is
items.s: A honeybee performs a ______ ______ inside the hive, and the other bees learn the direction of the flowers.
items.zh: 一隻蜜蜂在蜂巢內跳搖擺舞，而其他蜜蜂就知道花朵的方向。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour & Communication 動物行為與溝通

items.def: one of the long stiff hairs near an animal's mouth
items.s: A cat uses each ________ to measure narrow spaces, so you should never cut them off.
items.zh: 貓用每一根鬍鬚來測量狹窄的空間，所以你絕對不應該把它們剪掉。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour & Communication 動物行為與溝通

items.def: one of two long thin parts on an insect's head
items.s: The ant touched the other ant with its ________, and in this way it could smell who belonged to its nest.
items.zh: 那隻螞蟻用觸角碰觸另一隻螞蟻，而藉此牠能聞出誰屬於牠的蟻巢。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour & Communication 動物行為與溝通

items.def: to move quickly from side to side
items.s: Dogs usually ________ their tails when they are happy, but a stiff wagging tail can sometimes be a warning.
items.zh: 狗開心時通常會搖動尾巴，但僵硬地搖尾巴有時可能是一種警告。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour & Communication 動物行為與溝通

items.def: actions an animal uses to scare an enemy
items.s: The cat arched its back and made its fur stand up in a ______ ______, so the bigger dog decided to leave.
items.zh: 那隻貓拱起背、讓毛豎起來做出威嚇展示，所以那隻較大的狗決定離開。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour & Communication 動物行為與溝通

items.def: bright colours that tell enemies an animal is dangerous
items.s: Poison dart frogs have bright ______ ______, so birds learn quickly that these frogs are not safe to eat.
items.zh: 箭毒蛙有鮮豔的警戒色，所以鳥類很快就學會這些青蛙吃了不安全。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour & Communication 動物行為與溝通

items.def: to lie still and pretend to be dead
items.s: When a fox comes near, the opossum may ______ ______, and the fox often loses interest and walks away.
items.zh: 當狐狸靠近時，負鼠可能會裝死，而狐狸常常失去興趣然後走開。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour & Communication 動物行為與溝通

items.def: moving to another place each season
items.s: Taiwan is an important stop for many ________ birds, and birdwatchers gather at the coast every autumn.
items.zh: 台灣是許多遷徙的鳥類的重要中途站，而賞鳥人士每年秋天都聚集在海岸邊。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour & Communication 動物行為與溝通

items.def: able to find the way home from far away
items.s: People once used ________ pigeons to carry messages, because the birds always returned to their own nests.
items.zh: 人們曾經利用歸巢的鴿子傳遞訊息，因為這些鳥總會回到自己的巢。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour & Communication 動物行為與溝通

items.def: once tame but now living wild
items.s: Many ________ cats live near the old market, and volunteers feed them and take them to the vet.
items.zh: 許多野化的貓住在舊市場附近，而志工們餵養牠們並帶牠們去看獸醫。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour & Communication 動物行為與溝通

items.def: using objects to help get food or do tasks
items.s: Sea otters break shells with stones, and this ______ ______ shows that clever behaviour is not only found in apes.
items.zh: 海獺用石頭敲開貝殼，而這種工具使用顯示聰明的行為不只出現在猿類身上。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour & Communication 動物行為與溝通

items.def: a test to see if an animal recognises itself in a mirror
items.s: Elephants and dolphins have passed the ______ ______, so scientists believe they have some idea of who they are.
items.zh: 大象和海豚都通過了鏡子測驗，所以科學家相信牠們對自己是誰有某種概念。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour & Communication 動物行為與溝通

items.def: a colourful bird that can copy human speech
items.s: My neighbour's ________ can say twenty words, and it always says hello when someone opens the door.
items.zh: 我鄰居的鸚鵡會說二十個字，而且每當有人開門時牠都會打招呼。
items.sec: Animal Behaviour & Communication 動物行為與溝通

items.def: a group of wolves or wild dogs
items.s: A wolf ________ hunts together, so they can catch animals much larger than any single wolf.
items.zh: 一群狼會一起狩獵，所以牠們能捕捉比任何一隻狼都大得多的動物。
items.sec: Social Life, Mating & Parenting 社會生活、求偶與育幼

items.def: a group of monkeys
items.s: A ________ of monkeys stole the tourists' snacks, and the guide warned us to keep our bags closed.
items.zh: 一群猴子偷走了遊客的零食，而導遊警告我們要把包包關好。
items.sec: Social Life, Mating & Parenting 社會生活、求偶與育幼

items.def: a group of whales or dolphins
items.s: We saw a ________ of dolphins from the boat, and they jumped beside us for almost ten minutes.
items.zh: 我們從船上看到一群海豚，而牠們在我們旁邊跳躍了將近十分鐘。
items.sec: Social Life, Mating & Parenting 社會生活、求偶與育幼

items.def: a large moving group of insects
items.s: A ________ of bees landed on the school gate, so the teachers kept the students inside until it left.
items.zh: 一大群蜜蜂停在學校大門上，所以老師們讓學生待在室內直到牠們離開。
items.sec: Social Life, Mating & Parenting 社會生活、求偶與育幼

items.def: a home where bees live together
items.s: Each ________ has thousands of bees, but they all work together to collect food and protect the queen.
items.zh: 每個蜂巢裡有數千隻蜜蜂，但牠們全都一起合作採集食物並保護蜂后。
items.sec: Social Life, Mating & Parenting 社會生活、求偶與育幼

items.def: the only female bee in a hive that lays eggs
items.s: The ______ ______ can lay over a thousand eggs a day, while the worker bees feed her and clean the hive.
items.zh: 蜂后一天可以產下超過一千顆卵，而工蜂則餵養她並清潔蜂巢。
items.sec: Social Life, Mating & Parenting 社會生活、求偶與育幼

items.def: an ant that collects food and builds the nest
items.s: Each ______ ______ can carry objects much heavier than itself, so a small group can move a whole dead insect.
items.zh: 每隻工蟻都能搬運比自己重得多的東西，所以一小群工蟻就能搬動一整隻死掉的昆蟲。
items.sec: Social Life, Mating & Parenting 社會生活、求偶與育幼

items.def: a small insect that eats wood and lives in large groups
items.s: ________ in Africa build huge mounds of soil, and the tunnels inside keep the air cool.
items.zh: 非洲的白蟻會建造巨大的土丘，而裡面的通道讓空氣保持涼爽。
items.sec: Social Life, Mating & Parenting 社會生活、求偶與育幼

items.def: the most powerful male in a group
items.s: The ______ ______ eats first after a hunt, but he must also protect the group from danger.
items.zh: 首領雄性在狩獵後最先進食，但他也必須保護群體免受危險。
items.sec: Social Life, Mating & Parenting 社會生活、求偶與育幼

items.def: the order of rank within a group
items.s: The hens quickly formed a ______ ______, and the strongest hen always got the best place at the food bowl.
items.zh: 母雞們很快就形成了啄序，而最強壯的母雞總是在食盆旁佔到最好的位置。
items.sec: Social Life, Mating & Parenting 社會生活、求偶與育幼

items.def: cleaning another animal's fur
items.s: Monkeys spend hours on ________ each day, and this helps them build friendships within the group.
items.zh: 猴子每天花好幾個小時理毛，而這幫助牠們在群體內建立友誼。
items.sec: Social Life, Mating & Parenting 社會生活、求偶與育幼

items.def: helping relatives so that shared genes survive
items.s: A bee may die to protect its hive, and scientists explain this with ______ ______, because the other bees are its sisters.
items.zh: 一隻蜜蜂可能會為了保護蜂巢而死，而科學家用親屬選擇來解釋這點，因為其他蜜蜂是牠的姊妹。
items.sec: Social Life, Mating & Parenting 社會生活、求偶與育幼

items.def: working together with others
items.s: Lions are ________ hunters, so they often surround a zebra from different sides before they attack.
items.zh: 獅子是合作的獵手，所以牠們常常在攻擊前從不同方向包圍一隻斑馬。
items.sec: Social Life, Mating & Parenting 社會生活、求偶與育幼

items.def: caring more about others than yourself
items.s: The mother bird made a ________ move when she pretended to be hurt, and the fox followed her away from the chicks.
items.zh: 母鳥假裝受傷，做出了無私的舉動，而狐狸跟著她離開了雛鳥。
items.sec: Social Life, Mating & Parenting 社會生活、求偶與育幼

items.def: someone who takes help but gives nothing back
items.s: In a vampire bat group, a ________ who never shares blood is soon ignored, so the bats rarely cheat.
items.zh: 在吸血蝠群體中，從不分享血液的搭便車者很快就會被冷落，所以蝙蝠很少作弊。
items.sec: Social Life, Mating & Parenting 社會生活、求偶與育幼

items.def: actions an animal uses to attract a partner
items.s: The bird's ________ includes singing and dancing, and the female watches carefully before she chooses.
items.zh: 這種鳥的求偶包括唱歌和跳舞，而雌鳥在選擇之前會仔細觀察。
items.sec: Social Life, Mating & Parenting 社會生活、求偶與育幼

items.def: a bird's feathers
items.s: The male's bright ________ attracts females, but it also makes him easier for hawks to see.
items.zh: 雄鳥鮮豔的羽毛能吸引雌鳥，但也讓牠更容易被老鷹發現。
items.sec: Social Life, Mating & Parenting 社會生活、求偶與育幼

items.def: a male bird with a large, colourful tail
items.s: The ________ spread his beautiful tail in the park, and a crowd of children gathered to take photos.
items.zh: 那隻雄孔雀在公園裡展開牠美麗的尾巴，而一群孩子聚集過來拍照。
items.sec: Social Life, Mating & Parenting 社會生活、求偶與育幼

items.def: having only one partner
items.s: Swans are mostly ________, so a pair often stays together and raises chicks for many years.
items.zh: 天鵝大多是一夫一妻制的，所以一對天鵝常常會在一起並養育雛鳥好多年。
items.sec: Social Life, Mating & Parenting 社會生活、求偶與育幼

items.def: a strong long-term link between two partners
items.s: Penguins form a ______ ______ each season, and the parents call to each other to find their partner in the crowd.
items.zh: 企鵝每個季節都會建立配偶關係，而父母會互相呼叫，以便在擁擠的群體中找到伴侶。
items.sec: Social Life, Mating & Parenting 社會生活、求偶與育幼

items.def: a group of young birds born at the same time
items.s: The duck led her ________ across the road, and the drivers stopped their cars to let them pass.
items.zh: 那隻鴨子帶著她的一窩幼鳥過馬路，而駕駛們停下車讓牠們通過。
items.sec: Social Life, Mating & Parenting 社會生活、求偶與育幼

items.def: a group of eggs laid at one time
items.s: The turtle buried her ________ of eggs in the warm sand, and then she returned to the sea.
items.zh: 那隻海龜把她的一窩蛋埋在溫暖的沙子裡，然後回到海裡。
items.sec: Social Life, Mating & Parenting 社會生活、求偶與育幼

items.def: a baby bird
items.s: The hungry ________ opened its mouth very wide, and its father pushed a small fish inside.
items.zh: 那隻飢餓的雛鳥把嘴張得很大，而牠的爸爸把一條小魚塞了進去。
items.sec: Social Life, Mating & Parenting 社會生活、求偶與育幼

items.def: the ways parents look after their young
items.s: Most fish give little ______ ______, but some male seahorses carry and protect the babies themselves.
items.zh: 大多數魚類很少提供親代照顧，但有些雄海馬會親自攜帶和保護寶寶。
items.sec: Social Life, Mating & Parenting 社會生活、求偶與育幼

items.def: to feed a baby with milk from its mother
items.s: The mother cat ________ her kittens every few hours, so she rarely leaves the box during the first week.
items.zh: 母貓每隔幾個小時就哺乳她的小貓，所以她在第一週很少離開箱子。
items.sec: Social Life, Mating & Parenting 社會生活、求偶與育幼

items.def: a bat that feeds on the blood of animals
items.s: A hungry ______ ______ can die after two nights without food, so friends share their meals to keep each other alive.
items.zh: 一隻飢餓的吸血蝙蝠兩晚沒有進食就可能死亡，所以朋友之間會分享食物讓彼此活下去。
items.sec: Social Life, Mating & Parenting 社會生活、求偶與育幼

items.def: a small African animal that stands on its back legs
items.s: One ________ stands on a rock to watch for eagles, while the others dig for insects in the sand.
items.zh: 一隻狐獴站在岩石上留意老鷹，而其他狐獴在沙地裡挖昆蟲。
items.sec: Social Life, Mating & Parenting 社會生活、求偶與育幼

items.def: an animal or person who watches for danger
items.s: The goose that acts as a ________ keeps its head up, and it honks loudly if a dog comes near.
items.zh: 擔任守望者的那隻鵝會抬著頭，而如果有狗靠近牠就會大聲鳴叫。
items.sec: Social Life, Mating & Parenting 社會生活、求偶與育幼

items.def: an old female who leads a family group
items.s: The elephant ________ remembers where water can be found, so the group follows her during dry seasons.
items.zh: 象群的女族長記得哪裡可以找到水，所以群體在乾季會跟隨她。
items.sec: Social Life, Mating & Parenting 社會生活、求偶與育幼

items.def: splitting work so each member does a different job
items.s: Ant colonies have a clear ______ ______ ______, because some ants find food while others care for the young.
items.zh: 蟻群有明確的分工，因為有些螞蟻尋找食物，而其他螞蟻照顧幼蟲。
items.sec: Social Life, Mating & Parenting 社會生活、求偶與育幼

items.def: a careful study of something to understand it
items.s: The lab's ________ of the bones showed that the animal was young, so it probably died before it could have babies.
items.zh: 實驗室對骨頭的分析顯示這隻動物很年輕，所以牠很可能在生育之前就死了。

items.def: a statement about what will happen
items.s: Darwin made a ________ about a moth with a very long tongue, and scientists finally found it forty years later.
items.zh: 達爾文對一種舌頭極長的蛾做出了預測，而科學家終於在四十年後找到了牠。

items.def: a number or idea that is close but not exact
items.s: Six million years is only an ________, because scientists cannot know exactly when humans and chimps split.
items.zh: 六百萬年只是一個近似值，因為科學家無法確切知道人類和黑猩猩是何時分開的。

items.def: to give all your attention to something
items.s: The cat seemed to ________ completely on the mouse hole, and it did not move for almost an hour.
items.zh: 那隻貓似乎完全專注在老鼠洞上，而且牠幾乎一個小時都沒有動。

items.def: the most important basic quality of something
items.s: The ________ of Darwin's idea is simple, but it took him more than twenty years to publish it.
items.zh: 達爾文想法的本質很簡單，但他花了二十多年才把它發表出來。

items.def: to make something start working
items.s: Sunlight can ________ certain genes in your skin, so your skin becomes darker after a summer holiday.
items.zh: 陽光能活化你皮膚中的某些基因，所以暑假過後你的皮膚會變得比較黑。

items.def: to catch an animal or person
items.s: The team used soft nets to ________ the birds, and they released them after putting small rings on their legs.
items.zh: 研究團隊用柔軟的網子捕捉鳥類，並在牠們腳上套上小環後把牠們放走。

items.def: suggesting something but not proving it directly
items.s: The evidence against the dog was only ________, because nobody actually saw it eat the cake.
items.zh: 對那隻狗不利的證據只是間接的，因為沒有人真的看見牠吃了蛋糕。

items.def: depending on something else happening
items.s: The monkey's help was ________, so it only shared food with monkeys that had shared with it before.
items.zh: 那隻猴子的幫忙是有條件的，所以牠只和以前跟牠分享過食物的猴子分享。

items.def: depending on the situation around something
items.cn: 情境的；與上下文有關的
items.s: Students used ________ clues to guess the meaning of "gene pool", and most of them guessed correctly.
items.zh: 學生利用上下文的線索猜出「基因庫」的意思，而大多數人都猜對了。

items.def: to show that a popular belief is false
items.s: Our teacher wanted to ________ the myth that goldfish only remember things for three seconds, so she showed us a study.
items.zh: 我們老師想要駁斥金魚只有三秒記憶的迷思，所以她給我們看了一項研究。

items.def: to kill all of a group of animals
items.s: The city decided to ________ the rats near the market, but some people asked for a kinder solution.
items.zh: 市政府決定撲滅市場附近的老鼠，但有些人要求更溫和的解決辦法。

items.def: to show signs of something that will happen later
items.s: Small changes in the birds' songs may ________ the birth of a new species, although it could take thousands of years.
items.zh: 鳥鳴中的小變化可能預示一個新物種的誕生，雖然這可能需要數千年。

items.def: to show that something is involved in a problem
items.s: The study seemed to ________ one gene in the disease, but the scientists said more tests were needed.
items.zh: 這項研究似乎顯示一個基因與這種疾病有關，但科學家說還需要更多測試。

items.def: to get involved and cause problems
items.s: Tourists should not ________ with nesting turtles, because bright lights and noise can scare them back into the sea.
items.zh: 遊客不應該干擾正在築巢的海龜，因為強光和噪音會把牠們嚇回海裡。

items.def: to twist or link closely together
items.s: Genes and environment ________ in complex ways, so it is hard to say which one matters more.
items.zh: 基因和環境以複雜的方式交織在一起，所以很難說哪一個更重要。

items.def: to show that something is not correct
items.s: One mistake in the data could ________ the whole study, so the scientists checked every number twice.
items.zh: 資料中的一個錯誤就可能推翻整個研究，所以科學家把每個數字都檢查了兩次。

items.def: not too much and not too little
items.s: The plants grew best at ________ temperatures, but they died quickly when the greenhouse became too hot.
items.zh: 這些植物在適度的溫度下長得最好，但當溫室變得太熱時它們很快就死了。

items.def: to stop something from having an effect
items.s: Some animals such as the mongoose can ________ snake poison, so they can eat snakes without getting sick.
items.zh: 有些像獴這樣的動物能中和蛇毒，所以牠們可以吃蛇而不會生病。

items.def: to say again that something is true
items.s: The new fossils ________ the idea that birds came from dinosaurs, and few scientists now doubt it.
items.zh: 新的化石再次確認了鳥類來自恐龍的觀點，而現在很少有科學家懷疑這一點。

items.def: to cut or break completely
items.s: The new highway may ________ the path that the frogs use every spring, so the city built small tunnels under the road.
items.zh: 新的高速公路可能會切斷青蛙每年春天使用的路徑，所以市政府在路下方建造了小隧道。

items.def: to lose skin, hair or leaves naturally
items.s: Snakes ________ their skin several times a year, and you can sometimes find the old skin in the grass.
items.zh: 蛇每年會蛻皮好幾次，而你有時可以在草叢裡找到舊的蛇皮。

items.def: to become steady and stop changing
items.s: The number of deer began to ________ after wolves returned, and the forest plants slowly grew back.
items.zh: 狼回來之後鹿的數量開始穩定下來，而森林裡的植物也慢慢長了回來。

items.def: to be a sign of an idea
items.s: In many cultures, the owl is used to ________ wisdom, although owls are not cleverer than many other birds.
items.zh: 在許多文化中，貓頭鷹被用來象徵智慧，雖然貓頭鷹並沒有比許多其他鳥類更聰明。

items.def: happening at the beginning
items.s: The ________ results looked exciting, but later tests showed that the gene had only a small effect.
items.zh: 最初的結果看起來令人興奮，但後來的測試顯示這個基因只有很小的影響。

items.def: the structure of a body
items.s: A bat's wing and a human hand have a similar ________, because both contain the same kinds of bones.
items.zh: 蝙蝠的翅膀和人類的手有相似的解剖構造，因為兩者都包含相同種類的骨頭。

items.def: a perfect typical example of something
items.s: The lion is the ________ of a powerful hunter in stories, but in real life the females do most of the hunting.
items.zh: 獅子在故事中是強大獵手的典型，但在現實生活中大部分的狩獵是母獅做的。

items.def: influence or connection
items.s: Your diet as a child may have a ________ on your health as an adult, so parents should offer healthy meals.
items.zh: 你小時候的飲食可能對你成年後的健康有影響，所以父母應該提供健康的餐點。

items.def: a state of complete confusion
items.s: The fox ran into the chicken house, and there was ________ as the birds flew in every direction.
items.zh: 狐狸衝進雞舍，而雞群向四面八方飛竄，一片混亂。

items.def: working together with others
items.s: The project was a ________ between scientists from twenty countries, and they shared all their data online.
items.zh: 這個計畫是來自二十個國家科學家之間的合作，而他們在網路上分享所有的資料。

items.def: a decision you reach after thinking
items.s: After watching the crows for months, she came to the ________ that they could recognise human faces.
items.zh: 觀察烏鴉好幾個月之後，她得出了牠們能認出人臉的結論。

items.def: something developed from something else
items.s: Aspirin is a ________ of a chemical found in tree bark, and people used the bark as medicine long ago.
items.zh: 阿斯匹靈是樹皮中一種化學物質的衍生物，而人們很久以前就把樹皮當作藥使用。

items.def: something that does not follow the usual rule
items.s: Most mammals do not lay eggs, but the platypus is an ________, and that surprised early scientists.
items.zh: 大多數哺乳類動物不會下蛋，但鴨嘴獸是例外，而這讓早期的科學家很驚訝。

items.def: loyalty to a partner
items.s: Scientists once praised the ________ of swans, but DNA tests showed that some chicks have a different father.
items.zh: 科學家曾經讚揚天鵝的忠誠，但DNA檢測顯示有些雛鳥的父親是另一隻。

items.def: a mistake or weakness
items.s: There was a ________ in the experiment, because the scientists forgot to give one group of mice the same food.
items.zh: 這個實驗有一個缺陷，因為科學家忘了給其中一組老鼠吃同樣的食物。

items.def: something that makes progress difficult
items.s: A heavy tail can be a ________ when a bird escapes from a predator, but it helps the bird attract a mate.
items.zh: 沉重的尾巴在鳥逃離掠食者時可能是一種阻礙，但它能幫助鳥吸引配偶。

items.def: adding someone or something to a group
items.s: The ________ of more women in the study was important, because earlier results were based mostly on men.
items.zh: 在研究中納入更多女性很重要，因為先前的結果主要是基於男性。

items.def: an official question or investigation
items.s: The university started an ________ into the lab, because some results seemed too perfect to be true.
items.zh: 大學對這間實驗室展開了調查，因為有些結果看起來完美得令人難以置信。

items.def: a sign that shows something exists
items.s: Tail wagging is one ________ of a dog's mood, but you should also watch its ears and eyes.
items.zh: 搖尾巴是狗的情緒的一種表現，但你也應該觀察牠的耳朵和眼睛。

items.def: a story or explanation of events
items.s: The old ________ said humans left Africa only once, but new DNA evidence tells a more complex story.
items.zh: 舊的說法認為人類只離開非洲一次，但新的DNA證據講述了一個更複雜的故事。

items.def: an answer that shows something is wrong
items.s: The young scientist wrote a ________ to the article, and she used her own data to show its mistakes.
items.zh: 那位年輕的科學家針對這篇文章寫了一篇反駁，而她用自己的資料指出文章的錯誤。

items.def: all the things a person or animal can do
items.s: A mockingbird has a huge ________ of songs, and it can even copy car alarms and phones.
items.zh: 一隻嘲鶇擁有大量的曲目，而牠甚至能模仿汽車警報器和電話的聲音。

items.def: doubt about whether something is true
items.s: Many people met the idea of talking dolphins with ________, because the early studies were very small.
items.zh: 許多人以懷疑態度看待會說話的海豚這種想法，因為早期的研究規模很小。

items.def: a smaller group within a larger group
items.s: Only a small ________ of the birds learned the new song, but those birds attracted more females.
items.zh: 只有一小部分的鳥學會了新的歌曲，但那些鳥吸引了更多雌鳥。

items.def: special words used in a subject
items.s: Genetics has a lot of difficult ________, so our teacher gave us a word list before the lesson.
items.zh: 遺傳學有很多困難的術語，所以我們老師在上課前給了我們一張單字表。

items.def: the ability to accept or survive something
items.s: Some adults have no ________ for milk, because their bodies stop making the enzyme after childhood.
items.zh: 有些成年人對牛奶沒有耐受力，因為他們的身體在童年後就不再製造那種酵素。

items.def: happening by chance
items.s: The discovery was ________, because the scientist was studying something else when she noticed the glowing cells.
items.zh: 這個發現是意外的，因為那位科學家注意到發光細胞時正在研究別的東西。

items.def: having two sides that are not the same
items.s: Some owls have ________ ears, so they can tell exactly where a sound comes from in the dark.
items.zh: 有些貓頭鷹的耳朵是不對稱的，所以牠們能在黑暗中精確分辨聲音從哪裡傳來。

items.def: not having enough of something
items.s: The puppies were ________ in vitamins, so the vet changed their food and they soon became stronger.
items.zh: 那些小狗缺乏維生素，所以獸醫換了牠們的食物，而牠們很快就變得更強壯。

items.def: not working correctly
items.s: A ________ gene can cause a serious illness, but sometimes doctors can treat it with new medicines.
items.zh: 一個有缺陷的基因可能導致嚴重的疾病，但有時醫生可以用新藥治療。

items.def: working and useful
items.s: Ostriches have wings, but they are not ________ for flying, so the birds use them for balance instead.
items.zh: 鴕鳥有翅膀，但它們不是有功能的飛行翅膀，所以鴕鳥改用翅膀來保持平衡。

items.def: real and true
items.s: The dog showed ________ fear during the storm, so we let it sleep inside the house with us.
items.zh: 那隻狗在暴風雨中表現出真正的恐懼，所以我們讓牠和我們一起睡在屋子裡。

items.def: able to be recognised
items.s: Each zebra is ________ by its stripes, because no two zebras have exactly the same pattern.
items.zh: 每隻斑馬都可以藉由牠的條紋辨認出來，因為沒有兩隻斑馬的花紋完全相同。

items.def: not sensible or reasonable
items.s: It seems ________ for a bird to carry such a heavy tail, but the tail helps it win a partner.
items.zh: 一隻鳥背負這麼沉重的尾巴似乎不合邏輯，但這條尾巴幫助牠贏得伴侶。

items.def: not able to be affected by a disease
items.s: Some people are ________ to the virus, because they carry a rare gene that blocks it.
items.zh: 有些人對這種病毒是免疫的，因為他們帶有一個能阻擋病毒的罕見基因。

items.def: not needing help from others
items.s: Young sea turtles are ________ from the moment they hatch, so they must reach the sea without help.
items.zh: 小海龜從孵化的那一刻起就是獨立的，所以牠們必須在沒有幫助的情況下抵達大海。

items.def: having a strong effect on others
items.s: Darwin's book was very ________, and it changed the way people thought about nature and themselves.
items.zh: 達爾文的書非常有影響力，而它改變了人們對大自然和自身的看法。

items.def: not connected to the subject
items.s: The colour of a dog's fur is ________ to its intelligence, so you cannot judge a dog by its coat.
items.zh: 狗的毛色與牠的聰明程度無關，所以你不能以毛色來評斷一隻狗。

items.def: not complete
items.s: The scientists found only a ________ skeleton, but it was enough to show that the animal walked on two legs.
items.zh: 科學家只找到了一副部分的骨骼，但這足以顯示這隻動物用兩條腿走路。

items.def: continuing for a long time
items.s: The ________ crow tried again and again to open the box, and finally it worked out how to lift the lid.
items.zh: 那隻堅持不懈的烏鴉一次又一次地嘗試打開箱子，最後牠想出了如何掀開蓋子。

items.def: limiting what people can do
items.s: Some countries have very ________ laws on gene editing, but others allow scientists to do much more research.
items.zh: 有些國家對基因編輯有非常限制性的法律，但其他國家允許科學家進行更多研究。

items.def: not moving or changing
items.s: People once thought species were ________, but Darwin showed that they change slowly over time.
items.zh: 人們曾經認為物種是不變的，但達爾文證明了它們會隨著時間慢慢改變。

items.def: fair and not influenced by personal opinions
items.s: Scientists try to be ________ when they watch animals, but it is easy to see human feelings where there are none.
items.zh: 科學家觀察動物時盡量保持不偏不倚，但很容易在沒有人類情感的地方看到人類情感。

items.def: not able to be trusted
items.s: Some cheap DNA tests are ________, so you should not make health decisions based on them alone.
items.zh: 有些便宜的DNA檢測是不可靠的，所以你不應該只根據它們做健康方面的決定。

items.def: after something else happened
items.s: The lab first tested the drug on mice, and they ________ tested it on a small group of volunteers.
items.zh: 實驗室先在老鼠身上測試這種藥物，而他們隨後又在一小群志願者身上進行測試。

items.def: by many people or in many places
items.s: Darwin's theory is now ________ accepted, but it caused angry arguments when it was first published.
items.zh: 達爾文的理論現在被廣泛地接受，但它首次發表時曾引起激烈的爭論。

items.def: as a basic, natural part of something
items.s: Wolves are not ________ dangerous to people, but they may attack when they are very hungry or afraid.
items.zh: 狼本質上對人類並不危險，但牠們在非常飢餓或害怕時可能會攻擊。

items.def: gradually, step by step
items.s: The fish's fins became ________ stronger over millions of years, and finally they could support its body on land.
items.zh: 經過數百萬年，這種魚的鰭逐步地變得更強壯，最後它們能在陸地上支撐牠的身體。

items.def: on purpose
items.s: The bird ________ dropped the nut onto the road, and it waited for a car to crack the shell.
items.zh: 那隻鳥故意地把堅果丟到馬路上，然後等待汽車把殼壓碎。

items.def: as a group
items.s: The fish move ________ in a large school, so a shark finds it hard to focus on just one.
items.zh: 魚群以大群集體地移動，所以鯊魚很難只專注在其中一條魚上。

items.def: to some degree, but not completely
items.s: Your height is ________ decided by your genes, but good food and enough sleep also help you grow.
items.zh: 你的身高部分由基因決定，但良好的食物和充足的睡眠也能幫助你長高。

items.def: usually
items.s: Female cats ________ have four to six kittens, and the mother looks after them for about two months.
items.zh: 母貓通常會生四到六隻小貓，而貓媽媽會照顧牠們大約兩個月。

items.def: often
items.s: Dolphins ________ help each other when one is hurt, and they lift the injured dolphin to the surface to breathe.
items.zh: 當一隻海豚受傷時，海豚們經常互相幫助，而且牠們會把受傷的海豚托到水面呼吸。

items.def: for that reason
items.s: The two birds cannot produce young together, and ________ scientists classify them as separate species.
items.zh: 這兩種鳥無法一起生下後代，因此科學家把牠們歸類為不同的物種。

items.def: in a way that helps or affects both sides
items.s: The small fish clean the shark's teeth and get a free meal, so the relationship is ________ helpful.
items.zh: 小魚清潔鯊魚的牙齒並得到一頓免費的餐點，所以這種關係是互相有益的。

items.def: according to numbers and data
items.s: The difference between the two groups was not ________ important, so the scientists could not support their idea.
items.zh: 兩組之間的差異在統計上並不顯著，所以科學家無法支持他們的想法。

items.def: in a way that no other thing has
items.s: Humans are ________ good at learning languages, but many animals also communicate in surprising ways.
items.zh: 人類在學習語言方面獨特地擅長，但許多動物也以令人驚訝的方式溝通。

items.def: suddenly and by a large amount
items.s: The number of bees fell ________ last year, and farmers worried about their fruit trees.
items.zh: 蜜蜂的數量去年急劇地下降，而農民們擔心他們的果樹。

items.def: in a sudden and extreme way
items.s: The cost of reading DNA has fallen ________, so many hospitals can now test patients' genes.
items.zh: 讀取DNA的成本已經大幅地下降，所以現在許多醫院都能檢測病人的基因。

items.def: to form an idea of something in your mind
items.s: It is hard to ________ how long four billion years is, so our teacher compared Earth's history to a single day.
items.zh: 很難構想四十億年有多長，所以我們老師把地球的歷史比喻成一天。

items.def: to understand something in a certain way
items.s: People often ________ a chimp's wide smile as happiness, but it usually means the animal is afraid.
items.zh: 人們常常把黑猩猩咧嘴的笑容解讀為快樂，但那通常表示這隻動物很害怕。

items.def: to make someone believe something false
items.s: Some birds ________ their enemies by pretending to have a broken wing, and they lead the danger away from the nest.
items.zh: 有些鳥會假裝翅膀受傷來欺騙牠們的敵人，並把危險引離巢穴。

items.def: to be not the same
items.s: Human DNA does not ________ much from person to person, so we are all more alike than we think.
items.zh: 人類的DNA在人與人之間並沒有太大的不同，所以我們彼此比自己想像的更相似。

items.def: to show that something is not true
items.s: The experiment was designed to ________ the old belief, and the results clearly showed that it was wrong.
items.zh: 這個實驗是為了證明那個舊觀念是錯的而設計的，而結果清楚地顯示它確實錯了。

items.def: to make an exact copy
items.s: Before a cell divides, it must ________ its DNA, so each new cell gets a full set of instructions.
items.zh: 細胞在分裂之前必須複製它的DNA，這樣每個新細胞才能得到一整套指令。

items.def: (of time) to pass
items.s: Millions of years must ________ before a new species forms, so we rarely see it happen in our lifetime.
items.zh: 必須流逝數百萬年才會形成一個新物種，所以我們很少在一生中看到它發生。

items.def: to improve the quality of something
items.s: Zoos ________ the lives of their animals with toys and puzzles, because bored animals can become stressed.
items.zh: 動物園用玩具和益智遊戲來豐富動物的生活，因為無聊的動物會變得有壓力。

items.def: to give an advantage to
items.s: Cold weather tends to ________ animals with thick fur, so mammals in the far north are usually furry.
items.zh: 寒冷的天氣往往有利於毛皮厚的動物，所以極北地區的哺乳類通常都毛茸茸的。

items.def: (of insects or animals) to fill a place in large numbers
items.s: Fleas can ________ a house very quickly, so pet owners should check their animals regularly.
items.zh: 跳蚤能很快地侵擾一間房子，所以寵物主人應該定期檢查他們的動物。

items.def: to have or own
items.s: Many birds ________ a kind of compass in their eyes, and this helps them find their way across oceans.
items.zh: 許多鳥類眼中擁有一種指南針，而這幫助牠們找到橫越海洋的路。

items.def: to produce a liquid inside the body
items.s: Frogs ________ a slimy liquid from their skin, and it keeps them wet and protects them from germs.
items.zh: 青蛙從皮膚分泌一種黏滑的液體，而它能保持牠們濕潤並保護牠們免受細菌感染。

items.def: to take turns or change between two things
items.s: The two parent birds ________ between sitting on the eggs and looking for food, so the eggs are never left cold.
items.zh: 兩隻親鳥輪流孵蛋和尋找食物，所以蛋從來不會被留著變冷。

items.def: to cause a feeling or reaction
items.s: The strange noise ________ the dog's curiosity, so it walked slowly towards the bushes to find out more.
items.zh: 那奇怪的聲音激起了狗的好奇心，所以牠慢慢走向灌木叢想一探究竟。

items.def: to fix or join one thing to another
items.s: Scientists ________ tiny trackers to the turtles' shells, and they can follow the animals across the ocean.
items.zh: 科學家把小型追蹤器貼在海龜殼上，而他們就能追蹤這些動物橫越海洋。

items.def: to make something come closer
items.s: Male frogs sing loudly to ________ females, but the noise can also bring hungry bats.
items.zh: 雄蛙大聲鳴叫以吸引雌蛙，但這噪音也可能招來飢餓的蝙蝠。

items.def: to try to win against others
items.s: Young male deer ________ for the attention of females, and the winners are usually the largest ones.
items.zh: 年輕的雄鹿為了吸引雌鹿的注意而競爭，而勝利者通常是體型最大的。

items.def: to decide or find out exactly
items.s: In some turtles, the sand temperature can ________ whether a baby is male or female.
items.zh: 在某些海龜中，沙子的溫度能決定寶寶是雄性還是雌性。

items.def: to take someone's attention away
items.s: The mother bird flies around noisily to ________ the cat, while her chicks hide quietly in the nest.
items.zh: 母鳥吵鬧地四處飛來使那隻貓分心，而她的雛鳥安靜地躲在巢裡。

items.def: to know that something will happen
items.s: Few scientists could ________ how quickly gene editing would develop, and now laws are struggling to keep up.
items.zh: 很少有科學家能預見基因編輯會發展得這麼快，而現在法律正努力追趕。

items.def: to know someone or something you have seen before
items.s: Sheep can ________ the faces of other sheep, and they can remember them for up to two years.
items.zh: 羊能認出其他羊的臉，而且牠們能記住長達兩年。

items.def: to think of in a particular way
items.s: Many farmers ________ crows as pests, but scientists see them as some of the cleverest birds on Earth.
items.zh: 許多農民把烏鴉視為害鳥，但科學家把牠們看作地球上最聰明的鳥類之一。

items.def: to find or show a connection
items.s: Scientists are trying to ________ certain genes to sleep habits, because some people need much less sleep than others.
items.zh: 科學家正試著把某些基因與睡眠習慣相關聯，因為有些人需要的睡眠比別人少得多。

items.def: to make something easier to understand
items.s: The teacher tried to ________ the topic of DNA, so she compared it to a recipe book in a kitchen.
items.zh: 老師試著簡化DNA這個主題，所以她把它比喻成廚房裡的食譜書。

items.def: giving human feelings to animals or objects
items.s: Saying your dog feels guilty may be ________, because it might simply be reacting to your angry voice.
items.zh: 說你的狗感到內疚可能是擬人化，因為牠可能只是對你生氣的聲音做出反應。

items.def: never changing
items.s: Our genes are not completely ________, because small mutations happen almost every time our cells divide.
items.zh: 我們的基因並非完全不可改變的，因為幾乎每次我們的細胞分裂時都會發生小突變。

items.def: not good enough
items.s: The cage was ________ for such a large bird, so the rescue centre moved it to an outdoor area.
items.zh: 那個籠子對這麼大的鳥來說是不足的，所以救援中心把牠移到戶外區域。

items.def: not easily seen or noticed
items.s: Female ducks are brown and ________, so they can sit on their nests without being seen by foxes.
items.zh: 雌鴨是褐色而且不顯眼的，所以牠們能坐在巢上而不被狐狸看見。

items.def: impossible to tell apart
items.s: The two species of mosquito are almost ________, but only one of them carries the disease.
items.zh: 這兩種蚊子幾乎是無法區分的，但只有其中一種會傳播疾病。

items.def: impossible to prove wrong
items.s: The DNA evidence was ________, so the man finally admitted that he was the child's father.
items.zh: DNA證據是無可辯駁的，所以那名男子最終承認他是孩子的父親。

items.def: to understand something wrongly
items.s: Many people ________ a cat's slow blink as sleepiness, but it is actually a friendly sign of trust.
items.zh: 許多人把貓緩慢的眨眼誤解為想睡覺，但它其實是一種表示信任的友善訊號。

items.def: giving the wrong idea
items.s: The headline "Scientists find the gene for intelligence" was ________, because hundreds of genes affect how we think.
items.zh: 「科學家找到智力基因」這個標題是誤導的，因為有數百個基因會影響我們如何思考。

items.def: based on watching rather than experiments
items.s: Most of her work is ________, so she spends long hours in the forest and rarely does tests in a lab.
items.zh: 她大部分的研究是觀察性的，所以她在森林裡待很長的時間，很少在實驗室做測試。

items.def: able to make people believe something
items.s: Darwin's arguments were very ________, because he supported every idea with hundreds of careful examples.
items.zh: 達爾文的論點非常有說服力，因為他用數百個仔細的例子來支持每一個想法。

items.def: decided in advance
items.s: Your future is not ________ by your genes, because choices about food, sleep and exercise also matter.
items.zh: 你的未來並不是由基因預先決定的，因為對飲食、睡眠和運動的選擇也很重要。

items.def: causing strong reactions or arguments
items.s: The professor asked a ________ question about designer babies, and the class argued about it for the whole hour.
items.zh: 教授問了一個關於訂製嬰兒的引起爭議的問題，而全班為此爭論了整整一個小時。

items.def: able to be repeated with the same results
items.s: Good results should be ________, so other labs must get the same answer when they repeat the test.
items.zh: 好的研究結果應該是可重複驗證的，所以其他實驗室重做測試時必須得到相同的答案。

items.def: false, although it seems true
items.s: The link between ice cream sales and shark attacks is ________, because both simply increase in hot weather.
items.zh: 冰淇淋銷量和鯊魚攻擊之間的關聯是似是而非的，因為兩者只是都在炎熱天氣時增加。

items.def: clear, with only one meaning
items.s: The bee's dance sends an ________ message, so the other bees fly straight to the right flowers.
items.zh: 蜜蜂的舞蹈傳達出明確的訊息，所以其他蜜蜂會直接飛往正確的花朵。

items.def: accepted by everyone
items.s: The lion is the ________ leader of the group, but younger males may challenge him when he grows old.
items.zh: 這隻獅子是群體中無可爭議的首領，但當他變老時年輕的雄獅可能會挑戰他。

items.def: not supported by evidence
items.s: The claim that the pill makes children smarter is ________, so parents should not waste their money on it.
items.zh: 那種藥丸能讓孩子變聰明的說法是未經證實的，所以父母不應該把錢浪費在上面。

items.def: not yet tried or checked
items.s: The new treatment is still ________ on humans, so doctors cannot promise that it will be safe.
items.zh: 這種新療法在人類身上仍未經測試，所以醫生無法保證它是安全的。

items.def: recorded clearly in many reports
items.s: The friendship between elephants is ________, and many videos show them helping each other in trouble.
items.zh: 大象之間的友誼是有充分記錄的，而許多影片顯示牠們在困境中互相幫助。

items.def: a range where things change gradually
items.s: Intelligence is not a simple yes or no, because animals lie along a ________ from simple to very clever.
items.zh: 智力並不是簡單的有或沒有，因為動物分布在從簡單到非常聰明的連續的範圍上。

items.def: an example that shows a rule is not always true
items.s: The teacher said all mammals give birth to live young, but a student gave the platypus as a ________.
items.zh: 老師說所有哺乳類動物都是胎生的，但一位學生舉出鴨嘴獸作為反例。

items.def: the process of trying new ideas in tests
items.s: After years of ________, the team found a safe way to grow skin in the lab, and burn patients now benefit.
items.zh: 經過多年的實驗，研究團隊找到了在實驗室中安全培養皮膚的方法，而燒燙傷病人如今因此受益。

items.def: a person who watches something carefully
items.s: A careful ________ will notice that each crow has a slightly different call, so you can tell them apart.
items.zh: 一位細心的觀察者會注意到每隻烏鴉的叫聲都略有不同，所以你可以分辨牠們。

items.def: a plan or idea that is suggested
items.s: The government rejected the ________ to edit the genes of mosquitoes, because many citizens were worried.
items.zh: 政府否決了編輯蚊子基因的提案，因為許多市民感到擔憂。

items.def: a question
items.s: If you have a ________ about your DNA test results, you can email the company, and a genetic adviser will reply.
items.zh: 如果你對DNA檢測結果有疑問，可以寫電子郵件給公司，而一位遺傳顧問會回覆你。

items.def: an idea that is believed without proof
items.s: The idea that dinosaurs were grey was only a ________, but new fossils show that some had colourful feathers.
items.zh: 恐龍是灰色的這個想法只是推測，但新的化石顯示有些恐龍有色彩繽紛的羽毛。

items.def: a person or animal used in a study
items.s: Each ________ in the study wore a sleep tracker, and the scientists compared their results with their genes.
items.zh: 研究中的每位受試者都戴著睡眠追蹤器，而科學家把他們的結果和基因作比較。

items.def: a lucky or unusual result that happens by chance
items.s: At first, the scientists thought the clever bird was a ________, but other birds soon learned the same trick.
items.zh: 起初科學家認為那隻聰明的鳥只是偶然，但其他鳥很快也學會了同樣的把戲。

items.def: something that is not usual, often a health problem
items.s: The scan showed a small ________ in the baby's heart, but the doctor said it would probably heal by itself.
items.zh: 掃描顯示寶寶的心臟有一個小異常，但醫生說它可能會自行癒合。

items.def: something that causes an effect
items.s: Mosquitoes are the main ________ that spreads the disease, so the town cleaned all the standing water.
items.zh: 蚊子是傳播這種疾病的主要媒介，所以這個城鎮清除了所有的積水。

items.def: angry or violent behaviour
items.s: Male birds show more ________ in spring, because they must protect their area from other males.
items.zh: 雄鳥在春天表現出更強的攻擊性，因為牠們必須保護自己的地盤不受其他雄鳥侵犯。

items.def: relating to how a person or animal acts
items.s: The dog had several ________ problems, so the family hired a trainer to help it feel calm.
items.zh: 那隻狗有幾個行為的問題，所以這家人請了一位訓練師幫助牠平靜下來。

items.def: in a way relating to living things
items.s: Humans are ________ very similar to chimps, but our language and culture make us very different.
items.zh: 人類在生物學上和黑猩猩非常相似，但我們的語言和文化讓我們非常不同。

items.def: the state of being completely sure
items.s: Scientists cannot say with ________ why the dinosaurs had feathers, but warmth and display are likely reasons.
items.zh: 科學家無法確定恐龍為什麼有羽毛，但保暖和展示可能是原因。

items.def: usually or by many people
items.s: The fruit fly is ________ used in genetics labs, because it is cheap and breeds every two weeks.
items.zh: 果蠅普遍地被用於遺傳學實驗室，因為牠便宜而且每兩週就繁殖一次。

items.def: being awake and aware of yourself
items.s: Scientists still argue about animal ________, but most agree that dogs and apes have feelings.
items.zh: 科學家仍在爭論動物的意識，但大多數人同意狗和猿類有情感。

items.def: describing what something is like
items.s: Her first report was mainly ________, so it explained what the monkeys did but not why they did it.
items.zh: 她的第一份報告主要是描述性的，所以它解釋了猴子做了什麼，但沒有解釋為什麼。

items.def: the act of finding or noticing something
items.s: Early ________ of a genetic disease can help a baby, because doctors can start treatment right away.
items.zh: 遺傳疾病的早期發現能幫助嬰兒，因為醫生可以立即開始治療。

items.def: used to find out what illness someone has
items.s: The hospital bought new ________ equipment, so patients no longer wait weeks for their test results.
items.zh: 醫院購買了新的診斷的設備，所以病人不再需要等好幾週才拿到檢查結果。

items.def: in a way that works well
items.s: The new drug works ________ against the virus, but it is still too expensive for many patients.
items.zh: 這種新藥能有效地對抗病毒，但對許多病人來說仍然太貴。

items.def: working well without wasting time or energy
items.s: Penguins are very ________ swimmers, so they can travel long distances while using little energy.
items.zh: 企鵝是非常有效率的泳者，所以牠們能消耗很少的能量游很長的距離。

items.def: completely
items.s: Koalas eat almost ________ eucalyptus leaves, so they cannot survive where those trees do not grow.
items.zh: 無尾熊幾乎完全以尤加利樹葉為食，所以牠們無法在沒有這種樹的地方生存。

items.def: relating to the natural world and surroundings
items.s: Some illnesses come from genes, but others are caused by ________ factors like dirty air.
items.zh: 有些疾病來自基因，但其他疾病是由像髒空氣這樣的環境的因素所造成的。

items.def: to the same degree
items.s: The mother and father penguins share the work ________, and they take turns keeping the egg warm.
items.zh: 企鵝爸爸和媽媽平等地分擔工作，而且牠們輪流讓蛋保持溫暖。

items.def: the state of being real or alive
items.s: Scientists doubted the ________ of the giant squid for years, until someone finally filmed one in 2004.
items.zh: 科學家多年來一直懷疑大王魷的存在，直到2004年終於有人拍到了一隻。

items.def: extremely interesting
items.s: The way birds find their way home is ________, and scientists are still not sure how they do it.
items.zh: 鳥類找到回家路的方式是極有趣的，而科學家仍然不確定牠們是怎麼做到的。

items.def: slowly over time
items.s: The puppy ________ learned to trust the new family, and after a month it slept happily on the sofa.
items.zh: 那隻小狗逐漸地學會信任新家人，而一個月後牠快樂地睡在沙發上。

items.def: not exact
items.s: Early DNA tests were ________, so they sometimes gave the wrong answer about a person's family.
items.zh: 早期的DNA檢測是不精確的，所以有時會對一個人的家族給出錯誤的答案。

items.def: not producing the result you want
items.s: The old medicine became ________ against the germs, so doctors had to find a new one.
items.zh: 舊藥對這些病菌變得無效，所以醫生必須找到新的藥。

items.def: done naturally without learning
items.s: Swimming is ________ for baby ducks, so they follow their mother into the water on their first day.
items.zh: 游泳對小鴨來說是本能的，所以牠們在出生第一天就跟著媽媽下水。

items.def: clever and able to learn quickly
items.s: Octopuses are very ________ animals, and some have escaped from their tanks by opening the lids.
items.zh: 章魚是非常聰明的動物，而有些章魚曾經打開蓋子從水族箱裡逃脫。

items.def: small in amount or number
items.s: Pandas have a ________ diet of bamboo, so they must eat for up to fourteen hours a day.
items.zh: 熊貓只吃竹子，飲食有限，所以牠們一天必須進食長達十四個小時。

items.def: a failure to understand correctly
items.s: There is a common ________ that humans came from monkeys, but in fact we share an ancestor with them.
items.zh: 有一個常見的誤解是人類是從猴子變來的，但事實上我們和牠們有共同的祖先。

items.def: at first
items.s: Dogs were ________ wild wolves, but people tamed them and they slowly became our loyal friends.
items.zh: 狗原本是野生的狼，但人們馴服了牠們，而牠們慢慢成為我們忠實的朋友。

items.def: lasting forever or for a very long time
items.s: Gene therapy may offer a ________ cure, so patients would not need to take medicine every day.
items.zh: 基因療法可能提供永久的治癒，所以病人將不需要每天吃藥。

items.def: something that might happen or be true
items.s: There is a ________ that the gene also affects memory, so the scientists plan to test it next year.
items.zh: 這個基因也有可能性會影響記憶，所以科學家計畫明年進行測試。

items.def: possibly in the future
items.s: Gene editing could ________ cure many diseases, but it may also create problems that we cannot yet predict.
items.zh: 基因編輯可能治癒許多疾病，但它也可能造成我們目前還無法預測的問題。

items.def: likely to be true or to happen
items.s: A cold winter is the most ________ cause of the birds' deaths, but scientists are also testing for disease.
items.zh: 寒冷的冬天是這些鳥死亡最可能的原因，但科學家也在檢測是否有疾病。

items.def: full of difficulties
items.s: Keeping dolphins in small tanks is ________, because they normally swim long distances every day.
items.zh: 把海豚養在小水族箱裡是有問題的，因為牠們通常每天都游很遠的距離。

items.def: done with a clear aim
items.s: The crow's actions looked ________, so the scientists believed it was planning how to get the food.
items.zh: 那隻烏鴉的行為看起來是有目的的，所以科學家相信牠正在計畫如何拿到食物。

items.def: not often
items.s: Male hamsters ________ help raise their babies, so the mother must do all the work alone.
items.zh: 雄倉鼠很少幫忙養育寶寶，所以母倉鼠必須獨自完成所有工作。

items.def: acting in response to something rather than planning
items.s: Some dogs are very ________ to noise, and they bark loudly every time a motorbike passes.
items.zh: 有些狗對噪音非常易起反應，每當有機車經過時牠們都會大聲吠叫。

items.def: without being affected by something
items.s: The salmon swim upriver ________ of the danger, because they must lay their eggs where they were born.
items.zh: 鮭魚不管危險都會逆流而上，因為牠們必須在自己出生的地方產卵。

items.def: reacting quickly and positively
items.s: Babies are very ________ to their mother's voice, and they often stop crying when they hear her.
items.zh: 嬰兒對媽媽的聲音反應非常靈敏，而且他們聽到媽媽的聲音時常常會停止哭泣。

items.def: clear without needing proof
items.s: It may seem ________ that children look like their parents, but the reasons were a mystery until genetics.
items.zh: 孩子長得像父母這件事似乎不言而喻，但在遺傳學出現之前，其中的原因一直是個謎。

items.def: depending on the situation
items.s: The monkey's behaviour was ________, because it acted bravely with friends but hid when it was alone.
items.zh: 那隻猴子的行為是視情況而定的，因為牠和朋友在一起時很勇敢，但獨自一隻時就躲起來。

items.def: in a way that relates to living in groups
items.s: Wolves are ________ complex animals, so a lonely wolf often tries hard to find or form a new pack.
items.zh: 狼在社交上是複雜的動物，所以一隻孤狼常常會努力尋找或組成新的狼群。

items.def: right for a purpose
items.s: The beach was no longer ________ for nesting, because hotels had been built along the sand.
items.zh: 這片海灘已不再適合築巢，因為沙灘沿岸已經蓋了飯店。

items.def: giving help and encouragement
items.s: Elephants are very ________ of each other, and they gently touch a stressed friend with their trunks.
items.zh: 大象之間非常支持彼此，而牠們會用象鼻輕輕觸碰感到緊張的同伴。

items.def: in an unexpected way
items.s: Pigs are ________ clever, and some can learn to play simple video games with a joystick.
items.zh: 豬令人驚訝地聰明，而有些豬能學會用搖桿玩簡單的電玩遊戲。

items.def: affecting the whole body or system
items.s: The infection became ________, so it spread through the patient's blood and needed stronger treatment.
items.zh: 感染變成了全身性的，所以它擴散到病人的血液中，需要更強的治療。

items.def: defending an area from others
items.s: Robins are very ________ birds, and they will even attack their own reflection in a window.
items.zh: 知更鳥是非常有領域性的鳥類，而牠們甚至會攻擊自己在窗戶上的倒影。

items.def: not happening often
items.s: White tigers are ________ in the wild, because they need a rare gene from both parents.
items.zh: 白老虎在野外是不常見的，因為牠們需要從父母雙方都得到一個罕見的基因。

items.def: surprising and not planned
items.s: The results were ________, because the "lazy" ants actually acted as a back-up team when others were lost.
items.zh: 結果是出乎意料的，因為那些「懶惰」的螞蟻在其他螞蟻消失時其實擔任了後備隊伍。

items.def: without a known reason
items.s: Some whales beach themselves for ________ reasons, and scientists are studying whether noise may be the cause.
items.zh: 有些鯨魚因為無法解釋的原因擱淺，而科學家正在研究噪音是否可能是原因。

items.def: different from what is normal
items.s: It is ________ for a male fish to carry eggs, but male seahorses carry their babies in a special pouch.
items.zh: 雄魚攜帶卵是不尋常的，但雄海馬會把寶寶放在一個特別的育兒袋裡。

items.def: very useful or important
items.s: Old museum specimens are ________ to scientists, because their DNA shows how species have changed.
items.zh: 博物館的舊標本對科學家很寶貴，因為它們的DNA顯示了物種是如何改變的。

items.def: showing strong opposition
items.s: The two male cats were ________ towards each other, so the owner kept them in separate rooms.
items.zh: 那兩隻公貓彼此敵對，所以主人把牠們分開養在不同的房間。

items.def: able to understand and react to something
items.s: Dogs are closely ________ to human faces, and they can often tell when their owner is sad.
items.zh: 狗對人類的臉部表情非常熟悉，而且牠們常常能察覺主人什麼時候難過。

items.def: causing harm
items.s: Most mutations are ________ or have no effect, but a few help the animal survive.
items.zh: 大多數突變是有害的或沒有影響，但少數會幫助動物生存。

items.def: calm and easy to control
items.s: Farm animals became more ________ over many generations, because farmers kept the calmest ones for breeding.
items.zh: 農場動物經過許多世代變得更溫馴，因為農民保留最溫和的個體來繁殖。

items.def: being a typical symbol of something
items.s: The panda is ________ of animal protection, and its picture appears on many conservation posters.
items.zh: 熊貓是動物保護的象徵，而牠的圖片出現在許多保育海報上。

items.def: liking to be with others
items.s: Sheep are ________ animals, so a sheep that is kept alone often becomes stressed and stops eating.
items.zh: 羊是群居的動物，所以被單獨飼養的羊常常會感到壓力並停止進食。

items.def: very difficult to solve or control
items.s: The problem of rats on the island seemed ________, but a careful plan finally removed them all.
items.zh: 島上的鼠患問題似乎很棘手，但一項周密的計畫最終把牠們全部清除了。

items.def: calm and not easily upset
items.s: The old horse was ________ and gentle, so the riding school used it for young children.
items.zh: 那匹老馬溫和而溫順，所以騎馬學校讓牠給年幼的孩子騎。

items.def: a natural tendency to do something
items.s: Border collies have a strong ________ for herding, and they may even try to gather children together.
items.zh: 邊境牧羊犬有強烈的放牧傾向，而牠們甚至可能會試圖把孩子們聚集在一起。

items.def: avoiding others and living alone
items.s: The snow leopard is a ________ animal, so few people have ever seen one in the wild.
items.zh: 雪豹是一種不喜交際的動物，所以很少有人曾在野外看過牠。

items.def: finding something good by chance
items.s: Many great discoveries came from ________, because scientists noticed something strange and decided to study it.
items.zh: 許多偉大的發現來自機緣巧合，因為科學家注意到奇怪的事情並決定研究它。

items.def: willing to obey others
items.s: The young wolf showed ________ behaviour by lying on its back, and the leader stopped growling.
items.zh: 那隻年輕的狼仰躺著表現出順從的行為，而首領就停止了低吼。

items.def: shy and easily frightened
items.s: The rescued dog was ________ at first, but it slowly became braver with daily walks and kind words.
items.zh: 那隻被救援的狗起初很膽小，但隨著每天散步和溫柔的話語，牠慢慢變得勇敢。

items.def: good at noticing things
items.s: An ________ student noticed that the ants always took the same path, so she drew a map of their route.
items.zh: 一位觀察力敏銳的學生注意到螞蟻總是走同一條路，所以她畫了一張牠們路線的地圖。

items.def: quick to notice danger
items.s: Deer stay ________ while they eat, and they lift their heads every few seconds to listen for wolves.
items.zh: 鹿在進食時保持警覺，而且牠們每隔幾秒就抬起頭來聆聽狼的動靜。

items.def: protecting yourself from attack
items.s: The mother bear became ________ when we walked near her cubs, so the guide told us to back away slowly.
items.zh: 當我們走近她的小熊時，母熊變得具防禦性，所以導遊要我們慢慢後退。

items.def: able to move quickly and lightly
items.s: Mountain goats are very ________ climbers, and they can stand on rocks that look too small for their feet.
items.zh: 山羊是非常敏捷的攀爬者，而且牠們能站在看起來比牠們的蹄還小的岩石上。

items.def: bright and designed to attract attention
items.s: The male bird has ________ feathers, while the female is plain brown so she can hide on the nest.
items.zh: 雄鳥有華麗的羽毛，而雌鳥是樸素的褐色，好讓她能躲在巢裡。

items.def: possibly dangerous
items.s: Leaving the group is ________ for a young zebra, because lions often attack animals that are alone.
items.zh: 離開群體對年輕的斑馬來說是有風險的，因為獅子常常攻擊落單的動物。

items.def: not able to cause harm
items.s: Most spiders in Taiwan are ________ to people, but many children are still afraid of them.
items.zh: 台灣大多數蜘蛛對人類是無害的，但許多孩子仍然害怕牠們。

items.def: the idea that the best-suited living things survive
items.s: Some people use "______ ______ ______ ______" to describe business, but Darwin meant fitting the environment, not being the strongest.
items.zh: 有些人用「適者生存」來形容商業競爭，但達爾文的意思是適應環境，而不是最強壯。

items.def: to be common among members of one family
items.s: Musical talent seems to ______ ______ ______ ______, because my grandfather, my mother and my brother all play the piano.
items.zh: 音樂天分似乎是家族遺傳，因為我的外公、我媽媽和我哥哥都會彈鋼琴。

items.w: birds of a feather flock together
items.def: people who are alike spend time together
items.s: Tom and his friends all love insects and spend weekends looking for beetles, so ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______.
items.zh: 湯姆和他的朋友們都熱愛昆蟲，週末都在找甲蟲，所以真是物以類聚。

items.def: a son is often similar to his father
items.s: My dad laughs exactly the way my brother does, and my grandmother always smiles and says, "______ ______, ______ ______."
items.zh: 我爸爸笑起來跟我哥哥一模一樣，而我奶奶總是微笑著說：「有其父必有其子。」

items.w: the apple doesn't fall far from the tree
items.def: children are often like their parents
items.s: Her mother was a famous scientist, and now she is studying genes too, so ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______.
items.zh: 她的母親是一位著名的科學家，而現在她也在研究基因，所以真是有其父母必有其子女。

items.w: a chip off the old block
items.def: a person who is very similar to a parent
items.s: Kevin is as funny and talkative as his father, and everyone at the party said he was ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______.
items.zh: 凱文和他爸爸一樣風趣又健談，而派對上每個人都說他酷似他爸爸。

items.def: natural to someone because of their family
items.s: Running seems to be ______ ______ ______, because her parents were both Olympic athletes and she won her first race at six.
items.zh: 跑步似乎是她與生俱來的能力，因為她的父母都是奧運選手，而她六歲就贏得了第一場比賽。

items.def: to give something to children or the next generation
items.s: Parents can ______ ______ certain illnesses to their children, so doctors sometimes suggest a gene test before pregnancy.
items.zh: 父母可能會把某些疾病遺傳給孩子，所以醫生有時會建議在懷孕前做基因檢測。

items.def: to look or behave like an older family member
items.s: I ______ ______ my grandmother, because we both have green eyes and we both love gardening.
items.zh: 我長得像我奶奶，因為我們都有綠色的眼睛，而且都熱愛園藝。

items.w: the early bird catches the worm
items.def: people who start early will succeed
items.s: My mum always wakes me at six before exams, because she believes ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______.
items.zh: 考試前我媽媽總是六點叫我起床，因為她相信早起的鳥兒有蟲吃。

items.w: a leopard can't change its spots
items.def: people cannot change their basic character
items.s: He promised to stop being late, but he was late again the next day, so ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______.
items.zh: 他答應不再遲到，但隔天又遲到了，所以真是本性難移。

items.def: to give a false warning so people stop believing you
items.s: If you ______ ______ too often about being sick, your teacher may not believe you when you really feel ill.
items.zh: 如果你太常謊報生病，當你真的不舒服時老師可能不會相信你。

items.w: let the cat out of the bag
items.def: to tell a secret by mistake
items.s: We planned a surprise party for Mum, but my little sister ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, so the surprise was ruined.
items.zh: 我們為媽媽計畫了一場驚喜派對，但我妹妹洩露了祕密，所以驚喜就泡湯了。

items.w: the black sheep of the family
items.def: a family member who is different or disapproved of
items.cn: 家族中的害群之馬；異類
items.s: Everyone in my family became a doctor, but my uncle became a rock singer, so he calls himself ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______.
items.zh: 我家每個人都成了醫生，但我叔叔成了搖滾歌手，所以他自稱是家族中的異類。

items.def: the largest part of something
items.s: The dominant wolf usually takes ______ ______ ______ of the food, while the younger wolves wait for what is left.
items.zh: 地位最高的狼通常拿走食物中最大的一份，而年輕的狼則等著吃剩下的。

items.w: you can't teach an old dog new tricks
items.def: it is hard to change old habits
items.cn: 老狗學不會新把戲；積習難改
items.s: My grandfather refuses to use a smartphone and says ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, but I am still trying to teach him.
items.zh: 我爺爺拒絕使用智慧型手機，還說老狗學不會新把戲，但我仍在努力教他。

items.def: people copy what others do without thinking
items.s: My little brother copies everything I do, so when I started eating vegetables, he did too—______ ______, ______ ______.
items.zh: 我弟弟什麼都學我，所以當我開始吃蔬菜時，他也跟著吃——真是有樣學樣。

items.def: very competitive, where people harm others to succeed
items.cn: 殘酷競爭的；弱肉強食的
items.s: Life in the wild is a ________ world, and only the animals that find enough food survive the winter.
items.zh: 野外的生活是一個弱肉強食的世界，而只有找到足夠食物的動物才能熬過冬天。

items.def: to cause something to happen or exist
items.s: A small change in one gene can ______ ______ ______ a new feature, and over time that feature may spread through the species.
items.zh: 一個基因的小改變就能導致一個新特徵的出現，而隨著時間推移，這個特徵可能會擴散到整個物種。

items.def: to annoy or upset someone
items.s: My classmate's rude joke about my drawing ______ ______ ______, but I tried to stay calm and smiled at him.
items.zh: 我同學對我畫作的無禮玩笑惹惱了我，但我試著保持冷靜並對他微笑。

items.def: the work of collecting and writing news
items.s: My cousin studied ________ at university, and now she writes stories about local problems for an online newspaper.
items.zh: 我的表姊在大學主修新聞學，現在她為一家線上報紙撰寫關於地方問題的報導。
items.sec: News & Journalism 新聞與新聞業

items.def: a person who writes or reports the news
items.s: The ________ waited outside the hospital for hours, but the doctors refused to answer any of her questions.
items.zh: 那位記者在醫院外等了好幾個小時，但醫生們拒絕回答她的任何問題。
items.sec: News & Journalism 新聞與新聞業

items.def: a person who finds and tells news stories
items.s: A young ________ was sent to cover the typhoon, so he stood in the rain and described the damage on live TV.
items.zh: 一位年輕的記者被派去報導颱風，所以他站在雨中，在電視直播上描述災情。
items.sec: News & Journalism 新聞與新聞業

items.def: a journalist who reports from a particular place or topic
items.s: The BBC's ________ in Tokyo has lived in Japan for ten years, so she understands the local culture very well.
items.zh: 英國廣播公司駐東京的特派員已經在日本住了十年，所以她非常了解當地文化。
items.sec: News & Journalism 新聞與新聞業

items.def: a person who checks and decides what is published
items.s: The ________ asked me to cut my article from 1,000 words to 600, because there was not enough space on the page.
items.zh: 編輯要求我把文章從一千字刪到六百字，因為版面上沒有足夠的空間。
items.sec: News & Journalism 新聞與新聞業

items.def: a newspaper article giving the paper's opinion
items.s: Today's ________ criticises the government's new housing plan, and many readers have written letters to agree with it.
items.zh: 今天的社論批評政府的新住宅計畫，而許多讀者寫信表示贊同。
items.sec: News & Journalism 新聞與新聞業

items.def: the title of a news story in large letters
items.s: The ________ said that prices would double, but when I read the whole article, the real increase was only five percent.
items.zh: 那則標題說價格會翻倍，但當我讀完整篇文章時，實際漲幅只有百分之五。
items.sec: News & Journalism 新聞與新聞業

items.def: the first page of a newspaper with the main news
items.s: The photo of the flooded village appeared on the ______ ______ of every newspaper, so the whole country saw it the next morning.
items.zh: 那張被淹沒村莊的照片出現在每份報紙的頭版上，所以隔天早上全國的人都看到了。
items.sec: News & Journalism 新聞與新聞業

items.def: printed pages of news published daily or weekly
items.s: My grandfather still buys a paper ________ every morning, although most of his friends now read the news on their phones.
items.zh: 我爺爺每天早上仍然買一份紙本報紙，儘管他大部分朋友現在都用手機看新聞。
items.sec: News & Journalism 新聞與新聞業

items.def: the office where journalists prepare the news
items.s: The ________ was very busy on election night, and nobody went home until all the results had been reported.
items.zh: 選舉當晚新聞編輯室非常忙碌，直到所有結果都報導完之前沒有人回家。
items.sec: News & Journalism 新聞與新聞業

items.def: a meeting where someone answers reporters' questions
items.s: The mayor held a ______ ______ after the fire, but he left quickly because reporters kept asking difficult questions.
items.zh: 市長在火災後召開了記者會，但他很快就離開了，因為記者們一直問困難的問題。
items.sec: News & Journalism 新聞與新聞業

items.def: an official statement given to journalists
items.s: The company sent out a ______ ______ about its new phone, and dozens of websites copied the text without checking it.
items.zh: 那家公司發布了一份關於新手機的新聞稿，而幾十個網站沒有查證就照抄了內容。
items.sec: News & Journalism 新聞與新聞業

items.def: an important story one newspaper reports first
items.s: The student newspaper got a big ________ when it discovered the school's budget problems, and even national TV reported it later.
items.zh: 學生報發現學校的預算問題時拿到了一則大獨家新聞，後來連全國電視台都報導了。
items.sec: News & Journalism 新聞與新聞業

items.def: only given to one news company
items.s: The singer gave an ________ interview to one magazine, so fans had to buy that magazine to read about her new album.
items.zh: 那位歌手只接受一家雜誌的獨家專訪，所以粉絲必須買那本雜誌才能讀到她新專輯的消息。
items.sec: News & Journalism 新聞與新聞業

items.def: the line that shows who wrote an article
items.s: I was very proud to see my name in the ________ of the school magazine, because it was my first published article.
items.zh: 看到我的名字出現在校刊的署名欄上，我非常驕傲，因為那是我第一篇刊出的文章。
items.sec: News & Journalism 新聞與新聞業

items.def: a writer who regularly writes opinion pieces
items.s: The ________ writes about family life every Sunday, and many parents say her funny stories make them feel less alone.
items.zh: 那位專欄作家每個星期日寫關於家庭生活的文章，許多父母說她有趣的故事讓他們覺得不那麼孤單。
items.sec: News & Journalism 新聞與新聞業

items.def: an opinion article written by someone outside the newspaper
items.s: A doctor wrote an ________ about the dangers of vaping, and the newspaper published it because many teenagers are affected.
items.zh: 一位醫生寫了一篇關於電子菸危害的投書，報社刊登了它，因為許多青少年受到影響。
items.sec: News & Journalism 新聞與新聞業

items.def: a popular newspaper with short, exciting stories about famous people
items.s: The ________ printed a shocking story about the actor's private life, but later it had to admit that the story was false.
items.zh: 那份小報刊登了一則關於那位演員私生活的驚人報導，但後來不得不承認那則報導是假的。
items.sec: News & Journalism 新聞與新聞業

items.def: interesting or important enough to report
items.s: The editor said that a cat stuck in a tree was not ________, but the story became popular online anyway.
items.zh: 編輯說一隻卡在樹上的貓沒有新聞價值，但這則故事還是在網路上爆紅了。
items.sec: News & Journalism 新聞與新聞業

items.def: news about something that is happening right now
items.s: We were watching a cooking show when ______ ______ about the earthquake interrupted the programme, so everyone stopped and listened.
items.zh: 我們正在看烹飪節目時，關於地震的即時新聞打斷了節目，所以大家都停下來聆聽。
items.sec: News & Journalism 新聞與新聞業

items.def: trying to find hidden facts
items.s: The ________ report took six months to complete, but it finally showed how the factory had been polluting the river.
items.zh: 那篇調查報導花了六個月才完成，但最終揭露了工廠是如何汙染河流的。
items.sec: News & Journalism 新聞與新聞業

items.def: a person who tells the public about wrongdoing at work
items.s: The ________ lost her job after she reported the company's illegal dumping, but she said she did not regret telling the truth.
items.zh: 那位吹哨者揭發公司非法傾倒廢棄物後丟了工作，但她說她不後悔說出真相。
items.sec: News & Journalism 新聞與新聞業

items.def: a person who gives secret information to someone
items.s: The journalist promised never to reveal the name of her ________, because he could lose his job if people found out.
items.zh: 那名記者承諾絕不透露她線人的名字，因為如果別人發現，他可能會丟掉工作。
items.sec: News & Journalism 新聞與新聞業

items.def: a person who saw an event happen
items.s: An ________ told reporters that the car was driving very fast, and her description helped the police understand the accident.
items.zh: 一位目擊者告訴記者那輛車開得非常快，而她的描述幫助警方了解這起事故。
items.sec: News & Journalism 新聞與新聞業

items.def: photographers who follow famous people to take pictures
items.s: The ________ waited outside the restaurant all evening, so the famous couple had to leave through the kitchen door.
items.zh: 狗仔隊整晚守在餐廳外面，所以那對名人夫妻只好從廚房的門離開。
items.sec: News & Journalism 新聞與新聞業

items.def: a news article about a person who has recently died
items.s: The local paper published an ________ for the old teacher, and many former students shared it online with kind memories.
items.zh: 地方報紙為那位老教師刊登了一則訃聞，許多以前的學生在網路上分享並寫下溫馨的回憶。
items.sec: News & Journalism 新聞與新聞業

items.def: a company or website that publishes news
items.s: Several ______ ______ reported the same false story, because they all copied it from one social media post without checking.
items.zh: 好幾家新聞媒體報導了同一則假新聞，因為它們都沒有查證就從一則社群貼文抄來。
items.sec: News & Journalism 新聞與新聞業

items.def: the right of the media to report without government control
items.s: Taiwan ranks highly for ______ ______, so journalists here can criticise the government without fear of going to prison.
items.zh: 台灣的新聞自由排名很高，所以這裡的記者可以批評政府而不必擔心坐牢。
items.sec: News & Journalism 新聞與新聞業

items.def: a system that makes you pay to read online articles
items.s: I wanted to read the full article, but it was behind a ________, so I only saw the first two paragraphs.
items.zh: 我想讀完整篇文章，但它被放在付費牆後面，所以我只看到前兩段。
items.sec: News & Journalism 新聞與新聞業

items.def: made to shock or excite people rather than inform them
items.s: The website uses ________ headlines to attract clicks, but the articles themselves usually contain very little real information.
items.zh: 那個網站使用聳動的標題來吸引點擊，但文章本身通常只有很少的真實資訊。
items.sec: News & Journalism 新聞與新聞業

items.def: to remove parts of news, books or films that authorities dislike
items.s: The government ________ the documentary before it was shown, so viewers never saw the scenes of the protest.
items.zh: 政府在紀錄片播出前就審查刪剪了它，所以觀眾從未看到抗議的畫面。
items.sec: News & Journalism 新聞與新聞業

items.def: the control of what people can say, read or watch
items.s: Strict ________ means that some citizens cannot use foreign websites, so they often rely on VPNs to read international news.
items.zh: 嚴格的審查制度意味著有些公民無法使用外國網站，所以他們常依靠 VPN 來閱讀國際新聞。
items.sec: News & Journalism 新聞與新聞業

items.def: to send out a programme on TV or radio
items.s: The final match was ________ live on national television, so millions of people watched it at home and in restaurants.
items.zh: 那場決賽在全國電視台現場播出，所以數百萬人在家裡和餐廳收看。
items.sec: Broadcasting & Traditional Media 廣播與傳統媒體

items.def: a company or person that makes TV or radio programmes
items.s: The public ________ does not show adverts, because it is paid for by taxes rather than by companies.
items.zh: 那家公共廣播公司不播放廣告，因為它的經費來自稅收而不是企業。
items.sec: Broadcasting & Traditional Media 廣播與傳統媒體

items.def: a system or machine for watching programmes
items.s: Fewer young people watch ________ in the evening now, because they prefer short videos on their phones.
items.zh: 現在晚上看電視的年輕人比較少了，因為他們比較喜歡在手機上看短影片。
items.sec: Broadcasting & Traditional Media 廣播與傳統媒體

items.def: a show on TV or radio
items.s: My favourite ________ is a science show for teenagers, and each episode explains one strange fact about nature.
items.zh: 我最喜歡的節目是一個給青少年看的科學節目，每一集都解釋一個關於大自然的奇特事實。
items.sec: Broadcasting & Traditional Media 廣播與傳統媒體

items.def: a film or programme that gives facts about a real topic
items.s: We watched a ________ about plastic in the ocean, and afterwards the whole class decided to stop using plastic straws.
items.zh: 我們看了一部關於海洋塑膠的紀錄片，之後全班決定不再使用塑膠吸管。
items.sec: Broadcasting & Traditional Media 廣播與傳統媒體

items.def: a programme where a host chats with guests
items.s: The actor appeared on a late-night ______ ______, and he told funny stories about the mistakes he made while filming.
items.zh: 那位演員上了一個深夜談話節目，他講了一些拍片時犯錯的趣事。
items.sec: Broadcasting & Traditional Media 廣播與傳統媒體

items.def: a funny TV series about the same characters
items.s: My parents love an old American ________ about six friends in New York, so they watch the episodes again and again.
items.zh: 我爸媽很喜歡一部關於紐約六個朋友的老美國情境喜劇，所以他們一再重看那些集數。
items.sec: Broadcasting & Traditional Media 廣播與傳統媒體

items.def: a long-running drama series about people's lives
items.s: My grandmother never misses her favourite ______ ______, and she gets very upset when the characters argue or fall in love.
items.zh: 我奶奶從不錯過她最愛的連續劇，而且劇中人物吵架或談戀愛時她都會很激動。
items.sec: Broadcasting & Traditional Media 廣播與傳統媒體

items.def: a programme that films ordinary people in real situations
items.s: The ______ ______ claims to show real life, but some contestants later admitted that many scenes had been planned in advance.
items.zh: 那個真人實境秀聲稱呈現真實生活，但有些參賽者後來承認許多場景是事先安排好的。
items.sec: Broadcasting & Traditional Media 廣播與傳統媒體

items.def: a person who watches TV or videos
items.s: Many ________ complained about the violent scenes, so the channel moved the programme to a later time.
items.zh: 許多觀眾抱怨那些暴力場面，所以電視台把節目移到較晚的時段。
items.sec: Broadcasting & Traditional Media 廣播與傳統媒體

items.def: the people who watch, read or listen to something
items.s: The speaker made a joke at the beginning, and the whole ________ laughed, so she felt much more relaxed.
items.zh: 講者在一開始開了個玩笑，全場聽眾都笑了，所以她感覺放鬆多了。
items.sec: Broadcasting & Traditional Media 廣播與傳統媒體
