items.def: numbers showing how many people watch a programme
items.s: The show's ________ fell sharply after the main actor left, so the network decided to cancel it.
items.zh: 那位主角離開後，節目的收視率急劇下滑，所以電視網決定停播。
items.sec: Broadcasting & Traditional Media 廣播與傳統媒體

items.def: the evening hours when most people watch TV
items.s: Adverts shown during ______ ______ are very expensive, because that is when the largest number of families are watching.
items.zh: 在黃金時段播出的廣告非常昂貴，因為那時收看的家庭最多。
items.sec: Broadcasting & Traditional Media 廣播與傳統媒體

items.def: a pause in a programme for adverts
items.s: During the ______ ______ I quickly made some tea, but I missed the start of the next part of the film.
items.zh: 廣告時間的時候我很快泡了杯茶，但我錯過了電影下一段的開頭。
items.sec: Broadcasting & Traditional Media 廣播與傳統媒體

items.def: the person who introduces a show and talks to guests
items.s: The ________ of the quiz show was friendly and calm, so even nervous contestants were able to answer well.
items.zh: 那個益智節目的主持人友善又沉穩，所以連緊張的參賽者都能回答得很好。
items.sec: Broadcasting & Traditional Media 廣播與傳統媒體

items.def: a person who introduces a TV or radio programme
items.s: The weather ________ pointed to the map and warned that heavy rain would arrive by the weekend, so people prepared early.
items.zh: 氣象主播指著地圖警告大雨將在週末前到來，所以民眾提早做好準備。
items.sec: Broadcasting & Traditional Media 廣播與傳統媒體

items.def: a person who reads the news on TV or radio
items.s: The ________ stayed calm while she reported the disaster, but viewers could see that she was deeply affected.
items.zh: 那位新聞主播報導災難時保持冷靜，但觀眾看得出她深受影響。
items.sec: Broadcasting & Traditional Media 廣播與傳統媒體

items.def: one part of a TV or radio series
items.s: The last ________ of the series ended with a big surprise, and fans have been discussing it online ever since.
items.zh: 那部影集的最後一集以一個大驚喜收尾，粉絲們從那時起就一直在網路上討論。
items.sec: Broadcasting & Traditional Media 廣播與傳統媒體

items.def: a room where TV, radio or music is recorded
items.s: We visited a TV ________ on our school trip, and we were surprised by how small the set looked in real life.
items.zh: 我們校外教學參觀了一間電視攝影棚，我們很驚訝實際上的布景看起來那麼小。
items.sec: Broadcasting & Traditional Media 廣播與傳統媒體

items.def: a recorded audio programme you can download or stream
items.s: I listen to an English ________ on the bus every morning, and it has really improved my listening skills.
items.zh: 我每天早上在公車上聽一個英文播客節目，它真的提升了我的聽力。
items.sec: Broadcasting & Traditional Media 廣播與傳統媒體

items.def: the radio signals used for broadcasting
items.s: The song was all over the ________ that summer, so you could hear it in shops, taxis and almost every café.
items.zh: 那年夏天那首歌充斥廣播電台，所以在商店、計程車和幾乎每家咖啡廳都聽得到。
items.sec: Broadcasting & Traditional Media 廣播與傳統媒體

items.def: a news programme on TV or radio
items.s: My parents watch the evening ________ every day at seven, and they always discuss the main stories during dinner.
items.zh: 晚間新聞節目是我爸媽每天七點必看的，晚餐時他們總是討論其中的主要新聞。
items.sec: Broadcasting & Traditional Media 廣播與傳統媒體

items.def: available whenever you want it
items.s: The ________ service lets you watch shows whenever you like, so you no longer need to wait for a fixed time.
items.zh: 這個隨選服務讓你隨時想看就看，所以你不再需要等固定的時段。
items.sec: Broadcasting & Traditional Media 廣播與傳統媒體

items.def: a thin weekly or monthly publication with articles and pictures
items.s: She bought a science ________ at the airport, and the article about space travel kept her busy during the long flight.
items.zh: 她在機場買了一本科學雜誌，那篇關於太空旅行的文章讓她在漫長的航程中不無聊。
items.sec: Broadcasting & Traditional Media 廣播與傳統媒體

items.def: one printed version of a newspaper, book or magazine
items.s: The morning ________ of the paper had already been printed, so the late news about the election appeared online first.
items.zh: 報紙的早報版已經印好了，所以選舉的最新消息先出現在網路上。
items.sec: Broadcasting & Traditional Media 廣播與傳統媒體

items.def: newspapers and magazines printed on paper
items.s: ______ ______ has lost many readers to the internet, but some people still trust printed newspapers more than websites.
items.zh: 平面媒體已經因網路流失了許多讀者，但有些人仍然比較相信紙本報紙而不是網站。
items.sec: Broadcasting & Traditional Media 廣播與傳統媒體

items.def: TV, radio and newspapers that reach large numbers of people
items.s: The ______ ______ can shape public opinion quickly, so it has a responsibility to report facts carefully.
items.zh: 大眾傳媒能迅速塑造輿論，所以它有責任謹慎地報導事實。
items.sec: Broadcasting & Traditional Media 廣播與傳統媒體

items.def: words at the bottom of the screen translating speech
items.s: I watch Korean dramas with English ________, because it helps me learn new words while I enjoy the story.
items.zh: 我看韓劇時開英文字幕，因為這能幫助我在享受劇情的同時學新單字。
items.sec: Broadcasting & Traditional Media 廣播與傳統媒體

items.def: a person who listens to a radio programme
items.s: One ________ called the radio station to share her story, and the host thanked her for being so honest.
items.zh: 一位聽眾打電話到電台分享她的故事，主持人感謝她如此坦誠。
items.sec: Broadcasting & Traditional Media 廣播與傳統媒體

items.def: websites and apps where people share content and talk
items.s: Most teenagers get their news from ______ ______, but they do not always check whether the stories are true.
items.zh: 大多數青少年從社群媒體獲得新聞，但他們不一定會查證那些報導是否屬實。
items.sec: Social Media & the Internet 社群媒體與網路

items.def: to put a message or picture online
items.s: She ________ a photo of her lunch every day, and her friends always leave funny comments under it.
items.zh: 她每天發布一張午餐照片，而她的朋友總是在下面留些好笑的留言。
items.sec: Social Media & the Internet 社群媒體與網路

items.def: to share someone else's post again
items.s: Thousands of people ________ the video of the lost dog, so its owner found it within a few hours.
items.zh: 數千人轉發了那段走失狗狗的影片，所以牠的主人在幾小時內就找到了牠。
items.sec: Social Media & the Internet 社群媒體與網路

items.def: a person who chooses to see someone's posts
items.s: The baker has over 50,000 ________ online, so new customers visit his shop from all over the city.
items.zh: 那位麵包師傅在網路上有超過五萬名追蹤者，所以全市各地都有新客人來他的店。
items.sec: Social Media & the Internet 社群媒體與網路

items.def: a person with many online followers who affects what they buy
items.s: The ________ was paid to recommend the face cream, but she did not tell her followers that it was an advert.
items.zh: 那位網紅拿錢推薦那款面霜，但她沒有告訴追蹤者那是廣告。
items.sec: Social Media & the Internet 社群媒體與網路

items.def: a person who makes video blogs
items.s: The travel ________ films every meal and every hotel room, and his videos have made a small town in Taiwan famous.
items.zh: 那位旅遊影音部落客拍下每一餐和每一間飯店房間，而他的影片讓台灣一個小鎮出了名。
items.sec: Social Media & the Internet 社群媒體與網路

items.def: a person who writes an online journal
items.s: The food ________ gave the restaurant a bad review, so the owner invited her back to try the new menu.
items.zh: 那位美食部落客給那家餐廳負評，所以老闆邀請她再來試試新菜單。
items.sec: Social Media & the Internet 社群媒體與網路

items.def: a word after the # sign used to group posts
items.s: People used the same ________ to share photos of the clean-up, so it was easy to see how many beaches had been cleared.
items.zh: 人們用同一個主題標籤分享淨灘照片，所以很容易看出有多少海灘被清理乾淨了。
items.sec: Social Media & the Internet 社群媒體與網路

items.def: spread very quickly to many people online
items.s: A video of a cat playing the piano went ________ overnight, and the owner was soon invited onto several TV shows.
items.zh: 一段貓彈鋼琴的影片一夜之間爆紅，主人很快就被邀請上好幾個電視節目。
items.sec: Social Media & the Internet 社群媒體與網路

items.def: a funny image or text copied and shared online
items.s: My brother sent me a ________ about exams, and it was so true that I laughed while I was studying.
items.zh: 我哥傳給我一張關於考試的梗圖，內容太真實了，害我讀書時笑出來。
items.sec: Social Media & the Internet 社群媒體與網路

items.def: a small picture used in digital messages
items.s: She replied with a smiling ________, but I could not tell whether she was happy or just being polite.
items.zh: 她回了一個微笑的表情符號，但我分辨不出她是開心還是只是出於禮貌。
items.sec: Social Media & the Internet 社群媒體與網路

items.def: a photo you take of yourself
items.s: Tourists were taking ________ at the edge of the cliff, so the park added a fence to keep them safe.
items.zh: 遊客在懸崖邊拍自拍照，所以公園加裝了圍欄保障他們的安全。
items.sec: Social Media & the Internet 社群媒體與網路

items.def: the page with information about a user
items.s: Before the interview, the manager looked at my online ________, so I was glad that I had removed my old party photos.
items.zh: 面試前經理看了我的網路個人頁面，所以我很慶幸自己已經刪掉了以前的派對照片。
items.sec: Social Media & the Internet 社群媒體與網路

items.def: a message on your phone telling you something new
items.s: My phone kept showing ________ during class, so I finally turned them off and concentrated much better.
items.zh: 上課時我的手機一直跳出通知，所以我終於把它們關掉，結果專心多了。
items.sec: Social Media & the Internet 社群媒體與網路

items.def: to show video on the internet as it happens
items.s: The band ________ their concert for fans who could not buy tickets, and over a million people watched online.
items.zh: 那個樂團為買不到票的粉絲直播了演唱會，超過一百萬人在線上觀看。
items.sec: Social Media & the Internet 社群媒體與網路

items.def: a person who makes videos, posts or other online material
items.s: Being a ______ ______ looks easy, but many spend hours filming and editing a video that lasts only one minute.
items.zh: 當內容創作者看似簡單，但許多人要花好幾小時拍攝和剪輯一部只有一分鐘的影片。
items.sec: Social Media & the Internet 社群媒體與網路

items.def: a person who posts rude messages to upset others
items.s: A ________ left nasty comments under every photo she posted, so she decided to block him and ignore his messages.
items.zh: 一位酸民在她發的每張照片下留惡毒留言，所以她決定封鎖他並不理會他的訊息。
items.sec: Social Media & the Internet 社群媒體與網路

items.def: hurting or threatening someone online
items.s: ________ can follow students home from school, because hurtful messages arrive on their phones at any time.
items.zh: 網路霸凌會讓學生回到家也逃不掉，因為傷人的訊息隨時都會傳到他們的手機上。
items.sec: Social Media & the Internet 社群媒體與網路

items.def: an online space where you only hear opinions like your own
items.s: If you only follow people who agree with you, you may end up in an ______ ______, and you will never hear other views.
items.zh: 如果你只追蹤和你意見相同的人，你可能會陷入同溫層，而且永遠聽不到其他觀點。
items.sec: Social Media & the Internet 社群媒體與網路

items.def: when apps only show you content they think you like
items.s: The app keeps showing me the same kind of videos, so I worry that I am stuck in a ______ ______.
items.zh: 那個應用程式一直推給我同類型的影片，所以我擔心自己被困在過濾氣泡裡。
items.sec: Social Media & the Internet 社群媒體與網路

items.def: a picture of what is on a screen
items.s: He deleted the rude message quickly, but someone had already taken a ________, so everyone saw what he had written.
items.zh: 他很快就刪掉了那則無禮的訊息，但有人已經截圖了，所以大家都看到他寫了什麼。
items.sec: Social Media & the Internet 社群媒體與網路

items.def: the name you use to log in to a website or app
items.s: I forgot my ________ for the game, so I had to use my email address to get into my account.
items.zh: 我忘了那款遊戲的使用者名稱，所以必須用電子郵件地址才能登入帳號。
items.sec: Social Media & the Internet 社群媒體與網路

items.def: a website that helps you find information online
items.s: I typed the question into a ______ ______, but the first results were all adverts, so I scrolled down for better sources.
items.zh: 我把問題輸入搜尋引擎，但前幾個結果都是廣告，所以我往下滑找更好的資料來源。
items.sec: Social Media & the Internet 社群媒體與網路

items.def: a set of pages on the internet
items.s: The ________ looked professional, but it had no contact details, so my teacher said we should not trust it.
items.zh: 那個網站看起來很專業，但沒有任何聯絡資訊，所以老師說我們不應該相信它。
items.sec: Social Media & the Internet 社群媒體與網路

items.def: a private message sent on social media
items.s: She sent me a ______ ______ instead of commenting publicly, because she did not want everyone to read it.
items.zh: 她傳私訊給我而不是公開留言，因為她不想讓大家都讀到。
items.sec: Social Media & the Internet 社群媒體與網路

items.def: an online conversation with several people at once
items.s: Our class ______ ______ gets hundreds of messages every night, so I mute it while I am doing homework.
items.zh: 我們班的群組聊天每晚都有上百則訊息，所以我寫作業時會把它設為靜音。
items.sec: Social Media & the Internet 社群媒體與網路

items.def: to stop seeing someone's posts on social media
items.s: I ________ that account because it kept posting angry and false stories, and now my feed feels much calmer.
items.zh: 我取消追蹤了那個帳號，因為它一直發布憤怒和不實的報導，現在我的動態感覺平靜多了。
items.sec: Social Media & the Internet 社群媒體與網路

items.def: to stop someone from contacting you online
items.s: If a stranger sends you unkind messages, you should ________ the account and tell an adult you trust.
items.zh: 如果陌生人傳給你不友善的訊息，你應該封鎖那個帳號，並告訴你信任的大人。
items.sec: Social Media & the Internet 社群媒體與網路

items.def: the state of hiding your real name
items.s: ________ makes some people braver online, but it also allows others to say cruel things without any consequences.
items.zh: 匿名性讓有些人在網路上更敢說話，但也讓另一些人說出殘忍的話而不必承擔後果。
items.sec: Social Media & the Internet 社群媒體與網路

items.def: reading bad news online for too long
items.cn: 末日滾動；狂刷負面新聞
items.s: After an hour of ________ before bed, I felt anxious and could not sleep, so I now leave my phone in the kitchen.
items.zh: 睡前狂刷負面新聞一小時後，我感到焦慮又睡不著，所以我現在都把手機放在廚房。
items.sec: Social Media & the Internet 社群媒體與網路

items.def: the time you spend looking at a screen
items.s: My parents limit my ______ ______ to two hours a day, so I have more time for sport and reading.
items.zh: 我爸媽把我的螢幕使用時間限制在一天兩小時，所以我有更多時間運動和閱讀。
items.sec: Social Media & the Internet 社群媒體與網路

items.def: false information spread on purpose to trick people
items.cn: 蓄意造假的訊息；假訊息
items.s: The ________ campaign used fake accounts to spread lies about the vaccine, so many parents became afraid to protect their children.
items.zh: 那場假訊息攻勢利用假帳號散播關於疫苗的謊言，所以許多家長變得不敢讓孩子接種。
items.sec: Misinformation & Fake News 假訊息與假新聞

items.def: false stories that look like real news
items.s: My uncle shared a story about free money from the government, but it was ______ ______, so I showed him the official website.
items.zh: 我叔叔分享了一則政府發放免費現金的消息，但那是假新聞，所以我給他看了官方網站。
items.sec: Misinformation & Fake News 假訊息與假新聞

items.def: a trick that makes people believe something false
items.s: The photo of a shark swimming on the highway was a ________, but thousands of people believed it during the flood.
items.zh: 那張鯊魚在高速公路上游泳的照片是個惡作劇，但淹水期間成千上萬的人都信以為真。
items.sec: Misinformation & Fake News 假訊息與假新聞

items.def: a story passed between people that may not be true
items.s: A ________ spread that the school would close for a week, but the principal soon announced that it was not true.
items.zh: 有謠言說學校會停課一週，但校長很快就宣布那不是真的。
items.sec: Misinformation & Fake News 假訊息與假新聞

items.def: talk about other people's private lives
items.s: The office ________ about the manager turned out to be false, but it had already damaged her reputation.
items.zh: 辦公室裡關於經理的八卦結果是假的，但它已經損害了她的名聲。
items.sec: Misinformation & Fake News 假訊息與假新聞

items.def: information used by a government or group to control opinions
items.s: During the war, both sides used ________ posters to make their own soldiers look like heroes and the enemy look evil.
items.zh: 戰爭期間雙方都用宣傳海報把自己的士兵塑造成英雄，把敵人塑造成邪惡的。
items.sec: Misinformation & Fake News 假訊息與假新聞

items.def: a belief that a secret group caused an event
items.s: He believes a ______ ______ that the moon landing was filmed in a studio, although scientists have shown clear evidence against it.
items.zh: 他相信登月是在攝影棚拍攝的陰謀論，儘管科學家已提出明確的反駁證據。
items.sec: Misinformation & Fake News 假訊息與假新聞

items.def: online content with a misleading title to get clicks
items.s: The title promised a shocking secret about celebrities, but it was just ________, and the article said nothing new.
items.zh: 那個標題承諾要揭露名人驚人的秘密，但它只是釣魚標題，文章沒有任何新內容。
items.sec: Misinformation & Fake News 假訊息與假新聞

items.def: a statement that is not true
items.s: The politician repeated the same ________ in every speech, so many voters began to believe it was true.
items.zh: 那位政治人物在每場演講中重複同一個不實說法，所以許多選民開始相信那是真的。
items.sec: Misinformation & Fake News 假訊息與假新聞

items.def: a statement that is partly true but hides important facts
items.s: The advert said the drink had "no added sugar", which was a ________, because the juice itself was full of natural sugar.
items.zh: 那則廣告說這飲料「無添加糖」，這是半真半假的說法，因為果汁本身就充滿天然糖分。
items.sec: Misinformation & Fake News 假訊息與假新聞

items.def: to repeat someone's words wrongly
items.s: The singer said the newspaper had ________ her, because she never said that she hated her fans.
items.zh: 那位歌手說報紙錯誤引用了她的話，因為她從未說過她討厭她的粉絲。
items.sec: Misinformation & Fake News 假訊息與假新聞

items.def: changed in a dishonest way
items.s: The ________ photo made the crowd look much bigger, but experts noticed that some faces appeared twice.
items.zh: 那張動過手腳的照片讓人群看起來大很多，但專家注意到有些臉出現了兩次。
items.sec: Misinformation & Fake News 假訊息與假新聞

items.def: an organised effort to damage someone's reputation with lies
items.s: The candidate said she was the victim of a ______ ______, because fake stories about her family appeared just before the election.
items.zh: 那位候選人說她是抹黑行動的受害者，因為選舉前夕突然出現許多關於她家人的假消息。
items.sec: Misinformation & Fake News 假訊息與假新聞

items.def: harming someone's reputation by saying false things
items.s: The restaurant owner sued the blogger for ________, because the review falsely claimed that customers had become ill.
items.zh: 餐廳老闆控告那位部落客誹謗，因為那篇評論不實地聲稱顧客吃了生病。
items.sec: Misinformation & Fake News 假訊息與假新聞

items.def: false written statements that damage someone's reputation
items.s: The magazine had to pay a large fine for ________, because it published false claims about a businessman.
items.zh: 那本雜誌因書面誹謗必須支付一大筆罰款，因為它刊登了關於一位商人的不實指控。
items.sec: Misinformation & Fake News 假訊息與假新聞

items.def: false spoken statements that damage someone's reputation
items.s: What he said about his neighbour on the radio was ________, so the neighbour asked a lawyer for help.
items.zh: 他在廣播上說他鄰居的那些話是中傷，所以那位鄰居請律師幫忙。
items.sec: Misinformation & Fake News 假訊息與假新聞

items.def: presenting information in a way that makes you look good
items.s: The company called the job cuts "a new start", but everyone knew it was just ________, and the workers were still angry.
items.zh: 公司把裁員稱為「新的開始」，但大家都知道那只是粉飾說法，員工們仍然很憤怒。
items.sec: Misinformation & Fake News 假訊息與假新聞

items.def: a person paid to make news look good for a politician
items.cn: 公關操盤手；政治化妝師
items.s: The minister's ______ ______ quickly changed the story, so the scandal disappeared from the news within two days.
items.zh: 部長的公關操盤手很快就轉移了焦點，所以那件醜聞兩天內就從新聞中消失了。
items.sec: Misinformation & Fake News 假訊息與假新聞

items.def: a computer program that acts like a real user online
items.s: Many of the accounts praising the product were ________, because they all posted the same message at the same time.
items.zh: 許多稱讚那項產品的帳號都是機器人帳號，因為它們都在同一時間發布同樣的訊息。
items.sec: Misinformation & Fake News 假訊息與假新聞

items.def: a group paid to post false or angry comments online
items.s: Investigators found that a ______ ______ had created thousands of fake profiles, and they were all spreading the same rumours.
items.zh: 調查人員發現一個網軍工廠創造了數千個假帳號，而它們都在散播同樣的謠言。
items.sec: Misinformation & Fake News 假訊息與假新聞

items.def: spreading fear to make people believe or do something
items.s: Some news channels were accused of ________ during the outbreak, because they showed panic but gave little useful advice.
items.zh: 疫情期間有些新聞台被指控散播恐慌，因為它們只呈現恐慌卻很少提供有用的建議。
items.sec: Misinformation & Fake News 假訊息與假新聞

items.def: information you heard from others but cannot prove
items.s: The report was based on ________ rather than real evidence, so the editor refused to publish it.
items.zh: 那篇報導是根據道聽塗說而不是真正的證據，所以編輯拒絕刊登它。
items.sec: Misinformation & Fake News 假訊息與假新聞

items.def: not yet checked or proved to be true
items.s: The TV channel showed ________ videos from the scene, but later some of them turned out to be from a different country.
items.zh: 那家電視台播出了現場未經證實的影片，但後來其中一些被證實來自別的國家。
items.sec: Misinformation & Fake News 假訊息與假新聞

items.def: too easily tricked into believing things
items.s: My little brother is so ________ that he believed a website saying cats can speak French, and he tried to teach ours.
items.zh: 我弟弟非常容易受騙，他相信了一個說貓會講法語的網站，還試著教我們家的貓。
items.sec: Misinformation & Fake News 假訊息與假新聞

items.def: a person who pretends to be someone else
items.s: An ________ created an account with the actor's photos, so fans sent money to someone who was not really him.
items.zh: 一個冒名者用那位演員的照片開了帳號，所以粉絲把錢匯給了一個根本不是他的人。
items.sec: Misinformation & Fake News 假訊息與假新聞

items.def: humour that makes fun of people or ideas to criticise them
items.s: The article was ________ from a comedy website, but some readers did not understand the joke and believed it was real news.
items.zh: 那篇文章是喜劇網站的諷刺作品，但有些讀者不懂那是玩笑，以為是真的新聞。
items.sec: Misinformation & Fake News 假訊息與假新聞

items.def: a funny copy of something that exaggerates it
items.s: The students made a ________ of the school's promotional video, and even the teachers laughed when they watched it.
items.zh: 學生們拍了一部學校宣傳影片的惡搞版，連老師們看了都笑了。
items.sec: Misinformation & Fake News 假訊息與假新聞

items.def: to choose only facts that support your view
items.cn: 挑選對自己有利的（事實）
items.s: The report ________ the best results from the study, so it ignored the data showing that the drug did not work for most people.
items.zh: 那份報告只挑選研究中最好的結果，所以它忽略了顯示這藥物對多數人無效的數據。
items.sec: Misinformation & Fake News 假訊息與假新聞

items.def: strongly supporting one political party
items.s: The TV station is very ________, so it rarely reports any good news about the opposition party.
items.zh: 那家電視台非常偏袒特定政黨，所以它很少報導任何關於反對黨的好消息。
items.sec: Misinformation & Fake News 假訊息與假新聞

items.def: too much information, including false information, during a crisis
items.s: During the pandemic there was an ________ of advice online, and it was hard to know which tips were safe.
items.zh: 疫情期間網路上出現了建議的資訊疫情，很難知道哪些建議是安全的。
items.sec: Misinformation & Fake News 假訊息與假新聞

items.def: a strong feeling of anger and shock
items.s: The video caused ________ online, but later people discovered that it had been edited to look much worse.
items.zh: 那段影片在網路上引起公憤，但後來人們發現它被剪輯得看起來更嚴重。
items.sec: Misinformation & Fake News 假訊息與假新聞

items.def: likely to make people angry or violent
items.s: The post used ________ language about immigrants, so the platform removed it and suspended the account.
items.zh: 那則貼文使用了關於移民的煽動性語言，所以平台刪除了它並停用該帳號。
items.sec: Misinformation & Fake News 假訊息與假新聞

items.def: presenting news in a shocking way to attract attention
items.cn: 譁眾取寵的報導手法；煽情主義
items.s: ________ helps sell newspapers, but it often makes small risks seem much bigger than they really are.
items.zh: 煽情主義有助於賣報紙，但它常把小風險渲染得比實際嚴重得多。
items.sec: Misinformation & Fake News 假訊息與假新聞

items.def: to make sure that information is correct
items.s: Before you share a shocking story, you should ________ it on a reliable website, because many viral posts are false.
items.zh: 在分享一則驚人的消息之前，你應該到可靠的網站查核事實，因為許多爆紅的貼文是假的。
items.sec: Fact-Checking & Media Literacy 事實查核與媒體素養

items.def: a person or group that checks if claims are true
items.s: A ________ found that the quote was invented, so the newspaper removed the article and apologised.
items.zh: 一位事實查核員發現那句引言是捏造的，所以報社撤下文章並道歉。
items.sec: Fact-Checking & Media Literacy 事實查核與媒體素養

items.def: the ability to judge and understand news and media
items.s: Our school teaches ______ ______ in Year 10, so students learn how to recognise fake photos and misleading headlines.
items.zh: 我們學校在十年級教媒體素養，所以學生學習如何辨認假照片和誤導性標題。
items.sec: Fact-Checking & Media Literacy 事實查核與媒體素養

items.def: a search that finds where a picture first appeared
items.cn: 以圖搜圖；反向圖片搜尋
items.s: I did a ______ ______ ______ on the photo, and I found that it was taken five years earlier in another country.
items.zh: 我對那張照片做了以圖搜圖，發現它是五年前在另一個國家拍的。
items.sec: Fact-Checking & Media Literacy 事實查核與媒體素養

items.def: a note showing where information came from
items.s: Wikipedia asks writers to add a ________ for every fact, so readers can check the original source themselves.
items.zh: 維基百科要求作者為每個事實加上出處，讓讀者可以自己查證原始來源。
items.sec: Fact-Checking & Media Literacy 事實查核與媒體素養

items.def: to check information using a different source
items.s: Good reporters ________ every claim with at least two sources, because one person might be mistaken or lying.
items.zh: 優秀的記者會用至少兩個來源交叉核對每一項說法，因為一個人可能弄錯或說謊。
items.sec: Fact-Checking & Media Literacy 事實查核與媒體素養

items.def: a statement saying something published earlier was wrong
items.s: The magazine printed a ________ the following week, but far fewer people saw it than the original false story.
items.zh: 那本雜誌隔週刊登了撤回聲明，但看到的人比原本那則假報導少得多。
items.sec: Fact-Checking & Media Literacy 事實查核與媒體素養

items.def: a notice that fixes a mistake in a report
items.s: The website added a ________ at the bottom of the article, because the date of the event had been wrong.
items.zh: 那個網站在文章底部加上了更正啟事，因為活動日期寫錯了。
items.sec: Fact-Checking & Media Literacy 事實查核與媒體素養

items.def: a statement saying you are not responsible for something
items.s: The video had a ________ saying it was for entertainment only, but many viewers still treated it as medical advice.
items.zh: 那部影片有一則免責聲明說它僅供娛樂，但許多觀眾仍然把它當作醫療建議。
items.sec: Fact-Checking & Media Literacy 事實查核與媒體素養

items.def: known to be honest and reliable
items.s: For your project, please use ________ sources such as university websites, because blogs may contain personal opinions.
items.zh: 做專題時請使用信譽良好的資料來源，例如大學網站，因為部落格可能包含個人意見。
items.sec: Fact-Checking & Media Literacy 事實查核與媒體素養

items.def: trusted because it comes from an expert
items.s: The health ministry's website is the most ________ source of vaccine information, so I always check it first.
items.zh: 衛福部的網站是疫苗資訊最權威的來源，所以我總是先查看它。
items.sec: Fact-Checking & Media Literacy 事實查核與媒體素養

items.def: checking a site by reading what other sites say about it
items.s: Instead of staying on one website, try ______ ______, because other sources can tell you whether that site is trustworthy.
items.zh: 不要只停留在一個網站上，試試橫向閱讀，因為其他來源可以告訴你那個網站是否可信。
items.sec: Fact-Checking & Media Literacy 事實查核與媒體素養

items.def: the date and time when something was posted or recorded
items.s: The ________ on the video showed it was filmed in 2019, so it could not be from yesterday's storm.
items.zh: 影片上的時間戳記顯示它是在 2019 年拍的，所以它不可能是昨天暴風雨的畫面。
items.sec: Fact-Checking & Media Literacy 事實查核與媒體素養

items.def: hidden information about a digital file
items.s: Experts studied the photo's ________, and they discovered the exact phone and date used to take it.
items.zh: 專家研究了照片的詮釋資料，發現了拍攝時所用的手機型號與確切日期。
items.sec: Fact-Checking & Media Literacy 事實查核與媒體素養

items.def: a faint logo on an image to show who owns it
items.s: The photographer adds a ________ to every picture, so other websites cannot use her work without permission.
items.zh: 那位攝影師在每張照片上都加浮水印，所以其他網站無法未經許可使用她的作品。
items.sec: Fact-Checking & Media Literacy 事實查核與媒體素養

items.def: based on facts from research
items.cn: 以證據為基礎的；實證的
items.s: The doctor only gives ________ advice, so she told us not to trust diet tips from random videos.
items.zh: 那位醫生只給有實證根據的建議，所以她告訴我們不要相信隨便哪部影片裡的減肥秘訣。
items.sec: Fact-Checking & Media Literacy 事實查核與媒體素養

items.def: a person who checks and controls posts in an online group
items.s: The forum ________ deletes rude comments quickly, so the discussion usually stays friendly and helpful.
items.zh: 那個論壇的版主很快就會刪除無禮的留言，所以討論通常保持友善且有幫助。
items.sec: Fact-Checking & Media Literacy 事實查核與媒體素養

items.def: to mark something as possibly wrong or harmful
items.s: Users can ________ posts that look false, and then the platform sends them to fact-checkers for review.
items.zh: 使用者可以標記看起來不實的貼文，然後平台會把它們送交事實查核員審查。
items.sec: Fact-Checking & Media Literacy 事實查核與媒體素養

items.def: the removal of content from a website
items.s: After the singer complained, the website received a ________ notice, so the stolen song was removed within hours.
items.zh: 那位歌手投訴後，網站收到了下架通知，所以被盜用的歌曲在幾小時內就被移除了。
items.sec: Fact-Checking & Media Literacy 事實查核與媒體素養

items.def: a feeling that you cannot believe someone
items.s: Years of false promises have created deep ________ of politicians, so many young people no longer bother to vote.
items.zh: 多年來的虛假承諾造成了對政治人物深深的不信任，所以許多年輕人不再費心去投票。
items.sec: Fact-Checking & Media Literacy 事實查核與媒體素養

items.def: the belief that someone is honest and reliable
items.s: Once a news channel loses viewers' ________, it is very difficult to win back, even if it apologises.
items.zh: 一家新聞台一旦失去觀眾的信任，即使道歉也很難再贏回來。
items.sec: Fact-Checking & Media Literacy 事實查核與媒體素養

items.def: a way of presenting news that favours one side
items.s: The article had a clear political ________, because it quoted only people who supported the new law.
items.zh: 那篇文章有明顯的政治傾向，因為它只引用了支持新法的人的話。
items.sec: Fact-Checking & Media Literacy 事實查核與媒體素養

items.def: words chosen to create strong emotions
items.s: The report used ______ ______ like "invasion" and "disaster", so readers felt scared before they knew the facts.
items.zh: 那篇報導使用了「入侵」和「災難」等情緒性字眼，所以讀者在了解事實之前就感到害怕。
items.sec: Fact-Checking & Media Literacy 事實查核與媒體素養

items.def: the business of telling people about products to sell them
items.s: The company spends more money on ________ than on research, so its products are famous but not very good.
items.zh: 那家公司花在廣告上的錢比研究還多，所以它的產品很有名但不太好。
items.sec: Advertising, PR & Persuasion 廣告、公關與說服

items.def: a notice or video that tries to sell something
items.s: I saw an ________ for a cheap phone online, but the price was much higher when I got to the shop.
items.zh: 我在網路上看到一則便宜手機的廣告，但我到店裡時價格高得多。
items.sec: Advertising, PR & Persuasion 廣告、公關與說服

items.def: a company that pays for adverts
items.s: Many ________ left the platform after hateful posts appeared next to their adverts, so the company lost millions.
items.zh: 仇恨貼文出現在廣告旁邊後，許多廣告主離開了那個平台，所以那家公司損失了數百萬。
items.sec: Advertising, PR & Persuasion 廣告、公關與說服

items.def: a short, catchy phrase used in advertising
items.s: The shop's ________ is "Fresh every morning", and customers remember it because it is short and easy to say.
items.zh: 那家店的標語是「每天早上都新鮮」，顧客記得它，因為它又短又好念。
items.sec: Advertising, PR & Persuasion 廣告、公關與說服

items.def: a very large outdoor sign for adverts
items.s: A huge ________ beside the highway shows a new car, so thousands of drivers see it every day on their way to work.
items.zh: 高速公路旁一面巨大的廣告看板展示一款新車，所以每天有數千名駕駛在上班途中看到它。
items.sec: Advertising, PR & Persuasion 廣告、公關與說服

items.def: a small magazine with pictures and information about a product or place
items.s: The hotel ________ showed a quiet beach, but when we arrived the beach was crowded and full of rubbish.
items.zh: 飯店的宣傳手冊展示了一片寧靜的海灘，但我們抵達時海灘擁擠又滿是垃圾。
items.sec: Advertising, PR & Persuasion 廣告、公關與說服

items.def: a printed paper giving information about an event or offer
items.s: A student handed me a ________ about the charity concert, and I decided to go because the tickets were cheap.
items.zh: 一位學生遞給我一張慈善音樂會的傳單，我決定去，因為門票很便宜。
items.sec: Advertising, PR & Persuasion 廣告、公關與說服

items.def: a large printed picture or notice on a wall
items.s: We put up a ________ about the beach clean-up in the school hall, and more than fifty students signed up.
items.zh: 我們在學校大廳貼了一張淨灘活動的海報，有五十多位學生報名。
items.sec: Advertising, PR & Persuasion 廣告、公關與說服

items.def: a short, catchy song used in an advert
items.s: The ________ for the noodle advert was so catchy that my little sister sang it all day long.
items.zh: 那則泡麵廣告的廣告歌太洗腦了，我妹妹一整天都在唱。
items.sec: Advertising, PR & Persuasion 廣告、公關與說服

items.def: a symbol that represents a company
items.s: The company changed its ________ to a simpler design, but many customers preferred the old one and complained online.
items.zh: 那家公司把標誌換成更簡單的設計，但許多顧客比較喜歡舊的，還在網路上抱怨。
items.sec: Advertising, PR & Persuasion 廣告、公關與說服

items.def: a product name made by a particular company
items.s: My mother always buys the same ________ of soap, because she trusts it and does not want to try new ones.
items.zh: 我媽媽總是買同一個品牌的肥皂，因為她信任它，不想嘗試新的。
items.sec: Advertising, PR & Persuasion 廣告、公關與說服

items.def: attention given to someone or something by the media
items.s: The film got a lot of free ________ when its star was seen at the festival, so ticket sales rose quickly.
items.zh: 那部電影的主角在影展亮相後，它獲得了大量免費曝光，所以票房迅速上升。
items.sec: Advertising, PR & Persuasion 廣告、公關與說服

items.def: the work of creating a good image for an organisation
items.s: After the food poisoning case, the restaurant hired a ______ ______ firm, because it needed to win back customers' trust.
items.zh: 發生食物中毒事件後，那家餐廳聘請了一家公關公司，因為它需要贏回顧客的信任。
items.sec: Advertising, PR & Persuasion 廣告、公關與說服

items.def: a person who speaks officially for a group
items.s: A ________ for the airline apologised for the delays, but she did not explain why so many flights were cancelled.
items.zh: 航空公司的發言人為延誤道歉，但她沒有解釋為什麼取消了那麼多班機。
items.sec: Advertising, PR & Persuasion 廣告、公關與說服

items.def: the work of promoting and selling products
items.s: The new drink was not very tasty, but clever ________ on social media made it popular with teenagers.
items.zh: 那款新飲料不太好喝，但社群媒體上聰明的行銷讓它在青少年之間很受歡迎。
items.sec: Advertising, PR & Persuasion 廣告、公關與說服

items.def: showing a brand inside a film or show to advertise it
items.s: The hero drinks the same brand of coffee in every scene, so it is obvious that this is ______ ______.
items.zh: 主角在每一幕都喝同一個牌子的咖啡，所以很明顯這是置入性行銷。
items.sec: Advertising, PR & Persuasion 廣告、公關與說服

items.def: an advert that suddenly appears in a new window online
items.s: A ______ ______ appeared while I was reading the news, and it was so hard to close that I left the website.
items.zh: 我在看新聞時跳出一則彈出式廣告，它難關到我乾脆離開了那個網站。
items.sec: Advertising, PR & Persuasion 廣告、公關與說服

items.def: material paid for by a company but made to look like normal posts
items.s: Many travel videos are actually ______ ______, so the hotels in them may have paid for the good reviews.
items.zh: 許多旅遊影片其實是業配內容，所以影片中的飯店可能付了錢換取好評。
items.sec: Advertising, PR & Persuasion 廣告、公關與說服

items.def: a short phrase that a famous person often says
items.s: The comedian's ________ became so popular that students repeated it in class, and some teachers found it annoying.
items.zh: 那位喜劇演員的口頭禪變得非常流行，學生們在課堂上一直重複，有些老師覺得很煩。
items.sec: Advertising, PR & Persuasion 廣告、公關與說服

items.def: a statement from a customer praising a product
items.s: The website was full of glowing ________, but I later learned that some of them were written by the company's staff.
items.zh: 那個網站滿是讚不絕口的顧客推薦，但我後來得知其中一些是公司員工寫的。
items.sec: Advertising, PR & Persuasion 廣告、公關與說服

items.def: a character or animal that represents a team or company
items.s: The city's bear ________ appears at every festival, and children love taking pictures with it.
items.zh: 這座城市的熊吉祥物出現在每個節慶活動上，孩子們很喜歡和它拍照。
items.sec: Advertising, PR & Persuasion 廣告、公關與說服

items.def: to change the name or image of a company or product
items.s: The airline ________ itself after a terrible accident, because many passengers connected the old name with danger.
items.zh: 那家航空公司在一場嚴重事故後進行了品牌重塑，因為許多乘客把舊名稱和危險聯想在一起。
items.sec: Advertising, PR & Persuasion 廣告、公關與說服

items.def: a person who buys goods or services
items.s: Every ________ has the right to know what is in their food, so the law requires clear labels on packaging.
items.zh: 每位消費者都有權知道食物裡有什麼，所以法律要求包裝上有清楚的標示。
items.sec: Advertising, PR & Persuasion 廣告、公關與說服

items.def: exaggerated excitement and advertising about something
items.s: There was so much ________ about the new game, but when it was released it was full of bugs and many players were disappointed.
items.zh: 那款新遊戲被大肆炒作，但發售時卻充滿錯誤，許多玩家都很失望。
items.sec: Advertising, PR & Persuasion 廣告、公關與說服

items.def: excited talk about something new
items.s: The trailer created a lot of ________ online, so the cinema added extra showings on the first weekend.
items.zh: 那支預告片在網路上引起大量話題，所以電影院在首映週末加開了場次。
items.sec: Advertising, PR & Persuasion 廣告、公關與說服

items.def: relating to relationships between people
items.s: Good ________ skills are important for nurses, because they need to comfort worried patients and work closely with doctors.
items.zh: 良好的人際技巧對護理師很重要，因為他們需要安撫擔心的病人並與醫生密切合作。
items.sec: Communication & Interpersonal Skills 溝通與人際技巧

items.def: using spoken words
items.s: The coach gave us ________ instructions during the game, but the crowd was so loud that we could hardly hear him.
items.zh: 教練在比賽中給了我們口頭指示，但觀眾太吵了，我們幾乎聽不到他說話。
items.sec: Communication & Interpersonal Skills 溝通與人際技巧

items.def: without words, such as through body movements
items.s: Smiling and nodding are ________ signals, and they show the speaker that you are listening carefully.
items.zh: 微笑和點頭是非語言訊號，它們向說話者表示你正在仔細聆聽。
items.sec: Communication & Interpersonal Skills 溝通與人際技巧

items.def: a movement of the hand or head to show meaning
items.s: A thumbs-up is a friendly ________ in Taiwan, but in some countries it can be rude, so travellers should be careful.
items.zh: 豎起大拇指在台灣是友善的手勢，但在某些國家可能是無禮的，所以旅客應該小心。
items.sec: Communication & Interpersonal Skills 溝通與人際技巧

items.def: looking directly into someone's eyes
items.s: Try to make ______ ______ with the interviewer, because looking at the floor may make you seem nervous or dishonest.
items.zh: 試著和面試官保持眼神接觸，因為看著地板可能會讓你顯得緊張或不誠實。
items.sec: Communication & Interpersonal Skills 溝通與人際技巧

items.def: the way your voice sounds, showing your feelings
items.s: She said "fine", but her ______ ______ ______ was cold, so I knew she was still angry with me.
items.zh: 她說「好啊」，但她的語氣很冷淡，所以我知道她還在生我的氣。
items.sec: Communication & Interpersonal Skills 溝通與人際技巧

items.def: listening carefully and showing that you understand
items.s: ______ ______ means asking questions and repeating key points, so the other person feels that you really care.
items.zh: 主動聆聽的意思是提出問題並複述重點，讓對方覺得你真的在乎。
items.sec: Communication & Interpersonal Skills 溝通與人際技巧

items.def: polite conversation about unimportant things
items.s: At the party I made ______ ______ about the weather, because I did not know anyone and felt a little shy.
items.zh: 在派對上我聊了些天氣之類的閒聊，因為我誰都不認識，覺得有點害羞。
items.sec: Communication & Interpersonal Skills 溝通與人際技巧

items.def: a talk between two or more people
items.s: We had a long ________ about our future plans, and I realised that my best friend wants to study abroad.
items.zh: 我們針對未來計畫進行了一段很長的談話，我才發現我最好的朋友想出國留學。
items.sec: Communication & Interpersonal Skills 溝通與人際技巧

items.def: a discussion between groups to solve a problem
items.s: The two countries began a ________ about the fishing dispute, so many people hoped the conflict would end peacefully.
items.zh: 兩國就漁業爭端展開對話，所以許多人希望衝突能和平結束。
items.sec: Communication & Interpersonal Skills 溝通與人際技巧

items.def: a failure to share information clearly
items.s: Because of a ________ between the teachers, two classes arrived at the gym at the same time, and nobody knew which one should leave.
items.zh: 由於老師之間的溝通不良，兩個班同時到了體育館，沒有人知道哪一班該離開。
items.sec: Communication & Interpersonal Skills 溝通與人際技巧

items.def: a short written message sent by phone
items.s: I sent my mother a ______ ______ to say the bus was late, so she would not worry when I got home after dark.
items.zh: 我傳了一則簡訊給媽媽說公車誤點，這樣我天黑才到家時她就不會擔心。
items.sec: Communication & Interpersonal Skills 溝通與人際技巧

items.def: a spoken message left on a phone
items.s: The doctor did not answer, so I left a ________ asking her to call me back when she was free.
items.zh: 醫生沒有接電話，所以我留了一則語音留言，請她有空時回電給我。
items.sec: Communication & Interpersonal Skills 溝通與人際技巧

items.def: a message sent over the internet
items.s: I wrote a polite ________ to my teacher to ask for more time, and she kindly agreed to give me two extra days.
items.zh: 我寫了一封有禮貌的電子郵件給老師要求延期，她很親切地同意多給我兩天。
items.sec: Communication & Interpersonal Skills 溝通與人際技巧

items.def: a friend in another place you write letters to
items.s: I have a ______ ______ in Canada, and we have been writing to each other for three years, so my English has improved a lot.
items.zh: 我在加拿大有一位筆友，我們已經互相寫信三年了，所以我的英文進步很多。
items.sec: Communication & Interpersonal Skills 溝通與人際技巧

items.def: a call where people can see each other on screen
items.s: My grandparents live in the countryside, but we make a ______ ______ every Sunday, so they can see how the children are growing.
items.zh: 我的祖父母住在鄉下，但我們每個星期天都會視訊通話，讓他們看看孩子們長大了多少。
items.sec: Communication & Interpersonal Skills 溝通與人際技巧

items.def: speaking in front of a large group of people
items.s: Many students are afraid of ______ ______, but practising in front of a mirror can help them feel more confident.
items.zh: 許多學生害怕公開演說，但在鏡子前練習能幫助他們更有自信。
items.sec: Communication & Interpersonal Skills 溝通與人際技巧

items.def: a formal talk given to an audience
items.s: The principal gave a short ________ at graduation, and several parents cried when she thanked the students' families.
items.zh: 校長在畢業典禮上發表了簡短的致詞，她感謝學生家庭時，好幾位家長都哭了。
items.sec: Communication & Interpersonal Skills 溝通與人際技巧

items.def: nervousness before performing or speaking in public
items.s: He had terrible ______ ______ before the debate, but after the first minute he relaxed and spoke clearly.
items.zh: 辯論前他嚴重怯場，但第一分鐘過後他就放鬆下來，說得很清楚。
items.sec: Communication & Interpersonal Skills 溝通與人際技巧

items.def: the rules of polite behaviour
items.s: Business ________ is different in every country, so it is a good idea to learn the basics before you travel for work.
items.zh: 商務禮儀在每個國家都不同，所以出差前先學一些基本知識是個好主意。
items.sec: Communication & Interpersonal Skills 溝通與人際技巧

items.def: rules for polite behaviour on the internet
items.s: Typing in capital letters is bad ________, because readers feel as if you are shouting at them.
items.zh: 全用大寫字母打字是不好的網路禮儀，因為讀者會覺得你好像在對他們大吼。
items.sec: Communication & Interpersonal Skills 溝通與人際技巧

items.def: polite and respectful
items.s: The hotel staff were very ________, so we felt welcome even though our room was not ready yet.
items.zh: 飯店員工非常有禮貌，所以即使我們的房間還沒準備好，我們仍覺得受到歡迎。
items.sec: Communication & Interpersonal Skills 溝通與人際技巧

items.def: careful not to upset people when saying difficult things
items.s: She was ________ when she told me my essay needed work, so I did not feel hurt and was happy to improve it.
items.zh: 她告訴我作文需要修改時說得很委婉得體，所以我沒有受傷，也很樂意改進。
items.sec: Communication & Interpersonal Skills 溝通與人際技巧

items.def: saying exactly what you think, even if it is rude
items.s: My uncle is very ________ and says whatever he thinks, so he sometimes upsets people without meaning to.
items.zh: 我叔叔說話非常直白，想到什麼就說什麼，所以他有時候會無意間讓人不高興。
items.sec: Communication & Interpersonal Skills 溝通與人際技巧

items.def: liking to talk a lot
items.s: My little sister is very ________ at home, but she becomes quiet and shy when she meets new people.
items.zh: 我妹妹在家裡很愛說話，但遇到陌生人時就變得安靜又害羞。
items.sec: Communication & Interpersonal Skills 溝通與人際技巧

items.def: very informal words used by a particular group
items.s: Teenagers often use ________ that their parents do not understand, so family conversations can be confusing.
items.zh: 青少年常用父母聽不懂的俚語，所以家庭對話可能會讓人摸不著頭緒。
items.sec: Communication & Interpersonal Skills 溝通與人際技巧

items.def: a word made from the first letters of other words
items.s: "NASA" is an ________ that people say as one word, and many students do not know what the letters stand for.
items.zh: 「NASA」是一個人們當作一個字來唸的首字母縮略字，許多學生不知道那些字母代表什麼。
items.sec: Communication & Interpersonal Skills 溝通與人際技巧

items.def: to make a picture or idea appear in someone's mind
items.s: The word "headline" ________ images of big black letters, but today most headlines appear on small phone screens.
items.zh: 「頭條」這個字會讓人聯想到大大的黑色字體，但如今大多數標題都出現在小小的手機螢幕上。

items.def: to say publicly that something is bad
items.s: Many teachers ________ the use of phones in class, but some argue that phones can be useful learning tools.
items.zh: 許多老師抨擊在課堂上使用手機，但也有人認為手機可以是有用的學習工具。

items.def: to say that someone or something is not good or important
items.s: The new advert openly ________ rival brands, so many viewers complained that it was unfair and unkind.
items.zh: 那則新廣告公然貶低競爭品牌，所以許多觀眾抱怨它不公平又不厚道。

items.def: to say you are not connected with something
items.s: The party quickly ________ the fake website, because it was spreading lies in the party's name.
items.zh: 該黨很快就撇清與那個假網站的關係，因為它以該黨的名義散播謊言。

items.def: to decide that something is not important or true
items.s: You should not ________ a story just because you dislike the newspaper, so always look at the evidence first.
items.zh: 你不應該只因為不喜歡那家報紙就不採信一則報導，所以一定要先看證據。

items.def: to speak about someone in a way that shows no respect
items.s: The host often ________ his guests to get laughs, but many viewers found his jokes cruel rather than funny.
items.zh: 那位主持人常常貶損來賓來博取笑聲，但許多觀眾覺得他的笑話殘忍而不好笑。

items.def: to tell secret information
items.s: The reporter refused to ________ her source, even though the court threatened to fine her.
items.zh: 那位記者拒絕透露她的消息來源，即使法院威脅要對她罰款。

items.def: to make something seem less important than it is
items.s: The company tried to ________ the data leak, but customers were angry when they learned how many accounts were affected.
items.zh: 那家公司試圖淡化資料外洩事件，但顧客得知有多少帳號受影響時非常憤怒。

items.def: to make something seem more exciting or serious than it is
items.s: The video ________ a small argument between neighbours, so it looked like a violent fight.
items.zh: 那段影片把鄰居間的小爭執戲劇化了，所以看起來像一場暴力衝突。

items.def: to involve someone in a difficult situation
items.s: The singer became ________ in a copyright battle, and her new album was delayed for over a year.
items.zh: 那位歌手捲入了一場版權糾紛，她的新專輯延遲了一年多。

items.def: to avoid giving a clear answer
items.s: The minister ________ when reporters asked about the budget, so nobody knew whether the new hospital would be built.
items.zh: 記者詢問預算時部長含糊其辭，所以沒有人知道新醫院會不會蓋。

items.def: to mix up a message so it is hard to understand
items.s: The phone line was poor and his message was ________, so I could only understand a few words.
items.zh: 電話訊號很差，他的訊息斷斷續續聽不清楚，所以我只聽懂了幾個字。

items.def: to make something seem more attractive than it really is
items.s: Some films ________ smoking, so young viewers may think it looks cool rather than dangerous.
items.zh: 有些電影美化抽菸，所以年輕觀眾可能會覺得那很酷而不是危險。

items.def: to take control of something for your own purposes
items.s: A small group ________ the online discussion about school lunches, and soon everyone was arguing about politics instead.
items.zh: 一小群人挾持了關於學校午餐的網路討論，很快大家都改成在吵政治。

items.def: to suggest something bad in an indirect way
items.s: The article ________ that the athlete had cheated, but it did not give any real evidence.
items.zh: 那篇文章暗示那位運動員作弊，但沒有提出任何真正的證據。

items.def: to understand something wrongly
items.s: My friend ________ my joke as an insult, so I explained what I meant and apologised.
items.zh: 我朋友把我的玩笑誤解成侮辱，所以我解釋了我的意思並道歉。

items.def: to describe someone or something falsely
items.s: The short clip ________ the scientist's views, because it left out the part where she explained her doubts.
items.zh: 那段短片歪曲了那位科學家的觀點，因為它刪掉了她解釋自己疑慮的部分。

items.def: to mix things up and cause confusion
items.s: The two reports used different numbers, so they ________ readers who wanted to know the real cost.
items.zh: 兩份報告使用了不同的數字，所以讓想知道實際花費的讀者一頭霧水。

items.def: to make something deliberately unclear
items.s: The contract used long, difficult words to ________ the hidden fees, so few customers noticed them.
items.zh: 那份合約使用又長又難的字來混淆隱藏費用，所以很少顧客注意到。

items.def: to give people what they want even if it is wrong
items.s: Some websites ________ to readers' fears, because frightening stories get more clicks than calm ones.
items.zh: 有些網站迎合讀者的恐懼，因為嚇人的報導比冷靜的報導獲得更多點擊。

items.def: to make someone less angry
items.s: The manager offered free tickets to ________ the angry fans, but many still demanded a full refund.
items.zh: 經理提供免費門票來安撫憤怒的球迷，但許多人仍要求全額退款。

items.def: to claim something, often falsely
items.s: He ________ to be an expert on health, but he had no medical training and his advice was dangerous.
items.zh: 他自稱是健康專家，但他沒有受過醫學訓練，他的建議很危險。

items.def: to pass a message from one person to another
items.s: The teacher asked me to ________ the message to my classmates, because the school website was not working.
items.zh: 老師要我把訊息轉達給同學，因為學校網站故障了。

items.def: to say officially that something is not true
items.s: The scientist publicly ________ the claims made in the video, and she explained why they were wrong.
items.zh: 那位科學家公開駁斥影片中的說法，並解釋為什麼它們是錯的。

items.def: to stop someone from speaking or expressing opinions
items.s: The government tried to ________ critics by closing newspapers, but people continued to share news online.
items.zh: 政府試圖關閉報社來壓制批評者的聲音，但人們繼續在網路上分享新聞。

items.def: to treat a group of people as shameful
items.s: News reports should not ________ people with mental illness, because this stops many of them from asking for help.
items.zh: 新聞報導不應該污名化有精神疾病的人，因為這會讓他們許多人不敢求助。

items.def: to make something serious seem unimportant
items.s: The comedian's joke ________ the flood, so families who had lost their homes were deeply upset.
items.zh: 那位喜劇演員的笑話輕忽了水災的嚴重性，所以失去家園的家庭非常難過。

items.def: to make something weaker or less effective
items.s: The small mistakes in the report ________ its main argument, so readers began to doubt everything else in it.
items.zh: 報告中的小錯誤削弱了它的主要論點，所以讀者開始懷疑裡面的其他一切。

items.def: to show the truth about someone who was hiding it
items.s: Journalists ________ the person behind the fake charity, and the police arrested him a week later.
items.zh: 記者們揭穿了假慈善機構背後的人，警方一週後逮捕了他。

items.def: to say very bad things about someone, often unfairly
items.s: Some newspapers ________ the young footballer after one mistake, but his team continued to support him.
items.zh: 有些報紙在那位年輕足球員失誤一次後就大肆抨擊他，但他的球隊仍然支持他。

items.def: to say that someone or something is good or true
items.s: I can ________ for this website, because I have used it for years and its information has always been accurate.
items.zh: 我可以擔保這個網站，因為我用了好幾年，它的資訊一直都很準確。

items.def: to give a false idea of something
items.s: Her calm voice ________ how nervous she really felt, so the audience thought she was very confident.
items.zh: 她平靜的聲音掩飾了她真實的緊張，所以觀眾以為她非常有自信。

items.def: to choose and organise items for people to see
items.s: The app ________ news from many sources, but it is still important to check who wrote each story.
items.zh: 那個應用程式篩選整理來自許多來源的新聞，但查看每則報導是誰寫的仍然很重要。

items.def: to describe a person or group as evil
items.s: Politicians sometimes ________ their opponents to win votes, but this makes it harder for people to work together.
items.zh: 政治人物有時會妖魔化對手來贏得選票，但這會讓人們更難合作。

items.def: to make someone braver or more confident
items.s: The large number of likes ________ him to post even ruder comments, so his friends finally told him to stop.
items.zh: 大量的按讚讓他更大膽，發了更無禮的留言，所以他的朋友終於叫他住手。

items.def: to hold someone's attention completely
items.s: The storyteller ________ the children with her tales of dragons, and nobody moved until the very end.
items.zh: 那位說故事的人用她的龍的故事迷住了孩子們，直到最後都沒有人動一下。

items.def: to cause trouble or violence
items.s: The fake posts were designed to ________ anger between the two groups, so police warned people not to share them.
items.zh: 那些假貼文旨在挑起兩個群體之間的憤怒，所以警方警告民眾不要分享。

items.def: to earn money from something
items.s: Many creators ________ their videos through adverts, but they need thousands of viewers before they earn much.
items.zh: 許多創作者透過廣告讓影片變現，但他們需要上千名觀眾才能賺到不少錢。

items.def: to hear something by accident
items.s: I ________ two students talking about the exam, but I soon realised that their information was wrong.
items.zh: 我無意中聽到兩個學生在討論考試，但我很快就發現他們的資訊是錯的。

items.def: to say publicly that you no longer believe something you said
items.s: The witness ________ her story in court, so the journalists who had reported it had to publish corrections.
items.zh: 那位證人在法庭上撤回了她的說法，所以報導過的記者必須刊登更正。

items.def: to damage something on purpose to stop it working
items.s: Someone ________ the school's website before the vote, so students could not see the candidates' speeches.
items.zh: 有人在投票前蓄意破壞了學校網站，所以學生看不到候選人的演講。

items.def: to weaken a system or belief
items.s: False news can ________ democracy, because voters make choices based on information that is not true.
items.zh: 假新聞可能顛覆民主，因為選民根據不實的資訊做出選擇。

items.def: to officially order someone to come
items.s: The editor was ________ to court after the newspaper published secret documents, but she said the public had a right to know.
items.zh: 報社刊登機密文件後，總編輯被傳喚出庭，但她說大眾有知的權利。

items.def: to hide mistakes or bad facts
items.s: The report tried to ________ the company's safety problems, but workers later told reporters what had really happened.
items.zh: 那份報告試圖粉飾公司的安全問題，但員工後來告訴記者到底發生了什麼事。

items.def: to criticise someone strongly
items.s: The coach ________ the players for posting rude comments online, and he made them apologise to the other team.
items.zh: 教練嚴厲斥責球員在網路上發布無禮留言，並要他們向對手道歉。

items.def: to gently persuade someone
items.s: The reporter ________ the shy girl into telling her story, and her words touched thousands of viewers.
items.zh: 那位記者溫柔地勸那個害羞的女孩說出她的故事，而她的話感動了數千名觀眾。

items.def: to secretly join a group to get information
items.s: The journalist ________ the fake news group by pretending to be a new member, and she recorded how they planned their posts.
items.zh: 那名記者假裝成新成員潛入了那個假新聞團體，並記錄下他們如何策劃貼文。

items.def: to organise something carefully, often secretly
items.s: The protest looked natural, but it was actually ________ by a company that wanted to stop the new law.
items.zh: 那場抗議看起來很自然，但其實是一家想阻止新法的公司精心策劃的。

items.def: to do something wrong or harmful
items.s: The fraud was ________ by a group who sent fake messages from the bank, so many elderly people lost their savings.
items.zh: 那起詐騙是由一個冒充銀行發送假訊息的集團犯下的，所以許多老人失去了積蓄。

items.def: to tell someone sharply that they have done wrong
items.s: The judge ________ the TV station for showing the victim's face, because it put her safety at risk.
items.zh: 法官訓斥那家電視台播出被害人的臉，因為這讓她的安全陷入危險。

items.def: to have a strong effect that continues for a long time
items.s: The scandal ________ through the entertainment industry for months, and several other stars lost their sponsorship deals.
items.zh: 那起醜聞在娛樂圈持續發酵了好幾個月，其他幾位明星也失去了贊助合約。

items.def: to take someone's position or power without the right
items.s: Online videos have ________ the role that television once played, so many young people never watch the evening news.
items.zh: 網路影片已經取代奪走了電視曾扮演的角色，所以許多年輕人從不看晚間新聞。

items.def: to use something as a way to attack others
items.s: Some groups ________ social media to attack journalists, and several reporters have had to close their accounts.
items.zh: 有些團體把社群媒體武器化來攻擊記者，好幾位記者不得不關閉帳號。

items.def: to try to get someone's support
items.s: Both candidates tried to ________ young voters with short videos, because they knew most students do not watch TV debates.
items.zh: 兩位候選人都試圖用短影片拉攏年輕選民，因為他們知道大多數學生不看電視辯論。

items.def: to warn or criticise someone firmly
items.s: The teacher ________ the class for sharing a classmate's photo without permission, and she explained why it was harmful.
items.zh: 老師告誡全班未經同意就分享同學的照片，並解釋為什麼那是有害的。

items.def: to make the difference between things less clear
items.s: Sponsored videos ________ the line between advice and advertising, so viewers may not realise they are being sold something.
items.zh: 業配影片模糊了建議和廣告之間的界線，所以觀眾可能沒發現有人在向他們推銷東西。

items.def: to stop resisting and agree to something
items.s: The platform finally ________ to public pressure and removed the harmful videos, but critics said it had acted too slowly.
items.zh: 那個平台最終屈服於輿論壓力，刪除了有害影片，但批評者說它行動太慢了。

items.def: to work together secretly to cheat others
items.s: The two companies ________ to keep prices high, but a journalist found their emails and reported the story.
items.zh: 那兩家公司串通維持高價，但一名記者找到了他們的電子郵件並報導了此事。

items.def: to wrongly treat two different things as the same
items.s: Many people ________ opinion with fact, so they believe that a strong feeling must also be true.
items.zh: 許多人把意見和事實混為一談，所以他們相信強烈的感覺也一定是真的。

items.def: to make a tense situation calmer
items.s: The teacher ________ the argument by asking both students to explain their views calmly, and soon they were laughing.
items.zh: 老師請兩位學生冷靜地說明各自的觀點來化解爭吵，很快他們就笑了起來。

items.def: to make someone believe something that is not true
items.s: Don't ________ yourself that you can study well while watching videos, because your brain cannot focus on both.
items.zh: 別欺騙自己說你能邊看影片邊好好讀書，因為你的大腦無法同時專注兩件事。

items.def: to come from a particular source
items.s: The rumour seemed to ________ from a single anonymous account, but it soon spread to thousands of users.
items.zh: 那則謠言似乎源自一個匿名帳號，但很快就傳到了數千名使用者那裡。

items.def: to say words clearly
items.s: Good news presenters ________ every word, so even viewers with poor hearing can follow the news.
items.zh: 好的新聞主播會把每個字咬字清楚，所以即使聽力不好的觀眾也能聽懂新聞。

items.def: to avoid something on purpose
items.s: The newspaper ________ celebrity gossip, because it wants to focus on serious local and international news.
items.zh: 那份報紙刻意避開名人八卦，因為它想專注於嚴肅的地方和國際新聞。

items.def: to show officially that someone is not guilty
items.s: New video evidence ________ the young man, but by then his photo had already been shared as a "criminal" online.
items.zh: 新的影片證據證明那位年輕人無罪，但那時他的照片早已被當作「罪犯」在網路上流傳。

items.def: to pretend to feel something
items.s: He ________ surprise when he saw the results, but he had already read them online that morning.
items.zh: 他看到結果時假裝驚訝，但他那天早上已經在網路上看過了。

items.def: to break a rule openly
items.s: Some influencers ________ advertising rules by hiding paid posts, so the government is planning heavier fines.
items.zh: 有些網紅藉由隱瞞業配貼文公然違反廣告規定，所以政府打算加重罰款。

items.def: to interrupt with a comment
items.s: During the debate one student kept trying to ________, so the teacher reminded everyone to wait for their turn.
items.zh: 辯論時有位學生一直想插話，所以老師提醒大家等輪到自己再說。

items.def: to criticise someone very strongly
items.s: Critics ________ the film for its poor acting, but audiences loved it and it earned a lot of money.
items.zh: 影評人嚴厲抨擊那部電影演技很差，但觀眾很喜歡，它賺了很多錢。

items.def: to stay in a bad situation for a long time
items.s: The important report ________ on the minister's desk for months, so the public never learned about the problems in time.
items.zh: 那份重要報告在部長桌上被冷落了好幾個月，所以大眾沒能及時得知那些問題。

items.def: to cover or hide something
items.s: The cause of the accident remains ________ in mystery, because the company refuses to release the video.
items.zh: 那起事故的原因仍籠罩在謎團中，因為公司拒絕公開影片。

items.def: to say unfair and harmful things about someone
items.s: The actress said she had been ________ by fake stories, and she asked her fans to stop sharing them.
items.zh: 那位女演員說她被假新聞中傷，並請粉絲不要再分享。

items.def: to gather courage, strength or support
items.s: She finally ________ the courage to report the cyberbullying, and the school took action the same day.
items.zh: 她終於鼓起勇氣舉報網路霸凌，學校當天就採取了行動。

items.def: to make someone calm
items.s: The mother tried to ________ her crying baby with a song, but the noise on the train made it very difficult.
items.zh: 那位母親試著用一首歌安撫哭鬧的寶寶，但火車上的噪音讓這件事變得很困難。

items.def: to stop something from continuing
items.s: The company quickly posted a video to ________ the rumours about closing, and its share price rose the next day.
items.zh: 那家公司很快發布影片來平息關於倒閉的謠言，隔天股價就上漲了。

items.def: to talk for a long time in a confused way
items.s: The speaker ________ for twenty minutes without making a clear point, so half the audience started checking their phones.
items.zh: 那位講者東拉西扯了二十分鐘卻沒講出重點，所以一半的聽眾開始看手機。

items.def: to reply quickly and angrily
items.s: When the reporter asked about the mistake, the coach ________ that the referee was to blame, and he walked away.
items.zh: 記者問到那個失誤時，教練反駁說是裁判的錯，然後就走開了。

items.def: to stop someone from making progress
items.s: Slow internet ________ the students' research, so the teacher gave them extra time to finish the project.
items.zh: 網路太慢阻礙了學生的研究，所以老師給他們額外的時間完成專題。

items.def: to be unable to decide; to become less certain
items.s: Her support for the plan began to ________ after she read the critics' arguments, so she asked for more information.
items.zh: 讀了批評者的論點後，她對該計畫的支持開始動搖，所以她要求更多資訊。

items.def: to describe something as smaller than it really is
items.s: The official report ________ the number of people affected by the flood, so less help was sent than was needed.
items.zh: 官方報告少報了受水災影響的人數，所以送去的援助比需要的少。

items.def: to make something seem better than it really is
items.s: Many films ________ life in big cities, but in reality young workers often struggle with high rent and long hours.
items.zh: 許多電影美化大城市的生活，但現實中年輕上班族常為高房租和長工時所苦。

items.def: to blame someone unfairly for others' mistakes
items.s: The company ________ a junior employee for the data leak, although managers had ignored the warnings for months.
items.zh: 公司讓一名基層員工當代罪羔羊承擔資料外洩的責任，儘管主管們已忽視警告好幾個月。

items.def: to make someone seem guilty
items.s: The messages on his phone ________ him, because they showed that he had planned the fake reviews.
items.zh: 他手機裡的訊息顯示他有罪，因為那些訊息證明他策劃了假評論。

items.def: to say firmly that something is true or must happen
items.s: The influencer ________ that the photos were not edited, but experts showed clear signs that they had been changed.
items.zh: 那位網紅堅稱照片沒有修過，但專家指出了明顯被修改的跡象。

items.def: to state something officially or clearly
items.s: The organisers ________ the event a success, although many people complained about the long queues.
items.zh: 主辦單位宣布活動很成功，儘管許多人抱怨排隊太久。

items.def: to say something
items.s: He did not ________ a single word during the meeting, so his manager later asked whether he disagreed with the plan.
items.zh: 他在會議中一個字都沒說，所以經理後來問他是否不同意這個計畫。

items.def: to express an opinion or feeling
items.s: Several worried parents ________ concerns about the new app, because it secretly collected children's location data.
items.zh: 好幾位憂心的家長表達了對那個新應用程式的擔憂，因為它偷偷收集孩子的位置資料。

items.def: to stop someone from speaking freely
items.s: The new law could ________ the press, because journalists may be fined for reporting on government mistakes.
items.zh: 新法可能會封住媒體的口，因為記者可能因報導政府的錯誤而被罰款。

items.def: to admit that you did something wrong
items.s: The student ________ that he had copied the essay from a website, so the teacher let him write it again.
items.zh: 那位學生坦承他從網站上抄了那篇作文，所以老師讓他重寫。

items.def: suggesting that someone has done wrong
items.s: The comment sounded ________, so my friend felt hurt even though I had only asked a simple question.
items.zh: 那句留言聽起來帶有指責的意味，所以即使我只是問了個簡單的問題，我朋友還是覺得受傷。

items.def: refusing to change your opinion
items.s: The author was ________ that the story was true, but she could not provide any documents to prove it.
items.zh: 那位作者堅稱那個故事是真的，但她提不出任何文件來證明。

items.def: making people worried without good reason
items.s: The ________ headline said that all phones cause cancer, but the study it described was very small and uncertain.
items.zh: 那個危言聳聽的標題說所有手機都會致癌，但它所描述的研究規模很小又不確定。

items.def: involved with others in doing something wrong
items.s: By sharing the cruel video, many users became ________ in the bullying, although they did not create it.
items.zh: 許多使用者分享那段殘忍的影片，雖然不是他們拍的，卻也成了霸凌的共犯。

items.def: deserving blame
items.s: The court found the website ________ for the damage, because it had published the false story without checking.
items.zh: 法院判定那個網站對損害負有責任，因為它未經查證就刊登了不實報導。

items.def: trying to make people believe things that are false
items.s: The ________ seller used photos of a different house, so the family was shocked when they saw the real one.
items.zh: 那個不誠實的賣家使用了另一棟房子的照片，所以那家人看到真正的房子時大吃一驚。

items.def: showing a very poor opinion of someone
items.s: The player used a ________ word about his opponent, and the league banned him for three matches.
items.zh: 那名球員對對手使用了貶損的字眼，聯盟禁賽他三場。

items.def: pretending to be honest when you are not
items.s: It is ________ to say the advert is "just information", because the company clearly wants to sell its product.
items.zh: 說那則廣告「只是資訊」是不真誠的，因為那家公司顯然想賣它的產品。

items.def: showing that you think something is not important
items.s: The manager was ________ of the customer's complaint, so she posted a long review online that many people read.
items.zh: 經理對顧客的投訴不屑一顧，所以她在網路上發表了一篇很多人讀的長篇評論。

items.def: causing strong feelings
items.s: The charity used ________ pictures of hungry children, and donations increased sharply within a week.
items.zh: 那個慈善機構使用了飢餓兒童的觸動情感的照片，一週內捐款大幅增加。

items.def: based on facts, not opinions
items.s: The report contained several ________ errors, so the newspaper had to correct the dates and names the next day.
items.zh: 那篇報導有好幾處事實錯誤，所以報社隔天必須更正日期和人名。

items.def: very unlikely to be true
items.s: His explanation sounded ________, because nobody believes that a dog could really eat a whole laptop.
items.zh: 他的解釋聽起來很牽強，因為沒有人相信一隻狗真的能吃掉一整台筆電。

items.def: invented and not real
items.s: The website used ________ names for its "doctors", so none of them could be found in any medical records.
items.zh: 那個網站為它的「醫生」使用虛構的名字，所以在任何醫療紀錄中都找不到他們。

items.def: saying clearly and honestly what you think
items.s: The new principal is ________ about the school's problems, and parents appreciate that she does not hide bad news.
items.zh: 新校長對學校的問題直言不諱，家長們很欣賞她不隱瞞壞消息。

items.def: not necessary and often harmful
items.s: The film was full of ________ violence, so many parents decided it was not suitable for their children.
items.zh: 那部電影充滿不必要的暴力，所以許多家長認為它不適合孩子看。

items.def: not based on facts or reasons
items.s: The fears about the new phone tower were ________, but the rumours spread quickly in the village anyway.
items.zh: 對新基地台的恐懼是毫無根據的，但謠言還是在村子裡迅速散播開來。

items.def: having wrong or too little information
items.s: Many ________ comments appeared under the article, because people reacted to the headline without reading the story.
items.zh: 文章下方出現許多不了解狀況的留言，因為人們沒讀內容就對標題做出反應。

items.def: easily influenced by others
items.s: Young children are very ________, so they may copy dangerous stunts they see in online videos.
items.zh: 年幼的孩子很容易受影響，所以他們可能會模仿網路影片中看到的危險特技。

items.def: impossible to argue against
items.cn: 無可辯駁的；不容置疑的
items.s: The video gave ________ proof that the driver had run the red light, so he finally admitted his mistake.
items.zh: 那段影片提供了無可辯駁的證據，證明司機闖了紅燈，所以他終於承認錯誤。

items.def: angry because something seems unfair
items.s: The students were ________ when the school cancelled their trip without explanation, so they wrote a letter to the principal.
items.zh: 學校無故取消他們的旅行時，學生們憤憤不平，所以他們寫了一封信給校長。

items.def: giving useful information
items.s: The museum's website is very ________, and it helped me find all the facts I needed for my history project.
items.zh: 博物館的網站資訊非常豐富，它幫我找到歷史專題所需的所有資料。

items.def: bored or tired because you have seen too much of something
items.s: After years of political scandals, many voters feel ________, so they no longer pay attention to the news.
items.zh: 經過多年的政治醜聞，許多選民感到麻木厭倦，所以他們不再關注新聞。

items.def: shocking and full of unpleasant details
items.s: The magazine printed ________ details about the crime, but the victim's family said this caused them great pain.
items.zh: 那本雜誌刊登了犯罪案駭人聽聞的細節，但被害人家屬說這讓他們非常痛苦。

items.def: showing only one point of view
items.s: The documentary was ________, because it interviewed only the factory owners and none of the local farmers.
items.zh: 那部紀錄片很片面，因為它只採訪了工廠老闆，沒有採訪任何當地農民。

items.def: having strong views and expressing them too often
items.s: My uncle is very ________ about politics, so family dinners often end in loud arguments.
items.zh: 我叔叔對政治非常固執己見，所以家庭聚餐常以大聲爭吵收場。

items.def: saying exactly what you think in public
items.s: The ________ student spoke against the new rule at the meeting, and many classmates later thanked her for her courage.
items.zh: 那位敢言的學生在會議上反對新規定，後來許多同學感謝她的勇氣。

items.def: expressing disapproval or a low opinion
items.s: "Nerd" was once a ________ word, but today many young people use it proudly to describe themselves.
items.zh: 「書呆子」曾經是一個貶義的字，但如今許多年輕人驕傲地用它來形容自己。

items.def: claiming to support ordinary people against the elite
items.s: The ________ leader promised simple solutions to complex problems, and many frustrated voters liked his message.
items.zh: 那位民粹主義的領袖承諾用簡單的方法解決複雜的問題，許多不滿的選民喜歡他的訴求。

items.def: trying to seem more important or clever than you are
items.s: The review was full of long, ________ words, so most readers could not understand whether the critic liked the film.
items.zh: 那篇影評充滿又長又做作的字眼，所以大多數讀者看不懂影評人到底喜不喜歡那部電影。

items.def: containing too much interest in sexual or shocking details
items.s: Cheap tabloids often print ________ stories about celebrities, because such stories usually sell many more copies.
items.zh: 廉價小報常刊登關於名人的低俗煽情的報導，因為這類報導通常賣得好得多。

items.def: criticising very strongly
items.s: The critic wrote a ________ review of the restaurant, and within a month the owner had changed the whole menu.
items.zh: 那位評論家寫了一篇尖刻的餐廳評論，一個月內老闆就換掉了整份菜單。

items.def: done mainly to help yourself
items.cn: 自私自利的；為自己打算的
items.s: The company's apology seemed ________, because it spent more time praising its products than helping the victims.
items.zh: 那家公司的道歉似乎是在為自己打算，因為它花在稱讚產品的時間比幫助受害者還多。

items.def: used so often that it is no longer interesting
items.s: Her speech was full of ________ phrases like "follow your dreams", so the audience soon lost interest.
items.zh: 她的演講充滿像「追隨你的夢想」這樣老套的句子，所以聽眾很快就失去興趣。

items.def: honest and telling the truth
items.s: Please be ________ in your survey answers, because the results will help the school improve its services.
items.zh: 請誠實回答問卷，因為結果將幫助學校改善服務。

items.def: expressing opinions strongly and publicly
items.s: Parents have been very ________ about the dangers of the busy road, and the city has finally agreed to add a crossing.
items.zh: 家長們對那條繁忙道路的危險一直大聲疾呼，市政府終於同意增設行人穿越道。

items.def: expressing opinions loudly and forcefully
items.s: The plan faced ________ opposition from local residents, so the council decided to hold another public meeting.
items.zh: 該計畫遭到當地居民強烈反對，所以議會決定再舉行一次公聽會。

items.def: so strong it cannot be questioned
items.s: The lawyer's argument seemed ________, but the journalist found one small mistake that changed everything.
items.zh: 那位律師的論點看似無懈可擊，但那名記者找到一個改變一切的小錯誤。

items.def: done on purpose, knowing it is wrong
items.s: Sharing a story you know is false is ________ deception, so it is much worse than making an honest mistake.
items.zh: 分享你明知是假的消息是蓄意的欺騙，所以比無心之過嚴重得多。

items.def: rude in a way that upsets people
items.s: The joke was ________ to many people, so the comedian apologised and removed the video from his channel.
items.zh: 那個笑話冒犯了許多人，所以那位喜劇演員道歉並從他的頻道上撤下影片。

items.def: very strange and unusual
items.s: The website made ________ claims about a fruit that could cure every disease, but no scientist supported them.
items.zh: 那個網站對一種能治百病的水果做出荒誕的說法，但沒有科學家支持。

items.def: completely unreasonable or silly
items.s: The idea that the earth is flat is ________, but some videos promoting it still get millions of views.
items.zh: 地球是平的這個想法很荒謬，但一些宣揚它的影片仍然獲得數百萬次觀看。

items.def: so silly that it makes people laugh
items.s: The price of the concert tickets was ________, so many fans decided to watch the livestream instead.
items.zh: 演唱會門票的價格貴得離譜，所以許多粉絲決定改看直播。

items.def: making you think something is wrong
items.s: I received a ________ email asking for my bank password, so I deleted it and reported it to the bank.
items.zh: 我收到一封要我提供銀行密碼的可疑電子郵件，所以我刪除了它並通報銀行。

items.def: relating to things happening now
items.s: Our English teacher likes to discuss ________ issues in class, so we often read news articles from the same week.
items.zh: 我們的英文老師喜歡在課堂上討論時事議題，所以我們常讀同一週的新聞報導。

items.def: too long and boring
items.s: The manager's ________ email took ten minutes to read, but the main point could have been written in two sentences.
items.zh: 經理那封冗長的電子郵件要花十分鐘才讀完，但重點其實兩句話就能寫完。

items.def: not using words in their basic meaning
items.s: "A sea of faces" is a ________ expression, so it does not mean that the people were actually in water.
items.zh: 「一片人海」是比喻的說法，所以並不是指人們真的在水裡。

items.def: describing something by calling it something else
items.s: The writer used the ________ of a storm to describe the online anger, and readers found the image very powerful.
items.zh: 作者用暴風雨的隱喻來描述網路上的怒火，讀者覺得這個意象非常有力。

items.def: a fashionable word that becomes very popular
items.s: "Sustainable" has become a ________ in advertising, but many companies use it without changing how they work.
items.zh: 「永續」已成為廣告中的流行術語，但許多公司使用它卻沒有改變做事的方式。

items.def: the skill of making powerful public speeches
items.s: The leader was famous for his ________, and his speeches made crowds cheer even when his ideas were unclear.
items.zh: 那位領袖以他的演說技巧聞名，即使他的想法不清楚，他的演講也能讓群眾歡呼。

items.def: efforts to give help or information to people
items.s: The library runs an ________ programme in poor areas, so children without books at home can still read every week.
items.zh: 圖書館在貧困地區舉辦外展推廣計畫，所以家裡沒有書的孩子每週仍能閱讀。

items.def: a set of documents about a person or event
items.s: The journalist collected a thick ________ on the company's pollution, and she handed it to the police.
items.zh: 那名記者蒐集了一份關於該公司汙染的厚厚卷宗，並將它交給警方。

items.def: an official statement, especially after a meeting
items.s: The leaders released a joint ________ after the summit, but it contained few clear promises.
items.zh: 領袖們在高峰會後發表了聯合公報，但內容幾乎沒有明確的承諾。

items.def: a written statement of a group's aims and beliefs
items.s: The party's ________ promised free school lunches, so many families decided to vote for it.
items.zh: 該黨的政見承諾提供免費學校午餐，所以許多家庭決定投票給它。

items.def: a long, serious piece of writing on a subject
items.s: The professor wrote a ________ on the history of newspapers, and it is still used in universities today.
items.zh: 那位教授寫了一本關於報紙歷史的專著，至今仍在大學裡使用。

items.def: a book of works by different writers
items.s: Our teacher gave us an ________ of short stories, and each one was written by a writer from a different country.
items.zh: 老師給了我們一本短篇小說選集，每篇都是由不同國家的作家寫的。

items.def: a short, memorable phrase taken from a longer speech
items.cn: （新聞中引用的）精簡名句；原音片段
items.s: The news only showed one ________ from her speech, so viewers missed the important details she explained later.
items.zh: 新聞只播了她演講中的一句原音片段，所以觀眾錯過了她後來解釋的重要細節。

items.def: a large number of things coming at once
items.cn: 接二連三的一大堆；連珠砲
items.s: The singer faced a ________ of questions from reporters, but she smiled and answered them one by one.
items.zh: 那位歌手面對記者連珠砲似的提問，但她微笑著一一回答。

items.def: a large amount of something arriving suddenly
items.s: After the video went viral, he received a ________ of messages, and he needed several days to read them all.
items.zh: 影片爆紅後，他收到了如潮水般的訊息，花了好幾天才全部讀完。

items.def: a quick look or short experience of something
items.s: The documentary gives us a ________ of life inside a newsroom, and it shows how stressful the job can be.
items.zh: 那部紀錄片讓我們一窺新聞編輯室內的生活，也呈現出這份工作有多大的壓力。

items.def: a small piece of information or conversation
items.s: I only heard a ________ of their conversation, so I should not have told everyone what I thought they meant.
items.zh: 我只聽到他們對話的一小片段，所以我不該把我以為的意思告訴大家。

items.def: a claim that someone did something wrong, without proof yet
items.s: The newspaper reported the ________ against the coach, but it made clear that nothing had been proved.
items.zh: 報紙報導了對那位教練的指控，但清楚表明一切尚未獲得證實。

items.def: a careless and embarrassing mistake
items.s: The TV station made a big ________ when it showed the wrong winner, and the clip was shared all over the internet.
items.zh: 那家電視台公布錯誤得獎者，犯下了大錯，那段畫面在網路上瘋傳。

items.def: a very large number of things directed at someone
items.s: Children face a constant ________ of adverts online, so it is hard for them to know what they really need.
items.zh: 孩子們在網路上不斷受到廣告轟炸，所以他們很難知道自己真正需要什麼。

items.def: a drawing or description that exaggerates features for humour
items.s: The cartoonist drew a ________ of the president with huge ears, and it appeared on the front of the magazine.
items.zh: 那位漫畫家畫了一幅總統長著大耳朵的諷刺漫畫，它出現在雜誌封面上。

items.def: an idea or phrase used so often it is no longer interesting
items.s: "Time flies" is a ________, so my teacher told me to find a more original way to start my essay.
items.zh: 「光陰似箭」是陳腔濫調，所以老師要我找一個更有新意的方式來開頭作文。

items.def: a claim made to oppose another claim
items.s: A good essay mentions a ________ and then answers it, because this shows that the writer understands both sides.
items.zh: 好的論說文會提出反方主張再加以回應，因為這表示作者了解正反兩面。

items.def: a leader who wins support by using people's emotions and fears
items.s: The ________ blamed foreigners for every problem in the country, and his angry speeches attracted large crowds.
items.zh: 那個煽動家把國內的每個問題都歸咎於外國人，他憤怒的演說吸引了大批群眾。

items.def: a person who criticises someone or something
items.s: The new app has many fans, but its ________ say that it collects too much personal data.
items.zh: 那款新應用程式有很多粉絲，但批評者說它收集太多個人資料。

items.def: a polite word used instead of an unpleasant one
items.s: "Letting staff go" is a ________ for firing people, and the workers were not fooled by the gentle language.
items.zh: 「讓員工離開」是解僱的委婉說法，員工們並沒有被這種溫和的措辭騙到。

items.def: a lot of public attention and celebration
items.s: The new phone was launched with great ________, but after a few weeks many buyers complained about the battery.
items.zh: 那款新手機在大張旗鼓中上市，但幾週後許多買家抱怨電池問題。

items.def: a state of wild excitement
items.s: The rumour of a celebrity wedding caused a media ________, and reporters surrounded the hotel for two days.
items.zh: 名人婚禮的傳聞引發了媒體狂熱，記者們包圍那家飯店兩天。

items.def: a sudden expression of public anger
items.s: The decision to cancel the festival caused a ________ online, so the organisers changed their minds the next day.
items.zh: 取消音樂節的決定在網路上引起軒然大波，所以主辦單位隔天就改變了主意。

items.def: an embarrassing mistake in a social situation
items.s: The minister made a ________ when he forgot the name of the city he was visiting, and the video spread quickly.
items.zh: 部長忘了他正在訪問的城市名稱而失言出糗，那段影片迅速傳開。

items.def: a way of speaking that exaggerates a lot
items.s: Saying "I've told you a million times" is ________, because nobody really repeats something a million times.
items.zh: 說「我已經跟你講一百萬次了」是一種誇飾，因為沒有人真的會重複一件事一百萬次。

items.def: saying one thing but doing the opposite
items.s: People criticised the ________ of the star, because he talked about saving the planet but flew in a private jet every week.
items.zh: 人們批評那位明星的虛偽，因為他談論拯救地球，卻每週搭私人飛機。

items.def: an indirect remark suggesting something bad
items.s: The article used ________ rather than facts, so readers were left thinking the teacher had done something wrong.
items.zh: 那篇文章用含沙射影而非事實，所以讀者以為那位老師做了什麼錯事。

items.def: a name that does not describe something correctly
items.s: "Social media" can be a ________, because many people feel more lonely after using it for hours.
items.zh: 「社群媒體」可能是個名不副實的說法，因為許多人用了幾個小時後反而更覺得孤單。

items.def: a statement that is too obvious and often used
items.s: The company replied with a ________ about "valuing our customers", but it did nothing to solve the problem.
items.zh: 那家公司用「重視我們的顧客」這種老生常談回應，卻沒有做任何事來解決問題。

items.def: a strong written or spoken attack on an idea
items.s: His book is a ________ against social media, so it does not discuss the benefits that many users enjoy.
items.zh: 他的書是一篇對社群媒體的猛烈抨擊，所以它沒有討論許多使用者享受到的好處。

items.def: saying the opposite of what you mean to mock someone
items.s: ________ is hard to understand in text messages, so my friend thought I was serious when I was only joking.
items.zh: 反諷在簡訊中很難被理解，所以我只是開玩笑時，我朋友卻以為我是認真的。

items.def: an event that shocks the public because it is wrong
items.s: The ________ began when a journalist discovered that the charity had spent donations on luxury cars.
items.zh: 那起醜聞始於一名記者發現該慈善機構把捐款花在豪華汽車上。

items.def: a situation that looks like something but may not be
items.s: After the fire, the town slowly returned to some ________ of normal life, and the local paper reopened its office.
items.zh: 火災後，小鎮慢慢恢復了一些正常生活的樣貌，地方報社也重新開張。

items.def: an event that is exciting or shocking to watch
items.s: The trial became a media ________, and cameras followed the famous singer every time she left the court.
items.zh: 那場審判成了一場媒體奇觀，每次那位知名歌手離開法院時，鏡頭都緊追著她。

items.def: a hidden meaning that is not stated directly
items.s: The ________ of the advert was that you would be unpopular without the product, so many parents found it unhealthy.
items.zh: 那則廣告的言外之意是沒有這項產品你就不受歡迎，所以許多家長覺得它不健康。

items.def: a long, angry speech criticising someone
items.s: The customer posted a long ________ about the hotel, but the manager replied calmly and offered a refund.
items.zh: 那位顧客發了一篇針對飯店的長篇怒罵，但經理冷靜回應並提出退款。

items.def: a lot of public anger or noisy protest
items.s: There was an ________ when the school banned phones completely, so the principal agreed to discuss the rule with students.
items.zh: 學校全面禁止手機時引起了一片譁然，所以校長同意和學生討論這項規定。
