items.def: the quality of being true
items.s: Reporters questioned the ________ of the photo, because the shadows did not match the time of day.
items.zh: 記者質疑那張照片的真實性，因為陰影和當時的時間對不上。

items.def: what someone plans to do
items.s: The ________ of the fake account was to make people distrust the election, so the platform deleted it quickly.
items.zh: 那個假帳號的意圖是讓人們不信任選舉，所以平台很快就把它刪除了。

items.def: a mistake in action or judgement
items.s: Posting the joke was a serious ________ for the brand, and it lost thousands of followers in one day.
items.zh: 發布那個笑話是該品牌的嚴重失策，它一天內就失去了數千名追蹤者。

items.def: a large number of different things
items.s: A healthy democracy needs a ________ of voices, so it is important that small newspapers can survive too.
items.zh: 健全的民主需要多元的聲音，所以讓小型報社也能生存下去很重要。

items.def: an insulting remark about someone
items.s: The fan shouted a racist ________ at the player, and the club banned him from the stadium for life.
items.zh: 那位球迷對球員大喊種族歧視的侮辱性言語，球團終身禁止他進入球場。

items.def: a formal statement about what someone saw or knows
items.s: The witness's ________ was very clear, so the jury believed her rather than the man's online supporters.
items.zh: 那位證人的證詞非常清楚，所以陪審團相信她，而不是那名男子的網路支持者。

items.def: the set of beliefs and values of a group
items.s: The ________ of the newspaper is to tell the truth without fear, so it often publishes stories that powerful people dislike.
items.zh: 那家報社的精神是無畏地說出真相，所以它常刊登有權勢者不喜歡的報導。

items.def: a foolish action or idea
items.s: It would be ________ to believe every message in the family group chat, because many of them are forwarded without checking.
items.zh: 相信家族群組裡的每一則訊息是很愚蠢的，因為許多訊息都是未經查證就轉傳的。

items.def: freedom from punishment
items.s: Online trolls often act with ________, because they hide behind fake names and are rarely caught.
items.zh: 網路酸民常常肆無忌憚，因為他們躲在假名後面，很少被抓到。

items.def: a phrase repeated often as a belief or rule
items.s: "Check before you share" has become the ________ of our school's media club, and members repeat it at every meeting.
items.zh: 「分享前先查證」已成為我們學校媒體社的信條，社員們每次聚會都會複述。

items.def: laughing at someone in an unkind way
items.s: The boy's funny accent became the object of ________ online, so his parents asked the website to remove the video.
items.zh: 那男孩有趣的口音在網路上成了嘲笑的對象，所以他父母要求網站移除影片。

items.def: a very strong attack or a huge amount of something
items.s: The actress faced an ________ of hateful comments after the film, so she took a break from social media.
items.zh: 電影上映後，那位女演員遭到仇恨留言的猛烈攻擊，所以她暫時停用社群媒體。

items.def: a subject people avoid talking about
items.s: Mental health used to be a ________ in many families, but now more young people talk about it openly online.
items.zh: 心理健康過去在許多家庭中是禁忌，但現在越來越多年輕人在網路上公開談論。

items.def: a feeling of fear about something that may happen
items.s: She opened the comments under her first video with ________, but most of them were kind and encouraging.
items.zh: 她忐忑不安地打開第一支影片下的留言，但大部分都很友善又鼓勵人。

items.def: a position from which you can see or understand something well
items.s: From the ______ ______ of a small-town reporter, the national news often misses what really matters to local people.
items.zh: 從一位小鎮記者的角度來看，全國新聞常常忽略了對當地人真正重要的事。

items.def: according to what is claimed, but possibly not true
items.s: The video ________ shows a UFO over Taipei, but experts believe it is simply a lantern from a festival.
items.zh: 那段影片據稱拍到台北上空的幽浮，但專家認為那只是節慶放的天燈。

items.def: without knowing or intending
items.s: Many people ________ spread false news, because they share posts from friends without thinking to check them.
items.zh: 許多人不知不覺地散播假新聞，因為他們分享朋友的貼文時沒想到要查證。

items.def: in a way that is the opposite of what you expect
items.s: ________, the talk about the dangers of phones was interrupted when the speaker's own phone started ringing.
items.zh: 諷刺的是，那場談手機危害的講座因講者自己的手機響起而被打斷。

items.def: without any good reason
items.s: The headline ________ frightened parents, because the article said the risk to children was actually very low.
items.zh: 那個標題不必要地嚇壞了家長，因為文章說兒童的風險其實很低。

items.def: in a way that everyone can see or hear
items.s: The company ________ apologised for the misleading advert, and it promised to give customers their money back.
items.zh: 那家公司公開為誤導性廣告道歉，並承諾退款給顧客。

items.def: in a mistaken or unfair way
items.s: The man was ________ named as the thief on social media, so he received threats even though he was innocent.
items.zh: 那名男子在社群媒體上被誤指為小偷，所以即使他是無辜的，他仍收到威脅。

items.def: in a way that is not true
items.s: The website ________ claimed that the drink could prevent the flu, so the government ordered it to remove the advert.
items.zh: 那個網站不實地聲稱那款飲料可以預防流感，所以政府命令它撤下廣告。

items.def: without hiding anything
items.s: The athlete spoke ________ about her anxiety in an interview, and many fans thanked her for being so honest.
items.zh: 那位運動員在訪問中坦率地談論她的焦慮，許多粉絲感謝她如此誠實。

items.def: in a way that is easy to understand
items.s: The villagers were ________ angry about the false report, because it had frightened tourists away from their town.
items.zh: 村民們對那則不實報導感到憤怒是可以理解的，因為它把遊客嚇得不敢來他們的小鎮。

items.def: using exactly the same words
items.s: The student copied the article ________ into his essay, so the teacher noticed immediately that it was not his own work.
items.zh: 那位學生把文章一字不差地抄進他的作文，所以老師立刻注意到那不是他自己寫的。

items.def: to spread very quickly online
items.s: Her video of the rescue ______ ______ within hours, and soon TV stations from other countries wanted to interview her.
items.zh: 她的救援影片在幾小時內就爆紅，很快其他國家的電視台都想採訪她。

items.def: to spread very quickly
items.cn: 迅速蔓延；像野火般傳開
items.s: The rumour about the exam ______ ______ ______, so by lunchtime every student in the school was talking about it.
items.zh: 關於考試的謠言像野火般迅速傳開，所以到了午餐時間，全校每個學生都在談論它。

items.def: with some doubt, not believing everything
items.cn: 半信半疑地；有所保留地
items.s: You should take celebrity diet tips ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, because most stars have personal trainers and chefs.
items.zh: 你應該對名人的減肥秘訣持保留態度，因為大多數明星都有私人教練和廚師。

items.def: to become important news everywhere
items.cn: 登上頭條；成為新聞焦點
items.s: The small village ______ ______ ______ when a student found a rare fossil, and tourists began to visit every weekend.
items.zh: 一名學生發現了一塊罕見化石後，那個小村莊登上了頭條，遊客開始每個週末都來參觀。

items.def: said privately, not to be published
items.s: The official spoke ______ ______ ______, so the reporter could use the information but could not print his name.
items.zh: 那位官員是私下透露的，所以記者可以使用這些資訊，但不能刊出他的名字。

items.def: information passed from person to person by talking
items.s: The small café never advertised, but ______ ______ ______ brought so many customers that there is always a queue.
items.zh: 那家小咖啡店從不打廣告，但口碑帶來了大量顧客，所以門口總是大排長龍。

items.def: in private, without the public knowing
items.s: The decision was made ______ ______ ______, so the public only learned about it after the new rules started.
items.zh: 那項決定是閉門做出的，所以大眾直到新規定開始實施後才得知。

items.def: to make people understand what you mean
items.s: The poster used simple pictures to ______ ______ ______ ______, because many of the visitors could not read Chinese.
items.zh: 那張海報使用簡單的圖片來把訊息傳達清楚，因為許多遊客看不懂中文。

items.def: to avoid talking about the main topic
items.s: Please stop ______ ______ ______ ______ and tell me what happened, because I am really worried about you.
items.zh: 請不要再拐彎抹角了，直接告訴我發生了什麼事，因為我真的很擔心你。

items.def: to understand how people around you feel
items.s: The comedian failed to ______ ______ ______, so he told jokes at a sad event and many guests were offended.
items.zh: 那位喜劇演員沒能察言觀色，所以他在一個哀傷的場合講笑話，許多賓客都覺得被冒犯。

items.def: losing meaning when changed into another language
items.s: The joke was very funny in Japanese, but most of it was ______ ______ ______, so the English audience did not laugh.
items.zh: 那個笑話在日文裡非常好笑，但大部分在翻譯中失去了原意，所以英語觀眾沒有笑。

items.def: an obvious problem that nobody wants to talk about
items.cn: 大家避而不談的明顯問題
items.s: Everyone discussed the new logo, but nobody mentioned ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, which was the company's falling sales.
items.zh: 大家都在討論新標誌，卻沒有人提到那個明擺著卻沒人敢談的問題，也就是公司銷售額下滑。
items.t: 那個明擺著卻沒人敢談的問題

items.def: in a few words; briefly
items.s: ______ ______ ______, the report says that most teenagers trust videos more than newspapers, and this worries many teachers.
items.zh: 簡而言之，那份報告說大多數青少年相信影片勝過報紙，而這讓許多老師感到擔憂。

items.def: through informal talk between people
items.cn: 透過小道消息；輾轉聽說
items.s: I heard ______ ______ ______ that our teacher is leaving, but I am not sure whether it is true.
items.zh: 我透過小道消息聽說我們老師要離職了，但我不確定是不是真的。

items.def: to tell a secret too early
items.s: We planned a surprise party for Mum, but my little brother ______ ______ ______ at breakfast, so she knew everything.
items.zh: 我們為媽媽策劃了一場驚喜派對，但我弟弟在早餐時洩露了秘密，所以她全都知道了。

items.def: to change the meaning of what someone said
items.s: The reporter ______ ______ ______, because I said the plan had problems, not that it was a complete failure.
items.zh: 那位記者扭曲了我的話，因為我說的是那個計畫有問題，不是說它徹底失敗。

items.def: separated from the situation that explains its meaning
items.s: The clip took her comment ______ ______ ______, so it sounded rude, although she was actually making a joke.
items.zh: 那段短片把她的評論斷章取義，所以聽起來很無禮，儘管她其實是在開玩笑。

items.def: to correct a false story
items.s: The singer posted a video to ______ ______ ______ ______, because many fans believed the false rumours about her marriage.
items.zh: 那位歌手發布了一支影片來澄清事實，因為許多粉絲相信了關於她婚姻的不實謠言。

items.def: to say honestly what you think
items.s: Our teacher encourages us to ______ ______ ______ in class discussions, but she also asks us to respect other people's views.
items.zh: 老師鼓勵我們在課堂討論中說出自己的想法，但她也要求我們尊重別人的觀點。

items.def: agreeing about what to do
items.s: Before the interview, the team met to make sure everyone was ______ ______ ______ ______, so nobody gave different answers.
items.zh: 採訪前團隊開了會，確保大家有共識，這樣就不會有人給出不同的答案。

items.def: the scientific study of language
items.s: My cousin decided to study ________ at university because she loves languages, and she wants to understand how children learn to speak.
items.zh: 我的表姊決定在大學念語言學，因為她熱愛語言，而且她想了解孩子是如何學會說話的。
items.sec: Linguistics & Language Structure 語言學與語言結構

items.def: a person who studies how languages work
items.s: The ________ recorded the old villagers telling stories, and she later used the recordings to describe the grammar of their language.
items.zh: 這位語言學家錄下了年長村民講故事的聲音，之後她用這些錄音來描述他們語言的文法。
items.sec: Linguistics & Language Structure 語言學與語言結構

items.def: connected with language
items.s: Moving to Japan was a big ________ challenge for Tom, but he practised every day and could chat with neighbours after a year.
items.zh: 搬到日本對湯姆來說是一大語言上的挑戰，但他每天練習，一年後就能和鄰居聊天了。
items.sec: Linguistics & Language Structure 語言學與語言結構

items.def: the study of how language and society affect each other
items.s: In our ________ class we compared how teenagers and grandparents speak, and we found that each group uses very different words.
items.zh: 在我們的社會語言學課上，我們比較了青少年和祖父母說話的方式，結果發現每個族群使用的詞彙都非常不同。
items.sec: Linguistics & Language Structure 語言學與語言結構

items.def: the study of how the mind uses and understands language
items.s: Researchers in ________ use eye-tracking cameras, because they want to know exactly how our brains process words while we read.
items.zh: 心理語言學的研究人員使用眼動追蹤攝影機，因為他們想確切知道我們閱讀時大腦是如何處理文字的。
items.sec: Linguistics & Language Structure 語言學與語言結構

items.def: the study of speech sounds
items.s: Our teacher studied ________ in college, so she can explain exactly where to put our tongue when we make the "th" sound.
items.zh: 我們的老師在大學學過語音學，所以她能確切解釋我們發「th」音時舌頭該放在哪裡。
items.sec: Linguistics & Language Structure 語言學與語言結構

items.def: the study of the meaning of words and sentences
items.s: "Cheap" and "inexpensive" seem to mean the same thing, but ________ shows us that one word can sound more negative than the other.
items.zh: 「cheap」和「inexpensive」看似意思相同，但語意學告訴我們其中一個字聽起來可能比另一個更負面。
items.sec: Linguistics & Language Structure 語言學與語言結構

items.def: the study of how context changes what we mean
items.s: When my mum asks "Is the door open?", she usually wants me to close it, and ________ explains how we understand these hidden requests.
items.zh: 當我媽媽問「門開著嗎？」時，她通常是要我去關門，而語用學解釋了我們如何理解這些隱藏的請求。
items.sec: Linguistics & Language Structure 語言學與語言結構

items.def: a large collection of real texts used for language study
items.s: The dictionary team searched a huge ________ of newspapers and websites, so they could see how often people really use each word.
items.zh: 字典編輯團隊搜尋了一個由報紙和網站組成的龐大語料庫，以便了解人們實際上多常使用每個字。
items.sec: Linguistics & Language Structure 語言學與語言結構

items.def: the smallest part of a word that has meaning
items.s: The word "unhappy" has two parts, and each ________ adds meaning, because "un" means "not" and "happy" means "glad".
items.zh: 「unhappy」這個字有兩個部分，而每個詞素都增加了意思，因為「un」表示「不」，「happy」表示「高興」。
items.sec: Linguistics & Language Structure 語言學與語言結構

items.def: one of the smallest sound units in a language
items.s: English learners in Taiwan often mix up the sounds in "light" and "right", because each ________ does not exist separately in their first language.
items.zh: 台灣的英語學習者常常混淆「light」和「right」的發音，因為這兩個音素在他們的母語中並沒有分開存在。
items.sec: Linguistics & Language Structure 語言學與語言結構

items.def: a part of a word with one vowel sound
items.s: The word "banana" has three ________, and English speakers usually put the strongest sound on the middle one.
items.zh: 「banana」這個字有三個音節，而說英語的人通常把最重的音放在中間那個上。
items.sec: Linguistics & Language Structure 語言學與語言結構

items.def: letters added to the start of a word to change its meaning
items.s: If you add the ________ "re" to "write", you get "rewrite", and the new word means "write again".
items.zh: 如果你在「write」前面加上字首「re」，就會得到「rewrite」，而這個新字的意思是「再寫一次」。
items.sec: Linguistics & Language Structure 語言學與語言結構

items.def: letters added to the end of a word
items.s: The ________ "ness" turns adjectives into nouns, so "kind" becomes "kindness" and "dark" becomes "darkness".
items.zh: 字尾「ness」能把形容詞變成名詞，所以「kind」變成「kindness」，「dark」變成「darkness」。
items.sec: Linguistics & Language Structure 語言學與語言結構

items.def: a prefix or a suffix
items.s: Learning one common ________ can help you guess hundreds of new words, because the same pieces appear again and again.
items.zh: 學會一個常見的詞綴能幫你猜出幾百個新字，因為同樣的部分會一再出現。
items.sec: Linguistics & Language Structure 語言學與語言結構

items.def: the main part of a word that carries its basic meaning
items.s: The ______ ______ "port" means "carry", so once you know it, words like "transport" and "export" become much easier to remember.
items.zh: 字根「port」的意思是「攜帶」，所以一旦你知道它，像「transport」和「export」這樣的字就變得容易記多了。
items.sec: Linguistics & Language Structure 語言學與語言結構

items.def: a change in a word's ending to show tense, number, etc.
items.s: English adds an ________ like "-s" or "-ed" to many words, but Chinese verbs never change their form at all.
items.zh: 英文會在許多字後面加上像「-s」或「-ed」這樣的詞形變化，但中文的動詞完全不會改變形式。
items.sec: Linguistics & Language Structure 語言學與語言結構

items.def: a word made from two or more words
items.s: "Toothbrush" is a ______ ______ made from "tooth" and "brush", and German has even longer examples than English.
items.zh: 「toothbrush」是由「tooth」和「brush」組成的複合字，而德文的例子甚至比英文還要長。
items.sec: Linguistics & Language Structure 語言學與語言結構

items.def: the order in which words are arranged in a sentence
items.s: In English the ______ ______ is usually subject, verb, object, but in Japanese the verb normally comes at the end.
items.zh: 英文的詞序通常是主詞、動詞、受詞，但在日文中，動詞通常出現在句尾。
items.sec: Linguistics & Language Structure 語言學與語言結構

items.def: the way words are put together to form a sentence
items.s: My writing teacher told me to vary my ______ ______, because using only short simple sentences makes an essay sound boring.
items.zh: 我的寫作老師叫我變化句子結構，因為只用短的簡單句會讓文章聽起來很無聊。
items.sec: Linguistics & Language Structure 語言學與語言結構

items.def: the rules for forming words and sentences
items.s: Many students hate learning ________ rules, but these rules help them write clearly and avoid confusing their readers.
items.zh: 許多學生討厭學文法規則，但這些規則能幫助他們寫得清楚，並避免讓讀者感到困惑。
items.sec: Linguistics & Language Structure 語言學與語言結構

items.def: following or connected with the rules of grammar
items.s: The essay had a few ________ mistakes, but the ideas were so interesting that the teacher still gave it a high score.
items.zh: 這篇文章有幾個文法上的錯誤，但內容想法非常有趣，所以老師還是給了高分。
items.sec: Linguistics & Language Structure 語言學與語言結構

items.def: telling people how they should use language
items.s: Old grammar books were very ________ and told readers never to end a sentence with a preposition, but modern writers often ignore that rule.
items.zh: 舊的文法書非常規範性，告訴讀者絕對不要用介系詞結束句子，但現代作家常常忽略這條規則。
items.sec: Linguistics & Language Structure 語言學與語言結構

items.def: not following the rules of grammar
items.s: The sentence "He go to school yesterday" is ________, so the teacher circled it and asked the student to correct the verb.
items.zh: 「He go to school yesterday」這個句子是不合文法的，所以老師把它圈起來，要求學生改正動詞。
items.sec: Linguistics & Language Structure 語言學與語言結構

items.def: a word class such as noun, verb or adjective
items.s: "Light" can be a noun, a verb or an adjective, so you must check the sentence to decide its ______ ______ ______.
items.zh: 「light」可以是名詞、動詞或形容詞，所以你必須查看句子才能決定它的詞性。
items.sec: Linguistics & Language Structure 語言學與語言結構

items.def: a word that has the same origin as a word in another language
items.s: The English word "night" and the German word "Nacht" are ________, and that is why they look and sound so similar.
items.zh: 英文字「night」和德文字「Nacht」是同源字，這就是為什麼它們看起來、聽起來都那麼相似。
items.sec: Linguistics & Language Structure 語言學與語言結構

items.def: the form of a word that means more than one
items.s: Most English nouns add "s" to form the ________, but some, like "child" and "mouse", change in strange ways.
items.zh: 大多數英文名詞加「s」構成複數形，但有些字，像「child」和「mouse」，會以奇怪的方式改變。
items.sec: Linguistics & Language Structure 語言學與語言結構

items.def: showing only one person or thing
items.s: "News" looks like a plural noun, but it is actually ________, so we say "the news is good" and not "the news are good".
items.zh: 「news」看起來像複數名詞，但它其實是單數的，所以我們說「the news is good」而不是「the news are good」。
items.sec: Linguistics & Language Structure 語言學與語言結構

items.def: a sentence form where the subject receives the action
items.s: Science reports often use the ______ ______, so writers say "the water was heated" instead of "we heated the water".
items.zh: 科學報告常常使用被動語態，所以作者會說「水被加熱了」而不是「我們加熱了水」。
items.sec: Linguistics & Language Structure 語言學與語言結構

items.def: to list or change the forms of a verb
items.s: In Spanish class we had to ________ twenty verbs every week, and I often forgot the endings for "we" and "they".
items.zh: 在西班牙文課上，我們每週都必須變化二十個動詞的詞形，而我常常忘記「我們」和「他們」的字尾。
items.sec: Linguistics & Language Structure 語言學與語言結構

items.def: a way of pronouncing a language that shows where you are from
items.s: My new classmate has a strong Scottish ________, so at first I found him hard to understand, but now I enjoy listening to him.
items.zh: 我的新同學有很重的蘇格蘭口音，所以一開始我覺得他的話很難懂，但現在我很喜歡聽他說話。
items.sec: Sounds, Speech & Accents 語音、口說與口音

items.def: a form of a language spoken in one area or by one group
items.s: My grandparents speak a local ________ at home, while my parents usually speak Mandarin with me and my sister.
items.zh: 我的祖父母在家說當地的方言，而我的父母通常用國語和我及我妹妹說話。
items.sec: Sounds, Speech & Accents 語音、口說與口音

items.def: the rise and fall of the voice when speaking
items.s: If you say "Really?" with a rising ________, it sounds like a question, but a falling tone can make it sound bored.
items.zh: 如果你用上揚的語調說「Really?」，聽起來就像個問題，但下降的語調會讓它聽起來很無聊。
items.sec: Sounds, Speech & Accents 語音、口說與口音

items.def: a sound like a, e, i, o or u
items.s: English has many more ________ sounds than Japanese, so Japanese learners often find words like "ship" and "sheep" confusing.
items.zh: 英文的母音比日文多得多，所以日本學習者常常覺得像「ship」和「sheep」這樣的字很容易搞混。
items.sec: Sounds, Speech & Accents 語音、口說與口音

items.def: a speech sound that is not a vowel, like b, t or s
items.s: Some words begin with three ________ in a row, like "street" and "spring", and these clusters are hard for many learners to say.
items.zh: 有些字開頭連續有三個子音，像「street」和「spring」，而這些子音群對很多學習者來說很難發音。
items.sec: Sounds, Speech & Accents 語音、口說與口音

items.def: a regular pattern of strong and weak sounds
items.s: English has a bouncing ________ with strong and weak beats, so reading poems aloud is a good way to practise it.
items.zh: 英文有一種強弱拍交替的跳躍節奏，所以大聲朗讀詩是練習它的好方法。
items.sec: Sounds, Speech & Accents 語音、口說與口音

items.def: how high or low a sound is
items.s: In Mandarin the ________ of your voice can change a word's meaning, so "mā" and "mà" are completely different words.
items.zh: 在中文裡，聲音的音高可以改變一個字的意思，所以「媽」和「罵」是完全不同的字。
items.sec: Sounds, Speech & Accents 語音、口說與口音

items.def: to repeat sounds because it is hard to speak smoothly
items.s: He used to ________ when he felt nervous, but speech lessons gave him confidence, and now he hosts the school radio show.
items.zh: 他以前緊張時會結巴，但說話課程給了他信心，現在他主持學校的廣播節目。
items.sec: Sounds, Speech & Accents 語音、口說與口音

items.def: to speak quietly and unclearly
items.s: Please don't ________ during your presentation, because the students at the back of the hall need to hear every word.
items.zh: 請不要在報告時含糊地說話，因為禮堂後面的學生需要聽清楚每一個字。
items.sec: Sounds, Speech & Accents 語音、口說與口音

items.def: to speak very softly using your breath
items.s: We had to ________ in the library, but my friend kept laughing loudly, so the librarian asked us to leave.
items.zh: 我們在圖書館裡必須低聲說話，但我朋友一直大聲笑，所以圖書館員請我們離開。
items.sec: Sounds, Speech & Accents 語音、口說與口音

items.def: to make the sound of a word
items.s: Many people do not know how to ________ "Wednesday", because the first "d" is silent and the spelling looks very strange.
items.zh: 很多人不知道「Wednesday」怎麼發音，因為第一個「d」不發音，而且拼字看起來很奇怪。
items.sec: Sounds, Speech & Accents 語音、口說與口音

items.def: to say a word wrongly
items.s: The host ________ the singer's name twice, and the audience laughed, so he apologised and asked her to say it herself.
items.zh: 主持人把歌手的名字唸錯了兩次，觀眾都笑了，所以他道歉並請她自己說一次。
items.sec: Sounds, Speech & Accents 語音、口說與口音

items.def: parts in your throat that make the sound of your voice
items.s: Singers rest their ______ ______ before a big concert, because shouting or talking too much can damage their voice.
items.zh: 歌手在大型演唱會前會讓聲帶休息，因為大叫或說太多話會傷害他們的嗓子。
items.sec: Sounds, Speech & Accents 語音、口說與口音

items.def: a phrase that is difficult to say quickly
items.s: Our teacher starts each class with a ______ ______ like "She sells seashells", and we all laugh when we make mistakes.
items.zh: 我們老師每堂課都用一個像「She sells seashells」這樣的繞口令開始，而我們犯錯時大家都會大笑。
items.sec: Sounds, Speech & Accents 語音、口說與口音

items.def: a speech problem where "s" sounds like "th"
items.s: The little boy had a ________, so "sun" sounded like "thun", but it disappeared after he got his new front teeth.
items.zh: 那個小男孩有大舌頭，所以「sun」聽起來像「thun」，但他長出新門牙後這個問題就消失了。
items.sec: Sounds, Speech & Accents 語音、口說與口音

items.def: able to speak a language easily and well
items.s: Sara became ________ in French after living in Paris for two years, and now she works as a tour guide there.
items.zh: 莎拉在巴黎住了兩年後，法文變得流利，現在她在那裡當導遊。
items.sec: Sounds, Speech & Accents 語音、口說與口音

items.def: to have the same ending sound
items.s: Children's songs are easy to remember because the lines often ________, like "cat" and "hat" or "star" and "far".
items.zh: 兒歌很容易記住，因為歌詞常常押韻，像「cat」和「hat」或「star」和「far」。
items.sec: Sounds, Speech & Accents 語音、口說與口音

items.def: a letter that is written but not pronounced
items.s: The "k" in "knife" is a ______ ______, so we say "nife", which often surprises young learners.
items.zh: 「knife」中的「k」是不發音字母，所以我們唸成「nife」，這常常讓年幼的學習者感到驚訝。
items.sec: Sounds, Speech & Accents 語音、口說與口音

items.def: a set of symbols that show speech sounds
items.s: Most good dictionaries show words in the international ______ ______, so you can check the pronunciation even without audio.
items.zh: 大多數好的字典會用國際音標標示單字，所以即使沒有音檔，你也能查到發音。
items.sec: Sounds, Speech & Accents 語音、口說與口音

items.def: a person who learned a language from birth
items.s: Talking with a ______ ______ helped me learn natural expressions, but I also learned a lot from other learners in my class.
items.zh: 和母語人士交談幫助我學到自然的說法，但我也從班上其他學習者身上學到很多。
items.sec: Sounds, Speech & Accents 語音、口說與口音

items.def: the first language you learned as a child
items.s: Her ______ ______ is Hakka, but she also speaks Mandarin, English and a little Korean, so she often helps foreign tourists.
items.zh: 她的母語是客家話，但她也會說國語、英文和一點韓文，所以她常常幫助外國觀光客。
items.sec: Sounds, Speech & Accents 語音、口說與口音

items.def: a language you learn after your first one
items.s: English is a ______ ______ for millions of people in Asia, and many of them use it every day at work.
items.zh: 英文是亞洲數百萬人的第二語言，而且其中許多人每天在工作中使用它。
items.sec: Sounds, Speech & Accents 語音、口說與口音

items.def: a voice that stays on one level and sounds dull
items.s: The lecturer spoke in a ________ for the whole hour, so half the students fell asleep before he finished.
items.zh: 那位講師整整一小時都用單調的聲音說話，所以一半的學生在他講完前就睡著了。
items.sec: Sounds, Speech & Accents 語音、口說與口音

items.def: understanding speech by watching people's lips
items.s: My aunt cannot hear well, but she is very good at ________, so please look at her when you speak.
items.zh: 我阿姨聽力不好，但她很擅長讀唇，所以你說話時請看著她。
items.sec: Sounds, Speech & Accents 語音、口說與口音

items.def: a professional who helps people speak more clearly
items.s: The ______ ______ taught my brother some fun mouth exercises, and his speech became much clearer within a few months.
items.zh: 語言治療師教了我弟弟一些有趣的嘴部運動，而他的說話在幾個月內就清楚多了。
items.sec: Sounds, Speech & Accents 語音、口說與口音

items.def: technology that changes spoken words into text
items.s: The ______ ______ on my phone works well in quiet rooms, but it often writes the wrong words on a noisy bus.
items.zh: 我手機上的語音辨識在安靜的房間裡運作良好，但在吵雜的公車上常常打出錯字。
items.sec: Sounds, Speech & Accents 語音、口說與口音

items.def: in a voice that others can hear
items.s: Reading stories ________ to young children builds their vocabulary, and it also helps parents and kids feel closer.
items.zh: 為幼兒大聲朗讀故事能增加他們的詞彙量，而且也能讓父母和孩子感覺更親近。
items.sec: Sounds, Speech & Accents 語音、口說與口音

items.def: loud enough to be heard
items.s: The speaker's voice was barely ________ because the microphone was broken, so people at the back started to complain.
items.zh: 因為麥克風壞了，講者的聲音幾乎聽不太見，所以後面的人開始抱怨。
items.sec: Sounds, Speech & Accents 語音、口說與口音

items.def: a word with the same or a similar meaning
items.s: "Big" is a ________ for "large", but writers often choose "huge" or "enormous" when they want a stronger effect.
items.zh: 「big」是「large」的同義字，但當作者想要更強的效果時，常會選擇「huge」或「enormous」。
items.sec: Words, Meaning & Usage 詞彙、語意與用法

items.def: a word with the opposite meaning
items.s: The ________ of "generous" is "mean", and learning words in opposite pairs makes them easier to remember.
items.zh: 「generous」的反義字是「mean」，而以相反詞成對學習單字會讓它們更容易記住。
items.sec: Words, Meaning & Usage 詞彙、語意與用法

items.def: a word that sounds like another but has a different meaning
items.s: "Their" and "there" are ________, so even native speakers sometimes mix them up when they type quickly.
items.zh: 「their」和「there」是同音異義字，所以即使是母語人士快速打字時有時也會搞混。
items.sec: Words, Meaning & Usage 詞彙、語意與用法

items.def: a word spelled and said the same as another but with a different meaning
items.s: "Bat" is a ________, because it can mean an animal that flies at night or the stick used in baseball.
items.zh: 「bat」是一個同形同音異義字，因為它可以指晚上飛的動物，也可以指棒球用的球棒。
items.sec: Words, Meaning & Usage 詞彙、語意與用法

items.def: a group of words whose meaning is different from the single words
items.s: "It's raining cats and dogs" is a famous ________, but you will never see real animals falling from the sky.
items.zh: 「It's raining cats and dogs」是一個很有名的慣用語，但你永遠不會看到真的動物從天上掉下來。
items.sec: Words, Meaning & Usage 詞彙、語意與用法

items.def: natural and typical of native speakers
items.s: Watching TV series helped Kevin learn ________ English, so his speaking now sounds much less like a textbook.
items.zh: 看影集幫助凱文學到道地的英文，所以他現在說話聽起來不那麼像課本了。
items.sec: Words, Meaning & Usage 詞彙、語意與用法

items.def: a short well-known saying that gives advice
items.s: My grandmother often quotes the ________ "Slow and steady wins the race", because she wants me to study a little every day.
items.zh: 我奶奶常常引用諺語「慢而穩者勝」，因為她希望我每天讀一點書。
items.sec: Words, Meaning & Usage 詞彙、語意與用法

items.def: words that are often used together
items.s: We say "make a mistake" but not "do a mistake", and learning each common ________ makes your English sound natural.
items.zh: 我們說「make a mistake」而不是「do a mistake」，而學會每個常見的搭配詞會讓你的英文聽起來很自然。
items.sec: Words, Meaning & Usage 詞彙、語意與用法

items.def: a verb plus a small word like "up" or "off"
items.s: "Give up" is a common ______ ______, and it means to stop trying, which is very different from "give".
items.zh: 「give up」是一個常見的片語動詞，意思是放棄嘗試，這和「give」的意思非常不同。
items.sec: Words, Meaning & Usage 詞彙、語意與用法

items.def: the basic dictionary meaning of a word
items.s: The ________ of "home" is simply a place where you live, but the word also makes many people think of warmth and family.
items.zh: 「home」的本義只是你居住的地方，但這個字也讓許多人聯想到溫暖和家庭。
items.sec: Words, Meaning & Usage 詞彙、語意與用法

items.def: in the exact, basic meaning of the words
items.s: The German word "Handschuh" ________ means "hand shoe", and that is why many learners find it funny.
items.zh: 德文字「Handschuh」照字面意思是「手鞋」，這就是許多學習者覺得它很好笑的原因。
items.sec: Words, Meaning & Usage 詞彙、語意與用法

items.def: a statement that explains what a word means
items.s: I could not understand the ________ in my English dictionary, so I looked at the example sentence instead, and it was much clearer.
items.zh: 我看不懂英文字典裡的定義，所以我改看例句，結果清楚多了。
items.sec: Words, Meaning & Usage 詞彙、語意與用法

items.def: relaxed and used with friends, not in official situations
items.s: "Hey, what's up?" is fine in ________ chats with friends, but you should not use it in an email to your teacher.
items.zh: 「Hey, what's up?」在和朋友非正式的聊天中沒問題，但你不應該在寫給老師的電子郵件中使用它。
items.sec: Words, Meaning & Usage 詞彙、語意與用法

items.def: a word taken from another language
items.s: "Sushi" is a ________ from Japanese, and English has also borrowed words like "tea" from Chinese.
items.zh: 「sushi」是來自日文的外來語，而英文也從中文借了像「tea」這樣的字。
items.sec: Words, Meaning & Usage 詞彙、語意與用法

items.def: a newly invented word
items.s: "Selfie" was once a ________, but it became so popular that it was added to major dictionaries in just a few years.
items.zh: 「selfie」曾經是一個新造詞，但它變得非常流行，所以短短幾年內就被收入主要字典。
items.sec: Words, Meaning & Usage 詞彙、語意與用法

items.def: the history and origin of a word
items.s: I love reading about ________, because finding out that "salary" comes from the Latin word for salt is really fun.
items.zh: 我喜歡閱讀關於字源的東西，因為發現「salary」來自拉丁文的「鹽」真的很有趣。
items.sec: Words, Meaning & Usage 詞彙、語意與用法

items.def: a short form of a word or phrase
items.s: "Dr" is an ________ of "Doctor", and you will see many short forms like this on signs and forms.
items.zh: 「Dr」是「Doctor」的縮寫，而你會在標誌和表格上看到許多像這樣的簡短形式。
items.sec: Words, Meaning & Usage 詞彙、語意與用法

items.def: the way letters form a word
items.s: English ________ can be very confusing, because "though", "through" and "tough" all look similar but sound different.
items.zh: 英文拼字可能非常令人困惑，因為「though」、「through」和「tough」看起來很像，但發音不同。
items.sec: Words, Meaning & Usage 詞彙、語意與用法

items.def: to spell a word wrongly
items.s: I ________ my teacher's name on the birthday card, so I felt embarrassed and wrote her a new one.
items.zh: 我在生日卡上拼錯了老師的名字，所以我覺得很尷尬，又重新寫了一張給她。
items.sec: Words, Meaning & Usage 詞彙、語意與用法

items.def: all the words a person knows or uses
items.s: Reading for twenty minutes a day can grow your ________ quickly, and you will also learn how words are used in real sentences.
items.zh: 每天閱讀二十分鐘能快速增加你的字彙，而且你也會學到單字在真實句子中如何使用。
items.sec: Words, Meaning & Usage 詞彙、語意與用法

items.def: a group of words that share the same root
items.s: "Decide", "decision" and "decisive" belong to the same ______ ______, so learning one helps you understand the others.
items.zh: 「decide」、「decision」和「decisive」屬於同一個字族，所以學會其中一個能幫助你理解其他的。
items.sec: Words, Meaning & Usage 詞彙、語意與用法

items.def: rude or offensive words
items.s: The film contains a lot of ________, so the cinema did not allow children under fifteen to watch it.
items.zh: 那部電影包含大量的髒話，所以電影院不允許十五歲以下的孩子觀看。
items.sec: Words, Meaning & Usage 詞彙、語意與用法

items.def: a joke that uses a word with two meanings
items.s: My dad loves telling a bad ________ at dinner, like "I'm reading a book about glue, and I can't put it down."
items.zh: 我爸爸喜歡在晚餐時講冷雙關語，像是「我在讀一本關於膠水的書，我放不下它。」
items.sec: Words, Meaning & Usage 詞彙、語意與用法

items.def: the clever or funny use of words
items.s: Advertisers often use ________ in their slogans, because a clever joke helps customers remember the product.
items.zh: 廣告商常常在標語中使用文字遊戲，因為巧妙的玩笑能幫助顧客記住產品。
items.sec: Words, Meaning & Usage 詞彙、語意與用法

items.def: a word that reads the same backwards and forwards
items.s: "Level" is a ________, because you can read it from the left or from the right and it stays the same.
items.zh: 「level」是一個迴文，因為你可以從左邊或右邊讀它，而它都保持不變。
items.sec: Words, Meaning & Usage 詞彙、語意與用法

items.def: a word that copies the sound it describes
items.s: Comic books are full of ________ like "boom" and "crash", and these sound words make the action feel exciting.
items.zh: 漫畫書裡充滿了像「boom」和「crash」這樣的狀聲詞，而這些聲音詞讓動作場面感覺很刺激。
items.sec: Words, Meaning & Usage 詞彙、語意與用法

items.def: a comparison using "like" or "as"
items.s: "She runs like the wind" is a ________, and writers use comparisons like this to help readers picture a scene.
items.zh: 「她跑得像風一樣」是一個明喻，而作家用這樣的比較來幫助讀者想像畫面。
items.sec: Words, Meaning & Usage 詞彙、語意與用法

items.def: using several words that start with the same sound
items.s: Many brands use ________, like "Coca-Cola" and "PayPal", because names with repeated sounds are easy to remember.
items.zh: 許多品牌使用頭韻，像「Coca-Cola」和「PayPal」，因為有重複聲音的名字很容易記住。
items.sec: Words, Meaning & Usage 詞彙、語意與用法

items.def: two words with opposite meanings used together
items.s: "Jumbo shrimp" is a funny ________, because "jumbo" means very big while "shrimp" usually means something small.
items.zh: 「jumbo shrimp（巨無霸小蝦）」是一個有趣的矛盾修飾法，因為「jumbo」表示非常大，而「shrimp」通常表示很小的東西。
items.sec: Words, Meaning & Usage 詞彙、語意與用法

items.def: the way words are normally used
items.s: The dictionary gives notes on ________, so learners can see whether a word is polite, rude, formal or old-fashioned.
items.zh: 這本字典有關於用法的說明，所以學習者能看出一個字是禮貌的、粗魯的、正式的還是過時的。
items.sec: Words, Meaning & Usage 詞彙、語意與用法

items.def: a set of letters or symbols used for writing a language
items.s: Korean uses a ________ called Hangul, and many learners can read it after only a few days of practice.
items.zh: 韓文使用一種叫做韓文字母的文字，而許多學習者只要練習幾天就能閱讀。
items.sec: Reading, Writing & Scripts 讀寫與文字系統

items.def: the way a language is written down
items.s: Japanese has a complex ______ ______, because it mixes Chinese characters with two different sets of sound symbols.
items.zh: 日文有一套複雜的書寫系統，因為它混合了漢字和兩套不同的表音符號。
items.sec: Reading, Writing & Scripts 讀寫與文字系統

items.def: a single written symbol used in Chinese
items.s: Each ______ ______ has its own meaning, so foreign students must remember thousands of them before they can read a newspaper.
items.zh: 每個中文字都有自己的意思，所以外國學生必須記住好幾千個字才能讀報紙。
items.sec: Reading, Writing & Scripts 讀寫與文字系統

items.def: a picture used as a written sign for a word
items.s: The ________ for "mountain" looks like three peaks, so children enjoy guessing what these old picture-words mean.
items.zh: 代表「山」的象形文字看起來像三座山峰，所以孩子們很喜歡猜這些古老圖畫文字的意思。
items.sec: Reading, Writing & Scripts 讀寫與文字系統

items.def: a written symbol that shows an idea
items.s: The no-smoking sign is a modern ________, because people from any country can understand it without reading a word.
items.zh: 禁菸標誌是一種現代的表意符號，因為任何國家的人不用讀任何字就能看懂。
items.sec: Reading, Writing & Scripts 讀寫與文字系統

items.def: the art of beautiful handwriting
items.s: My grandfather practises Chinese ________ every morning, and he says that holding the brush calmly helps him relax.
items.zh: 我爺爺每天早上練習中國書法，而他說平穩地握著毛筆能幫助他放鬆。
items.sec: Reading, Writing & Scripts 讀寫與文字系統

items.def: the way a person writes by hand
items.s: The doctor's ________ was so messy that the pharmacist could not read it, so she called the clinic to check the medicine.
items.zh: 那位醫生的字跡太潦草了，藥劑師看不懂，所以她打電話到診所確認藥物。
items.sec: Reading, Writing & Scripts 讀寫與文字系統

items.def: able to read and write
items.s: Only half of the adults in the village were ________ in 1950, but today almost every young person there can read and write.
items.zh: 1950 年時那個村莊只有一半的成人識字，但如今那裡幾乎每個年輕人都能讀寫。
items.sec: Reading, Writing & Scripts 讀寫與文字系統

items.def: unable to read or write
items.s: Her great-grandmother was ________ because girls could not go to school then, so she asked her son to read letters for her.
items.zh: 她的曾祖母不識字，因為當時女孩不能上學，所以她請兒子幫她讀信。
items.sec: Reading, Writing & Scripts 讀寫與文字系統

items.def: marks like commas and full stops used in writing
items.s: Without correct ________, a sentence can be very confusing, so always check your commas before you hand in an essay.
items.zh: 如果沒有正確的標點符號，一個句子可能會非常令人困惑，所以交作文前一定要檢查你的逗號。
items.sec: Reading, Writing & Scripts 讀寫與文字系統

items.def: the punctuation mark ( , )
items.s: "Let's eat, Grandma" and "Let's eat Grandma" mean very different things, so one small ________ can save a life.
items.zh: 「我們吃飯吧，奶奶」和「我們吃奶奶吧」意思非常不同，所以一個小小的逗號能救一條命。
items.sec: Reading, Writing & Scripts 讀寫與文字系統

items.def: the mark ( ' ) used in words like "it's" or "Tom's"
items.s: Many people put an ________ in "its" by mistake, but "it's" only means "it is" or "it has".
items.zh: 很多人錯誤地在「its」中加上撇號，但「it's」只表示「it is」或「it has」。
items.sec: Reading, Writing & Scripts 讀寫與文字系統

items.def: the marks (" ") used around someone's exact words
items.s: When you copy a sentence from a website, put it in ______ ______, or your teacher may think you are cheating.
items.zh: 當你從網站複製一個句子時，要把它放在引號裡，否則你的老師可能會認為你在作弊。
items.sec: Reading, Writing & Scripts 讀寫與文字系統

items.def: a short line ( - ) that joins words
items.s: We write "well-known" with a ________ when it comes before a noun, but many students forget this small rule.
items.zh: 當「well-known」放在名詞前面時，我們要用連字號來寫，但許多學生忘了這個小規則。
items.sec: Reading, Writing & Scripts 讀寫與文字系統

items.def: a big letter such as A, B or C
items.s: Every English sentence begins with a ______ ______, and names of people and countries also need one.
items.zh: 每個英文句子都以大寫字母開頭，而人名和國名也需要。
items.sec: Reading, Writing & Scripts 讀寫與文字系統

items.def: handwriting where the letters are joined together
items.s: Some schools no longer teach ________, so many young people cannot read old letters written by their grandparents.
items.zh: 有些學校不再教草寫，所以許多年輕人看不懂祖父母寫的舊信。
items.sec: Reading, Writing & Scripts 讀寫與文字系統

items.def: a computer program that finds spelling mistakes
items.s: The ________ did not notice that I wrote "form" instead of "from", because both are real English words.
items.zh: 拼字檢查程式沒有發現我把「from」寫成了「form」，因為兩個都是真正的英文字。
items.sec: Reading, Writing & Scripts 讀寫與文字系統

items.def: a phone function that changes words it thinks are wrong
items.s: My phone's ________ changed "meet you at five" to "meat you at five", and my friend laughed at my message all day.
items.zh: 我手機的自動校正把「五點見」改成了「五點肉你」，我朋友一整天都在笑我的訊息。
items.sec: Reading, Writing & Scripts 讀寫與文字系統

items.def: a small mistake in typing
items.s: There was a ________ on the restaurant menu that said "fried lice" instead of "fried rice", so many tourists took photos of it.
items.zh: 餐廳菜單上有一個打字錯誤，把「炒飯」寫成了「炒蝨子」，所以很多觀光客都拍照留念。
items.sec: Reading, Writing & Scripts 讀寫與文字系統

items.def: a group of sentences about one main idea
items.s: Each ________ in your essay should start with a clear topic sentence, and the other sentences should support that idea.
items.zh: 你文章中的每個段落都應以清楚的主題句開頭，而其他句子應該支持那個想法。
items.sec: Reading, Writing & Scripts 讀寫與文字系統

items.def: a way of teaching reading through letter sounds
items.s: Young children learn ________ in their first year of school, so they can sound out new words like "c-a-t" by themselves.
items.zh: 幼童在上學第一年學習自然發音法，所以他們能自己拼讀出像「c-a-t」這樣的新字。
items.sec: Reading, Writing & Scripts 讀寫與文字系統

items.def: writing a language in the Latin alphabet
items.s: Street signs in Taipei use ________ for place names, so foreign visitors can find stations even if they cannot read Chinese.
items.zh: 台北的路標對地名使用羅馬拼音，所以外國遊客即使看不懂中文也能找到車站。
items.sec: Reading, Writing & Scripts 讀寫與文字系統

items.def: the official system for writing Chinese sounds with Roman letters
items.s: Many foreigners learn ________ before they learn characters, because it helps them pronounce Mandarin words correctly.
items.zh: 許多外國人在學漢字之前先學漢語拼音，因為它能幫助他們正確發出國語字詞的音。
items.sec: Reading, Writing & Scripts 讀寫與文字系統

items.def: to write words using the letters of another alphabet
items.s: Passport officers ________ Chinese names into English letters, but the same name can be spelled in several different ways.
items.zh: 護照官員會把中文名字音譯成英文字母，但同一個名字可能有好幾種不同的拼法。
items.sec: Reading, Writing & Scripts 讀寫與文字系統

items.def: to write something quickly and carelessly
items.s: I ________ the phone number on my hand because I had no paper, but later I could not read the last two numbers.
items.zh: 我因為沒有紙，就把電話號碼潦草地寫在手上，但後來我看不清最後兩個數字。
items.sec: Reading, Writing & Scripts 讀寫與文字系統

items.def: a computer program for writing documents
items.s: Most students write their reports with a ______ ______, because it is easy to change sentences and check spelling.
items.zh: 大多數學生用文書處理軟體寫報告，因為它很容易修改句子和檢查拼字。
items.sec: Reading, Writing & Scripts 讀寫與文字系統

items.def: the mark ( . ) at the end of a sentence
items.s: Remember to put a ______ ______ at the end of each sentence, or your reader will not know where one idea ends.
items.zh: 記得在每個句子結尾加上句號，否則你的讀者不會知道一個想法在哪裡結束。
items.sec: Reading, Writing & Scripts 讀寫與文字系統

items.def: the mark ( ? ) at the end of a question
items.s: Spanish puts an upside-down ______ ______ at the start of a question, while English only uses one at the end.
items.zh: 西班牙文會在問句開頭放一個倒過來的問號，而英文只在句尾用一個。
items.sec: Reading, Writing & Scripts 讀寫與文字系統

items.def: a language that is not spoken in your own country
items.s: Learning a ______ ______ opens many doors, because you can travel more easily and make friends from other cultures.
items.zh: 學習一門外語能打開許多扇門，因為你可以更輕鬆地旅行，也能結交其他文化的朋友。
items.sec: Learning & Using Languages 語言學習與使用

items.def: the language you are learning or translating into
items.s: Try to think in the ______ ______ when you speak, because translating every sentence in your head makes you slow.
items.zh: 說話時試著用目標語言思考，因為在腦中翻譯每個句子會讓你變慢。
items.sec: Learning & Using Languages 語言學習與使用

items.def: a problem in communication caused by different languages
items.s: There was a ______ ______ between the doctor and the tourist, so the hospital called a volunteer who spoke Thai.
items.zh: 醫生和那位觀光客之間存在語言障礙，所以醫院找來一位會說泰語的志工。
items.sec: Learning & Using Languages 語言學習與使用

items.def: meeting someone to practise each other's languages
items.s: I joined a ______ ______ with a student from Spain, so I teach her Chinese for an hour and she teaches me Spanish.
items.zh: 我和一位來自西班牙的學生參加了語言交換，所以我教她一小時中文，她教我西班牙文。
items.sec: Learning & Using Languages 語言學習與使用

items.def: a person who can speak many languages
items.s: My uncle is a ________ who speaks seven languages, and he says the secret is to practise a little every single day.
items.zh: 我叔叔是一位會說七種語言的多語者，而他說祕訣就是每天練習一點點。
items.sec: Learning & Using Languages 語言學習與使用

items.def: able to speak three languages
items.s: Children in Singapore often grow up ________, because they speak English at school and other languages with their families.
items.zh: 新加坡的孩子常常在三語環境中長大，因為他們在學校說英文，和家人說其他語言。
items.sec: Learning & Using Languages 語言學習與使用

items.def: to have a conversation
items.s: After a year in Tokyo, Ben could ________ easily with shop owners, although he still found business meetings difficult.
items.zh: 在東京待了一年後，班已經能輕鬆地和店主交談，雖然他仍覺得商務會議很困難。
items.sec: Learning & Using Languages 語言學習與使用

items.def: to talk in a friendly, informal way
items.s: We ________ with the hotel staff every morning, so by the end of the trip our Italian had improved a lot.
items.zh: 我們每天早上都和飯店員工聊天，所以到旅行結束時，我們的義大利文進步了很多。
items.sec: Learning & Using Languages 語言學習與使用

items.def: a person who is studying a language
items.s: Every ______ ______ makes mistakes, so don't be afraid to speak, because mistakes show you what to practise next.
items.zh: 每個語言學習者都會犯錯，所以不要害怕開口，因為錯誤會告訴你接下來該練習什麼。
items.sec: Learning & Using Languages 語言學習與使用

items.def: an exam where you talk to an examiner
items.s: I felt nervous before the IELTS ______ ______, but the examiner smiled and asked easy questions about my hometown first.
items.zh: 在雅思口說測驗前我很緊張，但考官面帶微笑，先問了一些關於我家鄉的簡單問題。
items.sec: Learning & Using Languages 語言學習與使用

items.def: understanding what you hear
items.s: Watching the news in English improved my ______ ______, and now I can follow lectures without reading the subtitles.
items.zh: 看英文新聞提升了我的聽力理解，現在我不看字幕也能聽懂講座。
items.sec: Learning & Using Languages 語言學習與使用

items.def: suitable for everyday talking
items.s: She only has ________ Japanese, so she can order food and ask for directions, but she cannot read business documents.
items.zh: 她只會日常會話程度的日文，所以她能點餐和問路，但看不懂商業文件。
items.sec: Learning & Using Languages 語言學習與使用

items.def: to notice and fix your own mistakes
items.s: Good speakers often ________ in the middle of a sentence, and examiners see this as a sign of strong language awareness.
items.zh: 好的說話者常常在句子說到一半時自我修正，而考官把這看作語言意識強的跡象。
items.sec: Learning & Using Languages 語言學習與使用

items.def: very close to the way a native speaker talks
items.s: Her pronunciation is almost ________, so most people think she grew up in London, even though she was born in Tainan.
items.zh: 她的發音幾乎像母語人士一樣，所以大多數人以為她在倫敦長大，即使她出生在台南。
items.sec: Learning & Using Languages 語言學習與使用

items.def: repeating what a speaker says right after hearing it
items.s: My tutor suggested ________ to improve my speaking, so I repeat each line of a podcast a second after I hear it.
items.zh: 我的家教建議用跟讀法來提升口說，所以我會在聽到播客的每一句後一秒就跟著複述。
items.sec: Learning & Using Languages 語言學習與使用

items.def: a person living in a foreign country
items.s: As an ________ in Taipei, Mark took Chinese lessons, because he wanted to talk with his neighbours and not only with foreigners.
items.zh: 身為在台北的外籍人士，馬克上了中文課，因為他想和鄰居交談，而不只是和外國人說話。
items.sec: Learning & Using Languages 語言學習與使用

items.def: to express ideas or feelings in words
items.s: Young children often cry when they are upset, because they cannot ________ their feelings clearly yet.
items.zh: 幼兒難過時常常哭，因為他們還無法清楚地用言語表達自己的感受。
items.sec: Learning & Using Languages 語言學習與使用

items.def: a person you are talking with
items.s: In the speaking exam you should look at your ________ and respond to their questions, rather than reciting a memorised speech.
items.zh: 在口說考試中，你應該看著你的對話者並回應他們的問題，而不是背誦事先記好的講稿。
items.sec: Learning & Using Languages 語言學習與使用

items.def: words you say when you meet someone
items.s: In Japan a bow is a common ________, but in many Western countries people usually shake hands or wave.
items.zh: 在日本，鞠躬是常見的打招呼方式，但在許多西方國家，人們通常握手或揮手。
items.sec: Learning & Using Languages 語言學習與使用

items.def: the act of saying goodbye
items.s: We said our ________ at the airport, and my host family gave me a card written in English and Chinese.
items.zh: 我們在機場道別，而我的寄宿家庭送了我一張用英文和中文寫的卡片。
items.sec: Learning & Using Languages 語言學習與使用

items.def: the quality of behaving and speaking with respect
items.s: In English, ________ often means adding "could you" or "please", so "Give me water" may sound rude to a waiter.
items.zh: 在英文中，禮貌常常意味著加上「could you」或「please」，所以對服務生說「給我水」聽起來可能很無禮。
items.sec: Learning & Using Languages 語言學習與使用

items.def: a word or title that shows respect
items.s: Korean has a special ________ ending for older people, so young learners must think carefully about who they are talking to.
items.zh: 韓文對長輩有特別的敬語字尾，所以年輕的學習者必須仔細想想自己在跟誰說話。
items.sec: Learning & Using Languages 語言學習與使用

items.def: the level of politeness and seriousness in language
items.s: The ________ of your email should match the reader, so you write "Dear Professor Lin" but "Hi Amy" to a friend.
items.zh: 你電子郵件的正式程度應該配合讀者，所以你會寫「親愛的林教授」，但寫給朋友就寫「嗨，艾咪」。
items.sec: Learning & Using Languages 語言學習與使用

items.def: a person you practise a language with
items.s: My ______ ______ lives in Canada, so we video chat every Sunday, and she corrects my grammar very kindly.
items.zh: 我的語伴住在加拿大，所以我們每週日視訊聊天，而她會很親切地糾正我的文法。
items.sec: Learning & Using Languages 語言學習與使用

items.def: abilities in listening, speaking, reading and writing
items.s: Employers value strong ______ ______, so people who can write clear English emails often get better jobs.
items.zh: 雇主重視良好的語言能力，所以能寫清楚英文電子郵件的人常常找到更好的工作。
items.sec: Learning & Using Languages 語言學習與使用

items.def: a small book of useful phrases for travellers
items.s: We carried a Thai ________ on our trip, but most of the time we used hand signals and smiles instead.
items.zh: 我們旅行時帶了一本泰語常用語手冊，但大多數時候我們還是用手勢和微笑溝通。
items.sec: Learning & Using Languages 語言學習與使用

items.def: a series of lessons to learn a language
items.s: She took a six-week ______ ______ in Seoul last summer, and she can now read menus and chat with taxi drivers.
items.zh: 她去年夏天在首爾上了六週的語言課程，現在她能看懂菜單，也能和計程車司機聊天。
items.sec: Learning & Using Languages 語言學習與使用

items.def: a short, fast course that teaches the basics
items.s: Before his business trip to Germany, my dad took a ______ ______ in German, but he still needed an app in meetings.
items.zh: 在去德國出差之前，我爸爸上了一個德文速成課程，但他在會議中仍需要用應用程式。
items.sec: Learning & Using Languages 語言學習與使用

items.def: a person who changes written text into another language
items.s: The ________ spent two years on the Harry Potter books, because she wanted every joke and name to work in Chinese.
items.zh: 這位譯者花了兩年翻譯哈利波特系列，因為她希望每個笑話和名字在中文裡都行得通。

items.def: text or speech changed into another language
items.s: I read the novel in English and then in ________, and I noticed that some funny lines lost their humour.
items.zh: 我先讀了這本小說的英文版，接著讀了譯本，而我注意到有些好笑的句子失去了幽默感。

items.def: a person who changes spoken words into another language
items.s: The president spoke in French, so an ________ stood beside him and repeated everything in English for the audience.
items.zh: 總統用法文演講，所以一位口譯員站在他身旁，為觀眾把所有內容用英文重述一遍。

items.def: the language that you translate from
items.s: When I translate a menu, Chinese is the ______ ______, and English is the language I translate into.
items.zh: 當我翻譯菜單時，中文是來源語言，而英文是我翻譯成的語言。

items.def: the original text that is being translated
items.s: A good translator reads the whole ______ ______ first, because the meaning of the beginning may depend on the ending.
items.zh: 好的譯者會先讀完整篇原文，因為開頭的意思可能取決於結尾。

items.def: to translate something wrongly
items.s: The sign ________ "slippery floor" as "carefully slide", so tourists took funny photos, but nobody understood the warning.
items.zh: 那個標誌把「地板濕滑」翻錯成「小心地滑」，所以觀光客拍了好笑的照片，但沒人看懂這個警告。

items.def: translation done by a computer
items.s: ______ ______ is fast and free, but it can still make strange mistakes with idioms and jokes.
items.zh: 機器翻譯又快又免費，但它在慣用語和笑話上仍可能犯奇怪的錯誤。

items.def: interpreting while the speaker is still talking
items.s: ______ ______ is very tiring, so interpreters at the United Nations usually change places every thirty minutes.
items.zh: 同步口譯非常累人，所以聯合國的口譯員通常每三十分鐘換一次班。

items.def: interpreting after the speaker stops for a moment
items.s: In ______ ______ the speaker pauses after a few sentences, and then the interpreter repeats the message in the other language.
items.zh: 在逐步口譯中，講者說幾句後會停頓，然後口譯員用另一種語言重述訊息。

items.def: to replace the voices in a film with another language
items.s: Many cartoons are ________ into Mandarin for young children, because they cannot read subtitles fast enough.
items.zh: 許多卡通會配上國語給幼兒看，因為他們讀字幕的速度不夠快。

items.def: to change a product to suit a local market and language
items.s: The company had to ________ its game for Taiwan, so it changed the jokes and added local foods to the story.
items.zh: 這家公司必須為台灣把遊戲在地化，所以它改了笑話，並在故事中加入了當地食物。

items.def: the work of adding translated words at the bottom of a screen
items.s: ________ is harder than it looks, because translators must fit each line into the screen while people are still speaking.
items.zh: 字幕翻譯比看起來難，因為譯者必須在人物仍在說話時把每一行塞進螢幕裡。

items.def: a translation that follows the words exactly
items.s: A ______ ______ of "break a leg" sounds terrible in Chinese, but the phrase actually means "good luck" to actors.
items.zh: 「break a leg」的直譯在中文裡聽起來很可怕，但這個片語對演員來說其實是「祝好運」的意思。

items.def: a translation that keeps the meaning but changes the words
items.s: The poet chose a ______ ______, because keeping the rhyme and feeling was more important to her than copying every word.
items.zh: 這位詩人選擇了意譯，因為對她來說保留押韻和情感比照抄每個字更重要。

items.def: translating a text back into its first language to check it
items.s: The medical team used ________ to check the survey, so a second translator turned the Chinese version back into English.
items.zh: 醫療團隊用回譯來檢查問卷，所以由第二位譯者把中文版翻回英文。

items.def: keeping close to the original meaning
items.s: Her translation is ________ to the original novel, but it also reads naturally, which is why it won an award.
items.zh: 她的譯文忠於原著小說，但讀起來也很自然，這就是它得獎的原因。

items.def: impossible to translate exactly
items.s: The Danish word "hygge" is often called ________, because no single English word captures that cosy, happy feeling.
items.zh: 丹麥字「hygge」常被稱為無法翻譯的，因為沒有一個英文字能抓住那種溫馨、快樂的感覺。

items.def: a short explanation of a difficult word in a text
items.s: The textbook gives a Chinese ________ beside each difficult word, so students can keep reading without opening a dictionary.
items.zh: 課本在每個難字旁邊都附上中文註解，所以學生不用翻字典就能繼續讀下去。

items.def: a note at the bottom of a page
items.s: The translator added a ________ to explain the Chinese joke, because English readers would not understand it otherwise.
items.zh: 譯者加了一個註腳來解釋這個中文笑話，因為否則英文讀者不會懂。

items.def: a small soundproof room where interpreters work
items.s: The two interpreters sat in a glass ______ ______ at the back of the hall, and they could see every speaker clearly.
items.zh: 兩位口譯員坐在大廳後方的玻璃口譯廂裡，而他們能清楚看到每位講者。

items.def: a small device worn in the ear to hear sound
items.s: Each delegate wore an ________ during the meeting, so they could hear the speech in their own language.
items.zh: 每位代表在會議中都戴著耳機，所以他們能聽到用自己語言播出的演講。

items.def: reading a document in one language aloud in another
items.s: The court interpreter did a ______ ______ of the letter, so she read the Vietnamese text aloud in Chinese for the judge.
items.zh: 法庭口譯員對那封信做了視譯，所以她把越南文內容直接用中文唸給法官聽。

items.def: an interpreter who works in courtrooms
items.s: The ______ ______ must translate every word exactly, because a small mistake could change the result of a trial.
items.zh: 法庭口譯員必須精確翻譯每一個字，因為一個小錯誤就可能改變審判的結果。

items.def: changing spoken words into written words automatically
items.s: The teacher uses a ________ app in class, so deaf students can read her words on their tablets as she speaks.
items.zh: 老師在課堂上使用語音轉文字的應用程式，所以聽障學生能在她說話時從平板上讀到她的話。

items.def: a phone program that translates words or speech
items.s: We used a ______ ______ to read the menu in Seoul, but it translated one dish as "angry chicken", which made us laugh.
items.zh: 我們在首爾用翻譯應用程式看菜單，但它把一道菜翻成「生氣的雞」，讓我們笑了出來。

items.def: computer translation that uses AI networks to learn from data
items.s: ______ ______ ______ produces smoother sentences than older systems, because it looks at whole sentences instead of single words.
items.zh: 神經機器翻譯產生的句子比舊系統更流暢，因為它看的是整個句子而不是單一的字。

items.def: fixing a machine translation by a human
items.s: Many translators now do ________, so they check and correct AI translations instead of starting from a blank page.
items.zh: 許多譯者現在做譯後編輯，所以他們檢查和修正 AI 的翻譯，而不是從一張白紙開始。

items.def: the two languages a translator works between
items.s: Her main ______ ______ is Japanese to Chinese, but she also accepts some simple English projects.
items.zh: 她主要的語言對是日譯中，但她也接一些簡單的英文案子。

items.def: a voice heard in a film or video without seeing the speaker
items.s: The documentary had a Chinese ________, so we could understand the story while we watched the animals in Africa.
items.zh: 這部紀錄片有中文旁白，所以我們能一邊看非洲的動物，一邊了解故事內容。

items.def: technology that translates spoken language aloud
items.s: New earbuds offer instant ______ ______, so two travellers can talk to each other even if they share no language.
items.zh: 新型耳機提供即時語音翻譯，所以即使兩位旅客沒有共通語言，也能彼此交談。

items.def: a group of languages that come from one older language
items.s: English and Hindi belong to the same ______ ______, although speakers of the two languages cannot understand each other today.
items.zh: 英文和印地文屬於同一個語系，雖然兩種語言的使用者如今無法聽懂彼此。
items.sec: World Languages & Language Change 世界語言與語言變遷

items.def: a shared language used by people with different first languages
items.s: English has become a ______ ______ in international business, so a Japanese manager and a Brazilian client may talk in English.
items.zh: 英文已成為國際商務的通用語，所以一位日本經理和一位巴西客戶可能會用英文交談。
items.sec: World Languages & Language Change 世界語言與語言變遷

items.def: a language used by a government and in law
items.s: Canada has two ______ ______, so road signs and food labels there use both English and French.
items.zh: 加拿大有兩種官方語言，所以那裡的路標和食品標籤同時使用英文和法文。
items.sec: World Languages & Language Change 世界語言與語言變遷

items.def: a language spoken by a small part of a population
items.s: Welsh is a ______ ______ in the UK, but children can now study all their subjects in Welsh at many schools.
items.zh: 威爾斯語在英國是一種少數語言，但現在許多學校的孩子可以用威爾斯語學習所有科目。
items.sec: World Languages & Language Change 世界語言與語言變遷

items.def: a language that may soon have no speakers
items.s: An ______ ______ often has only older speakers, because young people move to cities and use the national language instead.
items.zh: 瀕危語言常常只剩年長的使用者，因為年輕人搬到城市並改用國家語言。
items.sec: World Languages & Language Change 世界語言與語言變遷

items.def: when the last speakers of a language die out
items.s: ______ ______ is happening faster than ever, and experts believe half of the world's languages may disappear this century.
items.zh: 語言消亡正以前所未有的速度發生，而專家認為世界上一半的語言可能會在本世紀消失。
items.sec: World Languages & Language Change 世界語言與語言變遷

items.def: efforts to bring a disappearing language back into use
items.s: Hebrew is the most famous ______ ______ story, because it became an everyday language again after many centuries.
items.zh: 希伯來文是最有名的語言復振故事，因為它在許多世紀後再次成為日常語言。
items.sec: World Languages & Language Change 世界語言與語言變遷

items.def: a language that grew from mixing two languages and became a first language
items.s: In Haiti most people speak a French-based ________, and children learn it at home as their first language.
items.zh: 在海地，大多數人說一種以法文為基礎的克里奧爾語，而孩子們在家把它當作第一語言學習。
items.sec: World Languages & Language Change 世界語言與語言變遷

items.def: a simple mixed language used for trade between groups
items.s: Sailors and traders once used a simple ________ to do business, although nobody spoke it as their mother tongue.
items.zh: 水手和商人曾經用一種簡單的混雜語做生意，雖然沒有人把它當作母語。
items.sec: World Languages & Language Change 世界語言與語言變遷

items.def: when speakers of different languages meet and influence each other
items.s: Taiwanese Mandarin has many Japanese and Hokkien words because of ______ ______, and these words are now part of daily life.
items.zh: 由於語言接觸，台灣華語有許多日語和閩南語詞彙，而這些詞如今已成為日常生活的一部分。
items.sec: World Languages & Language Change 世界語言與語言變遷

items.def: English used around the world as an international language
items.s: Teachers who promote ______ ______ say that clear communication matters more than sounding British or American.
items.zh: 推廣全球英語的老師說，清楚溝通比聽起來像英國人或美國人更重要。
items.sec: World Languages & Language Change 世界語言與語言變遷

items.def: the different kinds of English used in different countries
items.s: Singapore, India and Nigeria all have their own ______ ______, and each variety has special words and accents.
items.zh: 新加坡、印度和奈及利亞都有自己的世界英語變體，而每一種都有特別的詞彙和口音。
items.sec: World Languages & Language Change 世界語言與語言變遷

items.def: a phrase translated word by word from another language
items.s: "Long time no see" may be a ________ from Chinese, because it follows the Chinese word order rather than normal English grammar.
items.zh: 「Long time no see」可能是來自中文的仿譯詞，因為它遵循中文的詞序，而不是一般的英文文法。
items.sec: World Languages & Language Change 世界語言與語言變遷

items.def: when a community stops using one language and uses another
items.s: In many immigrant families a ______ ______ happens within three generations, so the grandchildren speak only the new country's language.
items.zh: 在許多移民家庭中，語言轉移在三代之內就會發生，所以孫子輩只會說新國家的語言。
items.sec: World Languages & Language Change 世界語言與語言變遷

items.def: the final living person who speaks a language
items.s: When the ______ ______ of a language dies, many old songs and stories can disappear unless someone records them first.
items.zh: 當一種語言的最後一位使用者去世時，許多古老的歌曲和故事可能就此消失，除非有人先把它們錄下來。
items.sec: World Languages & Language Change 世界語言與語言變遷

items.def: stories and knowledge passed on by speaking, not writing
items.s: The tribe had no written language, but its ______ ______ kept their history alive, because elders told the stories again and again.
items.zh: 這個部落沒有文字，但他們的口述傳統讓歷史延續下來，因為長老們一再地講述那些故事。
items.sec: World Languages & Language Change 世界語言與語言變遷

items.def: the variety of different languages in a place
items.s: Papua New Guinea has amazing ______ ______, because more than 800 languages are spoken there by fewer than ten million people.
items.zh: 巴布亞紐幾內亞擁有驚人的語言多樣性，因為不到一千萬人在那裡使用超過八百種語言。
items.sec: World Languages & Language Change 世界語言與語言變遷

items.def: a government's rules about which languages are used
items.s: The new ______ ______ requires schools to teach a local language, so every pupil now has at least one hour of it each week.
items.zh: 新的語言政策要求學校教授一種本土語言，所以每位學生現在每週至少有一小時這門課。
items.sec: World Languages & Language Change 世界語言與語言變遷

items.def: teaching children in their first language
items.s: Research supports ______ ______ in the early years, because children learn to read faster in a language they already speak.
items.zh: 研究支持在早年實施母語教育，因為孩子用他們已經會說的語言學習閱讀會更快。
items.sec: World Languages & Language Change 世界語言與語言變遷

items.def: an ancient language that later languages developed from
items.s: Linguists have rebuilt many words of the ________ behind European languages, even though nobody ever wrote it down.
items.zh: 語言學家已經重建了歐洲語言背後那個原始語的許多字詞，即使從來沒有人把它寫下來。
items.sec: World Languages & Language Change 世界語言與語言變遷

items.def: an invented language created to be easy for everyone
items.s: ________ was invented in 1887 to help people from different countries communicate, and today a few thousand families still speak it at home.
items.zh: 世界語於 1887 年被發明出來，以幫助不同國家的人溝通，而如今仍有幾千個家庭在家中使用它。
items.sec: World Languages & Language Change 世界語言與語言變遷

items.def: a language that someone designed on purpose
items.s: Klingon is a ______ ______ from Star Trek, but some fans have learned it so well that they can hold whole conversations.
items.zh: 克林貢語是來自《星艦迷航記》的人造語言，但有些粉絲學得非常好，能進行完整的對話。
items.sec: World Languages & Language Change 世界語言與語言變遷

items.def: a group of people who share a language or way of speaking
items.s: Gamers form their own ______ ______ online, so outsiders often cannot understand their fast messages full of special terms.
items.zh: 玩家在網路上形成自己的言語社群，所以外人常常看不懂他們充滿專門術語的快速訊息。
items.sec: World Languages & Language Change 世界語言與語言變遷

items.def: deliberate efforts to manage how languages are used
items.s: After independence the country needed careful ______ ______, because people spoke more than twenty languages and needed one for schools.
items.zh: 獨立後這個國家需要謹慎的語言規劃，因為人們說二十多種語言，而學校需要一種共同語言。
items.sec: World Languages & Language Change 世界語言與語言變遷

items.def: the everyday language spoken by ordinary people
items.s: The priest began to preach in the ________ instead of Latin, so ordinary villagers could finally understand his message.
items.zh: 那位神父開始用白話而非拉丁文佈道，所以一般村民終於能聽懂他的訊息。
items.sec: World Languages & Language Change 世界語言與語言變遷

items.def: people's right to use their own language
items.s: Indigenous groups are fighting for ______ ______, so they can use their own languages in courts, hospitals and schools.
items.zh: 原住民族群正在爭取語言權，以便他們能在法院、醫院和學校使用自己的語言。
items.sec: World Languages & Language Change 世界語言與語言變遷

items.def: how easy something is to reach, use or understand
items.s: The museum improved the ________ of its website, so blind visitors can now listen to every page with a screen reader.
items.zh: 博物館改善了網站的易用性，所以視障訪客現在能用螢幕閱讀器聆聽每一頁。

items.def: public support for an idea or group
items.s: Her ________ for sign language helped deaf students, because the school finally hired two interpreters for its classes.
items.zh: 她對手語的倡議幫助了聽障學生，因為學校終於為課堂聘請了兩位口譯員。

items.def: the amount of something given for a purpose
items.s: The school's budget ________ for language classes was cut, so the French club had to buy its own books.
items.zh: 學校給語言課程的預算分配被刪減了，所以法文社必須自己買書。

items.def: a small change made to a law or document
items.s: Parliament passed an ________ to the education law, and now every primary school must offer a local language.
items.zh: 國會通過了教育法的修正案，現在每所小學都必須開設一種本土語言課程。

items.def: extra information at the end of a book or report
items.s: The grammar book has a useful ________ of irregular verbs, so I check it whenever I am not sure about a past tense.
items.zh: 這本文法書有一份實用的不規則動詞附錄，所以每當我不確定過去式時就會查看它。

items.def: understanding and enjoying the value of something
items.s: Learning Japanese gave me a deeper ________ of anime, because I could finally catch the jokes that subtitles missed.
items.zh: 學日文讓我對動漫有更深的體會，因為我終於能聽懂字幕漏掉的笑話。

items.def: a promise that makes someone feel confident
items.s: The company gave customers an ________ that every translation would be checked twice, so many hospitals chose its service.
items.zh: 這家公司向客戶保證每份翻譯都會檢查兩次，所以許多醫院選擇了它的服務。

items.def: saying who wrote or created something
items.s: You must give clear ________ when you use a quote from a book, or your essay may be marked as plagiarised.
items.zh: 當你引用書中的句子時必須清楚標明出處，否則你的文章可能被判定為抄襲。

items.def: a story with a hidden moral or political meaning
items.s: Animal Farm looks like a story about pigs, but it is really an ________ about power, and students discuss it in class.
items.zh: 《動物農莊》看似一個關於豬的故事，但它其實是一則關於權力的寓言，學生們會在課堂上討論它。

items.def: an indirect mention of something
items.s: The speech contained an ________ to a famous Chinese poem, so the foreign guests needed the interpreter to explain it.
items.zh: 演講中包含了一個著名中國詩詞的典故，所以外國賓客需要口譯員解釋。

items.def: something placed in the wrong historical time
items.s: The film about ancient Rome had an ________ in one scene, because a soldier was clearly wearing a wristwatch.
items.zh: 那部關於古羅馬的電影在某個場景中有時代錯置的錯誤，因為一名士兵明顯戴著手錶。

items.def: a short interesting story about a real event
items.s: The professor began with a funny ________ about getting lost in Paris, and everyone relaxed before the serious lecture.
items.zh: 教授以一個在巴黎迷路的好笑小故事開場，而大家在嚴肅的講座開始前都放鬆了。

items.def: the exact opposite
items.s: His careless speaking style is the ________ of his sister's, because she plans every word before she opens her mouth.
items.zh: 他隨便的說話風格和他姊姊的正好相反，因為她開口前會規劃好每個字。

items.def: approval or praise
items.s: The young translator won the ________ of the famous author, so her name now appears on the cover of the new edition.
items.zh: 這位年輕譯者贏得了知名作家的讚許，所以她的名字現在出現在新版的封面上。

items.def: a person who judges what is right or correct
items.s: Many people treat the Oxford dictionary as the final ________ of correct English, but language keeps changing anyway.
items.zh: 許多人把牛津字典當作正確英文的最終裁定者，但語言無論如何都在不斷變化。

items.def: agreement or approval
items.s: The teacher nodded her ________, so we started recording our English podcast during the lunch break.
items.zh: 老師點頭表示同意，所以我們在午休時間開始錄製英文播客。

items.def: honest and open speech
items.s: I appreciated my tutor's ________ about my accent, because she told me exactly which sounds I needed to fix.
items.zh: 我很感謝家教對我口音的坦率，因為她準確告訴我哪些音需要改正。

items.def: a release of strong emotions that makes you feel better
items.s: Writing a diary in English was a kind of ________ for her, because she could express feelings she could not say aloud.
items.zh: 用英文寫日記對她來說是一種情緒宣洩，因為她能表達說不出口的感受。

items.def: using many words when a few would do
items.s: When you forget a word, ________ can help you, so you might say "the thing that opens doors" instead of "key".
items.zh: 當你忘記一個字時，迂迴說法能幫助你，所以你可以說「開門的東西」而不是「鑰匙」。

items.def: a book with a lot of information on one subject
items.s: My uncle gave me a ________ of English idioms, and I read a few pages on the bus every morning.
items.zh: 我叔叔送我一本英文慣用語彙編，而我每天早上在公車上讀幾頁。

items.def: polite and correct behaviour
items.s: The students behaved with great ________ during the ceremony, but they started shouting and laughing as soon as it ended.
items.zh: 學生們在典禮中表現得非常得體，但典禮一結束他們就開始大叫大笑。

items.def: a feeling that something is not worth respect
items.s: Some people show ________ for text-message slang, but linguists see it as a creative new way of writing.
items.zh: 有些人對簡訊俚語表現出輕蔑，但語言學家把它看作一種有創意的新書寫方式。

items.def: a lack of agreement or harmony
items.s: There was a clear ________ between the minister's words and his actions, so voters stopped believing his promises.
items.zh: 部長的言行之間有明顯的不一致，所以選民不再相信他的承諾。

items.def: dishonest behaviour meant to trick people
items.s: The salesman's ________ shocked us, because he said the phone was new while he knew it had been repaired.
items.zh: 那位推銷員的欺騙行為讓我們震驚，因為他明知手機修過卻說是全新的。

items.def: a speech praising someone who has died
items.s: My cousin gave a moving ________ at our grandfather's funeral, and she spoke in both Hakka and Mandarin.
items.zh: 我表姊在爺爺的葬禮上發表了一篇感人的悼詞，而且她用客家話和國語兩種語言說。

items.def: a small weakness in someone's character
items.s: Correcting everyone's grammar is my teacher's only ________, but we forgive her because she is so kind.
items.zh: 糾正每個人的文法是我們老師唯一的小怪癖，但我們原諒她，因為她人非常好。

items.def: clever but dishonest behaviour
items.s: The fox in the story uses ________ to steal the crow's cheese, so the lesson is to be careful of people who flatter you.
items.zh: 故事中的狐狸用詭計偷走了烏鴉的起司，所以寓意是要小心奉承你的人。

items.def: an idea that strongly opposes accepted beliefs
items.s: Splitting an infinitive was once seen as ________ by grammar teachers, but most writers today think it is perfectly fine.
items.zh: 拆開不定詞曾被文法老師視為異端，但現今大多數作家認為這完全沒問題。

items.def: too much pride and self-confidence
items.s: The student's ________ led him to skip revision, because he believed his English was perfect, but he failed the writing test.
items.zh: 那名學生的狂妄自大讓他略過複習，因為他相信自己的英文完美無缺，但他寫作測驗不及格。

items.def: a person who attacks traditional ideas
items.cn: 反傳統者；打破舊習的人
items.s: The poet was an ________ who ignored punctuation rules, and young readers loved her daring style.
items.zh: 這位詩人是一個反傳統的人，她無視標點符號規則，而年輕讀者喜愛她大膽的風格。

items.def: humour in a serious situation
items.s: A little ________ helped the nervous candidates, so the examiner told a short joke before the speaking test began.
items.zh: 一點輕鬆幽默幫助了緊張的考生，所以考官在口說測驗開始前講了個小笑話。

items.def: a person who thinks and acts independently
items.s: The new teacher was a ________ who taught grammar through rap songs, and the students' scores rose quickly.
items.zh: 新老師是個特立獨行的人，他透過饒舌歌教文法，而學生的成績迅速提高。

items.def: a beginner
items.s: As a ________ in Korean, I could only say hello and thank you, but the shop owners still smiled and helped me.
items.zh: 身為韓文初學者，我只會說你好和謝謝，但店主們還是微笑著幫助我。

items.def: a happy but sad feeling about the past
items.s: Hearing her hometown dialect filled her with ________, because it reminded her of summers at her grandmother's house.
items.zh: 聽到家鄉的方言讓她充滿懷舊之情，因為那讓她想起在外婆家度過的夏天。

items.def: a perfect example of a quality
items.s: Our principal is a ________ of patience, because she listens to every student calmly even when they are shouting.
items.zh: 我們校長是耐心的典範，因為即使學生大吼大叫，她也會冷靜地聆聽每個人。

items.def: a person who is rejected by others
items.s: After he posted rude comments online, the singer became a ________, and many fans stopped buying his music.
items.zh: 在網上發布無禮留言後，這位歌手成了被排斥的人，許多粉絲不再買他的音樂。

items.def: a strong liking for something
items.s: The author has a ________ for long sentences, so translators often have to split them into shorter ones in Chinese.
items.zh: 這位作家偏好長句子，所以譯者常常必須在中文裡把它們拆成較短的句子。

items.def: complete honesty
items.s: Interpreters must show great ________, because they hear secret information and must never share it with anyone.
items.zh: 口譯員必須展現高度的正直，因為他們會聽到機密資訊，而且絕不能與任何人分享。

items.def: the main character in a story
items.s: The ________ of the novel is a young interpreter, and the story follows her life during the war.
items.zh: 這部小說的主角是一位年輕的口譯員，而故事描寫她在戰爭期間的生活。

items.def: long-lasting anger and bitterness
items.s: The two writers argued for years, but there was no ________ between them, because they still respected each other's work.
items.zh: 兩位作家爭論了好幾年，但他們之間沒有怨恨，因為他們仍然尊重彼此的作品。

items.def: a thin outer appearance that hides the truth
items.s: Under a ________ of politeness, the letter was actually very angry, and the translator worked hard to keep that hidden tone.
items.zh: 在禮貌的表面下，這封信其實非常憤怒，而譯者努力保留那種隱藏的語氣。

items.def: a person who praises powerful people to get advantages
items.s: The manager was surrounded by ________ who agreed with every idea, so nobody warned him about the bad translation.
items.zh: 經理身邊圍繞著什麼想法都附和的馬屁精，所以沒有人提醒他那份翻譯很糟。

items.def: the process of the world becoming more connected
items.s: ________ has made English more useful, but it has also put pressure on many small local languages.
items.zh: 全球化讓英文變得更有用，但也對許多當地的小語種造成壓力。

items.def: allowed or accepted, especially in court
items.s: The recording was not ________ in court, because the translation had not been checked by an official interpreter.
items.zh: 那段錄音在法庭上不可被採納，因為翻譯沒有經過官方口譯員檢查。

items.def: friendly and easy to talk to
items.s: The ________ shopkeeper chatted with us in slow English, so even my little brother felt brave enough to answer.
items.zh: 那位和藹可親的店主用慢速的英文和我們聊天，所以連我弟弟都有勇氣回答。

items.def: pleasant and friendly
items.s: My host father was an ________ man who corrected my mistakes gently, and he never made me feel stupid.
items.zh: 我的寄宿爸爸是個親切的人，他溫和地糾正我的錯誤，從不讓我覺得自己很笨。

items.def: friendly and without arguments
items.s: The two companies reached an ________ agreement, so the translation project continued without any lawyers.
items.zh: 兩家公司達成了友好的協議，所以翻譯計畫在沒有律師介入的情況下繼續進行。

items.def: very suitable for the situation
items.s: She closed her speech with an ________ proverb, and the audience clapped because it matched the topic perfectly.
items.zh: 她用一句貼切的諺語結束演講，觀眾都鼓掌了，因為它完美地呼應了主題。

items.def: demanding total obedience
items.s: The ________ government banned books in minority languages, but families kept teaching their children at home in secret.
items.zh: 專制的政府禁止少數語言的書籍，但家庭們仍在家中秘密地教孩子。

items.def: ordinary and boring
items.s: The song's lyrics were ________, but the melody was so catchy that it became a hit anyway.
items.zh: 這首歌的歌詞平淡無奇，但旋律非常好記，所以它還是紅了。

items.def: confused and puzzled
items.s: The tourist looked ________ when the waiter answered in fast Taiwanese, so I explained the menu to him in English.
items.zh: 當服務生用快速的台語回答時，那位觀光客看起來很困惑，所以我用英文為他解釋菜單。

items.def: involving two groups or countries
items.s: The two countries signed a ________ agreement, so students can now study the other country's language with free scholarships.
items.zh: 兩國簽署了一項雙邊協議，所以學生現在能獲得免費獎學金去學習對方國家的語言。

items.def: using big words to sound important
items.s: His essay was full of ________ language, but the teacher said simple and clear words would have been much better.
items.zh: 他的文章充滿浮誇的語言，但老師說簡單清楚的字會好得多。

items.def: real and genuine
items.s: Only ______ ______ students can get the discount, so you must show your student card at the language centre.
items.zh: 只有真正的學生才能享有折扣，所以你必須在語言中心出示學生證。

items.def: short and rude in speech
items.s: The officer's ________ reply upset the tourist, but maybe he was just tired and not good at English.
items.zh: 那位官員粗魯簡短的回答讓觀光客不高興，但也許他只是累了，而且英文不好。

items.def: very critical in a cruel way
items.s: The critic wrote a ________ review of the translation, but readers still loved the book and bought thousands of copies.
items.zh: 那位評論家對譯本寫了一篇尖酸刻薄的評論，但讀者仍然喜愛這本書，買了好幾千本。

items.def: trying to end an argument and make peace
items.s: After the argument, he sent a ________ message in Chinese and English, so his friend finally agreed to talk again.
items.zh: 爭吵後，他用中英文發了一則和解的訊息，所以他朋友終於同意再談一談。

items.def: matching or in agreement with something
items.s: Your body language should be ________ with your words, because a smile with angry words confuses the listener.
items.zh: 你的肢體語言應該和你說的話一致，因為帶著微笑說生氣的話會讓聽者困惑。

items.def: showing no respect
items.s: He gave a ________ laugh when I made a grammar mistake, so I decided to practise with a kinder partner.
items.zh: 我犯文法錯誤時他發出輕蔑的笑聲，所以我決定和一位更友善的夥伴練習。

items.def: very complicated and hard to follow
items.s: The instructions were so ________ that nobody could follow them, so the company rewrote them in plain English.
items.zh: 那些說明複雜難懂到沒人能照著做，所以公司用淺白的英文重寫了。

items.def: too ready to believe things
items.s: My ________ little sister believed that eating carrots would help her speak French, and she ate five that day.
items.zh: 我那容易輕信的妹妹相信吃紅蘿蔔能幫助她說法文，結果她那天吃了五根。

items.def: quick and skilful
items.s: The interpreter made a ________ change to the joke, so the Chinese audience laughed at exactly the right moment.
items.zh: 口譯員對那個笑話做了巧妙的改動，所以中文觀眾在恰當的時刻笑了出來。

items.def: shy and lacking confidence
items.s: She was ________ about speaking English at first, but the friendly class helped her become one of the most active students.
items.zh: 她一開始對說英文缺乏自信，但友善的班級幫助她成為最活躍的學生之一。

items.def: very small
items.s: The ________ girl had a surprisingly loud voice, so she won the school speech contest without a microphone.
items.zh: 那個嬌小的女孩有著驚人的大嗓門，所以她沒用麥克風就贏得了學校演講比賽。

items.def: showing a lot of feeling, especially praise
items.cn: 熱情洋溢的；過分熱情的
items.s: The author sent the translator an ________ thank-you letter, and she hung it on the wall above her desk.
items.zh: 作家寄給譯者一封熱情洋溢的感謝信，而她把信掛在書桌上方的牆上。

items.def: very happy and excited
items.s: I was ________ when I got band 7 in IELTS, so I called my parents right away and we went out for dinner.
items.zh: 我雅思考到 7 分時欣喜若狂，所以我馬上打電話給爸媽，然後我們出去吃晚餐。

items.def: joking at the wrong time
items.s: His ________ comment during the serious budget meeting annoyed the boss, so he apologised to her later that afternoon.
items.zh: 他在嚴肅的預算會議中說了一句不正經的話惹惱了老闆，所以他那天下午稍晚向她道歉了。

items.def: changing your mind often
items.s: Teenagers can be ________ about slang, so a word that is cool this month may sound silly next year.
items.zh: 青少年對俚語可能很善變，所以這個月很酷的字明年可能聽起來很蠢。

items.def: secret and trying not to be noticed
items.s: The student took a ________ look at his phone dictionary, but the examiner noticed and took it away.
items.zh: 那名學生偷偷摸摸地看了一眼手機字典，但考官注意到並把它拿走了。

items.def: talking too much about unimportant things
items.s: The ________ taxi driver talked for the whole trip, but it was great listening practice for my Spanish.
items.zh: 那位喋喋不休的計程車司機整趟車程都在說話，但這對我的西班牙文是很好的聽力練習。

items.def: speaking easily but without thinking carefully
items.s: The politician gave a ________ answer about education, so reporters asked him again for real details.
items.zh: 那位政治人物對教育問題給了一個隨口敷衍的回答，所以記者再次追問具體細節。

items.def: used so often that it is no longer interesting
items.s: "At the end of the day" is a ________ phrase, so try to find fresher words in your IELTS essay.
items.zh: 「At the end of the day」是一個陳腔濫調的片語，所以在你的雅思作文中試著找更新鮮的字詞。

items.def: proud and unfriendly to others
items.s: The ________ waiter laughed at my French pronunciation, but the chef came out and kindly helped me order.
items.zh: 那位傲慢的服務生嘲笑我的法文發音，但主廚走出來親切地幫我點餐。

items.def: showing no emotion
items.s: The interpreter kept an ________ face during the angry speech, because her job was to translate, not to react.
items.zh: 口譯員在那場憤怒的演講中保持面無表情，因為她的工作是翻譯，而不是做出反應。

items.def: rude and not showing respect
