items.s: Asking someone's salary can seem ________ in English-speaking countries, so it is better to avoid that question.
items.zh: 在英語系國家詢問別人的薪水可能顯得無禮，所以最好避免那個問題。

items.def: impossible to calm or change
items.cn: 無法平息的；毫不妥協的
items.s: The teacher was ________ about mobile phones, so any phone seen during the test was taken away until Friday.
items.zh: 老師對手機毫不妥協，所以考試中被看到的任何手機都會被沒收到星期五。

items.def: silly and without meaning
items.s: The chatbot gave an ________ answer to my question, so I checked a real grammar book instead.
items.zh: 聊天機器人對我的問題給了一個空洞的回答，所以我改去查一本真正的文法書。

items.def: not clear or easy to understand
items.s: He was so tired after the flight that his speech was ________, so we let him sleep before asking any more questions.
items.zh: 他飛行後非常疲累，說話語無倫次，所以我們讓他先睡覺再問更多問題。

items.def: unable to be changed or improved
items.cn: 無可救藥的；積習難改的
items.s: My brother is an ________ joker, so even during serious family dinners he keeps making silly puns.
items.zh: 我弟弟是個無可救藥的愛開玩笑者，所以即使在嚴肅的家庭晚餐上他也一直講冷雙關語。

items.def: not able to believe something
items.s: My friends were ________ when I said I had learned Korean in one year, so I spoke to them in Korean to prove it.
items.zh: 當我說我一年就學會韓文時，朋友們都不敢相信，所以我用韓文跟他們說話來證明。

items.def: never getting tired
items.s: The ________ volunteer taught Chinese to refugees every evening, and she still came to work early the next morning.
items.zh: 那位不知疲倦的志工每天晚上教難民中文，而且隔天早上仍然提早上班。

items.def: too great to be described in words
items.s: Standing on the mountain at sunrise gave me an ________ feeling, so I just stayed quiet and took no photos.
items.zh: 日出時站在山上給了我一種難以言喻的感覺，所以我只是靜靜地待著，沒有拍照。

items.def: never wrong
items.cn: 絕對正確的；萬無一失的
items.s: Translation apps are useful but not ________, so you should check important documents with a real person.
items.zh: 翻譯應用程式很有用但並非萬無一失，所以重要文件應該找真人確認。

items.def: innocent and trusting
items.s: The child's ________ question about why adults lie made everyone at the table laugh, but it also made us think.
items.zh: 那孩子問大人為什麼說謊這個天真的問題讓餐桌上的每個人都笑了，但也讓我們陷入思考。

items.def: impossible to understand or read
items.cn: 難以理解的；高深莫測的
items.s: The professor's ________ smile made us nervous, because we could not tell whether she liked our presentation.
items.zh: 教授高深莫測的微笑讓我們很緊張，因為我們看不出她是否喜歡我們的報告。

items.def: without interest or flavour
items.s: The textbook dialogues were ________, so our teacher used real TV clips, and the class became much more lively.
items.zh: 課本裡的對話很乏味，所以老師改用真實的電視片段，而課堂變得生動多了。

items.def: refusing to change your opinion
items.s: The two sides were ________ about the name of the new language school, so the meeting went on for four hours.
items.zh: 雙方對新語言學校的名稱互不讓步，所以會議進行了四個小時。

items.def: not showing respect for serious things
items.s: The comedian's ________ jokes about grammar teachers were very popular, although a few teachers in the audience were not amused.
items.zh: 那位喜劇演員對文法老師的調侃笑話很受歡迎，雖然觀眾中有幾位老師並不覺得好笑。

items.def: funny and joking
items.s: Our principal gave a ________ speech at graduation, so the parents laughed and the nervous students relaxed.
items.zh: 我們校長在畢業典禮上發表了一篇詼諧的演講，所以家長們笑了，緊張的學生也放鬆了。

items.def: using very few words
items.s: My grandfather is ________ and usually answers with one word, but he tells long stories when he talks about his childhood.
items.zh: 我爺爺話很少，通常只回答一個字，但談起童年時他會講很長的故事。

items.def: very bright or clear
items.s: Critics praised the ________ prose of the translation, because every sentence felt as clear and bright as the original.
items.zh: 評論家讚揚譯本清澈明亮的文筆，因為每個句子都感覺和原著一樣清晰明亮。

items.def: kind and generous, especially to a rival
items.s: The champion was ________ after the debate, so she praised her opponent's arguments and shook hands warmly.
items.zh: 冠軍在辯論賽後寬宏大量，她稱讚對手的論點並熱情地握手。

items.def: wanting to harm others
items.s: The ________ character in the story spreads lies in every village, but a young girl finally reveals the truth.
items.zh: 故事中那個惡毒的角色在每個村莊散布謊言，但一個年輕女孩最終揭露了真相。

items.def: not telling the truth
items.s: The advertisement made ________ claims about learning English in a week, so many parents complained to the government.
items.zh: 那則廣告做出一週學會英文的虛假聲明，所以許多家長向政府投訴。

items.def: changing mood quickly and suddenly
items.s: The director had a ________ temper, so the actors never knew whether he would laugh or shout at them.
items.zh: 導演的脾氣反覆無常，所以演員們永遠不知道他會笑還是對他們大吼。

items.def: unhappy and quiet
items.s: He was ________ after failing the speaking test, but his teacher encouraged him, and he passed on his second try.
items.zh: 他口說測驗不及格後悶悶不樂，但老師鼓勵他，而他第二次就通過了。

items.def: unclear and not well defined
items.s: His plan to "improve English" was too ________, so his tutor asked him to set a clear goal for each week.
items.zh: 他「提升英文」的計畫太模糊了，所以家教要求他為每週設定一個明確的目標。

items.def: calm and not worried
items.cn: 若無其事的；漫不經心的
items.s: She looked ________ before the interview, but she told me later that her hands were shaking under the table.
items.zh: 她面試前看起來若無其事，但她後來告訴我，她的手在桌子底下發抖。

items.def: too eager to please or obey
items.s: The ________ assistant agreed with everything the director said, so the bad ideas were never questioned.
items.zh: 那位諂媚的助理附和導演說的每件事，所以那些糟糕的想法從未受到質疑。

items.def: slow to understand
items.s: I felt ________ when I missed the joke in English, but my friend kindly explained the wordplay to me.
items.zh: 當我沒聽懂英文笑話時覺得自己很遲鈍，但朋友親切地向我解釋了那個文字遊戲。

items.def: showing off wealth or knowledge
items.s: He used ________ words in every sentence to impress people, but most listeners just found him hard to understand.
items.zh: 他每句話都用炫耀式的艱深字詞來給人留下印象，但大多數聽眾只覺得他很難懂。

items.def: childishly bad-tempered
items.s: The ________ boy threw his workbook on the floor, because he did not want to practise spelling any more.
items.zh: 那個任性的男孩把作業簿丟到地上，因為他不想再練習拼字了。

items.def: making you feel sad and moved
items.s: The film ends with a ________ letter from a soldier to his mother, and many people in the cinema started to cry.
items.zh: 這部電影以一封士兵寫給母親的感人信件作結，而電影院裡許多人開始哭泣。

items.def: doing something without the right or permission
items.s: It may seem ________ to call your professor by her first name, so wait until she invites you to do it.
items.zh: 直接叫教授的名字可能顯得冒昧，所以要等她邀請你這麼做。

items.def: ordinary and without imagination
items.s: The poem was translated into ________ language, so the beautiful images of the original were lost.
items.zh: 這首詩被翻譯成平淡無奇的語言，所以原作中美麗的意象都消失了。

items.def: narrow-minded and not interested in the wider world
items.s: Travelling abroad made her less ________, because she learned that many cultures see the world differently.
items.zh: 出國旅行讓她變得不那麼眼界狹隘，因為她了解到許多文化以不同方式看世界。

items.def: very careful about details and rules
items.s: The editor is ________ about commas, so she checks every page twice before the book goes to print.
items.zh: 那位編輯對逗號一絲不苟，所以書付印前她會把每一頁檢查兩次。

items.def: loud and rough
items.s: The ________ crowd at the night market made it hard to hear, so we had to shout our orders at the food stall.
items.zh: 夜市喧鬧的人群讓人很難聽清楚，所以我們必須在小吃攤大聲喊出點餐內容。

items.def: refusing to obey or cooperate
items.s: The ________ printer refused to work all morning, so we had to hand in our essays by email instead.
items.zh: 那台不聽使喚的印表機整個早上都不肯運作，所以我們只好改用電子郵件交作文。

items.def: full of something
items.s: Shakespeare's plays are ________ with expressions we still use, like "break the ice" and "wild-goose chase".
items.zh: 莎士比亞的戲劇充滿我們至今仍在使用的說法，例如「break the ice」和「wild-goose chase」。

items.def: very bad and deserving blame
items.s: Copying a classmate's translation is ________, so the teacher gave both students a zero and called their parents.
items.zh: 抄襲同學的翻譯是應受譴責的，所以老師給兩名學生零分，並打電話給他們的家長。

items.def: hopeful and positive
items.s: The coach is ________ about the team's chances, but the players know they still need to train hard every day.
items.zh: 教練對球隊的勝算很樂觀，但球員們知道他們每天仍需努力訓練。

items.def: mocking in a cold, unkind way
items.s: He gave a ________ smile when I mispronounced the word, so I felt embarrassed and stopped speaking.
items.zh: 我唸錯那個字時他露出嘲諷的微笑，所以我覺得很尷尬，就不再說話了。

items.def: calm and not complaining in hard times
items.s: She stayed ________ when her luggage was lost, and she calmly explained the problem in English to the airport staff.
items.zh: 她的行李遺失時仍保持淡定，並冷靜地用英文向機場人員說明問題。

items.def: loud, harsh and forceful
items.s: The protesters made ________ demands for bilingual road signs, and the city finally agreed to change them.
items.zh: 抗議者強硬地要求設置雙語路標，而市政府最後同意更換。

items.def: extremely beautiful or excellent
items.s: The singer's voice was ________, so even people who did not understand Italian had tears in their eyes.
items.zh: 那位歌手的嗓音美妙絕倫，所以即使不懂義大利文的人也眼含淚水。

items.def: too willing to obey others
items.s: In the old story the servant is always ________, but the modern film shows him as brave and independent.
items.zh: 在舊故事中那位僕人總是卑躬屈膝，但現代電影把他描繪成勇敢又獨立的人。

items.def: done secretly
items.s: He made a ________ recording of the lecture, but the professor saw the phone and asked him to delete it.
items.zh: 他偷偷地錄下講座內容，但教授看到手機並要求他刪除。

items.def: not saying much
items.s: My ________ classmate rarely speaks in class, but his written English is the best in our year.
items.zh: 我那位沉默寡言的同學很少在課堂上說話，但他的英文寫作是我們年級最好的。

items.def: only slightly connected to the main topic
items.s: His answer was ________ to the question, so the examiner reminded him to focus on what was asked.
items.zh: 他的回答和問題關係不大，所以考官提醒他專注在被問的內容上。

items.def: very short and a little unfriendly
items.s: My manager sent a ________ reply that only said "Fix it", so I wasn't sure whether she was angry.
items.zh: 我的主管回了一則簡短生硬的訊息，只寫著「修好它」，所以我不確定她是否生氣了。

items.def: lasting only a short time
items.s: Many slang words are ________, and expressions that were popular ten years ago now sound very old-fashioned.
items.zh: 許多俚語是短暫的，十年前流行的說法現在聽起來非常過時。

items.def: clear, strong and direct in criticism
items.s: The editor's ________ comments improved my article, although they hurt my feelings when I first read them.
items.zh: 編輯一針見血的意見改善了我的文章，雖然我第一次讀時有點受傷。

items.def: modest and not wanting attention
items.s: The ________ old man in our neighbourhood never talks about himself, but he turned out to be a famous translator of Russian novels.
items.zh: 我們社區裡那位不張揚的老先生從不談論自己，但他原來是一位知名的俄文小說譯者。

items.def: polite, confident and comfortable in social situations
items.s: The ________ host made every guest feel welcome, and he switched easily between English, French and Chinese.
items.zh: 那位溫文儒雅的主人讓每位客人都感到受歡迎，而且他能輕鬆地在英文、法文和中文之間切換。

items.def: boring and empty of ideas
items.s: The talk show was full of ________ chat about celebrities, so I switched to a documentary instead.
items.zh: 那個脫口秀充滿了關於名人的空洞乏味的閒聊，所以我轉台去看紀錄片。

items.def: felt by watching or reading about others
items.cn: 間接體驗的；感同身受的
items.s: Reading travel blogs gives me ________ pleasure, because I can explore Peru without leaving my bedroom.
items.zh: 閱讀旅遊部落格帶給我間接體驗的樂趣，因為我不用離開臥室就能探索秘魯。

items.def: extremely strong, harmful or full of hate
items.s: The singer received ________ attacks online, but she replied calmly and asked her fans to be kind.
items.zh: 那位歌手在網路上遭受惡毒的攻擊，但她冷靜地回應，並請粉絲們保持善意。

items.def: full of bitter, angry criticism
items.s: The ________ letter to the newspaper attacked the new language policy, but the editor still decided to print it.
items.zh: 那封寫給報社的尖酸刻薄的信抨擊新的語言政策，但編輯仍決定刊登。

items.def: playful and unusual
items.cn: 異想天開的；古怪有趣的
items.s: The children's book has a ________ style, so the translator invented new silly words to keep the fun in Chinese.
items.zh: 這本童書有一種古怪有趣的風格，所以譯者創造了新的傻氣字詞來保留中文版的趣味。

items.def: sadly wishing for something
items.s: My grandmother gave a ________ smile when she heard the old song, because it reminded her of her school days.
items.zh: 奶奶聽到那首老歌時露出惆悵的微笑，因為那讓她想起了學生時代。

items.def: between different cultures
items.s: The exchange programme improves ________ skills, so students learn how to work with people who have very different habits.
items.zh: 這個交換計畫能提升跨文化能力，所以學生學會如何與習慣非常不同的人合作。

items.def: involving two or more cultures
items.s: Eye contact can cause ________ misunderstandings, because it seems polite in some countries but rude in others.
items.zh: 眼神接觸可能造成跨文化的誤解，因為它在某些國家顯得禮貌，在其他國家卻顯得無禮。

items.def: showing feelings clearly
items.s: Italian speakers are often very ________ with their hands, so you can sometimes guess their meaning without words.
items.zh: 說義大利語的人常常用手勢表達得很生動，所以有時不用言語你也能猜出他們的意思。

items.def: only interested in your own small area
items.s: His views on language were rather ________, but living abroad for a year opened his mind to new ideas.
items.zh: 他對語言的看法相當狹隘，但在國外生活一年讓他對新想法敞開了心胸。

items.def: large and all the same, without variety
items.cn: 單一龐大的；鐵板一塊的
items.s: English is not a ________ language, because people in Scotland, India and Jamaica all speak it in very different ways.
items.zh: 英文並不是單一不變的語言，因為蘇格蘭、印度和牙買加的人說英文的方式都非常不同。

items.def: accepting many different groups and views
items.s: Taiwan is becoming more ________, so public announcements on the MRT are now made in four different languages.
items.zh: 台灣正變得更加多元，所以捷運上的公共廣播現在用四種不同的語言播報。

items.def: to agree to a request
items.s: The school ________ to the parents' request, so Japanese is now offered as an after-school class.
items.zh: 學校同意了家長的請求，所以現在日文被列為課後課程。

items.def: to judge officially
items.s: Three teachers ________ the English speech contest, and they gave marks for content, pronunciation and confidence.
items.zh: 三位老師評判這場英文演講比賽，而他們針對內容、發音和自信心給分。

items.def: to add something at the end
items.s: Please ________ a short glossary to your report, so readers can check the technical terms quickly.
items.zh: 請在你的報告後附加一份簡短的詞彙表，好讓讀者能快速查閱專業術語。

items.def: to inform someone
items.s: The airline ________ passengers of the delay in three languages, but many people still missed the announcement.
items.zh: 航空公司用三種語言通知乘客班機延誤，但許多人仍錯過了廣播。

items.def: to scold someone angrily
items.s: The coach ________ the players for their careless mistakes, but later he apologised for shouting so loudly.
items.zh: 教練嚴厲斥責球員們粗心的失誤，但後來他為大聲吼叫道歉。

items.def: to persuade someone with gentle words
items.s: My mum ________ my little brother into reading an English book, because she promised him ice cream afterwards.
items.zh: 我媽媽哄我弟弟讀一本英文書，因為她答應他之後給他冰淇淋。

items.def: to arrange rules into a written system
items.s: Early dictionary makers tried to ________ English spelling, but many strange spellings were already too common to change.
items.zh: 早期的字典編纂者試圖把英文拼字系統化，但許多奇怪的拼法已經太普遍而無法改變。

items.def: to show you don't agree
items.s: The manager suggested working on Sunday, but several staff ________, so the meeting was moved to Monday.
items.zh: 經理建議星期天加班，但好幾位員工表示異議，所以會議改到星期一。

items.def: to express disapproval of something
items.s: Some teachers ________ the use of translation apps in class, but others think they can be useful if used carefully.
items.zh: 有些老師不贊成在課堂上使用翻譯應用程式，但其他老師認為若謹慎使用會很有用。

items.def: to explain something in detail
items.s: The professor took an hour to ________ one short poem, and she showed us how every word carried hidden meaning.
items.zh: 教授花了一小時詳細解釋一首短詩，而她讓我們看到每個字如何承載隱藏的意思。

items.def: to fill with a feeling or quality
items.s: Her grandparents ________ her with a love of Taiwanese folk songs, so she now sings them at local festivals.
items.zh: 她的祖父母讓她充滿對台灣民謠的熱愛，所以她現在會在地方節慶中演唱。

items.def: to ask someone desperately
items.s: The lost tourist ________ us to help him find his hotel, so we called the front desk and explained in Chinese.
items.zh: 那位迷路的觀光客懇求我們幫他找飯店，所以我們打給櫃台並用中文說明。

items.def: to teach an idea by repeating it often
items.s: Good teachers ________ a habit of reading every day, because regular reading builds vocabulary better than lists.
items.zh: 好老師會反覆灌輸每天閱讀的習慣，因為規律閱讀比背單字表更能增加詞彙量。

items.def: to put things here and there among other things
items.s: The speaker ________ her talk with funny stories, so the audience stayed interested for the whole hour.
items.zh: 講者在演講中穿插好笑的故事，所以觀眾整整一小時都保持興趣。

items.def: to work with and share information with others
items.s: The translator will ________ with the Japanese team, so our manager does not need to send emails in Japanese.
items.zh: 譯者將與日本團隊聯絡協調，所以我們經理不需要用日文寄電子郵件。

items.def: to make someone less angry
items.s: The waiter tried to ________ the angry customer with a free dessert, and he apologised in careful English.
items.zh: 服務生試著用一份免費甜點安撫那位生氣的顧客，並用謹慎的英文道歉。

items.def: to remove the need for something
items.s: Clear instructions ________ the need for long explanations, so the workers can start the task right away.
items.zh: 清楚的說明能免除冗長解釋的需要，所以工人能立刻開始工作。

items.def: to make an idea or law widely known
items.s: The ministry ________ a new spelling guide for schools, and teachers had to learn the changes over the summer.
items.zh: 教育部頒布了一份新的學校拼寫指南，而老師們必須在暑假學會這些改變。

items.def: to avoid giving a direct answer
items.s: When the reporter asked about the error, the spokesman began to ________, so everyone suspected he was hiding something.
items.zh: 當記者問到那個錯誤時，發言人開始支吾其詞，所以大家懷疑他在隱瞞什麼。

items.def: to change the order or position of things
items.s: Learners sometimes ________ two letters when they type quickly, so "form" and "from" are a common mix-up.
items.zh: 學習者打字很快時有時會把兩個字母對調，所以「form」和「from」是常見的混淆。

items.def: to keep changing your mind
items.s: I ________ between studying Spanish and Japanese for months, but in the end I chose Japanese because of anime.
items.zh: 我在學西班牙文和日文之間搖擺不定好幾個月，但最後因為動漫選了日文。

items.def: to annoy or worry someone
items.s: English spelling continues to ________ students, because so many words are not written the way they sound.
items.zh: 英文拼字持續困擾學生，因為許多字的寫法和發音不一樣。

items.def: to make someone angry or unfriendly
items.s: Try not to ________ your teammates by correcting their English in front of everyone, because it can be embarrassing.
items.zh: 試著不要在大家面前糾正隊友的英文而激怒他們，因為那可能令人難堪。

items.def: to do something to make up for a wrong
items.s: He wanted to ________ for his rude comments, so he wrote a long apology to his host family in their language.
items.zh: 他想彌補自己無禮的言論，所以他用寄宿家庭的語言寫了一封長長的道歉信。

items.def: to limit something
items.s: The new rules ________ the use of phones during class, but students may still use dictionaries on them.
items.zh: 新規定限制課堂上使用手機，但學生仍可用手機查字典。

items.def: to deny or disagree with something
items.s: Nobody can ________ the value of reading, but many students still prefer watching short videos.
items.zh: 沒有人能否認閱讀的價值，但許多學生仍偏好看短影片。

items.def: to say something again using different words
items.s: If the examiner does not understand you, ________ your idea in simpler words, and keep talking calmly.
items.zh: 如果考官聽不懂你的話，就用更簡單的字換個說法，並保持冷靜繼續說。

items.def: to change the words of a text
items.s: The company had to ________ its new advertisement, because the direct translation sounded quite rude to customers in Spanish.
items.zh: 這家公司必須改寫新廣告的措辭，因為直接翻譯成西班牙文後對顧客來說聽起來相當無禮。

items.def: in a way that one can replace the other
items.s: People often use "big" and "large" ________, but we say "a big mistake" much more often than "a large mistake".
items.zh: 人們常常互換使用「big」和「large」，但我們說「a big mistake」比「a large mistake」頻繁得多。

items.def: clearly and on purpose
items.s: The exam rules ________ say that phones are not allowed, so the student who used one received a zero.
items.zh: 考試規則明確規定不得使用手機，所以那名使用手機的學生得了零分。

items.def: not exactly
items.s: The film is ________ based on a true story, so many events and characters were changed for the screen.
items.zh: 這部電影是大致根據真實故事改編的，所以許多事件和角色都為了銀幕而改動。

items.def: exactly and completely
items.s: ________ speaking, a tomato is a fruit, but most people still put it in salads and call it a vegetable.
items.zh: 嚴格來說，番茄是一種水果，但大多數人仍然把它放進沙拉並稱它為蔬菜。

items.def: an explanation that makes something clearer
items.s: If you don't understand a question in the interview, ask for ________, because guessing may lead to a wrong answer.
items.zh: 如果你在面試中聽不懂問題，就要求澄清，因為瞎猜可能導致錯誤的回答。

items.def: easy to understand because it is like your own life
items.s: The novel's teenage hero is very ________, so young readers in many countries see themselves in her problems.
items.zh: 這部小說的青少年主角非常能引起共鳴，所以許多國家的年輕讀者都在她的問題中看見自己。

items.def: the rise and fall of the voice when speaking
items.s: The poet read with a gentle ________, so even listeners who did not know Welsh enjoyed the sound of her words.
items.zh: 詩人用柔和的抑揚頓挫朗讀，所以即使不懂威爾斯語的聽眾也很享受她話語的聲音。

items.def: to move your hands while talking
items.s: When we could not find the right words, we ________ wildly, and the market seller finally understood that we wanted mangoes.
items.zh: 當我們找不到適當的字時，就拼命比手畫腳，而市場攤販終於明白我們想要芒果。

items.def: talking a lot
items.s: My ________ neighbour talks to me in English every morning, so my speaking has improved without any classes.
items.zh: 我那位健談的鄰居每天早上都和我用英文聊天，所以我沒上任何課口說就進步了。

items.def: sweet and smooth to hear
items.s: The radio host has a ________ voice, so many listeners say they feel calm while they drive to work.
items.zh: 那位廣播主持人有著甜美圓潤的嗓音，所以許多聽眾說他們開車上班時感覺很平靜。

items.def: close to dying or ending
items.s: The language was ________ by 1990, but a new school programme has brought hundreds of young speakers back.
items.zh: 這種語言到 1990 年時已瀕臨消亡，但一個新的學校計畫已帶回了數百名年輕使用者。

items.def: short but full of meaning
items.s: The teacher wrote a ________ comment on my essay, and those few words helped me more than a long report.
items.zh: 老師在我的作文上寫了一句精闢的評語，而那寥寥幾個字比長篇報告更能幫助我。

items.def: a short, clever joke
items.s: The interpreter could not translate the president's ________ about cheese, so she simply told the audience it was a joke.
items.zh: 口譯員無法翻譯總統關於起司的俏皮話，所以她只好告訴觀眾那是個笑話。

items.def: quick and clever replies in conversation
items.s: The two hosts are famous for their ________, but they say it took years of practice to sound so natural.
items.zh: 兩位主持人以機智的對答聞名，但他們說花了好幾年練習才能聽起來那麼自然。

items.def: too many unnecessary words
items.s: Cut the ________ from your essay, because examiners prefer clear points to long sentences that say very little.
items.zh: 刪掉你文章中的冗詞贅字，因為考官偏好清楚的論點，而不是說了很少內容的長句。

items.def: talking a lot and quickly
items.s: The ________ tour guide explained every building in fast English, so we had to ask her to slow down.
items.zh: 那位滔滔不絕的導遊用很快的英文解說每棟建築，所以我們只好請她說慢一點。

items.def: showing amused but slightly annoyed humour
items.s: He gave a ________ smile when the app translated his name as "fried egg", but he still showed it to his friends.
items.zh: 當應用程式把他的名字翻成「煎蛋」時，他露出苦笑，但他還是拿給朋友看。

items.def: to read something carefully
items.s: Please ________ the contract before you sign it, because the English version and the Chinese version may differ.
items.zh: 簽約前請仔細閱讀合約，因為英文版和中文版可能有出入。

items.def: to give your opinion
items.s: Many people ________ online about the "correct" way to speak, but linguists say every variety has its own rules.
items.zh: 許多人在網路上發表意見談論「正確」的說話方式，但語言學家說每種語言變體都有自己的規則。

items.def: an expert who gives opinions in the media
items.s: A TV ________ claimed that young people cannot write properly any more, but the research shows a different picture.
items.zh: 一位電視評論員聲稱年輕人已經不會好好寫作了，但研究呈現出不同的情況。

items.def: relevant to the subject
items.s: Your story about your holiday is interesting, but it is not ________ to the essay question, so please remove it.
items.zh: 你關於假期的故事很有趣，但和作文題目並不相關，所以請把它刪掉。

items.def: not serious when you should be
items.s: His ________ answer about climate change annoyed the examiner, so he lost marks for not taking the topic seriously.
items.zh: 他對氣候變遷輕率的回答惹惱了考官，所以他因為沒有認真看待題目而被扣分。

items.def: friendly and cheerful
items.s: The ________ old professor invited international students to his home, and he cooked dishes from each of their countries.
items.zh: 那位和藹的老教授邀請國際學生到他家，還煮了他們每個人國家的菜。

items.def: warm and polite
items.s: The two leaders had a ________ meeting, and their interpreters said the conversation went smoothly from start to finish.
items.zh: 兩位領袖進行了一場誠懇友好的會談，而他們的口譯員說對話從頭到尾都很順利。

items.def: to teach someone in a way that improves their mind
items.s: The museum's language exhibition is designed to ________ visitors, but it is also full of fun games for children.
items.zh: 博物館的語言展旨在啟發參觀者，但它也充滿了給孩子玩的有趣遊戲。

items.def: a sudden moment of understanding
items.s: I had an ________ when I realised that English "the" works a bit like pointing, and after that articles felt much easier.
items.zh: 當我明白英文的「the」有點像用手指東西時，我突然頓悟了，從那之後冠詞感覺容易多了。

items.def: full of energy and happiness
items.cn: 活力充沛的；熱情洋溢的
items.s: The ________ children sang the English song loudly, and their parents filmed the performance on their phones.
items.zh: 那些活力充沛的孩子大聲唱著英文歌，而他們的父母用手機錄下了表演。

items.def: a feeling of doubt or worry
items.s: I had some ________ about studying abroad alone, but the friendly people there soon made me feel at home.
items.zh: 我對獨自出國念書有些疑慮，但那裡友善的人們很快讓我感覺像在家一樣。

items.def: an uneasy feeling that you are doing wrong
items.s: She had no ________ about asking strangers for directions, so her French improved very quickly in Paris.
items.zh: 她對向陌生人問路毫無顧慮，所以她的法文在巴黎進步得非常快。

items.def: showing strong feeling
items.s: There was ________ opposition to closing the language centre, so hundreds of students signed a petition.
items.zh: 關閉語言中心遭到強烈的反對，所以有數百名學生連署請願。

items.def: not ashamed or embarrassed
items.s: He is an ________ fan of K-pop, and he proudly sings Korean songs at every school party.
items.zh: 他是一個毫不掩飾的 K-pop 迷，而且他在每場學校派對上都自豪地唱韓文歌。

items.def: thinking deeply, often a little sadly
items.s: She looked ________ as she read her grandfather's old letters, because she was trying to imagine his life in the 1950s.
items.zh: 她讀著爺爺的舊信時看起來若有所思，因為她正試著想像他在 1950 年代的生活。

items.def: serious and formal
items.s: The ceremony was ________, so the students stood silently while the national anthem played in two languages.
items.zh: 典禮很莊嚴，所以學生們靜靜站立，國歌以兩種語言播放。

items.def: friendship and trust among a group
items.s: There was real ________ in our language class, because we laughed at our mistakes together and helped each other study.
items.zh: 我們的語言班有真正的同儕情誼，因為我們一起笑看自己的錯誤，也互相幫助讀書。

items.def: a strong personal charm that attracts people
items.s: The speaker had so much ________ that people listened to every word, even though her English was not perfect.
items.zh: 那位講者極具個人魅力，以致人們專心聽她說的每一個字，即使她的英文並不完美。

items.def: so surprised or moved that you cannot speak
items.s: I was ______ ______ ______ when my students surprised me with a cake, so I just smiled and hugged them all.
items.zh: 當學生們用蛋糕給我驚喜時，我感動得說不出話，所以我只是微笑並擁抱了他們每一個人。

items.def: used to say something again more simply
items.s: The test is "not compulsory"; ______ ______ ______, you can choose not to take it, but most students take it anyway.
items.zh: 這個考試「並非強制」；換句話說，你可以選擇不考，但大多數學生還是會去考。

items.def: to be good at speaking or writing
items.s: My sister ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, so she always writes the birthday cards for our family.
items.zh: 我姊姊很會遣詞用字，所以我們家的生日卡片總是由她來寫。

items.def: to speak very directly, even if it is unkind
items.s: My coach does ______ ______ ______ ______, so when I play badly he tells me exactly what I did wrong.
items.zh: 我的教練說話直截了當，所以當我表現不好時，他會確切告訴我哪裡做錯了。

items.def: to make the final comment in an argument
items.s: My little brother always wants to ______ ______ ______ ______, so our arguments go on until Mum tells us to stop.
items.zh: 我弟弟總是想說最後一句話，所以我們的爭吵會一直持續到媽媽叫我們停止為止。

items.def: in exactly the same words
items.s: Don't copy the article ______ ______ ______, because your teacher wants you to explain the ideas in your own words.
items.zh: 不要逐字照抄那篇文章，因為老師希望你用自己的話來解釋這些想法。

items.def: I cannot understand this at all
items.s: My dad showed me his tax forms, but ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, so I told him to ask an accountant.
items.zh: 我爸爸給我看他的報稅表，但我完全看不懂，所以我叫他去問會計師。

items.def: to share similar ideas and understand each other
items.s: The designer and the engineer finally ______ ______ ______ ______, so the project moved much faster after that meeting.
items.zh: 設計師和工程師終於有了共同語言，所以那次會議之後計畫進展得快多了。

items.def: the ability to speak easily and persuasively
items.s: Our class president has ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, so she can talk the teachers into almost anything.
items.zh: 我們班長有好口才，所以她幾乎可以說服老師答應任何事。

items.def: unable to speak because you are nervous
items.s: I was ________ when I met my favourite singer, so I just stood there and forgot every English word I knew.
items.zh: 當我見到最喜歡的歌手時，我緊張得說不出話，所以我只是站在那裡，忘光了我會的每一個英文字。

items.def: a small mistake when you are speaking
items.s: Calling my teacher "Mum" was ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, but the whole class laughed for five minutes.
items.zh: 叫老師「媽媽」只是一個口誤，但全班笑了五分鐘。

items.def: to stop yourself from saying something
items.s: I wanted to correct my boss's English, but I ______ ______ ______, because the meeting was not the right time.
items.zh: 我想糾正老闆的英文，但我忍住沒說，因為會議中不是適當的時機。

items.def: to be careful not to use rude words
items.s: Please ______ ______ ______ in front of the children, because they copy every word they hear.
items.zh: 請在孩子面前注意你的用詞，因為他們會模仿聽到的每一個字。

items.def: to learn a language naturally without formal study
items.s: Young kids can ______ ______ ______ ______ quickly when they play with local children, while adults often need classes.
items.zh: 小孩和當地孩子一起玩時能很快地自然學會一種語言，而大人常常需要上課。

items.def: to know just enough of a language to manage
items.s: I can ______ ______ ______ Japanese when I travel, but I cannot understand the news or have deep conversations.
items.zh: 我旅行時能用日文勉強應付，但我聽不懂新聞，也無法深入交談。

items.def: to make people feel relaxed when they first meet
items.s: Our teacher played a name game to ______ ______ ______ on the first day, and soon everyone was chatting and laughing.
items.zh: 老師在第一天玩了一個名字遊戲來破冰，很快大家就聊天說笑起來了。

items.def: to misunderstand each other because you mean different things
items.s: We ______ ______ ______ ______ for ten minutes, because I meant the train station while she meant the bus station.
items.zh: 我們雞同鴨講了十分鐘，因為我指的是火車站，而她指的是公車站。

items.def: what you do matters more than what you say
items.s: He promised to practise English every day, but ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, so I'll believe it when I see it.
items.zh: 他答應每天練習英文，但行動勝於言語，所以等我親眼看到才會相信。

items.def: to say that someone said something they did not
items.cn: 曲解別人的話；硬說別人說過
items.s: Please don't ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, because I never said that your translation was bad.
items.zh: 請不要硬說我說過那些話，因為我從來沒說你的翻譯很糟。

items.def: to show something clearly without words
items.s: Her silence ______ ______ after the argument, so I knew I had to apologise before dinner.
items.zh: 爭吵後她的沉默說明了一切，所以我知道我必須在晚餐前道歉。

items.def: body tissue that tightens and relaxes to make you move
items.s: Lifting heavy boxes every day made my uncle's arm ________ very strong, but he still hurt his back last month.
items.zh: 每天搬重箱子讓我叔叔的手臂肌肉非常強壯，但他上個月還是傷了背。
items.sec: The Human Body & Anatomy 人體與解剖

items.def: having big, strong muscles
items.s: The swimmer has a very ________ back and shoulders, because she trains in the pool for four hours every morning.
items.zh: 這位泳者的背部和肩膀肌肉非常發達，因為她每天早上在泳池訓練四個小時。
items.sec: The Human Body & Anatomy 人體與解剖

items.def: a strong band that joins a muscle to a bone
items.s: The runner felt sharp pain above his heel, so the doctor checked the ________ and told him to rest for two weeks.
items.zh: 那位跑者感到腳跟上方一陣刺痛，所以醫生檢查了他的肌腱，並叫他休息兩週。
items.sec: The Human Body & Anatomy 人體與解剖

items.def: a strong band that holds bones together at a joint
items.s: She twisted her knee badly during the basketball game, and the scan showed that one ________ was partly damaged.
items.zh: 她在籃球比賽中嚴重扭傷膝蓋，而掃描顯示有一條韌帶部分受損。
items.sec: The Human Body & Anatomy 人體與解剖

items.def: smooth, soft tissue that protects the ends of bones
items.s: Years of running on hard roads wore down the ________ in his knees, so now he cycles instead of jogging.
items.zh: 多年在堅硬路面上跑步磨損了他膝蓋的軟骨，所以他現在改騎自行車而不慢跑了。
items.sec: The Human Body & Anatomy 人體與解剖

items.def: how strong and thick your bones are
items.s: Jumping and weight training can improve your ______ ______, so teenagers who exercise often have stronger bones later in life.
items.zh: 跳躍和重量訓練能提升你的骨質密度，所以常運動的青少年日後通常擁有更強壯的骨骼。
items.sec: The Human Body & Anatomy 人體與解剖

items.def: a muscle at the back of the upper leg
items.s: The striker grabbed the back of his leg after a fast sprint, and the coach said he had probably pulled a ________.
items.zh: 那位前鋒在快速衝刺後抓住大腿後側，而教練說他可能拉傷了大腿後肌。
items.sec: The Human Body & Anatomy 人體與解剖

items.def: the large muscle at the front of the upper leg
items.s: Squats build the ________ at the front of your thighs, and strong thighs help protect your knees when you land.
items.zh: 深蹲能鍛鍊大腿前側的股四頭肌，而強壯的大腿能在你落地時保護膝蓋。
items.sec: The Human Body & Anatomy 人體與解剖

items.def: the muscle at the front of the upper arm
items.s: My brother lifts dumbbells every night to make his ________ bigger, but his coach says he should train his legs too.
items.zh: 我哥哥每晚舉啞鈴想讓他的二頭肌變大，但他的教練說他也應該練腿。
items.sec: The Human Body & Anatomy 人體與解剖

items.def: relating to the stomach area
items.s: Planks strengthen your ________ muscles, and a strong middle helps you keep good posture when you sit at a desk.
items.zh: 棒式能強化你的腹部肌肉，而強壯的核心能幫助你坐在書桌前時保持良好姿勢。
items.sec: The Human Body & Anatomy 人體與解剖

items.def: the large bone structure at the base of the spine
items.s: The dancer fell awkwardly during practice, and an X-ray showed a small crack in her ________, so she missed the show.
items.zh: 那位舞者在練習時摔得很不順，X光顯示她的骨盆有一道小裂痕，所以她錯過了演出。
items.sec: The Human Body & Anatomy 人體與解剖

items.def: the joint between the foot and the leg
items.s: I landed on another player's foot and twisted my ________, so I had to watch the rest of the match from the bench.
items.zh: 我落地時踩到另一名球員的腳而扭傷了腳踝，所以我只能坐在板凳上看完剩下的比賽。
items.sec: The Human Body & Anatomy 人體與解剖

items.def: the small round bone at the front of the knee
items.s: The goalkeeper wore thick pads to protect his ________, because he often dives onto the hard ground during training.
items.zh: 那位守門員戴著厚護墊來保護他的膝蓋骨，因為他在訓練中常常撲倒在堅硬的地面上。
items.sec: The Human Body & Anatomy 人體與解剖

items.def: the bones that curve around your chest
items.s: Boxers train their stomach muscles to protect their ______ ______, because a hard punch to the chest can break a bone.
items.zh: 拳擊手會訓練腹肌來保護胸腔，因為胸口挨一記重拳可能會打斷骨頭。
items.sec: The Human Body & Anatomy 人體與解剖

items.def: one of the two organs in your chest used for breathing
items.s: Swimmers usually have strong ________, because they must hold their breath underwater and breathe quickly between strokes.
items.zh: 游泳選手通常擁有強壯的肺，因為他們必須在水下憋氣，並在划水之間快速換氣。
items.sec: The Human Body & Anatomy 人體與解剖

items.def: how many times your heart beats in one minute
items.s: My smartwatch shows my ______ ______ while I run, so I slow down when the number gets too high.
items.zh: 我的智慧手錶會在我跑步時顯示我的心率，所以當數字太高時我就放慢速度。
items.sec: The Human Body & Anatomy 人體與解剖

items.def: a tube that carries blood away from the heart
items.s: Regular exercise keeps every ________ in your body flexible, while smoking and junk food can make them hard and narrow.
items.zh: 規律運動能讓你體內的每一條動脈保持彈性，而抽菸和垃圾食物會讓它們變硬變窄。
items.sec: The Human Body & Anatomy 人體與解剖

items.def: a tube that carries blood back to the heart
items.s: After a hard workout the ________ in his arms stood out clearly, because more blood was flowing through his muscles.
items.zh: 激烈運動後他手臂上的靜脈清楚浮現，因為有更多血液流經他的肌肉。
items.sec: The Human Body & Anatomy 人體與解剖

items.def: a very thin blood tube in the body
items.s: Endurance training creates more ________ around the muscles, so oxygen can reach the working cells more easily.
items.zh: 耐力訓練會在肌肉周圍形成更多微血管，所以氧氣能更容易抵達運作中的細胞。
items.sec: The Human Body & Anatomy 人體與解剖

items.def: the gas in the air that our bodies need
items.s: Climbers on Mount Everest often carry extra ________, because the air at the top is very thin and breathing becomes difficult.
items.zh: 攀登聖母峰的登山者常常攜帶額外的氧氣，因為山頂的空氣非常稀薄，呼吸會變得困難。
items.sec: The Human Body & Anatomy 人體與解剖

items.def: the substance in red blood cells that carries oxygen
items.s: Athletes who train in the mountains produce more ________, so their blood can carry extra oxygen when they race at sea level.
items.zh: 在山區訓練的運動員會產生更多血紅素，所以他們在海平面比賽時血液能攜帶更多氧氣。
items.sec: The Human Body & Anatomy 人體與解剖

items.def: a tiny cell in the blood that carries oxygen
items.s: Each ______ ______ ______ carries oxygen from the lungs to the muscles, and low iron can reduce how many your body makes.
items.zh: 每一個紅血球都會把氧氣從肺部運送到肌肉，而缺鐵會減少你身體製造紅血球的數量。
items.sec: The Human Body & Anatomy 人體與解剖

items.def: a substance made in muscles during very hard exercise
items.s: Her legs burned at the end of the 400-metre race, and her coach said ______ ______ was building up in her muscles.
items.zh: 400公尺賽跑到最後她的雙腿灼熱，而教練說是乳酸正在她的肌肉中累積。
items.sec: The Human Body & Anatomy 人體與解剖

items.def: the form in which the body stores sugar for energy
items.s: Marathon runners eat lots of pasta before a race, because their muscles need full stores of ________ for the long distance.
items.zh: 馬拉松跑者在賽前會吃很多義大利麵，因為他們的肌肉需要儲滿肝醣來應付長距離。
items.sec: The Human Body & Anatomy 人體與解剖

items.def: the chemical processes that turn food into energy
items.s: My ________ seems to slow down in winter, so I try to walk more and eat lighter meals when the weather gets cold.
items.zh: 我的新陳代謝似乎在冬天變慢，所以天氣變冷時我會試著多走路，並吃得清淡一點。
items.sec: The Human Body & Anatomy 人體與解剖

items.def: relating to how the body uses energy
items.s: Short, intense workouts raise your ________ rate for hours afterwards, so your body keeps burning extra energy while you rest.
items.zh: 短時間高強度的運動會讓你的代謝率在之後數小時保持升高，所以你的身體在休息時仍持續燃燒額外的能量。
items.sec: The Human Body & Anatomy 人體與解剖

items.def: one of the long thin cells that form a muscle
items.s: Every ______ ______ gets tiny tears during heavy lifting, but the body repairs them and makes the muscle stronger.
items.zh: 每一條肌纖維在大重量訓練時都會產生微小撕裂，但身體會修復它們，讓肌肉變得更強壯。
items.sec: The Human Body & Anatomy 人體與解剖

items.def: describing muscle fibres that work quickly for short bursts
items.s: Sprinters have many ________ muscle fibres, so they can explode out of the blocks, although they tire more quickly than distance runners.
items.zh: 短跑選手擁有許多快縮型肌纖維，所以他們能從起跑架爆發衝出，雖然他們比長跑選手更容易疲勞。
items.sec: The Human Body & Anatomy 人體與解剖

items.def: describing muscle fibres that work for a long time without tiring
items.s: Long-distance cyclists rely on ________ fibres, because these muscles can keep working for hours while using oxygen efficiently.
items.zh: 長途自行車選手依賴慢縮型肌纖維，因為這些肌肉能在有效利用氧氣的同時持續運作好幾個小時。
items.sec: The Human Body & Anatomy 人體與解剖

items.def: gentle exercise you do before hard exercise
items.s: Never skip the ________ before a match, because cold muscles are much more likely to get injured when you suddenly sprint.
items.zh: 比賽前千萬不要省略熱身，因為冰冷的肌肉在你突然衝刺時更容易受傷。

items.def: easy exercise you do after hard exercise to relax the body
items.s: After the race we did a ten-minute ________ of slow jogging and stretching, so our legs felt less stiff the next day.
items.zh: 比賽後我們做了十分鐘慢跑和伸展的緩和運動，所以第二天我們的腿比較不僵硬。

items.def: to make your muscles longer by reaching or bending
items.s: You should ________ your legs gently after running, but you should never bounce, because that can damage the muscle.
items.zh: 跑步後你應該輕柔地伸展雙腿，但絕對不要彈跳，因為那可能傷害肌肉。

items.def: the ability to keep doing a hard activity for a long time
items.s: Cycling to school every day built up my ________, so I finished the five-kilometre fun run without stopping once.
items.zh: 每天騎腳踏車上學增強了我的耐力，所以我一次都沒停就跑完了五公里的趣味路跑。

items.def: exercise that uses weights to make muscles stronger
items.s: My grandmother started ______ ______ at seventy, and now she can carry her own shopping bags up the stairs again.
items.zh: 我奶奶七十歲才開始做肌力訓練，而現在她又能自己提著購物袋上樓了。

items.def: exercise that mixes very hard periods with easy rest periods
items.s: ______ ______ is popular with busy people, because thirty minutes of fast and slow running can be as useful as a longer jog.
items.zh: 間歇訓練很受忙碌的人歡迎，因為三十分鐘快慢交替的跑步可能和較長時間的慢跑一樣有效。

items.def: the sport or activity of lifting heavy weights
items.s: Taiwan has won several Olympic medals in ________, and many young athletes now train hard to lift even heavier weights.
items.zh: 台灣已在舉重項目贏得數面奧運獎牌，而現在許多年輕運動員努力訓練，想舉起更重的重量。

items.def: a short bar with a weight at each end, held in one hand
items.s: I keep a pair of ________ under my bed, so I can do a few arm exercises while I watch videos at night.
items.zh: 我在床底下放了一對啞鈴，所以晚上看影片時可以做幾組手臂運動。

items.def: a long bar with heavy weights on both ends
items.s: The coach added more plates to the ________ slowly, because lifting too much too soon can injure a young athlete's back.
items.zh: 教練慢慢地在槓鈴上加更多槓片，因為太快舉太重可能傷害年輕運動員的背部。

items.def: a machine with a moving belt that you walk or run on
items.s: It was raining heavily outside, so I ran on the ________ at the gym, although I find indoor running quite boring.
items.zh: 外面下著大雨，所以我在健身房的跑步機上跑步，雖然我覺得室內跑步相當無聊。

items.def: an exercise where you push your body up from the floor with your arms
items.s: Our PE teacher asked everyone to do twenty ________, but most of us could only manage ten before our arms started shaking.
items.zh: 我們的體育老師要求每個人做二十下伏地挺身，但我們大多數人只做了十下手臂就開始發抖。

items.def: an exercise where you bend your knees and lower your body
items.s: A deep ________ works almost every muscle in your legs, so many coaches call it the king of all exercises.
items.zh: 一個標準的深蹲幾乎能鍛鍊到你腿部的每一塊肌肉，所以許多教練稱它為所有運動之王。

items.def: an exercise where you step forward and bend both knees
items.s: Do ten ________ on each leg slowly, and keep your back straight so that your knees do not hurt.
items.zh: 每條腿慢慢做十下弓箭步，並保持背部挺直，這樣你的膝蓋才不會痛。

items.def: an exercise where you hold your body straight like a board
items.s: I can hold a ________ for two minutes now, but at the beginning of the year I collapsed after only thirty seconds.
items.zh: 我現在能撐棒式兩分鐘，但年初時我只撐了三十秒就垮了。

items.def: one complete movement of an exercise
items.s: Do twelve ________ of each exercise, and rest for one minute before you start the next set.
items.zh: 每個動作做十二下，並在開始下一組之前休息一分鐘。

items.def: exercise that makes your heart and lungs work harder
items.s: I do thirty minutes of ________ three times a week, so I can run up the stairs at the MRT station without feeling tired.
items.zh: 我每週做三次、每次三十分鐘的有氧運動，所以我能跑上捷運站的樓梯而不覺得累。

items.def: to run slowly and steadily for exercise
items.s: My parents ________ along the riverside park every evening, and they say it helps them sleep better at night.
items.zh: 我爸媽每天傍晚沿著河濱公園慢跑，而他們說這有助於他們晚上睡得更好。

items.def: to run as fast as you can for a short distance
items.s: The winger ________ down the left side of the field, and then he passed the ball to the striker in front of the goal.
items.zh: 那名邊鋒沿著球場左側全速衝刺，然後把球傳給球門前的前鋒。

items.def: a running race of about 42 kilometres
items.s: My aunt trained for six months before her first ________, and she finished the 42-kilometre race in just under five hours.
items.zh: 我阿姨在第一次馬拉松前訓練了六個月，而她以不到五小時的成績完成了這場42公里的賽跑。

items.def: doing different types of exercise to stay fit
items.s: Runners often add swimming as ________, because it builds fitness without putting stress on their knees and ankles.
items.zh: 跑者常常加入游泳作為交叉訓練，因為它能增進體能而不會對膝蓋和腳踝造成壓力。

items.def: a stretchy elastic band used for exercise
items.s: A ______ ______ is cheap and light, so I pack one in my suitcase and keep exercising in my hotel room.
items.zh: 彈力帶便宜又輕巧，所以我把一條放進行李箱，在飯店房間裡繼續運動。

items.def: a professional who plans exercise for one client
items.s: My dad hired a ______ ______ after his health check, and she designed a safe workout plan for his bad back.
items.zh: 我爸爸在健康檢查後請了一位私人教練，而她為他不好的背部設計了一套安全的運動計畫。

items.def: a room or building with equipment for exercise
items.s: The new ________ near our school is open twenty-four hours, so my brother often goes there after his part-time job.
items.zh: 我們學校附近新開的健身房二十四小時營業，所以我哥哥常在打工後去那裡。

items.def: training too much without enough rest, which harms performance
items.s: Her times got slower every week because of ________, so her coach told her to take five full days off.
items.zh: 由於過度訓練，她的成績每週都變慢，所以教練要她休息整整五天。

items.def: a strict plan for training, diet or health
items.s: The boxer follows a strict daily ________ of running, sparring and healthy meals, but he always rests on Sundays.
items.zh: 那位拳擊手遵循每日嚴格的訓練計畫，包括跑步、對打練習和健康飲食，但他星期天總是休息。

items.def: describing short, intense exercise that does not use much oxygen
items.s: Sprinting and heavy lifting are ________ activities, so you can only keep them up for a few seconds before you need a break.
items.zh: 衝刺和大重量訓練是無氧運動，所以你只能維持幾秒鐘就需要休息。

items.def: very hard and fast
items.s: The ________ class at my gym lasts only twenty minutes, but everyone is soaked in sweat by the end.
items.zh: 我健身房的高強度課程只有二十分鐘，但到最後每個人都汗流浹背。

items.def: gentle and not putting much stress on the joints
items.s: Swimming is a ________ sport, so doctors often recommend it for older people and for anyone with knee problems.
items.zh: 游泳是一種低衝擊的運動，所以醫生常常推薦給年長者以及任何有膝蓋問題的人。

items.def: a wristband that records steps, sleep and heart rate
items.s: My ______ ______ reminds me to stand up every hour, because I often sit at my desk for too long while I study.
items.zh: 我的運動手環每小時提醒我站起來，因為我讀書時常常在書桌前坐太久。

items.def: having enough water in your body
items.s: Good ________ is important during summer training, so the coach puts cold water bottles beside the field every afternoon.
items.zh: 夏季訓練時良好的補水很重要，所以教練每天下午都在球場旁放冰水。
items.sec: Sports Nutrition & Recovery 運動營養與恢復

items.def: to drink enough water for your body
items.s: Remember to ________ before the race starts, because you may not find a water station until the fifth kilometre.
items.zh: 記得在比賽開始前補充水分，因為你可能要到第五公里才會找到補給站。
items.sec: Sports Nutrition & Recovery 運動營養與恢復

items.def: to drink water again after losing a lot of it
items.s: The tennis players ________ with water and fruit between sets, because the court was over thirty-five degrees.
items.zh: 網球選手在局與局之間用水和水果補充水分，因為球場溫度超過三十五度。
items.sec: Sports Nutrition & Recovery 運動營養與恢復

items.def: a salt in the body, like sodium, that helps muscles work
items.s: You lose ________ when you sweat a lot, so a pinch of salt in your water can help prevent cramps.
items.zh: 你大量流汗時會流失電解質，所以在水裡加一小撮鹽有助於預防抽筋。
items.sec: Sports Nutrition & Recovery 運動營養與恢復

items.def: a drink with sugar and salts for people who exercise
items.s: A ______ ______ can help during a long match, but for a short walk ordinary water is cheaper and healthier.
items.zh: 運動飲料在長時間的比賽中可能有幫助，但如果只是短程散步，一般的水更便宜也更健康。
items.sec: Sports Nutrition & Recovery 運動營養與恢復

items.def: a drink with a lot of protein, often taken after exercise
items.s: My brother drinks a ______ ______ after every gym session, because he believes it helps his muscles recover faster.
items.zh: 我哥哥每次健身後都會喝一杯高蛋白飲，因為他相信這能幫助肌肉更快恢復。
items.sec: Sports Nutrition & Recovery 運動營養與恢復

items.def: a small snack bar that gives quick energy
items.s: I always pack an ______ ______ for long hikes, because it is light and gives me energy when I feel weak.
items.zh: 我長途健行時總會帶一根能量棒，因為它很輕，而且在我感到無力時能補充能量。
items.sec: Sports Nutrition & Recovery 運動營養與恢復

items.def: eating lots of carbohydrates before a long race
items.s: Many runners try ________ the night before a marathon, so pasta restaurants near the start line are always crowded.
items.zh: 許多跑者在馬拉松前一晚會嘗試賽前補碳水，所以起跑線附近的義大利麵餐廳總是擠滿了人。
items.sec: Sports Nutrition & Recovery 運動營養與恢復

items.def: a day with no hard training, used to recover
items.s: Even top athletes take a ______ ______ every week, because muscles actually get stronger while the body is resting.
items.zh: 即使是頂尖運動員每週也會安排一天休息日，因為肌肉其實是在身體休息時變強壯的。
items.sec: Sports Nutrition & Recovery 運動營養與恢復

items.def: sitting in very cold water to reduce muscle pain
items.s: After the final the players sat in an ______ ______ for ten minutes, and they screamed because the water was so cold.
items.zh: 決賽後球員們坐在冰浴裡十分鐘，而他們都尖叫了起來，因為水實在太冰了。
items.sec: Sports Nutrition & Recovery 運動營養與恢復

items.def: a cold bag put on an injury to reduce swelling
items.s: The nurse put an ______ ______ on my swollen ankle, and she told me to keep my foot raised for an hour.
items.zh: 護理師在我腫起來的腳踝上放了一個冰敷袋，並叫我把腳抬高一個小時。
items.sec: Sports Nutrition & Recovery 運動營養與恢復

items.def: a tube of hard foam you roll on to relax tight muscles
items.s: I use a ______ ______ on my legs after running, and although it hurts a little, my muscles feel much looser afterwards.
items.zh: 我跑步後會用滾筒按摩雙腿，雖然有點痛，但之後肌肉感覺放鬆多了。
items.sec: Sports Nutrition & Recovery 運動營養與恢復

items.def: treatment of injuries with exercise and massage
items.s: He needed three months of ________ after his knee operation, but he was back on the football field by spring.
items.zh: 他膝蓋手術後需要三個月的物理治療，但到了春天他已經回到足球場上。
items.sec: Sports Nutrition & Recovery 運動營養與恢復

items.def: a person trained to treat injuries with exercise and massage
items.s: The team ________ showed me some simple exercises for my shoulder, so I do them every morning before school.
items.zh: 球隊的物理治療師教了我一些簡單的肩膀運動，所以我每天早上上學前都會做。
items.sec: Sports Nutrition & Recovery 運動營養與恢復

items.def: painful, especially after exercise
items.s: My legs were very ________ after my first yoga class, so I walked down the stairs slowly for two days.
items.zh: 第一次上瑜伽課後我的雙腿非常痠痛，所以我兩天都慢慢地走下樓梯。
items.sec: Sports Nutrition & Recovery 運動營養與恢復

items.def: a feeling of pain in the muscles
items.s: Muscle ________ usually peaks two days after a hard workout, so don't worry if you feel worse on the second morning.
items.zh: 肌肉痠痛通常在激烈運動後兩天達到高峰，所以如果你第二天早上覺得更糟也不用擔心。
items.sec: Sports Nutrition & Recovery 運動營養與恢復

items.def: a sudden painful tightening of a muscle
items.s: The swimmer got a ________ in his leg halfway across the lake, but a lifeguard reached him quickly and helped him to the shore.
items.zh: 那位泳者游到湖中央時腿抽筋了，但救生員很快游到他身邊，幫助他上岸。
items.sec: Sports Nutrition & Recovery 運動營養與恢復

items.def: a substance in coffee and tea that makes you feel awake
items.s: Some cyclists drink coffee before a race, because ________ can make them feel more alert and less tired.
items.zh: 有些自行車選手在比賽前喝咖啡，因為咖啡因能讓他們感覺更警覺、更不疲倦。
items.sec: Sports Nutrition & Recovery 運動營養與恢復

items.def: a natural substance taken to help with short, powerful exercise
items.s: Many weightlifters take ________ powder, but doctors say teenagers should talk to an expert before using any supplement.
items.zh: 許多舉重選手會服用肌酸粉，但醫生說青少年在使用任何補充品之前應該先諮詢專家。
items.sec: Sports Nutrition & Recovery 運動營養與恢復

items.def: a simple sugar that the body uses for energy
items.s: Your brain and muscles both use ________ for fuel, so skipping breakfast can make you feel weak during morning PE class.
items.zh: 你的大腦和肌肉都以葡萄糖為燃料，所以不吃早餐可能讓你在早上的體育課感到無力。
items.sec: Sports Nutrition & Recovery 運動營養與恢復

items.def: a nutrient we need in large amounts: protein, fat or carbohydrate
items.s: Every ________ has a different job, because carbohydrates give quick energy while protein helps to repair muscles.
items.zh: 每一種巨量營養素都有不同的作用，因為碳水化合物提供快速能量，而蛋白質幫助修復肌肉。
items.sec: Sports Nutrition & Recovery 運動營養與恢復

items.def: a short sleep of about 20 minutes to get energy back
items.s: I take a ______ ______ after lunch on training days, and I feel much sharper during evening practice.
items.zh: 我在訓練日的午餐後會小睡片刻，而我在晚上練習時感覺精神好多了。
items.sec: Sports Nutrition & Recovery 運動營養與恢復

items.def: tight clothing that presses on muscles to help blood flow
items.s: Many runners wear a ______ ______ on their legs after a race, because they believe it reduces swelling and pain.
items.zh: 許多跑者在比賽後會在腿上穿壓縮衣，因為他們相信這能減少腫脹和疼痛。
items.sec: Sports Nutrition & Recovery 運動營養與恢復

items.def: to train less in the days before an important race
items.s: Swimmers usually ________ for two weeks before the national championships, so their bodies are fresh on race day.
items.zh: 游泳選手通常在全國錦標賽前兩週減量訓練，所以他們在比賽當天身體狀態充沛。
items.sec: Sports Nutrition & Recovery 運動營養與恢復

items.def: the blood flowing around the body
items.s: Sugar from a sports drink enters your ________ quickly, so you get energy within a few minutes.
items.zh: 運動飲料中的糖分很快進入你的血液，所以你在幾分鐘內就能獲得能量。
items.sec: Sports Nutrition & Recovery 運動營養與恢復

items.def: an expert who gives advice about food and diet
items.s: The team ________ planned our meals for the tournament, so we ate rice, fish and vegetables instead of fried chicken.
items.zh: 球隊的營養師規劃了我們比賽期間的餐點，所以我們吃米飯、魚和蔬菜，而不是炸雞。
items.sec: Sports Nutrition & Recovery 運動營養與恢復

items.def: the amount of fat in the body
items.s: The gym machine measured my ______ ______, and the trainer said the number was healthy for someone my age.
items.zh: 健身房的機器測量了我的體脂肪，而教練說這個數字以我的年齡來說是健康的。
items.sec: Sports Nutrition & Recovery 運動營養與恢復

items.def: thin and healthy, with little fat
items.s: Long-distance runners are usually very ________, because they burn a huge amount of energy during training every week.
items.zh: 長跑選手通常非常精瘦，因為他們每週訓練時都會燃燒大量的能量。
items.sec: Sports Nutrition & Recovery 運動營養與恢復

items.def: a milk protein powder used to help muscles recover
items.s: He mixes ______ ______ with milk after training, although a dietitian told him that ordinary food works just as well.
items.zh: 他訓練後把乳清蛋白和牛奶混在一起喝，雖然營養師告訴他普通食物效果一樣好。
items.sec: Sports Nutrition & Recovery 運動營養與恢復

items.def: an injury where a joint is twisted and hurt
items.s: She got a bad ________ while playing badminton, so she wore a support on her wrist for three weeks.
items.zh: 她打羽球時嚴重扭傷，所以她手腕戴了三週的護具。
items.sec: Injury, Health & Sports Medicine 運動傷害與運動醫學

items.def: to push a bone out of its normal place
items.s: The rugby player fell heavily and ________ his shoulder, so the doctor had to put the joint back in place.
items.zh: 那位橄欖球員重重跌倒，肩膀脫臼了，所以醫生必須把關節推回原位。
items.sec: Injury, Health & Sports Medicine 運動傷害與運動醫學

items.def: a crack or break in a bone
items.s: The scan showed a small ________ in his foot, and he had to wear a boot for six weeks.
items.zh: 掃描顯示他腳部有一處小骨折，而他必須穿護具靴六週。
items.sec: Injury, Health & Sports Medicine 運動傷害與運動醫學

items.def: a dark mark on the skin caused by a knock
items.s: My knee had a huge purple ________ after the match, but luckily nothing was broken.
items.zh: 比賽後我的膝蓋有一大塊紫色的瘀青，但幸好沒有骨頭斷裂。
items.sec: Injury, Health & Sports Medicine 運動傷害與運動醫學

items.def: the state of a body part becoming larger because of injury
items.s: Ice and rest reduced the ________ around my ankle, so I could put my shoe on again the next morning.
items.zh: 冰敷和休息減輕了我腳踝周圍的腫脹，所以隔天早上我又能穿上鞋子了。
items.sec: Injury, Health & Sports Medicine 運動傷害與運動醫學

items.def: larger than normal because of injury or illness
items.s: His wrist was still ________ on Monday, so the coach told him to miss training until the pain had gone.
items.zh: 他的手腕星期一還是腫著，所以教練叫他暫停訓練，直到疼痛消失。
items.sec: Injury, Health & Sports Medicine 運動傷害與運動醫學

items.def: to pull something apart or damage it by pulling
items.s: He felt something ________ in the back of his leg as he jumped, and the scan later showed a muscle injury.
items.zh: 他跳起時感覺大腿後側有東西撕裂，而後來的掃描顯示是肌肉受傷。
items.sec: Injury, Health & Sports Medicine 運動傷害與運動醫學

items.def: to walk with difficulty because one leg hurts
items.s: He had to ________ off the field after the tackle, but he was running normally again within ten days.
items.zh: 那次擒抱後他只能跛著腳離場，但不到十天他又能正常跑步了。
items.sec: Injury, Health & Sports Medicine 運動傷害與運動醫學

items.def: hard to move and a little painful
items.s: My shoulders felt ________ after sleeping badly, so I did some gentle stretches before swimming practice.
items.zh: 睡不好之後我的肩膀感覺僵硬，所以我在游泳練習前做了一些輕柔的伸展。
items.sec: Injury, Health & Sports Medicine 運動傷害與運動醫學

items.def: the state of being hard to move
items.s: Morning ________ is common in older runners, but a warm shower and slow walking usually make it better.
items.zh: 早晨的僵硬在年長跑者中很常見，但洗個熱水澡和慢慢走動通常就能改善。
items.sec: Injury, Health & Sports Medicine 運動傷害與運動醫學

items.def: unable to feel anything
items.s: My fingers went ________ during the winter race, so I wore thicker gloves for the next event.
items.zh: 冬季比賽中我的手指麻掉了，所以下一場比賽我戴了更厚的手套。
items.sec: Injury, Health & Sports Medicine 運動傷害與運動醫學

items.def: a small painful bubble of skin, often from rubbing
items.s: New running shoes gave me a painful ________ on my heel, so I covered it with a plaster before the race.
items.zh: 新跑鞋讓我的腳跟長了一個很痛的水泡，所以我在比賽前用膠布把它貼起來。
items.sec: Injury, Health & Sports Medicine 運動傷害與運動醫學

items.def: pain along the front of the lower leg from running
items.s: Running on concrete every day gave her ______ ______, so she moved her training onto grass and the pain slowly faded.
items.zh: 每天在水泥地上跑步讓她得了脛前疼痛，所以她把訓練改到草地上，疼痛就慢慢消退了。
items.sec: Injury, Health & Sports Medicine 運動傷害與運動醫學

items.def: pain in the outside of the elbow from overuse
items.s: My father got ______ ______ from painting the house, and interestingly he had never played tennis in his life.
items.zh: 我爸爸因為粉刷房子而得了網球肘，而有趣的是他這輩子從沒打過網球。
items.sec: Injury, Health & Sports Medicine 運動傷害與運動醫學

items.def: damage caused by repeating the same movement too often
items.s: Young pitchers often suffer an ______ ______ in the shoulder, so leagues now limit how many balls a child may throw.
items.zh: 年輕投手常常肩膀發生過度使用傷害，所以聯盟現在限制兒童可以投的球數。
items.sec: Injury, Health & Sports Medicine 運動傷害與運動醫學

items.def: to stop someone from playing because of injury
items.s: The knee problem ________ their best defender for two months, and the team lost four games while he was away.
items.zh: 膝蓋問題讓他們最好的後衛無法上場兩個月，而他缺席期間球隊輸了四場比賽。
items.sec: Injury, Health & Sports Medicine 運動傷害與運動醫學

items.def: the return of an illness or injury after it got better
items.s: He returned to training too early and suffered a ________, so this time he followed the doctor's advice carefully.
items.zh: 他太早回到訓練而導致傷勢復發，所以這次他仔細遵照醫生的建議。
items.sec: Injury, Health & Sports Medicine 運動傷害與運動醫學

items.def: the area of medicine dealing with exercise and injuries
items.s: She studied ______ ______ at university, and now she treats injured players for a professional basketball team.
items.zh: 她在大學主修運動醫學，現在她為一支職業籃球隊治療受傷的球員。
items.sec: Injury, Health & Sports Medicine 運動傷害與運動醫學

items.def: the doctor who looks after a sports team
items.s: The ______ ______ ran onto the pitch within seconds, and she checked the player's head before letting him stand up.
items.zh: 隊醫在幾秒內就跑進球場，而她在讓那名球員站起來之前先檢查了他的頭部。
items.sec: Injury, Health & Sports Medicine 運動傷害與運動醫學

items.def: simple medical help given immediately after an injury
items.s: Every coach at our school must learn ______ ______, so someone can always help quickly if a student collapses.
items.zh: 我們學校每位教練都必須學會急救，這樣如果有學生倒下，總會有人能迅速幫忙。
items.sec: Injury, Health & Sports Medicine 運動傷害與運動醫學

items.def: a machine that gives an electric shock to restart the heart
items.s: A ________ on the wall of the sports hall saved a runner's life last year, because a teacher used it within two minutes.
items.zh: 去年體育館牆上的一台去顫器救了一位跑者的命，因為一位老師在兩分鐘內就使用了它。
items.sec: Injury, Health & Sports Medicine 運動傷害與運動醫學

items.def: a medicine that reduces pain
items.s: Taking a ________ before a match can be dangerous, because you may not notice that an injury is getting worse.
items.zh: 比賽前服用止痛藥可能很危險，因為你可能不會察覺傷勢正在惡化。
items.sec: Injury, Health & Sports Medicine 運動傷害與運動醫學

items.def: a medicine that reduces heat and swelling in the body
items.s: The doctor gave him an ________ for his sore knee, but she also warned him not to take it for too long.
items.zh: 醫生給了他一種抗發炎藥來治療痠痛的膝蓋，但她也警告他不要服用太久。
items.sec: Injury, Health & Sports Medicine 運動傷害與運動醫學

items.def: a detailed picture of the inside of the body made by a machine
items.s: The club sent him for an ______ ______, because the pain had not improved after ten days of rest.
items.zh: 俱樂部送他去做磁振造影掃描，因為休息十天後疼痛仍沒有改善。
items.sec: Injury, Health & Sports Medicine 運動傷害與運動醫學

items.def: a medical operation
items.s: She needed ________ on her shoulder last winter, but she came back stronger and won the national title in June.
items.zh: 她去年冬天肩膀需要動手術，但她復出後更強，並在六月贏得全國冠軍。
items.sec: Injury, Health & Sports Medicine 運動傷害與運動醫學

items.def: a support worn around the knee
items.s: He played the whole season in a ______ ______, and he said it gave him the confidence to turn quickly again.
items.zh: 他整個球季都戴著護膝支架比賽，而他說這讓他有信心再次快速轉身。
items.sec: Injury, Health & Sports Medicine 運動傷害與運動醫學

items.def: a stick that helps an injured person walk
items.s: I used a ________ under each arm for two weeks, and my classmates kindly carried my bag to every lesson.
items.zh: 我兩邊腋下各用一支拐杖撐了兩週，而我的同學們親切地幫我把書包提到每一堂課。
items.sec: Injury, Health & Sports Medicine 運動傷害與運動醫學

items.def: a long strip of cloth used to cover or support an injury
items.s: The trainer wrapped a tight ________ around his ankle, so he could finish the last ten minutes of the game.
items.zh: 訓練員在他的腳踝上纏了一條緊緊的繃帶，所以他能打完比賽最後的十分鐘。
items.sec: Injury, Health & Sports Medicine 運動傷害與運動醫學

items.def: how far a joint can move
items.s: Gentle exercises slowly improved the ______ ______ ______ in his shoulder, and after a month he could raise his arm fully.
items.zh: 輕緩的運動慢慢改善了他肩膀的活動範圍，而一個月後他能完全舉起手臂。
items.sec: Injury, Health & Sports Medicine 運動傷害與運動醫學

items.def: the study of how the body moves
items.s: Scientists used ________ to study her throwing action, and small changes to her elbow angle added two metres to her distance.
items.zh: 科學家用生物力學研究她的投擲動作，而手肘角度的微小改變讓她的距離增加了兩公尺。
items.sec: Biomechanics, Gear & Sports Technology 生物力學、裝備與運動科技

items.def: the way a person walks or runs
items.s: The shop filmed my ________ on a treadmill, and then the staff recommended shoes that suited the way my feet landed.
items.zh: 那家店在跑步機上拍下我的步態，然後店員推薦了適合我落地方式的鞋子。
items.sec: Biomechanics, Gear & Sports Technology 生物力學、裝備與運動科技

items.def: the distance covered in one step while running
items.s: Increasing her ______ ______ made her faster at first, but it also tired her legs before the finish line.
items.zh: 加大步幅起初讓她跑得更快，但也讓她的雙腿在終點線前就疲累了。
items.sec: Biomechanics, Gear & Sports Technology 生物力學、裝備與運動科技

items.def: the way a player moves their feet in a sport
items.s: Good ________ matters more than strength in badminton, because you must reach the shuttle before you can hit it well.
items.zh: 在羽球中好的腳步動作比力量更重要，因為你必須先接近球才能打得好。
items.sec: Biomechanics, Gear & Sports Technology 生物力學、裝備與運動科技

items.def: the force of air or water that slows a moving body
items.s: Cyclists ride close behind each other to reduce ________, so the rider at the front uses far more energy.
items.zh: 自行車手緊跟在彼此後面以減少阻力，所以最前面的車手消耗的能量多得多。
items.sec: Biomechanics, Gear & Sports Technology 生物力學、裝備與運動科技

items.def: shaped so that air passes over it easily
items.s: Her new helmet is more ________ than the old one, and the team says it saves several seconds over forty kilometres.
items.zh: 她的新頭盔比舊的更符合空氣力學，而車隊表示在四十公里的賽程中能節省好幾秒。
items.sec: Biomechanics, Gear & Sports Technology 生物力學、裝備與運動科技

items.def: the point where the weight of a body is balanced
items.s: Gymnasts keep their ______ ______ ______ low when they land, because a low body position helps them stay steady.
items.zh: 體操選手落地時會保持重心較低，因為低的身體姿勢能幫助他們站穩。
items.sec: Biomechanics, Gear & Sports Technology 生物力學、裝備與運動科技

items.def: the way you hold something, or the ability to hold it firmly
items.s: A looser ________ on the bat gives you faster hands, but you must still hold it firmly enough when you swing.
items.zh: 握球棒時握法放鬆一點能讓你的手更快，但揮棒時你仍必須握得夠緊。
items.sec: Biomechanics, Gear & Sports Technology 生物力學、裝備與運動科技

items.def: the grip of something on a surface
items.s: My old shoes had no ________ on the wet court, so I slipped twice during the first game.
items.zh: 我的舊鞋在濕滑的球場上沒有抓地力，所以我在第一局就滑倒了兩次。
items.sec: Biomechanics, Gear & Sports Technology 生物力學、裝備與運動科技

items.def: soft material that reduces the shock of landing
items.s: Shoes with thick ________ protect your knees on hard roads, although some runners prefer a thinner, lighter sole.
items.zh: 有厚緩衝的鞋子能在堅硬路面上保護你的膝蓋，雖然有些跑者偏好較薄較輕的鞋底。
items.sec: Biomechanics, Gear & Sports Technology 生物力學、裝備與運動科技

items.def: a sharp point on the bottom of a sports shoe
items.s: Each ________ on a sprinter's shoe digs into the track, so she can push off powerfully at the start.
items.zh: 短跑選手鞋底的每一根鞋釘都會抓進跑道，所以她在起跑時能強力推進。
items.sec: Biomechanics, Gear & Sports Technology 生物力學、裝備與運動科技

items.def: a small lump on the bottom of a football boot
items.s: He changed to longer ________ because the pitch was muddy, and after that he stopped sliding on every turn.
items.zh: 他換上較長的鞋釘，因為球場很泥濘，之後他每次轉身就不再滑了。
items.sec: Biomechanics, Gear & Sports Technology 生物力學、裝備與運動科技

items.def: a hard hat that protects the head
items.s: Cycling without a ________ is dangerous, so our school will not let students join the road race unless they wear one.
items.zh: 不戴安全帽騎車很危險，所以除非學生戴上，我們學校不會讓他們參加公路賽。
items.sec: Biomechanics, Gear & Sports Technology 生物力學、裝備與運動科技

items.def: a soft plastic shield worn to protect the teeth
items.s: Every player must wear a ________ in rugby, because a knock to the face can easily break a tooth.
items.zh: 橄欖球比賽中每位球員都必須戴護齒套，因為臉部受到撞擊很容易斷牙。
items.sec: Biomechanics, Gear & Sports Technology 生物力學、裝備與運動科技

items.def: a hard cover that protects the front of the lower leg
items.s: He forgot his ______ ______ before the game, so a teammate kindly lent him an old pair.
items.zh: 他比賽前忘了帶護脛，所以一位隊友好心借了他一副舊的。
items.sec: Biomechanics, Gear & Sports Technology 生物力學、裝備與運動科技

items.def: special glasses that protect the eyes
items.s: My ________ leaked during the race, so I could hardly see the lane rope for the last fifty metres.
items.zh: 比賽中我的蛙鏡漏水，所以最後五十公尺我幾乎看不見水道繩。
items.sec: Biomechanics, Gear & Sports Technology 生物力學、裝備與運動科技

items.def: a device that measures how fast your heart beats
items.s: A ______ ______ on his chest sends data to his phone, so he can see when he is training too hard.
items.zh: 他胸前的心率監測器會把資料傳到手機，所以他能看出自己何時訓練過度。
items.sec: Biomechanics, Gear & Sports Technology 生物力學、裝備與運動科技

items.def: a room where air is blown over a person to test their shape
items.s: The cyclist spent a day in a ______ ______, and the engineers changed her riding position to cut the air resistance.
items.zh: 那位自行車手在風洞裡待了一天，而工程師調整了她的騎乘姿勢以減少空氣阻力。
items.sec: Biomechanics, Gear & Sports Technology 生物力學、裝備與運動科技

items.def: a board that measures the push of a foot on the ground
items.s: The jumper landed on a ______ ______, so the scientists could measure exactly how hard she pushed off.
items.zh: 那位跳躍選手落在測力板上，所以科學家能精確測量她蹬地的力量。
items.sec: Biomechanics, Gear & Sports Technology 生物力學、裝備與運動科技

items.def: a camera that records very fast movement in detail
items.s: A ______ ______ filmed his serve at a thousand frames a second, and the footage showed a small fault in his wrist.
items.zh: 高速攝影機以每秒一千格拍下他的發球，而影片顯示他手腕有個小瑕疵。
items.sec: Biomechanics, Gear & Sports Technology 生物力學、裝備與運動科技

items.def: studying recorded film to improve performance
items.s: The team does ______ ______ every Monday, so the players can see their own mistakes instead of just hearing about them.
items.zh: 球隊每週一都做影像分析，所以球員能親眼看見自己的錯誤，而不只是聽別人說。
items.sec: Biomechanics, Gear & Sports Technology 生物力學、裝備與運動科技

items.def: based on information and numbers
items.s: Modern coaching has become very ________, but good coaches still trust what they see with their own eyes.
items.zh: 現代的教練工作已變得非常數據驅動，但好的教練仍然相信自己親眼看到的東西。
items.sec: Biomechanics, Gear & Sports Technology 生物力學、裝備與運動科技

items.def: a device that counts how many steps you take
items.s: My grandfather carries a simple ________ in his pocket, and he walks around the block again if he has not reached ten thousand steps.
items.zh: 我爺爺口袋裡帶著一個簡單的計步器，如果還沒走到一萬步，他就會再繞街區走一圈。
items.sec: Biomechanics, Gear & Sports Technology 生物力學、裝備與運動科技

items.def: a small electronic tag that records a runner's race time
items.s: Each runner wears a ______ ______ on one shoe, so the computer records the exact moment they cross the line.
items.zh: 每位跑者在一隻鞋上戴著計時晶片，所以電腦會記錄他們通過終點線的確切時刻。
items.sec: Biomechanics, Gear & Sports Technology 生物力學、裝備與運動科技

items.def: one of the marked paths on a track or in a pool
items.s: She was given the outside ________ for the final, but she still swam a personal best and took the bronze.
items.zh: 她在決賽被分到最外側的水道，但她仍游出個人最佳成績並拿下銅牌。
items.sec: Biomechanics, Gear & Sports Technology 生物力學、裝備與運動科技

items.def: a surface of plastic grass used for sports
items.s: Our school replaced the muddy field with ______ ______, so matches are no longer cancelled when it rains.
items.zh: 我們學校把泥濘的球場換成人工草皮，所以下雨時比賽不再被取消。
items.sec: Biomechanics, Gear & Sports Technology 生物力學、裝備與運動科技

items.def: a very bright lamp that lights a sports field at night
items.s: The new ________ let the team train after dark, and local families now come to watch the evening games.
items.zh: 新的照明燈讓球隊能在天黑後訓練，而當地家庭現在會來觀看晚間的比賽。
items.sec: Biomechanics, Gear & Sports Technology 生物力學、裝備與運動科技

items.def: a special tight suit worn to swim faster
items.s: A ______ ______ can take twenty minutes to put on, and swimmers usually save it for their most important races.
items.zh: 一件競技泳衣可能要花二十分鐘才能穿好，而泳者通常把它留到最重要的比賽才用。
items.sec: Biomechanics, Gear & Sports Technology 生物力學、裝備與運動科技

items.def: your own fastest or highest result so far
items.s: She did not win a medal, but she set a new ______ ______ by four seconds, so her coach was delighted.
items.zh: 她沒有拿到獎牌，但她把個人最佳成績推進了四秒，所以她的教練非常高興。
items.sec: Competition & Peak Performance 競賽與巔峰表現

items.def: the best result ever achieved in the world
items.s: The young swimmer broke the ______ ______ in the morning heats, and then she broke it again in the evening final.
items.zh: 那位年輕泳將在早上的預賽打破世界紀錄，接著又在晚上的決賽再次刷新它。
items.sec: Competition & Peak Performance 競賽與巔峰表現

items.def: better than anything done before
items.s: It was a ________ season for our school, because we won three regional titles for the first time ever.
items.zh: 這對我們學校來說是破紀錄的一季，因為我們首度贏得三個區域冠軍。
items.sec: Competition & Peak Performance 競賽與巔峰表現

items.def: the raised platform where the top three athletes stand
items.s: Standing on the ________ with her parents watching was the proudest moment of her life, and she cried during the anthem.
items.zh: 在父母注視下站上頒獎台是她人生中最驕傲的時刻，而她在國歌響起時哭了。
items.sec: Competition & Peak Performance 競賽與巔峰表現

items.def: a person who has won a medal
items.s: An Olympic ________ visited our school last week, and she let every student hold her silver medal.
items.zh: 一位奧運獎牌得主上週造訪我們學校，而她讓每位學生都摸了她的銀牌。
items.sec: Competition & Peak Performance 競賽與巔峰表現

items.def: to reach the standard needed to enter a competition
items.s: He had to run under eleven seconds to ________ for the national finals, and he managed it on his third attempt.
items.zh: 他必須跑進十一秒才能取得全國決賽資格，而他在第三次嘗試時成功了。
items.sec: Competition & Peak Performance 競賽與巔峰表現

items.def: a match or race used to decide who enters a competition
items.s: Our team lost the first ________ badly, but we won the next two and reached the main tournament.
items.zh: 我們球隊第一場資格賽輸得很慘，但我們贏了接下來兩場並打進主賽。
items.sec: Competition & Peak Performance 競賽與巔峰表現

items.def: one of several early races used to choose the finalists
items.s: She jogged easily through her ________ in the morning, because she wanted to save her energy for the final.
items.zh: 她早上輕鬆跑完預賽，因為她想為決賽保留體力。
items.sec: Competition & Peak Performance 競賽與巔峰表現

items.def: the match before the final
items.s: Our volleyball team reached the ________ for the first time, although we lost to the eventual champions.
items.zh: 我們排球隊首次打進準決賽，雖然我們輸給了最終的冠軍。
items.sec: Competition & Peak Performance 競賽與巔峰表現

items.def: the part of a competition where the loser goes out
items.s: Once you reach the ______ ______, one bad afternoon can end your season, so every team plays very carefully.
items.zh: 一旦進入淘汰賽階段，一個下午的失常就可能結束你的球季，所以每支球隊都打得非常謹慎。
items.sec: Competition & Peak Performance 競賽與巔峰表現

items.def: ranked as one of the best players before a competition
items.s: She was ________ second in the draw, so she did not have to face the top player until the final.
items.zh: 她在籤表中被列為第二種子，所以她直到決賽才需要面對頭號選手。
items.sec: Competition & Peak Performance 競賽與巔峰表現

items.def: a player or team not expected to win
items.s: Everyone called us the ________ before the match, but we scored twice in the last ten minutes and won.
items.zh: 賽前每個人都說我們是不被看好的一方，但我們在最後十分鐘進了兩球並贏了。
items.sec: Competition & Peak Performance 競賽與巔峰表現

items.def: the benefit of playing in your own stadium
items.s: ______ ______ really matters in this league, because visiting teams must travel for six hours by bus.
items.zh: 主場優勢在這個聯賽真的很重要，因為客隊必須搭六小時的巴士。
items.sec: Competition & Peak Performance 競賽與巔峰表現

items.def: a match played at the opponent's ground
items.s: We lost the ______ ______ by one goal, but we still went through because we had won at home.
items.zh: 我們客場比賽以一球落敗，但我們仍然晉級，因為我們在主場贏過。
items.sec: Competition & Peak Performance 競賽與巔峰表現

items.def: the whole group of players a team can choose from
items.s: The coach named a ________ of eighteen players, so four of us had to watch the final from the stands.
items.zh: 教練公布了十八人的球隊名單，所以我們有四個人必須在看台上觀看決賽。
items.sec: Competition & Peak Performance 競賽與巔峰表現

items.def: the list of players chosen to start a match
items.s: My name was in the starting ______ for the first time, and I was so excited that I could hardly sleep.
items.zh: 我的名字第一次出現在先發陣容中，而我興奮得幾乎睡不著。
items.sec: Competition & Peak Performance 競賽與巔峰表現

items.def: the player who leads a team
items.s: As ________, she encouraged the younger players after every mistake, so nobody was afraid to try something difficult.
items.zh: 身為隊長，她在每次失誤後都鼓勵較年輕的球員，所以沒有人害怕嘗試困難的動作。
items.sec: Competition & Peak Performance 競賽與巔峰表現

items.def: the break in the middle of a match
items.s: At ________ we were two goals behind, but the coach changed our shape and we scored three times after the break.
items.zh: 中場休息時我們落後兩球，但教練改變了陣型，而我們在下半場進了三球。
items.sec: Competition & Peak Performance 競賽與巔峰表現

items.def: additional playing time when the scores are equal
items.s: The game went to ______ ______, and both teams looked exhausted as they ran into the final minutes.
items.zh: 比賽進入延長賽，而兩隊跑到最後幾分鐘時都顯得筋疲力盡。
items.sec: Competition & Peak Performance 競賽與巔峰表現

items.def: a way of deciding a drawn match by single kicks at goal
items.s: Our goalkeeper saved two shots in the ______ ______, so the whole school celebrated for the rest of the week.
items.zh: 我們的守門員在十二碼大戰中擋下兩球，所以全校接下來一整週都在慶祝。
items.sec: Competition & Peak Performance 競賽與巔峰表現

items.def: the person or team that finishes second
items.s: She was the ________ at the city championships last year, but this season she finally took first place.
items.zh: 她去年在市錦標賽拿到第二名，但本季她終於奪得第一。
items.sec: Competition & Peak Performance 競賽與巔峰表現

items.def: a player's first appearance for a team
items.s: He made his ________ at only sixteen, and he scored within twenty minutes of coming onto the pitch.
items.zh: 他年僅十六歲就初次登場，而他上場後二十分鐘內就得分了。
items.sec: Competition & Peak Performance 競賽與巔峰表現

items.def: an experienced older player
items.s: The team's ________ played his last match on Sunday, and the crowd stood and clapped for a full minute.
items.zh: 球隊的老將星期天打了他的最後一場比賽，而觀眾全體起立鼓掌整整一分鐘。
items.sec: Competition & Peak Performance 競賽與巔峰表現

items.def: a player in their first season
items.s: The ________ looked nervous in his first few games, but by December he was one of the best players in the league.
items.zh: 那位新人在頭幾場比賽看起來很緊張，但到十二月他已是聯賽中最好的球員之一。
items.sec: Competition & Peak Performance 競賽與巔峰表現

items.def: to be much better than an opponent
items.s: The champions completely ________ us in the first half, so we were just happy to score once in the second.
items.zh: 冠軍隊在上半場徹底壓制我們，所以我們只為了下半場進一球就很高興了。
items.sec: Competition & Peak Performance 競賽與巔峰表現

items.def: money given to the winners of a competition
items.s: The ______ ______ in women's events is now equal at this tournament, and many players fought for years to achieve that.
items.zh: 這項賽事女子組的獎金現在已經同等，而許多選手為此奮鬥了多年。
items.sec: Competition & Peak Performance 競賽與巔峰表現

items.def: the supporters watching in their own stadium
items.s: The ______ ______ sang for ninety minutes, and the players said the noise made them run harder when they were tired.
items.zh: 主場觀眾唱了九十分鐘，而球員說那股聲浪讓他們在疲累時跑得更拚。
items.sec: Competition & Peak Performance 競賽與巔峰表現

items.def: directly against one other person or team
items.s: Their ______ record is almost equal, so nobody could predict who would win Saturday's match.
items.zh: 他們的正面交鋒戰績幾乎相等，所以沒有人能預測星期六誰會贏。
items.sec: Competition & Peak Performance 競賽與巔峰表現

items.def: the ability to stay strong when things get hard
items.s: ______ ______ separates good players from great ones, because everyone can play well when the score is comfortable.
items.zh: 心理韌性區分了優秀與偉大的球員，因為在分數安全時每個人都能打得好。
items.sec: Sport Psychology, Fair Play & Society 運動心理、公平競賽與社會

items.def: picturing a perfect performance in your mind
items.s: She uses ______ ______ before every jump, so she pictures a perfect landing while she waits for her turn.
items.zh: 她在每次跳躍前都使用心像練習，所以她等待輪到自己時會想像完美的落地。
items.sec: Sport Psychology, Fair Play & Society 運動心理、公平競賽與社會

items.def: the words you say to yourself in your head
items.s: Positive ______ helped him through the last kilometre, because he kept repeating that he had trained for this moment.
items.zh: 正面的自我對話幫助他撐過最後一公里，因為他不斷重複說自己為這一刻訓練過。
items.sec: Sport Psychology, Fair Play & Society 運動心理、公平競賽與社會

items.def: the ability to stay calm under pressure
items.s: The young striker showed great ________ in front of goal, and he scored while three defenders were running at him.
items.zh: 那位年輕前鋒在球門前展現了極佳的沉著，而他在三名後衛衝向他時進了球。
items.sec: Sport Psychology, Fair Play & Society 運動心理、公平競賽與社會

items.def: the level of confidence and hope in a group
items.s: Team ________ dropped after four defeats, so the coach organised a barbecue and let the players simply enjoy themselves.
items.zh: 四連敗後球隊士氣低落，所以教練辦了一場烤肉，讓球員單純放鬆享受。
items.sec: Sport Psychology, Fair Play & Society 運動心理、公平競賽與社會

items.def: a feeling of loyalty and friendship within a team
items.s: Our ______ ______ is the reason we keep winning, because every player works hard for the person beside them.
items.zh: 我們的團隊精神是我們持續獲勝的原因，因為每位球員都為身旁的隊友努力。
items.sec: Sport Psychology, Fair Play & Society 運動心理、公平競賽與社會

items.def: the illegal use of drugs to improve sports performance
items.s: ________ ruined the sport's reputation in the 1990s, and it took many years to win back the public's trust.
items.zh: 1990年代使用禁藥毀了這項運動的名聲，而要贏回大眾的信任花了很多年。
items.sec: Sport Psychology, Fair Play & Society 運動心理、公平競賽與社會

items.def: an examination to find out whether an athlete has taken banned drugs
items.s: Every medallist must take a ______ ______ immediately, so officials wait outside the changing room after each final.
items.zh: 每位獎牌得主都必須立刻接受藥檢，所以官員在每場決賽後都在更衣室外等候。
items.sec: Sport Psychology, Fair Play & Society 運動心理、公平競賽與社會

items.def: making an athlete stronger or faster, often illegally
items.s: He was found with ________ drugs in his bag, so the federation removed his results from the record books.
items.zh: 有人在他的包裡發現提升運動表現的藥物，所以聯盟把他的成績從紀錄中刪除。
items.sec: Sport Psychology, Fair Play & Society 運動心理、公平競賽與社會

items.def: a drug that athletes are not allowed to use
items.s: Her cold medicine contained a ______ ______, so she now checks every tablet with the team doctor first.
items.zh: 她的感冒藥含有禁用物質，所以她現在每顆藥都先請隊醫確認。
items.sec: Sport Psychology, Fair Play & Society 運動心理、公平競賽與社會

items.def: a drug that builds muscle quickly but harms health
items.s: Taking a ________ may add muscle fast, but it can damage the heart and liver within a few years.
items.zh: 服用類固醇可能快速增加肌肉，但它可能在幾年內損害心臟和肝臟。
items.sec: Sport Psychology, Fair Play & Society 運動心理、公平競賽與社會

items.def: to stop someone from taking part because of a rule break
items.s: The judges had to ________ him for stepping outside his lane, even though he had crossed the line first.
items.zh: 裁判必須因為他跨出跑道而取消他的資格，儘管他是第一個通過終點線的。
items.sec: Sport Psychology, Fair Play & Society 運動心理、公平競賽與社會

items.def: honest and respectful behaviour in sport
items.s: He kicked the ball back to the other team after the injury, and the crowd applauded his sense of ______ ______.
items.zh: 受傷事件後他把球踢回給對方球隊，而觀眾為他的運動家精神鼓掌。
items.sec: Sport Psychology, Fair Play & Society 運動心理、公平競賽與社會

items.def: arranging the result of a game dishonestly
items.s: Two players were jailed for ________, and the league now trains every young professional about the risks.
items.zh: 兩名球員因打假球入獄，而聯盟現在會對每位年輕職業選手宣導其風險。
