items.sec: Sport Psychology, Fair Play & Society 運動心理、公平競賽與社會

items.def: happening at a local, ordinary level
items.s: ________ sport needs more funding, because children in small towns often have no safe place to play.
items.zh: 基層運動需要更多經費，因為小鎮的孩子往往沒有安全的地方可以運動。
items.sec: Sport Psychology, Fair Play & Society 運動心理、公平競賽與社會

items.def: a person who looks for talented young players
items.s: A ________ from a professional club watched our school match, and he spoke to two of our defenders afterwards.
items.zh: 一位職業俱樂部的球探觀看了我們學校的比賽，而他之後找了我們兩名後衛談話。
items.sec: Sport Psychology, Fair Play & Society 運動心理、公平競賽與社會

items.def: a school run by a club to train young players
items.s: He joined the club's ______ ______ at thirteen, so he studied in the morning and trained every afternoon.
items.zh: 他十三歲就加入俱樂部的青訓學院，所以他早上讀書，每天下午訓練。
items.sec: Sport Psychology, Fair Play & Society 運動心理、公平競賽與社會

items.def: the process of finding young people with ability
items.s: Good ______ ______ looks at more than size and speed, because attitude and learning ability matter just as much.
items.zh: 良好的選才看的不只是身材和速度，因為態度和學習能力同樣重要。
items.sec: Sport Psychology, Fair Play & Society 運動心理、公平競賽與社會

items.def: an athlete with a disability who competes in adapted sport
items.s: The ________ swam the 100 metres faster than most people can run it, and the stadium rose to its feet.
items.zh: 那位帕拉運動員游完一百公尺的時間比大多數人跑的還快，而全場觀眾起立致敬。
items.sec: Sport Psychology, Fair Play & Society 運動心理、公平競賽與社會

items.def: the international sports competition for athletes with disabilities
items.s: The ________ now attracts millions of viewers, and many of its stars have become household names at home.
items.zh: 帕拉林匹克運動會現在吸引數百萬觀眾，而它的許多明星已成為國內家喻戶曉的名字。
items.sec: Sport Psychology, Fair Play & Society 運動心理、公平競賽與社會

items.def: an unfair difference between men and women
items.s: There is still a ______ ______ in sports coverage, because women's matches receive far less television time.
items.zh: 運動報導上仍存在性別差距，因為女性賽事獲得的電視時段少得多。
items.sec: Sport Psychology, Fair Play & Society 運動心理、公平競賽與社會

items.def: the school subject in which students exercise and play sport
items.s: ______ ______ should be fun for everyone, because children who enjoy moving are far more likely to stay active as adults.
items.zh: 體育課應該讓每個人都覺得有趣，因為喜歡活動的孩子長大後更可能保持運動習慣。
items.sec: Sport Psychology, Fair Play & Society 運動心理、公平競賽與社會

items.def: a sport that many people enjoy watching
items.s: Baseball is the biggest ______ ______ in Taiwan, and families often spend a whole evening at the ballpark together.
items.zh: 棒球是台灣最大的觀賞性運動，而家庭常常一整個晚上都在球場一起度過。
items.sec: Sport Psychology, Fair Play & Society 運動心理、公平競賽與社會

items.def: the study of the body and mind in sport
items.s: She studies ______ ______ at university, and her dream is to work with a national team at the Olympics.
items.zh: 她在大學念運動科學，而她的夢想是在奧運與國家隊共事。
items.sec: Sport Psychology, Fair Play & Society 運動心理、公平競賽與社會

items.def: the habit of working hard and seriously
items.s: His ______ ______ impressed the coaches more than his talent, because he was always the first to arrive at training.
items.zh: 他的努力態度比他的天賦更令教練印象深刻，因為他總是第一個到訓練場。
items.sec: Sport Psychology, Fair Play & Society 運動心理、公平競賽與社會

items.def: a short encouraging speech before or during a match
items.s: The coach gave a quiet ______ ______ at half-time, and the players walked out looking far more confident.
items.zh: 教練在中場休息時做了一段平靜的激勵講話，而球員走出場時看起來自信多了。
items.sec: Sport Psychology, Fair Play & Society 運動心理、公平競賽與社會

items.def: the use of unfair tricks that are not quite against the rules
items.s: Wasting time at the end of a match is ________, and most supporters dislike it even when their own team does it.
items.zh: 比賽尾聲拖延時間是一種耍小手段，而大多數球迷即使是自己球隊這麼做也不喜歡。
items.sec: Sport Psychology, Fair Play & Society 運動心理、公平競賽與社會

items.def: natural physical skill, strength and speed
items.s: Her ________ amazed the scouts, but she still spent two seasons learning the tactics of the professional game.
items.zh: 她的運動能力讓球探驚嘆，但她仍花了兩個球季學習職業賽的戰術。
items.sec: Sport Psychology, Fair Play & Society 運動心理、公平競賽與社會

items.def: a careful judgement of how good or useful something is
items.s: The club published an honest ________ of last season, and it admitted that the training schedule had been far too heavy.
items.zh: 俱樂部公布了對上一季誠實的評估，並承認訓練課表之前太過沉重。

items.def: the act of reaching a goal or level
items.s: The ________ of an Olympic place takes years of quiet work, and most of that work happens before anyone is watching.
items.zh: 達成奧運資格需要多年默默的努力，而大部分的努力都發生在沒人注意的時候。

items.def: the relationship between a cause and its result
items.s: The study found a link between sleep and speed, but proving ________ is much harder than showing a pattern.
items.zh: 這項研究發現睡眠與速度之間有關聯，但證明因果關係比顯示一種模式困難得多。

items.def: the act of obeying a rule or request
items.s: ________ with the new safety rules is checked every month, so coaches must keep records of every head injury.
items.zh: 每個月都會檢查新安全規定的遵守情況，所以教練必須記錄每一次頭部受傷。

items.def: a channel through which something passes
items.s: The school website became the main ________ for training news, and parents checked it every Friday evening.
items.zh: 學校網站成了訓練消息的主要管道，而家長每週五傍晚都會查看。

items.def: careful thought or discussion before a decision
items.s: After long ________ the committee changed the rule, but some older members still disagreed with the decision.
items.zh: 經過長時間的審慎討論後，委員會修改了規則，但一些資深成員仍不同意這個決定。

items.def: a description or picture of something
items.s: The film's ________ of athletes' daily lives felt real, because the director had trained with the team for a year.
items.zh: 這部電影對運動員日常生活的描繪感覺很真實，因為導演曾與球隊一起訓練一年。

items.def: the origin of something, or where it comes from
items.s: The ________ of the word "marathon" goes back to ancient Greece, and most runners enjoy hearing the story.
items.zh: 「marathon」這個字的由來可追溯到古希臘，而大多數跑者都喜歡聽這個故事。

items.def: the act of stopping people from doing something by frightening them
items.s: Heavy fines work as ________ in most leagues, but a few players still take the risk every season.
items.zh: 高額罰款在大多數聯盟中發揮嚇阻作用，但每季仍有少數球員願意冒險。

items.def: the process of showing or finding differences
items.s: Clear ________ between tiredness and injury is important, because resting a sore muscle is not the same as ignoring pain.
items.zh: 清楚區別疲勞和受傷很重要，因為讓痠痛的肌肉休息和忽視疼痛並不相同。

items.def: the spreading of information to many people
items.s: The ________ of the research took two years, so coaches in small towns learned about it much later.
items.zh: 這項研究的傳播花了兩年，所以小鎮的教練知道得晚得多。

items.def: the act of adding more different types of something
items.s: ________ of a young athlete's sports is healthy, because playing several games builds different movement skills.
items.zh: 年輕運動員運動項目的多樣化是健康的，因為從事幾種運動能培養不同的動作技能。

items.def: the giving of power or confidence to people
items.s: The coach talks about ________ rather than control, so the players decide their own warm-up every Friday.
items.zh: 這位教練談的是賦權而不是控制，所以球員每週五自己決定熱身方式。

items.def: the act of making something into law
items.s: The ________ of the new concussion law changed school sport, and every coach now needs a short safety course.
items.zh: 新腦部撞擊法規的制定改變了校園運動，而現在每位教練都需要上一門短期安全課程。

items.def: a large gift of money given to an institution
items.s: A former student left an ________ to the university, so poorer athletes can now train without worrying about fees.
items.zh: 一位校友留下一筆捐贈基金給大學，所以較貧困的運動員現在能訓練而不必擔心費用。

items.def: an improvement that makes something better
items.s: A small ________ in recovery time can decide a championship, so teams study sleep as carefully as training.
items.zh: 恢復時間的小幅提升可能決定一個冠軍，所以球隊研究睡眠就像研究訓練一樣仔細。

items.def: the state of being equal in value or meaning
items.s: There is no simple ________ between gym strength and game performance, because sport also needs timing and decision-making.
items.zh: 健身房裡的力量和比賽表現之間沒有簡單的等同關係，因為運動還需要時機掌握和決策能力。

items.def: permission not to do or pay something
items.s: He was given an ________ from the fitness test because of his broken wrist, but he still attended every session.
items.zh: 因為手腕骨折，他獲得體能測驗的豁免，但他仍參加了每一次訓練。

items.def: great physical or mental effort
items.s: After two hours of ________ in the heat, the players were given a long break and plenty of cold water.
items.zh: 在高溫下費力運動兩小時後，球員們獲得長時間休息和充足的冰水。

items.def: the furthest part of something, such as a hand or foot
items.s: Blood flows away from each ________ in very cold weather, so your fingers and toes feel numb first.
items.zh: 在非常寒冷的天氣中血液會離開每個肢端，所以你的手指和腳趾最先感覺麻木。

items.def: the careful making of a plan, rule or product
items.s: The ________ of a new training plan took weeks, because the coach wanted every athlete to have different targets.
items.zh: 新訓練計畫的制定花了好幾週，因為教練希望每位運動員都有不同的目標。

items.def: the act of putting a plan into action
items.s: The idea was popular, but its ________ failed because the school did not have enough qualified staff.
items.zh: 這個想法很受歡迎，但它的執行失敗了，因為學校沒有足夠的合格人員。

items.def: the act of forcing a rule or burden on people
items.s: The ________ of a daily weigh-in upset the swimmers, so the coach quickly dropped the idea.
items.zh: 強制施行每日量體重讓泳者們不悅，所以教練很快就放棄了這個想法。

items.def: a change that puts something the opposite way round
items.s: The chart showed an ________ of the usual pattern, because the younger group recovered more slowly than the older one.
items.zh: 圖表顯示了常見模式的顛倒，因為較年輕的組別恢復得比年長組別慢。

items.def: the act of helping two sides reach an agreement
items.s: After weeks of argument, ________ by the league finally settled the dispute between the club and its captain.
items.zh: 經過數週爭論後，聯盟的調解終於解決了俱樂部與其隊長之間的糾紛。

items.def: the system of names used in a subject
items.s: Medical ________ can confuse young athletes, so the physiotherapist explains every injury in simple words.
items.zh: 醫學術語可能讓年輕運動員困惑，所以物理治療師用簡單的話解釋每一種傷勢。

items.def: the act of making something as good as possible
items.s: ________ of equipment helps a little, but hard training and good sleep still matter far more.
items.zh: 裝備的最佳化有一點幫助，但刻苦訓練和良好睡眠仍然重要得多。

items.def: the outer edge of an area
items.s: Spectators stood around the ________ of the field, and some children climbed trees to see the finish.
items.zh: 觀眾站在球場周邊，而一些孩子爬上樹想看終點。

items.def: the state of being the largest or strongest part
items.s: The ________ of slow-twitch fibres in her legs explains why she is better at long races than short ones.
items.zh: 她腿部慢縮型肌纖維的佔多數解釋了為什麼她長距離比賽比短距離更出色。

items.def: a growing feeling or movement among many people
items.s: There is now a ________ of support for free school sport, so several politicians have promised extra funding.
items.zh: 現在出現了一股支持免費校園運動的浪潮，所以好幾位政治人物已承諾增加經費。

items.def: a return to a worse or earlier state
items.s: A short ________ in performance is normal after illness, so do not panic if your times get slower.
items.zh: 生病後表現短暫退步是正常的，所以如果你的成績變慢也不要慌張。

items.def: the act of refusing to accept something
items.s: His ________ by the youth academy hurt at first, but he joined a local club and improved quickly.
items.zh: 青訓學院的拒絕起初讓他很受傷，但他加入了當地俱樂部並迅速進步。

items.def: the act of repeating a study to check its results
items.s: ________ of the experiment in three different countries gave the findings much greater weight, so coaches finally trusted them.
items.zh: 在三個不同國家對這項實驗的重複驗證讓研究結果更有份量，所以教練終於信任它們。

items.def: a change made to improve something
items.s: After one ________ of the rules, matches became safer, and the number of head injuries fell by a third.
items.zh: 在規則經過一次修訂後，比賽變得更安全，而頭部受傷的次數減少了三分之一。

items.def: the state of being completely full
items.s: Oxygen ________ in the blood drops at altitude, so new arrivals often feel breathless for several days.
items.zh: 血液中的氧飽和度在高海拔會下降，所以剛抵達的人常常好幾天都感到呼吸困難。

items.def: the act of keeping groups separate
items.s: Strict ________ of boys and girls in school sport is now rare, and many games are played in mixed teams.
items.zh: 校園運動中男女嚴格區隔現在已很少見，而許多比賽是以混合隊伍進行的。

items.def: the act of making something easier to understand
items.s: Some ________ is useful when teaching children, but telling them that fat is always bad is simply untrue.
items.zh: 教孩子時適度簡化是有用的，但告訴他們脂肪總是不好的根本不是事實。

items.def: a detailed description of how something should be made
items.s: The ball must meet an exact ________ for weight and size, so every match ball is tested before use.
items.zh: 球必須符合重量和尺寸的精確規格，所以每顆比賽用球在使用前都會檢測。

items.def: a condition that must be accepted
items.s: The sponsor added one ________ to the contract, and the club had to display its logo on every shirt.
items.zh: 贊助商在合約中加了一項規定，而俱樂部必須在每件球衣上展示其標誌。

items.def: the state of being based on personal feelings
items.s: ________ in judging is unavoidable in gymnastics, so several judges score each routine and the extremes are removed.
items.zh: 體操評分中的主觀性無法避免，所以每套動作由多位裁判評分，並去掉最高與最低分。

items.def: the act of replacing one thing with another
items.s: The ________ of water for sugary drinks improved the team's dental health within a single season.
items.zh: 用水替換含糖飲料在短短一季內就改善了球隊的牙齒健康。

items.def: a small detail that is not easy to notice
items.s: The ________ of her technique is hard to see at full speed, but slow-motion film shows it clearly.
items.zh: 她技術的細微之處在全速下很難看出，但慢動作影片能清楚呈現。

items.def: a number of things or people following one after another
items.s: A ________ of cold, wet matches left half the squad coughing, so the coach cut training for a week.
items.zh: 連續幾場寒冷潮濕的比賽讓半數隊員咳嗽，所以教練把訓練減少了一週。

items.def: the act of watching and directing an activity
items.s: Young children should lift weights only under ________, because poor technique can harm growing bones.
items.zh: 幼童只應在監督下舉重，因為錯誤的動作可能傷害發育中的骨骼。

items.def: the combining of different ideas into one whole
items.s: Her book is a ________ of research and practice, and coaches say it is the clearest guide they have read.
items.zh: 她的書是研究與實務的綜合，而教練們說這是他們讀過最清楚的指南。

items.def: the state of being the same everywhere
items.s: There is little ________ in school sports funding, so some students train on grass while others use car parks.
items.zh: 校園運動經費缺乏一致性，所以有些學生在草地上訓練，其他人卻用停車場。

items.def: the act of using something effectively
items.s: Better ________ of the school gym would help everyone, because the room sits empty most mornings.
items.zh: 更好地利用學校健身房會對大家都有幫助，因為那間房間大多數早上都空著。

items.def: a special right belonging to one person or group
items.s: Choosing the starting team is the coach's ________, although she usually listens to her senior players first.
items.zh: 選擇先發球員是教練的特權，雖然她通常會先聽取資深球員的意見。

items.def: the careful management of something you are responsible for
items.s: Under her ________ the club built a new pitch, and membership doubled within three years.
items.zh: 在她的管理下，俱樂部建了一座新球場，而會員人數在三年內增加了一倍。

items.def: a system of grouping things by type
items.s: The researchers created a simple ________ of runners, and they grouped athletes by how their feet landed.
items.zh: 研究人員建立了一套簡單的跑者分類系統，並依腳部落地方式將運動員分組。

items.def: the number of people or things studied
items.s: The ______ ______ was only twelve athletes, so the results are interesting but we should not trust them completely.
items.zh: 樣本數只有十二位運動員，所以這些結果很有趣，但我們不應完全相信。

items.def: a group that does not receive the treatment being tested
items.s: One group drank the new sports drink while the ______ ______ drank plain water, and both groups ran the same distance.
items.zh: 一組喝新的運動飲料，而對照組喝白開水，兩組都跑了相同的距離。

items.def: the amount by which a result may be wrong
items.s: The timing system has a tiny ______ ______ ______, but in sprinting even one hundredth of a second matters.
items.zh: 計時系統有極小的誤差範圍，但在短跑中即使百分之一秒也很重要。

items.def: a detailed study of one person or situation
items.s: The textbook includes a ______ ______ of one injured swimmer, and it follows her recovery over eighteen months.
items.zh: 這本教科書包含一位受傷泳者的個案研究，並追蹤她十八個月的康復過程。

items.def: information collected before it has been organised
items.s: The team published its ______ ______ online, so other scientists could check the calculations themselves.
items.zh: 團隊把原始資料公布在網路上，讓其他科學家能自己核對計算。

items.def: all the information that supports an idea
items.s: A large ______ ______ ______ now supports daily exercise, and doctors recommend it for almost every age group.
items.zh: 現在有大量的證據支持每日運動，而醫生幾乎為每個年齡層推薦它。

items.def: the set of ideas you use to judge something
items.s: Young players have a narrow ______ ______ ______, so they often think their own club's method is the only one.
items.zh: 年輕球員的參考框架較狹窄，所以他們常以為自己俱樂部的方法是唯一的。

items.def: the series of steps in an argument
items.s: Her ______ ______ ______ was easy to follow, and by the end even the doubters agreed with her conclusion.
items.zh: 她的推理思路很容易理解，而到最後連懷疑的人也同意她的結論。

items.def: an idea used as a starting point for research
items.s: Their ______ ______ was that cold baths speed up recovery, but the first results did not support it.
items.zh: 他們的工作假設是冰浴能加速恢復，但最初的結果並不支持它。

items.def: an improvement caused by belief rather than real treatment
items.s: Some of the benefit may be the ______ ______, because athletes feel stronger simply when they expect to.
items.zh: 部分效果可能是安慰劑效應，因為運動員只要預期會變強就會感覺更強。

items.def: a strong feeling of dislike
items.s: His ________ towards running came from school, where PE lessons had been a punishment rather than a pleasure.
items.zh: 他對跑步的反感源自學校，當時體育課是一種處罰而不是樂趣。

items.def: the area of work a person or group is responsible for
items.s: Injury prevention is outside the referee's ________, but she still warned the players about the slippery surface.
items.zh: 預防受傷不在裁判的職責範圍內，但她還是提醒球員注意濕滑的場地。

items.def: the group of people who make a country's laws
items.s: The ________ voted to fund school sport, and new gyms opened in dozens of rural towns.
items.zh: 立法機關投票通過資助校園運動，而數十個偏鄉小鎮開設了新的體育館。

items.def: the positive side of a situation
items.s: The ________ of her long injury was extra study time, so she finished the year with excellent grades.
items.zh: 她長期受傷好的一面是多出了讀書時間，所以她那一年成績優異。

items.def: a standard used for judging other things
items.s: That final has become a ________ for great matches, and commentators still compare new games with it.
items.zh: 那場決賽已成為精彩比賽的試金石，而評論員至今仍把新比賽與它相比。

items.def: an indirect result that follows something else
items.s: Closing the pool had a ______ ______, because the swimming club lost half of its younger members.
items.zh: 關閉游泳池造成了連帶影響，因為游泳社團失去了一半的年輕成員。

items.def: a spreading series of results from one event
items.s: One local champion created a ______ ______, and the number of children joining the club tripled.
items.zh: 一位當地冠軍帶來了漣漪效應，而加入社團的孩子人數增加了三倍。

items.def: a test result that wrongly shows something is there
items.s: The first test was a ______ ______, so his name was cleared after a second sample was examined.
items.zh: 第一次檢測是偽陽性，所以在第二份樣本檢驗後他的名聲得以恢復。

items.def: a line on a graph showing the general direction of change
items.s: The ______ ______ on the chart rises slowly, so her fitness is improving even though single tests go up and down.
items.zh: 圖表上的趨勢線緩慢上升，所以她的體能正在進步，儘管單次測驗時高時低。

items.def: the usual amount, found by adding and dividing
items.s: Her ________ over ten races was strong, but her best single run was more than a second faster.
items.zh: 她十場比賽的平均成績很好，但她單場最佳的一次快了一秒多。

items.def: the period during which something happens
items.s: The doctor gave a ______ ______ of eight weeks, and he reminded her that bones heal at different speeds.
items.zh: 醫生給出八週的時程，並提醒她骨頭癒合的速度各有不同。

items.def: one single piece of information in a set
items.s: A single ______ ______ proves nothing, so the scientists collected measurements every week for two years.
items.zh: 單一資料點無法證明任何事，所以科學家連續兩年每週收集數據。

items.def: one of several causes of a result
items.s: Poor sleep was only one ______ ______, because the players had also travelled for nine hours that day.
items.zh: 睡眠不足只是其中一個促成因素，因為球員們那天還旅行了九個小時。

items.def: a connection in which one thing makes another happen
items.s: Scientists have not proved a ______ ______ between the supplement and faster recovery, so they urge athletes to be careful.
items.zh: 科學家尚未證明這種補充品與恢復更快之間有因果關聯，所以他們呼籲運動員謹慎。

items.def: something used to represent or measure another thing
items.s: Resting heart rate is often used as a ________ for fitness, although it is affected by stress and sleep too.
items.zh: 靜止心率常被用作體能的替代指標，雖然它也受到壓力和睡眠影響。

items.def: something that shows what is likely to happen
items.s: Grip strength is a surprisingly good ________ of general health, so doctors now measure it during check-ups.
items.zh: 握力是整體健康令人意外的好預測指標，所以醫生現在在健康檢查時會測量它。

items.def: the methods accepted as the most effective
items.s: The federation published a guide to ______ ______, and every club received a printed copy by post.
items.zh: 聯盟出版了一本最佳做法指南，而每個俱樂部都收到一本郵寄的印刷版。

items.def: the most important result of a study
items.s: The ______ ______ was simple: athletes who slept nine hours were injured far less often than those who slept six.
items.zh: 主要發現很簡單：睡九小時的運動員受傷的次數遠少於睡六小時的人。

items.def: a small study done before a larger one
items.s: The ______ ______ involved just one school, but its promising results led to a national project.
items.zh: 這項先導研究只涉及一所學校，但它可期的結果促成了一項全國計畫。

items.def: a later study that checks earlier results
items.s: A ______ ______ five years later found that most of the young runners were still active.
items.zh: 五年後的一項後續研究發現，大多數年輕跑者仍保持運動習慣。

items.def: sensible and worth doing
items.s: It is ________ to see a doctor before starting hard training, especially if you have not exercised for years.
items.zh: 開始激烈訓練前去看醫生是明智的，尤其如果你已經好幾年沒運動。

items.def: said to be true but not yet proved
items.s: The ________ rule-breaking was reported in every newspaper, but the hearing cleared the player two months later.
items.zh: 被指稱的違規行為登上了每家報紙，但兩個月後的聽證會還了那位球員清白。

items.def: able to be explained as being caused by something
items.s: Most of her improvement is ________ to better sleep, although she also changed her diet last winter.
items.zh: 她大部分的進步可歸因於更好的睡眠，雖然她去年冬天也改變了飲食。

items.def: involving people working together
items.s: The project was highly ________, because doctors, coaches and teachers all met once a month.
items.zh: 這個計畫高度合作，因為醫生、教練和老師每個月都會開一次會。

items.def: happening at the same time
items.s: Two ________ studies reached the same conclusion, so the findings were taken seriously straight away.
items.zh: 兩項同時進行的研究得出相同結論，所以這些發現立刻受到重視。

items.def: important because it leads to serious results
items.s: The most ________ decision of the season was made in June, when the club replaced its head coach.
items.zh: 本季影響最重大的決定是在六月做出的，當時俱樂部換掉了總教練。

items.def: useful as an example
items.s: Her career is ________ of a wider change, because many athletes now study while they compete.
items.zh: 她的職涯說明了一種更廣泛的變化，因為許多運動員現在一邊比賽一邊讀書。

items.def: clear and easy to notice
items.s: There was a ________ difference after six weeks, and even the players themselves could feel the change.
items.zh: 六週後出現明顯的差異，而連球員自己都能感覺到這個變化。

items.def: describing what is considered normal or correct
items.s: The chart gives ________ values for teenagers, so you can compare your own result with the usual range.
items.zh: 這張圖表提供青少年的規範性數值，所以你可以把自己的結果與一般範圍比較。

items.def: waiting to be decided or dealt with
items.s: His appeal is still ________, so he may not play in any official match until the committee decides.
items.zh: 他的申訴仍未決，所以在委員會做出決定前他可能無法參加任何正式比賽。

items.def: able to be done successfully
items.s: Training twice a day is not ________ for students, because they also need time for homework and sleep.
items.zh: 一天訓練兩次對學生來說行不通，因為他們也需要時間做功課和睡覺。

items.def: able to show what will probably happen
items.s: The test has some ________ value, but no single number can tell you who will become a champion.
items.zh: 這項測驗有一定的預測價值，但沒有任何單一數字能告訴你誰會成為冠軍。

items.def: matching something else in size or importance
items.s: The punishment should be ________ to the offence, so a first small mistake rarely leads to a long ban.
items.zh: 處罰應該與違規行為相稱，所以初次的小錯誤很少導致長期禁賽。

items.def: considered in comparison with something else
items.s: Her ________ strength is excellent, because she lifts twice her own body weight despite being quite small.
items.zh: 她的相對力量非常出色，因為儘管她身材相當小，卻能舉起自身體重的兩倍。

items.def: needed for a particular purpose
items.s: He lacked the ________ experience for the national squad, so the selectors asked him to wait another year.
items.zh: 他缺乏進國家隊所必要的經驗，所以選拔委員請他再等一年。

items.def: belonging separately to each person mentioned
items.s: The two runners returned to their ________ clubs after the camp, and they met again at the final.
items.zh: 訓練營結束後兩位跑者回到各自的俱樂部，而他們在決賽中再次相遇。

items.def: done by one side only
items.s: The club made a ________ decision to cancel the tour, and the players only heard about it on the news.
items.zh: 俱樂部單方面決定取消巡迴賽，而球員們只是從新聞上得知。

items.def: able to be prevented
items.s: Most of these ankle injuries are ________, because a proper warm-up takes only ten minutes of your time.
items.zh: 這些腳踝傷害大多是可避免的，因為適當的熱身只需要花你十分鐘。

items.def: making someone very weak
items.s: The illness was ________, so she could not train for three months, but she returned stronger in the spring.
items.zh: 那場病使她非常虛弱，所以她三個月無法訓練，但她在春天以更強的狀態回歸。

items.def: unclear and open to more than one meaning
items.s: The results were ________, so the scientists refused to recommend the method until more work had been done.
items.zh: 結果模稜兩可，所以科學家在更多研究完成前拒絕推薦這個方法。

items.def: good for you or helpful
items.s: The weather was ________ on race day, and six runners finished inside their personal best times.
items.zh: 比賽當天天氣有利，而六位跑者都跑進了自己的最佳成績。

items.def: dangerous
items.s: Running on that road is ________ after dark, so the club moved its evening sessions to the park.
items.zh: 天黑後在那條路上跑步很危險，所以社團把晚間訓練移到公園。

items.def: not sensible or possible in real life
items.s: The plan was ________ for a small school, because it needed a full-time coach and a heated pool.
items.zh: 這個計畫對小型學校不切實際，因為它需要一位全職教練和一座溫水游泳池。

items.def: showing clear and deep understanding
items.s: Her ________ comments after the match helped the young players, and nobody felt blamed for the defeat.
items.zh: 她賽後富有洞見的評論幫助了年輕球員，而沒有人因為落敗而感到被責怪。

items.def: giving useful information or lessons
items.s: The defeat was ________, because it showed the team exactly which skills they still had to practise.
items.zh: 這場敗仗很有教育意義，因為它確切顯示了球隊還必須練習哪些技能。

items.def: involving several different subjects or specialists
items.s: A ________ team now supports the squad, and it includes a doctor, a dietitian and a psychologist.
items.zh: 現在有一支跨領域團隊支援這支隊伍，其中包括醫生、營養師和心理師。

items.def: able to be got or achieved
items.s: The data is freely ________ online, so any coach can read the full report without paying.
items.zh: 這些數據在網路上可免費取得，所以任何教練都能不付費閱讀完整報告。

items.def: quick to notice and understand things
items.s: A ________ coach spots tiredness before an athlete complains, and she changes the session straight away.
items.zh: 敏銳的教練會在運動員抱怨前就看出疲勞，而她會立刻調整訓練內容。

items.def: allowed by the rules
items.s: Only one type of shoe is ________ in this event, and officials check every athlete before the start.
items.zh: 這個項目只允許一種鞋款，而官員在起跑前會檢查每位選手。

items.def: able to be stopped before it happens
items.s: Heat illness is largely ________, so coaches must provide shade and water during summer training.
items.zh: 熱傷害大致上可預防，所以教練必須在夏季訓練時提供遮蔭和飲水。

items.def: based on careful thinking
items.s: She gave a ________ argument for resting the captain, and the other coaches quickly agreed with her.
items.zh: 她提出了讓隊長休息的有理有據的論點，而其他教練很快就同意了。

items.def: happening again and again
items.s: His ________ shoulder problem finally improved after he changed his swimming technique, and now he trains without pain.
items.zh: 他反覆出現的肩膀問題在他改變游泳技術後終於好轉，而現在他訓練時不再疼痛。

items.def: depending on someone or something
items.s: The team became too ________ on one striker, so when he was injured they struggled to score.
items.zh: 球隊變得太依賴一位前鋒，所以當他受傷時他們很難得分。

items.def: able to be done again in the same way
items.s: A good test must be ________, so the same athlete should get a similar score on a different day.
items.zh: 好的測驗必須可重複，所以同一位運動員在不同日子應該得到相似的分數。

items.def: able to be copied exactly by other researchers
items.s: The method is simple and ________, and three other universities have since repeated the experiment.
items.zh: 這個方法簡單且可複製，而後來有三所其他大學重複了這項實驗。

items.def: able to be used in a different situation
items.s: Teamwork is a ________ skill, so what you learn on the court also helps you in group projects at school.
items.zh: 團隊合作是一種可轉移的技能，所以你在球場上學到的也能幫助你在學校做小組作業。

items.def: impossible to prevent
items.s: Some physical contact is ________ in a fast basketball game, but dangerous play is punished immediately by the officials.
items.zh: 在快節奏的籃球比賽中某些身體接觸是無法避免的，但危險的動作會被裁判立刻處罰。

items.def: not managed or limited
items.s: ________ use of supplements worries doctors, because teenagers sometimes take far more than the label suggests.
items.zh: 補充品的未受管控使用令醫生擔憂，因為青少年有時服用的量遠超過標籤建議。

items.def: not valued as highly as it should be
items.s: Rest is the most ________ part of training, and many young athletes still think more is always better.
items.zh: 休息是訓練中最被低估的部分，而許多年輕運動員仍認為越多越好。

items.def: not wanted because it causes problems
items.s: Rapid weight loss has several ________ effects, so the dietitian planned a slower and safer programme.
items.zh: 快速減重有幾種不良影響，所以營養師規劃了一個較慢且較安全的計畫。

items.def: not helpful or good for you
items.s: Conditions were ________ for a record, because a strong wind blew straight into the runners' faces.
items.zh: 當時的條件對破紀錄不利，因為強風正面吹向跑者的臉。

items.def: not yet shown to be true or effective
items.s: The treatment is still ________, so the club will not pay for it until better evidence appears.
items.zh: 這種療法仍未經證實，所以在更好的證據出現前俱樂部不會支付費用。

items.def: suitable for a person's age
items.s: Children need ________ training in every sport, because exercises designed for adults can easily damage their growing joints.
items.zh: 兒童在每種運動中都需要適齡的訓練，因為為成人設計的運動很容易傷害他們發育中的關節。

items.def: based on what people say about themselves
items.s: The study used ________ sleep times, so the numbers may be a little too generous.
items.zh: 這項研究使用自我回報的睡眠時間，所以這些數字可能稍微偏寬鬆。

items.def: involving many people or a wide area
items.s: A ________ survey of ten thousand students found that only a third exercised every day.
items.zh: 一項對一萬名學生的大規模調查發現只有三分之一的人每天運動。

items.def: limited in size or number
items.s: The first trial was ________, but it gave the researchers enough confidence to apply for more funding.
items.zh: 第一次試驗規模很小，但它給了研究人員足夠的信心去申請更多經費。

items.def: continuing for a long period
items.s: The ________ benefits of exercise are enormous, although many people only notice the short-term tiredness.
items.zh: 運動的長期益處非常巨大，雖然許多人只注意到短期的疲累。

items.def: lasting only a short period
items.s: A ________ gain in speed is useless if the training leaves you injured for the whole season.
items.zh: 如果訓練讓你整季受傷，速度上的短期提升就毫無用處。

items.def: covering many different subjects
items.s: The report was ________, and it discussed everything from school timetables to the design of playgrounds.
items.zh: 這份報告範圍廣泛，從學校課表到遊戲場設計無所不談。

items.def: looking at many people at one point in time
items.s: A ________ study can show a pattern quickly, but it cannot prove that one thing caused another.
items.zh: 橫斷面研究能快速顯示一種模式，但它無法證明一件事導致了另一件事。

items.def: in a way that causes harm
items.s: Poor sleep ________ affects reaction time, so coaches now ask players to switch off their phones before midnight.
items.zh: 睡眠不足會不利地影響反應時間，所以教練現在要求球員在午夜前關掉手機。

items.def: by an amount large enough to notice
items.s: Her times improved ________ after she changed her diet, although she had not changed her training at all.
items.zh: 她改變飲食後成績明顯進步，雖然她完全沒有改變訓練方式。

items.def: in a clear and complete way, with no doubt
items.s: The athlete ________ denied taking any banned drug, and later tests supported what she had said.
items.zh: 那位運動員斷然否認服用任何禁藥，而後來的檢測支持了她的說法。

items.def: completely and in every way
items.s: Our team was beaten ________ in the first round, but we learned a great deal from the experience.
items.zh: 我們球隊在第一輪被徹底擊敗，但我們從這次經驗中學到很多。

items.def: in a firm way that settles something
items.s: She acted ________ at the final bend, and she had opened a clear gap before the others reacted.
items.zh: 她在最後一個彎道果斷地發動，而在其他人反應前她已拉開明顯差距。

items.def: in a way that can be proved
items.s: Warming up is ________ safer than starting cold, and dozens of studies have reached the same conclusion.
items.zh: 熱身明顯地比直接開始更安全，而數十項研究得出相同結論。

items.def: wrongly or by mistake
items.s: The report ________ stated that he had failed a test, so the newspaper printed an apology the next day.
items.zh: 那份報告錯誤地說他檢測未通過，所以報社隔天刊登了道歉。

items.def: in a way that is suggested but not said directly
items.s: By choosing him as captain, the coach ________ accepted his ideas about training, and the older players noticed.
items.zh: 教練選他當隊長，就隱含地接受了他對訓練的想法，而資深球員都注意到了。

items.def: without meaning to
items.s: He ________ took a banned substance in a cold remedy, but the panel accepted that it was an honest mistake.
items.zh: 他在感冒藥中無意間服用了禁用物質，但委員會接受那是個無心之過。

items.def: in a series of small steps
items.s: Add weight ________ each week, because sudden jumps are the quickest way to hurt yourself.
items.zh: 每週逐步增加重量，因為突然加重是最快讓自己受傷的方式。

items.def: in a way nobody can argue against
items.s: She is ________ the best player of her generation, although she has never won a world title.
items.zh: 她無可爭辯地是她那一代最好的球員，儘管她從未贏得世界冠軍。

items.def: with great care and attention to detail
items.s: He records every session ________, so he can see exactly what worked before his best races.
items.zh: 他一絲不苟地記錄每次訓練，所以他能確切看出在最佳表現前哪些做法有效。

items.def: without being influenced by feelings
items.s: Video lets coaches judge performance ________, because the camera does not care who the player is.
items.zh: 影片讓教練能客觀地評斷表現，因為攝影機不在意球員是誰。

items.def: in a way that matches something else in size
items.s: Children's equipment should be ________ smaller, so a junior ball is lighter than an adult one.
items.zh: 兒童的器材應該成比例地較小，所以兒童用球比成人用球輕。

items.def: in a strict and thorough way
items.s: Every supplement is tested ________ before the team uses it, because one mistake could end a career.
items.zh: 每種補充品在球隊使用前都經過嚴格檢測，因為一個錯誤可能結束一段職業生涯。

items.def: by an important amount
items.s: Injury numbers fell ________ after the new warm-up was introduced, and other schools soon copied it.
items.zh: 在引入新的熱身方式後，受傷人數顯著下降，而其他學校很快就效法。

items.def: in an organised, step-by-step way
items.s: The coach ________ worked through each weakness, and by March the team had almost no defensive errors.
items.zh: 教練系統地處理每一個弱點，而到了三月球隊幾乎沒有防守失誤。

items.def: in a careful, uncertain way
items.s: The doctors ________ cleared him to train, but they asked him to stop if any pain returned.
items.zh: 醫生暫時許可他訓練，但他們要求他若有任何疼痛復發就停止。

items.def: completely and carefully
items.s: Clean the equipment ________ after every single session, because shared mats can easily spread skin infections among players.
items.zh: 每一次訓練後都要徹底清潔器材，因為共用的墊子很容易在球員之間傳播皮膚感染。

items.def: by everyone or everywhere
items.s: The new rule was ________ welcomed, and even the oldest coaches admitted that it made the game safer.
items.zh: 新規則受到普遍歡迎，而連最資深的教練都承認它讓比賽更安全。

items.def: to give evidence or reasons for something
items.s: The lawyer could ________ no evidence of cheating, so the committee cleared the swimmer completely.
items.zh: 律師無法舉出任何作弊的證據，所以委員會徹底還了那位泳者清白。

items.def: to make use of something that is offered
items.s: Students should ________ themselves of the free gym classes, because the teachers are qualified and the sessions are safe.
items.zh: 學生應該利用免費的健身課程，因為老師都有資格，而課程也很安全。

items.def: to complain about something
items.s: Fans often ________ the cost of tickets, but they still fill the ground for every important match.
items.zh: 球迷常抱怨票價，但每場重要比賽他們仍把球場填滿。

items.def: to begin talking about a difficult subject
items.s: Nobody wanted to ________ the subject of retirement, so the captain finally raised it himself.
items.zh: 沒有人想開口談退休這件事，所以隊長最後自己提了出來。

items.def: to ask many people for their opinions
items.s: The club will ________ members before changing the shirt, because the old design has been used for fifty years.
items.zh: 俱樂部在更改球衣前會徵詢會員意見，因為舊設計已使用了五十年。

items.def: to criticise someone severely
items.s: The press ________ the manager after the defeat, but the players defended him in every interview.
items.zh: 媒體在落敗後嚴厲批評總教練，但球員在每次訪問中都為他辯護。

items.def: to slow down
items.s: Learning to ________ safely matters as much as sprinting, because most knee injuries happen when players stop suddenly.
items.zh: 學會安全減速和衝刺一樣重要，因為大多數膝傷發生在球員突然停下時。

items.def: to stop doing something
items.s: The referee warned both captains to ________ from arguing, or he would show a card to each of them.
items.zh: 裁判警告兩位隊長停止爭論，否則他會對他們各出一張牌。

items.def: to break up a group or team
items.s: The club had to ________ its junior section, because only four children turned up for training.
items.zh: 俱樂部必須解散青少年組，因為只有四個孩子出席訓練。

items.def: to separate things that are mixed together
items.s: Researchers tried to ________ the effects of diet and sleep, but the two were closely connected.
items.zh: 研究人員試圖釐清飲食和睡眠的影響，但兩者緊密相關。

items.def: to make something official
items.s: The school decided to ________ its safety rules, so every coach signed a written agreement.
items.zh: 學校決定正式確立其安全規定，所以每位教練都簽了書面同意書。

items.def: to make someone unable to do things
items.s: A single bad tackle can ________ a player for months, so dangerous challenges carry heavy punishments.
items.zh: 一次糟糕的擒抱就可能讓球員失去行動能力好幾個月，所以危險的動作會受到重罰。

items.def: to encourage people by offering a reward
items.s: The city tried to ________ walking by giving free bus tickets to people who recorded ten thousand steps.
items.zh: 市政府試圖以誘因鼓勵步行，為記錄到一萬步的人提供免費公車票。

items.def: to make something become usual or accepted
items.s: Clubs are working to ________ talking about mental health, so players no longer hide their worries.
items.zh: 俱樂部正努力讓談論心理健康變得稀鬆平常，所以球員不再隱藏自己的煩惱。

items.def: to punish someone for breaking a rule
items.s: Referees now ________ any contact with the head, and the number of serious injuries has fallen.
items.zh: 裁判現在會處罰任何碰觸頭部的動作，而重傷的數量已經下降。

items.def: to arrange information in a table
items.s: She asked us to ________ our weekly distances, so the pattern of our training became easy to see.
items.zh: 她要我們把每週的距離製成表格，這樣我們訓練的模式就變得容易看出。

items.def: to score so that both sides have the same points
items.s: We managed to ________ in the last minute, and the crowd behind the goal went completely wild.
items.zh: 我們在最後一分鐘成功追成平手，而球門後方的觀眾完全瘋了。

items.def: to officially end a law or rule
items.s: The federation voted to ________ the old rule, because modern equipment had made it pointless.
items.zh: 聯盟投票廢除舊規則，因為現代裝備已讓它失去意義。

items.def: to defeat someone completely
items.s: They expected to ________ the visitors easily, but the match ended in a surprising draw.
items.zh: 他們預期能輕鬆擊敗客隊，但比賽卻以令人意外的平手收場。

items.def: to change the position or arrangement of something
items.s: The physiotherapist helped him ________ his running style, and the pain in his hip slowly disappeared.
items.zh: 物理治療師幫助他重新調整跑姿，而他髖部的疼痛慢慢消失了。

items.def: to explain something by describing its situation
items.s: Good teachers ________ each statistic, so students understand what a number actually means in real life.
items.zh: 好老師會把每個統計數字放進脈絡中解釋，讓學生理解一個數字在現實中真正的意義。

items.def: to compare information from two different sources
items.s: The scientists ________ the training diaries with the injury records, and a clear pattern soon appeared.
items.zh: 科學家把訓練日誌與受傷紀錄交叉比對，而一個清楚的模式很快浮現。

items.def: to make something less steady or secure
items.s: Weak hip muscles can ________ the knee, so strengthening them often reduces pain for runners.
items.zh: 髖部肌肉無力會使膝蓋不穩定，所以強化它們常常能減輕跑者的疼痛。

items.def: to make an organisation smaller
items.s: The club had to ________ after losing its main sponsor, so two coaching posts disappeared at the end of June.
items.zh: 失去主要贊助商後俱樂部必須縮編，所以兩個教練職位在六月底消失了。

items.def: to make a practice part of an organisation's system
items.s: They want to ________ rest days, so every athlete gets one full day off written into the plan.
items.zh: 他們希望把休息日制度化，讓每位運動員的計畫中都寫入完整的一天休假。

items.def: to be connected with and affect each other
items.s: Sleep, diet and mood all ________, so changing one of them usually changes the other two as well.
items.zh: 睡眠、飲食和情緒全都相互關聯，所以改變其中之一通常也會改變另外兩項。

items.def: to list things separately
items.s: Please ________ every piece of equipment you need, and the school will tell you what the budget can cover.
items.zh: 請逐項列出你需要的每一件器材，而學校會告訴你預算能支付哪些。

items.def: to form a wrong opinion about something
items.s: The goalkeeper ________ the flight of the ball, so it bounced over his hands and into the net.
items.zh: 守門員誤判了球的飛行路線，所以球彈過他的手飛進球網。

items.def: to put things in order of quality or importance
items.s: The magazine tried to ________ the world's hardest races, but readers argued about the order for weeks.
items.zh: 那本雜誌試圖為世界上最艱難的比賽排名，但讀者為排序爭論了好幾週。

items.def: to make something simpler and more efficient
items.s: The federation plans to ________ the competition calendar, because players currently travel almost every weekend.
items.zh: 聯盟計畫精簡賽程表，因為球員目前幾乎每個週末都在奔波。

items.def: to adjust a measuring device or a plan
items.s: The staff must ________ the timing gates each morning, or the recorded speeds will be slightly wrong.
items.zh: 工作人員每天早上必須重新校準計時門，否則記錄的速度會稍有偏差。

items.def: to put something into a different group
items.s: Officials decided to ________ the event as high-risk, so medical staff must now be present throughout.
items.zh: 官員決定把這項賽事重新分類為高風險，所以現在醫護人員必須全程在場。

items.def: to arrange something in a different way
items.s: The gym was ________ over the summer, and the free-weight area is now twice as large.
items.zh: 健身房在暑假期間重新配置，而自由重量區現在大了兩倍。

items.def: to plan or make something again in a new way
items.s: Engineers had to ________ the helmet, because tests showed that it moved too easily on impact.
items.zh: 工程師必須重新設計那款頭盔，因為測試顯示它在撞擊時太容易移位。

items.def: to express or make something in a new form
items.s: The company had to ________ the drink after one ingredient was banned, and the new version tastes less sweet.
items.zh: 在一種成分被禁用後，公司必須重新調配這款飲料，而新版本嘗起來比較不甜。

items.def: to make things happen at exactly the same time
items.s: The pair must ________ every movement, because even a tiny difference loses marks in this event.
items.zh: 這組選手必須讓每個動作同步，因為在這個項目中即使微小的差異也會失分。

items.def: to tell someone about a problem before it happens
items.s: The doctor ________ her that recovery would be slow, so she was not shocked when progress took months.
items.zh: 醫生事先警告她復原會很慢，所以當進展花了好幾個月時她並不驚訝。

items.def: to do too much to make up for a problem
items.s: Injured runners often ________ with the other leg, and that is why a second injury appears so often.
items.zh: 受傷的跑者常用另一條腿過度補償，而這就是第二次受傷如此常見的原因。

items.def: to act first in order to prevent something
items.s: Good coaches ________ arguments by explaining their selections to the whole squad before the team sheet goes up.
items.zh: 好教練會在名單公布前向全隊解釋選人理由，以搶先避免爭吵。

items.def: to change the proportions of something
items.s: He had to ________ his week, so he now trains four days and studies on the other three.
items.zh: 他必須重新平衡自己的一週，所以他現在訓練四天，另外三天讀書。

items.def: to greatly increase your effort
items.s: After the narrow defeat the squad ________ its efforts, and the players arrived early every morning.
items.zh: 在那場惜敗後，隊伍加倍努力，而球員每天早上都提早到場。

items.def: to change the direction or focus of something
items.s: The club wants to ________ its programme towards enjoyment, because too many teenagers were giving up.
items.zh: 俱樂部想把課程重新定位於樂趣，因為太多青少年中途放棄。

items.def: to choose a small group from many applicants
items.s: The selectors will ________ twenty players next week, and the final squad will be named in May.
items.zh: 選拔委員下週會挑出二十位球員進入最終名單，而正式名單將在五月公布。

items.def: to check someone or something carefully before accepting them
items.s: The club must ________ every volunteer coach, because anyone working with children needs a background check.
items.zh: 俱樂部必須審查每位志工教練，因為任何與兒童共事的人都需要背景調查。

items.def: to make something bigger or available to more people
items.s: The city wants to ______ ______ the free swimming scheme, so every primary school will join by next year.
items.zh: 市政府希望擴大免費游泳計畫的規模，所以明年前每所小學都會加入。

items.def: to introduce a new plan or product widely
items.s: The league will ______ ______ the new concussion test in August, and all referees are being trained now.
items.zh: 聯盟將在八月全面推行新的腦部撞擊檢測，而所有裁判現在都在接受訓練。

items.def: to make small changes that improve something
items.s: She spent the winter trying to ________ her start, and she gained a tenth of a second by spring.
items.zh: 她整個冬天都在試著微調起跑，而到春天她進步了十分之一秒。

items.def: to check a finding by using three different sources
items.s: The researchers ________ their results with interviews, video and lab tests, so their conclusions were hard to argue with.
items.zh: 研究人員用訪談、影片和實驗室檢測三角驗證結果，所以他們的結論難以反駁。

items.def: to leave a player out of a team
items.s: The coach had to ________ two popular players, and she explained her reasons to them in private first.
items.zh: 教練必須不選入兩位受歡迎的球員，而她先私下向他們解釋了理由。

items.def: to write down a record of something regularly
items.s: Athletes ________ their training in an app, so the coach can spot problems before an injury happens.
items.zh: 運動員用應用程式記錄訓練，所以教練能在受傷發生前發現問題。

items.def: to set a higher standard than before
items.s: Her world record really ______ ______ ______ for everyone, and three other runners went faster within a year.
items.zh: 她的世界紀錄確實為所有人提高了標準，而一年內另外三位跑者都跑得更快了。

items.def: to unfairly change the rules or aims during something
items.s: The committee kept changing the entry standard, and the athletes complained that it was trying to ______ ______ ______.
items.zh: 委員會不斷改變參賽標準，而運動員抱怨它是在中途改變規則。

items.w: keep one's eye on the ball
items.def: to stay focused on what matters
items.s: There are many distractions before a big final, so the captain told everyone to ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______.
items.zh: 大賽前有許多令人分心的事，所以隊長叫大家專注於重點。

items.def: at a much higher level than you can match
items.s: We were clearly ______ ______ ______ ______ in the first half, but we defended bravely and only lost by two goals.
items.zh: 上半場我們明顯實力不如對手，但我們勇敢防守，只輸了兩球。

items.def: in a better position than your rivals
items.s: The club bought its own data system early, so it stayed ______ ______ ______ ______ for several seasons.
items.zh: 這家俱樂部很早就購入自己的數據系統，所以它好幾個球季都保持領先。

items.def: exactly equal in a race or competition
items.s: The two swimmers were ______ ______ ______ with ten metres to go, and the crowd rose to its feet.
items.zh: 剩下十公尺時兩位泳者不分軒輊，而觀眾全體站了起來。

items.def: not decided until the very last moment
items.s: The title race went ______ ______ ______ ______, because both teams won every match until the final weekend.
items.zh: 冠軍之爭撐到最後一刻，因為兩隊直到最後一個週末前都贏下每場比賽。

items.def: to give up
items.s: He was two sets behind and exhausted, but he refused to ______ ______ ______ ______ and somehow won the match.
items.zh: 他落後兩盤又疲憊不堪，但他拒絕認輸，最後竟然贏下了那場比賽。

items.def: to start too early
items.s: One sprinter ______ ______ ______ in the final, so the officials called the runners back and gave him a warning.
items.zh: 決賽中一位短跑選手搶跑，所以官員把跑者叫回並給了他一次警告。

items.def: normal and to be expected in that situation
items.s: Sore legs after a long run are ______ ______ ______ ______, so do not worry unless the pain is sharp.
items.zh: 長跑後雙腿痠痛是在所難免的，所以除非是劇痛，否則不用擔心。

items.def: to begin doing something confidently and well
items.s: She started the season slowly, but she ______ ______ ______ in March and scored in five matches.
items.zh: 她本季開季緩慢，但她在三月進入狀況，並在五場比賽中得分。

items.def: to find new energy after feeling tired
items.s: I thought I would have to walk, but I ______ ______ ______ ______ at the top of the hill and ran the rest.
items.zh: 我以為我得改成走路，但我在山頂恢復了體力，並跑完了剩下的路程。

items.def: to continue until something is finished
items.s: Many runners start too fast, so only those who pace themselves can really ______ ______ ______.
items.zh: 許多跑者一開始衝太快，所以只有懂得配速的人才能真正堅持到最後。

items.def: still having a chance of winning
items.s: After Saturday's win we are still ______ ______ ______ for the title, although we must beat the leaders next month.
items.zh: 星期六贏球後我們冠軍仍有機會，雖然我們下個月必須擊敗領先者。

items.def: to recover quickly after a defeat or problem
items.s: The young team lost badly in the opening game, but they ______ ______ and won their next four matches.
items.zh: 這支年輕球隊在開幕戰大敗，但他們重新振作並贏了接下來四場比賽。

items.def: you must work hard and suffer to improve
items.s: My coach always says "______ ______, ______ ______", but she also reminds us that sharp pain is a warning.
items.zh: 我的教練總是說「沒有付出就沒有收穫」，但她也提醒我們劇痛是一種警訊。

items.def: to win very easily
items.s: They expected a close game, but the visitors ______ ______ ______ and led by thirty points at half-time.
items.zh: 他們預期會是一場勢均力敵的比賽，但客隊輕鬆取勝，中場休息時已領先三十分。

items.def: by a very small amount
items.s: She missed the record ______ ______ ______, and she joked that she should have cut her hair that morning.
items.zh: 她以極小的差距錯失紀錄，而她開玩笑說那天早上應該去剪個頭髮。

items.def: the last part of a race or task
items.s: We are on ______ ______ ______ of the season now, so the coach wants everyone to stay healthy for three more weeks.
items.zh: 我們現在正處於本季的最後階段，所以教練希望大家再多保持三週的健康。

items.def: to try as hard as you possibly can
items.s: He did not win a medal, but he ______ ______ ______ ______ and his family were proud of him anyway.
items.zh: 他沒有拿到獎牌，但他全力以赴，而他的家人無論如何都為他感到驕傲。

items.def: a person who paints pictures
items.s: My aunt is a ________ who works in a small studio by the river, and she sells her pictures at the weekend market.
items.zh: 我阿姨是一位畫家,在河邊的小工作室工作,而且她週末會在市集賣她的畫。

items.def: strong cloth that artists paint on
items.s: The art teacher gave each of us a large white ________, but I felt nervous because I did not know what to paint.
items.zh: 美術老師給我們每人一張大大的白色畫布,但我覺得很緊張,因為我不知道要畫什麼。

items.def: a wooden stand that holds a painting while you work
items.s: She set up her ________ near the window to catch the morning light, and then she started to paint the old temple.
items.zh: 她把畫架架在窗邊以捕捉早晨的光線,然後開始畫那座古老的廟宇。

items.def: a flat board for mixing paint colours
items.s: He squeezed some blue and yellow onto his ________, and he mixed them slowly until he got the green colour of the hills.
items.zh: 他在調色盤上擠了一些藍色和黃色,並慢慢調和,直到調出山丘的綠色。

items.def: a brush used for putting paint on a surface
items.s: Remember to wash your ________ in clean water after class, or the paint will dry and the hairs will become hard.
items.zh: 下課後記得用清水洗你的畫筆,否則顏料會乾掉,刷毛會變硬。

items.def: paint mixed with water; a picture made this way
items.s: I prefer ________ to oil paint because it dries quickly, but it is hard to fix a mistake once the colour is on paper.
items.zh: 我比較喜歡水彩而不是油畫顏料,因為它乾得快,但顏色一上紙就很難修改錯誤。

items.def: thick paint made with oil that dries slowly
items.s: ______ ______ takes several days to dry completely, so the artist works on two or three pictures at the same time.
items.zh: 油畫顏料需要好幾天才能完全乾燥,所以這位畫家會同時進行兩、三幅畫。

items.def: made with a fast-drying plastic-based paint
items.s: We used ________ paint for the school mural because it is cheap and bright, and it does not wash away in the rain.
items.zh: 我們用壓克力顏料畫學校的壁畫,因為它便宜又鮮豔,而且不會被雨水沖掉。

items.def: a single mark made by a paintbrush
items.s: If you stand close to the painting, you can see every thick ________, but from far away the picture looks smooth and calm.
items.zh: 如果你站在畫作附近,可以看到每一道厚厚的筆觸,但從遠處看,畫面看起來平滑又寧靜。

items.def: a picture of objects such as fruit, flowers or bottles
items.s: For homework we had to paint a ______ ______ of fruit on the kitchen table, so I arranged some apples next to a teapot.
items.zh: 作業是要畫一幅廚房桌上水果的靜物畫,所以我把幾顆蘋果擺在茶壺旁邊。

items.def: a painting, drawing or photo of a person
items.s: The family asked a local artist to paint a ________ of their grandfather, and they hung it in the living room for his ninetieth birthday.
items.zh: 這家人請當地一位藝術家為爺爺畫一幅肖像畫,並在他九十歲生日時把它掛在客廳。

items.def: a picture an artist makes of himself or herself
items.s: Van Gogh painted more than thirty versions of his ________, because he was poor and could not pay models to sit for him.
items.zh: 梵谷畫了三十多幅自畫像,因為他很窮,付不起錢請模特兒讓他畫。

items.def: a picture of natural scenery such as hills or rivers
items.s: Traditional Chinese ______ ______ often shows tiny people under huge mountains, and this reminds viewers how small humans are in nature.
items.zh: 傳統中國山水風景畫常描繪巨大山脈下渺小的人物,這提醒觀者人類在自然中是多麼渺小。

items.def: a large picture painted on a wall
items.s: Students painted a colourful ________ on the wall of the old train station, and now tourists stop there to take photos.
items.zh: 學生們在舊火車站的牆上畫了一幅色彩繽紛的壁畫,現在遊客會在那裡停下來拍照。

items.def: the point where parallel lines seem to meet far away
items.s: Draw the road so that both sides meet at one ______ ______ on the horizon, and the street will suddenly look very deep.
items.zh: 把道路畫成兩側在地平線上的同一個消失點交會,街道就會突然看起來很有深度。

items.def: the part of a picture that looks nearest to you
items.s: In the ________ of the photo you can see a small dog, while the mountains stand quietly far behind it.
items.zh: 在這張照片的前景中你可以看到一隻小狗,而山脈則靜靜地矗立在牠後方遠處。

items.def: the part of a picture that looks farthest away
items.s: The girl in the painting wears a red dress, but the ________ is dark grey, so she really stands out.
items.zh: 畫中的女孩穿著紅色洋裝,但背景是深灰色的,所以她非常突出。

items.def: darker areas in a drawing that show shadow and shape
items.s: Without any ________, your drawing of the ball looks flat, so add some dark pencil marks on one side.
items.zh: 沒有任何陰影明暗,你畫的球看起來很扁平,所以在一側加上一些深色鉛筆線條吧。

items.def: a colour or shade of a colour
items.s: The sky turned a warm orange ________ just before sunset, and the photographer quickly took out his camera.
items.zh: 就在日落前,天空變成溫暖的橘色色調,攝影師趕緊拿出相機。

items.def: red, yellow or blue, which mix to make other colours
items.s: Red is a ______ ______, and when you mix it with yellow you get orange, so you only need a few tubes of paint.
items.zh: 紅色是一種原色,把它和黃色混合就會得到橘色,所以你只需要幾管顏料。

items.def: a black stick of burnt wood used for drawing
items.s: He drew the old fisherman's face in ________, and his fingers became completely black by the end of the lesson.
items.zh: 他用炭筆畫老漁夫的臉,到課程結束時他的手指全都變黑了。

items.def: a soft coloured chalk stick used for drawing
items.s: My little sister loves drawing with ________ because the colours are soft, but the dust gets all over her clothes.
items.zh: 我妹妹喜歡用粉彩筆畫畫,因為顏色很柔和,但粉末會沾得她滿身都是。

items.def: a book of blank pages for drawing
items.s: She always carries a small ________ in her bag, so she can draw interesting people on the MRT.
items.zh: 她的包包裡總是帶著一本小素描本,這樣她就能在捷運上畫有趣的人。

items.def: to draw small pictures without thinking carefully
items.s: I often ________ in the margins of my notebook during long meetings, but it actually helps me listen better.
items.zh: 我在冗長的會議中常在筆記本空白處隨手塗鴉,但這其實幫助我聽得更專心。

items.def: an artist who draws pictures for books or magazines
items.s: The ________ spent six months drawing pictures for the children's book, and the story became much more exciting.
items.zh: 那位插畫家花了六個月為這本童書繪製插圖,故事因此變得精彩許多。

items.def: a person who draws funny pictures or comic strips
items.s: The famous ________ draws a funny picture for the newspaper every day, and readers often laugh about politics because of him.
items.zh: 這位知名的漫畫家每天為報紙畫一幅有趣的漫畫,讀者常因為他而對政治一笑置之。

items.def: the border of wood or metal around a picture
items.s: We bought a simple wooden ________ for my daughter's drawing, and now it hangs proudly in the hallway.
items.zh: 我們為女兒的畫買了一個簡單的木製畫框,現在它驕傲地掛在走廊上。

items.def: how light or dark a colour is
items.s: The artist used a soft blue ________ for the whole picture, so the scene feels calm and a little sad.
items.zh: 這位畫家整幅畫都用柔和的藍色色調,所以畫面感覺寧靜又帶點憂傷。

items.def: to mix colours smoothly together
items.s: Use your finger to ________ the two colours at the edge, and the sky will change gently from pink to purple.
items.zh: 用手指在邊緣暈染這兩種顏色,天空就會從粉紅色柔和地漸變成紫色。

items.def: a circle that shows how colours relate to each other
items.s: Our teacher showed us a ______ ______, and we learned that colours opposite each other look very strong together.
items.zh: 老師給我們看一個色相環,我們學到彼此相對的顏色放在一起看起來非常強烈。

items.def: a work of art made by shaping stone, wood or metal
items.s: A huge metal ________ stands in front of the city hall, and children like to climb on its smooth base.
items.zh: 一座巨大的金屬雕塑矗立在市政府前,孩子們喜歡爬上它光滑的底座。
items.sec: Sculpture, Crafts & Materials 雕塑、工藝與媒材

items.def: an artist who makes sculptures
items.s: The ________ worked on the stone lion for two years, but he refused to show anyone until it was finished.
items.zh: 這位雕塑家花了兩年雕刻這隻石獅,但在完成前他拒絕讓任何人看。
items.sec: Sculpture, Crafts & Materials 雕塑、工藝與媒材

items.def: to make a shape from stone, wood or clay
items.s: During the summer camp, the kids learned to ________ animals from soft soap, and they proudly took them home to their parents.
items.zh: 夏令營期間,孩子們學會用柔軟的肥皂雕塑動物,並驕傲地把作品帶回家給父母。
items.sec: Sculpture, Crafts & Materials 雕塑、工藝與媒材

items.def: a metal tool with a sharp end for cutting wood or stone
items.s: He hit the ________ gently with a hammer, and small pieces of wood fell to the floor around him.
items.zh: 他用鐵鎚輕敲鑿子,小木屑掉落在他周圍的地板上。
items.sec: Sculpture, Crafts & Materials 雕塑、工藝與媒材

items.def: a soft substance used to make candles and models
items.s: The museum shows famous people made of ________, so visitors take selfies with them although they are not real.
items.zh: 這間博物館展示用蠟做成的名人像,所以雖然他們不是真人,遊客還是會和他們自拍。
items.sec: Sculpture, Crafts & Materials 雕塑、工藝與媒材

items.def: to make an object by pouring hot metal into a shape
items.s: The workers ________ the bronze bell in a special mould, and then they waited a whole week for it to cool down.
items.zh: 工人們在特製的模具中鑄造這口銅鐘,然後等了一整個星期讓它冷卻。
items.sec: Sculpture, Crafts & Materials 雕塑、工藝與媒材

items.def: to cut wood or stone into a shape
items.s: My grandfather likes to ________ small birds from old pieces of wood, and he gives them to his grandchildren as gifts.
items.zh: 我爺爺喜歡用舊木頭雕刻小鳥,並把它們當禮物送給孫子孫女。
items.sec: Sculpture, Crafts & Materials 雕塑、工藝與媒材

items.def: a large artwork that fills a room or space
items.s: The ________ filled the whole room with hanging paper lanterns, so visitors felt as if they were walking through a dream.
items.zh: 這件裝置藝術用懸掛的紙燈籠填滿整個房間,讓觀眾彷彿走在夢境之中。
items.sec: Sculpture, Crafts & Materials 雕塑、工藝與媒材

items.def: a person who makes pots and dishes from clay
items.s: The ________ in Yingge let us try making a cup, but mine looked strange because the clay kept moving.
items.zh: 鶯歌的陶藝家讓我們試做一個杯子,但我的看起來很奇怪,因為陶土一直移動。
items.sec: Sculpture, Crafts & Materials 雕塑、工藝與媒材

items.def: a turning round plate used to shape clay
items.s: She sat at the ______ ______ for hours, and she slowly shaped the wet clay into a tall, thin vase.
items.zh: 她在拉坯轉盤前坐了好幾個小時,慢慢把濕陶土塑成一個又高又細的花瓶。
items.sec: Sculpture, Crafts & Materials 雕塑、工藝與媒材

items.def: a shiny coating put on pottery before it is fired
items.s: After the bowls dried, we painted a blue ________ on them, so they became shiny and waterproof after firing.
items.zh: 碗乾了之後,我們在上面塗了一層藍色的釉,所以燒製後它們變得光亮又防水。
items.sec: Sculpture, Crafts & Materials 雕塑、工藝與媒材

items.def: pictures sewn onto cloth with coloured thread
items.s: Her grandmother's ________ shows flowers and birds in bright silk thread, and every tiny stitch was made by hand.
items.zh: 她奶奶的刺繡用鮮豔的絲線描繪花鳥,每一個小針腳都是手工縫製的。
items.sec: Sculpture, Crafts & Materials 雕塑、工藝與媒材

items.def: to make clothes from wool using two long needles
items.s: My mother likes to ________ scarves in winter, and she usually gives them to friends before Chinese New Year.
items.zh: 我媽媽冬天喜歡打毛線織圍巾,而且她通常會在農曆新年前把圍巾送給朋友。
items.sec: Sculpture, Crafts & Materials 雕塑、工藝與媒材

items.def: a warm bed cover made of many pieces of cloth
items.s: The women in the village made a ________ from old clothes, and each square tells a story about a family.
items.zh: 村裡的婦女用舊衣服做了一條拼布被,每一塊方格都訴說著一個家庭的故事。
items.sec: Sculpture, Crafts & Materials 雕塑、工藝與媒材

items.def: the Japanese art of folding paper into shapes
items.s: We learned ________ in art class and folded a hundred paper cranes, because our classmate was sick in hospital.
items.zh: 我們在美術課學了摺紙,折了一百隻紙鶴,因為我們的同學生病住院了。
items.sec: Sculpture, Crafts & Materials 雕塑、工藝與媒材

items.def: the art of cutting paper into pretty patterns
items.s: Red ________ decorations appear on many windows during Lunar New Year, and they usually show lucky words or animals.
items.zh: 農曆新年期間,許多窗戶上都會出現紅色的剪紙裝飾,通常是吉祥字或動物圖案。
items.sec: Sculpture, Crafts & Materials 雕塑、工藝與媒材

items.def: a print made from a picture cut into wood
items.s: The artist carved the design into a block of wood, and then she pressed it on paper to make a ________.
items.zh: 這位藝術家把圖案刻在木塊上,然後壓印在紙上製作出一幅木刻版畫。
items.sec: Sculpture, Crafts & Materials 雕塑、工藝與媒材

items.def: coloured glass used to make pictures in windows
items.s: Sunlight shone through the ______ ______ windows of the church, and colourful patterns danced across the floor.
items.zh: 陽光穿過教堂的彩繪玻璃窗,繽紛的圖案在地板上舞動。
items.sec: Sculpture, Crafts & Materials 雕塑、工藝與媒材

items.def: a picture made by sticking paper and photos onto a surface
items.s: We cut pictures out of old magazines to make a ________ about our dreams, and the teacher hung them on the classroom wall.
items.zh: 我們從舊雜誌剪下圖片,做了一幅關於夢想的拼貼畫,老師把它們掛在教室牆上。
items.sec: Sculpture, Crafts & Materials 雕塑、工藝與媒材

items.def: an event where people sell things they have made by hand
items.s: I bought a handmade leather wallet at the ______ ______ last weekend, and the seller even printed my name on it.
items.zh: 上週末我在手作市集買了一個手工皮夾,賣家甚至幫我在上面印了名字。
items.sec: Sculpture, Crafts & Materials 雕塑、工藝與媒材

items.def: a skilled activity of making things by hand
items.s: Many tourists buy local ________ such as bamboo baskets, because they want a real souvenir rather than a cheap plastic toy.
items.zh: 許多遊客會買竹籃之類的在地手工藝品,因為他們想要真正的紀念品,而不是廉價的塑膠玩具。
items.sec: Sculpture, Crafts & Materials 雕塑、工藝與媒材

items.def: rings, necklaces and other decorations you wear
items.s: She designs silver ________ in her small workshop, and she sells her rings and necklaces online to customers around the world.
items.zh: 她在小工作室裡設計銀首飾,並在網路上把戒指和項鍊賣給世界各地的顧客。
items.sec: Sculpture, Crafts & Materials 雕塑、工藝與媒材

items.def: a person who makes things from gold
items.s: The ________ melted the old gold chain carefully, and then he made it into a beautiful wedding ring for the young couple.
items.zh: 這位金匠小心地熔化舊金鍊,然後為這對年輕夫妻把它打造成一枚美麗的婚戒。
items.sec: Sculpture, Crafts & Materials 雕塑、工藝與媒材

items.def: a shiny liquid painted on wood to protect and decorate it
items.s: The wooden box is covered with red ________, and it looks so shiny that you can almost see your face in it.
items.zh: 這個木盒塗滿了紅漆,看起來亮到你幾乎能在上面看到自己的臉。
items.sec: Sculpture, Crafts & Materials 雕塑、工藝與媒材

items.def: a sheet with a shape cut out, used to paint the same shape
items.s: The street artist held a ________ against the wall and sprayed paint over it, so the same bird appeared in seconds.
items.zh: 這位街頭藝術家把鏤空模板貼在牆上並噴漆,同樣的鳥圖案幾秒內就出現了。
items.sec: Sculpture, Crafts & Materials 雕塑、工藝與媒材

items.def: objects made from metal by skilled workers
items.s: The exhibition shows beautiful ________ from old temples, such as bronze lamps and iron gates with flowers on them.
items.zh: 這個展覽展示了來自古廟的精美金工作品,例如青銅燈和帶有花朵圖案的鐵門。
items.sec: Sculpture, Crafts & Materials 雕塑、工藝與媒材

items.def: a sculpture of a person's head and shoulders
items.s: A marble ________ of the school's founder stands in the hall, and students sometimes put a hat on it for fun.
items.zh: 學校創辦人的大理石半身像立在大廳裡,學生有時會為了好玩幫它戴上帽子。
items.sec: Sculpture, Crafts & Materials 雕塑、工藝與媒材

items.def: the skill with which something is made
items.s: The chair is over a hundred years old, but it is still strong because the ________ is excellent.
items.zh: 這張椅子已經超過一百歲了,但它依然堅固,因為做工非常精良。
items.sec: Sculpture, Crafts & Materials 雕塑、工藝與媒材

items.def: a style of painting that shows light and quick impressions
items.s: ________ began in France in the 1870s, and its painters often worked outdoors to catch changing light on water and fields.
items.zh: 印象派於1870年代在法國興起,其畫家常在戶外作畫,以捕捉水面和田野上變幻的光線。
items.sec: Artists, Styles & Movements 藝術家、風格與流派

items.def: a painter in the style of Impressionism
items.s: Monet was a famous ________, and he painted the same pond again and again because the light changed every hour.
items.zh: 莫內是一位著名的印象派畫家,他一再畫同一座池塘,因為光線每小時都在變化。
items.sec: Artists, Styles & Movements 藝術家、風格與流派

items.def: an art style that shows objects as many geometric shapes
items.s: In ________, a face may be shown from the front and the side at the same time, so the picture can look confusing at first.
items.zh: 在立體派中,一張臉可能同時從正面和側面呈現,所以畫面一開始可能看起來令人困惑。
items.sec: Artists, Styles & Movements 藝術家、風格與流派

items.def: an art style that shows strange, dreamlike scenes
items.s: ________ was inspired by dreams, so its paintings often show melting clocks or fish flying through the sky.
items.zh: 超現實主義受到夢境啟發,所以它的畫作常出現融化的時鐘或在天空飛翔的魚。
items.sec: Artists, Styles & Movements 藝術家、風格與流派

items.def: very strange, like a dream
items.s: Walking through the empty city at dawn felt ________, because the streets that are usually so busy were completely silent.
items.zh: 黎明時走過空蕩的城市感覺很離奇,因為平常熱鬧的街道完全寂靜無聲。
items.sec: Artists, Styles & Movements 藝術家、風格與流派

items.def: an art style that shows strong feelings rather than real appearance
items.s: ________ uses wild colours and twisted shapes, because the artists wanted to show fear and anger rather than real faces.
items.zh: 表現主義使用狂野的色彩和扭曲的形狀,因為藝術家想表現恐懼和憤怒,而不是真實的面孔。
items.sec: Artists, Styles & Movements 藝術家、風格與流派

items.def: art that uses images from advertising and popular culture
items.s: ______ ______ turned soup cans and comic books into famous paintings, and it made people ask what art really is.
items.zh: 普普藝術把湯罐頭和漫畫書變成名畫,也讓人們思考藝術究竟是什麼。
items.sec: Artists, Styles & Movements 藝術家、風格與流派

items.def: showing things as they really are
items.s: The painter is known for his ________, and his pictures of tired farmers look almost like photographs.
items.zh: 這位畫家以寫實主義聞名,他筆下疲憊的農民看起來幾乎就像照片一樣。
items.sec: Artists, Styles & Movements 藝術家、風格與流派

items.def: an art movement that valued emotion, nature and imagination
items.s: ________ painters loved stormy seas and dark forests, because they believed nature could make people feel strong emotions.
items.zh: 浪漫主義畫家熱愛暴風雨的海洋和幽暗的森林,因為他們相信大自然能讓人產生強烈的情感。
items.sec: Artists, Styles & Movements 藝術家、風格與流派

items.def: in a rich, dramatic European style of the 1600s
items.s: The ________ church is full of gold decorations and dramatic paintings, so visitors usually look up at the ceiling in silence.
items.zh: 這座巴洛克風格的教堂到處是金色裝飾和戲劇性的畫作,所以遊客通常會靜靜地抬頭仰望天花板。
items.sec: Artists, Styles & Movements 藝術家、風格與流派

items.def: in a medieval style with tall pointed arches
items.s: The ________ cathedral has tall pointed windows, and it took almost two hundred years for the builders to finish it.
items.zh: 這座哥德式的大教堂有高聳的尖窗,而工匠們花了將近兩百年才完成它。
items.sec: Artists, Styles & Movements 藝術家、風格與流派

items.def: very new and experimental in art or ideas
items.s: The theatre group performs ________ plays without any words, so some audiences love them while others leave early.
items.zh: 這個劇團演出沒有任何台詞的前衛戲劇,所以有些觀眾很喜愛,而有些則提早離場。
items.sec: Artists, Styles & Movements 藝術家、風格與流派

items.def: art made in recent times
items.s: Many people find ______ ______ hard to understand, but the guide explained each work, so our visit became much more interesting.
items.zh: 許多人覺得當代藝術難以理解,但導覽員解說了每件作品,所以我們的參觀變得有趣多了。
items.sec: Artists, Styles & Movements 藝術家、風格與流派

items.def: art in which the idea matters more than the object
items.s: In ______ ______, the idea behind the work is more important than its skill, so a simple chair can become a serious artwork.
items.zh: 在觀念藝術中,作品背後的想法比技巧更重要,所以一張簡單的椅子也能成為嚴肅的藝術品。
items.sec: Artists, Styles & Movements 藝術家、風格與流派

items.def: art from about the 1860s to the 1970s that broke old rules
items.s: My grandfather says that ______ ______ looks like a child's drawing, but my sister explains why the artists broke the old rules.
items.zh: 我爺爺說現代藝術看起來像小孩的塗鴉,但我姊姊解釋了為什麼藝術家要打破舊規則。
items.sec: Artists, Styles & Movements 藝術家、風格與流派

items.def: traditional art made by ordinary people in a region
items.s: Hakka ______ ______ includes painted umbrellas and simple cloth patterns, and it shows the daily life of country people.
items.zh: 客家民俗藝術包括彩繪紙傘和簡樸的布料圖案,展現了鄉村百姓的日常生活。
items.sec: Artists, Styles & Movements 藝術家、風格與流派

items.def: a group of artists who share ideas and a style for a period
items.s: The young painters started a new ______ ______ in Paris, because they were tired of the strict rules of the art academy.
items.zh: 這群年輕畫家在巴黎發起一場新的藝術運動,因為他們厭倦了藝術學院的嚴格規範。
items.sec: Artists, Styles & Movements 藝術家、風格與流派

items.def: a type of art, music or writing
items.s: Hip-hop is my favourite music ________, but my parents prefer old Taiwanese folk songs from their childhood.
items.zh: 嘻哈是我最喜歡的音樂類型,但我爸媽比較喜歡他們童年時的台灣老民謠。
items.sec: Artists, Styles & Movements 藝術家、風格與流派

items.def: a particular way of making art
items.s: Each artist develops a personal ________ over many years, so experts can often recognise a painting before reading the name.
items.zh: 每位藝術家都要花很多年發展個人風格,所以專家常常在看到名字之前就能認出畫作。
items.sec: Artists, Styles & Movements 藝術家、風格與流派

items.def: relating to the style of a work of art
items.s: There are clear ________ differences between his early and late paintings, because he lost much of his eyesight in old age.
items.zh: 他早期和晚期的畫作有明顯的風格上的差異,因為他晚年視力大幅衰退。
items.sec: Artists, Styles & Movements 藝術家、風格與流派

items.def: an extremely good work of art
items.s: Many people think the "Mona Lisa" is a ________, but some visitors are surprised because the painting is quite small.
items.zh: 許多人認為《蒙娜麗莎》是一件傑作,但有些參觀者很驚訝,因為這幅畫相當小。
items.sec: Artists, Styles & Movements 藝術家、風格與流派

items.def: a great European painter from before about 1800
items.s: The museum owns a painting by an ______ ______ from the 1600s, so it is kept behind thick glass and guarded day and night.
items.zh: 博物館擁有一幅1600年代古典大師的畫作,所以它被放在厚玻璃後面,日夜都有人看守。
items.sec: Artists, Styles & Movements 藝術家、風格與流派

items.def: a person with great skill, especially in music
items.s: The young pianist is a real ________, and she can play the most difficult pieces without looking at the music.
items.zh: 這位年輕鋼琴家是真正的名家,她不看樂譜就能彈奏最困難的曲子。
items.sec: Artists, Styles & Movements 藝術家、風格與流派

items.def: a person who gives an artist ideas and inspiration
items.s: The singer says his wife is his ________, because most of his love songs were written about her.
items.zh: 這位歌手說他的妻子是他的繆思,因為他大部分的情歌都是為她寫的。
items.sec: Artists, Styles & Movements 藝術家、風格與流派

items.def: an artist's name written on a work
items.s: Experts checked the ________ in the corner of the painting carefully, because they suspected that the picture was a copy.
items.zh: 專家仔細檢查畫作角落的簽名,因為他們懷疑這幅畫是複製品。
items.sec: Artists, Styles & Movements 藝術家、風格與流派

items.def: living in an unusual, free way like many artists
items.cn: 波希米亞風的;放蕩不羈的
items.s: They live a ________ life in a small flat full of paintings, and they rarely care about money or fashion.
items.zh: 他們在堆滿畫作的小公寓裡過著放蕩不羈的生活,而且很少在乎金錢或時尚。
items.sec: Artists, Styles & Movements 藝術家、風格與流派

items.def: strange or unusual in behaviour
items.s: The ________ artist wore a bright purple suit every day, and he talked to his paintings as if they were friends.
items.zh: 這位古怪的藝術家每天都穿亮紫色西裝,而且會跟他的畫作說話,彷彿它們是朋友。
items.sec: Artists, Styles & Movements 藝術家、風格與流派

items.def: happening after a person's death
items.s: The poet enjoyed ________ fame, because her poems became popular only after she died in poverty.
items.zh: 這位詩人享有死後的名聲,因為她的詩直到她在貧困中過世後才受歡迎。
items.sec: Artists, Styles & Movements 藝術家、風格與流派

items.def: a room or building where art is shown or sold
items.s: We visited a small ________ in Taipei that shows young local artists, and the owner told us about each painting.
items.zh: 我們參觀了台北一家展出在地年輕藝術家作品的小畫廊,老闆向我們介紹了每一幅畫。
items.sec: Galleries, Museums & the Art Market 美術館、博物館與藝術市場

items.def: a building where valuable objects are kept and shown
items.s: The National Palace ________ is very crowded in summer, so we went early in the morning to avoid the tour groups.
items.zh: 國立故宮博物院夏天非常擁擠,所以我們一大早就去,以避開旅行團。
items.sec: Galleries, Museums & the Art Market 美術館、博物館與藝術市場

items.def: a group of objects gathered together
items.s: The museum's ________ includes more than five thousand paintings, but only a small number can be shown at one time.
items.zh: 這間博物館的收藏包括五千多幅畫作,但一次只能展出其中一小部分。
items.sec: Galleries, Museums & the Art Market 美術館、博物館與藝術市場

items.def: a person who gathers valuable objects as a hobby
items.s: The wealthy ________ bought paintings for fifty years, and before he died he gave all of them to the city.
items.zh: 這位富有的收藏家買了五十年的畫,並在過世前把它們全部捐給了這座城市。
items.sec: Galleries, Museums & the Art Market 美術館、博物館與藝術市場

items.def: a public sale where things go to the person who pays most
items.s: The painting was sold at ________ for ten million dollars, and the crowd clapped loudly when the hammer came down.
items.zh: 這幅畫在拍賣會上以一千萬美元售出,落槌時群眾大聲鼓掌。
items.sec: Galleries, Museums & the Art Market 美術館、博物館與藝術市場

items.def: the person who runs an auction
items.s: The ________ spoke very fast and pointed at people who raised their hands, so I was afraid to scratch my head.
items.zh: 拍賣官說話非常快,並指著舉手的人,所以我連抓頭都不敢。
items.sec: Galleries, Museums & the Art Market 美術館、博物館與藝術市場

items.def: to offer a price for something at an auction
items.s: Two collectors ________ against each other for the old vase, and the price rose higher and higher every few seconds.
items.zh: 兩位收藏家為這只古花瓶互相競標,價格每隔幾秒就越抬越高。
items.sec: Galleries, Museums & the Art Market 美術館、博物館與藝術市場

items.def: a person who offers money at an auction
items.s: The painting went to an unknown ________ on the telephone, so nobody in the room knew who the new owner was.
items.zh: 這幅畫由一位透過電話出價的匿名競標者得標,所以現場沒有人知道新主人是誰。
items.sec: Galleries, Museums & the Art Market 美術館、博物館與藝術市場

items.def: a person who buys and sells works of art
items.s: An ______ ______ noticed her paintings online, and he offered to sell them in his gallery in Hong Kong.
items.zh: 一位畫商在網路上注意到她的畫作,並提議在他香港的畫廊販售。
items.sec: Galleries, Museums & the Art Market 美術館、博物館與藝術市場

items.def: a judgement of how much something is worth
items.s: We took grandma's old painting for a ________, but the expert said it was worth only a few hundred dollars.
items.zh: 我們把奶奶的舊畫拿去估價,但專家說它只值幾百元。
items.sec: Galleries, Museums & the Art Market 美術館、博物館與藝術市場

items.def: so valuable that no price can be put on it
items.s: The museum's ancient scrolls are ________, so they are kept in dark rooms where the temperature never changes.
items.zh: 博物館的古代卷軸是無價的,所以它們被保存在溫度從不變化的暗室裡。
items.sec: Galleries, Museums & the Art Market 美術館、博物館與藝術市場

items.def: to prove that something is real and not a copy
items.s: Experts used X-rays to ________ the painting, and they found an older picture hidden under the paint.
items.zh: 專家使用X光來鑑定這幅畫的真偽,結果發現顏料底下藏著一幅更早的畫。
items.sec: Galleries, Museums & the Art Market 美術館、博物館與藝術市場

items.def: a person who repairs and protects old works of art
items.s: The ________ spent months cleaning the dirty painting with tiny brushes, and the bright colours slowly appeared again.
items.zh: 這位文物修復師花了好幾個月用小刷子清理骯髒的畫作,鮮豔的色彩慢慢重新顯現。
items.sec: Galleries, Museums & the Art Market 美術館、博物館與藝術市場

items.def: a visit led by a person who explains things
items.s: We joined a free ______ ______ of the museum, and the guide told us funny stories about the artists' lives.
items.zh: 我們參加了博物館的免費導覽,導覽員告訴我們藝術家生活中的趣事。
items.sec: Galleries, Museums & the Art Market 美術館、博物館與藝術市場

items.def: a trained guide who explains art in a museum
items.s: The ________ at the art museum is a retired teacher, and she explains the paintings so clearly that even children listen carefully.
items.zh: 美術館的導覽員是一位退休老師,她解說畫作清楚到連孩子都認真聆聽。
items.sec: Galleries, Museums & the Art Market 美術館、博物館與藝術市場

items.def: a recorded talk you listen to as you walk round a museum
items.s: I rented an ______ ______ at the entrance, so I could listen to information about each painting in Chinese.
items.zh: 我在入口租了一台語音導覽,這樣就能聽到每幅畫的中文介紹。
items.sec: Galleries, Museums & the Art Market 美術館、博物館與藝術市場

items.def: a shop in a museum that sells souvenirs
items.s: After the exhibition we went to the ______ ______, and I bought postcards of my favourite paintings for my friends.
items.zh: 看完展覽後我們去了紀念品店,我買了我最喜歡的畫作明信片送給朋友。
items.sec: Galleries, Museums & the Art Market 美術館、博物館與藝術市場

items.def: the first evening of an exhibition or show
items.s: Hundreds of guests came to the ______ ______ of her first exhibition, but she was so nervous that she hid in the bathroom.
items.zh: 數百位賓客出席她首次個展的開幕夜,但她緊張到躲進了廁所。
items.sec: Galleries, Museums & the Art Market 美術館、博物館與藝術市場

items.def: a large event where galleries show and sell art
items.s: Galleries from twenty countries come to the ______ ______ in Taipei every year, and collectors fly in to buy new works.
items.zh: 每年有來自二十個國家的畫廊參加台北的藝術博覽會,收藏家也會搭機前來購買新作品。
items.sec: Galleries, Museums & the Art Market 美術館、博物館與藝術市場

items.def: a large art exhibition held every two years
items.s: The famous ________ in Venice takes place every two years, and artists from all over the world hope to be invited.
items.zh: 威尼斯著名的雙年展每兩年舉辦一次,世界各地的藝術家都希望受邀參展。
items.sec: Galleries, Museums & the Art Market 美術館、博物館與藝術市場

items.def: a person who writes opinions about art
items.s: One well-known ______ ______ called the exhibition boring, but thousands of young visitors still queued to see it.
items.zh: 一位知名藝評家說這個展覽很無聊,但仍有數千名年輕觀眾排隊參觀。
items.sec: Galleries, Museums & the Art Market 美術館、博物館與藝術市場

items.def: something borrowed for a period of time
items.s: The famous painting is on ________ from a museum in Paris, so it will return to France after three months.
items.zh: 這幅名畫是巴黎一家博物館借展的,所以三個月後會回到法國。
items.sec: Galleries, Museums & the Art Market 美術館、博物館與藝術市場

items.def: a carefully planned robbery
items.s: Thieves stole thirteen paintings in a famous art ________ in 1990, and the frames still hang empty on the museum wall.
items.zh: 竊賊在1990年一起著名的藝術品竊案中偷走了十三幅畫,那些空畫框至今仍掛在博物館牆上。
items.sec: Galleries, Museums & the Art Market 美術館、博物館與藝術市場

items.def: to damage property on purpose
items.s: Someone tried to ________ the statue in the park last night, so the city has decided to put up cameras.
items.zh: 昨晚有人試圖蓄意破壞公園裡的雕像,所以市政府決定裝設監視器。
items.sec: Galleries, Museums & the Art Market 美術館、博物館與藝術市場

items.def: a base on which a statue stands
items.s: The small bronze horse stands on a tall stone ________, so visitors can look at it at eye level.
items.zh: 這匹小銅馬立在高高的石頭底座上,所以參觀者能平視欣賞它。
items.sec: Galleries, Museums & the Art Market 美術館、博物館與藝術市場

items.def: a strong light pointed at one thing
items.s: A single ________ shone on the painting in the dark room, and it made the gold colours glow beautifully.
items.zh: 一盞聚光燈照在暗室中的畫作上,讓金色光彩美麗地閃耀。
items.sec: Galleries, Museums & the Art Market 美術館、博物館與藝術市場

items.def: the buying and selling of art
items.s: The ______ ______ in Asia has grown quickly, because more young people now see paintings as a good investment.
items.zh: 亞洲的藝術市場成長迅速,因為現在更多年輕人把畫作視為好的投資。
items.sec: Galleries, Museums & the Art Market 美術館、博物館與藝術市場

items.def: the cost of something
items.s: The sculpture has a ______ ______ of two million dollars, but the gallery says several buyers are already interested.
items.zh: 這件雕塑的標價是兩百萬美元,但畫廊表示已經有好幾位買家感興趣。
items.sec: Galleries, Museums & the Art Market 美術館、博物館與藝術市場

items.def: the ability to make new and original things
items.s: The new art programme aims to develop students' ________, so there are no right or wrong answers in class.
items.zh: 新的藝術課程旨在培養學生的創造力,所以課堂上沒有標準答案。
items.sec: Creativity & the Creative Process 創造力與創作過程

items.def: good at thinking of new ideas or making things
items.s: My cousin is very ________, and she turned old jeans into a bag that everyone at school wanted to buy.
items.zh: 我表妹非常有創意,她把舊牛仔褲改成一個全校都想買的包包。
items.sec: Creativity & the Creative Process 創造力與創作過程

items.def: a person who makes something new
