items.s: The ________ of the popular cartoon was only twenty years old, but his drawings soon appeared on T-shirts everywhere.
items.zh: 這部熱門卡通的創作者只有二十歲,但他的畫很快就出現在各地的T恤上。
items.sec: Creativity & the Creative Process 創造力與創作過程

items.def: the ability to form pictures and ideas in your mind
items.s: Children have a wonderful ________, and a simple cardboard box can become a spaceship or a castle in their games.
items.zh: 孩子們擁有奇妙的想像力,一個簡單的紙箱在他們的遊戲中就能變成太空船或城堡。
items.sec: Creativity & the Creative Process 創造力與創作過程

items.def: to form a picture of something in your mind
items.s: Close your eyes and ________ a quiet beach at sunset, and then try to paint the colours you see.
items.zh: 閉上眼睛想像日落時寧靜的海灘,然後試著畫出你看到的顏色。
items.sec: Creativity & the Creative Process 創造力與創作過程

items.def: to give someone the wish or idea to do something
items.s: Her trip to Morocco helped ________ a new series of paintings, because the markets were full of bright colours.
items.zh: 她的摩洛哥之旅啟發了一系列新畫作,因為那裡的市集充滿鮮豔的色彩。
items.sec: Creativity & the Creative Process 創造力與創作過程

items.def: having excellent, original qualities
items.s: The director's ________ choice of music made the sad scene unforgettable, and many people in the cinema began to cry.
items.zh: 導演絕妙的配樂選擇讓這悲傷的一幕令人難忘,電影院裡許多人都哭了。
items.sec: Creativity & the Creative Process 創造力與創作過程

items.def: new and different from anything before
items.s: The judges wanted ________ designs, so they rejected any poster that looked like something on the internet.
items.zh: 評審想要原創的設計,所以他們淘汰了任何看起來像網路上作品的海報。
items.sec: Creativity & the Creative Process 創造力與創作過程

items.def: to think pleasant thoughts that take you away from the present
items.s: I often ________ on the bus about future trips, but sometimes I miss my stop because I am not paying attention.
items.zh: 我常在公車上做白日夢想著未來的旅行,但有時因為不專心而坐過站。
items.sec: Creativity & the Creative Process 創造力與創作過程

items.def: to make or perform something without preparation
items.s: The actor forgot his lines, so he had to ________, and the audience laughed because they thought it was part of the play.
items.zh: 這位演員忘了台詞,所以他只好臨場發揮,觀眾都笑了,因為他們以為那是劇情的一部分。
items.sec: Creativity & the Creative Process 創造力與創作過程

items.def: performing without planning beforehand
items.s: Jazz musicians are famous for ________, because they often create new tunes on stage without any written music.
items.zh: 爵士樂手以即興表演聞名,因為他們常在台上不看樂譜就創作新曲調。
items.sec: Creativity & the Creative Process 創造力與創作過程

items.def: the quality of acting naturally without planning
items.s: Children's drawings are full of ________, while adults often worry too much about making mistakes.
items.zh: 孩子的畫充滿隨性,而大人往往太擔心犯錯。
items.sec: Creativity & the Creative Process 創造力與創作過程

items.def: a natural ability to do something well
items.s: She has a real ________ for design, and even her simple school projects look like professional magazine pages.
items.zh: 她在設計方面很有天分,就連她簡單的學校作業看起來都像專業雜誌的版面。
items.sec: Creativity & the Creative Process 創造力與創作過程

items.def: a natural ability to do something well
items.s: He showed a great ________ for drawing when he was five, so his parents sent him to art classes every Saturday.
items.zh: 他五歲時就展現出很高的繪畫天賦,所以父母每週六都送他去上美術課。
items.sec: Creativity & the Creative Process 創造力與創作過程

items.def: showing skill in art
items.s: My brother is very ________, but he chose to study engineering because he worried about finding a job.
items.zh: 我哥哥很有藝術天分,但他選擇念工程,因為他擔心找不到工作。
items.sec: Creativity & the Creative Process 創造力與創作過程

items.def: showing your feelings and ideas through art or actions
items.s: Dance is a form of ________ for many teenagers, because they can show feelings that are hard to put into words.
items.zh: 對許多青少年來說,舞蹈是一種自我表達的方式,因為他們能展現難以言喻的感受。
items.sec: Creativity & the Creative Process 創造力與創作過程

items.def: thinking of many different answers to one problem
items.s: The teacher asked us to list fifty uses for a paper clip, because this exercise trains ______ ______.
items.zh: 老師要我們列出迴紋針的五十種用途,因為這個練習能訓練擴散性思考。
items.sec: Creativity & the Creative Process 創造力與創作過程

items.def: solving problems in unusual and creative ways
items.s: The puzzle seemed impossible, but ______ ______ helped us find a surprising answer that nobody expected.
items.zh: 這道謎題似乎無解,但水平思考幫助我們找到一個出乎所有人意料的答案。
items.sec: Creativity & the Creative Process 創造力與創作過程

items.def: a sudden moment when you find a great idea
items.s: The designer had a ______ ______ in the shower, and she quickly wrote her idea on the steamy mirror.
items.zh: 這位設計師在洗澡時靈光乍現,她趕緊把想法寫在起霧的鏡子上。
items.sec: Creativity & the Creative Process 創造力與創作過程

items.def: a time when you cannot produce new ideas
items.s: The songwriter suffered from a ______ ______ for months, so he travelled to the mountains to find fresh ideas.
items.zh: 這位詞曲創作者陷入創作瓶頸好幾個月,所以他到山上旅行尋找新靈感。
items.sec: Creativity & the Creative Process 創造力與創作過程

items.def: a time when a writer cannot think what to write
items.s: I had ______ ______ when I started my essay, but going for a short walk helped me think again.
items.zh: 我開始寫論文時遇到寫作瓶頸,但出去散步一下幫助我重新思考。
items.sec: Creativity & the Creative Process 創造力與創作過程

items.def: full of fun and not serious
items.s: The artist uses ________ shapes and bright colours, so even serious adults smile when they walk into her exhibition.
items.zh: 這位藝術家運用俏皮的形狀和鮮豔的色彩,所以就連嚴肅的大人走進她的展覽也會微笑。
items.sec: Creativity & the Creative Process 創造力與創作過程

items.def: a happy state of complete focus on an activity
items.s: When I paint, I sometimes enter a state of ________, and three hours pass without me noticing the time.
items.zh: 我畫畫時有時會進入心流狀態,三個小時過去了我卻沒注意到時間。
items.sec: Creativity & the Creative Process 創造力與創作過程

items.def: wanting to know or learn about something
items.s: Good designers are always ________ about how things work, so they ask many questions before they start drawing.
items.zh: 好的設計師總是對事物如何運作感到好奇,所以他們在開始畫之前會問很多問題。
items.sec: Creativity & the Creative Process 創造力與創作過程

items.def: willing to accept new and different ideas
items.s: Try to be ________ when you visit a modern art museum, because some works look strange but have interesting meanings.
items.zh: 參觀現代美術館時試著保持心胸開闊,因為有些作品看起來很怪,卻有有趣的含義。
items.sec: Creativity & the Creative Process 創造力與創作過程

items.def: doing things that might fail in order to achieve something
items.s: Creative work often needs a little ________, because many new ideas fail several times before they finally succeed.
items.zh: 創作工作常常需要一點冒險,因為許多新點子在最終成功前會失敗好幾次。
items.sec: Creativity & the Creative Process 創造力與創作過程

items.def: a collection of pictures and colours used to plan a design
items.s: Before designing the café, she made a ______ ______ with photos of plants and wood, so the owner could see her ideas.
items.zh: 在設計咖啡廳之前,她做了一塊貼滿植物與木頭照片的靈感板,讓老闆能看到她的構想。
items.sec: Creativity & the Creative Process 創造力與創作過程

items.def: the steps people follow to make something new
items.s: Every artist has a different ______ ______, and some begin with careful plans while others simply start painting.
items.zh: 每位藝術家都有不同的創作過程,有些人從周密的計畫開始,而有些人則直接動筆。
items.sec: Creativity & the Creative Process 創造力與創作過程

items.def: to make something skilfully
items.s: She spent weeks trying to ________ the perfect opening line for her novel, but she rewrote it many times.
items.zh: 她花了好幾週試圖精心寫出小說完美的開場白,但她改寫了很多次。
items.sec: Creativity & the Creative Process 創造力與創作過程

items.def: to change something in order to improve it
items.s: The editor asked the author to ________ the ending, because readers found it too sad and confusing.
items.zh: 編輯請作者修改結局,因為讀者覺得它太悲傷又令人困惑。
items.sec: Creativity & the Creative Process 創造力與創作過程

items.def: a person who takes photographs, often as a job
items.s: The wedding ________ asked everyone to stand closer together, and then he climbed on a chair to take a group photo.
items.zh: 婚禮攝影師請大家站近一點,然後他爬上椅子拍了一張團體照。
items.sec: Photography, Design & Digital Art 攝影、設計與數位藝術

items.def: the art or job of taking photos
items.s: He became interested in ________ when his grandfather gave him an old film camera on his sixteenth birthday.
items.zh: 他在爺爺於他十六歲生日送他一台舊底片相機後,開始對攝影產生興趣。
items.sec: Photography, Design & Digital Art 攝影、設計與數位藝術

items.def: a quick, informal photo
items.s: I took a quick ________ of my friends at the night market, and it became my favourite photo of the whole trip.
items.zh: 我在夜市幫朋友隨手拍了一張照片,它成了整趟旅行中我最喜歡的照片。
items.sec: Photography, Design & Digital Art 攝影、設計與數位藝術

items.def: a three-legged stand that holds a camera steady
items.s: You need a ________ to photograph stars at night, because even a tiny movement of your hands will make the picture blurry.
items.zh: 晚上拍星星需要三腳架,因為即使手稍微晃動都會讓照片模糊。
items.sec: Photography, Design & Digital Art 攝影、設計與數位藝術

items.def: the part of a camera that opens to let in light
items.s: Press the ________ button gently when the bird opens its wings, or you might miss the perfect moment.
items.zh: 在鳥張開翅膀時輕按快門鍵,否則你可能會錯過完美的瞬間。
items.sec: Photography, Design & Digital Art 攝影、設計與數位藝術

items.def: the hole in a camera lens that controls light
items.s: A wide ________ lets in more light, so it is useful when you take photos in a dark restaurant.
items.zh: 大光圈能讓更多光線進入,所以在昏暗的餐廳拍照時很有用。
items.sec: Photography, Design & Digital Art 攝影、設計與數位藝術

items.def: to make something look closer with a camera
items.s: The photographer had to ________ in on the shy deer, because it would run away if he walked any closer.
items.zh: 攝影師必須把鏡頭拉近拍那隻害羞的鹿,因為他再走近一點牠就會跑掉。
items.sec: Photography, Design & Digital Art 攝影、設計與數位藝術

items.def: a photo taken from very near
items.s: The film begins with a ________ of the girl's eyes, so the audience immediately feels her fear.
items.zh: 這部電影以女孩雙眼的特寫開場,所以觀眾立刻感受到她的恐懼。
items.sec: Photography, Design & Digital Art 攝影、設計與數位藝術

items.def: a bright light on a camera for dark places
items.s: Please turn off your ________ inside the museum, because strong light can slowly damage old paintings.
items.zh: 在博物館裡請關閉閃光燈,因為強光會慢慢損害古老的畫作。
items.sec: Photography, Design & Digital Art 攝影、設計與數位藝術

items.def: a dark room for developing film photos
items.s: In the school ________, we watched the picture slowly appear on the paper, and it felt like magic.
items.zh: 在學校的暗房裡,我們看著影像慢慢浮現在相紙上,感覺就像魔法一樣。
items.sec: Photography, Design & Digital Art 攝影、設計與數位藝術

items.def: showing only black, white and grey
items.s: She prefers ________ photos of old streets, because she thinks colour makes them look too modern.
items.zh: 她比較喜歡老街的黑白照片,因為她認為彩色會讓它們看起來太現代。
items.sec: Photography, Design & Digital Art 攝影、設計與數位藝術

items.def: the art of combining words and pictures for posters, websites etc.
items.s: My sister studies ______ ______ at university, and she designed the logo for our family's noodle shop.
items.zh: 我姊姊在大學念平面設計,她為我們家的麵店設計了招牌標誌。
items.sec: Photography, Design & Digital Art 攝影、設計與數位藝術

items.def: a person who designs posters, books or websites
items.s: The company hired a ______ ______ to make its website look modern, and sales rose within a few months.
items.zh: 這家公司聘請了一位平面設計師讓網站看起來更現代,幾個月內業績就上升了。
items.sec: Photography, Design & Digital Art 攝影、設計與數位藝術

items.def: the style and arrangement of printed letters
items.s: Good ________ makes a menu easy to read, but a strange font can make customers feel confused.
items.zh: 好的字體排印讓菜單容易閱讀,但奇怪的字型會讓顧客感到困惑。
items.sec: Photography, Design & Digital Art 攝影、設計與數位藝術

items.def: a set of letters in one style and size
items.s: Please use a simple ________ for your report, because the fancy one is hard for the teacher to read.
items.zh: 你的報告請用簡單的字型,因為花俏的字型老師很難閱讀。
items.sec: Photography, Design & Digital Art 攝影、設計與數位藝術

items.def: the set of colours chosen for a design
items.s: We chose a calm ______ ______ of light blue and white for the bedroom, so it feels peaceful at night.
items.zh: 我們為臥室選了淺藍和白色的沉穩配色,所以晚上感覺很寧靜。
items.sec: Photography, Design & Digital Art 攝影、設計與數位藝術

items.def: art made with computers or tablets
items.s: ______ ______ has become very popular with teenagers, because they can draw on a tablet and share the work online at once.
items.zh: 數位藝術在青少年間變得非常受歡迎,因為他們能在平板上作畫並立刻上網分享。
items.sec: Photography, Design & Digital Art 攝影、設計與數位藝術

items.def: one of the tiny dots that make a digital image
items.s: If you make the photo too large, you will see every ________, so the picture will look blocky.
items.zh: 如果你把照片放得太大,就會看到每一個像素,所以畫面會看起來像方塊。
items.sec: Photography, Design & Digital Art 攝影、設計與數位藝術

items.def: moving pictures made from drawings or computer images
items.s: Japanese ________ is loved around the world, and some films take years to finish because every scene is drawn by hand.
items.zh: 日本動畫受到全世界喜愛,有些電影要花數年才能完成,因為每一幕都是手繪的。
items.sec: Photography, Design & Digital Art 攝影、設計與數位藝術

items.def: a person who makes animated films
items.s: The ________ drew twelve pictures for every second of the film, so a short scene took him several weeks.
items.zh: 這位動畫師為影片的每一秒畫了十二張圖,所以一個短短的場景就花了他好幾週。
items.sec: Photography, Design & Digital Art 攝影、設計與數位藝術

items.def: a digital certificate that shows who owns a digital artwork
items.s: He sold a cartoon cat as an ________ for a lot of money, but a year later nobody wanted to buy it.
items.zh: 他把一隻卡通貓以非同質化代幣的形式賣了很多錢,但一年後就沒人想買了。
items.sec: Photography, Design & Digital Art 攝影、設計與數位藝術

items.def: made by artificial intelligence, not a person
items.s: The ________ picture won first prize in the contest, so many human artists complained that the result was unfair.
items.zh: 那幅人工智慧生成的圖片在比賽中贏得首獎,所以許多人類藝術家抱怨結果不公平。
items.sec: Photography, Design & Digital Art 攝影、設計與數位藝術

items.def: to improve a photo by making small changes
items.s: Magazines often ________ photos of models to hide spots, but this gives young readers unrealistic ideas about beauty.
items.zh: 雜誌常修圖遮掉模特兒臉上的斑點,但這讓年輕讀者對美產生不切實際的想法。
items.sec: Photography, Design & Digital Art 攝影、設計與數位藝術

items.def: a session when a photographer takes many photos
items.s: The band had a ______ ______ on the beach for their new album, but the strong wind kept blowing the singer's hair.
items.zh: 樂團為新專輯在海灘進行拍攝工作,但強風一直吹亂主唱的頭髮。
items.sec: Photography, Design & Digital Art 攝影、設計與數位藝術

items.def: a pen-shaped tool for drawing on a screen
items.s: She draws her comics with a ________ on a tablet, so she can easily fix mistakes with one click.
items.zh: 她用觸控筆在平板上畫漫畫,所以只要點一下就能輕鬆修正錯誤。
items.sec: Photography, Design & Digital Art 攝影、設計與數位藝術

items.def: images added to films by computer
items.s: The film used amazing ______ ______ to show dragons flying over the city, and it won an award for them.
items.zh: 這部電影運用驚人的視覺特效呈現飛越城市的巨龍,並因此獲獎。
items.sec: Photography, Design & Digital Art 攝影、設計與數位藝術

items.def: a funny drawing or animated film
items.s: My little brother watches a ________ every morning before school, and he copies the characters' funny voices all day.
items.zh: 我弟弟每天早上上學前都會看一部卡通,然後一整天模仿角色的搞笑聲音。
items.sec: Photography, Design & Digital Art 攝影、設計與數位藝術

items.def: a magazine that tells stories in pictures
items.s: I learned many English words from reading a ______ ______ every week, because the pictures helped me guess the meanings.
items.zh: 我每週讀一本漫畫書,從中學到很多英文單字,因為圖片幫助我猜出意思。
items.sec: Photography, Design & Digital Art 攝影、設計與數位藝術

items.def: the act of entertaining an audience
items.s: Her ________ in the school play was so moving that several parents wiped tears from their eyes.
items.zh: 她在學校話劇中的演出非常感人,好幾位家長都擦了眼淚。
items.sec: Performing Arts & Music 表演藝術與音樂

items.def: a person who entertains an audience
items.s: Each ________ at the festival had only ten minutes on stage, so they practised their acts many times.
items.zh: 節慶上每位表演者只有十分鐘的上台時間,所以他們把表演練習了很多次。
items.sec: Performing Arts & Music 表演藝術與音樂

items.def: a building where plays are performed
items.s: We went to the ________ to see a musical on Saturday, but the tickets were so expensive that we sat in the back row.
items.zh: 週六我們去劇院看音樂劇,但票價太貴了,所以我們坐在最後一排。
items.sec: Performing Arts & Music 表演藝術與音樂

items.def: a person who writes plays
items.s: The young ________ wrote a play about her grandmother's life, and it sold out every night for a month.
items.zh: 這位年輕劇作家寫了一齣關於她奶奶一生的戲,連續一個月每晚都售罄。
items.sec: Performing Arts & Music 表演藝術與音樂

items.def: to practise a play or music before a performance
items.s: The choir had to ________ every evening for a month, because the concert was only a few weeks away.
items.zh: 合唱團一個月來每晚都得排練,因為音樂會只剩幾週了。
items.sec: Performing Arts & Music 表演藝術與音樂

items.def: behind the stage in a theatre
items.s: The dancers waited nervously ________ before the show, while the audience slowly found their seats.
items.zh: 演出前舞者們緊張地在後台等待,而觀眾則慢慢找到座位。
items.sec: Performing Arts & Music 表演藝術與音樂

items.def: a short performance to get a role in a show
items.s: She practised the song for weeks before the ________, and she was thrilled when she got the main role.
items.zh: 她在試鏡前把那首歌練了好幾週,當她拿到主角時非常興奮。
items.sec: Performing Arts & Music 表演藝術與音樂

items.def: a person who plans the movements of a dance
items.s: The ________ changed the dance three times in one week, so the dancers felt exhausted and confused.
items.zh: 編舞家一週內改了三次舞步,所以舞者們感到筋疲力盡又困惑。
items.sec: Performing Arts & Music 表演藝術與音樂

items.def: the planned steps and movements of a dance
items.s: The ________ of the K-pop song is very difficult, but thousands of fans have learned it from online videos.
items.zh: 這首韓流歌曲的舞步設計非常困難,但數千名粉絲已經透過網路影片學會了。
items.sec: Performing Arts & Music 表演藝術與音樂

items.def: a graceful type of dance that tells a story
items.s: My niece has taken ________ lessons since she was four, and she dreams of dancing in "Swan Lake" one day.
items.zh: 我姪女從四歲就開始上芭蕾舞課,她夢想有一天能在《天鵝湖》中跳舞。
items.sec: Performing Arts & Music 表演藝術與音樂

items.def: a large group of musicians who play together
items.s: The school ________ has sixty students, and they play a free concert in the park every spring.
items.zh: 學校的管弦樂團有六十名學生,他們每年春天都會在公園舉辦免費音樂會。
items.sec: Performing Arts & Music 表演藝術與音樂

items.def: a person who writes music
items.s: The film's ________ wrote the music in only three weeks, but it became one of the most famous soundtracks in the world.
items.zh: 這部電影的作曲家只花三週就寫完配樂,但它成為世上最著名的電影原聲帶之一。
items.sec: Performing Arts & Music 表演藝術與音樂

items.def: to write music
items.s: Mozart began to ________ music when he was five, and he wrote more than six hundred pieces in his short life.
items.zh: 莫札特五歲就開始作曲,他在短暫的一生中寫了六百多首作品。
items.sec: Performing Arts & Music 表演藝術與音樂

items.def: a tune; a series of musical notes
items.s: The ________ of the song is very simple, so even small children can sing it after hearing it once.
items.zh: 這首歌的旋律非常簡單,所以連小孩子聽一次就會唱。
items.sec: Performing Arts & Music 表演藝術與音樂

items.def: pleasant musical notes sung or played together
items.s: The four singers practised their ________ for hours, and their voices finally sounded like one beautiful voice.
items.zh: 四位歌手練習和聲好幾個小時,他們的聲音終於聽起來像一個美麗的聲音。
items.sec: Performing Arts & Music 表演藝術與音樂

items.def: the words of a song
items.s: I love the tune, but I cannot understand the ________, so I looked them up online and translated them.
items.zh: 我喜歡這個曲調,但聽不懂歌詞,所以我上網查了並把它們翻譯出來。
items.sec: Performing Arts & Music 表演藝術與音樂

items.def: a long piece of music for an orchestra
items.s: Beethoven wrote his ninth ________ when he was almost completely deaf, and it is still played all over the world.
items.zh: 貝多芬在幾乎全聾時寫下他的第九號交響曲,至今仍在世界各地演奏。
items.sec: Performing Arts & Music 表演藝術與音樂

items.def: a musical performance in front of an audience
items.s: Thousands of fans waited outside the stadium all day, because the ________ was the band's last in Taiwan.
items.zh: 數千名粉絲整天在體育場外等待,因為這場演唱會是樂團在台灣的最後一場。
items.sec: Performing Arts & Music 表演藝術與音樂

items.def: a person who plays or writes music
items.s: The street ________ played the violin every evening near the station, and many commuters stopped to listen on their way home.
items.zh: 這位街頭音樂家每晚在車站附近拉小提琴,許多通勤族在回家途中停下來聆聽。
items.sec: Performing Arts & Music 表演藝術與音樂

items.def: an object such as a piano or guitar used to make music
items.s: Learning a musical ________ takes years of practice, but it can also improve your memory and patience.
items.zh: 學習一種樂器需要多年練習,但它也能改善你的記憶力和耐心。
items.sec: Performing Arts & Music 表演藝術與音樂

items.def: a play in which the words are sung with an orchestra
items.s: Taiwanese ________ is performed on outdoor stages near temples, and the actors wear colourful costumes and heavy make-up.
items.zh: 台灣歌仔戲在廟宇附近的戶外舞台演出,演員穿著色彩繽紛的戲服、畫著濃妝。
items.sec: Performing Arts & Music 表演藝術與音樂

items.def: a play or film with many songs and dances
items.s: We saw a Broadway ________ in New York, and I could not stop singing its songs for weeks after the trip.
items.zh: 我們在紐約看了一齣百老匯音樂劇,旅行結束後好幾週我都忍不住哼唱裡面的歌。
items.sec: Performing Arts & Music 表演藝術與音樂

items.def: the sound of people clapping
items.s: The ________ continued for five minutes after the show ended, so the actors came back on stage three times.
items.zh: 演出結束後掌聲持續了五分鐘,所以演員們回到台上謝幕了三次。
items.sec: Performing Arts & Music 表演藝術與音樂

items.def: when an audience stands up to clap for a long time
items.s: The old pianist received a ______ ______ after her last concert, and she bowed with tears in her eyes.
items.zh: 這位年邁的鋼琴家在最後一場音樂會後獲得全場起立鼓掌,她眼含淚水鞠躬致意。
items.sec: Performing Arts & Music 表演藝術與音樂

items.def: an extra song performed because the audience asks for it
items.s: The crowd shouted for an ________, so the band came back and played their most famous song once more.
items.zh: 觀眾大喊要安可曲,所以樂團回到台上再演奏了一次他們最有名的歌。
items.sec: Performing Arts & Music 表演藝術與音樂

items.def: the first public performance of a film or play
items.s: The actors walked on the red carpet at the film's ________, while fans screamed and took photos behind the barriers.
items.zh: 演員們在電影首映會上走紅毯,而粉絲們在圍欄後尖叫拍照。
items.sec: Performing Arts & Music 表演藝術與音樂

items.def: a person who performs music in the street for money
items.s: A talented ________ was singing outside the department store, and people dropped coins into his guitar case.
items.zh: 一位有才華的街頭藝人在百貨公司外唱歌,人們把硬幣丟進他的吉他盒裡。
items.sec: Performing Arts & Music 表演藝術與音樂

items.def: clothes worn by actors in a show
items.s: The ________ for the queen took two months to make, because every flower on the dress was sewn by hand.
items.zh: 女王的戲服花了兩個月才完成,因為裙子上的每一朵花都是手工縫製的。
items.sec: Performing Arts & Music 表演藝術與音樂

items.def: to look at something with pleasure and respect
items.s: We stopped to ________ the huge mural for a few minutes, and then we took photos of it for our class project.
items.zh: 我們停下來欣賞這幅巨大的壁畫幾分鐘,然後為班級報告拍了照片。

items.def: to clap or to praise someone's action
items.s: The audience began to ________ before the music finished, so the conductor turned around and smiled.
items.zh: 音樂還沒結束觀眾就開始鼓掌,所以指揮轉過身來微笑。

items.def: to surprise someone very much
items.s: The young girl's paintings ________ the judges, because nobody expected such skill from a ten-year-old.
items.zh: 這位小女孩的畫作讓評審大為驚訝,因為沒人預料到一個十歲孩子有如此技巧。

items.def: to hold someone's attention completely
items.s: The puppet show managed to ________ the noisy children, and the room became completely quiet within a minute.
items.zh: 這場木偶戲成功吸引住吵鬧的孩子們,一分鐘內整個房間就變得鴉雀無聲。

items.def: to show that an event or person is important
items.s: The festival aims to ________ local artists, so all the paintings on show were made by people from the village.
items.zh: 這個藝術節旨在頌揚在地藝術家,所以所有展出的畫作都是村民創作的。

items.def: to love and care for something very much
items.s: My mother still ________ the clay bowl I made in kindergarten, although it is uneven and slightly broken.
items.zh: 我媽媽至今仍珍惜我幼稚園時做的陶碗,雖然它歪歪的又有點破損。

items.def: to break an idea or object into parts to understand it
items.s: In art history class, we ________ famous paintings by looking at their colours, shapes and hidden symbols one by one.
items.zh: 在藝術史課上,我們透過逐一觀察顏色、形狀和隱藏的象徵來解構名畫。

items.def: to give someone great pleasure
items.s: The magician's tricks ________ the children at the party, and they begged him to perform again.
items.zh: 魔術師的把戲讓派對上的孩子們很開心,他們央求他再表演一次。

items.def: to think something is bad or wrong
items.s: My parents ________ of my plan to study art, because they think artists cannot earn enough money.
items.zh: 我爸媽不贊成我念藝術的計畫,因為他們認為藝術家賺不了足夠的錢。

items.def: to examine or try out something in order to learn about it
items.s: In her new paintings she wants to ________ the feeling of loneliness, so many of them show empty streets at night.
items.zh: 在她的新畫作中,她想探索孤獨的感受,所以許多作品描繪夜晚空蕩的街道。

items.def: to interest someone very much
items.s: Old maps have always ________ my brother, and he spends hours studying the strange sea monsters drawn on them.
items.zh: 古地圖一向讓我哥哥著迷,他會花好幾個小時研究上面畫的奇怪海怪。

items.def: to admire someone too much
items.s: Many teenagers ________ pop stars, but they often know little about the hard work behind the shows.
items.zh: 許多青少年崇拜流行歌星,但他們往往對演出背後的辛苦所知甚少。

items.def: to become completely involved in something
items.s: When she paints, she likes to ________ herself in the work, so she turns off her phone for the whole afternoon.
items.zh: 她畫畫時喜歡讓自己完全沉浸其中,所以她整個下午都會關掉手機。

items.def: to make someone free
items.s: Photography helped ________ painters from simply copying reality, so they began to experiment with colour and shape.
items.zh: 攝影幫助解放畫家,使他們不必只是複製現實,於是他們開始實驗色彩與形狀。

items.def: to hold someone's attention so they cannot look away
items.s: The dancer's slow movements seemed to ________ the crowd, and nobody even took out a phone during the show.
items.zh: 舞者緩慢的動作似乎讓觀眾入迷,表演期間甚至沒有人拿出手機。

items.def: to give human qualities to an object or idea
items.s: Many fairy tales ________ the wind and the moon, so children imagine that nature can talk and feel.
items.zh: 許多童話把風和月亮擬人化,所以孩子們想像大自然會說話、有感覺。

items.def: to explain or perform something in a new way
items.s: The young director decided to ________ the old Chinese legend, and she set the story in modern Taipei.
items.zh: 這位年輕導演決定重新詮釋這個中國古老傳說,並把故事背景設在現代台北。

items.def: to think about something again in a new way
items.s: The designers wanted to ________ the old factory as an art centre, so they kept the brick walls but added glass roofs.
items.zh: 設計師們想把舊工廠重新構想成藝術中心,所以保留了磚牆但加上玻璃屋頂。

items.def: to make something liked by many people
items.s: Television shows helped ________ cooking as a hobby, and now many young people share their recipes online.
items.zh: 電視節目幫助普及了烹飪這項嗜好,現在許多年輕人在網路上分享食譜。

items.def: to make something available to everyone
items.s: Smartphones have ________ photography, because almost everyone now carries a good camera in their pocket.
items.zh: 智慧型手機讓攝影大眾化了,因為現在幾乎人人口袋裡都有一台好相機。

items.def: to introduce new ideas or methods
items.s: Artists who refuse to ________ may lose their audience, because people want to see something fresh.
items.zh: 拒絕創新的藝術家可能會失去觀眾,因為人們想看到新鮮的東西。

items.def: to take and use an idea from another person or culture
items.s: Many Western artists ________ ideas from Japanese prints in the 1800s, and you can see this in their bold, flat colours.
items.zh: 1800年代許多西方藝術家借用了日本版畫的構想,你可以從他們大膽平塗的色彩中看出這點。

items.def: to make an idea clear and definite
items.s: Talking with my teacher helped ________ my ideas, so I finally knew what my final project would be about.
items.zh: 和老師談話幫助我把想法具體化,所以我終於知道期末作品要做什麼了。

items.def: to be a typical example of something
items.s: Bright colours and bold lines ________ his early work, while his later paintings are much darker.
items.zh: 鮮豔的色彩和大膽的線條是他早期作品的典型特徵,而他晚期的畫作則陰暗許多。

items.def: to try an activity without being serious about it
items.s: My father likes to ________ in painting at weekends, but he says he will never show his work to anyone.
items.zh: 我爸爸週末喜歡玩票畫畫,但他說他絕不會把作品給任何人看。

items.def: to be much better than others
items.s: The young actor managed to ________ the famous stars in the film, so many critics praised his performance.
items.zh: 這位年輕演員在片中勝過了那些知名明星,所以許多影評人稱讚他的演出。

items.def: to make something seem less bad
items.s: The film's story is weak, but the beautiful music helps ________ it, so I still enjoyed watching it.
items.zh: 這部電影的劇情很弱,但優美的配樂幫忙彌補了缺點,所以我還是看得很開心。

items.def: to make a feeling active again
items.s: Visiting the art museum helped ________ my interest in drawing, so I bought a new sketchbook on the way home.
items.zh: 參觀美術館重新燃起我對畫畫的興趣,所以我在回家路上買了一本新的素描本。

items.def: to make something more lively and interesting
items.s: Colourful murals ________ the grey walls of the old market, and more young people now visit it at weekends.
items.zh: 色彩繽紛的壁畫讓老市場灰色的牆面有了生氣,現在週末有更多年輕人來逛。

items.def: to laugh at someone in an unkind way
items.s: Critics ________ the Impressionists at first, but today their paintings are among the most expensive in the world.
items.zh: 評論家起初嘲笑印象派畫家,但如今他們的畫作是世上最昂貴的作品之一。

items.def: to show that you think something is worthless
items.s: Some traditional painters ________ digital art, but young artists believe a tablet is just another kind of brush.
items.zh: 有些傳統畫家鄙視數位藝術,但年輕藝術家認為平板只是另一種畫筆。

items.def: to laugh at someone and make them look silly
items.s: Classmates used to ________ his strange drawings, but now he is a successful illustrator with thousands of fans.
items.zh: 同學以前常嘲弄他奇怪的畫,但現在他是擁有數千名粉絲的成功插畫家。

items.def: to use humour to criticise people or ideas
items.s: The comedy show likes to ________ politicians, so some leaders have tried to stop it from being broadcast.
items.zh: 這個喜劇節目喜歡諷刺政治人物,所以有些領導人曾試圖阻止它播出。

items.def: to keep trying although it is difficult
items.s: Learning the violin was very hard at first, but she decided to ________, and now she plays in a famous orchestra.
items.zh: 學小提琴一開始非常困難,但她決定堅持不懈,現在她在一個知名管弦樂團演奏。

items.def: to make something exist again or copy it
items.s: The students tried to ________ the famous painting using only coloured rice, and the result looked surprisingly good.
items.zh: 學生們試著只用彩色米粒重現那幅名畫,結果看起來出奇地好。

items.def: to make someone feel worried or uncomfortable
items.s: The dark film is designed to ________ viewers, so the music becomes louder whenever the camera moves slowly.
items.zh: 這部黑暗電影的設計就是要讓觀眾不安,所以每當鏡頭緩慢移動時音樂就會變大聲。

items.def: to make someone very interested and curious
items.s: The strange title of the exhibition ________ me, so I went inside although I had planned to go shopping.
items.zh: 展覽奇特的名稱引起我的好奇,所以雖然我原本打算去逛街,還是走了進去。

items.def: to charm and delight someone
items.s: The old fairy-tale illustrations ________ readers of every age, and the book has been printed again and again.
items.zh: 這些古老的童話插畫迷住了各個年齡層的讀者,這本書也一再重印。

items.def: to impress someone greatly with skill or beauty
items.s: The fireworks show ________ the crowd by the river, and everyone looked up at the sky with their mouths open.
items.zh: 煙火秀讓河邊的人群驚豔不已,每個人都張大嘴巴仰望天空。

items.def: to make someone unable to move because of shock or interest
items.s: The huge whale sculpture seemed to ________ the children, and they stood under it without saying a word.
items.zh: 那座巨大的鯨魚雕塑似乎讓孩子們看呆了,他們一語不發地站在它下面。

items.def: to give too little money to something
items.s: The government continues to ________ the arts, so many small theatres have closed in recent years.
items.zh: 政府持續對藝術投入不足的資金,所以近年來許多小劇場都關門了。
items.t: 對 投入不足的資金

items.def: to give someone confidence or support to do something
items.s: Good teachers ________ students to try new materials, and they do not punish them for messy experiments.
items.zh: 好老師會鼓勵學生嘗試新素材,而且不會因為實驗弄得亂七八糟而處罰他們。

items.def: to release or make something available
items.s: Music can ________ old memories in people with poor memory, so some care homes play songs from the 1960s.
items.zh: 音樂能為記憶力不好的人開啟舊回憶,所以有些安養院會播放1960年代的歌曲。

items.def: to improve something by making small changes
items.s: The singer spent a week trying to ________ her performance, but she still felt nervous before the competition.
items.zh: 這位歌手花了一週試圖潤飾她的演出,但比賽前她仍然感到緊張。

items.def: art that does not show real objects
items.s: Her early paintings show real people, but later she moved towards pure ________, using only lines and colour.
items.zh: 她早期的畫作描繪真實人物,但後來轉向純粹的抽象,只使用線條和色彩。

items.def: a feeling of great respect and approval
items.s: I have great ________ for street artists, because they work in the heat and rain but rarely receive any credit.
items.zh: 我非常欽佩街頭藝術家,因為他們在炎熱和雨中工作,卻很少得到認可。

items.def: a feeling of great respect mixed with wonder
items.s: We stood in ________ in front of the giant Buddha statue, because it was much larger than we had imagined.
items.zh: 我們滿懷敬畏地站在巨大的佛像前,因為它比我們想像的大得多。

items.def: the group of works seen as the most important
items.s: Women artists were often left out of the art ________, so museums are now trying to show more of their work.
items.zh: 女性藝術家常被排除在藝術經典作品之外,所以博物館現在正努力展出更多她們的作品。

items.def: quiet, careful thinking about something
items.s: The quiet garden was designed for ________, so visitors are asked to turn off their phones and speak softly.
items.zh: 這座寧靜的庭園是為沉思而設計的,所以遊客被要求關掉手機並輕聲說話。

items.def: skill in making things by hand
items.s: The ________ of this wooden temple door is amazing, because no nails were used to hold it together.
items.zh: 這扇木製廟門的工藝技術令人驚嘆,因為完全沒有使用釘子來固定。

items.def: the ability to judge what is good
items.s: Collectors need ________ to choose valuable paintings, because many attractive works lose their value over time.
items.zh: 收藏家需要鑑賞力來挑選有價值的畫作,因為許多吸引人的作品會隨時間貶值。

items.def: the quality of being graceful and stylish
items.s: The dancer moved with great ________, so the audience hardly noticed how difficult the steps were.
items.zh: 這位舞者的動作極為優雅,所以觀眾幾乎沒察覺舞步有多困難。

items.def: a decoration added to make something more attractive
items.s: The old palace door has gold ________ on every corner, but the simple wooden centre is actually the oldest part.
items.zh: 這扇古老宮殿大門的每個角落都有金色裝飾,但樸素的木製中央部分其實是最古老的。

items.def: a person who is very interested in an activity
items.s: My uncle is a jazz ________, and he has collected more than two thousand old records since he was a teenager.
items.zh: 我叔叔是爵士樂愛好者,他從青少年時期就收集了兩千多張老唱片。

items.def: respect and admiration
items.s: The old calligrapher is held in high ________ in his town, so people ask him to write couplets for every festival.
items.zh: 這位老書法家在鎮上備受敬重,所以每逢節慶大家都請他寫春聯。

items.def: showing feelings or ideas through words or art
items.s: Poetry was her main form of ________, because she found it difficult to talk about her feelings with others.
items.zh: 詩是她主要的表達方式,因為她發現很難和別人談論自己的感受。

items.def: a very strong interest
items.s: His ________ with insects began in childhood, and later he became famous for his detailed drawings of butterflies.
items.zh: 他對昆蟲的著迷從童年就開始了,後來他以精細的蝴蝶素描而聞名。

items.def: the symbols used in a type of art and their meanings
items.s: Temple ________ is full of meaning, because each animal and colour on the roof represents a different blessing.
items.zh: 廟宇的象徵圖像充滿意義,因為屋頂上的每種動物和顏色都代表不同的祝福。

items.def: a perfect idea or standard you want to reach
items.s: Ancient Greek statues show an ________ of beauty, but real people rarely looked so perfect.
items.zh: 古希臘雕像展現了一種美的理想,但真實的人很少看起來那麼完美。

items.def: pictures or descriptions that create images in the mind
items.s: The poem uses rich ________ of the sea, so readers can almost hear the waves when they read it aloud.
items.zh: 這首詩運用了豐富的海洋意象,所以讀者朗讀時幾乎能聽見浪聲。

items.def: the feeling or idea you get from something
items.s: My first ________ of the gallery was not good, but the guide's stories changed my mind completely.
items.zh: 我對這家畫廊的第一印象不太好,但導覽員的故事完全改變了我的想法。

items.def: the ability to think and understand ideas
items.s: His paintings appeal to the ________ more than the heart, so some viewers find them clever but cold.
items.zh: 他的畫作訴諸理智多於情感,所以有些觀眾覺得它們聰明卻冷漠。

items.def: placing two different things side by side
items.s: The ________ of old temples and glass towers makes the city photos interesting, because it shows the past and future together.
items.zh: 古廟與玻璃高樓的並置讓這些城市照片很有趣,因為它同時呈現過去與未來。

items.def: great beauty and impressive size
items.s: Photos cannot show the ________ of the cathedral ceiling, so you really need to see it with your own eyes.
items.zh: 照片無法呈現大教堂天花板的壯麗,所以你真的需要親眼去看看。

items.def: the state of being unknown
items.s: The painter lived in ________ for most of his life, and only a few friends bought his paintings.
items.zh: 這位畫家大半生都默默無聞,只有幾位朋友買過他的畫。

items.def: money and support given to artists by a rich person
items.s: Thanks to the ________ of wealthy families, many Renaissance artists could work without worrying about food and rent.
items.zh: 由於富裕家族的贊助,許多文藝復興時期的藝術家能夠工作而不必擔心吃住問題。

items.def: the way someone or something is shown in art
items.s: The film's ________ of a teenage girl feels very real, because the director interviewed hundreds of students.
items.zh: 這部電影對少女的刻畫感覺非常真實,因為導演訪問了數百名學生。

items.def: respect that comes from success or importance
items.s: Winning the award brought great ________ to the small design company, and big clients soon began to call.
items.zh: 贏得這個獎為這家小設計公司帶來極高的聲望,大客戶很快就開始打電話來了。

items.def: a performance of a song or piece of music
items.s: Her ________ of the old folk song was so beautiful that my grandmother started to sing along quietly.
items.zh: 她對那首老民謠的演繹美極了,我奶奶也開始輕聲跟著唱。

items.def: the state of being famous
items.s: The ceramic artist gained international ________ after her work appeared in a London museum, and her prices rose sharply.
items.zh: 這位陶藝家的作品在倫敦一家博物館展出後,她獲得了國際聲望,作品價格也大幅上漲。

items.def: a copy of a work of art
items.s: The painting in our classroom is only a cheap ________, but it still helps us learn about the original.
items.zh: 我們教室裡的畫只是一幅便宜的複製品,但它仍幫助我們認識原作。

items.def: a special meaning or importance for someone
items.s: The song has special ________ for older Taiwanese listeners, because it reminds them of their hometowns.
items.zh: 這首歌對年長的台灣聽眾有特別的共鳴,因為它讓他們想起家鄉。

items.def: a time when something becomes popular again
items.s: There has been a ________ of interest in film cameras, and many teenagers now use them to take holiday photos.
items.zh: 人們對底片相機的興趣重新流行起來,現在許多青少年用它們拍度假照片。

items.def: the ability to understand and enjoy art or feelings
items.s: The young poet shows a rare ________ to nature, and her short poems about rain are loved by many readers.
items.zh: 這位年輕詩人展現了對自然罕見的感受力,她寫雨的短詩深受許多讀者喜愛。

items.def: the quality of being honest and true in feelings
items.s: The audience could feel the ________ in his songs, because he wrote them about his own difficult childhood.
items.zh: 觀眾能感受到他歌曲中的真誠,因為他寫的是自己艱辛的童年。

items.def: a high level of skill and complexity
items.s: The ________ of the young designer's work surprised everyone, because she had never studied at an art school.
items.zh: 這位年輕設計師作品的成熟老練讓所有人驚訝,因為她從未在藝術學校念過書。

items.def: the use of objects or colours to represent ideas
items.s: The painting is full of ________, and the broken clock in the corner represents the end of the artist's youth.
items.zh: 這幅畫充滿象徵手法,角落那座壞掉的時鐘代表藝術家青春的結束。

items.def: the quality of being bright, lively and exciting
items.s: The ________ of the night market inspired her photos, because she loved the colours, noise and steam everywhere.
items.zh: 夜市的活力啟發了她的攝影作品,因為她熱愛那裡無處不在的色彩、喧鬧與蒸氣。

items.def: very great skill in music or art
items.s: The violinist played with such ________ that the audience stood up and cheered before the last note ended.
items.zh: 這位小提琴家的演奏技藝如此精湛,觀眾在最後一個音結束前就起立歡呼。

items.def: brave or rude confidence to do something shocking
items.s: Critics were shocked by the ________ of the young artist, because she hung an ordinary bicycle in the national gallery.
items.zh: 評論家對這位年輕藝術家的大膽感到震驚,因為她把一輛普通的腳踏車掛在國家美術館裡。

items.def: the quality of being extremely good
items.s: The award recognises ________ in film-making, and this year it went to a documentary about mountain villages.
items.zh: 這個獎項表彰電影製作的卓越成就,今年頒給了一部關於山村的紀錄片。

items.def: great skill and delicate care
items.s: The chef decorates every cake with ________, so each one looks like a small work of art.
items.zh: 這位甜點師以細膩的手法裝飾每個蛋糕,所以每個都像一件小小的藝術品。

items.def: a very confident, colourful and showy style
items.s: The singer is famous for his ________, and he often appears on stage in gold suits and huge feathered hats.
items.zh: 這位歌手以張揚聞名,他常穿著金色西裝、戴著巨大的羽毛帽登台。

items.def: a smooth and attractive way of moving
items.s: The ballerina crossed the stage with great ________, and she seemed to float above the floor like a feather.
items.zh: 這位芭蕾舞者以極為優美的姿態穿越舞台,彷彿羽毛般飄浮在地板上方。

items.def: the quality of not thinking you are better than others
items.s: Despite his fame, the old master spoke with great ________, and he thanked his students for teaching him new ideas.
items.zh: 儘管名聞遐邇,這位老大師說話時非常謙遜,還感謝學生教了他新想法。

items.def: a situation that is the opposite of what you expect
items.s: The ________ is that the painter died poor, while his paintings now sell for millions of dollars.
items.zh: 諷刺的是,這位畫家死時一貧如洗,而他的畫作如今卻以數百萬美元售出。

items.def: the state of being accepted as real or fair
items.s: Street art has gained more ________ in recent years, and some cities now invite artists to paint public walls.
items.zh: 近年來街頭藝術獲得更多正當性,有些城市現在還邀請藝術家彩繪公共牆面。

items.def: great skill or knowledge of something
items.s: His ________ of light and shadow makes his paintings look almost real, and visitors often try to touch them.
items.zh: 他對光影的精通讓他的畫看起來幾乎是真的,參觀者常想伸手去摸。

items.def: the quality of being only average and not very good
items.s: The director refused to accept ________, so the actors had to repeat each scene until it was perfect.
items.zh: 導演拒絕接受平庸,所以演員們必須重複每一場戲直到完美為止。

items.def: a feeling of quiet sadness
items.s: There is a deep ________ in his paintings of empty beaches, because he painted them after his wife passed away.
items.zh: 他筆下空曠海灘的畫作中有一種深沉的憂鬱,因為那是他在妻子過世後畫的。

items.def: judging fairly without personal feelings
items.s: It is hard to judge art with complete ________, because each person brings different feelings and memories to a painting.
items.zh: 要完全客觀地評判藝術很難,因為每個人面對畫作時都帶著不同的感受和記憶。

items.def: a work that copies the style of other artists
items.s: The film is a ________ of old Hollywood musicals, so fans of classic movies will recognise many of the scenes.
items.zh: 這部電影是老好萊塢歌舞片的仿作,所以經典電影迷會認出許多場景。

items.def: the acceptance of many different styles or beliefs
items.s: Today's art world is marked by ________, because no single style is more important than the others.
items.zh: 當今藝術界的特色是多元並存,因為沒有任何單一風格比其他風格更重要。

items.def: a calm, confident way of behaving
items.s: Although she was only twelve, the pianist played with great ________, and she did not seem nervous at all.
items.zh: 雖然這位鋼琴家只有十二歲,她演奏時卻非常沉著,一點也不顯得緊張。

items.def: changing yourself or something completely
items.s: The singer is famous for constant ________, and every new album comes with a different look and sound.
items.zh: 這位歌手以不斷改頭換面聞名,每張新專輯都有不同的造型和曲風。

items.def: deep respect
items.s: Visitors speak with ________ inside the old temple, and they bow before the carved statues of the gods.
items.zh: 參觀者在古廟內帶著崇敬輕聲說話,並在神明雕像前鞠躬。

items.def: the state of being alone, often happily
items.s: Many writers need ________ to work, so they rent quiet rooms in the mountains far from their families.
items.zh: 許多作家需要獨處才能工作,所以他們會在遠離家人的山上租安靜的房間。

items.def: going beyond ordinary experience
items.s: Some people feel a sense of ________ when they listen to great music, as if their worries suddenly disappear.
items.zh: 有些人聆聽偉大的音樂時會感到一種超凡的感受,彷彿煩惱突然消失了。

items.def: a great success
items.s: The opening night was a ________, and the young director received flowers from the whole cast after the show.
items.zh: 首演之夜大獲成功,演出後年輕導演收到全體演員送的花。

items.def: the quality of being the only one of its kind
items.s: The ________ of each handmade cup makes it special, because no two cups have exactly the same shape.
items.zh: 每個手工杯子的獨特性使它與眾不同,因為沒有兩個杯子的形狀完全相同。

items.def: the ability to do many different things well
items.s: The actor is famous for his ________, and he can play a funny teacher one year and a cruel king the next.
items.zh: 這位演員以多才多藝聞名,他今年能演搞笑老師,明年又能演殘暴的國王。

items.def: playful, unusual humour
items.s: The children's book is full of ________, so cats ride bicycles and teapots dance on the kitchen table.
items.zh: 這本童書充滿奇想,所以貓會騎腳踏車,茶壺會在廚房餐桌上跳舞。

items.def: the ability to say clever and funny things
items.s: The writer's ________ made the serious topic easy to read, and readers laughed while they learned about history.
items.zh: 作者的風趣讓嚴肅的主題變得好讀,讀者一邊學歷史一邊大笑。

items.def: great energy and enthusiasm
items.s: At eighty, the painter still works with great ________, and she gets up at five every morning to paint.
items.zh: 八十歲的這位畫家仍然充滿熱情地工作,她每天早上五點起床畫畫。

items.def: the belief that only a small group deserves the best things
items.s: Some people accuse classical music of ________, because concert tickets are expensive and the dress code feels strict.
items.zh: 有些人指責古典音樂有菁英主義之嫌,因為音樂會票價昂貴,服裝規定也讓人覺得嚴格。

items.def: the quality of being available only to a few people
items.s: The gallery sells limited prints to create a sense of ________, so collectors feel lucky when they get one.
items.zh: 這家畫廊販售限量版畫來營造獨佔性,所以收藏家買到時會覺得很幸運。

items.def: an action that makes people angry or react
items.s: The artist's broken toilet was a deliberate ________, because he wanted people to argue about what art means.
items.zh: 這位藝術家的破馬桶作品是刻意的挑釁,因為他想讓人們爭論藝術的意義。

items.def: taking something from another person or culture and using it
items.s: Some fashion designers have been criticised for ________ of traditional patterns, because they did not ask local communities first.
items.zh: 有些時裝設計師因挪用傳統圖騰而受到批評,因為他們事先沒有徵詢當地社群。

items.def: including all kinds of people
items.s: The museum is working on ________, so it now offers sign language tours and touchable sculptures for blind visitors.
items.zh: 這間博物館正致力於包容性,所以現在提供手語導覽和可供視障者觸摸的雕塑。

items.def: money given for a particular purpose
items.s: The theatre lost its government ________ last year, so it had to ask local businesses for help.
items.zh: 這家劇院去年失去了政府經費,所以必須向在地企業求助。

items.def: giving money to help others
items.s: Her ________ has helped many young musicians, because she pays for their lessons and buys them good instruments.
items.zh: 她的慈善事業幫助了許多年輕音樂家,因為她為他們支付課程費用並買好樂器給他們。

items.def: a famous and respected person in a field
items.s: The festival invited several ________ of world cinema, and students queued for hours to hear them speak.
items.zh: 影展邀請了數位世界電影界的泰斗,學生們排隊好幾個小時聽他們演講。

items.def: a person who loves an activity very much
items.s: As a ________ of Taiwanese puppet theatre, my uncle watches every performance at the temple festival.
items.zh: 身為台灣布袋戲的熱衷者,我叔叔看遍廟會上的每一場演出。

items.def: a person who knows and loves a subject well
items.s: Every film ________ in the city came to see the old movie, because it had not been shown for forty years.
items.zh: 城裡每位電影行家都來看這部老電影,因為它已經四十年沒有放映了。

items.def: a great musician or conductor
items.s: The old ________ conducted the orchestra without any notes, and the young musicians followed every movement of his hands.
items.zh: 這位老大師不看樂譜指揮管弦樂團,年輕樂手們緊隨他手上的每一個動作。

items.def: praised by many people
items.s: The ________ director spoke to our class about her films, and she told us to watch people carefully on buses.
items.zh: 這位廣受讚譽的導演到我們班上談她的電影,她告訴我們要在公車上仔細觀察人們。

items.def: very skilled at something
items.s: My piano teacher is an ________ musician, but she is very patient with beginners like me.
items.zh: 我的鋼琴老師是一位技藝精湛的音樂家,但她對像我這樣的初學者非常有耐心。

items.def: attractive or interesting
items.s: The bright cover makes the book ________ to children, so it sells well in bookshops near primary schools.
items.zh: 鮮豔的封面讓這本書對孩子很吸引人,所以它在國小附近的書店賣得很好。

items.def: making you feel great respect and wonder
items.cn: 令人敬畏的;令人驚嘆的
items.s: The view from the top of the mountain was ________, and several of us were too surprised to say anything.
items.zh: 山頂的景色令人驚嘆,我們好幾個人驚訝得說不出話。

items.def: strong and clear, or brave
items.s: The poster uses ________ red letters, so people can read it easily from the other side of the street.
items.zh: 這張海報使用醒目的紅色字體,所以人們從對街就能輕鬆看清。

items.def: extremely beautiful or surprising
items.s: The dancers' final jump was ________, and the whole theatre was silent for a second before everyone cheered.
items.zh: 舞者最後一躍令人屏息,整座劇院安靜了一秒,接著所有人歡呼起來。

items.def: starting to develop and showing promise
items.cn: 嶄露頭角的;初露鋒芒的
items.s: The summer camp is designed for ________ artists, so most of the students are teenagers who have just begun painting.
items.zh: 這個夏令營是為嶄露頭角的藝術家設計的,所以大多數學員是剛開始畫畫的青少年。

items.def: brave and willing to take risks
items.s: Her ________ designs shocked the fashion world, but young people loved the unusual colours and shapes.
items.zh: 她大膽的設計震驚時尚界,但年輕人很喜歡那些不尋常的色彩和造型。

items.def: made to look pretty
items.s: The plates are purely ________, so please do not put food on them or wash them in the dishwasher.
items.zh: 這些盤子純屬裝飾性的,所以請不要在上面放食物或放進洗碗機清洗。

items.def: mysterious and hard to understand
items.s: The woman in the painting has an ________ smile, and visitors still argue about whether she is happy or sad.
items.zh: 畫中女子帶著神秘的微笑,參觀者至今仍爭論她是開心還是難過。

items.def: bringing strong memories or feelings to mind
items.cn: 引起回憶的;喚起情感的
items.s: The smell of the old bookshop was very ________, and it reminded me of reading with my father as a child.
items.zh: 舊書店的氣味非常喚起回憶,讓我想起小時候和爸爸一起閱讀的時光。

items.def: perfect, with no mistakes
items.s: The pianist gave a ________ performance, but she said afterwards that her hands were shaking the whole time.
items.zh: 這位鋼琴家的演出完美無瑕,但她事後說她的手一直在發抖。

items.def: very famous and seen as a symbol
items.s: Taipei 101 is an ________ building, so it appears on many postcards, posters and souvenirs.
items.zh: 台北101是一棟具代表性的建築,所以它出現在許多明信片、海報和紀念品上。

items.def: remembered for ever
items.s: Shakespeare's plays seem ________, because people around the world still perform them four hundred years later.
items.zh: 莎士比亞的戲劇似乎是不朽的,因為四百年後世界各地的人們仍在演出。

items.def: making people want to do something good
items.s: The blind painter gave an ________ talk at our school, and many students decided to try new hobbies afterwards.
items.zh: 這位盲人畫家在我們學校發表了一場激勵人心的演講,之後許多學生決定嘗試新嗜好。

items.def: very famous and admired for a long time
items.s: The ________ guitarist played a free concert in the park, and fans travelled from other cities to see him.
items.zh: 這位傳奇吉他手在公園舉辦免費音樂會,歌迷從其他城市遠道而來看他。

items.def: relating to books, poems and writing
items.s: She won a ________ prize for her first novel, and the book was soon translated into twelve languages.
items.zh: 她以第一本小說贏得文學獎,這本書很快就被翻譯成十二種語言。

items.def: very beautiful, large and impressive
items.s: The ________ mountains in the painting look calm and strong, while the tiny boat below seems lost.
items.zh: 畫中雄偉的山脈看起來沉靜而堅毅,而下方的小船則顯得迷茫。

items.def: important and having a clear purpose
items.s: Making art with elderly people was a ________ experience, because they shared stories about their lives as they painted.
items.zh: 和長者一起創作藝術是一次有意義的經驗,因為他們邊畫邊分享自己的人生故事。

items.def: worth remembering
items.s: The concert on the beach was truly ________, because the sun set behind the stage during the last song.
items.zh: 海灘上的音樂會真的令人難忘,因為最後一首歌時太陽在舞台後方落下。

items.def: making you feel strong emotions, especially sadness
items.s: The film about the old dog was so ________ that I cried, and my friend had to give me a tissue.
items.zh: 那部關於老狗的電影太感人了,我哭了,朋友只好遞給我一張面紙。

items.def: feeling happy and sad about the past
items.s: Old cartoon songs make my parents feel ________, so they sing along whenever they hear them on the radio.
items.zh: 老卡通歌曲讓我爸媽感到懷舊,所以每當在收音機聽到時他們都會跟著唱。

items.def: showing small but important differences
items.s: The actor gave a ________ performance, so the villain seemed both cruel and lonely at the same time.
items.zh: 這位演員的演出非常細膩,所以反派角色同時顯得既殘忍又孤獨。

items.def: used for decoration rather than use
items.s: The garden has many ________ stones, but the children use them as chairs during the summer festival.
items.zh: 花園裡有許多裝飾用的石頭,但夏日節慶時孩子們把它們當椅子坐。

items.def: beautiful and full of feeling, like poetry
items.s: The film has a ________ ending, and the last scene shows two old friends watching the rain in silence.
items.zh: 這部電影有個富有詩意的結局,最後一幕是兩位老朋友默默看著雨。

items.def: bright and shining
items.s: The bride looked ________ in her red dress, and the photographer said it was the easiest wedding he had ever photographed.
items.zh: 新娘穿著紅色禮服容光煥發,攝影師說這是他拍過最輕鬆的婚禮。

items.def: elegant and showing good taste
items.s: The tea house has a ________ atmosphere, so customers speak quietly while they enjoy their tea.
items.zh: 這間茶館有著高雅的氛圍,所以顧客品茶時都輕聲細語。

items.def: showing things as they look in real life
items.s: Children usually start with ________ drawings of houses and people, but later some of them try abstract shapes.
items.zh: 孩子們通常從房子和人物的具象畫開始,但後來有些人會嘗試抽象形狀。

items.def: calm and controlled, not too strong
items.s: The actor gave a ________ performance, but his quiet sadness touched the audience more than loud crying could.
items.zh: 這位演員的演出很克制,但他安靜的哀傷比大聲哭泣更打動觀眾。

items.def: having a regular repeated pattern of sounds
items.s: The ________ sound of the drums filled the street, and soon people began to dance in front of the temple.
items.zh: 有節奏的鼓聲充滿了街道,很快人們就開始在廟前跳起舞來。

items.def: connected with feelings and memories, not value
items.cn: 有情感價值的;多愁善感的
items.s: The old guitar has ________ value for my father, because his best friend gave it to him before moving abroad.
items.zh: 這把舊吉他對我爸爸有情感上的價值,因為那是他最好的朋友出國前送他的。

items.def: very good at doing something
items.s: The ________ potter made ten cups in an hour, and every one of them was the same size and shape.
items.zh: 這位技巧高超的陶藝家一小時做了十個杯子,而且每一個的大小和形狀都一樣。

items.def: extremely beautiful or impressive
items.s: The photos of the sunrise were ________, so the magazine used one of them for its front cover.
items.zh: 那些日出照片令人驚豔,所以雜誌用了其中一張當封面。

items.def: soft and not bright
items.s: The café uses ________ lighting in the evening, so customers feel relaxed and stay longer.
items.zh: 這家咖啡廳晚上使用柔和的燈光,所以顧客感到放鬆並待得更久。

items.def: extremely good
items.s: The actors were ________ in the new play, but the story was too long and some people fell asleep.
items.zh: 演員們在新戲中的表現一流,但故事太長,有些人睡著了。

items.def: making people think seriously
items.s: The documentary was ________, and after watching it our class discussed plastic waste for the whole lesson.
items.zh: 這部紀錄片發人深省,看完後我們班整堂課都在討論塑膠垃圾。

items.def: simple and not trying to attract attention
items.s: Her clothes are always ________, but people notice her because her colours are chosen so carefully.
items.zh: 她的衣著總是很低調,但人們會注意到她,因為她的配色選得非常用心。

items.def: different from what is usual or accepted
items.s: The teacher uses ________ methods, such as painting with toothbrushes, but her students win many prizes.
items.zh: 這位老師使用另類的方法,例如用牙刷畫畫,但她的學生贏得許多獎項。

items.def: hoping to become successful in a job
items.s: The workshop is free for ________ writers, so many university students joined it during the summer holiday.
items.zh: 這個工作坊免費開放給有志成為作家的人,所以許多大學生在暑假參加。

items.def: causing admiration
items.s: His drawing skills are ________ for a twelve-year-old, so the art teacher entered his work in a national competition.
items.zh: 以十二歲來說,他的繪畫技巧令人印象深刻,所以美術老師把他的作品送去參加全國比賽。

items.def: small and private, making people feel close
items.s: The singer chose an ________ café for her concert, because she wanted to talk with fans between songs.
items.zh: 這位歌手選了一家溫馨的小咖啡館開演唱會,因為她想在歌曲之間和歌迷聊天。

items.def: expressing feelings in a beautiful, song-like way
items.s: The writer's ________ descriptions of the countryside are beautiful, so many readers now want to visit the small village.
items.zh: 作者對鄉村抒情的描寫很優美,所以現在許多讀者都想去造訪那座小村莊。

items.def: showing emotions in a very exaggerated way
items.s: The TV drama is very ________, and the characters cry or shout in almost every scene.
items.zh: 這部電視劇非常誇張煽情,角色幾乎每場戲都在哭或大吼。

items.def: using only one colour or black and white
items.s: The artist painted the whole room in ________ grey, so the single red chair in the middle stood out.
items.zh: 藝術家把整個房間漆成單色的灰色,所以中間那把紅椅子格外醒目。

items.def: showing things as they appear in nature
items.s: The bird paintings are so ________ that scientists use them to identify species in the forest.
items.zh: 這些鳥類畫作非常逼真,科學家甚至用它們來辨認森林裡的物種。

items.def: not given enough attention or care
items.s: Many women painters were ________ for centuries, but museums are now bringing their works out of storage.
items.zh: 許多女性畫家數百年來被忽視,但博物館現在正把她們的作品從倉庫中拿出來展示。

items.def: thinking about something too much
items.s: He is ________ about details, so he spent three days painting a single leaf until he was happy.
items.zh: 他對細節非常執著,所以他花了三天畫一片葉子直到滿意為止。

items.def: unusual and not what most people expect
items.s: The band has an ________ style, and they often play songs with kitchen pots instead of drums.
items.zh: 這個樂團有不落俗套的風格,他們常用廚房的鍋子代替鼓來演奏。

items.def: unusual in an interesting way
items.s: The café is full of ________ furniture, such as a bathtub sofa, so it is very popular on Instagram.
items.zh: 這家咖啡廳充滿奇特的家具,例如浴缸沙發,所以在Instagram上非常受歡迎。

items.def: natural and not polished
items.s: The singer's voice sounds ________ and honest, so listeners feel that she really means every word.
items.zh: 這位歌手的聲音聽起來未經修飾而真誠,所以聽眾覺得她是真心唱出每一個字。

items.def: refusing to follow rules
items.s: The ________ young painters left the art academy, and they held their own exhibition in an old warehouse.
items.zh: 這群叛逆的年輕畫家離開了藝術學院,在一間舊倉庫舉辦了自己的展覽。

items.def: thinking quietly and deeply
items.s: The slow music put me in a ________ mood, so I sat by the window and thought about the past year.
items.zh: 緩慢的音樂讓我進入沉思的心情,所以我坐在窗邊回想過去這一年。

items.def: doing what pleases yourself without thinking of others
items.cn: 自我陶醉的;放縱自我的
items.s: Some critics called the film ________, because the director made it four hours long and included scenes from his own childhood.
items.zh: 有些評論家說這部電影自我陶醉,因為導演把它拍成四小時,還加入了他自己童年的場景。

items.def: dark and serious
items.s: The war museum uses ________ colours in every room, so visitors naturally speak more quietly inside.
items.zh: 戰爭博物館每個展間都使用肅穆的色調,所以參觀者在裡面自然而然地放低音量。

items.def: relating to deep feelings and beliefs rather than the body
items.s: For many people, temple music has a ________ meaning, and it helps them feel calm and connected to their ancestors.
items.zh: 對許多人來說,廟宇音樂具有心靈上的意義,它幫助他們感到平靜並與祖先相連。

items.def: drawn in a simple, artistic way rather than realistically
items.s: The cartoon uses ________ characters with huge eyes, but children still find them easy to understand.
items.zh: 這部卡通使用有著大眼睛的風格化角色,但孩子們仍覺得很容易理解。

items.def: ugly or offensive, showing bad judgement
items.s: Many people thought the advertisement was ________, because it made jokes about a recent disaster.
items.zh: 許多人認為這則廣告低俗,因為它拿最近的災難開玩笑。

items.def: suffering great mental pain
items.s: The ________ artist painted dark pictures after losing his son, and his friends worried about his health.
items.zh: 這位飽受折磨的藝術家在失去兒子後畫起了陰暗的作品,朋友們都擔心他的健康。

items.def: not completed
items.s: The composer died before the end of the piece, so the ________ symphony stops suddenly in the middle of a melody.
items.zh: 作曲家在作品完成前過世,所以這首未完成的交響曲在旋律中途戛然而止。

items.def: not given the respect it deserves
items.s: Her talent remained ________ for many years, but a short video online finally made her famous.
items.zh: 她的才華多年來未被賞識,但網路上一段短片終於讓她出名。

items.def: extremely well or brightly
items.s: The students performed the play ________, and the principal invited them to perform it again for the parents.
items.zh: 學生們出色地演出這齣戲,校長邀請他們再為家長演一次。

items.def: in a way that judges carefully
items.s: We learned to look ________ at advertisements, because many of them use beautiful images to hide the truth.
items.zh: 我們學會批判性地看待廣告,因為許多廣告用漂亮的圖像掩蓋真相。

items.def: in a gentle and careful way
items.s: The flowers on the vase are ________ painted, and each petal has several shades of pink.
items.zh: 花瓶上的花朵畫得很細緻,每片花瓣都有好幾層粉紅色。

items.def: clearly and noticeably
items.s: I ________ remember my first visit to the art museum, because a guard shouted at me for touching a statue.
items.zh: 我清楚地記得第一次去美術館的情形,因為警衛因我摸了雕像而對我大吼。

items.def: without seeming to try hard
items.s: The dancer moved ________ across the stage, but she later said that the routine took her two years to learn.
items.zh: 舞者毫不費力地在舞台上移動,但她後來說這套舞花了她兩年才學會。

items.def: unusually; to a very great degree
items.s: The young cellist is ________ talented, so she was invited to study in Vienna when she was only fourteen.
items.zh: 這位年輕大提琴家格外有才華,所以她十四歲就受邀到維也納深造。

items.def: exactly and accurately
items.s: The film ________ follows the novel, so readers who loved the book will not be disappointed.
items.zh: 這部電影忠實地依循原著小說,所以喜愛這本書的讀者不會失望。

items.def: without being limited or controlled
items.s: In the art room, the children can paint ________, and the teacher never tells them which colours to use.
items.zh: 在美術教室裡,孩子們可以自由地畫畫,老師從不告訴他們該用什麼顏色。

items.def: very strongly
items.s: The actress prepared ________ for the role, and she lived alone in a forest for a month before filming began.
items.zh: 這位女演員為角色極度投入地準備,開拍前她獨自在森林裡住了一個月。

items.def: with many small, detailed parts
items.s: The wooden screen is ________ carved with birds and flowers, and it took the craftsman three years to finish.
items.zh: 這座木屏風精細地雕刻著花鳥,工匠花了三年才完成。

items.def: by feeling rather than careful thinking
items.s: The painter chooses colours ________, so she never plans the picture before she starts working.
items.zh: 這位畫家憑直覺選擇顏色,所以她開始作畫前從不先規劃畫面。

items.def: very deeply
items.s: The visit to the war memorial ________ affected the students, and many of them wrote poems about peace afterwards.
items.zh: 參觀戰爭紀念館深刻地影響了學生,之後許多人寫了關於和平的詩。

items.def: only; completely
items.s: She paints ________ for pleasure, so she never sells her work although many people want to buy it.
items.zh: 她純粹為了樂趣而畫畫,所以雖然很多人想買,她從不出售作品。

items.def: in a very noticeable way
items.s: The two paintings look ________ similar, so experts believe the same artist painted both of them.
items.zh: 這兩幅畫看起來驚人地相似,所以專家相信它們出自同一位畫家之手。

items.def: in a slight way that is not easy to notice
items.s: The colours change ________ from blue to green, so you only notice it when you look at the whole painting.
items.zh: 顏色從藍色微妙地轉為綠色,所以只有看整幅畫時才會注意到。

items.def: very clearly and brightly
items.s: The writer describes the night market so ________ that readers can almost smell the stinky tofu.
items.zh: 作者把夜市描寫得如此生動,讀者幾乎能聞到臭豆腐的味道。

items.def: in a way that relates to seeing
items.s: The new museum is ________ beautiful, but some visitors say the signs are too small to read.
items.zh: 新博物館視覺上很美,但有些參觀者說標示太小看不清楚。

items.def: in a way that relates to beauty
items.s: The new bridge is ________ pleasing, and it also allows cyclists to cross the river safely.
items.zh: 這座新橋在美學上令人賞心悅目,也讓自行車騎士能安全過河。

items.def: in a creative way
items.s: The old warehouse was ________ turned into a library, and children can now read inside giant wooden boats.
items.zh: 這間舊倉庫被富有想像力地改造成圖書館,孩子們現在可以在巨大的木船裡閱讀。

items.def: suddenly and without planning
items.s: The crowd ________ began to sing along with the busker, and soon the whole station was full of music.
items.zh: 群眾自發地跟著街頭藝人唱起歌來,很快整個車站都充滿了音樂。

items.def: honestly and openly
items.s: The actor spoke ________ about his failures in the interview, so many young fans felt encouraged by his story.
items.zh: 這位演員在訪談中坦率地談論自己的失敗,所以許多年輕粉絲受到他的故事鼓舞。

items.def: in a way that is planned and deliberate
items.s: The designer ________ chose recycled materials, because she wanted her shop to cause less pollution.
items.zh: 這位設計師刻意地選擇回收材料,因為她希望她的店能減少污染。

items.def: without stopping
items.s: The little boy watched the video ________, so he could soon copy every dance move perfectly.
items.zh: 這個小男孩不斷地看那支影片,所以他很快就能完美模仿每個舞步。

items.def: in a way that is famous for something bad
items.s: Art school is ________ expensive in many countries, so many talented students cannot afford to attend it.
items.zh: 在許多國家,藝術學校出了名地昂貴,所以許多有才華的學生負擔不起。

items.def: with great skill
items.s: The director ________ builds tension in the film, and the audience holds its breath during the final scene.
items.zh: 導演在電影中高明地營造緊張感,觀眾在最後一幕都屏住了呼吸。

items.def: art made only for beauty, not for any other purpose
items.s: He does not paint to make money or teach lessons, because he believes in ______ ______ ______ ______.
items.zh: 他畫畫不是為了賺錢或說教,因為他信奉為藝術而藝術。

items.w: a picture is worth a thousand words
items.def: an image can explain more than a long description
items.s: Our teacher showed us one photo of the flood instead of reading the report, because ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______.
items.zh: 老師給我們看一張水災的照片而不是念報告,因為一圖勝千言。

items.w: beauty is in the eye of the beholder
items.def: different people have different ideas of what is beautiful
items.cn: 情人眼裡出西施;美因人而異
items.s: My brother thinks the strange sculpture is ugly, but I love it, so I guess ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______.
items.zh: 我哥覺得那座怪雕塑很醜,但我很喜歡,所以我想美是因人而異的。

items.def: the whole situation, not just small details
items.s: Do not worry too much about one small mistake in your drawing, and try to look at ______ ______ ______.
items.zh: 不要太擔心畫中的一個小錯誤,試著看看整體大局。

items.def: to describe something in a particular way
items.s: The documentary ______ ______ ______ ______ life in a poor fishing village, and many viewers decided to donate money.
items.zh: 這部紀錄片描繪出一個貧窮漁村的生活樣貌,許多觀眾因此決定捐款。

items.def: to get ideas for your work from something
items.s: Many fashion designers ______ ______ ______ old movies, so you can see styles from the 1950s in their new collections.
items.zh: 許多時裝設計師從老電影汲取靈感,所以你能在他們的新系列中看到1950年代的風格。

items.def: a painting, sculpture or other piece of art; something very beautiful
items.s: The birthday cake was ______ ______ ______ ______, and nobody wanted to cut it because it looked like a small castle.
items.zh: 那個生日蛋糕簡直是一件藝術品,沒有人捨得切,因為它看起來像一座小城堡。

items.def: hard work done because you love it, not for money
items.cn: 出於熱愛而做的辛苦工作
items.s: Restoring the old temple paintings was ______ ______ ______ ______ for the artist, because she received almost no money for her years of work.
items.zh: 修復這些古廟畫作對這位藝術家來說是一項出於熱愛的辛苦工作,因為她多年的付出幾乎沒有報酬。

items.def: to help yourself start having ideas
items.s: I always listen to music before I write, because it helps me ______ ______ ______ ______ ______.
items.zh: 我寫作前總是聽音樂,因為它幫助我激發創意。

items.def: to try to do more than what is usual or accepted
items.s: The young dancers want to ______ ______ ______ of traditional dance, so they mix Taiwanese folk steps with hip-hop.
items.zh: 這群年輕舞者想要突破傳統舞蹈的界限,所以他們把台灣民俗舞步和嘻哈混搭。

items.def: to show your feelings and ideas
items.s: Shy students often find it easier to ______ ______ through drawing, because they do not need to speak in front of others.
items.zh: 害羞的學生常覺得透過畫畫表達自己比較容易,因為他們不需要在別人面前說話。

items.def: to attract the most attention in a performance
items.s: The little girl only had one line in the play, but she ______ ______ ______ when she started to dance.
items.zh: 那個小女孩在劇中只有一句台詞,但她開始跳舞時就搶盡了風頭。

items.def: to become the most important or noticed thing
items.s: Local artists will ______ ______ ______ at this year's festival, while international stars will perform only on the last night.
items.zh: 在今年的藝術節中,在地藝術家將成為焦點,而國際明星只會在最後一晚演出。

items.def: someone so good that the next person will seem worse
items.s: The last art teacher was very popular, so she will be ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ for the new teacher.
items.zh: 上一位美術老師非常受歡迎,所以對新老師來說,她會是難以超越的榜樣。

items.def: to make something seem real and exciting
items.s: The talented actors ______ the old story ______ ______, and even students who hated history enjoyed the play.
items.zh: 才華洋溢的演員們讓那個老故事栩栩如生,就連討厭歷史的學生都很喜歡這齣戲。

items.def: not something a person likes
items.s: Opera is ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, but I still went with my grandmother because she really wanted company.
items.zh: 歌劇不是我的菜,但我還是陪奶奶去了,因為她真的很想要人作伴。

items.def: to make people feel sympathy or connection
items.s: The song about leaving home ______ ______ ______ with many young workers, because they also live far from their families.
items.zh: 那首關於離鄉的歌引起許多年輕上班族的共鳴,因為他們也住得離家人很遠。

items.def: secretly or in a way the public does not see
items.s: Many people work ______ ______ ______ at a concert, and without them the singers could not perform.
items.zh: 許多人在演唱會幕後工作,沒有他們,歌手就無法演出。

items.def: completely unique
items.s: Each handmade lamp is ______ ______ ______ ______, so you will never see the same one in another person's house.
items.zh: 每盞手工燈都是獨一無二的,所以你絕不會在別人家看到一模一樣的。

items.def: to become successful and noticed
items.s: The young director quickly ______ ______ ______ in the film industry, and her first movie won three awards.
items.zh: 這位年輕導演很快就在電影界嶄露頭角,她的第一部電影就贏得了三個獎項。

items.def: how plants use sunlight to make food from air and water
items.s: Green leaves need plenty of sunlight for ________, so the plants on our dark balcony grow slowly and look pale.
items.zh: 綠葉需要充足的陽光來進行光合作用,所以我們陰暗陽台上的植物長得很慢,看起來也很蒼白。
items.sec: Plant Structure & Biology 植物構造與生物學

items.def: the green substance in plants that absorbs sunlight
items.s: In autumn the trees stop making ________, so the green colour fades and the red and yellow colours finally appear.
items.zh: 秋天時樹木停止製造葉綠素,所以綠色逐漸褪去,紅色和黃色終於顯現出來。
items.sec: Plant Structure & Biology 植物構造與生物學

items.def: a tiny part of a plant cell where photosynthesis happens
items.s: Our biology teacher showed us a leaf under the microscope, and we could see hundreds of green ________ inside each cell.
items.zh: 生物老師讓我們在顯微鏡下看一片葉子,我們可以看到每個細胞裡有數百個綠色的葉綠體。
items.sec: Plant Structure & Biology 植物構造與生物學

items.def: the part of a plant that grows under the ground
items.s: The old tree survived the typhoon because its ________ went deep into the ground, but the young trees nearby fell over.
items.zh: 那棵老樹撐過了颱風,因為它的根深深扎入地下,但附近的小樹都倒了。
items.sec: Plant Structure & Biology 植物構造與生物學

items.def: a flat green part that grows from a stem or branch
items.s: My grandmother collects fallen ________ in the park every autumn, and she presses them inside heavy books to make bookmarks.
items.zh: 我奶奶每年秋天都會在公園收集落下的葉子,並把它們壓在厚重的書裡做成書籤。
items.sec: Plant Structure & Biology 植物構造與生物學

items.def: one of the coloured parts of a flower
items.s: The wind blew the cherry blossoms off the trees, so the path was covered with soft pink ________ for the whole week.
items.zh: 風把櫻花從樹上吹落,所以整個星期小路上都鋪滿了柔軟的粉紅色花瓣。
items.sec: Plant Structure & Biology 植物構造與生物學

items.def: the male part of a flower that produces pollen
items.s: If you look closely at a lily, you can see the long ________ in the centre, and their yellow pollen can stain your clothes.
items.zh: 如果你仔細看百合花,會看到中間長長的雄蕊,而它們的黃色花粉會弄髒你的衣服。
items.sec: Plant Structure & Biology 植物構造與生物學

items.def: the female part of a flower that receives pollen
items.s: The bee landed on the flower and touched the ________, so the pollen on its legs helped the plant produce seeds.
items.zh: 蜜蜂停在花上並碰觸了雌蕊,所以牠腳上的花粉幫助植物結出種子。
items.sec: Plant Structure & Biology 植物構造與生物學

items.def: a small part on a plant that will open into a leaf or flower
items.s: The rose bush is covered with tiny ________ this week, and my mother expects the first flowers to open by Sunday.
items.zh: 這週玫瑰叢上長滿了小小的花苞,我媽媽預計第一批花會在星期天前開放。
items.sec: Plant Structure & Biology 植物構造與生物學

items.def: a sharp point on the stem of a plant
items.s: I was picking roses for the table, but a sharp ________ cut my finger, so I had to put on a plaster.
items.zh: 我在摘玫瑰放在桌上,但一根尖銳的刺割傷了我的手指,所以我得貼上OK繃。
items.sec: Plant Structure & Biology 植物構造與生物學

items.def: the hard outer covering of a tree
items.s: Deer often eat the ________ of young trees in winter, so the park rangers wrap the trunks in plastic to protect them.
items.zh: 鹿在冬天常常吃小樹的樹皮,所以公園管理員會用塑膠把樹幹包起來保護它們。
items.sec: Plant Structure & Biology 植物構造與生物學

items.def: the thick main stem of a tree
items.s: The ________ of the old camphor tree is so wide that five students had to hold hands to reach around it.
items.zh: 那棵老樟樹的樹幹非常粗,五個學生必須手牽手才能把它圍起來。
items.sec: Plant Structure & Biology 植物構造與生物學

items.def: a part of a tree that grows out from the trunk
items.s: A heavy ________ fell onto the road during the storm, and traffic stopped until workers cut it into pieces.
items.zh: 暴風雨期間一根沉重的樹枝掉到路上,交通因此停頓,直到工人把它鋸成幾段。
items.sec: Plant Structure & Biology 植物構造與生物學

items.def: a very small thin branch
items.s: The birds collected dry ________ and grass from the garden, and within three days they had built a neat nest.
items.zh: 鳥兒從花園收集乾的細枝和草,三天內就築好了一個整齊的巢。
items.sec: Plant Structure & Biology 植物構造與生物學

items.def: the liquid that carries food inside a plant
items.s: When you cut the stem of this plant, a sticky white ________ comes out, so you should wear gloves when you prune it.
items.zh: 當你切開這種植物的莖時,會流出一種黏稠的白色樹液,所以修剪時你應該戴手套。
items.sec: Plant Structure & Biology 植物構造與生物學

items.def: tubes in a plant that carry water up from the roots
items.s: Water travels up through the ________ from the roots to the leaves, and this is why a cut flower can drink from a vase.
items.zh: 水分經由木質部從根部往上輸送到葉子,這就是剪下的花能從花瓶吸水的原因。
items.sec: Plant Structure & Biology 植物構造與生物學

items.def: tubes in a plant that carry sugar from the leaves
items.s: The ________ carries sugar from the leaves to other parts of the plant, but it can be damaged if animals strip off the bark.
items.zh: 韌皮部把糖分從葉子運送到植物的其他部位,但如果動物剝掉樹皮,它就可能受損。
items.sec: Plant Structure & Biology 植物構造與生物學

items.def: tiny holes on a leaf that let gases in and out
items.s: On hot afternoons many plants close their ________ to save water, so they take in less carbon dioxide and grow more slowly.
items.zh: 在炎熱的午後,許多植物會關閉氣孔以保存水分,所以吸收的二氧化碳變少,生長也變慢。
items.sec: Plant Structure & Biology 植物構造與生物學

items.def: very thin hairs on a root that take in water
items.s: Tiny ______ ______ cover the end of each root, and they help the plant absorb water and minerals from the soil.
items.zh: 微小的根毛覆蓋在每條根的末端,它們幫助植物從土壤中吸收水分和礦物質。
items.sec: Plant Structure & Biology 植物構造與生物學

items.def: one large main root that grows straight down
items.s: A carrot is actually a thick orange ________, so when we eat it we are eating the part that grew under the ground.
items.zh: 紅蘿蔔其實是一條粗大的橘色主根,所以我們吃它時,吃的是長在地下的部分。
items.sec: Plant Structure & Biology 植物構造與生物學

items.def: a round underground part from which some plants grow
items.s: We planted tulip ________ in the school garden in November, and they turned into colourful flowers in early spring.
items.zh: 我們在十一月把鬱金香球莖種在學校花園裡,它們在早春長成了色彩繽紛的花朵。
items.sec: Plant Structure & Biology 植物構造與生物學

items.def: a thick underground stem that stores food, like a potato
items.s: A potato is a ________ that stores food under the ground, so farmers must dig carefully when they harvest the crop.
items.zh: 馬鈴薯是一種在地下儲存養分的塊莖,所以農夫收成時必須小心挖掘。
items.sec: Plant Structure & Biology 植物構造與生物學

items.def: a stem that grows sideways under the ground
items.s: Ginger grows from a ________ that spreads under the soil, and cooks use this part to add a warm taste to soup.
items.zh: 薑是從一段在土壤下蔓延的根莖長出來的,廚師會用這個部分為湯增添溫暖的味道。
items.sec: Plant Structure & Biology 植物構造與生物學

items.def: a thin curling part a climbing plant uses to hold on
items.s: The cucumber plant wrapped its ________ around the fence, so it could climb higher and reach more sunlight.
items.zh: 小黃瓜植株把它的卷鬚纏繞在圍籬上,所以它能爬得更高,照到更多陽光。
items.sec: Plant Structure & Biology 植物構造與生物學

items.def: all the leaves of a plant or tree
items.s: The thick ________ of the forest blocked most of the sunlight, so it felt cool and dark even at noon.
items.zh: 森林茂密的枝葉擋住了大部分陽光,所以即使在中午也感覺涼爽而陰暗。
items.sec: Plant Structure & Biology 植物構造與生物學

items.def: flowers on a fruit tree or bush
items.s: Thousands of tourists visit Yangmingshan in spring because the cherry ________ turns the hills pink and white.
items.zh: 每年春天數千名遊客造訪陽明山,因為櫻花把山丘染成粉紅色和白色。
items.sec: Plant Structure & Biology 植物構造與生物學

items.def: the strong outer layer around a plant cell
items.s: Plant cells have a strong ______ ______ around them, but animal cells do not, so plants can stand upright without bones.
items.zh: 植物細胞外圍有一層堅固的細胞壁,但動物細胞沒有,所以植物不需要骨頭也能直立。
items.sec: Plant Structure & Biology 植物構造與生物學

items.def: the loss of water from a plant's leaves into the air
items.s: On a hot, windy day ________ happens much faster, so the farmer has to water the young plants twice.
items.zh: 在炎熱又多風的日子裡,蒸散作用發生得快得多,所以農夫必須替幼苗澆兩次水。
items.sec: Plant Structure & Biology 植物構造與生物學

items.def: the main stem of a plant, or a thin stem holding a leaf or flower
items.s: The sunflower grew so tall that its ________ bent under the heavy flower, so we tied it to a bamboo stick.
items.zh: 向日葵長得太高了,它的莖被沉重的花壓彎,所以我們把它綁在竹竿上。
items.sec: Plant Structure & Biology 植物構造與生物學

items.def: a new part that grows from a plant
items.s: After the spring rain, green ________ appeared all over the burnt hillside, and the villagers were glad to see new life.
items.zh: 春雨過後,燒焦的山坡上到處冒出綠色的嫩芽,村民們很高興看到新生命。
items.sec: Plant Structure & Biology 植物構造與生物學

items.def: keeping green leaves all year
items.s: Pine trees are ________, so they stay green in winter while the other trees in the park lose all their leaves.
items.zh: 松樹是常綠的,所以冬天時它們依然翠綠,而公園裡其他的樹則掉光了葉子。
items.sec: Plant Structure & Biology 植物構造與生物學

items.def: losing all its leaves every autumn
items.s: Maple trees are ________, so they drop their leaves every autumn, but they grow new ones again in spring.
items.zh: 楓樹是落葉樹,所以每年秋天都會掉葉子,但到了春天又會長出新葉。
items.sec: Plant Structure & Biology 植物構造與生物學

items.def: a small hard part from which a new plant grows
items.s: My little brother planted a sunflower ________ in a paper cup, and he watered it every morning before school.
items.zh: 我弟弟把一顆向日葵種子種在紙杯裡,而且每天上學前都會替它澆水。
items.sec: Plant Growth & Reproduction 植物生長與繁殖

items.def: a long case on a plant that holds seeds
items.s: When the ______ ______ dries in the sun, it splits open, and the seeds fall to the ground or blow away.
items.zh: 當種莢在陽光下曬乾後,它會裂開,種子便掉落地面或被風吹走。
items.sec: Plant Growth & Reproduction 植物生長與繁殖

items.def: a tiny cell that ferns and fungi use to reproduce
items.s: Ferns do not have flowers or seeds, but they produce millions of tiny ________ under their leaves instead.
items.zh: 蕨類沒有花也沒有種子,但它們會在葉子下方產生數百萬個微小的孢子來代替。
items.sec: Plant Growth & Reproduction 植物生長與繁殖

items.def: when pollen moves from one plant to another plant
items.s: Farmers keep bees near their apple trees because ________ produces more fruit, and the apples are often bigger too.
items.zh: 農夫把蜜蜂養在蘋果樹附近,因為異花授粉能結出更多果實,而且蘋果通常也比較大。
items.sec: Plant Growth & Reproduction 植物生長與繁殖

items.def: a sweet liquid in flowers that insects drink
items.s: Butterflies visit the garden every morning to drink ________ from the flowers, and they carry pollen from plant to plant.
items.zh: 蝴蝶每天早上來花園吸食花朵的花蜜,並把花粉從一株植物帶到另一株。
items.sec: Plant Growth & Reproduction 植物生長與繁殖

items.def: a small soft fruit with seeds
items.s: Birds eat the red ________ from the bushes in winter, and later they drop the seeds far away from the parent plant.
items.zh: 鳥兒在冬天吃灌木上的紅色漿果,之後把種子散落在遠離母株的地方。
items.sec: Plant Growth & Reproduction 植物生長與繁殖

items.def: the hard brown fruit of a pine tree that holds seeds
items.s: The children collected pine ________ in the forest, and their teacher helped them paint the cones for a Christmas display.
items.zh: 孩子們在森林裡收集松毬果,老師幫他們把毬果上色做成聖誕節的裝飾。
items.sec: Plant Growth & Reproduction 植物生長與繁殖

items.def: the nut of an oak tree
items.s: Squirrels bury hundreds of ________ every autumn, but they forget many of them, so new oak trees grow in spring.
items.zh: 松鼠每年秋天會埋下數百顆橡實,但牠們忘了很多,所以春天時就長出新的橡樹。
items.sec: Plant Growth & Reproduction 植物生長與繁殖

items.def: the ways seeds are spread away from the parent plant
items.s: Wind, water and animals all help with ______ ______, so plants can grow in new places far from where they started.
items.zh: 風、水和動物都有助於種子傳播,所以植物能在遠離原生地的新地方生長。
items.sec: Plant Growth & Reproduction 植物生長與繁殖

items.def: a period when a seed or plant rests and does not grow
items.s: Many seeds stay in a state of ________ during the cold winter, and they only begin to grow when the soil warms up.
items.zh: 許多種子在寒冷的冬天保持休眠狀態,只有在土壤變暖時才開始生長。
items.sec: Plant Growth & Reproduction 植物生長與繁殖

items.def: to start to grow and produce new leaves
items.s: We left the beans on wet cotton for three days, and they began to ________ faster than we had expected.
items.zh: 我們把豆子放在濕棉花上三天,它們發芽的速度比我們預期的還要快。
items.sec: Plant Growth & Reproduction 植物生長與繁殖
