items.def: to produce flowers
items.s: The cherry trees usually ________ in early spring, but this year they flowered late because the winter was so cold.
items.zh: 櫻花樹通常在早春開花,但今年因為冬天太冷,所以花開得晚。
items.sec: Plant Growth & Reproduction 植物生長與繁殖

items.def: to become weak and bend because of no water
items.s: I forgot to water my plants during the holiday, so they began to ________ and their leaves turned brown.
items.zh: 假期時我忘了替植物澆水,所以它們開始枯萎,葉子也變成褐色。
items.sec: Plant Growth & Reproduction 植物生長與繁殖

items.def: to cut off parts of a plant to help it grow better
items.s: The gardener ________ the rose bushes every winter, and as a result they produce more flowers in the following spring.
items.zh: 園丁每年冬天都會修剪玫瑰叢,因此它們隔年春天會開出更多花。
items.sec: Plant Growth & Reproduction 植物生長與繁殖

items.def: to join part of one plant onto another plant
items.s: Fruit farmers often ________ a branch from a sweet apple tree onto a strong young tree, and the new tree gives better fruit.
items.zh: 果農常把甜蘋果樹的枝條嫁接到強壯的小樹上,這樣新樹就能結出更好的果實。
items.sec: Plant Growth & Reproduction 植物生長與繁殖

items.def: a piece cut from a plant to grow a new plant
items.s: My neighbour gave me a ________ from her mint plant, and after a week in water it had already grown small roots.
items.zh: 鄰居給了我一段她薄荷的插枝,在水裡放了一星期後它已經長出了小根。
items.sec: Plant Growth & Reproduction 植物生長與繁殖

items.def: a type of plant developed by people for special qualities
items.s: Scientists created a new ________ of rice that grows well in salty soil, so farmers near the coast are very interested.
items.zh: 科學家培育出一種能在鹽分高的土壤中生長良好的新水稻栽培品種,所以沿海的農民非常感興趣。
items.sec: Plant Growth & Reproduction 植物生長與繁殖

items.def: a scientist who studies plants
items.s: The ________ spent three months in the mountains, and she discovered a small orchid that nobody had recorded before.
items.zh: 那位植物學家在山區待了三個月,並發現了一種從未有人記錄過的小型蘭花。
items.sec: Plant Growth & Reproduction 植物生長與繁殖

items.def: the scientific study of plants
items.s: My cousin studied ________ at university because she loves plants, and now she works at a research centre in Pingtung.
items.zh: 我表姊在大學主修植物學,因為她熱愛植物,現在她在屏東的一間研究中心工作。
items.sec: Plant Growth & Reproduction 植物生長與繁殖

items.def: a park where many kinds of plants are grown for study
items.s: Our class visited the Taipei ______ ______ last Friday, and we saw plants from rainforests, deserts and wetlands.
items.zh: 上週五我們班參觀了台北植物園,看到了來自雨林、沙漠和濕地的植物。
items.sec: Plant Growth & Reproduction 植物生長與繁殖

items.def: a collection of dried plants kept for study
items.s: The university keeps more than fifty thousand dried plants in its ________, and researchers use them to compare species.
items.zh: 這所大學的植物標本館收藏了五萬多件乾燥植物,研究人員用它們來比較不同物種。
items.sec: Plant Growth & Reproduction 植物生長與繁殖

items.def: a circle inside a tree trunk that shows one year of growth
items.s: We counted the ______ ______ on the cut tree trunk, and we found that the tree was more than eighty years old.
items.zh: 我們數了被砍下的樹幹上的年輪,發現這棵樹已經超過八十歲了。
items.sec: Plant Growth & Reproduction 植物生長與繁殖

items.def: when a plant grows towards light
items.s: The plant on my windowsill leans towards the glass because of ________, so I turn the pot around every few days.
items.zh: 我窗台上的植物因為向光性而朝玻璃傾斜,所以我每隔幾天就把花盆轉個方向。
items.sec: Plant Growth & Reproduction 植物生長與繁殖

items.def: a young tree
items.s: Every student planted a ________ on Arbor Day, and the school hopes they will become a small forest in twenty years.
items.zh: 植樹節時每個學生都種了一棵小樹,學校希望二十年後它們能成為一片小森林。
items.sec: Plant Growth & Reproduction 植物生長與繁殖

items.def: a plant that produces flowers and seeds
items.s: Most ______ ______ need insects to carry their pollen, so a drop in bee numbers is a serious problem.
items.zh: 大多數開花植物需要昆蟲傳播花粉,所以蜜蜂數量下降是一個嚴重的問題。
items.sec: Plant Growth & Reproduction 植物生長與繁殖

items.def: to fertilise itself with its own pollen
items.s: Some plants, like peas, can ________, so they still produce seeds even when there are no insects around.
items.zh: 有些植物,例如豌豆,能夠自花授粉,所以即使周圍沒有昆蟲,它們仍能結出種子。
items.sec: Plant Growth & Reproduction 植物生長與繁殖

items.def: a flower that grows naturally, not planted by people
items.s: The roadside is full of yellow ________ in spring, and many hikers stop to take photos of them.
items.zh: 春天時路邊開滿了黃色的野花,許多登山客停下來為它們拍照。
items.sec: Plant Growth & Reproduction 植物生長與繁殖

items.def: a large tree with hard wood that produces acorns
items.s: The old ________ in the village square is more than three hundred years old, so the town council has made it a protected tree.
items.zh: 村子廣場上那棵老橡樹已經三百多歲了,所以鎮議會把它列為受保護的樹木。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: an evergreen tree with needle-shaped leaves
items.s: The air in the mountains smells fresh because of the ________ trees, and many people go there to relax at weekends.
items.zh: 山上的空氣因為松樹而聞起來很清新,許多人週末會去那裡放鬆。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: a tree whose leaves turn red in autumn
items.s: In November the ________ trees in Hsinchu turn bright red, so the forest park is full of photographers.
items.zh: 十一月時新竹的楓樹會變成鮮紅色,所以森林公園裡擠滿了攝影師。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: a tree with thin white bark
items.s: The ________ trees have white bark that looks like paper, and in the past people even wrote messages on it.
items.zh: 樺樹的樹皮是白色的,看起來像紙,過去人們甚至在上面寫信息。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: a tree with long thin branches that often grows near water
items.s: A beautiful ________ grows beside the pond, and its long branches hang down so low that they touch the water.
items.zh: 池塘邊長著一棵美麗的柳樹,它長長的枝條垂得很低,甚至碰到水面。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: a tall tree once common in Europe
items.s: Millions of ________ trees died in Britain in the 1970s, but scientists are now planting new trees that can resist the disease.
items.zh: 1970年代英國有數百萬棵榆樹死亡,但科學家現在正在種植能抵抗這種疾病的新樹。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: a large evergreen tree with sweet-smelling wood
items.s: Taiwan's mountain forests are famous for their giant red ________ trees, and some of them are over two thousand years old.
items.zh: 台灣的山林以巨大的紅檜聞名,其中有些已經超過兩千歲了。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: a tall dark evergreen tree
items.s: The temple is surrounded by tall ________ trees, so the courtyard stays shady and quiet even in summer.
items.zh: 寺廟被高大的柏樹環繞,所以即使在夏天庭院依然陰涼又安靜。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: a very tall tree that grows in California
items.s: The tallest ________ in California is over one hundred metres high, but its exact location is kept secret to protect it.
items.zh: 加州最高的紅杉超過一百公尺高,但它的確切位置被保密以保護它。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: a tall Australian tree with oily, strong-smelling leaves
items.s: Koalas eat only ________ leaves, so they cannot survive when bushfires destroy large areas of forest.
items.zh: 無尾熊只吃尤加利樹的葉子,所以當森林大火燒毀大片森林時,牠們就無法生存。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: an evergreen tree with short needles, often used as a Christmas tree
items.s: Many families buy a small ________ as a Christmas tree, and after the holiday some cities collect the trees to make mulch.
items.zh: 許多家庭買一棵小雲杉當聖誕樹,節日過後有些城市會回收這些樹來做覆蓋物。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: a straight evergreen tree with flat needles
items.s: High on Hehuanshan, the hillsides are covered with ________ trees, and in winter their branches are often white with snow.
items.zh: 在合歡山高處,山坡上覆蓋著冷杉,冬天時它們的枝條常常被雪染白。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: a large tree with smooth grey bark
items.s: Taiwan ________ trees grow only on a few high mountains, and their leaves turn golden for just a few weeks each autumn.
items.zh: 台灣山毛櫸只生長在少數幾座高山上,它們的葉子每年秋天只會變成金黃色短短幾週。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: a tall tree with large leaves at the top and no branches
items.s: The beach is lined with ______ ______, so tourists can sit in the shade while they watch the waves.
items.zh: 海灘上種滿了一排排棕櫚樹,所以遊客可以坐在樹蔭下看海浪。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: having cones and needle-shaped leaves
items.s: Northern Canada is covered by ________ forests, and these trees stay green even when the temperature falls far below zero.
items.zh: 加拿大北部覆蓋著針葉林,即使氣溫降到遠低於零度,這些樹依然保持翠綠。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: having wide flat leaves, not needles
items.s: The lower slopes of the mountain have ________ trees, but higher up the forest changes to pine and fir.
items.zh: 山的較低坡面是闊葉樹,但往高處森林就變成松樹和冷杉。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: strong heavy wood from trees like oak
items.s: The new dining table is made of ________, so it was expensive, but it will probably last for fifty years.
items.zh: 新的餐桌是用硬木做的,所以很貴,但它大概可以用五十年。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: lighter wood from trees like pine
items.s: Most houses in North America are built with ________ because it grows quickly and is easy to cut.
items.zh: 北美大多數房屋是用軟木建造的,因為它長得快又容易切割。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: the huge cold forest in the far north of the world
items.s: The ______ ______ stretches across Russia and Canada, and it stores a huge amount of carbon in its soil.
items.zh: 北方針葉林橫跨俄羅斯和加拿大,它的土壤中儲存了大量的碳。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: another name for the cold northern forest
items.s: Few people live in the Siberian ________, but it is home to bears, wolves and the rare Siberian tiger.
items.zh: 很少人住在西伯利亞的針葉林帶,但那裡是熊、狼和稀有的西伯利亞虎的家。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: a wet mountain forest often covered in cloud
items.s: We hiked through a misty ______ ______, and the trees were covered with moss because the air was always wet.
items.zh: 我們徒步穿越一片霧氣瀰漫的雲霧林,樹上長滿了苔蘚,因為空氣總是很潮濕。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: a forest in a region with warm summers and cool winters
items.s: A ______ ______ has four clear seasons, so visitors can enjoy green leaves in summer and bright colours in autumn.
items.zh: 溫帶森林有分明的四季,所以遊客夏天能欣賞綠葉,秋天能欣賞鮮豔的色彩。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: a very old forest that has never been cut down
items.s: Only a small area of ______ ______ remains in the valley, so environmental groups are fighting to stop any new logging.
items.zh: 山谷中只剩下一小片原始林,所以環保團體正在努力阻止任何新的伐木。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: land covered with trees, smaller than a forest
items.s: There is a small ________ behind our school, and students often go there to study insects and birds.
items.zh: 我們學校後面有一片小林地,學生們常去那裡觀察昆蟲和鳥類。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: a small group of trees
items.s: The farmer planted an orange ________ on the hillside, and now he sells the fruit at the local market.
items.zh: 農夫在山坡上種了一片柑橘小樹林,現在他在當地市場賣這些水果。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: the ground in a forest
items.s: Very little sunlight reaches the ______ ______, so only plants that like shade can grow there.
items.zh: 很少陽光能照到森林地面,所以只有喜歡陰涼的植物能在那裡生長。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: the layer of small trees and plants under the tallest trees
items.s: The ________ of the rainforest is dark and damp, but it is full of insects, frogs and young trees.
items.zh: 雨林的林下層陰暗潮濕,但充滿了昆蟲、青蛙和幼樹。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: dead leaves lying on the ground
items.s: The ______ ______ on the ground slowly breaks down, and it gives food to the soil and the creatures living in it.
items.zh: 地上的落葉層慢慢分解,為土壤和住在其中的生物提供養分。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: an open area in a forest with no trees
items.s: We found a sunny ________ in the middle of the forest, so we stopped there to eat our lunch.
items.zh: 我們在森林中間找到一塊陽光充足的林間空地,所以就在那裡停下來吃午餐。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: the height on a mountain above which trees cannot grow
items.s: Above the ________, the wind is too strong and cold for trees, so only grass and small bushes can survive.
items.zh: 在林木線以上,風太強又太冷,樹木無法生長,所以只有草和小灌木能存活。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: a thick tropical forest
items.s: The explorers walked through the ________ for three days, and they had to cut a path with large knives.
items.zh: 探險家們在叢林裡走了三天,他們必須用大刀開出一條路。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: a small bush with several woody stems
items.s: The city planted low ________ along the road, because they reduce noise and do not block the drivers' view.
items.zh: 市政府沿著道路種植矮灌木,因為它們能減少噪音,也不會擋住駕駛的視線。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: a row of bushes growing close together
items.s: There is a tall ________ between our garden and the road, so passers-by cannot see into our house.
items.zh: 我們的花園和馬路之間有一道高高的樹籬,所以路人看不到我們家裡。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: a very small soft green plant that grows on wet surfaces
items.s: The stones on the mountain path were covered with green ________, so they were very slippery after the rain.
items.zh: 山路上的石頭覆蓋著綠色的苔蘚,所以雨後非常滑。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: a plant-like growth on rocks and trees, made of fungus and algae
items.s: Scientists study the ________ on trees because it cannot grow where the air is dirty, so it shows how clean the air is.
items.zh: 科學家研究樹上的地衣,因為它無法在空氣污濁的地方生長,所以它能顯示空氣有多乾淨。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: a fungus with a stem and a round top
items.s: We saw many ________ growing on a fallen log, but our guide warned us that some of them were poisonous.
items.zh: 我們看到一根倒下的木頭上長了許多菇類,但嚮導警告我們其中有些是有毒的。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: a plant that climbs up walls or trees
items.s: Green ________ covered the walls of the old house, and in summer they kept the rooms cool.
items.zh: 綠色的藤蔓爬滿了老房子的牆壁,夏天時它們讓房間保持涼爽。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: a climbing evergreen plant with dark shiny leaves
items.s: The library building is covered in ________, and students say it looks like a university in an old film.
items.zh: 圖書館大樓爬滿了常春藤,學生們說它看起來就像老電影裡的大學。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: a green plant with feathery leaves and no flowers
items.s: Tree ________ grow along the stream in Wulai, and some of them are taller than a two-storey house.
items.zh: 烏來的溪邊長著筆筒樹等樹蕨,其中有些比兩層樓的房子還高。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: a plant with beautiful and unusual flowers
items.s: Taiwan exports millions of ________ every year, and they are very popular gifts during Chinese New Year.
items.zh: 台灣每年出口數百萬株蘭花,它們是農曆新年期間非常受歡迎的禮物。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: a desert plant with thick stems and sharp spines
items.s: A ________ can store water in its thick stem, so it can survive for months without rain.
items.zh: 仙人掌能把水儲存在厚厚的莖裡,所以它可以好幾個月不下雨也能存活。
items.sec: Trees & Forest Types 樹木與森林類型

items.def: the science and work of looking after forests
items.s: My uncle has worked in ________ for thirty years, and his job is to decide which trees can be cut and which must be protected.
items.zh: 我叔叔從事林業三十年了,他的工作是決定哪些樹可以砍、哪些必須保護。
items.sec: Forest Ecology & Management 森林生態與經營

items.def: a person whose job is to look after a forest
items.s: The ________ checks the trees every month, and he reports any signs of disease to the forestry office.
items.zh: 林務員每個月檢查樹木,並把任何生病的跡象回報給林務局。
items.sec: Forest Ecology & Management 森林生態與經營

items.def: a factory where logs are cut into boards
items.s: The logs are taken by truck to the ________, and there they are cut into boards for building houses.
items.zh: 原木由卡車載到鋸木廠,在那裡被鋸成蓋房子用的木板。
items.sec: Forest Ecology & Management 森林生態與經營

items.def: wood that has been cut into boards
items.s: The price of ________ rose sharply last year, so many families decided to delay building their new homes.
items.zh: 去年木材價格急劇上漲,所以許多家庭決定延後建造新家。
items.sec: Forest Ecology & Management 森林生態與經營

items.def: cutting down all the trees in an area at once
items.s: ________ is cheap for timber companies, but it leaves the hillside bare, so heavy rain can wash the soil away.
items.zh: 皆伐對木材公司來說很便宜,但它讓山坡光禿禿的,所以大雨可能把土壤沖走。
items.sec: Forest Ecology & Management 森林生態與經營

items.def: cutting down only some chosen trees in a forest
items.s: With ______ ______, workers remove only certain trees, so the forest can recover much more quickly.
items.zh: 採用擇伐時,工人只移除特定的樹,所以森林能恢復得快得多。
items.sec: Forest Ecology & Management 森林生態與經營

items.def: planting trees on land that had no forest before
items.s: The government started an ________ project on the dry hills, and after ten years the area is green again.
items.zh: 政府在乾旱的山丘上開始了一項造林計畫,十年後這個地區又變綠了。
items.sec: Forest Ecology & Management 森林生態與經營

items.def: the activity of putting young trees into the ground
items.s: The company organised a ______ ______ day for its staff, and they planted five hundred trees along the river.
items.zh: 公司為員工舉辦了一天的植樹活動,他們沿著河岸種了五百棵樹。
items.sec: Forest Ecology & Management 森林生態與經營

items.def: a strip of cleared land that stops a fire from spreading
items.s: The workers cut a wide ________ through the forest, so the fire could not reach the village on the other side.
items.zh: 工人在森林中開出一條寬闊的防火線,所以大火無法蔓延到另一邊的村莊。
items.sec: Forest Ecology & Management 森林生態與經營

items.def: a small fire started on purpose to remove dry plants
items.s: Firefighters carried out a ______ ______ in spring, because removing dry grass early helps prevent huge fires in summer.
items.zh: 消防員在春天進行了計畫性燃燒,因為提早清除乾草有助於預防夏天發生大火。
items.sec: Forest Ecology & Management 森林生態與經營

items.def: a fire that burns a large area of forest
items.s: A careless camper caused a ______ ______ last summer, and it burned for five days before firefighters could stop it.
items.zh: 去年夏天一名粗心的露營者引發了一場森林火災,燒了五天消防員才撲滅。
items.sec: Forest Ecology & Management 森林生態與經營

items.def: a large fire in wild land, especially in Australia
items.s: The ________ spread quickly because of the strong wind, so thousands of people had to leave their homes.
items.zh: 叢林大火因為強風而迅速蔓延,所以數千人必須離開家園。
items.sec: Forest Ecology & Management 森林生態與經營

items.def: a small piece of burning wood from a fire
items.s: The wind carried burning ________ over the river, and they started new fires on the other side.
items.zh: 風把燃燒的火星吹過河,在對岸引發了新的火災。
items.sec: Forest Ecology & Management 森林生態與經營

items.def: dead trees and branches in a forest
items.s: Some people think ________ should be removed, but it actually provides homes for insects, birds and fungi.
items.zh: 有些人認為枯木應該被清除,但它其實為昆蟲、鳥類和真菌提供了棲身之所。
items.sec: Forest Ecology & Management 森林生態與經營

items.def: a living thing that breaks down dead plants and animals
items.s: Fungi and worms are important ________, because they turn dead leaves into food for new plants.
items.zh: 真菌和蚯蚓是重要的分解者,因為它們把枯葉轉化為新植物的養分。
items.sec: Forest Ecology & Management 森林生態與經營

items.def: dark rich soil made from dead leaves and plants
items.s: The soil in the old forest is full of ________, so it is dark, soft and very good for growing plants.
items.zh: 老森林的土壤富含腐植質,所以它又黑又軟,非常適合種植物。
items.sec: Forest Ecology & Management 森林生態與經營

items.def: the way nutrients move between soil, plants and animals
items.s: When leaves fall and rot, the ______ ______ continues, and their minerals return to the soil for other plants to use.
items.zh: 當葉子落下並腐爛時,養分循環便持續進行,其中的礦物質回到土壤供其他植物使用。
items.sec: Forest Ecology & Management 森林生態與經營

items.def: storing carbon from the air in plants, soil or rocks
items.s: Forests play a big role in ______ ______, so cutting them down makes climate change worse.
items.zh: 森林在碳封存中扮演重要角色,所以砍伐森林會讓氣候變遷更嚴重。
items.sec: Forest Ecology & Management 森林生態與經營

items.def: underground fungi that connect the roots of trees
items.s: Scientists have found that trees share sugar through a ______ ______ under the ground, so older trees can help young ones.
items.zh: 科學家發現樹木透過地下的菌根網絡分享糖分,所以老樹能幫助小樹。
items.sec: Forest Ecology & Management 森林生態與經營

items.def: an opening in the top layer of a forest
items.s: When an old tree falls, it leaves a ______ ______, and sunlight reaches the ground so young trees can grow.
items.zh: 當一棵老樹倒下時,會留下一個林冠孔隙,陽光照到地面,小樹便能生長。
items.sec: Forest Ecology & Management 森林生態與經營

items.def: the slow change in plants and animals in a place over time
items.s: After the volcano erupted, scientists watched ______ ______ as grass, then bushes and finally trees covered the land.
items.zh: 火山爆發後,科學家觀察到生態演替的過程,先是草,再來是灌木,最後是樹木覆蓋了這片土地。
items.sec: Forest Ecology & Management 森林生態與經營

items.def: the first plants to grow on empty or damaged land
items.s: Mosses and grasses are often ______ ______, because they can grow on bare rock and slowly create soil.
items.zh: 苔蘚和草通常是先驅物種,因為它們能在裸露的岩石上生長,並慢慢形成土壤。
items.sec: Forest Ecology & Management 森林生態與經營

items.def: the area of land covered by trees
items.s: Satellite photos show that ______ ______ in the region has dropped by twenty percent, so experts are worried about floods.
items.zh: 衛星照片顯示該地區的樹木覆蓋下降了百分之二十,所以專家擔心會發生洪水。
items.sec: Forest Ecology & Management 森林生態與經營

items.def: growing trees and crops together on the same farm
items.s: Coffee farmers in the mountains use ________, so their coffee plants grow under tall trees that give shade and protect the soil.
items.zh: 山區的咖啡農採用農林混作,所以他們的咖啡樹長在提供遮蔭、保護土壤的高大樹木下。
items.sec: Forest Ecology & Management 森林生態與經營

items.def: a bird that makes holes in trees with its beak
items.s: We heard a loud knocking sound in the forest, and our guide said it was a ________ looking for insects in the bark.
items.zh: 我們在森林裡聽到很大的敲擊聲,嚮導說那是一隻啄木鳥在樹皮裡找昆蟲。
items.sec: Forest Ecology & Management 森林生態與經營

items.def: a small animal with a bushy tail that lives in trees
items.s: A ________ ran down the tree and took the bread from my hand, so I was surprised by how brave it was.
items.zh: 一隻松鼠從樹上跑下來拿走我手中的麵包,所以我很驚訝牠竟然這麼大膽。
items.sec: Forest Ecology & Management 森林生態與經營

items.def: a bird with large eyes that hunts at night
items.s: An ________ lives in the old tree behind the temple, and you can hear it calling after dark.
items.zh: 一隻貓頭鷹住在寺廟後面的老樹上,天黑後你可以聽到牠的叫聲。
items.sec: Forest Ecology & Management 森林生態與經營

items.def: a large animal with long legs; the males have antlers
items.s: Too many ________ live in the forest now, so they eat most of the young trees before they can grow tall.
items.zh: 現在森林裡住了太多鹿,所以牠們在小樹長高之前就把大部分小樹吃掉了。
items.sec: Forest Ecology & Management 森林生態與經營

items.def: a small insect that lives under tree bark and can kill trees
items.s: Warmer winters have helped the ______ ______ spread, and millions of pine trees in North America have died.
items.zh: 較溫暖的冬天幫助了樹皮甲蟲的擴散,北美有數百萬棵松樹因此死亡。
items.sec: Forest Ecology & Management 森林生態與經營

items.def: wood that is cut and burned for heat or cooking
items.s: In some poor villages, families still collect ________ every day, so the nearby forests are slowly disappearing.
items.zh: 在一些貧窮的村莊,家家戶戶仍每天撿拾柴火,所以附近的森林正在慢慢消失。
items.sec: Forest Ecology & Management 森林生態與經營

items.def: soft wet wood fibres used to make paper
items.s: Most paper is made from ______ ______, so recycling paper means fewer trees need to be cut down.
items.zh: 大多數紙是用木漿做的,所以回收紙張意味著需要砍伐的樹木變少。
items.sec: Forest Ecology & Management 森林生態與經營

items.def: a sticky substance made by some trees
items.s: Pine trees produce sticky ________ when they are cut, and this protects the wound from insects and disease.
items.zh: 松樹被割傷時會分泌黏稠的樹脂,這能保護傷口免受昆蟲和疾病侵害。
items.sec: Forest Ecology & Management 森林生態與經營

items.def: light bark from a special oak tree
items.s: Wine bottles are often closed with ________, and the bark is taken from the trees without killing them.
items.zh: 酒瓶常用軟木塞封口,而且樹皮是在不殺死樹的情況下取下的。
items.sec: Forest Ecology & Management 森林生態與經營

items.def: soft wet land with grass and reeds
items.s: Many birds stop at the ________ near the river mouth in winter, because it gives them food and a safe place to rest.
items.zh: 冬天時許多鳥會停留在河口附近的沼澤,因為那裡提供牠們食物和安全的休息處。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: wet land with trees, often covered with water
items.s: Alligators live in the ________, so visitors must stay on the wooden path and never put their hands in the water.
items.zh: 鱷魚住在沼澤裡,所以遊客必須待在木棧道上,絕對不能把手伸進水裡。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: soft wet ground made of dead plants
items.s: The hikers walked into a ________ by mistake, and their boots sank deep into the wet ground.
items.zh: 登山客不小心走進了泥炭沼,他們的靴子深深陷進濕軟的地面。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: low wet land fed by groundwater
items.s: Farmers once drained the ________ to grow crops, but now some of the land is being returned to nature.
items.zh: 農夫曾經把低地沼澤的水排乾來種植作物,但現在部分土地正被歸還給自然。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: dark soil made of dead plants that stores carbon
items.s: In the past people burned ________ for heat, but now we know it stores huge amounts of carbon.
items.zh: 過去人們燃燒泥炭取暖,但現在我們知道它儲存了大量的碳。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: an area of land covered with peat
items.s: Damaged ________ can release carbon into the air, so countries are now trying to make them wet again.
items.zh: 受損的泥炭地會把碳釋放到空氣中,所以各國現在正努力讓它們重新變濕。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: a tall grass that grows in or near water
items.s: Tall ________ grow along the edge of the lake, and small birds build their nests among them.
items.zh: 高高的蘆葦沿著湖邊生長,小鳥在其中築巢。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: an area of water full of reeds
items.s: The town built a ______ ______ to clean its waste water, so the river is now much cleaner than before.
items.zh: 鎮上建造了一片蘆葦床來淨化廢水,所以現在河水比以前乾淨得多。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: a plant with large flat leaves that float on water
items.s: A frog was sitting on a ______ ______ in the pond, and it jumped into the water when we came closer.
items.zh: 一隻青蛙坐在池塘裡的睡蓮葉上,我們走近時牠就跳進水裡。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: a water plant with large pink or white flowers
items.s: Every summer the ________ pond in Baihe is full of pink flowers, and many families visit to take photos.
items.zh: 每年夏天白河的蓮花池開滿粉紅色的花,許多家庭前去拍照。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: a tiny green plant that floats on still water
items.s: The pond was covered in ________, so it looked like a green carpet, but the fish underneath had less light.
items.zh: 池塘被浮萍覆蓋,看起來像一張綠色的地毯,但下面的魚得到的光線變少了。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: the land along the side of a river
items.s: We had a picnic on the ________, and the children watched the ducks swimming past.
items.zh: 我們在河岸上野餐,孩子們看著鴨子游過。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: a small narrow river
items.s: A clear ________ runs through the valley, and the villagers use its water for their tea gardens.
items.zh: 一條清澈的小溪流過山谷,村民用它的水灌溉茶園。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: a small river or stream
items.s: The children like to catch small fish in the ________ behind their grandparents' farm, but they always put them back.
items.zh: 孩子們喜歡在祖父母農場後面的小溪抓小魚,但他們總是把魚放回去。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: a small area of still water
items.s: The school dug a small ________ in the garden, and soon frogs and dragonflies came to live there.
items.zh: 學校在花園裡挖了一個小池塘,很快青蛙和蜻蜓就來這裡定居了。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: flat muddy land covered by the sea at high tide
items.s: When the tide goes out, the ________ appear, and crabs come out to feed on the wet mud.
items.zh: 退潮時泥灘便露出來,螃蟹會出來在濕泥上覓食。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: birds such as ducks and geese that live on water
items.s: Thousands of ________ spend the winter at the wetland, so birdwatchers come from all over the country.
items.zh: 數千隻水禽在這片濕地過冬,所以賞鳥人士從全國各地前來。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: a tall grey bird with long legs that catches fish
items.s: A grey ________ stood very still in the shallow water, and suddenly it caught a fish with its long beak.
items.zh: 一隻灰色的蒼鷺靜靜地站在淺水中,突然用牠長長的嘴抓到一條魚。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: a white bird with long legs that lives near water
items.s: White ________ often follow farmers in the rice fields, because the tractors disturb insects that the birds can eat.
items.zh: 白鷺常跟著稻田裡的農夫,因為拖拉機會驚擾昆蟲,鳥兒就能吃到牠們。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: a small green animal with long back legs that jumps
items.s: After the heavy rain, hundreds of ________ started calling in the rice fields, so it was hard to fall asleep.
items.zh: 大雨過後,數百隻青蛙在稻田裡鳴叫,所以很難入睡。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: an insect with a long body and four thin wings
items.s: A blue ________ flew over the pond, and my little sister tried to catch it with her net.
items.zh: 一隻藍色的蜻蜓飛過池塘,我妹妹想用網子抓住牠。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: a long thin fish that looks like a snake
items.s: Young ________ swim up the river from the sea, but dams make it difficult for them to reach the upper streams.
items.zh: 幼鰻從海洋游上河流,但水壩讓牠們難以到達上游的溪流。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: a small animal with brown fur that swims and eats fish
items.s: Kinmen is one of the few places where wild ________ still live, so local people are working hard to protect the ponds.
items.zh: 金門是少數仍有野生水獺生存的地方之一,所以當地居民正努力保護池塘。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: an animal with a flat tail that builds dams in rivers
items.s: ________ were brought back to some rivers in Britain, and their dams have helped to reduce flooding in nearby towns.
items.zh: 英國有些河流重新引入了河狸,而牠們築的水壩已幫助減少附近城鎮的洪水。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: a bird with long legs that walks in shallow water
items.s: Many ______ ______ feed on the mudflats, and their long legs keep their bodies dry while they search for food.
items.zh: 許多涉禽在泥灘上覓食,牠們的長腿讓身體在找食物時保持乾燥。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: the process of making water clean
items.s: Wetland plants help with ______ ______, because their roots trap dirt and take in harmful chemicals.
items.zh: 濕地植物有助於水質淨化,因為它們的根會攔住髒污並吸收有害化學物質。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: something in nature that removes dirt from water or air
items.s: A wetland works like a ______ ______, so the water that leaves it is cleaner than the water that enters.
items.zh: 濕地就像一個天然過濾器,所以流出的水比流進的水更乾淨。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: ways of preventing or reducing floods
items.s: Wetlands are useful for ______ ______, because they soak up rainwater like a sponge and release it slowly.
items.zh: 濕地對防洪很有用,因為它們像海綿一樣吸收雨水,再慢慢釋放出來。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: an international agreement to protect important wetlands
items.cn: 拉姆薩公約(國際濕地公約)
items.s: The ______ ______ was signed in 1971, and more than one hundred and seventy countries have now joined it.
items.zh: 拉姆薩公約於1971年簽署,現在已有一百七十多個國家加入。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: making new land from sea or wetland
items.s: Large areas of coastal wetland were lost because of ______ ______, and the new land was used for factories.
items.zh: 大片沿海濕地因為填海造地而消失,新的土地被用來蓋工廠。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: fine sand and mud carried by a river
items.s: The river carries ________ down from the mountains, and it slowly builds up new land at the river mouth.
items.zh: 河流把淤泥從山上帶下來,並在河口慢慢堆積出新的土地。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: wet, soft earth
items.s: The children played in the ________ at the wetland park, so their parents had to wash their clothes twice.
items.zh: 孩子們在濕地公園玩泥巴,所以爸媽得把他們的衣服洗兩次。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: dark and dirty, not clear
items.s: The water in the pond became ________ after the storm, so we could not see the fish any more.
items.zh: 暴風雨後池塘的水變得混濁,所以我們再也看不到魚了。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: slightly salty, a mix of river water and sea water
items.s: Mangroves grow in ________ water near the coast, and they can survive where most other trees would die.
items.zh: 紅樹林生長在海岸附近的鹹淡水中,它們能在大多數其他樹會死亡的地方存活。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: living in or relating to water that is not salty
items.s: Many ________ fish are in danger because rivers are polluted and dams block their way.
items.zh: 許多淡水魚處於危險中,因為河流受到污染,水壩又擋住了牠們的去路。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: the height of the surface of water
items.s: The ______ ______ in the lake dropped during the dry season, so the boats could not reach the old pier.
items.zh: 乾季時湖的水位下降,所以船隻無法到達舊碼頭。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: a path made of wooden boards above wet ground
items.s: Visitors walk along a wooden ________ through the mangroves, so they can see the crabs without damaging the mud.
items.zh: 遊客沿著穿越紅樹林的木棧道行走,所以他們能看到螃蟹而不會破壞泥灘。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: the hobby of watching wild birds
items.s: My father took up ________ after he retired, and now he gets up at five o'clock to visit the wetland.
items.zh: 我爸爸退休後開始賞鳥,現在他早上五點就起床去濕地。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: a device with two lenses for seeing things far away
items.s: I forgot my ________ at home, so I could not see the rare birds on the other side of the lake.
items.zh: 我把雙筒望遠鏡忘在家裡了,所以看不到湖對岸的稀有鳥類。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: a small hut where people watch birds without being seen
items.s: We sat quietly in the ______ ______ for an hour, and finally a group of spoonbills landed in front of us.
items.zh: 我們在賞鳥屋裡安靜地坐了一個小時,終於有一群琵鷺降落在我們面前。
items.sec: Wetlands, Rivers & Bogs 濕地、河流與沼澤

items.def: a deadly tree disease spread by beetles
items.s: ______ ______ ______ killed most of the elm trees in Britain, so the countryside looked very different afterwards.
items.zh: 荷蘭榆樹病害死了英國大部分的榆樹,所以之後鄉間的樣貌大不相同。
items.sec: Plant Threats, Disease & Restoration 植物威脅、病害與復育

items.def: a fungal disease that kills ash trees
items.s: ______ ______ is spreading across Europe, and experts fear that most ash trees could be lost within a few decades.
items.zh: 白蠟樹枯梢病正在歐洲蔓延,專家擔心大部分白蠟樹可能在幾十年內消失。
items.sec: Plant Threats, Disease & Restoration 植物威脅、病害與復育

items.def: caused by or relating to a fungus
items.s: The banana farm was hit by a ________ disease, so the farmer had to destroy hundreds of sick plants.
items.zh: 香蕉園遭受一種真菌疾病侵襲,所以農夫必須銷毀數百株生病的植物。
items.sec: Plant Threats, Disease & Restoration 植物威脅、病害與復育

items.def: a living thing such as a mushroom or mould
items.s: A ________ was growing on the old log, and it slowly turned the hard wood soft and crumbly.
items.zh: 一種真菌在老木頭上生長,慢慢把堅硬的木頭變得鬆軟易碎。
items.sec: Plant Threats, Disease & Restoration 植物威脅、病害與復育

items.def: a living thing that lives on another and takes its food
items.s: Mistletoe is a ________ that grows on trees, and it takes water and food from the branches it lives on.
items.zh: 槲寄生是一種長在樹上的寄生植物,它從所依附的樹枝中吸取水分和養分。
items.sec: Plant Threats, Disease & Restoration 植物威脅、病害與復育

items.def: living on another living thing and taking its food
items.s: The ________ plant wrapped itself around the tree, and after a few years the tree became weak and sick.
items.zh: 那株寄生植物纏繞在樹上,幾年後那棵樹變得虛弱生病。
items.sec: Plant Threats, Disease & Restoration 植物威脅、病害與復育

items.def: a very small insect that sucks juice from plants
items.s: Tiny green ________ covered the roses, so my mother sprayed them with soapy water instead of chemicals.
items.zh: 小小的綠色蚜蟲佈滿了玫瑰,所以我媽媽用肥皂水而不是化學藥劑噴灑它們。
items.sec: Plant Threats, Disease & Restoration 植物威脅、病害與復育

items.def: a young butterfly or moth that looks like a small worm
items.s: A hungry ________ ate holes in all the cabbage leaves, but my grandmother did not mind because it would become a butterfly.
items.zh: 一隻飢餓的毛毛蟲把所有高麗菜葉都咬出洞來,但我奶奶不介意,因為牠會變成蝴蝶。
items.sec: Plant Threats, Disease & Restoration 植物威脅、病害與復育

items.def: an insect that flies in huge groups and eats crops
items.s: A huge cloud of ________ arrived in East Africa, and within hours they had eaten the crops of entire villages.
items.zh: 一大群蝗蟲飛抵東非,幾小時內就吃光了整個村莊的作物。
items.sec: Plant Threats, Disease & Restoration 植物威脅、病害與復育

items.def: a thin white fungus on plants or damp things
items.s: White ________ appeared on the cucumber leaves during the rainy season, so the farmer removed the sick leaves quickly.
items.zh: 雨季時小黃瓜葉上出現了白色的白粉病,所以農夫迅速摘除生病的葉子。
items.sec: Plant Threats, Disease & Restoration 植物威脅、病害與復育

items.def: to slowly break down and go bad
items.s: If you water a cactus too often, its roots will ________, so it is better to let the soil dry out.
items.zh: 如果你太常替仙人掌澆水,它的根會腐爛,所以最好讓土壤乾透。
items.sec: Plant Threats, Disease & Restoration 植物威脅、病害與復育

items.def: a plant or animal brought from another place
items.s: The mile-a-minute vine is an ______ ______ in Taiwan, and it grows so fast that it covers and kills native trees.
items.zh: 小花蔓澤蘭是台灣的外來種,它長得非常快,會覆蓋並殺死原生樹木。
items.sec: Plant Threats, Disease & Restoration 植物威脅、病害與復育

items.def: not originally from the area where it now lives
items.s: Volunteers removed ________ plants from the wetland, so the local plants had more space and light to grow.
items.zh: 志工們清除了濕地中的非原生植物,所以本地植物有更多空間和光線生長。
items.sec: Plant Threats, Disease & Restoration 植物威脅、病害與復育

items.def: cutting and burning forest to clear land for farming
items.s: ________ farming clears land quickly, but the soil loses its nutrients after a few years, so farmers move on.
items.zh: 刀耕火種農業能快速清出土地,但幾年後土壤就會失去養分,所以農民會轉移他處。
items.sec: Plant Threats, Disease & Restoration 植物威脅、病害與復育

items.def: when too many animals eat the plants in an area
items.s: ________ by goats has destroyed the grass on the hills, and now the soil is washed away every time it rains.
items.zh: 山羊的過度放牧破壞了山丘上的草,現在每次下雨土壤都會被沖走。
items.sec: Plant Threats, Disease & Restoration 植物威脅、病害與復育

items.def: rain made harmful by pollution in the air
items.s: Factory smoke caused ______ ______ in the region, and many trees on the mountain lost their leaves and died.
items.zh: 工廠的煙在該地區造成酸雨,山上許多樹都掉光了葉子而死去。
items.sec: Plant Threats, Disease & Restoration 植物威脅、病害與復育

items.def: a place where young trees are grown before planting
items.s: The ______ ______ grows ten thousand young trees every year, and volunteers plant them on the hills in winter.
items.zh: 那個苗圃每年培育一萬棵小樹,志工們在冬天把它們種到山丘上。
items.sec: Plant Threats, Disease & Restoration 植物威脅、病害與復育

items.def: new growth after something has been damaged or cut
items.s: The forest showed signs of ________ only a year after the fire, and green leaves appeared on the burnt trees.
items.zh: 火災後僅一年,森林就出現了重新生長的跡象,燒焦的樹上冒出了綠葉。
items.sec: Plant Threats, Disease & Restoration 植物威脅、病害與復育

items.def: not easily affected by disease
items.s: Scientists developed a ________ type of elm tree, so towns can plant elms again without fear of losing them.
items.zh: 科學家培育出一種抗病的榆樹品種,所以城鎮可以再次種植榆樹而不必擔心失去它們。
items.sec: Plant Threats, Disease & Restoration 植物威脅、病害與復育

items.def: a period when plants or animals are kept apart to stop disease
items.s: Imported plants must stay in ________ for several weeks, so inspectors can make sure they do not carry pests.
items.zh: 進口植物必須檢疫數週,這樣檢查人員才能確定它們沒有帶著害蟲。
items.sec: Plant Threats, Disease & Restoration 植物威脅、病害與復育

items.def: rules and actions that stop harmful pests and diseases entering a place
items.s: Australia has strict ________ rules at its airports, so travellers cannot bring fresh fruit or seeds into the country.
items.zh: 澳洲機場有嚴格的生物安全規定,所以旅客不能把新鮮水果或種子帶入境。
items.sec: Plant Threats, Disease & Restoration 植物威脅、病害與復育

items.def: an area where plants and animals are protected
items.s: The wetland became a ______ ______ in 2010, and since then the number of birds has almost doubled.
items.zh: 這片濕地在2010年成為自然保護區,從那之後鳥類數量幾乎增加了一倍。
items.sec: Plant Threats, Disease & Restoration 植物威脅、病害與復育

items.def: a large area of land protected by the government
items.s: Taroko is a famous ______ ______ in Taiwan, and its forests and gorges attract visitors from all over the world.
items.zh: 太魯閣是台灣著名的國家公園,它的森林和峽谷吸引世界各地的遊客。
items.sec: Plant Threats, Disease & Restoration 植物威脅、病害與復育

items.def: a place where nature is protected by law
items.s: Hunting is not allowed in the ______ ______, so wild animals can live there without being disturbed.
items.zh: 保護區內禁止打獵,所以野生動物可以在那裡生活而不被打擾。
items.sec: Plant Threats, Disease & Restoration 植物威脅、病害與復育

items.def: an expert who cares for trees
items.s: The school called an ________ to check the old banyan tree, because one large branch looked weak and dangerous.
items.zh: 學校請了一位樹藝師來檢查那棵老榕樹,因為有一根大樹枝看起來很脆弱又危險。
items.sec: Plant Threats, Disease & Restoration 植物威脅、病害與復育

items.def: a person who looks after a garden
items.s: The ________ waters the plants early in the morning, because less water is lost in the cool air.
items.zh: 園丁一大早就替植物澆水,因為在涼爽的空氣中水分流失較少。
items.sec: Plant Threats, Disease & Restoration 植物威脅、病害與復育

items.def: a strip of natural land that links two habitats
items.s: The city planted a ______ ______ of trees between two parks, so birds and insects can move safely between them.
items.zh: 市政府在兩座公園之間種植了一條樹木棲地廊道,所以鳥類和昆蟲能在其間安全移動。
items.sec: Plant Threats, Disease & Restoration 植物威脅、病害與復育

items.def: in large amounts; more than enough
items.s: Wild strawberries grow ________ on the hillside in May, so local children often go there with baskets to pick them.
items.zh: 五月時野草莓在山坡上大量地生長,所以當地孩子常提著籃子去那裡採。

items.def: to officially connect a group with a larger organisation
items.s: Our small nature club decided to ________ itself with a national wildlife group, so we can now join their training courses.
items.zh: 我們的小型自然社團決定加入一個全國性的野生動物團體,所以現在我們能參加他們的培訓課程。

items.def: a short note added to explain something
items.s: The professor added an ________ to each photo in the report, so readers could understand which plant they were looking at.
items.zh: 教授在報告的每張照片上加了註解,讓讀者能明白他們看的是哪一種植物。

items.def: how useful or suitable something is in a situation
items.s: The researchers tested the ________ of their method in three different wetlands, and it worked well in all of them.
items.zh: 研究人員在三個不同的濕地測試了他們方法的適用性,結果在三個地方都很有效。

items.def: in a way that is suitable or right
items.s: If the waste water is treated ________, it can be released into the wetland, and the plants will clean it even more.
items.zh: 如果廢水經過適當地處理,就能排放到濕地,植物還會進一步淨化它。

items.def: without a clear reason or plan
items.s: The old park boundaries were drawn ________, so some important forests were left outside the protected area.
items.zh: 舊的公園邊界是任意地劃定的,所以有些重要的森林被排除在保護區之外。

items.def: a group of things or living things found together
items.s: The pond contains a rich ________ of insects, so students use it to practise identifying different species.
items.zh: 這個池塘裡有豐富的昆蟲群集,所以學生用它來練習辨認不同物種。

items.def: a line or border that separates two areas
items.s: There is no clear ________ between the forest and the farmland, so wild boars often wander into the fields.
items.zh: 森林和農地之間沒有清楚的分界,所以野豬常常闖進田裡。

items.def: covering a very large area
items.s: From the top of the hill we had an ________ view of the wetland, and we could see thousands of birds on the water.
items.zh: 從山頂上我們看到廣闊的濕地景色,還能看到水面上成千上萬隻鳥。

items.def: when things depend on each other
items.s: The ________ between bees and flowers is very strong, so if one of them disappears, the other is also in danger.
items.zh: 蜜蜂和花之間的相互依存非常緊密,所以如果其中一方消失,另一方也會陷入危險。

items.def: to be next to and connected with something
items.s: The new housing estate will ________ the nature reserve, so many residents worry about noise and light pollution.
items.zh: 新住宅區將與自然保護區毗連,所以許多居民擔心噪音和光害。

items.def: the act of making a problem worse
items.s: Cutting down trees on the slope led to the ________ of soil loss, and the village road was soon blocked by mud.
items.zh: 砍伐坡地上的樹木導致土壤流失加劇,村莊的道路很快就被泥巴堵住了。

items.def: an increase in size or amount
items.s: The project aims at the ________ of tree numbers in the city, and each district must plant one thousand trees a year.
items.zh: 這個計畫的目標是增加城市中的樹木數量,每個區每年必須種植一千棵樹。

items.def: to grow or develop quickly
items.s: Interest in forest bathing has begun to ________ in Taiwan, and many hiking trails now offer special guided walks.
items.zh: 台灣人對森林浴的興趣開始蓬勃發展,許多步道現在都提供特別的導覽健行。

items.def: most important; basic
items.s: The ________ rule in the nature reserve is to stay on the path, because walking on the plants can kill them.
items.zh: 在自然保護區裡最重要的規則是待在步道上,因為踩踏植物可能會害死它們。

items.def: putting things into groups by type
items.s: The ________ of plants into families helps scientists understand them, but some species are still hard to place.
items.zh: 把植物分類成不同的科有助於科學家了解它們,但有些物種仍然很難歸類。

items.def: to live together in the same place
items.s: Many kinds of birds ________ in the same forest, but each one feeds on different food, so they do not compete much.
items.zh: 許多種鳥在同一片森林裡共同生活,但每一種吃不同的食物,所以牠們不太互相競爭。

items.def: when plants or animals move into and spread in a new area
items.s: The ________ of the burnt land by grasses began only weeks after the fire, and soon the hill was green again.
items.zh: 火災後僅僅幾週,草類就開始拓殖這片燒焦的土地,很快山丘又變綠了。

items.def: one of the separate parts that something is divided into
items.s: The forest is divided into numbered ________, so the rangers know exactly where each problem is.
items.zh: 森林被劃分成編號的區塊,所以管理員能確切知道每個問題在哪裡。

items.def: happening together with something else
items.s: The loss of wetlands and the ________ drop in bird numbers have worried scientists, so they are asking for urgent action.
items.zh: 濕地的消失以及伴隨的鳥類數量下降令科學家擔憂,所以他們呼籲採取緊急行動。

items.def: the process of becoming smaller
items.s: The ________ of the lake during the dry season was alarming, and fishermen said they had never seen it so small.
items.zh: 乾季期間湖泊的縮小令人震驚,漁民說他們從未見過湖這麼小。

items.def: a mix of two different areas or styles
items.s: The course is a ________ between biology and art, so students draw plants while they learn about them.
items.zh: 這門課是生物和藝術的跨界結合,所以學生在學習植物的同時也畫植物。

items.def: able to cure illness
items.s: Many forest plants have ________ properties, and scientists are studying them to develop new medicines.
items.zh: 許多森林植物具有療效,科學家正在研究它們以開發新藥。

items.def: to become worse in quality or condition
items.s: Without regular care, the wetland began to ________, and weeds soon filled the open water.
items.zh: 由於缺乏定期照顧,這片濕地開始退化,雜草很快就填滿了開闊的水面。

items.def: the spreading of something over a wide area
items.s: Scientists studied the ________ of pollution in the river, and they found that it reached the wetland within two days.
items.zh: 科學家研究了河中污染的擴散,發現它在兩天內就到達了濕地。

items.def: working well; producing the result you want
items.s: Planting reeds proved ________ in cleaning the water, so the city decided to use the method in other ponds.
items.zh: 種植蘆葦被證明在淨化水質上很有效,所以市政府決定在其他池塘也採用這個方法。

items.def: to make or become longer
items.s: Plants grown in the dark ________ their stems quickly, but they become weak and pale because they lack light.
items.zh: 在黑暗中生長的植物會迅速伸長它們的莖,但因為缺乏光線而變得虛弱蒼白。

items.def: putting something in danger
items.s: The ________ of rare orchids is caused mainly by illegal collecting, so the police now check flower markets.
items.zh: 稀有蘭花的瀕危狀態主要是非法採集造成的,所以警方現在會檢查花市。

items.def: to twist two or more things together
items.s: The roots of the two trees ________ under the ground, so it is impossible to remove one without hurting the other.
items.zh: 兩棵樹的根在地下纏繞在一起,所以不可能移除其中一棵而不傷到另一棵。

items.def: to cover or surround something completely
items.s: Thick fog often ________ the mountain forest in the morning, so hikers must be careful not to get lost.
items.zh: 早上濃霧常常籠罩著山林,所以登山客必須小心不要迷路。

items.def: the process of cleaning a liquid by passing it through something
items.s: The wetland provides natural ________, and the water that comes out is clean enough for fish to live in.
items.zh: 濕地提供天然的過濾作用,流出的水乾淨到足以讓魚生存。

items.def: not letting water pass through
items.s: Concrete is ________, so rain cannot sink into the ground, and cities flood more easily during storms.
items.zh: 混凝土是不透水的,所以雨水無法滲入地下,城市在暴風雨時更容易淹水。

items.def: impossible to separate
items.s: For the local tribe, the forest and their culture are ________, so losing the trees means losing their traditions.
items.zh: 對當地部落來說,森林和他們的文化是不可分割的,所以失去樹木就意味著失去傳統。

items.def: to connect things with each other
items.s: The new trails ________ the three parks, so cyclists can ride from one to another without using busy roads.
items.zh: 新的步道把三座公園互相連結起來,所以自行車騎士不必走繁忙的道路就能從一座騎到另一座。

items.def: stopping and starting again; not continuously
items.s: It rained ________ all afternoon, so we stopped our survey of the wetland several times and waited under a tree.
items.zh: 整個下午斷斷續續地下著雨,所以我們好幾次停下濕地調查,在樹下等待。

items.def: a flood of water over land
items.s: The yearly ________ of the river plain brings rich mud, so the farmland there is very fertile.
items.zh: 河川平原每年的洪水氾濫帶來肥沃的泥土,所以那裡的農地非常肥沃。

items.def: young; not yet adult
items.s: The mangrove roots protect ________ fish from bigger fish, so the area works like a nursery for the sea.
items.zh: 紅樹林的根保護幼魚免受大魚侵害,所以這個地區就像海洋的育嬰室。

items.def: growing or moving to the side
items.s: The tree sends out ________ roots near the surface, so it stays stable even in shallow soil.
items.zh: 這棵樹在接近地表處長出橫向的根,所以即使在淺薄的土壤中也能保持穩固。

items.def: a large number and variety
items.s: The rainforest has a ________ of plant species, so scientists find new ones on almost every trip.
items.zh: 雨林中植物物種繁多,所以科學家幾乎每次去都會發現新物種。

items.def: using a resource too much so that it runs out
items.s: ________ of the forest for timber left the hills bare, and the government finally banned logging there.
items.zh: 為了木材而過度開發森林,使山丘光禿禿的,政府最後禁止在那裡伐木。

items.def: to spread through every part of something
items.s: The smell of wet earth and leaves seemed to ________ the whole forest after the rain, and it made everyone feel calm.
items.zh: 雨後,濕潤泥土和樹葉的氣味彷彿瀰漫了整座森林,讓每個人都感到平靜。

items.def: having many small holes that let water or air through
items.s: Sandy soil is ________, so water drains away quickly, but clay soil holds water for much longer.
items.zh: 沙質土壤是多孔的,所以水很快就排掉,但黏土則能保水更久。

items.def: when animals kill and eat other animals
items.s: Young birds in the wetland face heavy ________ from snakes and cats, so only a few survive their first year.
items.zh: 濕地裡的幼鳥面臨蛇和貓的大量捕食,所以只有少數能活過第一年。

items.def: to stick out from a surface
items.s: The roots of the old banyan tree ________ from the ground, so people must watch their step on the path.
items.zh: 老榕樹的根從地面突出來,所以人們在步道上必須小心腳步。

items.def: to move back into an area that was empty
items.s: After the factory closed and the river became clean, fish began to ________ the stream, and herons soon followed.
items.zh: 工廠關閉、河水變乾淨後,魚開始重新移入溪流,蒼鷺很快也跟著來了。

items.def: a change to the opposite direction
items.s: The new law led to a ________ of forest loss, and tree cover has been growing slowly for ten years.
items.zh: 新法律使森林流失的趨勢出現逆轉,樹木覆蓋已經緩慢增加了十年。

items.def: the process of sand and mud settling at the bottom of water
items.s: Heavy ________ is filling the reservoir with mud, so it can hold less water every year.
items.zh: 大量的沉積作用正讓水庫充滿泥沙,所以它每年能蓄的水越來越少。

items.def: able to continue without outside help
items.cn: 自給自足的;自我維持的
items.s: The restored wetland is now ________, so the volunteers no longer need to plant reeds or remove weeds.
items.zh: 復育後的濕地現在已能自我維持,所以志工不再需要種蘆葦或除草。

items.def: holding on firmly; not giving up easily
items.s: The weed is very ________, and even if you pull it out, a small piece of root can grow into a new plant.
items.zh: 這種雜草非常頑強,即使你把它拔掉,一小段根也能長成新植株。

items.def: to move a plant and plant it somewhere else
items.s: We had to ________ the young trees before the road was built, so they were moved carefully to the park.
items.zh: 我們必須在道路興建前移植這些小樹,所以它們被小心地移到公園裡。

items.def: not changed or interrupted by people
items.s: The valley has remained ________ for centuries, so it is full of plants that cannot be found anywhere else.
items.zh: 這個山谷幾世紀以來一直未受干擾,所以充滿了在其他地方找不到的植物。

items.def: not controlled or stopped
items.s: If the invasive vine grows ________, it will cover the whole hillside, so volunteers cut it back every month.
items.zh: 如果這種入侵藤蔓不受控制地生長,它會覆蓋整個山坡,所以志工每個月都會修剪它。

items.def: beautiful because it has not been changed by people
items.s: The island still has ________ forests and beaches, but a new hotel project may change that soon.
items.zh: 這座島上仍有未受破壞的森林和海灘,但一個新的飯店計畫可能很快就會改變這一點。

items.def: green and full of plants
items.s: After the rainy season, the ________ hills looked beautiful, and many photographers came to take pictures.
items.zh: 雨季過後,翠綠的山丘看起來非常美麗,許多攝影師前來拍照。

items.def: able to take in liquid easily
items.s: Peat moss is very ________, so it holds water like a sponge and keeps the bog wet all year.
items.zh: 泥炭蘚非常吸水,所以它像海綿一樣保住水分,讓泥炭沼一整年都保持濕潤。

items.def: letting air into soil or water
items.s: Earthworms improve the ________ of the soil, so plant roots can breathe and grow more easily.
items.zh: 蚯蚓能改善土壤的通氣,所以植物的根能呼吸並更容易生長。

items.def: of the surrounding area or environment
items.s: The ________ temperature inside the forest is several degrees lower than in the city, so people go there to escape the heat.
items.zh: 森林內的環境溫度比城市低好幾度,所以人們去那裡避暑。

items.def: the total amount of living material in an area
items.s: Old forests hold a huge ________, so cutting them down releases large amounts of carbon.
items.zh: 老森林擁有龐大的生物量,所以砍伐它們會釋放大量的碳。

items.def: the area from which rain flows into a river or lake
items.s: Protecting the forest in the ________ keeps the reservoir clean, so the city has strict rules about building there.
items.zh: 保護集水區的森林能保持水庫乾淨,所以市政府對在那裡建設有嚴格的規定。

items.def: the distance around something round
items.s: The ________ of the giant tree's trunk is nearly twenty metres, so it is one of the largest in Asia.
items.zh: 這棵巨木樹幹的周長將近二十公尺,所以它是亞洲最大的樹之一。

items.def: able to catch fire and burn easily
items.s: Dry leaves and branches are highly ________, so rangers clear them away before the hot season begins.
items.zh: 乾葉和樹枝極為易燃,所以管理員在炎熱季節開始前會把它們清除。

items.def: keeping something harmful under control
items.s: Quick ________ of the fire saved most of the forest, but several hectares near the road were destroyed.
items.zh: 迅速控制火勢挽救了大部分森林,但靠近道路的幾公頃仍被燒毀。

items.def: easily set on fire
items.s: Eucalyptus leaves contain oil, so they are very ________ and can make bushfires spread faster.
items.zh: 尤加利葉含有油脂,所以它們非常易燃,會讓叢林大火蔓延得更快。

items.def: continuous change
items.s: A wetland is always in ________, because water levels rise and fall with the seasons and the tides.
items.zh: 濕地總是處於不斷變化中,因為水位隨著季節和潮汐起落。

items.def: the quality of being made of many different parts
items.s: The ________ of the landscape, with ponds, grass and trees, is the reason so many animals live there.
items.zh: 這片地景的異質性——有池塘、草地和樹林——正是這麼多動物住在那裡的原因。

items.def: relating to the movement of water on and under the land
items.s: Wetlands play an important ________ role, because they store water in wet years and release it in dry years.
items.zh: 濕地扮演重要的水文角色,因為它們在多雨年份蓄水,在乾旱年份釋放水分。

items.def: the start of burning
items.s: The ________ of the fire was traced to a cigarette, and the smoker was later fined by the police.
items.zh: 這場火災的起火原因被追查到是一根香菸,吸菸者後來被警方罰款。

items.def: not made from living things
items.s: Farmers used too much ________ fertiliser, and the extra chemicals washed into the nearby wetland.
items.zh: 農民使用了過多的無機肥料,多餘的化學物質被沖進附近的濕地。

items.def: the weather conditions in a small area
items.s: The valley has its own ________, so it stays warm and wet even when the rest of the region is dry.
items.zh: 這個山谷有自己的微氣候,所以即使周圍地區乾燥,它仍保持溫暖潮濕。

items.def: letting water pass through
items.s: The new car park uses ________ paving, so rainwater can soak into the ground instead of flooding the street.
items.zh: 新停車場使用可滲透的鋪面,所以雨水能滲入地下,而不是淹沒街道。

items.def: the state of having a lot of something valuable
items.s: Scientists measured the species ________ of the forest, and they counted more than three hundred kinds of trees.
items.zh: 科學家測量了森林的物種豐富度,他們數到三百多種樹。

items.def: the surface or material that a plant or animal lives on
items.s: Orchids do not grow in normal soil, so gardeners use bark as a ________ for their roots.
items.zh: 蘭花不長在一般土壤中,所以園丁用樹皮作為它們根部的基質。

items.def: living on land, not in water
items.s: Most ________ animals in the area depend on the wetland for water, so it is important even for animals that cannot swim.
items.zh: 這個地區大多數陸生動物依賴濕地取水,所以它即使對不會游泳的動物也很重要。

items.def: relating to plant growth without seeds
items.s: Many plants use ________ reproduction, so a small piece of stem can grow into a completely new plant.
items.zh: 許多植物採用營養繁殖,所以一小段莖就能長成一株全新的植物。

items.def: mentioned earlier
items.s: The ________ study showed that city trees reduce heat, so the council plans to plant more along busy streets.
items.zh: 上述的研究顯示城市樹木能降低溫度,所以議會計畫在繁忙街道沿線種更多樹。

items.def: giving a warning
items.s: The loss of the island's forests is a ________ tale, because it shows how quickly a rich environment can be destroyed.
items.zh: 這座島森林的消失是一個警示故事,因為它顯示一個富饒的環境能多快被摧毀。

items.def: the order in which events happened
items.s: Tree rings give a clear ________ of past climate, so scientists can see which years were very dry.
items.zh: 樹木年輪提供了過去氣候的清楚年表,所以科學家能看出哪些年份非常乾旱。

items.def: how easy it is to compare things fairly
items.s: To ensure ________, all teams measured the trees in the same way, and they used the same tools.
items.zh: 為確保可比性,所有團隊都用同樣的方式測量樹木,並使用相同的工具。

items.def: in a careful way that avoids big guesses
items.s: The forest is ________ estimated to hold two million trees, but the real number is probably much higher.
items.zh: 這片森林保守估計有兩百萬棵樹,但實際數量可能高得多。

items.def: able to be controlled
items.s: The fire was still ________ when the firefighters arrived, but strong winds later made it much bigger.
items.zh: 消防員抵達時火勢仍可控制,但強風後來讓火勢擴大許多。

items.def: designed to fix a problem
items.s: The government took ________ action after the river was polluted, and the factory had to clean the water at its own cost.
items.zh: 河川受到污染後政府採取了糾正措施,工廠必須自費清理河水。

items.def: able to be supported with good reasons
items.s: Cutting the sick trees was a ________ decision, because the disease could have spread to the whole forest.
items.zh: 砍掉生病的樹是一個站得住腳的決定,因為疾病可能會蔓延到整片森林。

items.def: a word or feature used to describe something
items.s: "Wet" is too simple a ________ for a wetland, because some wetlands are dry for half of the year.
items.zh: 用「濕」作為濕地的描述詞太過簡單,因為有些濕地一年中有半年是乾的。

items.def: showing a difference between things
items.s: The study found a ________ effect of shade on the two plants, so one grew well while the other almost died.
items.zh: 研究發現遮蔭對兩種植物有不同的影響,所以一種長得很好,另一種卻幾乎死掉。

items.def: a break or gap in something that should be continuous
items.s: The new highway created a ________ in the forest, so animals could no longer move freely from one side to the other.
items.zh: 新的高速公路在森林中造成了中斷,所以動物無法再自由地從一邊移動到另一邊。

items.def: not connected; broken into parts
items.s: The remaining forest is ________, and the small patches are too far apart for many animals to travel between.
items.zh: 剩下的森林支離破碎,小區塊之間距離太遠,許多動物無法往返。

items.def: not necessary; can be done without
items.s: Some people think wetlands are ________, but they actually protect cities from floods and clean the water.
items.zh: 有些人認為濕地是可有可無的,但它們其實能保護城市免於淹水並淨化水質。

items.def: not the same; different
items.s: The two forests look ________, but they grow from the same kind of soil and receive the same rainfall.
items.zh: 這兩片森林看起來不相似,但它們生長在同類土壤上,也接受同樣的雨量。

items.def: basic and powerful, like the forces of nature
items.s: Hikers can feel the ________ power of nature in the storm, so the guides always check the weather first.
items.zh: 登山客能在暴風雨中感受到大自然原始的力量,所以嚮導總是先查看天氣。

items.def: very; extremely (used for good qualities)
items.s: The site is ________ suitable for a wetland park, because it is flat, wet and close to the city.
items.zh: 這個地點非常適合建濕地公園,因為它地勢平坦、潮濕又靠近城市。

items.def: able to be proved wrong by testing
items.s: A good scientific idea must be ________, so the researchers designed an experiment that could show they were wrong.
items.zh: 一個好的科學想法必須是可證偽的,所以研究人員設計了一個可能證明他們錯了的實驗。

items.def: in a way that is possible
items.s: The forest could ________ be restored within twenty years, but it will need money and many volunteers.
items.zh: 這片森林可行地能在二十年內恢復,但需要資金和許多志工。

items.def: very small; only a small part
items.s: The new rule caused only a ________ increase in costs, but it protected thousands of trees.
items.zh: 新規定只造成極小的成本增加,但卻保護了數千棵樹。

items.def: a slow change from one thing to another in stages
items.s: There is a clear ________ of plants up the mountain, and the forest changes from tropical to cold types.
items.zh: 沿著山往上植物有明顯的漸變,森林從熱帶型轉變為寒帶型。

items.def: arranged in levels from high to low
items.s: Plant names follow a ________ system, so each species belongs to a genus, and each genus belongs to a family.
items.zh: 植物命名遵循階層式的系統,所以每個物種屬於一個屬,而每個屬又屬於一個科。

items.def: not important or relevant
items.s: Whether the tree is beautiful is ________, because the law protects it for its age and rarity.
items.zh: 這棵樹是否美麗無關緊要,因為法律是基於它的樹齡和稀有性而保護它。

items.def: used to add extra information
items.s: The study was about birds, but ________ it also found several rare plants, so a second project was started.
items.zh: 這項研究是關於鳥類的,但順帶一提,它也發現了幾種稀有植物,所以又開始了第二個計畫。

items.def: not exactly known or fixed
items.s: The age of the tree is ________, but experts think it is at least one thousand years old.
items.zh: 這棵樹的年齡不確定,但專家認為它至少有一千歲。

items.def: impossible to separate
items.s: The link between forests and clean water is ________, so protecting trees also protects our drinking water.
items.zh: 森林和乾淨水源之間的關聯密不可分,所以保護樹木也就保護了我們的飲用水。

items.def: something that slows down or stops a process
items.s: Some trees release a natural ________ from their roots, so other plants cannot grow close to them.
items.zh: 有些樹會從根部釋放一種天然的抑制物,所以其他植物無法在它們附近生長。

items.def: happening or lying between two times or places
items.s: In the ________ years, the farmland slowly turned back into forest, so the old village is now hidden by trees.
items.zh: 在這期間的幾年裡,農地慢慢恢復成森林,所以舊村莊現在被樹木遮蔽了。

items.def: to become or make longer
items.s: Warmer weather has begun to ________ the growing season, so some plants now flower two weeks earlier.
items.zh: 較溫暖的天氣開始延長生長季,所以有些植物現在提早兩週開花。

items.def: limited to a small area
items.s: The disease is still ________, but experts fear it could spread across the country if nothing is done.
items.zh: 這種疾病目前仍是局部的,但專家擔心如果不採取行動,它可能會擴散到全國。

items.def: relating to the planning of moving people and supplies
items.s: Planting trees on the island was a ________ challenge, because every sapling had to be carried there by boat.
items.zh: 在島上種樹是一項後勤挑戰,因為每一棵小樹都必須用船運過去。

items.def: by a small amount; not very much
items.s: Bird numbers have increased ________ since the wetland was restored, but they are still lower than in the 1980s.
items.zh: 濕地復育後鳥類數量小幅增加,但仍低於1980年代。

items.def: lasting for a very short time
items.s: There was a ________ silence in the forest, and then all the birds started singing again.
items.zh: 森林裡出現了短暫的寂靜,接著所有的鳥又開始歌唱。

items.def: partly covering the same area
items.s: The two species have ________ ranges, so in some valleys you can find both of them on the same hill.
items.zh: 這兩個物種的分布範圍部分重疊,所以在某些山谷裡,你可以在同一座山上找到牠們兩者。

items.def: able to be noticed
items.s: There was a ________ change in the water quality after the reeds were planted, and the river no longer smelled bad.
items.zh: 種植蘆葦後,水質有了可察覺的改變,河流也不再發出臭味。

items.def: the quality of being relevant
items.s: The teacher questioned the ________ of the photo in my report, because it showed a desert, not a wetland.
items.zh: 老師質疑我報告中那張照片的相關性,因為它拍的是沙漠,而不是濕地。

items.def: the state of being most important
items.s: The new plan gives ________ to protecting water sources, so no factories can be built near the river.
items.zh: 新計畫把保護水源放在首要地位,所以河邊不能興建任何工廠。

items.def: so much that people cannot afford it
items.s: Restoring the old mine site was ________ expensive, so the town turned it into a simple grassland instead.
items.zh: 復育舊礦區的費用高得令人卻步,所以鎮上改把它變成簡單的草地。

items.def: to change something slightly again to suit new conditions
items.s: Plants must ________ to the shorter days in autumn, so they slow their growth and prepare for winter.
items.zh: 植物必須重新調整以適應秋天較短的白晝,所以它們放慢生長並為冬天做準備。

items.def: relating to the connections between things
items.s: The study takes a ________ approach, so it looks at how plants, insects and birds affect one another.
items.zh: 這項研究採取關係取向,所以它探討植物、昆蟲和鳥類如何相互影響。

items.def: looking back at past events
items.s: A ________ study of old photos showed that the forest was twice as large in 1950, and this shocked many people.
items.zh: 一項對舊照片的回顧性研究顯示,1950年時森林的面積是現在的兩倍,這讓許多人震驚。

items.def: able to be made larger easily
items.s: The tree-planting method is ________, so it can be used for a school garden or a whole mountain.
items.zh: 這種植樹方法是可擴展的,所以既能用在學校花園,也能用在整座山。

items.def: the quality of being strong and firm
items.s: The ________ of the old wooden bridge surprised the engineers, because it had stood in the wet forest for a century.
items.zh: 那座舊木橋的堅固讓工程師感到驚訝,因為它已經在潮濕的森林中屹立了一個世紀。

items.def: being exact and detailed
items.s: The guidebook lacks ________, so it is hard to know exactly where each rare plant can be found.
items.zh: 這本導覽手冊缺乏明確性,所以很難確切知道每種稀有植物可以在哪裡找到。

items.def: in the way something is built or organised
items.s: The old tree is ________ weak, so the arborist recommended adding metal supports to its branches.
items.zh: 這棵老樹在結構上很脆弱,所以樹藝師建議在它的枝幹上加裝金屬支架。

items.def: one after another in order
items.s: Grass, bushes and trees ________ covered the abandoned field, and after forty years it looked like a forest.
items.zh: 草、灌木和樹木相繼地覆蓋了這片廢棄的田地,四十年後它看起來就像一片森林。

items.def: not changed
items.s: The landscape has remained ________ for hundreds of years, so visitors can see what the area looked like long ago.
items.zh: 這片地景數百年來未曾改變,所以遊客可以看到這個地區很久以前的樣貌。

items.def: in a way that cannot be doubted
items.s: The forest is ________ beautiful, but it is also fragile, so visitors must follow the rules.
items.zh: 這片森林無可否認地很美,但它也很脆弱,所以遊客必須遵守規定。

items.def: not in a regular or equal way
items.s: Rain falls ________ across the island, so the east coast has thick forests while the west is drier.
items.zh: 雨水在島上分布不均勻,所以東岸有茂密的森林,而西部比較乾燥。

items.def: necessary or reasonable because of the situation
items.s: Strict rules are ________ in the nature reserve, because even a small fire could destroy rare plants.
items.zh: 自然保護區裡實施嚴格規定是必要的,因為即使是小火也可能摧毀稀有植物。

items.def: to grow too big for something
items.s: The little tree will soon ________ its pot, so we need to plant it in the garden next month.
items.zh: 這棵小樹很快就會長得太大而不適合它的盆子,所以我們下個月需要把它種到花園裡。

items.def: to go further than intended
items.s: If global temperatures ________ the safe limit, many mountain forests may not be able to survive.
items.zh: 如果全球氣溫超過安全界限,許多高山森林可能無法存活。

items.def: to appear again after being hidden
items.s: The rare frog seemed to have disappeared, but it began to ________ in the wetland after the water became clean.
items.zh: 這種稀有青蛙似乎已經消失,但在水質變乾淨後,牠開始在濕地重新出現。

items.def: dividing something into smaller parts
items.s: The ________ of farmland into small house plots has destroyed many hedges and ponds in the area.
items.zh: 把農地細分成小塊住宅用地,已經摧毀了這個地區許多樹籬和池塘。

items.def: the reduction of something bad, such as noise or pollution
items.s: Planting trees along the motorway helped with noise ________, so people living nearby can now sleep more easily.
items.zh: 沿著高速公路種樹有助於噪音減輕,所以住在附近的人現在比較容易入睡。

items.def: the act of gathering many things into a group
items.s: The ________ of birds at the lake is greatest in January, so that is the best month for birdwatching.
items.zh: 湖邊鳥類的聚集在一月最多,所以那是賞鳥最好的月份。

items.def: making a problem or pain less severe
items.s: City parks contribute to the ________ of summer heat, because trees give shade and cool the air.
items.zh: 城市公園有助於緩解夏季的炎熱,因為樹木提供遮蔭並讓空氣降溫。

items.def: the joining of two or more things into one
items.s: The ________ of the two small reserves created one large protected area, and animals can now move more freely.
items.zh: 兩個小保護區的合併形成了一個大型保護區,動物現在可以更自由地移動。

items.def: settling an argument by asking a neutral person to decide
items.s: The land dispute between the timber company and the villagers went to ________, and the judge protected the old forest.
items.zh: 木材公司和村民之間的土地糾紛進入了仲裁,法官保護了那片老森林。

items.def: the clear expression of an idea
items.s: The young activist's ________ of the problem was so clear that even the mayor agreed to visit the wetland.
items.zh: 那位年輕倡議者對問題的闡述非常清楚,連市長都同意去參觀濕地。

items.def: making something weaker or smaller
items.s: Mangroves provide wave ________ during strong storms, so the small villages behind them suffer much less damage.
items.zh: 紅樹林在暴風雨時能使海浪減弱,所以它們後方的小村莊受損少得多。

items.def: adjusting an instrument so it measures correctly
items.s: The water sensors in the wetland need regular ________, because wrong readings could hide a serious pollution problem.
items.zh: 濕地裡的水質感測器需要定期校準,因為錯誤的讀數可能會掩蓋嚴重的污染問題。

items.def: to bring control into one place or group
items.s: The government decided to ________ the management of all national forests, so one office now makes the main decisions.
items.zh: 政府決定集中管理所有國有林,所以現在由一個辦公室做出主要決策。

items.def: describing the typical features of something
items.s: The scientists' ________ of the soil showed it was very acidic, so only certain plants could grow there.
items.zh: 科學家對土壤的特性分析顯示它非常酸,所以只有某些植物能在那裡生長。

items.def: existing at the same time or in the same place
items.s: The two ________ species share the pond peacefully, because one feeds at the surface and the other at the bottom.
items.zh: 這兩個共存的物種和平地共用池塘,因為一種在水面覓食,另一種在水底覓食。

items.def: in a clear and logical way
items.s: The student explained ________ how wetlands reduce floods, so the judges gave her the first prize.
items.zh: 那位學生有條理地解釋了濕地如何減少洪水,所以評審給了她第一名。

items.def: agreement between things
items.s: There is close ________ between the tree-ring data and old weather records, so scientists trust the results.
items.zh: 樹木年輪資料和舊天氣紀錄之間高度吻合,所以科學家信任這些結果。

items.def: able to be argued about
items.s: The company's claim that logging helps the forest is ________, and many scientists strongly disagree.
items.zh: 那家公司聲稱伐木有益森林的說法是有爭議的,許多科學家強烈反對。

items.def: someone or something that helps cause something
items.s: Farm fertiliser is a major ________ to the green algae in the lake, so farmers are being asked to use less.
items.zh: 農用肥料是湖中綠藻的主要促成因素,所以農民被要求減少使用。

items.def: a close connection or similarity
items.s: There is a clear ________ between rainfall and tree growth, so wide rings usually mean wet years.
items.zh: 雨量和樹木生長之間有明顯的對應關係,所以寬的年輪通常代表多雨的年份。

items.def: usually, as a tradition
items.s: Villagers ________ plant a tree when a baby is born, so the forest near the village grows with the community.
items.zh: 村民按慣例會在嬰兒出生時種一棵樹,所以村莊附近的森林隨著社區一起成長。

items.def: able to be clearly described
items.s: A wetland has a ________ edge in some places, but in others the land changes slowly from wet to dry.
items.zh: 濕地在某些地方有可界定的邊界,但在其他地方土地則是從濕慢慢變乾。

items.def: the quality of being special and different
items.s: The ________ of the island's plants attracts scientists, because half of them grow nowhere else on Earth.
items.zh: 這座島上植物的獨特性吸引了科學家,因為其中一半在地球上其他地方都不生長。

items.def: different and moving apart
items.s: Experts hold ________ views on the dam, so the government has asked for another study before it decides.
items.zh: 專家們對這座水壩持分歧的看法,所以政府在決定之前要求再做一次研究。

items.def: producing the result that was wanted
items.s: The fence was not ________ in keeping deer out, so the farmers had to build a taller one.
items.zh: 圍籬在阻擋鹿方面並不有效,所以農民必須蓋一道更高的。

items.def: adding more detail to explain something
items.s: The plan needs more ________, because it does not say who will water the new trees in summer.
items.zh: 這個計畫需要更多詳細說明,因為它沒有說明夏天由誰替新樹澆水。

items.def: the right to do or receive something
items.s: Farmers must meet certain rules for ________, and then they can receive money for planting trees on their land.
items.zh: 農民必須符合特定的資格規定,然後才能因為在自己土地上種樹而獲得補助。

items.def: rising above the surface or starting to appear
items.s: Frogs lay their eggs on ________ plants in the pond, so the eggs stay close to the water but not under it.
items.zh: 青蛙把卵產在池塘裡露出水面的植物上,所以卵靠近水面但不會被淹沒。

items.def: able to be made to be obeyed
items.s: The old law was not ________, so illegal logging continued until a new team of rangers was hired.
items.zh: 舊法律無法強制執行,所以非法伐木一直持續,直到聘請了一支新的巡守隊。

items.def: too much
items.s: If you water the plants ________, their roots cannot breathe, and they may die even though they have water.
items.zh: 如果你過度地替植物澆水,它們的根無法呼吸,即使有水也可能死掉。

items.def: a very good example of something
items.s: The restored wetland is an ________ of good planning, so other cities send teams to learn from it.
items.zh: 這片復育後的濕地是良好規劃的典範,所以其他城市派團隊來學習。

items.def: the ability to change easily
items.s: The ________ of the river's course means the wetland changes shape every few years, so maps quickly become old.
items.zh: 河道的易變性代表濕地每隔幾年就改變形狀,所以地圖很快就過時了。

items.def: all over the world
items.s: Forests ________ are losing an area the size of a football field every few seconds, and the problem is growing.
items.zh: 全球森林每隔幾秒就失去一個足球場大小的面積,而且問題正在擴大。

items.def: the quality of being all the same
items.s: The ________ of the pine plantation means that one disease could kill every tree, so planners now mix species.
items.zh: 松樹人工林的同質性意味著一種疾病就可能害死每一棵樹,所以規劃者現在會混種不同樹種。

items.def: light, or the act of giving light
items.s: Strong street ________ near the wetland confuses birds at night, so the city changed to softer lights.
items.zh: 濕地附近強烈的街道照明會在夜間干擾鳥類,所以市政府改用較柔和的燈光。

items.def: a situation where things are not equal or in balance
items.s: Killing all the wolves caused an ________ in the forest, because the deer population grew far too large.
items.zh: 殺光所有的狼造成了森林的失衡,因為鹿的數量變得太多了。

items.def: treating all sides fairly
items.s: The study was paid for by a timber company, so some people questioned its ________.
items.zh: 這項研究是由一家木材公司出資的,所以有些人質疑它的公正性。

items.def: a mistake; not being exact
items.s: There was an ________ in the old map, so the hikers expected a bridge that did not exist.
items.zh: 舊地圖上有一個錯誤,所以登山客以為會有一座其實不存在的橋。

items.def: being unable to exist together without problems
items.s: The ________ of farming and wetland protection is not total, because some farms now grow rice in ways that help birds.
items.zh: 農業和濕地保育之間的不相容並非絕對,因為有些農場現在用有益鳥類的方式種稻。

items.def: the start of something
items.s: The ________ of the tree-planting project was delayed by heavy rain, but work finally began in March.
items.zh: 植樹計畫的啟動因大雨而延後,但工作終於在三月開始了。

items.def: demanding something firmly
items.s: Thanks to the villagers' ________, the road was moved away from the old forest, so the trees were saved.
items.zh: 多虧村民的堅持,道路被改道遠離老森林,所以樹木得救了。

items.def: the instruments used to measure something
items.s: The research station has modern ________ for measuring rain and wind, so data is collected every minute.
items.zh: 研究站有測量雨量和風的現代儀器設備,所以每分鐘都會收集資料。

items.def: becoming stronger or more extreme
items.s: The ________ of farming near the river has reduced the number of hedges, so birds have fewer places to nest.
items.zh: 河邊農業的集約化加劇減少了樹籬的數量,所以鳥類能築巢的地方變少了。

items.def: not happening at fixed times or in a regular shape
items.s: Bamboo flowers very ________, sometimes only once in sixty years, so seeing it in bloom is very rare.
items.zh: 竹子開花非常不規則,有時六十年才開一次,所以看到竹子開花非常罕見。

items.def: in a fair, legal and acceptable way
items.s: The company can ________ cut trees in this area, because it has a permit and follows the rules for replanting.
items.zh: 這家公司可以合法地在這個區域砍樹,因為它有許可證並遵守補植規定。

items.def: a connection between two things
items.s: Researchers found a strong ________ between tree cover and people's mental health, so green cities may be happier.
items.zh: 研究人員發現樹木覆蓋和人們心理健康之間有密切的關聯,所以綠色城市可能更快樂。

items.def: the state of being fully grown
items.s: Oak trees take about forty years to reach ________, so the trees we plant today will help our grandchildren.
items.zh: 橡樹大約需要四十年才能達到成熟,所以我們今天種的樹將幫助我們的孫子。

items.def: as great or as large as possible
items.s: Plants reach ________ growth in early summer, when there is plenty of light and water.
items.zh: 植物在初夏達到最大的生長量,這時有充足的光線和水分。

items.def: a person who helps two sides reach an agreement
items.s: A ________ was invited to help the farmers and the park office agree on how much water the wetland should get.
items.zh: 一位調解人受邀協助農民和公園管理處就濕地應得多少水量達成共識。

items.def: understanding something wrongly
items.s: A ________ of the satellite photos led to a false report, because the "forest loss" was only a cloud shadow.
items.zh: 對衛星照片的誤解導致了錯誤的報告,因為所謂的「森林流失」其實只是雲的陰影。

items.def: organising people to take action
items.s: The quick ________ of volunteers saved the wetland after the oil spill, and hundreds of birds were cleaned.
items.zh: 志工的快速動員在漏油事件後拯救了濕地,數百隻鳥被清洗乾淨。

items.def: watching and checking something over time
items.s: Regular ________ of the river shows that the water is getting cleaner, so the restoration project is working.
items.zh: 對河流的定期監測顯示水質越來越乾淨,所以復育計畫正在發揮作用。

items.def: only by a small amount
items.s: The old tree ________ escaped being cut down, because a student group protested just one day before the work began.
items.zh: 那棵老樹險些被砍掉,因為一個學生團體在施工前一天提出了抗議。

items.def: making something seem simpler than it really is
items.s: Saying that "trees stop all floods" is an ________, because heavy storms can flood even forested valleys.
items.zh: 說「樹木能阻止所有洪水」是一種過度簡化,因為強烈暴風雨甚至會讓林木茂密的山谷淹水。

items.def: a strange or unusual feature
items.s: One ________ of this plant is that it only opens its flowers at night, so few people have ever seen them.
items.zh: 這種植物的一個特點是它只在夜間開花,所以很少有人見過它的花。

items.def: extremely good or great
items.s: The bamboo showed ________ growth after the rain, and some stems grew almost one metre in a single day.
items.zh: 雨後竹子展現了驚人的生長速度,有些竹莖一天就長了將近一公尺。

items.def: how likely something is to be true
items.s: The scientists tested the ________ of the theory, and they found that it explained the tree deaths very well.
items.zh: 科學家檢驗了這個理論的合理性,發現它能很好地解釋樹木死亡的原因。

items.def: giving an advantage to some people or things
items.s: The government offers ________ loans to farmers who protect wetlands, so many of them have joined the programme.
items.zh: 政府提供優惠貸款給保護濕地的農民,所以他們當中很多人加入了這個計畫。

items.def: thinking about one thing so much that you forget others
items.s: The city's ________ with building roads meant that parks were forgotten, so there are few trees downtown.
items.zh: 市政府一心只想著修路,意味著公園被遺忘了,所以市中心的樹很少。

items.def: deciding which things are most important
items.s: Careful ________ is needed, because there is not enough money to protect every wetland in the country.
items.zh: 需要謹慎地排定優先順序,因為沒有足夠的經費保護國內每一片濕地。

items.def: for now, until something is decided
items.s: The site has been ________ protected, but a final decision will be made after the public meeting next month.
items.zh: 這個地點已被暫時保護,但最終決定將在下個月的公聽會後做出。

items.def: measuring something as a number
items.s: The ________ of carbon stored in the peatland was difficult, because the peat is several metres deep.
items.zh: 量化泥炭地中儲存的碳很困難,因為泥炭有好幾公尺深。

items.def: without a plan or pattern
items.s: The researchers ________ chose fifty spots in the forest, and they counted all the plants in each one.
items.zh: 研究人員在森林中隨機地選了五十個地點,並計算每個地點的所有植物。

items.def: great speed
items.s: The ________ of the fire's spread surprised everyone, so the village had only twenty minutes to escape.
items.zh: 火勢蔓延的迅速讓所有人都很驚訝,所以村子只有二十分鐘可以逃離。

items.def: finding a way for two different needs to exist together
items.s: The project aims at the ________ of farming and nature, so farmers are paid to leave wild strips at the edge of fields.
items.zh: 這個計畫的目標是農業和自然的調和,所以農民會因在田邊保留野生帶狀區而獲得報酬。

items.def: sharing something out again in a different way
items.s: The ________ of water from the dam to the wetland helped the birds, but some farmers were unhappy.
items.zh: 把水壩的水重新分配給濕地幫助了鳥類,但有些農民不太高興。

items.def: relating to official rules
