items.s: The ________ body carefully checks every logging permit, so companies cannot cut any trees without official approval.
items.zh: 監管機構會仔細檢查每一張伐木許可證,所以公司未經正式批准不能砍任何樹。

items.def: how easily something is affected by changes
items.s: Mosses have a high ________ to air pollution, so they quickly disappear when the air becomes dirty.
items.zh: 苔蘚對空氣污染有很高的敏感度,所以空氣變髒時它們很快就會消失。

items.def: the state of being thinly spread
items.s: The ________ of trees on the hill is caused by poor soil, so planting there needs special care.
items.zh: 山丘上樹木稀疏是由貧瘠的土壤造成的,所以在那裡種植需要特別照料。

items.def: making something steady and firm
items.s: Tree roots help with the ________ of the riverbank, so the soil is not washed away during floods.
items.zh: 樹根有助於河岸的穩固,所以洪水時土壤不會被沖走。

items.def: making things follow the same rules or methods
items.s: The ________ of survey methods is important, because it allows scientists in different countries to compare their results.
items.zh: 調查方法的標準化很重要,因為它讓不同國家的科學家能比較他們的結果。

items.def: a company owned by a larger company
items.s: The paper company set up a ________ to plant trees, so it could replace the forests that it had cut.
items.zh: 那家造紙公司成立了一家子公司來種樹,以補種它砍伐掉的森林。

items.def: how right or appropriate something is
items.s: Before planting, the team tested the ________ of the soil, and they found it was too salty for most trees.
items.zh: 種植之前,團隊測試了土壤的適合性,發現它對大多數樹木來說太鹹了。

items.def: the whole of something
items.s: The scientists studied the forest in its ________, so they looked at soil, plants, animals and water together.
items.zh: 科學家從整體來研究森林,所以他們同時觀察土壤、植物、動物和水。

items.def: able to be followed back to its origin
items.s: All the timber in the shop is ________, so customers can check which forest the wood came from.
items.zh: 店裡所有的木材都是可追溯的,所以顧客可以查到木頭來自哪一片森林。

items.def: the passing of something from one thing to another
items.s: Beetles are responsible for the ________ of the disease, so stopping the insects is the key to saving the trees.
items.zh: 甲蟲是這種疾病傳播的媒介,所以阻止這些昆蟲是拯救樹木的關鍵。

items.def: complete agreement among everyone
items.s: There was ________ among the villagers about protecting the forest, so the plan was accepted without a vote.
items.zh: 村民們對保護森林全體一致贊成,所以這個計畫不經投票就被接受了。

items.w: can't see the wood for the trees
items.def: to miss the main point because of too many details
items.s: The manager spent hours on small spelling mistakes in the report, so he ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ and missed the big problem.
items.zh: 經理花了好幾個小時在報告的小拼字錯誤上,所以他見樹不見林,漏掉了大問題。

items.def: no longer in danger or difficulty
items.s: The old oak tree is recovering after the disease, but the arborist says it is not ______ ______ ______ ______ yet, so we must keep watching it.
items.zh: 那棵老橡樹在生病後正在恢復,但樹藝師說它還沒有脫離險境,所以我們必須持續觀察。

items.def: to change your behaviour and start to act better
items.s: Tom used to throw rubbish in the park, but after the clean-up day he decided to ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ and he now recycles everything.
items.zh: 湯姆以前會在公園亂丟垃圾,但在淨灘日之後他決定改過自新,現在他什麼都回收。

items.def: to stop a problem early before it grows bigger
items.s: The rangers noticed the invasive plant problem early, so they decided to ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ before it spread around the lake.
items.zh: 管理員及早注意到入侵植物的問題,所以他們決定在它擴散到湖邊之前就及早制止。

items.def: to look for an answer in the wrong place
items.s: The police thought the farmer had started the fire, but they were ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, because a camper was responsible.
items.zh: 警方以為是農夫引發了火災,但他們找錯對象了,因為該負責的是一名露營者。

items.def: to start doing something new and different
items.s: The small tea farm decided to ______ ______ into forest tours, and now visitors come to learn about the trees as well as the tea.
items.zh: 那間小茶園決定拓展到森林導覽,現在遊客不只來學茶,也來認識樹木。

items.def: to settle and make a permanent home somewhere
items.s: My parents moved around a lot when they were young, but they finally ______ ______ ______ in Hualien, and they have lived there for twenty years.
items.zh: 我父母年輕時經常搬家,但最終在花蓮落地生根,他們已經在那裡住了二十年。

items.def: to become established and begin to grow
items.s: The idea of a car-free Sunday slowly began to ______ ______ in our town, and now hundreds of families cycle together every week.
items.zh: 無車星期日的想法在我們鎮上慢慢紮根,現在每週有數百個家庭一起騎自行車。

items.def: the main reason behind a problem
items.s: Experts say that poverty is ______ ______ ______ of forest loss in some countries, because poor families need land to grow food.
items.zh: 專家說在某些國家,貧窮是森林流失的根本原因,因為貧困的家庭需要土地種植糧食。

items.def: money is limited and must be used carefully
items.cn: 錢不是從天上掉下來的
items.s: I wanted a new bike, but my mother said, "______ ______ ______ ______ ______," so I started saving my pocket money.
items.zh: 我想要一台新腳踏車,但媽媽說:「錢不是從樹上長出來的」,所以我開始存零用錢。
items.t: 錢不是從樹上長出來的

items.def: a person who becomes successful later than others
items.s: My brother was ______ ______ ______, because he did badly at school but became a top scientist in his thirties.
items.zh: 我哥哥是個大器晚成的人,因為他在學校成績不好,卻在三十多歲時成為頂尖科學家。

items.def: to relax and enjoy life instead of always being busy
items.s: My father works very hard every day, so on holidays my mother reminds him to ______ ______ ______ ______ ______.
items.zh: 我爸爸每天都很努力工作,所以假日時媽媽會提醒他放慢腳步享受生活。

items.def: with all the flowers open
items.s: The cherry trees were ______ ______ ______ when we visited Alishan, so the park was crowded with tourists.
items.zh: 我們去阿里山時櫻花正盛開,所以園區裡擠滿了遊客。

items.def: to say or do something risky that others may not support
items.s: The young scientist ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ by saying the old forest could be saved, but later her idea proved correct.
items.zh: 那位年輕科學家冒險主張老森林可以被拯救,但後來她的想法被證明是正確的。

items.def: to become stuck and unable to make progress
items.s: The meeting ______ ______ ______ in small details about the budget, so we never discussed the main plan for the park.
items.zh: 會議陷入預算的細節而停滯不前,所以我們始終沒有討論公園的主要計畫。

items.def: to make a situation more confusing
items.s: The company's new report only ______ ______ ______, because it used different numbers from the government's study.
items.zh: 那家公司的新報告只是混淆視聽,因為它用了和政府研究不同的數據。

items.def: to start an idea or feeling that will grow later
items.s: A school trip to the wetland ______ ______ ______ ______ her love of nature, and she later became a biologist.
items.zh: 一次到濕地的校外教學播下了她熱愛自然的種子,她後來成為一名生物學家。

items.w: the grass is always greener on the other side
items.def: other people's situations always seem better than yours
items.cn: 這山望著那山高;外國的月亮比較圓
items.s: Jason wanted to move to another city for a better job, but his friend reminded him that ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______.
items.zh: 傑森想搬到另一個城市找更好的工作,但他的朋友提醒他這山望著那山高。

items.def: a person or thing that keeps causing trouble
items.s: The noisy factory near the wetland has been ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ for years, so the villagers are happy that it will close.
items.zh: 濕地附近那間吵雜的工廠多年來一直是村民的心頭之患,所以村民很高興它即將關閉。

items.w: great oaks from little acorns grow
items.def: big things can start from small beginnings
items.s: Our recycling club started with only three students, but ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, and now the whole school takes part.
items.zh: 我們的回收社一開始只有三名學生,但萬丈高樓平地起,現在全校都參與了。

items.def: a small place where people see a doctor
items.s: My grandmother goes to the ________ near our home every month, and the doctor there checks her blood pressure.
items.zh: 我奶奶每個月都去我們家附近的診所,那裡的醫生會幫她量血壓。
items.sec: Medical Care & Hospitals 醫療照護與醫院

items.def: a patient who visits a hospital but does not stay overnight
items.s: The hospital treats more than two thousand ________ every day, so the waiting area is always crowded.
items.zh: 這間醫院每天治療兩千多名門診病人,所以候診區總是很擁擠。
items.sec: Medical Care & Hospitals 醫療照護與醫院

items.def: a patient who stays in a hospital for treatment
items.s: Visitors can see ________ only between six and eight in the evening, because the patients need plenty of rest.
items.zh: 訪客只能在晚上六點到八點探視住院病人,因為病人需要充分休息。
items.sec: Medical Care & Hospitals 醫療照護與醫院

items.def: the part of a hospital for people who need help immediately
items.s: My brother broke his arm at basketball practice, so we rushed him to the ______ ______ late at night.
items.zh: 我弟弟在籃球練習時摔斷了手臂,所以我們深夜急忙把他送到急診室。
items.sec: Medical Care & Hospitals 醫療照護與醫院

items.def: a vehicle that takes sick or injured people to hospital
items.s: An old man fainted on the MRT platform, and a passenger called an ________ while others gave him water.
items.zh: 一位老先生在捷運月台上昏倒,一名乘客叫了救護車,其他人則給他水喝。
items.sec: Medical Care & Hospitals 醫療照護與醫院

items.def: a trained person who gives medical help in an ambulance
items.s: The ________ arrived within ten minutes, and they treated the driver before they took him to hospital.
items.zh: 醫護救援人員在十分鐘內抵達,他們先為駕駛治療,再把他送往醫院。
items.sec: Medical Care & Hospitals 醫療照護與醫院

items.def: a family doctor who treats common illnesses
items.s: If you have a cough that lasts for weeks, you should first see a ______ ______, and he may send you to a specialist.
items.zh: 如果你咳嗽持續好幾週,應該先去看家庭醫師,他可能會把你轉介給專科醫師。
items.sec: Medical Care & Hospitals 醫療照護與醫院

items.def: a medical doctor
items.s: The ________ listened carefully to my father's heart, but she said he needed more tests to be sure.
items.zh: 那位醫師仔細聽了我爸爸的心跳,但她說需要更多檢查才能確定。
items.sec: Medical Care & Hospitals 醫療照護與醫院

items.def: a doctor who knows a lot about one area of medicine
items.s: My mother waited three weeks to see a skin ________, but the treatment finally cleared her problem.
items.zh: 我媽媽等了三週才看到皮膚科專科醫師,但治療終於解決了她的問題。
items.sec: Medical Care & Hospitals 醫療照護與醫院

items.def: a person who prepares and sells medicine
items.s: The ________ explained how often I should take the medicine, and she warned me not to drink coffee with it.
items.zh: 藥劑師向我解釋藥要多久吃一次,還提醒我不要配咖啡服用。
items.sec: Medical Care & Hospitals 醫療照護與醫院

items.def: a shop where medicines are sold
items.s: There is a 24-hour ________ next to the hospital, so patients can get their medicine even late at night.
items.zh: 醫院旁邊有一家二十四小時營業的藥局,所以病人即使深夜也能拿到藥。
items.sec: Medical Care & Hospitals 醫療照護與醫院

items.def: a doctor's written order for medicine
items.s: You cannot buy this strong medicine without a ________, so you need to see a doctor first.
items.zh: 沒有處方箋你不能買這種強效藥物,所以你需要先去看醫生。
items.sec: Medical Care & Hospitals 醫療照護與醫院

items.def: a general medical examination
items.s: My parents have a full ________ every year, because doctors can find many problems early this way.
items.zh: 我爸媽每年都做一次完整的健康檢查,因為醫生可以藉此及早發現許多問題。
items.sec: Medical Care & Hospitals 醫療照護與醫院

items.def: an arranged time to meet a doctor or other person
items.s: I made an ________ with the dentist online, so I did not have to wait in line at the clinic.
items.zh: 我在網路上和牙醫預約了時間,所以不必在診所排隊等候。
items.sec: Medical Care & Hospitals 醫療照護與醫院

items.def: a list of people who must wait for a service
items.s: There is a long ______ ______ for knee operations, so some patients wait almost a year for surgery.
items.zh: 膝蓋手術的等候名單很長,所以有些病人要等將近一年才能開刀。
items.sec: Medical Care & Hospitals 醫療照護與醫院

items.def: to let someone stay in hospital for treatment
items.s: The doctor decided to ________ my grandfather for a few days, because his fever was not going down.
items.zh: 醫生決定讓我爺爺住院幾天,因為他的燒一直沒有退。
items.sec: Medical Care & Hospitals 醫療照護與醫院

items.def: sending a patient to another doctor or service
items.s: My family doctor wrote a ________ to the eye hospital, and I got an appointment there the next week.
items.zh: 我的家庭醫師開了一張到眼科醫院的轉診單,我隔週就在那裡掛到號了。
items.sec: Medical Care & Hospitals 醫療照護與醫院

items.def: a meeting with a doctor to discuss a health problem
items.s: Each ________ lasts only five minutes at the busy clinic, so I write down my questions before I go.
items.zh: 在那間忙碌的診所,每次看診只有五分鐘,所以我去之前會先把問題寫下來。
items.sec: Medical Care & Hospitals 醫療照護與醫院

items.def: a hospital area for very seriously ill patients
items.s: After the car accident, the driver spent two weeks in the ______ ______ ______, but he is now slowly recovering.
items.zh: 車禍之後,那名駕駛在加護病房待了兩週,但他現在正慢慢康復。
items.sec: Medical Care & Hospitals 醫療照護與醫院

items.def: a long frame used to carry a sick or injured person
items.s: The player could not walk after the fall, so two medics carried him off the field on a ________.
items.zh: 那名球員跌倒後無法走路,所以兩名醫護人員用擔架把他抬離球場。
items.sec: Medical Care & Hospitals 醫療照護與醫院

items.def: a chair with wheels for people who cannot walk
items.s: My grandmother uses a ________ after her operation, so we chose a restaurant with no steps at the entrance.
items.zh: 我奶奶手術後要坐輪椅,所以我們選了一家入口沒有階梯的餐廳。
items.sec: Medical Care & Hospitals 醫療照護與醫院

items.def: a check of a small amount of blood for health problems
items.s: You must not eat breakfast before the ______ ______, because food can change the results.
items.zh: 驗血前你不能吃早餐,因為食物會影響檢驗結果。
items.sec: Medical Care & Hospitals 醫療照護與醫院

items.def: the official history of a person's health and treatment
items.s: Doctors in Taiwan can check your ______ ______ on your health card, so they know which medicines you are taking.
items.zh: 台灣的醫生可以透過健保卡查看你的病歷,所以他們知道你正在服用哪些藥。
items.sec: Medical Care & Hospitals 醫療照護與醫院

items.def: a system that pays for medical care
items.s: Most people in Taiwan have national ______ ______, so a visit to the doctor costs only a few hundred dollars.
items.zh: 台灣大多數人都有全民健康保險,所以看一次醫生只要幾百元。
items.sec: Medical Care & Hospitals 醫療照護與醫院

items.def: deciding which patients need treatment first
items.s: In the emergency room, nurses use ________ to decide who needs help first, so people with small injuries may wait longer.
items.zh: 在急診室裡,護理師會用檢傷分類決定誰最需要先治療,所以小傷的人可能要等比較久。
items.sec: Medical Care & Hospitals 醫療照護與醫院

items.def: a doctor who treats children
items.s: The baby had a high temperature all night, so her parents took her to the ________ early in the morning.
items.zh: 寶寶整晚發高燒,所以她的爸媽一大早就帶她去看小兒科醫師。
items.sec: Medical Care & Hospitals 醫療照護與醫院

items.def: a doctor who treats heart problems
items.s: My uncle often felt pain in his chest, so his doctor sent him to a ________ for more tests.
items.zh: 我叔叔常常胸口痛,所以他的醫生把他轉給心臟科醫師做更多檢查。
items.sec: Medical Care & Hospitals 醫療照護與醫院

items.def: a room in a hospital where operations are done
items.s: The surgeons were already waiting in the ______ ______, and the nurses prepared all the tools for the long operation.
items.zh: 外科醫師已經在手術室裡等候,護理師們則為這場漫長的手術準備好所有器械。
items.sec: Medical Care & Hospitals 醫療照護與醫院

items.def: a bed in a hospital for a patient
items.s: During the flu season there were not enough ______ ______, so some patients had to stay in the corridor.
items.zh: 流感季期間病床不夠,所以有些病人只能待在走廊上。
items.sec: Medical Care & Hospitals 醫療照護與醫院

items.def: paid by the patient, not by insurance
items.s: The new cancer drug is not covered by insurance, so the ________ costs are too high for many families.
items.zh: 這種新的抗癌藥不在保險給付範圍內,所以自費金額對許多家庭來說太高了。
items.sec: Medical Care & Hospitals 醫療照護與醫院

items.def: the doctors and nurses who work in a hospital
items.s: The ______ ______ worked very long hours during the pandemic, and many of them were completely exhausted.
items.zh: 疫情期間醫護人員工作時數非常長,他們當中許多人都筋疲力盡。
items.sec: Medical Care & Hospitals 醫療照護與醫院

items.def: a period of work during the night
items.s: My aunt is a nurse who often works the ______ ______, so she sleeps during the day while we are at school.
items.zh: 我阿姨是護理師,經常上夜班,所以我們上學時她在白天睡覺。
items.sec: Medical Care & Hospitals 醫療照護與醫院

items.def: an illness of people, animals or plants
items.s: Heart ________ is one of the main causes of death in Taiwan, but a healthy diet can lower the risk.
items.zh: 心臟疾病是台灣主要的死因之一,但健康的飲食可以降低風險。

items.def: the state of being sick
items.s: Tom missed two weeks of school because of a serious ________, so his classmates sent him their notes.
items.zh: 湯姆因為一場嚴重的疾病缺課兩週,所以同學們把筆記寄給他。

items.def: a disease caused by germs entering the body
items.s: The cut on my knee became red and hot, so the doctor said I had an ________ and gave me some cream.
items.zh: 我膝蓋上的傷口變得又紅又熱,所以醫生說我被感染了,並給了我一些藥膏。

items.def: to give someone a disease
items.s: Please stay at home when you have the flu, because you could easily ________ your classmates.
items.zh: 得流感時請待在家裡,因為你很容易傳染給同學。

items.def: a very small living thing that can cause disease
items.s: Wash your hands before you eat, because your fingers carry many ________ that you cannot see.
items.zh: 吃東西前要洗手,因為你的手指上帶有許多看不見的病菌。

items.def: a disease that spreads over many countries
items.s: The COVID-19 ________ closed schools around the world, so millions of students had to study online.
items.zh: 新冠肺炎全球大流行讓世界各地的學校停課,所以數百萬學生必須在線上學習。

items.def: carried through the air
items.s: Measles is an ________ disease, so it can spread quickly in a crowded classroom with closed windows.
items.zh: 麻疹是一種經由空氣傳播的疾病,所以在門窗緊閉、擁擠的教室裡會快速傳播。

items.def: a very small drop of liquid
items.s: When you sneeze, tiny ________ fly into the air, so you should cover your mouth with your elbow.
items.zh: 打噴嚏時微小的飛沫會飛到空中,所以你應該用手肘遮住嘴巴。

items.def: the time between catching a disease and showing signs
items.s: The virus has an ______ ______ of about five days, so people can spread it before they feel sick.
items.zh: 這種病毒的潛伏期大約五天,所以人們在感到不舒服之前就可能傳播病毒。

items.def: having a disease but showing no signs of it
items.s: Many young people were ________, so they did not know they had the virus until they took a test.
items.zh: 許多年輕人是無症狀的,所以他們直到做了檢測才知道自己感染了病毒。

items.def: a body temperature that is higher than normal
items.s: My little sister had a high ________ last night, so my mother stayed with her and checked her temperature every hour.
items.zh: 我妹妹昨晚發高燒,所以媽媽陪著她,每小時量一次體溫。

items.def: the act or sound of pushing air out of the throat
items.s: I have had a dry ________ for two weeks, so the doctor wants me to take an X-ray of my chest.
items.zh: 我已經乾咳兩週了,所以醫生要我照一張胸部X光片。

items.def: to force air out through the nose suddenly
items.s: Every spring I ________ a lot because of the pollen, so I always carry tissues in my bag.
items.zh: 每年春天我都因為花粉常常打噴嚏,所以我總是在包包裡放面紙。

items.def: pain in the throat, often from a cold
items.s: I had a ______ ______ after the concert, so I drank warm water with honey and stopped talking for a day.
items.zh: 演唱會後我喉嚨痛,所以我喝了溫蜂蜜水,還一整天不說話。

items.def: a nose with liquid coming out because of a cold
items.s: The little boy had a ______ ______ all week, but he still wanted to play outside with his friends.
items.zh: 那個小男孩整個星期都在流鼻水,但他還是想和朋友在外面玩。

items.def: a common infectious illness with fever and aches; the flu
items.s: Every winter many elderly people catch ________, so the government offers them free flu jabs.
items.zh: 每年冬天許多長者會感染流行性感冒,所以政府提供他們免費的流感疫苗。

items.def: a mild illness with a runny nose and sore throat
items.s: There is still no cure for the ______ ______, but most people feel better after about a week.
items.zh: 普通感冒至今仍無法根治,但大多數人大約一週後就會好轉。

items.def: a serious infectious disease that mainly affects the lungs
items.s: ________ can be cured with medicine, but patients must take the pills every day for several months.
items.zh: 肺結核可以用藥物治癒,但病人必須連續數個月每天服藥。

items.def: an infectious disease that causes red spots and fever
items.s: ________ spreads very easily among children, so doctors want every child to be vaccinated before school.
items.zh: 麻疹在兒童之間非常容易傳播,所以醫生希望每個孩子上學前都接種疫苗。

items.def: a tropical disease spread by mosquitoes
items.s: Cases of ______ ______ rise in southern Taiwan every summer, so residents are told to empty water from old containers.
items.zh: 每年夏天南台灣的登革熱病例都會增加,所以居民被要求清除舊容器裡的積水。

items.def: a disease that damages the liver
items.s: ________ B used to be very common in Taiwan, but a vaccine for babies has reduced it greatly.
items.zh: B型肝炎過去在台灣非常普遍,但嬰兒疫苗已經大幅減少了這種病。

items.def: a serious disease in which cells grow in an uncontrolled way
items.s: Smoking is a major cause of lung ________, so my father finally quit after his doctor warned him.
items.zh: 吸菸是肺癌的主要成因,所以我爸爸在醫生警告後終於戒菸了。

items.def: a lump that grows inside the body
items.s: The scan showed a small ________ in her brain, but luckily the doctors could remove it completely.
items.zh: 掃描顯示她的腦部有一個小腫瘤,但幸運的是醫生能將它完全切除。

items.def: any illness that affects the heart
items.s: Eating too much salt can lead to ______ ______, so the school canteen now uses less salt in its dishes.
items.zh: 吃太多鹽可能導致心臟病,所以學校餐廳現在的菜都少放鹽了。

items.def: a sudden serious problem when blood stops reaching the heart
items.s: A man had a ______ ______ in the gym, but a staff member saved his life with CPR before the ambulance came.
items.zh: 一名男子在健身房心臟病發作,但一位員工在救護車抵達前用心肺復甦術救了他一命。

items.def: relating to breathing and the lungs
items.s: Air pollution can cause ________ problems, so many people wear masks on days when the air quality is poor.
items.zh: 空氣污染會引起呼吸系統的問題,所以空氣品質差的日子許多人會戴口罩。

items.def: a serious infection of the lungs
items.s: My grandfather caught a cold that turned into ________, so he had to stay in hospital for ten days.
items.zh: 我爺爺的感冒惡化成肺炎,所以他必須住院十天。

items.def: a common children's disease that causes itchy red spots
items.s: My little brother caught ________ at kindergarten, and he had itchy red spots all over his body for a week.
items.zh: 我弟弟在幼兒園得了水痘,他全身長滿會癢的紅疹,持續了一週。

items.def: a bad reaction of the body to certain food, dust or plants
items.s: Jenny has a peanut ________, so she always checks the label before she buys any snacks.
items.zh: 珍妮對花生過敏,所以她買任何零食前都會先看標籤。

items.def: an illness that makes breathing difficult at times
items.s: Kevin has ________, so he always carries an inhaler when he goes running in cold weather.
items.zh: 凱文有氣喘,所以天冷去跑步時他總是隨身帶著吸入器。

items.def: to stay away from other people to avoid spreading a disease
items.s: After she tested positive, she had to ________ at home for five days, so her friends delivered food to her door.
items.zh: 她檢測呈陽性後必須在家自我隔離五天,所以朋友們把食物送到她家門口。

items.def: a person who passes a disease to many others
items.s: One ________ at the wedding infected forty guests, and health officials had to trace all of them.
items.zh: 婚禮上一名超級傳播者傳染了四十位賓客,衛生官員必須追蹤所有人。

items.def: the body's ability to fight a disease
items.s: After you have had chickenpox, you usually have ________ for life, so you will not catch it again.
items.zh: 得過水痘之後,你通常會有終身免疫力,所以不會再被感染。

items.def: a substance the body makes to fight germs
items.s: The vaccine helps your body make ________, and these protect you if the real virus enters your body.
items.zh: 疫苗幫助你的身體製造抗體,而當真正的病毒進入體內時,這些抗體會保護你。

items.def: giving people a vaccine to protect them from disease
items.s: ________ has saved millions of lives, but some parents still worry about the side effects.
items.zh: 預防接種已經拯救了數百萬條生命,但有些家長仍擔心副作用。
items.sec: Vaccines, Medicine & Treatment 疫苗、藥物與治療

items.def: to give someone a vaccine
items.s: The school nurse will ________ all first-year students next week, so parents must sign the form by Friday.
items.zh: 學校護理師下週將為所有一年級學生接種疫苗,所以家長必須在週五前簽好同意書。
items.sec: Vaccines, Medicine & Treatment 疫苗、藥物與治療

items.def: an extra dose of a vaccine to keep protection strong
items.s: Protection from the vaccine becomes weaker over time, so older people are advised to get a ________ every year.
items.zh: 疫苗的保護力會隨著時間減弱,所以建議長者每年接種一劑追加劑。
items.sec: Vaccines, Medicine & Treatment 疫苗、藥物與治療

items.def: an injection, especially a vaccine (informal)
items.s: I was nervous about my flu ________, but it was quick and my arm only hurt a little the next day.
items.zh: 我對打流感疫苗很緊張,但它很快就結束了,隔天手臂只痛了一點點。
items.sec: Vaccines, Medicine & Treatment 疫苗、藥物與治療

items.def: an amount of medicine taken at one time
items.s: Take one ________ of this medicine after each meal, but do not take more than three in one day.
items.zh: 這種藥每餐飯後吃一劑,但一天不要超過三次。
items.sec: Vaccines, Medicine & Treatment 疫苗、藥物與治療

items.def: a small round piece of medicine that you swallow
items.s: My grandfather takes four different ________ every morning, so he uses a box with the days of the week on it.
items.zh: 我爺爺每天早上要吃四種不同的藥丸,所以他用一個標有星期幾的藥盒。
items.sec: Vaccines, Medicine & Treatment 疫苗、藥物與治療

items.def: a small tube of medicine that you swallow whole
items.s: Swallow the ________ with a full glass of water, and do not open it or chew it.
items.zh: 請配一整杯水吞下這顆膠囊,不要打開或咀嚼它。
items.sec: Vaccines, Medicine & Treatment 疫苗、藥物與治療

items.def: used to fight viruses
items.s: The doctor gave her ________ medicine on the first day of the flu, so she recovered much faster.
items.zh: 醫生在她得流感的第一天就開了抗病毒藥物,所以她康復得快多了。
items.sec: Vaccines, Medicine & Treatment 疫苗、藥物與治療

items.def: a smooth cream you put on the skin to heal it
items.s: Put this ________ on the burn twice a day, and keep the area clean and dry.
items.zh: 這種藥膏每天擦在燙傷處兩次,並保持患部清潔乾燥。
items.sec: Vaccines, Medicine & Treatment 疫苗、藥物與治療

items.def: a tube with a needle used to give injections
items.s: The nurse filled the ________ with the vaccine, and then she asked me to relax my arm.
items.zh: 護理師把疫苗吸進注射器,然後請我放鬆手臂。
items.sec: Vaccines, Medicine & Treatment 疫苗、藥物與治療

items.def: putting medicine into the body with a needle
items.s: Some children cry when they get an ________, so the nurse gives them a sticker afterwards.
items.zh: 有些孩子打針時會哭,所以護理師之後會送他們一張貼紙。
items.sec: Vaccines, Medicine & Treatment 疫苗、藥物與治療

items.def: to put medicine into the body with a needle
items.s: People with diabetes may need to ________ insulin every day, so they learn to do it themselves.
items.zh: 糖尿病患者可能每天都需要注射胰島素,所以他們學會自己打針。
items.sec: Vaccines, Medicine & Treatment 疫苗、藥物與治療

items.def: a liquid or cream that kills germs on cuts
items.s: Clean the cut with some ________ first, or it may become infected in this hot weather.
items.zh: 先用一點消毒劑清潔傷口,否則在這麼熱的天氣裡可能會感染。
items.sec: Vaccines, Medicine & Treatment 疫苗、藥物與治療

items.def: to become healthy again after an injury
items.s: The cut on his hand took two weeks to ________, because he kept getting it wet at work.
items.zh: 他手上的傷口花了兩週才癒合,因為他工作時一直把它弄濕。
items.sec: Vaccines, Medicine & Treatment 疫苗、藥物與治療

items.def: treatment of cancer with strong drugs
items.s: My aunt lost her hair during ________, but it grew back after her treatment finished.
items.zh: 我阿姨在化療期間掉了頭髮,但治療結束後頭髮又長回來了。
items.sec: Vaccines, Medicine & Treatment 疫苗、藥物與治療

items.def: treatment of cancer using radiation
items.s: After the operation, he needed six weeks of ________, so he went to the hospital every weekday.
items.zh: 手術後他需要六週的放射治療,所以他每個平日都要去醫院。
items.sec: Vaccines, Medicine & Treatment 疫苗、藥物與治療

items.def: giving a body part to help someone who is ill
items.s: My father signed up for ______ ______, because he believes it is a way to save lives after death.
items.zh: 我爸爸簽署了器官捐贈同意書,因為他相信這是死後拯救生命的一種方式。
items.sec: Vaccines, Medicine & Treatment 疫苗、藥物與治療

items.def: cutting the body open to repair or remove something
items.s: The ________ on her knee was successful, but she must use crutches for a month.
items.zh: 她的膝蓋手術很成功,但她必須拄一個月的拐杖。
items.sec: Vaccines, Medicine & Treatment 疫苗、藥物與治療

items.def: to make pain or a problem less bad
items.s: A hot shower can ________ the pain in your back, and gentle stretching will also help.
items.zh: 洗個熱水澡可以緩解背痛,溫和的伸展也會有幫助。
items.sec: Vaccines, Medicine & Treatment 疫苗、藥物與治療

items.def: too much of a drug taken at one time
items.s: Never take two kinds of cold medicine together, because an ________ of paracetamol can damage your liver.
items.zh: 絕不要同時服用兩種感冒藥,因為乙醯胺酚用藥過量會傷害你的肝臟。
items.sec: Vaccines, Medicine & Treatment 疫苗、藥物與治療

items.def: medicine made from plants
items.s: Many older people in Taiwan use ______ ______, but they should tell their doctor because it can mix badly with other drugs.
items.zh: 台灣許多長者會使用草藥,但他們應該告訴醫生,因為它可能和其他藥物產生不良交互作用。
items.sec: Vaccines, Medicine & Treatment 疫苗、藥物與治療

items.def: treatment using thin needles put into the skin
items.s: My mother tried ________ for her shoulder pain, and she said she felt better after three visits.
items.zh: 我媽媽為了肩膀痛去試了針灸,她說去了三次後感覺好多了。
items.sec: Vaccines, Medicine & Treatment 疫苗、藥物與治療

items.def: able to be bought without a doctor's prescription
items.s: You can buy ________ medicine for a headache at any pharmacy, but read the instructions carefully.
items.zh: 你可以在任何藥局買到治頭痛的成藥,但要仔細閱讀說明。
items.sec: Vaccines, Medicine & Treatment 疫苗、藥物與治療

items.def: a cheaper copy of a brand-name medicine
items.s: The hospital now uses a ______ ______ for high blood pressure, because it works the same but costs much less.
items.zh: 醫院現在改用一種治療高血壓的學名藥,因為效果相同但便宜得多。
items.sec: Vaccines, Medicine & Treatment 疫苗、藥物與治療

items.def: protection that happens when most people in a group are immune
items.s: When most children are vaccinated, ______ ______ protects babies who are too young for the vaccine.
items.zh: 當大多數孩子都接種疫苗時,群體免疫就能保護年紀太小還不能打疫苗的嬰兒。
items.sec: Vaccines, Medicine & Treatment 疫苗、藥物與治療

items.def: unwillingness or delay in getting vaccinated
items.s: ______ ______ grew because of false stories online, so doctors started making short videos to explain the facts.
items.zh: 疫苗猶豫因網路上的不實消息而增加,所以醫生們開始製作短片來說明事實。
items.sec: Vaccines, Medicine & Treatment 疫苗、藥物與治療

items.def: a thin sharp metal tube used for injections
items.s: Some adults are afraid of ________, so they look away while the nurse gives them a vaccine.
items.zh: 有些大人害怕針頭,所以護理師幫他們打疫苗時他們會把頭轉開。
items.sec: Vaccines, Medicine & Treatment 疫苗、藥物與治療

items.def: short threads used to close a cut in the skin
items.s: He cut his head when he fell off his bike, so the doctor gave him five ________ in the emergency room.
items.zh: 他騎腳踏車摔倒時割傷了頭,所以醫生在急診室幫他縫了五針。
items.sec: Vaccines, Medicine & Treatment 疫苗、藥物與治療

items.def: a mark left on the skin after a wound heals
items.s: The operation left a long ________ on his stomach, but he says it reminds him how lucky he is.
items.zh: 手術在他的肚子上留下一道長長的疤痕,但他說這提醒他自己有多幸運。
items.sec: Vaccines, Medicine & Treatment 疫苗、藥物與治療

items.def: an injury where the skin is cut or broken
items.s: The nurse cleaned the ________ carefully and covered it, and she told me to change the bandage every day.
items.zh: 護理師仔細清理了傷口並包紮起來,她告訴我每天換一次繃帶。
items.sec: Vaccines, Medicine & Treatment 疫苗、藥物與治療

items.def: a sweet liquid medicine for coughs
items.s: This ______ ______ may make you sleepy, so you should not drive after you take it.
items.zh: 這種止咳糖漿可能會讓你想睡,所以服用後不應該開車。
items.sec: Vaccines, Medicine & Treatment 疫苗、藥物與治療

items.def: liquid medicine that you put into your eyes
items.s: My eyes feel dry after hours on the computer, so the doctor told me to use ______ ______ three times a day.
items.zh: 我在電腦前待好幾個小時後眼睛很乾,所以醫生要我一天點三次眼藥水。
items.sec: Vaccines, Medicine & Treatment 疫苗、藥物與治療

items.def: a population with a growing share of old people
items.s: Taiwan has a rapidly ______ ______, so the government needs more care workers and nursing homes.
items.zh: 台灣正面臨快速的人口老化,所以政府需要更多照顧服務員和護理之家。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: a society where over 20% of people are 65 or older
items.s: Taiwan became a ______ ______ in 2025, which means more than one in five people are over sixty-five.
items.zh: 台灣在2025年成為超高齡社會,這表示每五個人當中就有超過一人年滿六十五歲。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: an older person, usually over 65
items.s: ______ ______ can ride the bus at a discount in Taipei, so my grandparents often travel around the city.
items.zh: 台北的年長者搭公車可享優惠,所以我的祖父母常常在城市裡四處走走。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: a person who receives a pension after retiring
items.s: Many ________ in Taiwan worry about rising prices, because their monthly income does not increase much.
items.zh: 台灣許多領退休金的人擔心物價上漲,因為他們每月的收入並沒有增加多少。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: a person who has stopped working because of age
items.s: Many ________ volunteer at the local library, and they enjoy reading stories to young children.
items.zh: 許多退休人士在當地圖書館當志工,他們喜歡為小朋友讀故事。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: a person who is 100 years old or more
items.s: The number of ________ in Taiwan has grown quickly, so scientists are studying their daily habits.
items.zh: 台灣百歲人瑞的人數快速增加,所以科學家正在研究他們的日常習慣。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: the later part of life
items.s: My grandfather is still very active in his ______ ______, and he goes swimming three times a week.
items.zh: 我爺爺在晚年仍然非常活躍,他每週去游泳三次。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: a line that forms on the skin as you get older
items.s: My grandmother laughs a lot, so she has many ________ around her eyes, but she says each one is a happy memory.
items.zh: 我奶奶很愛笑,所以眼睛周圍有很多皺紋,但她說每一條都是快樂的回憶。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: hair that has lost its colour with age
items.s: My father found his first ______ ______ at forty, and he joked that his teenage children were the reason.
items.zh: 我爸爸四十歲時發現了第一根白髮,他開玩笑說原因是家裡那幾個青少年孩子。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: a small device that helps people hear better
items.s: My grandfather wears a ______ ______ now, so he can join our conversations at dinner again.
items.zh: 我爺爺現在戴著助聽器,所以他又能在晚餐時加入我們的談話了。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: a stick that helps a person walk
items.s: My grandmother uses a ______ ______ on the hiking trail, because the path is steep and sometimes slippery.
items.zh: 我奶奶在登山步道上會用手杖,因為那條路很陡,有時又很滑。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: glasses that help older people see small print
items.s: My mother needs ______ ______ to read the menu, but she keeps forgetting them at home.
items.zh: 我媽媽需要老花眼鏡才能看菜單,但她老是把眼鏡忘在家裡。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: a cloudy area in the eye that makes it hard to see
items.s: My grandfather had ________ surgery last year, and now he can see colours clearly again.
items.zh: 我爺爺去年做了白內障手術,現在他又能清楚看見顏色了。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: a disease that makes bones weak and easy to break
items.s: Women over fifty have a higher risk of ________, so doctors advise them to get enough calcium and exercise.
items.zh: 五十歲以上的女性罹患骨質疏鬆症的風險較高,所以醫生建議她們攝取足夠的鈣並運動。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: a disease that makes joints painful and stiff
items.s: My grandmother has ________ in her fingers, so she finds it hard to open jars and button her clothes.
items.zh: 我奶奶的手指有關節炎,所以她很難打開罐子和扣衣服的扣子。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: a break in the bone at the top of the leg
items.s: Falls at home often cause a ______ ______ in older people, so families should remove loose rugs and add handrails.
items.zh: 在家跌倒常導致長者髖部骨折,所以家人應該移除鬆動的地毯並加裝扶手。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: the state of being physically weak, often due to age
items.s: Regular exercise can slow down ________ in old age, so the community centre offers free classes for seniors.
items.zh: 規律運動可以減緩老年的衰弱,所以社區中心為長者開設免費課程。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: unable to get out of bed because of illness or age
items.s: After the stroke, my great-aunt was ________ for months, so a care worker came to help her every day.
items.zh: 中風後,我姑婆臥床好幾個月,所以每天都有照顧服務員來幫忙她。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: the inability to remember things
items.s: Some ______ ______ is normal with age, but if it affects daily life, you should see a doctor.
items.zh: 隨著年齡增長出現一些記憶力減退是正常的,但如果影響到日常生活,你就應該去看醫生。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: a person whose job is to look after old or sick people
items.s: A ______ ______ visits my grandmother three times a week, and she helps her with bathing and cooking.
items.zh: 一位照顧服務員每週來探視我奶奶三次,幫她洗澡和做飯。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: care given to people in their own homes
items.s: Most older people prefer ______ ______ to nursing homes, because they want to stay in a familiar place.
items.zh: 比起護理之家,大多數長者更喜歡居家照護,因為他們想待在熟悉的地方。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: a place that looks after older people during the day
items.s: My grandfather goes to a ______ ______ ______ while my parents are at work, and he enjoys the singing classes there.
items.zh: 我爸媽上班時,爺爺會去日間照顧中心,他很喜歡那裡的歌唱課。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: support for people who cannot fully look after themselves for a long time
items.s: The government expanded its ______ ______ plan, so more families can get help with elderly relatives.
items.zh: 政府擴大了長期照顧計畫,所以更多家庭能在照顧年長親人方面得到協助。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: a place where old or ill people live and receive care
items.s: We visit my great-grandmother at the ______ ______ every Sunday, and we often bring her favourite cakes.
items.zh: 我們每週日去護理之家探望曾祖母,常常帶她最喜歡的蛋糕過去。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: a place where retired people live together
items.s: My grandparents moved into a ______ ______ by the sea, and they have made many new friends there.
items.zh: 我的祖父母搬進了海邊的一間養老院,他們在那裡交了許多新朋友。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: housing where older people get some help with daily tasks
items.s: ______ ______ lets older people keep their own apartment, but staff are there to help when they need it.
items.zh: 協助型生活住宅讓長者保有自己的公寓,而當他們需要時,工作人員就在身邊提供協助。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: respect and care for one's parents and older relatives
items.s: ______ ______ is an important value in Taiwan, so many adults feel they should take care of their parents at home.
items.zh: 孝道在台灣是很重要的價值觀,所以許多成年人覺得應該在家照顧父母。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: involving people of different generations
items.s: The school started an ________ project, and students now teach seniors how to use smartphones.
items.zh: 學校展開了一項跨世代計畫,學生現在教長者如何使用智慧型手機。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: a parent whose children have grown up and left home
items.s: After my sister went to university, my parents became ______ ______, so they started travelling more.
items.zh: 我姊姊上大學後,我爸媽成了空巢父母,所以他們開始更常去旅行。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: a woman whose husband has died
items.s: Our neighbour became a ________ last year, so we often invite her for dinner so she does not feel alone.
items.zh: 我們的鄰居去年成了寡婦,所以我們常邀她來吃晚餐,讓她不會感到孤單。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: the age at which people usually stop working
items.s: Some countries have raised the ______ ______ to sixty-seven, because people are living and working longer.
items.zh: 有些國家已把退休年齡提高到六十七歲,因為人們活得更久、工作也更久。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: the number of non-working people compared with workers
items.s: As the ______ ______ rises, each worker must support more elderly people through taxes, so young people worry about the future.
items.zh: 隨著扶養比上升,每位勞工必須透過稅收撫養更多長者,所以年輕人擔心未來。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: business and services aimed at older people
items.s: The ______ ______ is growing fast, so many companies now design products for older customers.
items.zh: 銀髮經濟正快速成長,所以許多公司現在為年長顧客設計產品。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: designed to be easy for older people to use
items.s: Our city wants to become more ________, so it is adding benches and lifts to MRT stations.
items.zh: 我們的城市想變得更加高齡友善,所以正在捷運站增設長椅和電梯。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: care that reduces pain for people who cannot be cured
items.s: When the cancer could not be cured, my uncle received ______ ______, so he could spend his last weeks without pain.
items.zh: 當癌症無法治癒時,我叔叔接受了安寧緩和照護,讓他能沒有痛苦地度過最後幾週。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: a place that cares for people who are dying
items.cn: 安寧病房;安寧療護機構
items.s: The nurses at the ________ were very kind, and they helped our family say goodbye peacefully.
items.zh: 安寧病房的護理師非常親切,她們幫助我們全家平靜地道別。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: medical and emotional care for people near death
items.s: Good ______ ______ respects the wishes of the patient, so families should talk about it early.
items.zh: 良好的臨終照護會尊重病人的意願,所以家人應該及早討論。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: intended to stop or slow the signs of getting older
items.s: Many ________ creams are very expensive, but doctors say that cheap sunscreen actually protects your skin much better.
items.zh: 許多抗老乳霜非常昂貴,但醫生說便宜的防曬乳其實更能保護你的皮膚。
items.sec: Ageing & Elderly Care 老化與長者照護

items.def: the health of the whole population and how it is protected
items.s: Clean water and vaccines are two of the greatest successes in ______ ______, and they have saved millions of lives.
items.zh: 乾淨的水和疫苗是公共衛生最偉大的兩項成就,它們拯救了數百萬條生命。
items.sec: Public Health & Prevention 公共衛生與預防

items.def: the study of how diseases spread in populations
items.s: My cousin studies ________ at university, because she wants to help stop the next pandemic.
items.zh: 我表姊在大學主修流行病學,因為她想幫忙阻止下一場大流行。
items.sec: Public Health & Prevention 公共衛生與預防

items.def: a scientist who studies how diseases spread
items.s: The ________ explained on TV how the virus was spreading, and she asked people to stay calm.
items.zh: 那位流行病學家在電視上解釋病毒如何傳播,並呼籲民眾保持冷靜。
items.sec: Public Health & Prevention 公共衛生與預防

items.def: finding people who have been near an infected person
items.s: Taiwan used fast ______ ______ during the pandemic, so health workers could find people at risk quickly.
items.zh: 台灣在疫情期間採用快速的接觸者追蹤,所以衛生人員能迅速找到高風險的人。
items.sec: Public Health & Prevention 公共衛生與預防

items.def: a covering for the nose and mouth
items.s: Many people in Taipei wear a ______ ______ when they have a cold, because they do not want to infect others.
items.zh: 台北許多人感冒時會戴口罩,因為他們不想傳染給別人。
items.sec: Public Health & Prevention 公共衛生與預防

items.def: a liquid that kills germs on your hands without water
items.s: There is a bottle of ______ ______ at the door of every classroom, so students clean their hands before they enter.
items.zh: 每間教室門口都有一瓶乾洗手液,所以學生進教室前會先清潔雙手。
items.sec: Public Health & Prevention 公共衛生與預防

items.def: keeping a safe distance from other people to stop disease
items.s: During the outbreak, cinemas left empty seats between customers to allow ______ ______, and many people watched films at home instead.
items.zh: 疫情爆發期間,電影院在觀眾之間留下空位,以保持社交距離,許多人則改在家看電影。
items.sec: Public Health & Prevention 公共衛生與預防

items.def: an official order for people to stay at home
items.s: During the ________ the streets of the city were almost empty, and people could only go out to buy food.
items.zh: 封城期間城市街道幾乎空無一人,人們只能出門買食物。
items.sec: Public Health & Prevention 公共衛生與預防

items.def: checks on people entering a country
items.s: Taiwan introduced strict ______ ______ early in 2020, so the virus spread slowly at first.
items.zh: 台灣在2020年初實施了嚴格的邊境管制,所以病毒一開始傳播得很慢。
items.sec: Public Health & Prevention 公共衛生與預防

items.def: a government body in charge of health
items.s: The local ______ ______ closed the restaurant for a week, because many customers had food poisoning.
items.zh: 當地衛生主管機關勒令那家餐廳停業一週,因為許多顧客食物中毒。
items.sec: Public Health & Prevention 公共衛生與預防

items.def: an organised effort to improve people's health
items.s: The city launched a ______ ______ about drinking water instead of bubble tea, and posters appeared in every school.
items.zh: 市政府推出了一項提倡喝水取代珍珠奶茶的健康宣導活動,每所學校都貼出了海報。
items.sec: Public Health & Prevention 公共衛生與預防

items.def: teaching people how to stay healthy
items.s: ______ ______ classes teach students about sleep and diet, so they can make better choices.
items.zh: 健康教育課教導學生睡眠和飲食的知識,讓他們能做出更好的選擇。
items.sec: Public Health & Prevention 公共衛生與預防

items.def: a law that stops people smoking in certain places
items.s: After the ______ ______ in restaurants, the air inside became much cleaner, and more families came to eat.
items.zh: 餐廳實施禁菸令後,室內空氣變得乾淨多了,也有更多家庭前來用餐。
items.sec: Public Health & Prevention 公共衛生與預防

items.def: smoke breathed in by people near a smoker
items.s: ______ ______ is dangerous for children, so my uncle now smokes only outside the house.
items.zh: 二手菸對孩子很危險,所以我舅舅現在只在屋外抽菸。
items.sec: Public Health & Prevention 公共衛生與預防

items.def: a tax on drinks with a lot of sugar
items.s: Several countries introduced a ______ ______ on soft drinks, and companies reduced the sugar to avoid paying it.
items.zh: 好幾個國家對汽水課徵糖稅,飲料公司便減少糖分以避免繳稅。
items.sec: Public Health & Prevention 公共衛生與預防

items.def: dried leaves that are smoked in cigarettes
items.s: The government raised the tax on ________, so the price of cigarettes went up and fewer young people started smoking.
items.zh: 政府提高了菸草稅,所以香菸價格上漲,開始抽菸的年輕人也變少了。
items.sec: Public Health & Prevention 公共衛生與預防

items.def: the addictive drug in cigarettes
items.s: ________ makes smoking very hard to give up, so many people need help from a doctor to quit.
items.zh: 尼古丁讓人很難戒菸,所以許多人需要醫生的幫助才能戒掉。
items.sec: Public Health & Prevention 公共衛生與預防

items.def: an electronic device that lets people breathe in nicotine
items.s: Selling ________ is now illegal in Taiwan, because health experts worry that they attract teenagers.
items.zh: 販售電子菸在台灣現在是違法的,因為衛生專家擔心它們會吸引青少年。
items.sec: Public Health & Prevention 公共衛生與預防

items.def: a notice that tells people about a danger to health
items.s: Every cigarette packet has a large ______ ______ with a picture, but some smokers still ignore it.
items.zh: 每包香菸上都印有附圖片的大型健康警語,但有些吸菸者仍然視而不見。
items.sec: Public Health & Prevention 公共衛生與預防

items.def: water that is safe to drink
items.s: Millions of people around the world still have no access to ______ ______, so they often suffer from stomach diseases.
items.zh: 全世界仍有數百萬人無法取得乾淨的水,所以他們常罹患腸胃疾病。
items.sec: Public Health & Prevention 公共衛生與預防

items.def: spread by water
items.s: After the flood, doctors warned about ________ diseases, so people were told to boil all their drinking water.
items.zh: 洪水過後醫生警告要注意經由水傳播的疾病,所以民眾被告知要把所有飲用水煮沸。
items.sec: Public Health & Prevention 公共衛生與預防

items.def: a system that gives medical care to everyone
items.s: Taiwan's ______ ______ ______ system covers almost every citizen, so even poor families can see a doctor.
items.zh: 台灣的全民健康照護制度幾乎涵蓋每位國民,所以即使是貧窮家庭也能看醫生。
items.sec: Public Health & Prevention 公共衛生與預防

items.def: a person who works in medical care, such as a nurse
items.s: ______ ______ received the vaccine first, because they were at the highest risk of infection.
items.zh: 醫療工作者最先接種疫苗,因為他們感染的風險最高。
items.sec: Public Health & Prevention 公共衛生與預防

items.def: working directly in the most important or dangerous place
items.s: ________ nurses worked twelve-hour shifts during the outbreak, and many of them could not go home for weeks.
items.zh: 疫情爆發期間第一線護理師輪十二小時的班,其中許多人好幾週無法回家。
items.sec: Public Health & Prevention 公共衛生與預防

items.def: a chemical that kills germs on surfaces
items.s: The cleaners wipe the door handles with ________ twice a day, so germs do not spread around the school.
items.zh: 清潔人員每天用消毒劑擦拭門把兩次,讓病菌不會在校園裡傳播。
items.sec: Public Health & Prevention 公共衛生與預防

items.def: the act of washing your hands
items.s: Regular ________ with soap is one of the easiest ways to prevent illness, but many people do it too quickly.
items.zh: 經常用肥皂洗手是預防疾病最簡單的方法之一,但許多人洗得太快了。
items.sec: Public Health & Prevention 公共衛生與預防

items.def: a net hung over a bed to keep mosquitoes away
items.s: Charities give families in Africa a ______ ______ for every bed, because it greatly reduces malaria.
items.zh: 慈善團體為非洲家庭的每張床提供一頂蚊帳,因為它能大幅減少瘧疾。
items.sec: Public Health & Prevention 公共衛生與預防

items.def: unfair differences in health between groups of people
items.s: People in remote mountain villages live shorter lives, and this ______ ______ worries the government.
items.zh: 偏遠山區村莊的居民壽命較短,這種健康不平等讓政府感到憂心。
items.sec: Public Health & Prevention 公共衛生與預防

items.def: the number of deaths in a group in a period of time
items.s: The ______ ______ from road accidents fell after the city lowered speed limits, so the plan was seen as a success.
items.zh: 市政府降低速限後,交通事故的死亡率下降了,所以這項計畫被視為成功。
items.sec: Public Health & Prevention 公共衛生與預防

items.def: the number of babies born in a period of time
items.s: Taiwan has one of the lowest ______ ______ in the world, so many primary schools have closed in recent years.
items.zh: 台灣是全世界出生率最低的地方之一,所以近年來許多小學已經關閉。
items.sec: Public Health & Prevention 公共衛生與預防

items.def: the number of babies who die before age one
items.s: ______ ______ has dropped sharply in the last fifty years, because more mothers give birth in hospitals.
items.zh: 過去五十年來嬰兒死亡率大幅下降,因為有更多母親在醫院生產。
items.sec: Public Health & Prevention 公共衛生與預防

items.def: intended to stop something bad from happening
items.s: ________ medicine saves money in the long run, because treating serious diseases is very expensive.
items.zh: 預防醫學長期來看能省錢,因為治療重大疾病非常昂貴。
items.sec: Public Health & Prevention 公共衛生與預防

items.def: finding a disease at an early stage
items.s: ______ ______ of breast cancer saves many lives, so women over forty-five are offered free scans.
items.zh: 乳癌的早期發現能拯救許多生命,所以四十五歲以上的女性可以接受免費檢查。
items.sec: Public Health & Prevention 公共衛生與預防

items.def: a quick test that gives results in minutes
items.s: I took a ______ ______ at home before visiting my grandmother, because I did not want to give her the virus.
items.zh: 去探望奶奶之前我在家做了快篩,因為我不想把病毒傳給她。
items.sec: Public Health & Prevention 公共衛生與預防

items.def: choosing food that is good for your body
items.s: Our school promotes ______ ______, so the canteen now serves more vegetables and fewer fried foods.
items.zh: 我們學校推廣健康飲食,所以餐廳現在供應更多蔬菜、更少油炸食物。
items.sec: Healthy Lifestyle & Wellness 健康生活型態

items.def: movement of the body, such as walking or sport
items.s: Children need at least an hour of ______ ______ every day, but many spend most of their free time on phones.
items.zh: 孩子每天至少需要一小時的身體活動,但許多人把大部分空閒時間花在手機上。
items.sec: Healthy Lifestyle & Wellness 健康生活型態

items.def: heavier than is healthy
items.s: The doctor told my uncle that he was ________, so he started walking to work instead of driving.
items.zh: 醫生告訴我叔叔他體重過重,所以他開始走路上班而不是開車。
items.sec: Healthy Lifestyle & Wellness 健康生活型態

items.def: lighter than is healthy
items.s: Some teenage girls are ________ because they eat too little, so the school nurse talks to them about healthy meals.
items.zh: 有些少女因為吃得太少而體重過輕,所以學校護理師會和她們談健康的飲食。
items.sec: Healthy Lifestyle & Wellness 健康生活型態

items.def: a number based on weight and height used to judge health
items.s: Your ______ ______ ______ is calculated from your height and weight, but it does not show how much muscle you have.
items.zh: 你的身體質量指數是由身高和體重計算出來的,但它無法顯示你有多少肌肉。
items.sec: Healthy Lifestyle & Wellness 健康生活型態

items.def: the size of the middle of your body
items.s: Doctors say a large ________ is a warning sign, because fat around the stomach is linked to heart disease.
items.zh: 醫生說腰圍過大是一個警訊,因為腹部脂肪與心臟病有關。
items.sec: Healthy Lifestyle & Wellness 健康生活型態

items.def: quick, cheap food such as burgers and fries
items.s: Eating ______ ______ every day is bad for your health, but it is popular because it is quick and cheap.
items.zh: 每天吃速食對健康不好,但它因為又快又便宜而很受歡迎。
items.sec: Healthy Lifestyle & Wellness 健康生活型態

items.def: the amount of food served to one person
items.s: ______ ______ in restaurants have grown over the years, so many people eat more than they really need.
items.zh: 多年來餐廳的份量越來越大,所以許多人吃得比實際需要的更多。
items.sec: Healthy Lifestyle & Wellness 健康生活型態

items.def: a white substance used to flavour food
items.s: Instant noodles contain a lot of ________, so you should not drink all the soup if you have high blood pressure.
items.zh: 泡麵含有大量的鹽,所以如果你有高血壓,就不應該把湯喝光。
items.sec: Healthy Lifestyle & Wellness 健康生活型態

items.def: not getting enough sleep
items.s: Many high school students suffer from ______ ______, because they study late and use their phones in bed.
items.zh: 許多高中生睡眠不足,因為他們讀書讀到很晚,又在床上滑手機。
items.sec: Healthy Lifestyle & Wellness 健康生活型態

items.def: the time when you usually go to bed
items.s: Experts say you should stop using screens an hour before ________, or you may find it hard to fall asleep.
items.zh: 專家說你應該在就寢時間前一小時停止使用螢幕,否則可能難以入睡。
items.sec: Healthy Lifestyle & Wellness 健康生活型態

items.def: the number of steps you walk in a day
items.s: My father checks his ______ ______ every evening, and he takes a walk if it is under eight thousand.
items.zh: 我爸爸每天晚上都會查看他的步數,如果不到八千步他就會出去散步。
items.sec: Healthy Lifestyle & Wellness 健康生活型態

items.def: a slow Chinese exercise of gentle movements
items.s: Every morning a group of seniors practise ______ ______ in the park, because it improves balance and calms the mind.
items.zh: 每天早上一群長者在公園練太極拳,因為它能改善平衡感並讓心情平靜。
items.sec: Healthy Lifestyle & Wellness 健康生活型態

items.def: a phone program that tracks your health
items.s: I use a ______ ______ to record how much water I drink, and it reminds me when I forget.
items.zh: 我用一個健康應用程式記錄我喝了多少水,我忘記時它會提醒我。
items.sec: Healthy Lifestyle & Wellness 健康生活型態

items.def: a watch that works like a small computer
items.s: My mother's ________ measures her heart rate while she sleeps, so she knows how well she rested.
items.zh: 我媽媽的智慧手錶會在她睡覺時測量心率,所以她知道自己休息得好不好。
items.sec: Healthy Lifestyle & Wellness 健康生活型態

items.def: the health of a person's mind and feelings
items.s: Our school now has a counsellor for ______ ______, because many students feel worried about exams.
items.zh: 我們學校現在有一位負責心理健康的輔導老師,因為許多學生對考試感到焦慮。
items.sec: Healthy Lifestyle & Wellness 健康生活型態

items.def: a cream that protects skin from the sun
items.s: Put on ________ before you go to the beach, or your skin may burn badly in the strong sun.
items.zh: 去海灘前要先擦防曬乳,否則你的皮膚可能在強烈的陽光下嚴重曬傷。
items.sec: Healthy Lifestyle & Wellness 健康生活型態

items.def: a doctor who looks after teeth
items.s: I visit the ________ every six months, so any small problems with my teeth can be fixed early.
items.zh: 我每六個月去看一次牙醫,所以牙齒的小問題都能及早處理。
items.sec: Healthy Lifestyle & Wellness 健康生活型態

items.def: relating to teeth
items.s: Good ________ health starts in childhood, so parents should help young children brush their teeth.
items.zh: 良好的牙齒健康從童年開始,所以父母應該幫小孩刷牙。
items.sec: Healthy Lifestyle & Wellness 健康生活型態

items.def: a pain in a tooth
items.s: I had a terrible ________ during the holiday, but all the dental clinics were closed.
items.zh: 假期中我牙痛得很厲害,但所有的牙科診所都休診了。
items.sec: Healthy Lifestyle & Wellness 健康生活型態

items.def: a hole in a tooth caused by decay
items.s: The dentist found two ________ in my teeth, because I drink too many sweet drinks.
items.zh: 牙醫在我的牙齒上發現兩顆蛀牙,因為我喝了太多含糖飲料。
items.sec: Healthy Lifestyle & Wellness 健康生活型態

items.def: to clean between your teeth with a thin thread
items.s: You should ________ every night before bed, because a toothbrush cannot reach between your teeth.
items.zh: 你應該每晚睡前用牙線清潔,因為牙刷刷不到牙齒之間的縫隙。
items.sec: Healthy Lifestyle & Wellness 健康生活型態

items.def: the ability to see
items.s: Too much screen time can harm your ________, so look at something far away every thirty minutes.
items.zh: 過長的螢幕時間會傷害你的視力,所以每三十分鐘要看看遠方。
items.sec: Healthy Lifestyle & Wellness 健康生活型態

items.def: able to see near things clearly but not far things
items.s: More than eighty percent of high school students in Taiwan are ________, so glasses are very common in class.
items.zh: 台灣超過百分之八十的高中生近視,所以教室裡戴眼鏡的人非常普遍。
items.sec: Healthy Lifestyle & Wellness 健康生活型態

items.def: the condition of being unable to see far things clearly
items.s: Doctors believe that playing outdoors can slow ________ in children, so schools encourage outdoor lessons.
items.zh: 醫生認為戶外活動可以減緩兒童的近視,所以學校鼓勵在戶外上課。
items.sec: Healthy Lifestyle & Wellness 健康生活型態

items.def: a reduced ability to hear
items.s: Listening to loud music with earphones can cause ______ ______, so keep the volume below sixty percent.
items.zh: 用耳機聽大聲的音樂可能造成聽力損失,所以音量要保持在百分之六十以下。
items.sec: Healthy Lifestyle & Wellness 健康生活型態

items.def: to stop doing something, such as smoking
items.s: My grandfather finally ________ smoking at seventy, and he says he can now climb stairs without stopping.
items.zh: 我爺爺七十歲時終於戒菸了,他說現在爬樓梯都不用停下來休息。
items.sec: Healthy Lifestyle & Wellness 健康生活型態

items.def: careful about doing things that are good for your health
items.s: More ________ customers are choosing drinks with less sugar, so shops have added new options.
items.zh: 越來越多注重健康的顧客選擇少糖飲料,所以店家增加了新的選項。
items.sec: Healthy Lifestyle & Wellness 健康生活型態

items.def: made at home rather than bought
items.s: ________ meals usually contain less oil and salt, so my mother cooks dinner even when she is busy.
items.zh: 自己煮的飯菜通常油和鹽都比較少,所以我媽媽即使很忙也會煮晚餐。
items.sec: Healthy Lifestyle & Wellness 健康生活型態

items.def: a strong need to keep doing or using something harmful
items.s: Phone ________ is a growing problem among teenagers, so some schools ask students to leave their phones in lockers.
items.zh: 手機成癮在青少年中是日益嚴重的問題,所以有些學校要求學生把手機放在置物櫃裡。
items.sec: Healthy Lifestyle & Wellness 健康生活型態

items.def: the time of life when you are an adult
items.s: Habits that start in childhood often continue into ________, so it is important to teach children to exercise.
items.zh: 童年養成的習慣常會延續到成年期,所以教孩子運動很重要。

items.def: something that causes pain or suffering
items.s: Back pain is a common ________ among office workers, because they sit at their desks for hours.
items.zh: 背痛是上班族常見的病痛,因為他們在辦公桌前一坐就是好幾個小時。

items.def: a minor illness
items.s: The pharmacist can help with small ________ like colds and headaches, so you do not always need to see a doctor.
items.zh: 藥劑師可以幫忙處理感冒和頭痛這類小病,所以你不一定都要去看醫生。

items.def: money given regularly for a special purpose
items.s: Families who look after a disabled relative can get a monthly ________, but the forms are complicated.
items.zh: 照顧失能親人的家庭可以領取每月津貼,但申請表格很複雜。

items.def: worry about something that may happen
items.s: Many patients feel some ________ before surgery, so the nurses explain every step to calm them.
items.zh: 許多病人在手術前會感到些許憂慮,所以護理師會解釋每個步驟來安撫他們。

items.def: harm or damage
items.s: He worked long hours to the ________ of his health, and in the end he became seriously ill.
items.zh: 他長時間工作,對健康造成損害,最後他病得很重。

items.def: a condition that limits a person's movement or senses
items.s: Buildings should be designed for people with a ________, so ramps and wide doors are now required.
items.zh: 建築物應該為身心障礙人士設計,所以現在規定要有坡道和寬門。

items.def: a feeling of mild pain or being uncomfortable
items.s: You may feel some ________ after the injection, but it usually disappears within a day.
items.zh: 注射後你可能會感到些許不適,但通常一天內就會消失。

items.def: the feeling of not being happy with something
items.s: There is growing ________ with long waiting times, so the hospital is hiring more doctors.
items.zh: 民眾對漫長的等候時間越來越不滿,所以醫院正在招募更多醫生。

items.def: how long something is expected to last
items.s: Life ________ in Taiwan is now over eighty years, but people often spend their last years in poor health.
items.zh: 台灣的預期壽命現在已超過八十歲,但人們往往在健康不佳中度過最後幾年。

items.def: a death caused by an accident or disease
items.s: The new road safety rules reduced traffic ________ by twenty percent, and fewer families lost loved ones.
items.zh: 新的道路安全規定讓交通死亡人數減少了百分之二十,失去親人的家庭也變少了。

items.def: the quality of being weak and easily broken
items.s: The pandemic showed the ________ of the health system, because hospitals quickly ran out of beds.
items.zh: 疫情顯示出醫療體系的脆弱,因為醫院很快就沒有病床了。

items.def: physical or mental weakness, especially from old age
items.s: Despite the ________ of old age, my great-grandmother still insists on cooking her own meals, and she refuses any help.
items.zh: 儘管年老體弱,我曾祖母仍堅持自己煮飯,而且拒絕任何幫忙。

items.def: the rate of illness in a population
items.s: Air pollution increases ________ in big cities, so more people visit doctors for breathing problems.
items.zh: 空氣污染提高了大城市的罹病率,所以更多人因呼吸問題去看醫生。

items.def: something that you need
items.s: For older people living alone, a phone that calls for help is a ________, not a luxury, so many families buy one for their grandparents.
items.zh: 對獨居長者來說,一支能求救的電話是必需品,而不是奢侈品,所以許多家庭會為祖父母買一支。

items.def: failure to take proper care
items.s: The family sued the hospital for ________, because the nurse gave the patient the wrong medicine.
items.zh: 那家人控告醫院疏失,因為護理師給病人用錯了藥。

items.def: stopping something bad from happening
items.s: The ________ of diabetes is cheaper than treatment, so the government pays for free health checks.
items.zh: 預防糖尿病比治療便宜,所以政府支付免費健康檢查的費用。

items.def: a period when a serious illness becomes less severe
items.s: After a year of treatment, her cancer is in ________, but she still has regular check-ups.
items.zh: 經過一年的治療,她的癌症已進入緩解期,但她仍然定期回診檢查。

items.def: the ability to continue for a long time
items.s: Experts question the ________ of the health insurance system, because costs are rising every year.
items.zh: 專家質疑健保制度的永續性,因為成本每年都在上升。

items.def: the state of needing something or someone too much
items.s: Doctors try to avoid long-term ________ on sleeping pills, so they suggest other ways to improve sleep.
items.zh: 醫生盡量避免病人長期依賴安眠藥,所以會建議其他改善睡眠的方法。

items.def: making information known
items.s: The law requires the ________ of side effects, so every medicine box contains a long information sheet.
items.zh: 法律規定必須揭露副作用,所以每盒藥裡都附有一張很長的說明書。

items.def: public support or approval
items.s: The new exercise programme received an ________ from the health ministry, so many schools adopted it.
items.zh: 這項新的運動計畫獲得衛福部的背書,所以許多學校採用了它。

items.def: the act of officially joining a programme
items.s: ________ in the free flu vaccine programme begins in October, and seniors can sign up at any clinic.
items.zh: 免費流感疫苗計畫的登記從十月開始,長者可以在任何診所報名。

items.def: the act of making a problem worse
items.s: Cold weather often causes an ________ of asthma, so patients should keep warm in winter.
items.zh: 寒冷的天氣常導致氣喘惡化,所以病人冬天應該注意保暖。

items.def: the state of not being good enough
items.s: The report pointed out the ________ of mental health services in rural areas, because few counsellors work there.
items.zh: 報告指出鄉村地區心理健康服務的不足,因為那裡很少有輔導人員。

items.def: the inability to do something
items.s: Because of his ________ to walk after the accident, he had to stop working for six months.
items.zh: 由於車禍後他無法行走,他必須停止工作六個月。

items.def: the failure to use time or money well
items.s: Paper records caused great ________ in hospitals, so most of them now use computer systems.
items.zh: 紙本病歷造成醫院嚴重的效率不彰,所以現在大多數醫院都改用電腦系統。

items.def: the inability of the body to accept certain food or drugs
items.s: My friend has a lactose ________, so she drinks soy milk instead of cow's milk.
items.zh: 我朋友有乳糖不耐症,所以她喝豆漿而不是牛奶。

items.def: the state of being normal
items.s: After two years of the pandemic, life slowly returned to ________, and people travelled abroad again.
items.zh: 經過兩年的疫情,生活慢慢恢復常態,人們又開始出國旅行。

items.def: taking part in an activity
items.s: ________ in the free health check was low, so the city sent buses to take villagers to the clinic.
items.zh: 免費健康檢查的參與率很低,所以市政府派巴士載村民去診所。

items.def: something that is more important than other things
items.s: Protecting older people was the government's top ________, so they received the vaccine before everyone else.
items.zh: 保護長者是政府的首要優先事項,所以他們比其他人都先接種疫苗。

items.def: a person or company that supplies a service
items.s: The insurance company works with many health care ________, so patients can choose their own clinic.
items.zh: 這家保險公司與許多醫療照護提供者合作,所以病人可以自己選擇診所。

items.def: words that make someone feel less worried
items.s: The worried mother needed ________ from the doctor, so he explained that the fever was not serious.
items.zh: 那位擔心的母親需要醫生的寬慰,所以他解釋發燒並不嚴重。

items.def: a person who receives something
items.s: The kidney ________ wrote a thank-you letter to the donor's family, and she said he had given her a new life.
items.zh: 那位腎臟受贈者寫了一封感謝信給捐贈者的家人,她說他給了她新的生命。

items.def: a suggestion about what should be done
items.s: The doctor's ________ was to walk for thirty minutes a day, and my father has followed it carefully.
items.zh: 醫生的建議是每天走路三十分鐘,我爸爸一直認真遵守。

items.def: a decrease in size or amount
items.s: The new law led to a large ________ in smoking, so fewer people now suffer from lung disease.
items.zh: 新法律使吸菸人口大幅減少,所以現在罹患肺病的人變少了。

items.def: money paid back to someone
items.s: You can apply for ________ of your medical costs, but you must keep all the receipts.
items.zh: 你可以申請醫療費用的給付,但必須保留所有收據。

items.def: the act of making something valid again
items.s: My grandfather's driving licence ________ required an eye test, because he is now over seventy-five years old.
items.zh: 我爺爺的駕照更新需要做視力檢查,因為他已經超過七十五歲。

items.def: the ability of germs to survive a drug
items.s: Taking antibiotics too often can lead to ________, so the medicine may not work when you really need it.
items.zh: 太常服用抗生素會導致抗藥性,所以當你真正需要時藥可能就沒效了。

items.def: stopping something for a period of time
items.s: The hospital announced the ________ of visits during the outbreak, so families talked to patients by video.
items.zh: 醫院宣布疫情期間暫停探病,所以家屬透過視訊和病人交談。

items.def: the state of having a lot of money
items.s: Growing ________ has changed people's diets, so diseases like diabetes have become much more common in Asia.
items.zh: 日益富裕改變了人們的飲食,所以像糖尿病這樣的疾病在亞洲變得更加普遍。

items.def: a new medical problem that makes an illness worse
items.s: The operation went well, but a ________ developed afterwards, so she stayed in hospital longer.
items.zh: 手術很順利,但術後出現了併發症,所以她在醫院待得比較久。

items.def: an illness of the mind or body
items.s: He was diagnosed with a sleep ________, so he now sleeps with a machine that helps him breathe.
items.zh: 他被診斷出睡眠障礙,所以他現在睡覺時使用一台幫助呼吸的機器。

items.def: a problem that stops something from continuing normally
items.s: The typhoon caused serious ________ to hospital services, and some operations had to be cancelled.
items.zh: 颱風對醫院服務造成嚴重中斷,有些手術必須取消。

items.def: unfairness
items.s: There is clear ________ in access to doctors, because rural towns have far fewer clinics than cities.
items.zh: 在就醫機會上存在明顯的不公平,因為鄉鎮的診所遠少於城市。

items.def: a level of quality
items.s: The ________ of care in this nursing home is very high, so there is a long waiting list.
items.zh: 這間護理之家的照護水準非常高,所以候補名單很長。

items.def: the act of agreeing to or believing in something
items.s: Public ________ of the new vaccine was slow at first, but it grew as more people got it safely.
items.zh: 大眾對新疫苗的接受度一開始很低,但隨著越來越多人安全接種而逐漸提高。

items.def: a situation in which people share the same opinion
items.s: There is general ________ among doctors that sugary drinks harm children, so schools no longer sell them.
items.zh: 醫生們普遍同意含糖飲料對孩子有害,所以學校不再販售它們。

items.def: official permission
items.s: The new drug needs government ________ before doctors can use it, so testing may take several years.
items.zh: 新藥需要政府核准醫生才能使用,所以測試可能要花好幾年。

items.def: the beginning of something
items.s: Patients must stop eating twelve hours before the ________ of the operation, or it will be delayed.
items.zh: 病人必須在手術開始前十二小時禁食,否則手術會延後。

items.def: keeping information private
items.s: Doctors must respect patient ________, so they cannot share your health information without your permission.
items.zh: 醫生必須遵守病人資料保密,所以他們不能未經允許分享你的健康資訊。

items.def: the act of carrying on with something
items.s: The ________ of the free school lunch programme depends on next year's budget, so parents are worried.
items.zh: 免費營養午餐計畫能否延續取決於明年的預算,所以家長們很擔心。

items.def: a reduction in amount or number
items.s: There has been a steady ________ in smoking among teenagers, and experts credit the higher prices.
items.zh: 青少年吸菸人數持續下降,專家認為這要歸功於價格上漲。

items.def: the act of providing a service
items.s: The ________ of health services in mountain areas is difficult, so doctors sometimes travel by helicopter.
items.zh: 在山區提供醫療服務很困難,所以醫生有時要搭直升機前往。

items.def: making sure a law is obeyed
items.s: Stricter ________ of the smoking ban means that shops selling to teenagers now face large fines, so fewer teenagers can buy cigarettes.
items.zh: 更嚴格地執行禁菸令意味著販售給青少年的商店現在會面臨高額罰款,所以能買到香菸的青少年變少了。

items.def: the act of starting an organisation
items.s: The ________ of a new hospital in the town means residents no longer have to travel two hours for treatment, so the whole town celebrated.
items.zh: 鎮上設立了一間新醫院,這表示居民不必再花兩小時去看病,所以全鎮都在慶祝。

items.def: a building or place for a particular purpose
items.s: The new care ________ has a garden and a gym, so residents can stay active every day.
items.zh: 新的照護設施有花園和健身房,所以住民每天都能保持活動。

items.def: a feeling of happiness from doing something useful
items.s: Many retirees find ________ in volunteer work, and studies show that they also tend to live longer.
items.zh: 許多退休人士在志工工作中找到成就感,研究也顯示他們往往活得更久。

items.def: the way an organisation is controlled and managed
items.s: Poor ________ at the hospital led to serious mistakes, so the director was replaced last month.
items.zh: 醫院治理不善導致嚴重錯誤,所以院長上個月被撤換了。

items.def: a small increase
items.s: The dose is raised in small ________ each week, so the body has time to get used to the medicine.
items.zh: 劑量每週以小幅增量提高,讓身體有時間適應藥物。

items.def: a company that provides insurance
items.s: My ________ refused to pay for the treatment, because they said it was only for beauty, not health.
items.zh: 我的保險公司拒絕給付這項治療,因為他們說這只是為了美容,不是為了健康。

items.def: a reason for not agreeing
items.s: Some parents raised an ________ to the new vaccine rule, but most families supported it.
items.zh: 有些家長對新的疫苗規定提出異議,但大多數家庭都支持。

items.def: something that must happen before something else
items.s: Good sleep is a ________ for good health, so doctors ask about sleep at every check-up.
items.zh: 良好的睡眠是健康的先決條件,所以醫生每次檢查都會詢問睡眠情況。

items.def: the state of being prepared
items.s: The drill tested the hospital's ________ for a major earthquake, and the staff responded quickly.
items.zh: 這次演習測試了醫院對大地震的準備程度,工作人員反應迅速。

items.def: saying no to something
items.s: His ________ to take the medicine worried his family, so they asked the doctor to talk to him.
items.zh: 他拒絕吃藥讓家人很擔心,所以他們請醫生和他談談。

items.def: a new part that takes the place of an old one
items.s: My grandmother had a knee ________ last spring, and now she can walk to the market without pain.
items.zh: 我奶奶去年春天做了膝關節置換手術,現在她走路去市場都不會痛了。

items.def: to cause pain or suffering to someone
items.s: Back problems ________ millions of office workers, so many companies now buy standing desks for their staff.
items.zh: 背部問題折磨著數百萬上班族,所以許多公司現在為員工購買站立式辦公桌。

items.def: to make something last longer
items.s: Regular exercise can ________ your healthy years, so it is never too late to start moving.
items.zh: 規律運動可以延長你的健康年歲,所以開始動起來永遠不嫌晚。

items.def: to pay part of the cost of something
items.s: The government will ________ hearing aids for older people, so they will cost much less.
items.zh: 政府將補助長者購買助聽器,所以價格會便宜很多。

items.def: to pay back money someone has spent
items.s: The company will ________ the cost of your health check, but you must send the receipt within a month.
items.zh: 公司會給付你的健檢費用,但你必須在一個月內寄回收據。

items.def: to give someone or something too much work
items.s: The flu outbreak may ________ local hospitals, so people with mild symptoms should stay at home.
items.zh: 流感爆發可能會使地方醫院負擔過重,所以症狀輕微的人應該待在家裡。

items.def: to become worse
items.s: His cough began to ________ after a week, so he finally went to the doctor.
items.zh: 一週後他的咳嗽開始惡化,所以他終於去看醫生了。

items.def: to make a system try to do more than it can
items.s: Too many patients can ________ a small hospital, and then the quality of care drops.
items.zh: 太多病人可能會使一間小醫院不堪負荷,接著照護品質就會下降。

items.def: to put someone in danger
items.s: Driving after taking strong cold medicine can ________ other road users, because it makes you sleepy.
items.zh: 服用強效感冒藥後開車可能危及其他用路人,因為它會讓你想睡。

items.def: to stop something from happening
items.s: Washing your hands often can ________ many infections, so teachers remind students to do it before lunch.
items.zh: 經常洗手可以預防許多感染,所以老師會在午餐前提醒學生洗手。

items.def: to advise that something should be done
items.s: Doctors ________ at least seven hours of sleep a night, but many teenagers get much less.
items.zh: 醫生建議每晚至少睡七個小時,但許多青少年睡得少得多。

items.def: to make something smaller or less
items.s: Eating more vegetables can ________ the risk of heart disease, so try to fill half your plate with them.
items.zh: 多吃蔬菜可以降低罹患心臟病的風險,所以試著讓蔬菜佔你餐盤的一半。

items.def: to protect someone from disease, usually with a vaccine
items.s: The programme aims to ________ every child against measles, so nurses visit even remote villages.
items.zh: 這項計畫的目標是為每個孩子接種麻疹疫苗,所以護理師連偏遠村莊都會前往。

items.def: to help
items.s: Volunteers ________ older patients at the hospital entrance, and they show them where to register.
items.zh: 志工在醫院入口協助年長病人,並告訴他們在哪裡掛號。

items.def: to make something shorter
items.s: Smoking can ________ your life by ten years, but quitting at any age brings real benefits.
items.zh: 吸菸可能縮短你十年的壽命,但任何年紀戒菸都能帶來實際的好處。

items.def: to watch over someone to make sure they act correctly
items.s: A senior doctor must ________ new doctors during their first year, so patients stay safe.
items.zh: 資深醫師必須在新進醫師第一年期間督導他們,以確保病人安全。

items.def: to stop developing or growing
items.s: Life expectancy began to ________ in some countries, and experts blamed poor diets and stress.
items.zh: 某些國家的平均壽命開始停滯,專家將原因歸咎於不良飲食和壓力。

items.def: to increase very quickly
items.s: The price of face masks began to ________ at the start of the pandemic, so the government set a fixed price.
items.zh: 疫情剛開始時口罩價格開始飆升,所以政府訂定了固定價格。

items.def: to reduce something by half
items.s: Regular exercise can ________ the risk of some diseases, so it is one of the best medicines we have.
items.zh: 規律運動可以使某些疾病的風險減半,所以它是我們擁有的最好的藥之一。

items.def: to send someone to hospital for treatment
items.s: More than one hundred children were ________ with flu last month, so schools were asked to clean classrooms daily.
items.zh: 上個月有一百多名兒童因流感住院,所以學校被要求每天清潔教室。

items.def: to give advice to someone about their problems
items.s: Nurses ________ new mothers on how to feed their babies, and they also visit them at home.
items.zh: 護理師輔導新手媽媽如何餵養嬰兒,也會到家裡訪視她們。

items.def: to tell someone facts
items.s: Doctors must ________ patients about the risks of an operation, so they can make a careful decision.
items.zh: 醫生必須告知病人手術的風險,讓他們能審慎做決定。

items.def: producing the result that you want
items.s: The new flu vaccine is very ________, so doctors expect far fewer hospital visits this winter.
items.zh: 新的流感疫苗非常有效,所以醫生預期今年冬天就醫人數會少很多。

items.def: ill or in a weak condition
items.s: She moved back to her hometown to look after her ________ mother, and she found a part-time job nearby.
items.zh: 她搬回家鄉照顧生病的母親,並在附近找了一份兼職工作。

items.def: showing kindness and care for people who suffer
items.s: Patients love Dr. Lin because she is so ________, and she always takes time to listen.
items.zh: 病人們很喜歡林醫師,因為她非常有同情心,總是花時間傾聽。

items.def: very serious and dangerous
items.s: The injured driver was in a ________ condition, so he was taken straight to the operating theatre.
items.zh: 受傷的駕駛情況危急,所以被直接送進手術室。

items.def: not working normally or properly
items.s: Critics say the ________ system wastes money, because patients see several doctors for the same problem.
items.zh: 批評者說這個運作不良的制度浪費金錢,因為病人為了同一個問題看好幾位醫生。

items.def: increasing quickly
items.s: The ________ cost of medicine worries many families, so they are asking the government for help.
items.zh: 不斷升高的藥價讓許多家庭擔憂,所以他們向政府請求協助。

items.def: very weak
items.s: After weeks in bed, my grandfather felt ________, so a physiotherapist helped him walk again.
items.zh: 臥床幾週後,我爺爺覺得很虛弱,所以一位物理治療師幫助他重新走路。

items.def: clean and free of germs
items.s: The night market stall looks ________, because the cook wears gloves and covers all the food.
items.zh: 這個夜市攤位看起來很衛生,因為廚師戴著手套並把所有食物都蓋起來。

items.def: not doing much physical activity
items.s: People who stay ________ for long periods lose muscle quickly, so even short walks can help.
items.zh: 長時間缺乏活動的人肌肉流失很快,所以即使短距離散步也有幫助。

items.def: able to cause death
items.s: A peanut allergy can be ________, so Mia always carries an emergency pen in her bag.
items.zh: 花生過敏可能危及生命,所以米亞總是在包包裡帶著緊急注射筆。

items.def: (of a tumour) dangerous and likely to spread
items.s: The doctor was relieved that the lump was not ________, so the patient did not need cancer treatment.
items.zh: 醫生鬆了一口氣,因為那個腫塊不是惡性的,所以病人不需要接受癌症治療。

items.def: not serious or strong
items.s: Most people with the virus have only ________ symptoms, but older people may become very ill.
items.zh: 大多數感染病毒的人只有輕微的症狀,但長者可能會病得很重。

items.def: relating to the food you need to be healthy
items.s: The school lunch must meet ________ standards, so a dietitian plans the menu every month.
items.zh: 學校午餐必須符合營養標準,所以營養師每個月都會規劃菜單。

items.def: very overweight in a way that is unhealthy
items.s: The number of ________ children has increased, so schools now offer more after-school sports clubs.
items.zh: 肥胖兒童的人數增加了,所以學校現在提供更多課後運動社團。

items.def: having too much work or too many problems
items.s: ________ nurses often quit their jobs, so the hospital is trying to reduce their working hours.
items.zh: 負擔過重的護理師常常辭職,所以醫院正試著縮短她們的工時。

items.def: having too much to do with too few resources
items.s: The emergency room was ________ during the holiday, and some patients waited more than six hours to see a doctor.
items.zh: 假期期間急診室不堪負荷,有些病人等了超過六個小時才看到醫生。

items.def: relating to how the body works
items.s: Stress causes ________ changes like a faster heartbeat, so it can affect your health over time.
items.zh: 壓力會引起心跳加快等生理變化,所以長期下來會影響你的健康。

items.def: done to avoid possible danger
items.s: As a ________ measure, the school closed for two days, although only three students were sick.
items.zh: 作為防範措施,學校停課兩天,儘管只有三名學生生病。

items.def: helping someone return to normal life after illness
items.s: After the stroke, he joined a ________ programme, and he can now use his right hand again.
items.zh: 中風後他參加了一項復健計畫,現在他的右手又能使用了。

items.def: clean and not likely to cause disease
items.s: Poor ________ conditions in the camp led to an outbreak of disease, so aid groups sent clean water.
items.zh: 營區衛生條件差導致疾病爆發,所以救援團體送來了乾淨的水。

items.def: partly paid for by the government
items.s: Seniors can join ________ exercise classes at the community centre, so each lesson costs only fifty dollars.
items.zh: 長者可以參加社區中心受補助的運動課程,所以每堂課只要五十元。

items.def: (of an illness) leading to death
items.s: When her father was diagnosed with ________ cancer, she took leave from work to spend time with him.
items.zh: 當她父親被診斷出末期癌症時,她向公司請假陪伴他。

items.def: bad for your health
items.s: Many convenience store snacks are ________, so I try to bring fruit to school instead.
items.zh: 許多便利商店的零食都不健康,所以我盡量改帶水果到學校。

items.def: dirty and likely to spread disease
items.s: The restaurant kitchen was so ________ that inspectors closed it, and its regular customers were shocked by the news.
items.zh: 那家餐廳的廚房非常不衛生,所以稽查員勒令它停業,常客們聽到消息都很震驚。

items.def: not given medical care
items.s: If high blood pressure is left ________, it can lead to a stroke, so regular checks are important.
items.zh: 如果高血壓未經治療,可能導致中風,所以定期檢查很重要。

items.def: relating to the treatment of patients
items.s: The nursing students spend their final year in ________ training, so they learn by working with real patients.
items.zh: 護理系學生在最後一年進行臨床訓練,所以他們透過照顧真正的病人來學習。

items.def: able to be cured
items.s: Many types of cancer are ________ if they are found early, so regular screening saves lives.
items.zh: 許多類型的癌症若及早發現是可治癒的,所以定期篩檢能救命。

items.def: able to be treated with medicine or therapy
items.s: Depression is a ________ illness, so people who feel low for weeks should ask for help.
items.zh: 憂鬱症是一種可治療的疾病,所以情緒低落好幾週的人應該尋求協助。

items.def: not needing to cut or enter the body
items.s: The new scan is ________, so patients can go home right after it without any pain.
items.zh: 這種新的掃描是非侵入性的,所以病人做完後馬上就能回家,也不會痛。

items.def: not given enough money
items.s: Mental health services are ________ in many countries, so patients wait several months for professional help.
items.zh: 許多國家的心理健康服務資金不足,所以病人要等好幾個月才能得到專業協助。

items.def: not satisfied or provided
items.s: There is a large ________ need for dental care in rural areas, because few dentists want to work there.
items.zh: 鄉村地區有大量未被滿足的牙科照護需求,因為很少牙醫願意在那裡工作。

items.def: too expensive to pay for
items.s: The new medicine is ________ for most families, so doctors hope insurance will cover it soon.
items.zh: 這種新藥對大多數家庭來說是負擔不起的,所以醫生希望保險很快能給付。

items.def: done without choosing to
items.s: Sneezing is an ________ action, so you cannot stop it, but you can cover your mouth.
items.zh: 打噴嚏是一種不自主的動作,所以你無法阻止它,但你可以遮住嘴巴。

items.def: lasting only a short time
items.s: The benefits of crash diets are ________, because most people regain the weight within a year.
