items.zh: 速成節食的效果是短暫的,因為大多數人一年內就會復胖。

items.def: continuing for a long time
items.s: Good habits that you build as a teenager have ________ effects, so start exercising regularly while you are young.
items.zh: 青少年時期養成的好習慣有持久的效果,所以趁年輕開始規律運動吧。

items.def: happening in all parts of a country
items.s: The government launched a ________ campaign against smoking, and adverts appeared on every TV channel.
items.zh: 政府發起了一項全國性的反菸運動,每個電視頻道都出現了廣告。

items.def: happening all over the world
items.s: The ________ spread of the virus shocked everyone, because it reached almost every country within months.
items.zh: 病毒在全世界的擴散震驚了所有人,因為它在幾個月內就傳到了幾乎每個國家。

items.def: happening quickly and unexpectedly
items.s: A ________ pain in the chest can be a sign of a heart attack, so call an ambulance immediately.
items.zh: 胸口突然的疼痛可能是心臟病發作的徵兆,所以要立即叫救護車。

items.def: developing gradually and evenly
items.s: There has been a ________ rise in the number of people over eighty, so more care homes are needed.
items.zh: 八十歲以上的人數持續增加,所以需要更多照護機構。

items.def: small in degree
items.s: I had a ________ headache after the vaccine, but it went away after a short nap.
items.zh: 打完疫苗後我有輕微的頭痛,但小睡一下就好了。

items.def: that you can choose to do or not
items.s: The flu vaccine is ________ for students, but the school strongly encourages everyone to get it.
items.zh: 流感疫苗對學生來說是自由選擇的,但學校強烈鼓勵每個人都去接種。

items.def: well enough
items.s: Many older people do not drink ________ in summer, so they can become ill in the heat.
items.zh: 許多長者夏天沒有充分地喝水,所以在炎熱中可能會生病。

items.def: in a way that causes worry
items.s: The number of children with myopia is ________ high, so doctors want students to spend more time outdoors.
items.zh: 近視兒童的人數高得令人擔憂,所以醫生希望學生多花時間在戶外。

items.def: for a long time and not easily cured
items.s: ________ ill patients often visit the hospital every month, so they get to know the nurses well.
items.zh: 長期患病的病人常常每個月都去醫院,所以他們和護理師都很熟。

items.def: too much or too little compared with others
items.s: The heatwave ________ affected older people living alone, because many of them had no air-conditioning at home.
items.zh: 熱浪不成比例地影響了獨居長者,因為他們許多人家裡沒有冷氣。

items.def: in a fair way
items.s: The vaccines should be shared ________ between rich and poor countries, but this did not always happen.
items.zh: 疫苗應該在富國和窮國之間公平地分配,但這並非總是如此。

items.def: to an average degree; not too much
items.s: Experts say you should exercise ________ most days, so a fast walk counts as good exercise.
items.zh: 專家說大多數日子你都應該適度地運動,所以快走也算是很好的運動。

items.def: very quickly
items.s: The virus spread ________ through the cruise ship, because passengers ate and danced together every night.
items.zh: 病毒在郵輪上迅速地傳播,因為乘客們每晚都一起用餐跳舞。

items.def: very badly or seriously
items.s: Several workers were ________ injured in the fire, and they were taken to three different hospitals.
items.zh: 好幾名工人在火災中嚴重受傷,他們被送往三間不同的醫院。

items.def: enough
items.s: If you do not sleep ________, your body cannot fight infections well, so you catch colds more often.
items.zh: 如果你睡得不夠,身體就無法有效對抗感染,所以你會更常感冒。

items.def: in a way that is not needed
items.s: Some patients visit the emergency room ________, so people who are really sick must wait longer.
items.zh: 有些病人不必要地跑急診,所以真正病重的人必須等更久。

items.def: as a normal part of a process
items.s: Babies are ________ checked for hearing problems after birth, so any issues can be treated early.
items.zh: 嬰兒出生後會例行接受聽力檢查,所以任何問題都能及早治療。

items.def: too early
items.s: Smoking makes your skin age ________, so many young smokers look older than they are.
items.zh: 吸菸會讓你的皮膚過早老化,所以許多年輕吸菸者看起來比實際年齡老。

items.def: by your own choice
items.s: Many people ________ stayed at home during the outbreak, although the government did not order a lockdown.
items.zh: 疫情爆發期間許多人自願待在家裡,雖然政府並沒有下令封城。

items.def: without help from others
items.s: The aim of rehabilitation is to help patients live ________, so they can cook and shop by themselves.
items.zh: 復健的目標是幫助病人獨立生活,讓他們能自己煮飯和購物。

items.def: in a way that relates to the body
items.s: My grandmother is still ________ strong at eighty, but she sometimes forgets the names of people she has met.
items.zh: 我奶奶八十歲了身體仍然很硬朗,但她有時會忘記見過的人的名字。

items.def: in a way that relates to medicine
items.s: The boy was declared ________ fit to play again, so he rejoined the team after three months.
items.zh: 那個男孩被判定醫學上已適合再度上場,所以三個月後他重返球隊。

items.def: according to medical tests or treatment
items.s: The cream has been ________ tested on thousands of people, so the company says it is safe.
items.zh: 這種乳霜已在數千人身上經過臨床測試,所以公司說它是安全的。

items.def: across the whole country
items.s: The health programme started in Taipei, but it will be offered ________ from next year.
items.zh: 這項健康計畫從台北開始,但明年起將在全國推行。

items.def: often and at even times
items.s: If you check your blood pressure ________, you can notice problems before they become serious.
items.zh: 如果你定期量血壓,就能在問題變嚴重前發現它們。

items.def: for a short time only
items.s: The clinic is ________ closed for repairs, so patients must go to the hospital until next month.
items.zh: 診所因整修暫時關閉,所以病人在下個月前必須到醫院就診。

items.def: for all time
items.s: Loud noise at work can ________ damage your hearing, so factory workers must wear ear protection.
items.zh: 工作場所的噪音可能永久地傷害你的聽力,所以工廠工人必須配戴護耳設備。

items.def: without anything in between
items.s: The new app sends test results ________ to your phone, so you do not need to return to the clinic.
items.zh: 新的應用程式會把檢驗結果直接傳到你的手機,所以你不必再回診所。

items.def: in a way that is easy to see
items.s: After a month of walking every day, my father looked ________ healthier, and he slept better too.
items.zh: 每天走路一個月後,我爸爸看起來明顯更健康了,睡得也更好。

items.def: a little
items.s: My temperature was ________ high this morning, so I stayed at home and rested all day.
items.zh: 我今天早上的體溫稍微偏高,所以我待在家休息一整天。

items.def: in a way that matches the size of something
items.s: As the number of patients grows, the number of nurses should increase ________, but this rarely happens.
items.zh: 隨著病人數量增加,護理師的人數應該按比例增加,但這很少發生。

items.def: in the best possible way
items.s: To work ________, the brain needs both sleep and water, so do not skip either before an exam.
items.zh: 大腦要最佳地運作,需要睡眠和水分,所以考試前兩者都不要省略。

items.def: in a way that does not waste time or money
items.s: The new booking system helps the clinic run more ________, so patients spend less time waiting.
items.zh: 新的預約系統幫助診所更有效率地運作,所以病人等待的時間減少了。

items.def: at a price people can pay
items.s: The charity provides glasses ________ to poor families, and some children can read the board for the first time.
items.zh: 這個慈善團體以合理的價格為貧困家庭提供眼鏡,有些孩子第一次能看清黑板。

items.def: continuing for a long time
items.s: If you feel ________ tired for weeks, you should see a doctor, because it may be a sign of illness.
items.zh: 如果你連續幾週持續感到疲倦,應該去看醫生,因為那可能是疾病的徵兆。

items.def: in a way that was expected
items.s: ________, flu cases rose after the long holiday, because many people had travelled and met relatives.
items.zh: 可想而知,長假過後流感病例增加了,因為許多人去旅行並與親戚相聚。

items.def: quickly and without delay
items.s: Burns should be cooled ________ under running water, so the skin is not damaged further.
items.zh: 燙傷應該立即用流動的水沖涼,這樣皮膚才不會進一步受損。

items.def: in a way that can be trusted
items.s: The test can ________ detect the virus within fifteen minutes, so it is used at airports.
items.zh: 這種檢測能在十五分鐘內可靠地驗出病毒,所以被用於機場。

items.def: without danger
items.s: The hospital must dispose of used needles ________, or the cleaners who empty the bins could be badly injured.
items.zh: 醫院必須安全地處理用過的針頭,否則清倒垃圾桶的清潔人員可能會嚴重受傷。

items.def: in a way that can continue for a long time
items.s: The health system must be funded ________, or there will not be enough money when we are old.
items.zh: 醫療體系必須被永續地籌資,否則等我們老了就沒有足夠的錢了。

items.def: the state of being good or enough
items.s: Researchers checked the ________ of school lunches, and they found that many lacked enough vegetables.
items.zh: 研究人員檢查了學校午餐的充分性,發現許多午餐蔬菜不足。

items.def: the state of being equal
items.s: The charity works for ________ in health care, so that poor families receive the same treatment as rich ones.
items.zh: 這個慈善團體致力於醫療平等,讓貧困家庭獲得和富裕家庭相同的治療。

items.def: an action that breaks a rule or law
items.s: Sharing a patient's photo online is an ________ of privacy, so the nurse was punished.
items.zh: 在網路上分享病人的照片是侵犯隱私的行為,所以那名護理師受到了處分。

items.def: an official check
items.s: Health officials carry out a surprise ________ of night markets every summer, and stalls with dirty kitchens are fined.
items.zh: 衛生官員每年夏天都會對夜市進行突擊稽查,廚房骯髒的攤位會被罰款。

items.def: money spent to get future benefits
items.s: More ________ in nurses would improve patient care, but the hospital says its budget is too small.
items.zh: 對護理人員更多的投資能改善病人照護,但醫院說它的預算太少。

items.def: the amount of money spent
items.s: Government ________ on health has grown every year, because the population is getting older very quickly.
items.zh: 政府在醫療上的支出逐年增加,因為人口正快速老化。

items.def: the process of developing or getting worse
items.s: The new drug slows the ________ of the disease, so patients can live normally for longer.
items.zh: 這種新藥能減緩疾病的進展,所以病人能更長時間正常生活。

items.def: a sign that shows something exists
items.s: High blood sugar is a ________ of diabetes risk, so doctors test it during every health check.
items.zh: 高血糖是糖尿病風險的指標,所以醫生在每次健康檢查時都會檢測。

items.def: a connection between two things
items.s: Studies show a strong ________ between loneliness and poor health, so communities organise activities for seniors.
items.zh: 研究顯示孤獨與健康不佳之間有密切關聯,所以社區為長者舉辦活動。

items.def: to stop something from spreading
items.s: Health workers moved quickly to ________ the outbreak, so it stayed in one small town.
items.zh: 衛生人員迅速行動以遏制疫情,所以它只停留在一個小鎮。

items.def: to buy insurance against loss or illness
items.s: Many parents ________ their children against accidents, because hospital costs can be very high in an emergency.
items.zh: 許多父母為孩子投保意外險,因為緊急情況下的住院費用可能非常高。

items.def: to limit how much of something each person can have
items.s: At the start of the pandemic, the government had to ________ face masks, so each person could buy only a few a week.
items.zh: 疫情初期政府必須限量供應口罩,所以每人每週只能買幾個。

items.def: to use something too much
items.s: If people ________ antibiotics, germs become stronger, so doctors give them only when they are needed.
items.zh: 如果人們過度使用抗生素,病菌就會變得更強,所以醫生只在必要時才開藥。

items.def: to deal successfully with a difficult situation
items.s: Small hospitals could not ________ with so many patients, so some people were sent to other cities.
items.zh: 小醫院無法應付這麼多病人,所以有些人被送到其他城市。

items.def: likely to be harmed
items.s: Free flu jabs are offered to ________ groups, such as pregnant women and people over sixty-five.
items.zh: 免費流感疫苗提供給高風險族群,例如孕婦和六十五歲以上的人。

items.def: having a greater chance of danger
items.s: Smokers are a ________ group for lung disease, so they are offered free lung scans every two years.
items.zh: 吸菸者是肺部疾病的高風險族群,所以每兩年提供他們免費肺部掃描。

items.def: earning little money
items.s: ________ families can get free dental care for their children, but many parents do not know about it.
items.zh: 低收入家庭的孩子可以獲得免費牙科照護,但許多家長不知道這件事。

items.def: able to be passed from one person to another
items.s: ________ diseases like flu spread fast in schools, so sick students should stay at home.
items.zh: 像流感這樣的傳染性疾病在學校傳播得很快,所以生病的學生應該待在家裡。

items.def: getting gradually worse over time
items.s: Arthritis is a ________ disease, but exercise and a healthy weight can slow it down.
items.zh: 關節炎是一種退化性疾病,但運動和健康的體重可以減緩它。

items.def: able to cause death
items.s: The ________ virus killed thousands of people, so scientists worked day and night to develop a vaccine.
items.zh: 這種致命的病毒奪走了數千人的生命,所以科學家日以繼夜地研發疫苗。

items.def: dangerous
items.s: The water in the old well was ________ to drink, so the village built a new water system.
items.zh: 老井裡的水喝起來不安全,所以村子建了新的供水系統。

items.def: usually; in most cases
items.s: Women ________ live longer than men, but the gap in Taiwan has become smaller in recent years.
items.zh: 女性通常比男性長壽,但近年來台灣的差距已經縮小。

items.def: sometimes but not often
items.s: It is fine to eat fried chicken ________, but you should not eat it every day.
items.zh: 偶爾吃炸雞沒關係,但你不應該每天吃。

items.def: too; very much
items.s: Some parents are ________ worried about small colds, so they take their children to the doctor too often.
items.zh: 有些父母對小感冒過度擔心,所以太常帶孩子去看醫生。

items.def: in a way that makes people worried
items.s: ________, more teenagers are using e-cigarettes, so many schools have started new health lessons about their dangers.
items.zh: 令人擔憂的是,越來越多青少年使用電子菸,所以許多學校開始了關於其危害的新健康課程。

items.def: in a way that may cause harm
items.s: His blood pressure was ________ high, so the doctor sent him straight to the hospital by ambulance.
items.zh: 他的血壓高得危險,所以醫生用救護車直接把他送到醫院。

items.def: to a great degree
items.s: People who drink ________ have a higher risk of liver disease, so doctors advise them to cut down.
items.zh: 大量飲酒的人罹患肝病的風險較高,所以醫生建議他們減量。

items.def: given only to people whose income is low enough
items.s: The care allowance is ________, so only families below a certain income can receive it.
items.zh: 照顧津貼是經資產調查的,所以只有收入低於一定標準的家庭才能領取。

items.def: the system of taxes
items.s: Higher ________ on cigarettes helps pay for health care, and it also stops many young people from smoking.
items.zh: 對香菸提高課稅有助於支付醫療費用,也能阻止許多年輕人吸菸。

items.def: too many people in one place
items.s: ________ in the emergency room is common in winter, so the hospital opened a new waiting area.
items.zh: 冬天急診室過度擁擠的情況很常見,所以醫院開設了新的候診區。

items.def: giving official permission to do something
items.s: Strict ________ of pharmacies protects the public, because only trained staff can sell strong medicine.
items.zh: 對藥局嚴格核發執照能保護大眾,因為只有受過訓練的人員才能販售強效藥物。

items.def: an official document that proves something
items.s: Care workers need ________ before they can work in a nursing home, so they take a ninety-hour course.
items.zh: 照顧服務員在護理之家工作前需要取得證照,所以他們要上九十小時的課程。

items.def: how good something is
items.s: The ________ of care in public hospitals is high, but the waiting times can be very long.
items.zh: 公立醫院的照護品質很高,但等候時間可能非常長。

items.def: a feeling of worry
items.s: There is growing ________ about teenage mental health, so the government has hired more school counsellors.
items.zh: 人們對青少年心理健康的擔憂日益增加,所以政府聘請了更多學校輔導人員。

items.def: the way a person acts
items.s: Changing unhealthy ________ takes time, so doctors encourage small steps like taking the stairs instead of the lift.
items.zh: 改變不健康的行為需要時間,所以醫生鼓勵從小地方做起,例如走樓梯而不搭電梯。

items.def: a feeling that something is true
items.s: There is a common ________ that cold drinks cause colds, but doctors say germs are the real cause.
items.zh: 人們普遍認為冷飲會導致感冒,但醫生說真正的原因是病菌。

items.def: sudden and large
items.s: There was a ________ rise in heatstroke cases during the heatwave, so the city opened cooling centres.
items.zh: 熱浪期間中暑病例急劇增加,所以市政府開放了避暑中心。

items.def: not fair or the same for everyone
items.s: Access to doctors is ________ across the island, because most specialists work in big cities.
items.zh: 全島的就醫機會是不平等的,因為大多數專科醫師都在大城市工作。

items.def: feeling a little ill
items.s: I felt a bit ______ ______ ______ this morning, so I stayed at home and drank lots of warm water.
items.zh: 我今天早上覺得有點身體不適,所以我待在家裡喝了很多溫水。

items.def: very healthy and strong
items.s: My grandfather is eighty-five, but he is still ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ because he swims every morning.
items.zh: 我爺爺八十五歲了,但他仍然身體硬朗,因為他每天早上都去游泳。

items.w: an apple a day keeps the doctor away
items.def: eating healthy food keeps you from getting ill
items.cn: 一天一蘋果,醫生遠離我
items.s: My mother always puts fruit in my lunch box, because she believes that ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______.
items.zh: 我媽媽總是在我的便當盒裡放水果,因為她相信一天一蘋果,醫生遠離我。
items.t: 一天一蘋果,醫生遠離我

items.def: it is better to stop a problem than to fix it later
items.s: The school nurse reminds us that ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, so she teaches us to wash our hands properly.
items.zh: 學校護理師提醒我們預防勝於治療,所以她教我們正確地洗手。

items.def: getting better after an illness or injury
items.s: Grandma had a bad fall last month, but she is ______ ______ ______ now and can walk around the house again.
items.zh: 奶奶上個月重重摔了一跤,但她現在正逐漸康復,又能在家裡走動了。

items.def: a report saying that someone is healthy
items.cn: 健康證明;一切健康的診斷
items.s: After a full check-up, the doctor gave my father ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, so we celebrated with a family dinner.
items.zh: 做完全面健康檢查後,醫生說我爸爸一切健康,所以我們全家吃了一頓晚餐慶祝。

items.def: healthy or active again after an illness
items.s: It took my aunt three months after the operation, but she is finally ______ ______ ______ ______ and has returned to work.
items.zh: 我阿姨手術後花了三個月,但她終於恢復健康,已經回去上班了。

items.w: take a turn for the worse
items.def: to suddenly become more ill
items.s: My grandfather's condition ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ last night, so the whole family rushed to the hospital.
items.zh: 我爺爺的病情昨晚突然惡化,所以全家人急忙趕到醫院。

items.def: too old to do something well (informal)
items.s: My dad joked that he was ______ ______ ______ at fifty, but then he ran his first marathon the next year.
items.zh: 我爸爸開玩笑說他五十歲就已經過了巔峰,但隔年他就跑完了人生第一場馬拉松。

items.def: to become old
items.s: My grandparents are ______ ______ ______ ______, so we moved them to a flat with a lift last summer.
items.zh: 我的祖父母上了年紀,所以我們去年夏天幫他們搬到一間有電梯的公寓。

items.def: you can be active and happy at any age
items.s: My seventy-year-old neighbour started learning the guitar, and she says that ______ ______ ______ ______ ______.
items.zh: 我七十歲的鄰居開始學吉他,她說年齡只是個數字。

items.def: to start to have an illness
items.s: Half of my class ______ ______ ______ the flu last week, so the teacher postponed the test.
items.zh: 我們班上週有一半的人染上了流感,所以老師把考試延期了。

items.def: a person who looks very healthy
items.cn: 健康的典範;看起來非常健康
items.s: After a month in the countryside, my uncle looked like ______ ______ ______ ______, and his skin was brown from the sun.
items.zh: 在鄉下待了一個月後,我叔叔看起來非常健康,皮膚也被太陽曬成了古銅色。

items.def: an unpleasant fact that you must accept
items.s: Being told to stop playing football because of his knee was ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, but he became a coach instead.
items.zh: 因為膝蓋問題被告知不能再踢足球,對他來說是難以接受的事實,但他後來改當教練。

items.def: laughing helps you feel better
items.s: The volunteers tell jokes to the children in hospital, because they believe ______ ______ ______ ______ ______.
items.zh: 志工們對住院的孩子們講笑話,因為他們相信笑是最好的良藥。

items.def: a chance to be active and happy again
items.s: The hip operation gave my grandmother ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, and now she goes dancing twice a week.
items.zh: 髖關節手術讓我奶奶重獲新生,現在她每週去跳舞兩次。

items.def: to slow the spread of a disease so hospitals can cope
items.s: Everyone stayed at home to help ______ ______ ______, so the hospitals had enough beds for the sickest patients.
items.zh: 每個人都待在家裡協助讓疫情曲線趨緩,所以醫院有足夠的病床給最嚴重的病人。

items.def: to stop doing something harmful, such as smoking
items.s: My uncle smoked for thirty years, but he finally ______ ______ ______ when his first grandchild was born.
items.zh: 我叔叔抽了三十年菸,但在第一個孫子出生時終於戒掉了這個惡習。

items.def: to recover from a serious illness
items.s: The doctors were not sure he would survive the accident, but he ______ ______ and left hospital in May.
items.zh: 醫生們不確定他能否撐過那場車禍,但他度過了難關,並在五月出院。

items.def: feeling and acting young although you are old
items.s: My grandmother is eighty but very ______ ______ ______, so she loves trying new games with her grandchildren.
items.zh: 我奶奶八十歲了但心態非常年輕,所以她喜歡和孫子們一起嘗試新遊戲。

items.def: a written plan of how a new business will work and make money
items.s: Before the bank agreed to lend her any money, it asked to see a detailed ______ ______, so she spent two weeks writing it.
items.zh: 在銀行同意借她任何錢之前，它要求看一份詳細的營運計畫書，所以她花了兩週撰寫。
items.sec: Starting & Running a Business 創業與公司經營

items.def: a person who owns and runs a business alone
items.s: My uncle works as a ______ ______ selling handmade furniture, so he keeps all the profit but also carries all the risk.
items.zh: 我叔叔以獨資經營者的身分販售手工家具，所以他保有全部利潤，但也承擔所有風險。
items.sec: Starting & Running a Business 創業與公司經營

items.def: the right to sell a company's products under its name
items.s: She bought a coffee shop ______ from a famous chain, and the company trained her staff before the shop opened.
items.zh: 她向一家知名連鎖店買下咖啡店的加盟經營權，而且該公司在開店前培訓了她的員工。
items.sec: Starting & Running a Business 創業與公司經營

items.def: a person who runs a shop under a franchise
items.s: Every ______ must follow the same recipes and rules, but each one can choose how to decorate the shop.
items.zh: 每一位加盟主都必須遵守相同的食譜與規定，但每個人可以自行決定如何裝潢店面。
items.sec: Starting & Running a Business 創業與公司經營

items.def: the main office of a large company
items.s: The company's ______ is in Taipei, but most of its factories are in other countries where land is cheaper.
items.zh: 這家公司的總部位於台北，但它大部分的工廠都在土地較便宜的其他國家。
items.sec: Starting & Running a Business 創業與公司經營

items.def: a smaller office of a company in another place
items.s: The bank opened a new ______ ______ near our school, so my parents no longer have to drive downtown.
items.zh: 這家銀行在我們學校附近開了一間新的分公司，所以我爸媽不必再開車到市中心了。
items.sec: Starting & Running a Business 創業與公司經營

items.def: the person who starts a company
items.s: The ______ of the company started the business in her garage, and now it employs more than five hundred people.
items.zh: 這家公司的創辦人在她的車庫裡開始這門生意，而現在公司雇用了超過五百人。
items.sec: Starting & Running a Business 創業與公司經營

items.def: one of two or more people who start a company together
items.s: He became a ______ of the app with his best friend from university, and they still share the same office.
items.zh: 他和大學時最好的朋友一起成為這個應用程式的共同創辦人，而且他們至今仍共用同一間辦公室。
items.sec: Starting & Running a Business 創業與公司經營

items.def: the person with the highest position in a company
items.s: The ______ ______ announced the new plan at the meeting, and the share price rose the next morning.
items.zh: 執行長在會議上宣布了新計畫，而隔天早上股價就上漲了。
items.sec: Starting & Running a Business 創業與公司經營

items.def: the group of people who control a company
items.s: The ______ ______ ______ voted against the risky project, so the manager had to find a cheaper idea.
items.zh: 董事會投票反對這個高風險的計畫，所以經理必須另找一個比較便宜的點子。
items.sec: Starting & Running a Business 創業與公司經營

items.def: the person who leads a meeting or a board
items.s: As ______ of the meeting, Ms Lin made sure everyone had a chance to speak, but she kept each person to two minutes.
items.zh: 身為會議的主席，林女士確保每個人都有發言的機會，但她將每個人限制在兩分鐘內。
items.sec: Starting & Running a Business 創業與公司經營

items.def: the person in charge of running a company each day
items.s: The ______ ______ visits every department once a month because she wants to hear workers' ideas directly.
items.zh: 總經理每個月走訪每個部門一次，因為她想直接聽取員工的想法。
items.sec: Starting & Running a Business 創業與公司經營

items.def: a company, especially a small or professional one
items.s: My cousin works for a small law ______ in Kaohsiung, and she often stays late when there is an important case.
items.zh: 我表姐在高雄一家小型法律事務所工作，而且遇到重要案件時她常常加班到很晚。
items.sec: Starting & Running a Business 創業與公司經營

items.def: a large company or group of companies
items.s: The huge ______ owns hotels, airlines and supermarkets, so it can offer customers discounts across all of them.
items.zh: 這家龐大的大型企業擁有飯店、航空公司和超市，所以能在所有這些事業中提供顧客折扣。
items.sec: Starting & Running a Business 創業與公司經營

items.def: a company whose owners only lose what they invested if it fails
items.s: They turned their family shop into a ______ ______, so their own house would be safe if the business failed.
items.zh: 他們把家族商店改成有限公司，這樣即使生意失敗，他們自己的房子也會安全。
items.sec: Starting & Running a Business 創業與公司經營

items.def: the way a company plans to make money
items.s: The free app shows adverts to users, and this ______ ______ has made the company very rich.
items.zh: 這個免費應用程式會向使用者顯示廣告，而這種商業模式讓公司賺了大錢。
items.sec: Starting & Running a Business 創業與公司經營

items.def: a short sentence about a company's main aims
items.s: The ______ ______ on the wall says the company wants to make healthy food cheap, but some workers doubt it.
items.zh: 牆上的使命宣言寫著公司希望讓健康食品變便宜，但有些員工對此存疑。
items.sec: Starting & Running a Business 創業與公司經營

items.def: the building and land a business uses
items.s: Smoking is not allowed anywhere on the ______, so the staff have to walk to the park during their break.
items.zh: 營業場所內任何地方都禁止吸菸，所以員工休息時必須走到公園去。
items.sec: Starting & Running a Business 創業與公司經營

items.def: the money needed to run a business every day
items.s: Electricity and rent make up most of the restaurant's ______ ______, so the owner switched to energy-saving lights.
items.zh: 電費和租金占了這家餐廳大部分的營運成本，所以老闆改用節能燈具。
items.sec: Starting & Running a Business 創業與公司經營

items.def: unable to pay one's debts
items.s: The bookshop went ______ last year because fewer people bought paper books, and the building is now a café.
items.zh: 這家書店去年破產了，因為買紙本書的人變少，而那棟建築現在成了咖啡店。
items.sec: Starting & Running a Business 創業與公司經營

items.def: the state of being unable to pay debts
items.s: The airline was close to ______ during the pandemic, but the government lent it money to keep flying.
items.zh: 這家航空公司在疫情期間幾乎破產，但政府借錢給它讓它能繼續飛行。
items.sec: Starting & Running a Business 創業與公司經營

items.def: closing a company and selling everything to pay debts
items.s: After the company went into ______, all its computers and desks were sold, and the workers lost their jobs.
items.zh: 這家公司進入清算後，所有電腦和桌子都被賣掉，員工們也失去了工作。
items.sec: Starting & Running a Business 創業與公司經營

items.def: when one company gets control of another
items.s: The small game studio agreed to the ______ because the bigger company promised to keep all its designers.
items.zh: 這家小型遊戲工作室同意了這項收購，因為那家較大的公司承諾留下所有設計師。
items.sec: Starting & Running a Business 創業與公司經營

items.def: when two companies join to become one
items.s: The ______ of the two banks created the largest bank in the country, but some branches had to close.
items.zh: 兩家銀行的合併創造了國內最大的銀行，但有些分行不得不關閉。
items.sec: Starting & Running a Business 創業與公司經營

items.def: a business project run by two companies together
items.s: The Taiwanese firm and a Japanese carmaker started a ______ ______ to build electric scooters, and both share the profits.
items.zh: 這家台灣公司與一家日本汽車製造商成立了一家合資企業來生產電動機車，而且雙方共享利潤。
items.sec: Starting & Running a Business 創業與公司經營

items.def: a small or medium-sized business
items.s: Most companies in Taiwan are small, and a typical ______ has fewer than two hundred workers, so such firms matter to the economy.
items.zh: 台灣大多數公司規模都很小，一家典型的中小企業員工少於兩百人，因此這類公司對經濟很重要。
items.sec: Starting & Running a Business 創業與公司經營

items.def: owned and managed by one family
items.s: We always eat at a small ______ noodle shop near the station because the grandmother still cooks the soup herself.
items.zh: 我們總是在車站附近一家小小的家族經營的麵店吃飯，因為奶奶仍然親自熬湯。
items.sec: Starting & Running a Business 創業與公司經營

items.def: working for yourself, not for a company
items.s: Since becoming ______, my aunt can choose her own hours, but she has to find all her customers by herself.
items.zh: 自從成為自雇者後，我阿姨可以自己選擇工作時間，但她必須自己找所有的客戶。
items.sec: Starting & Running a Business 創業與公司經營

items.def: a person who owns a company or shop
items.s: As a ______ ______, Mr Chen worries about rent every month, yet he loves being his own boss.
items.zh: 身為企業主，陳先生每個月都擔心房租，但他很喜歡自己當老闆。
items.sec: Starting & Running a Business 創業與公司經營

items.def: a new company created from part of an older one
items.s: The video team became a ______ of the TV channel, and it now makes its own shows for streaming sites.
items.zh: 影片團隊成為電視頻道分拆出來的公司，而現在它為串流網站製作自己的節目。
items.sec: Starting & Running a Business 創業與公司經營

items.def: a person whose job is to keep or check money records
items.s: Our ______ checks the shop's records every month, and she told us we were spending too much on packaging.
items.zh: 我們的會計師每個月檢查店裡的帳目，而且她告訴我們包裝花費太多了。
items.sec: Money, Finance & Accounting 金錢、財務與會計

items.def: the job of keeping and checking money records
items.s: She studied ______ at university because she is good with numbers, and now she works for a big bank.
items.zh: 她在大學主修會計，因為她擅長數字，而現在她在一家大銀行工作。
items.sec: Money, Finance & Accounting 金錢、財務與會計

items.def: recording the money a business receives and spends
items.s: Simple ______ software helps small shop owners record every sale, so they know exactly how much money they have.
items.zh: 簡單的記帳軟體幫助小店主記錄每一筆銷售，所以他們清楚知道自己有多少錢。
items.sec: Money, Finance & Accounting 金錢、財務與會計

items.def: a report showing what a company owns and owes
items.s: The ______ ______ showed that the company owed more than it owned, so the investors became very worried.
items.zh: 資產負債表顯示這家公司負債多於資產，所以投資人變得非常擔心。
items.sec: Money, Finance & Accounting 金錢、財務與會計

items.def: money moving into and out of a business
items.s: The shop sells a lot in December, but its ______ ______ is weak in summer, so the owner saves money in advance.
items.zh: 這家店在十二月賣得很多，但夏天的現金流很弱，所以老闆會預先存錢。
items.sec: Money, Finance & Accounting 金錢、財務與會計

items.def: the first part of the price paid when buying something big
items.s: My parents saved for ten years to make a ______ ______ on a flat, and they will pay the rest over twenty years.
items.zh: 我爸媽存了十年的錢來支付一間公寓的頭期款，而剩下的款項他們會在二十年內付清。
items.sec: Money, Finance & Accounting 金錢、財務與會計

items.def: the percentage paid for borrowing money
items.s: When the bank raised its ______ ______, many families paid more for their homes, so they cut down on eating out.
items.zh: 當銀行調高利率時，許多家庭的房貸支出變多，所以他們減少外食。
items.sec: Money, Finance & Accounting 金錢、財務與會計

items.def: money that you owe to someone
items.s: He used three credit cards at the same time, and soon he was in serious ______ that took years to pay back.
items.zh: 他同時使用三張信用卡，很快他就陷入了花好幾年才還清的嚴重債務中。
items.sec: Money, Finance & Accounting 金錢、財務與會計

items.def: a plastic card used to buy things and pay later
items.s: Paying with a ______ ______ is convenient, but you should pay the full bill each month or the bank charges extra.
items.zh: 用信用卡付款很方便，但你應該每個月付清全額帳單，否則銀行會額外收費。
items.sec: Money, Finance & Accounting 金錢、財務與會計

items.def: a document asking a customer to pay for goods or work
items.s: The designer sent the client an ______ after finishing the logo, but she still had not been paid two months later.
items.zh: 設計師完成標誌後寄給客戶一張請款單，但兩個月後她仍然沒有收到款項。
items.sec: Money, Finance & Accounting 金錢、財務與會計

items.def: a paper showing that you have paid for something
items.s: Please keep your ______ in case the shoes do not fit, because the shop will not return your money without it.
items.zh: 請保留你的收據以防鞋子不合腳，因為沒有收據店家不會退款。
items.sec: Money, Finance & Accounting 金錢、財務與會計

items.def: a form you send to the government about your income
items.s: Every May my father fills in his ______ ______ online, and he is always happy when he gets some money back.
items.zh: 每年五月我爸爸都在網路上填寫他的報稅單，而且他拿到退稅時總是很開心。
items.sec: Money, Finance & Accounting 金錢、財務與會計

items.def: a person who officially checks a company's accounts
items.s: The ______ found several mistakes in the company's records, so the managers had to explain where the money went.
items.zh: 稽核員在公司的紀錄中發現了好幾個錯誤，所以經理們必須解釋錢的去向。
items.sec: Money, Finance & Accounting 金錢、財務與會計

items.def: the money left after all costs are paid
items.s: The café sold a lot of drinks this year, but its ______ ______ was small because rent and wages were so high.
items.zh: 這家咖啡店今年賣出很多飲料，但它的淨利很少，因為租金和薪資太高了。
items.sec: Money, Finance & Accounting 金錢、財務與會計

items.def: money that a person or company earns
items.s: The company's ______ rose by ten percent this year, so every worker received a small extra payment.
items.zh: 這家公司今年的盈餘成長了百分之十，所以每位員工都得到一筆小額的額外款項。
items.sec: Money, Finance & Accounting 金錢、財務與會計

items.def: the twelve months a company uses for its accounts
items.s: At the end of the ______ ______, the team counts every sale, and then the boss decides next year's budget.
items.zh: 在會計年度結束時，團隊會統計每一筆銷售，然後老闆決定明年的預算。
items.sec: Money, Finance & Accounting 金錢、財務與會計

items.def: a period of three months in a business year
items.s: Sales were poor in the first ______, but they improved after the summer campaign, so the year ended well.
items.zh: 第一季度的銷售很差，但在夏季活動後有所改善，所以這一年結束得很好。
items.sec: Money, Finance & Accounting 金錢、財務與會計

items.def: the place where shares in companies are bought and sold
items.s: My grandfather has put money into the ______ ______ for thirty years, but he never buys shares he does not understand.
items.zh: 我爺爺把錢投入股票市場已經三十年了，但他從不買自己不了解的股票。
items.sec: Money, Finance & Accounting 金錢、財務與會計

items.def: the cost of one share in a company
items.s: The ______ ______ fell sharply after the phone caught fire, and investors lost a lot of money that week.
items.zh: 在那款手機起火後股價大跌，投資人那週損失了很多錢。
items.sec: Money, Finance & Accounting 金錢、財務與會計

items.def: an organisation where company shares are traded
items.s: The company joined the ______ ______ last year, so now anyone can buy a small part of it.
items.zh: 這家公司去年在證券交易所上市，所以現在任何人都可以買下它的一小部分。
items.sec: Money, Finance & Accounting 金錢、財務與會計

items.def: a person who buys and sells shares for other people
items.s: Instead of paying a ______, many young people now use apps to buy shares, but some lose money quickly.
items.zh: 許多年輕人現在不付錢給股票經紀人，而是用應用程式買股票，但有些人很快就賠錢。
items.sec: Money, Finance & Accounting 金錢、財務與會計

items.def: raising money from many people, usually online
items.s: The students used ______ to pay for their robot, and more than three hundred strangers gave small amounts online.
items.zh: 學生們利用群眾募資來支付機器人的費用，而且有超過三百位陌生人在網路上捐了小額款項。
items.sec: Money, Finance & Accounting 金錢、財務與會計

items.def: money invested in new companies with high risk
items.s: The start-up received ______ ______ from a big fund, so it could hire twenty engineers in one year.
items.zh: 這家新創公司獲得了一筆大型基金的創業投資，所以一年內就能雇用二十名工程師。
items.sec: Money, Finance & Accounting 金錢、財務與會計

items.def: a rich person who gives money to a new business early
items.s: An ______ ______ gave them their first million dollars, and she also helped them find good staff.
items.zh: 一位天使投資人給了他們第一筆一百萬美元，而且她也幫助他們找到好員工。
items.sec: Money, Finance & Accounting 金錢、財務與會計

items.def: money you take out of a bank beyond what is in your account
items.s: The shop used its ______ to pay suppliers in a bad month, but the bank charged high fees for it.
items.zh: 這家店在生意差的月份用透支付款給供應商，但銀行為此收取高額費用。
items.sec: Money, Finance & Accounting 金錢、財務與會計

items.def: digital money that is not controlled by a bank
items.s: Some shops now accept ______ as payment, but its value changes so fast that many owners still prefer cash.
items.zh: 有些商店現在接受用加密貨幣付款，但它的價值變化太快，所以許多店主仍偏好現金。
items.sec: Money, Finance & Accounting 金錢、財務與會計

items.def: a person or bank that lends money
items.s: The ______ refused to give him more money because he had not paid back his last loan on time.
items.zh: 放款人拒絕再借他錢，因為他沒有準時還清上一筆貸款。
items.sec: Money, Finance & Accounting 金錢、財務與會計

items.def: to pay back money you borrowed
items.s: She promised to ______ the money within a year, and she worked weekends at a café so she could keep her promise.
items.zh: 她承諾在一年內償還這筆錢，而且她週末在咖啡店打工以便信守承諾。
items.sec: Money, Finance & Accounting 金錢、財務與會計

items.def: money spent on something
items.s: Travel is the biggest ______ for our sales team, so the company now holds more meetings online.
items.zh: 交通是我們業務團隊最大的開支，所以公司現在更多會議改在線上舉行。
items.sec: Money, Finance & Accounting 金錢、財務與會計

items.def: collecting money for a cause or project
items.s: The school's ______ event raised enough money for a new library, and parents baked cakes to sell.
items.zh: 學校的募款活動籌到足夠的錢蓋新圖書館，而且家長們烤了蛋糕來義賣。
items.sec: Money, Finance & Accounting 金錢、財務與會計

items.def: a person whose job is to make people want a product
items.s: A good ______ studies what young people watch online, and then she plans adverts that appear in the right places.
items.zh: 一位好的行銷人員會研究年輕人在網路上看什麼，然後規劃出現在正確位置的廣告。

items.def: collecting information about what customers want
items.s: Before launching the drink, the company did ______ ______ in five cities, and it found that people wanted less sugar.
items.zh: 在推出這款飲料前，公司在五個城市做了市場調查，而且發現人們想要少一點糖。

items.def: the group of people a product is made for
items.s: The ______ ______ for this game is teenagers, so the adverts appear on video sites rather than in newspapers.
items.zh: 這款遊戲的目標市場是青少年，所以廣告出現在影音網站上而不是報紙上。

items.def: all the regular customers of a business
items.s: The bakery has a loyal ______ ______ in the neighbourhood, but it wants to attract tourists as well.
items.zh: 這家麵包店在社區裡有忠實的顧客群，但它也想吸引觀光客。

items.def: creating a special image and name for a product
items.s: Clever ______ made the cheap water bottle look stylish, so teenagers were happy to pay more for it.
items.zh: 聰明的品牌塑造讓這個便宜的水壺看起來很時尚，所以青少年樂意花更多錢買它。

items.def: when customers keep buying the same brand
items.s: Many phone users show strong ______ ______, so they buy the same brand again even when others are cheaper.
items.zh: 許多手機使用者表現出強烈的品牌忠誠度，所以即使其他品牌更便宜，他們還是會再買同一個牌子。

items.def: how many people know about a brand
items.s: The company sponsored a popular marathon to increase ______ ______, and its logo appeared on every runner's shirt.
items.zh: 這家公司贊助一場熱門馬拉松來提高品牌知名度，而且它的標誌出現在每位跑者的上衣上。

items.def: what people think and feel about a brand
items.s: The scandal damaged the company's ______ ______, so it spent millions on adverts about protecting nature.
items.zh: 這起醜聞損害了公司的品牌形象，所以它花了數百萬在保護自然的廣告上。

items.def: a picture, film or text that tries to sell something
items.s: I skipped the ______ before the video, but I still remembered the song because it was so catchy.
items.zh: 我跳過了影片前的廣告，但我還是記得那首歌，因為它太好記了。

items.def: activities to make people buy a product
items.s: The supermarket is running a ______ this week, so if you buy two bottles of shampoo, you get one free.
items.zh: 超市這週正在舉辦促銷活動，所以如果你買兩瓶洗髮精，就送你一瓶。

items.def: made to advertise a product
items.s: The band handed out free ______ T-shirts at the concert, and fans wore them on social media for weeks.
items.zh: 樂團在演唱會上發送免費的宣傳T恤，而歌迷們好幾週都穿著它們出現在社群媒體上。

items.def: a reduction in the price of something
items.s: The phone company announced a big ______ ______ after sales fell, and long queues formed outside its shops.
items.zh: 手機公司在銷量下滑後宣布大幅降價，而它的門市外排起了長長的隊伍。

items.def: a piece of paper or code that lets you pay less
items.s: My mother always uses a ______ when she orders pizza online, so we usually get a free drink as well.
items.zh: 我媽媽在網路上訂披薩時總是使用優惠券，所以我們通常還會得到一杯免費飲料。

items.def: a small amount of a product given away to try
items.s: The shop gave out a ______ ______ of the new cookies, and many people bought a whole box after tasting one.
items.zh: 那家店發送新餅乾的免費試用品，而許多人嘗過之後就買了一整盒。

items.def: a planned series of adverts for one product
items.s: The ______ ______ for the new sports shoes used famous athletes, but it was criticised for being too expensive.
items.zh: 新款運動鞋的廣告活動請來知名運動員，但它因花費過高而受到批評。

items.def: when a famous person says they use and like a product
items.s: The skin cream sold out quickly after a ______ ______ by a popular singer, although experts doubted it worked.
items.zh: 在一位當紅歌手的名人代言後，這款乳霜很快就賣光了，儘管專家懷疑它是否有效。

items.def: marketing that spreads fast as people share it online
items.s: The funny video was a clever piece of ______ ______, because millions of people shared it without knowing it was an advert.
items.zh: 這支好笑的影片是一個聰明的病毒式行銷，因為數百萬人在不知道它是廣告的情況下分享了它。

items.def: paying popular online people to show a product
items.s: Many beauty brands spend more on ______ ______ than on TV adverts, because young people trust online stars more.
items.zh: 許多美妝品牌在網紅行銷上的花費比電視廣告還多，因為年輕人更信任網路明星。

items.def: sending adverts and offers to customers by email
items.s: The shop uses ______ ______ to tell customers about sales, but too many messages can make people unsubscribe.
items.zh: 這家店用電子郵件行銷告訴顧客特價訊息，但太多訊息可能會讓人們取消訂閱。

items.def: making a website appear higher in search results
items.s: The small hotel improved its ______, so now it appears near the top when tourists search for rooms in Tainan.
items.zh: 這家小飯店改善了它的搜尋引擎最佳化，所以現在遊客搜尋台南的房間時它會出現在前面。

items.def: the percentage of people who click on an online advert
items.s: The ______ ______ for the new banner was very low, so the designers changed the colours and the words.
items.zh: 新橫幅廣告的點擊率非常低，所以設計師更改了顏色和文字。

items.def: one group of customers with similar needs
items.s: Electric bikes for older people are a growing ______ ______, so several companies are designing lighter models.
items.zh: 給年長者的電動自行車是一個成長中的市場區隔，所以好幾家公司正在設計更輕的車款。

items.def: how a company wants customers to see its product compared to others
items.s: The brand's ______ as a luxury product means it never offers discounts, even when sales are slow.
items.zh: 這個品牌作為奢侈品的市場定位意味著它從不打折，即使銷售緩慢也一樣。

items.def: the special feature that makes a product different
items.s: The phone's ______ ______ ______ is its long battery life, so the adverts show people using it on a three-day trip.
items.zh: 這款手機的獨特賣點是電池續航力長，所以廣告呈現人們在三天旅行中使用它的情景。

items.def: a small group asked to give opinions on a product
items.s: The company showed the new snack to a ______ ______ of teenagers, and most of them said it was too salty.
items.zh: 公司把新零食拿給一群青少年組成的焦點團體看，而他們大多數說太鹹了。

items.def: a list of written questions to collect opinions
items.s: Customers who fill in the short ______ get a free coffee, so many people are happy to give their opinions.
items.zh: 填寫簡短問卷的顧客可以得到一杯免費咖啡，所以許多人樂意提供意見。

items.def: the way people choose and buy things
items.s: Studies of ______ ______ show that people buy more when music is slow, so many shops play calm songs.
items.zh: 消費者行為的研究顯示，音樂緩慢時人們會買得更多，所以許多商店播放輕柔的歌曲。

items.def: the combination of product, price, place and promotion
items.s: The class learned that the ______ ______ includes price and place, and then each group planned one for a new drink.
items.zh: 全班學到行銷組合包含價格與通路，然後每一組為一款新飲料做了規劃。

items.def: a card that gives regular customers rewards
items.s: I have a ______ ______ for the bubble tea shop, and after ten drinks I get one for free.
items.zh: 我有那家珍奶店的集點卡，而且集滿十杯後我可以免費得到一杯。

items.def: money a company gives to an event in return for advertising
items.s: The bank's ______ of the school football team paid for new uniforms, and its name is printed on every shirt.
items.zh: 銀行對校足球隊的贊助支付了新球衣的費用，而它的名字印在每件球衣上。

items.def: a person who buys goods or services
items.s: The shop owner greets every ______ by name, so people feel welcome and keep coming back.
items.zh: 店主會叫出每位顧客的名字打招呼，所以人們覺得受歡迎並且一再回來。
items.sec: Sales, Customers & Retail 銷售、顧客與零售

items.def: a person or company that pays for professional services
items.s: The designer met her ______ in a café to show the first drawings, and he asked for a few small changes.
items.zh: 設計師在咖啡店與她的客戶見面展示初稿，而他要求做幾處小修改。
items.sec: Sales, Customers & Retail 銷售、顧客與零售

items.def: help that a company gives to its customers
items.s: The airline's ______ ______ was so slow that I waited forty minutes on the phone, but the staff were finally very kind.
items.zh: 這家航空公司的客戶服務太慢了，我在電話上等了四十分鐘，但工作人員最後非常親切。
items.sec: Sales, Customers & Retail 銷售、顧客與零售

items.def: a person whose job is selling things
items.s: The ______ explained every feature of the laptop patiently, so my father decided to buy it that afternoon.
items.zh: 銷售員耐心解說筆電的每項功能，所以我爸爸那天下午就決定買了。
items.sec: Sales, Customers & Retail 銷售、顧客與零售

items.def: the amount a seller is expected to sell
items.s: Our team reached its ______ ______ two weeks early, so the manager took everyone out for dinner.
items.zh: 我們團隊提早兩週達成銷售目標，所以經理請大家出去吃晚餐。
items.sec: Sales, Customers & Retail 銷售、顧客與零售

items.def: a person who serves customers in a shop
items.s: The ______ ______ helped me find a smaller size, and she even checked the other branch when it was sold out.
items.zh: 店員幫我找了小一號的尺寸，而且在賣完時她甚至幫我查了另一家分店。
items.sec: Sales, Customers & Retail 銷售、顧客與零售

items.def: the place in a shop where you pay
items.s: There was a long queue at the ______, so I used the self-service machine and left the store quickly.
items.zh: 結帳櫃檯排了很長的隊，所以我用了自助結帳機並很快離開商店。
items.sec: Sales, Customers & Retail 銷售、顧客與零售

items.def: money returned to a customer
items.s: The headphones stopped working after two days, so I took them back and asked for a full ______.
items.zh: 耳機用了兩天就壞了，所以我拿回去要求全額退款。
items.sec: Sales, Customers & Retail 銷售、顧客與零售

items.def: a shop's rules about taking back goods
items.s: The store has a generous ______ ______, so you can bring clothes back within thirty days if you keep the label.
items.zh: 這家店有寬鬆的退貨政策，所以只要保留標籤，你可以在三十天內退回衣服。
items.sec: Sales, Customers & Retail 銷售、顧客與零售

items.def: a written promise to repair a product if it breaks
items.s: The washing machine has a two-year ______, so the company repaired it for free when it started leaking.
items.zh: 這台洗衣機有兩年保固，所以它開始漏水時公司免費修好了。
items.sec: Sales, Customers & Retail 銷售、顧客與零售

items.def: help a company gives after you buy something
items.s: Good ______ ______ is important for expensive products, because customers want help if something goes wrong.
items.zh: 良好的售後服務對昂貴產品很重要，因為顧客希望出問題時能得到協助。
items.sec: Sales, Customers & Retail 銷售、顧客與零售

items.def: a statement that something is wrong or unfair
items.s: The hotel received a ______ about noise from the bar, so the manager closed it earlier on weeknights.
items.zh: 飯店接到關於酒吧噪音的投訴，所以經理讓它在平日提早打烊。
items.sec: Sales, Customers & Retail 銷售、顧客與零售

items.def: an opinion about a product or place posted on the internet
items.s: One bad ______ ______ can scare away customers, so many restaurants reply politely to every comment.
items.zh: 一則負面的網路評論就可能嚇跑顧客，所以許多餐廳會禮貌回覆每一則留言。
items.sec: Sales, Customers & Retail 銷售、顧客與零售

items.def: something bought for less than its usual price
items.s: The jacket was a real ______ at half price, and I have worn it almost every day this winter.
items.zh: 這件夾克半價買真是划算，而且我這個冬天幾乎每天都穿它。
items.sec: Sales, Customers & Retail 銷售、顧客與零售

items.def: to argue about the price of something
items.s: Tourists often ______ with the sellers at the night market, but some stalls have fixed prices on signs.
items.zh: 遊客常在夜市和攤販討價還價，但有些攤位在招牌上標有固定價格。
items.sec: Sales, Customers & Retail 銷售、顧客與零售

items.def: a list showing the prices of goods or services
items.s: The hair salon put its ______ ______ on the window, so customers know the cost before they walk in.
items.zh: 這家髮廊把價目表貼在窗戶上，所以顧客進門前就知道價格。
items.sec: Sales, Customers & Retail 銷售、顧客與零售

items.def: the price a shop charges customers
items.s: The ______ ______ of the game is two thousand dollars, but online stores often sell it for less.
items.zh: 這款遊戲的零售價是兩千元，但網路商店常常賣得更便宜。
items.sec: Sales, Customers & Retail 銷售、顧客與零售

items.def: the amount added to the cost to make a profit
items.s: Restaurants put a large ______ on drinks, so a bottle of water can cost three times more than in a shop.
items.zh: 餐廳對飲料有很高的加價，所以一瓶水可能比商店貴三倍。
items.sec: Sales, Customers & Retail 銷售、顧客與零售

items.def: a sale to get rid of old stock cheaply
items.s: The furniture shop is closing down, so it is holding a ______ ______ with everything at seventy percent off.
items.zh: 這家家具店即將歇業，所以正在舉辦全面三折的清倉拍賣。
items.sec: Sales, Customers & Retail 銷售、顧客與零售

items.def: a large building with many shops
items.s: On rainy weekends, families crowd into the ______ ______ because it has cinemas, restaurants and air-conditioning.
items.zh: 在下雨的週末，家庭們擠進購物中心，因為那裡有電影院、餐廳和冷氣。
items.sec: Sales, Customers & Retail 銷售、顧客與零售

items.def: buying things on the internet
items.s: ______ ______ saves time, but my grandmother still prefers the market because she likes to touch the vegetables.
items.zh: 網路購物節省時間，但我奶奶仍偏好市場，因為她喜歡摸摸蔬菜。
items.sec: Sales, Customers & Retail 銷售、顧客與零售

items.def: a list of items you plan to buy on a website
items.s: I left three books in my online ______ ______ for a week, and then the shop sent me a discount code.
items.zh: 我把三本書放在網路購物車裡一個星期，然後商店寄給我一組折扣碼。
items.sec: Sales, Customers & Retail 銷售、顧客與零售

items.def: delivery without any charge
items.s: The website offers ______ ______ on orders over one thousand dollars, so I added a few more items to my order.
items.zh: 這個網站訂單滿一千元就免運費，所以我在訂單裡多加了幾樣東西。
items.sec: Sales, Customers & Retail 銷售、顧客與零售

items.def: not available because all have been sold
items.s: The new console was ______ ______ ______ in every shop, so my brother had to wait three months for one.
items.zh: 新款遊戲主機在每家店都缺貨，所以我哥哥必須等三個月才買到。
items.sec: Sales, Customers & Retail 銷售、顧客與零售

items.def: a room where goods like cars are shown to buyers
items.s: We visited the car ______ to test-drive an electric car, but the salesperson could not answer all our questions.
items.zh: 我們去汽車展示間試駕電動車，但銷售員無法回答我們所有的問題。
items.sec: Sales, Customers & Retail 銷售、顧客與零售

items.def: looking at goods in shops without buying
items.s: We had no money left, so we just went ______ ______ along the street and dreamed about the shoes.
items.zh: 我們沒錢了，所以只是沿著街逛街看櫥窗，夢想著那些鞋子。
items.sec: Sales, Customers & Retail 銷售、顧客與零售

items.def: buying things suddenly without planning
items.s: Shops put sweets next to the checkout to encourage ______ ______, and children often beg their parents for them.
items.zh: 商店把糖果放在結帳櫃檯旁來鼓勵衝動購物，而小孩常會向父母討著要。
items.sec: Sales, Customers & Retail 銷售、顧客與零售

items.def: to persuade a customer to buy a more expensive item
items.s: The waiter tried to ______ us a large meal with dessert, but we only wanted a light lunch.
items.zh: 服務生試圖向我們追加銷售含甜點的大份餐點，但我們只想吃頓簡單的午餐。
items.sec: Sales, Customers & Retail 銷售、顧客與零售

items.def: a person who is paid to work for a company
items.s: Every new ______ gets a laptop on the first day, and a senior worker shows them around the office.
items.zh: 每位新員工第一天都會拿到一台筆電，而且一位資深員工會帶他們參觀辦公室。
items.sec: The Workplace & Management 職場與管理

items.def: all the people who work for an organisation
items.s: The restaurant is short of ______ during the holidays, so the owner's children help in the kitchen.
items.zh: 這家餐廳在假期期間人手不足，所以老闆的孩子會到廚房幫忙。
items.sec: The Workplace & Management 職場與管理

items.def: a person who controls a team or part of a business
items.s: The ______ listened to our ideas carefully, but she said we had to finish the project before Friday.
items.zh: 經理仔細聽取我們的想法，但她說我們必須在週五前完成專案。
items.sec: The Workplace & Management 職場與管理

items.def: the people who control a company
items.s: The ______ decided to close the factory, so hundreds of workers protested outside the head office.
items.zh: 管理階層決定關閉工廠，所以數百名工人在總公司外抗議。
items.sec: The Workplace & Management 職場與管理

items.def: a person who guides a small group of workers
items.s: As ______ ______, Ken gives each person a clear task, and he checks their progress every afternoon.
items.zh: 身為組長，阿肯給每個人明確的任務，而且他每天下午檢查他們的進度。
items.sec: The Workplace & Management 職場與管理

items.def: the person who is in charge of you at work
items.s: My ______ lets me work from home on Fridays because I always finish my reports on time.
items.zh: 我的上司讓我週五在家工作，因為我總是準時完成報告。
items.sec: The Workplace & Management 職場與管理

items.def: a section of a large organisation
items.s: She moved from the sales ______ to marketing last year, and she enjoys planning adverts much more.
items.zh: 她去年從銷售部門調到行銷部，而且她更喜歡規劃廣告。
items.sec: The Workplace & Management 職場與管理

items.def: the department that deals with hiring and staff
items.s: If you have a problem with your contract, you should talk to ______ ______, because they handle staff issues.
items.zh: 如果你的合約有問題，你應該找人力資源部談，因為他們負責處理員工事務。
items.sec: The Workplace & Management 職場與管理

items.def: a meeting where an employer asks questions to choose a worker
items.s: I felt nervous before my first ______ ______, but I had practised my answers, so it went well.
items.zh: 我在第一次工作面試前很緊張，但我練習過答案，所以進行得很順利。
items.sec: The Workplace & Management 職場與管理

items.def: a written list of the duties of a job
items.s: According to the ______ ______, the assistant must speak English, so my sister decided to apply.
items.zh: 根據職務說明，這位助理必須會說英文，所以我姊姊決定去應徵。
items.sec: The Workplace & Management 職場與管理

items.def: an increase in the money you earn
items.s: After three years without a ______ ______, the nurses asked the hospital for more money, and it finally agreed.
items.zh: 在三年沒有加薪之後，護理師們向醫院要求加薪，而醫院最終同意了。
items.sec: The Workplace & Management 職場與管理

items.def: extra money added to normal pay
items.s: Workers in Taiwan usually get a year-end ______ before Lunar New Year, so they can buy gifts for their families.
items.zh: 台灣的員工通常在農曆新年前拿到年終獎金，所以他們可以為家人買禮物。
items.sec: The Workplace & Management 職場與管理

items.def: all the extra things a job offers, like insurance and holidays
items.s: The salary was lower than I hoped, but the ______ ______ included free meals and extra holidays.
items.zh: 薪水比我期望的低，但福利方案包括免費餐點和額外假期。
items.sec: The Workplace & Management 職場與管理

items.def: a meeting to discuss how well someone works
items.s: In her ______ ______, the manager praised her teamwork, but she said Amy should speak up more in meetings.
items.zh: 在她的績效評估中，經理稱讚她的團隊合作，但說艾美應該在會議中多發言。
items.sec: The Workplace & Management 職場與管理

items.def: to leave your job officially
items.s: He decided to ______ from the bank because he wanted to open his own café, and his boss wished him luck.
items.zh: 他決定從銀行辭職，因為他想開自己的咖啡店，而他的老闆祝他好運。
items.sec: The Workplace & Management 職場與管理

items.def: the act of leaving a job
items.s: The coach handed in his ______ after the team lost ten games in a row, so the club began looking for a new one.
items.zh: 在球隊連輸十場後，教練遞出了辭呈，所以球隊開始尋找新教練。
items.sec: The Workplace & Management 職場與管理

items.def: to make someone leave their job
items.s: The company had to ______ the worker who stole money, and it also changed the way cash is counted.
items.zh: 公司必須開除那名偷錢的員工，而且也改變了點算現金的方式。
items.sec: The Workplace & Management 職場與管理

items.def: the process of finding new workers
items.s: ______ is hard for factories in the countryside, because many young people prefer to work in big cities.
items.zh: 鄉間工廠的招募很困難，因為許多年輕人比較喜歡在大城市工作。
items.sec: The Workplace & Management 職場與管理

items.def: helping new workers learn about their job and company
items.s: The company's ______ lasts two weeks, so new staff learn the systems before they meet any customers.
items.zh: 公司的新人到職訓練為期兩週，所以新員工在接觸任何客戶前會先學習系統。
items.sec: The Workplace & Management 職場與管理

items.def: working well together as a group
items.s: The project succeeded because of good ______, and each member helped the others when they fell behind.
items.zh: 這個專案因為良好的團隊合作而成功，而且每位成員在別人進度落後時都會幫忙。
items.sec: The Workplace & Management 職場與管理

items.def: a written record of what was said at a meeting
items.s: Linda wrote the ______ of the meeting, so anyone who was absent could read what had been decided.
items.zh: 琳達撰寫了會議的會議紀錄，所以任何缺席的人都能讀到決議內容。
items.sec: The Workplace & Management 職場與管理

items.def: giving part of your work to someone else
items.s: Good ______ helps busy managers, because they can focus on big decisions while their team handles daily tasks.
items.zh: 良好的授權能幫助忙碌的經理，因為他們可以專注於重大決策，而團隊處理日常事務。
items.sec: The Workplace & Management 職場與管理

items.def: a healthy mix of time for work and personal life
items.s: Many young workers care about ______ ______, so they choose jobs that let them leave at six o'clock.
items.zh: 許多年輕員工重視工作與生活的平衡，所以他們選擇可以六點下班的工作。
items.sec: The Workplace & Management 職場與管理

items.def: a system where workers choose when to start and finish
items.s: With ______, my mother starts work at seven, so she can pick up my brother from school at four.
items.zh: 有了彈性工時，我媽媽七點開始上班，所以她可以四點去學校接我弟弟。
items.sec: The Workplace & Management 職場與管理

items.def: the order of power from the top to the bottom of a group
items.s: In a large company, a ______ ______ ______ is clear, but it can make decisions very slow.
items.zh: 在大公司裡，指揮體系很清楚，但它可能讓決策變得非常緩慢。
items.sec: The Workplace & Management 職場與管理

items.def: a manager between top leaders and ordinary workers
items.s: As a ______ ______, Mr Wu must follow orders from above, yet he also has to keep his own team happy.
items.zh: 身為中階主管，吳先生必須服從上級命令，但他也得讓自己的團隊開心。
items.sec: The Workplace & Management 職場與管理

items.def: a person who is learning a job
items.s: The ______ chef watched the head cook closely, and after six months she could make the soup on her own.
items.zh: 那位實習廚師仔細觀察主廚，而且六個月後她就能獨自做湯了。
items.sec: The Workplace & Management 職場與管理

items.def: the ways people try to gain power at work
items.s: He was good at his job, but he hated ______ ______, so he left to work for himself.
items.zh: 他很擅長自己的工作，但他討厭辦公室政治，所以他離職自己創業。
items.sec: The Workplace & Management 職場與管理

items.def: work to create new products and improve old ones
items.s: The company spends a fifth of its income on ______ ______ ______, so it releases new phones every year.
items.zh: 這家公司把五分之一的收入花在研發上，所以它每年都推出新手機。
items.sec: Innovation & Start-up Culture 創新與新創文化

items.def: changing an industry by doing things in a new way
items.s: Streaming was a ______ idea for the film industry, and many video rental shops closed within a few years.
items.zh: 串流對電影產業是一個顛覆性的想法，而許多錄影帶出租店在幾年內就關門了。
items.sec: Innovation & Start-up Culture 創新與新創文化

items.def: an organisation that helps new companies grow
items.s: The university runs an ______ for student businesses, so young founders get free offices and advice.
items.zh: 大學經營一個學生創業的育成中心，所以年輕創辦人能得到免費辦公室和建議。
items.sec: Innovation & Start-up Culture 創新與新創文化

items.def: a short programme that helps start-ups grow very fast
items.s: After joining a three-month ______ in Singapore, the team improved its app and met many investors.
items.zh: 在加入新加坡一個為期三個月的加速器計畫後，團隊改進了他們的應用程式並結識許多投資人。
items.sec: Innovation & Start-up Culture 創新與新創文化

items.def: a young company worth over one billion dollars
items.s: The delivery app became a ______ in only four years, but it has never made a profit.
items.zh: 這個外送應用程式只花了四年就成為獨角獸企業，但它從來沒有獲利過。
items.sec: Innovation & Start-up Culture 創新與新創文化

items.def: a talk that tries to persuade someone to buy
items.s: His ______ ______ was short and funny, so the investors listened carefully and asked for a second meeting.
items.zh: 他的推銷話術簡短又有趣，所以投資人仔細聆聽並要求第二次會面。
items.sec: Innovation & Start-up Culture 創新與新創文化

items.def: a set of slides used to present a business idea
items.s: The founders spent all night on their ______ ______, because they had only ten minutes to impress the judges.
items.zh: 創辦人整晚都在準備他們的募資簡報，因為他們只有十分鐘來打動評審。
items.sec: Innovation & Start-up Culture 創新與新創文化

items.def: the first money a new company gets to start
items.s: With the ______ ______, they built a simple version of the app, and then they asked users for feedback.
items.zh: 他們用種子資金開發了一個簡單版本的應用程式，然後向使用者徵求回饋。
items.sec: Innovation & Start-up Culture 創新與新創文化

items.def: a young company that is growing very quickly
items.s: The firm is no longer a tiny start-up but a ______, so it is opening offices in three new countries.
items.zh: 這家公司已不再是小小的新創，而是一家規模化成長企業，所以它正在三個新國家開設辦公室。
items.sec: Innovation & Start-up Culture 創新與新創文化

items.def: the simplest version of a product that people can test
items.s: Instead of waiting a year, the team launched a ______ ______ ______ in a month and improved it with users' ideas.
items.zh: 團隊沒有等上一年，而是在一個月內推出最小可行產品，再根據使用者的想法改進。
items.sec: Innovation & Start-up Culture 創新與新創文化

items.def: to repeat a process to improve something step by step
items.s: Designers ______ quickly by testing small changes every week, and they keep only the ones users like.
items.zh: 設計師每週測試小改動來快速反覆改進，而且只保留使用者喜歡的部分。
items.sec: Innovation & Start-up Culture 創新與新創文化

items.def: one version in a series of improvements
items.s: The first ______ of the robot kept falling over, but the fifth version could walk up stairs.
items.zh: 這個機器人的第一個版本一直跌倒，但第五個版本已經能走上樓梯。
items.sec: Innovation & Start-up Culture 創新與新創文化

items.def: to change a business plan in a new direction
items.s: The start-up sold cameras at first, but it decided to ______ to software when sales were poor.
items.zh: 這家新創起初賣相機，但在銷售不佳時決定轉型做軟體。
items.sec: Innovation & Start-up Culture 創新與新創文化

items.def: an early version of software tested by users
items.s: I joined the ______ of the new game, so I could play it early and report any bugs to the makers.
items.zh: 我加入了新遊戲的測試版，所以我能提早玩並向開發者回報任何錯誤。
items.sec: Innovation & Start-up Culture 創新與新創文化

items.def: the process of creating a new product
items.s: ______ ______ took three years because the engineers wanted the battery to be completely safe.
items.zh: 產品開發花了三年，因為工程師希望電池完全安全。
items.sec: Innovation & Start-up Culture 創新與新創文化

items.def: how easy and pleasant something is to use
items.s: The bank improved the ______ ______ of its app, so older customers can now pay bills without asking for help.
items.zh: 銀行改善了應用程式的使用者體驗，所以年長顧客現在不用求助就能繳費。
items.sec: Innovation & Start-up Culture 創新與新創文化

items.def: at the beginning of development
items.s: Investing in ______ companies is risky, because many of them close before they make any money.
items.zh: 投資早期階段的公司風險很高，因為許多公司在賺到錢之前就關門了。
items.sec: Innovation & Start-up Culture 創新與新創文化

items.def: the skills and activity of starting businesses
items.s: The school offers a course in ______, and students must design and sell a real product by the end of term.
items.zh: 學校開設一門創業課程，而學生必須在學期末前設計並銷售一個真正的產品。
items.sec: Innovation & Start-up Culture 創新與新創文化

items.def: willing to take risks to start new businesses
items.s: My cousin is very ______, so she started selling phone cases online when she was only fifteen.
items.zh: 我表妹很有創業精神，所以她才十五歲就開始在網路上賣手機殼。
items.sec: Innovation & Start-up Culture 創新與新創文化

items.def: a very large and powerful technology company
items.s: The small app was bought by a ______ ______, and its founders became rich overnight.
items.zh: 這個小應用程式被一家科技巨頭收購，而它的創辦人一夜致富。
items.sec: Innovation & Start-up Culture 創新與新創文化

items.def: an area in California famous for tech companies
items.s: Many engineers dream of working in ______ ______, but the high rent there makes life expensive.
items.zh: 許多工程師夢想在矽谷工作，但那裡的高房租讓生活很昂貴。
items.sec: Innovation & Start-up Culture 創新與新創文化

items.def: an event where people build software together very fast
items.s: Our team stayed awake for two days at the ______, and we built an app that helps students share notes.
items.zh: 我們團隊在黑客松熬了兩天，而且我們做出了一個幫助學生分享筆記的應用程式。
items.sec: Innovation & Start-up Culture 創新與新創文化

items.def: getting ideas or work from a large group of people online
items.s: The museum used ______ to name its new dinosaur, and thousands of children sent in suggestions.
items.zh: 博物館利用群眾外包為新的恐龍命名，而數千名孩子寄來了建議。
items.sec: Innovation & Start-up Culture 創新與新創文化

items.def: a person or company that copies another's idea
items.s: Soon after the cafe became popular, a ______ opened across the street with the same menu and lower prices.
items.zh: 那家咖啡店爆紅不久，對街就開了一家菜單相同、價格更低的模仿者。
items.sec: Innovation & Start-up Culture 創新與新創文化

items.def: the benefit of being the first company in a new market
items.s: The company had a ______ ______ in electric scooters, but rivals soon offered cheaper models.
items.zh: 這家公司在電動機車市場擁有先行者優勢，但競爭對手很快就推出更便宜的車款。
items.sec: Innovation & Start-up Culture 創新與新創文化

items.def: solving problems by focusing on users' real needs
items.s: Using ______ ______, the students interviewed elderly people first, and then they designed an easier remote control.
items.zh: 學生們運用設計思考，先訪問了長者，然後設計出更好用的遙控器。
items.sec: Innovation & Start-up Culture 創新與新創文化

items.def: technology used to provide financial services
items.s: ______ apps let people send money with their phones, so many young people rarely visit a bank.
items.zh: 金融科技應用程式讓人們用手機轉帳，所以許多年輕人很少去銀行。
items.sec: Innovation & Start-up Culture 創新與新創文化

items.def: a system where people rent or share things through apps
items.s: Bike rental apps are part of the ______ ______, and they let people ride without owning a bike.
items.zh: 租借腳踏車的應用程式是共享經濟的一部分，讓人們不用擁有腳踏車也能騎車。
items.sec: Innovation & Start-up Culture 創新與新創文化

items.def: a country or company that sells goods abroad
items.s: Taiwan is a major ______ of computer chips, so its economy depends on demand from other countries.
items.zh: 台灣是電腦晶片的主要出口國，所以它的經濟依賴其他國家的需求。
items.sec: Global Trade & the Economy 全球貿易與經濟

items.def: a country or company that buys goods from abroad
items.s: Japan is a big ______ of food, because it does not have enough farmland to feed everyone.
items.zh: 日本是糧食的主要進口國，因為它沒有足夠的農地養活所有人。
items.sec: Global Trade & the Economy 全球貿易與經濟

items.def: trade between countries without taxes or limits
items.s: Supporters of ______ ______ say it makes goods cheaper, but some farmers fear they cannot compete.
items.zh: 自由貿易的支持者說它讓商品更便宜，但有些農民擔心他們無法競爭。
items.sec: Global Trade & the Economy 全球貿易與經濟

items.def: an agreement between countries about buying and selling goods
items.s: The two countries signed a ______ ______ last month, so fruit can now be exported without extra taxes.
items.zh: 兩國上個月簽署了一項貿易協定，所以現在水果可以免額外關稅出口。
items.sec: Global Trade & the Economy 全球貿易與經濟

items.def: when countries keep raising taxes on each other's goods
items.s: During the ______ ______, prices of phones and toys went up, and many factories moved to other countries.
items.zh: 在貿易戰期間，手機和玩具的價格上漲，而且許多工廠遷往其他國家。
items.sec: Global Trade & the Economy 全球貿易與經濟

items.def: the value of one currency compared with another
items.s: The ______ ______ was good when we visited Japan, so our hotel and meals felt cheaper than usual.
items.zh: 我們去日本時匯率很好，所以飯店和餐點感覺比平常便宜。
items.sec: Global Trade & the Economy 全球貿易與經濟

items.def: a large company that works in many countries
items.s: She works for a ______ with offices in twenty countries, so she often has meetings late at night.
items.zh: 她在一家在二十個國家設有辦公室的跨國公司工作，所以她常在深夜開會。
items.sec: Global Trade & the Economy 全球貿易與經濟

items.def: the total value of goods and services a country produces in a year
items.s: The country's ______ grew by three percent last year, but many families said they did not feel richer.
items.zh: 這個國家的國內生產毛額去年成長了百分之三，但許多家庭說他們並沒有覺得更富裕。
items.sec: Global Trade & the Economy 全球貿易與經濟

items.def: an increase in the amount of goods and services produced
items.s: Fast ______ ______ created many new jobs, but it also caused traffic and pollution in the cities.
items.zh: 快速的經濟成長創造了許多新工作，但它也在城市造成交通和污染問題。
items.sec: Global Trade & the Economy 全球貿易與經濟

items.def: an expert who studies how money and trade work
items.s: The ______ warned that prices would keep rising, so she advised families to save more money.
items.zh: 這位經濟學家警告物價會持續上漲，所以她建議家庭多存點錢。
items.sec: Global Trade & the Economy 全球貿易與經濟

items.def: how much you can buy with your money
items.s: When prices rise faster than wages, people lose ______ ______, and they buy fewer things.
items.zh: 當物價漲得比薪水快時，人們就會失去購買力，而且買的東西會變少。
items.sec: Global Trade & the Economy 全球貿易與經濟

items.def: when companies keep cutting prices to beat each other
items.s: The two bubble tea chains started a ______ ______, and customers enjoyed cheap drinks for a whole month.
items.zh: 兩家珍奶連鎖店展開了一場價格戰，而顧客享受了整整一個月的便宜飲料。
items.sec: Global Trade & the Economy 全球貿易與經濟

items.def: an economy where prices are set by buyers and sellers, not the government
items.s: In a ______ ______, prices go up when goods are scarce, but this can hurt poor families.
items.zh: 在自由市場中，商品稀少時價格會上漲，但這可能傷害貧困家庭。
items.sec: Global Trade & the Economy 全球貿易與經濟

items.def: a country whose economy is growing and developing fast
items.s: Vietnam is an ______ ______ with many young workers, so foreign companies are building factories there.
items.zh: 越南是一個擁有許多年輕勞工的新興市場，所以外國公司正在那裡蓋工廠。
items.sec: Global Trade & the Economy 全球貿易與經濟

items.def: a poorer country that is building up its industry
items.s: Cheap mobile phones changed life in every ______ ______, because farmers could check prices before selling crops.
items.zh: 便宜的手機改變了每個開發中國家的生活，因為農民在賣作物前就能查詢價格。
items.sec: Global Trade & the Economy 全球貿易與經濟

items.def: when a country imports more than it exports
items.s: The country has a large ______ ______ because it buys more cars and oil than it sells abroad.
items.zh: 這個國家有很大的貿易逆差，因為它購買的汽車和石油比它出口的還多。
items.sec: Global Trade & the Economy 全球貿易與經濟

items.def: protecting home industries by taxing foreign goods
items.s: ______ may save some local jobs, but it often makes goods more expensive for ordinary shoppers.
items.zh: 貿易保護主義可能保住一些本地工作，但它常讓一般消費者的商品變得更貴。
items.sec: Global Trade & the Economy 全球貿易與經濟

items.def: a time when an economy suddenly becomes very weak
items.s: During the ______ ______, many banks failed, and my parents worried that they would lose their savings.
items.zh: 在經濟危機期間，許多銀行倒閉，而我爸媽擔心他們會失去積蓄。
items.sec: Global Trade & the Economy 全球貿易與經濟

items.def: a sudden, large fall in share prices
items.s: Many people lost money in the ______ ______, so they became afraid of buying shares for years.
items.zh: 許多人在股市崩盤中賠了錢，所以他們好幾年都害怕買股票。
items.sec: Global Trade & the Economy 全球貿易與經濟

items.def: money given to save a company or country from failing
items.s: The government gave the airline a ______ to keep it flying, but taxpayers were angry about it.
items.zh: 政府給予航空公司紓困讓它繼續營運，但納稅人對此很生氣。
items.sec: Global Trade & the Economy 全球貿易與經濟

items.def: a group of companies that agree to keep prices high
items.s: The oil ______ agreed to produce less oil, so petrol prices rose all over the world.
items.zh: 石油卡特爾同意減產，所以全世界的汽油價格都上漲了。
items.sec: Global Trade & the Economy 全球貿易與經濟

items.def: a time when share prices are rising
items.s: In a ______ ______ almost everyone seems to make money, but wise investors still save some cash.
items.zh: 在多頭市場中幾乎每個人似乎都在賺錢，但明智的投資人仍會保留一些現金。
items.sec: Global Trade & the Economy 全球貿易與經濟

items.def: a time when share prices are falling
items.s: The ______ ______ lasted almost two years, so my uncle waited patiently before selling his shares.
items.zh: 那次空頭市場持續了將近兩年，所以我叔叔耐心等待才賣出他的股票。
items.sec: Global Trade & the Economy 全球貿易與經濟

items.def: a fall in the value of a country's money
items.s: After the ______ of the currency, imported goods became much more expensive, but tourists found the country cheap.
items.zh: 在貨幣貶值後，進口商品變得貴很多，但遊客發現這個國家很便宜。
items.sec: Global Trade & the Economy 全球貿易與經濟

items.def: a path used to move goods between places
items.s: The canal is an important ______ ______ between Asia and Europe, so a blockage there delays ships worldwide.
items.zh: 這條運河是亞洲和歐洲之間重要的貿易路線，所以那裡一旦堵塞就會延誤全世界的船隻。
items.sec: Global Trade & the Economy 全球貿易與經濟

items.def: buying and selling between countries all over the world
items.s: Thanks to the internet, a small tea farm can sell to the ______ ______, and customers in Canada now buy its oolong.
items.zh: 多虧了網路，一座小茶園也能銷售到全球市場，而加拿大的顧客現在會買它的烏龍茶。
items.sec: Global Trade & the Economy 全球貿易與經濟

items.def: a person who studies data and gives advice
items.s: The ______ studied the company's sales figures carefully, and she predicted that profits would rise next year.
items.zh: 這位分析師仔細研究了公司的銷售數字，而且她預測明年利潤會上升。

items.def: help or support, often money
items.s: With the ______ of a large bank, the young company could build a new factory, so it hired fifty workers.
items.zh: 有了一家大銀行的支持，這家年輕的公司得以蓋新工廠，所以雇用了五十名員工。

items.def: discussing to reach an agreement about price or pay
items.s: After weeks of ______, the union and the company agreed on a pay rise, so the workers ended their strike.
items.zh: 經過數週的談判，工會和公司就加薪達成協議，所以工人結束了罷工。

items.def: the ability to do something well
items.s: The new manager showed great ______ in her first month, and the team quickly began to trust her decisions.
items.zh: 新經理在第一個月就展現了出色的能力，而團隊很快就開始信任她的決定。

items.def: the ability to compete well with others
items.s: The factory bought new machines to improve its ______, because cheaper rivals were winning many customers.
items.zh: 工廠購買了新機器來提升競爭力，因為較便宜的對手正在搶走許多顧客。

items.def: feeling too satisfied, so you stop trying hard
items.s: The market leader lost customers through ______, because it stopped improving while smaller rivals kept innovating.
items.zh: 這家市場龍頭因為自滿而流失顧客，因為它停止進步，而較小的對手持續創新。

items.def: following rules or laws
items.s: All our toys must be ______ with safety laws, so every batch is tested in a laboratory before shipping.
items.zh: 我們所有的玩具都必須符合安全法規，所以每一批在出貨前都會在實驗室檢測。

items.def: a company that gives expert advice
items.s: The hospital hired a ______ to cut waiting times, and the experts suggested a new booking system.
items.zh: 醫院聘請了一家顧問公司來縮短等候時間，而專家們建議採用新的預約系統。

items.def: an expert who is paid to give advice
items.s: The ______ visited our shop for a week, and she told us to move the best-selling items near the door.
items.zh: 這位顧問來我們店裡一週，而她告訴我們把最暢銷的商品移到門口附近。

items.def: relating to a contract
items.s: The builder had a ______ duty to finish the office by June, so he paid a fine when it was late.
items.zh: 營造商有合約上的義務要在六月前完成辦公室，所以延誤時他付了罰款。

items.def: to work together for the same goal
items.s: The two rival shops decided to ______ during the festival, and they shared one large stall to save money.
items.zh: 兩家競爭的商店決定在節慶期間合作，而且他們共用一個大攤位來省錢。

items.def: trusted to pay back money
items.s: The bank decided she was ______ because she always paid her bills on time, so it lent her the money quickly.
items.zh: 銀行認定她信用良好，因為她總是準時繳帳單，所以很快就借錢給她。

items.def: a reduction in spending or staff
items.s: The newspaper made big ______ last year, so many reporters lost their jobs and the paper became thinner.
items.zh: 這家報社去年大幅削減開支，所以許多記者失業，報紙也變薄了。

items.def: hard work and strong commitment
items.s: Her ______ to the small bakery was amazing, because she woke up at four every morning for ten years.
items.zh: 她對這家小麵包店的投入令人驚嘆，因為十年來她每天凌晨四點就起床。

items.def: a piece of work you must complete and hand over
items.s: The first ______ of the project is a simple website, and the client wants to see it by next Monday.
items.zh: 這個專案的第一項交付成果是一個簡單的網站，而客戶想在下週一前看到它。

items.def: careful and steady effort
items.s: Thanks to his ______, the young clerk found an error worth a million dollars, so the boss gave him a reward.
items.zh: 多虧他的勤奮，這位年輕職員發現了一筆價值百萬元的錯誤，所以老闆給了他獎勵。

items.def: becoming smaller or less
items.s: The company spent more and more on adverts, but it saw ______ results, so it stopped the campaign.
items.zh: 公司在廣告上花得越來越多，但看到的效果卻遞減，所以它停止了這個活動。

items.def: not happy with something
items.s: ______ customers often tell their friends about bad service, so the shop trains its staff to solve problems quickly.
items.zh: 不滿意的顧客常會把糟糕的服務告訴朋友，所以這家店訓練員工迅速解決問題。

items.def: having many different types of business
items.s: The company is ______, selling food, clothes and electronics, so a bad year in one area does not hurt it much.
items.zh: 這家公司經營多元化，販售食品、服飾和電子產品，所以某一領域表現不佳不太會影響它。

items.def: energy and new ideas
items.s: The city's young population gives its economy great ______, and new cafés and studios open every month.
items.zh: 這座城市的年輕人口為它的經濟帶來極大的活力，而且每個月都有新咖啡店和工作室開幕。

items.def: not using much money or fuel
items.s: The small car is very ______ to run, so delivery companies use it for short trips in the city.
items.zh: 這款小車開起來非常省錢，所以快遞公司在市區短程配送時使用它。

items.def: to attract someone by offering something good
items.s: The shop used free gifts to ______ customers inside, and most of them ended up buying something.
items.zh: 那家店用免費贈品吸引顧客進來，而他們大多數最後都買了東西。

items.def: more than is needed
items.s: The factory sells its ______ stock to discount shops, so it does not waste goods that nobody ordered.
items.zh: 工廠把過剩的存貨賣給折扣商店，所以不會浪費沒人訂購的商品。

items.def: a person who provides large amounts of money for business
items.s: A wealthy ______ paid for the new stadium, but he wanted his company's name on the front of it.
items.zh: 一位富有的金融家出資興建新體育館，但他希望把公司名稱放在場館正面。

items.def: friendly feelings toward a business
items.s: The shop gave free meals to firefighters, and this act of ______ made many locals become loyal customers.
items.zh: 那家店提供免費餐點給消防員，而這份善意讓許多當地人成為忠實顧客。

items.def: to find and offer a job to a skilled person from another company
items.s: A rival firm tried to ______ our best engineer, so our boss offered her a higher salary to stay.
items.zh: 一家競爭公司試圖挖角我們最優秀的工程師，所以老闆提供她更高的薪水讓她留下。

items.def: currently holding a position or leading a market
items.s: The ______ phone company had controlled the market for years, but a new rival quickly won young customers.
items.zh: 那家在位的電信公司多年來掌控市場，但一家新對手很快就贏得了年輕顧客。

items.def: owing money
items.s: Many students are heavily ______ after university, so they take any job to pay back their loans.
items.zh: 許多學生大學畢業後背負沉重債務，所以他們接受任何工作來償還貸款。

items.def: to make prices or numbers higher than they should be
items.s: Some hotels ______ their prices during festivals, so smart travellers book their rooms months earlier.
items.zh: 有些飯店在節慶期間抬高價格，所以精明的旅客會提前幾個月訂房。

items.def: being unable to pay what you owe
items.s: The shoe shop faced ______ after sales dropped, but a larger company bought it and saved most jobs.
items.zh: 銷售下滑後這家鞋店面臨無力償債，但一家較大的公司收購了它並保住大部分工作。

items.def: easy to sell, or attractive to employers
items.s: Learning to code makes students more ______, because many companies need people who understand software.
items.zh: 學習寫程式讓學生更有市場，因為許多公司需要懂軟體的人。

items.def: able to be changed through discussion
items.s: The salary in the advert is ______, so experienced applicants can ask for more money at the interview.
items.zh: 廣告中的薪資可議，所以有經驗的應徵者可以在面試時要求更高的薪水。

items.def: discussion to reach an agreement
items.s: The ______ between the two companies lasted three months, but in the end they agreed to work together.
items.zh: 兩家公司之間的協商持續了三個月，但最終他們同意合作。

items.def: the fact of owning something
items.s: The ______ of the football club changed last year, and the new owners promised to build a bigger stadium.
items.zh: 這家足球俱樂部的所有權去年易主，而新老闆承諾要蓋更大的體育館。

items.def: that must be paid
items.s: The rent is ______ on the first day of each month, so the shop owner sets a reminder on his phone.
items.zh: 房租是每月第一天應付的，所以店主在手機上設定了提醒。

items.def: the act of making someone agree or believe
items.s: It took a lot of ______ to convince my grandmother to shop online, but now she orders vegetables every week.
items.zh: 花了好一番說服才讓奶奶願意網購，但現在她每週都訂蔬菜。

items.def: the ability to make a profit
items.s: The airline cut unpopular routes to improve its ______, and it made money for the first time in five years.
items.zh: 航空公司刪減冷門航線來改善獲利能力，而且五年來首次賺錢。

items.def: to get back money you have spent or lost
items.s: The film cost a fortune to make, but it ______ its costs in the first week because millions of people saw it.
items.zh: 這部電影耗資巨大，但它在第一週就收回了成本，因為數百萬人看了它。

items.def: losing your job because it is no longer needed
items.s: The bank offered ______ to two hundred staff after it closed many branches, and each person received extra pay.
items.zh: 銀行關閉許多分行後對兩百名員工提出資遣，而且每個人都得到額外補償。

items.def: to put profits back into a business
items.s: Instead of buying a new car, the owner decided to ______ the profit in better coffee machines.
items.zh: 老闆沒有買新車，而是決定把利潤再投資在更好的咖啡機上。

items.def: payment for work
items.s: The ______ for the job includes a good salary and a car, so many experienced managers applied for it.
items.zh: 這份工作的報酬包括優渥的薪水和一輛車，所以許多資深經理應徵了這個職位。

items.def: to discuss and change an agreement again
items.s: When rents rose, the café owner tried to ______ her contract, and the landlord agreed to a smaller increase.
items.zh: 房租上漲時，咖啡店老闆試著重新協商合約，而房東同意了較小的漲幅。

items.def: having so many products that no more can be sold
items.s: The bubble tea market is ______ in this area, so a new shop must offer something special to survive.
items.zh: 這一區的珍奶市場已經飽和，所以新店必須提供特別的東西才能生存。

items.def: having enough money to pay all debts
items.s: The company stayed ______ during the crisis because it had saved money in good years.
items.zh: 這家公司在危機期間保持有償債能力，因為它在好年頭有存錢。

items.def: a formal offer to do work at a stated price
items.s: Five companies sent in a ______ to build the new bridge, and the city chose the one with the best safety plan.
items.zh: 五家公司提出了建造新橋的投標，而市政府選擇了安全計畫最好的那一家。

items.def: growing and doing very well
items.s: The once-quiet street now has a ______ night market, and visitors come from all over the island.
items.zh: 這條曾經冷清的街道現在有個蓬勃發展的夜市，而遊客從全島各地前來。

items.def: a big improvement after a bad period
items.s: The new boss led an amazing ______, and the shop that was losing money is now one of the best in town.
items.zh: 新老闆帶來了驚人的轉虧為盈，而那家原本虧錢的店現在是鎮上最好的店之一。

items.def: not making a profit
items.s: The company closed its ______ stores in small towns, but it opened bigger ones in the cities.
items.zh: 公司關閉了小鎮裡無利可圖的門市，但在城市開了更大的店。

items.def: an improvement in business or the economy
