items.s: There was an ______ in hotel bookings after the borders reopened, so the staff who had left were rehired.
items.zh: 邊境重新開放後飯店訂房出現好轉，所以先前離職的員工被重新雇用。

items.def: an unexpected amount of money
items.s: The family received a ______ when their old land was bought for a new railway, so they paid off their debts.
items.zh: 這家人的舊土地被收購來建新鐵路，他們得到一筆意外之財，所以還清了債務。

items.def: a message saying you have received something
items.s: The company sent an ______ of my application by email, but I did not hear anything more for a month.
items.zh: 公司用電子郵件寄來我申請的確認通知，但之後一個月我都沒再收到任何消息。

items.def: the ability to change to suit new situations
items.s: Employers value ______, because markets change quickly and workers must learn new tools every year.
items.zh: 雇主重視適應力，因為市場變化很快，員工每年都必須學習新工具。

items.def: relating to office work and managing an organisation
items.s: Teachers spend many hours on ______ tasks like filling in forms, so they have less time to plan lessons.
items.zh: 老師花很多時間在填表等行政工作上，所以他們備課的時間變少了。

items.def: an official connection with a group or company
items.s: The hotel has an ______ with a famous international chain, so guests can collect points for free nights.
items.zh: 這家飯店與一家國際知名連鎖集團有隸屬關係，所以房客可以累積點數換取免費住宿。

items.def: official permission
items.s: You need your manager's ______ to spend more than ten thousand dollars, so please send her an email first.
items.zh: 花費超過一萬元需要經理的授權，所以請先寄電子郵件給她。

items.def: relating to a budget
items.s: Because of ______ limits, the school could not buy new computers, so students shared the old ones.
items.zh: 由於預算限制，學校無法購買新電腦，所以學生們共用舊電腦。

items.def: in a way that makes money
items.s: The film was praised by critics, but it was not ______ successful, because few people bought tickets.
items.zh: 這部電影受到影評人稱讚，但它在商業上並不成功，因為很少人買票。

items.def: a fall in the value of something over time
items.s: A new car suffers fast ______, so it may be worth only half its price after three years.
items.zh: 新車折舊很快，所以三年後可能只值原價的一半。

items.def: having money available to spend quickly
items.s: The shop had plenty of stock but little ______, so it could not pay its suppliers on time.
items.zh: 這家店有很多存貨，但資金周轉不足，所以無法準時付款給供應商。

items.def: using chances for your own advantage
items.s: Some ______ sellers raised the price of masks during the outbreak, but the government quickly fined them.
items.zh: 有些投機的賣家在疫情爆發期間抬高口罩價格，但政府很快就罰了他們。

items.def: a chance to do something good
items.s: The trade fair was a great ______ to meet buyers, so the small company brought hundreds of samples.
items.zh: 這場貿易展是結識買家的好機會，所以這家小公司帶了數百件樣品。

items.def: too much of something for the demand
items.s: An ______ of mangoes this summer made prices fall, so farmers turned many of them into juice and dried fruit.
items.zh: 今年夏天芒果供過於求導致價格下跌，所以農民把許多芒果做成果汁和果乾。

items.def: to think something is worth more than it is
items.s: Investors may ______ new tech companies, and when reality appears, their share prices can fall quickly.
items.zh: 投資人可能會高估新科技公司，而當現實出現時，它們的股價可能迅速下跌。

items.def: deciding how much to charge for something
items.s: The gym changed its ______ to attract students, so now a monthly pass costs half the old price.
items.zh: 健身房改變了定價來吸引學生，所以現在月票只要原價的一半。

items.def: rich and successful
items.s: The port town became ______ when the factory opened, and many families could afford new homes.
items.zh: 工廠開設後這座港口小鎮變得繁榮，而許多家庭有能力買新房子。

items.def: to do less well than expected
items.s: Shares in the company continued to ______ this year, so some investors sold them and bought others.
items.zh: 這家公司的股票今年持續表現不佳，所以有些投資人賣掉它們改買其他股票。

items.def: paid or done before the work starts
items.s: The builder asked us to pay half the money ______, and we would pay the rest when the kitchen was finished.
items.zh: 營造商要求我們預先支付一半的錢，剩下的在廚房完工時再付。

items.def: in a strong and determined way
items.s: The new coffee chain is expanding ______, opening a shop on almost every corner, so local cafés are worried.
items.zh: 新咖啡連鎖店正強勢地擴張，幾乎在每個街角都開店，所以本地咖啡店很擔心。

items.def: a person or group that supports you
items.s: The small farmers found an ______ in a big supermarket, which agreed to sell their vegetables at fair prices.
items.zh: 小農們在一家大型超市找到了盟友，它同意以公平價格販售他們的蔬菜。

items.def: by itself, without a person doing it
items.s: The system ______ orders more paper when the supply is low, so the office never runs out.
items.zh: 系統會在存量不足時自動地訂購更多紙張，所以辦公室從不會缺紙。

items.def: a feeling that you can trust someone or something
items.s: When shoppers lose ______ in the economy, they spend less, and many shops see their sales fall.
items.zh: 當消費者對經濟失去信心時，他們會減少消費，而許多商店的銷售就會下滑。

items.def: very fierce and without kindness
items.s: The food delivery business is ______, and companies offer huge discounts just to stop customers leaving.
items.zh: 外送產業競爭激烈，而且公司提供巨額折扣只為了留住顧客。

items.def: happening quickly
items.s: The company's ______ reply to the complaint impressed the customer, so she gave it five stars online.
items.zh: 公司對投訴的迅速回覆讓顧客印象深刻，所以她在網路上給了五顆星。

items.def: a person's job
items.s: Please write your ______ on the form, and the bank will use it to decide what kind of account suits you.
items.zh: 請在表格上填寫你的職業，而銀行會用它來決定哪種帳戶適合你。

items.def: a person or company you work with in business
items.s: She found a business ______ who was good at numbers, while she focused on designing the clothes.
items.zh: 她找到一位擅長數字的事業合夥人，而她則專注於設計服裝。

items.def: to call, email or write to someone
items.s: If you have any questions about your order, please ______ our team, and we will reply within one day.
items.zh: 如果你對訂單有任何問題，請聯絡我們的團隊，我們會在一天內回覆。

items.def: to move forward or make progress
items.s: She took evening classes in management because she wanted to ______ in her career, and she was promoted a year later.
items.zh: 她上了管理學夜間課程，因為她想在職涯中晉升，而一年後她就升職了。

items.def: the ability to lead people
items.s: Under her ______, the small team won three national awards, so other companies tried to hire her.
items.zh: 在她的領導下，這個小團隊贏得了三項全國獎項，所以其他公司都想聘請她。

items.def: communication between groups so they work well together
items.s: Ben works as a ______ between the designers and the factory, so problems are solved before production starts.
items.zh: 阿班擔任設計師與工廠之間的聯絡窗口，所以問題在生產開始前就能解決。

items.def: documents and forms you must complete
items.s: Opening a company involves a lot of ______, so many people pay an accountant to help them.
items.zh: 開公司涉及大量的文書工作，所以很多人付錢請會計師幫忙。

items.def: the people employed by an organisation
items.s: Only authorised ______ can enter the laboratory, so visitors must wait in the meeting room.
items.zh: 只有經授權的人員才能進入實驗室，所以訪客必須在會議室等候。

items.def: a statement of how much a job will cost
items.s: We asked three builders for a ______, and then we chose the one who explained the costs most clearly.
items.zh: 我們向三家營造商要了報價單，然後選擇了把費用說明得最清楚的那一家。

items.def: to choose someone officially for a job
items.s: The board will ______ a new chief executive next month, and many people expect it to be a woman.
items.zh: 董事會將在下個月任命一位新執行長，而許多人預期會是一位女性。

items.def: to give something officially as a prize or contract
items.s: The city decided to ______ the contract to a local company, so the new park will create jobs for residents.
items.zh: 市政府決定把合約授予一家本地公司，所以新公園將為居民創造工作機會。

items.def: to finally win or agree on something
items.s: Our sales team flew to Tokyo to ______ the deal, and they came back with a contract worth millions.
items.zh: 我們的業務團隊飛到東京去敲定這筆交易，而且他們帶回了一份價值數百萬的合約。

items.def: to attract and keep someone's interest
items.s: Short videos ______ young viewers better than long adverts, so many brands now post daily clips.
items.zh: 短影片比長廣告更能吸引年輕觀眾，所以許多品牌現在每天發布短片。

items.def: to offer more money than someone else
items.s: A wealthy collector managed to ______ the museum at the auction, so the painting went to a private home.
items.zh: 一位富有的收藏家在拍賣會上成功出價高過博物館，所以這幅畫流入私人宅邸。

items.def: to sell more than another product or company
items.s: Electric cars may soon ______ petrol cars in some countries, because they are cheaper to run.
items.zh: 在某些國家，電動車很快就可能銷量超過汽油車，因為它們的使用成本更低。

items.def: to ask for too much money
items.s: The taxi driver tried to ______ the tourists, but they checked the price on a map app and refused to pay.
items.zh: 計程車司機試圖對遊客多收費，但他們用地圖應用程式查了價格並拒絕付款。

items.def: to spend more money than planned
items.s: Many families ______ during the holidays, and then they have to save hard in January.
items.zh: 許多家庭在假期期間超支，然後在一月就得努力省錢。

items.def: to increase prices or taxes suddenly
items.s: The airline decided to ______ its fares before the holiday, so many students chose to take the train instead.
items.zh: 航空公司決定在假期前調漲票價，所以許多學生改搭火車。

items.def: to reduce something a lot
items.s: The shop will ______ prices on winter coats next week, so I am waiting before I buy one.
items.zh: 這家店下週將大砍冬季外套的價格，所以我要等一等再買。

items.def: to go down slightly for a short time
items.s: Sales usually ______ in February after the holidays, but they rise again when the weather gets warmer.
items.zh: 銷售通常在假期後的二月小幅下滑，但天氣轉暖時又會回升。

items.def: to fall quickly in value
items.s: Share prices began to ______ after the bad news, and some investors lost half their money in a week.
items.zh: 壞消息傳出後股價開始暴跌，而有些投資人一週內損失了一半的錢。

items.def: to become three times bigger
items.s: Online orders ______ during the lockdown, so the company had to hire more drivers and pack faster.
items.zh: 封城期間線上訂單增為三倍，所以公司必須雇用更多司機並加快打包速度。

items.def: to sell part of a business or investment
items.s: The company decided to ______ its oil business, because it wanted to focus on clean energy.
items.zh: 公司決定出售它的石油事業，因為它想專注於潔淨能源。

items.def: to send someone a request for payment
items.s: The plumber will ______ us at the end of the month, so we do not have to pay him today.
items.zh: 水電工會在月底開帳單給我們，所以我們今天不用付錢給他。

items.def: to ask an amount of money for something
items.s: Some airlines ______ extra for bags, so passengers try to fit everything into one small suitcase.
items.zh: 有些航空公司對行李額外收費，所以乘客試著把所有東西塞進一個小行李箱。

items.def: to have enough money to pay for something
items.s: Young couples in big cities often cannot ______ a flat, so many of them live with their parents for years.
items.zh: 大城市的年輕夫妻常常負擔不起一間公寓，所以他們很多人和父母同住好幾年。

items.def: to have to pay money back to someone
items.s: The shop still ______ its supplier a lot of money, but it promised to pay everything after the holiday sales.
items.zh: 這家店仍欠供應商很多錢，但它承諾在假期促銷後全部付清。

items.def: to take an amount away from a total
items.s: The company will ______ the cost of the uniform from your first salary, so you will receive a little less.
items.zh: 公司會從你的第一份薪水中扣除制服的費用，所以你會領得少一點。

items.def: to officially refuse to allow something
items.s: The chairperson can ______ any plan she thinks is too risky, but she usually listens to the team first.
items.zh: 主席可以否決任何她認為風險太高的計畫，但她通常會先聽取團隊的意見。

items.def: to agree to pay for losses or costs if needed
items.s: A large insurer agreed to ______ the concert, so the organisers would not lose money if it rained.
items.zh: 一家大型保險公司同意為這場演唱會承保，所以即使下雨主辦單位也不會賠錢。

items.def: to pay money that you owe
items.s: Please ______ your bill before you leave the hotel, and you can pay by card or in cash.
items.zh: 請在離開飯店前結清你的帳單，你可以刷卡或付現。

items.def: to make someone want to work hard
items.s: Bonuses can ______ staff for a short time, but many workers say interesting tasks matter more.
items.zh: 獎金可以在短時間內激勵員工，但許多員工說有趣的任務更重要。

items.def: to attract someone with something tempting
items.s: The tech company tried to ______ top graduates with free meals and a gym, and many accepted its offers.
items.zh: 這家科技公司試圖用免費餐點和健身房來引誘頂尖畢業生，而且許多人接受了它的錄用。

items.def: to do what you promised
items.s: The new phone did not ______ the long battery life it promised, so many angry buyers asked for refunds.
items.zh: 新手機沒有兌現它承諾的長效電池續航力，所以許多憤怒的買家要求退款。

items.def: to sell something you have bought
items.s: Some people buy concert tickets only to ______ them at higher prices, so real fans cannot get seats.
items.zh: 有些人買演唱會門票只是為了以更高價格轉售，所以真正的歌迷買不到位子。

items.def: growing very fast and successfully
items.s: Tourism is ______ on the island, so new hotels and restaurants are opening along the beach.
items.zh: 島上的觀光業正蓬勃發展，所以海灘沿線陸續開了新飯店和餐廳。

items.def: well known and getting a lot of attention
items.s: The brand hired a ______ actor for its advert, but the campaign cost more than the whole year's budget.
items.zh: 這個品牌為廣告請來一位高知名度的演員，但這個活動的花費超過了整年的預算。

items.def: not working to make money for owners
items.s: She works for a ______ group that teaches farmers how to sell online, and any extra money goes back to them.
items.zh: 她在一個非營利團體工作，教農民如何在網路上販售，而任何結餘都回饋給他們。

items.def: likely to be successful
items.s: The judges said the students' idea was very ______, and an investor offered to help them build it.
items.zh: 評審說學生們的點子非常有前途，而一位投資人主動提出幫他們實現。

items.def: having a lot of experience
items.s: A ______ manager knows that problems will happen, so she always keeps extra time in the schedule.
items.zh: 一位經驗豐富的經理知道問題一定會發生，所以她總是在時程中預留額外時間。

items.def: wanted by many people
items.s: Engineers who understand AI are very ______ these days, and companies compete hard to hire and keep them.
items.zh: 懂人工智慧的工程師非常搶手，而且公司們激烈競爭來聘用他們。

items.def: having a lot of money
items.s: The shop sells handbags to ______ tourists, but most local people cannot afford its prices.
items.zh: 這家店把手提包賣給富有的觀光客，但大多數本地人負擔不起它的價格。

items.def: needing many workers
items.s: Making clothes by hand is ______, so many brands move their factories to countries with lower wages.
items.zh: 手工製衣是勞力密集的，所以許多品牌把工廠移到工資較低的國家。

items.def: needing a lot of money for machines and buildings
items.s: Building computer chips is ______, so only a few huge companies can afford the factories.
items.zh: 製造電腦晶片是資本密集的，所以只有少數大公司負擔得起這些工廠。

items.def: mainly interested in making money
items.s: Critics say ______ companies ignore the environment, but some firms prove that green businesses can make money.
items.zh: 批評者說以獲利為導向的公司忽視環境，但有些企業證明綠色事業也能賺錢。

items.def: paying close attention to what customers need
items.s: The bank became more ______ after the complaints, and now staff call customers back within an hour.
items.zh: 在收到投訴後，銀行變得更以顧客為中心，而現在員工會在一小時內回電給顧客。

items.def: not having enough money
items.s: The ______ museum asked every visitor for donations, because the city had cut its funding last year.
items.zh: 這間缺錢的博物館向參觀者請求捐款，因為市政府削減了它的經費。

items.def: losing money instead of making profit
items.s: The company sold its ______ toy department, so it could focus on games that earned money.
items.zh: 公司賣掉了虧損的玩具部門，以便專注於能賺錢的遊戲。

items.def: not taxed
items.s: Tourists can get ______ shopping at some department stores, so they bring their passports when they go shopping.
items.zh: 觀光客在某些百貨公司可以免稅購物，所以他們逛街時會帶著護照。

items.def: sold without import tax, often at airports
items.s: My father always buys ______ chocolate at the airport, because it is cheaper than in the city.
items.zh: 我爸爸總是在機場買免稅巧克力，因為比市區便宜。

items.def: owned by someone else before
items.s: ______ phones are popular with students, because they cost half the price and still work well.
items.zh: 二手手機很受學生歡迎，因為它們只要半價而且還很好用。

items.def: completely new and not used
items.s: He bought a ______ laptop for university, but he still uses his old one to play games.
items.zh: 他為了上大學買了一台全新的筆電，但他仍然用舊的那台玩遊戲。

items.def: sold in very large numbers
items.s: The author's ______ book about saving money has been translated into twenty languages, so she is now famous worldwide.
items.zh: 這位作者關於存錢的最暢銷書籍已被翻譯成二十種語言，所以她現在全球知名。

items.def: attracting attention easily
items.s: The shop's ______ window display made people stop and look, and many of them came inside.
items.zh: 這家店吸睛的櫥窗擺設讓人停下來觀看，而許多人走了進來。

items.def: easy to use
items.s: The ticket machine is ______, so even young children and tourists can buy tickets without help.
items.zh: 這台售票機很容易使用，所以即使小孩和觀光客也能自行買票。

items.def: careful about spending money
items.s: ______ shoppers compare prices online before they buy anything, so shops must offer really good deals.
items.zh: 注重成本的消費者在購買前會先上網比價，所以商店必須提供好的優惠。

items.def: not wanting to take risks
items.s: My parents are ______ investors, so they keep most of their money in the bank instead of buying shares.
items.zh: 我爸媽是規避風險的投資人，所以他們把大部分的錢存在銀行而不是買股票。

items.def: planning for the future with new ideas
items.s: The ______ mayor invested in electric buses early, and now the city has some of the cleanest air in the country.
items.zh: 那位有遠見的市長很早就投資電動公車，而現在這座城市擁有全國數一數二乾淨的空氣。

items.def: expensive and of high quality
items.s: The ______ restaurant charges a lot for each dish, but it uses only the best local ingredients.
items.zh: 這家高檔的餐廳每道菜都收費很高，但它只使用最好的在地食材。

items.def: cheap
items.s: ______ airlines have made travel much cheaper, but passengers must pay extra for food and bags.
items.zh: 廉價航空讓旅行變得更便宜，但乘客必須額外支付餐點和行李費用。

items.def: made for and sold to very many people
items.s: The company makes ______ shoes in huge numbers, so it can keep prices low for ordinary families.
items.zh: 這家公司大量生產大眾市場的鞋子，所以能為一般家庭維持低價。

items.def: done by a company's own staff
items.s: The firm has an ______ design team, so it does not need to pay outside agencies for its adverts.
items.zh: 這家公司有內部的設計團隊，所以不需要付錢請外部廣告公司做廣告。

items.def: ready-made and available to buy
items.s: The shop used ______ software for its website, because building its own system would cost too much.
items.zh: 這家店的網站用了現成的軟體，因為自己建置系統的成本太高。

items.def: among the best in the world
items.s: The city wants to build a ______ convention centre, so it can hold big international trade fairs.
items.zh: 這座城市想建造一座世界級的會展中心，以便舉辦大型國際貿易展。

items.def: controlled by leaders at the top
items.s: The company used a ______ style, so workers rarely shared ideas, and many talented people left.
items.zh: 這家公司採用由上而下的管理風格，所以員工很少分享想法，而許多人才離開了。

items.def: starting from ordinary workers or people
items.s: The school took a ______ approach, and students suggested most of the changes to the cafeteria menu.
items.zh: 學校採取由下而上的方式，而學生提出了大部分餐廳菜單的改變。

items.def: not getting involved in details
items.s: Our boss has a ______ style, so we can decide how to do our work as long as we meet deadlines.
items.zh: 我們老闆的風格是放手的，所以只要我們準時完成，就可以自己決定怎麼做事。

items.def: existing for a long time and respected
items.s: The ______ bakery has served the town for sixty years, but it now also sells cakes online.
items.zh: 這家歷史悠久的麵包店已為鎮上服務六十年，但它現在也在網路上賣蛋糕。

items.def: needing to be done quickly
items.s: This offer is ______, so if you do not reply by Friday, the discount will no longer be available.
items.zh: 這個優惠有時效性，所以如果你週五前沒有回覆，折扣就不再適用。

items.def: in a way related to money
items.s: Many young adults want to be ______ independent, so they take part-time jobs while studying.
items.zh: 許多年輕人想要在財務上獨立，所以他們在求學期間兼職打工。

items.def: in a way related to the economy
items.s: The new port is ______ important for the region, because it will bring jobs and trade to small towns.
items.zh: 這座新港口在經濟上對地區很重要，因為它會為小鎮帶來工作和貿易。

items.def: in a way that makes a profit
items.s: The farm now runs ______ because it sells directly to customers, so it no longer depends on middlemen.
items.zh: 這座農場現在有利潤地經營，因為它直接賣給顧客，所以不再依賴中間商。

items.def: at a price similar to or lower than rivals
items.s: The new phone is ______ priced, so it may attract buyers who usually choose more famous brands.
items.zh: 這款新手機的定價具競爭力，所以可能會吸引通常選擇更知名品牌的買家。

items.def: in a carefully planned way
items.s: The shop is ______ located near two schools, so it is busy every afternoon when classes finish.
items.zh: 這家店策略性地設在兩所學校附近，所以每天下午放學時都很忙。

items.def: in many countries
items.s: The Taiwanese bicycle brand is now sold ______, and it sponsors races in Europe and America.
items.zh: 這個台灣自行車品牌現在在國際上銷售，而且它在歐美贊助賽事。

items.def: in the nearby area
items.s: The restaurant buys its vegetables ______, so the food is fresher and farmers earn more money.
items.zh: 這家餐廳在當地採購蔬菜，所以食物更新鮮，農民也賺得更多。

items.def: only a little
items.s: Prices rose only ______ this year, but many families still felt that life was getting harder.
items.zh: 今年物價只稍微上漲，但許多家庭仍然覺得生活越來越辛苦。

items.def: at the present time
items.s: The company is ______ looking for summer interns, so students should send their CVs before May.
items.zh: 這家公司目前正在招募暑期實習生，所以學生應在五月前寄出履歷。

items.def: in a way that achieves what you wanted
items.s: The team ______ launched the app on time, and it had ten thousand users by the end of the week.
items.zh: 團隊準時成功地推出了應用程式，而且到週末已經有一萬名使用者。

items.def: together with others
items.s: The two companies ______ own the new factory, so they share both the costs and the profits.
items.zh: 兩家公司共同擁有這座新工廠，所以他們共同分擔成本和利潤。

items.def: separately, one by one
items.s: Each cake is wrapped ______, so customers can buy just one and keep the rest fresh.
items.zh: 每塊蛋糕都個別包裝，所以顧客可以只買一塊，其餘的也能保持新鮮。

items.def: owned by a person, not the government
items.s: The hospital is ______ owned, so patients often pay more, but they usually wait less.
items.zh: 這家醫院是私人擁有的，所以病人常常要付更多錢，但通常等候較短。

items.def: in a morally right way
items.s: The brand says its coffee is ______ sourced, so farmers receive a fair price for their beans.
items.zh: 這個品牌說它的咖啡是合乎道德地採購的，所以農民能為他們的咖啡豆得到公平價格。

items.def: in a careful and sensible way
items.s: Banks should lend money ______, because people who borrow too much can lose their homes.
items.zh: 銀行應該負責任地放款，因為借太多錢的人可能會失去他們的房子。

items.def: practical knowledge and skill
items.s: The small company lacked the ______ to sell abroad, so it hired an experienced export manager.
items.zh: 這家小公司缺乏海外銷售的專業技術，所以它聘請了一位有經驗的出口經理。

items.def: meeting people who may help your career
items.s: ______ events help young designers meet clients, so my sister goes to one every month.
items.zh: 建立人脈的活動幫助年輕設計師認識客戶，所以我姊姊每個月都去參加一場。

items.def: the skill and good behaviour expected at work
items.s: The staff dealt with the angry customer with great ______, and he calmed down and apologised.
items.zh: 員工以極佳的專業素養處理那位憤怒的顧客，而他冷靜下來並道了歉。

items.def: being on time
items.s: Japanese trains are famous for their ______, so passengers expect an apology if a train is one minute late.
items.zh: 日本的火車以準時聞名，所以列車晚一分鐘乘客就會期待道歉。

items.def: the ability to find clever ways to solve problems
items.s: With little money but great ______, the students turned old boxes into furniture and sold it at the market.
items.zh: 這些學生雖然缺錢但極有應變能力，他們把舊箱子做成家具並在市集販售。

items.def: an agreement about how something will be done
items.s: The two shops have an ______ to share delivery drivers, so both of them save money every month.
items.zh: 兩家店有一項共用送貨司機的協議，所以雙方每個月都能省錢。

items.def: a company that provides goods to another company
items.s: Our main ______ raised the price of flour, so the bakery had to charge a little more for bread.
items.zh: 我們的主要供應商調漲了麵粉價格，所以麵包店不得不把麵包賣貴一點。

items.def: a person or company that sells something
items.s: The school chose a new ______ for its lunch boxes, because parents complained the old food was too oily.
items.zh: 學校為便當選擇了一家新廠商，因為家長抱怨以前的食物太油。

items.def: money that should already have been paid
items.s: The family fell into ______ on their rent after the father lost his job, so a charity helped them.
items.zh: 父親失業後，這家人積欠了房租欠款，所以一個慈善團體幫助了他們。

items.def: a person or company that is owed money
items.s: When the company closed, each ______ received only part of the money they were owed, so many were angry.
items.zh: 公司倒閉時，每位債權人只拿回部分欠款，所以很多人很生氣。

items.def: a person who owes money
items.s: The bank gave the ______ more time to pay, because he had lost his job but was looking for a new one.
items.zh: 銀行給了那位債務人更多時間還款，因為他失業了但正在找新工作。

items.def: one of several payments for something
items.s: We are paying for the sofa in monthly ______, so it will be fully ours after one year.
items.zh: 我們用每月分期付款的方式買沙發，所以一年後它就完全屬於我們了。

items.def: a large amount of money paid at one time
items.s: When he retired, he received a ______ ______ from the company, and he used it to open a small tea shop.
items.zh: 他退休時從公司領到一筆一次付清的款項，而他用這筆錢開了一家小茶店。

items.def: money received from selling something or an event
items.s: All ______ from the charity concert will go to the children's hospital, so the tickets sold out quickly.
items.zh: 慈善音樂會的所有收益都將捐給兒童醫院，所以門票很快就賣光了。

items.def: the difference between cost and selling price
items.s: Bubble tea has a high ______ ______, because the ingredients are cheap but each drink sells for sixty dollars.
items.zh: 珍珠奶茶的利潤率很高，因為原料便宜，但每杯能賣六十元。

items.def: money given back to a buyer
items.s: The government offers a ______ to people who buy energy-saving fridges, so many families replaced their old ones.
items.zh: 政府對購買節能冰箱的人提供回饋金，所以許多家庭換掉了舊冰箱。

items.def: money you have kept and not spent
items.s: She used her ______ to start a small online shop, but she kept her day job until it made a profit.
items.zh: 她用自己的積蓄開了一家小網店，但在它獲利之前她仍保留白天的工作。

items.def: a share in a business
items.s: The tech giant bought a ten percent ______ in the start-up, so it now has a seat on the board.
items.zh: 這家科技巨頭買下新創公司百分之十的股份，所以它現在在董事會有一席。

items.def: an extra amount added to the usual price
items.s: The restaurant adds a ten percent ______ on public holidays, because staff must be paid more on those days.
items.zh: 這家餐廳在國定假日加收百分之十的附加費，因為那些天員工的薪資要更高。

items.def: the most important of a group of products or shops
items.s: The brand opened its ______ store on the busiest street, and fans queued all night for the opening.
items.zh: 這個品牌在最熱鬧的街上開了它的旗艦店，而粉絲們為了開幕整晚排隊。

items.def: achieving good results
items.s: The ______ businesswoman gives free talks at schools, because she wants girls to believe they can run companies.
items.zh: 這位成功的女企業家在學校舉辦免費講座，因為她希望女孩們相信自己也能經營公司。

items.def: something achieved with effort
items.s: Opening a second shop was a great ______ for the young couple, and they celebrated with their staff.
items.zh: 開第二家店對這對年輕夫妻來說是一項了不起的成就，而他們和員工一起慶祝。

items.def: speaking clearly and confidently about what you want
items.s: Good salespeople need ______, but they must also listen carefully, or customers will feel pushed.
items.zh: 好的銷售員需要自信果斷，但他們也必須仔細聆聽，否則顧客會覺得被強迫。

items.def: comparing the costs and advantages of something
items.s: The city did a ______ study of the new metro line, and it found the benefits were twice the costs.
items.zh: 市政府對新捷運線做了一份成本效益研究，而發現效益是成本的兩倍。

items.def: polite and kind behaviour
items.s: The hotel is famous for the ______ of its staff, so many guests return year after year.
items.zh: 這家飯店以員工的禮貌聞名，所以許多房客年年回訪。

items.def: the process of making choices
items.s: Good data can improve ______ in a company, but managers still need common sense and experience.
items.zh: 好的數據可以改善公司的決策，但經理們仍需要常識和經驗。

items.def: treating people unfairly to gain profit
items.s: The factory was criticised for ______ working hours, so the brand promised to check all its suppliers.
items.zh: 這家工廠因剝削性的工時而受到批評，所以品牌承諾要檢查所有供應商。

items.def: the person or company most likely to win
items.s: The local firm is the ______ for the new contract, but two foreign companies are still competing.
items.zh: 這家本地公司是新合約的領先者，但仍有兩家外國公司在競爭。

items.def: gained through a lot of hard work
items.s: Consumers want good value for their ______ money, so they read reviews before buying expensive things.
items.zh: 消費者希望辛苦賺來的錢能物有所值，所以他們在買昂貴的東西前會先看評論。

items.def: not able to do a job well
items.s: The ______ manager lost several important clients, so the company finally moved him to another role.
items.zh: 那位不稱職的經理流失了好幾位重要客戶，所以公司最後把他調到別的職位。

items.def: a situation where two things do not fit well together
items.s: There is a ______ between the skills graduates have and the skills companies need, so many young people struggle to find jobs.
items.zh: 畢業生具備的技能與公司需要的技能之間不匹配，所以許多年輕人很難找到工作。

items.def: trying to do more than is possible
items.s: The plan to open fifty shops in a year was ______, and the company ran out of money halfway.
items.zh: 一年內開五十家店的計畫野心過大，而公司在半途就把錢用光了。

items.def: the return of money you invested
items.s: Solar panels are expensive at first, but the ______ comes within eight years because electricity bills fall.
items.zh: 太陽能板一開始很貴，但八年內就能回本，因為電費會下降。

items.def: making unfair profits, especially in hard times
items.s: The government warned shops against ______ after the typhoon, because some had doubled the price of water.
items.zh: 颱風過後政府警告商店不得牟取暴利，因為有些商店把水價提高了一倍。

items.def: rich or successful through your own work
items.s: The ______ millionaire grew up poor, but he started selling snacks at fifteen and never stopped working.
items.zh: 這位白手起家的百萬富翁在貧困中長大，但他十五歲就開始賣零食而且從不停歇。

items.def: earning a lot of money
items.s: Engineering jobs in Taiwan are usually ______, so many students choose to study science at university.
items.zh: 工程類工作通常高薪，所以許多學生在大學選擇讀理科。

items.def: a person who works too much and finds it hard to stop
items.s: My uncle is a ______ who checks emails even on holiday, so his family has asked him to switch off his phone.
items.zh: 我叔叔是個連度假都在收信的工作狂，所以他的家人要求他關掉手機。

items.def: something that helps you survive a difficult time
items.s: Online orders were a ______ for small restaurants during the lockdown, because customers could not eat inside.
items.zh: 封城期間線上訂單是小餐廳的救命索，因為顧客無法內用。

items.def: a quicker way of doing something
items.s: There is no ______ to building a good brand, so companies must keep their promises for many years.
items.zh: 建立好品牌沒有捷徑，所以公司必須多年來信守承諾。

items.def: past achievements that show how good someone is
items.s: The manager has a strong ______ ______ of saving failing shops, so the owners hired her immediately.
items.zh: 這位經理有挽救經營不善店家的出色過往紀錄，所以老闆們立刻聘請了她。

items.def: a new and confident company that challenges older ones
items.s: The ______ airline offered cheap flights to Japan, and the older airlines quickly lowered their prices too.
items.zh: 這家新貴航空推出飛日本的便宜航班，而老牌航空公司也很快降低了價格。

items.def: a cheap copy of a famous product
items.s: The bag looked like a famous brand, but it was a ______, so the zip broke after only a week.
items.zh: 這個包包看起來像名牌，但它是仿冒品，所以拉鍊才一週就壞了。

items.def: something that costs far too much
items.s: Ten dollars for a bottle of water is a ______, so we waited and bought one at a convenience store.
items.zh: 一瓶水要十美元根本是敲竹槓，所以我們等到便利商店才買。

items.def: to earn just enough to cover costs, with no profit or loss
items.s: The new café lost money for six months, but it finally ______ ______ in the summer, so the owner felt hopeful.
items.zh: 這家新咖啡店虧了六個月的錢，但終於在夏天達到損益兩平，所以老闆覺得很有希望。

items.def: to reduce the money a business spends
items.s: The factory had to ______ ______ after sales fell, so it turned off machines at night and used less packaging.
items.zh: 銷售下滑後工廠必須削減成本，所以它晚上關掉機器並減少包裝。

items.def: the most important fact; or the final profit
items.s: We can discuss colours all day, but ______ ______ ______ is that customers will not pay more than five hundred dollars.
items.zh: 我們可以整天討論顏色，但最重要的是顧客不會付超過五百元。

items.def: to stop trading because a company has failed
items.s: Many video shops ______ ______ ______ ______ when streaming became popular, and their buildings became cafés.
items.zh: 串流普及後許多錄影帶店倒閉了，而它們的店面變成了咖啡店。

items.def: to start a business in a place
items.s: The young chef decided to ______ ______ ______ in her hometown, because rent was cheaper than in Taipei.
items.zh: 這位年輕主廚決定在她的家鄉開店，因為租金比台北便宜。

items.def: to control most of the sales of a product
items.s: The company tried to ______ ______ ______ in smart watches, but cheaper rivals soon appeared from abroad.
items.zh: 這家公司試圖在智慧手錶領域壟斷市場，但較便宜的對手很快就從國外出現。

items.def: to start successfully
items.s: The project never ______ ______ ______ ______, because the team could not find enough money to build the first model.
items.zh: 這個計畫始終沒能順利起步，因為團隊找不到足夠的錢來製作第一個模型。

items.def: a result that is good for everyone involved
items.s: The farmers sell fresh fruit to the school, and students eat healthy snacks, so it is ______ ______ ______.
items.zh: 農民把新鮮水果賣給學校，而學生吃到健康點心，所以這是一個雙贏局面。

items.def: back to the beginning after failing
items.s: The investor pulled out at the last minute, so the founders were ______ ______ ______ ______ and had to start searching again.
items.zh: 投資人在最後一刻退出，所以創辦人們回到原點，必須重新開始尋找。

items.def: a rough estimate of a number
items.s: I know you cannot give an exact price yet, but can you give me ______ ______ ______ so I can plan my budget?
items.zh: 我知道你還不能給確切的價格，但你可以給我一個大概的數字讓我規劃預算嗎？

items.def: owing money or losing money
items.s: The bookshop has been ______ ______ ______ for two years, but the owner keeps it open because she loves it.
items.zh: 這家書店已經虧損兩年了，但老闆因為熱愛它而繼續營業。

items.def: making a profit; not in debt
items.s: After many difficult years, the airline is finally ______ ______ ______, so it can pay back the government loan.
items.zh: 經過多年的艱困期，這家航空公司終於有盈餘了，所以它可以償還政府的貸款。

items.def: with very little money
items.s: They started the company ______ ______ ______, working in a tiny room and using their own old laptops.
items.zh: 他們以極少的資金創立了公司，在一間小房間工作並使用自己的舊筆電。

items.def: to make a lot of money quickly
items.s: Umbrella sellers ______ ______ ______ during the sudden storm, because hundreds of tourists had not brought one.
items.zh: 突如其來的暴風雨期間賣傘的小販大賺一筆，因為數百名遊客沒有帶傘。

items.def: a rule that shops should try to satisfy customers
items.s: The owner believes that ______ ______ ______ ______ ______, but she will not let anyone be rude to her staff.
items.zh: 老闆相信顧客永遠是對的，但她不會讓任何人對她的員工無禮。

items.def: to move up to higher positions in a company
items.s: He worked long hours to ______ ______ ______ ______, but later he realised he wanted more time with his children.
items.zh: 他長時間工作以在公司裡步步高升，但後來他意識到自己想多陪陪孩子。

items.def: to start dealing with the important matter
items.s: After a few minutes of small talk, the manager said, "Let's ______ ______ ______ ______," and she opened the sales report.
items.zh: 閒聊幾分鐘後，經理說：「我們言歸正傳吧。」然後她打開了銷售報告。

items.def: to finally make an agreement certain
items.s: The two companies had talked for months, and they finally ______ ______ ______ over dinner in Tokyo.
items.zh: 兩家公司談了好幾個月，最後在東京的晚餐上拍板成交。

items.def: wasting time means wasting money
items.s: The delivery company believes that ______ ______ ______, so its drivers use apps to find the fastest routes.
items.zh: 這家快遞公司相信時間就是金錢，所以司機們用應用程式尋找最快的路線。

items.def: to decide to do something risky after thinking about it
items.s: After years of dreaming, my aunt finally ______ ______ ______ and quit her office job to open a bakery.
items.zh: 夢想多年之後，我阿姨終於放手一搏，辭掉辦公室工作開了一家麵包店。

items.s: The price of ________ ________ went up sharply last month, so many airlines raised their ticket prices for the summer holidays.
items.zh: 上個月原油價格急劇上漲，所以許多航空公司調高了暑假的機票價格。
items.sec: Fossil Fuels & Extraction 化石燃料與開採
items.def: oil in its natural state before it is cleaned

items.s: Most homes in our city cook with ________ ________, but some older buildings still use heavy gas bottles instead.
items.zh: 我們城市大多數家庭用天然氣煮飯，但有些舊大樓仍然使用笨重的瓦斯桶。
items.sec: Fossil Fuels & Extraction 化石燃料與開採
items.def: a gas from under the ground used for heating and cooking

items.s: Thousands of workers moved to the desert after a huge ________ ________ was discovered, and a new town quickly grew there.
items.zh: 在發現一座巨大的油田之後，數千名工人搬到沙漠，一座新城鎮很快就在那裡發展起來。
items.sec: Fossil Fuels & Extraction 化石燃料與開採
items.def: an area where a lot of oil is under the ground

items.s: The company drilled a new ________ ________ near the coast, but local fishermen worried that a leak could harm the sea.
items.zh: 這家公司在海岸附近鑽了一口新油井，但當地漁民擔心外洩可能會傷害海洋。
items.sec: Fossil Fuels & Extraction 化石燃料與開採
items.def: a deep hole made in the ground to get oil out

items.s: A new gas ________ will run under the sea to our island, so we will no longer need to ship gas by boat.
items.zh: 一條新的天然氣管線將從海底通到我們的島，所以我們將不再需要用船運送天然氣。
items.sec: Fossil Fuels & Extraction 化石燃料與開採
items.def: a long pipe that carries oil, gas or water far away

items.s: Some countries have banned ________ because it uses huge amounts of water and may cause small earthquakes in nearby towns.
items.zh: 有些國家已經禁止水力壓裂法，因為它使用大量的水，而且可能在附近城鎮引發小地震。
items.sec: Fossil Fuels & Extraction 化石燃料與開採
items.def: pumping water into rocks to break them and release gas

items.s: The USA produces a lot of ________ ________ today, and this has made gas much cheaper for American factories and homes.
items.zh: 美國現在生產大量的頁岩氣，這讓美國工廠和家庭的天然氣變得便宜許多。
items.sec: Fossil Fuels & Extraction 化石燃料與開採
items.def: natural gas trapped inside layers of soft rock

items.s: Getting oil out of ________ ________ uses a lot of energy and water, so environmental groups say it is a very dirty process.
items.zh: 從油砂中提煉石油會消耗大量能源和水，所以環保團體說這是非常骯髒的過程。
items.sec: Fossil Fuels & Extraction 化石燃料與開採
items.def: sand mixed with thick, sticky oil

items.s: The news reported that oil now costs over ninety dollars a ________, and drivers are worried about paying more for petrol.
items.zh: 新聞報導石油現在每桶超過九十美元，駕駛人擔心要付更多油錢。
items.sec: Fossil Fuels & Extraction 化石燃料與開採
items.def: a unit used to measure oil, about 159 litres

items.s: My dad always fills the car with ________ before a long trip, because there are few stations on the mountain road.
items.zh: 我爸爸在長途旅行前總是先把車加滿汽油，因為山路上的加油站很少。
items.sec: Fossil Fuels & Extraction 化石燃料與開採
items.def: liquid fuel used in most cars

items.s: Most big trucks run on ________, but the city plans to replace its old buses with quieter electric ones next year.
items.zh: 大多數大卡車使用柴油，但市政府計畫明年用更安靜的電動公車取代舊公車。
items.sec: Fossil Fuels & Extraction 化石燃料與開採
items.def: a heavy fuel used in trucks, buses and some cars

items.s: During the typhoon the electricity went off, so my grandmother lit an old ________ lamp and we played cards together.
items.zh: 颱風期間停電了，所以奶奶點了一盞舊的煤油燈，我們一起玩牌。
items.sec: Fossil Fuels & Extraction 化石燃料與開採
items.def: an oil burned in lamps and some heaters

items.s: Planes burn a huge amount of ________ ________ on long flights, so airlines are testing cleaner fuels made from used cooking oil.
items.zh: 飛機在長途飛行中燃燒大量的航空燃油，所以航空公司正在測試用廢食用油製成的更乾淨燃料。
items.sec: Fossil Fuels & Extraction 化石燃料與開採
items.def: special fuel used by aeroplanes

items.s: Taiwan imports most of its gas as ________ ________ ________, which arrives in special ships and is stored in cold tanks.
items.zh: 台灣進口的天然氣大多是液化天然氣，它由特殊船隻運來，並儲存在低溫儲槽中。
items.sec: Fossil Fuels & Extraction 化石燃料與開採
items.def: natural gas cooled until it becomes liquid for shipping

items.s: We took a small ________ stove on our camping trip, and it was easy to cook noodles even in the rain.
items.zh: 我們露營時帶了一個小型丙烷爐，即使在下雨也很容易煮麵。
items.sec: Fossil Fuels & Extraction 化石燃料與開採
items.def: a gas sold in tanks for cooking and heating

items.s: A huge ________ ________ got stuck in the canal for six days, and many other ships had to wait outside.
items.zh: 一艘巨大的油輪在運河中卡了六天，許多其他船隻只好在外面等候。
items.sec: Fossil Fuels & Extraction 化石燃料與開採
items.def: a large ship that carries oil

items.s: Saudi Arabia has some of the largest ________ ________ in the world, so it has great power in the energy market.
items.zh: 沙烏地阿拉伯擁有世界上最大的石油蘊藏量之一，所以它在能源市場上擁有很大的影響力。
items.sec: Fossil Fuels & Extraction 化石燃料與開採
items.def: the amount of oil a country still has underground

items.s: Burning ________ creates more pollution than other types of coal, but some power plants still use it because it is cheap.
items.zh: 燃燒褐煤比其他種類的煤產生更多污染，但有些電廠仍使用它，因為它很便宜。
items.sec: Fossil Fuels & Extraction 化石燃料與開採
items.def: soft brown coal that produces a lot of smoke

items.s: Some experts believe we have already reached ________ ________, while others think new technology will let us find more oil.
items.zh: 有些專家認為我們已經到達石油產量頂峰，而其他人則認為新技術將讓我們找到更多石油。
items.sec: Fossil Fuels & Extraction 化石燃料與開採
items.def: the time when world oil production reaches its highest point

items.s: You can see huge flames at night because of ________ ________, and this wastes gas that could heat thousands of homes.
items.zh: 由於天然氣燃除，你在夜晚可以看到巨大的火焰，而這浪費了足以供暖數千戶家庭的天然氣。
items.sec: Fossil Fuels & Extraction 化石燃料與開採
items.def: burning off unwanted gas at an oil well

items.s: Many ________ factories line the southern coast, and people living nearby often complain about the bad smell in the air.
items.zh: 許多石化工廠沿著南部海岸設立，住在附近的居民常常抱怨空氣中的難聞氣味。
items.sec: Fossil Fuels & Extraction 化石燃料與開採
items.def: made from oil or natural gas

items.s: After ________, crude oil can be turned into petrol, diesel and plastics, so the process is very important for industry.
items.zh: 經過精煉之後，原油可以轉變成汽油、柴油和塑膠，所以這個過程對工業非常重要。
items.sec: Fossil Fuels & Extraction 化石燃料與開採
items.def: the process of making oil clean and useful

items.s: My uncle works on a ________ in the North Sea for two weeks at a time, and then he flies home to rest.
items.zh: 我叔叔在北海的一座鑽油平台上一次工作兩週，然後再搭飛機回家休息。
items.sec: Fossil Fuels & Extraction 化石燃料與開採
items.def: a large structure used to drill for oil or gas

items.s: An old oil ________ still stands in the town square, and tourists take photos of it to remember the town's history.
items.zh: 一座舊的石油井架仍矗立在鎮上廣場，遊客會拍照留念這個城鎮的歷史。
items.sec: Fossil Fuels & Extraction 化石燃料與開採
items.def: a tall metal tower built over an oil well

items.s: A storm hit the ________ ________ last night, so all the workers were flown back to land by helicopter.
items.zh: 昨晚一場暴風雨襲擊了海上採油平台，所以所有工人都被直升機載回陸地。
items.sec: Fossil Fuels & Extraction 化石燃料與開採
items.def: a structure in the sea where oil is taken from the seabed

items.s: We stopped at a ________ ________ to fill the tank, and my little brother bought some snacks from the shop there.
items.zh: 我們在加油站停下來加滿油，我弟弟在那裡的商店買了一些零食。
items.sec: Fossil Fuels & Extraction 化石燃料與開採
items.def: a place where you buy fuel for your car

items.s: Many families in the countryside buy ________ ________ every autumn, because the winters there are long and very cold.
items.zh: 許多鄉下家庭每年秋天都會購買暖氣用油，因為那裡的冬天又長又冷。
items.sec: Fossil Fuels & Extraction 化石燃料與開採
items.def: oil burned to keep buildings warm

items.s: The government allowed ________ ________ near the national park, but many citizens protested because they wanted to protect the wildlife.
items.zh: 政府允許在國家公園附近進行石油探勘，但許多市民抗議，因為他們想要保護野生動物。
items.sec: Fossil Fuels & Extraction 化石燃料與開採
items.def: searching for new places where oil can be found

items.s: We smelled something strange in the kitchen, so we opened all the windows and called the company to check for a ________ ________.
items.zh: 我們在廚房聞到奇怪的味道，所以打開所有窗戶，並打電話請公司來檢查是否有瓦斯外洩。
items.sec: Fossil Fuels & Extraction 化石燃料與開採
items.def: gas escaping by accident from a pipe

items.s: A large ________ ________ spread along the beach after the accident, and volunteers spent weeks cleaning oil off seabirds.
items.zh: 事故發生後，一大片浮油沿著海灘擴散，志工們花了好幾週清理海鳥身上的油汙。
items.sec: Fossil Fuels & Extraction 化石燃料與開採
items.def: a layer of oil floating on the sea

items.s: The new ________ ________ will supply electricity to half a million homes, but people living nearby are worried about the noise.
items.zh: 這座新發電廠將供電給五十萬戶家庭，但住在附近的人擔心噪音問題。
items.sec: Electricity & the Power Grid 電力與電網
items.def: a factory that produces electricity

items.s: A fallen tree broke a ________ ________ during the storm, so our whole street had no electricity until the next morning.
items.zh: 暴風雨期間一棵倒下的樹弄斷了一條電線，所以我們整條街直到隔天早上都沒有電。
items.sec: Electricity & the Power Grid 電力與電網
items.def: a wire that carries electricity over long distances

items.s: Workers are building a giant ________ on the hill, and it will carry electricity from the wind farm to the city.
items.zh: 工人們正在山丘上建造一座巨大的電塔，它將把風力發電場的電輸送到城市。
items.sec: Electricity & the Power Grid 電力與電網
items.def: a tall metal tower that holds up power lines

items.s: The ________ outside our building exploded with a loud bang, so the lifts stopped and everyone had to use the stairs.
items.zh: 我們大樓外的變壓器發出巨響爆炸了，所以電梯停了，大家只好走樓梯。
items.sec: Electricity & the Power Grid 電力與電網
items.def: a device that changes the voltage of electricity

items.s: The power company is building a ________ near our school, but parents want to know whether it is completely safe.
items.zh: 電力公司正在我們學校附近興建一座變電所，但家長們想知道它是否完全安全。
items.sec: Electricity & the Power Grid 電力與電網
items.def: a place where electricity is changed before reaching homes

items.s: There was a ________ ________ in the middle of my online exam, so I had to explain the problem to my teacher by phone.
items.zh: 我線上考試考到一半時停電了，所以我只好打電話向老師解釋問題。
items.sec: Electricity & the Power Grid 電力與電網
items.def: a time when the electricity supply stops

items.s: The heatwave caused a huge ________ across the city, and traffic lights stopped working during the busy evening rush hour.
items.zh: 熱浪造成全市大停電，交通號誌在繁忙的傍晚尖峰時段都停止運作。
items.sec: Electricity & the Power Grid 電力與電網
items.def: a time when a whole area loses electricity

items.s: The company apologised for the two-hour ________, and it promised to give every customer a small discount on next month's bill.
items.zh: 公司為長達兩小時的停電道歉，並承諾下個月的帳單給每位客戶小額折扣。
items.sec: Electricity & the Power Grid 電力與電網
items.def: a period when a service like electricity stops working

items.s: ________ ________ usually happens on hot summer afternoons, because almost every office and home turns on the air conditioning.
items.zh: 尖峰用電需求通常發生在炎熱的夏日午後，因為幾乎每間辦公室和住家都會開冷氣。
items.sec: Electricity & the Power Grid 電力與電網
items.def: the time when people use the most electricity

items.s: We run the washing machine at night because ________ electricity is cheaper, and it helps us save money every month.
items.zh: 我們在晚上使用洗衣機，因為離峰電價比較便宜，這幫助我們每個月省錢。
items.sec: Electricity & the Power Grid 電力與電網
items.def: at a time when fewer people use something, so it is cheaper

items.s: Coal plants used to supply most of the ________, but now gas and nuclear plants provide more of this steady power.
items.zh: 燃煤電廠過去提供大部分的基載電力，但現在燃氣和核能電廠提供更多這種穩定的電力。
items.sec: Electricity & the Power Grid 電力與電網
items.def: the minimum amount of power needed all the time

items.s: This small heater uses about one ________ of power, so it can warm a bedroom without making the bill too high.
items.zh: 這台小型暖氣機大約耗電一千瓦，所以它可以讓臥室變暖又不會讓電費太高。
items.sec: Electricity & the Power Grid 電力與電網
items.def: a unit of power equal to 1,000 watts

items.s: Electricity costs about four dollars per ________ in summer, so my mum asks us to turn off lights we are not using.
items.zh: 夏天每度電大約四元，所以媽媽要我們關掉沒在用的燈。
items.sec: Electricity & the Power Grid 電力與電網
items.def: a unit of electricity used, shown on your bill

items.s: Each of the new wind turbines can produce eight ________, and together they will power thousands of homes on the coast.
items.zh: 每一座新的風力發電機都能產生八百萬瓦的電力，合起來將供電給沿海的數千戶家庭。
items.sec: Electricity & the Power Grid 電力與電網
items.def: a unit of power equal to one million watts

items.s: This LED bulb uses only ten ________, but it gives as much light as an old bulb that used sixty.
items.zh: 這顆LED燈泡只用十瓦，但它的亮度和舊的六十瓦燈泡一樣。
items.sec: Electricity & the Power Grid 電力與電網
items.def: a basic unit for measuring electric power

items.s: Homes are supplied with ________ ________, but phones and laptops need an adapter because they run on direct current.
items.zh: 家庭供應的是交流電，但手機和筆電需要變壓器，因為它們使用直流電。
items.sec: Electricity & the Power Grid 電力與電網
items.def: electricity that changes direction many times a second

items.s: There is only one ________ next to my bed, so I use an extension cord to charge my phone and lamp.
items.zh: 我床邊只有一個插座，所以我用延長線來替手機充電和接檯燈。
items.sec: Electricity & the Power Grid 電力與電網
items.def: the place in a wall where you plug things in

items.s: British ________ have three square pins, so we bought a travel adapter before our trip to London.
items.zh: 英國的插頭有三根方形插腳，所以我們在去倫敦前買了一個旅行轉接頭。
items.sec: Electricity & the Power Grid 電力與電網
items.def: the part at the end of a wire that goes into a socket

items.s: Never connect too many heaters to one ________ ________, because it can get very hot and may even start a fire.
items.zh: 千萬不要在一條延長線上接太多暖氣機，因為它會變得很燙，甚至可能引起火災。
items.sec: Electricity & the Power Grid 電力與電網
items.def: a long wire that lets you plug in things far from a socket

items.s: I plug my computer, printer and lamp into one ________ ________, so I can switch them all off with one button.
items.zh: 我把電腦、印表機和檯燈都插在一個排插上，這樣我只要按一個按鈕就能全部關掉。
items.sec: Electricity & the Power Grid 電力與電網
items.def: a row of sockets on a short cable

items.s: When we used the oven and the heater together, the ________ ________ switched off, and the whole kitchen went dark.
items.zh: 當我們同時使用烤箱和暖氣機時，斷路器跳掉了，整個廚房一片漆黑。
items.sec: Electricity & the Power Grid 電力與電網
items.def: a switch that stops electricity when there is a problem

items.s: Water got into the old hair dryer and caused a ________ ________, so there was a spark and a smell of burning plastic.
items.zh: 水跑進那台舊吹風機造成短路，所以冒出火花，還有塑膠燒焦的味道。
items.sec: Electricity & the Power Grid 電力與電網
items.def: a fault where electricity takes the wrong path

items.s: The fire was caused by an ________ fault in the old building, so the owner has now replaced all the wiring.
items.zh: 這場火災是舊大樓的電氣故障所引起的，所以屋主現在已經更換了所有電線。
items.sec: Electricity & the Power Grid 電力與電網
items.def: related to or using electricity

items.s: The ________ ________ sent a letter about higher prices, but it also offered tips on how families can use less power.
items.zh: 公用事業公司寄來一封關於漲價的信，但也提供了家庭如何少用電的小技巧。
items.sec: Electricity & the Power Grid 電力與電網
items.def: a company that supplies electricity, gas or water

items.s: A new ________ ________ will carry solar power from the south to the north, because most factories are in the north.
items.zh: 一條新的輸電線路將把太陽能電力從南部送到北部，因為大部分工廠都在北部。
items.sec: Electricity & the Power Grid 電力與電網
items.def: a high-voltage cable that carries power across a country

items.s: Hospitals need a steady ________ ________ all the time, so they keep large backup generators in case the main electricity fails.
items.zh: 醫院隨時都需要穩定的電力供應，所以他們備有大型備用發電機，以防主電源中斷。
items.sec: Electricity & the Power Grid 電力與電網
items.def: the electricity that is provided to a place

items.s: Lightning hit our neighbourhood last night, but my computer was fine because it was plugged into a ________ ________.
items.zh: 昨晚閃電打中我們社區，但我的電腦沒事，因為它插在突波保護器上。
items.sec: Electricity & the Power Grid 電力與電網
items.def: a device that protects machines from sudden strong electricity

items.s: A ________ ________ can send power where it is needed most, so it reduces waste and helps prevent sudden blackouts.
items.zh: 智慧電網能把電力送到最需要的地方，所以它減少浪費，並幫助防止突然大停電。
items.sec: Electricity & the Power Grid 電力與電網
items.def: an electricity network that uses computers to manage power

items.s: The island village built its own ________ with solar panels and batteries, so it no longer depends on the main power network.
items.zh: 這個島上的村莊用太陽能板和電池建造了自己的微電網，所以不再依賴主要電網。
items.sec: Electricity & the Power Grid 電力與電網
items.def: a small local power network that can work alone

items.s: During the energy shortage, the city used ________ ________ to save power, so each district lost electricity for two hours.
items.zh: 能源短缺期間，城市實施輪流停電來節省電力，所以每個區域停電兩小時。
items.sec: Electricity & the Power Grid 電力與電網
items.def: planned power cuts that move from area to area

items.s: The government plans to ________ all the railways by 2035, because electric trains are cleaner and quieter than diesel ones.
items.zh: 政府計畫在2035年前將所有鐵路電氣化，因為電動火車比柴油火車更乾淨也更安靜。
items.sec: Electricity & the Power Grid 電力與電網
items.def: to supply something with electricity

items.s: South Africa has suffered from ________ ________ for years, so many shops now keep their own generators to stay open.
items.zh: 南非多年來一直受限電之苦，所以許多商店現在自備發電機以維持營業。
items.sec: Electricity & the Power Grid 電力與電網
items.def: cutting power to some areas so the system does not fail

items.s: The old salt fields were turned into a ________ ________, and now they produce clean electricity for nearby towns.
items.zh: 舊鹽田被改建成太陽能發電場，現在為附近城鎮生產乾淨的電力。
items.def: a large area of land covered with solar panels

items.s: Our school has started using ________ ________ on its roof, and the electricity bill has dropped by almost a third.
items.zh: 我們學校已經開始在屋頂使用太陽能發電，電費幾乎減少了三分之一。
items.def: electricity made from sunlight

items.s: My calculator has a tiny ________ ________ above the screen, so I never need to change its battery.
items.zh: 我的計算機螢幕上方有一個小小的太陽能電池，所以我從來不需要換電池。
items.def: a small device that changes sunlight into electricity

items.s: My grandparents installed a ________ ________ ________ on their roof, and now they can take hot showers without using gas.
items.zh: 我祖父母在屋頂裝了太陽能熱水器，現在他們不用瓦斯就能洗熱水澡。
items.def: a system on a roof that uses the sun to heat water

items.s: More families are choosing ________ ________ because it lowers their bills, and they can sell extra power back to the grid.
items.zh: 越來越多家庭選擇屋頂型太陽能，因為它能降低電費，而且他們可以把多餘的電賣回電網。
items.def: solar panels placed on the roofs of buildings

items.s: We could see a ________ ________ from the beach, and the tall white turbines were turning slowly in the sea breeze.
items.zh: 我們從海灘上可以看見一座風力發電場，高大的白色風機在海風中緩緩轉動。
items.def: a group of wind turbines that make electricity

items.s: Taiwan is building many ________ ________ ________ in the Taiwan Strait, because the wind there is strong for most of the year.
items.zh: 台灣正在台灣海峽興建許多離岸風場，因為那裡一年大部分時間風都很強。
items.def: a group of wind turbines built in the sea

items.s: Denmark gets about half of its electricity from ________ ________, so it is often used as a model for other countries.
items.zh: 丹麥大約一半的電力來自風力發電，所以它經常被當作其他國家的典範。
items.def: electricity made by the movement of wind

items.s: Each ________ of the turbine is longer than a football field, so it must be carried to the coast on a special truck.
items.zh: 風機的每一片葉片都比足球場還長，所以必須用特殊卡車運到海岸。
items.def: one of the long flat parts of a turbine that turns

items.s: The engineer stopped the ________ because the wind was too strong, and he did not want the machine to be damaged.
items.zh: 工程師讓轉子停下來，因為風太強了，他不希望機器受損。
items.def: the turning part of a machine

items.s: The ________ station in the mountains uses water from the river, and it can quickly increase power when demand is high.
items.zh: 山區的水力發電廠利用河水，當需求高時它能迅速增加發電量。
items.def: producing electricity from moving water

items.s: The new ________ will store water for farmers and produce electricity, but hundreds of families must move away from the valley.
items.zh: 新水壩將為農民儲水並發電，但數百戶家庭必須搬離山谷。
items.def: a wall built across a river to hold back water

items.s: ________ ________ is very predictable because tides come at fixed times, but building the machines in the sea is expensive.
items.zh: 潮汐發電非常容易預測，因為潮汐在固定時間出現，但在海中建造機器很昂貴。
items.def: electricity made from the rise and fall of the sea

items.s: Scientists are testing machines that collect ________ ________ off the coast, and they hope the idea will work on a large scale.
items.zh: 科學家正在海岸外測試收集波浪能的機器，他們希望這個構想能大規模運作。
items.def: power taken from the movement of ocean waves

items.s: The pig farm turns animal waste into ________, so it can heat its own buildings and reduce bad smells at the same time.
items.zh: 這座養豬場把動物排泄物轉變成沼氣，所以既能為自己的建築供暖，同時也能減少臭味。
items.def: gas made from rotting food, plants or animal waste

items.s: In Brazil many cars run on ________ made from sugar cane, so the country needs less imported oil.
items.zh: 在巴西，許多車使用由甘蔗製成的乙醇，所以這個國家需要進口的石油較少。
items.def: an alcohol made from plants that can be used as fuel

items.s: Our city's rubbish trucks now use ________ made from used cooking oil, and the air around the stations smells less of smoke.
items.zh: 我們城市的垃圾車現在使用廢食用油製成的生質柴油，車站周圍的空氣也比較沒有煙味了。
items.def: a fuel made from vegetable oil or animal fat

items.s: Steel companies are interested in ________ ________, because it could replace coal and cut a huge amount of pollution.
items.zh: 鋼鐵公司對綠氫很感興趣，因為它可能取代煤炭並大幅減少污染。
items.def: hydrogen made using renewable electricity

items.s: This bus runs on a hydrogen ________ ________, and the only thing that comes out of the back is clean water.
items.zh: 這輛公車使用氫燃料電池，從車尾排出的唯一東西就是乾淨的水。
items.def: a device that makes electricity from hydrogen and oxygen

items.s: Japan wants to use more ________ in the future, because burning it produces water instead of harmful gases.
items.zh: 日本未來想使用更多氫，因為燃燒它產生的是水，而不是有害氣體。
items.def: a very light gas that can be used as clean fuel

items.s: Many young people want to work in ________ ________, because they believe it is good for the planet and has a bright future.
items.zh: 許多年輕人想在乾淨能源領域工作，因為他們相信這對地球有益，而且前途光明。
items.def: power that causes little or no pollution

items.s: Our class did a project on ________ ________, and each group built a small model powered by the sun or wind.
items.zh: 我們班做了一個關於替代能源的專題，每一組都做了一個靠太陽或風驅動的小模型。
items.def: energy that does not come from fossil fuels

items.s: The share of electricity from ________ has grown quickly, but coal and gas are still the main sources in many countries.
items.zh: 來自再生能源的電力比例快速成長，但在許多國家煤和天然氣仍是主要來源。
items.def: energy sources such as sun and wind that never run out

items.s: The biggest problem with solar power is ________, because panels produce nothing at night and very little on cloudy days.
items.zh: 太陽能最大的問題是間歇性，因為太陽能板在夜間完全不發電，陰天也發電很少。
items.def: the problem of not producing power all the time

items.s: The ________ ________ will create many new jobs, but workers in coal towns are afraid that they will be left behind.
items.zh: 能源轉型將創造許多新工作，但煤礦城鎮的工人擔心他們會被拋在後頭。
items.def: the change from fossil fuels to clean energy

items.s: The government offers a generous ________ ________, so farmers can earn money by putting solar panels on their fish ponds.
items.zh: 政府提供優厚的躉購費率，所以農民可以在魚塭上裝設太陽能板來賺錢。
items.def: a fixed price paid for clean power sold to the grid

items.s: We bought a ________ lamp for the garden, and it charges during the day and turns on by itself at night.
items.zh: 我們買了一盞太陽能花園燈，它白天充電，晚上會自己亮起來。
items.def: using energy from the sun

items.s: The solar panels on our roof stopped working because the ________ was broken, so the technician came to replace it.
items.zh: 我們屋頂的太陽能板停止運作，因為逆變器壞了，所以技術人員來更換。
items.def: a device that changes direct current into alternating current

items.s: Southern Taiwan gets plenty of ________ all year round, so it is a good place to build large solar projects.
items.zh: 台灣南部全年都有充足的陽光，所以是建造大型太陽能計畫的好地點。
items.def: the light that comes from the sun

items.s: The turbines only start turning when the ________ ________ is high enough, so on calm days they produce no power at all.
items.zh: 風機只有在風速夠高時才會開始轉動，所以在無風的日子完全不發電。
items.def: how fast the wind is blowing

items.s: After days of heavy rain, the ________ was opened to release water, and crowds gathered to watch the powerful flow.
items.zh: 連續數日豪雨之後，溢洪道被打開洩洪，群眾聚集觀看強大的水流。
items.def: a channel that lets extra water flow out of a dam

items.s: A small ________ power station was built on the stream, so the village gets electricity without flooding the valley.
items.zh: 小溪上建了一座小型川流式發電站，所以村莊不必淹沒山谷就能取得電力。
items.def: using a river's natural flow without a big dam

items.s: The country's ________ ________ for solar power has doubled in five years, but actual output depends on the weather.
items.zh: 這個國家的太陽能裝置容量五年內增加了一倍，但實際發電量取決於天氣。
items.def: the maximum power that all machines can produce

items.s: Offshore turbines have a higher ________ ________ than those on land, because the wind at sea is stronger and steadier.
items.zh: 離岸風機的容量因數比陸上風機高，因為海上的風更強也更穩定。
items.def: how much power a plant really makes compared with its maximum

items.s: The last ________ ________ ________ in Taiwan was shut down in 2025, but people are still debating whether to restart it.
items.zh: 台灣最後一座核能發電廠在2025年停機，但人們仍在爭論是否要重新啟用。
items.def: a power station that uses nuclear reactions

items.s: The ________ ________ is kept inside a thick concrete building, so radiation cannot escape even if there is an accident.
items.zh: 核子反應爐被安置在厚重的混凝土建築內，所以即使發生事故，輻射也無法外洩。
items.def: the machine in which nuclear energy is produced

items.s: Australia has large amounts of ________, and it sells this metal to countries that run nuclear power stations.
items.zh: 澳洲擁有大量的鈾，並把這種金屬賣給經營核電廠的國家。
items.def: a heavy metal used as fuel in nuclear power

items.s: ________ can stay dangerous for thousands of years, so it must be stored under strict security.
items.zh: 鈽可以維持危險性長達數千年，所以必須在嚴格的安全措施下儲存。
items.def: a dangerous metal made in nuclear reactors

items.s: Nuclear power stations use ________ to produce heat, and this heat turns water into steam that drives the turbines.
items.zh: 核電廠利用核分裂產生熱能，而這些熱把水變成蒸汽來推動渦輪機。
items.def: the splitting of an atom, which releases energy

items.s: Nobody wants to live near a store of ________ ________, so finding a safe place to keep it is very difficult.
items.zh: 沒有人想住在核廢料儲存場附近，所以要找到安全的存放地點非常困難。
items.def: dangerous material left after making nuclear power

items.s: The workers wore special suits because the area was ________, and they could only stay inside for a few minutes.
items.zh: 工人們穿著特殊防護衣，因為這個區域具有放射性，他們只能在裡面待幾分鐘。
items.def: giving off harmful energy from atoms

items.s: After the earthquake, there was a ________ at the power station, and thousands of people had to leave their homes.
items.zh: 地震之後，電廠發生了爐心熔毀，數千人必須離開家園。
items.def: a serious accident when a nuclear reactor overheats

items.s: The ________ ________ at Chernobyl happened in 1986, but the area around the plant is still mostly empty today.
items.zh: 車諾比的核子事故發生在1986年，但電廠周圍的地區至今仍大多空無一人。
items.def: an event that releases harmful radiation by mistake

items.s: It will take about twenty years to ________ the old reactor, because every part must be removed and cleaned carefully.
items.zh: 除役這座舊反應爐大約需要二十年，因為每個部分都必須被小心拆除和清理。
items.def: to officially stop using a large machine or plant

items.s: The ________ ________ is kept in deep pools of water for years, because it is still very hot and radioactive.
items.zh: 用過核燃料被存放在深水池中好幾年，因為它仍然非常燙而且具有放射性。
items.def: used nuclear fuel that is still very dangerous

items.s: Each ________ ________ inside the reactor is replaced after a few years, and the old ones must be stored safely.
items.zh: 反應爐內的每一根燃料棒在幾年後就要更換，而舊的必須被安全存放。
items.def: a long metal tube that holds nuclear fuel

items.s: The reactor must have a steady flow of ________, because without it the core would become dangerously hot very quickly.
items.zh: 反應爐必須有穩定的冷卻劑流動，因為沒有它，爐心會非常快就變得危險地高溫。
items.def: a liquid used to stop a machine from getting too hot

items.s: People often think the white cloud above the ________ ________ is smoke, but it is actually just water vapour.
items.zh: 人們常以為冷卻塔上方的白雲是煙，但其實那只是水蒸氣。
items.def: a tall round tower that releases heat from a power plant

items.s: Some citizens want a ________ homeland, while others think nuclear power is necessary to reduce carbon emissions.
items.zh: 有些市民想要非核家園，而另一些人則認為核能對減少碳排放是必要的。
items.def: having no nuclear power or weapons

items.s: Scientists measured the ________ in the soil after the accident, and they found that some farms were no longer safe.
items.zh: 科學家在事故後測量土壤中的放射性，他們發現有些農場已經不再安全。
items.def: the harmful energy given off by some materials

items.s: ________ is the main industry in this region, so many families depend on it for their income.
items.zh: 採礦是這個地區的主要產業，所以許多家庭仰賴它維持收入。
items.def: the work of digging minerals out of the ground

items.s: My great-grandfather worked in a gold ________ for thirty years, and he often told stories about the dark tunnels.
items.zh: 我曾祖父在金礦坑工作了三十年，他常常講那些黑暗坑道的故事。
items.def: a deep hole or tunnels where minerals are dug out

items.s: The ________ ________ is so big that you can see it from space, and the trucks inside look like tiny toys.
items.zh: 這座露天礦大到從太空就看得見，裡面的卡車看起來就像小玩具。
items.def: a mine dug as a huge hole from the surface

items.s: ________ ________ destroyed the forests on the hills, so the company now has to plant new trees and restore the soil.
items.zh: 露天剝採摧毀了山丘上的森林，所以公司現在必須種新樹並恢復土壤。
items.def: removing the top layer of land to reach coal

items.s: Scientists warn that ________ ________ could harm creatures we have not discovered yet, but companies say the metals are needed.
items.zh: 科學家警告深海採礦可能傷害我們尚未發現的生物，但公司表示這些金屬是必需的。
items.def: taking metals from the bottom of the ocean

items.s: Jiufen was once a busy ________ ________, but now it is famous for its tea houses and beautiful views.
items.zh: 九份曾經是繁忙的礦業小鎮，但現在它以茶館和美麗景色聞名。
items.def: a town built around a mine

items.s: Geologists found a rich ________ ________ in the mountains, and a company soon asked for permission to start digging.
items.zh: 地質學家在山中發現了一處豐富的礦床，一家公司很快就申請開挖許可。
items.def: a natural collection of rock containing useful metal

items.s: Your smartphone contains several ________ ________ ________, and most of them come from mines in just a few countries.
items.zh: 你的智慧型手機含有好幾種稀土元素，而其中大多數來自少數幾個國家的礦場。
items.def: special metals used in phones, magnets and electric cars

items.s: Demand for ________ has grown quickly because electric cars need it for their batteries, so its price has gone up.
items.zh: 對鋰的需求快速成長，因為電動車的電池需要它，所以它的價格上漲了。
items.def: a light metal used in rechargeable batteries

items.s: Much of the world's ________ comes from Central Africa, and some mines there have been criticised for using child workers.
items.zh: 世界上大部分的鈷來自中非，而那裡有些礦場因使用童工而遭受批評。
items.def: a hard metal used in batteries and blue colours

items.s: Indonesia produces a lot of ________, and it wants to build battery factories instead of only selling the raw metal.
items.zh: 印尼生產大量的鎳，它想要建造電池工廠，而不只是出售原料金屬。
items.def: a silver-coloured metal used in batteries and coins

items.s: People often buy ________ when the economy is uncertain, because they believe its value will stay high.
items.zh: 經濟不確定時人們常購買黃金，因為他們相信它的價值會維持在高點。
items.def: a valuable yellow metal

items.s: ________ is used in solar panels as well as jewellery, so the growing solar industry has increased its price.
items.zh: 銀除了用在珠寶，也用在太陽能板上，所以成長中的太陽能產業推升了它的價格。
items.def: a valuable shiny grey metal

items.s: Car makers use ________ to clean exhaust gases, and it is also used in hydrogen fuel cells.
items.zh: 汽車製造商使用白金來淨化廢氣，它也被用在氫燃料電池中。
items.def: a rare and valuable silver-white metal

items.s: Recycling one ________ can saves enough energy to run a television for three hours, so please do not throw cans away.
items.zh: 回收一個鋁罐所節省的能源足以讓電視運轉三小時，所以請不要把罐子丟掉。
items.def: a light silver metal used for cans and planes

items.s: Australia exports huge amounts of ________, and factories in other countries turn it into aluminium for cans and cars.
items.zh: 澳洲出口大量的鋁土礦，其他國家的工廠把它製成用於罐子和汽車的鋁。
items.def: the rock from which aluminium is made

items.s: The steel roof is covered with a thin layer of ________, so it does not rust even in the wet coastal weather.
items.zh: 鋼製屋頂覆蓋著一層薄薄的鋅，所以即使在潮濕的海邊氣候中也不會生鏽。
items.def: a blue-white metal used to protect steel from rust

items.s: Electronic parts are joined with a mix that contains ________, so this metal is important for the phone industry.
items.zh: 電子零件是用含有錫的焊料連接的，所以這種金屬對手機產業很重要。
items.def: a soft silver metal often used to coat other metals

items.s: Some ________ are mined in war zones, so many buyers now ask for proof that their stones were mined fairly.
items.zh: 有些鑽石是在戰區開採的，所以許多買家現在要求證明他們的寶石是以公平方式開採的。
items.def: a very hard, clear and valuable stone

items.s: Old phones contain small amounts of ________ ________, so recycling them can be more profitable than mining new ore.
items.zh: 舊手機含有少量的貴金屬，所以回收它們可能比開採新礦更有利可圖。
items.def: a rare metal of high value, such as gold

items.s: In the 1800s, a lucky ________ could become rich overnight, but most people who searched for gold found nothing.
items.zh: 在十九世紀，一位幸運的探礦者可能一夜致富，但大多數尋找黃金的人一無所獲。
items.def: a person who searches for gold or minerals

items.s: The California ________ ________ brought thousands of people to the west, and small villages quickly grew into busy cities.
items.zh: 加州淘金熱吸引了數千人前往西部，小村莊很快發展成繁忙的城市。
items.def: a time when many people rush to a place to find gold

items.s: A huge ________ was digging up the hillside, so the road was closed and we had to take a longer way home.
items.zh: 一台巨大的挖土機正在挖山坡，所以道路封閉，我們只好繞遠路回家。
items.def: a large machine used for digging

items.s: The dam holding the mine's ________ broke after heavy rain, and toxic mud flowed into the river and killed the fish.
items.zh: 圍住礦場尾礦的壩在豪雨後潰堤，有毒的泥漿流入河中，毒死了魚。
items.def: waste rock and mud left after mining

items.s: The steel factory used to dump its ________ near the beach, but now it turns this waste into material for roads.
items.zh: 這家鋼鐵廠過去把爐渣倒在海灘附近，但現在把這種廢料變成鋪路材料。
items.def: waste material left after metal is taken from rock

items.s: The farmer owns the land, but a company bought the ________ ________, so it can dig under his fields.
items.zh: 這位農夫擁有這塊地，但一家公司買下了礦業權，所以它可以在他的田地底下開挖。
items.def: the legal right to take minerals from a piece of land

items.s: Tech companies promise not to use ________ ________, because they do not want their products to support violence.
items.zh: 科技公司承諾不使用衝突礦產，因為他們不希望自己的產品支持暴力。
items.def: minerals mined in war areas that help pay for fighting

items.s: Illegal ________ ________ has made the river much deeper, so the bridge is now in danger of falling down.
items.zh: 非法採砂讓河道變得深很多，所以那座橋現在有倒塌的危險。
items.def: taking sand from rivers and beaches for building

items.s: The copper ________ near the river closed down, so hundreds of workers lost their jobs but the air became cleaner.
items.zh: 河邊的銅冶煉廠關閉了，所以數百名工人失業，但空氣變乾淨了。
items.def: a factory where metal is taken out of rock by heating

items.s: My neighbour collects ________ ________ from old cars and machines, and he sells it to a recycling factory every week.
items.zh: 我鄰居從舊車和機器收集廢金屬，每週把它賣給回收工廠。
items.def: old metal that can be melted and used again

items.s: The company carried out a ________ ________ in the bay, but environmental groups said the loud noise could hurt whales.
items.zh: 這家公司在海灣進行了震測調查，但環保團體說巨大的噪音可能傷害鯨魚。
items.def: a study that uses sound waves to look under the ground

items.s: ________ is mixed with a little carbon to make steel, so it is one of the most important metals in the world.
items.zh: 鐵加入少量的碳就能製成鋼，所以它是世界上最重要的金屬之一。
items.def: a strong grey metal used to make steel

items.s: Taiwan has few ________ ________ of its own, so it must import most of its oil, gas and coal.
items.zh: 台灣本身的天然資源很少，所以必須進口大部分的石油、天然氣和煤。
items.sec: Natural Resources & Scarcity 天然資源與短缺
items.def: things from nature that people use, like water and oil

items.s: ________ ________ is a serious problem for future generations, because many materials cannot be replaced once they are gone.
items.zh: 資源耗竭對未來世代是個嚴重問題，因為許多材料一旦用完就無法替代。
items.sec: Natural Resources & Scarcity 天然資源與短缺
items.def: using up natural resources faster than they return

items.s: The ________ ________ was cut for two days during the drought, so families had to collect water from trucks.
items.zh: 乾旱期間供水中斷了兩天，所以家家戶戶只好向水車取水。
items.sec: Natural Resources & Scarcity 天然資源與短缺
items.def: the water provided to an area for people to use

items.s: Chip factories use a lot of water, so a ________ ________ in spring can be a serious problem for the whole economy.
items.zh: 晶片工廠用水量很大，所以春季缺水可能成為整個經濟的嚴重問題。
items.sec: Natural Resources & Scarcity 天然資源與短缺
items.def: a situation when there is not enough water

items.s: The charity dug a new ________ in the village, so children no longer have to walk hours every day to fetch water.
items.zh: 慈善機構在村子裡鑿了一口新的水井，所以孩子們不再需要每天走好幾個小時去取水。
items.sec: Natural Resources & Scarcity 天然資源與短缺
items.def: a deep narrow hole dug to find water or oil

items.s: The old ________ in the temple yard dried up during the drought, but the villagers hope it will fill again after the rains.
items.zh: 寺廟院子裡的老井在乾旱期間乾涸了，但村民希望下雨後它會再度有水。
items.sec: Natural Resources & Scarcity 天然資源與短缺
items.def: a hole dug in the ground to get water

items.s: Coal and oil are ________ resources, so we will eventually run out of them if we keep burning them.
items.zh: 煤和石油是不可再生資源，所以如果我們持續燃燒它們，終有一天會用光。
items.sec: Natural Resources & Scarcity 天然資源與短缺
items.def: not able to be replaced once it has been used

items.s: Clean water is a ________ ________ in many places, so people should not waste it while washing cars or watering lawns.
items.zh: 在許多地方乾淨的水是有限資源，所以人們在洗車或澆草坪時不應浪費。
items.sec: Natural Resources & Scarcity 天然資源與短缺
items.def: something that exists only in a limited amount

items.s: Some ________ countries are still poor, because the money from oil and minerals does not reach ordinary people.
items.zh: 有些資源豐富的國家仍然貧窮，因為來自石油和礦產的錢沒有流到一般百姓手中。
items.sec: Natural Resources & Scarcity 天然資源與短缺
items.def: having a lot of natural resources

items.s: Economists use the term ________ ________ to describe countries where oil money causes corruption and slows growth.
items.zh: 經濟學家用資源詛咒這個詞來描述石油收入導致貪腐、拖慢成長的國家。
items.sec: Natural Resources & Scarcity 天然資源與短缺
items.def: when rich natural resources lead to poor development

items.s: ________ of groundwater has made the land sink along the coast, so some homes now flood at every high tide.
items.zh: 地下水的過度抽取使沿海地層下陷，所以有些房屋現在每逢漲潮就淹水。
items.sec: Natural Resources & Scarcity 天然資源與短缺
items.def: taking too much of a resource from the ground

items.s: Farmers and factories are arguing over ________ ________, because there is not enough river water for both groups this year.
items.zh: 農民和工廠正為水權爭執，因為今年的河水不夠兩方使用。
items.sec: Natural Resources & Scarcity 天然資源與短缺
items.def: the legal right to use water from a river or lake

items.s: Our school uses ________ ________ to water the gardens, so we save tap water and reduce our water bill.
items.zh: 我們學校利用雨水回收來澆灌花園，所以既節省自來水，也降低了水費。
items.sec: Natural Resources & Scarcity 天然資源與短缺
items.def: collecting rain so it can be used later

items.s: ________ old phones keeps valuable metals in use, and it also stops toxic materials from ending up in landfill.
items.zh: 回收舊手機能讓珍貴金屬持續被利用，也能防止有毒物質最後進入掩埋場。
items.sec: Natural Resources & Scarcity 天然資源與短缺
items.def: treating used things so they can be used again

items.s: Piles of ________ are shipped to poor countries, where workers burn cables to get the copper and breathe in toxic smoke.
items.zh: 成堆的電子廢棄物被運到貧窮國家，那裡的工人燒電線取銅，吸入有毒煙霧。
items.sec: Natural Resources & Scarcity 天然資源與短缺
items.def: thrown-away electronic devices like phones and computers

items.s: In a ________ ________, old products are repaired or recycled, so fewer new raw materials need to be dug from the ground.
items.zh: 在循環經濟中，舊產品會被修理或回收，所以需要從地下挖掘的新原料就比較少。
items.sec: Natural Resources & Scarcity 天然資源與短缺
items.def: a system where products are reused and recycled, not thrown away

items.s: The factory improved its ________ ________ by reusing water and metal scraps, and it saved a lot of money as well.
items.zh: 這家工廠透過再利用水和金屬碎料提高了資源效率，也省下了很多錢。
items.sec: Natural Resources & Scarcity 天然資源與短缺
items.def: using fewer materials to make the same product

items.s: Taiwan imports almost all its fuel, so ________ ________ is a major concern if shipping routes are ever blocked.
items.zh: 台灣幾乎所有燃料都靠進口，所以若航道遭封鎖，能源安全就是一大隱憂。
items.sec: Natural Resources & Scarcity 天然資源與短缺
items.def: having a reliable supply of energy at a fair price

items.s: During the ________ ________ in 2022, gas prices in Europe rose so much that some factories had to close.
items.zh: 在2022年的能源危機期間，歐洲天然氣價格漲得太多，以致有些工廠不得不關閉。
items.sec: Natural Resources & Scarcity 天然資源與短缺
items.def: a serious shortage of energy and very high prices

items.s: Many elderly people live in ________ ________, so they cannot afford to heat their homes properly in winter.
items.zh: 許多長者處於能源貧窮，所以冬天他們無法負擔讓家裡足夠溫暖的暖氣費用。
items.sec: Natural Resources & Scarcity 天然資源與短缺
items.def: not being able to afford enough energy at home

items.s: ________ ________ keeps rising because of new data centres, so power companies must build more plants quickly.
items.zh: 能源需求因為新的資料中心而持續上升，所以電力公司必須迅速興建更多電廠。
items.sec: Natural Resources & Scarcity 天然資源與短缺
items.def: the amount of energy that people need

items.s: During the 1973 ________ ________, petrol was so short that people waited in long queues at every station.
items.zh: 在1973年的石油危機期間，汽油短缺到人們在每個加油站都大排長龍。
items.sec: Natural Resources & Scarcity 天然資源與短缺
items.def: a time when oil becomes very scarce and expensive

items.s: A ________ ________ hit the country after the port was closed, so buses ran less often and many flights were cancelled.
items.zh: 港口關閉後，這個國家發生燃料短缺，所以公車班次減少，許多航班被取消。
items.sec: Natural Resources & Scarcity 天然資源與短缺
items.def: a situation when there is not enough fuel

items.s: Many ________ countries are now investing in solar power, because they know oil will not last forever.
items.zh: 許多石油蘊藏豐富的國家現在投資太陽能，因為他們知道石油不會永遠存在。
items.sec: Natural Resources & Scarcity 天然資源與短缺
items.def: having large amounts of oil

items.s: The president promised ________ ________ within ten years, but experts doubted that the goal was realistic.
items.zh: 總統承諾十年內達成能源自主，但專家懷疑這個目標是否切合實際。
items.sec: Natural Resources & Scarcity 天然資源與短缺
items.def: producing enough energy without relying on other countries

items.s: Investors fear the new coal plant will become a ________ ________, because clean energy is getting cheaper every year.
items.zh: 投資人擔心這座新燃煤電廠會變成擱淺資產，因為乾淨能源每年都變得更便宜。
items.sec: Natural Resources & Scarcity 天然資源與短缺
items.def: something valuable that loses its value early, like an unused coal plant

items.s: Our ________ ________ was very high in August, so we decided to use fans more often instead of the air conditioner.
items.zh: 我們八月的電費非常高，所以我們決定多用電風扇而不是冷氣。
items.sec: Saving Energy at Home & on the Road 居家與交通節能
items.def: the amount you pay for gas and electricity

items.s: We replaced all our old light bulbs with ________ ones, and our electricity bill dropped noticeably the next month.
items.zh: 我們把所有舊燈泡都換成節能燈泡，隔月的電費明顯降低。
items.sec: Saving Energy at Home & on the Road 居家與交通節能
items.def: using less energy than usual

items.s: Please ________ ________ the projector after class, because leaving it on all night wastes electricity and shortens its life.
items.zh: 下課後請關掉投影機，因為整夜開著會浪費電，也會縮短它的壽命。
items.sec: Saving Energy at Home & on the Road 居家與交通節能
items.def: to turn off a machine or light

items.s: Before we went on holiday, my mum told us to ________ the TV and computer, so they would not use power while we were away.
items.zh: 我們去度假之前，媽媽要我們拔掉電視和電腦的插頭，這樣我們不在家時它們就不會耗電。
items.sec: Saving Energy at Home & on the Road 居家與交通節能
items.def: to take a plug out of a socket

items.s: Many TVs stay in ________ ________ all night, and together they waste a surprising amount of electricity every year.
items.zh: 許多電視整夜維持在待機模式，加總起來每年浪費的電量驚人。
items.sec: Saving Energy at Home & on the Road 居家與交通節能
items.def: when a machine is off but still uses a little power

items.s: Check the ________ ________ before buying a fridge, because a more efficient model will save you money for many years.
items.zh: 買冰箱前要先看能源標章，因為較節能的機型能讓你省錢很多年。
items.sec: Saving Energy at Home & on the Road 居家與交通節能
items.def: a sticker showing how much energy a machine uses

items.s: Improving the ________ ________ of old buildings is one of the cheapest ways to reduce pollution, but many owners ignore it.
items.zh: 提升舊建築的能源效率是減少污染最便宜的方法之一，但許多屋主卻忽略它。
items.sec: Saving Energy at Home & on the Road 居家與交通節能
items.def: using less energy to do the same job

items.s: Data centres have greatly increased the country's ________ ________, so the government is asking them to use more renewable power.
items.zh: 資料中心大幅增加了國家的能源消耗，所以政府要求它們使用更多再生能源。
items.sec: Saving Energy at Home & on the Road 居家與交通節能
items.def: the amount of energy used

items.s: Most houses in Britain have ________ ________, so the rooms stay warm even when it is snowing outside.
items.zh: 英國大多數房子都有中央暖氣，所以即使外面下雪，房間仍保持溫暖。
items.sec: Saving Energy at Home & on the Road 居家與交通節能
items.def: a system that heats a whole building from one place

items.s: I put my wet gloves on the ________ to dry, and they were warm and ready by the time I left for school.
items.zh: 我把濕手套放在暖氣片上烘乾，到我出門上學時它們已經溫暖又乾了。
items.sec: Saving Energy at Home & on the Road 居家與交通節能
items.def: a metal heater on a wall, filled with hot water

items.s: Setting the ________ ________ to 26 degrees instead of 22 saves a lot of energy, and the room still feels comfortable.
items.zh: 把冷氣機設定在26度而不是22度能省下很多能源，房間仍然感覺舒適。
items.sec: Saving Energy at Home & on the Road 居家與交通節能
items.def: a machine that makes a room cool

items.s: An ________ ________ uses much less power than air conditioning, so we use it on days that are warm but not too hot.
