items.zh: 電風扇比冷氣省電得多，所以在溫暖但不太熱的日子我們就用它。
items.sec: Saving Energy at Home & on the Road 居家與交通節能
items.def: a machine with blades that moves air to cool you

items.s: Our flat gets very damp in spring, so we run a ________ every day to stop our clothes from smelling bad.
items.zh: 我們的公寓在春天非常潮濕，所以我們每天開除濕機，避免衣服產生異味。
items.sec: Saving Energy at Home & on the Road 居家與交通節能
items.def: a machine that removes water from the air

items.s: My grandmother uses a ________ ________ in her bedroom, but we remind her to keep it away from the curtains.
items.zh: 奶奶在臥室使用電暖器，但我們提醒她要讓它遠離窗簾。
items.sec: Saving Energy at Home & on the Road 居家與交通節能
items.def: a small portable machine that heats one room

items.s: There is a cold ________ coming under the front door, so we put a long cushion there to keep the heat inside.
items.zh: 有一股冷風從前門底下吹進來，所以我們在那裡放了一個長墊子把熱氣留在屋內。
items.sec: Saving Energy at Home & on the Road 居家與交通節能
items.def: cold air coming into a room through a gap

items.s: We decided to ________ our old windows before winter, and the house now feels much warmer without extra heating.
items.zh: 我們決定在冬天前為舊窗戶做防風密封，現在不用額外開暖氣房子就感覺溫暖許多。
items.sec: Saving Energy at Home & on the Road 居家與交通節能
items.def: to block gaps so cold air cannot come in

items.s: Adding ________ ________ is cheap and quick, but it can cut a family's heating costs by a large amount each year.
items.zh: 加裝閣樓隔熱層既便宜又快速，卻能每年大幅降低一個家庭的暖氣費用。
items.sec: Saving Energy at Home & on the Road 居家與交通節能
items.def: material in the roof space that keeps heat in

items.s: An expert did an ________ ________ of our school, and she found that old lights and computers were wasting a lot of power.
items.zh: 一位專家為我們學校做了能源稽核，她發現舊燈具和電腦浪費了大量電力。
items.sec: Saving Energy at Home & on the Road 居家與交通節能
items.def: a check of how a building uses and wastes energy

items.s: I always use ________ ________ on the washing machine, because it uses less water and power even though it takes longer.
items.zh: 我洗衣服總是使用節能模式，因為雖然花比較久，但用水和用電都比較少。
items.sec: Saving Energy at Home & on the Road 居家與交通節能
items.def: a setting that makes a machine use less energy

items.s: My uncle bought a ________ ________ last year, and he is happy because he now visits the petrol station much less often.
items.zh: 我叔叔去年買了一輛油電混合車，他很開心，因為現在他去加油站的次數少很多。
items.sec: Saving Energy at Home & on the Road 居家與交通節能
items.def: a car with both a petrol engine and an electric motor

items.s: ________ ________ are quiet and produce no exhaust, but some drivers worry that the batteries will run out on long trips.
items.zh: 電動車安靜且不排放廢氣，但有些駕駛擔心長途旅行時電池會沒電。
items.sec: Saving Energy at Home & on the Road 居家與交通節能
items.def: a car that runs only on electricity from batteries

items.s: There are more ________ ________ in shopping centres now, so drivers can charge their cars while they buy groceries.
items.zh: 現在購物中心有更多充電站，所以駕駛人可以一邊買菜一邊替車子充電。
items.sec: Saving Energy at Home & on the Road 居家與交通節能
items.def: a place where electric cars can be charged

items.s: I always carry a ________ ________ on school trips, because my phone battery runs out quickly when I take lots of photos.
items.zh: 我校外教學時總會帶著行動電源，因為拍很多照片時手機電量很快就用完。
items.sec: Saving Energy at Home & on the Road 居家與交通節能
items.def: a small portable battery for charging phones

items.s: My parents chose a ________ car because petrol prices keep rising, and they drive to work every day.
items.zh: 我父母選了一輛省油的車，因為油價不斷上漲，而他們每天開車上班。
items.sec: Saving Energy at Home & on the Road 居家與交通節能
items.def: using only a small amount of fuel

items.s: My neighbour finally sold his old ________ ________, because filling its huge tank every week was costing him too much money.
items.zh: 我鄰居終於賣掉了他那輛老耗油車，因為每週加滿它的大油箱讓他花太多錢。
items.sec: Saving Energy at Home & on the Road 居家與交通節能
items.def: a big car that uses a lot of fuel

items.s: I connected the heater to a ________ ________, so I can turn it on from my phone before I get home.
items.zh: 我把暖氣機接上智慧插座，所以我可以在到家前用手機打開它。
items.sec: Saving Energy at Home & on the Road 居家與交通節能
items.def: a plug you can control with your phone

items.s: Our ________ ________ lowers the heating when nobody is home, and it warms the house again just before we return.
items.zh: 我們的智慧溫控器在沒人在家時會調低暖氣，並在我們回來之前讓房子再度變暖。
items.sec: Saving Energy at Home & on the Road 居家與交通節能
items.def: a device that controls heating and learns your habits

items.s: Most ________ ________ in old houses happens through the roof and windows, so these are the first places to improve.
items.zh: 老房子大部分的熱能流失發生在屋頂和窗戶，所以這些是最先需要改善的地方。
items.sec: Saving Energy at Home & on the Road 居家與交通節能
items.def: heat escaping from a building

items.s: The lights in our school toilets have a ________ ________, so they turn off automatically when nobody is inside.
items.zh: 我們學校廁所的燈裝有動作感應器，所以沒人在裡面時會自動關燈。
items.sec: Saving Energy at Home & on the Road 居家與交通節能
items.def: a device that turns on when it notices movement

items.s: Only boil as much water as you need in the ________, because heating extra water wastes both time and electricity.
items.zh: 用熱水壺只煮你需要的水量，因為加熱多餘的水既浪費時間也浪費電。
items.sec: Saving Energy at Home & on the Road 居家與交通節能
items.def: a container for boiling water

items.s: The ________ of fuel subsidies made petrol more expensive, so taxi drivers held a protest outside the government building.
items.zh: 燃料補貼的廢除讓汽油變貴，所以計程車司機在政府大樓外抗議。
items.def: the official ending of a law or system

items.s: In the ________ of strong wind, the turbines stood still all week, so the grid had to use more gas power.
items.zh: 在缺乏強風的情況下，風機整週都靜止不動，所以電網必須使用更多燃氣發電。
items.def: the state of not being there

items.s: Public ________ is important for new power plants, because projects often fail when local residents strongly oppose them.
items.zh: 民眾的可接受度對新電廠很重要，因為當地居民強烈反對時，計畫常常會失敗。
items.def: how far something is accepted by people

items.s: Student ________ helped stop the coal plant, because young people organised marches and wrote thousands of letters to officials.
items.zh: 學生的社會運動幫助阻止了燃煤電廠，因為年輕人組織遊行並寫了數千封信給官員。
items.def: action taken to bring about social or political change

items.s: The minister set up an ________ group of scientists, and it will suggest ways to cut energy use in public buildings.
items.zh: 部長成立了一個由科學家組成的諮詢小組，它將建議減少公共建築用電的方法。
items.def: giving advice

items.s: Social media led to the ________ of fears about nuclear power, so many people became anxious even without new evidence.
items.zh: 社群媒體造成對核能恐懼的擴大，所以即使沒有新證據，很多人仍變得焦慮。
items.def: the act of making something larger or stronger

items.s: Our building still has an ________ electricity meter, so a worker has to visit every month to read the numbers.
items.zh: 我們大樓仍使用類比式電表，所以每個月都要有工作人員來抄錶。
items.def: using older, non-digital technology

items.s: The city took ________ action before the summer, so extra power was ready when the heatwave arrived.
items.zh: 市政府在夏天前採取了預先行動，所以熱浪來襲時已準備好額外電力。
items.def: done before something is expected to happen

items.s: There is an ________ in information between energy companies and customers, so many people do not understand their own bills.
items.zh: 能源公司和顧客之間存在資訊不對稱，所以許多人看不懂自己的帳單。
items.def: a lack of balance between two sides

items.s: The fan made the hot classroom more ________, but students still found it difficult to concentrate in the afternoon.
items.zh: 電風扇讓炎熱的教室變得比較可以忍受，但學生下午仍覺得很難專心。
items.def: able to be accepted or dealt with

items.s: The sun provides almost ________ energy, but we still need better ways to store it for the night.
items.zh: 太陽提供幾乎無限的能源，但我們仍需要更好的方法把它儲存到夜晚使用。
items.def: without limits

items.s: The old system was highly ________, so one problem at a large power plant could cause blackouts across the whole country.
items.zh: 舊系統高度集中，所以大型電廠的一個問題就可能造成全國大停電。
items.def: controlled from one main place

items.s: Copper is very ________, so it is used for most electrical wires, but it is becoming more expensive.
items.zh: 銅非常導電，所以大多數電線都使用它，但它正變得越來越貴。
items.def: allowing electricity or heat to pass through

items.s: Silver has the highest ________ of all metals, but it is too expensive to use for ordinary household wiring.
items.zh: 銀在所有金屬中導電性最高，但它太貴了，無法用於一般家用電線。
items.def: how easily electricity or heat moves through a material

items.s: The drought and the ________ fall in river levels meant that the hydroelectric dams produced much less power.
items.zh: 乾旱和隨之而來的河川水位下降，意味著水力發電水壩的發電量少了很多。
items.def: happening as a result of something

items.s: Printer ink and paper are ________ in the office, so the school is trying to reduce how much it buys.
items.zh: 印表機墨水和紙張是辦公室的消耗品，所以學校正試著減少購買量。
items.def: a product that is used up and must be replaced

items.s: The village suffered from ________ power cuts last summer, so many families bought small generators for their homes.
items.zh: 這個村莊去年夏天飽受頻繁的停電之苦，所以許多家庭替家裡買了小型發電機。
items.def: happening again and again

items.s: Old wiring was a ________ factor in the fire, but the main cause was a heater left on overnight.
items.zh: 老舊電線是這場火災的促成因素之一，但主要原因是暖氣機整夜開著。
items.def: helping to cause something

items.s: The council ________ approved a new gas plant, and many residents said they had not been asked for their opinions.
items.zh: 市議會具爭議地核准了一座新燃氣電廠，許多居民說他們沒被徵詢意見。
items.def: in a way that causes public disagreement

items.s: Electricity was ________ produced by burning coal, but today many countries are using more solar and wind power.
items.zh: 電力傳統上是靠燃燒煤炭生產的，但如今許多國家使用更多太陽能和風力發電。
items.def: in the usual, traditional way

items.s: Heat from the factory is ________ into electricity, so the company now produces part of its own power.
items.zh: 工廠的熱能可轉換成電力，所以公司現在可以自行生產部分電力。
items.def: able to be changed into another form

items.s: Energy use is closely ________ with temperature, so electricity demand rises sharply whenever a heatwave hits the city.
items.zh: 能源使用和氣溫密切相關，所以每當熱浪侵襲城市，電力需求就會急劇上升。
items.def: closely connected, so one changes with the other

items.s: The study compared the ________ of solar panels and insulation, and it found that insulation saved money faster.
items.zh: 這項研究比較了太陽能板和隔熱材料的成本效益，發現隔熱材料省錢更快。
items.def: how much benefit you get for the money spent

items.s: Energy prices kept rising, so the government introduced several ________, such as cash support for poor families.
items.zh: 能源價格持續上漲，所以政府推出了幾項對策，例如為貧困家庭提供現金補助。
items.def: an action taken to reduce a danger or problem

items.s: On very sunny days there is ________ of solar power, because the grid cannot use all the electricity being produced.
items.zh: 在陽光非常充足的日子會削減太陽能發電，因為電網無法使用所有產生的電力。
items.def: the act of reducing or limiting something

items.s: A ________ energy system uses many small power sources, so one failure does not shut down the whole network.
items.zh: 分散式能源系統使用許多小型電源，所以單一故障不會讓整個電網停擺。
items.def: spread out instead of controlled from one place

items.s: The town's ________ coal industry has left many shops empty, but a new battery factory may bring jobs back.
items.zh: 鎮上日漸衰退的煤礦產業讓許多商店空置，但一座新電池工廠可能把工作帶回來。
items.def: becoming less or smaller

items.s: The car park has ten ________ spaces for electric cars, and each one has its own charging point.
items.zh: 停車場有十個電動車專用車位，每一個都有自己的充電樁。
items.def: used only for one particular purpose

items.s: Battery ________ means that phones hold less charge after a few years, so many people replace them too early.
items.zh: 電池劣化意味著手機幾年後蓄電量變少，所以許多人太早換掉手機。
items.def: the process of becoming worse in quality

items.s: The rapid ________ of solar panels has lowered their price, so more families can now afford them.
items.zh: 太陽能板的快速推廣降低了價格，所以現在更多家庭負擔得起。
items.def: the act of putting something into use

items.s: The government decided to ________ the electricity market, so new companies can now compete with the old state supplier.
items.zh: 政府決定對電力市場解除管制，所以新公司現在可以和老牌國營供應商競爭。
items.def: to remove government rules from an industry

items.s: The ________ of nuclear power is still debated, because it is low-carbon but produces dangerous waste.
items.zh: 核能的可取性仍有爭議，因為它低碳卻產生危險廢料。
items.def: how much something is wanted or seen as good

items.s: The ________ condition of the old pipes caused several gas leaks, so the city decided to replace them all.
items.zh: 舊管線日益惡化的狀況造成好幾起瓦斯外洩，所以市政府決定全部更換。
items.def: becoming worse

items.s: The oil spill caused terrible ________ along the coast, and it took years for the fishing industry to recover.
items.zh: 漏油事件沿著海岸造成了可怕的嚴重破壞，漁業花了好幾年才復原。
items.def: very great damage

items.s: There has been a steady ________ in coal's share of power, while solar and wind have grown each year.
items.zh: 煤炭在發電中的占比穩定減少，而太陽能和風力每年都在成長。
items.def: a reduction in size or importance

items.s: One ________ of wind power is the noise, so some people do not want turbines built near their homes.
items.zh: 風力發電的一個缺點是噪音，所以有些人不希望風機蓋在家附近。
items.def: something that makes a situation less good

items.s: The ________ of the bus service forced many villagers to drive, so fuel use in the area actually went up.
items.zh: 公車服務的停駛迫使許多村民開車，所以這個地區的燃料使用量反而增加了。
items.def: the act of stopping something

items.s: Some power is always lost through heat ________ in long cables, so engineers use high voltages to reduce waste.
items.zh: 長距離電纜總會因熱能散失而損失一些電力，所以工程師使用高壓來減少浪費。
items.def: the gradual loss of energy, often as heat

items.s: The carbon tax has ________ effects, because poorer families spend a larger part of their income on energy.
items.zh: 碳稅有分配效應，因為較貧窮的家庭在能源上花費的收入比例較高。
items.def: related to how something is shared among people

items.s: Solar prices have followed a ________ trend for twenty years, so the technology is now cheaper than coal in many places.
items.zh: 太陽能價格二十年來呈下降趨勢，所以這項技術如今在許多地方比煤還便宜。
items.def: moving towards a lower level

items.s: The country's ________ gas supplies have pushed it to import more, so its energy bills have risen sharply.
items.zh: 這個國家日漸減少的天然氣供應迫使它進口更多，所以能源費用急劇上升。
items.def: becoming gradually smaller in amount

items.cn: 令人振奮的；激動人心的
items.s: The scientist gave an ________ speech about clean energy, and many students decided to study engineering afterwards.
items.zh: 那位科學家發表了一場關於乾淨能源激動人心的演講，之後許多學生決定念工程。
items.def: extremely exciting

items.s: The new energy plan is broad and ________, because it covers transport, housing and industry instead of just power stations.
items.zh: 新的能源計畫範圍廣且涵蓋全面，因為它涵蓋交通、住宅和工業，而不只是發電廠。
items.def: including many different things

items.s: We are not living with an ________ supply of oil, so we must start using cleaner sources soon.
items.zh: 我們並不是擁有無止境的石油供應，所以我們必須盡快開始使用更乾淨的能源。
items.def: seeming to have no end

items.s: Our ________ science teacher started a recycling club, and now students collect hundreds of cans every week.
items.zh: 我們精力充沛的自然老師創立了回收社團，現在學生每週收集數百個罐子。
items.def: having a lot of energy and enthusiasm

items.s: By my ________, our family could save about two thousand dollars a year if we used less air conditioning.
items.zh: 根據我的估計，如果我們少開冷氣，我們家一年大約能省下兩千元。
items.def: a judgement of an amount without exact measuring

items.s: Oil is an ________ resource, so countries that depend on it must plan for the day it runs out.
items.zh: 石油是可耗盡的資源，所以依賴它的國家必須為它用完的那天做準備。
items.def: able to be completely used up

items.s: The battery system is ________, so the school can add more units later when it installs more solar panels.
items.zh: 這套電池系統是可擴充的，所以學校日後加裝更多太陽能板時可以增加更多單元。
items.def: able to be made larger

items.s: Only a small part of the gas under the sea is ________, because the rest is too deep or too costly to reach.
items.zh: 海底的天然氣只有一小部分是可開採的，因為其餘的太深或成本太高而難以取得。
items.def: able to be used for profit

items.s: ________ industries like mining create jobs, but they often leave serious damage to the land and water.
items.zh: 像採礦這樣的採掘產業創造了工作，但它們常對土地和水源留下嚴重破壞。
items.def: related to taking resources out of the ground

items.s: The hospital uses diesel generators as a ________, so it can keep operating even during a long power cut.
items.zh: 醫院以柴油發電機作為備案，所以即使長時間停電也能持續運作。
items.def: a plan or option kept for when others fail

items.s: ________ oil prices make it hard for airlines to plan, so they often buy fuel months in advance.
items.zh: 波動的油價讓航空公司難以規劃，所以他們常提前數月購買燃料。
items.def: rising and falling often

items.s: Better weather ________ helps grid operators prepare, because they know when solar and wind power will be low.
items.zh: 更好的天氣預測幫助電網營運者做準備，因為他們知道太陽能和風力何時會偏低。
items.def: predicting what will happen in the future

items.s: Coal will still be used in the ________ future, but its share of electricity is expected to fall steadily.
items.zh: 在可預見的未來煤炭仍會被使用，但它在電力中的占比預計將穩定下降。
items.def: able to be predicted

items.s: The data on energy use in villages is ________, so researchers had to visit homes to collect better information.
items.zh: 村莊能源使用的資料很零碎，所以研究人員必須親自家訪以收集更好的資訊。
items.def: incomplete and in small parts

items.s: Our teacher explained the ________ of electricity first, and then we built simple circuits with batteries and bulbs.
items.zh: 老師先解釋了電的基本原理，然後我們用電池和燈泡做了簡單的電路。
items.def: the basic and most important parts of something

items.s: Energy and ________ are closely linked, because countries that control oil and gas can put pressure on their neighbours.
items.zh: 能源和地緣政治緊密相關，因為控制石油和天然氣的國家可以對鄰國施壓。
items.def: how geography affects international politics

items.s: In a ________ economy, a war far away can raise petrol prices at home, so no country is completely safe.
items.zh: 在全球化的經濟中，遠方的戰爭也能讓國內油價上漲，所以沒有國家是完全安全的。
items.def: connected across the whole world

items.s: The ________ of the energy crisis forced leaders to act quickly, but some of their decisions were not well planned.
items.zh: 能源危機的迫切性迫使領導人迅速行動，但他們有些決定並未經過周詳規劃。
items.def: the quality of being urgent and happening now

items.s: Many young people are angry about government ________ on energy, because they will live with the results the longest.
items.zh: 許多年輕人對政府在能源議題上的不作為感到憤怒，因為他們將承受後果最久。
items.def: failure to do anything

items.s: The old grid is ________ of handling so much solar power, so engineers must upgrade it soon.
items.zh: 舊電網無法處理這麼多太陽能電力，所以工程師必須盡快升級它。
items.def: not able to do something

items.s: Our village wants greater ________ from the national grid, so we are building a small solar and battery system.
items.zh: 我們村莊希望更獨立於國家電網，所以我們正在建造小型太陽能與電池系統。
items.def: freedom from control or help by others

items.s: As poorer countries ________, their energy use rises quickly, so they need affordable and clean power sources.
items.zh: 隨著較貧窮的國家工業化，它們的能源使用量迅速上升，所以需要便宜又乾淨的電力來源。
items.def: to develop industries in a country or area

items.s: Demand for electricity is quite ________, because people still need lights and fridges even when prices go up.
items.zh: 電力需求相當缺乏彈性，因為即使價格上漲，人們仍需要電燈和冰箱。
items.def: not changing much when price changes

items.s: Building a dam in the earthquake zone was judged ________, so the engineers chose a different valley instead.
items.zh: 在地震帶興建水壩被判定為不可行，所以工程師改選了另一個山谷。
items.def: not possible to do in practice

items.s: Nuclear plants are fairly ________, because they cannot quickly increase or decrease their power to match demand.
items.zh: 核電廠相當缺乏彈性，因為它們無法迅速增減發電量來配合需求。
items.def: unable to change easily

items.s: Energy ________ grew when the shipping route was blocked, so the government asked people to save electricity.
items.zh: 航道被封鎖時能源不安全感升高，所以政府呼籲民眾節約用電。
items.def: a lack of safety or certainty

items.s: An ________ of rain this spring meant the reservoirs were low, so water had to be rationed in some cities.
items.zh: 今年春天雨量不足導致水庫水位偏低，所以一些城市必須限水。
items.def: a lack of enough of something

items.s: The ________ between the two countries' grids allows them to share power, so a shortage in one can be covered by the other.
items.zh: 兩國電網之間的互聯讓它們能共享電力，所以一方短缺時可由另一方補足。
items.def: a link between two or more things

items.s: ________ electric buses can now travel 400 kilometres on one charge, so they are suitable for trips between cities.
items.zh: 長程電動巴士現在充一次電可以行駛四百公里，所以適合城市間的行程。
items.def: covering a long distance or period

items.s: Profit ________ was the company's main goal, so it ignored complaints about pollution from its factory.
items.zh: 利潤最大化是這家公司的主要目標，所以它忽視了關於工廠污染的投訴。
items.def: the act of making something as large as possible

items.s: Waste ________ is part of our school policy, so we use refillable bottles and print on both sides of paper.
items.zh: 廢棄物最小化是我們學校政策的一部分，所以我們使用可重複裝填的水壺，並且雙面列印。
items.def: the act of making something as small as possible

items.s: The ________ of the old power station cost billions, but it now produces more electricity with less pollution.
items.zh: 舊電廠的現代化耗資數十億，但它現在以更少污染產生更多電力。
items.def: the process of making something more up to date

items.s: One company used to ________ the electricity market, so customers had no choice and prices stayed high.
items.zh: 過去一家公司壟斷了電力市場，所以顧客別無選擇，價格一直居高不下。
items.def: to have complete control of something

items.s: Cheap energy acts as a ________ for economic growth, because factories can produce more goods at lower cost.
items.zh: 廉價能源是經濟成長的倍增因素，因為工廠能以較低成本生產更多商品。
items.def: something that increases the effect of something else

items.s: Some politicians want to ________ the power companies, while others believe private competition keeps prices lower.
items.zh: 有些政治人物想要把電力公司收歸國有，而其他人則相信民間競爭能讓價格更低。
items.def: to bring a private company under government control

items.s: Europe's ________ on imported gas became a problem in 2022, so many countries quickly looked for other suppliers.
items.zh: 歐洲對進口天然氣的過度依賴在2022年成了問題，所以許多國家迅速尋找其他供應商。
items.def: relying too much on one thing

items.s: The ________ from installing insulation came quickly, because our heating bills fell by almost half that winter.
items.zh: 安裝隔熱材料的回報來得很快，因為那年冬天我們的暖氣費幾乎減少了一半。
items.def: a benefit you get from something you did

items.s: Americans use much more energy ________ ________ than people in most other countries, because their homes and cars are larger.
items.zh: 美國人的人均能源使用量遠高於大多數其他國家的人，因為他們的房子和車子比較大。
items.def: for each person

items.s: The government announced a ________ plan to close coal plants, so workers will have time to train for new jobs.
items.zh: 政府宣布了分階段關閉燃煤電廠的計畫，所以工人將有時間接受新工作的訓練。
items.def: done gradually in stages

items.s: ________ must balance cheap energy and clean air, but it is not easy to satisfy both goals at once.
items.zh: 政策制定者必須在廉價能源與乾淨空氣之間取得平衡，但同時滿足兩個目標並不容易。
items.def: a person who makes government plans and rules

items.s: Many customers are ________, so they quickly switch to a cheaper electricity supplier when they see a better offer.
items.zh: 許多顧客對價格敏感，所以一看到更好的方案就會迅速換到更便宜的電力供應商。
items.def: likely to change behaviour when prices change

items.s: The country decided to ________ its water company, but many citizens were worried that prices would rise.
items.zh: 這個國家決定將水公司民營化，但許多市民擔心價格會上漲。
items.def: to sell a state-owned company to private owners

items.s: ________ of the railways was meant to improve service, but many passengers say trains have become more expensive.
items.zh: 鐵路的民營化原本是為了改善服務，但許多乘客說火車變得更貴了。
items.def: the selling of state-owned companies to private owners

items.s: The ________ cost of the new reactor has doubled, so some lawmakers want to cancel the project.
items.zh: 新反應爐的預計成本已經翻倍，所以有些立法委員想要取消這項計畫。
items.def: expected based on current information

items.s: The ________ of money from roads to public transport was popular with students, because buses became cheaper and more frequent.
items.zh: 把經費從道路重新分配到大眾運輸很受學生歡迎，因為公車變得更便宜、班次也更多。
items.def: moving resources to a different use

items.s: After the earthquake, there was a full ________ of nuclear safety, and some old plants were closed for good.
items.zh: 地震之後，核能安全被全面重新評估，一些老舊電廠永久關閉。
items.def: the act of judging something again

items.s: Most parts of a solar panel are ________, so old panels do not have to end up in landfill.
items.zh: 太陽能板大部分零件都是可回收的，所以舊面板不必最後進入掩埋場。
items.def: able to be recycled

items.s: Electric cars use ________ braking, so some energy is returned to the battery every time the driver slows down.
items.zh: 電動車使用再生煞車，所以每次駕駛減速時都會有一些能量回充到電池。
items.def: able to recover energy that would be lost

items.s: ________ of oil profits into schools and hospitals has helped Norway, so the country is rich and well prepared for the future.
items.zh: 把石油利潤再投資於學校和醫院幫助了挪威，所以這個國家富裕且為未來做好準備。
items.def: putting profits back into a business or project

items.s: The phone's battery is easily ________, so you can buy a new one instead of throwing the whole phone away.
items.zh: 這支手機的電池很容易替換，所以你可以買新電池，而不必丟掉整支手機。
items.def: able to be replaced

items.s: The ________ of underground water takes many years, so farmers should not pump more than the rain can replace.
items.zh: 地下水的補充需要很多年，所以農民抽取的量不應超過雨水能補回的量。
items.def: filling something up again

items.s: We bring ________ shopping bags to the supermarket, because plastic bags are made from oil and are hard to recycle.
items.zh: 我們帶可重複使用的購物袋去超市，因為塑膠袋是用石油製成的，而且很難回收。
items.def: able to be used again

items.s: The ________ of smart meters began last year, and now customers can check their electricity use on an app.
items.zh: 智慧電表的推出從去年開始，現在顧客可以在應用程式上查看用電量。
items.def: the introduction of a new product or service to many people

items.s: The ________ of the new battery design is uncertain, because making it in large factories may be very expensive.
items.zh: 新電池設計的可擴展性還不確定，因為在大型工廠生產它可能非常昂貴。
items.def: the ability to grow larger easily

items.s: The island values ________, so it produces its own food and electricity instead of depending on the mainland.
items.zh: 這座島重視自力更生，所以它生產自己的食物和電力，而不依賴本島。
items.def: depending on your own abilities and resources

items.s: Unlike sunlight, coal is easily ________, so power plants can keep large piles of it for months.
items.zh: 不像陽光，煤炭很容易儲存，所以電廠可以存放大量煤炭好幾個月。
items.def: able to be kept for later use

items.s: The report questioned the ________ of the country's gas supplies, because demand in winter could be much higher than expected.
items.zh: 報告質疑國家天然氣供應的充足性，因為冬季需求可能遠高於預期。
items.def: the state of being enough

items.s: Carbon permits are ________, so companies that pollute less can sell their extra permits to other firms.
items.zh: 碳排放許可是可交易的，所以污染較少的公司可以把多餘的許可賣給其他公司。
items.def: able to be bought and sold

items.s: The future of the coal mine is ________, so many young people in the town are moving to the city for work.
items.zh: 這座煤礦的未來不確定，所以鎮上許多年輕人搬到城市找工作。
items.def: not known or not sure

items.s: Years of ________ in the power grid led to frequent blackouts, so the government finally promised a large budget.
items.zh: 電網多年來投資不足導致頻繁停電，所以政府終於承諾編列大筆預算。
items.def: not spending enough money on something

items.s: Many school roofs are ________, so the city wants to cover them with solar panels to produce clean power.
items.zh: 許多學校屋頂都未被充分利用，所以市政府想在上面鋪設太陽能板來生產乾淨電力。
items.def: not used as much as it could be

items.s: Some phone plans offer ________ data, but streaming videos all day still uses a lot of energy in data centres.
items.zh: 有些手機方案提供無限流量，但整天串流影片仍會在資料中心消耗大量能源。
items.def: without any limit

items.s: ________ pumping of groundwater has caused the land to sink, so new rules now limit how much farmers can take.
items.zh: 不受限制的抽取地下水造成地層下陷，所以新規定現在限制農民可以抽取的量。
items.def: not limited by rules

items.s: Only about a third of the energy in coal becomes ________ electricity, while the rest is lost as heat.
items.zh: 煤炭中只有大約三分之一的能量變成可用的電力，其餘都以熱的形式散失。
items.def: able to be used

items.s: The report showed huge ________ of water in old pipes, so the city plans to repair leaks across every district.
items.zh: 報告顯示老舊水管有大量的水損耗，所以市政府計畫修理每個區域的漏水。
items.def: the amount of something that is wasted

items.s: The gap between rich and poor may ________ if energy prices keep rising, because poor families spend more of their income on bills.
items.zh: 如果能源價格持續上漲，貧富差距可能會擴大，因為貧窮家庭把更多收入花在帳單上。
items.def: to become or make wider

items.s: The factory needed ________ power for its new machines, so it installed solar panels on all its roofs.
items.zh: 工廠的新機器需要額外的電力，所以它在所有屋頂上都裝了太陽能板。
items.def: extra or more

items.s: The ________ of the desert makes farming difficult, but it is an excellent place for solar power because it rarely rains.
items.zh: 沙漠的乾燥讓農耕困難，但因為很少下雨，那裡是發展太陽能的絕佳地點。
items.def: the state of being very dry

items.s: Only ________ workers may enter the power station, so visitors must wear a pass and stay with a guide.
items.zh: 只有經授權的工作人員可以進入發電廠，所以訪客必須配戴通行證並跟著導覽員。
items.def: officially allowed

items.s: Some people called the village ________ because it had no electricity, but now it is a model of solar power.
items.zh: 有些人說這個村莊落後，因為它沒有電，但現在它是太陽能的典範。
items.def: not developed or modern

items.s: The power grid was on the ________ of collapse during the heatwave, so the government asked offices to turn off their lights.
items.zh: 熱浪期間電網瀕臨崩潰邊緣，所以政府要求辦公室關燈。
items.def: the point just before something bad happens

items.s: The savings from new windows are easily ________, so the salesman showed us exactly how much we would save each year.
items.zh: 新窗戶省下的錢很容易計算，所以業務員讓我們清楚看到每年能省多少。
items.def: able to be worked out with numbers

items.s: Our history project lists energy inventions ________, starting with the water wheel and ending with modern solar cells.
items.zh: 我們的歷史專題依時間順序列出能源發明，從水車開始，到現代太陽能電池結束。
items.def: in the order in which events happened

items.s: Engineers check the heat ________ of each window, because a lower number means less heat escapes from the house.
items.zh: 工程師會檢查每扇窗戶的傳熱係數，因為數字越低代表從房子散失的熱越少。
items.def: a number that measures a particular quality

items.s: The ________ of hydrogen cars has been slow, because there are very few places where drivers can refuel.
items.zh: 氫能車的商業化一直很緩慢，因為駕駛可以加氫的地方非常少。
items.def: turning an invention into a product that is sold

items.s: There are ________ demands for river water, because farmers, factories and cities all need it in the dry season.
items.zh: 河水有相互競爭的需求，因為農民、工廠和城市在乾季都需要它。
items.def: trying to get the same thing as others

items.s: Most of the world's oil is ________ in a few regions, so problems there can affect prices everywhere.
items.zh: 世界上大部分石油都集中在少數幾個地區，所以那裡出問題就會影響各地的價格。
items.def: gathered closely in one place

items.s: The bank agreed to give the loan, but only on the ________ that the factory would cut its pollution by half.
items.zh: 銀行同意提供貸款，但條件是工廠必須將污染減半。
items.def: something that must happen before something else can happen

items.s: Our school budget is ________ this year, so we cannot buy new air conditioners and must use fans instead.
items.zh: 我們學校今年的預算受限，所以我們不能買新冷氣，只好改用電風扇。
items.def: limited or restricted

items.s: Sea water is very ________, so offshore wind turbines need special paint to protect them from rust.
items.zh: 海水具有很強的腐蝕性，所以離岸風機需要特殊塗料保護以防生鏽。
items.def: able to slowly damage metal or other materials

items.s: Strong local groups act as a ________ to big energy companies, so residents' voices are heard before new projects begin.
items.zh: 強大的地方團體是大型能源公司的制衡力量，所以新計畫開始前居民的聲音會被聽見。
items.def: something that balances another force or influence

items.s: The new battery is cheaper, and ________, it can be charged in only ten minutes, so drivers will not have to wait long.
items.zh: 新電池比較便宜，而且最關鍵的是，它只要十分鐘就能充好電，所以駕駛不必等很久。
items.def: in a way that is extremely important

items.s: The company offers ________ energy plans, so each family pays for the kind of power it actually uses.
items.zh: 這家公司提供量身訂製的能源方案，所以每個家庭只為實際使用的電力付費。
items.def: made for a particular person or need

items.s: ________ of the steel industry is difficult, because making steel usually needs very high heat from coal.
items.zh: 鋼鐵業的去碳化很困難，因為煉鋼通常需要來自煤炭的極高溫。
items.def: reducing the carbon dioxide produced by an activity

items.s: The ________ of electricity production lets families sell solar power, so they become producers as well as customers.
items.zh: 電力生產的分散化讓家庭可以出售太陽能電力，所以他們既是顧客也是生產者。
items.def: moving power or control away from one centre

items.s: The country faced ________ after oil prices dropped, so shops kept cutting prices and companies earned less.
items.zh: 油價下跌後這個國家面臨通貨緊縮，所以商店不斷降價，公司的收入也減少了。
items.def: a general fall in prices in an economy

items.s: Electric cars used to ________ quickly, but now buyers trust the batteries more, so used ones keep their value better.
items.zh: 電動車過去貶值很快，但現在買家比較信任電池，所以二手車更能保值。
items.def: to lose value over time

items.s: Sudden changes in oil prices can be ________ for poor countries, because they cannot easily pay for fuel imports.
items.zh: 油價的突然變動對貧窮國家可能造成不穩定，因為它們無法輕易支付燃料進口費用。
items.def: making a situation less steady or safe

items.s: ________ of energy decisions to cities has worked well, because local leaders understand their residents' needs better.
items.zh: 將能源決策權力下放給城市成效良好，因為地方領袖更了解居民的需求。
items.def: passing power from central government to local areas

items.s: Sunlight is a ________ source of energy, so we need large areas of panels to collect enough of it.
items.zh: 陽光是分散的能源，所以我們需要大面積的太陽能板才能收集足夠的能量。
items.def: spread over a large area, not concentrated

items.s: Environmental groups complained about the ________ of the new law, because many of its strict rules were removed.
items.zh: 環保團體抱怨新法遭到削弱，因為許多嚴格規定被刪除了。
items.def: making something weaker by adding something else

items.s: The dam has a ________ ability to produce power in summer, because the river carries much less water then.
items.zh: 這座水壩夏季的發電能力減弱，因為那時河水流量少了很多。
items.def: made smaller or weaker

items.s: The ministry issued a new ________ last week, and all public buildings must now keep air conditioning above 26 degrees.
items.zh: 部會上週發布了一項新指令，所有公共建築現在必須將冷氣溫度維持在26度以上。
items.def: an official instruction

items.s: The bank had to ________ its forecast for the energy company, because the new gas field produced less than expected.
items.zh: 銀行不得不下修對這家能源公司的預測，因為新氣田的產量低於預期。
items.def: to lower the level or importance of something

items.s: Pollution from the mine travelled ________, so villages many kilometres away could no longer use the river for drinking.
items.zh: 礦場的污染流向下游，所以許多公里外的村莊再也無法飲用河水。
items.def: further along a river, towards its end

items.s: The ________ voted against the new nuclear plant, so the government had to look for other ways to produce power.
items.zh: 選民投票反對新核電廠，所以政府必須尋找其他發電方式。
items.def: all the people allowed to vote

items.s: The ________ of mines onto farmland has angered villagers, because they are losing the fields their families farmed for generations.
items.zh: 礦場對農地的侵占激怒了村民，因為他們正失去家族世代耕種的田地。
items.def: slowly taking over land or rights

items.s: The ________ of the port will allow bigger gas ships to arrive, but fishermen worry about losing their fishing areas.
items.zh: 港口的擴建將讓更大的天然氣船能夠進港，但漁民擔心失去漁場。
items.def: the act of making something bigger

items.s: Cheap coal can ________ old habits, so countries may find it harder to move to cleaner energy later.
items.zh: 廉價煤炭可能讓舊習慣根深蒂固，所以各國日後可能更難轉向更乾淨的能源。
items.def: to fix an idea or system firmly so it is hard to change

items.s: The country produces more gas than it needs, so the extra is ________ and brings in a lot of money.
items.zh: 這個國家生產的天然氣多於所需，所以多餘的部分可以出口，帶來大量收入。
items.def: suitable for selling to other countries

items.s: Air pollution is a negative ________ of coal power, because people living nearby suffer but do not get paid for it.
items.zh: 空氣污染是燃煤發電的負面外部性，因為住在附近的人受害卻沒有得到補償。
items.def: a cost or benefit that affects people outside a business

items.s: The new solar farm has a large ________, so the designers placed it on an old landfill instead of on farmland.
items.zh: 新的太陽能發電場占地很大，所以設計師把它設在舊掩埋場而不是農地上。
items.def: the amount of space or effect something has

items.s: There is ________ in the solar panel industry, so many factories are selling panels at very low prices.
items.zh: 太陽能板產業產能過剩，所以許多工廠以非常低的價格出售面板。
items.def: having more ability to produce than is needed

items.s: The ________ pipe leaked oil into the river for hours, but workers finally managed to shut off the flow.
items.zh: 破裂的管線把石油漏進河裡好幾個小時，但工人最後終於成功止漏。
items.def: broken or split

items.s: There is a ________ difference in attitudes to energy, because young people care more about climate change than their grandparents.
items.zh: 人們對能源的態度存在世代差異，因為年輕人比他們的祖父母更在乎氣候變遷。
items.def: related to different age groups

items.s: There is ________ security at the gas terminal after the warning, so every truck is checked before it enters.
items.zh: 收到警告後，天然氣接收站的安全戒備升高，所以每輛卡車進入前都要接受檢查。
items.def: made stronger or greater

items.s: Japan is highly ________ for energy, so it keeps large stores of oil in case supplies are cut.
items.zh: 日本在能源上高度依賴進口，所以它儲備大量石油以防供應中斷。
items.def: relying on goods from other countries

items.s: The ________ of foreign money into wind projects has created jobs, and local factories now make turbine parts.
items.zh: 外國資金流入風電計畫創造了就業，當地工廠現在也生產風機零件。
items.def: movement of something into a place

items.s: An ________ meeting was held to discuss shared rivers, because the dams in one country affect water in the others.
items.zh: 為了討論共享河流舉行了一場政府間會議，因為一國的水壩會影響其他國家的水源。
items.def: between or involving several governments

items.s: There will be a short ________ to the water supply tomorrow morning, so please fill some bottles tonight.
items.zh: 明天早上供水將短暫中斷，所以請今晚先裝好幾瓶水。
items.def: a break in a service or activity

items.s: The wetland is ________ for migrating birds, so scientists strongly opposed plans to build a gas terminal there.
items.zh: 這片濕地對候鳥來說是無可取代的，所以科學家強烈反對在那裡興建天然氣接收站。
items.def: too special or rare to be replaced

items.s: The mine has ________ changed the shape of the mountain, so the old hiking trail can never be restored.
items.zh: 這座礦場已經不可逆地改變了山的形狀，所以舊登山步道再也無法恢復。
items.def: in a way that cannot be changed back

items.s: Thousands of jobs are in ________ because the coal plant is closing, so the town is looking for new industries.
items.zh: 由於燃煤電廠即將關閉，數千個工作陷入危險，所以鎮上正在尋找新的產業。
items.def: danger of loss or harm

items.s: The country is ________ and has no ports, so it must send its oil through pipelines across other countries to reach the sea.
items.zh: 這個國家是內陸國，沒有港口，所以它必須透過穿越其他國家的管線把石油送到海邊。
items.def: surrounded by land, with no coast

items.s: Nuclear plants have a long ________ ________, so a plant planned today may not produce power for over ten years.
items.zh: 核電廠的前置時間很長，所以今天規劃的電廠可能要十多年後才能發電。
items.def: the time between starting something and finishing it

items.s: Methane ________ from old gas pipes is a serious problem, because this gas traps much more heat than carbon dioxide.
items.zh: 老舊天然氣管線的甲烷洩漏是嚴重問題，因為這種氣體比二氧化碳吸收更多熱。
items.def: the escape of liquid or gas through a hole

items.s: Parliament plans to ________ against selling new petrol cars after 2035, but car makers have asked for more time.
items.zh: 國會計畫立法禁止在2035年後販售新的汽油車，但汽車製造商要求更多時間。
items.def: to make laws

items.s: Solar panels have a ________ of about twenty-five years, so they continue producing power long after their cost is paid back.
items.zh: 太陽能板的壽命大約二十五年，所以在回本之後仍會持續發電很久。
items.def: the period of time something lasts

items.s: The ________ benefits of insulation are clear, but many landlords do not want to pay the cost today.
items.zh: 隔熱的長期好處很明顯，但許多房東不想現在付出成本。
items.def: relating to a long period of time

items.s: Big energy projects sometimes ________ local communities, because decisions are made in the capital without asking them.
items.zh: 大型能源計畫有時會把地方社區邊緣化，因為決策在首都做出而沒有詢問他們。
items.def: to treat a person or group as unimportant

items.s: The government placed a ________ on new coal mines, so no new projects can start for the next five years.
items.zh: 政府對新煤礦下了暫停令，所以未來五年都不能啟動新計畫。
items.def: an official stop to an activity for a time

items.s: A ________ agreement was signed to protect the river, because it flows through four different countries.
items.zh: 為了保護這條河，各國簽署了一項多邊協議，因為它流經四個不同國家。
items.def: involving three or more countries

items.s: The city aims to reach carbon ________ by 2050, so it is planting trees and switching buses to electric power.
items.zh: 這座城市目標在2050年達成碳中和，所以它正在植樹並把公車改為電動。
items.def: the state of not causing a particular effect

items.s: ________ wind farms are cheaper to build, but people living nearby sometimes complain about the noise and the view.
items.zh: 陸上風場建造成本較低，但附近居民有時會抱怨噪音和景觀。
items.def: on land rather than at sea

items.s: There was a large ________ of money from oil companies last year, because investors moved their money into clean energy.
items.zh: 去年石油公司出現大量資金流出，因為投資人把錢轉移到乾淨能源。
items.def: movement of something out of a place

items.s: The ________ of battery production to other countries saved money, but it also made the car industry less secure.
items.zh: 把電池生產外包到其他國家省下了錢，但也讓汽車產業變得較不安全。
items.def: paying another company to do work for you

items.s: The ________ ________ for rooftop solar is about seven years, so after that the family gets almost free electricity.
items.zh: 屋頂太陽能的回收期大約七年，所以之後這個家庭幾乎可以免費用電。
items.def: the time it takes for savings to repay the cost

items.s: The ________ of electric cars in Norway is very high, so most new cars sold there are now electric.
items.zh: 挪威的電動車普及率非常高，所以那裡賣出的新車現在大多是電動車。
items.def: how far something has spread into a market

items.s: The ________ of coal will take many years, because the country still depends on it for much of its electricity.
items.zh: 煤炭的逐步淘汰將需要很多年，因為這個國家仍有大量電力依賴它。
items.def: the gradual ending of something

items.s: The city started a ________ project with electric scooters, and if it succeeds, the programme will spread to every district.
items.zh: 市政府啟動了一項電動機車的先導計畫，如果成功，這個方案將推廣到每個區域。
items.def: done on a small scale as a test

items.s: Opinion on nuclear power is very ________, so it is hard for the government to make a decision everyone accepts.
items.zh: 對核能的意見非常兩極化，所以政府很難做出人人都接受的決定。
items.def: divided into two strongly opposing groups

items.s: Investors value the ________ of tidal power, because the tides follow a clear pattern every day.
items.zh: 投資人重視潮汐發電的可預測性，因為潮汐每天都遵循清楚的規律。
items.def: the quality of being expected or known in advance

items.s: The government set a ________ ________ on cooking gas, so poor families could still afford to cook during the crisis.
items.zh: 政府對烹飪用瓦斯設定了價格上限，所以貧窮家庭在危機期間仍能負擔得起煮飯。
items.def: the highest price allowed by law

items.s: ________ for lithium has started in the desert, and many people hope it will bring jobs to the poor region.
items.zh: 沙漠中已經開始探勘鋰礦，許多人希望它能為這個貧窮地區帶來工作。
items.def: searching an area for gold, oil or minerals

items.s: ________ policies made imported solar panels more expensive, so local factories sold more but customers paid higher prices.
items.zh: 保護主義政策讓進口太陽能板變貴，所以本地工廠賣得更多，但消費者付了更高的價格。
items.def: protecting local industry by limiting foreign goods

items.s: Because of the ________ ________, some people drive more after buying an efficient car, so the total fuel saved is smaller.
items.zh: 由於反彈效應，有些人買了省油車之後開得更多，所以總共省下的燃料變少了。
items.def: when saving energy leads people to use more

items.s: Land ________ after mining takes years, but the old coal site is now a park with lakes and walking paths.
items.zh: 採礦後的土地復育需要好幾年，但舊煤礦場現在已成為有湖泊和步道的公園。
items.def: making damaged land useful again

items.s: Experts say only half of the oil in the field is ________, because the rest is trapped too deep in the rock.
items.zh: 專家說這座油田只有一半的石油可開採，因為其餘的被困在岩層太深處。
items.def: able to be taken out or got back

items.s: The ________ of families from the dam area was painful, because many had lived in the valley for generations.
items.zh: 水壩區家庭的遷移令人痛苦，因為許多人世代居住在這座山谷。
items.def: moving to a new place

items.s: Soil ________ at the old factory site will cost millions, so the government is asking the company to pay.
items.zh: 舊工廠廠址的土壤整治將耗資數百萬，所以政府要求公司付費。
items.def: the process of cleaning up polluted land or water

items.s: The ________ of the gas contract took months, but in the end both countries agreed on a lower price.
items.zh: 天然氣合約的重新談判花了好幾個月，但最後兩國同意了較低的價格。
items.def: discussing an agreement again to change it

items.s: Some damage from mining is ________, so planting trees and cleaning rivers can help the land recover.
items.zh: 有些採礦造成的破壞是可逆的，所以種樹和清理河川能幫助土地復原。
items.def: able to be changed back

items.s: An economic ________ reduced factory output, so electricity demand fell for the first time in ten years.
items.zh: 經濟放緩使工廠產量減少，所以電力需求十年來首次下降。
items.def: a reduction in speed or activity

items.s: Norway put its oil money into a ________ wealth fund, so future generations will also benefit from the country's resources.
items.zh: 挪威把石油收入放進主權財富基金，所以未來世代也能從國家資源中受益。
items.def: having full control over its own affairs

items.s: The new battery factory had a positive ________ on the town, because restaurants and shops got more customers.
items.zh: 新電池工廠對小鎮產生了正面的外溢效應，因為餐廳和商店有了更多客人。
items.def: an effect that spreads beyond its original area

items.s: The strike brought the oil refinery to a ________, so petrol stations soon began to run out of fuel.
items.zh: 罷工讓煉油廠陷入停頓，所以加油站很快就開始缺油。
items.def: a situation with no movement or progress

items.s: ________ will pay for cleaning up the old mine, because the mining company went bankrupt years ago.
items.zh: 納稅人將支付清理舊礦場的費用，因為那家採礦公司多年前就破產了。
items.def: a person who pays tax

items.s: The government plans to ________ the rules on factory pollution, so companies must install cleaner equipment within three years.
items.zh: 政府計畫加強工廠污染規範，所以公司必須在三年內安裝更乾淨的設備。
items.def: to make rules stricter

items.s: A ________ energy company owns power plants in ten countries, so its decisions affect millions of customers.
items.zh: 一家跨國能源公司在十個國家擁有電廠，所以它的決策影響數百萬名顧客。
items.def: operating across several countries

items.s: Demand for air conditioning has continued ________, so power companies must keep building new capacity.
items.zh: 冷氣需求持續有增無減，所以電力公司必須不斷擴建新的發電容量。
items.def: continuing without becoming weaker

items.s: The fire at the oil depot became ________, so firefighters had to evacuate everyone living within two kilometres.
items.zh: 油庫的火勢變得無法控制，所以消防員必須疏散兩公里內的所有居民。
items.def: impossible to control

items.s: The city put its power lines ________, so typhoons no longer knock down cables and cause blackouts.
items.zh: 市政府把電線埋在地下，所以颱風不再吹倒電纜造成停電。
items.def: below the surface of the ground

items.s: Africa has huge ________ solar potential, so investors believe it could become a major producer of clean power.
items.zh: 非洲擁有巨大的未開發太陽能潛力，所以投資人相信它可能成為乾淨電力的主要生產地。
items.def: not yet used or developed

items.s: The ________ heat lasted for two weeks, so the power company asked people to avoid using washing machines in the afternoon.
items.zh: 持續不斷的高溫延續了兩週，所以電力公司要求民眾避免在下午使用洗衣機。
items.def: continuing strongly without stopping

items.s: Groundwater is being used ________ in this region, so the wells may be completely dry within twenty years.
items.zh: 這個地區的地下水正被不可持續地使用，所以水井可能在二十年內完全乾涸。
items.def: in a way that cannot continue for a long time

items.s: A new dam was built ________, so the farmers downstream now receive much less water for their crops.
items.zh: 上游蓋了一座新水壩，所以下游的農民現在得到的灌溉用水少了很多。
items.def: towards the beginning of a river

items.s: There has been an ________ trend in electricity prices, so families are looking for ways to cut their use.
items.zh: 電價呈現上升趨勢，所以家庭都在尋找減少用電的方法。
items.def: moving towards a higher level

items.s: Oil companies have a ________ ________ in keeping petrol cars on the road, so they sometimes oppose new electric car policies.
items.zh: 石油公司在讓汽油車繼續上路方面有既得利益，所以它們有時會反對新的電動車政策。
items.def: a personal reason for wanting something to happen

items.s: The ________ water shortage forced the city to reduce water pressure at night, so some tall buildings had no water.
items.zh: 日益惡化的缺水迫使市政府在夜間降低水壓，所以一些高樓沒有水。
items.def: becoming worse

items.s: Our new school bus ________ ________ electricity, so it is much quieter and the students no longer breathe in diesel smoke.
items.zh: 我們的新校車以電力為動力，所以安靜許多，學生也不再吸到柴油廢氣。
items.def: to use something as fuel or power

items.s: During the storm, engineers worked all night to ________ ________ ________ ________, and the city did not lose power.
items.zh: 暴風雨期間，工程師整夜工作以維持供電，所以城市沒有停電。
items.def: to keep the power supply or a business running

items.s: Many countries want to ________ ________ the strong winds at sea, so they are building large offshore wind farms.
items.zh: 許多國家想要利用海上的強風，所以它們正在興建大型離岸風場。
items.def: to make use of a supply of something

items.s: The old air conditioner is ________ ________ ________ our money, so we have decided to replace it with a more efficient one.
items.zh: 那台舊冷氣是我們金錢上的一大負擔，所以我們決定換一台更省電的。
items.def: something that uses up money or resources

items.s: The wells in the village began to ________ ________ during the long drought, so families had to buy water from trucks.
items.zh: 長期乾旱期間村裡的井開始乾涸，所以家家戶戶只好向水車買水。
items.def: to have no water or supply left

items.s: The minister's rude comment about protesters only ________ ________ ________ ________ ________, and even more people joined the march.
items.zh: 部長對抗議者的無禮言論只是火上加油，結果更多人加入遊行。
items.def: to make a bad situation even worse

items.s: We were ________ ________ ________ petrol in the mountains, so we drove slowly and looked anxiously for a station.
items.zh: 我們在山區時汽油快用完了，所以我們慢慢開，焦急地尋找加油站。
items.def: to have only a small amount of something left

items.s: The small company ________ ________ with its cheap solar lamp, because millions of families without electricity wanted one.
items.zh: 這家小公司以便宜的太陽能燈大獲成功，因為數百萬個沒有電的家庭都想要一盞。
items.def: to suddenly find something very valuable or successful

items.s: I spent the weekend in the mountains to ________ ________ ________, and I felt ready to study hard again on Monday.
items.zh: 我週末去山上養精蓄銳，星期一就覺得準備好再次努力讀書了。
items.def: to rest so you have energy again

items.s: Our family decided to ________ ________ ________ ________ an electric scooter, because petrol was getting too expensive.
items.zh: 我們家決定改用電動機車，因為汽油變得太貴了。
items.def: to change from one thing to another

items.s: Turning off unused lights is ________ ________, so our school started with that before installing solar panels.
items.zh: 關掉沒在用的燈是容易達成的目標，所以我們學校在安裝太陽能板前先從這件事做起。
items.def: the easiest things to do or achieve first

items.w: scrape the bottom of the barrel
items.cn: 退而求其次；別無選擇只能用最差的
items.s: The country was ________ ________ ________ ________ ________ ________ by burning dirty coal, because it had run out of cleaner fuels.
items.zh: 這個國家只能退而求其次燃燒骯髒的煤，因為它已經用光了更乾淨的燃料。
items.def: to use the worst things because nothing better is left

items.w: burn the candle at both ends
items.s: My sister has been ________ ________ ________ ________ ________ ________ before her exams, so she looks tired and often gets headaches.
items.zh: 我姊姊考試前一直蠟燭兩頭燒，所以她看起來很疲倦，常常頭痛。
items.def: to work very hard and sleep too little

items.s: The government decided to ________ ________ ________ ________ the new coal plant, because the costs were too high and many people opposed it.
items.zh: 政府決定叫停新的燃煤電廠，因為成本太高，而且許多人反對。
items.def: to stop an activity or project

items.s: After working three night shifts in a row, the nurse was ________ ________ ________, so she went straight to bed.
items.zh: 連續上了三個夜班之後，那位護理師已經筋疲力盡，所以她直接上床睡覺。
items.def: having no energy or resources left

items.s: During the typhoon our small generator was ________ ________ ________ ________ ________, because it kept the fridge and lights working.
items.zh: 颱風期間我們的小發電機非常珍貴，因為它讓冰箱和電燈持續運作。
items.def: extremely useful or valuable

items.s: Residents had to ________ ________ to pay for repairs after the flood, but neighbours also helped each other generously.
items.zh: 水災後居民必須竭盡全力支付修繕費用，但鄰居之間也慷慨地互相幫忙。
items.def: to use all your strength or money for something

items.s: Our plans for a beach holiday ________ ________ ________ ________ when petrol prices doubled, so we stayed home instead.
items.zh: 當油價翻倍時，我們去海邊度假的計畫化為泡影，所以我們改成待在家裡。
items.def: to fail or be destroyed completely

items.s: When the nuclear plant closed, gas power was used to ________ ________ ________, but it made electricity more expensive.
items.zh: 核電廠關閉時，燃氣發電被用來填補缺口，但這讓電價變得更貴。
items.def: to provide something that is missing

items.s: My brother had the air conditioner ________ ________ ________ all afternoon, so my parents were shocked when the electricity bill arrived.
items.zh: 我弟弟整個下午把冷氣開到最大，所以電費帳單寄來時我父母都嚇了一跳。
items.def: as strongly or loudly as possible
